synopsis: On the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the promulgation of racial laws in 2018, the events that led from the laws against Italian Jews to their deportation (1943-1945) are reconstructed through five stories told largely by the direct protagonists. Starting with that of a family of fascist Jews, the Ovazza family, massacred on Lake Maggiore in the autumn of 1943, passing through the story of a Jewish from the Ghetto of Rome, the legendary 'Moretto', who decided to fight against persecution and who managed to save himself by flirting with the niece of a fascist collaborator. Up to that of Franco Schonheit and his parents, all of whom survived the Nazi extermination camps. Then follows the story of a Jewish woman from Fiume, who was saved by hiding at the house of a Vatican engraver, and finally the story of a family of alleged fascist informers accused of having denounced her Jewish neighbors to the Germans. In fact, it is not only the victims, the persecuted but also the so-called persecutors who speak. They are joined by the other witnesses, that is the vast majority of Italians who did not adhere to the racial laws, but did not even oppose them.

title: Al Hayba

title: Al Malaika la tuhaliq fi al-dar albayda
synopsis: Said's pregnant wife Aicha and children live in a small village in Morocco. Said, on the other hand, has moved to Casablanca and works with Othman and Ismail in a restaurant. However, their dreams and aspirations collide with harsh reality, in a whirlwind of tragic events that suddenly disrupts their lives ...
cast: Abdessamed Miftah El Kheir, Abderrazak El Badaoui, Leila El Hayani, Rachid El Hazmir

title: Al Massir
synopsis: Cordoba, twelfth century. To meet the demands of the fundamentalist groups, Caliph Al Mansour orders that all the works of Averroes, a man of vast culture and commentator of Aristotle, be set on fire. His disciples, aided by the relatives of the great philosopher, decide to copy the manuscripts to take them safely out of Andalusia.
cast: Nour El Cherif, Laila Eloui, Mahmoud Hemeida, Safia El Emary

title: Al Midan
synopsis: The revolution in Tahir Square led to the fall of the Mubarak government but, while for the whole world everything could be considered concluded, for five revolutionaries that is only the beginning of a radical change. Between the euphoria of victory and the uncertainties and dangers of the military transition period, the five are on a journey that will change their lives and highlight how those in power are not willing to give it up easily.
cast: Khalid Abdalla, Magdy Ashour, Ahmed Hassan, Ragia Omran, Ramy Essam, Dina Abdallah, Aida El Kashef

title: Al Mosafer
synopsis: Three days in the life of a man, three crucial days of his long existence during which he forges, through an intense human experience, which is both research and escape from himself, his sensitivity and his character. First day. Autumn 1948, Port Said. Hassan is on his first day at work but the arrival of a telegram pushes him to cross the Atlantic aboard a ship where he meets the beautiful Nura. Between the two it is love at first sight that will be consumed within the same day also for the arrival of the man to whom Nura is already betrothed. Second day. Autumn 1973, Alexandria in Egypt. Hassan is in town to meet Nadia, daughter of Nura, at the bedside of her twin brother. Third day. Autumn 2001, Cairo. Hassan is in town to meet Ali, Nadia's son.
cast: Omar Sharif, Cyrine AbdelNour, Khaled El Nabawi, Amr Waked, Sherif Ramzy, Basma

title: Al Murray, The Pub Landlord - Glass of White Wine for the Lady
Al acecho

title: Al bar dello sport
synopsis: Lino, an immigrant from Puglia in Turin, has a poor job, humiliations from his family and up to his neck in debts. Then, the stroke of luck: one billion and three hundred million in the football pools! With his friend Parola, mute scullery from the bar, he begins a journey towards luck.
cast: Lino Banfi, Jerry Calà, Mara Venier, Annie Belle, Mirella Banti, Franco Barbero, Pino Ammendola, Enzo Andronico

title: Al calar della sera
synopsis: A young actress, who specializes in underwear advertising, has been receiving strange phone calls from a stranger for some time. One evening, as she prepares to leave for the weekend, a maniac attacks her and rapes her. But the girl reacts and the situation is reversed: now it is the maniac who is the woman's merchandise, who wonders if it is better to kill him or hand him over to the police. The relationship between the victim and his executioner has been investigated many times by the cinema. This honest thriller tries to mix "The Night Porter" with "Bonds!", But between Cavani and Almodóvar, the monotony of the already seen wins.
cast: Daniela Poggi, Gianluca Favilla, Paolo Lorimer, Cecilia Luci, Anna Orso, Andrea Ward

title: Al cuore si comanda
synopsis: Thirty-year-old Lorenza has not yet found the man of her life. She then decides to hire a man who is nice to her and who acts as her companion. The choice falls on Riccardo, a whimsical trumpet player always broke who, after some time, takes her to bed. Lorenza goes into crisis the day she meets Giulio, a charming dentist with whom she begins dating. The time has therefore come to fire Riccardo, but it is not an easy task.
cast: Claudia Gerini, Pierfrancesco Favino, Pierre Cosso, Sabrina Impacciatore, Giovanni Esposito

title: Al di là del bene e del male
synopsis: A woman and two men try to build a sentimental triangle in late 19th century Rome. But the joined sides soon separate in sketched straight lines: one becomes homosexual, the other goes mad, and the woman who is the real engine of the story becomes a proto-feminist virginity.
cast: Dominique Sanda, Erland Josephson, Robert Powell, Virna Lisi

title: Al di là del lago
synopsis: Luca Ferri is a listed professional specialized in veterinary medicine. Between affections and work, he decidedly chose the latter, moving to America to pursue a career by now well underway and economically rewarding. But a shocking news brings him back to his hometown on the shores of the lake: Valerio, his best friend, is dead. Luca reunites with Barbara, his previous girlfriend, who later became the wife of Valerio himself. The couple's son, Lorenzo, is obviously upset by the loss, and the only way to help him is to save Freccia, Valerio's horse, who was seriously injured in the same fire that killed his master ...
cast: Kaspar Capparoni, Gioia Spaziani, Anna Safroncik, Giovanna Ralli

title: Al di là dell'odio
synopsis: Two children are the only survivors of an Indian attack on a farm, following the bullying of the pioneers. The child is taken away and raised by the boss as a daughter. Years later, his brother will lead a punitive expedition against the same Indians. Wounded, he will be recognized and lovingly cared for by her. But the will to destroy will take no account of any affection. In years of revision of the western epic by Hollywood cinema, even our own products try to adapt and have their say on the subject. Aside from the bleak lack of ideas, the script is null and the interpretation non-existent.
cast: Jeff Cameron, Stefania Nelli, George Cavendish, Cameron Steel, Laila Shed

title: Al di là della legge
synopsis: Cudlip, a wanderer who travels the West accompanied by a black man and a strange preacher, takes possession of a bag containing the wages of the miners of Silver Canyon left momentarily unattended aboard a stagecoach. Later, by chance, Cudlip has the opportunity to meet the engineer Novak, the man in charge of transporting the sum of money of the mining company. Indeed, it will be the victim of his scam, Novak, to save his life during a violent brawl in a saloon.

title: Al di là delle nuvole

Paris: Patrizia fails to win back her husband who is cheating on her and establishes a relationship with a man abandoned by his wife. Aix-en-Provence: a young woman has a nagging suitor, but she is about to enter the convent.

title: Al di qua
synopsis: A homeless man dies on the street in his bed. About forty free friends Marciano United in the hospital where he gravitated, to make him the extreme greeting.

title: Al diavolo la celebrità
synopsis: Franco Bresci, while acting as an interpreter in an official meeting of the highest level, incurs a translation accident and is slandered out. Furious, he sends to the devil all the illustrious gentlemen for whom he is forced to work and the Devil decides to make him feel the thrill of fame.
cast: Marcel Cerdan, Ferruccio Tagliavini, Mischa Auer, Marilyn Buferd, Carlo Campanini, Leonardo Cortese, Aldo Silvani, Giuseppe Pierozzi, Cesare Polacco

title: Al final del túnel
synopsis: Joaquin is in a wheelchair. His home has seen better days but is now dark and gloomy. Stripper Berta and her daughter Betty knock on her door, responding to an ad she has placed to sublet the house. Their presence in the house brings joy back to Joaquin's life, who one night while he is repairing a computer in the cellar hears an almost imperceptible noise: a group of thieves, led by a certain Galerete, is digging a tunnel under the house to rob a bank. . From that moment, Joaquin begins to monitor the thieves, takes notes and gets all the details on the spot. He also realizes that Berta is actually Galerete's girlfriend and that she has arrived at the residence to distract him from what is going on underground. So he decides to put in place a plan to contrast the projects of the two.
cast: Leonardo Sbaraglia, Pablo Echarri, Clara Lago, Javier Godino, Federico Luppi

title: Al lupo al lupo
synopsis: Of the three brothers, Vanni (Rubini) has always been the most reliable. In fact, he is now an established pianist, unlike Gregorio (Verdone) who had started playing the violin, but today he is a dee jay. Vanni notices at a certain point that their father has disappeared. Contacted Livia (Neri), their sister, the three set off around Tuscany in search of their missing father.
cast: Carlo Verdone, Sergio Rubini, Francesca Neri, Barry Morse

title: Al límite
synopsis: A journalist, while conducting a radio show, receives a phone call from a serial killer who tells her about a murder live. What the maniac describes happens in earnest, and the police, who have long been tracking down the mysterious killer, begin to fear for the woman's safety. To his aid, an inspector with several years of experience and a psychiatrist ...
cast: Lydia Bosch, Bud Spencer, Juanjo Puigcorbe, Béatrice Dalle

title: Al massimo ribasso
synopsis: An unscrupulous forty-year-old lives by guaranteeing the assignment of auctions to the underworld. No one knows how, but he always knows the lowest offer, which pollutes the market and wrecks cooperatives and small entrepreneurs. But one day he is faced with the purely ethical question of choice.
cast: Matteo Carlomagno, Viola Sartoretto, Stefano Dell'Accio, Alberto Barbi, Luciana Littizzetto

title: Al momento giusto
synopsis: Livio Perozzi is the nice journalist of a small private broadcaster. He is convinced that he has a special "twist". The results, however, are modest until the day when an exceptional scoop is in his hands: the images of the collapse of the tower of Pisa. Hired by Tg1 with his team, he has a year to get another exclusive.
cast: Giorgio Panariello, Kasia Smutniak, Luisa Corna, Giovanni Cacioppo, Carlo Pistarino

title: Al morir la matinée
synopsis: 1993. On a damp day, wet and characterized by a pouring rain, one of the best things to do is looking for refuge in a large, old, cinema room. At Montevideo Opera Cinema, some spectators are thus rushed to attend the evening screening of a film on Frankenstein (Frankenstein Day of the Beast). But there is also a crazy psychopathic in the room, which begins to reap victims while the images of the film flow.
cast: Luciana Grasso, Ricardo Islas, Julieta Spinelli, Franco Duran, Pedro Duarte, Yuly Aramburu, Hugo Blandamuro, Daiana Carigi, Valeria Martínez Eguizabal, Lucas Fressero

title: Al mumiya
synopsis: Towards the middle of the 19th century, an Egyptologist notices the plundering of the tombs of the Pharaohs near Thebes. A mission in Luxor discovers that the members of a tribe have lived for centuries from the thefts committed by devastating ancient burials, of which only they know the location. On the death of the chieftain, his two sons refuse to continue these robberies, and one of them, for this, will be killed. Considered among the best films of Egyptian cinema and a masterpiece worldwide.
cast: Nadia Lotfi, Ahmed Mirai, Ahmed Higazi

title: Al piacere di rivederla
synopsis: Cesare Bonfigli, patriarch of a family of real estate and welfare businessmen, dies in rather obscure circumstances. Mario Aldara, a ministerial official who in his youth had been engaged to the wife of the deceased, investigates what increasingly appears to be a crime. The secrets of the corrupt Bonfigli family all come to the surface ...
cast: Miou Miou, Ugo Tognazzi, Françoise Fabian, Alberto Lionello, Paolo Bonacelli

title: Al posto suo
synopsis: Damiano and Chicco are twins. One is an unscrupulous manager and the other is a free spirit who earns his living as a rider. Their father Cesare forces them to switch roles: in order not to lose the inheritance they will have to live each other's life for a month ...
cast: Alessandro Tiberi, Aurora Ruffino, Andrea Bosca, Liz Solari, Roberto Citran, Mauro Serio

title: Al posto tuo
synopsis: Luca Molteni is a charming man, single by choice and has great success with women. Rocco Fontana is married to Claudia, has three children, a house in the countryside and is constantly on a diet. One is a whimsical architect, the other a precise surveyor. They have only one thing in common: work. Both creative directors of two ceramic and sanitary companies on the verge of a merger, they will compete for the sole position of Manager in the new company. The qualities of one seem to be lacking in the other and for this reason the company decides to make them an "indecent proposal": a real exchange of lives to try to understand (and accept) their respective habits and the inevitable secrets .
cast: Luca Argentero, Stefano Fresi, Ambra Angiolini, Grazia Schiavo, Carolina Poccioni, Marco Todisco, Giulietta Rebeggiani, Gualtiero Burzi, Pia Lanciotti, Fioretta Mari, Serena Rossi

title: Al primo soffio di vento
synopsis: On a muggy August afternoon, a group of seasonal workers mainly from Africa harvest wheat and make hay. Their movements are punctuated by the sun and the sounds of nature. Antonio observes them from the garden of the main house.
cast: Primo Gaburri, Mariella Fabbris, Ida Carnevali

title: Al tishkechi oti
synopsis: Tom, afflicted with an eating disorder and admitted to the clinic, has his menstrual cycle returned. When the doctor tells her it's a good sign because it means her condition is improving, she panics: the idea of ??regaining the lost pounds scares the hell out of her. It would seem a day to forget, but the meeting with Neil, a trombone player with some socialization problems, changes everything: a very strong understanding is born between the two, cemented by the common desire to escape everything that is considered socially acceptable.
cast: Moon Shavit, Nitai Gvirtz, Carmel Bato

title: Al tropico del cancro
synopsis: Fred Wright (Gabriele Tinti) and his wife Grace (Anita Strindberg) arrive in Haiti to find Dr. Williams (Anthony Steffen) who has discovered a new hallucinogen. Many businessmen and others are interested in its formula, willing to do anything to get hold of it. Meanwhile, the doctor's two assistants mysteriously disappear.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Anita Strindberg, Gabriele Tinti, Umberto Raho, Stelio Candelli, Gordon Felio, Kathryn Witt, Richard Osborne, Alfio Nicolosi, Bob Lemoine

title: Al'tovaya sonata: Dmitrij Shostakovic
synopsis: Begun by Aranovic, this biography of the illustrious composer from St. Petersburg (1906-1975) has taken on its definitive appearance thanks to the archive materials selected by Sokurov, which focus on the dramatic contrasts between Shostakovic and the omnipresent, inflexible apparatus censorship of the Stalinist regime.

title: Al-Hob wa Al-Sariqa wa Mashakel Ukhra
synopsis: A Palestinian car thief faces the most difficult time of his life when he steals the wrong car. What he believed to be an Israeli car and an easy way to make money in his poor refugee camp will turn out to be his worst misfortune with the kidnapped Israeli soldier locked in the trunk.

title: Al-mohager

When a North Korean MIG threatens them, the group engages in a fierce fight in which one of the comrades dies and another disappears. Cheol-hui and Tae-hun decide to join forces to save their missing friend and prevent a catastrophic war.

title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
synopsis: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire’s son.

title: Aladdin
synopsis: A little street thief, Aladdin, madly in love with Princess Jasmine, finds a lamp that he discovers to be magical. It holds captive a genius whose destiny is to grant three wishes to the owner of the lamp. The road seems clear but the lamp is stolen by the evil Jafar. It will be necessary the intervention of the genius who will receive freedom as a reward.

title: Aladdin
synopsis: Aladdin is an unfortunate but adorable street boy, in love with the beautiful Princess Jasmine, the daughter of the Sultan of Agrabah. In order to realize his dream he will be able to count on the support of the Genie, a magical creature with the power to grant three wishes for anyone who comes into possession of his magic lamp, but he will also have to defeat Jafar, the evil sorcerer who aims for power over the kingdom of Agrabah.

title: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
synopsis: Aladdin is finally about to marry Princess Jasmine: despite the presence and encouragement of his friends Genio, Tappeto and Abu, he is worried and anxious. What haunts him most is his future role as a father, since he has never known his own. But when the Forty Thieves jeopardize their upcoming nuptials by attempting to steal a magical talisman that turns everything into gold, Aladdin finds himself embroiled in a dangerous adventure to foil their plan that will also lead him on the trail of his long-lost father.

title: Aladin et la lampe merveilleuse
synopsis: From his laboratory hidden in the eye of the Sphinx, the wizard of Africa plots to recapture the magic lamp that grants absolute power to its owner. The genius of darkness informs him that the lamp is hidden in a distant country and that only the innocent hand of a child can get hold of it. With the help of his magic carpet, the magician travels to a city full of minarets and beautiful gardens over which a sultan reigns. Here, he meets Aladdin, a poor boy who lives alone with his mother. Introducing himself as his uncle, the magician tricked Aladdin into helping him in his search for the magic lamp.

title: Alakada Reloaded
synopsis: To cope with her feelings of inferiority, a woman from an impoverished family tells tall tales of her wealth and influence to upgrade her social status.
cast: Kehinde Bankole, Lilian Esoro, Bolaji Amusan, Toyin Abraham, Gabriel Afolayan, Bidemi Kosoko, Wumi Toriola, Tayo Amokade, Helen Paul, Liz DaSilva

title: Alamar
synopsis: A young father of Maya origin and his son, half Italian, embark on an ancestral journey on the open sea. Banco Chinchorro is their destination, an area north of Cancun that is part of the second largest coral reef on the planet.With the help of Matraca, an old fisherman who knows the area, the daily activity unfolds in its depths revealing harmonies forget between man and nature, between father and son.
cast: Jorge Machado, Natan Machado Palombini, Nestór Marín, Roberta Palombini

title: Alambrado

The threat to their universe comes in the form of a survey engineer for the planned construction of an airport. The three react with different strategies of resistance or escape, physical and mental.

synopsis: A Vietnamese community has settled in the small Texan port of Alamo Bay, frowned upon by local fishermen already harassed by the crisis. In this context of racial tension Glory hires Dinh, one of the young immigrants, triggering the violent reaction of her man. The clash will end tragically.

title: Alan Davies: Live at the Lyric
Alan Saldaña: Locked Up
synopsis: Mexican comedian Alan Saldaña is back, poking gentle fun at himself and parceling advice, especially about how to stay married and how to be parents.

title: Alan Saldaña: Mi vida de pobre
synopsis: Mexican comic Alan Saldaña has fun with everything from the pressure of sitting in an exit row to maxing out his credit card in this stand-up special.
cast: Alan Saldaña

title: Alarmoty in the Land of Fire
synopsis: While vacationing at a resort, an ornery and outspoken man is held captive by a criminal organization.

title: Alaska
synopsis: After the death of his wife, Jake decides to leave Chicago and travel with his two teenage children Jessie and Sean to a remote Alaskan village: he will transport supplies by plane to hard-to-reach areas. During one of these missions, his plane crashes into a mountain location and the two boys set off in search of him and come across a polar bear cub who has fallen into the trap set by a poacher who will immediately go after them. Charlton Heston returns to the screen directed by his son Fraser in an ecological tale that wisely exploits the beautiful landscapes of Alaska, British Columbia and Baffin Island. The story is conventional, the performers below average. In short, nothing new under the snow.
cast: Thora Birch, Vincent Kartheiser, Dirk Benedict, Charlton Heston

title: Alaska
synopsis: Fausto and Nadine meet for the first time in a large hotel in Paris, finding themselves fragile, alone and obsessed with an apparently unattainable idea of ??happiness. While Fausto is Italian and lives in the French city working as a waiter, Nadine is French and is characterized by a moving beauty. For the two of them, fate will have many obstacles in store, which will lead them to get lost, love each other and suffer.
cast: Elio Germano, Astrid Berges Frisbey, Valerio Binasco, Elena Radonicich, Antoine Oppenheim, Paolo Pierobon, Pino Colizzi, Marco D'Amore, Roschdy Zem

title: Alaska Is a Drag
synopsis: Tormented by bullies, an aspiring drag star working at an Alaskan cannery becomes a skilled fighter and is tapped for competition by a boxing coach.

title: Alata
synopsis: In a Tel Aviv nightclub, Palestinian student Nimr meets Israeli lawyer Roy. The attraction between the two is mutual and they soon discover they are in love. Afflicted by a homeland where he would have to give up his sexual identity, by a family unaware of his choices and by the state of Israel that repudiates him for his nationality, Nimr finds a safe haven in Roy and hopes one day to continue studying. in the United States. When his Israeli student visa is suddenly revoked, Nimr and Roy find themselves having to fight with all their might to prevent Nimr from being deported.

title: Alatriste
synopsis: 17th century: Diego Alatriste is a soldier in the service of Philip IV of Spain. Balboa, his best friend, on his deathbed entrusts him with Iñigo, his only son. When Alatriste returns to Madrid to the woman he loves - the actress María de Castro - and to his duty, he finds the empire in full decline: he will still have to keep his word and defend the young Iñigo (in love with Angelica, the daughter of the terrible Luis de Alquézar), facing new dangerous adventures ...

title: Albakiara
synopsis: Chiara is a girl of today, a high school student like many others, who signs her appearances on the network with the nickname "Albakiara", from the famous song by Vasco. However, the presence of that extra "k" is not just a concession to modernity and the language of chats. Because Chiara is not like the girl who sang Vasco. She has no interest in school, and does not dress "listlessly" but is very attentive to her look, a victim like everyone else of the culture of appearance. Chiara has a boyfriend, Nico, who is a DJ and who has a porn site where he films himself in disguise having sex with her friends, unbeknownst to Chiara. They are also joined by drugs, an easy and "carefree" high. And so when Chiara and Nico discover a hidden drug lot near the high school, they decide not to say anything and try to sell it on their own. Naturally ending up in a lot of trouble.
cast: Raz Degan, Alessandro Haber, Franco Nero, Kelly Potts, Ivano Marescotti, Dario Bandiera, Davide Rossi, Vito, Laura Gigante, Aura Rolenzetti

title: Albatross
synopsis: Emelie is a witty and intelligent young wannabe writer who hides her vulnerability with a cheeky temper and her excessive appearance. While waiting for better times, she agrees to work as a maid in a seaside hotel owned by Jonathan Fincher. In addition to running the place, Jonathan is a middle-aged writer in the midst of a crisis of inspiration, married to Joa, an actress who gave up her career to follow him, and father of Beth, a teenager who plans to move to Oxford to studying medicine. Emelie and Beth, thanks to their young age, quickly become friends but their relationship risks being compromised when Emelie herself begins a clandestine relationship with Jonathan, born from sharing the same passion for literature.

title: Albergo Luna, camera 34
synopsis: Bianca, a singing teacher in financial difficulties, robs an occasional acquaintance. The suspicious man tries to track her down but suddenly dies. Bianca is then suspected of murder by the police, but thanks to the proverbial help of a songwriter friend, she will get invaluable help to prove her innocence ...
cast: Chiaretta Gelli, Carlo Campanini, Andrea Checchi, Roberto Villa

title: Albergo Roma
synopsis: We are in 1939: due to the imminent arrival of the Duce, the orchestra of a small Tuscan town seeks harmony on the notes of Rossini's "Gazza ladra". The poisonous inhabitants, on the other hand, are something to talk about, aided by a dog who, on a dark and stormy night, picks up a decaying fetus. Whose wretched creature will it ever be?
cast: Claudio Bisio, Alessandro Benvenuti, Tchéky Karyo, Debora Caprioglio, Lucia Poli

title: Alberi che camminano
synopsis: To tell the profound bond that unites trees and people, Erri De Luca starts from the exclamation of the blind man from Bethsaida to whom Christ, after wetting his eyes with saliva, restores sight: “I see men as walking trees”. Behind the similarity lies a simple yet insidious question: can the human species be said to live up to the vision of the blind Bethsaida?
cast: Erri De Luca

title: Albert
synopsis: Albert is a smart and cheeky kid who is much feared for his pranks throughout the city. When he accidentally destroys the statue of the local hero, the famous balloon captain Leopoldus decides to go on an adventure to become a captain himself to solve the trouble he has done.

title: Albert Nobbs

Furthermore, while Satoshi Onoe prides himself on his writing skills and his sense of ethics, Motoharu Kaburagi is very different. The photographer has poor manners and takes a haphazard approach to work. The two clash as they begin their joint assignments, resentful that they have to work together. But as they try to catch the ultimate scoop, they unexpectedly begin to develop feelings for one another. title: American Moon
synopsis: July 20, 1969: the first images of the descent on lunar soil circulate on the televisions all over the earth. The two astronauts perform what Armstrong calls in words such as "a small step for man, a big step for humanity". Comrade Michael Collins is also present, who instead remains in orbit. An event deemed emblematic of technological development - especially American, in competition with the eternal rival, Russia - unconditionally accepted by the public of the time and obviously passed to history. What if instead that epochal event had been the result of a sensational staging? The first to support, black on white, that "we never went to the moon" was Bill Kaysing, author of a book of the same name that caused a sensation in the mid -seventies, then circulated, starting from 1997, also in Italy. Subsequently, analyzing above all the filmed documents and the photographic component of the mission, others have said that they were a great staging. This documentary, to be viewed without prejudices, poses non -trivial questions about the reality of the Alhunaggio, at least in the terms in which the entire mission was "shown".

title: Amici miei

Their adventures are called "gypsies" and take place near Florence. Doctor Sassaroli met the other four when they were admitted to his clinic after an accident and has since joined the group. In their sights everything and everyone (passengers on a train are slapped), but above all the retired Righi, the target of their jokes even at a funeral. Entrusted to some "masks" of Italian comedy, the film is a hilarious gallery of jokes (some have become proverbial) and jokes. Conceived by Pietro Germi, however, it was directed by Monicelli due to the untimely death of his colleague and friend. It was a great success with the public and won the David di Donatello in 1975.

title: Amici miei - Come tutto ebbe inizio

Not even the plague makes them desist from their "gypsies". Indeed that dramatic situation seems the most fertile to act free and undisturbed and follow up on their jokes ...
cast: Christian De Sica, Michele Placido, Massimo Ghini, Massimo Ceccherini, Giorgio Panariello, Pamela Villoresi, Chiara Francini, Alessandra Acciai, Alessandro Benvenuti, Barbara Enrichi

title: Amici miei atto II
synopsis: Count Mascetti, the surveyor Melandri, the surgeon Sassaroli, the innkeeper Necchi have not lost their taste for "gypsies", not even on the occasion of the funeral of their fifth partner, the journalist Perozzi. Without awe for anything or anyone (the Church, the tragic flood of the Arno in 1966), every occasion is exploited for ferocious mockery, even among themselves, brand new or recalled. Seven years after the very successful first chapter, the streak of screenwriters and directing has not run out, and the film is worth the previous one, biting, supported by a cruel humor that often turns to black. And the actors are always in great shape.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Gastone Moschin, Adolfo Celi, Renzo Montagnani

title: Amici miei atto III
synopsis: The architect Melandri, the surgeon Sassaroli and the innkeeper Necchi join Count Mascetti one by one in the luxurious gerontocomio where he is reduced to a wheelchair. But this does not mean they renounce to put in place other perfidious jokes, indeed the guests of "Villa Serena" find themselves the victims of the mocking machinations of the four friends to whom age has brought neither wisdom nor pity. The director of the film changes, after the two signed by Monicelli in 1975 and 1982, and the screenwriters resort to heavy unpleasantness, often bordering on vulgarity, if not beyond. An epilogue that, after all, it would have been more decent to spare.

synopsis: Collection of animated shorts directly inspired by the first famous film in the saga of the Wachowski brothers, Matrix. The story of the birth and rise to power of the "Machines" is described in The Second Renaissance. It is an inverted metaphor in which robots are oppressed and exploited workers and represent a minority of different people discriminated against and persecuted by the hatred of the human population, in a crescendo of social tensions destined to lead to the inevitable final war, in which human beings do not they fail to once again demonstrate a certain foolishness. In Kid's Story Neo contacts - in the same way in which he himself was contacted by Morpheus - The Kid (the boy), who will soon find himself hunted by the Agents, inside the same school he attended and forced to a frantic escape. The Kid (called simply Kid by everyone) is the pedantic young boy who welcomes Neo who has just returned to Zion in Matrix Reloaded and is the only person in the Matrix who has been able to "get out" of the matrix on his own, without the help of anyone. red pill. In Program, set in the winter landscape of a Japanese Middle Ages (which is actually a simulated environment), Zion's would-be warrior Cis is trained. She will be called to choose between love and fidelity to the cause of mankind. In World record Dan is a sprinter, world record holder. His incredible willpower, even before the power and physical strength, allow him during a competition to break for a moment that simulation which - like an inevitable fate - secretly commands the destinies of human beings. An event that Agents cannot allow. In Beyond everything suggests that we are facing a quiet city, an ordinary suburb where nothing happens. But even a perfect simulation like the Matrix has its bugs (programming errors) and this has generated a small anomalous zone in which there are rendering errors: here the physical laws are suspended, and everything seems possible. Young Yoko and some children see it as a fantastic playground. But debuggers are on the way. In A Detective Story, private detective Ash is unexpectedly hired for a mysterious assignment: to catch a dangerous hacker named Trinity (voiced by Carrie-Anne Moss herself in the original). Finally, in the episode entitled Matriculated, a robot probe from the Matrix is ??captured by a small group of rebels who have ventured to the surface. Humans will connect with it in a dreamlike simulation, attempting to teach the machine what the human condition means.

cast: Eduardo Verástegui, Tammy Blanchard, Manny Perez, Ali Landry, Angélica Aragón, Jaime Tirelli, Ramon Rodriguez, Lukas Behnken, Peter Bucossi, David Castro, Sophie Nyweide

title: Bella addormentata
synopsis: Inspired by the dramatic case of Eluana Englaro, victim of a car accident that forced her to 17 years of vegetative state and died in Udine in 2009 following the interruption of artificial nutrition by the will of her father. Marco Bellocchio reconstructs the last six days of a girl in a coma through three episodes that highlight different points of view, belonging to an actress mother (Isabelle Huppert) who gives up everything because of the desperation of seeing her daughter reduced to a vegetable, to a doctor (Pier Giorgio Bellocchio) who does everything to save a girl (Maya Sansa) from physical suicide and to Maria (Alba Rohrwacher), an ultra-Catholic activist and daughter of a PDL deputy (Toni Servillo) - in disagreement with the lines of his party for the vote on the Sacconi measure - which protests in front of the clinic where Eluana is housed. During the demonstrations of dissent, Maria comes into contact with Roberto (Michele Riondino), a secular counter protester with whom she falls in love.
cast: Toni Servillo, Alba Rohrwacher, Michele Riondino, Maya Sansa, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Isabelle Huppert, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Brenno Placido, Fabrizio Falco, Roberto Herlitzka, Francesco Roder, Fabrice Scott, Federica Fracassi

title: Bella and the Bulldogs
synopsis: The life of cheerleader Bella Dawson turns upside down when, in a twist of fate, she becomes quarterback for her middle school's football team.
cast: Brec Bassinger, Coy Stewart, Jackie Radinsky, Buddy Handleson, Lilimar, Haley Tju, Dorien Wilson, Rio Mangini, Annie Tedesco

title: Bella ciao
synopsis: Documentary on the G8 in Genoa consisting of the editing of the scenes shot by Rai and other televisions during the many events of the Summit. From the problems generated by globalization to the burning issues on security and respect for civil rights, the choice not to comment on the images that scroll on the screen is functional to the profound dramatic rendering of the events represented.

title: Bella ciao - Per la libertà
synopsis: The story of Bella Ciao, song of the Italian Resistance symbol of freedom, told through a meticulous research work carried out by the director Giulia Japanese in his birth region, mainly between Piacenza, Ferrara and Bologna.

title: Bella di giorno moglie di notte
synopsis: Found next to her dead husband with the gun still in hand, the beautiful Paola is taken to the police station, where she recalls her married life. In order to help the family economy and pay for some expensive clothes, Paola started prostituting herself ...
cast: Eva Czemerys, Nino Castelnuovo, Ennio Biasciucci, Giulio Baraghini, Enzo Liberti, Fernando Cerulli, Renato Pinciroli

title: Bella e perduta
synopsis: From the bowels of Vesuvius, Pulcinella, a foolish servant, is sent to Campania today to fulfill the last wishes of Tommaso, a simple shepherd: to rescue a young buffalo named Sarchiapone. In the Royal Palace of Carditello, a Bourbon residence abandoned to itself in the heart of the land of fires, of whose remains Tommaso took care of, Pulcinella finds the buffalo and takes it with him to the north. The two servants, man and animal, embark on a long journey in a beautiful and lost Italy, at the end of which there will not be what they hoped to find.
cast: Tommaso Cestrone, Sergio Vitolo, Gesuino Pittalis

title: Bella, ricca, lieve difetto fisico, cerca anima gemella
synopsis: Michele Fiore is a skilled swindler of rich widows: he ensnares them with captivating advertisements in the newspapers, he knows them, he robs them. Trouble begins when he discovers that one of the widowers is a werewolf, while another is suffering from a conspicuous physical defect. But the final blow will be suffered by Paola, one of his victims, who, while he is in prison, changes sex.
cast: Carlo Giuffrè, Marisa Mell, Erika Blanc, Gina Rovere, Elena Fiore, Nino Terzo, Maria Cumani Quasimodo, Renato Pinciroli, Renato Malavasi, Rita Di Lernia

title: Bellamy
synopsis: As every year, Commissioner Paul Bellamy goes on vacation to Nîmes, in the family home of his wife Françoise to spend a few days of relaxation, but things get complicated with the arrival of his stepbrother Jacques, a young and petty adventurer with a certain passion for life. alcohol, envious, after all, of the commissioner's quiet life and his stable and happy professional and family life. As if that were not enough Bellamy is contacted by a certain Nol Gentil, a runaway subject, hidden in a nearby motel, who fears of killing a man, no one knows who, no one knows why. Intrigued by the character he decides to embark on solving the riddle and to devote time and intellectual resources to save a possible murderer, all under the hostile gaze of his stepbrother who will do everything to make things even more complicated.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Clovis Cornillac, Vahina Giocante, Marie Bunel, Jacques Gamblin, Yves Verhoeven, Adrienne Pauly, Rodolphe Pauly, Marie Matheron

title: Bellas Mariposas
synopsis: On the night of August 3, in a popular district of Cagliari, 11-year-old Cate (Sara Podda) is awakened by the screams of a condominium, which accentuate the girl's desire to get away from that house, from the problems of her large family and from the tyranny of the father (Luciano Curreli). Not wanting to end up like her sister Mandarina (Silvia Coni), who got pregnant at thirteen, or like Samantha (Anna Karina Dyatlyk), an object girl in the neighborhood, Cate keeps away from certain "games" and is in love with her neighbor Gigi ( Davide Todde), whose life is in danger. As the hours go by, in fact, Cate learns that her brother Tonio (Simone Paris) that same evening wants to kill Gigi. Intending to stop him, while waiting for the appointed time to arrive, she spends the day with her inseparable friend Luna (Maya Mulas), with whom she lives various adventures at the sea and in the streets of the city. When everything seems to be written, the coga Aleni (Micaela Ramazzotti), a beautiful witch who reads into people's future, appears to change the course of events out of nowhere.
cast: Sara Podda, Maya Mulas, Davide Todde, Simone Paris (II), Luciano Curreli, Micaela Ramazzotti, Anna Karina Dyatlyk, Maria Loi, Susanna Mantega, Giulia Coni, Silvia Coni, Rosalba Piras, Carlo Molinari, Enrico Sanna, Luca Sanna, Gianluca Lai, Roberto Voce

title: Belle
synopsis: Dido Belle, half white and half black, was born at the end of the 18th century from the union between the English aristocratic admiral John Lindsay and an African slave. When her mother dies, Dido is only six years old and, against all odds, the admiral decides to take her to England and raise her in his family home in Kenwood in Hampstead. Here, she is entrusted to the care of her uncle, the Earl of Mansfield, to be educated and raised like her cousin Elizabeth, with all the privileges of a girl in whose veins runs noble blood. Once she becomes a woman, however, Dido cannot find a husband due to the color of her skin and is forced to confront the barriers of race and class.
cast: Gugu Mbatha Raw, Tom Wilkinson, Sam Reid, Emily Watson, Sarah Gadon, Penelope Wilton, Matthew Goode, Miranda Richardson, Tom Felton, James Norton, James Northcote, Lauren Julien Box

title: Belle Dormant
synopsis: The prince of Latvia, who finds solace only in playing drums, is determined to find the kingdom of Kent, where Princess Rosemunde and her court have been sleeping under a spell for a hundred years. A Unesco archaeologist will try to help him.

title: Belle Star's Daughter
synopsis: Rose tries to kill the sheriff to avenge the death of her mother, the legendary Belle Starr. But the sheriff is innocent and wins her over. An outlaw as the protagonist is not usual for the western, but the film is weak.
cast: Ruth Roman, George Montgomery, Rod Cameron

title: Belle Starr
synopsis: After the American Secession War, Belle, intrepid young girl from the South, after refusing the tight court of a northern captain, falls in love with Starr, a Confederate who continues the struggle as a bandit, and marries him. But her beloved and her brother are captured by a jealous Union captain, once rejected by the beautiful girl and who has now followed in her husband's footsteps. A little fictionalized life of the most famous outlaw in the West, with a splendid Tierney.
cast: Randolph Scott, Dana Andrews, Gene Tierney

title: Belle Toujours
synopsis: Henri Husson and Séverine Serizy meet after many years. She tries to avoid the man in every way, but Henri pests her until she can get his attention. He promises to reveal a secret that only he knows about Séverine and her husband ...
cast: Michel Piccoli, Bulle Ogier, Leonor Baldaque, Júlia Buisel, Ricardo Trêpa

title: Belle al bar
synopsis: Leo is in crisis. In crisis especially in his relationship with his wife: ten years of marriage and the usual misunderstandings. But luckily he has to leave. In the city where he is for work reasons, he realizes that he is being followed by an unknown woman and, when he is struck by a faint, she is the one who helps him. Leo wakes up in the house of the woman who shows he knows various details of her childhood. Stunned and confused, Leo finally manages to understand: the stranger is none other than his cousin Giulio who in the meantime has become a charming transex. Thus began an eventful coexistence.
cast: Alessandro Benvenuti, Eva Robin's, Assumpta Serna, Andrea Brambilla

title: Belle and Sebastian: The Adventure Continues
Belle da morire
synopsis: Eddie is an opera manager with a penchant for women. Being married doesn't hold him back that much. Nor does the suicide of Lucy, a young opera singer with whom he had previously had an affair, particularly disturbs him. The situation worsens, however, when the corpses of his ex-lovers multiply. Riccardo Sesani had already distinguished himself in Good as the bread, played by Carmen Russo. In this ugly copy of Dario Argento's Opera, he instead uses Adriana Russo, an ex-plus from Drive-In, thus demonstrating that she has a certain sense of size and little imagination in surnames.

title: Belle da morire
synopsis: Bruno, young and unscrupulous, is an entrepreneur in the world of night clubs. The way he treats the lap dancers he manages is absolutely dictatorial: he even forces them to prostitute themselves and he doesn't mind going to bed with each of them. An exasperated girl takes her own life and things begin to change - for the worse - for Bruno.

synopsis: Louise works for a photomodelle agency and, to make a career or at least round, does not hesitate to go to bed with wealthy men. When she knows she Bruce she believes she is in front of one of them, but she ignores the secret that man hides in himself.

title: Belle de jour
synopsis: A surgeon's wife indulges in her sadomasochistic inclinations. Thus began a double life: love for her husband at night; frequenting a dating house during the day.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Jean Sorel, Michel Piccoli, Geneviève Page

title: Belle du Seigneur
country: France, Luxembourg, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland, Great Britain
synopsis: Solal (Jonathan Rhys Meyers), a diplomat of poor extraction, falls madly in love with Ariane (Natalia Vodianova), a rich and spoiled aristocrat, despite her being the wife of his colleague Adrien (Ed Stoppard), a man enslaved by his desire to make a career and reach a position that redeems him in the eyes of society. At first, Solal tries to suppress his feelings but then, seeing them reciprocated, he runs away with the woman. Soon, however, with the initial passion exhausted, both will come to terms with the different idea they have of love, ethereal for Solal and much more immediate and physical for Ariane.
cast: Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Natalia Vodianova, Marianne Faithfull, Ed Stoppard, Maria Bonnevie, Janine Horsburgh, Leslie Woodhall, Jimmy De Brabant, Stefan Weinert, Gilbert Johnston

title: Belle et Sébastien
synopsis: During the Second World War near a small village in the Alps shaken by the arrival of the Germans, Belle, a large dog considered dangerous, escapes from the kennel where he was locked up. A bounty prompts hunters to chase him through the woods and snow-capped mountains but Belle finds refuge and protection in Sébastian, a seven-year-old boy who grew up without parents. Their destiny will intertwine with that of an elderly man in search of his past, a partisan in search of love, a young woman in search of an adventure and a German lieutenant in search of forgiveness.

title: Belle et Sébastien 3, le dernier chapitre
synopsis: Sebastien is now twelve years old while his beloved Belle - a magnificent specimen of Pyrenean mountain dog - has become a mother. Pierre and Angelina will get married and dream of another life somewhere else. Sebastien, however, refuses to leave César, the chalet and the mountain he loves so much. When Joseph, Belle's old master, shows up believing he is taking back what belongs to him, Sebastien will do anything to defend his world and his four-legged friend.
cast: Félix Bossuet, Tchéky Karyo, Thierry Neuvic, Margaux Chatelier, Clovis Cornillac, André Penvern, Anne Benoît, Lilou Fogli

title: Belle et Sébastien, l'aventure continue
synopsis: September 1945. The Second World War is over and little Sébastien is now ten years old. Together with the dog Belle, Sébastien awaits Angelina's return, ignoring that she was the victim of a plane crash in the middle of the transalpine forests. While everyone loses hope of finding her alive, grandfather César is convinced that Pierre, a man he knows, can help them in some way. Before saving Angelina, Belle and Sébastien will have to face many dangers, collide with a thousand trials and face a secret that will change their lives forever.
cast: Félix Bossuet, Tchéky Karyo, Margaux Chatelier, Urbain Cancelier, Thierry Neuvic, Thylane Blondeau

title: Belle et Sébastien, nouvelle génération
synopsis: Sébastien, ten years old, reluctantly spend the holidays in the mountains with his grandmother and aunt. He has to give them a hand with the sheepfold and nothing would be more boring if he didn't meet beautiful, a huge bitch mistreated by his master. In the desperate attempt to avoid the violence he suffers and protect it, Sébastien will experience the craziest summer of his life.

title: Belle fille
synopsis: Louise leaves Corsica to forget the betrayal of her husband. After a night of Follie, she finds lifeless what was the one evening lover. Andrea, the mother of the deceased, arrives on the island and exchanges Louise for his daughter -in -law. Trapped. The woman will find herself forced to play the role of the ideal daughter -in -law for a few days. Or at least, this is what he hopes, because the "new" mother -in -law has no intention of losing it.

title: Belle ma povere
synopsis: Romolo and Salvatore are two young Roman men with a great desire to have fun and little desire to work. They are engaged to each other's sister: Anna Maria and Marisa. They enroll in an evening school of radio technology, but while Romolo is studying with profit (he will come to open a small laboratory) Salvatore ends up in a round of burglars, from which, however, he comes out in time to stab his Marisa, while Romolo marries Anna Maria, and Giovanna, a former flame of theirs, her Franco.

title: Belle Époque
synopsis: In Spain in 1931, taking advantage of the disorder following the fall of the monarchy, the young Fernando deserted from the army and was welcomed by Manolo, a painter who lived alone, becoming his friend. When Manolo's four daughters come to spend a holiday in their father's house, Fernando has, with the painter's approval, amorous adventures with all of them, before marrying one. Oscar (somewhat surprisingly) as best foreign film for a film that travels through the difficult territories of the grotesque, at times with scathing derisive effectiveness but also, at times, with a more disordered and "goliardic" rather than controlled boldness.
cast: Penélope Cruz, Miriam Díaz Aroca, Jorge Sanz, Fernando Fernán Gómez

title: Belle épine
synopsis: Prudence Friedman is 17 and lost her mother a few days ago. Left to herself in the family home, she meets Marilyne, a girl she knew long ago and who has dropped out of school. The new friend introduces her to a particular environment, that of the Rungis, a clandestine racing circuit, where large-displacement cars and small rigged motorcycles dangerously face each other. Fascinated by the gang that revolves around the races - Reynald, Franck and all the others - Prudence tries to break in and earn a place among them, in an attempt to chase away the loneliness.

title: Belle's Magical World
synopsis: Film divided into three segments. "The Magic Word": A misunderstanding between Belle and the Beast is an opportunity for a lesson on forgiveness. "An unforgettable evening": a romantic walk in the snow goes up in smoke due to an accident. "The Broken Wing": Belle attempts to convince the Beast to free a singing bird.

title: Belle: Ryu to Sobakasu no Hime
synopsis: Suzu, a seventeen year old high school student, lives in a country village with his father. For years she has been almost always alone. One day, he decides to enroll in U, a virtual community that has 5 billion users on the net. Here, he has the opportunity to be no longer suzu but turns into Belle, a singer famous all over the world. Soon he also meets a mysterious creature, who will take her to the center of a journey of adventures, changes and love, useful to understand who she really is.

title: Belles on their Toes
synopsis: Widowed with twelve dependent children, Mirna Loy does not lose heart and sets up a school for managers. Enjoyable, but not exciting comedy, it is the sequel to "Twelve call him dad".
cast: Myrna Loy, Debra Paget, Jeffrey Hunter

title: Bellezze a Capri
synopsis: An ancient rivalry exists between Don Violante, parish priest of Anacapri and an old-fashioned priest, and Don Camillo who heads the community of Capri and who has modern ideas. When Gennaro, a young organist protected by Don Camillo, falls in love with Clelia, Don Violante's nephew, the sentimental affair exacerbates the disagreement between the two priests. The organist would like to get engaged officially, but meets the opposition of his uncle priest. Adelchi Bianchi, not to be confused with Giorgio, directs a comedy and sets it on the blue island, where it is easy to set anything. Unfortunately the interpreters are not up to par and the indisputable sympathy of Ave Ninchi is not enough.
cast: Nando Bruno, Ave Ninchi, Tamara Lees, Adelchi Bianchi

title: Bellezze in bicicletta
synopsis: The misadventures by train in the car and then by bicycle of two dancers traveling to Bologna where Totò's magazine company is located. The song was a great success and the film as well.

synopsis: The patients of the psychiatric clinic of Professor De Matteis are set free for three days to spend at the sea. The holiday is healthy for patients who recover immediately. It is much less so for the professor who instead goes crazy. Seaside farce of no interest.

title: Bellflower
synopsis: Wood and Aiden have been friends since childhood and together they share an obsession with the end of the world. Convinced that they can give life to an invincible duo capable of being able to subjugate the population left on the planet, they dedicate themselves body and soul to the construction of a super car, equipped with weapons of destruction and flamethrowers useful for their purpose. One evening, in a club, they accidentally meet the young Milly and Wood ends up falling in love with her, moving away from the crazy project. However, he will return to work on it when the relationship with the girl is shattered, leaving him in the throes of a growing explosion of violence generated by anger at the end of the story and the desire for revenge.
cast: Evan Glodell, Jessie Wiseman, Tyler Dawson, Rebekah Brandes, Vincent Grashaw, Zack Kraus, Keghan Hurst, Alexandra Boylan, Bradshaw Pruitt, Brian Thomas Evans

title: Belli ciao
synopsis: Starting or staying? Stay or leave? Pio and Amedeo are two inseparable friends, or at least they have been until the day of maturity, when it also triggers for them, inexorable, the fateful dilemma that grips the young people of the South: giving up everything in search of a better future or staying at home and Try to build that possible tomorrow? Pio, with the ambition of finance, decides to leave for Milan to drink, Amedeo - always passionate about medicine - chooses instead of being convinced that even in the south a future can be designed. And, even if he never took a stethoscope in his hand and found himself selling health articles, he works alongside the mayor to block the inevitable escape of young people to the North. But to relaunch the local economy, a great investment would be needed ... and it will be so, for an unpredictable joke of fate, that the two friends will find themselves years later, on opposite fronts but perhaps with a common dream. Although Pio is now Milanese by adoption and successful manager with a life at the top and Amedeo, with relentless southern pride, continues to commit himself to commit his country to offer a future to young people. Will the two friends manage to demonstrate that theirs is not a country for old people?
cast: Pio D'Antini, Amedeo Greco, Lorena Cacciatore, Rosa Diletta Rossi, Nicasio Catanese, Giorgio Colangeli

title: Belli di papà
synopsis: Vincenzo is a successful entrepreneur. A widower, suddenly left alone, has to look after three twenty-year-old children, Matteo, Chiara and Andrea, who represent a real worry for him. The boys live, in fact, a life full of ease, but without sense and above all unaware of any responsibility, with a light everyday life, far from the duties and the desire to earn a living. Vincenzo therefore tries to bring them back to reality: a staging with which he makes his children believe that the family business is failing due to fraudulent bankruptcy. They are therefore forced to make a sudden escape worthy of real fugitives. The four take refuge in an old and now battered family home in Puglia. To survive, Chiara, Matteo and Andrea will have to start doing something they have never done before: work.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Antonio Catania, Matilde Gioli, Andrea Pisani, Francesco Di Raimondo, Francesco Facchinetti, Marzo Zingaro, Niccolò Senni, Valentina Principi, Barbara Tabita, Nick Nocella, Uccio De Santis

title: Belli e brutti ridono tutti
synopsis: An adulterous husband receives a nasty surprise, an industrialist in love is blackmailed by a waiter, a betrayed wife decides to take revenge and a dishonest notary takes advantage of the rich widow of a noble.
cast: Walter Chiari, Luciano Salce, Olga Karlatos, Cochi Ponzoni

title: Bellifreschi
synopsis: Tom (Banfi) and Jerry (De Sica), chased by the US police for shooting a star, find nothing better than to blend in with women's clothes. Two girls, Barbara and Conchita, stay with them for some time, but Tom is also haunted by the "affection" of a rich and weird old man. The two cronies go through trouble, lose sight of each other and meet again only ten years later.
cast: Lino Banfi, Christian De Sica, Lionel Stander

title: Bellissima
synopsis: Maddalena Cecconi, wife of a Roman master builder, tries to get her eight-year-old daughter Maria into the world of cinema and takes her to Cinecittà for an audition. Here she meets a certain Annovazzi who, after having stolen some money from her, tries to abuse her. The girl still passes the audition, but the woman realizes that she has exploited her daughter for her own frustrations and leaves the game.

title: Bellissime
synopsis: Giovanna is an attractive 20-year-old, but in the early 2000s she was the most requested baby model in Italy, and perhaps in the world. For five years she was the testimonial of Mattel ads dedicated to Barbie. Francesca has just turned eighteen. It has been cut out of the minimum measures. A brake, but not a stop. This is why she enrolled in Miss Mascotte, the anteroom of Miss Italy. In Valentina's aspirations there is a reality show, Il Collegio, and that incredible possibility of grabbing fame with the favor of the remote control. To keep fit, Mama Cristina trains by doing pole dance: the huge pole has been mounted right in the center of her living room. She has set herself the goal of working as a dancer in the clubs of Ibiza, and she has to be perfect. Theirs is a family of four women united by the same passion: beauty.

title: Bello come un arcangelo
synopsis: Gaetano Avallone, a sales representative proud of his virility, conquers the sixteen-year-old Mariangela, daughter of the lawyer Totonno Fortis Pantaleo. In order to continue to frequent it, he pretends to be a childhood friend of his father who welcomes him willingly. His hope is that Gaetano will free him from his decrepit mother and that he will not decide to die forcing her to exhausting nights of love. Meanwhile, Gaetano is forced into a real sexual tour de force by Mariangela, by Totonno's sister and by a busty servant.

title: Bello di mamma

The father, Duke William, believes himself to be a stallion and threatens Rosaria, wife of the lawyer Ciccio. The Duchess Esmeralda, William's wife and Mimì's mother, is obsessed with the idea that the future head of the Trinacria family is powerless and, consequently, tries to make him fall in love first with Nunzia and then with the horrendous Filomena, a girl from a good family. Maddalena, sister of Mimì, widowed, would like the inheritance to pass to her son William jr.
cast: Philippe Leroy, Carmen Scarpitta, Jenny Tamburi, Carole André

title: Bello onesto emigrato Australia sposerebbe...
synopsis: Amedeo Battipaglia, no longer young Italian who emigrated to Australia, decides that the time has come to marry and, considering the Australians too emancipated for his tastes, he brings Carmela from Italy. The fact that he is not handsome, rather he suffers from epilepsy, and that she is not unharmed, indeed she is a former prostitute, does not prevent the two, after various vicissitudes, from joining a happy marriage.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Alberto Sordi, Riccardo Garrone, Angelo Infanti

title: Bells Are Ringing
synopsis: An underground betting organizer, an actor, a musician and a girl who runs an answering phone service come up with a story with a happy ending. Judy Holliday's latest film, it is a musical comedy (by Betty Comden, Adolph Green and Julie Style) and directed by the great Minnelli and you can hear it, even if it is not among the director's masterpieces.
cast: Judy Holliday, Dean Martin, Fred Clark, Jean Stapleton

title: Bells of Europe
synopsis: The bells are a symbol that unites the Christian Churches of Europe and accompany the peoples of the Old Continent in the experience of faith.

title: Belluscone - Una storia siciliana
synopsis: The political epic of Silvio Berlusconi is retraced observing one of his main strongholds, Sicily, and through the misadventures of the Palermo impresario of neo-melodic singers, organizer of street parties, Ciccio Mira and the two artists of his "stable", Erik and Vittorio Ricciardi.

title: Belly of the Beast
synopsis: Jake Hopper has just left the CIA, but is back in action when his daughter is kidnapped by a terrorist group. To bring her home he ventures to Thailand and sinks his hands into a dangerous intertwining of politics, corruption and betrayal and ... magic! In fact, his opponent hires a Thai voodoo sorcerer, while ours will be protected by a Buddhist monk master ...
cast: Steven Seagal, Max Ruddock, Byron Mann, Monica Lo, Tom Wu, Sarah Malukul Lane

title: Belmonte
synopsis: An artist muddles through a midlife crisis while trying to balance his dimming career with a yearning to be a better father.

synopsis: Kyoichi Suzuki is an average college student in his junior year. Although he's not in one of the top universities, he's satisfied with his college life studying architecture. Kyoichi left home and is finally on his own, living in a beat-up apartment in Tokyo. However, this apartment building is home to some out-of-the-ordinary residents, who are always bugging Kyoichi. His next-door neighbor hits Kyoichi up for a loan when he finds out that Kyoichi just got paid. His other next-door neighbor who works at a nightclub, always calls Kyoichi, demanding him to come pick her up because she's so drunk. Other than that, Kyoichi is satisfied with his normal life until he meets a girl one day. Kyoichi comes home from his part-time job as a night-time security guard. He returns to his room to find a girl sleeping on his bed - a girl he has never seen before. She looks a bit older than Kyoichi and is quite beautiful. Kyoichi can't believe his eyes. Kyoichi closes the door and goes outside to the entrance of the apartment, to make sure he's in the right apartment and room. There's no mistake. He returns inside, but the girl is gone. There's nobody in his room. Was it just his imagination? Was he hallucinating? Kyoichi can't understand what just happened. Later, he discovers that something is missing from his grocery bag - the Chinese noodles he was looking forward to eating are gone. This is how Kyoichi first meets Surumi Kataoka. After they meet, Surumi continues living in Kyoichi's room. She points to an apartment visible from Kyoichi's room and says that the guy living there dumped her for another girl. Surumi says that she's waiting to check out the girl she was dumped for. Kyoichi doesn't know if he ought to believe her or not. All Kyoichi knows is that while Surumi is such a charming girl, the expression on her face is sad at times. Kyoichi is not that disappointed about sharing his room with a cute girl. He starts to think that this lifestyle may go on forever, until one day, Surumi suddenly disappears-just like the day she suddenly appeared. All she leaves for Kyoichi are unanswered questions. Her eldest, stickler Tatsuya, does the job in her place while keeping younger brothers Riku, and Junpei firmly in line. The sparks are constantly flying, but that's the way it goes in this home. title: Camorra
synopsis: An evocative historical and socio-anthropological portrait of Naples, the Campania capital, and of the organized crime that afflicts it. The result of months of research among the treasures of the Rai Teche archives, the surprising period films, many of them unpublished, find a visceral link in the music and in the original songs written by Meg. It delves into the soul of an inscrutable city. In the films of the Teche Rai and in the photographs of the Riccardo Carbone Archive there is the story, which goes from the sixties to the nineties, of the development of the Camorra phenomenon: from the relationship of subordination to the mafia, which managed the smuggling of cigarettes in Campania in the post-war years through local families, until the advent of Cutolo who manages to unify his extortion power in a single large military and economic organization providing its members with an identity ideology of social and territorial redemption. The peak of Cutolo's power coincides with one of the darkest events in the history of the Republic, when the commissioner Ciro Cirillo is kidnapped by the Red Brigades and the secret services turn to Cutolo to negotiate with the terrorists for the release of the politician: the boss frees Cirillo, the state is indebted to him.
