According to the chronicles, Canepazzo committed suicide in 1986 but this thesis does not convince Marco, who through some clues found suspects that the truth is even more complex and chilling. Also helping him is David Moiraghi (Giuseppe Schisano), a young journalist who has developed a particular neurosis towards Canepazzo.
cast: Giuseppe Schisano, Gian Marco Tavani, Marco Bonetti, Franco Trevisi, Tinto Brass, Franco Nero, Myriam Catania, Daniele Miglio, Alberto Tordi, Marta Bifano, Marcella Braga, David Petrucci, Valentina Chico, Giorgia Sinicorni

title: Cani arrabbiati
synopsis: The Doctor, Scalpel and 32 are three robbers who, along with a fourth accomplice, steal the wages of employees of a small pharmaceutical company. The blow goes bad immediately, the fourth man leaves the feathers and the three escape by a whisker from the police, taking hostage first a woman, Maria, then a man who is kidnapped the car, not knowing that the car is also a sick child, who should be taken to hospital as soon as possible. The three will have to travel for a long time together with their victims in the cramped cockpit.
cast: Riccardo Cucciolla, Lea Lander, Luigi Montefiori, Aldo Caponi

title: Cani e gatti
synopsis: The hotelier Elvira (De Filippo) and the pharmacist Don Filippo (Spadaro) are opponents in the elections in a small village. An old sentimental rust makes the quarrel more bitter, but the love between his daughter and her grandson changes everything, between comedy and sentimentality. Titina De Filippo (1898-1963) had just brought Filumena Marturano (1951), written for her by her brother Eduardo, to the big screen.
cast: Titina De Filippo, Umberto Spadaro, Antonella Lualdi, Armando Francioli, Carlo Romano, Marisa Merlini, Carlo Sposito, Gianni Cavalieri

title: Caniba
synopsis: A reflection on the shocking significance of cannibalistic desire in human history and culture through the thought and experience of the Japanese Issei Sagawa (and his disturbing relationship with his brother).

title: Caniche
synopsis: Bernardo (Àngel Jové) and Eloisa (Consol Tura) are a brother and sister of the Spanish middle class who live together in a big house and who are linked to each other by a morbid affection, to the point that to mask their incestuous impulses, translate their libido on dogs, resulting in zoophilia.
cast: Àngel Jové, Consol Tura, Linda Pérez Gallardo, Miguel Avilès

title: Canimals
synopsis: Modern day urban pixies - mischievous, adventurous and inquisitive. They love to play and create innocent mayhem.

title: Canine Intervention
synopsis: No dog, no breed, no behavior is unfixable for Cali K9's Jas Leverette. Follow the Oakland dog trainer as he works with a range of canines and owners.
cast: Jas Leverette

title: Cannabis
synopsis: When a huge marijuana shipment falls prey to thieves, the aftermath touches players from all ranks of the drug trade between Morocco and Europe.
cast: Jean Michel Correia, Yasin Houicha, Pedro Casablanc, Christophe Paou, Kate Moran, Santi Pons

title: Canne mozze
synopsis: The convict Giovanni Molè (Antonio Sabàto) killed his brother, involved in a mafia feud. Upon hearing the news, Giovanni escapes and, waiting for the right moment to enact his revenge, hides in a villa, kidnapping its owners, a couple of young newlyweds.
cast: Antonio Sabato, Ritza Brown, John Richardson, Attilio Dottesio, Roberto Panico, Claudio Cuomo, Maria Renata Franco, Domenico Bua, Jean Pierre Sabagh

title: Cannibal
synopsis: A man places an ad on the internet looking for someone who wants to be eaten. After some time, someone replies saying they are willing to turn his desire into a real nightmare.
cast: Carsten Frank, Victor Brandl, Tobias Sickert, Joachim Sigl, Carina Palmer, L. Dora, Bernd Widmann, Manoush

title: Cannibal Holocaust
synopsis: A troupe of four American documentarists famous for their extreme reportage - the director Alan Yates, the screenwriter Shanda Tomaso and the two operators Jack Anders and Mark Williams - disappears in the Amazon rainforest during the filming of a film on the indigenous cannibal tribes. Harold Monroe, anthropologist of New York University, agrees to conduct a rescue mission in the hope of finding disappeared reporters. In anticipation of his arrival, the military personnel stationed in the rainforest leads an incursion against the local tribe of the Yacumo and takes a young man hostage to negotiate with the natives. Monroe arrives on the site in the seaplane and, after several days of walking in the jungle, the members of his rescue team come across a Yacumo. They organize the release of the host and in return they are brought to the village, where they discover the remains of the four Americans and the coils of the material they have shot.
cast: Francesca Ciardi, Luca Barbareschi, Robert Kermann, Lucia Costantini

title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
synopsis: A government agency hires a professor, a well-known militant of feminist movements, to track down the "piranha women" who live in the Avocado jungle. To succeed in the enterprise, however, the explorer is forced to rely on a guide, a chauvinist tomboy, with whom she immediately comes into conflict.
cast: Shannon Tweed, Bill Maher, Karen Mistral, Adrienne Barbeau

title: Cannon Busters
synopsis: Immortal renegade Philly the Kid and his transforming pink Cadillac join a relentlessly upbeat friendship droid on her quest to find a missing prince.
cast: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka, Hinaki Yano, Shiori Izawa, Junji Majima, Yosuke Akimoto, Nobuyuki Hiyama, Takaya Kuroda, Katsuhisa Houki, Taro Yamaguchi, Junko Minagawa, Tomomi Maruyama

title: Cannon Movie Tales: Sleeping Beauty
synopsis: The famous fairy tale in the "fantasy" version (with musical numbers), between queens, princes and elves.
cast: Morgan Fairchild, Tahnee Welch, Kenny Baker, David Holliday, Nicholas Clay, Sylvia Miles, Shaike Ophir, Jane Wiedlin

title: Cannon Movies Tale: Red Riding Hood
synopsis: Television remake of the famous fairy tale, shown here in the original, more elaborate version from the 1700s by the Brothers Grimm.
cast: Isabella Rossellini, Craig T. Nelson, Amelia Shankley, Rocco Sisto, Helen Glazary, Linda Kaye, Amnon Meskin, Julian Chagrin

title: Cannon for Cordoba
synopsis: Hector Cordoba, a Mexican bandit who usually raids the border towns between Mexico and the United States, is actively sought by the police of both countries. After all attempts to bring him to justice have failed, the Americans instruct Captain Red Douglas to storm the base where the outlaw is hiding. The officer gets help from three soldiers, a Mexican lieutenant and Leonora, a former lover of Cordoba. But once they arrive at their destination, the girl betrays the Americans and informs Cordoba of their intentions ...
cast: George Peppard, Giovanna Ralli, Raf Vallone, Pete Duel

title: Cannonball
synopsis: Drivers with fur on their stomachs face each other in a forbidden car race: six thousand kilometers from California to New York. Little history and chain incidents, with a slowing pace.
cast: David Carradine, Bill McKinney, Veronica Hamel

title: Cannonball Run
synopsis: The "Cannonball Run" is an illegal car race that sees some super-racers driven by rich jokers from all over the world engaged on the normal roads from New York to Los Angeles. The real opponent is therefore the traffic police. Several bizarre competitors take part in the race, including: a sheikh in a souped-up Rolls Royce; J.J. and his friend Victor with a fireball disguised as an ambulance; Roger Moore (in the part of himself) who drives a vehicle at 007 and there is no shortage of the usual Japanese, with a supercomputerized car, nor a couple of beautiful girls who drive a black Lamborghini.
cast: Burt Reynolds, Roger Moore, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., Farrah Fawcett, Dom DeLuise, Jack Elam, Adrienne Barbeau, Terry Bradshaw, Jackie Chan

title: Cannonball Run 2
synopsis: California, as we know, is the US state where everything is oversized compared to normal. Even motor racing is therefore no exception, especially if the most extravagant characters appear in large numbers among the drivers, the pit crew and the various "fauna" that gravitates around the racetracks.
cast: Burt Reynolds, Dom DeLuise, Dean Martin, Frank Sinatra, Sammy Davis Jr., Jamie Farr, Marilu Henner, Telly Savalas, Shirley MacLaine, Susan Anton, Jackie Chan, Catherine Bach

title: Canola
synopsis: High school student Hye-ji is a troubled and fearful girl who keeps a secret. One day she is reunited with her grandmother, Gye-Choon, whom she hasn't seen for 12 years and who lives working as a driver on Jeju Island.
cast: Yuh Jung Youn, Kim Go Eun, Kim Hee Won, Shin Eun Jung, Yang Ik June, Minho, Ryoo Joon Yeol, Nam Tae Boo

title: Canone inverso. Making Love
synopsis: On a night in August 1968 on the shore of the Moldava the violinist Jeno and together with Costanza retrace fragments of his existence. Jeno tells of when he was still a child and played the violin without knowing the music, consoling the pigs that went to the slaughterhouse. Jeno remembers the beautiful Sophie, a famous pianist, who years later she will conquer with her music. He then remembers the Collegium Musicum which he has the privilege of attending thanks to the scholarship and where his friendship with David was born.
cast: Hans Matheson, Melanie Thierry, Gabriel Byrne, Lee Williams, Ricky Tognazzi, Peter Vaughan, Domiziana Giordano, Nia Roberts, Andrea Prodan, Adriano Pappalardo, Rachel Shelley, Andy Luotto, Mattia Sbragia

title: Canova
synopsis: Among the artists who have created masterpieces Antonio Canova must be counted. Considered the greatest neoclassical artist, he amazed and moved with his extraordinary work. Francesco Invernizzi retraces his artistic growth, from his first experiences in Venice to the realization of his works in Rome, Paris and, finally, Venice again. Thanks to the Possagno museum, travel through the milestones that created his legend and explore the landscapes that inspired his famous marble sculptures.

title: Cansada de besar sapos
synopsis: When young designer Martha discovers that her boyfriend is cheating on her, she decides to change her life once and for all.
cast: Juan Manuel Bernal, Ana Serradilla, Ana Layevska, Mónica Huarte, Miguel Rodarte, Itatí Cantoral, Pedro Damián, Julio Bracho, José María De Tavira, Carlos De La Mota

title: Cantami 'Buongiorno tristezza'
synopsis: Giovanna, a beautiful girl, employed in a medicine factory, is engaged to Sergio, her workmate. Marco, son of the owner of the company, who fell in love with her, simulates the theft of a quantity of morphine and causes Sergio to be accused. Marco induces Giovanna to leave her boyfriend and she accepts with difficulty, convinced in this way to save the man she loves. Meanwhile Sergio, who has a passion for theater and who has been fired, accepts the writing offered him by an impresario who saw him perform at the corporate Cral. When Marco's father realizes that Giovanna is pregnant, he forces his son to marry her.
cast: Giacomo Rondinella, Arnoldo Foà, Milly Vitale

title: Cantando dietro i paraventi
synopsis: In the guise of an old captain, an actor tells the story of a famous pirate woman: the widow Ching, who in order to avenge the treasonable killing of her husband convinces her crews to refuse any other offer and to engage in boarding and looting. The widow does not fear anyone and even attacks the ships under imperial protection, so much so that the government of the Generals orders the supreme admiral Kwo-lang to eliminate the outrageous pirate ...
cast: Jun Ichikawa, Bud Spencer, Sally Ming Zeo Ni, Camillo Grassi, Makoto Kobayashi

title: Cantate con noi
synopsis: Two old "comparis" find themselves at a distance of many years. One has two children, the other two daughters. The marriage is combined, but the boys rebel against the idea. However, when the young people meet randomly, the spark clogs and so the old people are also satisfied. Typical film among those that buried neorealism under a whipped sugar.
cast: Rosario Borelli, Tina Pica, Virgilio Riento, Carlo Giuffrè, Beniamino Maggio, Isabella Abati, Guglielmo Inglese, Annamaria Regannino, Nino Imparato, Carlo Pisacane

title: Canterbury No. 2 - nuove storie d'amore del '300
synopsis: The writer Geoffrey Chaucer, accompanied by Knight Quick, finds herself in an inn together with some pilgrims heading to Canterbury. Blocked by bad weather, the guests entertain themselves by telling each other.
cast: Patrizia Adiutori, Rik Battaglia, Shirley Corrigan, Federico Boido, Giacomo De Angelis, Dada Gallotti, Franco Mazzieri, Alex Rebar, Gualtiero Rispoli, Claudio Ruffini

title: Canto, ma sottovoce...
synopsis: Commendatore Annibale Lantieri decides to move with his family from Rome to Salerno to avoid the bombings of the Second World War. Since their driver is blocked from the landing of the allies in Sicily, through an announcement they remedy Peppino, a sailor who likes to sing. Nothing will go as planned.
cast: Francesco Albanese, Mariella Lotti, Guglielmo Barnabò, Ave Ninchi, Paolo Stoppa

title: Canvas
synopsis: After a heartbreaking loss, a grandfather struggling to reclaim his passion for painting finds the inspiration to create again.

title: Canyon Passage
synopsis: Times of summary justice, towards the middle of the last century, in the West facing the Red Indians and with turbulence even among the pioneers. Robert does not know how to adapt to this climate of precariousness of the law, and is both witness and protagonist of dramatic conflicts resolved with more barbarism than civilization. Excellent actors and direction of the wrist for a film of robust construction.
cast: Dana Andrews, Patricia Roc, Hoagy Carmichael, Susan Hayward

title: Canzone proibita
synopsis: Roberto Aloisi, who is doing his military service, would like to marry the teacher Bianca with whom he has fallen madly in love. The girl, however, loves Paolo, who, among other things, is betrothed. War breaks out, we are in 1940, and Roberto and Paolo are called up and sent to the Russian front. In the course of an attack, Roberto is wounded, while Paolo's traces are lost. At the hospital the first meets Bianca who has joined the army as a Red Cross nurse and they also learn that Paolo is dead. In the meantime Roberto's old love has rekindled and Paola this time gives in to the insistence of man.
cast: Claudio Villa, Fiorella Mari, Franco Silva, Dante Maggio

title: Canzoni di ieri, canzoni di oggi, canzoni di domani
synopsis: More than a real film, an editing work that has distorted and recomposed, distorting two of Paolella's musical comedies, "Songs of half a century" and "Songs, songs, songs". A series of sketches and musical numbers interpreted by the former showmen, Sordi and Rascel, to which was added an episode with Ernesto Calindri and Adriano Celentano's clan.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Renato Rascel, Ernesto Calindri, Carlo Dapporto, Adriano Celentano, Antonella Lualdi, Lauretta Masiero, Delia Scala, Marina Vlady

title: Canzoni in... bikini
synopsis: Simone and Ulderico are at the head of two advertising agencies, the flourishing Televedo and the Telecanto always on the verge of bankruptcy. Both compete to win the production of a TV commercial. To complicate things is Salvatore, an employee of Simone who falls madly in love with Guendalina, an employee of Telecanto. But an unexpected twist shatters the engagement. Salvatore, in fact, is forced under the threat of a shotgun to marry the daughter of a mafia boss, while Guendalina will find true love.
cast: Maria Grazia Buccella, Tino Scotti, Tiberio Murgia

title: Canzoni nel mondo
synopsis: Catwalk of songs interpreted by famous stars of the Sixties of Italian and French pop music, interspersed with sketches and striptease numbers filmed at Crazy Horse and Lido in Paris. A peak of provincialism and banality.
cast: Mina, Gilbert Bécaud, Peppino Di Capri, Dean Martin, Melina Mercouri, Marpessa Dawn, Juliette Gréco, Georges Ulmer

title: Canzoni, bulli e pupe
synopsis: The young Franco, to launch a product invented by his aunts on the market, uses the help of a madman. He claims to be in correspondence with Leonardo da Vinci and delights to experiment with increasingly bizarre inventions, who attract the attention of an attacker.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, France Anglade, Gigliola Cinquetti, Alice Kessler, Ellen Kessler, Stelvio Rosi, Rossella Como, Carlo Pisacane, Carlo Delle Piane

title: Caníbal
synopsis: Carlos is one of the most prestigious tailors in Granada but, in great secrecy, he is also a cruel killer who has never felt any remorse or guilt for his victims. However, his existence changes when Nina, a girl in search of her missing twin sister, appears in her life: as much as Carlos unconsciously embodies evil, so much Nina is the symbol of pure innocence. By making him understand the true nature of his acts, Nina will awaken long-dormant feelings of love in Carlos.
cast: Antonio De La Torre, Olimpia Melinte, María Alfonsa Rosso, Joaquín Núñez, Gregory Brossard

title: Can’t Complain
synopsis: Raised by a father to fraudulently act as one person, three identical brothers end up pining for the same woman as one triplet seeks psychiatric help.
cast: Ahmed Helmy, Menna Shalaby, Khaled El Sawy, Lotfy Labib

title: Can’t Live without You
synopsis: The story of a woman's children who have to take care of their Alzheimer-sick mother but can't due to conditions.
tags: Neurological Disorder, Family Relationship, Illness, Alzheimer's Disease
cast: Kim Ho Jin, Park Eun Hye, Joo Hyun, Kim Hae Sook, Park Yoo Hwan, Park Sun Young

title: Caos calmo
synopsis: The wife of Pietro Paladini, a top executive of a television network, suddenly dies leaving him alone with his ten-year-old daughter Claudia. In order not to be overwhelmed by pain, one morning Pietro decides to stay in front of his daughter's school, after having accompanied her. And so does the next day too. And the next day again. And suddenly, that station becomes his "new office", a place from which to observe things with new eyes and around which the others - at first amazed, then participate - begin to rotate, in a strange ballet ...
cast: Nanni Moretti, Alessandro Gassmann, Isabella Ferrari, Valeria Golino, Blu Yoshimi, Silvio Orlando, Kasia Smutniak, Hippolyte Girardot, Manuela Morabito, Beatrice Bruschi, Alba Rohrwacher

title: Cap Nord
synopsis: The one night party in a ballroom in Brittany, between apparently futile conversations, improvised choreographies and dances, flirtations that intertwine and unravel to the rhythm of fleeting conquests.
cast: Muriel Amat, Elio Amazouz, Kamel Amazouz, Simon Arbez, Nolwenn Assolant, Bruno Ayme, Stéphane Batut, Chloé Benoit, Gwendal Bescond, Sébastien Buchmann

title: Capaev
synopsis: Urals, 1919. During the bloody civil war, the farmer Ciapaiev becomes aware and turns against the white troops, becoming a legend ...
cast: Boris Babochkin, Leonid Kmit, Varvara Myasnikova, Boris Blinov, Illarion Pevtsov, Stepan Shkurat, Vyacheslav Volkov, Nikolai Simonov, Boris Chirkov, Emil Gal

title: Cape Fear
synopsis: Cady, a criminal released from jail after serving an eight-year sentence, decides to make Sam Bowden pay, a prosecution witness he holds responsible for his sentence. Cady takes it out on Sam's wife and little daughter. But the lawyer will know how to take revenge by luring the former convict in the swamps of Florida, where the showdown takes place.
cast: Robert Mitchum, Gregory Peck, Polly Bergen, Martin Balsam, Jack Kruschen, Telly Savalas, Barrie Chase, Paul Comi, Edward Platt, Will Wright, Joan Staley

title: Cape Fear
synopsis: Max Cady (De Niro) got fourteen years in prison for rape. Not that Max was innocent, but it is true that Sam Bowden (Nolte), his lawyer, failed to present a document that could have lightened the sentence. Today Bowden lives in North Carolina, with his wife Leigh (Lange) and teenage daughter Danielle (Lewis). All these things Max knows because he decided to make him pay for it. But, at least at the beginning, not in an obvious way. It is enough to be seen around in the places he frequents, to sit in front of him at the cinema, to kill his dog, maybe, to put some doubts in the head of the young Danielle. Nothing for which one can be put in jail. Throughout the first half, you don't know which side to stand on. De Niro is not exactly nice, but Nolte is also not a saint's shin. Then in the second part the film plunges into an unbridled "andante con moto", with De Niro who never dies because he is incurable and ineliminable as a remorse. In between is the key scene, that of "Little Red Riding Hood", the one in which De Niro suggests to Lewis to read Henry Miller and she, in response, begins to suck his thumb. An irresistible film.
cast: Robert De Niro, Nick Nolte, Jessica Lange, Juliette Lewis, Robert Mitchum, Gregory Peck

title: Capharnaüm
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Zain rebels against the life that has been imposed on him and starts a lawsuit against his parents for giving birth to him. He is thus claiming dignity for himself and for all those who have been deprived of the most basic rights.
cast: Nadine Labaki, Zain Al Rafeea, Yordanos Shiferaw, Treasure Bankole, Kawthar Al Haddad, Fadi Youssef, Haita Izam, Alaa Chouchnieh

title: Capitaine Conan
synopsis: At the end of 1918 the French army stationed in Bulgaria tries to "make war", but the dirty dozen led by Conan thinks to win it. A "barbarian" compared to the stalking officers, a volcano that kills enemies with a knife, capable of driving ugly, dirty and evil ex-convicts, but soaked up to their necks with courage.
cast: Philippe Torreton, Samuel Le Bihan, Claude Rich

title: Capital Scandal
synopsis: This drama is set in the 1930's when Korea was under the rule of Japan. Na Yeo Kyeong was the owner of a book store and she was also a freedom fighter. Seon Woo Wan was the playboy son of a rich family and he became involved in the independence movement through a bet with his co-workers to win Na Yeo Kyeong's heart. His father paid for the education of his worker's son, Lee Soo Hyeon, and was disappointed to find him working for the Security Branch of the Japanese government. Cha Song Joo was a famous gisaeng who ran a high class brothel.
tags: Japanese Colonial Rule, Friendship, Strong Female Lead, Mother-Daughter Relationship, 1930s, Historical Fiction
cast: Kang Ji Hwan, Han Ji Min, Ryu Jin, Han Go Eun

title: Capital in the Twenty-First Century
synopsis: Based on economist Thomas Piketty's best-selling book, this documentary examines wealth accumulation and its looming social repercussions.

title: Capitali culturali d'Europa: Praga cuore agitato d'Europa
synopsis: Made for the "Cultural Capitals of Europe" series, produced by Rai, the film by Vera Chytilova, a leading exponent of the Czech "New wave" of the 1960s, is a portrait of the city through its dramatic history and, at the same time, a kaleidoscope with multiple perspectives on Prague's cultural identity. Made in the difficult period of normalization following the repression of Dubcek's "Spring".

title: Capitalism: A Love Story
synopsis: Exactly twenty years after the pioneering Roger & Me, Michael Moore's new film returns to the question examined by the director throughout his career: the disastrous effects produced by the domination of large companies on the daily lives of the inhabitants of the United States and the whole world. But this time the culprit is much bigger than General Motors, and the crime scene much larger than Flint, Michigan. Mixing humor with indignation, Moore examines the tormenting question of the price America pays for its love of capitalism.
cast: Michael Moore

title: Capitan Apache
synopsis: Charged with shedding light on the murder of Indian Commissioner Collier, Captain Apache begins the investigation to locate his killers. The commissioner's last words before he dies will take Captain Apache on the train that will take President Grant to California.
cast: Lee Van Cleef, Carroll Baker, Stuart Whitman, Elisa Montes

title: Capitan Basilico
synopsis: Captain Basilico is the first Ligurian superhero with the mission of helping others. Unfortunately, his very useful work is constantly hindered by his beautiful (and vengeful) ex-girlfriend Regina, who, after a series of spectacular blows, will even go so far as to kidnap him to permanently tarnish his reputation as a hero. Fortunately Captain Basilico will not be left alone to his fate and Dark Pesto will come into action.
cast: Massimo Bosso, Massimo Morini, Davide Ageno, Gianni Casella, Federica Saba, Maurizio Borzone, Nino Cancilla, Giorgia Wurth, Danilo Straulino

title: Capitan Basilico 2 - I Fantastici 4+4
synopsis: Captain Basilico has a new enemy, the dangerous BarMan, once his schoolmate and now a bitter rival due to jealousy: he can't stand Captain Basilico's relationship with the charming Queen. Following BarMan is a handful of pseudo-superheroes - #from Diabolik to Harry Potter, passing through the Teletubbies and the Pirates of the Caribbean - who are on the hunt for the components of a deadly weapon that, if completed, would have the power to to bend anyone to the will of those who wield it. Thus a furious battle is unleashed throughout Liguria between the perhaps of BarMan on one side and Captain Basilico and the Buio Pesto on the other, committed to preventing the criminal plan from going through.
cast: Massimo Bosso, Massimo Morini, Davide Ageno, Gianni Casella, Maurizio Borzone, Federica Saba, Massimo Ranieri, Giorgia Wurth, Nino Cancilla, Danilo Straulino, Luigi Marangoni, Giuseppe Pavia, Simone Cristicchi, Toto Cutugno

title: Capitan Corelli's Mandolin
synopsis: When Corelli, the Italian captain of the occupation troops, lands on the island of Kefalonia, he is struck by the beauty of Pelagia, an ambitious girl. Corelli and his men are struck by the charm of the island and the local girls. Soon a tender feeling was born between Corelli and Pelagia. Forced to face the violent reality of war, the officer faces the possibility of leaving Kefalonia and the woman he is in love with.
cast: Nicolas Cage, Penélope Cruz, John Hurt, Christian Bale

title: Capitan Fantasma
synopsis: We are in 1808, during the war between France and Spain. Captain Miguel de Cubanil is expelled from the Artillery Academy for killing a man in a duel. Thanks to the help of a singer he is able to embark as a sailor on the Asuncion, a ship that transports the gold of the Spanish crown. During the journey the boat meets Anita Lopez. The daughter of the governor of Havana and her housekeeper Soledad are transferred on board. Miguel will try to foil a colossal scam.
cast: Frank Latimore, Anna Maria Sandri, Paola Barbara, Tino Buazzelli

title: Capitan Nemo and the Underwater City
synopsis: From the sinking of a sailing ship, due to a furious storm, all but six passengers are saved. While they sink, they are rescued from death by the intervention of Captain Nemo who welcomes them on the submarine "Nautilus", in his underwater city. The six, including Senator Frazer, try to return to the surface. They take possession of a submersible but it explodes. The only two survivors are then picked up by a ship's crew.
cast: Robert Ryan, Chuck Connors, Luciana Paluzzi, Nanette Newman

title: Capitani
synopsis: In a Luxembourg village where everyone is keeping secrets, gruff police inspector Luc Capitani investigates the suspicious death of a 15-year-old girl.
cast: Luc Schiltz, Sophie Mousel, Claude De Demo, Joe Dennenwald, Konstantin Rommelfangen, Jules Werner, Jil Devresse, Julie Kieffer

title: Capitães de Abril
synopsis: Portugal. On the night between 24 and 25 April 1974, the radio broadcasts Grãndola, a forbidden song. This is the agreed signal for the launch of a military coup that will change the face of a country afflicted by decades of dictatorship and the fate of immense territories in Africa. At the sound of the voice of the poet José Alfonso, the troops occupy the barracks: it is the revolution of the Carnations. The recount of those 24 hours is told by taking the point of view of two captains and a girl.
cast: Maria De Medeiros, Stefano Accorsi, Joaquim De Almeida, Frédéric Pierrot

title: Capo Nord
synopsis: Four young Neapolitans arrive in Germany full of hope, but they see the dream of the coup that could fix their lives vanish. Convinced that it is impossible to retrace their steps, they choose the path of adventure and board a train bound for Norway. Here, the first goal is to make ends meet, but no one has the basis for exercising a profession and no one has ever done much for himself. They carry out a series of thefts, but after the arrest of one of the group they understand that it is time to start taking on the real responsibilities.
cast: Emanuele Valenti, Francesco Vitiello, Alberto 'Polo' Cretara, Luca Riemma

title: Capone
synopsis: America is ready to experience the most tragic apotheosis of crime. Prohibition proliferates clandestine alcohol smuggling organizations. In this context, the unstoppable rise of Alfredo Capone, who manages to defeat the competition of the Irish mafia by establishing a climate of terror that leads to the notorious Valentine's Day massacre.
cast: Ben Gazzara, John Cassavetes, Harry Guardino

title: Capone
synopsis: A ruthless businessman and smuggler who ruled Chicago with an iron fist, Al "Fonzo" Capone was the most infamous and feared gangster in American history. At the age of 47, however, dementia has taken over her mind and the harrowing memories of her violent and brutal origins mingle with her present.
cast: Tom Hardy, Linda Cardellini, Matt Damon, Kyle MacLachlan, Kathrine Narducci, Jack Lowden, Gino Cafarelli

title: Caporale di giornata
synopsis: In the sentry box of a barracks a newborn is found with a note that attributes its paternity to an unidentified military man named Felice. In that barracks, however, more than one soldier bears that name and all have good reasons to believe they are the father of the child. The suspicions fall on a soldier who is about to be arrested, but the child's mother, who in the meantime has been able to leave the hospital, goes to the barracks and recognizes the father of the child in the surly corporal of the day. The narrative pretext is weak, the realization as well, the starting point is like an old Parisian pochade.

cast: Darby Stanchfield, Alan Ruck, Larry Fessenden, Ashley Bell, Pat Healy, James Landry Hébert, Bob Bancroft, Michael Villar, Graham Skipper, Andy Greene

Soon, he finds himself making friends with neighbor Tucker Longstreet, a wealthy womanizer suspected by the FBI of being a serial killer. At first wary, Caroline learns to appreciate its charm and generosity, but the wave of violent crimes that have devastated the town is far from over.
cast: Gabrielle Anwar, Colin Egglesfield, Pancho Demmings, Andrew W. Walker, Jud Tylor, Jennifer Taylor, Drew James, Antonio D. Charity, Kym Jackson, Ed Lauter

title: Carnal Knowledge

Sandy meets Susan at a party with a girl he has a relationship with. Jonathan, betraying his friend's trust, in turn manages to have a short fling with the girl. Time passes and Sandy, a medical graduate, marries Susan, while Jonathan begins living with Bobbie. But soon the two couples enter into crisis.

synopsis: Antonio, an old playboy, leads a lively life, living with his lover and two women. However, he is forced to change his life due to a heart attack. Thus began a war between the women and relatives of Antonio for the division of inheritance.

title: Carne trémula
synopsis: Victor Plaza was born on one of the darkest days of the Franco regime, on a bus that was taking his mother, a prostitute, to the hospital. One night, he meets Elena and it is with her that he has his first sexual relationship. All he has left of that meeting is a napkin with the girl's phone number and address. When Victor goes to Elena's house, she is waiting for a dealer who, however, does not show up. Victor's arrival precipitates events ...
cast: Francesca Neri, Liberto Rabal, Javier Bardem, Angela Molina, Penélope Cruz

title: Carnera. The Walking Mountain
synopsis: The sporting and human career of a true boxing "giant": Primo Carnera, the Friulian giant who, from being a circus attraction, was projected into the world of great boxing until he won the WBA title of the greatest in 1933, at Madison Square Garden, becoming a symbol for all Italians and especially for emigrants to the USA.
cast: Andrea Iaia, Anna Valle, F. Murray Abraham, Antonio Cupo, Neculai Predica, Paolo Seganti, Kasia Smutniak, Paul Sorvino, Christopher Troxler

title: Carnival of Souls
synopsis: Mary miraculously survives a car accident. However, in addition to the friends she was traveling with, she loses her memory. He often has nervous breakdowns. She decides to go to work as an organist in a church in Salt Lake City and one day, looking in the mirror, she discovers that a zombie, invisible to the naked eye, is constantly behind her and spying on her.
cast: Candace Hilligoss, Frances Feist, Sidney Berger, Art Ellison, Stan Levitt, Tom McGinnis, Forbes Caldwell, Dan Palmquist, Bill De Jarnette, Steve Boozer

title: Carnival of Souls
synopsis: Alex was shocked by Louis Seagram's brutal rape and murder of her mother, who committed the crime disguised as a clown. Many years pass, and Alex seems to see Louis again threatening her dressed up in the same costume ...
cast: Bobbie Phillips, Shawnee Smith, Larry Miller, Paul Johansson

title: Carnosaur
cast: Diane Ladd, Raphael Sbarge, Jennifer Runyon, Ned Bellamy, Harrison Page

title: Carny
synopsis: In the nomadic world of Luna Park Frankie and Petch are a steady couple. Petch sells the rag balls and Frankie is the target. Everything is fine until Carny (Jodie Foster) arrives and the friendship between the two cracks. To complicate matters further, there is a gang that offers its "protection."
cast: Robbie Robertson, Jodie Foster, Gary Busey, Meg Foster, Kenneth McMillan, Elisha Cook Jr., Tim Thomerson, Teddy Wilson, John Lehne, Bill McKinney

title: Caro Michele
synopsis: Michele is in exile in London after getting into trouble with the student riots of '68, but it matters little because we never see him anyway. Instead, let's follow the story of his mother Adriana, recently widowed, of the various sisters and also of Mara, a girl from Varese ready to swear that the father of her son is just Michele.
cast: Mariangela Melato, Delphine Seyrig, Aurore Clément, Lou Castel, Fabio Carpi, Marcella Michelangeli, Isa Danieli, Alfonso Gatto, Eriprando Visconti

title: Caro diario
synopsis: In the first episode ("In Vespa") Nanni Moretti wanders through a summer and semi-deserted Rome, goes to the cinema, reaches the Lido di Ostia up to the place where Pasolini was killed. In the second ("Isole") we leave Lipari to arrive in Filicudi in the company of Gerardo, an unconfessed couch potato. The final episode ("Medici") instead follows the odyssey of Moretti who is diagnosed with a tumor in the lymphatic system. Of the three episodes the best is the first, all tracking shots and shots from below in the middle of the Roman palaces. But the third also works well, so dry and devoid of rhetoric, moreover on an autobiographical subject in which it would have been easy to lose the measure.
cast: Nanni Moretti, Renato Carpentieri, Antonio Neiwiller, Moni Ovadia, Jennifer Beals, Carlo Mazzacurati, Alexandre Rockwell, Marco Paolini, Claudia Della Seta, Lorenzo Alessandri, Raffaella Lebboroni

title: Caro papà
synopsis: Albino Millozza (Gassman) is a businessman with little time to devote to his family. In fact, his wife periodically and unsuccessfully tries to commit suicide. The son sympathizes with terrorists, and perhaps even more.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Stefano Madia, Andrée Lachapelle, Aurore Clément

title: Carogne si nasce
synopsis: Young prosecutor and pseudo bounty hunter against a Texan gang that expropriates land with pistol shots.
cast: Glenn Saxon, Gordon Mitchell, Renato Baldini, Philippe Hersent, Nello Pazzafini, John Bartha, Ferruccio Viotti, Mirella Pamphili

title: Carol

cast: Cate Blanchett, Rooney Mara, Sarah Paulson, Kyle Chandler, Jake Lacy, John Magaro, Cory Michael Smith, Carrie Brownstein, Kevin Crowley, Nik Pajic

title: Carolina
synopsis: Carolina Mirabeau grew up with her two sisters in the countryside, under the guidance of the eccentric and vaguely tyrannical grandmother Millcent. Everyone thinks she is destined to marry Albert, a writer who has always frequented their home and therefore she has known since she was a child. However, when he meets and starts dating the brilliant Heath, Albert becomes very jealous. For Carolina, the moment of a choice is approaching, to be made finally freeing herself from the yoke of her grandmother.
cast: Julia Stiles, Shirley MacLaine, Alessandro Nivola, Randy Quaid, Edward Atterton, Azura Skye, Mika Boorem, Jennifer Coolidge, Alan Thicke, John Capodice

title: Carolina Moon
synopsis: The murder of little Hope shocks the Progress community. The body is found thanks to the indications of her friend Tory, who says she had a vision, but the suspicions fall on her violent father and the family is removed. Eighteen years later, Tory returns to Progress to face the ghosts of the past ...
cast: Claire Forlani, Jacqueline Bisset, Oliver Hudson, Josie Davis, Jonathan Scarfe, Chad Willett, Shaun Johnston, Greg Lawson, Maureen Rooney, Kailin See

title: Caroline Chérie
synopsis: The young Caroline De Bièvres, from a noble but fallen family, gives herself to Gaston De Sallanches on 14 July 1789, the day the Bastille is taken. Throughout the long period of the Revolution, the girl will live in a succession of adventures passing from one man to another: from the elderly revolutionary with whom she agrees to marry so as not to have problems with the new political leaders, to those she runs into through vicissitudes. infinite. Then, finally, she reunites with her beloved Gaston from whom she had been separated by the tragic events in France.
cast: France Anglade, Vittorio De Sica, Bernard Blier, Charles Aznavour, Isa Miranda

title: Caroline?
synopsis: Caroline Carmichael, who everyone believed to have died for years with her mother in a car accident, suddenly shows up at the home of her father who has since remarried. Caroline's influence on her stepbrothers Winston and Heidi is frowned upon by their mother, Grace, with whom a dramatic disagreement arises over the education of the child, born with severe handicaps. A young woman who mysteriously "resurrects", bitter conflicts over an unhappy woman with serious mental and physical problems: melodramatic material treated with little measure. Beware of old glories Patricia Neal and Dorothy McGuire.
cast: Stephanie Zimbalist, Pamela Reed, George Grizzard, Patricia Neal, Dorothy McGuire

title: Carosello Carosone
synopsis: New York 1958: Renato Carosone is rehearsing the songs from the concert he will hold at Carnegie Hall, where the likes of Duke Ellington and Benny Goodman play. It is his international consecration and that of the trio he forms with the eclectic drummer Gegè Di Giacomo and with the Dutch guitarist Peter Van Wood. On the piano he recalls the important moments of his life: the birth of the songs Maruzzella, Torero, O 'Sarracino, up to the explosive Tu vuo' fa the American who made Italy dance in the 1950s. He sees himself as a young pianist "repassatore" at the service of opera singers and at the departure for Massawa as the leader of a big band, where he discovers the African rhythms, swing and jazz that rage in America. He remembers the meeting with Lita, the love of his life, a Venetian dancer and single mother, whose son Pino he will adopt. With them in Naples he finds the musical synthesis he was looking for: Neapolitan tradition and jazz rhythms and gives life to the Trio that will revolutionize our local music. The success is immediate and projects the band into an adventure that sees them as protagonists in the hottest clubs: from the Shaker in Naples to the sparkling Caprice, the heart of the Milanese jet-set. Fame is unstoppable and Carosone leaves, with a renewed musical group, for his first tour across the border, which culminates in his triumph at New York's Carnegie Hall.
cast: Eduardo Scarpetta, Ludovica Martino, Vincenzo Nemolato, Tony Laudadio, Marianna Fontana, Nicolo Pasetti, Flavio Furno, Davide Lorino, Andrea Di Maria, Leonardo Lidi, Alfonso Postiglione

title: Carosello del varietà
synopsis: A painter gives his daughter, who is about to turn eighteen, a television set. At the birthday party, the father invites Odoardo Spadaro (who plays himself), who sees a variety show with them. The show consists of excerpts from magazines, musical numbers and excerpts from films. On the small screen there are well-known artists of the variety, magazine and cinema: from Ettore Petrolini to Totò, from Josephine Baker to Wanda Osiris, from Erminio Macario to Renato Rascel, from the _Quartetto Cetra_ to Natalino Otto.
cast: Aldo Quinti, Odoardo Spadaro, Josephine Baker, Aldo Fabrizi, Gino Latilla

title: Carosello napoletano
synopsis: An evicted storyteller goes around Naples with his large family and with his piano di Barberia: it is the common thread that binds the episodes of this re-enactment in a musical key of pictures of city life through the centuries, from the time of the pirates Barbary to that of French domination, from the Spanish to the English, to the Americans.
cast: Paolo Stoppa, Sophia Loren, Giacomo Rondinella, Clelia Matania, Léonide Massine, Achille Millo, Agostino Salvietti, Maria Fiore, Tina Pica, Maria Pia Casilio, Dolores Palumbo

title: Carousel
synopsis: Bill tells the "administrator of the ether" his story (of when he was alive): of how he married Julie, of not having been a model husband, of dying on the run after a failed robbery, of never having known the child Julie was expecting. He will have 24 hours of "leave".
cast: Gordon MacRae, Shirley Jones, Cameron Mitchell, Gene Lockhart

title: Carpool
synopsis: In Seattle, a "Hammermans" confectionery shop is the subject of a robbery. Cornered by a series of clumsy misunderstandings, a certain Franklin Laszlo seizes a car carrying a man, his two children and three other terrible babies. Thus begins the chase by the police, who try by all means to stop the fugitive.
cast: Tom Arnold, Rod Steiger, David Paymer, Rhea Perlman, Kim Coates

title: Carrie
synopsis: The very shy student Carrie White is mercilessly targeted by the jokes - often quite cruel - of her classmates. Who, however, are unaware that Carrie is endowed with extraordinary telekinetic faculties, thanks to which she is able to move bodies of any size with the power of thought alone. During the prom, two rather unpleasant young people organize a particularly hateful joke against the girl: this unleashes her anger, and the episode turns into tragedy ...
cast: Angela Bettis, Patricia Clarkson, Rena Sofer, Kandyse McClure

title: Carrie
synopsis: Ultra-conservative and deeply devoted Margareth White (Julianne Moore) lives in the quiet suburb of Chamberlain, in the state of Maine, with her daughter Grace (Chloë Grace Moretz), a mild-mannered and well-mannered girl who is sheltered by her mother from the dangers of the surrounding society. Physical education teacher Miss Dejardin (Judy Greer) tries in vain to protect Grace from attacks by classmates who, led by popular Chris Hargenson (Portia Doubleday), never miss an opportunity to taunt and humiliate her. Sue Snell (Gabriella Wilde), one of Chris's friends, regrets her treatment and, to apologize, convinces her boyfriend Tommy Ross (Ansel Elgort) to accompany Grace to the school prom. During the evening, pushed beyond all limits, Carrie will take revenge for any abuse suffered by unleashing the extraordinary paranormal powers that she acquired in the transition to adolescence.
cast: Chloë Grace Moretz, Julianne Moore, Judy Greer, Alex Russell, Gabriella Wilde, Portia Doubleday, Ivana Baquero, Ansel Elgort

title: Carrie
synopsis: Carrie, a poor provincial girl (Jones), and George, a restaurant manager (Olivier), run away with the boss's money. But the police are on their trail. Wyler explores the souls of the two lovers with intelligence and pathos, transforming Dreiser's crude novel "Our Sister Carrie" into a melodrama, a vehicle for two high-class actors.
cast: Laurence Olivier, Jennifer Jones, Eddie Albert, Miriam Hopkins

title: Carrie
synopsis: An outcast teen with telekinetic ability lashes out with her deadly power when the high school "in crowd" torments her with a sick joke at the prom.
cast: Sissy Spacek, Piper Laurie, Amy Irving, William Katt, John Travolta, Nancy Allen, Betty Buckley, P.J. Soles, Priscilla Pointer, Sydney Lassick, Stefan Gierasch, Michael Talbott, Doug Cox, Harry Gold, Noelle North

title: Carried Away
synopsis: Joseph Svenden, a former farmer and now a teacher in a small Midwestern town, is cornered by his girlfriend Rosealee Henson, who is pressing for their relationship to be regularized. But one of Joseph's students, the beautiful Catherine Wheeler, tries to seduce him and does nothing to hide it ...
cast: Dennis Hopper, Amy Irving, Amy Locane, Julie Harris, Gary Busey

title: Carriers
synopsis: As a lethal virus spreads globally, four friends seek a reputed plague-free haven. But while avoiding the infected, the travelers turn on one another.
cast: Lou Taylor Pucci, Chris Pine, Piper Perabo, Emily VanCamp, Christopher Meloni, Kiernan Shipka, Ron McClary, Mark Moses

title: Carrington
synopsis: We are in 1915. The World War upsets Europe, but the world of the artists and writers of bohemian London leads the usual carefree life. Lytton Strachey, a tall, thin, bearded, evidently homosexual bachelor leaves his environment to embark on a journey to the south coast of England, where he will be the guest of Vanessa Bell, sister of Virginia Woolf. There Strachey is dazzled by a figure who seems to him a beautiful teenager, but who instead turns out to be the young and wild painter Dora Carrington. From that moment on, a deep affection will bind them. The first film directed by the screenwriter of Stephen Frears, "Carrington" has all the characteristics of English cinema: political commitment, photography, direction and perfect editing up to the affectation, textbook acting. Fortunately, the boredom made inevitable by these premises is somewhat mitigated by the humor of some scenes. Jury Prize and Best Actor Award (Pryce) in Cannes.
cast: Jonathan Pryce, Emma Thompson, Janet McTeer, Steven Waddington

title: Carry On Don't Lose Your Head
Cars

synopsis: Lightning McQueen is once again joining his old best friend Mater for a series of international adventures and a series of fantastic challenges against the fastest cars in the world.

title: Cars 3
synopsis: Lightning McQueen is used to the role of young champion. However, time passes and by now it begins to feel a bit obsolete. To compete in the increasingly technological world of auto racing, he needs help as a result. Fortunately, the Hispanic Cruz Ramirez will come to his rescue, who will train him to face his new opponents.

title: Carson City
synopsis: In 1870 the state of Nevada still does not have its own railway network, and stagecoaches are often prey to bandit attacks. Jeff Kincaid (Scott), engineer and resolute man, is commissioned to build a railway through the mountains. The work will be hindered in every way by the criminals.
cast: Randolph Scott, Lucille Norman, Raymond Massey, Richard Webb

title: Cartagine in fiamme
synopsis: As Carthage declares war on Rome, the exiled Hiram enters the city to see his woman again. Meanwhile, the Roman Fulvia is designated to be sacrificed to the god Moloch. The model of the blockbuster "De Mille" remains distant, but the film is decent.
cast: Pierre Brasseur, Daniel Gélin, Anne Heywood, Ilaria Occhini

title: Cartas boca arriba
synopsis: A mysterious criminal organization that intends to conquer the world transforms some individuals with a very rare blood type into authentic killer automatons. The crimes, which follow one another at an incessant pace, affect illustrious political figures from various countries. Interpol, given vain attempts to identify the base of the organization, decides to entrust the investigation to James Clint, an agent who has long retired. All the stereotypes of the spy, and even of the silent "serials", in a film directed with humor, and a few more lira than usual, by a master of the Z series. The demented ending discovers, in fact, the cards.
cast: Eddie Constantine, Françoise Brion, Fernando Rey, Mara Kelly

title: Cartel Land
synopsis: As in the most classic of westerns, the police forces on the border between the United States and Mexico fight the smugglers of the Mexican drug cartels. Thanks to unprecedented access to their work, the documentary investigates illegality, the breakdown of the established order and the possibility that citizens fight violence with violence.

title: Cartesius
synopsis: Another history lesson from the director of "Paisà". In 1614, René Descartes finished his mathematics studies and on those models he laid the foundations of a speculative method - both philosophical and scientific - capable of rationally justifying the presence of man in the world, through the "ontological" demonstration of existence of God.

title: Cartoni animati
synopsis: Salvatore arrives at the Villaggio Felice slum and distributes colored bottles containing potions that make dreams come true. The inhabitants seem happy when a multinational buys the land to build a shopping center and gives everyone an apartment. But a short time later, shouts and insults can be heard from the houses. Salvatore decides to leave and invites everyone to follow him.

title: Cartouche
synopsis: Cartouche is saved from certain death thanks to the intervention of the gypsy Vénus, who falls in love with him. Together they perform all sorts of feats, keeping the Paris police in check. One day, Cartouche secretly goes to a date with a woman: but it is a trap and the police arrest him. Vénus saves him once again, but he dies in the action. Full of remorse, Cartouche buries her and ...

title: Caruso - La voce dell'amore
synopsis: Naples. The young man of humble origins Enrico Caruso (Gianluca Terranova) has one big dream: to become the greatest tenor in the world. But this ambition of his is strongly hindered by his father (Patrizio Rispo).
cast: Gianluca Terranova, Vanessa Incontrada, Martina Stella, Sascha Zacharias, Yari Gugliucci, Patrizio Rispo, Fabio Fulco, Enrico Iannello, Serena Rossi, Renato Carpentieri, Ivan Castiglione

title: Caruso Pascoski
synopsis: A young Florentine psychoanalyst "gives the numbers" when his wife Giulia leaves him. She has started with a patient of her husband, a latent homosexual, and Caruso decides to become the lover of his ex-wife. Giulia's new partner is convinced by the analyst to live his own diversity serenely, but he begins to turn his attention to Caruso. Then everything works out. Since Francesco Nuti has chosen "do it yourself" for directing, the level of the films he plays has dropped a lot. Here too we laugh little and badly.

title: Caruso, zero in condotta
synopsis: Lorenzo Caruso is a widower who works as a psychoanalyst in a small provincial town. His life passes quietly between one visit and another. Then one day a police gazelle stops in front of his house. All of a sudden he discovers that his daughter Giulia is part of a baby gang. At first Lorenzo tries to justify his daughter's behavior, then he starts spying on her and wondering if it is right to do so.
cast: Francesco Nuti, Cecilia Dazzi, Giulia Serafini, Lorenzo De Angelis

title: Carve Her Name with Pride
synopsis: The young widow of an English officer is enlisted as an intelligence agent in 1940. After rendering numerous services to the country, she is killed by the Germans. Mix of genres that starts as a comedy and ends in tragedy. A solid English production, well directed and well interpreted.
cast: Virginia McKenna, Paul Scofield, Jack Warner, Denise Grey, Alain Saury, Maurice Ronet

title: Cary Grant - De l'autre côté du miror
synopsis: Cary Grant was one of the greatest actors in Hollywood. However, not everyone knows that at the age of fifty, Grant began an LSD treatment to free himself from his demons. For the first time, her story is retraced in her own words, played by actor Jonathan Pryce. The result is a portrait of a man in search of himself and the love he never had.
cast: Jonathan Pryce, Judy Balaban, Mark Glancy, Barbara Jaynes, David Thomson

title: Casa & bottega
synopsis: The engineer Mario Trezzi (Renato Pozzetto), owner of an underwear company in Laveno, is married to Teresa (Anna Galiena), who runs a nursery. They have two beautiful daughters: Susanna (Stella Egypt), soon married to Fabrizio (Massimo Poggio), and Emma (Cristina Marino); with them also lives Teresa's brother, Erminio (Nino Frassica), his brother-in-law's driver without a license. Due to the crisis and the ruthless competition from the Chinese, Mario ends up in the hands of an unscrupulous financial company and is forced to close the company.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Nino Frassica, Anna Galiena, Stella Egitto, Massimo Poggio, Cristina Marino, Marco Cocci, Desirèe Noferini, David Sef, Sarah Maestri, Giampiero Judica, Marzia Ubaldi

title: Casa Grande
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Jean grew up in the upper neighborhoods of Rio de Janeiro, in a context made up of private schools, drivers and housekeepers. As Jean, in his senior year of secondary school, tries to evade the worries of his overprotective parents, they silently face the approach of impending financial bankruptcy. Without letting Jean and her younger sister know, the father has in fact squandered all his money.
cast: Thales Cavalcanti, Marcello Novaes, Suzana Pires, Alice Melo, Bruna Amaya, Clarissa Pinheiro

title: Casa Ricordi
synopsis: The film tells the family saga of the famous Milanese music publishing house born in the Napoleonic era by a modest printer who, in exchange for a commission from the military garrison, obtained the old scores lying in the warehouse of the "Alla Scala" theater. Through the saga of Memories, the film also traces the history of Italian opera in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, from Rossini to Verdi, from Donizetti to Puccini ...
cast: Paolo Stoppa, Gabriele Ferzetti, Myriam Bru, Nadia Gray

title: Casa Vita
synopsis: Early Lindstrom, a young farmer from Iowa, is chosen to take part in training for a baseball team in Los Angeles. As soon as he is in town, he goes to the Mexican restaurant owned by teammate Beto's family and here he is particularly impressed by chef Ariana. To get closer to her, he manages to get hired as an assistant cook. Gradually, they will discover that they have a lot in common.
cast: Jean Luc Bilodeau, Lindsey Morgan, Esai Morales, Hector Bucio, Patrick Fabian, Sherilyn Fenn, Joe Lando, Casey Bond, Michelle DeFraites, Percy Daggs III, Kelsey Crane, Leith M. Burke

title: Casa d'appuntamento

Unjustly convicted, Antoine manages to escape but dies in a motorcycle accident following a police chase. When those who were present at the rendezvous house on the night of the crime begin to be murdered one after the other, everyone is convinced that Antoine has returned from the underworld to obtain justice.
cast: Anita Ekberg, Rosalba Neri, Evelyne Kraft, Howard Vernon, Pietro Martellanza, Barbara Bouchet, Robert Sacchi, Eva Astor, Rolf Eden, William Alexander

title: Casa de Antiguidades
synopsis: Cristovam, originally from the Brazilian hinterland, works in a milk factory in a prosperous former Austrian colony in Brazil. However, he feels lonely and ostracized due to cultural and ethnic differences. One day he discovers an abandoned house full of objects that remind him of his origins. Gradually it settles there, where objects start appearing out of nowhere without a valid explanation, as if the place were alive. Seeing no other way to resist the present, he slowly transforms into an animal man, emptied of conscience, devoid of social interactions and disconnected from the rest of the world.
cast: Antonio Pitanga, Ana Flavia Cavalcanti, Sam Louwyck

title: Casa de los Babys
synopsis: Six Americans travel to Latin America to find children to adopt. The law requires adoptive mothers to settle in the country of origin of their new children and adapt to local customs. Among the women is a worker, a member of an association of alcoholics anonymous, a moody New York Jew, a wealthy girl, a Bostonian in financial difficulty and an athlete.

title: Casa de mi Padre

But when she decides to help her husband without his knowledge, she forges her father's signature and gets a loan. This will backfire when the creditor Nils Krogstad (Arnoldo Foà) starts blackmailing her.

title: Casa di piacere
cast: Valentine Demy, Alex Freyberger, Alessandro Scotti, David D'Ingeo

title: Casa dolce casa
synopsis: A young woman wanders in an endless corridor, while other people knock on a door at night. A man takes pictures in Montmartre, two women hand him money, while the patron runs a network of Italian callers from rue Myrha. In an interior with children, Adiba sings an ancient Moroccan song and in Pune, India, Vidya is engaged in daily puja. In Turin Giuli drives at night humming and during the day he runs to the station. Parallel stories, each character caught "in situation", closed
cast: Joana Preiss, Lou Castel, Olivia Corsini, Serge Lai, Catherine Libert, Abel Ferrara, Enrico Ghezzi

But for Zhao Xiaoyong, a former farmer who became a painter, this objectifying dimension, which removes its content from form, is no longer enough. He wants to understand Van Gogh better, to touch the heart of what cannot be reproduced: the soul of an artist and his work. And he wants to win his own. synopsis: An alchemist who escaped the Inquisition takes refuge in Mexico bringing with him his tragic and sensational discovery: a mechanism capable of stopping time, but also of inducing the happy immortal to an inextinguishable dependence on human blood. In the Thirties the machine reappears, discovered by chance by an antique dealer (Luppi). Then the billionaire Dieter de la Guardia becomes interested in her. Great debut by the Mexican (from Guadalajara) Benicio Del Toro. It's still the same old vampire story (and the script isn't quite bombproof), but shot with inventiveness and good style. The Argentine Federico Luppi is always a certainty.

Three gangsters destined to become victims of their own legends are well aware of this: brought by chance to the same restaurant on the Chinese side of the border, they are suspected of planning a coup d'état together.

So, in search of his sister, he finds himself in a village tavern, abandoning himself to the pain and tenderness of memories with his former rival, Yong-taek.

However, the final preparations are jeopardized by Winston Churchill, who fears repeating the disastrous massacre of 1915 on the beaches of Gallipoli. His greatest fear is that of being remembered as the architect of the carnage. Despite the push of his opponents and of King George VI himself, Churchill would like to back down but only the intervention of his brilliant wife Clementine manages to avoid the worst.

title: Chuva e cantoria na aldeia dos mortos
synopsis: There are no spirits or snakes around and the forest around the village is quiet for a night. 15-year-old Ihjãc has been having nightmares ever since he lost his father. It is an indigenous Krahô from the north of Brazil. He walks in the dark and fear pushes his steps. From afar, through the palm trees, a song reaches him: it is his father's voice calling him to the waterfall. It is time to organize the funeral ceremony so that the spirit can leave for the village of the dead. The mourning must stop but, denying his duty and to escape the process that would make him a shaman, Ihjãc escapes to the city. Far from his people and his culture, he will have to deal with being an indigenous in today's Brazil.
cast: Henrique Ihjãc Krahô, Raene Ihjãc Krahô

title: Château en Suède

To complete the group there is also Ofelia, Ugo's first wife who, however, spends her days being kidnapped and is considered by all to be dead. To them is added Sebastiano a cynical individual who lives by exploiting others. These four characters spend their time weaving love affairs and making philosophical considerations. One day Federico arrives and joins the game, but will get Eleonora's favors.
cast: Monica Vitti, Jean Claude Brialy, Curd Jürgens, Suzanne Flon

One day, the three come across soldier Ma Hsin with whom, after the attempted robbery, they make friends in order to find a den of bandits, hidden in the mountains. Soon, however, it becomes clear to everyone that the soldier's intentions are quite different and, to avoid ending up in the arms of Mi Lan, Ma Hsin returns to the army to devote himself to a career. Years later, the four meet again but nothing seems to be left of the old friendship.

When she leaves him and throws him out of the house, his life changes forever. Finding himself in the middle of a street, Davide, together with a group of his unlikely friends, will find a very original housing solution that will also give him an idea for a new business.

title: Ci sha xiao shuo jia
synopsis: Willing to do anything to find his missing daughter alive without leaving any trace, a man agrees to help a mysterious woman in murdering a writer of fantasy stories. At the same time, however, the protagonist of the book has begun his plan of revenge, and his actions seem to be reflected in the real world, producing a wave of shocking events and unprecedented power. Hunted on two fronts but at the same time willing to do anything to see his daughter again, the man will be catapulted into an incredible adventure straddling two worlds and will come into contact with magical creatures, supernatural forces and frightening powers.
cast: Zijian Dong, Jingfei Guo, Jiayin Lei, Liya Tong, Mi Yang, Hewei Yu

title: Ci sposeremo a Capri
synopsis: Raffaele and Pasquale, already very close friends, have become enemies since Pasquale opened a betting shop at the Totocalcio in the district where the Raffaele lottery box office is located. But it happens that Raffaele jr., Raffaele's nephew and Maria, Pasquale's daughter, love each other and that a family friend fosters their passion.
cast: Tina Pica, Franco Sportelli, Enzo Turco, Rocco D'Assunta, Mario Siletti

title: Ci sta un francese, un inglese e un napoletano
synopsis: In a military base of a multinational force on a peace mission, some soldiers of various nationalities are drawing lots for a "volunteer" for a very delicate operation. Among them is Salvatore, a Neapolitan who is not very heroic and rather opposed to the initiative of his companions. After a series of controversies and funny skirmishes, Salvatore is chosen. He will have to marry Majena, a local woman, who has become pregnant with a missing soldier, who otherwise would risk capital punishment. To complicate the situation, however, there is Noemi, Salvatore's historical girlfriend who arrives at the camp unaware of everything.
cast: Eduardo Tartaglia, Biagio Izzo, Mario Porfito, Veronica Mazza, Regina Bianchi, Teresa Del Vecchio, Genti Kame, Francesco Procopio

title: Ci troviamo in galleria
synopsis: Ignazio Panizza treads the scenes of the avanspectacle with the stage name of "Gardenio". Perhaps this is why success does not smile on him. In a mountain village, after the usual disastrous performance, he listens to a singer with a beautiful voice and hires her. He soon became her husband. The woman goes from success to success while he continues to remain in the shadows. One evening, the woman organizes an evening of honor for her husband who, moved, can taste success for once. Graceful comedy that reconstructs the world of variety, with all its typical characters, its characterizing specks and its vaguely retro taste.
cast: Nilla Pizzi, Carlo Dapporto, Mario Carotenuto, Sophia Loren, Alberto Sordi

title: Ci vediamo a casa
synopsis: In Rome, three different couples are grappling with the problems of finding a home in which to live together. In the popular Prenestino district, a newly married couple (Ambra Angiolini and Edoardo Di Leo) agree to take care of an elderly person (Antonello Fassari), with the promise of becoming the only heirs of the house in which he lives; in the rich neighborhood of Monteverde Vecchio, on the other hand, two other young people (Myriam Catania and Giulio Forges Davanzati) cannot decide which of their houses to live in; finally, in Ostia, a couple of young homosexuals (Nicolas Vaporidis and Primo Reggiani) would like to move into the house that the terrible and unbearable mother of one of them (Giuliana De Sio) rented in black to a group of immigrants.
cast: Ambra Angiolini, Edoardo Leo, Antonello Fassari, Myriam Catania, Giulio Forges Davanzati, Isabelle Adriani, Nicolas Vaporidis, Primo Reggiani, Giuliana De Sio

title: Ci vediamo domani
synopsis: Marcello Santilli (Enrico Brignano) has always dreamed of being able to change his life and have the right opportunity to get rich. Over time he has developed several ideas but all of them have turned out to be a rip off, so much so that his wife is tired of having to constantly take care of him and his daughter has lost all esteem towards him. By now on the pavement, Marcello has another gimmick of his own and decides to open the only funeral agency in a small remote village in Puglia, inhabited alone over ninety, with the vain hope that the new fellow citizens will soon be able to die and turn into customers.
cast: Enrico Brignano, Burt Young, Ricky Tognazzi, Francesca Inaudi, Giorgia Wurth, Giulia Salerno, Liliana Vallasciani, Andrea Mianulli, Giovanna Matechicchia, Luca Avalgiano, Corinne Jiga, Salvatore Cantalupo

title: Ci vediamo in tribunale
synopsis: Carlo and Giulia, both lawyers, are professionally very different: he is correct and idealistic, she is all too casual. When they find themselves as adversaries in a cause of separation, passion arises between them. But various events push them against each other, so much so that Giulia ends up in handcuffs. And Carlo will have to do violence to his principles to get it out: but there is an excellent reason why he does it ... It certainly cannot be said that this is a particularly robust story. Within its limits, the story works discreetly, at a passable pace and with performers who get along well.
cast: Nancy Brilli, Tullio Solenghi, Amanda Sandrelli, Blas Roca Rey

title: Ci vuole un fisico
synopsis: Alessandro and Anna meet by chance. Both of them would have a gallant date but they get stuck. Thus fate brings them together. In the beginning Alessandro can't stand that girl he considers ugly and intrusive. But in the course of a long night full of fights, wild dancing, night baths and other adventures, he gets to know her better and learn more about himself. At dawn the two boys find themselves more mature, ready to come to terms with their past and, perhaps, in love.
cast: Anna Ferraioli Ravel, Alessandro Tamburini, Francesca Valtorta, Niccolò Senni, Gianpaolo Fabrizio, Claudio Bigagli

title: Ci vuole un gran fisico
synopsis: Torn between family and work, Eva (Angela Finochiaro) is a woman who is a slave to a sense of duty, always in a hurry and unfailingly stressed. Four days after the fateful 50 years, Eva works as a saleswoman in the cosmetics department of a department store to support Francesca (Antonella Lo Coco), her "rocker" daughter, and Lidia (Rosalina Neri), the sprightly mother, after separating from Gino (Elio), the ex-husband who never grew up and is able to complicate her life even more. The sudden dismissal of a colleague by the foreman Pagliai (Raul Cremona) gives rise to the fear in Eva that the same fate may also affect her and, in an attempt to appear impeccable, she will make several mistakes that will further complicate her existence. A sort of guardian angel, a strange character who follows her at all times (Giovanni Storti), will guide her towards the resolution of her problems.
cast: Angela Finocchiaro, Raul Cremona, Elio, Jurij Ferrini, Antonella Lo Coco, Laura Marinoni, Rosalina Neri, Giovanni Storti

title: Cia Codename: Alexa
synopsis: Guest of the United States, diplomat Victor Mahler has taken possession of a super microchip which, once decoded, would allow him to hold the world in his hand. The CIA, to force Mahler's young lover, Alex, to collaborate on the plan to recover the precious object, kidnaps her daughter. Once the mission is complete, the girl must fight to save the child from Mahler's hands, but this time she will have at her side Graver, a counterintelligence agent to whom in the meantime she has linked herself. Cartoon plate hastily packaged for TV. The male protagonist is Lorenzo Lamas, son of Esther Williams and Fernando Lamas.
cast: Lorenzo Lamas, Kathlen Kinmont, O. J. Simpson

title: Ciak, si muore
synopsis: An actress is mysteriously killed on a film set. A colleague looks like the main suspect. While director and screenwriter continue to fight, the police start with the investigations; But in no time the murders multiply.
cast: George Ardisson, Annabella Incontrera, Ivano Staccioli, Belinda Bron, Antonio Pierfederici, Carlo Enrici, Renzo Ozzano

title: Ciakmull
synopsis: Ciakmull, a man who does not remember anything of his past life, escapes from the nursing home where he is hospitalized and heads to the city of Osaka, to which he feels bound by vague memories. Here he is recognized by Udo who recognizes in him the traits of his brother and who pushes him to kill Caldwell, an elderly head of a rival family. Before he can carry out the crime, Ciakmull discovers that the predestined victim is, in reality, his father and that Udo, taking advantage of his amnesia, has put in place a plan to eliminate Caldwell.
cast: Leonard Mann, Woody Strode, Peter Martell, Luca Montefiori

title: Cialo
synopsis: A cynical prosecutor and his daughter suffering from anorexia try, each in their own way, to overcome the tragic death of a person very dear to them. When one day the girl's therapist announces that she has been contacted from the other side and has a message for them, both will be forced to revise their beliefs about life and death.
cast: Janusz Gajos, Maja Ostaszewska, Justyna Suwala

title: Ciao Brother
synopsis: Angelo is a messy forty-year-old, likeable but a bit scoundrel. He makes his living by selling fake paintings to rich Japanese people on vacation, until one day he is unmasked and to escape the chasing police he takes the first flight to an unknown destination. It so happens that the first plane he can catch takes him to Los Angeles. Arriving in California penniless and with his credit cards blocked, he makes do a few days by being a bum when suddenly here is the brilliant idea. Angelo, in fact, reads in a newspaper that the rich Italian-American entrepreneur Vittorio Di Spirito died leaving a boundless inheritance to his son George, and he cannot fail to notice that the dead rich man looks like his father in all respects. Thanks to this similarity, Angelo shows up at the funeral, staging a dramatic and heartfelt grief, and then shows up at George's villa claiming to be his brother ...
cast: Fabrizio Nardi, Nico Di Rienzo, Benedicta Boccoli, Mietta, Emanuela Aurizi, Francesca Della Ragione, Claudia Tosoni, Clayton Norcross, Massimo Ceccherini, Roberto Ciufoli, Christian Marazziti

title: Ciao ma'... Baci da Roma

cast: Lorenzo Flaherty, Silvia Ramenghi, Marco Leonardi, Valerio Andrei, Claudia Gerini, Marco Carsi, Sonia Cameriere

title: Ciao marziano
synopsis: Sure that the Earth has only fifty years of life left, the inhabitants of the distant planet Gemello send the extraterrestrial Bix to Rome. Its task is to transport twelve earthlings to the planet so that we can find out if they are fit to live there. Bix, who is distinguished from earthlings only because he has a green face, also has supernatural powers that allow him to right the wrongs done to him. On the eve of his departure for Gemello, with the twelve earthlings, a trap is set for him ...
cast: Pippo Franco, Silvia Dionisio, Isabella Biagini, Bombolo, Aldo Giuffré

title: Ciao maschio
synopsis: Lafayette makes a living in New York as a lighting technician for a feminist theater group and as an electrician in a wax museum. His friend Luigi finds a chimpanzee and entrusts it to him. Lafayette legally adopts him under the name of Cornelius, instead refusing recognition of the child Angelica is about to have from him. After Luigi's suicide and Cornelius's tragic death, Lafayette sets the museum on fire and perishes there along with the owner. Angelica becomes the mother of a little girl.

title: Ciao nemico
synopsis: World War II: the Americans landed in Sicily where they have to blow up an ancient Roman bridge. The Italians also have to blow up the same bridge and send their team on the spot. The two platoons are led by Lieutenant Kirby and Lieutenant Tocci. The officers end up becoming friends also thanks to the complicity of their soldiers who are not very predisposed to action.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Johnny Dorelli, Vincent Gardenia, Carmen Russo, Eros Pagni, Jackie Basehart, Sal Borgese, Vincenzo Crocitti, Cyrus Elias, Riccardo Garrone

title: Ciao nì!
synopsis: Renato Zero is on tour with his agent Dollar, his assistant Mignolo and his waitress Zucchero. One day he receives a letter containing death threats: a stranger, who signs himself Ciao nì!, Writes that he will kill him "in the limelight". The singer, with the help of his super ego psychoanalyst, then begins to dig into his own past, to trace the identity of his potential killer.
cast: Renato Zero, Renzo Rinaldi, Nerina Montagnani, Carlo Monni, Franco Garofalo, Guerrino Crivello, Elio Bertolotti, Rita Di Lernia, Marco Girondino, Mauro Vestri

synopsis: Juliette is an actress, she hears a little girl screaming in the apartment next to hers, she doesn't pick up the invocation for help and some time later she discovers that the little girl is dead, perhaps beaten by her father. Life goes on. Jean is the brother of Juliette's partner; a restless young man who lives alone with his silent father. One day he runs away and disappears into thin air. Life goes on. Jean angrily threw some paper at a Romanian woman begging for alms. Due to a series of circumstances, the beggar is forced to return home by the police, who treat her like all "sans papiers". Back in the midst of misery. Life goes on. The paintings of history are like small films set together, united by the tragic thread of drift, of incommunicability, of existential ruin, of urban alienation; often punctuated by off-screen where violence explodes, invisible, but present. The moral problem that Haneke, the great Austrian director still misunderstood in Italy despite fundamental titles such as "The sixth continent" and "Benny's Video", poses is precisely this: how life continues in the West (read: Europe) if indifference creates a wall far worse than that of Berlin? "Stories", the original title refers to the lack of a "social" language, is a very hard, ruthless film that places the viewer in front of a mirror in which it is difficult to recognize oneself. But Haneke proves that that reflected image is not deceiving: it is ours.

One evening, he receives an unexpected visit from his neighbor, who wants to share a secret with him: a treasure is buried in the garden of his grandparents' house and, if Costi finds a metal detector, he is willing to share it with him. Initially skeptical, Costi accepts the deal, preparing himself for a weekend of loot hunting.

title: Compagna di viaggio
synopsis: Cora, a restless and wandering twenty year old, lives for the day. One day they offer her a particular assignment: she has to assist an old retired professor, so distracted that he often leaves home and forgets the way back. The man refuses to be assisted, so the girl should watch over him in secret, following him at a distance and intervening only in times of need. For a while, things went smoothly. But one day the professor gets on a train, and Cora follows him. A strange journey through Italy begins, and from station to station the girl begins to confront a previously unexplored dimension of life. An opportunity completely missed by Peter Del Monte, a director whose narrative intentions will never be up to the visual system: beautiful images, beautiful industrial landscapes, but the script is just an unlikely "mess". And to think that Del Monte had an actor of the caliber of Piccoli on his hands: he could have limited himself to following his wanderings, in silence, and would have found more coherence anyway.

Things get complicated when the professor helps arrest a mugger who turns out to be one of the school's pupils. This TV movie takes up the theme of the relationship between teacher and suburban children already undertaken many years ago on TV by dramas such as "Diary of a master" by De Seta. In this case, however, the result leaves something to be desired.

In the company there is also the little professor all inhibitions and complexes. In reality it is the latter (Verdone) who has maintained its own coherence, despite many contradictions.

The unusual triangle will help Caroline in her growth while the quiet and apathy of the place will not be shaken even by the presence of a serial killer in action.

An unmarried woman escapes from prison to have an abortion.

synopsis: The underwater tunnel that connects the island of Manhattan to New Jersey is traversed by a huge number of commuters every day. But the danger stimulates the courage and skills of Kit Latura, one of the many prisoners in the gallery. Version of the most typical catastrophic 70s updated to the era of computer special effects. The film contains everything you would have liked to have found twenty years ago. The only exception is that the character who takes on the role of the leader is not the ordinary type who improvises himself as a hero. He is the hero par excellence, Stallone at his best.

Days of Being Wild

Few motor racing movies have worked - this isn't one of them. The film is based on the skirmishes between the two rival pilots first, and on the amorous ones with the Kidman, then.

Delusional suburban adventures follow one another before the summer really begins with its hangover, the clashes, the mutual humiliations. Bitter comedy about the condition of youth in the American province. A very low-budget production that fits into the panorama of "made in USA" adolescent cinema, to give us a non-trivial picture of the situation.
