In Just another vampir story, the nocturnal encounters of an alcoholic vampire are revealed. In Is TV Bad for Kids ?, a couple goes out in the evening leaving their daughters alone in front of the TV. In Returnable Void, Enrico is an ordinary man, like everyone he has a job, a family, a house, a number tattooed on his arm. In Perspectives, at the center is a surreal dream of Asia Argento. In Chains, a group of friends decide to spend an evening in a club where, however, everyone is afraid of being snared by women. In India - 21, a Roman taxi driver one night loads a strange client ... invisible. In Finally together, a he and a she finally go to live together, but between fantasy and reality they will end up hating each other. In Squeak !, a gang of junkies chases a failed yuppie.

The first woman to wear it is quite old and, despite this, strange desires awaken in her that will be fatal. Worn by Johanna arouses insatiable desires in the conductor of a train and bus. The third film (presented at the Venice Film Festival in 1996) by the Dutch author of "Abel" has a liberating streak, here and there wild (not to say anarchic). Which instigates madness, not forgetting to point out the price to pay.

More and more disturbing truths open up to him, and eventually he will have to face the horror alone.

Action that will start the First World War. Ophüls deserves the credit for having staged the tragedy that led to the Great War for the first time. The shooting of the film, ironically, had to be interrupted in September 1939, at the outbreak of the Second World War and then resumed in February 1940.

Shortly after a tragedy disrupts Stephanie's life, causing her to lose the use of her legs. But Ali does not care and for Stephanie the relationship with that giant at the same time helpful and anaffective becomes unexpectedly the hook she needs to remain attached to life, which after the trauma seems unlivable.

At eight o'clock, he walks into a meeting room, takes a gun out of his briefcase, and shoots two of his superiors. While waiting for the police to arrive to arrest him, Paul locks himself in his room and goes through his story, dwelling on what led him to that point.

title: De bruit et de fureur

She makes friends with a proud young hooligan, and then with a teacher, who abandons him when she is accused of having an affair with him. Definitely at the mercy of his friend and his own ghosts, Bruno runs towards self-destruction. According to a feature film by an interesting French author, the film can provoke different reactions, but it does not leave indifferent. Brisseau finds the right formal balance in the staging of two brutally opposed elements: daily violence and the dream world of a boy thirsty for love.

Since then a long time has passed and, at 24 years old, Antonia dreams of becoming conductor. However, no one seems to take her seriously and the reason is simple: she is a woman. As a result, Antonia decides to challenge everything alone and everyone to try to be admitted to the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. However, with the looming on the horizon of the love of his life, he will be called to a harsh choice.

title: De fem benspænd

The starting point is the short film _Det perfekte menneske_, made by Jørgen Leth in 1967. Lars von Trier asks his friend to make five different remakes and, each time, imposes different obstructions.

A Chilean exile, Ruiz uses the occasion as a pretext for reflecting on how to make a documentary.

They have already decided to separate but have chosen to leave to please their children, still unaware of their painful choice. In the solitude of the landscapes she passes through, from the back seat of the car Lucia slowly realizes that the journey will mark the end of her carefree adolescence, realizing that the tense atmosphere between her father and mother hides something far more serious than the usual quarrel.

title: De l'amour

synopsis: A closer look at Germany's lead years, the 70s, and the events related to the RAF terrorist formation (Rote Armee Fraktion) founded and led by Andreas Baader, Ulrike Meinhof and Gudrun Ensslin.
cast: Martina Gedeck, Moritz Bleibtreu, Johanna Wokalek, Bruno Ganz, Simon Licht, Jan Josef Liefers, Alexandra Maria Lara, Heino Ferch, Nadja Uhl, Hannah Herzsprung

title: Der Ball ist ein Sauhund
synopsis: The legendary German coach Rudi Gutendorf and Werner Herzog talk about their passion for football, taken up by the latter's son.
cast: Werner Herzog, Rudi Gutendorf

title: Der Besuch
cast: Ingrid Bergman, Anthony Quinn, Paolo Stoppa, Romolo Valli, Valentina Cortese, Claude Dauphin, Irina Demick

title: Der Blaue Engel
synopsis: Professor Unrat falls in love with the singer Lola-Lola who performs at the cabaret "The Blue Angel". He manages to marry her to follow her on tour, facing shame and humiliation. Returning two years later to the "Blue Angel", at first he refuses to put on a show in front of the former students who crowd the room, and then, overcome by jealousy, he tries to strangle Lola-Lola.
cast: Marlene Dietrich, Emil Jannings, Kurt Gerron, Hans Albers, Rosa Valetti, Reinhold Bernt

title: Der Bunker
synopsis: A young student looking for peace and solitude focuses on an important job but ends up running into a strange family and teaching little Klaus, who is educated at home by his parents who live in an isolated villa bunker.
cast: Pit Bukowski, Daniel Fripan, Oona Von Maydell, David Scheller

title: Der Clown
synopsis: Max Zander, an agent of W. I. P. A, the World Intelligence Police Agency, is transferred to the city of Dusseldorf for a year in order to investigate the infiltration of the Russian mafia in Germany. When a close friend blows up, victim of an attack, Max is at first gripped by a feeling of pain and grief, but later decides to avenge his death by taking the guise of an anonymous clown. Thus masked, the former special agent hopes to soon find those responsible for the murder and above all to be able to hit them in the shadows, in silence, before anyone can discover his true identity.
cast: Sven Martinek, Diana Frank, Volkmar Kleinert, Hanns Zischler

title: Der Clown
synopsis: The "Clown" is the code name of Special Agent Max Zander. When one of his collaborators, the journalist Claudia, is killed, Max decides to leave the service: but four years later, the kidnapping of Leah - Claudia's sister - by the dangerous gangster Zorbek convinces him to brush up on her disguise ...
cast: Sven Martinek, Eva Habermann, Götz Otto, Thomas Anzenhofer, Patrice Bouédibéla, Xenia Seeberg

title: Der Dirnenmörder von London
synopsis: In Victorian London, a serial killer wanders about claiming victims among prostitutes.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Josephine Chaplin, Herbert Fux, Lina Romay

title: Der Fall Collini
synopsis: Jean-Baptiste Meyer, a highly respected 85-year-old industrialist, is murdered for no apparent reason. According to police, Fabrizio Collini, a recently retired Italian worker, is guilty of the murder. Young and inexperienced lawyer Caspar Leinen is assigned to the case as a public defender but would like to decline the assignment since he knew the dead man for having a teenage affair with his niece Johanna. In this way, he will have the opportunity to run into one of the biggest legal scandals in the history of Germany.
cast: Elyas M'Barek, Alexandra Maria Lara, Heiner Lauterbach, Franco Nero, Manfred Zapatka, Jannis Niewöhner, Rainer Block, Sandro Di Stefano

title: Der Fan
synopsis: Irresistibly attracted to a famous rock star, teenager Simone (Désirée Nosbusch) learns that her idol is a guest in town during a television recording. Simone manages to approach the star, only to discover that he is completely indifferent to him. Distraught and increasingly obsessed with an unrequited feeling, she begins to behave irrational and dangerous.
cast: Désirée Nosbusch, Bodo Staiger, Simone Brahmann, Jonas Vischer, Helga Tölle, Klaus Münster, Ian Moorse, Wilfried Blasberg, Sabine Kueckelmann, Claudia Schumann

title: Der Fangschuss
synopsis: Baltic countries, 1919. The Bolsheviks are about to take power and the German expeditionary force is now on its way. Erich is a young army officer, he is handsome and homosexual, but he is seduced by a countess. For the woman this love is only a pastime to make the now certain death less cruel. It will be the same officer to hear the countess, killing her when the revolution has already triumphed. Shot in the same landscapes where Schlöndorff's most famous film, Torless, had been shot ten years earlier, it was written and starred by Margarethe von Trotta, the director's wife at the time.
cast: Margarethe Von Trotta, Matthias Habich, Rüdiger Kirschstein, Mathieu Carrière, Marc Eyraud, Valeska Gert, Bruno Thost, Henry Van Lyck, Hannes Kaetner

title: Der Gang in die Nacht
synopsis: Doctor Eigil Borne is engaged to Hélène, a girl madly in love with him. On the girl's birthday, Eigil takes her to a cabaret show, where he meets Lily, a passionate and determined dancer, ready to seduce him.
cast: Olaf Fønss, Erna Morena, Conrad Veidt, Gudrun Bruun Stephensen, Clementine Plessner

title: Der Geist der Befreiung
synopsis: With restored and filled era images, the liberation of Europe is told by Nazi -fascism by the allies: from the beaches of Normandy to the heart of the Reich of Hitler, up to the victory of 1945.

title: Der Goldene Handschuh
synopsis: In the 1970s, the city of Hamburg is being held under fire by Fritz Honka, a serial killer who killed four women. All victims meet the maniac in The Golden Glove pub in the St. Pauli neighborhood.
cast: Jonas Dassler, Margarethe Tiesel, Hark Bohm, Marc Hosemann, Philipp Baltus, Uwe Rohde, Dirk Böhling, Lars Nagel

title: Der Golem
synopsis: Prague. Rabbi Löw, who predicts a catastrophe to the detriment of the Jews, models a large clay statue, the Golem, and gives it life, then using it as a servant. Miriam, Löw's daughter, is in love with Florian, but the Golem, incited by the rabbi's assistant, kills the young man, kidnaps the girl and sets fire to the Jewish quarter. It will be a child, by chance, to cause the undoing of the "monster". Reworking of the 1914 film of the same name, also directed by Wegener with Henrik Galeen and inspired by a Jewish legend, a powerful metaphor for the conflict between intelligence and brute force, the film is a masterpiece of expressionist visionary, with astonishing anthropomorphic architecture (by Hans Pölzig) and prodigious lighting effects in the photography of Karl Freund.
cast: Paul Wegener, Albert Steinrück, Lyda Salmonova, Ernst Deutsch, Hans Stürm, Max Kronert, Otto Gebühr, Dore Paetzold

title: Der Hauptmann
synopsis: 1945. At the end of the Second World War, the corporal Willi Herold is chased by his own comrades, who consider him a deserter. When the situation seems to leave him no way out, Willi finds the uniform of an old Luftwappe captain and, wearing it, he will make sure to exercise the new acquired power ...
cast: Max Hubacher, Milan Peschel, Frederick Lau, Bernd Hölscher, Waldemar Kobus, Alexander Fehling, Samuel Finzi, Wolfram Koch, Blerim Destani, Britta Hammelstein

title: Der Heilige Berg
cast: Leni Riefenstahl, Luis Trenker, Ernst Petersen, Frida Richard

title: Der Henker Von London
synopsis: In London there are strange murders of which some people are victims who in the past have committed the most varied crimes but have managed to escape justice. Next to the corpses Scotland Yard always finds a dossier relating to a trial conducted by the mysterious executioner, which ends with the death sentence. The young inspector John Hillier is assigned to follow the case but cannot find any traces that lead him to the mysterious executioner ...
cast: Hansjörg Felmy, Maria Perschy, Dieter Borsche, Rudolf Forster, Chris Howland, Wolfgang Preiss, Harry Riebauer, Rudolf Fernau, Alexander Engel, Narziß Sokatscheff

title: Der Himmel über Berlin
synopsis: Damiel and Cassiel, two angels, roam the streets of Berlin with the mission of listening to the happy or sad thoughts of the people who live in the city. Damiel, who shows himself more involved in the anxieties of human beings, sees Marion, a trapeze artist fired from the circus for which he works and falls in love. The girl is marked by impending loneliness and dark omens of death. An actor, a former angel, who has renounced his true nature and who is making a film about Nazi Germany, will notice his discreet presence.
cast: Bruno Ganz, Otto Sander, Peter Falk, Solveig Dommartin

title: Der Händler der vier Jahreszeiten
synopsis: Hans had joined the Foreign Legion to escape the protection of his mother. Back in Germany from a wife who does not love him and who has asked for a divorce, he collides with the harshness of reality and starts selling fruit in the courtyards of the houses. One of Fassbinder's first major films; a merciless analysis of the relations between the sexes in bourgeois society.
cast: Hans Hirschmüller, Hanna Schygulla, Irm Hermann, Ingrid Caven

title: Der Knochenmann
synopsis: A new murder case for private investigator Brenner, who has to go to the countryside where a famous place roasts thousands of chickens every week, sowing the bones on the back that are recycled - ironically - as chicken feed. But this cannibalistic circle isn't just about chickens, as Brenner will soon discover.
cast: Josef Hader, Josef Bierbichler, Birgit Minichmayr, Simon Schwarz, Pia Hierzegger, Helmut Vinaccia, Christopher Luser, Sitpe Erceg

title: Der Kommer En Dag
synopsis: In the 1960s, two young brothers are forced to live in a child's house forgotten by time. Here, they engage in a terrifying battle against the tyrannical headmaster Heck to win their freedom.
cast: Lars Mikkelsen, Sofie Gråbøl, Lars Ranthe, Sonja Richter, David Dencik

title: Der Kotzbrocken
synopsis: Sophie Brand, as a single mom, has to look after her two children and earn the money she needs by doing two jobs. Due to some unpaid tickets, she is sentenced to perform 300 hours of social work in a rehabilitation center for the handicapped. Here, he has the opportunity to meet Georg, the judge's brother and former athlete confined to a wheelchair by a car accident and considered every assistant's nightmare. A friendship was soon born between the two, destined to make Georg want to get back into the game.
cast: Aglaia Szyszkowitz, Roeland Wiesnekker, Martin Rapold, Arsseni Bultmann, Emilie Neumeister, Eva Löbau, Annika Kuhl, Philip Köstring, Felix Vörtler, Patrick Schorn

title: Der Kreis
synopsis: Zurich, 1958. The shy teacher Ernst Ostertag and the German stand-up comedian Röbi Rapp meet in the secret Swiss organization called "Der Kreis". Despite their differences, the two fall in love and, in defending their sentiment, witness the splendor and decline of what is the first European movement for gay emancipation.
cast: Matthias Hungerbühler, Sven Schelker, Marianne Sägebrecht, Anatole Taubman, Antoine Monot Jr., Marie Leuenberger, Markus Merz, Aaron Hitz, Babett Arens, Maja Stolle, Ruth Schwegler, Ueli Jäggi

title: Der Krieger und die Kaiserin
synopsis: Sissi, a nurse in a psyschiatric hospital, is hit by a truck and Bodo, an ex-stricken soldier, saves her life. Healed, she searches for him and finds him and falls in love with him while he is doing a bank robbery. Sissi will offer herself this time as a savior.
cast: Franka Potente, Benno Fürmann, Joachim Krol, Marita Breuer

title: Der Kuchenmacher
synopsis: After a few months, the relationship between Thomas, a pastry chef from Berlin, and Oran, a married man from Israel, is cut short by a tragic event. Oran is killed in a car accident and Thomas feels he has no choice but to seek out the widow, who is now forced to raise their beloved's son alone. Despite the initial distrust due to Thomas's German origins, the widow Anat decides to offer him a job in her club, unaware that what unites them is the pain of the loss of the same man.
cast: Zohar Shtrauss, Sarah Adler, Stephanie Stremler, Tim Kalkhof, Roy Miller, Sandra Sadeh, Eliezer Shimon, Tamir Ben Yehuda, Tagel Eliyahu, Gal Gonen

title: Der Kuss meiner Schwester
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Mattis Lomberg reunites with his twin sister Mieke, who has spent a long time abroad for study. The affection that naturally exists between them will eventually turn into something shocking.
cast: Florian Heiden, Alexandra Schalaudek, August Zirner, Christian Wunderlich

title: Der Leone Have Sept Cabeças
synopsis: Emblematic didactic and symbolic apologist on the African situation of the early 70s. Made with cadences from Popular Theater, it develops in various episodes that see a CIA agent, a German mercenary, a Portuguese merchant, a priest, a white warrior, a revolutionary garment and a reformist bourgeois in the center (the seven heads of colonialism, Precisely that well highlight the "third -third" political situation of the African continent) and where the people act as a choir.
cast: Rada Rassimov, Giulio Brogi, Gabriele Tinti, Jean Pierre Léaud, Aldo Bixio, Baiack, Reinhard Kolldehoff, Hugo Carvana, Segolo Dia Manungu, Miguel

title: Der Mann aus dem Eis
synopsis: In the Ötztal Alps, more than 5,300 years ago, a Neolithic clan settled near a stream following the directions of Cape Kelab. One day, while the chief is hunting, the clan is attacked and the only one to survive is a newborn. In pain and anger, Kelab contemplates only one thing: revenge. The search for the killers, however, will turn into an odyssey for him, which will lead him to fight for the child's survival and against the forces of nature. A fatal mistake, then, will transform him from hunter to prey.
cast: Jürgen Vogel, Susanne Wuest, André Hennicke, Sabin Tambrea, Martin Schneider, Franco Nero, Paula Renzler, Nora Pider, Ann Birgit Höller, Violetta Schurawlow

title: Der Mann mit dem goldenen Pinsel
cast: Willy Colombini, Marcella Michelangeli, Edwige Fenech, Rainer Basedow

title: Der Menschiliche Faktor
synopsis: A European model family, in which parents speak German and French like children, lives in Germany and has a holiday home on the Belgian coast. And right here, in the sea by the sea, a sudden effort will unravel the family balance. The accident is perceived by each in a different way, the conflicts behind the apparently perfect facade emerge and the distrust is made.
cast: Mark Waschke, Hassan Akkouch, Marthe Schneider, Spencer Bogaert, Sabine Timoteo, Jule Hermann, Tom Van Landuyt, Karen Margrethe Gotfredsen, Isaak Dentler, Steve Driesen

title: Der Nachtmahr
synopsis: In the height of summer, Tina and her friends take part in a youth party in Berlin. After the revelry of the evening, Tina is obsessed with a mysterious creature that haunts her and the only person she talks to is her psychologist, who advises her to face her fears. When she hears that her parents intend to admit her to a psychiatric hospital, Tina realizes that the creature is none other than the embodiment of her thoughts and feelings. Deciding to hide the creature in her room, Tina appears to change and have the courage for the first time in her life to truly be herself. The problems will increase, however, when the parents and his friends also spot the creature.
cast: Carolyn Genzkow, Sina Tkotsch, Wilson Gonzalez Ochsenknecht, Arnd Klawitter, Julika Jenkins, Kim Gordon, Michael Epp, Uwe Preuss, Alexander Scheer, Arnel Taci

title: Der Philosoph
synopsis: George Hermes has only one passion: philosophy and, in particular, Heraclitus about which he has just finished writing a book that is about to be published. He lives spartanly without a telephone or television. He has never met a woman. Having to attend the conference to present his book, he goes to buy a dress in a shop run by three girls who fall in love with him, "adopt" him and together make him discover the joys of sex and love. Dressing him in the role of comedy, director Rudolf Thome has built a film in which fidelity and betrayal, love and feelings are faced.
cast: Johannes Herrschmann, Adriana Altaras, Friederike Tiefenbacher

title: Der Plötzliche Reichtum der armen Leute von Kombach
cast: Wolfgang Bächler, Walter Buschhoff, Johannes Buzalski, Karl Josef Cramer

title: Der Prinz und der Bettelknabe
synopsis: In 16th century England a young prince discovers he has a double, a very poor boy. The two, for fun, decide to switch roles. Yet another version of Twain's novel, and not the best, produced by Disney for TV.
cast: Sean Scully, Guy Williams, Laurence Naismith, Niall MacGinnis

title: Der Richter und sein Henker
synopsis: During the investigation of a murder, a senior police inspector must fight against his poor health and deal with emotional problems. Furthermore, the case is complicated by the influences of corrupt politicians ...
cast: Jon Voight, Jacqueline Bisset, Martin Ritt, Robert Shaw

title: Der Räuber
synopsis: Johann Rettenberger does two things well: robbing banks and running the marathon. Two activities rather distant from each other, but faced with the same method and with the same care and destined to give him the same load of adrenaline and endorphins. He lives with Erika in Vienna, perfectly unsuspected by everyone, were it not for his repeated absences, always for three days, on the occasion of the shots to be scored. When the police find out, they just have to do what they do best: run, without stopping.
cast: Andreas Lust, Franziska Weisz, Johann Bednar, Max Edelbacher, Walter Huber, Markus Schleinzer, Peter Vilnai, Florian Wotruba

title: Der Samurai
synopsis: A wolf moves through the woods around an isolated German village. Young police officer Jacob is on his way but what he discovers is unexpected. In front of him is a wiry man carrying a katana, an ancient samurai sword. When the samurai urges him to follow him in his crusade against the country, Jakob realizes he is facing a madman to stop before he carries out his indiscriminate destruction. The night that awaits him will awaken his most hidden demons in Jakob.
cast: Michel Diercks, Pit Bukowski, Uwe Preuss, Ulrike Hanke Haensch, Kaja Blachnik, Christopher Kane, Janin Halisch, Ulrike Bliefert, Michael Fritz Schumacher, Manfred Möck, Yvonne Yung Hee, Gernot Alwin Kunert

title: Der Scharlachrote Buchstabe
synopsis: The famous novel by Nathaniel Hawtorne according to Wenders. In early 17th century America a woman, guilty of adultery, is forced by the community in which she lives to always wear a large red letter "A" sewn on her clothes.
cast: Senta Berger, Lou Castel, Hans Christian Blech

title: Der Schneider von Ulm
synopsis: In the town of Ulm, a tailor invents a way to fly, ending up falling into a river.
cast: Tilo Prückner, Vadim Glowna, Hannelore Elsner, Harald Kuhlmann, Dieter Schidor, Rudolf Wessely, Marie Colbin, Herbert Prikopa, Dana Medrická, Otto Lackovic

title: Der Schutzengel
synopsis: Maria Fender, on her first day of work as a therapist, is entrusted with Marc Bittner, a violent criminal found guilty of brutally killing some women. The woman is convinced that the man, suffering from personality disorders, is innocent and deserves to return to freedom.
cast: Christiane Paul, Heino Ferch, Barbara Rudnik, Huub Stapel, Günther Bothur

title: Der Seewolf
synopsis: The intellectual Humphrey van Weyden is on board a ferry that, due to the fog, collides with another boat and sinks. Adrift, Humphrey is picked up by the ship of Captain Wolf Larsen, a brutal, cynical but highly intelligent seal hunter who with his methods terrifies a handful of willing sailors. Forced to work as a hub, Humphrey will have to learn to watch his back and protect himself.
cast: Thomas Kretschmann, Florian Stetter, Petra Schmidt Schaller, Henning Baum, Vinzenz Kiefer, Alexander Hörbe, Jaymes Butler, Gennadi Vengerov

title: Der Sieg des Glaubens
synopsis: Nuremberg, 1933: with five operators, Riefenstahl resumes the various phases of the National Socialist Party congress, Hitler's speeches, military parades.

title: Der Staat gegen Fritz Bauer
synopsis: Germany 1957. The young Federal Republic wishes to leave the horrors of the Nazis behind as a single man fights to bring the perpetrators of the worst atrocities to justice. This is the intransigent attorney general Fritz Bauer, who 12 years after the end of the Second World War obtained the necessary information to track down Adolf Eichmann. Together with the young prosecutor Karl Angermann, Bauer, however, finds himself facing resistance from the upper echelons, who would like to stop the searches and investigations.
cast: Burghart Klaußner, Ronald Zehrfeld, Sebastian Blomberg, Lilith Stangenberg, Dani Levy, Laura Tonke, Cornelia Gröschel, Götz Schubert, Jörg Schüttauf, Michael Schenk

title: Der Stand der Dinge
synopsis: A group of people, dressed in overalls and with their faces covered, is advancing in a desert region to the sea. They appeared in a science fiction film. The operator informs the director that he has run out of film: the production stops. The crew is housed in a dilapidated oceanfront hotel in Portugal. Director Fritz tries to get in touch with the producer in Los Angeles and, failing to find him, leaves for the American city. Wenders signs one of his masterpieces (Golden Lion in Venice) between exasperated intimacy and bitter reflection on cinema and death. Photograph by Henri Alekan and prominent role for director Fuller.
cast: Patrick Bauchau, Viva Auder, Samuel Fuller, Allen Goorwitz, Paul Getty III

title: Der Starke Ferdinand
cast: Heinz Schubert, Joachim Hackethal, Gert Günther Hoffmann, Erich Kleiber, Verenice Rudolph

title: Der Student von Prag
synopsis: Balduin, a poor student in cane, is in love with Countess Margit. He becomes rich when a magician offers him a hundred thousand florins in exchange for the right to take whatever he wants from his room. Balduin agrees and the magician takes possession of his image in the mirror, which becomes his double and persecutor.
cast: Conrad Veidt, Elizza La Porta, Fritz Alberti, Ágnes Eszterházy, Ferdinand Von Alten, Werner Krauss, Erich Kober, Max Maximilian

title: Der Tod der Maria Malibran
synopsis: Through explicitly theatrical and experimental setting sequences, commented on by various musical pieces, Werner Schroeter recalls the life and death of the famous 19th century opera singer Maria Malibran (Magdalena Montezuma) with references to Goethe, Lautréamont and others, as well as through a strong visionary and centrality of lesbian attractions.
cast: Magdalena Montezuma, Christine Kaufmann, Candy Darling, Manuela Riva, Ingrid Caven, Anette Tirier, Einar Hanfstaengl, Gabor Von Lessner, Kurt Jungmann, Joachim Bauer

title: Der Tod des Empedokles
synopsis: The famous philosopher Empedocles is chased from Agrigento by his jealous enemies of the very high degree of spirituality he has achieved. Only his disciple Pausanias follows him into exile. Realizing their mistake, however, his former enemies beg him to return but Empedocles refuses and kills himself. Exemplary cinematographic transposition of Hölderlin's tragedy, set in suggestive Sicilian locations (Donnafugata, Etna, Segesta).
cast: Andreas Von Rauch, Vladimir Baratta, Martina Baratta, Ute Cremer

title: Der Tod kommt nach Venedig
synopsis: The restorer Lukas Albrecht drowns in mysterious circumstances in the Marani channel in Venice. While the accommodating Holy Commissioner depends the tragedy as an accident, the victim of the victim, Anna, suspect there is willful misconduct: the husband did not have alcohol in his blood, knew the lagoon and was an excellent swimmer. When a client of Lukas, the elegant director of an art museum, asks Anna news of a painting by Botticelli who had disappeared whose husband had made a copy, the doubts of the widow increase. To find out what happened that night on the channel, Anna investigates with the help of Lukas' best friend.
cast: Alwara Höfels, Christopher Schärf, Filip Wyzinski, Roman Binder, Leonardo Nigro, Katia Fellin, Julia Stemberger, Rudy Ruggiero, Christian Koerner, Hyun Wanner, Christina Trefny, Daniel Langbein, Mario Canedo, Norbert Prammer, Jörg Reifmesser, Elisabeth Leeb, Chiara Casarella, Ferdinando Chefalo

title: Der Todesking
synopsis: Seven episodes that have death as a common thread: 1) the representation of the life of a man who leads his existence in total banality but realizes that he is in a glass bubble; 2) watching a Nazi movie distorts the mind of a young boy; 3) under a pouring rain a depressed man unleashes himself in front of a woman; 4) various shots and tracking shots show us the structure of a bridge, where in each sequence the names of the people who plunged into the abyss appear; 5) a woman and her solitude: from the window she can see a happy young couple exchanging smiles and caresses; 6) a boy devises a camera equipment to record a rock concert on film but when he enters the club ...; 7) a severe headache squeezes its terrible grip on a boy's defenseless temples.
cast: Susanne Betz, Gerd Breitung, Ingo Buesing, Jörg Buttgereit, Andreas Doehler, Heinrich Ebber, Bela B. Felsenheimer, Daniela Geburtig, Angelika Hoch, Manfred O. Jelinski

title: Der Trafikant
synopsis: 17-year-old Franz goes to Vienna to work as an apprentice in a tobacconist's. Here, he meets Sigmund Freud, a regular customer with whom he quickly forms a singular friendship. When he falls in love with the dancer Anezka, Franz seeks advice from the famous psychoanalyst, forced to admit that for him too the female universe represents a big enigma. While the political and social conditions in Austria worsen dramatically with the arrival of the Nazis in Vienna, Franz, Freud and Anezka will find themselves drawn into the maelstrom of events. Each of them will have to deal with the biggest decision to make: stay in Vienna or run away.
cast: Bruno Ganz, Karoline Eichhorn, Johannes Krisch, Simon Morzé, Gerti Drassl, Michael Fitz, Emma Drogunova, Thomas Mraz, Regina Fritsch, Angelika Strahser

title: Der Transport
synopsis: In charge of the transfer to the front of a group of prisoners, in the last days of the war, a German lieutenant instead tries to save them, at the risk of his own life. Convincing characters, but the staging is a bit flat.
cast: Hannes Messemer, Armin Dahlen, Peter Herzog

title: Der Turm der Verbotenen Liebe
synopsis: Accused of killing Queen Margherita's father, Captain Buridan decides to go to Paris to investigate the real killer. However, the French capital has long been the scene of the murder of young nobles, whose bodies are fished out in the Seine.
cast: Jean Piat, Teri Tordai, Marie Ange Aniès, Uschi Glas, Frank Olivier

title: Der Typ, 13 Kinder & ich
synopsis: After his father's death, Leon reluctantly takes over the family business, specializing in the manufacture of porcelain. But the young man has much more headaches, caused by his uncle, an incurable hypochondriac, and by his girlfriend, determined to make Leon actively participate in the business of the factory ...
cast: Tim Bergmann, Julia Brendler, Felix Vörtler, Zora Holt, Wilfried Hochholdinger, Rosa Enskat, Heinz W. Krückeberg, Alexander Martschewski, Lil Oggesen, Julius Nitschkoff

title: Der Untergang
synopsis: April 20, 1945. Berlin is about to be besieged by Russian troops. Adolf Hitler took refuge with the other leaders of the Nazi regime in the bunker under the Chancellery. His typist Traudl Junge witnesses the collapse of Nazism, Himmler's betrayal, Speer's loyalty and the suicide of Goebbels, his wife Magda and the poisoning of his six children. The führer would like to push Germany to resist, but on April 30 he will commit suicide with Eva Braun.
cast: Bruno Ganz, Alexandra Maria Lara, Corinna Harfouch, Ulrich Matthes, Juliane Köhler

title: Der Verdingbub
synopsis: After being orphaned, Max has learned to take care of himself and is forced to accept even heavy work that allows him to survive. He is thus sent as an apprentice to a peasant family who, from foster parents, turn out to be cruel exploiters and who do not hesitate to treat Max like a working beast, allowing their natural son to humiliate him continuously. In the midst of so many torments, Max's only relief is the accordion, which plays in a masterly way and which attracts the attention of a teacher, determined to help him and unaware of the outcome.
cast: Katja Riemann, Stefan Kurt, Maximilian Simonischek, Max Hubacher, Lisa Brand, Miriam Stein, Andreas Matti, Heidy Forster, Ursina Lardi, Ernst C. Sigrist

title: Der Weihnachtshund
synopsis: The winter holiday season is finally here and Max, a hyperactive and confusing journalist, is about to leave for the long-awaited vacation. Before setting off, however, he must find someone to entrust his pet to: at the Katrin kennel, which is just looking for an animal to take care of ...
cast: Florian Fitz, Nadeshda Brennicke, Gunther Gillian, Adele Neuhauser, Fritz Von Friedl, Katharina Stemberger, Nicole R. Beutler, Michou Friesz, Hertha Schell, Klaus Ofczarek

title: Der Zauber der verdunkelten Seele
synopsis: A child squints, it strikes twelve; Will his eyes always stay that way? A woman dies, she still sees the dawn. A family warms up in front of the computer "like a hearth". Simultaneously on the outside: battles of men against usurped power, twilight on the Ground Zero construction site, a night battle in Iraq. Above, the starry vault.

title: Der Zauberberg
synopsis: In the early years of the twentieth century, Hans Castorp, fresh from university and about to become a civil engineer, visited his cousin Joachim, an army officer struck by tuberculosis, at the Berghof sanatorium in the Swiss Alps. Their projector was certainly not as good as the Lumière's, but it worked. One hundred years later, Wim Wenders, with the active collaboration of the Munich film students, brings to light the sensational claim: we Germans invented the Seventh Art! The film, therefore, presents itself as a kind of historical document in the form of fiction in the manner of silent cinema with a second part entirely dedicated to the ninety-year-old Lucia, daughter of Max, still lucid and full of memories. Nazi.

He tries to get compensation for his broken guitar, then decides to go to Sylt: on the way, he visits Helga with her family, in Dulmen, where Dorli offers him hospitality (and not only). Helga and Marianne also contend for Hermann, but the former is hampered by her moralistic grandmother, the latter is married. Hermann then leaves for Sylt, buys his guitar and meets Clarissa, to whom he tells the recent events that happened to him ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die Hochzeit
synopsis: With the complicity of Elisabeth, who lends her the house, the young Waltraud - called Schnüsschen - gives herself to Hermann and wins him over, even though he always loves Clarissa inside. Which meanwhile, through an audition in Paris, goes on tour in San Francisco. At Hermann and Schnüsschen's wedding, all friends flock to La Tana della Volpe: Helga flirts with a Rhenish trumpet player, Renate arrives with Doctor Bretschneider, Evelyne with an African student, Jean-Marie sings accompanied by Volker on the piano. And Clarissa also arrives, to whom Volker declares his love. At the Cerphal house, meanwhile, Juan tries to kill himself, but Reinhard saves him ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die Zeit der ersten Lieder
synopsis: 1960: Embittered by the end - provoked by family opposition - of his relationship with Klärchen, twelve years his senior, Hermann Simon leaves Schabbach and Hunsrück to move to Munich. Musician and composer (one of his concerts has already been broadcast on the radio), Hermann passes the admission exam to the conservatory; meanwhile, while looking for a room to rent, he makes friends with the talented Chilean flutist Juan and with his fellow countryman Clemens, who plays drums in nightclubs. But despite having sworn to himself not to fall in love anymore, it is the meeting with Clarissa, a cello student, that marks him deeply ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Daniel Smith, Franziska Traub, Salome Kammer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die Zeit der vielen Worte
synopsis: The rift between Hermann and his wife intensifies when she enrolls at the university: often, in fact, the girl invites groups of students who treat the landlord as a perfect stranger. In reality, what burns most to Hermann is the fact that Schnüsschen feels fulfilled by dealing with the recovery - however very problematic - of drug addicts. After yet another violent quarrel, the two break up: Hermann leaves for Berlin where he is hosted by Kathrin, who has never hidden her sympathy from him; but the life of the commune doesn't suit him and after some time he returns to Munich, where he finds the empty house ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Anke Sevenich, Frank Roth, Carolin Fink

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die ewige Tochter
synopsis: The only one who still has access to the Cerphal house is Juan. Elisabeth goes to visit her father, a former Nazi hierarch and publishing magnate, who continues to treat her like a child and entrusts her with the task of recovering material from his office: she is surprised by the police, but is released. Her parent forces her to graduate to inherit everything, while Elisabeth realizes she has lived out of this world. Soon the house will be sold to a company that will make 150 homes. Meanwhile, Hermann returns to the conservatory to receive his diploma, Volker has become a great pianist, Clarissa is back and regains interest in him ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Eifersucht und Stolz
synopsis: Narrative parenthesis on the young Evelyne Cerphal, who in 1961 - after her father's funeral - discovers that she is an illegitimate daughter: disappointed and embittered, she leaves for Munich determined to study music; here she is hosted - rather unwillingly, to tell the truth - by aunt Elisabeth, a mature and rich intellectual who often makes her villa available to artists and musicians. One evening, the filmmakers Reinhard, Stefan and Rob show their documentary on the bombing of Munich: Clarissa and Hermann are also present, always on the razor's edge "between jealousy and pride"; meanwhile Evelyne sympathizes with Ansgar, a medical student ...
cast: Gisela Müller, Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Kennedys Kinder
synopsis: Elisabeth Cerphal's villa also hosts Alex, a billed philosophy student, among others. Hermann is busy advertising the ultra-modern music concert he is preparing: the always in love - but rejected - Helga helps him. Clarissa takes a loan from Hermann, who directs her to Jean-Marie and Volker. The two, who have both had an affair with her, discover that she is pregnant and wants to have an abortion, and provide her with the necessary money. Hermann, Juan and the young Schnüsschen go to see _Cleopatra_ at the cinema, while Helga attempts suicide. Meanwhile, the news of Kennedy's assassination arrives: it is November 23, 1963 ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Kunst oder Leben
synopsis: Ten years after his arrival in Munich, Hermann would have every reason to feel fulfilled. But her heart is full of restlessness, and yet another, noisy Oktoberfest is the spark that makes her explode: tired of everything, Hermann goes from train to train in search of Clarissa, the true love of his life, always enigmatic and elusive . On the way, he meets Renate and Juan and feels sorry for the modest fate that both of them have had; he sees his wife Schnüsschen and little Lulu again, cold and hostile; on a poster he also sees the face of Helga, wanted as a terrorist of the Baader-Meinhof. And one day, in Amsterdam, he finally finds Clarissa ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Weihnachtswölfe
synopsis: End of 1963: Clarissa is depressed by the abortion, Hermann is nervous about her music and her absence, compensated by the attentions of the young Schnüsschen. During her concert, Evelyne sings a lied previously composed with Ansgar. Clarissa ends up in hospital with septicemia, and Volker and Jean-Marie - more and more friends - assist her. Stefan and Helga take a trip to the mountains while Schnüsschen and Hermann's relationship continues. At Christmas, Evelyne sings in an empty church, while Clarissa - after a quarrel with her mother - leaves the hospital and takes refuge in Hermann's house: together they write a lied about the impossibility of making their love come true ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Zeit des Schweigens
synopsis: Hermann makes ends meet by playing at parties thanks to Clemens' contacts; However, his financial situation improves when consul Handschuh, owner of Isarfilm, offers him to work on the futuristic multimedia project "Varia-Vision" together with Rob. For her part, Helga increases her political commitment by demonstrating against the American presence in Vietnam. But it is the couple's life that doesn't work: both Hermann and Schnüsschen, both Volker and Clarissa are in crisis, and the two women confide in loneliness and frustration. Meanwhile, on the anniversary of Reinhard's death, friends meet on the lake, where Rob films the point of disappearance ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Peter Weiss, Noemi Steuer

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Zwei fremde Augen
synopsis: Hermann gets Juan (who failed the conservatory entrance exam) a job as a gym teacher; in the meantime, the two friends think they can make some money by giving concerts in the villas of the rich Munich bourgeoisie, but are immediately disillusioned. Hermann, Juan and Clarissa become more and more intimate; and while the first discovers with horror that his suitcase - containing, among other things, the scores of all his compositions - has been stolen, Juan and the girl go by train to visit her mother. Over time, attractions and jealousies intersect between the three; and luckily, one day, Hermann's suitcase is found ...
cast: Henry Arnold, Daniel Smith, Salome Kammer

title: Die andere Heimat - Chronik einer Sehnsucht
synopsis: Against the backdrop of rural Germany in the mid-nineteenth century, when entire villages were depopulated due to hunger and poverty and emigration to distant South America was the order of the day, two brothers one day find themselves faced with the most difficult of dilemmas: to stay or leave. their land. Jacob, unusually romantic for a country boy, dreams of finding paradise in Brazil and makes plans with his great love, the daughter of a stonemason from his village. The return of his brother Gustav from military service, however, gives rise to events that will give a completely different direction to Jacob's projects.
cast: Maximilian Scheidt, Jan Schneider, Marita Breuer, Werner Herzog, Rüdiger Kriese, Antonia Bill, Philine Lembeck, Mélanie Fouché, Eva Zeidler

title: Die angst des tormanns beim elfmeter
synopsis: From the novel of the same name by Peter Handke, the story of Josef Bloch, goalkeeper in a football team, and his expulsion from the sports group.
cast: Arthur Brauss, Kai Fischer, Erika Pluhar

title: Die bian
cast: Lau Siu Ming, Michelle Mee, Huang Shutang, Zhang Guozhu

title: Die bitteren Tränen der Petra von Kant
synopsis: Petra Von Kant, a stylist from Bremen widowed by her first husband and separated from her second, falls in love with Karin, who is ten years younger. Petra is possessive in her love, while Karin wants to keep her independence and just take advantage of the situation. Sadomasochistic and claustrophobic melodrama, based on a play written by the director himself, is a chilling exposing of power relations disguised as erotic relationships. Morbid, austere, one of Fassbinder's best films.
cast: Margit Carstensen, Hanna Schygulla, Irm Hermann, Eva Mattes

title: Die drei Räuber
synopsis: Little Tiffany is traversing a forest in a stagecoach to her new "home", an orphanage run by a tyrannical and brutal director, when three terrifying-looking brigands, dressed in black, block her. But Tiffany, as daring as she is perceptive, understands that this can prove to be a good opportunity to escape the forced stay in the clutches of the director and, playing with cunning, manages to be "kidnapped" by the three brigands, thus paving the way for a relationship destined to reveal what can be hidden under the black cloaks, beyond appearances.

title: Die dritte Generation
synopsis: West Berlin, 1978. Police intensify the fight against terrorism using computers purchased from the firm of Peter Lenz (Constantine). On 27 April 1979, Carnival day, a terrorist group, which includes Lenz's secretary Susanna (Schygulla), kidnaps the industrialist and forces him to declare on video that he is a "prisoner of the people". And he, as he says it, almost laughs. From a news story that shocked German public opinion, Fassbinder made an irreverent, impudent and irrational film.
cast: Eddie Constantine, Hanna Schygulla, Bulle Ogier, Margit Carstensen

title: Die fetten Jahre sind vorbei
synopsis: Jan, Peter and Jule are united by the passion to change the world. Jan and Peter are transformed into "educators", mysterious executors who in a non-violent way warn the rich that their well-being is numbered. Meanwhile, Jule realizes that she has fallen in love with both of her friends. The situation is further complicated when an operation goes wrong and the three young idealists have to deal with their values.
cast: Daniel Brühl, Julia Jentsch, Stipe Erceg, Burghart Klaußner

title: Die fliegenden Ärzte von Ostafrika
synopsis: Reportage made by Herzog, on behalf of German television, on the activities of the Flying Doctors Service, a humanitarian organization of volunteer doctors always flying between the hospitals of the missions of Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania.
cast: Michael Woods

title: Die freudlose Gasse
synopsis: At the end of the First World War, Marie, a resident of a popular street in Vienna, became a prostitute by trade. Another girl, Greta, would follow the same path were it not for the intervention of an American officer. Stunning narrative solutions in a joyless and hopeless story. The interpretations of Asta Nielsen and Greta Garbo stand out from the others.
cast: Asta Nielsen, Greta Garbo, Valeska Gert, Renate Brausewetter, Gregori Chmara, Mario Cusmich, Agnes Esterhazy, Karl Etlinger, Maria Forescu, Jaro Fürth, Robert Garrison

title: Die göttliche Ordnung
synopsis: 1970. Nora is a young housewife and mother who lives in a small and characteristic Swiss village with her husband and two children. The Swiss countryside is touched by the great social upheavals that the 1968 movement brought with it but Nora does not seem to be affected. At least until the day he begins to publicly fight for women's suffrage, on which men are called to express themselves on February 7, 1971.
cast: Marie Leuenberger, Maximilian Simonischek, Rachel Braunschweig, Sibylle Brunner, Marta Zoffoli, Bettina Stucky

title: Die in One Day - Improvvisa o muori
synopsis: After a failed marriage, Richard is on the hunt for his daughter Mindy. Disgraced and devastated, he meets Sasha, an aspiring actress who promises to help him. The hope of making easy money by playing a 24-hour theatrical game will prove to be a nightmare for him.
cast: Kateryna Korchynska, David White, Mirko D'Antona, Cinzia Susino, Biagio Sampietro, Daniela Ladisi, Lisa Marie Picciolo, Dario Grassi, Vincenzo Intermite, Giuseppe Leo

title: Die in a Gunfight
synopsis: Rathcarts and Gibbon can consider themselves the Montecchi and Capulets of the present day. Rival families, each controls its own media empire in New York City. However, their young children ignore the family feud and fall in love, despite the parents to try to keep them away.
cast: Diego Boneta, Alexandra Daddario, Travis Fimmel, Justin Chatwin, Wade Allain Marcus, Emmanuelle Chriqui, Nicola Correia Damude, John Ralston, Michelle Nolden, Stuart Hughes

title: Die innere Sicherheit
synopsis: Clara and Hans are a couple of former terrorists that the police have been looking for for nearly fifteen years. Their hiding is jeopardized when their teenage daughter Jeanne falls in love with a boy she met on the beach.
cast: Julia Hummer, Barbara Auer, Richy Müller, Bilge Bingül, Rogério Jacques, Maria João Luís, Vasco Machado, Noberto Paula, Bernd Tauber, Katharina Schüttler, Günther Maria Halmer, Inka Löwendorf, Manfred Möck

title: Die kleine Hexe
synopsis: A little witch has a big problem: she is only 127 years old and consequently too young to dance with the other witches on Walpurgis night. Therefore, she sneaks into the party but is punished. Within a year, she will have to show everyone that she is a good witch and that she knows all the spells from the great magic book. With determination and commitment, she will also have to avoid all the obstacles that the witch Rumpumpel will put in front of her.
cast: Karoline Herfurth, Suzanne Von Borsody, Alex Prahl, Momo Beier, Luis Vorbach, Therese Affolter, Eveline Hall

title: Die kleine Lady
synopsis: In the late 19th century, nine-year-old Emily lives happily with her widowed mother in a working-class neighborhood in New York. Her tranquility is shattered when a distinguished nobleman from Europe tells her that he is the only heir of the wealthy Countess von Liebenfels and that, as such, she must be brought to her palace for a proper education. Upon his arrival, Emily is confronted by a cold and heartless woman who is awe-inspiring to everyone around her. However, with his contagious cheerfulness, he will be able to open her heart.
cast: Christiane Hörbiger, Veronica Ferres, Stefania Rocca, Philippa Schöne, Xaver Hutter, Christiane Filangieri

title: Die poetische Kraft der Theorie
synopsis: Reflections, questions, aphorisms and theories accompanied by images: enigmatic philosophical phrases from Aristotle to Heidegger with techno music; Marx's "surplus value"; the philosopher and translator of Gilles Deleuze, Josef Vogl about the moon, companion of men and their thought; the central concept of "goodwill" according to Immanuel Kant; _The gay science_ of Nietzsche and Lou Andreas.

title: Die schwarzen Brüder
synopsis: In the mid-19th century, Ticino families were forced by poverty to sell their little children, recruited as chimney sweeps for the city of Milan. Giorgio (Can Schneider) is one of those children who, like many of his peers, had to leave his dear parents to climb onto the roofs of Milanese houses and clean the soot from the flues with his bare hands. Without ever giving up in the face of difficulties, with his companions in misfortune Giorgio founded the League of the Black Brothers, a gang whose members are always ready to join forces to fight poverty, face gangs of street children and try to return as soon as possible to their beloved valleys.
cast: Moritz Bleibtreu, Fynn Henkel, Oliver Ewy, Ruby O. Fee, Richy Müller, Sabine Timoteo, Waldemar Kobus, Leonardo Nigro, Can Schneider, Nabil Al Maaqbeh, Andreas Warnbrunn, Rafael Koussouris, Ciro De Chiara, Julian Graupner

title: Die schöne Lügnerin
synopsis: During the Congress of Vienna in 1815, Sissi, the grandson of an orchestral, fell in love with Ferdinand, the secretary of the Comte de Metternich. Seen by the Tsar wearing a splendid dress, she is introduced by him to a party. Suspected of being a spy, Sissi invents extravagant stories that, unexpectedly, have a confirmation in reality and in this way she saves Austria after Napoleon's escape from the island of Elba.
cast: Romy Schneider, Jean Claude Pascal, Charles Regnier, Helmut Lohner, Paul Guers, Hans Moser

title: Die sehnsucht der Veronika Voss
synopsis: A sports journalist meets a mysterious woman by chance: he follows her and discovers she is a former film star at the time of the Third Reich. But now the woman lives only on memories and is dominated by morphine and an unscrupulous doctor. It was the penultimate film by the great German director and the last in a series of female portraits of German culture and life. Ambiguously played on the relationship between life and the film set, it makes use of a prodigious black and white photograph that underlines the nostalgic and tragic tone of the story, yet another splendid melodrama on power relations. He won the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival.
cast: Rosel Zech, Hilmar Thate, Cornelia Froboess, Annemarie Düringer, Doris Schade, Erik Schumann, Peter Berling, Günther Kaufmann

title: Die unendliche Geschichte III
synopsis: Bastian has moved to another city. His father Berney has remarried to Jane, a divorced woman who has a daughter, Nicole, and who doesn't get along too well with him. At school a group of repetitors, led by the cruel Slip, begins to torment him: they lock him up in the boilers, force him to take refuge in the library where he finds Mr. Koreander. However, he brought with him the magical book "The Neverending Story". Thus new adventures begin.
cast: Jason James Richter, Melody Kay, Freddie Jones, Jack Black

title: Die verlorene Ehre der Katharina Blum
synopsis: The young waitress Katharina meets Ludwig, with whom she triggers a mutual and fulminating attraction. But in the aftermath of a night spent together, the police break into her apartment in search of the man accused of terrorism. Not finding him, the agents arrest Katharina and humiliate her mercilessly; as if that weren't enough, a reporter will drag her further into the mud. The girl's reaction will be both lucid and desperate.
cast: Angela Winkler, Dieter Laser, Mario Adorf, Heinz Bennent, Margarethe Von Trotta

title: Die vierte Macht
synopsis: To forget the worries that his professional and private life give him, the famous journalist Paul Jensen leaves Berlin to move to Moscow, where he accepted the job proposed to him by his former mentor, editor of a trendy magazine. The chance encounter with Katia, a young activist with a mysterious past over which he loses his head, ends up putting him in trouble when she dies in a terrorist attack, revealing connections with a web of political intrigue.
cast: Moritz Bleibtreu, Kasia Smutniak, Max Riemelt, Mark Ivanir, Rade Serbedzija, Stipe Erceg, Cosima Shaw, Reiner Schöne, Michael Ihnow, Merab Ninidze

title: Die weisse Massai
synopsis: Carola, of German nationality, leaves for a holiday in Kenya, where she falls in love with Lemalian, a Masai warrior. To stay with him, he abandons his companion and becomes part of the tribe of man. To integrate with the community life of the indigenous people and their traditions, Carola must adapt not only to customs, but also to accept their opinion towards women.
cast: Nina Hoss, Jacky Ido, Katja Flint, Nino Prester, Janek Rieke

title: Die weiße Hölle von Piz Palü
synopsis: Mountaineer Johannes Krafft, obsessed with his wife's death, continues to search for her across the mountains. Ten years after the accident, he meets a married couple, with whom he tackles the ascent of Piz Palu. The trio doesn't know that a storm is approaching ...
cast: Gustav Diessl, Leni Riefenstahl, Ernst Petersen, Ernst Udet, Mizzi Götzel, Otto Spring, Kurt Gerron, Charles McNamee

title: Die wilden Hühner und das Leben
synopsis: This time the Wild Hens gang is grappling with an eventful school trip.
cast: Michelle Von Treuberg, Lucie Hollmann, Sonja Gerhardt, Jette Hering, Zsa Zsa Inci Bürkle, Jeremy Mockridge, Vincent Redetzki, Philip Wiegratz, Martin Kurz, Paula Schramm

title: Die xue jietou
synopsis: 1967, Hong Kong. Three friends involved in a gangster affair decide to leave the island and move to Saigon, where they hope to make money on the black market. Their adventure becomes an odyssey after being captured by the Viet Cong.
cast: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee, Simon Yam

title: Die! Die! My Darling!
synopsis: Young Pat Carroll visits the mother of her first boyfriend, who died under tragic circumstances. The woman, who lives with the two servants Harry and Anna, immediately appears visibly upset. She decides to stop for the night and leave the next day, but she doesn't know that a spiral of violence and terror awaits her, unleashed by the sick mind of her mother-in-law.
cast: Tallulah Bankhead, Stefanie Powers, Peter Vaughan, Maurice Kaufmann

title: Die, Monster, Die!
genres: Drama, Horror, Thriller, Science Fiction, Foreign
synopsis: Stephen Reinhart arrives in the small town of Arkham, but, when he says he wants to go to Villa Witley, he finds a hostile reaction. The only possibility is to walk through a strange and ghostly landscape, with the branches of the trees crumbling in his hand and a deep crater in the middle of the meadow. At Villa Witley he finds no better welcome: the head of the family Nahum Witley wants him to leave immediately ...
cast: Boris Karloff, Nick Adams, Freda Jackson, Patrick Magee

title: Dieci inverni
synopsis: He and she close, far and still close: Camilla (Isabella Ragonese) and Silvestro (Michele Riondino), eighteen, meet on the vaporetto that connects the islands of the Venetian lagoon. He decides to follow her through the misty streets. It is the prologue to a story that will see the two boys get lost and find each other for ten winters, between Venice and Moscow.
cast: Isabella Ragonese, Michele Riondino, Liuba Zaizeva, Glen Blackhall, Sergei Zhigunov, Sergei Nikonenko, Alice Torriani, Vinicio Capossela, Sara Lazzaro, Francesco Brandi, Luca Avagliano

title: Dieci italiani per un tedesco
synopsis: In March 1944 twelve German soldiers died in an attack carried out by the partisans in via Rasella, in Rome. The retaliation carried out by Colonel Kappler, with the help of the Rome police chief Caruso, is terrible. Some civilians are captured in the ambush neighborhood, then fish are drawn from political prisoners and also from prisoners for common crimes until a list of one hundred and twenty people is compiled, destined to die in retaliation that will be consumed in the massacre of the Fosse Ardeatine.
cast: Gino Cervi, Andrea Checchi, Sergio Fantoni, Ivo Garrani, Carlo D'Angelo, Cristina Gaioni, Loris Gizzi, Gloria Milland, Nino Pavese, Oliviero Prunas

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: I velieri
synopsis: #The story of a boy who grows up as a prisoner of wealth; in his past there is a rapture and a ransom.
cast: Raphael Mendez De Azevedo, Monique Lejeune, Eva Pilz, José Quaglio, Ignazio Oliva

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: Il commissionario
synopsis: The commissioner is a metaphor for the bewilderment and disruption that go through today's society, but Pomilio is the least cinematic writer imaginable. And this is a story full of suggestions and ambiguous psychological excavations, and it seems devoid of action. So I borrowed "the fact" from another of his stories, The Neighbor. Fidelity to a literary text does not consist so much in the reproduction of a plot, as in grasping its style ... ”(Florestano Vancini).
cast: Marisa Mell, Paolo Bonacelli, Andréa Ferréol

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: Il matrimonio di Caterina
synopsis: Caterina is not flashy, she is approaching thirty and still lives with her parents in a small town in Calabria, which was not so well received in the 1950s. The father, to resolve the situation, calls a matchmaker, a typical figure of that historical period, to help him "buy" a husband. The "new" boyfriend, whose name is Giuseppe, seems perfect and capable of making Caterina happy. Everything is going well, but as wedding preparations press, Giuseppe begins to show the hallmarks of his true nature.
cast: Anna Melato, Stefano Madia, Clelia Rondinella, Tino Petilli

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: Inverno di malato
synopsis: The stay in the sanatorium of Girolamo, an adolescent from a middle-class family suffering from tuberculous coxitis, amidst the classist harassment by his rough roommate, sadistically backed by an Austrian nurse, and the tenderness of his relationship with Polly, a sweet English girl.
cast: Domenico Cundari, Clarita Gatto, Giovanni Guidelli, Daniela Guzzi, Jean Pierre Leroux

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: L'avventura di un fotografo
synopsis: A man, who has received a camera as a gift, finds in his partner the ideal way to fix reality on film. The instrument changes its existence almost obsessively.
cast: Paolo Falace, Nunzia Greco, François Marthouret

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: La segnorina
synopsis: Peppino returns to Naples after years spent in war and discovers that his wife Lenuccia has become a prostitute in great demand by American troops. He finds an American military uniform in his closet, puts it on and goes out to find the woman and take revenge, armed with a knife; when he meets her, she does not recognize him and takes him home with her. But a neighbor warns her that her husband is back.
cast: Ida Di Benedetto, Leopoldo Mastelloni, Lina Sastri

title: Dieci registi italiani, dieci racconti italiani: Lighea
synopsis: Faithful adaptation of a story by Tomasi di Lampedusa on the encounter between a man and a mermaid, for the television series Ten Italian directors, ten Italian short stories, in which Gianni Amelio, Luigi Comencini, Carlo Lizzani participated among others.
cast: Philippe Lemaire, Carlos De Carvalho, Barbara May, Anna Bolens, Fausto Di Bella, Adolfo Fenoglio, Clara Garlovic, Prospero Richelmy

title: Diecisiete
synopsis: As foreseen by the rehabilitation program of the juvenile detention center where he is held, 17-year-old Hector forges an unbreakable bond with a dog as shy and aloof as he is. When the animal is suddenly adopted and never returns, Hector runs away from the center to look for it. Thus begins an unexpected journey in the company of his older brother Ismael, his grandmother Cuca, two dogs, a cow and other animals.
cast: Biel Montoro, Nacho Sánchez, Kandido Uranga, Itsaso Arana, Chani Martín, Iñigo Aranburu, Lola Cordón, Mamen Duch, Jorge Cabrera, Carolina Clemente

title: Diego Maradona
synopsis: On 5 July 1984 Diego Armando Maradona joined the Napoli football team. Seven years will follow in which the charismatic Argentine champion will lead Napoli to win the title of champion of Italy and in international competitions. However, the success will present the bill to the champion, who will soon feel like a prisoner of the city.
cast: Diego Armando Maradona

title: Dieses bescheuerte Herz
synopsis: Lenny, the 30-year-old son of a renowned cardiologist, lives as he wants until the day when, tired of his behavior aimed only at fun and wasting money, his father blocks his credit card. To get his life back, Lenny will have to look after 15-year-old David, who has been suffering since he was born. At first reluctant to the idea, Lenny will let himself be conquered by the teenager learning what a sense of responsibility is.
cast: Elyas M'Barek, Philip Schwarz, Nadine Wrietz, Uwe Preuss, Lisa Bitter, Jürgen Tonkel, Karin Thaler, Jo Kern, Gerhard Wittmann, Lena Meckel

title: Diet of Sex
synopsis: Ágata suffers from anhedonia, a disorder that prevents her from experiencing enjoyment in circumstances and activities that are normally pleasurable for others, such as sex. Her lover Marc will help her to successfully overcome the problems thanks to a series of culinary adventures that will give her a satisfying sex life.
cast: Raquel Martínez, Marc Rodríguez, Alberto Casqueiro, Antón Lamapereira, Che Mariño, Ángeles Menduiña

title: Dieta mediterránea
synopsis: The special triangle between Sofia, a chef aspiring to success, and the two men in her life: the staid Toni and the reckless Frank.
cast: Olivia Molina, Paco León, Alfonso Bassave, Carmen Balagué, Roberto Álvarez, Jesús Castejón, Jordi Martínez, Usun Yoon, Dolo Beltrán, André Bonnaure

title: Dieter Nuhr: Nuhr in Berlin
synopsis: The cerebral and popular German cabaret comic expounds his theories on gender norms, primal instincts and a decidedly gastrointestinal Big Bang.
cast: Dieter Nuhr

title: Dietro gli occhiali bianchi
synopsis: A musical portrait dedicated to a master of Italian cinema: Lina Wertmüller. A trip with the director to some places that have a particular meaning for her life: the Roman house in Piazza del Popolo; the countries between Puglia and Basilicata where he set his first film, I basilischi (1963); the Palazzina, the old country house of her husband Enrico Job; the legendary beach in Sardinia Overwhelmed by an unusual fate in the blue sea of ??August.

Little Sawyer, who lives nearby with his mother and who immediately binds himself to the animal, left without a tail after the accident that took place, immediately took care of it. The intense friendship between the two will ensure that the whole community is interested in raising the necessary funds for the caudal prosthesis surgery, which will be performed by a doctor expert in plastic reconstruction.
cast: Morgan Freeman, Ashley Judd, Kris Kristofferson, Harry Connick Jr., Ray McKinnon, Nathan Gamble, Frances Sternhagen, Rus Blackwell, Marc Macaulay, Jim Fitzpatrick

title: Dolphin Tale 2
synopsis: Winter the dolphin, who survived a tragic injury by receiving a prosthetic tail, bonds with an orphaned baby dolphin after her beloved pool mate dies.
cast: Morgan Freeman, Ashley Judd, Harry Connick Jr., Kris Kristofferson, Nathan Gamble, Austin Stowell, Juliana Harkavy, Charles Martin Smith, Austin Highsmith, Cozi Zuehlsdorff

title: Dom Hemingway
synopsis: Dom (Jude Law), the charismatic burglar and self-styled prince of robberies, returns to freedom on the streets of London after twelve years in prison. For him, the time has finally come to recover what is owed to him. Visiting France with his friend Dickie from his boss to request a prize for the years of silence, in the throes of alcohol and drugs Dom realizes that what is lost cannot be replaced by anything and decides to do what he does best : to blow everything up and ruin everyone's business. Only after meeting a femme fatale and a car accident, will he return home to try to reconnect with his daughter.
cast: Jude Law, Emilia Clarke, Richard E. Grant, Demián Bichir, Madalina Ghenea, Jumayn Hunter, Kerry Condon, Richard Graham, Jordan A. Nash

title: Dom durakov
synopsis: Chechnya, 1996. Fragile Janna lives in a psychiatric hospital on the Russian border. When it turns out that all the staff have left the hospital, chaos breaks out among the patients who must learn to organize themselves without anyone's help. Some of them decide to leave, but the deafening noises of the first Chechen war block their way. In the course of the siege by a group of Chechen rebels, Janna is tied up with a soldier, Ahmed. The arrival of the Russians will wreak havoc and the war will spread to the hospital.
cast: Julia Vysotskij, Eugenj Mironov, Sultan Islamov, Bryan Adams

title: Dom na Trubnoj
synopsis: Recently arrived in the capital from the suburbs, Parasha is hired - and exploited - by the hairdresser Golikov and his wife, enriched petty bourgeois in search of a non-union maid. Thanks to a misunderstanding, however, the girl will make a career in politics ...
cast: Vladimir Fogel, Vera Maretskaja, Yelena Tjapkina, Sergej Komarov

title: Dom za vesanje
synopsis: Perhan and Daza, two Slavic boys, are tossed between Yugoslavia and Italy, in the hands of a bunch of criminals who are trafficking with human beings. Before the dissolution of the Titoist republic. Kusturica in his third film changes screenwriter and it shows. Abdullah Sidran is gone and so we miss out on much of the atmosphere and fun. Goran Brgovic's music is excellent, and some moments are captivating, even if the film has moments of tiredness.
cast: Davor Dujmovic, Bora Todorovic, Ljubica Adzovic

title: Dom zly
synopsis: Edward Srodon, an unemployed livestock farmer with a growing problem of alcoholism, would like to start all over again. He then moved to the Bieszczady Mountains after accepting a job at the local state farm. Fate leads him to stop for a night at the house of the Dziabas family. The initial feelings of mutual distrust are soon smoothed by the abundant brandy and the three are reaching an ever-increasing degree of intimacy. The story told overlaps with the events of four years later, during the martial law in Poland, with Srodon himself who, accompanied by the police, takes part in a re-enactment of the events of that night in the Dziobas house.
cast: Arkadiusz Jakubik, Marian Dziedziel, Kinga Preis, Bartlomiej Topa, Robert Wieckiewicz

title: Dom över död man
synopsis: Tornes Segerstedt was one of the greatest journalists of the twentieth century and the most admired Swedish citizen in Denmark and Norway during the Second World War. Editor of an economic newspaper of Goteborg, from 1933 until his death in 1945 he conducted a lonely war against Hitler and his Nazi regime. The great personalities of the period - politicians, economists and even the king of Sweden - try to silence him for fear of retaliars but Torgnny continues undaunted on his way with the support of Axel Forssman, the president of the board of directors of the newspaper. Friends also in private life, both attend Goteborg's high society together with their wives. While Torgnny's wife is Norwegian, Axel's wife is of Jewish origin and this explains their aversion to the Nazi regime.
cast: Jesper Christensen, Pernilla August, Amanda Ooms, Peter Andersson, Ulla Skoog, Bengt C.W. Carlsson, Björn Granath, Adam Lundgren, Lia Boysen, Maria Heiskanen, Lennart Hjulström

title: Domaine
synopsis: Pierre is a 17-year-old teenager, ensnared by the intellectual charm of his aunt Nadia, whose addiction to alcohol is undermining his health. Their relationship, very exclusive and ambiguous, governed by times, paths and habits that are always the same, gradually undergoes sentimental repercussions coming from the outside, which induce the two to separate and find each other after some time without the possibility of re-establishing the agreement. lost.
cast: Béatrice Dalle, Isaïe Sultan, Alain Libolt, Raphaël Bouvet, Silvie Rother, Udo Samel, Taiana Vialle, Bernd Birkhahn, Manuel Marmier, Gloria Hallé Pedemonte, Gisèle Vienne, Thomas Landbo

title: Domangchin yeoja
synopsis: While her husband is on a business trip, Gamhee meets three of her friends on the outskirts of Seoul. They chat amicably as always but there are several currents that flow independently of each other, both above and below the surface.
cast: Kim Minhee, Seo Younghwa, Song Seonmi, Kim Saebyuk, Lee Eunmi, Kwon Haehyo, Shin Seokho, Ha Seongguk

title: Domani
synopsis: The earth trembles. In a few, eternal seconds, the cracks tear the walls of houses, churches, schools and those same cracks open deep gashes in the heads and habits of the inhabitants of Cacchiano. Imaginary Umbrian village, known for its garlic salami factory and a fresco by Fra Angelico. Everyone, terrified and screaming, suddenly wakes up in the night. They will be, for an indefinite period, without a roof and without a just law that favors reconstruction.
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Ornella Muti, Niccolò Senni, Ilaria Occhini

title: Domani accadrà
synopsis: Maremma, 1847. Two white-hearted cowboys, Lupo (Hendel) and Edo, chased for a robbery, first run into a terrible brigand, then find refuge in the villa of the Marquis Ombraviva. Here, they become the guinea pigs of a philosophical bet between the landlord and a tutor who followed Rousseau. In order to demonstrate the validity of the Enlightenment theories, according to which education can make a prince of every rough "savage", Edo will be elegantly educated, while Lupo will be left to himself. The paradoxical fold of the story vividly depicts the great "confusion under the Italian sky" on the eve of the upheavals of '48. Paolo Hendel is in his first appearance as a protagonist.
cast: Paolo Hendel, Giovanni Guidelli, Margherita Buy, Ciccio Ingrassia, Nanni Moretti, Claudio Bigagli, Quinto Parmeggiani, Giacomo Piperno, Dario Cantarelli, Gianfranco Barra, Angela Finocchiaro, Agnese Nano

title: Domani mi sposo
synopsis: In the 24 hours before the wedding with Susy, while the preparations are in full swing, in Jerry's mind the memories of his previous loves resurface, in particular that of Simona who, already married, would still like to run away with him. His friends, on the occasion of the bachelor party, "give him" a woman Rita who, however, as a lover and nocturnal confidant ends up falling in love with Jerry. After a series of interminable further ups and downs, which seem to definitively compromise the marriage. Jerry and Susy finally meet to exchange their "yes", in the cathedral of Mantua, under the eyes of Simona and Rita. Stupid and vulgar comedy. Calà's success remains a mystery.
cast: Jerry Calà, Isabella Ferrari, Milly Carlucci, Karina Huff, Guido Nicheli, Claudio Bisio, Enrico Papa, Adriana Alben, Renato D'Amore

title: Domani passo a salutare la tua vedova... parola di Epidemia
synopsis: Two criminals rob a bank, but are in turn robbed: the search for the loot proceeds with difficulty, around the circle of organized crime. But the company will be long and tiring, due to the unexpected intrusion of bandits of all sorts ...
cast: Craig Hill, Claudie Lange, Pedro Sanchez, Chris Huerta, Carlo Gaddi

title: Domani si balla!
synopsis: Sent to a retirement home for artists by their small private broadcaster, Maurizio (Nichetti) and Mariangela (Melato) undergo an incredible experience. An airplane of a mysterious station, "TV Etere" lands and, through an equally mysterious radiation, pushes all present to joy and dance. The epidemic spreads quickly, so much so as to require the intervention of the authorities who will sadly succeed in restoring order. Third film directed by Nichetti who had not yet recovered from the immediate and dazzling success of Ratataplan. All in all, a fun, but not overwhelming film.
cast: Maurizio Nichetti, Mariangela Melato, Paolo Stoppa, Elisa Cegani, Francesco Carnelutti, Clara Zovianoff, Mirella Falco, Osvaldo Salvi, Claudio Caramaschi, Walter Valdi

title: Domani torno a casa
synopsis: The story of two children, innocent victims of the war, hospitalized in two Emergency hospitals.

title: Domani è troppo tardi
cast: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Gino Leurini, Vittorio De Sica, Lois Maxwell, Lauro Gazzolo, Carlo Romano, Olga Solbelli

title: Domani è un altro giorno
synopsis: The story of the deep friendship between Giuliano (Marco Giallini), a rather well-known actor who lives and works in Rome, and Tommaso (Valerio Mastandrea), teacher and researcher in the field of robotics moved to Canada. Between funny moments and other dramatic ones, humor, complicity and emotion, the two will find themselves spending four unforgettable days together. Seducer and in love with life, Giuliano is condemned by a terminal diagnosis. His most painful task is to find accommodation for Pato, his wonderful and very tender four-legged friend.
cast: Marco Giallini, Valerio Mastandrea, Anna Ferzetti, Andrea Arcangeli, Jessica Cressy, Barbara Ronchi, Marta Bulgherini, Massimo De Santis, Stefano Fregni, Fabrizia Sacchi, Renato Scarpa, Pietro De Silva

title: Domani è un altro giorno
synopsis: A young woman is about to throw herself into the river. A doctor saves her and takes her to the clinic. Here the girl comes into contact with other realities similar to hers: a dishonored young woman who in turn attempted suicide, a woman who would like to die believing she had lost her child, an elderly lady who has just killed herself.
cast: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Anna Maria Ferrero, Laura Gore, Rossana Podestà, Aldo Silvani, Arnoldo Foà, Olga Solbelli, Roberto Risso, Franca Tamantini, Mario Riva

title: Domani è un'altra truffa
synopsis: A series of chain deceptions involves some characters: ranging from the pensioner who loses his life savings to the prostitute struggling with right-thinking condominiums. And then the aspiring actress, the producer, the tour operator, the former restaurateur; all scammers who turn into scammers, in an infinite spiral ...
cast: Enzo Salvi, Antonio Giuliani, Aida Yespica, Maurizio Mattioli, Eva Grimaldi, Biagio Izzo, Leo Gullotta, Pier Maria Cecchini, Alvaro Vitali, Valerio Foglia Manzillo

title: Domenica
synopsis: Sunday is not a public holiday, but the name of a Neapolitan girl who, during her 11 years of life, has known few parties. Orphan, already shrewd and skilled, she must go with Inspector Sciarra to the morgue to recognize the fool who raped her (and who in the meantime died: perhaps suicidal, perhaps killed by a violent cop) ...
cast: Claudio Amendola, Domenica Giuliano, Annabella Sciorra, Peppe Servillo

title: Domenica d'agosto
synopsis: There are those who go to the sea by bicycle, those who take the whole family with their taxi, those who pretend to be rich to win the love of the woman of their dreams, those who lose love and get involved in a robbery , and so on. It is Italy of 7 August 1949, the feast of San Gaetano ...
cast: Anna Baldini, Vera Carmi, Emilio Cigoli, Anna Di Leo, Franco Interlenghi, Salvo Libassi, Elvy Lissiak, Pina Malgarini, Marcello Mastroianni, Ave Ninchi, Massimo Serato

synopsis: The popularity of the program _Il musichiere_ has by now aroused a real fever in Italian families. Countess Castaldi, for example, sent an application to participate in the name of her daughter Maria Luisa because she hopes to stop the financial difficulties caused by the gambling debts of the "Commander" with the eventual winnings. The girl initially disagrees, but then accepts and finds herself competing with the engineer Alberto Carboni, an industrialist passionate about songs ...
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Mario Riva, Lorella De Luca

title: Domestic Disturbance
synopsis: A recovering alcoholic is skeptical of his son's claim that his new stepfather is a killer – but soon begins to sense the boy is telling the truth.
