title: Domestic Violence
synopsis: A group of elderly ladies goes on a visit to a sort of refuge / rehabilitation center, crowded with women who have suffered violence at home: their point of view reproduces that of the spectators, projected into a vast, chilling and misunderstood. A disturbing and essential document.

title: Domestic Violence 2
synopsis: Analysis of the American justice system on domestic violence based in Tampa, Florida. The magistrates face the dramatic cases of some couples: release or bail negotiations, places and times of visits by relatives, punishments based on guilt, possibility of redemption.

title: Domicile conjugal
synopsis: Antoine and Christine Doinel are expecting the birth of their first child. Their life passes quietly between a violin lesson (she receives students at home) and a sprinkle of fake flower paint (he takes care of coloring the plastic flowers). Then one day Antoine succumbs to Kyoko's exotic charm.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Claude Jade, Silvana Blasi, Hiroko Berghauer

title: Dominick and Eugene
synopsis: Nick and Gino are twenty-six-year-old twins. The first works to keep the other at university (medicine). Nick is mentally retarded. Everything is fine with Gino: study, love. The story of a child killed by a abusive father brings out the shocking reason for Nick's condition from the past. And this memory, strengthening the affection between the two, will give more security to the less fortunate. Robert Young is not looking for melodrama numbers. The pathetic is contained by a very careful script and sober direction. Well done the two protagonists.
cast: Tom Hulce, Ray Liotta, Jamie Lee Curtis

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
cast: Stellan Skarsgård, Gabriel Mann, Clara Bellar, Billy Crawford

title: Dominique
cast: Jean Simmons, Cliff Robertson, Jenny Agutter, Simon Ward, Ron Moody

title: Dominique's Story Thou Shalt not Kill
synopsis: African American Dominique Green was sentenced to death in 1993, when he had just turned 19. A fate marred by a marked racial prejudice. His story represents that of many young people like him.

title: Domino
country: Denmark, France, Belgium, Italy, Netherlands, United States, United Kingdom
synopsis: A Copenhagen police officer hunts for the man who attacked his partner, only to stumble into a high-stakes game of espionage.

synopsis: The story of Domino Harvey, daughter of actor Laurence, who abandoned her modeling career for the Ford agency to become a "head hunter".
cast: Keira Knightley, Mickey Rourke, Mena Suvari, Lucy Liu, Christopher Walken, Jacqueline Bisset, Brian Austin Green, Ian Ziering, Macy Gray, Mo'Nique

title: Domovoy
synopsis: Vika, a single mother, buys an apartment in a Moscow building but does not know that for centuries the place is the residence of an elf, a mythical creature who has always done everything so as not to divide his space with humans. This explains why no one has ever resisted within those walls and for what reason a real estate agent recruited a witch to get rid of it. Together with the eight -year -old daughter, Vika will find herself to make friends with the elf and learn to live with her presence.

synopsis: With Asia under his complete control, criminal mastermind Don turns to Europe, battling the mob bosses of each nation along the way.

title: Don Bluth's Thumbelina
synopsis: A childless woman turns to a witch who gives her a grain of barley. Planted in a pot, it produces a flower from which a tiny girl, as tall as a thumb, comes out and is called Thumbelina. Hearing her sing, the fairy prince, Cornelius, tall like her, but with transparent wings, falls in love with her, but the girl is kidnapped by a family of singing toads.

title: Don Bosco
synopsis: The story of Don Bosco's life, from adolescence to conversion, passing through the hardships and work that preceded his entry into the seminary of Chieri.
cast: Gian Paolo Rosmino, Maria Vincenza Stiffi, Ferdinando Mayer, Roberto Pasetti, Vittorio Vaser, Felice Minotti, Cesare Gani Carini, Arturo Zan

title: Don Bosco
synopsis: Seated without strength in an armchair, close to death, Don Bosco thinks back on his life: from his adventurous childhood to the beginning of his activity of assistance to the young Turin proletarians. From the hostility and threats he received first for this commitment of his, up to the help of the popes who finally supported his cause.
cast: Ben Gazzara, Leopoldo Trieste, Philippe Leroy, Patsy Kensit, Karl Zinny, Laurent Terzieff, Piera Degli Esposti, Raymond Pellegrin, Edmund Purdom, Pier Luigi Misasi, Rik Battaglia

title: Don Bosco
synopsis: The life of Don Giovanni Bosco, the priest for children who transformed the vocation into an educational mission.
cast: Flavio Insinna, Lina Sastri, Charles Dance, Daniel Tschirley, Fabrizio Bucci, Lewis Crutch, Brock Everitt Elwick, Alessandra Martines, Ry Finerty, Arnaldo Ninchi

title: Don Camillo
synopsis: In a village in the Lower Po Valley, in the immediate post-war period, a Communist mayor was elected: Giuseppe Bottazzi known as Peppone. To counter him in every way is the parish priest, the combative Don Camillo. The "reds" proclaim an agricultural strike and Don Camillo does everything to make it fail, but then he does not refuse to bless the Casa del Popolo and gives the baptism to the last born of his rival. In their love-hate, in their battles and in their alliances, in their intrigues and in their peaceful coexistence, the two characters represent the Italian struggling with politics in the years of the Reconstruction. Indifferent, but we still laugh with gusto.
cast: Gino Cervi, Fernandel, Leda Gloria, Franco Interlenghi, Vera Talchi, Sylvie, Charles Vissières, Clara Auteri Pepe, Italo Clerici, Peppino De Martino, Carlo Duse

title: Don Camillo e i giovani d'oggi
synopsis: We are in the years of protest and the youth rebellion does not spare even the village of Brescello. Peppone's son is an extra-parliamentarian and a young priest in the mood for post-conciliar innovations puts the traditionalist parish priest in crisis. More tares are brought by Caterina, a restless niece of Don Camillo.
cast: Gastone Moschin, Lionel Stander, Carole André, Paolo Giusti, Daniele Dublino, Dolores Palumbo, Elvira Tonelli, Luciano Bartoli, Jean Rougeul, Barbara Herrera

title: Don Camillo e l'onorevole Peppone
synopsis: The Communist Mayor Peppone decides to run for Parliament. There are many obstacles to overcome: first of all, the achievement of the elementary school certificate. Peppone receives the decisive help of Don Camillo. To lend a hand to the mayor, the party federation launches a very energetic electoral campaign.
cast: Fernandel, Gino Cervi, Claude Sylvain, Leda Gloria, Saro Urzì, Umberto Spadaro, Memmo Carotenuto, Guido Celano, Luigi Tosi

title: Don Camillo monsignore... ma non troppo
synopsis: Don Camillo and Peppone have left the village and live in Rome: one is a senator, the other a monsignor of the Curia. In the Bassa, however, the souls of the villagers have not changed and are always prone to political brawl. The reason for the dispute, this time, is the construction of new social housing in a land on which stands a small votive chapel much venerated. By their respective superiors, the two old lions are sent back to the country to attempt mediation which results in the most classic of "historical compromises".
cast: Fernandel, Gino Cervi, Leda Gloria, Valeria Ciangottini, Gina Rovere, Saro Urzì, Marco Tulli, Andrea Checchi, Emma Gramatica, Carlo Taranto

title: Don Cesare di Bazan
synopsis: Don Cesare is an invincible swordsman who, in eighteenth -century Spain, tries to save the sovereign from a conspiracy and is condemned to shooting. Escaped the danger he will seek revenge.

title: Don Chisciotte e Sancio Panza
synopsis: Don Quixote della Mancha has only one passion in life: chivalry books. Excited by the tales of intrepid heroes, incredible prodigies and damsels in distress, he decides to leave to repeat the exploits of the ancient knights errant. Picking up equipment that he thinks is worthy of a knight, to show his courage and nobility, he agrees to be accompanied on his journey only by the funny squire Sancho Panza.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Fulvia Franco, Enzo Garinei, Paolo Carlini, Umberto D'Orsi, Franco Fantasia, Aldo Bufi Landi, Carlo Delle Piane, Mirella Pamphili, Liana Trouché

title: Don Franco e Don Ciccio nell'anno della contestazione
synopsis: In a Sicilian village there is a strong rivalry between the two local parish priests. Don Franco, who has progressive sympathies, is accused of having given way to the Communists during a strike with a subsequent road block. His suspicion is that Don Ciccio, the conservative, reported him to the bishop. The final battle will take place on a football field and will end in tarallucci and wine.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Edwige Fenech, Lino Banfi, Ennio Girolami, Umberto D'Orsi, Luca Sportelli, Enzo Andronico, Renato Malavasi, Mirella Pamphili

title: Don Gato: El Inicio de la Pandilla
synopsis: Poor and lonely, Top Cat lives on the street and is a sad cat until the moment he casually meets Benny, a naive and good-hearted cat looking for adventure. The two soon become best friends and accomplices, seeing pickpocketing their way out of poverty. In an attempt to improve their conditions, they decide to strike a blow against Mr. Big, a mysterious diamond thief who rules the back alleys of New York.

title: Don Giovanni
synopsis: Don Giovanni is an attractive gentleman to whom women cannot resist; Just luck our fortune has overwhelmed its male contenders. Among these, however, there is a commander, killed in a duel, who returns to torment him in the form of a statue.
cast: Giorgio Albertazzi, Franco Parenti, Margherita Guzzinati, Marco Bezzi, Carlo Cataneo, Stefano Satta Flores, Sergio Tofano, Gianna Giachetti, Milla Sannoner, Renzo Palmer

title: Don Giovanni
synopsis: Don Giovanni, after having been the lover of a woman, falls in love with her daughter - a young girl with a strong religious passion - and persists in wanting to conquer her, despite the young woman being a more difficult "prey" than usual.
cast: Carmelo Bene, Lydia Mancinelli, Vittorio Bodini, Gea Marotta, John Francis Lane, Salvatore Vendittelli

title: Don Giovanni
synopsis: Don Giovanni kills the father of one of his conquests. So, as a joke, he invites his funeral monument to dinner. The statue, animated, drags him to hell. Intelligent cinematic version of Mozart's work, with the setting in a funeral Venice and political metaphor intentions clarified by a caption by Gramsci: Don Giovanni is the immorality that manifests itself when the old is dead and the new is struggling to be born. The orchestra is conducted by Lorin Maazel.
cast: Ruggero Raimondi, Kiri Te Kanawa, José Van Dam, Edda Moser, Teresa Berganza

title: Don Giovanni in Sicilia
synopsis: Don Giovanni is a calf from Catania accustomed to living as a great seducer. One day he decides to go to Milan in search of adventures, but in the metropolis he is sucked into work. His wife moves away from him, and the gallant successes are no longer what they used to be. Eventually the call of Sicily will make itself felt again.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Katia Moguy, Rossana Martini

title: Don Gnocchi. L'angelo dei bimbi
synopsis: 1941. Don Carlo Gnocchi teaches at the Gonzaga Institute in Milan and among his pupils the disciplined Francesco and the rebel Matteo stand out. Following a discussion with a fascist hierarch, Don Carlo convinces Cardinal Shuster to allow him to leave as a volunteer chaplain in the Albanian war. Meanwhile, his students follow his exploits passionately from afar. The direct contact with the horror of war and with death profoundly changes the thinking of the man of faith who, returning to Milan, tries to persuade his students not to follow his example, but in vain. In fact, almost all of his boys have already enrolled volunteers, including Francesco and Matteo ...
cast: Daniele Liotti, Giulio Pampiglione, Francesco Martino, Alexandra Dinu, Pietro Taricone, Matteo Ripaldi, Luisa Maneri, Lucio Zagaria, Luciano Roffi, Roberto Citran

The passion for Barbara pushes Jon to ignore their differences but on his way he soon finds Esther (Julianne Moore), a woman a few years older who has recently been widowed. Esther seems to understand Jon more than Jon himself understands, prompting him to look within and embark on an inner journey to accomplish what he truly wants.

title: Don Juan DeMarco
synopsis: A masked young man wants to commit suicide for an unhappy love. Dissuaded by a psychiatrist, he is hospitalized in a clinic where, during the sessions, he tells the doctor about his life, full of conquests and adventures, until he meets Ana who denies him and for which the protagonist wants to die. . The doctor, in order not to have the young man interned, forces him to take psychiatric drugs, but the ending is open.
cast: Marlon Brando, Johnny Depp, Faye Dunaway, Géraldine Pailhas

Don has received a letter from an old flame of his, Sonny (Elisabeth Sue), who tells him that she has cancer, and has little time to live. But upon his arrival Don discovers that the reality is very different ...

He himself defined the small remote village on Mount Giovi as "a church surrounded by a few houses scattered here and there". Misery and loneliness sow madness, but Don Lorenzo tries to help the poor by creating a school for the youngest.

title: Don Quijote de Orson Welles
cast: Francisco Reiguera, Akim Tamiroff

title: Don Quixote
synopsis: An avid devourer of ancient adventurous texts, Alonso Quixada decides one day to transform himself into a knight-errant with the name of Don Quixote de la Mancha. Chosen as squire the fellow citizen Sancho Panza, he will travel the dusty streets of Spain to conquer the glory and the heart of Dulcinea del Toboso, the Beauty among the Beauties ...

title: Doragon bôru Z 11: Sûpâ senshi gekiha! Katsu no wa ore da

title: Dying Eye
synopsis: One night, Amemura Shinsuke, a bartender at a Nishi Azabu bar in Tokyo, is attacked by a male stranger and loses a part of his memories. However, he soon learns that he caused the death of a woman called Kishinaka Minae in a traffic accident one and a half years ago. And the man who came to attack him and later committed suicide, was her husband Reiji. For some reason, Shinsuke is frequently advised by the people around him that it is better not to recall bad things. He begins to have misgivings about the truth of the accident. Then when Shinsuke returns to the bar on one rainy night, Ruriko, a woman in mourning clothes and of unwordly beauty, shows up all of a sudden. From the time of her appearance, Shinsuke descends into a world of madness and anguish. Does she truly exist or is she a figment of imagination conjured by a guilty conscience? (Source: jdramas.wordpress.com)

title: Dying Young
synopsis: Hilary, a simple girl disappointed by a love story that ended badly, agrees to nurse Victor, a leukemic, the 28-year-old son of a billionaire. The boy is the victim of terrible crises caused by chemotherapy; all this does not prevent the two from falling in love and running away together. Once the therapy is suspended, Victor becomes prey to pain to overcome which he begins to use morphine; the drug, taken in ever more massive doses, makes him addictive and makes things worse. Only with her love can Hilary hope to help him. Schumacher measures himself with melodrama, relying on the graces of Roberts. The idea is to overturn the dynamic of "Love Story" and this time to condemn the rich scion to death; interesting, but maybe it took more nastiness, or less molasses.

Everyone knows that he will never receive it, all the inhabitants of the village and his thin wife, who keeps wondering "What are we going to eat?".

title: El crimen del padre Amaro
synopsis: Eager to change the world, young Amaro takes his vows. Before leaving for Rome where his theological studies await him, on the advice of the bishop - his great friend - he goes to the church of Los Reyes to acquire the necessary preparation under the supervision of Father Benito. Here he meets Amelia, a very devoted and extremely sensual girl, and little by little he falls in love with her, challenging the fate that would impose celibacy. Even the girl, fascinated by the kind ways of the priest, ends up feeling attracted to him.
cast: Gael García Bernal, Sancho Gracia, Ana Claudia Talancón, Angélica Aragón

title: El cuaderno de Sara
synopsis: Laura spent the last years of her life in search of her sister Sara, who disappeared in the depths of the Congo jungle. Neither the NGO she worked for nor the embassy heard from her until a photo of her appeared in a mining town. Apparently, the woman is a prisoner of a rebel leader, who controls the criminal activities related to columbite. Despite the difficulties, Laura decides to travel to Kampala and track Sara, facing the threats of the jungle and the local underworld.
cast: Belén Rueda, Manolo Cardona, Enrico Lo Verso, Florín Opritescu, Marian Álvarez, Marta Belaustegui, Malcolm Sitté, Iván Mendes, Nick Devlin, Rafa Rojas Díez

title: El cuento de las comadrejas
synopsis: A beautiful star from the golden age of cinema and her actor husband who has always lived in her shadow live together with her screenwriter and director of her films in an old, forgotten house. A young couple persuades the actress to sell the house and return to the stage. The intentions of the two are to take possession of the property and to send the four elders to a retirement home. The four, however, are not as stupid as they seem ...
cast: Clara Lago, Oscar Martínez, Luis Brandoni, Graciela Borges, Marcos Mundstock, Nicolás Francella

title: El cuerpo
synopsis: A night watchman is accidentally killed while escaping in a panic from the morgue where he works. The police are called to conduct the investigation, who soon discover that the body of a recently dead woman has disappeared. Inspector Jaime Peña (José Coronado) then decides to turn to the new widower and during a surprising evening he discovers the truth behind the woman's death before solving the mystery of the stolen body.
cast: Belén Rueda, Hugo Silva, Aura Garrido, José Coronado, Juan Pablo Shuk, Cristina Plazas, Oriol Vila, Manel Dueso, Pere Brasó, Aida Oset

title: El delfín: La historia de un soñador
synopsis: Daniel is a young dolphin who, instead of devoting himself to fishing like all the other members of his group, spends his time playing with the waves of the coral reef. While everyone considers him a time waster, Daniel cultivates the dream of riding the perfect wave and to make it come true he does not hesitate to abandon the safety of his refuge to venture into the ocean, facing numerous challenges and dangers in order to give voice to his desires and discover the value of life.

title: El desconocido
synopsis: One day Carlos, a bank manager, receives an anonymous phone call as he drives his children to school. The mysterious individual on the other end of the phone asks him for a large amount of money to be raised in a few hours. If Carlos doesn't, his car will explode ...
cast: Luis Tosar, Javier Gutiérrez, Elvira Mínguez, Fernando Cayo, Goya Toledo, Paula Del Río, Marco Sanz

title: El desconocido
synopsis: Based on real events, the fictional story of Mexican drug lord El Chato's number one hitman, El Cholo.
cast: Guillermo Iván, César Manjarrez, Estrella Solís, Liliana Moreno, Marco Uriel, Mario Zaragoza, Fernando Sarfatti, José Ángel Bichir, Paty Blanco, Pía Sanz, Scarlet Gruber, Pakey Vázquez, Ivonne Montero

title: El despertar de las hormigas
synopsis: Isabel is a 28 year old seamstress. By all accounts, she is a good mother, wife and daughter-in-law. However, her family insists that she have another son, a son, in addition to the daughters she already has. The pressure will slowly awaken his desire for rebellion.
cast: Daniella Valenciano, Leynar Gomez, Isabella Moscoso, Avril Alpizar

title: El dia de la bestia
synopsis: During Christmas Eve 1995 in Madrid, Angel Berriartua, a distinguished theologian and priest, prepares for the arrival of the Antichrist. His problem is that he does not know the place where it will manifest itself and for this reason he decides to consult Professor Cavan, who hosts an esoteric show on television "The Dead Zone". He calls into question his girlfriend Susanna and an unscrupulous producer. Despite their intervention, Evil advances inexorably.
cast: Alex Angulo, Armando De Razza, Santiago Segura, Terele Pavéz

title: El diario de Carlota
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Carlotta is in love with a young athlete named Oriol but discovers sex thanks to Sergio, the son-in-law that every mother would like to have. Moreover, she is in great difficulty but no one, neither her parents nor her friends Elisa and Mirea, can help her. Among the many things that worry her are Elisa's attempts to get close to her beloved Lucas by disguising herself as a man and Mirea's desire to seduce Oriol by betraying her friendship.
cast: Andrea Ros, Lydia Fairén, Lorena Mateo, David Castillo, Marcel Borràs, Omar Muñoz, Ana Rayo, Sergio Parralejo, Benito Sagredo, Luis Callejo

title: El eslabón podrido
synopsis: In a village with only twenty twenty houses live Raulo, a mental disabled person. Her mother Ercilia is considered like a sorcerer while her sister Roberta prostitutes herself. Hearing death approaching, Hercilia does not hesitate to warn her daughter: if she has sex with all the men of the city, she will die. The threat is much more felt than it seems: there is in fact only one man with whom Roberta has never slept.
cast: Germán De Silva, Lola Berthet, Valentín Javier Diment, Marilu Marini, Luis Ziembrowski, Paula Brasca, Sergio Boris, Susana Pampín, Sebastián Mogordoy, Pamela Rementería

title: El espinazo del diablo
synopsis: Spain, late 1930s: 12-year-old Carlos is abandoned by his guardian in the orphanage of Santa Lucia. Here he comes into conflict with Jaime, a restless teenager, leader of all the other boys. To complicate everything, there are the dangerous ties between the director Carmen, Professor Casares, the goalkeeper Jacinto and the teacher Conchita ...
cast: Eduardo Noriega, Marisa Paredes, Federico Luppi, Fernando Tielve

title: El espíritu de la colmena
synopsis: Ana is a girl who lives in a remote country of Franco's Spain with her father, who is dedicated to the study of bees. One day she attends the screening of James Whale's _Frankenstein_ and is fascinated by the monster. More and more closed in her reverie, when she comes into contact with a republican looking for help because he is wounded, she confuses him with the monster of her cinematographic suggestions and welcomes him giving him help in an abandoned cottage ...
cast: Fernando Fernán Gómez, Ana Torrent, Isabel Telleria, José Villasante, Teresa Gimpera

title: El exterminador de la carretera
synopsis: The Exterminator and his girlfriend looking for drinking water. Low post-atomic co-production, designed for depressed markets. There is also Luca Venantini ("Strangled Lives").
cast: Robert Jannucci, Alicia Moro, Luca Venantini

title: El faro de las orcas
synopsis: Lola is traveling with Tristan, her son with autism: she wants to meet Beto, a guardian who has a very special relationship with the wild orcas of Patagonia, Argentina. Lola's determination to fight for her son, Tristan's particular personality and his special relationship with nature will change the lives of the three forever.
cast: Maribel Verdú, Joaquín Furriel, Joaquin Rapalini Olivella, Ciro Miró, Ana Celentano

title: El fin de ETA
synopsis: This documentary chronicles the decade-long process that led to the end of the ETA, a Basque terrorist group that operated for more than 50 years.

title: El final del paraíso
synopsis: In Colombia, the DEA's new director targets a gang of dealers pushing a powerful drug while contending with an enemy who possesses a deep network.
cast: Carmen Villalobos, Catherine Siachoque, Fabián Ríos, Gregorio Pernía, Kimberly Reyes, Stephanía Duque, Elianis Garrido, Carolina Gaitán, Juan Pablo Urrego, Juan Pablo Gamboa

title: El fotógrafo de Mauthausen
synopsis: With the help of a group of Spanish prisoners who lead the clandestine organization for the liberation of the Mauthausen concentration camp, Francesc Boix, a prisoner who works in the photographic laboratory of the same camp, risks his life by planning the release of some negatives that will show the world the atrocities committed by the Nazis. Those same images will be taken as evidence during the 1946 Nuremberg Trials.
cast: Mario Casas, Macarena Gomez, Alain Hernández, Luka Peros, Stefan Weinert, Frank Feys, Marc Rodríguez, Minnie Marx, Eduard Buch, Joan Negrié

title: El futuro perfecto
synopsis: Xiaobin is 17 and doesn't speak a word of Spanish when she arrives in Argentina. Despite this, in a few days she already has a new name, Beatriz, and a job in a Chinese supermarket. His family lives in a parallel world, the laundromat, without ever mixing with the Argentines. Unbeknownst to everyone, Xiaobin sets aside some money and enrolls in a language school. What he learns in class, he puts it into practice on the road. After learning to "make an appointment", for example, he decides to set one up with a supermarket customer: Vijay. He is from India and, although they can barely communicate, they start a secret relationship. But when it comes to studying conditional mode, Xiaobin begins to wonder about his future. What if her parents found out about the affair with Vijay? The more her Spanish improves, the more she gets into the film's script, while her Chinese classmates comment on the events like a choir.
cast: Xiaobin Zhang

title: El gran calavera
synopsis: Don Ramiro, a very rich widower who went into debauchery, spends his days between a hangover and an orgy. In the meantime, his family members take advantage of him: his brother idles at his expense, his sister-in-law, a hypochondriac, uses Ramiro's money to pay for his medicines, his son smashes and changes one car after another, and his daughter suffers the court of a handsome dowry hunter. At a certain point, another brother, a doctor, decides to put Ramiro in front of the harsh reality, according to which, if he goes on like this, he will waste all the assets in a short time.
cast: Fernando Soler, Rosario Granados, Andrés Soler, Rubén Rojo, Gustavo Rojo, Maruja Grifell, Francisco Jambrina, Luis Alcoriza, Antonio Bravo, Antonio Monsell

title: El guardián invisible
synopsis: At the edge of the Baztan River, the naked body of a teenager killed in apparently mysterious circumstances is found. Amaia Salazar, police inspector, moves from Pamplona to Elizondo to investigate the case. In the same places where she lived as a child and of which she has no happy memories, Amaia discovers with her investigations the figure of a serial killer who continues to end the lives of his young victims with a surprising modus operandi. The police will have to track him down before he can commit another crime but the mythology of the Norte region and its fantastic figures will surprise everyone.
cast: Marta Etura, Elvira Mínguez, Nene, Francesc Orella, Javier Botet, Colin McFarlane, Pedro Casablanc, Miquel Fernández, Miguel Herrán, Manolo Solo, Arlette Torres

title: El habitante incierto
synopsis: Felix is ??a young architect who, recently left by his girlfriend, finds himself living alone in a huge apartment. One evening a stranger knocks on his door and asks if he can make a phone call. Felix lets him in, but in a moment of distraction he loses sight of him and the man disappears without a trace. From this moment on, a series of increasingly distressing events leads Felix to think that the stranger is living in the house with him.
cast: Andoni Gracia, Mónica López, Francesc Garrido, Agustí Villaronga, Minnie Marx, Pablo Derqui, Violeta Llueca, Xavier Capdet, Pere Abelló, Fina Rius

title: El hijo de Jesse James
synopsis: Jesse James' son, as a child, sees his father killed by his best friend. Due to the complexes that haunt him for being the son of the most famous of bandits, he will experience a continuous inner struggle, always poised between good and evil.
cast: Robert Hundar, Mercedes Alonso, Adrian Hoven, Ralph Baldwin, Janos Bartha, Joe Kamel, Robert Camardiel, Robert Johnson Jr.

title: El hijo de la novia
synopsis: Rafael is a successful man, in his family and at work, but he doesn't seem to notice: he is always apathetic and grumpy, ready to argue with anyone. He will have to come close to death, suffering from a heart attack, to begin to appreciate the beauty of his life and the affection of those around him.
cast: Ricardo Darín, Hector Alterio, Norma Aleandro, Eduardo Blanco, Natalia Verbeke, Gimena Nóbile, David Masajnik, Claudia Fontán, Atilio Pozzobon, Salo Pasik

title: El hombre che mató a Billy el Niño
synopsis: William H. Bonney to defend his mother from an attack is forced to kill, thus becoming the famous Billy the Kid. When an amnesty is granted to all the bandits as long as they surrender their weapons, Billy goes to the sheriff, but ...
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Fausto Tozzi, Dyanik Zurakowska, Francisco Sanz

title: El hombre de al lado
synopsis: Only a wall divides two buildings and two lives, that of Leonardo and Victor, two men with habits at the antipodes. Leonard lives with his wife and daughter in a large apartment, designed by the famous architect Le Corbusier, and is a wealthy industrial designer, famous and snobbish; Victor, has just moved into a modest place and is a reseller of used objects, with a rough, vulgar and bullying manner. Their lives, however, come into contact when Victor opens a breach in the communicating wall to give more light to his home, falling into the neighbor's house. A long war, made up of low blows, awaits the two men.
cast: Rafael Spregelburd, Daniel Aráoz, Eugenia Alonso, Inés Budassi, Lorenza Acuña, Eugenio Scopel, Debora Zanolli, Bárbara Hang, Enrique Gagliesi, Ruben Guzman

title: El hombre de las mil caras
synopsis: The nineties. Francisco Paesa, a former secret agent of the Spanish government responsible for the largest operation against ETA in history, is involved in an extortion case during the crisis of the Armed Liberation Group and is forced to flee the country. Years later he returns but his personal life is not going through a good time. He then received a visit from Luis Roldán, former director general of the Civil Guard, and from his wife Nieves. Both offer him a million dollars in exchange for his help to save 1.5 billion pesetas stolen from public funds. Francisco then saw there an opportunity to improve his economic situation and to take revenge, among other things, on the Spanish government. Thus begins a masterful spying operation with the help of his inseparable friend Jesús.
cast: Eduard Fernández, José Coronado, Marta Etura, Carlos Santos, Enric Benavent, Alba Galocha, Philippe Rebbot, Pedro Casablanc, Israel Elejalde, Tomás Del Estal, Luis Callejo, Emilio Gutiérrez Caba

title: El hoyo
synopsis: One day Goreng wakes up next to Trimagasi on the 33rd floor of a mysterious place similar to a prison, crossed by a hole with a platform in the center from which the remains of the meals consumed by those on the upper levels descend. Trimagasi knows the laws that regulate the mysterious place: to survive, you need to go upwards. Staying low, no food arrives and nothing or anyone can be trusted.
cast: Antonia San Juan, Ivan Massagué, Algis Arlauskas, Alexandra Masangkay, Eric Goode, Emilio Buale, Zorion Eguileor, Miriam Martín, Óscar Oliver

title: El hoyo en la cerca
synopsis: As every year, the Los Pinos school, a prestigious school of the confessional type, sends its children on retreat to the countryside. Under the watchful eye of teachers and priests, the children are led on the path of their physical and moral development. Everyone tries to find their place in an elite and closed society where the economic solvency and the color of the skin determine the status of each of them.The first night the atmosphere is disturbed by the discovery of a passage in the fence that surrounds the perimeter of the field, triggering a series of mysterious events. It seems that an intruder from the dangerous nearby village has managed to infiltrate and that the boys could be the target of organ traffickers practicing Satanic rites, fueled by a desire for social revenge. As the hysteria and paranoia spread, it begins to become clear that things are not what they seem. What if the threat, instead of coming from without, came from within?
cast: Valeria Lamm, Yubáh Ortega Iker Fernández, Lucciano Kurti, Joaquin Del Paso, Eric David Walker, Jacek Poniedzialek, Juan Pablo García Fabela, Alexander Waters, Carlos Morett, Héctor Kuri Hernández, Matias Del Castillo Negrete, Giovanni Conconi, Charles Oppenheim, Carlos Morett Joaquín Mcarthy, José Manuel Vázquez, Gabriel Fritsch, Emilio Monico Rojas, Enrique Lascurain, Raúl Vasconcelos

title: El impenetrable
synopsis: Director Daniele Incalcaterra inherited from his father 5,000 hectares of land in the Paraguayan region of Chaco and plans to create a national park. His neighbors - oilmen, transgenic soybeans and ranchers - are not very happy with his idea, starting a long dispute that has the flavor of a modern western in a still virgin land.

title: El imperio de la fortuna
synopsis: If you want to escape from poverty, Dionisio Pinzón (Ernesto Gómez Cruz) takes care of a wounded rooster with the aim of making him fight. When the bird proves to be a capable fighter, the man begins to earn well and leaves the Christmas village to give himself to unbridled luxury.
cast: Ernesto Gómez Cruz, Blanca Guerra, Alejandro Parodi, Zaide Silvia Gutiérrez, Socorro Avelar, Juan Antonio Llanes, Carlos Cardán, Loló Navarro, Edmundo Barahona, Raymundo Gómez Cruz, María Barber, Jorge Fegán, Alfonso Godínez, Emilio Ebergenyi, José Ruvinskis, Abel Woolrich, Raúl Valerio, José Escandón, Tito Guillén, Eduardo Cassab, Alberto Estrella, René Pereyra, Margarita Narváez, Ignacio Retes, Adolfo Magaldi, Federico González, Regino Herrera, Francisco Llopis, Miriam Aragón, Eduardo López Rojas, Isela Díaz, Ernesto Yañez, Alfredo Sevilla, Fernando Palavicini, Yaco Alva, Isidro Téllez, Margarita Sanz, Carlos Lopez, Luisa Huertas, Carlos Chávez, Leonor Llausás, Wolf Ruvinskis

title: El incendio
synopsis: Lucia and Marcelo are in their thirties and carrying a hundred thousand dollars in cash to pay for their new home. However, something is wrong and the signing of the documents is postponed. Tense and desperate, they head to their old home and put the money in a safe place. During the twenty-four hours that are missing from the contract, the true nature of the relationship between the two will be revealed, letting the inherent crisis and violence emerge.
cast: Pilar Gamboa, Juan Barberini, Luciano Suardi, Marcelo D'Andrea, Andrea Garrote, Laura Paredes, Cecilia Rainero, Valeria Correa, Fabio Ronzano, Mariano Sayavedra

title: El jorobado de la Morgue
synopsis: The hunchbacked Gotho works as an assistant in a morgue in Switzerland. Secretly in love with a woman, when she dies of tuberculosis, he does not hesitate to kill some medical students to steal her body and hide it in a damp crypt. Hoping to bring his beloved back to life, Gotho asks for help from Alberto Dalbes, a mad scientist who has been working on a monstrous project for some time. In return, Gotho must however arrange to recover the corpses of newly deceased people from the mortuary to be fed to a monstrous creature already created by Dalbes.
cast: Paul Naschy, Rosanna Yanni, Víctor Alcázar, María Elena Arpón, Manuel De Blas, Antonio Pica, Kino Pueyo, Adolfo Thous, Ángel Menéndez, Fernando Sotuela

title: El jugador de ajedrez
synopsis: Diego Padilla becomes chess champion in 1934 but, after the outbreak of the Civil War, he is forced to go into exile in France with Marianne Latour, a French journalist he is madly in love with, and their daughter. During the Nazi occupation, however, Padilla is accused of being a spy and ends up in an SS prison, where he will try to survive thanks to Colonel Maier's passion for chess.
cast: Marc Clotet, Melina Matthews, Alejo Sauras, Lionel Auguste, Stefan Weinert, Pau Durà, Mike Hoffmann, Maarten Dannenberg, Christian Stamm, Andrés Gertrúdix

title: El laberinto del fauno
synopsis: 1944. A girl travels with her mother and adoptive father to rural areas of Northern Spain after Franco's victory. The young woman meets (or perhaps thinks she meets) a faun who promises her a fantastic kingdom, provided that she passes three tests ...
cast: Ivana Baquero, Doug Jones, Sergi López, Ariadna Gil, Maribel Verdú, Alex Angulo

title: El lugar sin límites
synopsis: Manuela, homosexual father of the young Japanese, lives with this and other reiets in an unwanted brothel and tries to survive between powerful rich and violent men.
cast: Lucha Villa, Ana Martin, Gonzalo Vega, Julian Pastor, Carmen Salinas, Fernando Soler, Emma Roldán, Blanca Torres, Marta Aura, Agustín Silva

title: El límite infinito
synopsis: From early struggles to his climb up the Himalayas, Jean Maggi gets profiled in this documentary that highlights his advancement of adaptive sports.
cast: Jean Maggi

title: El mar
synopsis: Manuel Tur and Andreu Ramallo are ten years old when the civil war arrives on the island of Mallorca, where they live. Their first encounter with the cruelty of adults takes place when a friend's father is shot before their eyes. After ten years, the two find themselves in an island hospital to take care of tuberculosis: the civil war is over, the social climate is depressing and the two men water between a past full of obsessive memories and a dark future.
cast: Roger Casamajor, Bruno Bergonzini, Antònia Torrens, Hernán González

title: El mariachi
synopsis: Arriving in town with his guitar, the mariachi (walking storyteller of Mexican origin) finds himself in the middle of the war between the bands of Moco, owner of all the bars and all the a guitar case). For further complication, the young man falls in love with Domino, Moco's woman. Result: a massacre, which only the protagonist survives. Robert Rodriguez's sensational debut, with a very low-cost film, suggestive in the shots and with a frenzied rhythm. A narrative that makes this brazen anarchy its best gift. The director himself made a remake of it in Hollywood, "Desperado", starring Antonio Banderas.
cast: Carlos Gallardo, Consuelo Gomez, Reinol Martinez, Peter Marquardt

title: El misterioso señor Van Eyck
synopsis: Charles Van Eyck dies when he falls overboard during a quarrel on a yacht with one of the sailors. With him sinks a secret treasure that many will want to recover.
cast: Franco Fabrizi, Massimo Girotti, Emilio Gutiérrez Caba, Ricardo G. Lilló, Espartaco Santoni, Tere Velázquez

title: El método
synopsis: A meeting of the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund is taking place in Madrid and the streets are overrun with demonstrators. In the meantime, at the headquarters of a multinational, a selection test is scheduled for a position of drig, to which seven candidates are presented, two women and five men. These are gathered in a room, where they are invited to take their seats around a table, in front of a video terminal. The voice of a speaker informs them that through a series of tests they will have to decide who to eliminate; at the same time, he reveals to them that one of those present is, in fact, an undercover psychologist.
cast: Eduardo Noriega, Najwa Nimri, Eduard Fernández, Pablo Echarri, Ernesto Alterio, Carmelo Gomez, Adriana Ozores, Natalia Verbeke

title: El nino y el Papa
synopsis: A severe earthquake in Mexico divides a boy, Angelino, from his mother. When they meet again, she has lost her memory from the shock. But during the Pope's visit to Colombia, Angelino manages to approach him on stage and his mother, seeing the scene on television, miraculously heals.
cast: Christopher Lago, Veronica Castro, Andrés García, Carmenza Duque, Victor Hugo Morant, Nelly Moreno, Jose Luis Paniagua

title: El niño
synopsis: El Niño and friend El Compi want to set up their own business and transport hashish from Africa to Europe, crossing the Strait of Gibraltar. To them, it all seems simple, since they grew up in the culture of drug trafficking. Police officers Jesús and Eva have long been trying to demonstrate how the hashish route from the black continent paved the way for cocaine trafficking in the old continent, targeting el Inglés, the one who holds the ranks of the impregnable business. Destiny will cause the four to cross their path, reaching a point of no return that will make them discover how their respective worlds are more complex, ambiguous and dangerous than they ever believed.
cast: Luis Tosar, Sergi López, Eduard Fernández, Jesús Carroza, Bárbara Lennie, Jesús Castro, Meriem Bachir, Moussa Maaskri, Ian McShane, Oti Manzano

title: El olivo
synopsis: Alma is 20 years old and works on a chicken farm. Her grandfather, who to the amazement of the family has stopped talking for years, is the person she cares about the most in the world. When the man also stops eating, Alma is convinced that the only way to help him is to recover the millennial olive tree that the family sold against his will twelve years earlier. Without revealing his intentions, without a precise plan and with little money, he decides to venture into the almost impossible mission of recovering the tree, replanted somewhere in Europe, and to bring it back to the family farm.
cast: Javier Gutiérrez, Anna Castillo, Juanma Lara, Nikolai Will, Pep Ambròs, Manuel Cucala, Paula Usero, Carme Pla, Miguel Angel Aladren, Ana Ulloa, Inés Ruiz

title: El olvido que seremos
synopsis: Hèctor Abad Gomez is an important doctor who works in the polarized and violent Medellin of the seventies. Father of a family who is concerned not only with the welfare of his children but also with that of children belonging to the most disadvantaged classes, he believes in an education based on tolerance and love. Fate, however, rages on his family when a cancer takes away one of his beloved daughters. Driven by sadness and anger, Hector begins to deal with social and political causes, becoming one of the major activists of his time. However, this will not be welcomed by the strong powers.
cast: Javier Cámara, Nicolás Reyes Cano, Patricia Tamayo, Juan Pablo Urrego, Laura Londoño, María Teresa Barreto, Elisabeth Minotta, Aida Morales, Kepa Amuchastegui

title: El orfanato
synopsis: A woman returns with her family to her hometown to restore an old orphanage and make it a center dedicated to disabled children. The new environment excites the imagination of his son, who begins to entertain himself with a kind of "invisible friend". But when the fantasies start to get more disturbing, the woman begins to realize that something is threatening her family. He then summons a group of parapsychologists to try to understand the origins of those presences.
cast: Belén Rueda, Fernando Cayo, Roger Príncep, Mabel Rivera, Montserrat Carulla, Andrés Gertrúdix, Edgar Vivar, Óscar Casas, Mireia Renau, Georgina Avellaneda, Geraldine Chaplin

title: El otro Tom
synopsis: Elena is a single mother and depends on social services. His son Tom has behavioral problems and is labeled at school as a 'problematic child'. Their difficult relationship is further complicated by an absent paternal figure. Following a diagnosis of attention deficit disorder and hyperactivity, psychotropic drugs are prescribed. However, a strange episode alerts the mother on the side effects. When the woman refuses to continue administering drugs, social services threaten to remove Tom from her.
cast: Jorge Castro, Leah Miller, Michelle Flores, Rigo Zamarron, Joseph De La Riva, Jaco Rodriguez, Sofía Prieto, Gloria Carden, Marina Garbalena, Alma Brockhoff, Gigi Chaires, Jeanell Carden, Frank Rico, Malicia Dominguez, Abby Alonzo, Alejandra Dozal, Samantha Jasso, Cristopher Jones

title: El otro hermano
synopsis: Cetarti, a newly fired civil servant, moves from Buenos Aires to Lapachito, a lonely town in the province of Chaco, to take care of the dead bodies of his mother and brother, who were brutally murdered and with whom he had no particular emotional ties. The only thing that motivates him is the possibility of collecting a small life insurance, an amount that would allow him to move to Brazil. In Lapachito, however, he meets Duarte, a kind of godfather who is also a friend of his mother's killer. The two form a strange alliance to collect the money. However, the stay of Cetarti will not be so simple ...
cast: Leonardo Sbaraglia, Daniel Hendler, Angela Molina, Max Berliner, Pablo Cedrón, Alian Devetac, Alejandra Flechner

title: El otro lado de la cama
synopsis: Javier and Sonia have been together for a long time and live a seemingly perfect life. On the contrary, their friends Pedro and Paula are facing a painful separation. To overcome the difficult moment, Pedro asks Sonia for comfort: he does not yet know that the new boyfriend of his ex is Javier ...
cast: Ernesto Alterio, Paz Vega, Guillermo Toledo, Natalia Verbeke, Alberto San Juan

title: El pasado
synopsis: After twelve years of marriage, a couple separates. The rediscovery of freedom, the hunt for love, the search for the perfect woman, will bring more trouble to the fascinating Rimini, a man who has always loved women.
cast: Gael García Bernal, Analia Couceyro, Moro Anghileri, Ana Celentano

title: El patrón, radiografía de un crimen
synopsis: A lawyer defends an illiterate man whose exploitation by a cruel boss while working as a butcher in Buenos Aires led to tragedy. Based on a true case.
cast: Joaquín Furriel, Luis Ziembrowski, Guillermo Pfening, Mónica Lairana, Germán De Silva, Victoria Raposo, Andrea Garrote

title: El perro
synopsis: Patagonia. 52-year-old mechanic Juan Villegas has lost his job and sells handcrafted knives that nobody wants to survive. One day, in exchange for a repair, he receives as payment a beautiful dog named Bombón. At first the mistrust is mutual, but then the two become inseparable, especially after Bombón wins a prize at a local competition ...

After numerous reticence, the patient explains the reasons for the insane gesture, perhaps due to a disappointment in love ...
cast: Richard Burton, Peter Firth, Colin Blakely, Joan Plowright, Harry Andrews

title: Er Più. Storia d'amore e di coltello
synopsis: In 1900 Rome, Nino Petroni, a fishmonger nicknamed Er Più, gets out of prison and is welcomed into his neighborhood like a king. He has to deal with a police confidant and another boss who bullies and woos Rosa, his girlfriend. The whirlwinds that the two exchange are a prelude to a rustic duel; but the matter is resolved by a third-party pistol shot.
cast: Adriano Celentano, Maurizio Arena, Claudia Mori, Fiorenzo Fiorentini

title: Er gol de Turone era bono
synopsis: The Juventus match - Rome of 10 May 1981 is remembered for the cancellation of a key goal scored by Maurizio "Ramon" Turone. The decision is of the referee's assistant, who on the contrary had confirmed the goal. Roma will lose the Scudetto and will never forget that key moment of its history: the documentary traces the whole day together with the protagonists of the time.

title: Er ist wieder da
synopsis: Adolf Hitler suddenly awakens sixty-six years after his supposed death. In modern Berlin, he finds himself without war, without a party and without Eve, and moreover surrounded by a climate of peace, thousands of foreigners and Angela Merkel. Against all odds, he has to start over and gets a job on television, where everyone believes he's a comedian.
cast: Oliver Masucci, Fabian Busch, Christoph Maria Herbst, Katja Riemann, Franziska Wulf, Lars Rudolph, Michael Kessler

title: Er shi si cheng ji
synopsis: In Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan, an old model factory is about to be demolished. In its place a new luxury residential complex will be built: "24 City". Against the backdrop of this urban transformation, three generations confront each other, between nostalgia for the past and hopes and ambitions for the future: the old workers, the new rich and the young.
cast: Joan Chen, Zhao Tao, Liping Lu, Jianbin Chen

title: Era Sam Wallash... lo chiamavano 'Così Sia'
synopsis: Sam Wallash escapes an attack by ferocious bandits, who kill a friend of his. Sam decides to take revenge on the killers and their leader Donovan, who was also found guilty of the murder of his parents years earlier.
cast: Robert Woods, Dino Strano, Benito Pacifico, Amerigo Castrighella, Simonetta Vitelli, Piera Bruni, Pietro Fumelli

title: Era d'estate
synopsis: In 1985, the judges Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellini were forced to stay at Asinara, where in solitary confinement for security reasons they wrote the maxi investigation for the great Mafia trial the following year.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Massimo Popolizio, Valeria Solarino, Claudia Potenza, Elisabetta Piccolomini, Elvira Camarrone, Giovanni D'Aleo, Sofia Langlet, Lidia Vitale, Francesco Acquaroli, Giovanni Anzaldo

title: Era di venerdì 17
synopsis: Paolo, a middle-aged traveling salesman, during one of his trips meets Maria, a sad and worried girl. Intrigued, the man asks her the reason for so much despair. Maria is returning home to her parents after living in the city for some time. Abandoned by her boyfriend and moreover pregnant she does not have the courage to introduce herself to her parents. So she asks Paolo to accompany her home and pretend to be her husband.
cast: Fernandel, Giulia Rubini, Alberto Sordi, Tina Pica, Leda Gloria

title: Era lei che lo voleva!
synopsis: The boxer Dynamite has broken through the heart of the beautiful researcher Nausicaa. The two get married, but she is jealous and ends up abandoning him. Dynamite returns to the ring totally unmotivated, but then the misunderstanding is dissolved. Walter Chiari (who had been a cavvero boxer) goes free, but the film is non-existent.
cast: Lucia Bosé, Walter Chiari, Enzo Fiermonte, Carlo Campanini

title: Era lui... sì! sì!
synopsis: Commendatore Fernando is stressed by a nightmare in which a young man, always the same, blows beautiful women under his nose. One fine day Walter, a young man identical to the persecutor of his dreams, appears to ask him for work, and Fernando, in a mad anger, would like to drive him out. The man gives up on his purpose on the advice of the doctor and through the intercession of his daughter.
cast: Walter Chiari, Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Campanini, Isa Barzizza, Enrico Viarisio, Nyta Dover, Fanfulla, Lilia Landi, Luigi Tosi

title: Era notte a Roma
synopsis: As the battle rages around Monte Cassino, an American, a British and a Russian soldier manage to escape from a concentration camp. A woman, who lives off the black bag, hosts them in the attic of her house, but the three, unable to remain inactive, get in touch with the partisans. Their movements, however, do not go unnoticed and the woman, betrayed by a spy, will be arrested.
cast: Giovanna Ralli, Leo Genn, Sergey Bondarchuk, Peter Baldwin, Renato Salvatori, Enrico Maria Salerno, Paolo Stoppa, Laura Betti

title: Era ora
synopsis: Dante has a beautiful relationship with his girlfriend Alice but has a really bad one over time. Absorbed by a thousand commitments, he always arrives late and has the impression that he's life is scrolling too quickly. The day when he turns forty that impression becomes incredibly reality. From that moment Dante finds himself jumping forward from year to year, without having more control of his life.
cast: Edoardo Leo, Barbara Ronchi, Mario Sgueglia, Francesca Cavallin, Raz Degan, Massimo Wertmüller, Andrea Purgatori

title: Era uma vez...
synopsis: Rio de Janeiro. Dé lives in the Cantagalo slum in Ipanema. Son of the maid Bernadette and abandoned by his father, Dé saw his brother Beto killed by a drug trafficker and his other brother exiled. Fortunately, he has not followed the path of crime but sells hot dogs on the beach, where he observes Nina, the only daughter of a wealthy family. Soon, the two meet and fall in love but their different worlds of belonging generate prejudices and contrasts.
cast: Thiago Martins, Vitória Frate, Rocco Pitanga, Cyria Coentro, Paulo César Grande, Marcos Pitombo, Fernando Brito, Rodrigo Costa, Luana Schneider

title: Era una notte buia e tempestosa...
synopsis: Felix, who is a stand-up comedian awaiting success, shares a small apartment with Valentina and Riccardino. The coexistence of the three "singles" proceeds between ups and downs, between banal routines and small accidents in a funny and bewildered atmosphere. Until, unexpectedly, the eviction arrives ...
cast: Alessandro Benvenuti, Athina Cenci, Daniele Trambusti

title: Eragon
synopsis: In the kingdom of Alagaesia, the young Eragon comes across a magical dragon egg: his destiny is to become a dragon knight, as were his master Brom and Galabtorix, now tyrant of the realm. The dragon Saphira will accept to be the young man's steed, and together with some allies the two will try to restore peace and serenity ...
cast: Ed Speleers, Jeremy Irons, Sienna Guillory, Robert Carlyle, John Malkovich, Joss Stone

title: Eran trecento...
synopsis: Lucania, 1857. A band of liberals, led by Volpintesta, fights against the Bourbons and tries in vain to help Carlo Pisacane's expedition.
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Myriam Bru, Franca Marzi, Peter Trent

title: Erased
synopsis: Satoru Fujinuma can travel back in time to save others' lives. When he wakes up 18 years in the past, he has a chance to save his murdered classmates.
cast: Tao Tsuchiya, Shinnosuke Mitsushima, Aoi Yuki, Chinatsu Akasaki, Yo Taichi, Akari Kito, Ayaka Nanase, Yukitoshi Kikuchi, Takahiro Mizushima, Minami Takayama, Mitsuru Miyamoto

title: Eraser
synopsis: John Kruger, a commander of the federal police, is part of the WITSEC special group, which is concerned with providing a new identity to witnesses under protection. The exceptional physical strength and intensive training he undergoes make him the best member of the group. Eraser (this is his nickname) is faced with the most demanding challenge of his career: protecting the witnesses entrusted to him by a mole, which from within his own organization constitutes a terrible threat to their safety. Arnold Schwarzenegger deceives us every now and then: he did it with "The Twins" and especially with "True Lies", where James Cameron threw him into intelligent satire (of himself, James Bond and all his emulators), without giving up super effects. But from "The Eliminator" don't expect anything that vaguely resembles "True Lies". Here Schwarzy has returned to take himself seriously and is a full-blown action man, very acrobatic and rather dull, within a plot that could not be more obvious.
cast: Arnold Schwarzenegger, James Caan, James Coburn, Vanessa Williams

title: Eraserhead
synopsis: Harry Spencer, a typographer by profession, lives in a seedy flat on the outskirts of a big city. Married to Mary who has just given him a child, he turns out to be a kind of monster in all respects.
cast: Jack Nance, Charlotte Stewart, Jeanne Bates, Judith Anna Roberts

title: Ercole al centro della Terra
synopsis: Hercules must reach the center of the Earth to find the living stone needed to save his fiancée Deianira, a prisoner of the tyrant Licos, from madness. The enterprise is far from easy even for the son of Zeus; dangers and traps dot his path and terrifying monsters try to stop him from his mission. The hero's strength is, however, equal to his cunning. Scripted by Bava, Sandro Continenza, Franco Prosperi and Duccio Tessari, the film represents a real foray into mythology for our master of horror cinema (but even here there is more than a hint in that direction). The character of Hercules is played by Reg Park, former Leeds footballer, then bodybuilder, three-time winner of the Mister Universe title as well as editor of industry magazines and owner of gyms.
cast: Reg Park, Christopher Lee, Leonora Ruffo, Marisa Belli

title: Ercole alla conquista di Atlantide
synopsis: Foretold by fatal signs from heaven, the mysterious people of Atlantis are about to conquer Greece. Of all the Hellenic rulers, it is only Androclus, king of Thebes, who has the courage to challenge the invaders, but his ship is captured and he is imprisoned. Hercules, however, is on his trail and, after having managed to penetrate the city of Atlantis, hidden in the bowels of a mountain-island, undoes the spell that makes its inhabitants invincible.
cast: Reg Park, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gian Maria Volonté, Fay Spain, Ettore Manni, Luciano Marin, Laura Efrikian, Mario Valdemarin, Mimmo Palmara, Raf Baldassarre

title: Ercole contro Moloch
synopsis: The Greek warrior Glauco, who for his strength calls himself Hercules, offers to fight against Moloch, being deformed and bloodthirsty. Our hero will be able to save Medea, with whom he has fallen in love, before she is killed by the horrid monster.
cast: Gordon Scott, Alessandra Panaro, Rosalba Neri, Arturo Dominici

title: Ercole contro Roma
synopsis: In 244 the prefect Philip Afro had the Jordan Emperor slain with all his faithful, then he took up the throne of Rome. Giordano's daughter, Ulpia, however, is rescued by Hercules who arrived just in time from Pannonia. Then, with the consul Quinto Traiano, he moves against Afro.
cast: Sergio Ciani, Wandisa Guida, Daniele Vargas, Andrea Aureli, Livio Lorenzon, Dina De Santis, Carlo Tamberlani, Tullio Altamura, Simonetta Simeoni

title: Ercole contro i figli del sole
synopsis: This time Hercules is committed to righting the wrongs and punishing the evil ones in what was called the empire of the sun: the kingdom of the Peruvian Incas. Hercules arrives, rescues the daughter of the deposed king Huascar, defeats Athahualpa and puts an end to the raging struggle between the Incas. Giuliano Gemma is not Hercules, but Prince Maytha. After all, even Civirani is not a director.
cast: Mark Forest, Giuliano Gemma, Anna Maria Panaro, Giulio Donini

title: Ercole contro i tiranni di Babilonia
synopsis: The tyrants of Babylon, two brothers and a sister, took the queen of Hellas prisoner. Phaleg, king of Assyria, would like to marry her to take over the kingdom of the woman, but he gets a refusal from the Babylonians. Hercules intervenes and, among various betrayals, battles, destruction and other sensational events, we arrive at the triumph of the good and the punishment of the wicked.
cast: Peter Lupus, Mario Petri, Helga Liné, Anna Maria Polani, Livio Lorenzon, Tullio Altamura, Franco Balducci, Diego Pozzetto, Mirko Valentin, Diego Michelotti

title: Ercole e la regina di Lidia
synopsis: On the way to Thebes, his hometown, together with his woman and the young Ulysses, Hercules must fight against Antaeus; then, trying to pacify Thebes, outraged by the conflict between Eteocles and Polynice, sons of Oedipus, she falls victim to the spells of Onfale, queen of Lydia. Eteocles and Polynice succumb in the course of a deadly duel, while Ulysses with the Argonauts rescues Hercules and releases him from the enchantment.
cast: Steve Reeves, Sylva Koscina, Sylvia Lopez, Primo Carnera, Gabriele Antonini

title: Ercole l'invincibile
synopsis: Hercules, after killing a lion that terrified the king's daughter, ends up falling in love with it. The father, however, in exchange for the girl's love places as a condition the killing of a terrible dragon that slaughters his people. Of course the enterprise succeeds. When Hercules returns to the village to collect the coveted "prize", he realizes that everything has been destroyed by the violent tribe of Demios, who live in the extinct basin of a volcano. A thousand ups and downs still await our hero before the happy ending.
cast: Dan Vadis, Spela Rozin, Ken Clark, Carrol Brown, John Simons

title: Ercole sfida Sansone
synopsis: Hercules and Ulysses are shipwrecked among the Jews where Samson suspects they are spies of the Philistine oppressors. Between the two strongmen, Delilah also starts sowing discord. A harmless tale where the real protagonists are the scenarios and the papier-mâché boulders, as well as the shiny and always evident muscles of the two giants.
cast: Kirk Morris, Richard Lloyd, Liana Orfei, Enzo Cerusico, Aldo Giuffré

title: Ercole, Sansone, Maciste e Ursus gli invincibili
synopsis: Ercole is in love with the beautiful Onfale and would like to marry her. To win his love he would have to fight with Samson, but Delilah knocks out. the biblical hero cutting his hair. Lydia's messengers, not understanding why Samson did not accept the challenge, have him kidnapped by Ursus: but the latter, in turn, is punished by Maciste.
cast: Sergio Ciani, Howard Ross, Nadir Moretti, Yann Larvor, Moira Orfei, Luciano Marin, Hélène Chanel, Lia Zoppelli, Arnaldo Fabrizio, Livio Lorenzon

title: Ergastolo
synopsis: Rosa has an illegitimate son, Stefano, who lives with her in Professor Arlotta's house. The boy is twenty years old and is madly in love with Lydia, the professor's niece. Unfortunately the young man has the habit of gambling, and in order to pay off a gambling debt he is forced to accept the court of Jeannette, owner of the place where Stefano goes to play. Jeannette is the lover of Pasquale, a very influential Camorra leader. One day the boss is killed in Jeannette's house and trouble begins for Stefano ...
cast: Franco Interlenghi, Ignazio Balsamo, Marisa Merlini, Tina Pica

title: Eric Andre: Legalize Everything
synopsis: Eric Andre takes the stage in New Orleans and tackles flawed fast-food icons, the wonders of autofill and the bizarre choice for the "Cops" theme song.
cast: Eric André

title: Eric Clapton: A Life in 12 Bars
synopsis: "Clapton is God" was the phrase that, written on the walls of London, underlined how Eric Clapton had become for many a great hero of the rock guitar. Winner of 18 Grammy Awards, Clapton is universally recognized as one of the greatest performers of all time but behind his success lies restlessness and tragedy. His story, from his traumatic childhood to the long fight against drugs and alcohol, from the first successes to the death of his little son following the fall from the window of a New York skyscraper, is retraced through his own words and songs, counterpointed from the interventions of family, friends and musical collaborators.
cast: Eric Clapton

title: Eric ldle's What About Dick?
synopsis: In a madcap stage play from Monty Python icon Eric Idle, comic greats perform the decline and fall of the British Empire ... as told through a piano.
cast: Russell Brand, Billy Connolly, Tim Curry, Eric Idle, Eddie Izzard, Jane Leeves, Jim Piddock, Tracey Ullman, Sophie Winkleman

title: Erik il vichingo
synopsis: In the Middle Ages, Erik, to get away from his treacherous cousin who inherited the throne, sets out in search of new lands beyond the great sea. After a long and adventurous crossing and landing on an unknown continent: America. Here he will have to deal with indigenous tribes.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Gordon Mitchell, Eleonora Bianchi, Carrol Brown, Elisa Montes, Eduardo Fajardo, Beni Deus, Lucio De Santis, Roberto Ceccacci

title: Erik the Viking
synopsis: In the land of the Vikings the sun never rises. The young Erik (Robbins), on the advice of the sorceress Freya (Kitt), takes courage with four hands and leaves for the land of Argard where the Gods and Heroes who died in battle live. After defeating the Monster of the Oceans and the terrible Halfaan the Black, Erik succeeds in his feat, finally bringing the sun back to his land. You can smell Monty Python in this movie (there is John Cleese as well as Terry Jones himself), but there is not their unbridled comedy. A little undecided between that and fantasy, Jones remains halfway across the ford. Still excellent Tim Robbins.
cast: Tim Robbins, Terry Jones, Eartha Kitt, John Cleese

title: Erin Brockovich
synopsis: Erin Brockovich is an intelligent, purposeful, beautiful and flashy single mom. Instead of looking for another husband, look for a job; runs into a fat, rough but good-hearted lawyer and gets hired by him. It will be thanks to this new job of his that, with resourcefulness and a sense of justice, he will begin to investigate the Pacific Gas and Electric Company, which has contaminated the aquifers of a Californian town, causing cancer to residents.
cast: Julia Roberts, Albert Finney, Aaron Eckhart, David Brisbin, Dawn Didawick, Valente Rodriguez, Conchata Ferrell, George Rocky Sullivan, Pat Skipper, Jack Gill, Irene Olga López

title: Erinnerungen an die Zukunft
synopsis: Fantasy-archeology, pseudo-archeology or mysterious archeology: three ways of indicating that UFO branch born on the wave of the success of the writings of Erich von Däniken, then continued by the Italian Pier Domenico Colosimo. The documentary, through the analysis of unusual and abstruse archaeological finds (late Paleolithic rock graffiti portraying aliens and astronauts, proto-models of spaceships, Nazca lines, Egyptian and South American Pyramids) examines the extraterrestrial hypothesis as the primary cause of formation human cultural.
cast: Heinz Detlev Bock, Klaus Kindler, Christian Marschall, Aleksandr Kazantsev, Wiatscheslav Saitsew, Hans Domnick, Jean Fontaine, Thor Heyerdahl, Bruce Johansen, Hermann Oberth

title: Ermitage. Il potere dell'arte
synopsis: The docufilm, produced in close collaboration with the State Hermitage Museum in St. Petersburg, tells the great stories that have passed through the corridors of the museum and the streets of the city: from the founding of Peter I to the splendor of Catherine the Great, from the triumph of Alexander I against Napoleon, the Revolution of 1917, up to the present day. Spectacular images lead to the grandiose interiors of the Museum and the Winter Palace, to the Theater, to the Raphael Loggias, to the Heroes Gallery of 1812: a magical place revealed through the stories of the protagonists, the stories and secret places open to cameras for the occasion. An incomparable metropolis of art rich in over 3 million works. Inside the Hermitage, after all, you can retrace all the great European art, from Leonardo to Raphael, from Van Eyck to Rubens up to Titian and Rembrandt, while outside its walls history unfolds through places full of memories. But the legend of St. Petersburg is also transmitted through poems and novels that have shown its charm over the centuries, such as those of Nabokov, Dostoevskij and Achmatova. To visually tell the urban and architectural development, St. Petersburg is presented in its daytime guise and in the splendor of its nights, with Nevsky Prospect, the embankment, the bridges, the profile of the Hermitage complex, the Bronze Horseman, the statues by Pushkin, by Caterina the Great, by Gogol, the noble residences that overlook the canals, without forgetting the music and the work of the great Italian architects, such as Trezzini, Rastrelli, Quarenghi, who designed the profile.
cast: Toni Servillo

title: Ernest & Celestine
synopsis: In the world of bears, no one looks favorably on friendship with a mouse. Yet Ernest, a great bear clown and musician, welcomes Celestine to his home, an orphan who has escaped from the underworld of rodents. From that moment on, Ernest's life will be turned upside down thanks to a friendship that goes beyond any prejudice dictated by the differences between the world of mice and the world of bears.
director: Stéphane Aubier, Vincent Patar, Benjamin Renner

title: Ernest Goes to Camp
synopsis: A hateful and rather stupid boy decides he wants to become the group leader of a summer camp for boys at any cost. In the end, despite everything, he succeeds.
cast: Jim Varney, Victoria Racimo, John Vernon

title: Ernest et Célestine - Le Voyage en Charabie
synopsis: Ernest and Célestine go to his country of origin, Charabie, to make the violin repaired that has broken, but once they arrive they discover that the music has been banned over the entire country for many years now. They then decide to run for cover and they alleviate themselves with a mysterious masked executioner to bring music back everywhere.

title: Ernesto
synopsis: In Trieste in 1898, Ernesto (Martin Halm) is a Jewish boy from a petty-bourgeois family of merchants who lives with his mother (Virna Lisi) and uncles (Conchita Velasco and Francisco Marsó). Ernesto works as a trainee in the firm of Mr. Wilder (Turi Ferro) but has socialist sympathies and artistic aspirations. One of the laborers with whom he sympathizes (Michele Placido) falls in love with him and convinces him to make love in hiding. Ernesto, partly out of confusion and partly out of pride, decides not to see him again and resigns from the company. At a concert, one evening he meets another Jewish boy aspiring violinist, Emilio (Lara Wendel). The two fall in love but the third inconvenience is their twin sister Rachele (Lara Wendel).
cast: Martin Halm, Michele Placido, Virna Lisi, Turi Ferro, Lara Wendel, Concha Velasco, Francisco Marsó, Enrique San Francisco, Enrique Vivó, Gisela Hahn, Renato Salvatori

title: Ero in guerra ma non lo sapevo
synopsis: After more than thirty years of escape, in 2019 the terrorist of the P.A.C. Cesare Battisti is arrested in Bolivia and delivered to Italy to serve his sentence. Thus closes a story that began when the Torregian goldsmith was killed by Sicari specifically hired. The son, Alberto Torregiani was injured in the ambush and from that day he underwent the ordeal of a wheelchair due to a bullet that hit him in the back. Then he began for him a second life, which often led him to ask himself why so much pain and a lot of badness.
cast: Francesco Montanari, Laura Chiatti, Juju Di Domenico, Alessandro Tocco, Maria Vittoria Dallasta, Gianluca Gobbi, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Stefano Fregni, Luca Guastini, Paolo Pitossi, Raffaele Cantone, Michele Maccagno, Gualtiero Burzi

title: Erode il Grande
synopsis: Herod, king of Judea, rules with violence and terror. To avoid the invasion of his lands by the victorious Romans, he decides to parley with Octavian. On his departure for Rome, however, the intrigues of the palace are unleashed: the queen mother spreads the false news of his death preparing the accession to the throne of his brother-in-law, Aristobulus. While Herod's wife, Mariam, destined to be killed if her jealous consort was killed, is spared by the faithful Aron. Back home, Herod is so blinded by anger that his insane revenge will eventually overwhelm everything and everyone. Modest costume film made just before the Ercoli boom.
cast: Edmund Purdom, Sylvia Lopez, Massimo Girotti, Sandra Milo, Elena Zareschi, Alberto Lupo, Corrado Pani, Renato Baldini, Camillo Pilotto, Carlo D'Angelo, Enrico Glori

title: Eroi Kareshi Ga Watashi Wo Madowasu
synopsis: Sakaino Hitomi is an honest lady from a well-to-do family. She is envied by everyone for being engaged with Akashi Keigo, a man with a good appearance, high income, high education, and kindness. Hitomi is about to get married but suddenly becomes attracted to a man, Manabu, who she met at a construction site. (Source: DramaWiki)
tags: Miniseries, Infidelity, Sexual Content, Rich Woman/Poor Man, Love Square
cast: Matsui Airi, Kasamatsu Sho

title: Eroi all'inferno
synopsis: In WWII German-occupied France, some Allied soldiers break out of prison and join the local resistance. Together with a handful of partisans, they orchestrate a daring plan that involves the conquest of an important German outpost, the stealing of burning top secret documents and the kidnapping of a high-ranking Nazi officer.
cast: Lars Bloch, Ettore Manni, Rosemarie Lindt, Lu Kamante, Klaus Kinski, George Manes, Carlos Ewing, Franco Garofalo

title: Eroi per caso
synopsis: In 1918, during the last period of the First World War, a Roman photographer was called up. Together with Don Silvano, he accompanies a traitor soldier to the Trincea Torre. But the path to your destination is anything but simple.
cast: Flavio Insinna, Neri Marcoré, Ambra Angiolini, Michele Alhaique, Serena Rossi, Anna Dalton, Gigio Morra, Renato Scarpa, Giorgio Bongiovanni, Giovanni Moschella

title: Eroica
synopsis: Film built on two episodes, both set in the Second World War. In the first "Polish Scherzo", a cunning boy, in an attempt to save his skin, becomes a hero and finds a reason to fight.
cast: Edward Dziewonski, Barbara Polomska, Ignacy Machowski

title: Eros
synopsis: Three short films directed by Wong Kar-wai, Steven Soderbergh, Michelangelo Antonioni. In _La mano_, set in Shanghai in 1963, Chang, a tailor's apprentice, is seduced by the body measurements of Miss Hua, a charming and handsome high-class prostitute. In _Equilibrium_ we are in New York in 1955: an advertiser is obsessed with the recurring dream of a woman he knows but cannot remember when he wakes up. Ironically, his psychoanalyst during their first analytic session is continually distracted by an attractive woman peering through the windows of the office. Finally in _The dangerous thread of things_, set in today's Tuscany, a forty-year-old couple in crisis decides to take a short trip to the sea to rediscover some magic in their relationship. Her husband's passion, on the other hand, seems to awaken thanks to the meeting with a young woman with a free spirit.

director: Wong Kar Wai, Steven Soderbergh, Michelangelo Antonioni

title: Erotic Games in the Third Galaxy
Erotic Nights of the Living Dead
Erotikon
synopsis: Entomologist Lev neglects his wife Irene, preferring to spend time at work and with his seductive granddaughter Marthe. Irene, far from despairing, consoles herself by dividing herself between Preben and Felix.

title: Erotique
synopsis: Los Angeles: Rosie, aspiring actress who dreams of abandoning herself to perverse transgressions to land the Lunario works in a chat line. Tired of telling his fantasies by phone, he decides to live them seriously. Hamburg: two girls looking for adventures are wandering for the city nightclubs, they are looking for a lover for Julia. But at some point, the man finds herself flals jealousy. Hong Kong: Adrian, an Australian of Chinese origin meets Ann an old love of the school's times and to conquer it he must rediscover the ancient Chinese love rites.

director: Lizzie Borden, Monika Treut, Clara Law

title: Errante corazón
synopsis: Santiago, a single and gay father, has reached a turning point in his life. Upset by a bitter sentimental break, he also has to face the imminent departure of his daughter Laila, with whom he has a strong bond. Since the fear of remaining only annihilates it, begins to behave in an increasingly unruly way. During a chaotic summer between Argentina and Brazil, Santiago will have to learn to let Laila go so that everyone can find their freedom.

title: Errementari
synopsis: Ten years have passed since the First Carlist War of 1833. In the small village of Avala, a government commissioner named Alfredo investigates a case that takes him deep into the forests in the presence of the blacksmith Patxi, a dangerous and lonely man. The inhabitants of the area tell strange stories related to robberies, murders and demonic pacts, until the orphan Usue accidentally arrives in the mysterious workshop, revealing the truth behind Patxi.

Among the characters they meet are the actor Vernacchio, the Hermaphrodite, the Minotaur, the enriched freedman Trimalcione and the poet Eumolpo, in an initiation story with a tragic outcome. Drawing inspiration from the work of Petronius Arbiter and giving free rein to his unbridled vision, Fellini draws a fresco in which the defects and "sins" of modernity are reflected, hidden and distorted under the guise of a phantasmagoric and funereal staging.
cast: Martin Potter, Hiram Keller, Max Born, Salvo Randone, Mario Romagnoli

title: Fellini degli spiriti
synopsis: Deeply in love with life, Fellini went through his life always looking for its meaning. Anselma Dell'Olio investigates in depth his passion for what he called, in short, the mystery, the esoteric, the "unseen world" in an incessant search for other possibilities, other dimensions, other journeys and all that it can make the spirit and the mind fly. These aspects, present throughout his cinematography, were initially his object of investigation with the great Jungian psychoanalyst Ernst Bernhard, who not only revealed to him the secrets of the Unconscious, but also showed him a new vision of the world through the Tarot reading and IChing consultation. But it will be the meeting with Professor Gustavo Rol, known for Juliet of the spirits, who, through his experiments, will prove to him that other dimensions really exist and that there is no end to the journey of human beings.

title: Fellini fine mai
synopsis: Federico Fellini relives through the power of images, sounds and photographs kept by Rai Teche: fragments of life and poetics of cinema, often unknown, and revealed by those who had the good fortune to work with him and share his experience as precisely Eugenio Cappuccio, who reconstructs the path that led him to meet Fellini in Rimini when he was just a teenager and then, after studying at the Experimental Center of Cinematography, to collaborate as an assistant on the set of Ginger and Fred. Through repertoire materials and interviews, Cappuccio starts from the places where Fellini began to tell his stories, and launches himself towards new discoveries of his "secret world" which will find its maximum expression in the possibilities offered by Cinecittà: a sort of " revelation "on what gave shape and life to many of the most beautiful films in the history of cinema, an intimate personal and family journey, but also a look at Fellini's" unfinished "in many ways even more enigmatic.

title: Fellinopolis
synopsis: Accompanied by backstage images and interviews with Fellini's closest collaborators, you have the opportunity to observe "through the hole of the lock" the master at work and discover new aspects of man and his creative process. At the request of Fellini, Ferruccio Castronuovo had the unique privilege of being able to run on the sets of Casanova, the city of women, and the ship Va and Ginger and Fred, documenting and revealing the elements of the "great game", the inventions and " Bugie "by the director. The exceptional shots of Castronuovo meet the memories of the professionals who worked with Fellini, including Oscar prizes Lina Wertmüller, Nicola Piovani and Dante Ferretti, while talking about their work and their life experience in Fellinopolis, the imaginary city behind the scenes of his films.

title: Given
synopsis: Tightly clutching his Gibson guitar, Mafuyu Satou steps out of his dark apartment to begin another day of his high school life. Noticing Uenoyama's knowledge of the instrument, Satou pleads for him to fix it and to teach him how to play. Uenoyama eventually agrees and invites him to sit in on a jam session with his two bandmates: bassist Haruki Nakayama and drummer Akihiko Kaji. Satou's voice is strikingly beautiful, filling Uenoyama with the determination to make Satou the lead singer of the band. Though reticent at first, Satou takes the offer after an emotional meeting with an old friend. With the support of his new friends, Satou must not only learn how to play guitar but also come to terms with the mysterious circumstances that led him to be its owner.
