This and other elements lead Rankin to suspect that it may have been Tenant, suffering from paralysis and attacks of violence, the real killer of the five girls, probably acting in a trance state. synopsis: The more than one hundred-year-old relationship between cinema and war, from their first meeting, back in 1911, on the occasion of the Italian invasion of Libya, up to the present day. This is how a reflection on images is configured and, as in a great novel divided into four chapters - distant past, near past, present and future -, the work tries to recompose the fragments of visual memory from the early 1900s to today and puts on stage the multiplication of visions that, like a constant background noise, accompany our current lives. Four important European institutions host the narration of the film and constitute its solid space-time framework. From the constant research and restoration of ancient war films of the Istituto Luce in Rome; to the daily life of the Crisis Unit of the Italian Foreign Ministry with its monitors permanently on the world; from the training of young soldiers who learn to produce war images at the Ecpad (Military Archive and Image Agency of the French Ministry of Defense); to the conservation of the precious archives of the International Red Cross kept at the Swiss Film Archive in Lausanne, the directors D'Anolfi and Parenti tell how the aesthetics of war, much more than the aesthetics of peace, have always accompanied us, reflecting and projecting ourselves into the ephemeral present that surrounds us. And they question the consequences of the war, the meaning of history and the preservation of memory for the benefit of future generations.

Kan doesn't have a good reputation with his co-workers or customers, but Kurosu Kanako recognizes something in him. Kanako is a mysterious woman. She tells Kan that she is going to open a French restaurant soon and that "The staff needs originality. You will be a good serviceman." The French restaurant is located in a cemetery, which is itself away from the busy streets and residential areas. The staff at the French restaurant do not appear suited for such a restaurant. Kawai Taichi was once an apprentice to become a hairdresser. Tsutsumi Keitaro worked as the manager of a rice & beef bowl restaurant for five years. Ozawa Yukio worked as a chef, but all of the restaurants where he worked went out of business. Lastly, Yamagata Shigeomi worked as a sommelier after he retired as a bank executive. Why does Kanako gather these people? Will the French restaurant open? (Source: AsianWiki)

The girls rebel against the conformism and greyness of the society that surrounds them and give free rein to their imagination: they take refuge in their little unreal world, contrary to the hypocrisy of the family and the formalism of the school. When Pauline's mother threatens to separate them, the girl doesn't hesitate to kill her. Peter Jackson comes from the most bloody and smashing horror, and this passage to the "high" cinema (honored with a Silver Lion in Venice) retains traces of his heterodox past. Delusional dream moments, with appearances of a double of Orson Welles, the erotic idol of the two protagonists. The film is bizarre and obnoxious (girls are no better than the world they rebel against), and it is possible to prefer other, more "dirty" titles by the same director.

title: Heimat - Eine Chronik in elf Teilen
synopsis: Made by Edgar Reitz Filmproduktion between 1979 and 2006 (30 chapters, 55 hours in duration), Heimat is an immense saga on the history of Germany that spans a span of time from 1919 to the beginning of the third millennium. From Schabbach, an imaginary village in the Rhineland, the director's region of origin, and with large sections in Munich and Berlin, through the events of the Simon family, Reitz follows the evolution of German history, its tragedies and the profound transformations experienced in the span of a century. It is a complex reconstruction of historical memory in search of the deepest roots of the German soul, torn apart by the events of the twentieth century. The point of view adopted is that of the "humble", common people protagonists of the truest history of a country, and the re-foundation of the authentic and profound concept of Heimat that derives from it is in stark contrast to the sweetened celebrations of the Heimatfilm, for a long time present in German cinema, from the years of Nazism to the 1950s. The work is divided into three sections and an epilogue: Heimat - A German story; Heimat 2 -History of a youth; Heimat 3 - Chronicle of an epochal turning point; Heimat Fragmente.

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Abschied von Schabbach

Who, what, why? Nobody has clear ideas, there are those in jail, the old people suffer and die, an earthquake upsets men and things and not even the homeland is the same anymore. Gathering characters and emotions the puppeteer Reitz makes the last center: the visionary scene of the return to Schabbach is extraordinary in its fantastic rate and that finale with Mozart played by the child who will be great in the 2000s leaves us with a feeling of reasoned and pessimistic yearning of the heart and reason.

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Allen geht's gut
synopsis: 1995. Hermann lives a period of contradiction and inner malaise, which greatly depend on negative events: love with Clarissa is in crisis, due to his wife's desire to free herself from domestic security, symbolized by the nest on the mountain. Hermann's family of origin loses his elder brother, Anton, also a symbol: mentor of a Germany that is passing, cynical but capable, determined; Finally, the mutual indifference between Hermann and his daughter Lulu reaches the most painful paroxysm. Collaterally, the contradictory life of his nephew Hartmut, son of Anton, is fulfilled, divided, but with the same enthusiasm, between his farsighted projects, in the entrepreneurial field, and his private life with Galina (who is afraid to live his new life): but a much bleaker future seems to be looming for the spoiled scion of the old Anton, someone is preparing to present him the bill. The cynical and aloof Ernst at his brother's grave improvises an intense and atypical funeral oration; he declares his affection for that feared and admired brother, despite the differences. At the funeral of the patriarch, Hermann finds his first wife, Lulu's mother ... A bitter episode that makes some recent experiences and traces the epilogue of other older ones. Hermann is crossed back from his past: the fixed points, which he believed to be such and stainless, seem to dissolve or die, leaving him in full, conscious, solitude; on the other hand the pain (also physical: it ends with a leg inside a trap), makes it artistically reborn: this seems to define an equation. Clarissa was secretly certain of this equation: family stasis risked killing her artistically, just as it had already killed the music in her husband. But the equations seem to have life until they are interpreted; they create causes and effects and link them together: but, more often than not, arbitrarily. Hermann and Clarissa then review, in their own way, selfishly and egocentric, all the mosaic composed so far and their existences, but in a fatalistic way. Until the heavy symbols of each one are not confronted, and the weak between the two (at least temporarily) succumbs: each person carries with him his own experience, and manifests it, directs it into the future. So Clarissa decides to do, while Hermann loses direction and floats adrift. Anton's life suddenly ends. A life that consciously represents that rebirth of Germany destroyed by war, and which has focused on quality, sacrificing even its own freedom, in the name of work. But he dies happy, after yet another victory (albeit football), and despite his children, today, are only related by legal means. Hartmut, who still has the aura of a little boy, begins to understand that the strength of his father lives within him: but he sacrifices those schemes, and social roles, for a life outside the tradition more suited to the parent. That parent that the child experienced as a coercive shadow that cools everything in rationality, which now, surprisingly, he misses. But Hartmut is convinced of this: times have changed, quality is a concept that no longer pays, a more globalized vision of the market is born; you can not spend more than you earn, and this, on the death of the father, he also says to the employees, who, in response, desert the wake of the old master. Anton's funeral is little attended, without a priest, the relatives are around an unprecedented cinerary urn (a novelty of the times), which denounces a cultural impoverishment and of the collective soul: an ingratitude immediately stigmatized by the difficult and unconventional Ernst, The antithetical and mad brother of Anton and Hermann, his funeral oration, is perhaps the highest moment of the entire third series of Heimat.

The almost 16 hours of screening tell the story. choral of a family and a village and, through this, the history of the German nation from the end of the First World War to the 1980s. A river-movie that took Edgar Reitz and his collaborators more than 5 years, one and a half of which just for filming. Reitz has been able to distil emotions and sensations: a series of contrasts and nuances from whose skilful juxtaposition the image of Germany emerges, involving and complex.

synopsis: The attitude of Judge Valerio Rossello and his wife Lucia towards their only child Maurizio is very different: the father is inflexible, the mother more permissive. But when Maurizio finds himself in trouble with the law ...
cast: Isa Miranda, Carlo Ninchi, Vittorio De Sica, Sandro Ninchi

title: I coltelli del vendicatore
synopsis: Arald, at the head of a tribe of Vikings, for three years traveling with his warriors, is struck in the dearest affections (his wife and son) by Aghen, an adventurer of few scruples. His kidnapping attempts are, however, frustrated by Rurik, a mysterious stranger. He is, in reality, the noble prince of a tribe who, years earlier, to avenge the death of his father and wife, had attacked the presumed guilty tribe of Arald.
cast: Cameron Mitchell, Fausto Tozzi, Jack Rossi Stuart, Luciano Polletin

title: I compagni
synopsis: At the end of the last century, in a Turin textile industry, a serious accident sparked off the first workers' protests against inhuman working conditions. The protest turns into a harsh strike, led by Professor Sinigaglia, during which a worker dies. The workers return to the factory, defeated, but with a thread of hope. Bankruptcy at the box office, it remains Monicelli's masterpiece despite some pathetic excesses. Perhaps too ahead of its time, it was an interesting attempt to turn the Italian comedy towards social commitment and historical reconstruction. Screenplay by Monicelli, Age and Scarpelli (which got the nomination).
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Renato Salvatori, Annie Girardot, Gabriella Giorgelli, Folco Lulli, Bernard Blier, Raffaella Carrà, François Périer, Vittorio Sanipoli

title: I complessi
synopsis: Episode movies. A very shy Nino Manfredi reveals himself to his beloved at the wrong moment; a husband all home and church discovers his wife's somewhat risque past; Deaf, aspiring journalist, although he has what it takes, he is rejected by the television for his excessive set of teeth. The most famous and funniest episode is the one with Sordi, directed by Luigi Filippo D'Amico and with appearances by TV stars of the time, from Nanni Loy to Luttazzi and the Kessler twins.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Ugo Tognazzi, Alberto Sordi, Ilaria Occhini, Riccardo Garrone, Umberto D'Orsi, Claudie Lange, Paola Borboni, Claudio Gora, Romolo Valli
director: Dino Risi, Luigi Filippo D'Amico, Franco Rossi

title: I contrabbandieri di Santa Lucia
synopsis: After the coup d'etat in Iran, a large quantity of drugs from the country of the dismissed Shah passed from hand to hand until reaching Naples. An FBI agent seeks help from an organization of "honest" smugglers to track down the cargo and vanquish the traffickers.
cast: Mario Merola, Antonio Sabato, Gianni Garko

title: I corpi estranei
synopsis: Little Pietro has a brain tumor and together with his father Antonio (Filippo Timi) is in Milan, the city where the two emigrated from the south with the hope of a glimmer of salvation. The fifteen-year-old Jaber, on the other hand, arrived in the Lombard capital recently together with a group of compatriots fleeing from a North Africa in turmoil due to the riots of the Arab Spring. It is in the hospital, where he is to assist his brotherly friend Youssef, that Jaber meets Antonio for the first time, who like him is a lonely and frightened soul struggling with pain and precariousness.
cast: Filippo Timi, Jaouher Brahim, Gabriel De Glaudi, Tijey De Glaudi, Dragos Toma, Naim Chalbi, El Farouk Abd Alla

title: I corpi presentano tracce di violenza carnale
synopsis: A maniac brutally kills several girls and some witnesses, then dies fleeing after an authentic massacre.
cast: Suzy Kendall, Tina Aumont, Luc Merenda, John Richardson, Roberto Bisacco, Ernesto Colli, Angela Covello, Carla Brait, Conchita Airoldi, Patrizia Adiutori

title: I corvi ti scaveranno la fossa
synopsis: A transport company hires a bounty hunter and some gunslingers to defend itself from bandit raids. One of these, Jack Sullivan, also has a personal revenge to do: the criminal Glenn Kovacks has in fact murdered his wife ...
cast: Craig Hill, Fernando Sancho, Dominique Boschero

title: I cosacchi
synopsis: To control the Circassians, submissive but not dominated, the Russians take young Jamal hostage, the son of chief Chamil, and send him to Petersburg where he will attend a school for officer cadets. Jamal swears allegiance to the tsar and will even save his life, which angers his father who in the meantime has decided to resume the guerrilla war. The Russian troops, under the command of Prince Voronzoff, move against the Circassians and Chamil resolves to imprison Jamal himself along with Tatiana, the daughter of Voronzoff with whom he is in love. But the two manage to escape and ...
cast: Edmund Purdom, John Drew Barrymore, Pierre Brice, Massimo Girotti, Giorgia Moll

title: I criminali della galassia
cast: Tony Russel, Lisa Gastoni, Massimo Serato, Franco Nero, Carlo Giustini

title: I crudeli
synopsis: The Civil War is now over, but not for Colonel Jonas (Joseph Cotten) who, having taken refuge across the Mexican border, plans to reorganize the Confederate troops thanks to a large amount of gold stolen during the war.
cast: Joseph Cotten, Al Mulock, Norma Bengell, Aldo Sambrell, Gino Pernice

title: I cuori infranti
synopsis: Carlo is about to marry a girl from a good family, but his ex-lover manages to screw up the marriage by accusing him of theft. A modern couple shares the work: she hits the pavement, he looks after the baby. When she gets sick and cannot exercise, he offers to replace her in prostitution. Film composed of two very different episodes: the first is the classic pochade, while the next is a bitter look at an Italy that is beginning to need more and more money to satisfy the need for consumption. Sexy role for Paola Quattrini, former child prodigy and subsequently an excellent theatrical actress.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Franca Valeri, Paola Quattrini, Norma Bengell, Aldo Giuffré, Linda Sini, Dany París, Tino Buazzelli

title: I delfini
synopsis: In an Italian provincial town, young people of the rich bourgeoisie amuse themselves between boring parties and squalid loves. A poor girl is also introduced into the tour who, pregnant, will force the rich Alberto to marry her; and a city doctor, Mario. The good time of these "dolphins" will last only a year: between marriages and bankruptcies all their hypocrisies and falsehoods will come to the surface.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Antonella Lualdi, Betsy Blair, Sergio Fantoni, Anna Maria Ferrero, Tomas Milian, Gérard Blain, Enzo Garinei, Germana Paolieri

title: I delitti del BarLume - A bocce ferme
synopsis: An old case never resolved from 1968 is reopened when a well -known industrialist dies and thanks to his testament it turns out that he was the one who killed his father for the inheritance. The result is an investigation that also involves the old people of Barlume, which could remember some details of the time, fundamental for history.
cast: Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Michele Di Mauro, Giordana Faggiano, Guglielmo Favilla, Stefano Fresi, Enrica Guidi, Corrado Guzzanti, Daniele Marmi, Marcello Marziali, Lucia Mascino, Massimo Paganelli, Filippo Timi

title: I delitti del BarLume - Aria di mare
synopsis: Il BarLume still bears the signs of Tiziana's destructive fury, customers are scarce, debts increase and Massimo can only drown his bad thoughts in the use and abuse of alcohol and psychiatric drugs. Even Fusco is not doing better: replaced by the obtuse Commissioner Tassone, she finds herself managing the office for lost and found objects due to the troubles she made the previous summer. But when the body of a colleague of Tiziana is found, in the supply warehouse where the girl went to work, Fusco sees the possibility of redeeming herself and works to solve the case first. At his side there will once again be Massimo, who thanks to one of his brilliant intuitions, will understand that to find the murderer they will first have to solve the mystery about the real identity of the victim, a mystery that seems to be linked to the presence in the village of the famous blind pianist De Matteis, with whom the old men have engaged in a battle of jokes and sold to the death.
cast: Filippo Timi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Massimo Paganelli, Marcello Marziali, Atos Davini, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Piera Degli Esposti

title: I delitti del BarLume - Azione e reazione
synopsis: In Pineta, a Russian tourist drains a Cuba Libre at the BarLume and falls to the poisoned dead ground. But was he really the victim of the ambush or maybe someone wanted to kill Massimo? And why does the Fusco seem more elusive than usual? While the beautiful Tiziana juggles between the service at the tables and the counter and the old men kill time between jokes and gossip, Massimo and Fusco proceed with their investigations between sudden illuminations and continuous squabbles.
cast: Filippo Timi, Lucia Mascino, Alessandro Benvenuti, Enrica Guidi, Atos Davini, Massimo Paganelli, Marcello Marziali

title: I delitti del BarLume - Compro oro
synopsis: Massimo and Commissioner Fusco return to investigate the case of the murder of a gold buyer, in Pineta, which overlaps an old unresolved case.
cast: Annalisa Arena, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Michele Di Mauro, Guglielmo Favilla, Stefano Fresi, Enrica Guidi, Corrado Guzzanti, Thomas Kadman, Daniele Marmi, Marcello Marziali, Lucia Mascino, Massimo Paganelli, Alfio Sorbello, Filippo Timi

title: I delitti del BarLume - Donne con le palle
synopsis: Pineta hosts the women's beach volleyball playoffs and Beppe (Stefano Fresi), thanks to the new piano of the BarLume, seems to impress one of the players, making Tizi (Enrica Guidi) jealous. Meanwhile Fusco (Lucia Mascino) and Tassone (Michele Di Mauro) have to deal with a new murder case, with the usual contribution of Pasquale (Corrado Guzzanti), Beppe, Emo (Alessandro Benvenuti) and all the old men of BarLume. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to everyone, none other than Massimo Viviani (Filippo Timi) returns to the village.
cast: Filippo Timi, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Stefano Fresi, Corrado Guzzanti, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Massimo Paganelli

title: I delitti del BarLume - Hasta Pronto Viviani
synopsis: After a life stopped in Pineta, at the age of seventy the old men leave their beloved BarLume to fly overseas towards Buenos Aires: Massimo's new Argentine girlfriend has come to ask for help because Viviani has been kidnapped. And, while the quartet goes on an adventure, the sleepy summer season of Pineta is interrupted by an inexplicable robbery at the BarLume, in which Beppe risks dying but, by mistake, remains dry by one of the two criminals. As usual, it will be up to Fusco to understand something ...
cast: Filippo Timi, Stefano Fresi, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Massimo Paganelli, Corrado Guzzanti

title: I delitti del BarLume - Il Battesimo di Ampelio
synopsis: Everything is ready for the baptism of Tizi's son when the priest's corpse is found. From here begins a daring investigation that sees Pasquali and a chameleon-like femme fatale under investigation. Will Fusco be able to solve the mystery this time too? Meanwhile, another mystery deepens. What's going on at Viviani? A beautiful Argentine girl introduces herself to the old men of the BarLume by surprise: Massimo is in trouble and needs their help.
cast: Filippo Timi, Stefano Fresi, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Massimo Paganelli, Corrado Guzzanti

title: I delitti del BarLume - Il re dei giochi
synopsis: Massimo (Filippo Timi), a former mathematician who dropped out of university, runs the bar in the Tuscan village of Pineta. Among the patrons of the restaurant, there are four customers who, after the age of seventy, have no intention of enjoying their retirement: Ampelio (Carlo Monni), Aldo (Massimo Paganelli), Pilade (Atos Davini) and Gino (Marcello Marziale) ). When a car accident causes the death of the son of a head of the press office of a local politician, the four are convinced that there is something else behind them and begin to investigate, hindering the work of Commissioner Fusco (Lucia Mascino). However, it will be up to Massimo to resolve the case.
cast: Filippo Timi, Carlo Monni, Massimo Paganelli, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Enrica Guidi, Lucia Mascino, Paolo Cioni, Massimo Salvianti, Olga Rossi, Sergio Pierattini

title: I delitti del BarLume - Il telefono senza fili
synopsis: Summer is back in Pineta. Same bar, same faces and a new mystery to solve for the bartender Massimo and Commissioner Fusco. The famous magician Atlante, an occult scientist or rather a great scoundrel, keeper of the secrets of half the country, is murdered. The murderer may be hiding among his clients, but who were they and why did they go to him? And why did the owner of a farm outside Pineta disappear a few days before his death?
cast: Filippo Timi, Lucia Mascino, Alessandro Benvenuti, Enrica Guidi, Atos Davini, Massimo Paganelli, Marcello Marziali

title: I delitti del BarLume - La battaglia navale
synopsis: The BarLume elders embark on a crusade to prevent the construction of a resort in a beautiful bay, where the body of Olga, a young Ukrainian with a disfigured face, is found. And while Inspector Fusco investigates using Beppe as a weird aide, Olga's husband arrives in Pineta, a criminal who has mistreated her for years. Who then is the woman found in the bay?
cast: Filippo Timi, Stefano Fresi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Massimo Paganelli, Marcello Marziali, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Mara Maionchi, Corrado Guzzanti

title: I delitti del BarLume - La briscola in cinque
synopsis: At dawn on a Sunday morning, with the after-effects of an evening at the disco, Marchino finds the body of a young and beautiful girl in an abandoned shed just outside Pineta. Our Viviani will be forced to investigate alongside Fusco to solve this mysterious case. Between the jokes of the old men, the jealousies of Tiziana and the constant two of spades of Vittoria, Massimo will discover that whoever is on your team is not always your ally.
cast: Filippo Timi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Massimo Paganelli, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Paolo Cioni, Claudio Bigagli

title: I delitti del BarLume - La carta più alta
synopsis: Aldo is forced to close his restaurant due to a flood and the owner of a prestigious resort offers him the management of the building. Convinced, however, that twenty years earlier the owner of the resort had killed the old one to get the building, Aldo and his 70-year-old friends Ampelio, Pilade and Gino, begin to investigate him, also involving Massimo, the owner of the BarLume in convalescence for a broken knee.
cast: Filippo Timi, Carlo Monni, Massimo Paganelli, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Enrica Guidi, Lucia Mascino, Paolo Cioni, Olga Rossi, Mariella Valentini, Paolo Pierobon

title: I delitti del BarLume - La loggia del cinghiale
synopsis: Despite all the antidepressants he swallows, Massimo is increasingly down and obsessed with the thought of Tiziana, now unreachable. To cheer him up, the old men of the BarLume drag him into a funny and delirious bachelor party organized by the Loggia del Cinghiale, a band of jokers of which the four are part. Too bad, however, that the dead man escapes and everyone ends up at the police station. The killer can only be one of the party's attendees, but who? Fusco does not want to believe it but the more she goes on in the reconstruction of the evening, the more she realizes that the greatest suspect is precisely Massimo who, due to a deadly cocktail of alcohol and antidepressants, no longer remembers anything. It will be only thanks to sudden intuitions, bizarre stories, squabbles with Tiziana and self-esteem collapses, that Massimo will be able to retrieve all the pieces of the puzzle from his memory and recompose his innocence. But he will be able to do nothing against Tiziana, who will need the worst of revenge with a final twist.
cast: Filippo Timi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Massimo Paganelli, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Paolo Cioni

title: I delitti del BarLume - La tombola dei troiai
synopsis: Massimo Viviani can't even stay in peace during the funeral of his uncle Ampelio: a scream calls the whole town, someone has killed the pharmacist. The old men, world champions of Bar gossip, are sure it was Emo, Massimo's former father-in-law. But Commissioner Fusco is not convinced. Viviani will clarify a funny Christmas raffle and therefore on the case, but will get confused a lot between the advances of her beautiful counter agent Tiziana and those of Vittoria Fusco.
cast: Filippo Timi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Massimo Paganelli, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Paolo Cioni, Claudio Bigagli

title: I delitti del BarLume - Mare forza quattro
synopsis: A strong storm at the end of March hits the Pineta seafront destroying the tables and chairs of the beloved BarLume. Will it be a metaphor for the arrival of the virus? When in doubt, the old men, with the exception of Bandinelli, have already shut themselves up in the house and thus cannot witness the discovery of the body that the storm brought under the bar. The case turns out to be mangy for Fusco but luckily Viviani is there to give her a hand.
cast: Filippo Timi, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Stefano Fresi, Corrado Guzzanti, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Massimo Paganelli

title: I delitti del BarLume - Ritorno a Pineta
synopsis: The life of the inhabitants of Pineta, enlivened by the investigations of Commissioner Fusco and the presence of the old men of the BarLume, is marked by the unexpected return of Massimo Viviani. After the misadventures in South America and the intervention of her "children", Viviani returns home and has to deal with all the changes that have occurred during her absence. Returning to the death of a friend of his who committed suicide, Massimo is convinced that he was killed. And it will be his intuitions that will lend a hand to Fusco in resolving the case.
cast: Filippo Timi, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Stefano Fresi, Corrado Guzzanti, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Massimo Paganelli

title: I delitti del BarLume - Tana libera tutti
synopsis: The lockdown due to CoVid-19 also started in Pineta. The streets are deserted and, in addition to forced cohabitation, such as that of Tiziana and Massimo and that of Pasquali and Beppe, the old men of BarLume have to make peace with technology. Pasquali, with the excuse of learning Spanish, has video-call appointments with Dolores, a beautiful Spanish, who suddenly disappears. Pasquali does not give himself peace and involves Massimo first and then also the old people to understand what has happened.
cast: Filippo Timi, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Stefano Fresi, Corrado Guzzanti, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Marcello Marziali, Massimo Paganelli

title: I delitti del BarLume - Un due tre stella!
synopsis: The new bathing season in Pineta is upon us, when Viviani (Filippo Timi) suddenly disappears. Is it in danger? Did he leave voluntarily? Or did the aliens kidnap him, how are Gino (Marcello Marziale) and Pilade (Atos Davini) convinced? While Commissioner Fusco (Lucia Mascino) tries to solve the murder of an old sailor, it will be understood that the two mysteries are deeply linked and the link seems to be Beppe Battaglia (Stefano Fresi), a Lebowski with the accent of the Tufello unexpectedly linked to our Viviani. The newfound quiet, however, cannot last also because, by now we know, in Pineta you cannot spend a quiet summer.
cast: Filippo Timi, Stefano Fresi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Atos Davini, Massimo Paganelli, Marcello Marziali, Lucia Mascino, Enrica Guidi, Mara Maionchi, Corrado Guzzanti

title: I demoni di San Pietroburgo
synopsis: St. Petersburg, 1860. An attack causes the death of a member of the imperial family. A few days later the writer Fyodor Mikhajlovic Dostoyevsky meets Gusiev, a young man who is hospitalized in a psychiatric hospital and who confesses to him that he was part of the terrorist group, revealing that his comrades are preparing a plan to eliminate another relative of the Tsar. The young man also reveals the address of Aleksandra, their leader. Despite being shocked, pressured by creditors, by the imminent deadline for delivery of a new book and by the frequent epilepsy attacks, Dostoyevsky is committed to finding her and convincing her to stop this new terrorist act.
cast: Miki Manojlovic, Carolina Crescentini, Anita Caprioli, Roberto Herlitzka, Filippo Timi, Sandra Ceccarelli, Giordano De Plano, Giovanni Martorana, Stefano Saccotelli, Emilio De Marchi, Anna Basso De Marc

title: I diafanoidi vengono da Marte
synopsis: The solar system is invaded by aliens, evanescent and greenish beings made only of light. They settle on Mars, which they transform into their base, and launch an attack on Earth's space stations, killing or hypnotizing crew members. Their goal is the conquest of planet Earth. But the Grounders, led by the valiant commander Mike Halstead, send a fleet on a mission to destroy the Martian base.
cast: Tony Russell, Lisa Gastoni, Franco Nero, Carlo Giustini, Michel Lemoine, Enzo Fiermonte, Linda Sini

title: I diamanti che nessuno voleva rubare
synopsis: Spiros, an old paralytic usurer, summons five criminals of different nationalities to his home in Rome to carry out a big blow against a jewelry store. The blow, studied by Spiros in every detail, is made with extreme ease by the five bandits, who, however, not wanting to submit to the conditions imposed by their inspirer, do not hesitate to kill him. In turn, they are exterminated with machine gun shots by a very faithful friend of Spiros, while another gang of criminals, who had managed to take possession of the stolen jewels, soon ends up in the hands of the police. Only one of the bandits, Fangio, manages to escape capture, fleeing on board a plane to Switzerland, in the company of Ursula, Spiros's beautiful secretary, with whom he fell in love during the preparatory phase of the coup.
cast: John Elliot, Aldo Giuffré, Salvo Randone, Jeanne Valerie, Mario Brega

title: I diari di Angela - Noi due cineasti. Capitolo secondo
synopsis: The documentary first tells the private life of the Gianikian Cup and Ricci Lucchi, revealing what the two directors lived while the films in the pipeline - on the violence of the wars, on colonialism and fascism - took shape. In particular, he resumes the writings of the soldiers, mutilated and prisoners of the war. The pages describe some places of the battles, the boundaries of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, show the face and sharp gaze of Freya Stark in Asolo and make Walter Chiari's unmistakable voice rethink in Soviet Armenia. In those years simultaneously with the war trilogy the two worked in the march of man, a great installation. Then they are dedicated to the twentieth century triptych, which began in 2002 and ended in 2008 for the Mart of Rovereto. Among the many themes developed are the end of the Second World War, hunger, and the economic miracle.

title: I diavoli della guerra
synopsis: A German lieutenant frees the American prisoners with whom he has faced a march in the Tunisian desert. But the killing logic of war triumphs in the end. Adalberto Albertini came to direct in 1968 after twenty years as an operator.
cast: Guy Madison, Venantino Venantini, Pascale Petit, Anthony Steel, Enrique Avila, Raf Baldassarre, Claudio Biava, Federico Boido, Frank Braña, Giuseppe Castellano

title: I dieci gladiatori
synopsis: Ten gladiators led by Glauco Valerio conspire against Nero. They will manage to eliminate him but not before the emperor has set fire to Rome. Modest film of the gladiatorial genre. The athletic sequences of the clashes in the arena are interesting.
cast: Roger Browne, Susan Paget, Dan Vadis, Mirko Ellis, Giuliano Dell'Ovo

title: I divertimenti della vita privata
synopsis: In the Paris of the French Revolution, the beautiful wife of a deputy is temporarily replaced by an actress, who is also a prostitute, and then disappears. It will be known that she is a voluntary prisoner in the castle of an old libertine; while the fake lady fits perfectly into the new respectable existence.
cast: Delphine Forest, Christophe Malavoy, Giancarlo Giannini, Vittorio Gassman, Roberto Infascelli (II), Roberto Citran, Nathalie Guetta, Luciano Barcaroli

title: I dritti
synopsis: Aldo has only one philosophy in life: that of being smart, taking shortcuts, being able to cheat others. Then he gets in trouble, gets framed by a cuckold husband (because of him) and even ends up in jail. Behind the bars he repents and is illuminated by Tosca's love.
cast: Valeria Moriconi, Corrado Pani, Paolo Panelli, Checco Durante, Jacques Torrens, Franca Badeschi, Alberto Sorrentino, Hedda Linton, Ferruccio Amendola

title: I due Kennedy
synopsis: Gianni Bisiach deals with the history of the Kennedy family starting from the period of prohibition, when the Irish emigrant Joe begins to accumulate wealth with the traffic of alcoholic beverages. Then follows the public development, with the entry into politics of the sons John and Robert, murdered, the first as President of the United States in Dallas in 1963 and the second, as presidential candidate, in Los Angeles in 1968. and the other had made many enemies, including warmongers, organized crime and the country's backward forces. And the Warren Commission report on John's death is far from convincing.

title: I due Pompieri
synopsis: Two firefighters are in love with the same girl. One of them makes her believe that the other is already engaged and, even, is about to get married. After the usual misunderstandings, a second girl balances the fate of the two friends-rivals. Orange blossom for four on the way.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Monica Pardo, Dante Maggio

title: I due assi del guantone
synopsis: Franco Marsala and Ciccio Trapani, in search of fortune in Rome from their native Sicily, survive by eating in the best restaurants and pretending to be poisoned by mushrooms when paying the bill. When the trick fails, Ciccio presents the appears as a boxing champion and, bribing his opponents, the matter works for a while.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Paola Tedesco, Gino Milli, Mario Carotenuto, Ave Ninchi, Umberto D'Orsi, Giulio Rinaldi, Tiberio Murgia, Nuccia Belletti, Carla Mancini, Ada Pometti, Enzo Andronico

title: I due carabinieri
synopsis: Marino (Verdone) and Glauco (Montesano), for different reasons, join the Carabinieri. Marino courts Rita, who however prefers the court of Glauco. Marino is transferred to Piedmont but here he finds Glauco again: the two participate in an anti-drug action, after which they succumb to the temptation of a taste of the "dust". They will prove their heroism in rescuing a team of kidnapped scouts.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Carlo Verdone, Massimo Boldi, Paola Onofri

title: I due colonnelli
synopsis: In Montegreco, a Balkan village, during the last war an English colonel and an Italian are engaged in the alternate conquest of both the village and a seductive indigenous girl whose mother, following the alternating events of the war, exhibits the portraits of the Duce and Churchill.
cast: Totò, Walter Pidgeon, Nino Taranto, Scilla Gabel, Toni Ucci, Adriana Facchetti, Nino Terzo, Francis Lane, Sergio Bixio, Giancarlo Maestri

title: I due compari
synopsis: Giovanni Bettini (Fabrizi) is a peddler of fountain pens and has a partner. He is a widower and his only daughter, Juliet, attended schools in an exclusive boarding school. In fact, the girl believes that her father is an important and wealthy businessman. Juliet is in love with Enrico, the son of the industrialist Carletti but, when she discovers the truth about her father, she breaks the engagement. In the end, however, everything works out for the best. The film attempts to revive the Fabrizi-De Filippo couple with a subject by Fabrizi himself. It works as long as it stays on the comic register, a little less when it throws it on the pathetic.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Peppino De Filippo, Giulia Rubini, Carlo Ninchi

title: I due crociati
synopsis: The noble Ciccio di Braghelunge and the corporal of fortune Franco, united in misery as well as ineptitude, enlisted in the troops of Goffredo di Bouillon in the war against the Saracens. The two soon reveal themselves to be a calamity for the Christian camp, whose strategic plans and tricks they unwittingly sabotage.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Janet Agren, Umberto D'Orsi, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Ignazio Leone, Marco Tulli, Nino Fuscagni, Enzo Andronico, Fabio Testi

title: I due della Formula 1 alla corsa più pazza...
synopsis: The builder Ambrogio Barillà is on the verge of suicide because the pilot Pepito has been kidnapped. To help him intervene Franco perfect double of the runner and his partner Ciccio. It is the latter who proposes to Barillà to use Franco in the Monza Grand Prix.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Marisa Traversi, Umberto D'Orsi

title: I due della legione
synopsis: Unjustly accused of a murder, two careless swindlers end up in the foreign legion, marching in the desert among sheikhs, harems and camels, obviously to combine a sea of ??troubles.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Alighiero Noschese, Rosalba Neri, Aldo Giuffré, Maria Teresa Vianello, Nino Terzo, Aldo Bufi Landi, Carlo Lombardi, Jo Garso

title: I due evasi di Sing Sing
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio work as attendants in a public bathroom in New York. By chance they save the life of the gangster Attanasia from the threat of his rival Tristan. In gratitude, the boss introduces them to the rigged round of boxing. Attanasia reconciles with Tristan and they both bet on Franco's defeat. But the boxer wins and, in the grip of anger at an alleged mockery, the two kill each other in a shooting. Accused of murder, Franco and Ciccio are locked up in Sing Sing prison where, fearing a death sentence, they refuse to leave their cell ...
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Gloria Paul, Arturo Dominici, Mimmo Poli

title: I due figli di Ringo
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio, assuming the identity of Django and Gringo, sons of the famous Ringo, are involved in a series of adventures in the boundless landscapes of the Wild West.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, George Hilton, Gloria Paul

title: I due gladiatori
synopsis: Now grown up, after being abandoned by his mother immediately after his birth, the brother of Commodus, the despotic Roman emperor, tries in every way to eliminate him. His project finds widespread support among the people cruelly oppressed by the sovereign and who can't wait to get rid of him. To carry out his purpose, Commodus's brother makes use of the collaboration of two fearsome gladiators.
cast: Richard Harrison, Moira Orfei, Alberto Farnese, Mimmo Palmara, Mirko Ellis, Piero Lulli, Enzo Fiermonte, Ivy Holzer, Giuliano Gemma, Álvaro De Luna

title: I due mafiosi
synopsis: Two inseparable cronies are hired by a mafia boss to transport a suitcase to Paris, which they believe contains gold, but which is instead a load of TNT destined for a massacre of rebel mobsters. During the journey, the suitcase is accidentally exchanged with that of a magician. Hence the frenetic and confused search, from one night club to another in the Ville Lumière.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aroldo Tieri, Mischa Auer, Isabella Biagini, Gino Buzzanca, Moira Orfei, Silvia Solar, Carmelo Oliviero, Nino Fuscagni

title: I due maggiolini più matti del mondo
synopsis: Like every weekend Franco and Ciccio go fishing in their villa near Fiumicino. Along the way they give a ride to two beautiful hitchhikers who are joined by a group of young people who then invite themselves into the house. Suspicious of a phone call, their wives rush to the villa. In the meantime, the young people have left, replaced by a gang of fugitives.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Gia Sandri, Katia Christine, Dada Gallotti, Franca Haas, Emanuela Fallini, Flora Carosello, Silvana Bacci

title: I due maghi del pallone
synopsis: Ciccio Ingrassetti, in charge of finding the coach for Pizzusiccu's team, signs a "magician", K.K., who is a fortune-teller who is completely unfamiliar with the game of football. For a fortunate set of circumstances (and thanks to an excellent striker) everything works wonders, until, on the eve of the derby with Ghindinedda, the striker is kidnapped. Then K. K. himself takes the field.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Karin Schubert

title: I due magnifici fresconi
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio are unable to sell a load of wine and so they try to exploit the beauty of their wives to entice buyers, but they get a taste for it. They are later hired by an individual who wants to get rid of his wife. Boring and patchy.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Ennio Girolami, Valeria Fabrizi

title: I due marescialli
synopsis: Antonio Capurro performs his "blows" in cassock. Discovered by Marshal Cottone, he also manages to steal his uniform. But in Italy on September 8 it is not a brilliant idea. Capurro will end up deported to Germany but Marshal Cottone will be able to realize that the thief has been saved. And that has not lost neither the hair nor the vice.
cast: Totò, Vittorio De Sica, Gianni Agus, Arturo Bragaglia, Franco Giacobini, Inger Milton, Elvi Lissiak, Olimpia Cavalli, Riccardo Olivieri

title: I due nemici
synopsis: Abyssinia, 1941. A unit of Italians captures the English major Richardson. Shortly after, however, during a clash with an English unit, the commander of the Italians lost his life. The command is then taken by the junior officer, Captain Blasi. The latter, convinced that the English major will induce his own to give up hunting the Italians given the smallness of their forces, leaves him free. The scenario in which the story takes place is the tragic one of the Abyssinian war. But immediately the film, inspired by those tragic events, focuses on the sketches of military life.
cast: David Niven, Alberto Sordi, Amedeo Nazzari

title: I due orfanelli
synopsis: Gaspare and Battista are handymen in a college in Paris that welcomes "nobody's children". The first discovers that he is the descendant of a noble and rich family and leaves to look for his parents. Arriving at the palace, however, he discovers that his place has been taken by a usurper. In trying to assert his rights he also risks his skin. In the end, however, it all turns out to be a bad dream.
cast: Totò, Carlo Campanini, Isa Barzizza, Nerio Bernardi, Franca Marzi, Raymond Bussières, Ada Dondini, Guglielmo Barnabò, Annette Poivre, Luigi Almirante, Galeazzo Benti

title: I due parà
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio, by mistake, end up in a South American republic. Because of their gullibility, they seize power, but it won't last long.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Linda Sini, Maria Silva

title: I due pericoli pubblici
synopsis: Two clumsy fraudulent brothers cause the failure of a fake diplomat's plan to steal money from an industrialist. Forced to repay the gang for the damage suffered, they collect failure after failure, until they find themselves ... in Heaven. Farce that even steals some ideas from Kubrick's "Doctor Strangelove".
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Margaret Lee, Riccardo Garrone

title: I due pezzi da 90
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio, butchers in trouble with the taxman, must close their shop. The two are forced to accept the invitation of Nico, godfather of the first who, without their knowledge, turns them into drug couriers. A rival gang sets out on their trail.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Enzo Andronico, Franco Balducci

title: I due sanculotti
synopsis: On the eve of the French Revolution, two Sicilian bankrupts arrive in Paris. The extraordinary resemblance of one of the two to the king's brother means that they are introduced to the court where they enjoy hitherto unknown pleasures. After the storming of the Bastille, however, troubles begin for them, hunted by the revolutionaries and scrambled by the realists ...
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Barbara Carrol, Luigi Pavese

title: I due sergenti
synopsis: Two sergeants of the Napoleonic army in Italy are sentenced to death for having performed an act of piety, but only one will have to suffer the penalty. He gets the chance to visit the family one last time and the other offers himself as a hostage. Paolo Lorenzini (grandson of Collodi from "Pinocchio") wrote the novel: a classic of popular literature. Brought to the screen with professionalism by the old Guazzoni (that of the silent "Quo vadis?"), It was a huge success with the public.
cast: Gino Cervi, Alida Valli, Mino Doro, Antonio Centa, Evi Maltagliati, Nico Pepe, Lamberto Picasso, Luisa Ferida, Ugo Ceseri, Nella Maria Bonora, Vera Dani, Margherita Bagni

title: I due superpiedi quasi piatti
synopsis: Clever Matt (Hill) and massive Wilbur (Spencer) are two good-hearted thieves in perpetual struggle with a vicious drug kingpin. To escape capture ... they find themselves enlisted in the police but, at that point, they decide to get serious and to effectively fight the underworld. Their archenemy will get in the way.
cast: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Laura Gemser, David Huddleston, Luciano Catenacci, Edy Biagetti, Luciano Rossi, Riccardo Pizzuti, Ottaviano Dell'Acqua

title: I due toreri
synopsis: Our two heroes, peasants in Sicily, accept the offer of a certain Signor Pierre, unaware of his shady activity. As far as they know, they should grow a special salad - but it's actually marijuana. The two are shipped with their cargo to Barcelona. There is the bulk of the gang that hired them, and the two unwitting and clumsy protagonists begin to combine all the colors. Between one adventures and another, they will find themselves in the unlikely guise of matadors. For them, of course, everything will end in the best way. The plot, as almost always in similar cases, is solid as a spider's web, and all the weight - so to speak - of the film rests on the jokes of Franchi and Ingrassia. Back then, the film seemed too bold in terms of language. Today it is almost for boarders.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Maria Teresa Vianello, Rossella Como

title: I due vigili
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio, zealous motorcycle policemen, become the involuntary accomplices of a robbery. Thinking they are escorting a minister's car to the airport, they end up facilitating a robber's escape. Intended for the humblest of services, they combine one mess after another. One day, they think they see in the garden of a villa the car that the robber had used for his escape.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Umberto D'Orsi, Luciana Scalise, Isabella Biagini, Franco Giacobini, Rosita Pisano, Britt Garland, Mario Frera, Dada Gallotti, Enzo Maggio, Dominique Badou

title: I due violenti
synopsis: Cassidy, accused of murder, escaped from jail. The ranger Logan, a friend of the wanted man, manages to capture him: during the return journey, the two are attacked by a band of cattle thieves. Taking advantage of the confusion, Cassidy makes him lose track ...
cast: Alan Scott, George Martin, Susy Andersen, Mary Badmayer

title: I falsari
synopsis: To unmask a gang of forgers, Inspector Moroni (Giachetti) pretends to be a traveling salesman and thus comes into contact with Teresa (Duranti), a pious benefactress, apparently, who takes care of orphans but who also secretly keeps the ranks of an organization that "manufactures" banknote paper. Having passed unscathed through a thousand controversies, the former diva of the regime Doris Duranti appears in this first film, not very promising, by Franco Rossi, the future director of the television "Odyssey" (1968), who died in 2000.
cast: Fosco Giachetti, Doris Duranti, Erno Crisa, Lianella Carell, Gabriele Ferzetti, Mario Angelotti, Leopoldo Trieste, Saro Urzì, Nerio Bernardi

title: I familiari delle vittime non saranno avvertiti
synopsis: Antonio Mancuso, whose father was eliminated by Don Vincenzo's men, has decided to take revenge. He manages to win the trust of the boss, thus becoming his most reliable killer. When the disagreements with Don Vincenzo begin, Antonio reunites the leaders of the mafia and obtains from them the authorization to kill the boss. The mission succeeds but, at this point, it is he who is in the sights of the mafia. Conventional imitation of American crime films according to the patterns that were fashionable in the seventies.
cast: Antonio Sabato, Telly Savalas, Paola Tedesco, Guido Lollobrigida, Giuliano Persico, Nino Dal Fabbro, Sergio Rossi, Sergio Tramonti, Piero Morgia, Carlo Gaddi

title: I fantasmi di Portopalo
synopsis: Portopalo is a small town of less than 4000 inhabitants located on the southern tip of Sicily, a few kilometers from Capo Passero, the southernmost point of mainland Italy. The country is tightened around its port, which is home to one of the most important fishing fleets in Sicily. On Christmas Eve 1996 the fisherman Saro Ferro saves a castaway after returning from a fishing trip in the stormy sea. He is a teenager with Indian features who does not remember anything about himself, neither his name nor where he came from nor how he ended up in the water. In the following days, other fishermen, and Saro himself, fish for corpses in the sea. Something big has happened in the Strait of Sicily, something that neither the newspapers nor the institutions are aware of yet. But who should alert them? The launch of any investigation would cause the fishing area to be closed for an indefinite period, and the families of the fishermen live on this alone. What, then, to do with those corpses?
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Giuseppe Battiston, Roberta Caronia, Adriano Chiaramida, Bagya Lankapura, Angela Curri, Domenico Centamore, Saro Minardi, Maurizio Prollo

title: I fantasmi di San Berillo
synopsis: San Berillo is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Catania. Between destroyed houses and degraded alleys, painful or ironic stories of an idealized past and a present to be restored are traced: myth, popular culture and closed houses are the background to a journey that shows what remains of an area suspended in time and populated from ghosts of yesterday and today.

title: I fantastici 3 supermen
synopsis: The evil Golem has invented a machine that duplicates both banknotes and humans. To stop him, the secret services "enlist" two robbery masters and join them alongside Brad, a brave FBI agent.
cast: Brad Harris, Tony Kendall, Gloria Paul, Nick Jordan, Jochen Brockmann

title: I fatti della Banda della Magliana
synopsis: The birth, the splendor and the decline of the Banda della Magliana, which from 1975 to 1991 raged in Rome. The confession of the repentant Luciano Amodio calls into question his ex-comrades: everyone has their own truth to tell ...
cast: Francesco Pannofino, Roberto Brunetti, Fabio Grossi, Francesco Dominedò, Leo Gullotta

title: I fetentoni
synopsis: Life goes on apparently quiet in a corrupt southern town, fed and suffocated by subsidies and extraordinary interventions. Bribes are everywhere and allow everyone to do everything. Power is in the hands of two complementary bosses: Saro Lodato and Cosò Raffati, the most influential man in the city and the largest voting package in the province. Ninni, a banker, son of the former mayor, lives in the city, far from politics; and it is precisely of him that Lodato and Raffati think of as front names.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Anna Ammirati, Aldo Maccione, Oreste Lionello

title: I fichissimi
synopsis: In the Milanese suburbs, Romeo, a thoroughbred northerner, and Felice, a perfectly integrated Apulian, command two rival gangs. Romeo falls in love with Juliet without knowing that this is Felice's sister. When the truth comes out, the hurricane breaks out. Following the failed robbery of a pawnshop, Romeo also ends up in jail, where he leaves just in time to take Juliet away from the altar, ready to marry another with Felice's consent. A pseudo-Milanese farce dominated by a first style Abatantuono, who shuffles the cards from Romeo and Juliet to West Side Story, passing through The Graduate. Too much grace, Saint Anthony.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Jerry Calà, Simona Mariani, Mauro Di Francesco, Simone Bongiovanni, Renato Cecchetto, Carmine Faraco, Fabio Grossi, Barbara Herrera

title: I fidanzati
synopsis: Giovanni, a Milanese worker, accepts the temporary transfer to Sicily for a better professional qualification, but also as an opportunity to rethink his engagement with Liliana, which has lasted for years and which has now become a routine relationship. Loneliness weighs, despite the daily commitment at work, but the letters he receives from the girl strengthen a love that was withering.
cast: Carlo Cabrini, Anna Canzi

title: I figli del leopardo
synopsis: The adventures, between farce and speck, of two wandering "tooth pickers", sons of a penniless baron. The protagonists have to deal first with the band of the Brigand Bagalone, then with the Bourbon soldiers, finally, even, with Giuseppe Garibaldi's "red shirts".
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Evi Marandi, Alberto Bonucci, Anthony Steffen, Vittorio Congia, Mario Castellani, Elisa Mainardi, Silvio Bagolini, Enzo Andronico, Raimondo Vianello

title: I figli della notte
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Giulio is sent by his parents to a boarding school in South Tyrol for offspring of high society. For him, surviving the rigid rules of the institute is a very hard test but fortunately he finds a friend in Edoardo, who is there because he has the habit of running away from home. The two become inseparable and together they discover that at night, one day a week, it is possible to leave boarding school. You just need to be careful not to be seen and come back before dawn.
cast: Vincenzo Crea, Ludovico Succio, Fabrizio Rongione, Yuliia Sobol, Luigi Bignone, Pietro Monfreda, Michael Bernhard Plattner, Dario Cantarelli

title: I figli di Zanna Bianca
synopsis: A little girl, granddaughter of a rich industrialist, was kidnapped in Sardinia just when her parents decided to separate. The police are groping in the dark and the intervention of an aspiring journalist assisted by the dog Buck, who is very fond of the child, is decisive. The unprecedented couple succeeds where the police have failed; the kidnappers are captured and the parents are reconciled.
cast: Sal Borgese, Ileana Rigano, Gualtiero Rispoli, Claudia Bianchi, Piero Fabiani, Danny Ribol, Antonio Maimone, Luciano Rossi

title: I figli di nessuno
synopsis: Luisa loves Guido, but the latter's mother hinders them. He also makes her kidnap her son. Luisa, believing that the child is dead, locks herself up in the convent. Many years later the boy finds himself working in the mines of Guido, who has married another woman. When after an argument with Guido himself, the young man runs away and is seriously injured, his father learns the whole truth from his wife.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Yvonne Sanson, Françoise Rosay, Folco Lulli, Enrica Dyrell, Enrico Olivieri, Teresa Franchini, Gualtiero Tumiati, Alberto Farnese, Aristide Baghetti, Enrico Glori

title: I figli... so' pezzi 'e core
synopsis: Tommaso is a luckless singer who earns his living on the streets and in taverns. His wife Matilde is expecting their first child who dies soon after giving birth. In the same hours a single mother dies giving birth to a beautiful and healthy baby. With the complicity of the midwife Tommaso and Matilde exchange the little ones and raise the "stolen" baby with great love. Then Matilde also dies and Tommaso is left alone with the boy. One day, however, the natural father, a little good, shows up and gets the baby back from the court. This time the Neapolitan drama points to the dearest feelings. Bandit or beggar Merola is always the same.
cast: Mario Merola, Anna Maria Ackermann, Carlo Giuffrè, Michele Esposito

title: I fobici
synopsis: Four episodes. "Night shift": a man runs all night giving information, even if not requested, on the timetables of the night buses. "All a tic": Andrea has many tics but is happy. When he decides to cure himself because he is in love, his life becomes hell. "Have I turned off the gas?": A doubt assails Carlo already out of the house before a trip and forces him to return. "Forbidden Fruit": Alvaro loves curvy women and cars. When he is forced to choose between the two ...
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Luca Laurenti, Daniele Liotti, Gian Marco Tognazzi

title: I fratelli Castiglioni
synopsis: In search of the winning lottery ticket, the heirs of a landowner go to the grave of the deceased to find it. But nothing is found, and the deadline for the collection of the premium is approaching inexorably.
cast: Camillo Pilotto, Ugo Ceseri, Amedeo Nazzari, Luisa Ferida

title: I fratelli De Filippo
synopsis: It is the beginning of the twentieth century, the three brothers Peppino, Titina and Eduardo live with the beautiful and young mother, Luisa De Filippo. In the family a father is not there, or rather he hides in the role of the "uncle" Eduardo Scarpetta, the most famous, rich and acclaimed actor and playwright of his time. Scaritta, although not recognizing the three natural children, has introduced them to children in the world of theater since. Upon the death of the great actor, the legitimate children spart his inheritance, while in Titina, Eduardo and Peppino, is not responsible for. To the three young people, however, "Uncle" Scarpetta transmitted a special gift, his great talent, who instead did not touch the legitimate son Vincenzo, also an actor and playwright, who became the owner of the paternal company. The redemption of the painful family history passes through the formation of the Trio De Filippo, a dream caressed for years by Eduardo and his brothers and finally realized, overcoming difficulties and conflicts.
cast: Mario Autore, Domenico Pinelli, Anna Ferraioli Ravel, Biagio Izzo, Susy Del Giudice, Marisa Laurito, Marianna Fontana, Maurizio Casagrande, Giovanni Esposito, Nicola Di Pinto, Augusto Zucchi, Lucianna De Falco, Maurizio Micheli, Vincenzo Salemme, Giancarlo Giannini

title: I fratelli Dinamite
synopsis: From an early age, the three Dinamite brothers - sons of a drunkard captain - have combined all the colors. Shipwrecked on a desert island and saved by some hunters who entrusted them to the protection of indulgent Aunt Cloe, the terrible kids grew up free and intolerant of any discipline, to the point of even escaping the Devil himself. After a string of pranks, the trio arrives in Venice during the carnival, where they will be able to redeem themselves by returning a smile to a child ...

title: I fratelli Karamazov
synopsis: Reduction for the small screen of Dostoevsky's monumental novel; seven episodes of about an hour each to tell the events that see Dimitri Karamazov unjustly accused of having murdered his father and the consequent disputes that arise with the brothers Ivan and Aleksej, as well as with Smerdjakov, the illegitimate brother of the three.
cast: Corrado Pani, Carlo Simoni, Umberto Orsini, Lea Massari, Salvo Randone, Antonio Salines, Carla Gravina, Cesare Polacco, Laura Carli, Antonio Battistella

title: I fratelli corsi
synopsis: Two twins grew up apart after their family was exterminated. Paul, raised by a doctor, is now a brilliant student. Leone, who grew up in the environment of the Bonapartist partisans, became a brigand. They find themselves by chance and from that moment on they live only for one goal: to avenge their parents. They will of course succeed, but Leo will pay with his life once the battle is over. Adapted from the novel of the same name by Alexandre Dumas father. Anton Giulio Majano, not at all intimidated by the intricacies of the reference literary intrigue, practices what will become the television specialization that will make him popular.
cast: Geoffrey Horne, Valerie Lagrange, Emma Danieli, Amedeo Nazzari, Jean Servais

title: I fuorilegge
synopsis: In a small village, after the defeat of Sicilian separatism, a young peasant woman falls in love with Cosimo, a defeated rebel and isolated from everyone. The two would like to get married, but life as an outlaw seems an insurmountable obstacle, moreover, Turi, the girl's brother, returns from abroad. He seeks revenge on the bandit who dishonored his sister and uses a slimy lawyer to drive him into a trap.
cast: Maria Grazia Francia, Vittorio Gassman, Umberto Spadaro, Ermanno Randi, Tino Buazzelli, Giovanna Galletti

title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
synopsis: A prologue and five episodes sarcastically describe the many points on which a bill on divorce has been built.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Annie Girardot, Romolo Valli, Marina Malfatti
director: Paolo Taviani, Vittorio Taviani, Valentino Orsini

title: I gabbiani volano basso
synopsis: A former Vietnam fighter, deserter, is blackmailed by an Italian industrialist and forced to kill a partner of the principal. The killer then wants to return to his homeland, but for a mistake he runs away: now he has against the police and his former accomplices. The owner of a Roman boutique helps him, but when the protagonist discovers that she is arrested for this, he lets himself be reached by his opponents. Unlikely and cartoonish "noir", with a plot so absurd that not even a few touches of the craft in the making can save.
cast: Nathalie Delon, Maurizio Merli, Mel Ferrer, Dagmar Lassander

title: I gemelli del Texas
synopsis: Two pairs of swaddled twins are separated in a stagecoach attack. Two become ferocious bandits, while the others make a career as irreproachable journalists. When the former are charged with eliminating the latter, many misunderstandings will arise.
cast: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Diana Lorys, Alfonso Rojas

title: I giardini dell'Eden
synopsis: Jeoshua, after having completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter, sets out on a journey around the world. Arriving in Jerusalem, he comes into contact with the arrogance of the rich and that of the Roman invasion and does everything to fight it. Leaving the worldly sphere, he comes into contact with the Essene community in which property and money are abolished and receives their precious teachings. Meanwhile Jochannah, recognizing him as the Messiah who is to come, stimulates him to begin preaching.
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Said Taghmaoui, Massimo Ghini, Boris Terral, Lorenzo Cherubini

title: I giganti
synopsis: A repatriation between old friends. A house lost in a valley forgotten by the world. Many memories, lead, and love stories from the abyss.
cast: Bonifacio Angius, Stefano Deffenu, Michele Manca, Riccardo Bombagi, Stefano Manca, Francesca Niedda, Noemi Medas, Roberta Passaghe, Mila Angius

title: I giganti della Tessaglia
synopsis: Jason, king of Thessaly, is on his way to Colchis in search of the Golden Fleece. Argo's ship, after passing a violent storm, lands on a small island, where Jason kills a monster that demands offerings in human flesh. Meanwhile Adrastus, who the king had left to rule Thessaly in his absence, aims to seize the throne and threatens Queen Creusa.
cast: Roland Carey, Ziva Rodan, Alberto Farnese, Luciano Marin

title: I giganti di Roma
synopsis: Four valiant soldiers of Caesar commando neutralize a powerful war machine of Vercingetorix.
cast: Richard Harrison, Wandisa Guida, Ettore Manni, Philippe Hersent, Ralph Hudson, Nicole Tessier, Goffredo Unger, Renato Baldini, Piero Lulli, Alessandro Sperli

title: I giochi del diavolo - Il sogno dell'altro
synopsis: A distinct young man meets a gentleman who offers him to become his heir. In return he will have to give up on him and take that of the elderly.
cast: Anna Nogara, Alfredo Pea, Stefano Madia, José Quaglio, Renzo Lori, Franco Passatore

title: I giochi del diavolo - L'uomo della sabbia
synopsis: When he was a child, Nathanael was persuaded by his mother to go to sleep with the threat of the monstrous Sandman coming. One day, hearing footsteps in the night, he believes the terrible threat has materialized. In truth, it is a family friend who reached out to the boy's father.
cast: Domiziano Arcangeli, Laura Belli, Massimo Girotti, Sylva Koscina, Francesca Muzio, Iris Peynado, Barbara Pilavin, Donato Placido, Saverio Vallone

title: I giochi del diavolo - La Venere d'Ille
synopsis: A young landowner, close to marriage, finds a statue of Venus. This, animated, falls in love with him to the point of being jealous and killing him during the wedding night ...
cast: Daria Nicolodi, Marc Porel, Mario Maranzana

title: I giochi del diavolo - La presenza perfetta
synopsis: A ghost fully reveals himself as a gentleman, tormenting an entire English family.
cast: William Berger, Rada Rassimov, Franco Ressel, Giancarlo Zanetti

title: I giochi proibiti de l'Aretino Pietro
synopsis: Angelica, Lisa, Violetta and Bettina, four women from Gubbio, are taken to court by their respective husbands and lovers. Each is accused of committing adultery.
cast: Femi Benussi, Tony Kendall, Shirley Corrigan, Angela Covello, Orchidea De Santis

title: I giorni bianchi
synopsis: Italy, March 2020. Prime Minister Conte announces the National Lockdown to arrest the exponential growth of the dead from Covid. However, quarantine promises to be a tragedy in the tragedy for a family: the wife wants desperately and impotently to become a mother; The woman's brother, a man sickly, lives in an endless football dream; And Franco seems to be the only one to remain anchored to reality.
cast: Daniele Malagnino, Denis Malagnino, Simona Malagnino

title: I giorni cantati
synopsis: Marco, a very famous singer-songwriter at the time of '68, after a near accident on the highway gets on the roof of his car and begins to sing the first three numbers. The attempted suicide went in vain, he tried to take back his life by being in contact with his fellow songwriters and with the political context of his time. Disappointed by what he has found, he decides to leave everything to join a group of young people who occupy the apartment next to him: Guglielmo, Luca and Costanza. In their company he manages to find his compositional vein, realizing that his life is in the middle between the complete abstraction from things and the need for them.
cast: Paolo Pietrangeli, Mariangela Melato, Anna Nogara, Roberto Benigni

title: I giorni contati
synopsis: Cesare is a fifty-five-year-old plumber, a widower. Seeing someone of his age die, Cesare becomes aware that death could strike him too. So he decides to quit his job and enjoy what he has left to live. But it is useless to chase after youth that is now past, to cultivate hopes that result in as many disappointments: to defeat desperation and loneliness, he just has to go back to work. Intense and bitter elegy on the fading of life, Elio Petri's film deals with an unusual subject with excellent sensitivity and measure. Salvo Randone is formidable and gives the figure of Caesar an exceptional "truth".
cast: Salvo Randone, Paolo Ferrari, Vittorio Caprioli, Franco Sportelli, Regina Bianchi, Marcella Valeri, Angela Minervini, Lando Buzzanca

title: I giorni del commissario Ambrosio
synopsis: Commissioner Ambrosio investigates the death of a playboy convicted of drugs and prostitution. The testimony of a violinist is not convincing and he, cornered, confesses that he is the murderer. But it is only an attempt to cover up the real culprit, something that does not escape a man of great experience like Ambrosio.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Carlo Delle Piane, Carla Gravina, Athina Cenci, Claudio Amendola, Pupella Maggio, Rossella Falk, Cristina Marsillach, Amanda Sandrelli, Duilio Del Prete, Teo Teocoli

title: I giorni dell'abbandono
synopsis: Olga, thirty-five with two children, is left by her husband. After completely losing her self-confidence, she finds happiness again thanks to an encounter with a neighboring musician and a painful self-analysis.
cast: Margherita Buy, Luca Zingaretti, Goran Bregovic, Alessia Goria

title: I giorni dell'amore e dell'odio
synopsis: In Kefalonia, the Acqui Division refused to surrender to the Germans after the armistice of 8 September and was massacred. The hateful act was perpetrated not by the SS but by the Wermacht, the German regular army. Against the background of this bitter war page, the story of Wolfgang and Helberg is told, two South Tyrolean brothers who choose one Italy and the other Germany.
cast: Daniele Liotti, Liberto Rabal, Mandala Tayde, Ricky Tognazzi

title: I giorni dell'ira
synopsis: Young Scott works as a street sweeper but waits for the opportunity to prove what he's really made of. A gunslinger arrives, Talby, who takes him under his protection and teaches him how to handle weapons. Scott proves to be very good at the subject and Talby puts him in his gang. Scott's fate seems sealed but the boy will know how to redeem himself.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Lee Van Cleef, Walter Rilla, Christa Linder, Ennio Balbo, Lukas Ammann, Andrea Bosic, José Calvo, Giorgio Gargiullo, Anna Orso

title: I giorni della vendemmia
synopsis: In September 1984, in a small Emilian town, the young Emilia arrives to help her grandparents during the harvest season. Presumptuous and casual, she takes advantage of that short stay to complete her degree thesis and change the world of Elia, the teenage son of neighbors William and Maddalena, a convinced Marxist and a fervent Catholic. Living at home with his parents and his elderly grandmother, Elia finds himself for the first time at the center of a disorder that moves his life and which is aggravated by the concomitant return of his brother Samuele, a former 1968-year-old music journalist who has returned from a year around Europe.
cast: Lavinia Longhi, Marco D'Agostin, Gian Marco Tavani, Maurizio Tabani, Claudia Botti, Elide Bertani, Luigi Gandolfi, Rossella Torri, Claudio Binini, Emiliano Bisegna

title: I giorni della violenza
synopsis: His brother is killed by the Northerners and Josh joins the Southern guerrillas. After the war he meets Christine (Loncar), betrothed to the assassin officer, and kidnaps her in revenge by dragging her to the border. But the road is long. Few ideas for a botched serial western.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Beba Loncar, Luigi Vannucchi, Andrea Bosic, Nello Pazzafini, Lucio Rosato, Rosalba Neri, Gianni Solaro, Romano Puppo

title: I giorni più belli
synopsis: The builder Valentini carefully prepared the plans for the construction of a large building. However, things are not as easy as they seem and a problem immediately arises. The land where Valentini intends to build is occupied by a school where Miss Giannelli teaches. And the teacher, tied to old memories, naturally doesn't want to leave.
cast: Emma Gramatica, Antonella Lualdi, Franco Interlenghi, Vittorio De Sica

title: I giovani tigri
synopsis: Some young people to escape boredom get together one summer evening in a villa near Milan. Here, in the course of an absurd game, a girl dies. Fosco, Dario and Paride, after having agreed on the version to be given to the authorities, inform the police. The investigation ends quickly, with the belief that it was an involuntary accident. The three, increasingly bored, join Sam and Consuelo and decide to organize a robbery against someone who is not in a position to report them. The choice falls on a thief.
cast: Helmut Berger, Luca Della Porta, Vanni De Maigret, Ray Lovelock

title: I giovedì della signora Giulia
synopsis: Every Thursday Mrs. Giulia, wife of the well-known lawyer Esengrini, visits her daughter Emilia, in Milan, newly married to Carlo. One Thursday of Giulia's traces are lost and the first suspect according to the police is her husband, a lawyer.
cast: Tom Ponzi, Francesco Di Federico, Claudio Gora, Gianfranco Barra, Hélène Remy, Andrea Petricca, Umberto Ceriani, Gianni Mantesi, Enzo Ricciardi, Attilio Dottesio

title: I girasoli
synopsis: Giovanna sets out in search of her husband who has been reported missing in Russia during the war. She finds him again, but he is married. A De Sica in full decline, in a melodramatic film that serves above all to provide an opportunity for Loren's sanguine interpretation. Screenplay by Zavattini and Tonino Guerra, music by Henry Mancini.
cast: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Lyudmila Saveleva, Glauco Onorato, Galina Andreeva, Anna Carena, Nadya Serednichenko, Germano Longo, Silvano Tranquilli, Marisa Traversi

title: I giudici
synopsis: Two months after retirement, the chief prosecutor, a friend of Falcone, is murdered in a street in Palermo. The tragic episode forces Falcone to hire a bodyguard, Mario. Despite leading a risky life, the judge falls in love with a magistrate of the Court of Appeal, Francesca Morvillo, whom he meets at a dinner with Borsellino and his wife. The fight of the two judges against the mafia octopus will be interrupted by two violent attacks in which they will lose their lives.
cast: Chazz Palminteri, Andy Luotto, F. Murray Abraham, Anna Galiena

title: I grandi magazzini
synopsis: Suspected of theft, blackmailed by the chief of staff, abandoned by her boyfriend, a department store clerk no longer knows what to do. Then the truth comes out, the chief of staff is exposed and love triumphs. Camerini with Assia Noris and De Sica were the best that could be asked of the Italian cinema of the time. Once again, the director investigates the places of the nascent modernity and lovingly outlines the very small Italian bourgeoisie that faces them.
cast: Assia Noris, Vittorio De Sica, Luisella Beghi, Andrea Checchi, Enrico Glori, Virgilio Riento, Milena Penovich, Mattia Giancola

title: I guappi
synopsis: Naples, late 19th century. Nicola leaves the reform school with the intention of becoming a lawyer. Thanks to Don Gaetano, boss of the Camorra, he graduated and was "guaranteed" to Don Antonio as an honored picciotto. He will find himself defending the innocent Don Gaetano from the false accusation of rape and murder.
cast: Franco Nero, Fabio Testi, Lina Polito, Raymond Pellegrin

title: I guappi non si toccano
synopsis: Tony, a former FBI agent, is called by the Naples police commissioner to investigate the trafficking of two gangs. He infiltrates the outlaws, pushes them to mortally clash with each other, but realizes that there is something stinking about the whole thing. Very "shouted" detective. Music by Tullio De Piscopo, secondary part for the late singer Pino Mauro, specialized in underworld songs.
cast: Gabriele Tinti, Paola Senatore, Richard Harrison, Pino Mauro, Marisa Laurito, Tommaso Palladino, Enrico Maisto, Enzo D'Ausilio, Emi Salvador, Gianni Diana

title: I guardiani del tesoro
synopsis: In the Jordanian desert, during some excavations, the archaeologist Victoria Carter (Anna Friel) unearths an ancient scroll containing, in an encrypted way, the information useful for recovering the Seal of King Solomon, an ancient relic given according to legend by God himself. The Vatican, however, fears that the discovery of the object could give immense powers to those who seize it and send Angelo (Raoul Bova), an agent of a secret papal organization, to the place to assist Victoria in the research.
cast: Raoul Bova, Anna Friel, Volker Bruch, Florentine Lahme, Patrick Lyster, Andre Jacobs, David Sherwood

title: I guerrieri dell'anno 2072
synopsis: In 2072 the Earth is united under one power and the citizens live only according to the TV shows. A network organizes a deadly game in the Colosseum arena and to ensure the success of the initiative ensures that among the gladiators there is also a motorcycling champion unjustly condemned. With the help of a girl and another gladiator, the young man rebels and takes revenge by destroying the radio stations. Poor film but with many ideas and a good realization directed by veteran Lucio Fulci. Among the performers an unknown Eleonora Brigliadori and Renato Rossini, who played Ercole in the sixties.
cast: Jared Martin, Fred Williamson, Howard Ross, Eleonora Brigliadori, Renato Rossini, Cosimo Cinieri, Claudio Cassinelli, Valeria Cavalli, Donald O'Brien, Penny Brown, Al Cliver, Mario Novelli, Hal Yamanouchi

title: I jomfruens tegn
cast: Ole Søltoft, Sigrid Horne Rasmussen, Bent Warburg, Mette Von Kohl

title: I jukilnomui sarang
synopsis: A young boxer becomes a bodyguard to the actress responsible for his brother's attempted suicide. She falls in love with him, unaware of his true identity or his plans for revenge.
cast: Rain, Shin Min A, Sa Rang Kim, Ki Woo Lee

title: I ladri
synopsis: Sent back as undesirable by the United States to Naples, the mobster Joe Castagnato carries with him, hidden in jars of jam, the rich loot of a robbery. But someone discovers the trick, and uses the worst methods to get hold of the loot ...
cast: Totò, Giovanna Ralli, Armando Calvo, Giacomo Furia, Enzo Turco, Renato De Simone, Juanjo Menendez, Rafael Luis Calvo, Maria Luisa Rolando, Félix Fernández, Fred Buscaglione

title: I laureati
synopsis: The graduates (or rather "undergraduates") of the title are Leonardo, a newly divorced, Rocco, southern night watchman, Bruno, a Roman emigrant, Pino, a failed entertainer. Four thirty-year-olds largely out of school, who share the same suburban apartment trying to graduate more out of respect for their parents than for personal ambition. During the day everyone has their own commitments, in the evening they all get together to tell each other and share male embarrassments, apparitions (more or less fleeting) of women, weaknesses, small dramas and a lot of daily boredom.
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Rocco Papaleo, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Alessandro Haber, Massimo Ceccherini

title: I leoni di Pietroburgo
