synopsis: Eldar Kan fights alongside the oppressed in 19th-century Russia. However, he does not know that he is descended from an ancient noble family. Kan, with his deeds, is an obstacle to the expansionist aims of two noble families who try to eliminate him by also resorting to the kidnapping of his girlfriend, Tamila. Confused movie of adventure, sword and alcove.
cast: Mark Damon, Erna Schurer, Gary Wilson, Barbara O'Neil

title: I leopardi di Churchill
synopsis: At the outbreak of the Second World War, two British twins with a German mother split up. One enters the Wehrmacht with the rank of officer and is sent to the French front: during a fight near a dam on the Meuse, he is fatally shot by the Allies. The twin, who remained loyal to Great Britain, is contacted by the French partisans to take the place - as a spy - of his brother ...
cast: Richard Harrison, Frank Braña, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: I love you, stupid
synopsis: After Marcos is dumped by his girlfriend, he attempts to reinvent himself as a modern man with the help of a childhood friend and an online guru.
cast: Quim Gutiérrez, Natalia Tena, Alfonso Bassave, Alba Ribas, Patricia Vico, Ernesto Alterio

title: I lunghi capelli della morte
synopsis: In the fifteenth century, a woman was sentenced to death on charges of having assassinated the ruling duke, but launched a terrible curse on the stake. #Years after the anathema comes inexorable.
cast: Georges Ardisson, Barbara Steele, Haline Zalewska

title: I lunghi giorni dell'odio
cast: Guy Madison, Peter Martell, Lucienne Fridou, Rik Battaglia

title: I lunghi giorni della vendetta
synopsis: Ted is out of luck: his father has been murdered and he ends up in jail on charges of a murder he didn't commit. Fortunately for him, he manages to escape and therefore tries to discover his father's killer and the perpetrator of the crime for which he ended up in jail. Naturally, the two leads lead to a single gang of criminals, arms smugglers, in the pay of the local boss who also has a corrupt deputy on the payroll. Ted's revenge can now be accomplished, relentless.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Francisco Rabal, Gabriella Giorgelli, Nieves Navarro, Conrado San Martín, Franco Cobianchi, Manuel Muñiz, Teodoro Corrà, Milo Quesada, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia

title: I lupi dentro
synopsis: The documentary traces the relations of the naive painter Raffaele Andreassi with Antonio Ligabue and with his places. But Ligabue is just a pretext, in a wandering at the mouth of the Po among farmhouses, artists and madmen: legendary fishermen, river navigators, dozens of naive painters.

title: I magi randagi
synopsis: Three acrobats, veterans of a failed circus, wander around the centers of the Italian province organizing a small show: and, since they have no animals available, they interpret the beasts themselves. To survive, they also accept to play the Three Kings in a living nativity scene called by the parish priest of a small village where no more children are born; at that point, between drinking and mystical crises, they actually fall into the role of Magi.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Patrick Bauchau, Rolf Zacher, Gastone Moschin

title: I magliari
synopsis: Mario is an Italian worker who left the city of Hanover, where he tried in vain to find his luck, and is about to return to Italy. One day he accidentally meets Totò, a shrewd Roman swindler who trades in fabrics, who convinces him to stay. The two begin to work together, then Mario enters the service of Raffaele, an enterprising Neapolitan who, through a group of knitters, has organized a large-scale trade in fake fabrics.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Belinda Lee, Renato Salvatori, Aldo Giuffré

title: I magnifici Brutos del West
synopsis: The Brutos, four sons of the West, inherit a started funeral home. Their first client requests that they take care of transporting the body of a relative to another location. In reality, instead of the corpse, there is a treasure of inestimable value. During the journey, our four heroes are attacked by the Indians and are captured. The chief of the Indians intends to give them in husband to his four very ugly daughters. After countless vicissitudes, the Brutos thwart the criminal plan of the fake funeral and, full of glory, return as heroes to their country.
cast: I Brutos, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Emma Penella, Darry Cowl

title: I magnifici tre
synopsis: To defend the population of Nonduras from the abuses of the dictator Bonarios, who has the hobby of kidnapping the young brides, the three daughters of the deceased sheriff, they propose to the exasperated population to hire some courageous pistoleros. Unfortunately, the three girls find Pablo, Domingo and José, all believed to be skilled gunslingers. In reality, the three are the most obtuse bandits in the region, so much so that they are sentenced to death and take home the skin only thanks to the intervention of the three girls.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Aroldo Tieri

title: I maniaci
synopsis: Episode films - some of which are very short-lived, almost simple sketches - in which fashions, tics, the most widespread manias in Italian society of the time are targeted. We are in 1964 and therefore in full economic boom: here are those who have made money and try to set a tone by becoming passionate about antiques and who, following the first, shy, freedom of costumes, rushes to striptease shows. But there are also bills (another great national "passion") and the political undergrowth of the old DC ...
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Raimondo Vianello, Vittorio Caprioli, Walter Chiari, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Barbara Steele, Gaia Germani, Aroldo Tieri, Franca Valeri, Lisa Gastoni, Franco Fabrizi, Sandra Mondaini, Margaret Lee

title: I mariti
synopsis: Countess Emma, ??secretly in love with the Count of Riverbella, is forced by her family to marry the lawyer Fabio Regoli who will not be noble, but is honest. Riverbella in fact gets framed for fraud, but Fabio assumes his defense and gets him acquitted. So Emma's sister gets into trouble with a Don Juan, who is also a count, and once again Fabio resolves the situation by challenging him to a duel.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Irma Gramatica, Clara Calamai, Giulio Stival, Roberto Villa, Rubi D'Alma, Sandro Ruffini

title: I marziani hanno 12 mani
synopsis: Yes, there are other forms of more or less intelligent life in the universe. When the Martians decide it's time to pay a little visit to Earth, they choose to take a sightseeing tour in Rome. We are in the 60s, Fellini and Paparazzi are depopulated, the Anitona is a diva, and the Martians, in contact with the Dolce Vita of the capital, decide that perhaps it is appropriate to move permanently to the city.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Paolo Panelli, Magali Noël

title: I masnadieri
synopsis: The Duke of Bolsena, Fabrizio Frangipane, after having the prince of Portoreale arrested, a rival in the succession to the Vatican throne, kidnaps his daughter Alba. In an attempt to rescue the princess, Brother Silenzio and the Sienese nobleman Leonardetto Ardenghi fall, in turn, into the hands of the duke. Thanks to the intervention of a group of thugs, the two escape from prison and free Alba. Since an edict of Sixtus V, who succeeded Gregory XIII, prohibits the use of weapons, the duke resorts to a ruse to capture Alba again.
cast: Daniela Rocca, Antonio Cifariello, Salvo Randone, Folco Lulli

title: I miei più cari amici
synopsis: A group of actors on the brink of bankruptcy receives a letter that appears to be the result of a benevolent fate. The letter contains an invitation to spend a period of time in a castle belonging to the dukes of Camerario: the occasion is the birthday of Martha, an actress whose recital has been canceled. The person who wrote the letter is Alessio, a globetrotting adventurer, whom everyone has lost sight of for fifteen years. But some strange events begin to unfold after they arrive.
cast: Alessandro Benvenuti, Eva Robin's, Athina Cenci, Alessandro Gassmann

title: I miei primi 40 anni
synopsis: The irresistible rise of Marina's jet set into Olympus takes forty years, from the end of the war to the present day. The chosen path is that of erotic encounters and seductions that aim higher and higher, passing from boys met in Piazza Navona to dukes, princes and businessmen. In the alcove, however, some more or less, they all make a meager figure. The glossy photography, the performers little more than decorative, the dull screenplay make one think of a rotogravure; in fact the film is inspired by the autobiographical novel by Marina Ripa di Meana. Overwork for makeup artists and costume designers.
cast: Carol Alt, Elliott Gould, Jean Rochefort, Paola Quattrini, Pierre Cosso, Massimo Venturiello, Capucine, Riccardo Garrone, Carlo Monni, Teo Teocoli, Claudio Insegno, Riccardo Serventi Longhi

title: I migliori giorni
synopsis: Four episodes, each focused on a holiday - Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day and on March 8 - to tell the different ways with which people face the days of celebration. A deputy invites the secretary of her party to the eve dinner, hoping for future support. A rich entrepreneur tries to remedy the damage to the image by passing the New Year as a volunteer to the canteen of the poor, where he meets his former driver unjustly fired and determined to take revenge. A couple still celebrates Valentine's Day after 25 years, but this time, with the presence of her lover, there is more traffic than usual. A famous TV presenter is forced to spend March 8 publicly apologize for having aired a service on the ideal woman.
cast: Edoardo Leo, Massimiliano Bruno, Anna Foglietta, Max Tortora, Paolo Calabresi, Luca Argentero, Valentina Lodovini, Greta Scarano, Claudia Gerini, Stefano Fresi

title: I milanesi a Napoli
synopsis: Clemente Simoni and Dora Vincenzi, two Milanese industrialists, plan to set up a "Telepizze" factory in Naples, that is, Neapolitan-style pizzas, packaged according to the chemical formula invented by Simoni. Meanwhile, Franco Baraldi, the general secretary of the company for which the two work, is involved in another initiative, which aims at the industrialization of Sorrento embroidery. Immacolata Santolillo, a nice Sorrentine, owner of a workshop where the famous embroideries are made, and sister of the "Bersagliere", owner of a well-known pizzeria, with a clever stratagem causes the construction of the planned embroidery factory to be suspended. Meanwhile, the pizza chefs of Naples, led by Immacolata herself, decide to oppose the "Telepizze" industry by any means.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Carlo Campanini, Nino Taranto, Dolores Palumbo, Enrico Viarisio, Eva Nova, Carlo Sposito, Enzo Turco

title: I miserabili - Caccia all'uomo
synopsis: Jean Valjean (Gino Cervi) stole out of hunger and was imprisoned. Then he tried several times to escape, but was always caught by the policeman Javert. When his attempt is successful, he changes areas and gradually builds a huge fortune by becoming a respectable man. It is the first of two episodes of the film by Riccardo Freda, the Italian master of adventure. One of the best films of the author and the best film adaptation of Hugo's novel.
cast: Gino Cervi, Valentina Cortese, Giovanni Hinrich, Aldo Nicodemi

title: I miserabili - Tempesta su Parigi
synopsis: Hunted by Javert, Jean Valjean takes refuge in Paris under a false name. He became rich and could be saved if his adopted daughter Cosetta did not fall in love with Marius, one of the leaders of the insurrection. The riot fails and Valjean rescues Marius from arrest, but he is recognized and killed. Freda's direction is very skilled especially in the exciting battle scenes. Debut film for Mastroianni. Second part of the beautiful Fredian version of "I miserabili" by Hugo.
cast: Gino Cervi, Valentina Cortese, Marcello Mastroianni

title: I missed you: Director's Cut
synopsis: A workaholic reconnects with two men she blocked on social media five years ago and begins to reflect on her past life choices.
cast: Wu Kang Ren, Eve Ai, Fu Meng Po, Lin Mei Hsiu, 9m88

title: I misteri della giungla nera
synopsis: For fifteen years Captain MacPerson searched, in vain, for his daughter kidnapped at the age of three by the Tughs. The opportunity to continue the investigation presents itself to the officer when the English Command calls him back to service to lead an expedition against the rebels. While the men commanded by MacPerson are about to disembark in the place where the Tughs are supposed to have taken refuge, Tremal-Naik also arrives on the trail of the rebel tribe.
cast: Guy Madison, Inge Schoner, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Ivan Desny

title: I misteri della giungla nera
synopsis: In India, the Tughs sect kidnaps little Ada, daughter of the commander of an English garrison, to make her a priestess. Having become a beautiful girl, Ada will have to serve the bloodthirsty goddess Kali, but the Bengali hunter Tremal Naik, who has fallen in love with her, will be able to save her. Almost twenty years after the successes of the Sandokan series, Kabir Bedi returns to play the role of an exotic hero in a TV movie based on Salgari. In the script by Rulli and Petraglia, the adventurous and imaginative atmosphere of the original story is moderated by a strong emphasis on the "pink" implications.
cast: Stacy Keach, Virna Lisi, Kabir Bedi, John Rhys Davies, Ennio Fantastichini

title: I misteri di Roma
synopsis: Driven by the enthusiasm of the unstoppable Cesare Zavattini, as well as armed with a remarkable vis controversy, a handful of seventeen directors (including Giuseppe Ferrara and Lorenza Mazzetti) descend through the streets of the capital to grasp them, in a day like many others, the moods and flavors that animate it.

title: I mitici. Colpo gobbo a Milano
synopsis: Giulio is in jail, but he already dreams of the next shot. As soon as he comes out, he recruits his brother Fabio, a good and honest antenna player, but left without a job, and a series of even more down-and-out characters. The goal is a jewelry store in via Montenapoleone, but the blow goes badly and the group finds themselves immersed in the garbage. But it is precisely here that the missed thieves find a real treasure: five billion thrown away by someone because they were too hot. The aim of the film was certainly not to remake "I soliti ignoti" by Monicelli but, on the basis of that, to create a nice and funny story. Bellucci is beautiful and quite self-deprecating.
cast: Claudio Amendola, Monica Bellucci, Ricky Memphis, Tony Sperandeo

title: I mongoli
synopsis: Son of the Great Khan, Ogotai is at odds with his father over the peace proposal that comes from the European sovereigns. Stephen of Krakow leads the difficult negotiations, but when he arrives at the Ogotai camp he barely escapes an attack to which the perfidious Huluna, wife of the prince, is no stranger. Stefano then tries to reach the camp of Genghis Khan, more prone to peace, but Ogotai has his father killed and takes his place. It is war. De Toth seems to have directed almost nothing in this boring blockbuster shot in Italy. The battles, the essential part of the film, were shot by Riccardo Freda, other parts of the film by Leopoldo Savona.
cast: Jack Palance, Anita Ekberg, Antonella Lualdi, Franco Silva, Roldano Lupi

title: I morti non pagano tasse
synopsis: The accountant Marco Vecchietti, a modest civil servant, is in trouble. They are about to evict him and he, in applying for a new home, discovers that he has died for the registry office, for seven years already. His new condition as a dead man certainly has positive sides, but new troubles seem to be approaching. Tino Scotti will be remembered more for Falqui advertising than for films like this one.
cast: Tino Scotti, Titina De Filippo, Carlo Campanini

title: I morti rimangono con la bocca aperta
synopsis: In the central Italy of 1944 four partisans flee, chased just as he rages a storm of snow. Wandering in search of a shelter where to hide, they meet a girl.
cast: Emiliano Marrocchi, Domenico D'Addabbo, Fabio Fusco, Olimpia Bonato, Antonio Sinisi

title: I moschettieri del mare
synopsis: A stampede from France leads the three friends Pierre, Moreau and Gosselin to join the filibusta. The ship they are on board, however, is shipwrecked, but the three friends manage to get on a galleon and, having captured the crew, set sail for Maracaibo. The Brothers of the Coast await them there. Although served by a banal story, Steno manages to build a funny story, mixing the comic genre with the picaresque one, also aided by the skill of the actors.
cast: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Robert Alda, Aldo Ray, Channing Pollock

title: I mostri
synopsis: Sometimes there is a little story, sometimes a simple flash is enough to describe the new selfishness of Italians in a society that has left behind the miseries of the post-war period and knows well-being. The unemployed man who lives in the shacks of the Roman suburbs seems tormented by doubts, but then at the stadium he screams like crazy. The old boxer now played is pushed by the businessman on the pavement to return to the ring, but the meeting will be fatal. The deputy, the playboy and the dirty old man, for their part, do not miss an opportunity to prove themselves as real monsters.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Ugo Tognazzi, Michèle Mercier, Lando Buzzanca, Daniele Vargas

title: I mostri oggi
synopsis: Two southerners speculate on hospitality to immigrants, a euphoric and rampant psychoanalyst destroys the already depressed patient, a funeral brings together a successful and a failed actor.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Sabrina Ferilli, Claudio Bisio, Carlo Buccirosso, Angela Finocchiaro, Giorgio Panariello, Anna Foglietta, Rosalia Porcaro, Enzo Cannavale, Ugo Conti, Pilar Abella, Mauro Meconi, Susy Laude, Neri Marcoré, Valeria De Franciscis, Tushar, Chiara Gensini, Veronica Corsi, Cristel Checca

title: I mysi patrí do nebe
synopsis: Lizzy is a small mouse while Red is a fox. For nature they are two sworn enemies. One day, after an unfortunate accident, the two meet in the animal paradise. Together, they will undertake a fantastic journey that will allow them to find out how thanks to friendship, everything can be overcome.

title: I nipoti di Zorro
synopsis: Ciccio and Franco clandestinely board a ship to reach California and venture out in search of gold. Once they land in Las Palmas, they go to their uncle Diego De La Vega for financial help. Then they are duped by two astute scammers and, in the meantime, create problems for Diego De La Vega's son, the famous Zorro.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Dean Reed, Agata Flory

title: I nomi del signor Sulcic
synopsis: A researcher from the University of Ferrara goes to Trieste to find news about a woman buried in the Jewish cemetery. From here begins a research with multiple voices and faces, between Italy and Slovenia, through characters who, little by little, build the contours of the story.
cast: Lucka Pockaj, Elena Radonicich, Ivana Pantaleo, Gabriele Levada, Branko Završan, Roberto Herlitzka, Adalberto Maria Merli, Paolo Graziosi, Claudio Magris, Giorgio Pressburger

title: I nostri anni
synopsis: Natalino, a former partisan, replies to young interviewers. Alberto, his old companion, meets another old man, struck by paresis, in a hospice. The images of the present mingle with those of the past, the faces of the old coexist with those of their young and resistant. Then the revelation: the old paralytic is in reality the ferocious republican who had tortured and massacred Natalino's companions. Alberto goes to Natalino: we found him, he says, we have to kill him, even after fifty years.
cast: Virgilio Biei, Piero Franzo, Giuseppe Boccalatte

title: I nostri fantasmi
synopsis: For fear that the social workers will bring him via Carlo, Valerio decides to hide with his son in the attic and live like ghosts by terrifying the families who alternate one after the other in the apartment below. Everything goes smoothly until Melania and little Emma arrive at home. Melania is in a hurry to enter and is different from the previous tenants: a little because it has a hearing deficit and when the left noises that the two make, moving in the attic are without appliance, come to it as well as in a submerged world; A little because what is out of the way is much more scared of those elusive appearances. His is a flesh and blood ghost, his name is Cristian, and he is violent. But if Melania is too busy dealing with concrete dangers, Emma noticed almost immediately, despite her two years, that there is someone else at home. When finally Melania also discovers the hidden passage for the attic, the instinctive trust that her daughter shows towards the ghosts, convinces Melania not to chase them away immediately. Valerio and Melania begin to like each other but, when they are ready to approach, the unresolved ghosts of their past return to knock overly their door.
cast: Michele Riondino, Hadas Yaron, Paolo Pierobon, Orlando Forte, Alessandro Haber

title: I nostri figli
synopsis: Roberto and Anna Falco live in Senigallia, they have two children and theirs is a successful marriage. He is a small building contractor, while she is an employee of a shopping center. In our crisis-ridden years, Roberto and Anna worked hard to start a family. They feel fulfilled and look to the future with optimism. But suddenly, in front of the Falcos, another family crumbles forever: Elena Di Stefano, Roberto's Sicilian cousin, was killed in Sicily by her ex-husband. He had three children, Luca, Giovanni and Claudio. Like thousands of other children and adolescents, they are "the ones who remain" after the tragedy of a femicide. If there are no relatives willing to take care of them, they will be sent to foster homes. And so it could take years. And "those who remain" will be orphaned forever. But Roberto and Anna, faced with the loneliness and the empty future of these three Sicilian children, make a choice that only the heart can dictate: to immediately take them into foster care, and then later, after a thousand difficulties, to proceed with their adoption.
cast: Vanessa Incontrada, Giorgio Pasotti, Francesco Chinnici, Gabriele Provenzano, Francesco Tiburzi, Rayen Hamzoui, Elia Maugeri, Fabio Galli, Annalisa Insardà, Jerry Mastrodomenico, Monica Dugo, Marzia Ubaldi

title: I nostri ieri
synopsis: The passion for work pushes Luca, documentary maker temporarily lent to teaching in an prison structure, to reconstruct, together with the prisoners, the crime of one of them, forceing their will. Retracing the path of events backwards to create the scenography to be superimposed with the Blue Screen technique, Luca finds himself meeting the family ties that revolve around the incident by pushing him to question himself on his own relationship between identity and memory.
cast: Peppino Mazzotta, Daphne Scoccia, Francesco Di Leva, Maria Roveran, Thierry Toscan, Teresa Saponangelo

title: I nostri mariti
synopsis: Film in three episodes due to three different hands. In the first, by D'Amico, a young man is attracted to a rather masculine woman. After the wedding she refuses any relationship and, indeed, decides to ... Luigi Zampa is the author of the episode entitled "Olga's husband": a man, in order to get hold of an inheritance linked to a strange clause, pushes his wife in the arms of a friend. In the episode of Dino Risi a thief gets caught by the police out of jealousy, but he is very happy because he has had proof of his wife's loyalty.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Ugo Tognazzi, Liana Orfei
director: Luigi Zampa, Dino Risi, Luigi Filippo D'Amico

title: I nostri ragazzi
synopsis: Two very different brothers, one a lawyer and the other a pediatrician, and their respective wives, who can hardly bear each other, have the habit of meeting once a month in a luxury restaurant. Theirs is a tradition that has been going on for years and that proceeds in absolute ordinariness until, one evening, one of the security cameras films a stunt of their respective children. From that moment on, the balance of the two families was shattered.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Luigi Lo Cascio, Barbora Bobulova, Rosabell Laurenti Sellers, Jacopo Olmo Antinori

title: I nostri sogni
synopsis: A penniless young man pretends to be very rich to win the daughter of the company's accountant but not everything will go as planned ...
cast: Maria Mercader, Vittorio De Sica, Paolo Stoppa, Guglielmo Barnabò

title: I nuovi barbari
synopsis: In the year 2019 the great nuclear war is over and the survivors are fighting each other on a polluted and doomed planet. Powerful is the band of Templars led by leader One against which Skorpion fights, helped by other strange characters. The model is Mad Max, the completely self-sufficient realization. And it shows.
cast: Giancarlo Prete, Luigi Montefiori, Fred Williamson, Anna Kanakis

title: I nuovi mostri
synopsis: Fourteen episodes of ordinary monstrosity: a singer is exploited by her entrepreneur husband; a cardinal brings to order a group of faithful in turmoil; a debauched aristocrat "rescues" a pedestrian; cook and waiter scramble in the kitchen of a trattoria; a group of comedians turns a funeral into a small unscheduled show ...
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Ornella Muti, Alberto Sordi, Ugo Tognazzi
director: Mario Monicelli, Ettore Scola, Dino Risi

title: I onde dager
synopsis: The wedding between Lars and Lisa saw better days. Their lives have not finished as they thought. However, a weekend trip to a hut in the woods could give them the opportunity to start from scratch ... as soon as one of the two died.
cast: Noomi Rapace, Aksel Hennie, Andre Eriksen, Christian Rubeck, Atle Antonsen, Nils Ole Oftebro, Tor Erik Gunstrøm

title: I padroni dell'estate
synopsis: The intact coasts of Sardinia have always been the subject of attempted or successful building speculations. A group of young people who for years have been spending their holidays in those places are experiencing some experiences related to an attack on a villa and the upheaval of a fishing village.
cast: Christiane Jean, Jean Boissery, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gianni Agus

title: I padroni della città
synopsis: The clash between Luigi's gang and that of the "Scarred" is unequal. The latter is stronger, so much so that Beppe, Luigi's lieutenant, kills his boss and goes to the other side. But the "Scarred" did not deal with Ric and Tony, who set up a trap at the slaughterhouse and make a clean sweep of their enemies by taking possession of all their wealth.
cast: Jack Palance, Al Cliver, Harry Baer, Gisela Hahn, Edmund Purdom, Vittorio Caprioli

title: I pagliacci
synopsis: Served twenty years in prison for a passionate murder, a man tries to reconcile with his daughter (who knows nothing of his past) who grew up in a wealthy family. The man tells his story to a composer who draws an opera from it, witnessing which the girl is moved by understanding the drama of her father. A curious variation on the theme of Leoncavallo's "Pagliacci" which skilfully mixes cinema (the re-enactment of the real news story that inspired Leoncavallo's opera) and melodrama (you can see a scene from the opera).
cast: Alida Valli, Paul Hörbiger, Beniamino Gigli

title: I pagliacci
synopsis: From Ruggero Leoncavallo's best-known work: Canio, a clown in a company of wandering actors, is jealous of his wife Nedda, who actually has a lover, Silvio, a young landowner in the area. When the truth comes out, Canio acts with death in his heart but then loses the sense of fiction and confronts his wife with a dagger.
cast: Tito Gobbi, Gina Lollobrigida, Afro Poli, Filippo Morucci

title: I paladini - Storia d'armi e di amori
synopsis: A sorceress has predicted to the Christian warrior Bradamante that she will fall in love with an enemy: a Saracen named Ruggero who, however, is destined to die at the hands of Rolando who loves Isabella, who is a prisoner of Bradamante ... courtly tradition (and, perhaps involuntarily, to the puppet opera), Battiato makes a film that is not very inspired, aesthetic and not at all involving.
cast: Zeudi Araya, Barbara De Rossi, Rick Edwards, Leigh McCloskey

title: I pappagalli
synopsis: The Sunday of the maids of a Roman building under the watchful and good-natured eye of a janitor. Some "curtains" among the many: Angela tries to kill herself with gas after learning that her boyfriend has left her to marry another. A shy sailor would like to "board" a servant girl. He will succeed only with the good-natured complicity of the porter. Doctor Tanzi seduces Juliet as soon as his wife leaves him alone. A little later, in agreement with his wife, he fires her.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Alberto Sordi, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Elsa Merlini

title: I pavoni
synopsis: Vittorio, a boy from a good family, but spoiled, arrogant and with money as his only value, with the help of some friends he kills his family. Inspired by the story of Pietro Maso, with some pretense of formal rigor and some verbose sociologism too many.
cast: Rinaldo Rocco, Nicola Russo, Sabrina Knaflitz, Vincenzo Crivello, Victor Cavallo

title: I peggiori
synopsis: Hoping to guarantee a better future for their thirteen-year-old sister Chiara, Massimo and Fabrizio, two penniless brothers with no prospects, invent an unusual business. Armed with masks and micro-cameras, they will publicly demolish the identity of the various 'smart guys in the neighborhood', thus becoming two unlikely 'paid heroes'.
cast: Lino Guanciale, Vincenzo Alfieri, Miriam Candurro, Antonella Attili, Tommaso Ragno, Sara Tancredi, Biagio Izzo, Francesco Paolantoni, Ernesto Mahieux

title: I peggiori giorni
synopsis: Four episodes set in as many different days of celebration, who know how to bring out the worst by people. At Christmas, three brothers decide to draw up to choose who, among them, will have to give a kidney to the father. An entrepreneur, already in itself close to bankruptcy, during the celebrations for May 1st is kidnapped by one of his former employees fired without just cause and willing to do anything to obtain the money of the liquidation they are responsible for. In August, the classic grilled is seasoned by a heated clash between social classes. In Halloween a magician discovers he has been hired by what has always been his rival in love.
cast: Edoardo Leo, Massimiliano Bruno, Anna Foglietta, Giuseppe Battiston, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Claudia Pandolfi, Neri Marcoré, Ricky Memphis, Rocco Papaleo, Anna Ferzetti, Giovanni Storti, Sara Baccarini

title: I piaceri dello scapolo
synopsis: Two middle-aged bachelors decide to hire a garçonniere for their love affairs. Until then, in fact, the lack of a job was the justification for their frequent failures. But every time the two brothers try to use the apartment with the conquest of the moment, a new impediment arises. The protagonists of the film are the Carotenuto brothers, who generally play minor roles. The comedy is pulled away with various stunts.
cast: Mario Carotenuto, Memmo Carotenuto, Sylva Koscina

title: I picari
synopsis: Two vagabonds, Guzman (Giannini) and Lazzarillo (Montesano), try to make do in sixteenth-century Spain. They improvise servants, pretend to be blind, act as actors and try to prostitute a beautiful girl. But it is all useless: they will have to continue to be pìcari, or vagabonds who have to take care above all to survive.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Enrico Montesano, Vittorio Gassman, Nino Manfredi, Giuliana De Sio

title: I piccoli maestri
synopsis: Autumn 1943: a group of university students leaves for the Asiago plateau to fight against the Nazis. The group is joined by a worker, a sailor, a professor who cultivates an anti-fascist sentiment and a young Alpine non-commissioned officer. At the first round-up the boys realize that war is a serious matter.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Stefania Montorsi, Marco Paolini, Giorgio Pasotti

title: I pionieri
synopsis: Sicily, late 80s. Enrico Belfiore's parents have a single passion and one faith, that for politics and for the communist party. The boy, on the other hand, would just like to live a normal life, without being replaced as "the little Soviet". Tired of the ideological heritage that is imposed on him by his parents, Enrico runs away in the woods together with his friend Renato. Together the pioneers of Italy, a communist scout field, almost re -worsen, managing to involve other peers. What was born first as an escape and then as a game, will soon become a growth path that will prove to be fundamental for the boys involved.
cast: Mattia Bonaventura, Francesco Cilia, Danilo Di Vita, Matilde Sofia Fazio, Peppino Mazzotta, Lorenza Indovina, Eleonora Danco, Claudio Bigagli

title: I pirati della Malesia
synopsis: A young Hindu falls in love with a beautiful white girl held captive by a ferocious sect of Thugs. In an attempt to free her, he is taken prisoner and at that point he is forced to submit to blackmail: he can only be saved if he kills the English governor. It is a Salgari badly brought to the screen by the veteran Guazzoni, attempting an autarchic path to exoticism which proved to be unsuccessful.
cast: Massimo Girotti, Clara Calamai, Camillo Pilotto

title: I pirati della Malesia
cast: Steve Reeves, Mimmo Palmara, Jacqueline Sassard, Nando Gazzolo, Andrea Bosic, Pierre Cressoy

title: I pirati della costa
synopsis: The precious silver cargo transported on the Spanish ship captained by Luis de Monterey is raided by pirates. Luis, held responsible for the incident, is then tried and sentenced to forced labor for life. On the ship that transports him to the penal colony, he leads a mutiny, takes command of the ship and heads for the pirate base on the island of Tortuga. He soon becomes a pirate leader. The short film is shot without means and without pretensions.
cast: Lex Barker, Gérard Blain, Liana Orfei, Livio Lorenzon

title: I pirati di Capri
synopsis: Naples, second half of the 18th century: Captain Scirocco leads the hungry and oppressed people of Queen Carolina, enslaved to the German nobleman von Holstein, to revolt. However, the Count of Amalfi is hiding under her guise, trying to get her to sign the armistice ...
cast: Louis Hayward, Binnie Barnes, Mariella Lotti, Massimo Serato

title: I più grandi di tutti
synopsis: Friends Loris (Alessandro Roya), Sabrina (Claudia Pandolfi), Rino (Dario Cappanera) and Maurilio (Marco Cocci) played their rock music for pleasure when with their band, Pluto, they experienced an extraordinary successful season, which in the mid-nineties he brought them from Livorno to climb the sales charts and perform around the world. Later, due to a series of successive misunderstandings, they split up, losing sight of and abandoning the music, until they were forgotten. But one day Loris receives an e-mail from their only fan, a disabled boy, who invites them to reconstitute the group for a special concert.
cast: Claudia Pandolfi, Alessandro Roja, Marco Cocci, Corrado Fortuna, Frankie Hi Nrg, Dario Cappanera, Catherine Spaak, Claudia Potenza

title: I pompieri
synopsis: The fire brigade of Rome is enriched with a new team: number 17. This is made up of young people in civil service or recalled elderly. It goes without saying that the team is known for its ineptitude until, when called by a former colleague to put out a fire in a restaurant, they behave in an excellent way.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Lino Banfi, Ricky Tognazzi, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato

title: I pompieri di Viggiù
synopsis: Today the song that gives the title to the film is perhaps an archaeological find, but in its time it was at least as famous as the Hymn of Mameli. In order to exploit this "boom", the little film was made which, in some way linking magazine pictures, carries on a plot thread: the firefighters who do not want to be mocked by the song and their commander who wants to marry his daughter to a fireman, but discovers that he is far too stupid. The actors are the ones who raged in the magazine and Mario Mattoli directs for pure routine, but some numbers are truly incomparable documents (Totò who is the mannequin and the conductor, Dapporto Petronio and Monsieur Verdoux etc.). Almost a documentary, and see the beautiful article that Ennio Flaiano wrote about it at the time.
cast: Carlo Campanini, Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Croccolo, Totò

title: I predatori
synopsis: The Pavone and the Vismara are two completely different families of extraction. At the antipodes are apparently opposite nuclei that share the same jungle, Rome. A trivial accident will make those two poles touch. And the madness of a 25-year-old boy will make them collide, uncovering the cards to reveal that everyone has a secret and no one is what they seem. And that we are all predators.
cast: Massimo Popolizio, Manuela Mandracchia, Pietro Castellitto, Giorgio Montanini, Dario Cassini, Anita Caprioli, Marzia Ubaldi, Antonio Gerardi, Nando Paone, Vinicio Marchioni

title: I predatori dell'anno Omega
synopsis: Nuclear wars have devastated and transformed the world. In command of his Omega forces, now the sinister Prossor maintains the dictatorship over the Illuminati with an iron fist. Directed by David Worth, in 1989 co-director of Kickboxer.
cast: Robert Ginty, Persis Khambatta, Fred Williamson

title: I predatori di Atlantide
synopsis: A Russian submarine sinks off Florida. Recovery is attempted from a US platform. During the operations, a tablet with pre-Columbian inscriptions emerges from the ocean floor. A terrifying wave sweeps across the platform. The few survivors and two adventurers who sailed in the area end up on a mysterious island, not marked on the maps, dominated by a masked tyrant. Series C adventures, with little money and more than a debt to Indiana Jones
cast: Christopher Connelly, Gioia Maria Scola, Tony King, George Hilton, Ivan Rassimov

title: I predoni della steppa
synopsis: In order to obtain a large ransom, Sandar, leader of a tribe of marauders, kidnaps Samira, daughter of Yessen and betrothed to the powerful Altan. But falling in love with the girl, he ends up returning her to his parent with the hope of being forgiven.
cast: Kirk Morris, Moira Orfei, Ombretta Colli, Giulio Donnini

title: I prepotenti
synopsis: A long series of quarrels between two families, one Roman and the other Neapolitan, ends with an engagement. Amusing jumble of regionalist parochialism, adequately supported by the actors on the field. The film had a good success and today it remains enjoyable even without great pretensions.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Nino Taranto, Mario Riva, Ferruccio Amendola

title: I primi della lista
synopsis: June 1, 1970. In the circles of the University of Pisa, the news spread that the Italian army is ready for a coup d'état like that of a few years earlier in Greece and the most exposed students are advised to leave home for a couple of days, in order to avoid arrest. Pino Masi, a young left-wing singer-songwriter, returns home and together with Renzo Lulli and Fabio Gismondi, two high school students fascinated by his music, plans to cross the border and leave Italy. They set off by car but, after avoiding the Yugoslav border, they head for Austria, where they realize they have made a huge mistake.
cast: Claudio Santamaria, Francesco Turbanti, Paolo Cioni, Sergio Pierattini, Daniela Morozzi, Pierpaolo Capovilla, Fabio Gismondi

title: I promessi sposi
synopsis: The film faithfully traces the pages of the great novel by Alessandro Manzoni, beginning with the warning of the bravo to Don Abbondio not to celebrate the fateful marriage. Then continuing with the escape from the country, the conversion of the Unnamed, the revolt, the plague and, therefore, the wedding. Film substantially faithful to the novel, also from an iconographic point of view (often referring to the illustrations of the 1827 edition), a little cold but highly professional: produced with a great deal of means by Lux, it was written by Gabriele Baldoini and Ivo Perilli with the collaboration of Emilio Cecchi and Riccardo Bacchelli and set to music by Ildebrando Pizzetti.
cast: Gino Cervi, Dina Sassoli, Ruggero Ruggeri, Gilda Marchiò

title: I promessi sposi
synopsis: The destinies and stories of some people struggling with the period preceding the wedding day. The protagonists are the couples about to get married, the employees of the marriage offices of the Italian municipalities and a provincial priest. Each of them gives us back an aspect of marriage.

title: I prosseneti
synopsis: The elderly Davide and his wife, Countess Gilda have transformed their splendid villa into a dating house. Odile, daughter of a woman tortured by mercenaries, meets one of the torturers in the villa and wishes to relive the sufferings suffered by her mother on her body. An ambassador abandoned by his partner, he imposes on his new partner to take his place. An unscrupulous eighteen year old sticks an orgy.
cast: Alain Cuny, Juliette Mayniel, Luciano Salce, Stefania Casini, Ilona Staller

title: I protagonisti
synopsis: The Sardinian bandit Taddeu agrees to meet, for a fee, tourists looking for excitement. A group of five people join him, but while they are intent on interviewing him, the police forces arrive and have discovered the outlaw's lair. The behavior of the tourists is ambiguous, one even fires a few shots at the agents. In the years of the "contestation", the debut of a director who would specialize in comedies. Here, on a subject by Flaiano, he tackles issues of social criticism without great inventiveness against the backdrop of Sardinian landscapes. The rich cast is a little confused.
cast: Jean Sorel, Sylva Koscina, Lou Castel

title: I pugni in tasca
synopsis: A blind mother and her four children live in a country villa. Theirs is a very particular family, also because many of the boys have serious mental problems. Among these only Augustus seems to aspire to a condition of bourgeois normality. Leone is subnormal and ends up drowned in the tub by Sandro. He is epileptic and Giulia is also not entirely "okay", at least judging by the way she watches her brother die during an epilepsy crisis.
cast: Lou Castel, Paola Pitagora, Marino Masé, Pier Luigi Troglio, Liliana Gerace

title: I quattro bersaglieri
synopsis: Mario (Sordi) is in the military in Rome. He gets engaged to Maria and, when he is transferred to Libya, she follows him as a Red Cross nurse. Failed attempt at comedy that renders the atmosphere of the Italian belle qpoque. We do not laugh enough, nor do we cry enough when, in the end, we touch the tragedy.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Lyla Rocco, Mirka Ellis, Maurizio Arena

title: I quattro del pater noster
synopsis: Three adventurers stumble upon a hidden treasure and steal it. Unfortunately, however, it is the stolen goods of a group of bandits. Believed to be responsible for the thefts, they are captured and imprisoned. They will be chased away by a fourth buddy, but once outside they will have to contend with the bandits who want their gold back.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Lino Toffolo, Enrico Montesano, Oreste Lionello, Rosemary Dexter, Mariangela Giordano, Silvia Donati, Enzo Fiermonte, Salvatore Borghese, Gaetano Scala

title: I quattro dell'Apocalisse
synopsis: The characters in the title are the cheater and ex-convict Stubby, the pregnant prostitute Bunny, the negro Burt and the drunkard Clem. After escaping a massacre perpetrated in their village by a hooded gang, the four wander the desert where they meet the ferocious Chaco who rapes Bunny and kills Clem while Burt goes mad. But the troubles of the gang are not over.
cast: Fabio Testi, Lynne Frederick, Tomas Milian, Michael J. Pollard, Harry Baird, Adolfo Lastretti, Bruno Corazzari, Giorgio Trestini, Donald O'Brien

title: I quattro dell'Ave Maria
synopsis: Cacopoulos is now an old bandit who, due to the betrayal of his cronies, is serving a long prison sentence. A proposal is made to him to be able to end his stay in prison: he must find Cat and Hutch, two robbers, and recover the money that the two criminals have stolen from a bank. Finding them, he relieves them of the booty which he begins to distribute to the poor. Second film by the couple Terence Hill-Bud Spencer, one year before the resounding success of the Trinity cycle, when the comic and manesque formula was not yet finalized; it stands out for its epic and light-hearted tone, although there are some delays mainly due to the script by Colizzi himself.
cast: Eli Wallach, Bud Spencer, Terence Hill, Kevin McCarthy, Brock Peters, Steffen Zacharias

title: I quattro pistoleri di Santa Trinità
synopsis: Far west. A gang targets a girl to have her deliver some precious documents. Nothing to do: she runs away with the papers and finds understanding and help in a journalist and a sheriff in disguise. The trio will battle the bandits.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Ida Galli, Raf Baldassarre, Valeria Fabrizi, Salvatore Furnari, Daniela Giordano, Philippe Hersent, Antonella Murgia, Antonio Pierfederici, Daniele Vargas

title: I quattro tassisti
synopsis: Film in four episodes. "The bridegroom": a boyfriend, reluctantly headed to the church where he is expected for the wedding, changes his mind in favor of the beautiful taxi driver. "A good work": a false nun swindles a driver and extorts a large sum from him. "Treasure hunt": a lady from high society makes a tantrum at the expense of a taxi driver. "The man in blue": a killer customer also wants to eliminate the man who carries him.
cast: Gino Bramieri, Peppino De Filippo, Erminio Macario, Aldo Fabrizi

title: I racconti dell'Orso
synopsis: A little girl dreams: a magical and deserted world, where a mechanical monk chases a strange little red man through abandoned woods, lakes and cities; wandering, the two encounter an injured teddy bear and try to save him.
cast: Samuele Sestieri, Olmo Amato, Freya Roberts, Bengt Roberts

title: I racconti della camera rossa
cast: Lily Hwa, Mei Chan, Kok Tan, Rose Yu, Hung Li Mia

title: I racconti di Canterbury
synopsis: Pellegrini traveling for Canterbury tells about short stories: a student seduces the wife of a superstitious woodsmith; Two friends take revenge on a dishonest miller; The misadventures of Candido and Gaio Perkin; An insatiable woman "consumes" five husbands; A mature bachelor marries a too young wife; the descent to the underworld of a friar; The failures of another friar to whom nobody wants to buy the relics. Second film of the "Trilogy of life", in which Pasolini marries the popular narrative vein of Geoffrey Chaucer with sensitivity of filmmaker and virulent choice of intellectual provocation. But the film is the least vital and interesting of the trilogy. Golden bear in Berlin.
cast: Hugh Griffith, Laura Betti, Ninetto Davoli, Franco Citti, Josephine Chaplin

title: I racconti di Viterburi - Le più allegre storie del '300
synopsis: Messer Antonio, inexperienced with women, spends his wedding night with his mother-in-law, who has offered to instruct him. The Ghibelline Menico da Pistoia, who loves Tonia (the daughter of the Guelph Jacopo della Quercia), tries several times to enter his beauty's house, passing through the window, but a series of disastrous falls convince him to give up on the girl. A diabolical turkey ruins an unfaithful wife's affair with an exorcist friar. Mona Fiora uses an ingenious trick to make love with her mother's consent. Gallinella, Nicolò's wife, is at first afraid of consummating the marriage, but when it is decided to reduce her husband to death. In agreement with her husband, the wife of a miller obtains the labor for free, putting her lovers to the millstone. Cecco da Viterbo frees himself with the cunning of a man who would like to force him into a shotgun marriage with his sister.
cast: Rosalba Neri, Christa Linder, Toni Ucci, Giacomo Rizzo, Peter Landers, Mario Brega

title: I racconti romani di una ex novizia
synopsis: To cheer up his cellmates, a prisoner tells a story that Pietro Aretino would have already told in the past to Leo X. It is the story of Nanna, who entered the convent full of devotion and then left without virginity and without faith. Later she manages to marry thanks to the help of her mother and to convince her husband of her own illegality. One day, Nanna learns that her husband is organizing an orgy with four friends and a servant, so she abandons him to become a prostitute. When her daughter gets old enough, Nanna will start her on the same path ...
cast: Karin Mayer, Gino Cervi, Francis Blanche, Luciana Turina, Tania Lopert, Céline Bessy

title: I ragazzi dei Parioli
synopsis: Pretending to be film producers, two young men from Roma hope to attract young girls. The first meeting seems to turn into tragedy, then everything is resolved with laughter. At the beginning of his career Corbucci had some claim to social analysis, which was immediately abandoned. This is a portrait of a post-neorealist environment, uncertain but with some acute moments.
cast: Raf Mattioli, Alessandra Panaro, Ennio Girolami, Scilla Gabel, Nino Manfredi

title: I ragazzi del 42º plotone
synopsis: Vietnam. A showgirl hired to raise the troop's low morale arrives in an American gathering camp. During his performance, the Vietcong launch a deadly attack. Two marines manage to save the girl and escape into the jungle.
cast: Victor Rivers, Christopher Alan

title: I ragazzi del juke box
synopsis: Between the commendator Cesari, owner of a record company, and his daughter Giulia there is an irremediable disagreement as the first fiercely supports the superiority of the Italian-style melodic song, the second that of the modern song. Cesari, who is determined to remove from his company all those who do not think like him, promotes the foundation of a fan club in Appio Claudio, a champion of melodic music.
cast: Tony Dallara, Betty Curtis, Fred Buscaglione, Mario Carotenuto, Adriano Celentano

title: I ragazzi del massacro
synopsis: Milan, suburbs. A group of stoned classmates kidnap, rape and kill the teacher. Investigate Duca Lamberti, who will find himself having to deal with a wall of "rubber" and silence as not even in Palermo.
cast: Pier Paolo Capponi, Susan Scott, Marzio Margine, Renato Lupi

title: I ragazzi dell'Hully Gully
synopsis: The legacy of Maurice, a degenerate descendant of a noble lineage enriched by composing light music, entices the scandalized but shabby relationship. To get your hands on the heritage, however, you have to submit to a condition set by the deceased: guess which song will win the national grand prix ...
cast: Alicia Brandet, Claudio Privitera, Ave Ninchi, Angela Luce, Carlo Pisacane, Carlo Delle Piane, Carlo Dapporto

title: I ragazzi della Roma violenta
cast: Gino Milli, Cristina Businari, Emilio Lo Curcio, Sara Crespi

title: I ragazzi della via Pál
synopsis: The stories of a gang of kids, the Società dello Stucco, and their friends / rivals, the Red Shirts, in the everyday life of a childhood spent in the streets of the city of Budapest in an area of ??building land near the Pál street, to look for spaces where to play freely.
cast: Gáspár Mesés, Nancy Brilli, Mario Adorf, Virna Lisi, Bálint Menyhért Bán, Zoltán Benkóczy, Gaby Dohm, Csaba Gáspár, János Gosztonyi, István Göz

title: I ragazzi dello Zecchino d'Oro
synopsis: Bologna, the sixties. Mimmo, 9, is a very lively child with little inclination to study. When the little boy is suspended from school after yet another prank, mother Ernestina, desperate, takes him to an audition for a singing competition. What nobody knows yet is that that audition is the beginning of a show destined to make history: the Zecchino d'Oro. Mimmo is taken along with other children of all backgrounds and social classes who, under the guidance of the young Mariele, become increasingly good. After the show, however, the children resume their usual life, sad because they will no longer sing together. Mariele, sorry for having "abandoned" her boys, decides to form a stable choir, which is a real school of music and life: the Piccolo Coro dell'Antoniano.
cast: Matilda De Angelis, Maya Sansa, Antonio Gerardi, Valentina Cervi, Simone Gandolfo, Saul Nanni, Ruben Santiago Vecchi, Stefano Pesce, Guido Roncalli, Eros Galbiati, Olga Rui Marchi, Gregorio Mondello

title: I ragazzi di Bandiera gialla
cast: Gianni Pettenati, Gianni Boncompagni, Lucio Dalla, Patty Pravo

title: I ragazzi di via Panisperna
synopsis: 1934, Rome: sincere but not always happy friendship between Enrico Fermi and Ettore Majorana, souls of the physics research group called _The boys of via Panisperna_, to discover slow neutrinos, which are then essential for nuclear energy.
cast: Andrea Prodan, Ennio Fantastichini, Laura Morante, Michele Melega

title: I rec u
synopsis: Neve is 19 and suffers from a rare eye disease: she sees all women out of focus. He can only see them correctly in recorded movies and images. For this he wears special glasses that record every moment of his life, allowing him to see correctly. His life, however, has thus become a film in its own way: this until the day when he meets a woman, the only one, who can see correctly, without the aid of recorded images.
cast: Federica Bertolani, Guglielmo Favilla, Terry Gilliam, Cay Izumi, Dolphine Lundgren, Andrea Massaccesi, Sara Mastellone, Isabella Pennisi, Lorenzo Porzi, Mattia Settembrini

title: I recuperanti
synopsis: 1945: the veteran Gianni, having returned to his native village on the Asiago plateau, finds his girlfriend but not his job. The only job he can find is very dangerous: he must in fact recover metal residues (unexploded bombs) together with the elderly Du.
cast: Andreino Carli, Antonio Lunardi, Alessandra Micheletto, Oreste Costa

title: I ricordi del fiume
synopsis: Over a thousand people of different nationalities lived among rats and garbage in shacks built with metal sheets and wood. It was the platz, one of the largest slums in Europe, on the banks of the Stura river in Turin. Many - including children, women and the elderly - lived for years in this invisible microcosm: an urban yet vital anomaly destined to no longer exist. In fact, in December 2014, an ambitious and delicate project with a high social impact brought about its dismantling and the transfer of part of the families to normal homes.
director: Gianluca De Serio, Massimiliano De Serio

title: I rymden finns inga känslor
synopsis: The eighteen year old Simon is affected by Asperger's syndrome and needs a methodical and schematic life that his brother Sam has always guaranteed him, trying not to alter his rhythms and habits. But Sam, dumped by the girl, falls into a state of apathy and desolation that no longer allows him to stay behind Simon who, disoriented and enveloped by chaos, can only devise a plan to get everything back to normal: find him a new girl, despite knowing nothing about how emotions and love work.
cast: Bill Skarsgård, Martin Wallström, Cecilia Forss, Sofie Hamilton, Susanne Thorson, Kristoffer Berglund, Jimmi Edlund, Per Andersson, Lotta Tejle, Ingmar Virta

title: I senza Dio
synopsis: After the robbery in El Paso, a price of $ 15,000 is placed on the head of the bandit Corbancho. And when $ 400,000 loot is plundered in Tucson (with the aggravating circumstance of the murder of McFallow, director of the lender), everyone believes it is a new venture by the same outlaw. They don't think so Roy, the son of the late McFallow, and a bounty hunter known as the "Minnesota Killer". Banker Barrett, his wife Jennifer and Sheriff Sam Huston are also interested in the misdeeds that are multiplying in the region ...
cast: Antonio Sabato, Erika Blanc, Paul Stevens, Franco Marletta, Pilar Velazquez

title: I sequestrati di Altona
synopsis: Franz Gerlach, a former Wehrmacht officer, remained for years in the attic of the family villa in Altona, near Hamburg, hidden and protected by his father and sister. But after meeting his sister-in-law Johanna, his life changes radically ...
cast: Sophia Loren, Maximilian Schell, Fredric March, Françoise Prevost

title: I sette del gruppo selvaggio
synopsis: Cooper's gang rages around the village of Stanton, and his latest brutality is the robbery of a young widow, who was then raped and killed. Sheriff Perry is upright and brave, but his action is too slow and legal for Jeff, the gunfighter's brother. The differences between the two cause the death of a friend of the sheriff and of Liz, a girl dear to Jeff. Then, the gunslinger and the lawman join forces, find the support of other men and liquidate Cooper's gang. Indigestible sequence of stereotyped scenes and situations, exploited a thousand times by a genre that in 1975, when the film (shot three years earlier) comes out, is already dead and buried.
cast: Femi Benussi, Gordon Mitchell, Mario Brega, Dean Strattford

title: I sette dell'Orsa maggiore
synopsis: On 19 December 1941, a group of navy soldiers, under the leadership of officer Silvani, with their submarines managed to break through the defenses of the port of Alexandria and held up against the British battleships Valiant and Queen Elizabeth, winning the battle.
cast: Pierre Cressoy, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Tino Carraro, Paolo Panelli

title: I sogni del lago salato
synopsis: Kazakhstan is experiencing the euphoria of development that Italy does not even remember anymore. Yet its growth is closely linked to the Italian economy. The growth of the Kazakh economy, equal to 6% per year (a rate that Italy only had in the 1960s), is largely based on the extraction of oil and gas. ENI plays a key role in the management of Kazakh fields and there are many Italians working in Kazakhstan. The images of the great Eurasian steppes, of the infinite and orderly spaces of the post-Soviet lands with images of Italy in the Sixties, found both in the ENI archives and in the personal ones shot by Andrea Segre's mother and father.

title: I sogni muoiono all'alba
synopsis: November 1956. Budapest, Hotel Duna. Locked in a room, five Italian journalists of different political tendencies live together the last hours of the Hungarian revolution. Among them are the young Communist who goes into crisis and goes down to fight with the Hungarian revolutionaries against the Soviet invasion, the old trombone and ignorant journalist, and the elderly, detached and cultured journalist.
cast: Lea Massari, Aroldo Tieri, Mario Feliciani, Ivo Garrani, Gianni Santuccio
director: Indro Montanelli, Enrico Gras, Mario Craveri

title: I sogni nel cassetto
synopsis: Lucia, chemistry student in Pavia and Mario, a young graduate in medicine, fall in love. Their problem is that her parents are against it. But Lucia and Paolo do not want to know and go to a priest to be united in marriage. Once this is done, the parents are forced to accept their union which is cheered by the birth of a beautiful baby. But Lucia dies in giving birth to the child and Paolo decides to go and live with the child with Lucia's parents.
cast: Lea Massari, Enrico Pagani, Lilla Brignone, Sergio Tofano

title: I sogni proibiti di don Galeazzo, curato di campagna
cast: Franco Aloisi, Eva Gabriel, Anna Zinnemann, Eleonora Morana

title: I soliti idioti. Il film
synopsis: The elderly Ruggero (Francesco Mandelli), vulgar and dishonest like few others, can no longer stand to see the teachings on life that he has long tried to pass on to his son Gianluca (Fabrizio Biggio), a young university researcher who still lives in home with his parents but now close to marriage with his girlfriend Fabiana. Accused of being clumsy, inconclusive and not very attracted to women, one day, however, Gianluca amazes his father by revealing to him that he is infatuated with the model (Madalina Ghenea) with an underwear commercial and so, instead of taking him to church on his wedding day, Ruggero drags him on a crazy journey from Milan to Rome, in search of the model with whom he can prove to be a real man and characterized by increasingly bizarre encounters.
cast: Francesco Mandelli, Fabrizio Biggio, Madalina Ghenea, Valeria Bilello, Giordano De Plano, Miriam Leone, Marco Foschi, Gian Marco Tognazzi

title: I soliti ignoti
synopsis: An inexperienced and down-and-out group of thieves has organized a theft in a Roman pawnshop. The old former stable boy Capannelle, the Sicilian Ferribotte, the photographer Tiberio, the mammon Mario and the boxer played Peppe take lessons from the burglar Dante. The action, despite some unforeseen events, goes through; but instead of breaking through the right wall the group ends up in ...
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Vittorio Gassman, Marcello Mastroianni, Totò, Carlo Pisacane

title: I soliti ignoti vent'anni dopo
synopsis: Tiberio (Mastroianni), Peppe (Gassman) and Ferribotte (Murgia), three of Monicelli's Soliti ignoti, throw themselves back into an illegal enterprise, with other occasional partners. It will end badly this time too and, for one of them, very badly. The film aims to be fun and at the same time bring out the regret for the good time it was. The results, however, are rather modest and do not hold up to the comparison with the 1958 film. Modest pace, not exactly irresistible gags, but a poignant beginning and a dry drama finish. Recycled music by Nino Rota.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio Gassman, Tiberio Murgia, Clelia Rondinella

title: I sopravvissuti della città morta
synopsis: Dean, an English lord passionate about archeology, goes to Turkey in search of the temple of the god Gilgamesh and the golden scepter, which according to a legend would give those who possess it the power to intervene on the fate of the world. But the evil Emir Abdullah is also interested in the precious artifact.
cast: David Warbeck, John Steiner, Susie Sudlow, Alan Collins, Ricardo Palacios

title: I sovversivi
synopsis: Against the background of Togliatti's funeral there are four stories of communist militancy: a director leaves the cinema to go around the world in search of more direct contacts with reality and with men; a Venezuelan exile returns to his country to take the place of a comrade killed by the government; a PCI official goes into crisis with his wife; a philosopher turns to photography and turns out to be nonconformist and individualistic.
cast: Giulio Brogi, Lucio Dalla, Ferruccio De Ceresa

title: I tabù
synopsis: Despite modernity, today's world is still studded with numerous taboos. A reportage sheds light on the most cruel, useless, violent and haunting, alternating ancient myths and modern anguish.
cast: Laila Novak, Vincent Price, Stefano Sibaldi

title: I tartari
synopsis: The Viking leader Oleg goes with his brother Eric to the Tatar camp where the great chief Trogul awaits them. He would like to establish an alliance with the Vikings to counter the advance of the Slavs. But when Oleg refuses, Trogul attacks him, trying to hurt him, but he's the one who gets the worst of it and succumbs. He is succeeded by his brother Burundai, thirsting for revenge also because his daughter Samia is in the hands of the Vikings and it is his intention to exchange her with Helga, the wife of Oleg, his prisoner. At the moment of the exchange, however, Burundai rapes Helga and she, for the shame suffered, tries to commit suicide. The situation worsened ...
cast: Orson Welles, Victor Mature, Folco Lulli, Liana Orfei, Arnoldo Foà

title: I tartassati
synopsis: Cavalier Pezzella, who owns a large fabric shop, fears an inspection by the Tributary. When this happens, Pezzella tries every expedient to bribe the honest Marshal Topponi. His attempts are in vain, although the shopkeeper also tries to exploit the relationship between his son and Topponi's daughter. Fortunately, social satire is not even mentioned. The film is a collection of duets by Totò and Fabrizi, in which the first is almost always the winner.
cast: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Louis De Funès, Cathia Caro, Cesare Fantoni

title: I teddy boys della canzone
synopsis: A promising but very unfortunate singer and an inventor with no apparent quality implant a pirate antenna on the roof of a house, producing a broadcast that is very successful among the public and creates a niche of fans. They will be hired by state TV, despite the illegality of their actions, as their verve will prove enormously appreciated.
cast: Tony Dallara, Delia Scala, Teddy Reno, Paolo Panelli, Mina

title: I tempi felici verranno presto
synopsis: Tommaso and Arturo managed to escape by seeking refuge in the forest. Life is beautiful now, despite everything. But you always die when you least expect it, even if you are young, happy at last and have never done anything wrong. Many years later, nowadays, the forest seems to be infested with hungry wolves. Nobody remembers the story of the two young men, but Ariane discovers a strange hole in that forest. Is Ariane, then, the girl that valley legend talks about? Why Ariane entered that hole remains a mystery, the fact is that nothing more was known about her. Everyone tells this story in his own way, but everyone agrees that Ariane the wolf met him.
cast: Sabrina Seyvecou, Luca Bernardi, Erikas Sizonovas, Carlo Rigoni, Marco Giordana, Marinella Cichello, Paolo Viano

title: I terribili sette
synopsis: Some children accidentally find a baby in swaddling clothes abandoned in a meadow. Initially, after taking him to their lair, they plan to sell him to a caravan of gypsies, to found a football team with the proceeds of the barter. As the days go by, however, they become fond of the baby and some of them begin to think again. Meanwhile, the mother - who had been seized by an illness - is desperately looking for the baby ...
cast: Roberto Chevalier, Antonio Piretti, Stefano Tamborra, Stefano Conti, Loris Loddi, Massimo Giuliani, Claudio Maccari, Patrizia Canevari, Angelo Secchi, Umberto D'Orsi

title: I tre aquilotti
synopsis: Marco, Mario and Filippo, students of the Aeronautical Academy of Caserta, enthusiastically follow the courses for obtaining the pilot's license. The arrival of the young sister of one of the three immediately becomes a matter of contention and their lasting friendship risks breaking abruptly ...
cast: Michela Belmonte, Leonardo Cortese, Alberto Sordi, Carlo Minello, Piero Carnabuci

title: I tre che sconvolsero il West
synopsis: King wants to get hold of a large hidden sum on a stagecoach. A lone bandit spoils the blow by accident; to be forgiven he offers to find the money. He succeeds, but there is also the cheater Clay on the trail of the loot. The three chase each other through the West. At one point the bag falls into the river; it is recovered by a fisherman who dictates its conditions to return it.
cast: Antonio Sabato, John Saxon, Frank Wolff, Agata Flory, Leo Anchoriz

title: I tre corsari
synopsis: During the war between the Franco-Piedmontese and the Spanish, Captain Van Gould treacherously kills the Count of Ventimiglia. The count's three sons, Alberto, Enrico and Luigi are captured and embarked for the Antilles. But the galleon is attacked by pirates. The three Ventimiglias take the names of Corsaro Rosso, Verde and Nero and, allied with the corsairs, fight to avenge their father, but Enrico will die. From "Il Corsaro Verde" by Emilio Salgari, a cinematic adaptation with few attractions. Mario Soldati doesn't even try to put a hint of elegance on it.
cast: Ettore Manni, Cesare Danova, Renato Salvatori, Mark Lawrence

title: I tre ladri
synopsis: Two thieves, Tapioca and his "pupil" Gastone, who has far surpassed the teacher, find themselves in the same apartment when, suddenly, the owners return. One ends up in prison but in the end, after complicated rounds of compromising letters (one of the two is the mistress of the landlord's wife), having discovered that after all the industrialist is one of them, a company is born.
cast: Totò, Simone Simon, Jean Claude Pascal, Gino Bramieri, Giovanna Ralli

title: I tre nemici
synopsis: An international spy, who has come into possession of a formula for a new explosive, has the unfortunate idea of ??transcribing it into an embarrassing body part of Leo (Bramieri), a tattoo addict. A woman, a doctor and a painter try in every way to get hold of it. Predictable farce, without bite and repetitive, directed by such a specialist.
cast: Gino Bramieri, Cristina Gajoni, Hélène Chanel, Raimondo Vianello

title: I tre sergenti del Bengala
synopsis: Three British sergeants are charged with a dangerous mission to the rebel tribes of Bengal. At first things go wrong because their guide turns out to be the leader of the rioters and has them captured. The three, however, will be able to free themselves and, taking possession of the machine guns, will massacre the enemies.
cast: Richard Harrison, Wandisa Guida, Ugo Sasso, Nazzareno Zamperla

title: I tre volti
synopsis: A reporter learns that a mysterious princess is about to undergo a film audition. Risking everything, he convinces the editor of the newspaper to publish the news: it could in fact be Soraya, the former empress of Persia repudiated by her husband. Another woman, Linda, leads a (unhappy) worldly life alongside a well-known writer. A wealthy American passing through Rome proves reluctant towards a Roman Latin lover, placed at her disposal by his travel agency.
cast: Soraya, Alberto Sordi, Richard Harris, Ivano Davoli
director: Michelangelo Antonioni, Mauro Bolognini, Franco Indovina

title: I tre volti del terrore
synopsis: In a train compartment two men and a woman are sleeping. Suddenly they are awakened by the irruption of a mysterious individual, Professor Peter Price, who claims to be able to read deeply into his interlocutors thanks to a metal sphere he invented for hypnosis. This meeting transforms young travelers into the unwitting protagonists of three nightmare stories: _The ring of the moon_, _Dr Lifting_, _The guardian of the lake_.
cast: John Phillip Law, Riccardo Serventi Longhi, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Ambre Even

title: I tre volti della paura
synopsis: Film in three episodes: In the "Telephone" (taken from F.G. Snyder, although he claims to be taken from Maupassant) a woman threatens a friend with anonymous phone calls. The friend asks her for help. In "I Wurdalak" (taken from Aleksej Tolstoy) it tells of a family that falls prey to a form of vampirism: they kill those they have loved the most. In "Drop of water" (which is taken from Chekhov) a nurse steals the ring from a dead woman, ignoring that the deceased was a medium: the theft will be fatal.
cast: Boris Karloff, Michèle Mercier, Jacqueline Pierreux, Lydia Alfonsi

title: I tromboni di Fra' Diavolo
synopsis: The French who occupy the Kingdom of Naples hunt down the elusive brigand and patriot Fra 'Diavolo; he regularly manages to trap them with cunning and unexpected moves, until he ends up trapped in a mountain monastery where he must marry his beloved Cristina. The French manage to replace the friars, who lock them up in the basement of the monastery.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Moira Orfei, Francisco Rabal

title: I tulipani di Haarlem
synopsis: The young Pierre meets the British Sarah who tried to kill herself for a failed love. He is happy to help her, to give her back the pleasure of life; when he declares his love for her, Sarah decides to stay in Holland with him. But now it is the girl's jealousy to which Pierre has to pay a heavy price.
cast: Carole André, Frank Grimes, Gianni Garko

title: I vampiri
synopsis: A Parisian noblewoman is convinced that the secret of eternal youth is hidden in human blood. For this he bleeds some girls: a journalist becomes suspicious and manages to discover the horrible ritual ...
cast: Gianna Maria Canale, Paul Müller, Dario Michaelis

title: I vendicatori dell'Ave Maria
synopsis: In the California of the gold rush, a troupe of acrobats witness a robbery carried out by a gang of alleged Mexicans. Instead, the bandits are Yankees, and the powerful father of one of them exterminates the sheriff's family to free his captured son. Only Katie is saved: the acrobats, allied with a Mexican rebel, defeat all the wicked in his name.
cast: Tony Kendall, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Peter Thorrys, Ida Meda

title: I vesuviani
synopsis: Episode movies. "La linea di Iana": a group of motorcyclists roam the streets of the Neapolitan province sowing terror. "Maruzzella": a transvestite who wanders the corridors of a red light cinema. "Sofialorén": a fisherman catches an octopus which at night turns into a sensual woman. "The devil in the bottle": a bum buys from a stranger a bottle in which the devil would live. "The climb": the mayor of Naples on his way to the top of Vesuvius limps.
cast: Tonino Taiuti, Anna Bonaiuto, Iaia Forte, Enzo Moscato, Renato Carpentieri
director: Antonio Capuano, Pappi Corsicato, Antonietta De Lillo, Stefano Incerti, Mario Martone

title: I viaggiatori
synopsis: A group of friends, in search of the missing brother of one of them, activates a mysterious machine that catapult them in Rome in 1939, between fascist guards and racial laws. A journey through time in the eternal city on the verge of a new world conflict.
cast: Fabrizio Gifuni, Vanessa Scalera, Matteo Schiavone, Fabio Bizzarro, Andreagaia Wlderk, Francesca Alice Antonini, Gianmarco Saurino, Federico Tocci

title: I viaggiatori della sera
synopsis: In a disturbing future, the citizens of the country of the Order are under the strict control of the Army of Public Health: the 50-year-old disc-jockey known as "Bursting Bear" and his feminist wife are forced to leave their home and their businesses. to embark on a cruise from which it seems that no one has ever returned ...
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Ornella Vanoni, Roberta Paladini, Corinne Cléry, Piero Brambilla, Deddi Savignone

title: I vigliacchi non pregano
synopsis: Returning from the Civil War, after going through a thousand vicissitudes, the young Brian finds his young wife raped and killed. He vows to take revenge but his revenge turns into a boundless and insane hatred that drives him mad. Ruthless, violent and wild western, but spoiled by the clichés of the genre.
cast: Gianni Garko, Sean Todd, Elisa Montes, Jerry Wilson

title: I vinti
synopsis: Three episodes for three crimes set in France, Italy and England. Protagonists as many young people from good families, but without solid ethical horizons, who, for various reasons, succumb to the charm of extreme transgression. Shot in three languages. According to Antonioni's film, it underwent various censorships for its desolate vision of bourgeois youth. Especially noteworthy is the English episode.
cast: Franco Interlenghi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Peter Reynolds, Jean Pierre Mocky

title: I violenti di Roma bene
cast: Antonio Sabato, Pierre Marfurt, Pupo De Luca, Franca Gonella, Cesare Barro, Gianluca Farnese, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: I vizi morbosi di una governante
cast: Rino Bellini, Beppe Colombo, Annie Carol Edel, Corrado Gaipa

title: I vsyo-taki ya veryu...
synopsis: Lights and shadows of the Soviet system twenty years after the death of the most enduring Secretary General of the Central Committee.
director: Mikhail Romm, Marlen Khutsiyev, Elem Klimov

title: I'd Climb the Highest Mountain
synopsis: Pastor William Thompson carries out his ministry in a village in the mountains. With him is his wife Mary. The two come from the city, but their participation in the life of the community soon leads them to share the joys and sorrows of the parishioners, whether they are believers or not. When William and Mary have to leave by order of a higher order, everyone regrets them.
cast: Susan Hayward, William Lundigan, Rory Calhoun, Barbara Bates

title: I'd Rather Be Rich
synopsis: Philip Dulaine (Chevalier), a wealthy businessman, has suffered a heart attack and asks as a last wish to have his niece Cynthia (Dee) next to him. She would like to leave with her boyfriend, but he falls ill. The girl then asks a friend to replace him and accompany her. The situation becomes complicated when the grandfather recovers and the real boyfriend returns to the scene.
cast: Sandra Dee, Robert Goulet, Maurice Chevalier, Andy Williams

title: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!: Uncut Version
synopsis: Seo Jin U, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Ui Hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead! ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Junkneuni Toesahagetseumnida, Isanim!" (죽느니 퇴사하겠습니다, 이사님!) by Bori Mustache (보리수염).
tags: Assistant Manager Male Lead, Workplace Setting, Adapted From A Web Novel, Office Setting, Office Worker Male Lead, Gay Male Lead, Short Length Series, Gay Romance, Filmed Vertically, Workplace Romance
cast: Jeung Hoon, Han Chang Woo

title: I'll Always Know What You Did Last Summer
synopsis: During the carnival, Amber, her boyfriend Colby and friends Zoe and Roger organize a joke to simulate the return of a serial killer but something goes wrong and a friend of theirs is accidentally killed. To cover up the evidence and not be indicted, the boys make a pact to keep silence and avoid getting into trouble. A year later, however, the four friends begin to receive disturbing messages from someone who appears to have seen what they did that night.
cast: Brooke Nevin, David Paetkau, Torrey DeVitto, Ben Easter, Seth Packard, K.C. Clyde, Clayton Taylor, Michael Flynn, Britt Leary, Star LaPoint

title: I'll Be Home for Christmas
synopsis: Absent for a few years, this time Jake can't miss the traditional family party appointment in New York. But now, for a variety of reasons, poor Jake finds himself in the middle of the Californian desert, dressed as Santa Claus and without a dollar. And the Big Apple is far, far away ...
cast: JonathanTaylor Thomas, Jessica Biel, Adam Lavorgna, Gary Cole

title: I'll Be Seeing You
synopsis: TV journalist Patricia Collins (Alison Eastwood) finds herself unwillingly embroiled in a murder case that leads her to question her entire past as well. Summoned to the morgue by the police, she discovered that a young woman, identical in appearance to her, was murdered due to an identity exchange and that the real victim should have been her, persecuted for some time by a stalker. But the investigation will also lead her to the mysterious disappearance of her father, revealing unexpected family secrets.
cast: Alison Eastwood, Iris Quinn, Bo Svenson, Derwin Jordan, Richy Müller, Mark Humphrey, Margot Kidder, Matthew Walker, Christina Jastrzembska, Amy Matysio

title: I'll Be Seeing You
synopsis: During Christmas, at the home of little Barbara's uncles, love is born between the sergeant and the young Mary, imprisoned on special leave.
cast: Ginger Rogers, Joseph Cotten, Shirley Temple, John Derek, Spring Byington, Tom Tully, Chill Wills, Kenny Bowers

title: I'll Be There
synopsis: Sixteen years ago, rock star Paul Kerr had everything he could want: fame, success and all the money he wanted. He did not know, however, that he also has a daughter named Olivia who now wants to meet her dad. The task that Olivia has to complete is to get her father and mother back together, who have not spoken to each other for almost twenty years.
cast: Charlotte Church, Craig Ferguson, Jemma Redgrave, Imelda Staunton

title: I'll Cry Tomorrow
synopsis: After the death of her boyfriend Lilian Roth, a star of cinema and theater, she turns to alcohol.
