He reaches the point of delirium tremens, attempts suicide and then goes to the clinic to detoxify. Based on Roth's autobiographical novel, Daniel Mann's film is quite convincing thanks to the interpretations of Susan Hayward (who won the Palme d'Or at Cannes) and r Jo Van Fleet.
cast: Susan Hayward, Richard Conte, Eddie Albert, Jo Van Fleet

synopsis: What happens when a 23-year-old boy takes part in the elections to become mayor of a large city in southern Italy and decides to record everything that happens to him with a hidden camera, making his campaign a transparent box? This is the true story of Ismaele, who finished fourth in the municipal elections in June 2017 in Palermo, the city that exported the mafia all over the world. The unwitting "actors" of this film are the Italian politicians, those who commanded Italy until yesterday and those who are ruling it today. In the midst of all the real documents there is a comedy, the life of a boy and his bulky Italian mother, set in a city that is an open-air set. Everyone will make their own idea of ??this adventure. It helped Ishmael to understand that politics is basically a simple world. It doesn't matter to know how to do what you promise, it matters to promise it well. It doesn't matter where the votes come from, it matters that they come. It doesn't matter if you say one thing and do another, and above all it doesn't matter if it's true. It matters to say it many times. And then if someone gives you what you want, you give them what they want. If you do it with a boss it is a vote of exchange, if you do it with whoever is inside the system it is no longer called that. It is called a political agreement.
cast: Ismaele La Vardera

title: Il Sorpasso
synopsis: Bruno Cortona, extroverted and superficial forty years old, accidentally meets, in the depopulated Rome of Ferragosto, the university student Roberto Mariani, shy and studious, and convinces him to join him for a car raid. They are two very different temperaments, and the young man feels a mixture of repulsion and attraction for his occasional companion. Perhaps the masterpiece of the Italian comedy of the boom, a cross section so perfect that it is charged with allegorical force. Masterly Gassman, unforgettable the wandering of the two, suspended between hilarious moments and other tragic ones. To understand Italy in the 1960s (and beyond), better than a history book.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Jean Louis Trintignant, Catherine Spaak, Claudio Gora, Luciana Angiolillo, Linda Sini, Barbara Simon, Lilly Darelli, Mila Stanic, Nando Angelini, Luigi Zerbinati, Franca Polesello, Edda Ferronao

title: Il Tigre
synopsis: Francesco Vincenzini (Gassman) at forty-five is a successful man. He runs a company, has a faithful wife, two rather modern children, and even has a little girl who would be crazy for him. It's the latter that gets him into trouble. Carolina insists, he is not insensitive, the paranoia of old age are strong and the omelette is done. All this will change the life of engineer Vincenzini.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Ann Margret, Eleanor Parker, Fiorenzo Fiorentini

title: Il Vangelo secondo Matteo
synopsis: The film retraces the salient moments of the Gospel: the Annunciation, the Magi, the flight into Egypt, the massacre of the Innocents, Jesus in the desert, the healing of the leper, the Sermon on the Mount, the death of the Baptist, the multiplication of the loaves and of fishes, the entry into Jerusalem, the passion, the resurrection.
cast: Enrique Irazoqui, Susanna Pasolini, Settimio Di Porto

title: Il Vangelo secondo Simone e Matteo
synopsis: In Senegal, Simone and Matteo for a misunderstanding are mistaken for robbers. To escape the police they disguise themselves as priests.
cast: Paul Smith, Michael Coby, Dominic Bartho, Jacques Herlin, Giuseppe Maffioli

title: Il West ti va stretto, amico... è arrivato Alleluja
synopsis: The gunslinger Alleluja agrees, for a fair fee, to provide the revolutionary leader Ramirez with an Aztec idol, known by all as "El Niño". Possession of the precious statue would guarantee the insurgent the support of the Indians against Maximilian and his general Miranda.
cast: George Hilton, Agata Flori, Raymond Bussières, Umberto D'Orsi

title: Il a déjà tes yeux
synopsis: Paul and Marianne have just opened a flower shop on the outskirts of Paris. All their loved ones are present at the inauguration, including Marianne's parents who don't like their son-in-law because Paul can't make their daughter a mother. The next day, Marianne receives a call from the French adoption agency: an adorable six-month-old baby for them. His name is Benjamin but he is white, blond and with blue eyes, exactly the opposite of what Marianne and Paul are.
cast: Lucien Jean Baptiste, Aïssa Maïga, Vincent Elbaz, Naidra Ayadi, Michel Jonasz, Zabou Breitman

title: Il bacio
synopsis: A coveted noble title (and relative patrimony), a small countess with a tender heart, her husband easy victim of the seduction of a dark dancer. In outline, a diabolical countess, a disowned natural child, intrigues and poisonings in a Venetian setting.
cast: Martine Beswick, Maurizio Bonuglia, Eleonora Giorgi, Valentina Cortese, Massimo Girotti, Brian Deacon, Vladek Sheybal, Antonio Pierfederici, Gianni Cavina

title: Il bacio del sole - Don Vesuvio
synopsis: Naples, in the first post-war period, many young people live abandoned to themselves, committing violence and petty theft. A priest, Don Mario Borrelli, decides to take care of them and obtains permission from the Cardinal to mix with the boys in disguise in order to be able to help and control them more effectively. He dresses as a poor sailor, spends the night in their company and stands out for the vivacity of his spirit and for the natural authority that leads him to dominate, so much so that they give him the nickname of Vesuvius. He also manages to save the boys from the hands of the police, making himself known and vouching for them. However, the superior authority received news that was not entirely appreciated, so Don Mario was forced to give up his disguise and present himself as a priest. In seeing Vesuvius appear before him in a cassock, the boys at first believe it is a bad joke; but when they are convinced of the seriousness of the matter and understand that Don Vesuvio (as they continue to call him) is truly a priest, the group splits up: some leave, while others decide to stay, especially since the dynamic priest has succeeded in the meantime. to have at their disposal a dilapidated house, in which the children feel at ease. Thus the house of the street urchin arises, with great difficulty, with a few willing people who help Don Mario. The boys gradually grow fond of work; but often the money is not enough to feed them. Faced with certain phenomena of misunderstanding, Don Vesuvio, disheartened, is about to abandon the company, but provident benefactors opportunely intervene. The young dissidents who have separated from the group do not sit idle: during a party they break into the house and steal the money deposited in the common box. However, they are chased by the robbed, who, after a fight, regain possession of the sum. In the hustle and bustle, the smallest of the brigade, while crossing a road, is hit by a car: his death in the hospital will at least have the effect of provoking the repentance of the dissidents, who will re-enter the group of workers.
cast: O. W. Fischer, Nino Taranto, Lorella De Luca, Marisa Merlini

title: Il bacio di una morta
synopsis: Milan, 19th century. Clara is the daughter of a wealthy merchant, supplier to the Austrian army. She loves Enrico, a Carbonaro, but her father would like to give her in marriage to a young pro-Austrian count, dissolute and penniless. The latter denounces Enrico who, forced to flee, is hit by an Austrian bullet while crossing the Ticino. Clara, believing that the man she loves is now dead, is desperate and agrees to marry the count. But the aristocrat has a mistress, who instigates him to kill his wife in order to seize the estate she inherited. Clara is poisoned and falls into trance, but is believed dead. Enrico, who is still alive, returns to the city and, hearing the tragic news, goes to the chapel where the woman's body is exposed to give her the last kiss. The man realizes that Clara is not dead and, kidnaps her, takes her to a convent to be treated. Meanwhile, the revolt of the "Five Days" breaks out in Milan: it is March 18, 1848. The count, repentant of his atrocious act and determined to rehabilitate himself, participates in the conflict and dies. Enrico, after having fought on the barricades, leaves for the first war of independence.
cast: Virginia Belmont, Gianna Maria Canale, Peter Trent, Aldo Bufi Landi, Vinicio Sofia, Paul Muller, Enzo Biliotti, Carlo Tamberlani, Rubi D'Alma, Mariù Gleck

title: Il bagno turco. Hamam
synopsis: A rampant architect married to a cheating career woman inherits a Turkish bath in Istanbul from his aunt. He leaves Rome a little annoyed with the intention of quickly selling the whole hut. But the Turkish family that guards the hamam and a particular love story will make him change his mind.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Francesca D'Aloja, Mehmet Gunsur, Halil Ergün, Serif Sezer, Basak Köklükaya, Alberto Molinari, Carlo Cecchi, Zerrin Arbas

title: Il bambino cattivo
synopsis: Brando is an 11-year-old child, the son of a family that is about to break up. Parents Flora and Michele, a couple of university professors who have been in conflict for years, use it by involving him in quarrels and recriminations without his having the strength to defend himself. When the situation worsens due to his relationship with Lilletta, a girl he was in love with at school, and Flora's suicide attempt, Brando finds himself tossed first by his grandparents and then in a foster home.
cast: Leonardo Della Bianca, Luigi Lo Cascio, Donatella Finocchiaro, Erika Blanc, Isabella Aldovini, Eleonora Sergio, Augusto Zucchi, Mia Benedetta, Patrizia Pellegrino, Pino Quartullo, Mariella Valentini, Marina Ninchi

title: Il bambino della domenica
synopsis: Catania. Marcello La Spada grew up without a family, but with a great passion for boxing through which he met his coach Nino who was his father. Marcello has Saro as his best friend, in league with crime.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Anita Caprioli, David Coco, Riccardo Nicolosi, Maurizio Marchetti, Vittoria Piancastelli

title: Il bambino e il poliziotto
synopsis: Rosanna Clerici is arrested by the commissioner Carlo Vinciguerra for drug dealing. His son Giulio has no intention of ending up in an institution and the policeman takes him into the house, reorganizing his entire bachelor life according to the boy. Rosanna, however, who risks a long detention, does not like the matter at all, until one day, Giulio is kidnapped. Triumph of good feelings (and molasses in wagons) in a period when Verdone did not know which way to turn. The character is little more than a speck; the photogenic Adriana Franceschi has never seen herself again.
cast: Carlo Verdone, Federico Rizzo (II), Adriana Franceschi, Barbara Cupisti

title: Il bambino e la befana
synopsis: The traditional Epiphany fair is set up on 6 January in Piazza Navona in Rome. The crowd is crammed among the stalls of trinkets and sweets, and it's easy for a child to get lost in all that confusion. Adriana takes advantage of it and kidnaps little Carletto from his mother Laura. The child will end up in a shady criminal circle as a bargaining chip, in the midst of prostitutes, immigrants, but also banks and journalists. Desperate, Laura seeks the help of her companion Giangilberto, without suspecting in the least that he himself organized the kidnapping.
cast: Ivan Franek, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Giampaolo Morelli, Giuliana De Sio, Nicolò Diana, Damir Todorovic, Enzo Salvi, Genti Kame, Simone Colombari

title: Il bambino nascosto
synopsis: Gabriele Santoro lives in a popular neighborhood in Naples and is the owner of the piano chair at the San Pietro in Majella Conservatory. One morning, while he is raising his beard, the postman sounds the intercom to warn him that there is a package, he opens the door and, before welcoming him, runs to wash his face. In that short period of time, a ten -year -old boy insinuates himself into his apartment and hides there. "The Maestro" - so they call it in the neighborhood - will only notice it late in the evening. When it happens, he recognizes in the intruder, Ciro, a child who lives with his parents and brothers in the attic of his own palace. Question about why his escape Ciro does not speak. Despite this, the master, instinctively, decides to hide it at home, hiring a singular, and tenacious, challenge to the enemies of Ciro.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Giuseppe Pirozzi, Roberto Herlitzka, Lino Musella, Imma Villa, Salvatore Striano, Tonino Taiuti, Francesco Di Leva, Gianfelice Imparato

title: Il bambino sull'acqua
synopsis: The rare and serious form of asthma that affects the little son Valentino radically changes the menage of the young spouses Antonia and Renzo: she is forced to leave her job, he multiplies the hours in the factory to scrape together the necessary money. The family tightens around the little one, but the difficulties increase and the contrasts are not lacking ...
cast: Vittoria Belvedere, Giuseppe Fiorello, Mattia D'Alessio, Valeria Fabrizi

title: Il banchiere anarchico
synopsis: At the end of a meal, a banker shows a friend that his anarchist beliefs and actions have nothing to envy to those of bombers.
cast: Giulio Base, Paolo Fosso

title: Il bandito
synopsis: Back from captivity in Germany, the young Ernesto finds the house destroyed, his parents dead, his sister turned into a prostitute. During an argument with the protector, the girl is killed and Ernesto in turn kills the man. Thus begins his career in the world of crime where, however, Ernesto stands out for his good heart and is therefore frowned upon by others. He will find death after being denounced by his own lover. Lattuada made a neorealist film shooting it with the ways of the American detective. The result is a raw and nervous portrait of post-war Italy between the will and the impossibility of starting a normal life again. Spelndido use of Aldo Tonti's cast and black and white.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Anna Magnani, Carla Del Poggio, Carlo Campanini, Eliana Banducci

title: Il bandito dagli occhi azzurri
synopsis: During the day he is a meek archivist as his mother taught him, poor and lame, but at night, without his wig and brown contact lenses, Renzo Dominici turns out to be a very different type of fabric: athletic and ingenious, he prepares a shot from two billion to the detriment of the Genoese company where he works. And luck assists him: the robbery succeeds and Renzo leaves undisturbed for the South Seas. With a few less simplicity in the narrative solutions and a greater attention to the figure of the protagonist, the film would have been better. Overall it is not bad, written and directed by Alfredo Giannetti, screenwriter of the Railwayman and of Un giorno da leoni.
cast: Franco Nero, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Giovanni Iavarone

title: Il bandolero stanco
synopsis: Having become rich with the gold mines, poor Pepito hopes to marry the beautiful Carmen. However, the matter is not that easy. Weak western parody.
cast: Renato Rascel, Lauretta Masiero, Tino Buazzelli, Lia Di Leo

title: Il barbiere di Rio
synopsis: Matteo is a forty year old in a growing identity crisis since - after fifteen years of marriage - he separated from his wife Silvia. To prove to the woman that she is unable to meet her requests for an increase in the monthly allowance, she is reduced to living, with her two children aged ten and seven, in a loft above a small barber shop. Until fate makes him come across a real guardian angel who invites him to go to Brazil. There must be Vittorio Cecchi Gori's hand in this timid operation to relaunch the Italian comedy. Ingredients: a star with a strong and bulky personality, who already eliminates the competition from the opening credits; a script written in haste by two horses of the Florentine stable (Chiti and Veronesi): a "Brazilian" trip to show that the money has been spent in earnest. The guardian angel is Irene Grandi.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Rocco Papaleo, Zuleika Dos Santos, Irene Grandi

title: Il barbiere di Siviglia
synopsis: Everyone wants Rosina. Her guardian Don Bartolo wants her to get hold of the dowry that he himself has already partly squandered. Count d'Almaviva also wants her who, falling madly in love with her, does not hesitate to hire Figaro and organize the kidnapping of the girl with him. The kidnapping ends badly, but the count's choice of the astute Figaro was a good one, because it is he who solves the situation. First example of that strand of the film-opera that raged until the 1950s, often at the hands of Costa himself. In the cast we find Tito Gobbi and Ferruccio Tagliavini, singing celebrities of the time.
cast: Tito Gobbi, Ferruccio Tagliavini, Nelly Corradi, Vito De Taranto

title: Il barone Carlo Mazza
synopsis: Baron Carlo Mazza (Taranto) squandered all the substances left him by his ancestors. To remedy the situation he accepts a marriage of interest with a beautiful girl who, however, turns out to be rather free of morals and makes him ridiculous among friends. The marriage, which took place with a strange ritual, is not valid and the girl can go to America to enjoy her riches. The baron will have to find other ways to get by. Taranto re-proposes on the screen one of its most famous and hilarious specks, on a non-existent script.
cast: Nino Taranto, Silvana Pampanini, Mario Riva, Enzo Turco, Franco Coop, Carlo Lombardi, Raimondo Van Riel, Gianna Dauro, Anna Corinto, Franca Del Frate

title: Il bell'Antonio
synopsis: The handsome Antonio Mangano (Mastroianni) returns to Catania from Rome, preceded by fame as a Don Juan, to marry the splendid and apparently naive Barbara (Cardinal). After a while it turns out that he is impotent and she is therefore still a virgin. Barbara's relatives then see the opportunity for a good deal.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Claudia Cardinale, Pierre Brasseur, Rina Morelli, Tomas Milian, Fulvia Mammi, Patrizia Bini, Anna Arena, Maria Luisa Crescenzi

title: Il bello, il brutto, il cretino
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio are two thugs who get by with small tricks. One day a southern sergeant confides to them, on his deathbed, the place where a treasure is buried. The two, however, each know only half of the indications for the precious recovery. On the trail of gold there is also another character: the "Beautiful". The three buddies, however, are mocked by the fascinating Fabienne.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mimmo Palmara, Brigitt Petry, Lothar Gunther, Pietro Ceccarelli, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia, Bruno Scipioni, Enzo Andronico

title: Il bene mio
synopsis: Providence has been a ghost town for ten years, ever since it experienced the devastation of the earthquake. Elijah was the last to occupy those houses without a soul. In fact, he has always refused to move to the 'new town', made up of concrete barracks built at the foot of the hill, where all the others are crammed. Elia lives in one of the few houses left standing and, over the years, he has become the guardian of the memory of that village. For the illusion of being able to restore life among those dead stones, for the inability to free himself from the memory of his wife Maria who lost her life among those stones. A choice, his, not shared by the inhabitants of the village below who would like to bring him down and, finally, turn off the last light on of what was once Providence. The memory of Mary and her task as guardian of the memory of a lost community make their strength felt again and Elijah will be faced with a choice.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Sonya Mellah, Teresa Saponangelo, Dino Abbrescia, Francesco De Vito, Michele Sinisi

title: Il berretto a sonagli
synopsis: Beatrice discovers that her husband has cheated on her with Ciampa's young wife, a man of a certain age and with modest ambitions, who for a quiet life prefers - even knowing - that it is not known. But Beatrice has decided to publicly denounce the matter and for this reason she risks passing as a victim ... or crazy.
cast: Eduardo De Filippo, Angelica Ippolito, Giuliana Calandra, Luca De Filippo, Armando Marra, Maria Facciolà, Hilde Renzi, Chiara Toschi, Patrizia Boccella, Giovanna Carola

title: Il bestione
synopsis: Sandro Colautti, a rough Lombard truck driver, is assigned Nino Patrovita, a young and exuberant Sicilian, as second driver. At the beginning, also given the profound difference in character, between the two they are sparks, but then Sandro and Nino even decide to go on their own. They will have trouble with the "big beast" they now own, but they will come out unscathed and more friends than ever. The two protagonists are well defined, but the mixture of humorous and dramatic elements is a little too strident; the opportunity is wasted for a convincing analysis of an under-exploited environment.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Michel Constantin, Giuliana Calandra, Giuseppe Maffioli

title: Il bianco, il giallo, il nero
synopsis: Speculator Butler had a sacred pony sent by the emperor of Japan to a colony of immigrants from the Rising Sun kidnapped. His intention is to provoke an Indian war. Sheriff Black Jack has to give him the box with the ransom money; he is joined by the aspiring samurai Sakura and the gunslinger Blanc de Blanc.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Tomas Milian, Eli Wallach, Manuel De Blas, Jacques Berthier, Romano Puppo, Nazareno Zamperla

title: Il bidone
synopsis: Augusto is a modest scammer who acts in partnership with Roberto and Picasso. When Picasso's wife begins to have doubts about her husband's activity, he cuts off all relations with his accomplices. Augusto, on the other hand, who has long since left his family, commits another scam to help his daughter, trying to pocket the entire loot. His new buddies won't forgive him.
cast: Broderick Crawford, Giulietta Masina, Richard Basehsart, Franco Fabrizi

title: Il bigamo
synopsis: The life of Mario De Santis, sales representative, husband of Valeria and father of a child, is turned upside down by the accusation of bigamy. In fact, the police station shows that a few years earlier he married a certain Isolina in Forlimpopoli. Confronted with Mario, the woman recognizes him as her legitimate spouse. Faced with this situation, the man loses his head and, in anger, becomes aggressive, loses control and ends up under arrest.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica, Franca Valeri, Memmo Carotenuto

title: Il birichino di papà
synopsis: Nicoletta, a girl with a restless character and spoiled by her father, is locked up in boarding school under pressure from a marquise, an in-laws. The boarding school is shaken by Nicoletta and the girl goes from one punishment to another. Having the suspicion that the brother-in-law is not faithful to his older sister, Nicoletta the plague concocts a plan.
cast: Chiaretta Gelli, Dina Galli, Anna Proclemer, Armando Falconi, Paola Borboni, Amelia Chellini, Carlo Campanini, Franco Scandurra, Nicoletta Parodi, Giuseppe Pierozzi

title: Il bisbetico domato
synopsis: Elia (Celentano) lives in his splendid isolation near Voghera. He does not love the city, he does not like company and he is bothered by the women he sees as perturbers of rural peace. Only the housekeeper Mamy is allowed on the farm. But one day the beautiful Lisa (Muti) breaks the car right there and falls in love with the misanthrope; first for a bet, then for passion, she decides to seduce him. It won't be an easy feat and Lisa will succeed when she least expects it. Perhaps the greatest success of the Celentano-Muti duo. Although Celentano is comfortable in the role, the film is ramshackle, moralistic, crafty and superficial.
cast: Adriano Celentano, Ornella Muti, Edith Peters, Milly Carlucci, Pippo Santonastaso, Sandro Ghiani, Nicola De Buono, Vincenzo De Toma, Jimmy Il Fenomeno

title: Il bivio
synopsis: A deputy commissioner of police is, in fact, the leader of a gang of robbers to whom he provides the "tips" for the shots. Led by such a leader, the criminals strike a perfect blow that leads to the indictment of three policemen, held responsible. A few days later the wife of one of the agents is found dead. The deputy commissioner understands that it is a crime committed by a man of his gang. He thus falls into a moral crisis that leads him to ...
cast: Raf Vallone, Charles Vanel, Saro Urzì, Saro Arcidiacono, Pierangelo Attino

title: Il boia di Lilla
synopsis: Anna, a maid in a monastery, falls in love with Erberto, a young officer. For his sake she steals a precious necklace and runs away with him. The two are arrested. The officer, accused of desertion and theft, is sentenced, while the girl, without worrying about her fate, runs away. Erberto's brother, who is an executioner in Lilla, to punish the girl, imprints the stigma on her shoulder.
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Yvette Lebon, Armando Francioli, Jean Roger Caussimon, Massimo Serato

title: Il boia di Venezia
synopsis: The Inquisition tries in every way to eliminate the Doge of Venice, to assume his powers; the main obstacle is the Doge's son, who, however, unbeknownst to everyone, is illegitimate.
cast: Lex Barker, Guy Madison, Alessandra Panaro, Mario Petri, Alberto Farnese, Giulio Marchetti, Feodor Chaliapin Jr., Franco Fantasia, Raf Baldassarre, Mirella Roxy

title: Il boia scarlatto
synopsis: To take some sexy photographs to use as the cover of some horror novels, a photographer and his model decide to use the old castle of Travis Anderson, an actor who has long since retired from the scene, as a set. Once inside the manor, however, the crew members begin to fall under the blows of a masked killer, who they believe to be the reincarnation of a murderer executed in the 17th century, now intent on protecting the mansion from intruders.
cast: Femi Benussi, Alfredo Rizzo, Massimo Pupilio, Mickey Hargitay, Rita Klein, Walter Brandi, Luisa Baratto, Barbara Nelli, Moa Tahi, Ralph Zucker, Nando Angelini

title: Il boom
synopsis: An improvised entrepreneur tries to exploit the wave of the favorable economic situation and throws himself into disheveled speculations. But he doesn't have what it takes and business is bad. Even his wife, a vain and ambitious woman, threatens to leave him. To save himself from debts and raise the shack, he accepts the offer of a creditor, who has lost an eye and asks for his in return.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Gianna Maria Canale, Maria Grazia Buccella, Elena Nicolai, Ettore Geri, Mariolina Bovo, Gloria Cervi, Sandra Verani

title: Il bosco 1
cast: Coralina Cataldi Tassoni, Diego Ribon, Luciano Crovato, Elena Cantarone, Stefano Molinari

title: Il bosco fuori
synopsis: Aurora and Rino go away with their car. But shortly after they are attacked by a group of thugs. A couple rushes to their rescue, Antonio and Clara who invite them to their house in the middle of the woods. They don't know what awaits them.
cast: Daniela Virgilio, Daniele Grassetti, Rino Diana, Santa De Santis

title: Il boss
synopsis: The Palermo hitman Lanzetta accepts contracts only if his boss, Don Carrasco, proposes them. The latter has become not only the master of the city, but has now extended his influence as far as Rome, at the top of politics. Once the wind has changed, and forced to make new alliances, Carrasco decides to make a clean sweep of old friends, starting with Lanzetta.
cast: Henry Silva, Richard Conte, Gianni Garko, Vittorio Caprioli

title: Il braccio violento del Thay-Pan
synopsis: Collection of episodes taken from films shot by Bruce Lee at different times; repertory materials have been added to the various clips.
cast: Bruce Lee, Yeo Ban, Paul Hung, Tommy Wu, Hoi Wong

title: Il branco
synopsis: In the Roman province, a group of boys accepts Sola's proposal to rape two German tourists on vacation in Italy held prisoner in a shed of a junkyard. Of the group the only one who pulls back is Raniero, the others gladly accept to follow him. Slowly the news of the two imprisoned tourists spreads like wildfire and attracts all the males in the area.
cast: Giampiero Lisarelli, Ricky Memphis, Salvatore Spada, Luca Zingaretti

title: Il bravo di Venezia
synopsis: Forced with blackmail by the Council of Ten, which governs Venice, a gentleman takes on the role of the executioner. With him, the powerful of the city secretly solve all the cases that do not want to be publicized. The assignment is hateful, but it becomes completely unsustainable when the man is confronted, as the next victim, with his own son. The production commitment for a film shot in the period of cinematographic autarchy is discreet. Between conspiracies, killings and betrayals, the script is not so much for the subtle.
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Paola Barbara, Valentina Cortese, Gustav Diessl, Emilio Cigoli, Giacomo Moschini, Carlo Duse

title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
synopsis: A bungling cop suffers serious degradation, but wants to prove his worth at all costs. He finally gets involved in an important case, or so he believes, because in reality he is used by his colleagues as a decoy. Despite everything, however, his contribution is decisive, but even more decisive becomes that of his wife, a virago champion of karate, between exchanges of person, quarrels and other tangles. To exhibit the longed-for recognition, however, the sergeant must give it to himself with the complicity of an usher.
cast: Lino Banfi, Aldo Giuffré, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Francesco Ager, Rosario Borelli, Sal Borgese, Gabriella Andreini, Luca Sportelli, Renzo Marignano

title: Il brigante
synopsis: Unjustly accused of murder by the fascists, Michele is imprisoned. Having fled, he joins the allied troops and returns to the country after the Liberation: here he leads the occupation of the land by the peasants, but the old accusation reappears and he must flee again. His partner follows him and is killed by mistake by the carabinieri: Michele, mad, commits a massacre before dying.
cast: Adelmo Di Fraia, Francesco Seminaro, Serena Vergano, Anna Filippini

title: Il brigante Musolino
synopsis: Giuseppe Musolino, a young Calabrian charcoal burner, was convicted of an unspoken crime: the murder of the mafioso Don Pietro, to whom Mara was betrothed, with whom the young man is in love. Two years later he escapes, thirsty for revenge, and is joined by Mara, who then becomes pregnant. The woman ends up killed by Don Pietro's murderer. Joseph completes his revenge and constitutes himself. Between neorealism and westerns, Camerini skillfully directs this story of honor and despair, inspired by a famous story. The real Musolino will protest the inaccuracies, justifying the final caption on creative freedom.
cast: Silvana Mangano, Amedeo Nazzari, Guido Celano, Ignazio Balsamo, Rocco D'Assunta

title: Il brigante di Tacca del Lupo
synopsis: A company of bersaglieri led by Captain Giordani must find the lair of the bandit Raffa Raffa. The company beats the mountains of Calabria engaging in numerous firefights with outlaws. It will be a girl, however, who had been raped by the bandit, to lead the soldiers on his trail. The film starts from a historical fact and reinterprets it in an adventurous and almost western key.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Cosetta Greco, Saro Urzì, Fausto Tozzi

title: Il buco
synopsis: In August 1961, the young members of the Piedmontese Speleological Group, already explorers of all the cavities of Northern Italy, change course and head to the South, in the desire to explore other caves unknown to man, plunging into the subsoil of a South, which everyone is abandoning. Here, in Pollino, in Calabria, these young speleologists, descending into the darkness of the earth, will discover the second deepest cave in the world, the Abisso di Bifurto.

title: Il buco in testa
synopsis: Maria S. lives near the sea, in the province of Naples. He has a precarious job, no love. A practically mute mother. Forty years earlier, a far-left militant killed his father, a deputy police sergeant in his early twenties, during a political demonstration. Maria was born two months later. One day he learns that his father's murderer has a name, a face, a job. He has served his sentence and lives in Milan. "Now I know who to hate", Maria thinks. He dyes his hair and takes a fast train to meet him. He has a gun with him.
cast: Teresa Saponangelo, Tommaso Ragno, Francesco Di Leva, Gea Martire, Vincenza Modica, Anita Zagaria, Daria D'Antonio

title: Il buono, il brutto e il cattivo
synopsis: While the Civil War rages on, Biondo, Tuco and Sentenza, three disreputable individuals, reluctantly get together to find a treasure in gold coins, hidden in a tomb. Two of them know part of the secret to finding the place beyond enemy lines, the third is unscrupulous and can be useful in the enterprise. The agreement is difficult to maintain: the hunt is done by the three separately, but by supervising each other, until the decisive confrontation in the cemetery.
cast: Clint Eastwood, Lee Van Cleef, Eli Wallach, Rada Rassimov, Aldo Giuffré, Enzo Petito, Luigi Pistilli, Claudio Scarchilli, John Bartha

title: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
Il burattinaio
cast: Fabio Testi, Ron Nummi, Gabriele Ferzetti, Orso Maria Guerrini, Francesco Gabriele, Lino Patruno, Maria Giulia Cavalli

title: Il burbero
synopsis: Mary lives in New York and works as a waitress; she returns to Italy called by her husband and upon his arrival she discovers him involved in very shady deals. He relies on a gruff lawyer (Celentano) he met on the plane. He, in spite of himself, helps her and naturally ends up falling in love with her, reciprocated. The lawyer and the bad guy arrive at the final battle also to contend for the woman. The Celentano trend has raged in Christmas programming for about ten years. The bizarre and grumpy character cut out by the singer, in this film is now worn and patched up. Castellano and Pipolo scrape the bottom of the barrel.
cast: Adriano Celentano, Debra Feuer, Jean Sorel, Angela Finocchiaro, Mattia Sbragia, Peppe Lanzetta, Percy Hogan, Vincenzo De Toma, Francesco Scali, Franco Diogene, Iaia Forte

title: Il cacciatore di squali
synopsis: An Italian-American, after his wife and son died in a car accident, retired to live on a tropical island: apparently to devote himself to hunting sharks, in reality to recover one hundred million dollars from the sea depth remained in the wreck of a plane that sank off the island. To achieve this, he needs the help of Pablo Martinez, a local diving expert ...
cast: Franco Nero, Werner Pochath, Jorge Luke, Michael Forest, Patricia Rivera, Mirta Miler, Eduardo Fajardo, Enzo G. Castellari, Rocco Lerro

title: Il caimano del Piave
synopsis: WWI. Lucilla di Torrebruna goes to visit her father who commands a regiment engaged in the battle of Caporetto. The father dies and Lucilla takes over his place, performing gestures of valor and covering herself with honor. She falls prisoner of the Austrians, but before they have time to deport her, she is saved by her fiancé Franco. Shortly after, Italy ended the conflict victorious. A lot of rhetoric and a splash of neorealism: the peasants were chosen from among the real inhabitants of the area, clips of period documentaries were used for the battle scenes.
cast: Milly Vitale, Gino Cervi, Frank Latimore, Francesco Golisano, Harry Feist, Carlo Croccolo, Ludmilla Dudarova, Lilia Landi

title: Il cambio della guardia
synopsis: Mario, mayor of Ardea, hearing that the allies are getting closer, decides to transfer the municipal powers to the host Attilio, an irreducible anti-fascist. The daughter is about to get married with the latter and Mario is all happy because he is convinced that the staff of command remains in the family. Everything would go well if Crippa, a local squire, a passionate fascist, did not intervene. He has the wedding ceremony interrupted and a squadron arrives from Latina. But at night Crippa is killed, now it is a question of making the body disappear ...
cast: Fernandel, Gino Cervi, Milla Sannoner, Franco Parenti, Andrea Aureli, Franck Fernandel, Dada Gallotti, Gérard Herter

title: Il camionista
synopsis: The 48-year-old Riccardo, the separated father of a ten-year-old girl, is a truck driver. At the service of a gang of criminals, he receives the order to guard an African girl, suffering from mental disorders but perfect for organ trafficking.
cast: Giorgio Tirabassi, Simona Borioni, Pippo Delbono, Elena Cotta, Nicola Nocella, Nicola Di Pinto, Emily Rinaldi, Marie Christine Mubake Mwanga

title: Il cammino della speranza
synopsis: Left without work, a group of poor Sicilians set out north in the attempt to reach France. But the man who promised them, for a fee, to organize their clandestine expatriation, is in reality a scammer who abandons them to their fate at the foot of the Alps. The Sicilians, however, do not give up and continue the journey that becomes like this a dramatic odyssey.
cast: Raf Vallone, Elena Varzi, Saro Urzì, Saro Arcidiacono, Franco Navarra

title: Il camorrista
synopsis: In the Poggioreale prison, the authority of a prisoner grows, known as "the professor", who manages to create a new and powerful Camorra organization. After escaping he goes to New York, where he receives the "investiture" from the top management of the Cosa Nostra. His undisputed authority also makes him necessary for the games of politics, in which his intervention is required even after returning to prison.
cast: Ben Gazzara, Laura Del Sol, Leo Gullotta, Marzio Honorato, Franco Interlenghi, Luciano Bartoli, Nicola Di Pinto, Anita Zagaria

title: Il campione
synopsis: Very young, full of talent, undisciplined, rich and spoiled: all this is Christian Ferro, a young Serie A footballer, all genius and recklessness, who has become the new idol of the fans of an entire city. Valerio Fioretti, lonely and shy, with economic problems to manage and a shadow of the past looming over the present, is the professor who is joined by the young goalscorer when - after yet another stunt - the President of the club decides that the time has come to give him some discipline. Between the two they will initially be sparks, but soon they will find themselves next to each other, generating a bond that will make them both grow and change.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Andrea Carpenzano, Ludovica Martino, Mario Sgueglia, Camilla Semino Favro, Massimo Popolizio, Anita Caprioli

title: Il cantante e il campione
synopsis: Franco is an aspiring singer, Massimo a skilled dancer. Will they be able to become famous?
cast: Marc Daimon, Elena Valentino, Francesco Colella, Sabrina Corcione, Ninì Grassia, Angelo Murano, Guido Palliggiano, Ettore Squillace

title: Il canto della vita
synopsis: To avoid the horrors of war, the son of a Roman landowner lives hidden in a cave, assisted by a girl. Before the war is over, he manages to get her pregnant, even if there is no mention of marriage. The young man marries an aristocrat who dies after a couple of years without leaving heirs. At that point the master father remembers his bastard nephew and forces his son into a belated shotgun wedding.
cast: Alida Valli, Carlo Ninchi, Roberto Bruni, Mario Pisu, Luigi Almirante, Maria Mercader, Roberto Donati

title: Il caos da Ana
synopsis: Ana is a very young artist raised by her hippy father in a cave in Ibiza who lives by selling her paintings in the markets of the island. One day he meets Justine, a wealthy Madrid woman, who - admiring her talent - offers her to take her with him to Madrid, where she will receive a complete artistic education and training on condition that she undertakes to study. In her new life Ana meets friends and her first love, Said. And she also meets Anglo, a man who subjects her to sessions of regressive hypnosis, bringing her into contact with her previous existences and thus making an incredible journey into the depths of her psyche.
cast: Manuela Velles, Charlotte Rampling, Bebe, Nicolas Cazalé, Asier Newman, Matthias Habich, Lluís Homar, Gerrit Graham, Raúl Peña, Giacomo Gonnella

title: Il capitale umano
synopsis: Near Lake Como, on the eve of the Christmas holidays, a cyclist is run over during the night. The event and the dynamics of the events have consequences that will forever change the rich Bernaschi family and the Ossola family on the verge of bankruptcy. Looking closely at the lives of the members of the two families, it becomes evident that the anxiety for money, the anguish of wanting to multiply it and the fear of its loss have ended up deteriorating every emotional bond and marking destiny forever. of each.
cast: Valeria Golino, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Luigi Lo Cascio, Fabrizio Gifuni, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Vincent Nemeth, Gigio Alberti, Bebo Storti, Nicola Centonze, Pia Engleberth, Giovanni Anzaldo, Matilde Gioli, Guglielmo Pinelli

title: Il capitano nero
synopsis: XVI century: Giuliano raped Luisa, with whom he pretended to be in love. The woman's brothers swear to clean up the offense but the rapist kills them, certain of enjoying impunity thanks to the support of the Duke of Corvara. The only survivor is Marco, who is pondering revenge ...
cast: Steve Barclay, Marina Berti, Mario Ferrari, Marisa Merlini

title: Il cappello a tre punte
cast: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Leda Gloria, Tina Pica, Enrico Viarisio

title: Il cappotto
synopsis: Carmine, a humble employee, has a secret dream: to buy himself a coat. When he finally manages to buy the garment, after several sacrifices, he is robbed on the street by a thief. Without her new coat anymore, Carmine wanders the city in the middle of the night, struggling with the cold and the dark.
cast: Renato Rascel, Yvonne Sanson, Antonella Lualdi, Giulio Stival

title: Il cappotto di Astrakan
synopsis: Piero (Dorelli), on a visit to Paris, is involved in a sentimental adventure with two charming Frenchmen. The merit, however, is solely due to her extraordinary resemblance to Maurice, the "tough" (now in jail) husband of one and lover of the other. The gangster's return to freedom, however, seems to put an end to Piero's adventure. Compared to the novel by Piero Chiara from which it is based, the film by Marco Vicario is more bluntly farcical.
cast: Johnny Dorelli, Andréa Ferréol, Carole Bouquet, Marcel Bozzuffi

title: Il carabiniere
synopsis: The brothers Francesco and Paolo Palumbo live with their widowed mother on a farm that they run with great sacrifices. Paolo loves, in return, Angela, the daughter of a landowner who has set her sights on the farm land for speculation. To achieve his goals, angela's father does not hesitate to trample the feelings of the two lovers and, when Paolo, to better defend his interests, enlisted in the carabinieri, he even resorted to crime.
cast: Fabio Testi, Massimo Ranieri, Valeria Valeri, Enrico Maria Salerno

title: Il carabiniere a cavallo
synopsis: The regulation prohibits marriage before the fifteenth year of service, and the carabiniere Francesco is forced to marry secretly. However, on the very day of the wedding, someone steals his horse. Helped by his wife and a friend, Francesco will find him in a gypsy camp.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Peppino De Filippo, Annette Stroyberg, Maurizio Arena, Clelia Matania, Luciano Salce, Eugenio Maggi, Athena Nocera, Aldo Giuffré, Fanfulla

title: Il cardinale Lambertini
synopsis: In 1739 Cardinal Lambertini, close to being elected pope, did his best to ensure that two young people in love were able to marry. Adaptation of a comedy by Alfredo testoni. Great interpretation by Gino Cervi, in an otherwise negligible film.
cast: Gino Cervi, Nadia Gray, Arnoldo Foà, Sergio Tofano

title: Il caricatore
synopsis: The passion for cinema is so great, the means are very few (only one magazine, that is, a box of film). It is the reality against which the three boys who are serious about making their life dream come true. But the script work goes on for a long time, the producer Arcopinto appears enigmatic on his racing bike and forces them to play football, there is no certainty of the future. Yet, in the end, the film will be made. The three directors-protagonists limit themselves to staging one of the many true events of Italian cinema today, accentuating the grotesque aspects. It turns out a quick fun and cool movie. Dedicated to Tanio Boccia (director of Z series peplum), originating from a short film awarded in Locarno. The football match that pits two true independent film producers (Arcopinto and Procacci) and sees aspiring directors lined up with commitment is hilarious, as is self-segregation to write a story that allows you to find the money.
cast: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata, Gianluca Arcopinto
director: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata

title: Il carniere
synopsis: Three friends, Paolo, Renzo and Roberto, on board a station wagon, are reaching a game reserve in the Balkan peninsula. The journey is repeated every year, as soon as autumn begins just when the deer become less suspicious and come out of the woods in herds. The three have an appointment with Boris, the huntsman who will have to escort them to the waiting boxes placed in a splendid clearing. But this year, unlike previous years, something is not working, in fact, in the place of Boris, the three find the daughter of the guide. A mysterious, beautiful and taciturn girl who does not give explanations and who replaces her father. Suddenly the group of friends find themselves embroiled in the war that has bloodied Yugoslavia.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Antonio Catania, Paraskeva Djukelova, Leo Gullotta

title: Il cartaio
synopsis: A mysterious assassin challenges the police who hunt him down by signing the Cartaio, given his mania for the game. His challenge consists of a series of video poker games to be played between himself and the police, in the virtual space of the network. Each time, a human life is at stake.
cast: Stefania Rocca, Liam Cunningham, Silvio Muccino, Adalberto Maria Merli, Claudio Santamaria, Fiore Argento, Cosimo Fusco, Giovanni Visentin, Luis Molteni, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Vera Gemma, Mia Benedetta, Pier Maria Cecchini, Micaela Pignatelli, Carlo Gabardini, Alessandro Mistichelli, Francesco Guzzo

title: Il casinista
synopsis: The comedian Enrico Marullo (Montagnani) snatches Pippo Casciotta (Franco) who writes the lyrics for him, so that he is inspired by new comedians and stories anchored to the Italian reality. From here, an odyssey of misadventures for poor Casciotta between sports, hospital, prison, the underworld, terrorists, and so on. So much so that Pippo decides to undertake the dog catcher business, like his brother-in-law (Bombolo).
cast: Pippo Franco, Renzo Montagnani, Bombolo, Simona Mariani, Solveyg D'Assunta, Sergio Leonardi, Sal Borgese, Enzo Cannavale

title: Il caso Enzo Tortora - Dove eravamo rimasti?
synopsis: Rome. On the morning of June 17, 1983, the well-known TV presenter Enzo Tortora (Ricky Tognazzi) was arrested in a hotel on charges of criminal association of a Camorra type. For the presenter it will be the beginning of a real judicial ordeal.
cast: Ricky Tognazzi, Bianca Guaccero, Carlotta Natoli, Enzo De Caro, Thomas Trabacchi, Tony Sperandeo, Mariano Rigillo, Eugenia Costantini, Francesco Venditti

title: Il caso Martello
synopsis: How come no one, for forty years, has ever collected the insurance for the death in an accident of the wife of the former partisan Antonio Martello? A young official is in charge of liquidating the file, but is faced with silences, reticence, misdirection and even personal dangers. A world that does not understand and does not love, an experience and a dip in the past that will leave deep marks on him.
cast: Alberto Gimignani, Roberta Lena, Luigi Diberti, Felice Andreasi, Valeria Cavalli, Bruno Gambarotta, Ivano Marescotti, Cesare Peracchio

title: Il caso Mattei
synopsis: In addition to the pilot, Enrico Mattei and an American journalist, the Eni twin-jet that was carrying from Sicily to Milan crashed into the sky of Bascapè (Pavia) on 27 October 1962. Rosi reconstructs the life of the "state entrepreneur" from the immediate after the war until his death, his action that had put against him very powerful enemies and tries a hypothesis on the accident. Thanks to a tight script, a robust narrative management and a masterful interpretation of Gian Maria Volonté in the role of the protagonist, the film captivates for its spectacular effectiveness and for the charge of civil commitment.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Luigi Squarzina, Peter Baldin, Franco Graziosi

title: Il caso Moro
synopsis: The days of the imprisonment of the Christian Democrat statesman, kidnapped and murdered by the Red Brigades in 1978. A controversial and contradictory work that overshadows the Moor political exponent to focus on the human drama. It is a provocative film that expresses a thesis that has been circulating for some time at the time of its release. An example of cinema-truth about the years of lead, it often reduces the protagonists, except for the central figure of Aldo Moro, to opaque caricatures. There remains an undoubted, accurate documentary research work and a truly extraordinary interpretation by Gian Maria Volonté.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Margarita Lozano, Sergio Rubini, Bruno Zanin, Consuelo Ferrara, Enrica Maria Modugno, Enrica Rosso, Maurizio Donadoni, Stefano Abbati

title: Il caso Raoul
synopsis: Life, loves and tragedy of a difficult boy, his adoptive parents and his two older brothers. The past, however, hides a secret that turns out to be terrible for the young man.
cast: Stanko Molnar, Delia Boccardo, Alida Valli, Milena Vukotic

title: Il caso dell'infedele Klara
synopsis: A forty-year-old musician tormented by tremendous jealousy hires a private investigator to watch over his girlfriend Klara, much younger than him, with whom he should marry. The girl's behavior, in reality, is absolutely calm, but the man's jealousy is suffocating and the detective slowly begins to modify his reports, omitting details that would be misunderstood, in order not to provide him with material with which to feed his obsession. To the point of making an extreme choice.
cast: Iain Glen, Claudio Santamaria, Kierston Wareing, Anna Geislerová, Laura Chiatti, Paulina Bakarova, Miroslav Simunek, Dorota Nvotová, Zuzana Fialová, Yemi Akinyemi

title: Il caso difficile del commissario Maigret
synopsis: In a Parisian art gallery, a thief steals a precious Van Gogh painting after killing the keeper who was trying to oppose the theft. Inspector Maigret is in charge of the investigations who, having gathered the first clues, begins to follow Holoway, a well-known collector of paintings. The latter, having moved to Lausanne, is found mysteriously killed in his hotel room after a night spent in a night club.
cast: Heinz Rühmann, Françoise Prevost, Günther Stoll, Günther Strack

title: Il castello
synopsis: After the attack on the Twin Towers on 11 September 2001, airports have become the symbol of fear, of the place through which terrorists pass and the borders between good and evil are defined, putting a strain on the freedom of individuals. animals and goods that pass through it. For a whole year, we follow and document what happens at the international airport of Milan Malpensa, where the police are experimenting with new forms of control and passengers, especially Africans and South Americans, find themselves looking suspicious.

title: Il castello dei morti vivi
synopsis: A small group of acrobats receive an invitation from Count Drago (Lee) to hold a show in his castle. During the performance Bruno, one of the actors, dies. In a short time, other deaths of a mysterious nature follow one another, until the guests discover who was responsible for those killings. It is the count who has given them a drug of his own invention that causes death and instant embalming. Typical autarchic horror of the sixties directed by Luciano Ricci under the pseudonym of Herbert Wise. Donald Sutherland makes his debut playing two roles (one of which in costume).
cast: Christopher Lee, Gaia Germani, Philippe Leroy, Donald Sutherland

title: Il cattivo poeta
synopsis: 1936. Giovanni Comini has just been promoted federal, the youngest that Italy can boast. This is what his mentor, Achille Starace, secretary of the Fascist Party and number two of the regime wanted. Comini is immediately summoned to Rome for a delicate mission: he will have to supervise Gabriele d'Annunzio and put him in a position to do no harm. The poet, the national poet, has recently appeared displeased, and Mussolini fears it could damage his imminent alliance with Hitler's Germany. But at the Vittoriale, the political plan of which Comini is only a small executor will begin to lose its solid contours and the young federal, torn between loyalty to the Party and fascination for the poet, will end up seriously endangering his career. .
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Francesco Patanè, Tommaso Ragno, Clotilde Courau, Fausto Russo Alesi, Massimiliano Rossi, Elena Bucci, Lidiya Liberman, Janina Rudenska, Lino Musella

title: Il cav. Costante Nicosia demoniaco...
synopsis: Costante Nicosia is the Sicilian owner of a toothpaste industry, the "Pasta del Colonnello". Vampirized by Count Draculesco, of whom he was a guest during a business trip to Romania, he returns to Italy and finds the ideal solution to satisfy his craving for plasma with his existence as a respectable bourgeois: he organizes the Nicosia blood bank for the employees of the his company, which encourages blood donation by giving bonuses.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Rossano Brazzi, Sylva Koscina, Moira Orfei

title: Il cavaliere del castello maledetto
synopsis: Giannetto, aka the Masked Knight, fights against the abuses of Ugo di Collefeltro (Serato) and also conquers the heart of the beautiful Isabella. Silly Italian adventure film co-produced with France.
cast: Massimo Serato, Irene Tunc, Luisella Boni

title: Il cavaliere del sogno
synopsis: The film tells the difficult love between the musician Gaetano Donizetti and Luisa di Cerchiara against the backdrop of the Risorgimento riots. Having met at the court of the king of Naples, the two fall madly in love and meet again first in Switzerland and then in Bergamo. But everything gets complicated because the woman is married to an Austrian field marshal, who naturally does not like the affair.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Dina Sassoli, Sergio Tofano, Mario Ferrari, Giulio Tomasini, Tito Schipa, Rubi D'Alma

title: Il cavaliere inesistente
synopsis: Agilulf runs from Scotland to Morocco in search of Sofronia, the noblewoman who, alone, can prove to the world that he is a true knight, with a regular investiture. The doubts for the truth are well founded: Agilulf has an armor, a voice, but no body. Fun by the designer Pino Zac, based on a famous novel by Italo Calvino, mixing animation and real life actors.
cast: Stefano Oppedisano, Hana Ruzickova, Evelina Vermigli Gori, Pilar Castel, Tony Eré, Adriana Facchetti, Marina Fiorentini, Carlo Micolano

title: Il cavaliere misterioso
synopsis: Casanova's brother is unjustly accused of having stolen some documents, actually stolen by spies in the service of Catherine of Russia. Giacomo Casanova therefore sets out on their trail and overcomes various obstacles thanks to his skill with the sword and the fascination he has on women. After a thousand adventures he finally manages to recover the documents and exonerate his brother. First leading role for Gassman. The sumptuous production is by Lux Film which entrusts the direction to Riccardo Freda, master of the fantastic and adventure film. Very fast pace, beautiful atmospheres and great success with the public.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Maria Mercader, Gianna Maria Canale, Yvonne Sanson, Alessandra Mami, Hans Hinrich, Dante Maggio, Guido Notari, Vittorio Duse, Elli Parvo, Antonio Centa, Anna Maria Canali

title: Il cavaliere sole
synopsis: An elderly theatrical actor decides to stage _The Sun Knight_ for the last time. Therefore he travels the length and breadth of Sicily in search of the old actors of his company.
cast: Franco Scaldati, Melino Imparato, Vincenzo Albanese, Sara Favarò, Gaspare Cucinella

title: Il cavaliere, la morte e il diavolo
synopsis: Dad, mom and eleven-year-old daughter in a distressing intrigue between dream and reality. Irritating psycho-magical-erotic mess.
cast: Paolo Bonacelli, Mirella D'Angelo, Piero Vida, Francesco Costa

title: Il cekista
synopsis: The film tells the existential parable of a "Cheekist", that is one of the policemen of the Soviet special forces active in the mass murder during the era of the Stalinist "purges".
cast: Igor Sergeev, Aleksej Polujan, Michail Vasserbaum

title: Il chiromante
synopsis: Candide, a handyman in the service of a carousel and darling of a band of urchins who have formed a sort of tribe, disguises himself as a fortune teller to escape the beating of a bully. So made up, he meets Grazia, a girl who has entered the booth to have his hand read and falls in love with her. But someone tries to trap the pretty girl, a flower girl in a nightclub. It is a young man who is at the head of a clique of counterfeiters. There is not much to save, not even Macario, in this banal doublet.
cast: Erminio Macario, Luisella Beghi, Enzo Fiermonte, Carlo Rizzo, Mario Angillotti, Luciano Gherardi, Valdemaro Attuale, Idolo Tancredi

title: Il ciclone
synopsis: Five flamenco dancers, who are setting up a show, get lost in the Tuscan countryside to the delight of the town and the Quarini family. Family in which the father who is in charge of the old Communist Party (the only newspaper he reads is "L'Unità") and who has baptized his children, Levante, Selvaggia and Libero. Country that has its characters: the pharmacist Isabella who gets on with Selvaggia, the waitress Franca who is ready to be infatuated with the entrepreneur who is a little too big and Pippo who has only a fixed idea. The beautiful women throw everyone into turmoil and prove ready to be courted. For (almost) everyone the happy end is around the corner.
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Lorena Forteza, Natalia Estrada, Benedetta Mazzini, Paolo Hendel, Alessandro Haber, Barbara Enrichi, Tosca D'Aquino, Massimo Ceccherini

title: Il cielo brucia
synopsis: Adventures systematically with a happy ending of an Italian pilot from the northern Africa front, in 1940, to the post -war period. Inseparable appendix of the hero the of him air of him, a trimotor who undergoes various transformations (from silling bomber to transport). Good battle sequences even if there is a lot of repertoire material. As usual, the fearless Nazzari.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Folco Lulli, Antonella Lualdi, Franco Interlenghi, Faith Domergue, Fausto Tozzi, Walter Santesso, Santiago Rivero, Luigi Tosi, Lida Baarova

title: Il cielo cade
synopsis: Summer of 1944, Tuscany. Penny and her sister Baby, orphaned of their father and mother, who died in a car accident, live with aunt Nina and her husband Wilhelm Einstein, Albert's cousin. Through Penny's eyes we get to know the strange world that populates the villa and the strange guests who live there. The girl is a witness to the ambiguities of fascist Italy and the horrors of war that also reach the villa nestled in the Florentine hills.
cast: Isabella Rossellini, Jeroen Krabbe, Barbara Enrichi, Gianna Giachetti

title: Il cielo in una stanza
synopsis: It is a typical Saturday evening at the end of the millennium and for Marco, a seventeen-year-old Roman, everything goes wrong: the girl left him, the scooter was stolen under his nose, it is three in the morning and his father is waiting for him to lecture him. He reproaches him for the lack of responsibility, while Marco can no longer bear his severity. By magic, the two meet again in the sixties and so Marco's father has the opportunity to show his son that he too was young.
cast: Ricky Tognazzi, Elio Germano, Gabriele Mainetti, Francesco Venditti

title: Il cielo è sempre più blu
synopsis: The daylight fades in the sky and on the terraces of Rome. And it is immediately evening, indeed night. A man does gymnastics and contemplates the void; three young men rob a restaurant; a dentist talks about financial strategies. At dawn the city wakes up and the traffic, the voices, the office and street life begin again. The robbers try to sell the stolen goods; a reporter tries to write her article; four masons argue. A birthday party, a seduction, a heart attack, a taxi driver, two policemen, a killer: many fates touch each other in the space of twenty-four hours, without recognizing each other. Grimaldi orchestrates this small metropolitan symphony formed by a constellation of characters in constant expansion. The choral dimension is used as a sort of family album of Italian cinema of the Eighties and Nineties, which would seem to collect the incipits of thirty or more virtual screenplays.
cast: Asia Argento, Luca Barbareschi, Margherita Buy, Roberto Citran, Monica Bellucci, Giulio Scarpati, Ivano Marescotti, Gigio Alberti

title: Il cilindro
synopsis: A woman, posing as a prostitute, lures customers who she charges in advance and then leads them to her bedroom, where her husband's (alleged) body is located. The ploy is more than enough to get customers to run away without asking for the money back.
cast: Monica Vitti, Vincenzo Salemme, Luca De Filippo, Eduardo De Filippo, Pupella Maggio, Franco Folli, Sergio Solli, Franco Angrisano, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Linda Moretti

title: Il cinema della realtà
synopsis: Neorealism in cinema is retraced through the memories, reconsiderations and regrets of those who contributed to creating it and making it vital that season. From the return to the changed set of Rome, open city to the interview with Pasolini on the set of Uccellacci and uccellini, the testimonies of Rossellini, Zavattini, Amidei, De Sica, Moravia, Bellocchio, Bertolucci and others, dot a complex system of analysis of texts and of the strongest instances that have led Italian cinema to confront reality.

title: Il cinico, l'infame, il violento
synopsis: Commissioner Tanzi leaves the police in protest against superiors who disapprove of his unorthodox methods. In contravention of what he was "advised" (pretending to be dead and fleeing to Switzerland) he threw himself back into the fray, but his past pursued him. Luigi Maietto, in fact, ended up in jail because of him, is back free and wants to take revenge.
cast: Maurizio Merli, John Saxon, Tomas Milian, Renzo Palmer, Gabriella Lepori, Robert Hundar, Bruno Corazzari, Marco Guglielmi, Gabriella Giorgelli

title: Il circolo Pickwick
synopsis: Adventures and misadventures of four gentlemen, led by Mr. Pickwick, who wander around England in the early nineteenth century.
cast: Mario Pisu, Guido Alberti, Gigi Ballista, Leopoldo Trieste, Clelia Matania, Enzo Cerusico, Gigi Proietti, Antonio Meschini, Marco Tulli, Loris Loddi

title: Il cittadino si ribella
synopsis: In Genoa, during a robbery in a post office, three bandits take one of the customers hostage, the engineer Carlo Antonelli. Beaten to death and abandoned in a car, Antonelli wants revenge but, when he realizes that the police will not help him much, he decides to go in search of the bandits and to take his own justice. To this end, he blackmails a young fool who then goes over to his side. Usual film of the vein "I'll make the law", but certainly not the worst of the series. Among the curiosities the presence, in the cast, of Barbara Bach, ex-girlfriend of James Bond and later wife of the "Beatle" Ringo Starr.
cast: Franco Nero, Giancarlo Prete, Barbara Bach, Renzo Palmer, Nazzareno Zamperla, Massimo Vanni, Romano Puppo, Renata Zamengo, Franco Borelli

title: Il clan dei camorristi
synopsis: The story of one of the most ruthless mafia and criminal organizations that has ever known Italy, a clan capable of building over the years a plot of unprecedented violence and impunity, of becoming an economic enterprise and a political party from time to time, to corrode institutions from within, to find niches of unsuspected complicity even at the highest levels of the state.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Giuseppe Zeno, Claudia Potenza, Massimo Popolizio, Francesca Beggio, Francesco Di Leva, Vanessa Compagnucci, Renato Marchetti, Serena Rossi, Salvatore Striano, Gianluca Di Gennaro

title: Il clan dei due Borsalini
synopsis: Franco Franchetti is a night watchman who actually performs the duties of a teacher in a school for thieves. In this capacity he is preparing a shot at a jewelry store that will serve as a test for his students. The shot fails, but ...
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Isabella Biagini, Gabriella Giorgelli, Adriana Giuffrè, Lino Banfi, Evi Farinelli, Renato Malavasi, Franca Haas

title: Il club dei 27
synopsis: Giuseppe Verdi, the greatest Italian composer, bequeathed 27 masterpieces to the world. About a century after its birth, an exclusive club is formed in the same places: each of the 27 members bears the name of an opera by Verdi. The charge lasts for life. Half a century later, in the land of melodrama, Giacomo Anelli was born. Despite his tender age, he wants to join the Club of 27. And he is very determined to succeed.
cast: Giacomo Anelli, Irene Carra, Pietro Anelli, Noa Zatta, Ettore Scarpa, Claudio Guain

title: Il cocco di mamma
synopsis: Aldo has two passions, boxing and courting all girls. Then one day he meets Laura, a serious girl who opposes her gallantry with the coldest indifference. When Aldo, seriously in love, realizes that the girl does not intend to give up, he decides to contact Laura's mother.
cast: Maurizio Arena, Ingeborg Schöner, Geronimo Meynier, Franca Rame, Isabella Biagini

title: Il codice del babbuino
synopsis: The body of a woman, victim of rape, is found in the vicinity of a Roma camp on the outskirts of Rome; immediately the girl's partner, Tiberius, sets out in search of those responsible, convinced to personally avenge his woman.
cast: Denis Malagnino, Tiberio Suma, Stefano Miconi Proietti, Marco Pocetta

title: Il colibrì
synopsis: The story of the life of Marco Carrera, "Il Colibrì", a life of fatal coincidences, losses and absolute loves. The story proceeds according to the strength of memories that allow you to jump from one period to another, from one era to another, in a liquid time that goes from the early 70s to a near future. It is at the sea that Marco meets Luisa Lattes, a beautiful and unusual girl. A love that will never be consumed and will never go out, throughout life. His marital life will be another, in Rome, together with Marina and his daughter Adele. Marco will return to Florence thrown away by an relentless destiny, which submits him to very hard tests. To protect him from the most violent impacts will find Daniele Carradori, the Marina psychoanalyst, who will teach Marco how to welcome the most unexpected changes of course.
cast: Kasia Smutniak, Pierfrancesco Favino, Nanni Moretti, Bérénice Bejo, Laura Morante, Sergio Albelli, Fotinì Peluso, Alessandro Tedeschi, Benedetta Porcaroli, Massimo Ceccherini, Elisa Fossati

title: Il colore del vento
synopsis: The story of the journey of a merchant ship in the Mediterranean Sea: the life of the sailors who spend most of their lives on the water, who get lost in the sea to discover women, men and cities, crossing peoples and cultures, intertwining past and present . Each airport is a city, each city a story.

title: Il colore della vittoria
synopsis: We are in 1934. Italy participates in the final phase of the soccer world championships. The Duce wants us to win "at all costs"; the task of preparing the implementation of this imperative falls to Commissioner Vittorio Pozzo. After the final victory over Czechoslovakia he will be carried in triumph by his Azzurri. A sporting exploit dear to the memories of the fans: De Sisti avoids the trap of competitive reconstruction and fixes attention on the human and political implications of the event. In the cast some important names of the new generation of Italian performers.
cast: Adalberto Maria Merli, Claudio Amendola, Nancy Brilli, Claudio Botosso, Massimo Bonetti, Sydne Rome, Giorgio Vignali, Jean Claude Bouillon, Gianni Garofalo, Matteo Bellina

title: Il colore delle parole
synopsis: Four African friends, musicians, mediators and writers, all in Italy for over thirty years, are fighting for the rights of immigrants in the country, but also to make Italians aware of their culture. It is the early seventies when Teodoro, Steve, Martin and Justin arrive in Rome, sent by families or governments to study in Italy and prepare to become the ruling class of their countries. In Italy they experience friendship, love affairs, political struggles and decide to stay. They play football, set up a musical group then everyone takes their own path, they get married, some with Italian women, they buy a house, they have children, but they still do not have Italian citizenship. Over the years they have seen their name change: from students to vu cumprà, from non-EU citizens to immigrants. The laws change in a repressive sense and the Martelli law leads to the current security package that widens the distance between Italian citizens and immigrants.

title: Il colore nascosto delle cose
synopsis: Teo (Adriano Giannini) is a fascinating career advisor. He has a girlfriend, a lover and a troubled family past behind him. One day, he meets Emma (Valeria Golino), a blind, charming and strong-willed woman who has never given up on her handicap. An overwhelming and apparently impossible love breaks out between the two, destined to create havoc in the lives of both.
cast: Valeria Golino, Adriano Giannini, Laura Adriani, Arianna Scommegna, Anna Ferzetti, Andrea Pennacchi, Beniamino Marcone, Mattia Sbragia, Valentina Carnelutti, Giuseppe Cederna, Roberto De Francesco

title: Il colosso di Roma - Muzio Scevola
synopsis: The Etruscans, led by Porsenna, besiege Rome incited by the overthrown King Tarquinio the Superb. Muzio Scevola enters the Etruscan camp to kill Porsenna, but having failed to do so he burns his right hand to punish himself. Tarquinio, meanwhile, has kidnapped Muzio's betrothed and imprisoned Porsenna and his family. Muzio Scevola then confronts him in a duel and, even fighting with the left, wins him. Between history and legend, a film of friendly craftsmanship.
cast: Gordon Scott, Gabriella Pallotta, Massimo Serato, Maria Pia Conte

title: Il colpo del cane
synopsis: On their first day of work as a dog sitter, Rana and Marti suffer the theft of the French bulldog who has been placed in their care by a wealthy lady. Without many other alternatives, they decide to go after the thief, the fake veterinarian Mopsi. But who is he? To understand this, it is necessary to relive the days before the theft and dive into the life of the melancholy Horace. This is the only way to understand the reasons that led him to transform himself into the mysterious Doctor Mopsi.
cast: Edoardo Pesce, Silvia D'Amico, Daphne Scoccia, Sabrina Marchetta, Vittorio Viviani, Silvana Bosi, Federico Tocci, Giulia Salvarini, Anna Bonaiuto

title: Il coltello di ghiaccio
synopsis: Jenny, a young pop singer who has just returned from a tour, is welcomed at the Montseigny station by her cousin Martha who has been mute for fifteen years due to trauma suffered in a train accident. The two girls arrive at their uncle's house where a series of inexplicable murders begins. The first victim is Jenny, who is soon joined by the housekeeper and little Cristina. Commissioner Duran investigates, flanked by the ambiguous Dr. Lawrence, friend of Martha, who in turn fears of ending up in the assassin's sights. Doing a French noir calling yourself Umberto Lenzi instead of Duvivier or Becker is like playing golf without clubs.
cast: Carroll Baker, Alan Scott, Evelyn Stewart, Eduardo Fajardo

title: Il comandante
synopsis: The new general Cavalli is retiring. The new life does not satisfy him at all: he gets bored and, fidgeting, annoys everyone a little. His wife hires him by a real estate agency (she secretly pays his salary), to get him out of the way. The "employers" are two handlers who nearly end up in jail. Finally, Cavalli adjusts to his new status of nothing.
cast: Totò, Andreina Pagnani, Britt Ekland, Isa Crescenzi, Linda Sini, Franco Fabrizi

title: Il comandante e la cicogna
synopsis: In Turin, in the shadow of the statues that observe and accompany the movements of people, Leo (Valerio Mastandrea), a plumber with two children to raise and with his wife Teresa (Claudia Gerini) who appears and disappears, visiting him every now and then at night for a couple of chat, he turns to the lawyer Malaffano (Luca Zingaretti), powerful and fraudulent, to solve the tortuous affair that made his eldest daughter the unwitting protagonist of a porno film that ended up on the web. Here, he meets Diana (Alba Rohrwacher), a penniless young artist who is repainting the walls of the studio for little money. Little by little, what seemed like just an ephemeral acquaintance turns into true love while around them revolve a chorus of characters grappling with their little (mis) adventures. In fact, they are accompanied by Elia, Leo's youngest son, who is doing badly at school and secretly raises a stork, Amanzio (Giuseppe Battiston) who left his job to live like a metropolitan hermit, the Chinese Fiorenzo. , a slipper manufacturer and a mysterious private investigator.
cast: Alba Rohrwacher, Claudia Gerini, Luca Zingaretti, Giuseppe Battiston, Valerio Mastandrea, Michele Maganza, Maria Paiato, Shi Yang Shi, Luca Dirodi, Serena Pinto, Giselda Volodi, Giuseppe Cederna, Fausto Russo Alesi

title: Il commissario
synopsis: The young Commissioner Lombardozzi was charged with following the investigation into the death of a well-known politician, Professor Di Pietro. Despite the embarrassments of the family and the opposition of his superiors, he reconstructs what happened: Di Pietro was killed by a prostitute with whom he had secluded. Having obtained the confession of the woman and her accomplice, he drags the latter to court: but he will be acquitted, while Lombardozzi's career will be compromised.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Franca Tamantino, Alessandro Cutolo, Mino Doro, Franco Scandurra, Alfredo Leggi, Angela Portaluri, Andrea De Pino

title: Il commissario Lo Gatto
synopsis: A crime has been committed in the Vatican: Commissioner Lo Gatto (Banfi), in charge of the delicate investigations, does not stop in front of anyone and even goes so far as to question the pope and therefore is transferred by his superiors on the island of Favignana. Here one day an attractive tourist, Wilma, mysteriously disappears. The inspector's investigations are immediately triggered, but it turns out that the woman, rather than kidnapped, was a "guest" of the Prime Minister on a Navy ship.
cast: Lino Banfi, Maurizio Ferrini, Maurizio Micheli, Albano Bufalini, Nicoletta Boris, Isabel Russinova, Galeazzo Benti, Renata Attivissimo

title: Il commissario Montabano - Come voleva la prassi
synopsis: The corpse of a beautiful girl is found naked, wearing only a bathrobe soaked in blood, on the cold floor of an entrance hall in Via Pintacuda. What prompted the girl to drag herself, lifeless, into there? Montalbano suspects that the victim is a prostitute from Eastern Europe. And he hopes that the Cuffaros, who manage the prostitution market in Vigata, isolate those responsible for such a heinous crime.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Isabell Sollman, Sonia Bergamasco, Angelo Russo, Nuccio Vassallo, Giulio Corso, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Lana Vlady, Viktoriya Pisotska, Sofia Pulvirenti

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Amore
synopsis: In short, it is useless to go around it: Montalbano is not very comfortable with matters related to love. And the death of the beautiful Michela Prestia puts her ability to extricate herself in the labyrinths of complexity and the fatal deceptions of amorous sentiment to the greatest ever test. Michela is a girl with a dramatic, if not downright tragic past: unjustly rejected at a very young age by her family, she met the wrong men, who humiliated and exploited her, leading her to become a prostitute. But over time she managed to recover from that ruin, rebuilt her life and found love: Saverio Moscato, with whom she now lives and who in turn loves her totally and unconditionally. But just now that she seems to have found a stable and happy condition, Michela mysteriously disappears. Most believe that, having had so many lovers in the past, she simply abandoned Saverio and ran away with another man. Montalbano, however, soon realizes that this is not the case. That something serious must have happened to Michela. Maybe she was even killed. But by whom? And why? The meeting with two elderly theater actors, the Di Giovanni spouses, helps him to solve this mystery. Montalbano, through their bizarre and tender history? and also thanks to a renewed feeling of jealousy towards Livia? he understands that Michela's disappearance is the fruit of a crazy, impossible and tragic love.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Sonia Bergamasco, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Serena Iansiti, Angelo Russo, Fabrizio Ferracane, Stella Egitto, Gigio Morra, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Gigliola Reina, Vincenzo Catanzaro, Fabio Costanzo, Gino Nicolosi, Paola Abruzzo, Alessandro Mario, Ketty Governali

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Gatto e cardellino
synopsis: In Vigata, within a few days, three old ladies are attacked by a strange individual: in fact, on board a motorbike and with his face covered by his helmet, he shoots at them without killing them. Since the assistant commissioner Mimì Augello (Cesare Bocci) is on marriage license, Montalbano is joined in the investigation by Barbara Bellini (Mariacristina Morocco), his childhood friend who has just won a competition in the police.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Giovanni Guardiano, Mariacristina Marocco

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Gli arancini di Montalbano
synopsis: Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti), not wanting to go to Paris with his girlfriend Livia (Katharina Böhm), ??decided to spend New Year's Eve with a dinner based on delicious arancini. But first he must investigate the death of a couple who fell into a ravine in their car.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Isabell Sollman

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il campo del vasaio
synopsis: Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) investigates two cases: the discovery of a corpse, torn to pieces and buried in a potter's clay field, and the disappearance of a maritime officer, reported by his disturbing wife Dolores Gutierrez (Belén Rodriguez).
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Belén Rodríguez, Isabell Sollman, Tuccio Musumeci, Giacinto Ferro

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il cane di terracotta
