synopsis: Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) receives the confession of the boss Tanu 'u Greco, determined to turn himself in. Following the revelations of the old mafioso, he sets out on the trail of a large arms trade: discovering the deposit in a cave, he also finds two skeletons whose autopsy convinces Montalbano to investigate their dark past.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il gioco degli specchi
synopsis: A low-potential bomb explodes in front of Angelino Arnone's warehouse door and, while everyone believes it is a threat to unpaid protection money, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) is not convinced of this hypothesis. Realizing that the recipient of that warning is someone else, Montalbano focuses his attention on Carlo Nicotra and Stefano Tallarita, two offenders who live near the warehouse. Although the case turns out to be a real headache, Montalbano also finds time to deal with the damage to the car of his neighbor Liliana Lombardo (Barbora Bobulova).
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Barbora Bobulova, Cesare Bocci, Andrea Renzi, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Roberto Nobile, Marcello Perracchio, Pietro Masotti, Enrico Roccaforte, Fabio Costanzo, Mirella Petralia, Santo Cavallaro, Mariuccia Cannata

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il gioco delle tre carte
synopsis: A well-known builder from Vigata is found dead on the side of a road but his accountant Ciccio Monaco (Gilberto Idonea) is convinced that the man was not hit by a car. During the investigation, Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) will also have to deal with the killing of a mysterious stranger.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Simona Cavallari, Valeria Milillo, Barbara Tabita, Stefano Dionisi, Gilberto Idonea

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il giro di boa
synopsis: Following the tragic events of the G8 in Genoa, Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) is even thinking about resigning from the police. In the meantime, he participates in the landing operations of a group of illegal immigrants; in addition he has to solve the case of the discovery of a body in the waters of Marinella.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Isabell Sollman

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il ladro di merendine
synopsis: A Tunisian was killed on a fishing boat: the assistant commissioner Mimì Augello (Cesare Bocci) is in charge of the case. The next day Aurelio Lapecora, a merchant, is found dead in the lift; his wife (Guja Jelo) is convinced that he was stabbed by her husband's lover: Karima Moussa (Afef Jnifen), a beautiful Tunisian cleaning lady who is reported missing. Commissioner Salvo Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) begins the research.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Guia Jelo, Afef Jnifen, Jonis Bashir

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il senso del tatto
synopsis: Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) investigates Enea Silvio Piccolomini, a blind man who died following the administration of an excessive dose of the medicine he was taking. The investigations lead him to the island of Levanzo in search of Ignazia (Lucia Sardo), sister of the deceased.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Lucia Sardo

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Il sorriso di Angelica
synopsis: Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) is grappling with the theft that took place in the house by the sea and in the luxurious apartment of Carlo and Caterina Peritore. Since the thieves have not left any mark or imprint, Montalbano is led to believe that they are people who know the Peritore well, linking the theft to the one that occurred a few days earlier against the lawyer Lojacono and Dr. Vaccaro and realizing that it is a matter of a gang that has targeted a circle of friends belonging to the Vigata elite. When Angelica Cosulich (Margareth Madé) is robbed, Montalbano finds himself in front of a beautiful 30-year-old bank manager, who immediately hits him with her magnetic smile.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Margareth Madè, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Roberto Nobile, Lina Perned, Davide Lo Verde, Hamza Choukri, Aldo Messineo, Carmen Longo, Gabriele Gallinari, Luciano Miele, Giacinto Ferro, Fabio Costanzo

title: Il commissario Montalbano - L'altro capo del filo
synopsis: The landings of migrants follow one another almost every night, and Commissioner Montalbano has to face this emergency with his few men, who work non-stop. And he does so without ever losing his humanity and his sense of justice. In the midst of all this, a terrible crime strikes Vigata: Elena Biasini is brutally massacred in her tailor's shop. The murder seems inexplicable. But Montalbano will know how to grasp the thread of this mysterious and extraordinary woman's life.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Sonia Bergamasco, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Elena Radonicich, Angelo Russo, Ahmed Hafiene, Eurydice El Etr, Giorgia Salari, Carlo Calderone, Anna Ferruzzo, David Cannavò, Davide Dolores, Davide Lo Verde, Aglaia Mora, Giovanni Guardiano, Nour Zarafi, Safa Derguala, Hossein Taheri

title: Il commissario Montalbano - L'età del dubbio
synopsis: The crew of the "Vanna", a luxurious yacht, found the body of a man who died of poisoning at sea: Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) investigates with the help of Lieutenant Laura Belladonna (Isabella Ragonese), a handsome officer of the captain's office of port.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Isabella Ragonese, Ana Caterina Morariu, Caterina Vertova, Giacinto Ferro

title: Il commissario Montalbano - L'odore della notte
synopsis: The accountant Gargano disappeared with the money that many citizens of Vigata had entrusted to him, hoping for a profitable gain. Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti), while investigating this sensational case of fraud, finds himself struggling with the sentimental torments of his assistant superintendent and friend Mimì Augello (Cesare Bocci), a convinced fimminaro but now close to the wedding.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giacinto Ferro, Claudia Fichera

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La caccia al tesoro
synopsis: During a daring blitz carried out in a dilapidated building, Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) discovers a worn out inflatable doll. Some time later another is found, just as the inspector receives a strange anonymous letter.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Dajana Roncione, Giovanni Moschella

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La danza del gabbiano
synopsis: Before allowing himself some well-deserved rest, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) is forced to deal with the mysterious disappearance of one of his attendants: Inspector Giuseppe Fazio (Peppino Mazzotta).
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Ilenia Maccarrone, Sebastiano Rapisarda, Massimo Procopio, Concetta Lazzaro

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La forma dell'acqua
synopsis: In a mannara - a kind of stable - two garbage collectors find the corpse of the engineer Luparello inside his car. Arriving at the scene, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) receives confirmation from Doctor Pasquano (Marcello Perracchio) that Luparello's death took place during a sexual encounter. The main suspect in the murder is the Swedish Ingrid Sjostrom (Isabell Sollman).
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Isabell Sollman, Angelica Ippolito

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La giostra degli scambi
synopsis: An electronics store was burned down, a clearly arson attack. But it's not just about this: Marcello Di Carlo, the owner of the shop, has disappeared, there is no longer any trace of him. He is a handsome Di Carlo man, and also a playboy of some success, but he has the habit of spending a lot more than he can earn. Montalbano begins to investigate, but the mystery of this disappearance seems to be becoming more and more elusive. And then in those days something else is also happening, something very strange and disturbing: a bizarre kidnapper deceives some girls, chloroforms them, kidnaps them for a few hours and then leaves them free outside Vigàta: he doesn't touch them, he does not violence against them, nor does he rob them ... the reasons for these kidnappings? lightning seem really incomprehensible. Montalbano will understand that the two cases, apparently very different, are actually linked, and above all he will realize that to get to the head of this complex investigation he will have to find out who is the mysterious latest flame of Di Carlo, the girl with whom the playboy spent a beautiful holiday in the Canaries and which he has not introduced to any of his friends and acquaintances. And she will not only have to find out who she is, but also where she is now, why she hasn't reported to the police so far, or if something hasn't happened to her.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Sonia Bergamasco, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Sebastiano Lo Monaco, Angelo Russo, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Desirèe Noferini, Raffaele Esposito, Chiara Muscato, Davide Lo Verde, Ubaldo Lo Presti, Ketty Governali, Daniela Giordano, Noemi Giambirtone, Salvatore La Mantia

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La gita a Tindari
synopsis: A man comes to the police station visibly anxious because he has no more news of his elderly parents. Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti), while investigating them, finds the corpse of a computer scientist, killed on the door of the building where the two missing old men live.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Carmela Gentile, Giovanni Moschella

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La luna di carta
synopsis: During the investigation into the murder of Angelo Pardo (Ludovico Caldarera), a well-known fimminaro, Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) runs into Elena Sclafani (Antonia Liskova), the victim's beautiful lover.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Antonia Liskova, Francesca Chillemi, Giovanni Visentin, Pia Lanciotti, Ludovico Caldarera

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La pazienza del ragno
synopsis: Following the discovery of an abandoned scooter on a road outside Vigata, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) deals with the strange kidnapping of a girl, Susanna Mistretta (Federica De Cola).
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Roberto Nobile, Federica De Cola, Clelia Rondinella

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La piramide di fango
synopsis: It is late at night and it is pouring with rain. A man, in his underwear and undershirt, seriously injured, bleeding, runs desperately on a bicycle, until he enters a building site that is now all a quagmire. With the last of his remaining strength, he goes to slip into a large pipe of the water pipeline under construction. That's where the body is found, the next morning. He was shot dead. Inspector Montalbano understands that the man must have been surprised in the night, while he was sleeping; the killer shot him, he tried to escape with his bicycle, hid in that pipe, but the wound was too serious and he died. So he had to live near the construction site. The inspector therefore manages to find his home and identify it: it is the thirty-five-year-old Gerlando Nicotra, accountant of the same construction company of that site where he died; lived with his beautiful German wife, Inge. It is a very complex and strange case, on which the Commissioner is called to shed light.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Sonia Bergamasco, Teresa Mannino, Tony Laudadio, Mimmo Mignemi, Giulia Iannì, Ubaldo Lo Presti, Yuliya Mayarchuk

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La pista di sabbia
synopsis: The corpse of a horse is found on the beach of Marinella, which is then mysteriously made to disappear: Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) then finds himself investigating the world of clandestine horse racing, also prompted by the request for help from the fascinating Rachele Estermann (Mandala Tayde ).
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Mandala Tayde, Giovanni Moschella, Gigio Morra, Isabell Sollman

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La vampa d'agosto
synopsis: For a completely random circumstance, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) finds the body of a girl who disappeared a few years earlier: he then begins the investigation with the help of the sensual Adriana Morreale (Serena Rossi), the victim's twin.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Marcello Perracchio, Serena Rossi, Gaetano Aronica, Vincenzo Peluso

title: Il commissario Montalbano - La voce del violino
synopsis: Michela Licalzi (Alessia Merz) is a beautiful woman who is found dead, naked in an abandoned house. Everything suggests that the culprit is Maurizio Di Blasi (Maurizio Prollo), a boy morbidly attracted to her. But Commissioner Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) is not at all convinced.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Katharina Böhm, Maurizio Prollo, Alessia Merz, Sergio Fantoni

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Le ali della sfinge
synopsis: In crisis with his eternal girlfriend Livia and with himself, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) investigates the death of a girl found naked in an old landfill.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giorgio Bongiovanni, Giuseppe Caponnetto, Isabell Sollman, Valbona Malaj

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Par condicio
synopsis: Against the backdrop of the mafia war between the family of Don Balduccio Sinagra (Francesco Sineri) and the Cuffaro clan, Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) follows the case of the disappearance of a foreign girl: according to the elements gathered during the research, she was handed over of a criminal involved in the white trade.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Giacinto Ferro, Francesco Sineri

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Tocco d'artista
synopsis: Agent Catarella (Angelo Russo) calls Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) on the phone to inform him of the suicide of a goldsmith he knows. Following the development of the investigations, Giacomo Larussa (Luigi Maria Burruano), younger brother of the deceased and the only testamentary heir, was arrested.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Cesare Bocci, Davide Lo Verde, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Giovanni Guardiano, Katharina Böhm, Bianca Maria D'Amato, Luigi Maria Burruano

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Un covo di vipere
synopsis: One morning the 60-year-old businessman Cosimo Barletta is found dead in his beach house. He was shot dead in the back of the head while sitting quietly in the kitchen drinking coffee. There are no signs of a break-in, so someone who knew him, who he himself may have let in, or even a woman who may have spent the night there with him, killed him. The case soon takes on very dark colors, because Montalbano discovers, also thanks to the testimony of the murdered's children, that Barletta was anything but a mirrored person.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Sonia Bergamasco, Alessandro Haber, Valentina Lodovini, Angelo Russo, Alice Canzonieri, Marcello Mazzarella, Beatrice Arnera, Marcello Perracchio, Giovanni Visentin, Valeria Panepinto

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Un diario del '43
synopsis: Three stories come to Montalbano from the past: the discovery, after the demolition of an old silo, of a diary written in the summer of 1943 by a boy who was fifteen at the time, a certain Carlo Colussi. The boy, steeped in fascist ideology, confesses to having carried out a terrible act in the aftermath of 8 September 1943, a massacre. On the very day of the discovery of the diary, a sprightly-looking ninety-year-old, a certain John Zuck, arrives at Montalbano. The man, born in Vigata, was taken prisoner by the Americans during the war. Also thanks to the death of both parents in a car accident, he decided to stay in the USA and make a life there. Back in Vigata, he discovered his name incorrectly entered on the tombstone of the war dead. He then asks Montalbano if he can help him get his name deleted from the monument. Zuck is very sympathetic to Montalbano, who takes his Pirandello story to heart. The day after meeting Zuck another ninety-year-old, Angelino Todaro, one of the richest entrepreneurs in the city, is found dead. Someone killed him. Among the lights of the feast of San Calorio, Montalbano will understand that the three stories are connected to each other.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Sonia Bergamasco, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Dominic Chianese, Selene Caramazza, Angelo Russo, Giulio Brogi, Roberta Caronia, Marco Basile, Roberto Nobile, Aldo La Spina, Davide Lo Verde, Giovanni Guardiano, Rosa Giustolisi, Angelo Tosto, Silvia La Monica, Francesco Colaiemma, Nellina Laganà, Nino Bellomo, Lorenzo Adorni, Fabrizio Romano

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Una faccenda delicata
synopsis: Months after François's death, Livia seems to have gotten over her mourning. Salvo is with her in Liguria and Livia is happy to have him all to herself for a few days. Unfortunately, however, Montalbano receives a call from his police station: there has been a murder and he must return immediately to Vigata. As soon as he returns, he discovers that the prostitute Maria Castellino, an almost seventy-year-old strangled with a men's belt in the mini-apartment where she worked, has been killed.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Sonia Bergamasco, Miriam Dalmazio, Paolo Graziosi, Lollo Franco, Sebastiano Tringali, Ileana Rigano, Ketty Governali, Liborio Natoli

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Una lama di luce
synopsis: Salvatore Di Marta (Ivan Alovisio), wealthy owner of the largest supermarket in Vigata, goes to the police station with his young wife Loredana (Valentina Reggio) to report the robbery of the woman the previous night while she was going to deposit in the cashier the bank continues the 30 thousand euros of the daily collection. Since the report they provided presents many unclear points, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) decides to investigate further, first discovering that Loredana was once engaged to Carmelo Savastano, a petty criminal. While the case takes a cruel and twisted turn, another bizarre story engages Montalbano: the small landowner Gaspare Intelisano (Santo Pennisi) in fact reports that someone has mounted a door and covered the holes in the windows in his dilapidated country cottage.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Lina Perned, Peppino Mazzotta, Dajana Roncione, Angelo Russo, Roberto Nobile, Marcello Perracchio, Ivan Alovisio, Valentina Reggio, Santo Pennisi, Giacinto Ferro, Davide Lo Verde, Fabio Costanzo, Hamza Choukri, Antonio Silvia, Natalì La Rosa, Piero Calabrese, Ester Pantano

title: Il commissario Montalbano - Una voce di notte
synopsis: On his birthday, Inspector Montalbano (Luca Zingaretti) finds himself arresting a pirate who turns out to be Giovanni Strangio, the son of the president of the Province of Montelusa. As if that were not enough, the same day he is called to investigate a theft that took place in the supermarket which, directed by Guido Nicotra and under the control of the Cuffaro mafia family, has the honorable Mongibello as president of the board of directors. Faced with two cases that become more and more mangy, Montalbano will be forced to do something he has never done.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Saverio Marconi, Angelo Russo, Antonio Milo, Andrea Croci, Roberto Nobile, Marcello Perracchio, Giacinto Ferro, Davide Lo Verde, Giovanni Visentin, Saro Minardi, Alice Torriani, Mirella Petralia, Evelyn Famà

title: Il commissario Montalbano: Il metodo Catalanotti
synopsis: Carmelo Catalanotti was murdered with a stab in the chest but the murder, even if only for the strange composure of the body and the lack of blood spilled, immediately presents something strange. Inspector Montalbano soon discovers that the victim was a loan shark, albeit in his "fair" way or at least not particularly greedy. But Catalanotti was not just a usurer, he was first of all a fervent and original theater artist, soul and founder of Trinacriarte, a very active amateur theater company in Vigata. The Trinacriarte is not a simple amateur dramatics, most of its members are literally possessed, if not possessed, by the passion of the theater, Carmelo Catalanotti was the guru of such followers, a guru who knew how to be brilliant but also cruel and sadistic. So much so that Montalbano realizes that it is precisely within his art, his very personal and disturbing Method, that he is the solution to the mystery of his death. To complicate the difficult case, however, there is the incorrigible Mimi Augello, who in an attempt to escape the husband of her umpteenth lover, comes across a corpse with great surprise. Corpse that, with even greater surprise, he will never be able to find again.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Sonia Bergamasco, Greta Scarano, Antonia Truppo, Carlo Cartier, Marina Rocco, Monica Dugo, Aglaia Mora, Maurizio Bologna, Giampiero Cicciò, Gaetano Aronica

title: Il commissario Montalbano: La rete di protezione
synopsis: A strange new enigma awaits Inspector Montalbano. The engineer Sabatello brings him some short films shot for decades by the now deceased father that always depict the same thing: the fixed shot of a wall. The inspector realizes that it is not just a bizarre story, but that behind those strange films there is a remote affair with tragic and gloomy colors. However, it will not be only this cold case to commit the commissioner because, in those days, in the school attended by Augello's son a frightening and incomprehensible attack is carried out. Two individuals with covered faces break into the institute, shoot, sowing terror among teachers and children, and launch their menacing and obscure proclamation. A new mystery to shed light on… and justice.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Sonia Bergamasco, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Disa Östrand, Carolina Carlsson, Fredrik Hiller, Tuccio Musumeci, Peppe Tuccillo, Luigi Tuccillo, Corrado Brancaforte, Mario Pupella, Graziano Piazza, Ketty Governali

title: Il commissario Montalbano: Salvo amato, Livia mia
synopsis: The brutal murder of Agata Cosentino, whose body is found in a corridor of the municipal archive, cannot leave Inspector Montalbano indifferent. The victim was a dear friend of Livia: a shy and reserved girl who gave her friendship and love to a few people. Montalbano's investigation focuses on the latter, because it soon becomes clear that Agata was killed by someone who was very close to her. It is perhaps a sexual violence degenerated into murder, but this hypothesis does not immediately convince Montalbano, who begins his investigation starting from the knowledge of the victim.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Sonia Bergamasco, Cesare Bocci, Peppino Mazzotta, Angelo Russo, Katia Greco, Federica De Benedittis, Roberta Giarrusso, Ketty Governali, Saro Minardi, Nicolò Prestigiacomo, Rosario Lisma, Fabio Costanzo

title: Il commissario Pepe
synopsis: In a small town in northern Italy, apparently clean and dignified, Commissioner Pepe (Tognazzi) discovers a completely different reality, steeped in rot, in which many unsuspected people are involved. From above comes the invitation to neglect the excellent names. At which, the commissioner chooses another solution: either all or none.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Silvia Dionisio, Tano Cimarosa, Elsa Vazzoler, Giuseppe Maffioli, Marianne Comtell, Dana Ghia, Véronique Vendell, Rita Calderoni

title: Il commissario Zagaria
synopsis: In Salento the commissioner Pasquale Zagaria (Lino Banfi), now close to retirement, finds himself collaborating with the young assistant superintendent Stefano Amato (Marco Cocci) to stop the war between the local criminals and the new criminals who arrived from Calabria. With his intuition, Zagaria is convinced that first of all we must frame the unsuspected notary from Lecce Antonio Matera.
cast: Lino Banfi, Marco Cocci, Ana Caterina Morariu, Rosanna Banfi, Antonio Stornaiolo, Sandro Ghiani, Isabelle Adriani, Manrico Gammarota, Luigi Petrucci, Paolo De Vita

title: Il commissario di ferro
synopsis: Commissioner Mariani, due to his irascible and abusive character, is left by his wife and downgraded to a neighborhood police station. To complicate his life comes a psychopath who holds him responsible for the death of his father and seeks revenge, even harassing Mariani's family and taking his colleagues hostage.
cast: Maurizio Merli, Janet Agren, Ettore Manni, Cristea Avram, Massimo Mirani

title: Il compagno
synopsis: We are in Turin in 1939. Pablo is handsome and young and loves playing the guitar and for this reason he is highly sought after by all boys and girls. He is not interested in social problems or politics. Through his friend Aurelio, who has been paralyzed in the legs due to an accident, he meets the beautiful Linda and falls in love with her. After the first meetings Linda suddenly disappears. Pablo, in love, looks for her and finds her with a man: Carletto, a handsome actor with a hump. For a while the two lovers continue to meet each other by attending a club, "Il Mascherino" where prostitutes and magicians work. Television version of a classic Cesare Pavese novel, the film oscillates between aestheticizing moments and other didactic moments, without lifting from an average television package.
cast: Lucio Zagaria, Stefania Sandrelli, Slvia De Santis, Nunzia Greco

title: Il compagno Don Camillo
synopsis: Brescello, the village of don Camillo and Peppone, is twinned with a Russian citizen. A municipal delegation, led by the mayor, therefore goes to the homeland of royal socialism to perfect the twinning. To it, in disguise, the parish priest also joins, anxious to grasp the deleterious aspects of communist society.
cast: Gino Cervi, Fernandel, Graziella Granata, Gianni Garko, Leda Gloria, Saro Urzì, Paul Muller, Marco Tulli, Jacques Herlin

title: Il compagno americano
synopsis: Paris 1940. In a cell of anti-fascists, the young Muffa militates, whose enthusiasm is equal to ingenuity. His comrades decide to send him to Italy as a diversion, to cover up the real envoy, who must organize an attack against Mussolini. But the attack goes awry, and the poor Yankee finds himself catapulted to Cinecittà where everyone is waiting for mr. Hogan, a technician who must reveal the secrets of Technicolor for the first Italian production in color.
cast: Hugh O'Connor, Nancy Brilli, Tosca D'Aquino, Giulio Base

title: Il compleanno
synopsis: Two couples of friends are on holiday in Sabaudia. The return from America of the twenty-year-old son of one of the couples awakens a series of conflicts and a dramatic passion that leads to tragedy.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Maria De Medeiros, Massimo Poggio, Michela Cescon, Christo Jivkov, Piera Degli Esposti, Thyago Alves, Marianna De Rossi, Lynn Swanson

title: Il compromesso... erotico - Ménage a quattro
cast: Pupo De Luca, Ria De Simone, Armando Marra, Alfredo D'Ippolito

title: Il comune senso del pudore
synopsis: A worker, to celebrate his silver wedding anniversary, takes his wife to the cinema after four years, but he finds only unseemly films. The woman is scandalized, but in some way suffers the contagion. An intellectual is called to direct a pornographic magazine: he suddenly jumps from misery to well-being. Handcuffs quickly snap on his wrists. The wife of a magistrate on the front line against obscenity is drawn to what her husband condemns. A German actress, multiple Oscar winner, refuses to interpret the most gory sequence of a film about Lady Chatterley in which a Neapolitan producer has invested a lot of money not hers. A group of cinema experts will convince you. Deaf, "champion" of (his) morals, discovers that sex is also a big business on which many profit and thrive. In something - from the screenplay by Sonego and his - he gets it right. But, for much of the film, it runs in circles with little bite.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Alberto Sordi, Florinda Bolkan, Rossana Di Lorenzo, Cochi Ponzoni, Silvia Dionisio

title: Il condannato - Cronaca di un sequestro
synopsis: The discovery of the red Renault in which the body of Aldo Moro was found, abandoned in a police depot, is the beginning of the reconstruction of the kidnapping of statesman Aldo Moro and his 55 days of imprisonment, which ended in the worst possible way. The story of the journalist Ezio Mauro begins on March 16, 1978, the day in which the Red Brigades were grappling with the preparations for the kidnapping.

title: Il conformista
synopsis: Marcello lives in the remorse of having killed a taxi driver who wanted to rape him at 13 years of age. On a honeymoon, in 1937, he went to Paris to prepare the murder of Professor Quadri, an anti -fascist exile that he had been the master of him at the University. Despite the suspicions of the wife of paintings, attracted by Giulia, Marcello's wife, the assassination succeeds. On July 25 '43, among the crowd in celebration for the fall of fascism, Marcello met the driver who believed he had killed ...
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Stefania Sandrelli, Dominique Sanda, Pierre Clementi, Gastone Moschin, Enzo Tarascio, Fosco Giachetti, José Quaglio, Yvonne Sanson, Alessandro Haber, Milly, Giuseppe Addobbati

title: Il conquistatore di Corinto
synopsis: Messengers sent from Rome arrive in Corinth to ask the senate of that city to leave the Achaean league to establish relations with the Eternal City. The request is not only denied, but the members of the mission are attacked by the crowd in the main square of the city. The centurion Caio Vinicio, wounded in the fray, manages to take refuge in the house of Callicrato, head of the pro-Roman party. Here he meets Ebe, daughter of the strategist Critolao and falls in love with her. But Artemis, wife of Callicrato, also fell in love with the centurion.
cast: Jacques Sernas, Geneviève Grad, Carlo Tamberlani, Gianni Santuccio, Gianna Maria Canale

title: Il consigliori
synopsis: Thomas, godson and "advisors" of a Los Angeles mafia boss, decides to marry and retire from the family's shady business. But he must rejoin the ranks for a war between clans with a tragic ending. Epigone of the "Godfather", with little originality and many banalities.
cast: Tomas Milian, Martin Balsam, Francisco Rabal, Dagmar Lassander, Perla Cristal, Carlo Tamberlani, John Anderson, Nello Pazzafini, Manuel Zarzo

title: Il console italiano
synopsis: Near the end of her mandate, Giovanna Bruno, the Italian consul in South Africa, undertakes to find her compatriot Marco Borghi, a journalist with whom she had had an affair at the time of high school and now a partner of Palesa, a young black woman. Through personal investigations, Giovanna discovers that the mysterious disappearance of the reporter is connected to a shady trafficking of women destined for the European prostitution markets, on which Marco was making a report. Despite the initial differences of opinion, the consul and Palesa will venture into a dangerous search.
cast: Anna Galiena, Luca Lionello, Giuliana De Sio, Alessandro Haber, Adrian Galley, Franco Trevisi, Lira Molapo, Sabine Palfi, Edwin Angless

title: Il contagio
synopsis: In a building on the Roman outskirts, the lives of Marcello and Chiara, of Mauro and Simona, of Valeria and Attilio, of Flaminia and Bruno, of the neighborhood boss Carmine and of Professor Walter are stirring. A plot that combines love and paid sex, crime and hope, tragic and comic, forming a variegated mosaic in which the periphery is a monstrous giant stranded on the edge of a big city. But even the Rome of the center, made up of building workers and businessmen, is no less.
cast: Vinicio Marchioni, Maurizio Tesei, Anna Foglietta, Vincenzo Salemme, Giulia Bevilacqua, Daniele Parisi, Michele Botrugno, Alessandra Costanzo, Lucianna De Falco, Carmen Giardina, Fabio Gomiero, Flonja Kodheli, Nuccio Siano

title: Il conte Dracula
synopsis: Count Dracula instructs the lawyer Jonathan to buy a house for him. Having taken possession of the house, the count keeps the young lawyer with him, then makes him his victim.
cast: Christopher Lee, Klaus Kinski, Herbert Lom, Soledad Miranda, Maria Rohm, Fred Williams, Paul Müller, Jack Taylor

title: Il conte Max
synopsis: Alberto, who has a kiosk in via Veneto, has a hidden desire to be part of that high society with which he has to deal every day, but from which he is fatally excluded. To realize his dream, an extravagant client comes to his aid, the fallen count Max Orsini Baraldo: thanks to his precious advice, Alberto manages to have a relationship with a baroness. But then he realizes that that world was not made for him ...
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Anne Vernon, Susana Canales, Tina Pica

title: Il conte Max
synopsis: Alfredo is a young mechanic who dreams of the good life. The old Count Max lends him advice and clothes to follow Isabella, a top model he has fallen in love with. In Paris, Alfredo sneaks into high society. When a homosexual billionaire falls in love with him and offers him a golden "marriage" he is about to accept, but at the last moment he runs away from Isabella who is waiting for him with open arms.
cast: Christian De Sica, Ornella Muti, Galeazzo Benti, Anita Ekberg, Maria Mercader, Bruno Corazzari, Antonello Fassari, Karen Moore, Paolo Triestino

title: Il conte Tacchia
synopsis: In Rome at the beginning of the century, Checco Puricelli, the son of a modest carpenter, aspires to become a noble. The sincere love that binds him to Fernanda does not prevent him from falling in love with the Duchessina Elisa, who is engaged to the Marquis Lollo. This attitude only worsens his relations with the Marquis, so much so that the latter pushes him into a duel against a French nobleman. For this purpose he is truly appointed count. Having also reached wealth, he marries the commoner.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Vittorio Gassman, Paolo Panelli, Ninetto Davoli, Giuseppe Pambieri, Claudio Gora, Riccardo Pizzuti, Ania Pieroni

title: Il conte Ugolino
synopsis: Count Ugolino della Gherardesca is the most powerful lord of Pisa. This bothers many and in particular the regent of the Republic, Archbishop Ruggieri, who manages to have him walled up alive together with his children under the false accusation of treason. The dark historical story, made famous by Dante in canto XXXII of the " Divina Commedia ", is narrated here in a dark and claustrophobic melody, with more than one gothic element and highly effective directorial solutions.
cast: Carlo Ninchi, Gianna Maria Canale, Peter Trent, Luigi Pavese, Piero Palermini, Carla Calò, Ugo Sasso, Ciro Berardi, Armando Guarnieri

title: Il conte di Matera
synopsis: Pressed by the troops of the ruthless count of Tramontana, the elderly lord of Matera and his daughter Gisella are forced into exile. Before dying, the nobleman has the joy of seeing his son Paolo, believed dead in battle, who will lead the revenge against the oppressor ...
cast: Virna Lisi, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Wandisa Guida, Otello Toso, Aldo Bufi Landi, Paul Muller, Guido Celano, Emilio Petacci, Armando Migliari

title: Il conte di Melissa
synopsis: On April 2, 1608, Count Gian Battista Campitello died at the age of 63 in the castle of Strongoli. The fiefdom was divided between his four children. Strongoli Castle was assigned to Hannibal, who stayed there to live with his sister Giovanna. The fiefdom of Casabona went as a dowry to Pompeo; the castle of Melissa with all the circumscribed territory was annexed to Francesco. On 22 August of the same year, Francesco with his court joined Melissa. The town was celebrating, folk songs and dances welcomed the new owner. Francesco Campitello was happy to see so many people coming to cheer him on purpose, among so many shy women he was particularly struck by Eleonora, a beautiful girl, who, feeling insistently observed by the count, hid behind her family. The count immediately asked Patanè, his trusted cousin, for news of the girl, who knew well the places and people of that area; he learned from him that the girl was about to marry a certain Luigi Vulcano. The count, in love with the girl, first decided to respect her so that she could give herself freely, but then restored the ancient custom of jus primae noctis in order to possess it. Infinite griefs inevitably go back to that night of love: Eleonora, who got pregnant, hid her daughter Marianna, making her pass for a child; the count increased his abuses on the population to the point of provoking a popular revolt; Marianna in turn risked the worst. The Count of Melissa's dream sank into the darkest tragedy.
cast: Maria Gangale, John D'Aquino, Lorenzo Flaherty, Alfonso Santagata, Massimiliano Virgili, Melba Ruffo, Franco Interlenghi, Nadia Rinaldi, Francesca Rettondini, Mario Spinocchio

title: Il conte di Sant'Elmo
synopsis: At the head of a group of Carbonari the heroic and indomitable count of Sant'Elmo (almost a local version of the Primula Rossa) fights against Cassano, the minister of the Bourbon police. When Serato was angelic and Buazzelli a little thinner.
cast: Massimo Serato, Tino Buazzelli, Anna Maria Ferrero, Nelly Corradi, Tina Lattanzi, Carlo Croccolo, Alfredo Varelli, Pier Luigi Costantini, Renato Malavasi

title: Il conto è chiuso
synopsis: Plot in preparation
cast: Luc Merenda, Carlos Monzon, Gianni Dei, Giampiero Albertini, Mario Brega, Susana Giménez, Luisa Maneri, Leonora Fani, Claudio Zucchet, Nello Pazzafini

title: Il contratto
synopsis: Thanks to a fortuitous accident, Geronta Sabezio is believed capable of resurrecting the dead. People rely on him en masse and he invariably offers everyone the same contract: he will guarantee resurrection to anyone who donates all his assets to all his relatives, near and far.
cast: Franco Angrisano, Eduardo De Filippo, Luca De Filippo, Angela Luce, Vincenzo Salemme

title: Il coraggio
synopsis: The corpulent Commendatore Paoloni (Cervi), a sanguine temperament and an excellent swimmer, has a rather particular "hobby": saving anyone who tries to kill himself by throwing himself into the waters of the Tiber. In his last speech he brought up a poor man full of problems, Gennaro Vaccariello (Totò), who however did not like it. Out of spite Vaccariello settles in Paoloni's house with the whole family ...
cast: Totò, Gino Cervi, Irene Galter, Leopoldo Trieste, Gabriele Tinti, Paola Barbara, Bruna Vecchio, Ernesto Almirante, Gianna Maria Canale

title: Il coraggio di Angela
synopsis: Angela Latella, an enterprising forty-year-old Neapolitan, owns a paint shop with her husband Pasquale. A tireless worker, Angela managed to ensure a certain well-being for her two children. His life, however, is suddenly upset by the Camorra's requests for lace. But the constant requests for money do not weaken Angela's strength, nor do they break family relationships, strengthened by the common resistance of the whole family, not at all willing to give up the fruit of a lifetime's work ...
cast: Lunetta Savino, Gianluca Di Gennaro, Andrea Tidona, Gaetano Amato, Antonio Pennarella, Vincenzo Pirozzi, Maria Pia Calzone, Ninni Bruschetta

title: Il coraggio di parlare
synopsis: A Calabrian boy risks becoming part of the 'Ndrangheta. He first emigrated to Milan, then returned and had the local bosses arrested, causing a healthy awareness of the young people of the country. Bad pseudo-denunciation film, based on a horrible children's novel, made by a dull "educational" author (his is also the biography of Don Bosco with Gazzara).
cast: Gian Luca Schiavoni, Riccardo Cucciolla, Lello Arena, Giuliana Calandra

title: Il coraggio di vincere
synopsis: Rocco is a former boxer who is over forty. With a rather complicated and suffered past behind him, he lost the opportunity to establish himself nationally due to a series of scams he was the victim of. By now Rocco no longer hopes that his existence will change and lives with little, managing an old gym with Marcello, his former trusted coach. One day, by chance, Rocco witnesses a small fight between young people and sees a boy who seems to be comfortable with punching and boxing. This is Ben, a Senegalese who makes do as best he can for a living. Realizing his talent, Rocco begins to train him for free but with one perspective in mind: to make him participate in the Italian national championship.
cast: Adriano Giannini, Nino Frassica, Serena Rossi, Yann Gael, Nina Torresi, Luca Angeletti, Massimo De Santis, Patrizio Oliva

title: Il corazziere
synopsis: Urbano Marangoni has only one desire in life: to wear, like his father, the cuirassier uniform. But between the realization of his dream and reality there is only one problem: height. Falling in love with Mirella, the daughter of a hierarch, Urbano feels a decisive refusal from the girl's father, not at all willing to have a half-sock as a son-in-law. Disappointed, Urban is sure to take revenge when bad luck forces him to take part in all the wars of the time.
cast: Renato Rascel, Tino Buazzelli, Claudia Mori, Carlo Giuffrè

title: Il corpo
synopsis: Adventurer Antoine arrives in Trinidad and begins a love story with the beautiful Princesse, a black woman. His wife, however, leaves him and goes to live in the city. Antoine meets Alain, welcomes him into the house but he falls in love with Princesse. Together they decide to kill the protagonist and escape.
cast: Zeudi Araya, Enrico Maria Salerno, Leonard Mann, Carroll Baker, Luigi Antonio Guerra

title: Il corpo dell'anima
synopsis: The writer Ernesto, a wealthy 64-year-old widower without children, lives alone in a large house in a middle-class neighborhood in Rome. With an introverted character and little inclined to social acquaintances, man experiences his solitude as a conscious choice. Ernesto, who is writing a script about the life of Teresa of Avila, is suddenly abandoned by the Filipino waitress, so he is forced to hire Luana. He soon gets overwhelmed by the girl's exuberance and beauty and loses his head for her.
cast: Roberto Herlitzka, Raffaella Ponzo, Ennio Fantastichini, Sabina Vannucchi

title: Il corpo della ragassa
synopsis: The beautiful Teresa, known as Tirisin, who grew up with her father among the hard work on the banks of the Po (we are in the 1920s), is weaned at the "Blue Grotto" casino. She is noticed by Doctor Quario who hires her as a waitress, educating her in the arts of femininity. Arts that Tirisin will put to work with the doctor. The film could be the portrait of a sentimental and erotic education and at the same time the historical fresco of an era, as in the beautiful novel by Gianni Brera from which it is based. Instead, we fall into the banality of erotic comedy, even if Carati (before personal drift and hard-core) was one of the sexiest actresses in Italian cinema.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Lilli Carati, Renzo Montagnani, Giuliana Calandra

title: Il corsaro
synopsis: After losing his ship to the game, the English pirate Jeffrey Brook is captured by the French and deported to a desert island. During the journey he leads a mutiny, frees all prisoners, finds his boat and recaptures it. Then he lands on an island controlled by the Portuguese, leads the pro-British revolt, distributes gold to the rebels and resumes the sea route ...
cast: Robert Woods, Tania Alvarado, Cris Huerta, Armando Calvo

title: Il corsaro della Mezzaluna
synopsis: The head of the guards of a castle on the banks of the Tyrrhenian Sea is the subject of a mysterious attack. Immediately after the castle is besieged by a pirate ship, which requires the delivery of some hostages including the daughter of the baron owner of the castle. The girl discovers that the pirate leader is actually a nobleman forced into hiding by the false accusations of the chief guard.
cast: John Derek, Gianna Maria Canale, Alberto Farnese, Ingeborg Schöner, Raf Mattioli, Camillo Pilotto, Gianni Rizzo, Paul Muller, Raf Baldassarre, Yvette Masson

title: Il corsaro nero
synopsis: The adventures of the English privateer, Captain Blakie, between kidnappings, ransoms and boarding ships loaded with gold. Very modest and light-hearted adventure film; Salgari has little to do with it.
cast: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Silvia Monti, George Martin, Sal Borgese, Diana Lorys

title: Il cortile
synopsis: Nando is a thirteen year old thief. Locked up in a reformatory, he flees to the city where a busker believes in the fundamental goodness of his soul and takes him with him. A suspicious landlady risks ruining everything.
cast: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Marisa Merlini

title: Il cosmo sul comò
synopsis: The bizarre teachings of an oriental master to the two disciples are the setting for four episodes in which Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo experience extravagant adventures. Once they are friends grappling with one of their own desire for fatherhood; then they organize the departure for the holidays, in a crescendo of misunderstandings and unexpected events. They are also protagonists of the naive life of a suburban parish; finally, they become an integral part of the portraits of an art gallery, transmigrating from one painting to another.
cast: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Sergio Bustric, Victoria Cabello, Silvana Fallisi, Raul Cremona, Sara D'Amario, Angela Finocchiaro, Elena Giusti, Cinzia Massironi, Isabella Ragonese, Debora Villa

title: Il cratere
synopsis: In a cursed land, a father uses his daughter and her voice to take control of the world and his own destiny. Success will become an obsession for him in the same way that talent will turn into punishment.
cast: Sharon Caroccia, Rosario Caroccia

title: Il crimine non va in pensione
synopsis: In the elderly center "La Serenissima" everything flows quietly until the placid atmosphere of a day like so many others is upset by the hospitalization of Edda, a woman of about 73 years, treated and distinguished who has accused an illness caused by strong stress for losing his savings by gambling illegally. The woman was worried about her daughter's financial problems and had tried desperately to help her with a big win. When the companions of the center become aware of his difficulties, they clumsily decide to rob Bingo Havana, a place where they usually spend a few hours to break the monotony of everyday life.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Ivano Marescotti, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Fabio Fulco, Franco Nero, Orso Maria Guerrini, Maurizio Mattioli, Salvatore Misticone, Giacomo Piperno, Rosaria D'Urso, Silvana Bosi, Gisella Sofio

title: Il cugino americano
synopsis: Julian Salina, an engineer of Italian origin, lives in Baltimore. His father Joe had been helped by the Cosa Nostra, then he had paid the debt but the mafia has always continued to blackmail him. This time they ask him for an important favor: to send Julian to Italy to use him against his cousin, Giuliano, a magistrate in charge of dealing with mafia cases. Julian will have to introduce the criminals to the bunker where Giuliano lives. As soon as he arrives in Palermo, Julian realizes, however, that he will never give in to blackmail. First part of a much trumpeted television movie a few years ago as an imitation of The Octopus, but without success.
cast: Brad Davis, Tony Lo Bianco, Vincent Spano, Barbara De Rossi, Arnoldo Foà, Angelo Infanti, Delia Boccardo, Ricky Tognazzi, Michael V. Gazzo, Maria Conchita Alonso, Joe Spinell

title: Il cuore altrove
synopsis: Rome, 1920s. The thirty-five-year-old Nello Balocchi is a shy and awkward man who is sent by his father to teach in a high school in Bologna with the hope that he will finally find a wife, guaranteeing the descent to the family. In Bologna, Nello shares a room in a boarding house with a Neapolitan barber who successfully initiates him into sex. One day he ends up in an institution for the blind and meets a beautiful and unscrupulous girl with whom he falls madly in love. It is the beginning of a love story between two "different" ones.
cast: Neri Marcoré, Vanessa Incontrada, Nino D'Angelo, Giancarlo Giannini, Giulio Bosetti

title: Il cuore grande delle ragazze
synopsis: In the mid-thirties, after returning from the city where she had been sent to study, Francesca Osti (Micaela Ramazzotti) falls in love with Carlino (Cesare Cremonini), the reckless son of the Vigetti, a couple of farmers who work in the lands of the Osti . Francesca does not know, however, that Carlino was destined, at the behest of his father Sisto and mother Rosalia, to marry one of his two older sisters, the elderly Maria and Amabile - who had already started courting -, but his arrival upsets every floor and between the two young people will be love at first sight ...
cast: Micaela Ramazzotti, Cesare Cremonini, Gianni Cavina, Andrea Roncato, Erika Blanc, Sydne Rome, Patrizio Pelizzi, Gisella Sofio, Manuela Morabito, Massimo Bonetti, Alessandro Haber, Stefania Barca, Sara Pastore, Rita Carlini

title: Il cuore nel pozzo
synopsis: The escape of a group of children from Tito's partisans, set in the last years of the Second World War.
cast: Leo Gullotta, Giuseppe Fiorello, Antonia Liskova, Marcello Mazzarella, Cesare Bocci, Mia Benedetta, Dragan Bjelogrlic, Alfredo Pea, Sonia Aquino, Vladimir Aleksic

title: Il debito coniugale
synopsis: Tired of work and his wife, Romolo goes off in search of adventures with a former comrade in arms and a stripper. Tired gags and joke-collecting rhythm.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Barbara Bouchet, Orazio Orlando, Pippo Franco, Mario Carotenuto

title: Il decalogo di Vasco
synopsis: An imaginary and real journey by car, divided into ten chapters, with the "silhouette" of Vasco Rossi who observes the world out of the window and daydreams.
cast: Vasco Rossi

title: Il decimo clandestino
synopsis: Marcella (Piera Degli Esposti), a widowed Emilian farmer, wants to open a shop for agricultural products in Bologna but cannot find a house in the city due to her numerous nine children. When she gets the chance to rent an apartment in the building of an austere aristocrat, Marcella lies by saying she is alone. From that moment, in order not to be discovered, she will be forced to resort to various tricks to keep her children hidden.
cast: Piera Degli Esposti, Dominique Sanda, Hartmut Becker, Susanna Marcomeni, Giorgio Trestini, Marco Musolesi

title: Il decisionista
synopsis: The film follows in the footsteps of a fixer, Gian Luigi Rossi, "the decision maker" in fact, who tries to thrive in the shadow of business bigger than himself. He is a man without ideals whose only purpose is money - the non-his billions that he administers in Switzerland, the boards of directors - and not even the passionate encounter with a journalist, engaged in an investigation aimed at unmasking the shady trafficking that surround him, he manages to redeem him.
cast: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Luca Lionello

title: Il delitto Mattarella
synopsis: January 6, 1980. The President of the Sicilian Region Piersanti Mattarella is going to Mass with his family. A young man approaches the car window and shoots Piersanti in cold blood and kills him. Despite the disorientation of the moment with a series of misdirections towards left-wing terrorism, the crime appeared anomalous in its modalities. The young Deputy Prosecutor on duty that day of the Epiphany will be Pietro Grasso, future Anti-Mafia Prosecutor and President of the Senate. The investigations will be continued by the investigating judge Giovanni Falcone, who will find dangerous relationships between the Mafia, Politics, Nar and neo-fascists, the Magliana gang, Gladio and Secret Services.
cast: David Coco, Francesco Di Leva, Donatella Finocchiaro, Sergio Friscia, Leo Gullotta, Vittorio Magazzù, Tuccio Musumeci, Antonio Alveario, Claudio Umberto Cantone, Claudio Castrogiovanni, Nicasio Catanese, Domenico Ciaramitaro, Fabio Costanzo, Vincenzo Crivello, Lollo Franco, Ivan Giambirtone, Guia Jelo, Francesco La Mantia, Tony Sperandeo, Andrea Tidona, Angelo Tosto

title: Il delitto Matteotti
synopsis: Vancini's film retraces and reconstructs, even with the minutia of the documentary, the story of the assassination of Giacomo Matteotti by the fascists. At times action film, at times more reflective, in the 1970s it was the classic historical reflection film for schools. The reconstruction of the environment is accurate, and the story is told clearly but without too much weight. A decent example of the "political cinema" of those years.
cast: Mario Adorf, Riccardo Cucciolla, Manuela Kustermann, Franco Nero, Damiano Damiani, Gastone Moschin, Vittorio De Sica, Renzo Montagnani

title: Il delitto del diavolo - Le regine
cast: Evelyn Stewart, Ray Lovelock, Silvia Monti, Haydee Politoff

title: Il delitto di Giovanni Episcopo
synopsis: An employee bewitched by a woman marries her and endures endless humiliations. Except one.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Roldano Lupi, Yvonne Sanson, Ave Ninchi, Nando Bruno, Alberto Sordi, Francesco De Marco, Amedeo Fabrizi, Folco Lulli

title: Il delitto di Via Poma
synopsis: On the evening of 7 August 1990, the body of Simonetta Cesaroni (Astrid Meloni), brutally murdered with 29 stab wounds, is found in a building in via Poma in the elegant district of Roma Prati, at the office where the girl worked. as a secretary. Nobody seems to have noticed anything strange that day and the hypotheses about the murderer lead in various directions, so much so that the investigators' investigations lead nowhere. Twenty years later, Niccolò Montella (Silvio Orlando) is called to shed light on the crime.
cast: Astrid Meloni, Giulia Bevilacqua, Silvio Orlando, Giorgio Colangeli, Fabio Traversa, Imma Piro, Rosa Pianeta, Michele Alhaique, Milena Miconi, Daniela Piperno, Maddalena Ferrara, Alessio Caruso, Vittorio Ciorcalo, Paolo Buglioni, Luca Cimma

title: Il deserto dei tartari
synopsis: A young officer, Lieutenant Drogo, is sent to serve in a fortress on the edge of the desert. Here he waits, together with his companions, to be able to measure himself against the enemies, the Tartars. But the days go by without anything happening. Meanwhile, the lieutenant sees his dreams of glory shattered: he falls seriously ill without being able to fight.
cast: Jacques Perrin, Vittorio Gassman, Philippe Noiret, Francisco Rabal

title: Il deserto di fuoco
synopsis: Prince of a small kingdom in the Sahara, Ben falls in love with his sister. The mother senses and reveals to Ben the secret of her adoption as soon as she is born; the young man thus leaves around the world in search of his true origins. In the meantime, however, the evil cousin Dubai, greedy for power, takes his little sister in marriage.
cast: Anthony Delon, Mandala Tayde, Virna Lisi, Fabio Testi, Giuliano Gemma, Vittorio Gassman, Claudia Cardinale, Franco Nero, Orso Maria Guerrini, Jean Sorel, Luca Lionello

title: Il destino ha quattro zampe
synopsis: Giuseppe is a middle-aged actor who had previously experienced some success with a children's show. Over the years, however, his career is in decline and the only parts he manages to remedy are from extras, until Tempesta, an actor dog, joins his life.
cast: Lino Banfi, Nino Frassica, Edoardo Baietti, Rosa Pianeta, Michela Noonan

title: Il dialogo di Roma
synopsis: A man and a woman around Rome evoke a civilization and an ancient love.
cast: Paolo Graziosi, Anna Nogara

title: Il diario di Matilde Manzoni
synopsis: The existence of Matilde Manzoni, daughter of Alessandro, was consumed in the indifference of the great writer. Her short life as a consumptive was consumed in the unrequited desire for paternal love, of which some letters and a diary covering a few months attest. The story of Vittoria, the writer's other daughter, is also intertwined with her story.
cast: Ludovica Andò, Lea Gramsdorff, Urbano Barberini, Corinne Cléry

title: Il diario di una schizofrenica
synopsis: Anna is eighteen and has suffered from a mental illness since childhood that no cure has been able to solve. His parents don't want to leave any stone unturned. Anna is taken to Switzerland, where she is treated by Madame Blanche, a psychiatrist who uses non-traditional methods and great emotional participation. She will be the one to heal her. Upon release, the film, which had psychologist Franco Fornari as its consultant, caused great admiration.
cast: Ghislaine D'Orsay, Margarita Lozano, Marija Tocinowsky, Umberto Raho, Manlio Busoni

title: Il diavolo
synopsis: Amedeo Ferretti, a fur sales representative, travels to Stockholm to negotiate the purchase of a stock of these fine garments. The man, who has always heard about the sexual freedom of Swedes, sees the possibility, once he arrives on the spot, to establish romantic relationships with splendid creatures. Although Amedeo flaunts his Latin charm, he does not reach the goal he had set for himself.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Gunila Elm Tornqvist, Ulf Palme, Anne Charlotte Sjöberg

title: Il diavolo a sette facce
synopsis: Worried about the disappearance of her twin sister Mary, Julie Harrison seeks the help of lawyer Dave Barton, after she too is chased by a mysterious man through the streets of Amsterdam. Mary, however, has not disappeared but has become part of a gang of dangerous criminals intent on taking possession of the seven-faced Devil, a precious diamond belonging to an Indian maharaja.
cast: Carroll Baker, George Hilton, Stephen Boyd, Lucretia Love, Luciano Pigozzi, Daniele Vargas, Franco Ressel, Carla Mancini, Gianni Pulone, Roberto Messina

title: Il diavolo e l'acquasanta
synopsis: A former footballer on the verge of suicide, Manuel Marangoni, is saved by the intervention of a priest, Don Gaetano, who then welcomes him to the rectory together with his girlfriend. The two cause a lot of trouble for the priest. Then Don Gaetano has an intuition: he decides to entrust the country's soccer team to Manuel, engaged in a difficult tournament. Even as a coach, the man combines some good, but then comes the opportunity for redemption.
cast: Tomas Milian, Piero Mazzarella, Savina Gersak, Margherita Fumero

title: Il diavolo in convento
synopsis: Brother Angelo (Govi) organizes a fake miracle to prevent the sale of the convent to an industrialist who wants to make it a hotel. History doesn't matter: only Gilberto Govi ??counts.
cast: Gilberto Govi, Carlo Ninchi, Ave Ninchi

title: Il diavolo nel cervello
synopsis: Ricky, an introverted child, is found with a gun in his hand next to his father's corpse. Accused seems a shadow of a doubt of the murder, Ricky is locked up by his mother, Countess Sandra De Blanc, in an institution for unstable young people. Worried about the good name of the family, Sandra is helped by Oscar, a doctor of her former suitor who delights in the investigation. After having ascertained Ricky's good mental health, Oscar will try to trace the truth and make Sandra relive the moments in which she approached her husband's corpse.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Keir Dullea, Micheline Presle, Tino Buazzelli

title: Il diavolo sulle colline
synopsis: On the hills of Monferrato three young university students, plus a fourth rich friend, plus her wife and the strange game that arises between them. TV version of Pavese's story directed by the veteran Cottafavi and interpreted by a bunch of incompetents.
cast: Daniela Silverio, Matteo Corvino, Urbano Barberini, Alessandro Fontana, Roberto Accornero, Kristina Van Eyck

title: Il dio chiamato Dorian
synopsis: Dorian, a rich and handsome young man, loves Sybil, an aspiring actress: a feeling that distracts him, at least a little, from his extreme narcissism. In this period he is also posing for a portrait that his painter friend Basil is making of him. When the portrait is finished Dorian expresses his regret: he will necessarily have to age and wither but the painting will remain unchanged over time, portraying its beauty. That same night he has a violent quarrel with Sybil, which he drives away. With fright the next morning he discovers that his image in the portrait appears slightly tired, as if aged. Dorian thus decides to hide the painting and continues his vicious life, without sparing himself. Yet, to age, it is only the image.
cast: Helmut Berger, Richard Todd, Herbert Lom, Marie Liljedahl, Margaret Lee, Maria Rohm, Beryl Cunningham, Isa Miranda, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Renato Romano, Stewart Black

title: Il dio serpente
synopsis: Finding herself the widow of Bernard, an elderly rich man in the Caribbean, Paola makes friends with Stella and is fascinated by the magical rituals of the place. In particular, she ends up involved in orgiastic ceremonies dedicated to Djamballa, the serpent god, "embodied" in a handsome young man ...
cast: Nadia Cassini, Beryl Cunningham, Sergio Tramonti, Galeazzo Benti, Arnaldo Palacios, Juana Sobreda, Claudio Trionfi, Evaristo Marquez, Koike Mahoco

title: Il diritto alla felicità
synopsis: Libero is a passionate seller of used books and Essien is an immigrant boy who has lived in Italy for a few years. The friendship between the two passes through the books that Libero lends to Essien and the complicity among them grows parallel to the emotions that each of these novels can give. Essien meets the West through his literature, free bears the meaning of his name trying to make Essien a free man. Life, with its commandments, will place a melancholy ending but nothing is lost where there is complicity and affection.
cast: Remo Girone, Corrado Fortuna, Didie Lorenz Tchumbu, Moni Ovadia, Pino Calabrese, Lapo Braschi, Liliana Fiorelli, Annamaria Fittipaldi, Biagio Iacovelli, Valentina Olla, Federico Perrotta

title: Il disco volante
synopsis: In a village of Veneto a flying jug launches. A carabinieri brigadier is in charge of the investigation. Thus begins to question the witnesses but these, including the brigadier, will end up in the asylum: the case will soon be forgotten.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Monica Vitti, Silvana Mangano, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Gianluigi Crescenzi, Alberto Fogliani, Liana Del Balzo, Carlo Mazzarella, Lello Bersani, Graziella Polesinanti, Guido Celano, Lars Bloch, Piero Morgia, Erika Blanc

title: Il disordine
synopsis: Looking for a job in the chaotic Milan of the 1960s, the cradle of Italian neocapitalism, Mario tries to establish himself by associating with the people who matter in the upper middle-class circles: an industry tycoon, a capricious lady and a group of tormented snobs.
cast: Renato Salvatori, Curd Jürgens, Alida Valli, Jean Sorel, Louis Jourdan

title: Il disordine del cuore
synopsis: Anna Davati, a beautiful in her forties, moves from a big city to a small provincial town to answer a job advertisement in a newspaper. This is how he presents himself in the home of Carlo Silvio, a forty-five-year-old writer who has gone blind after gaining popularity and international recognition with only three books published. The man is looking for a secretary and the only requirement is that she be an ugly woman. Despite her beauty, Anna is hired but as the days go by, living with the writer turns out to be rather complicated.
cast: Milena Miconi, Paolo Fosso, Erika Blanc, Franco Pistoni, Marco Falaguasta, Ami Codovini, Janet De Nardis

title: Il dito nella piaga
synopsis: The arrival of the Germans saves two thieving and violent American soldiers from being shot, but they redeem themselves by fighting to the death.
cast: Klaus Kinski, George Hilton, Ray Saunders, Betsy Bell

title: Il divorzio
synopsis: Leonardo Nenci, an architect now close to forty, divorces his wife Elena after fifteen years of marriage due to frequent quarrels, and tries to be a bachelor. Convinced of still being able to arouse interest in women, he faces his new life with the enthusiasm of a boy. After a series of easy and unsatisfactory adventures, he decides to return to his ex-wife, but realizes that the woman has reserved an unwelcome surprise for him.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Anna Moffo, Helena Ronee, Anita Ekberg, Nino Castelnuovo, Mario Brega, Nadia Cassini, Riccardo Garrone, Massimo Serato, Tiberio Murgia, Claudie Lange

title: Il dolce corpo di Deborah
synopsis: Marcel and Deborah are on their honeymoon in Geneva: everything seems to be going well, but one day they meet their old friend Philip, who blames them for the suicide of his girlfriend Susan. From that moment on, the two newlyweds are persecuted by Philip, who pursues them with messages of vengeance. To deal with the terror, Deborah begins taking barbiturates. One evening, the ex-friend enters the bedroom and tries to kill the woman in her sleep: Marcel intervenes, triggering a spiral of dramatic events that drag the couple into the abyss ...
cast: Carroll Baker, Jean Sorel, Evelyn Stewart, Luigi Pistilli, George Hilton

title: Il dolce e l'amaro
synopsis: Saro Scordia is a little boy who lives in Palermo, in the Capo neighborhood, and since childhood he has understood that the key to being successful in his part is to become part of the Cosa Nostra. For twenty years he struggles in an attempt to become a "man of honor", to rise to the rank of mafia boss, but in fact he remains a small fish for life ...
cast: Fabrizio Gifuni, Luigi Lo Cascio, Donatella Finocchiaro

title: Il dolce rumore della vita
synopsis: Sofia falls in love with her acting teacher, a 35-year-old of Slavic origin with an irresistible charm. Sofia, who is twenty years old and who believes in this story with all her might, is shocked when she learns that Bruno is homosexual. The setback is so strong that he decides to run away. On the train that is supposed to take her far away, she will happen to have to take care of a child abandoned in the toilet.
cast: Francesca Neri, Rade Serbedzija, Niccolò Senni, Rosalinda Celentano

title: Il domestico
synopsis: Three armies: the Italian one in the days of the armistice, the German one, the American one. A film producer, a Roman nobleman, an ambiguous married couple, an oilman with political intrigues and his wife. Finally, the cellmates in the jail where his parable ends. These, in succession, are the "employers" of the servant Zazà, animated by an uncontrollable vocation to service.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Martine Brochard, Arnoldo Foà, Silvia Monti, Femi Benussi, Leonora Fani, Paolo Carlini, Enzo Cannavale, Nanda Primavera, Renzo Marignano, Erika Blanc

title: Il dominatore del deserto
synopsis: The tyrant Yussuf, in one of his numerous raids, kidnaps a group of women. Among these is the beautiful Fatima, who however manages to escape. He takes refuge in the desert where he risks dying. At the last moment, however, she is saved by the brave Nadir, a Brber warrior who already has, on his own, more than one reason to oppose Yussuf. After a bloody battle, Nadir defeats the tyrant. A film that oscillates between adventure and exoticism, action and struggle, but without a shred of fantasy. Amerigo Anton is actually Tanio Boccia.
cast: Kirk Morris, Rosalba Neri, Hélène Chanel, Paul Müller, Aldo Bufi Landi

title: Il dono
cast: Michelangelo Frammartino, Gabriella Maiolo

title: Il dottor Antonio
synopsis: In the nineteenth century an English girl who is passing through Livorno is treated by an Italian doctor and falls in love with him. When he, who participates in the riots in Naples in '48, is imprisoned by the Bourbons, the enterprising young lady flies to the aid of her beloved. From a novel by Sergio Ruffini, a film with a traditional structure but solidly set and not without rhythm.
cast: Ennio Cerlesi, Maria Gambarelli, Lamberto Picasso

title: Il duca nero
synopsis: End of the 15th century: the dominion of the cruel Cesare Borgia is opposed by Caterina Sforza and the conspirators of the Red Carnation, who charge the beautiful Geneva with invaghire the duke and then poison him. The two, however, really fall in love ...
cast: Cameron Mitchell, Conrado San Martín, Grazia Maria Spina, Gloria Milland, Franco Fantasia, Dina De Santis, Robert Dean, Gloria Osuna, Nino Persello

title: Il est plus facile pour un chameau...
synopsis: Federica is very rich. This privilege does not make her feel free and prevents her from living a normal existence and assuming her responsibilities. In particular, the girl has to contend with a boyfriend who would like to start a family, an ex-lover who suddenly reappears, a family with whom she constantly quarrels and who is destabilized by the announcement of her father's death. Federica thus finds comfort in her imagination and indulges in her daydreams.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Chiara Mastroianni, Jean Hugues Anglade

title: Il falco d'oro
synopsis: Sienese countryside, 1600. The Montefalco and Della Torre families hate each other. To try to make peace, they decide to arrange a marriage between their firstborn. The only one who proves opposed to the wedding is Fiammetta, a girl, usually wearing men's clothes, in love with the groom.
cast: Anna Maria Ferrero, Massimo Serato, Nadia Gray, Mariangela Giordano, Frank Latimore, Carlo Sposito, Charles Fawcett, Rose Alba, Arturo Bragaglia, Umberto Sacripante

title: Il falco e la colomba
synopsis: Michele, rampant politician, is stalked by some terrorists. Rescue from the young Viva, drug addict, Michele falls in love with him, leaves his wife and gives up his career. But his former companions, fearing a scandal, try to bring alive in the drug tunnel.
cast: Fabio Testi, Lara Wendel, Simonetta Stefanelli, Danilo Mattei

title: Il fanciullo del West
synopsis: In an imaginary country of Far West two families are fighting each other for dominance. The clashes are complicated by the presence of a band of outlaw that sows terror. Maccarey's good -natured doctor tries to put an end to disputes and to end rivalries.
cast: Erminio Macario, Elli Parvo, Giovanni Grasso, Tino Scotti

title: Il fantasma dell'Opera
synopsis: A newborn abandoned in the Seine is saved by two mice. Paris 1877, in the great theater a mysterious presence sows terror. A kind of cruel but romantic "ghost" who falls in love with soprano Christine.
cast: Asia Argento, Julian Sands, Andrea Di Stefano, Coralina Cataldi Tassoni

title: Il fantasma di Corleone
synopsis: Is it possible that a man (Bernardo Provenzano) has managed to live hidden on an island for 42 years, hunted down by hundreds of policemen and continues to be the supreme leader of the Cosa Nostra? The disturbing question is posed in rhetorical form by the authors Andrea Purgatori and Marco Amenta, with the latter at the helm of directing.

title: Il fascino dell'insolito: Impostore
synopsis: An alien spatial ship arrives on Earth and a crew member takes the appearance of Spence Olham (Adalberto Maria Merli) to detonate a bomb he has inside his body. The military hunt him.
cast: Daniele Dublino, Adalberto Maria Merli, Antonio Piovanelli, Giorgio Giuliano, Elisabetta Carta, Italo Dall'Orto, Bruno Marinelli, Renato Montalbano

title: Il fascino dell'insolito: Miriam
synopsis: Miriam is an elderly widow who lives a quiet existence with his canary. However, her everyday life is shocked by the sudden appearance of a ten -year -old girl with the same name as her.
cast: Luisa Rossi, Corrado Annicelli, Claudia Vegliante, Martina Carpi, Aldo Bufi Landi, Claudio Sorrentino, Margherita Sestito

title: Il federale
synopsis: In 1944 a fascist fanatic who hopes to become a Federal must bring an opponent of the regime from Abruzzo to Rome. Along the journey (by sidecar) the two get to know each other better, against the backdrop of an Italy now in ruins and in disarray. Despite the clear evidence of the collapse of the regime, the comrade's faith does not falter, again due to the mirage of promotion.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Georges Wilson, Mireille Granelli, Stefania Sandrelli, Gianrico Tedeschi, Elsa Vazzoler, Renzo Palmer, Gianni Agus, Franco Giacobini, Ester Carloni

title: Il feroce Saladino
synopsis: A former variety artist ends up selling sweets in a theater: when he discovers that his chocolate bars all contain the very rare figurine of the ferocious Saladin (the one from the Perugina competition), he tries to relaunch himself with a magazine inspired by the character.
cast: Angelo Musco, Alida Valli, Rosina Anselmi, Mario Mazza, Elli Parvo, Checco Durante, Alberto Sordi, Carlo Duse

title: Il ferroviere
synopsis: Andrea Marcocci worked all his life in the railways, but he never made friends with his colleagues; in addition, the children prove to be a disappointment: the male in fact does not want to work, while the girl continues to have extramarital affairs. Andrea begins to drink more and more until he suffers a train accident: in that difficult situation, his workmates deny him solidarity because he had worked during a strike ...
cast: Pietro Germi, Sylva Koscina, Luisa Della Noce, Saro Urzì, Carlo Giuffrè, Amedeo Trilli, Renato Speziali, Edoardo Nevola, Riccardo Garrone

title: Il fiacre n. 13
synopsis: The countess of Latour leaves everything to her son Filippo, disinheriting Giorgio, the most reckless. He kills his brother and makes his son disappear too, but an innocent person is accused of the crime. Years later, the family requests a review of the trial, but the papers have disappeared.
cast: Leonardo Cortese, Vera Carmi, Roldano Lupi, Ginette Leclerc, Sandro Ruffini

title: Il ficcanaso
synopsis: Luciano is in love with Susanna. The girl returns her feelings because she is convinced that Luciano is able to foresee things before they happen. To the young man who has no powers, from time to time, a Guardian Angel appears who foretells him things that will promptly come true.
cast: Pippo Franco, Edwige Fenech, Pino Caruso, Luc Merenda, Laura Troschel

title: Il fidanzamento
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Martine Brochard, Didi Perego, Anna Proclemer

title: Il fidanzato di mia moglie
synopsis: On the eve of the wedding, the young Renata Sarti discovers from the certificate of marital status that she has already been married. The anger of her fiancé and relatives lead her to go to her native country to clear up the misunderstanding. To her great surprise, the girl meets a man who is in the same condition as her: the matter begins to get more and more intricate ...
cast: Vera Carmi, Eduardo De Filippo, Leonardo Cortese, Aroldo Tieri, Sergio Tofano

title: Il figlio del Corsaro Rosso
synopsis: Count Enrico di Ventimiglia, son of the famous Corsaro Rosso, searches all seas for the sinister Van Hais, whose betrayal cost his father his life. The filibuster is captured while boarding a Spanish galleon. On board the ship is the Marquise of Montellimar who is made a sign of the attentions of Enrico's men. To try to save himself, Van Hais promises to reveal the place where the count's sister has disappeared for years. The nobleman learns that his sister is in the service of a noblewoman in Maracaibo. Posing as a Spanish officer, Enrico tries to get in touch with her.
cast: Lex Barker, Sylvia Lopez, Vira Silenti, Renato Bracale, Tiziano Cortini, Elio Pandolfi, Luciano Marin, Antonio Crast, Fanfulla, Vicky Lagos

title: Il figlio della luna
synopsis: Carmelo and Lucia Frisone, are a couple of poor Sicilians already parents of two girls who find themselves having to raise a third child, Fulvio, suffering from dystonic spastic quadriplegia since birth. Always supported by his mother, the little one at school discovers a passion for poetry, painting and above all physics.
cast: Lunetta Savino, Paolo Briguglia, Antonio Milo, Alessandro Morace, Alessandra Costanzo, Paride Benassai, Evelyn Famà, Vito Favata, Maria Giovanna Grassi, Victoria Larchenko

title: Il figlio della sepolta viva
synopsis: France, 1700. The Duchess of Cambyses usurped the title after having the true nobleman buried alive and murdering her husband. A friar, a pilgrim, a court jester and the son of the buried alive, aware of the secret, are ready to unmask her.
cast: Fred Robsham, Eva Czemerys, Pier Maria Rossi, Gabriella Lepori

title: Il figlio dello sceicco
synopsis: Frightened by the prospect of his greedy brother succeeding him in the regency, the elderly sheikh of the United Arab Emirates discovers that he has an unsuspecting natural son who works as a gas station attendant in Rome. To accept the succession, however, the young man sets a condition ...
cast: Tomas Milian, Bo Svenson, Kirsten Gille, Andrea Aureli, Roberto Messina

title: Il figlio dello sceicco
synopsis: Egypt, 19th century. The tyrant Omar uses an iron fist against the inhabitants of the province of which he is governor. Kerim, son of the sheikh, takes care of defending the interests of the weakest. Omar tries in every way to respond to the attacks of the champion of justice.
cast: Gordon Scott, Cristina Gajoni, Alberto Farnese, Moira Orfei

title: Il figlio di Aquila Nera
synopsis: Alessio Andrejevic, son of the legendary hero Black Eagle, puts himself at the head of the Cossacks and fights against the ruthless Governor of the Caucasus. Falling into the hands of his enemy, he is freed by the intervention of Natasha (Fenech).
cast: Mimmo Palmara, Edwige Fenech, Ingrid Schoeller, Franco Ressel, Andrea Aureli, Ivy Holzer, Loris Gizzi, Massimo Carocci, Franco Pasquetto, Tullio Altamura

title: Il figlio di Bakunin
synopsis: Tullio Saba is the son of the anarchist cobbler Antonio, known as Bakunin. First miner, then anti-fascist, finally activist of the Communist Party and leader of the people, he is an almost legendary character in Sardinia between the 1940s and 1950s. In his own way, an adventurer, loved and hated by women, carabinieri and mine strikers.
cast: Fausto Siddi, Renato Carpentieri, Laura Del Sol, Massimo Bonetti, Paolo Bonacelli

title: Il figlio di Cleopatra
synopsis: The valiant nomad El Kebir is actually the son of Caesar and Cleopatra. Now that Egypt is oppressed by a cruel governor of Rome, he leads the revolt of the people. Even the emperor Octavian will have to recognize that he has every right to it.
cast: Mark Damon, Scilla Gabel, Arnoldo Foà, Livio Lorenzon

title: Il figlio di Django
synopsis: As a child, Tracy witnessed the killing of her father Django. Having also become a gunslinger, he is tasked with killing a bandit who is extorting a small town in the West.
