He discovers that behind the outlaw is one of the most powerful men in the city and that he himself had caused the death of his father. He kills him and then, tired of the violence, he makes a decision.
cast: Guy Madison, Gabriele Tinti, Daniele Vargas, Andrea Scotti, Ingrid Schoeller, Ignazio Spalla, Roberto Messina, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia, Cristina Penz

title: Il figlio di Spartacus
synopsis: It turns out that Spartacus had an heir, Rando, who, when he is a Roman centurion, is captured by the Lydians and reduced to slavery. Rando leads the revolt of his unfortunate companions, only he - contrary to what happened to his parent and his followers - comes out the winner.
cast: Steve Reeves, Jacques Sernas, Gianna Maria Canale, Claudio Gora

title: Il figlio di Zorro
synopsis: Mexico, at the time of Maximilian of Austria. The aristocracy is shaken by the apparitions of the son of Zorro, a supporter of the rebels and committed to collecting aid for the revolution. The young Zorro will have to avenge the killing of Don Herrera, Alcalde of San Ramon, who took his side.
cast: Robert Widmark, William Berger, Fernando Sancho, Elisa Ramirez, Franco Fantasia, George Wang

title: Il figlio più piccolo
synopsis: Luciano Baietti (Christian De Sica), a real estate developer from Rome, is a profiteer who has a relationship with a woman, Fiamma, (Laura Morante) who is exactly his opposite. The two decide to marry some time after the birth of two children but, immediately after the marriage, Luciano leaves her, not without having managed to obtain the family apartments of his wife, with the help of Sergio, (Luca Zingaretti), one ruthless accountant. Years pass and the two children become adults: Paolo (Nico Toffoli), the eldest son, works in a local center and grew up with a blinding hatred for that father who ran away and never returned, while the youngest son Baldo (Nicola Nocella) is a good and generous boy who lives with his mother and Sheyla (Sidney Rome), an eccentric Californian musician. It will be relying on his naivety that his missing father will return to the office to try a new scam.
cast: Christian De Sica, Laura Morante, Luca Zingaretti, Nicola Nocella, Nico Toffoli, Sydne Rome, Gisella Marengo, Massimo Bonetti, Pino Quartullo, Manuela Morabito

title: Il figlio sospeso
synopsis: Lauro loses his father Anturio at the age of only two. The mother Giacinta ensures that the memory, already faded of the father, is completely erased from the memory of the son depriving him of stories and photographs concerning Anturio. The young Lauro grows up with a paternal image modeled on his needs and, therefore, distorted in his objective affectivity. An event upsets the normal course of his daily life made up of fears and uncertainties: by chance he finds a clue that leads him to believe that his father had had, in Sicily, a relationship from which a son was born. The thirst for truth pushes him on the roads of a "journey" in search of a brother but, what he will discover will concern him intimately and personally: Lauro was conceived with the modality of a rented womb. Little by little the truth makes space and emerges in its drama, but also in its liberating force.
cast: Paolo Briguglia, Gioia Spaziani, Aglaia Mora, Laura Giordano, Egidio Termine, Consuelo Lupo, Giorgio Musumeci, Gianmaria Termine

title: Il figlioccio del padrino
synopsis: Oronzo, godson of the mafia boss Don Vincenzo, is sent from the USA to Italy, as a guest of Don Salvatore, so that he may lose the habit of hunting for women and become a man of honor. But Oronzo is surrounded by one of Don Salvatore's two daughters.
cast: Franco Franchi, Riccardo Garrone, Saro Urzì, Laura Belli

title: Il filo invisibile
synopsis: Simone and Paolo are a couple who managed to have a son thanks to the help of Tilly, a woman who lives in California and who was a surrogate mother for them, giving light lion. The child has grown up in Italy and is now sixteen years old, but just as he is realizing a school project that tells his story, he will discover himself in love and perhaps his certainties, both personal and familiar, will be put in crisis.
cast: Filippo Timi, Francesco Scianna, Francesco Gheghi, Giulia Maenza, Jodhi May, Valentina Cervi, Emanuele Maria Di Stefano, Matteo Oscar Giuggioli, Mauro Conte, Alessia Giuliani, Gerald Tyler, Enrico Borello, Gianluca De Marchi, Gianpiero Pumo, Tim Daish, Nichi Vendola, Mauro Pescio, Ambrosia Caldarelli

title: Il fiore dai petali d'acciaio
synopsis: During a terrible fight, the surgeon Andrea accidentally kills Daniela by making her fall on a flower-shaped ornament with steel petals. The doctor tears the body apart and turns it into mush. Daniela's half-sister, Evelyn, worried about the woman's absence and knowing that she used to attend the doctor accuses Andrea of ??her disappearance. Thanks to Inspector Garrano, we learn that Andrea is married and has hospitalized his nymphomaniac wife in a clinic.
cast: Carroll Baker, Gianni Garko, Pilar Velazquez, Paola Senatore

title: Il fiore delle Mille e una notte
synopsis: The story of Nur-el-Din and the beautiful slave Zumurrud; the trap set by Tiffané and Zeudé to find out who is the best lover between a boy and a girl. And again: the different fates of Aziz and Tagi, the first punished with emasculation for a love betrayal, the second, instead much more fortunate. Finally, two princes, through different but equally adventurous paths, end up becoming bonzes. It is the last chapter of the famous Pasolini's "Trilogy of life". One wonders what is left of the film, certainly scissored for television programming.
cast: Ninetto Davoli, Franco Citti, Tessa Bouché, Franco Merli, Ines Pellegrini, Margareth Clémenti, Claudia Rocchi, Alberto Argentino, Francesco Paolo Governale

title: Il fischio al naso
synopsis: The industrialist Giuseppe Inzerna is afflicted with a hissing in the respiratory tract. Nothing pathological, just a trivial annoyance. Finding himself on business in a luxurious private clinic, he is persuaded to be admitted to eliminate the inconvenience. Following analyzes and examinations, however, other ailments are found, the treatments of which make his health worse and worse. Inzerna's conditions thus worsen more and more until the victim ends up in the terminally ill ward. Second direction by Tognazzi. Based on a famous story by Buzzati, it is a black satire of medical malpractice, sometimes sketchy, but pungent.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Tina Louise, Olga Villi, Franca Bettoia, Riccardo Garrone, Alicia Brandet, Gildo Tognazzi, Gigi Ballista, Marco Ferreri, Alessandro Quasimodo

title: Il fiume del grande caimano
synopsis: The director of a holiday village in the tropics is organizing the inauguration of the hotel complex. But the natives are restless: they believe that the settlement of the whites could cause the awakening of an ancient curse. Some tourists disappear but, fearing negative publicity, the fact is hushed up. Together with a photographer, the director discovers that the area is haunted by a huge caiman, revered by the natives as a cruel deity. Together, the two will manage to defeat him. Adventure film focusing on the charm of Barbara Bach and on slightly grungy special effects.
cast: Barbara Bach, Claudio Cassinelli, Mel Ferrer, Richard Johnson, Romano Puppo, Fabrizia Castagnoli, Silvia Collatina, Enzo Fisichella, Lory Del Santo, Anny Papa, Bobby Rhodes, Clara Colosimo

title: Il fiume ha sempre ragione
synopsis: Just like Johannes Gutenberg, Alberto Casiraghy ??has transformed his house in Osnago into a real publishing “workshop”: with an old movable type machine he prints small and precious books of poems and aphorisms. Not far away, across the Swiss border, Josef Weiss combines the sensitivity of the graphic designer with the technique of the restorer to create his artistic editions.

title: Il fiume, a ritroso
synopsis: Looking for a place or fleeing from someone, a girl climbs the course of a river from its mouth, backwards. Among wolves and mysterious glances, she will find someone who will welcome her and who will ask her, in turn, for help.
cast: Nicoletta Gori, Andrea Gazzola

title: Il flauto
synopsis: Gennaro Esposito, an ignorant garbage man, finds himself on a particular island, where men in uniform roam without memory under the control of a strange staff. This is the place where souls are waiting to be born, under the control of an alien multinational that has as its purpose the exploitation and total globalization of planet Earth. With simplicity and innocence, the only weapons in his possession, Gennaro will be able to upset the current order by helping souls to recover their memories and infecting them with the virus of freedom.
cast: Patrizio Oliva, Francesca Ferri, Mister Lei, Totonno Chiappetta, Loredana Trombetta, Sonia Di Pascali, Giuseppe Franco, Fausto Saponara, Sante Ceci, Pietro Daniele Aldrovandi

title: Il flauto magico
synopsis: Prince Tamino loves Pamina, but to enter the Kingdom of Light with her he will have to overcome - with the help of his magic flute - the three tests of silence, water and fire.

title: Il fornaretto di Venezia
synopsis: A Venetian nobleman, Count Alvise, was killed and the culprit is pointed to a young baker. The trial takes on more and more political character: as the hearing proceeds, in fact, the innocence of the young man appears evident, but the nobles who make up the court will condemn him for ruthless political calculation. Not even the confession of the real murderer, a noble, will help save the unfortunate young man.
cast: Jacques Perrin, Michèle Morgan, Enrico Maria Salerno, Sylva Koscina, Stefania Sandrelli, Gastone Moschin, Fred Williams, Ugo Attanasio, Rodolfo Lodi, Mario Brega

title: Il frullo del passero
synopsis: Silvana left alone, the man who kept her died and she is about to abandon the village of Romagna in which she lives. At that point Gabriele, rich and widower, who proposes to go and live with him, as long as she is willing to listen to her past love adventures, is going on.
cast: Ornella Muti, Philippe Noiret, Nicola Farron, Claudine Auger, Chiara Argelli, Sabrina Ferilli, Rosa Di Brigida, Beppe Chierici, Claudio Del Falco, Miriam Axa, Giuseppe Mauro Cruciano

title: Il fuggiasco
synopsis: Padua, 1976. The eighteen year old Massimo Carlotto is accused of a murder, on which he had only to testify, and sentenced to 18 years in prison. Massimo flees to France and here he comes into contact with exiles and political refugees who, with their solidarity and friendship, allow him to move forward, then he goes to Spain and Mexico where he tries to rebuild his life. Meanwhile in Padua, the parents, with the help of the lawyer Vignoni, try to bring out the truth ...
cast: Daniele Liotti, Roberto Citran, Francesca De Sapio, Claudia Coli, Alessandro Benvenuti, Joaquim De Almeida

title: Il fulgore di Dony
synopsis: The very special love story set nowadays in Bologna between two fifteen-year-olds. She, Dony, is a girl with enormous strength, who manages to conquer the boy of her life when he, Marco, has a skiing accident which, due to neurological damage, brings him to the threshold of dementia.
cast: Greta Zuccheri Montanari, Saul Nanni, Lunetta Savino, Giulio Scarpati, Ambra Angiolini, Andrea Roncato, Alessandro Haber

title: Il furto è l'anima del commercio?!...
synopsis: Libero Sbardellone and his wife's uncle, the noble Gaetano Gargiullo, are in and out of prison, in Naples, because of their fraudulent activities and prepare a sensational "coup": a theft from a lottery shop on a very special occasion . To begin with, it causes a false eruption of Vesuvius to raise the number of plays.
cast: Alighiero Noschese, Enrico Montesano, Bernard Blier, Pia Giancaro, Ave Ninchi, Lino Banfi, Francis Blanche, Elio Crovetto, Enzo Cannavale, Ignazio Leone, Giacomo Furia

title: Il futuro è donna
synopsis: In a crowded nightclub, Malvina, a pregnant girl, is harassed and harassed by a group of drifters. Anna, who is there, rescues her and decides to take her home where she and Gordon host her for a night. Malvina proves to be too intrusive and ends up being chased by the two, even if it is Anna herself who asks her home. A strange relationship of mutual attraction begins to develop between the three.
cast: Ornella Muti, Hanna Schygulla, Niels P. Arestrup, Maurizio Donadoni

title: Il gabbiano
synopsis: A councilor of state hosts his sister, a theatrical actress, with her son and lover on his estate. The young man suffers from the egocentrism of his mother who comes to mock a text written for her by her son. Out of disappointment, the young man tries to kill himself ...
cast: Laura Betti, Giulio Brogi, Pamela Villoresi, Remo Girone, Gisella Burinato, Antonio Piovanelli, Mattia Pinoli, Clara Colosimo, Remo Remotti, Gaetano Campisi

title: Il garofano rosso
synopsis: Alessio is the scion of a wealthy Sicilian family who sent him to study in Syracuse. Full of ideals and energies, the boy lets himself be carried away by the rebellions of his friend Tarquinio and by the delicate feeling towards his contemporary Giovanna.
cast: Miguel Bosé, Denis Karvil, Elsa Martinelli, Marisa Mantovani

title: Il gatto
synopsis: The brothers Amedeo (Tognazzi) and Ofelia (Melato) have received a very tempting offer for the old building they own, as long as they manage to free it from all those who live there. They try by all means, and even the feline can be useful. Two sordid protagonists in a chorus of minor characters sketched with incisive attention. On a screenplay full of humors, Comencini draws a story that unfolds masterfully in the tortuous interiors of the building, which punctually captures the significant aspects of the characters and which offers the actors, more or less famous, the opportunity for tasty interpretations.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Mariangela Melato, Michel Galabru, Jean Martin, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Aldo Reggiani, Adriana Innocenti, Philippe Leroy, Armando Brancia, Mario Brega

title: Il gatto a nove code
synopsis: Carlo Giordani, a journalist, finds himself on the trail of the murder of a scientist who has discovered the genetic code of the inclination to delinquency. Giordani is helped by Franco Arnò, a blind man with a passion for puzzles. The two manage to contact the dead man's girlfriend, but she too, shortly after, ends badly. The matter is becoming more and more risky and tangled.
cast: James Franciscus, Karl Malden, Catherine Spaak, Rada Rassimov, Pier Paolo Capponi, Horst Frank, Aldo Reggiani, Carlo Alighiero, Vittorio Congia, Ugo Fangareggi

title: Il gatto dagli occhi di giada
synopsis: Mara, a young actress from carbaret, while on her way to the pharmacist Biagio, witnesses his murder and glimpses the culprit. The woman is threatened by the stranger and scared to death decides to turn to Lukas, to whom another man who feels persecuted by mysterious individuals turns to him. Meanwhile, a harmless teacher who had no enemies is also killed. Lukas investigating discovers that the two victims had been part of the popular jury that had condemned an innocent. Lukas discovers that the man has escaped from prison and communicates his suspicions to the judge who conducted the trial.
cast: Corrado Pani, Paola Tedesco, Franco Citti, Fernando Cerulli

title: Il gatto di Brooklyn aspirante detective
synopsis: The penniless detective Tony Mangiafoglia and his partner Frank Lonego must ascertain whether a villa is truly haunted, as Countess De Porcaris wants to make it an orphanage, according to the wishes of her niece Guendalina. Received the advance of one million lire, Tony and Frank settle in the villa. While the former does not notice anything and lives quietly in the building, the latter is terrified of all sorts of apparitions. The investigation continues and the mystery becomes more and more dense ...
cast: Franco Franchi, Luigi Pistilli, Annabella Incontrera, Gianni Agus, Camille Keaton

title: Il gatto mammone
synopsis: Lollo Mascialucia is a small Sicilian industrialist who is convinced that his wife is sterile. To satisfy his desire for fatherhood, in agreement with the woman, he convinces a single mother to mate with him to finally have the heir, but it doesn't work. The wife then takes care of it, with a substitute for her husband who, now clearly, was sterile.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Rossana Podestà, Gloria Guida, Grazia Di Marzà, Tiberio Murgia, Franco Lantieri, Sofia Lusy, Umberto Spadaro

title: Il gaucho
synopsis: Marco Ravicchio leads a miserable delegation of Italian filmmakers to a festival in Buenos Aires. Amidst trifles and provincialisms, there is the opportunity to exploit the nostalgia for Italy of an emigrant who made a fortune and to meet another who has remained a poor fellow.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Amedeo Nazzari, Silvana Pampanini, Nino Manfredi, Nelly Panizza, Maria Grazia Buccella, Annie Gorassini, Umberto D'Orsi, Guido Gorgatti, Norberto Sánchez Calleja, Maria Fiore, Francesco Mulè

title: Il gemello
synopsis: Twenty-nine-year-old Raffaele has been living in the Secondigliano prison in Naples for 12 years. Nicknamed "the Twin" for having two more twin brothers, he is there for robbing a bank when he was only 15 years old. Due to his charismatic character, he enjoys the respect of other inmates, such as his cellmate Gennaro, a contemporary sentenced to life imprisonment with whom he works in separate waste collection. Raffaele also has an excellent relationship with Nico, the head of the prison guards who is trying to introduce more humane rules in prison.
cast: Raffaele Costagliola, Domenico Manzi

title: Il generale
synopsis: 1860-61: Garibaldi, from the conquest of Naples, during the expedition of the Thousand, up to the years of his retirement in Caprera and his political commitment to the Parliament of Turin.
cast: Franco Nero, Hector Alterio, Relja Basic, Flavio Bucci, Cosimo Cinieri, Chris Heaven, Erland Josephson, Davor Juresko, Philippe Leroy, Angela Molina

title: Il generale Dalla Chiesa
synopsis: After distinguishing himself in Sicily in the fight against the Mafia, in 1974 the Carabiniere officer Carlo Alberto Dalla Chiesa was called to fight a new and fearsome enemy: the Red Brigades. He immediately realizes that that subversive group has been underestimated.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Stefania Sandrelli, Francesca Cavallin, Chiara Mastalli, Milena Mancini, Marco Vivio, Alberto Angrisano, Lorenzo Majnoni, Anna Ammirati, Ninni Bruschetta

title: Il generale Della Rovere
synopsis: Giovanni Bertone is a petty crook who, posing as an army general, swindles the family members of German prisoners. One day he is discovered by the Gestapo and arrested. In exchange for his freedom, the authorities ask him to collaborate by collecting information on the partisans in prison.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Hannes Messemer, Sandra Milo, Giovanna Ralli, Vittorio Caprioli, Nando Angelini, Anne Vernon, Linda Veras, Lucia Modugno, Luciano Pigozzi

title: Il generale dei briganti
synopsis: Carmine Crocco (Daniele Liotti), a young man of humble origins, after a series of vicissitudes is forced to go into hiding: joining a band of brigands, he will decide to participate in the uprisings that will lead to the unification of Italy.
cast: Daniele Liotti, Raffaella Rea, Danilo Brugia, Massimo Dapporto, Fabio Troiano, Massimiliano Dau, Marco Leonardi, Christiane Filangieri, Larissa Volpentesta, Massimo Bonetti, David Coco, Fabio Sartor, Roberta Lanfranchi, Annalisa De Simone

title: Il generale della Rovere
synopsis: Giovanni Bertone (Pierfrancesco Favino), a former cavalry colonel, is a scammer who extorts money from the families of Nazi-fascist prisoners, promising their release in exchange. Discovered by Colonel Muller (Hristo Shopov), he is offered a pact: to save his life, he will have to go to Milan under a false identity to discover the members belonging to the Resistance.
cast: Pierfrancesco Favino, Raffaella Rea, Andrea Tidona, Alexandra Dinu, Hristo Shopov, Julian Vergov, Michele Nani, Hristo Garbov

title: Il generale dorme in piedi
synopsis: Colonel Leone, a veterinarian "promoted" as a doctor out of necessity, becomes director of the Higher School of Health, but not a general, as he would like more than anything else. Forced to sleep standing up, because lying down he reveals dangerous truths about the army in his sleep, writes his memoirs, and they are not roses and flowers for the military hierarchy. As long as you don't publish them, you get the "Greek".
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Mariangela Melato, Franco Fabrizi, Mario Scaccia, Daniele Vargas, Stefano Satta Flores, Checco Rissone, Edda Ferronao, Georges Wilson, Piero Nuti, Gianni Solaro, Enzo Robutti

title: Il gesto delle mani
synopsis: Even today, in order to create a bronze sculpture, it is necessary to resort to the same measures adopted in the 5th century BC for the realization of the Riace Bronzes. These gestures and passages are not taught in schools but are handed down from generation to generation among the artisans. They know this well at the historic Battaglia artistic foundry in Milan, where a group of specialized artisans have been working bronze with traditional methods for over a hundred years. The story of the creation process of the sculpture of a bronze dog by the artist Velasco Vitali shows the history of the foundry of yesterday and today.
cast: Caled Saad, Luigi Contino, Simion Marius Costel, Mario Conti, Nicolae Ciortan, Elia Alunni Tullini, Velasco Vitali, Lino De Ponti, Tommaso Rossi, Ilaria Cuccagna

title: Il giardino dei Finzi Contini
synopsis: We are in Ferrara, in the years leading up to the Second World War; also in Italy anti-Semitic politics is about to take off. In the luxurious villa of the Finzi Contini, an ancient and aristocratic Jewish family, daily events, loves and sentimental misunderstandings follow one another among the youngest offspring. But these amorous dramas are soon overwhelmed by the cruel historical drama of war and deportations.
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Dominique Sanda, Fabio Testi, Helmut Berger, Romolo Valli, Camillo Cesarei, Inna Alexeievna, Katina Morisani, Barbara Pilavin

title: Il giardino delle delizie
cast: Maurice Ronet, Evelyn Stewart, Lea Massari, Franco Bertoni

title: Il gigante di Metropolis
synopsis: In 20,000 BC a caravan of the brave tries to reach the city of Metropolis to stop the madness of the tyrant Yotar. To reach the middle is only Obro, an intrepid young man, who fights to save the inhabitants of the city from the terrible experiments of the king, eager to save his nephew by "grafting" him a new brain. Meanwhile, astronomers and scientists in the city predict a frightening cataclysm.
cast: Gordon Mitchell, Bella Cortez, Roldano Lupi, Liana Orfei

title: Il ginecologo della mutua
synopsis: Doctor Lobianco, burdened with debts, flees abroad and hands over the well-started gynecological study to his colleague Giovannaldi. The latter is able to win the trust of high society and, thanks to the relationship started with the wife of a wealthy builder (enough to get her pregnant), he gets a luxurious clinic financed by his cuckold husband. And there will also be a prize for Lobianco.
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Paola Senatore, Mario Carotenuto, Isabella Biagini, Karin Schubert, Aldo Fabrizi

title: Il giocatore invisibile
synopsis: A university professor, Stefano Nari, a professor of comparative literature, is returning to the faculty after a love encounter with the student Olivia. An unpleasant surprise awaits him: his assistant Lorenzo shows him a letter published in the latest issue of the Athenaeum magazine. An anonymous accuses him of having made a sensational error in one of his articles dedicated to "the praise of betrayal": citing as a positive example of betrayal the work of Jean Luc Godard, Contempt, based on the novel of the same name by Alberto Moravia, Nari forgets that the film, in its Italian version, was in turn badly "betrayed" by the producer who modified the music and cut some significant scenes. A trivial forgetfulness for a normal person but not for an established university professor, respected, envied for his career, and feared for his academic power. From this moment on Nari is assailed by doubts and suspicions: who hates him to the point of wanting to hit him so subtly?
cast: Luca Lionello, Sergio Albelli, Francesco Turbanti, Guenda Goria, Ludovica Bazzaglia, Lorenzo Alessandri, David Riondino, Paolo Benvenuti, Paolo Cioni, Cristina Gardumi, Luciana Cipriani, Fabrizio Brandi, Andrea Kaemmerle

title: Il giocattolo
synopsis: Vittorio has long been the factotum of an unscrupulous industrialist. Wounded in a robbery attempt, he decides to buy a gun. Some time later he kills a criminal and becomes a kind of hero for a few days in the circles of the rich Milanese bourgeoisie. But soon after he was abandoned by everyone, including the industrialist for whom he had lent himself to all kinds of trafficking. He then decides to take revenge.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Marlène Jobert, Arnoldo Foà, Olga Karlatos, Pamela Villoresi, Daniele Formica, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Carlo Bagno, Renato Scarpa, Luciano Catenacci, Mario Brega

title: Il gioco
synopsis: Mark Walker, a well-known art critic specializing in unmasking and unmasking copyright forgeries, ensnares Michela, a young actress who shares her apartment with photographer Corinna, convincing her to play for him a fascinating female figure named Fiammetta. Mark's break-in into the two girls' lives triggers the reaction of Corinna's boyfriend ...
cast: Susan Lynch, Claudia Gerini, Jonathan Pryce, Enrico Silvestrin

title: Il gioiellino
synopsis: Leda is one of the largest agro-food companies in the country: present on five continents, listed on the stock exchange, constantly expanding towards new markets and new sectors. What is called a gem, the result of the entrepreneurial action of Amanzio Rastelli, founder and owner, who put his closest relatives in command posts - his son, his granddaughter -, plus some trusted managers. The result is an inadequate management team to face the new challenges that the market requires of Leda. And in fact the group is in debt. More and more. It is not enough to falsify balance sheets, inflate sales, ask politicians for support, take the risk on savers through increasingly daring creative finance operations… The chasm has become too large and is preparing to swallow everything.
cast: Toni Servillo, Remo Girone, Sarah Felberbaum, Walter DeForest, Fausto Maria Sciarappa, Lino Guanciale, Renato Carpentieri, Brett McClelland, Gianna Paola Scaffidi, Lisa Galantini

title: Il gioko
synopsis: A middle school teacher realizes that there is something mysterious and disturbing in the psychology of her pupils: her fears are tragically confirmed when a young girl is found raped and killed.
cast: Alessandra Acciai, Jean Herbert, Daria Nicolodi, Viola Simoncioni

title: Il giorno + bello
synopsis: Leo cultivates few but essential certainties about his existence: he loves, reciprocated, Nina and knows they will never get married. But when Nina suddenly asks him to marry him, Leo thinks it's to prove that a different marriage is possible. But things don't go quite as he hoped ...
cast: Fabio Troiano, Violante Placido, Carla Signoris, Marco Giuliani, Max Bruno

title: Il giorno del Cobra
synopsis: Larry "Cobra" Staziani, after being disbarred from the police and having spent three years in prison, moved to San Francisco to be a detective. Forced to accept a post from one of his former superiors, he returns to Italy. He will have to bring his sworn enemy to justice.
cast: Franco Nero, Sybil Danning, Mario Maranzana, Mickey Knox

title: Il giorno del giudizio
cast: Ty Hardin, Craig Hill, Gordon Mitchell, Rossano Brazzi, Rosalba Neri

title: Il giorno dell'Assunta
synopsis: It is August 15th and two urbanized southerners walk the deserted streets of Rome: every now and then they stop to discuss, consult topographical maps, listen to passages engraved on magnetic tapes, cite Campanella and Carlo Levi. In their wanderings they arrive in Cinecittà.
cast: Tino Schirinzi, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Il giorno della civetta
synopsis: Mafia crime in Sicily: Captain Bellodi, commander of the local carabinieri, comes from northern Italy and stubbornly opposes the silence, openly facing the mafia leaders of the city. It will get some success, thanks also to the collaboration of the popular Rosa Nicolosi fair ...
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Franco Nero, Lee J. Cobb, Serge Reggiani, Tano Cimarosa, Nehemiah Persoff, Ennio Balbo, Ugo D'Alessio, Fred Coplan

title: Il giorno della rivoluzione
synopsis: Chronicle of the Romanian revolution: from the upheavals in October, at the peak between 21 and 22 December 1989, up to the black stock exchange, emigration and stabilization.

title: Il giorno di San Sebastiano
synopsis: The subject of the film is based on a historical fact that really happened in the countryside of the Sicilian village of Caltavuturo, in the last years of the nineteenth century. Here, during the feast of the patron saint San Sebastiano, the peasants take advantage of the presence of the whole town to claim ownership of the land they work. A platoon of Bersaglieri, sent to suppress the demonstration with the connivance of the local mafia, fired on the crowd. Fifteen dead remain on the ground.
cast: Silvana Prinzivalli, Franco Scaldati, Vincenzo Albanese

title: Il giorno e la notte
synopsis: Apparently everything is going well in Rome, in the late afternoon of any day, when televisions and radios interrupt their programming for an extraordinary edition: a probable large-scale chemical-bacteriological attack threatens the city. It is necessary that the inhabitants go to their homes or remain in the closed places where they are. The threat is serious, everyone must cooperate. As fear of the terrorist attack empties the streets and extinguishes life, four men and four women will test their feelings for each other, either by hitting the bottom of their stories or rising to the surface.
cast: Dario Aita, Elena Gigliotti, Barbara Esposito, Francesco Acquaroli, Isabella Ragonese, Matteo Martari, Milena Mancini, Vinicio Marchioni, Giordano De Plano

title: Il giorno in più
synopsis: Pressed by friends and family, the forty-year-old Giacomo (Fabio Volo) - too busy with work to devote himself to women - tells of having an elusive affair with Michela (Isabella Ragonese), the girl he meets every morning on the tram and with whom, beyond beyond an exchange of glances, there has never been anything, although he feels he feels something towards him. One morning, however, she finds the courage to break the ice and discovers that Michela is about to move to New York, where a new life and a new job await her. Some time later, Giacomo is looking forward to a big deal in South America and the plane on which he embarks stops near the US metropolis. For him, the obligatory stage turns into an opportunity to finally say goodbye to bachelor habits and beliefs.
cast: Fabio Volo, Isabella Ragonese, Stefania Sandrelli, Valeria Bilello, Luciana Littizzetto, Jack Perry, Roberto Citran, Pietro Ragusa, David Fierro, Lino Toffolo, Irene Ferri, Hassani Shapi

title: Il giorno più bello
synopsis: Aurelio (Paolo Kessisoglu) inherited the profession of Wedding-Planner from his father and throughout his life he sacrificed his dreams in the name of a mission: to give happiness. Today, however, thanks to the crisis and a divorce behind, he feels the need for radical change. He is in love with Serena, one of her collaborator, and with her dreams of starting a new life, giving up everything to sail the oceans on a sailing boat. Before savoring freedom, however, Aurelio must resolve two not insignificant issues: to sell "the most beautiful day" (as the family business is called) and convince Serena to divorce by Giorgio, who is a fraternal friend of Aurelio from Liceo times. Things seem to be fine when, after a lot of waste, a possible buyer for the activity, Dr. Musso is ahead. In Aurelio all that remains is to organize the last wedding of his career, the one between two scions of the upper bourgeoisie, Pier and Chiara. Except that, on the day of the reception, he discovers that the bride's father is Musso, determined to make that ceremony the test bench to choose whether or not to buy "the most beautiful day". In a few moments, what should have been a routine party must be transformed into the wedding of the century. The feat, however, is far from obvious, just look at the scalcagnata company of collaborators who turn around Aurelio: an assistant, Adele, always on the verge of a nervous crisis, a singer, Billy, bankrupt who has He had a story with the bride, and in the kitchen a precarious brigade and on the point of a revolt. Not to mention that, last but not least, the only photographer available is Giorgio ... Aurelio will be able to extricate himself between the gaffes of the waiters, with jealousy, clumsy union claims and culinary disasters, avoiding that "the most beautiful day" of Pier e Chiara transforms into a nightmare party?
cast: Valeria Bilello, Luca Bizzarri, Paolo Kessisoglu, Carlo Buccirosso, Fiammetta Cicogna, Stefano De Martino, Lodo Guenzi, Violante Placido

title: Il giorno più bello del mondo
synopsis: Arturo Meraviglia, a troubled theater manager, suddenly has to take care of Giele and Rebecca, two children received "as an inheritance" from an old uncle. When he realizes that Joel has superpowers, Arturo realizes how his trump card could turn out to be to avoid an imminent meltdown. However, the talent of the little illusionist does not escape a team of shady scientists who want to find out what lies behind these great gifts. With the help of funny and rambling friends and a beautiful researcher, between twists and adventurous situations, Arturo will do everything to protect Joel and to put his theater back on its feet and thus live the best day in the world.
cast: Alessandro Siani, Stefania Spampinato, Giovanni Esposito, Sara Ciocca, Leone Riva, Enrico Ianniello, Gianni Ferreri, Stefano Pesce, Leigh Gill, Jun Ichikawa, Nicola Rignanese, Benedetto Casillo, Vincenzo Paci

title: Il giorno più corto
synopsis: Two Sicilians unwittingly contribute to victory in the First World War by blowing up an enemy ship by accident.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Virna Lisi, Nino Taranto

title: Il giorno prima
synopsis: Plot in preparation
cast: Burt Lancaster, Ingrid Thulin, Ben Gazzara, Erland Josephson, Kate Nelligan, Andrea Occhipinti, Zeudi Araya

title: Il giovane Casanova
synopsis: Giacomo Casanova (Stefano Accorsi) is a violinist who lives in a theater run by the Balletti family, who treat him with extreme benevolence. Beautiful and seductive, he effortlessly conquers every woman he meets in his frantic wanderings. But love can hurt.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Thierry Lhermitte, Cristiana Capotondi, Catherine H. Flemming, Katja Flint, Massimo Venturiello, Barbara Schulz, Alfredo Pea, Caterina Murino

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Capodanno
synopsis: Montalbano has adapted to the new Vigata police station where he moved. Colleagues respect him and even the medical examiner, with whom he never misses an opportunity to tease, seems to appreciate his spirit of observation. Months after his arrival, Montalbano continues to live in the Hotel Pirandello when a mysterious murder, which took place on New Year's Eve, leads him in the footsteps of the thief Cirrinincia, thanks to whom he is able to rent a house on the sea that he had for some time. His girlfriend Mery then decides to go and live in the new home too, but living together turns out to be more difficult than expected.
cast: Michele Riondino, Andrea Tidona, Adriano Chiaramida, Alessandra Mortelliti, Beniamino Marcone, Katia Greco, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Giuseppe Santostefano

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Ferito a morte
synopsis: While Montalbano is busy investigating the murder of a usurer, his father finds the courage to go to his house and begin to sympathize with Livia. Upon returning, Montalbano is troubled to see his girlfriend in a friendly attitude with the man who ruined his childhood. After being locked away for a short period of time in silence, he decides to reveal to Livia where all the disagreements with his father come from, telling her what he discovered after her mother's death. In the meantime, at the police station, the time has come to say goodbye to Inspector Carmine Fazio, whose retirement request has been successful.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Tea Falco, Beniamino Marcone, Adriano Chiaramida, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Giuseppe Santostefano, Alessandra Costanzo, Sarah Felberbaum

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Il ladro onesto
synopsis: While waiting for the transfer to Genoa to be closer to Livia, the girlfriend with whom he made peace, Montalbano investigates the disappearance of Pamela, a very uninhibited young barmaid. The commissioner also has to deal with some strange thefts that have taken place at home: the thief, in fact, only steals small sums of money.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Sarah Felberbaum, Serena Iansiti, Gaetano Aronica, Dario Veca, Claudio Casisa, Angelo Tosto, Carmelo Galati, Alessandro Giuggioli, Giovanni Argante, Giuditta Perriera, Marco Gambino, Emma Cardillo, Alessio Piazza, Maurilio Leto, Ludovica Mairè Rogati, Giuseppe Santostefano, Massimo De Rossi, Luciano Messina

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Il terzo segreto
synopsis: While he is busy simultaneously solving two cases related to the murder of a young Albanian bricklayer and the mysterious disappearance of the marriage bulletin board from the municipality, Commissioner Montalbano begins to show Livia the first signs of her grumpy character when he suspects that she may be betraying him with Augello. . In the meantime, the young Giuseppe Fazio entered the police station, taking the place left empty by his father, immediately revealing himself to be an excellent purchase. To conclude his investigations, Montalbano also needs the help of Catarella, called for the first time to a dangerous task.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Nino D'Agata, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Giuseppe Santostefano, Sarah Felberbaum

title: Il giovane Montalbano - L'uomo che andava appresso ai funerali
synopsis: Commissioner Montalbano investigates the murder of Pasqualino Cutufà, a singular peaceful and harmless individual, who, since he was forced to stop working due to an accident on a construction site, had the assiduous occupation of going to all the funerals of Vigata. The crime is intertwined with the disappearance of Giovanna Bonocore, wife of Ernesto Guarraci, a former building contractor and owner of the construction site where Pasqualino had had the accident.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Sarah Felberbaum, Serena Iansiti, Ottavio Amato, Alessio Piazza, Maurilio Leto, Bruno Torrisi, Giuseppe Alagna, Mimma Lovoi, Giuseppe Santostefano, Luciano Messina, Giovanna Drauss Di Rauso, Maurizio Bologna

title: Il giovane Montalbano - La prima indagine di Montalbano
synopsis: Thanks to the intercession of his girlfriend Mery, the deputy commissioner Salvo Montalbano was promoted to chief commissioner and obtained the transfer from the village of Mascalippa to Vigata, his hometown. Here, his father still lives, with whom relations have long been interrupted, and in order not to feel the weight of loneliness Montalbano begins to familiarize himself with his colleagues at the police station, taking particular interest in the fate of Catarella, a policeman with a simple soul who was orphaned . Once the investigation into the murder of a cattle thief in Mascalippa is closed, the commissioner finds himself facing his first case in Vigata, foiling the plans of revenge of Viola, a victim of rape.
cast: Michele Riondino, Andrea Tidona, Katia Greco, Valentina D'Agostino, Adriano Chiaramida, Pietro De Silva, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Gianfelice Imparato

title: Il giovane Montalbano - La stanza numero 2
synopsis: During a walk by the sea, Montalbano and Livia, his wife, come across a fire in a hotel. Aurelio Ciulla, the owner, informs the commissioner that he has let all the customers out, except one, who was stuck inside. The firefighters are late: so Salvo, to Livia's terror, does not hesitate to intervene. But the fire has already invaded the whole building and the poor customer dies in the flames. Livia is very upset about what has happened but the inspector manages to reassure her. We therefore begin to look for what could be the reason for the fire.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Sarah Felberbaum, Nicola Rignanese, Enrico Lo Verso, Antonio Alveario, Aglaia Mora, Alessio Piazza, Maurilio Leto, Rosario Terranova, Roberta Procida, Franco Sciacca, Serena Lupo, Federico Rosati, Bruno Crucitti, Gigi Borruso

title: Il giovane Montalbano - La transazione
synopsis: A theft occurred at the Agricultural Bank: 60 safe deposit boxes were opened and robbed. To clarify the incident, Montalbano turns to Stella Parenti, the young director of Banca Popolare di Montelusa. The commissioner also investigates the murder of Corrado Militello, an elderly retired doctor.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Beniamino Marcone, Serena Iansiti, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Sarah Felberbaum, Adriano Chiaramida, Paola Sambo, Elisabetta Carta, Guia Jelo, Alessandra Costanzo, Federico Cimò, Leonardo Marino, Alessio Piazza, Maurilio Leto, Giuseppe Santostefano, Carmelo Galati, Maurizio Bologna

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Morte in mare aperto
synopsis: Matteo Cosentino telephones the police station to communicate that one of his fishing boats has a dead man on board: the victim is the engineer Franco Arnone, killed by an accidentally fired gunshot. Tano Cipolla, one of the fishermen of the crew, says desperately that Franco had asked to show him his gun but, due to a sudden movement of the boat, due to a strong wave, the fisherman lost his balance and left the blow. The hypothesis of the accident does not seem entirely plausible, so we investigate the relationship between Tano and his beautiful wife Michela; unclear aspects soon emerge about Cosentino and the business of its fishing boats.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Sarah Felberbaum, Domenico Centamore, Alessandra Costanzo, Alessio Piazza, Maurilio Leto, Giovanni Carta, Giusy Buscemi, Orio Scaduto, Naike Anna Silipo, Luigi Tabita, Giuseppe Santostefano, Maurizio Bologna

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Ritorno alle origini
synopsis: Due to the flash kidnapping of little Laura Belli, Inspector Montalbano meets Livia, a girl from Genoa with whom he immediately gets in tune. Still burned by the breakup with his girlfriend Mery, Montalbano would like to find the courage to get back into the game and the opportunity provides him with the arrival of Mimì Augello, the new unrepentant womanizing deputy commissioner, who wastes no time in tamping Livia. Meanwhile, Inspector Carmine Fazio falls ill during an operation and, in this circumstance, Montalbano makes the acquaintance of his son Giuseppe, a young man who is studying hard to become an inspector himself.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Vincenzo Ferrera, Beniamino Marcone, Vincenzo Pizzuto, Alessandra Costanzo, Sarah Felber

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Sette lunedì
synopsis: Montalbano and his girlfriend Livia have decided to treat themselves to their first holiday together, leaving for Provence. Before embarking on the journey, Livia hopes that the commissioner will finally be able to reconnect with her father and pushes her to go and see him. Montalbano, for his part, is totally committed to finding the person responsible for the alleged patricide of Attilio Gambarella when a case looms on the horizon that seems to lead to the world of religious fanaticism. For seven Mondays in a row, someone has been killing cattle in a predetermined way that suggests a serial killer, more dangerous than it seems. So, when Montalbano decides to give up the trip, Livia leaves in the company of another man.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Adriano Chiaramida, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Giuseppe Santostefano, Sarah Felberbaum

title: Il giovane Montalbano - Un'albicocca
synopsis: By now almost everything is ready for the transfer of Commissioner Montalbano to Genoa, aware of the fact that he is leaving a world, Vigata, of which he feels an integral part. Returning home with Livia, Montalbano discovers, in a car off the road, the body of the young and beautiful model Annarosa. But what looks like an accident could actually hide a murder.
cast: Michele Riondino, Alessio Vassallo, Andrea Tidona, Beniamino Marcone, Fabrizio Pizzuto, Sarah Felberbaum, Lucia Cammalleri, Claudio Castrogiovanni, Adriano Chiaramida, Roland Litrico, Roberto Mantovani, Serena Ganci, Osvaldo Livio Alzari, Alessio Piazza, Maurilio Leto, Alessandro Giuggioli, Giuseppe Santostefano, Massimo De Rossi, Luciano Messina

title: Il giovane Toscanini
synopsis: Little Arturo Toscanini happens to listen to singer Nadia Bulicioff at the age of eight with his father at La Scala in a superb interpretation of Aida. Passionate about music since childhood, at eighteen he already knows the scores of the greatest masters by heart. But when he introduces himself as cellist at La Scala for a competition, he lets himself be overwhelmed by his impulsive and arrogant temperament, he insults the jury and leaves without getting the job. Taking advantage of the situation, a provincial theater manager convinces him to go on a tour in Brazil.
cast: C. Thomas Howell, Sophie Ward, John Rhys Davies, Elizabeth Taylor

title: Il giovane favoloso
synopsis: The story of the short life of the writer and poet Giacomo Leopardi from the Recanati of the paternal library to the Naples of cholera and Vesuvius. Around him move his family, his life partner Antonio Ranieri, the intellectuals of the time, Fanny Targioni-Tozzetti (the woman for whom he ignited with passion) and, above all, his strongly autobiographical writing. What emerges is the portrait of a man who is free of thought, ironic, socially unscrupulous, rebellious and often marginalized by the nineteenth-century society in which he lives.
cast: Elio Germano, Isabella Ragonese, Michele Riondino, Massimo Popolizio, Anna Mouglalis, Valerio Binasco, Paolo Graziosi, Edoardo Natoli, Raffaella Giordano, Sandro Lombardi, Iaia Forte, Federica De Cola

title: Il giovane normale
synopsis: Giordano, a penniless young man, accepts the invitation of the mature Sid, his young wife Diana and Nelson, all three Americans, to go with them to Tunisia. While traveling he has the opportunity to appreciate the unscrupulousness of his companions, and in particular of the couple, flirting with Diana. With themes, atmosphere and style close to the comedy of sixties costume, it is a film not without subtleties which, however, does not have the lucid and corrosive determination of Risi's best works. Freely based on a novel by Umberto Simonetta.
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Janet Agren, Eugene Walter, Jeff Morrow

title: Il giovanotto matto
synopsis: Director Pupi Avati meets the popular conductor, actor and singer Lelio Luttazzi, the undisputed star of the golden age of Italian television variety, between the 1960s and 1970s. From the sofa of the Roman house in the Trastevere district or strolling through the streets or squares of Trieste where he was born, Luttazzi retraces his glorious career and the years of being away from the small screen following a legal incident, using old television clips that they see him engaged alongside icons such as Mina, the Kessler twins and Mike Bongiorno, and who show how Italian culture has changed over the course of fifty years.
cast: Lelio Luttazzi, Alice Kessler, Ellen Kessler, Sylvie Vartan, Mike Bongiorno, Monica Vitti, Lionel Hampton, Donatella Luttazzi, Mina

title: Il giovedì
synopsis: Separated, Dino can see his son once a week and takes on the attitudes of a great man with him that do not even convince the boy. During one of these days, reality takes it upon itself to ruthlessly demolish its pathetic mask.
cast: Walter Chiari, Michèle Mercier, Silvio Bagolini, Edy Biagetti

title: Il giudice e il suo boia
synopsis: Commissioner Barlach is on the trail of a killer. Suspicions converge on a powerful criminal on the loose, Gastmann; but Barlach realizes he has to look elsewhere, where no one would suspect. Although it could be the right opportunity to finally make Gastmann pay for it.
cast: Paolo Stoppa, Franco Volpi, Ugo Pagliai, Glauco Mauri, Gabriella Farinon, Paola Arduini, Andrea Aureli, Miranda Campa, Dante Cona, Enrico D'Amato

title: Il giudice e la minorenne
synopsis: Marco Serra, investigating judge, is called to deal with a case of rape against a minor. The elderly plumber Mariani, guilty of the crime, claims it was the girl who provoked him, according to a trend common among her peers. Serra also becomes the object of morbid attention: first it is a companion of his daughter Mirella who throws herself into his arms, then the alleged victim of Mariani. The judge is in doubt, and during his investigation there is still room for countless and unpleasant surprises ...
cast: Piero Mazzarella, Chris Avram, Caterina Barbero, Nieves Navarro, Antiniska Nemour, Giuliana Rivera, Flora Saggese, Romy Schell, Guido Spadea, Teo Teocoli

title: Il giudice meschino
synopsis: Alberto Lenzi (Luca Zingaretti), public prosecutor of Reggio Calabria with a reputation as lazy and indolent, is separated from his wife, has an 8-year-old son who feels like a burden and clandestinely frequents Marina (Luisa Ranieri), marshal of the carabinieri. However, Alberto's life is upset by a terrible event: his fellow magistrate and his dear friend Giorgio Maremmi is killed in an ambush. For Alberto it is a rude awakening, which makes him throw headlong into work to try to solve the case as soon as possible. However, this will also mean clashing with the methods of the new 'Ndrangheta.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Luisa Ranieri, Paolo Briguglia, Andrea Tidona, Maurizio Marchetti, Gioele Dix, Gaetano Bruno, Felicitas Woll, Lorenzo D'Agata

title: Il giudice ragazzino
synopsis: Rosario Livatino, one of the magistrates that President Cossiga defined "child judges" for their young age, acts as a substitute for the Agrigento prosecutor's office. He is one of the first to engage fully against the Mafia, helped by a Marshal of the Arma who will soon be murdered. His work knows more and more obstacles, until, on 21 September 1991, Livatino falls victim to an attack. A film of undeniable civil commitment that is deliberately kept by the author away from the narrative schemes typical of TV dramas. The impression one gets from it, however, is that of a story that has all too passed through a "cooled" reconstruction. Excellent Scarpati and Ferilli.
cast: Giulio Scarpati, Sabrina Ferilli, Leopoldo Trieste, Regina Bianchi, Renato Carpentieri, Ileana Rigano, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Paolo De Vita, Turi Scalia, Ninni Bruschetta, Salvatore Puntillo, Giacinto Ferro

title: Il giudizio
synopsis: Andrea and his son Junior have two visions to the antipodes of life. However, they find themselves having to share a long journey to visit Ettore, Andrea's father. After the initial quarrels and misunderstandings, the two will see their relationship change thanks to those places that have marked, for better or for worse, the rise and fall of Andrea.
cast: Fabrizio Nevola, Caterina Murino, Tobia De Angelis, Fortunato Cerlino, Sandra Ceccarelli, Mattia Sbragia, Massimiliano Rossi, Federico Pacifici, Giuseppe Antignati

title: Il giudizio universale
synopsis: We are in Naples, on an ordinary day. Suddenly a thundering voice from heaven announces the beginning of the Last Judgment for that same day. Gradually the obsessive voice is taken seriously and everyone reacts in some way: there are those who despair, those who repent, those who are incredulous, those who dive into pleasures. At the appointed time, however, instead of the dreaded "judgment" only a storm breaks out. Everyone can thus return to their former life (including vices).
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio Gassman, Anouk Aimée, Fernandel, Nino Manfredi

title: Il giustiziere dei mari
synopsis: At the end of the 1700s, David Robinson, a young scion of a noble English family and naval officer under the orders of the shady Captain Redway, appears totally unscrupulous, gets into trouble and is sentenced to death. He manages to escape in the company of a Dutch filibuster and becomes a pirate. By beating the coasts of Australia, he will have the opportunity to confront each other and therefore to defeat his former commander.
cast: Richard Harrison, Michèle Mercier, Roldano Lupi, Walter Barnes, Marisa Belli, Paul Muller, Carlo Hintermann, Italo Sain, Romolo Giomini

title: Il giustiziere di Dio
synopsis: Far west. A priest is actually a repentant former gunslinger. When three bandits attack his property, however, the man does not struggle to get the gun back in his hand; what he does not know is that there is a large quantity of gold bars under his church.
cast: William Berger, Nuccia Cardinali, Tony Di Mitri, Attilio Dottesio, Donald O'Brien, Alessandro Perrella, Lorenzo Piani, Antonia Santilli, Victor Stocchi, George Wang

title: Il giustiziere di mezzogiorno
synopsis: The surveyor Franco Gabbiadini is left by his wife Agata who takes her little daughter Titina with her. In addition, he is harassed by the office manager and has to deal with the amorous offers of his colleague Barzuacchi. Exasperated, Franco turns into an avenger, until his wife and daughter return to him. Without the usual company of Ciccio Ingrassia, Franco Franchi engages in the parody of the executioner, without panache.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ombretta De Carlo, Alberto Farnese, Gigi Ballista, Maria Antonietta Beluzzi, Franco Diogene, Raf Luca, Gino Pagnani, Enzo Andronico, Aldo Puglisi, Giovanni Sabbatini

title: Il giustiziere sfida la città
synopsis: Rambo, a former gangster, takes his own way on the side of justice to avenge his brother, a private detective killed by the kidnappers of a boy, whom he unmasked. To defeat them, he sets them up against another gang: the two criminal groups almost exterminate each other. Finally, Rambo intervenes, concludes the work and frees the prisoner boy. Then, he goes off on his motorcycle. The setting is metropolitan and contemporary, but the spirit is not very far from that of the western made in Italy. There is no shortage of touches of humor, which characterize the character of Milian. Among the protagonists an elderly Joseph Cotten.
cast: Tomas Milian, Joseph Cotten, Maria Fiore, Mario Piave, Femi Benussi

title: Il gladiatore di Roma
synopsis: The Valeri, a family of noble Roman patricians, disgraced by the emperor Caracalla, are killed, their goods confiscated and their slaves brought to Minturno and used for the construction of public works. The commissioner Annio notices, among these men, Marcus, an individual of exceptional strength and has him transferred to Rome in the gymnasium of his gladiators. Together with Marcus, Nisa, daughter of the king of Cilicia, is also sent to the capital of the empire. Help the two slaves, Valerio, who accidentally escaped the slaughter of his family.
cast: Gordon Scott, Wandisa Guida, Roberto Risso, Ombretta Colli, Piero Lulli, Alberto Farnese, Gianni Solaro, Charles Borromel, Mirko Ellis, Pietro De Vico

title: Il gobbo
synopsis: In the last phase of the Second World War, Alvaro, a young man from the Roman suburbs, nicknamed "Il gobbo", gained fame by carrying out attacks against the Germans and the fascists. His main opponent is Police Commissioner Poletti who, in revenge, sees his daughter Nina raped. From that moment on, destiny unites the fate of the two young people. Alvaro is wounded by the Germans and thinks of taking refuge in Nina's house who, despite what has happened, falls in love with him.
cast: Gérard Blain, Anna Maria Ferrero, Bernard Blier, Ivo Garrani

title: Il grande Blek
synopsis: While waiting for the train that will take him to work, and to live in another city, Yuri remembers his adolescence and his friends in Ascoli Piceno. Especially the virile and somewhat enigmatic figure of Rocket, an older friend who dies in a car accident. Then the political demonstrations, the Lambretta races, the loves and disappointments, the joys and sorrows. Interesting first work Il grande Blek takes its title from that of a well-known comic of the time, which immediately defines the cut of nostalgia and memory that Piccioni confers (despite some naivety) to its story.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Roberto De Francesco, Dario Parisini, Francesca Neri

title: Il grande Torino
synopsis: One of the strongest football teams in history tragically disappears in a plane crash.
cast: Ciro Esposito, Katy Saunders, Tosca D'Aquino, Gaetano Amato, Michele Placido, Fausto Verginelli, Carlo Pistarino, Remo Girone, Francesco Venditti, Massimo Popolizio

title: Il grande addio
synopsis: After his death on March 5, 1953, Josip Vissarionovic Dzugasvili is honored with a ceremony that expresses, with all the grandeur dear to the regime, his condolences for the disappearance of the "Little Father". To follow, _The speeches of Stalin_, montage of unpublished materials on the public rallies of the Soviet leader.
director: Dziga Vertov, Mikhail Ciaureli, Sergej Gerassimov

title: Il grande attacco
synopsis: A group of people from different countries met in Berlin during the 1936 Olympics. The men, gathered in an officer's house, toast to a future of peace and brotherhood. Instead they will all find themselves on the front, in a few years, pursuing a tragically similar fate in a different way.
cast: Helmut Berger, Samantha Eggar, Giuliano Gemma, Henry Fonda

title: Il grande botto
synopsis: Ostuni, Puglia. It's Saturday and Michele, the owner of a bar, is listening to the lottery draws in front of an old TV. For weeks he, Emilio, Mario, Giuseppe and Antonio have been playing the same numbers with the hope of making a big bang. This time luck knocks on their door and the five take home eighty-six billion. After the understandable initial shock Michele wonders who is holding the matrix. Antonio has it, the only one of the five who is currently unavailable.
cast: Carlo Buccirosso, Emilio Solfrizzi, Alessandro Di Carlo

title: Il grande cocomero
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Pippi, prey to epileptic seizures since childhood, arrives at the pediatric neuropsychiatry department directed by the young Arturo. He soon realizes that the problem is attributable to the family environment, made up of enriched and absent parents, lacking any ability to listen and to communicate. He therefore decides to attempt analytic therapy. The relationship, intense and not always easy, with the girl will be an opportunity for him too - after a marital crisis - to rediscover a sense of his own existence.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Alessia Fugardi, Anna Galiena, Lara Pranzoni

title: Il grande colpo dei sette uomini d'oro
synopsis: Caught red-handed during a robbery in Rome, the seven golden men and the Professor, their leader, instead of being punished by the Great Power in whose net they have ended up, are charged with carrying out a delicate political mission. Our men intend, however, to exploit the situation to steal 7,000 tons of gold. So with an atomic submarine and the most modern electronic devices, the seven brilliantly solve the task entrusted to them and at the same time seize the gold. Sequel to the "Seven Golden Men", more blatantly comic and less fortunate. The rhythm with respect to the first epidose has dropped vertically.
cast: Rossana Podestà, Philippe Leroy, Gastone Moschin, Gabriele Tinti

title: Il grande colpo di Surcouf
synopsis: Now a quiet family man, the former privateer Surcouf is commissioned by Napoleon to recover some precious documents fallen into the hands of the English together with the fortress of the island of Mahais. Sample of technical and narrative naivety.
cast: Gérard Barray, Antonella Lualdi, Alberto Cevenini, Terence Morgan, Genevieve Casile, Armand Mestral, Gérard Tichy, Fernando Sancho

title: Il grande duello
synopsis: Philipp Wermeer was framed for the murder of a powerful character known as The Patriarch. The three sons of the deceased, the Saxon brothers, place a price on Philipp's head who is captured by former Sheriff Clayton who was removed from his office in Jefferson for his obsession with the Saxons. The two men team up and set out to tell the truth ...
cast: Lee Van Cleef, Jess Hahn, Horst Frank, Peter O'Brien

title: Il grande giorno
synopsis: Giacomo and Giovanni have been friends for many years, as well as members at work. When the respective children, Elio and Caterina, decide to join in marriage, the two friends do not seem to be able to join this piece with their bond and therefore organize a sumptuous ceremony on Lake Como, without sparing any luxury, between catering, celebrations, development of the location. However, something comes to disturb the serenity of the three days of celebration: the new companion of Giovanni's ex -wife, Margherita, mother of the bride. It's called Aldo and it is the opposite of the two friends, exuberant and mess. Just with his disordered enthusiasm he will combine trouble, gaffes and accidents that will put to the test both the event in his entirety and the relationship between Giovanni and Giacomo.
cast: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Elena Lietti, Lucia Mascino, Antonella Attili, Giovanni Anzaldo, Pietro Ragusa, Roberto Citran, Margherita Mannino, Eleonora Romandini

title: Il grande giuoco
synopsis: When the Parisian lawyer Marc met Silvia he completely lost his mind: to be close to her he committed dishonest acts that ruined his career. So he joined the foreign legion, to forget and be forgotten. A fortune-teller predicts new misfortunes for him, but he tries to rebuild a life with Elena, a girl he met in a brothel. Just as he is about to redeem his mistakes, he meets Silvia again and abandons everything by returning to the legion.
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Arletty, Raymond Pellegrin, Peter Van Eyck, Jean Claude Pascal, Jean Témerson, Jean Hébey, Gérard Buhr, Lila Kedrova

title: Il grande momento
synopsis: On foot along the road, Sebastiana (Laura Levi) willingly accepts a passage offered by a unknown motorist (Paolo Gramignano), without imagining to end up under his morbid attention. Attentions interrupted only by the arrival of three thugs whose face is hidden behind motorcyclist helmets. Violeated by the three unknown persons, it is noticed by a couplet that is walking in the area. While the boy (Riccardo Zamagni) flees afraid, the young woman (Sabrina Mastrolerenzi) observes intrigued.
cast: Giuseppe Alotta, Giuseppe Curia, Antonio Gaipa, Paolo Gramignano, Guia Lauri Filzi, Laura Levi, Sabrina Mastrolorenzi, Stella Smart, Riccardo Zamagni

title: Il grande passo
synopsis: Is it possible to go to the moon with vehicles built in a country barn? Is it possible to recover in a few days the relationship between two brothers who have practically never met? Mario and Dario Cavalieri physically resemble each other but in reality they are very different. Life will give him an opportunity to get closer and to be the protagonists of an amazing enterprise.
cast: Giuseppe Battiston, Stefano Fresi, Flavio Bucci, Roberto Citran, Camilla Filippi, Teco Celio, Luisa De Santis, Ludovica Modugno, Francesco Roder, Vitaliano Trevisan, Marco Sincini

title: Il grande racket
synopsis: In Rome, racketeering ruthlessly strikes those who do not pay protection money. The bravacci della mala have had a free hand: violence and death for those who fail. Faced with the impotence of the law, Marshal Nico Palmieri organizes a team of vigilantes as violent as the "bad guys".
cast: Fabio Testi, Vincent Gardenia, Renzo Palmer, Orso Maria Guerrini, Glauco Onorato, Marcella Michelangeli, Romano Puppo, Antonio Marsina, Sal Borgese, Joshua Sinclair

title: Il grande salto
synopsis: Nello and Rufetto are two second-line robbers, they are over forty and live in a suburb of Rome.After they served four years in prison for a robbery that went wrong, for them to resume their business and, above all, to make it go to good ending is not easy at all ...
cast: Ricky Memphis, Giorgio Tirabassi, Marco Giallini, Valerio Mastandrea, Gianfelice Imparato, Roberta Mattei, Pasquale Petrolo, Paola Tiziana Cruciani

title: Il grande silenzio
synopsis: From the hills of Utah, snow and misery drive desperate and outlawed outlaws into the bush, passing game for bounty hunters. Against Tigrero, the most ruthless of them, a mute gunslinger called Silenzio stands up. A sheriff gets in the way between the two, but the dramatic epilogue is only postponed.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Klaus Kinski, Frank Wolff, Vonetta McGee, Marisa Merlini, Luigi Pistilli, Mario Brega, Carlo D'Angelo, Raf Baldassarre

title: Il grande sogno
synopsis: Nicola (Scamarcio) is a young policeman with a passion for the theater. Infiltrated by his superiors at the La Sapienza University occupied by students led by Libero (Argentero), he falls in love with Laura (Trinca), a Catholic student ready to fight against injustice ...
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Jasmine Trinca, Luca Argentero, Massimo Popolizio, Dajana Roncione, Federica Vincenti, Brenno Placido, Marco Iermanò, Silvio Orlando, Laura Morante, Ottavia Piccolo, Michele Placido, Alessandra Acciai

title: Il grande spirito
synopsis: In a neighborhood on the outskirts of Taranto, during a robbery, one of the three accomplices, a seedy-looking fifty-year-old, Tonino called Barboncino (Sergio Rubini), taking advantage of the distraction of the other two, steals all the loot and runs away. His race proceeds upwards, from roof to roof until he reaches the highest terrace, to take refuge in an old wash house, where he finds a strange individual (Rocco Papaleo) with an eccentric appearance: he claims to be called Cervo Nero and to belong to the Sioux tribe. For his part, Tonino is under siege: the neighborhood is guarded by his pursuers, the corners of the controlled streets. In this forced immobility, realizing that he is completely alone, Tonino is left with only one desperate alternative: to ally himself with the deranged one who behaves like a red man and who, precisely because he looks at the world from another perspective, will perhaps be able to provide him with the key to get out of the impasse he ended up in.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Rocco Papaleo, Bianca Guaccero, Ivana Lotito, Geno Diana, Alessandro Giallocosta, Ilaria Cangialosi, Antonio Andrisani

title: Il grido della Terra
synopsis: Freed from a concentration camp thanks to the allies, the surgeon Tannen reaches Palestine and discovers that his son David is engaged in the guerrilla war against the British. Following an attack, David is captured and taken to arms.
cast: Andrea Checchi, Marina Berti, Carlo Ninchi, Luigi Tosi, Vivi Gioi, Filippo Scelzo, Peter Trent, Elena Zareschi, Alessandro Fersen, Nerio Bernardi

title: Il gruppo
synopsis: Stefano, Massimo, Francesco and Lorenzo do group therapy with Elena, a charming and competent psychotherapist who tries to help them solve their problems with women. The four are of different ages and all struggling with sentimental situations that are high or in a marriage crisis: Francesco would like to lose weight to please his wife again; Lorenzo, despite the love he has for his girlfriend, feels attraction for other girls; Massimo is mistakenly believed to be Giulia's secret lover; Finally, Stefano has an extramarital affair. Attending the therapeutic center means that a strong friendship is consolidated between them, so much so that they will try to help each other.
cast: Emilio Solfrizzi, Fabio De Luigi, Neri Marcoré, Massimo Poggio, Lorenza Indovina

title: Il guerriero Camillo
synopsis: Camillo is a candid and innocent thirty-year-old who does not speak, sees the world in black and white and lives with two elderly puppeteers who picked him up who knows where. Camillo is a dreamer convinced that he comes from distant worlds, perhaps from the Middle Ages: he likes to wear armor and helmets and go into the woods to fight his very private battles. His best friend is a Down boy, son of the town marshal, the only one who seems to listen to the nonsense of the man who, for many, is just the classic village idiot. But, suddenly, Camillo's adoptive parents die and with them, also the court of friends that gravitated around.
cast: Claudio Bigagli, Carlo Croccolo, Marco Messeri, Carlo Monni, Valeria Sabel, Fabrizia Sacchi

title: Il labirinto dei sensi
synopsis: The beautiful Valérie works as factotum in the Chang house, dedicating the right attention to every member of the family. To break the idyllic balance, however, is the arrival of the elderly father of the head of the head of the family, a sixty -year -old widower who lets himself be enchanted by Valérie.
cast: Monica Seller, Steven Rogers, Lora Luna, Mike Monty, Muriel Lim, Ricky Jonez, Liezl Santos

title: Il ladro di Bagdad
synopsis: The fairy-tale character is looking for the magical blue rose that will allow him to heal the sultan's daughter, struck by a mysterious disease that no doctor has managed to eradicate. The feat will not be easy, but in the end, the hand of the girl will also be there for the hero.
cast: Steve Reeves, Giorgia Moll, Arturo Dominici, Edy Vessel, Daniele Vargas, Antonio Battistella, Fanfulla, Giancarlo Zarfati, Gina Mascetti, Ignazio Dolce

title: Il ladro di Damasco
synopsis: During the Roman domination in Syria, two thieves, Jesen and Tisba, used by patriots to create unrest, are pursued by the consul's guards. In the escape Jesen takes refuge in the house of the potter Ammon, and falls in love with his daughter Miriam. The girl is kidnapped and, in an attempt to save her, the two are taken, but the consul recognizes in one of them the son who was kidnapped at an early age. He is one of the mediocre "peplums" of period Italian cinema but at least he is joking.
cast: Tony Russell, Luciana Gilli, Gianni Solaro, Ferruccio Amendola

title: Il ladro di bambini
synopsis: Rosetta, (Scalici), a ten-year-old girl of Sicilian origin living in Milan, must be escorted with her little brother Luciano (Ieracitano) to an institution for minors at risk, in Civitavecchia, because their mother was arrested. Reason: instigation and exploitation of prostitution. The accompaniment is entrusted to a couple of young carabinieri. Given the ease of the task, one disappears with the complicity of the other, Antonio (Lo Verso), who sets out on a journey. In Civitavecchia, however, the director of the institute refuses to welcome the children, appealing to a series of bureaucratic quibbles and the journey must thus extend to Sicily, where the relatives of the children live. During this second journey the soldier decides to make some digressions, including a visit to his relatives in Calabria and a short stop at the sea.
cast: Enrico Lo Verso, Valentina Scalici, Giuseppe Ieracitano, Florence Darel, Marina Golovine, Renato Carpentieri, Vitalba Andrea, Fabio Alessandrini, Vincenzo Peluso

title: Il ladro di cardellini
synopsis: A forest ranger from a town in southern Italy is fired for catching and selling poaching birds. When he returns to his country he will have to solve both his problems with an obese daughter, a singer in village festivals with his idle partner, and for his own survival and the vices to which he is addicted: gambling and paranoid bond with his dead wife. for some time now. Joining a band of shabby old men headed by his father-in-law, he begins to follow them during the stages of a scam with the disguise of very rare and precious white goldfinches that could make them turn around and enrich them. But above all, a marriage with a Romanian caregiver arranged by his daughter to raise the family fortunes after the man was hit by a heart attack, will change the fate of Pasquale who finally regains possession of his life by getting rid of all the cages that have made him a sort of puppet. Together with the Goldfinches of the maltolto all illusion will fly away.
cast: Nando Paone, Pino Mauro, Ernesto Mahieux, Gigi De Luca, Viviana Cangiano, Lino Musella, Tonino Taiuti, Giovanni Ludeno, Yuliya Mayarchuk, Antonella Attili, Vincenzo Nemolato

title: Il ladro di giorni
synopsis: Salvo is about five years old when his father Vincenzo disappears, taken away by two carabinieri. A few years later, once out of prison, Vincenzo returns to take back his son who in the meantime has gone to live in Trentino with his uncles. Father and son hardly recognize each other, and, like two strangers, they drive to the south of Italy, where Vincenzo has a mission to fulfill. It will be time for the journey to confront them with the truth of their relationship and what they are for each other.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Massimo Popolizio, Augusto Zazzaro, Giorgio Careccia, Vanessa Scalera, Carlo Cerciello, Rosa Diletta Rossi

title: Il ladrone
synopsis: Caleb is a petty thief. One day he witnesses the miracle of Jesus transforming water into wine and decides to follow him, believing him to be nothing more than a scammer. However, he will remain fascinated and in some way touched by Grace. He will die with him on the cross. Unsuccessful attempt to see the story of Jesus from a different point of view, which results in a modest comedy played entirely on Montesano, and moved only by setting.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Edwige Fenech, Bernadette Lafont, Claudio Cassinelli

title: Il legame
synopsis: Francesco (Riccardo Scamarcio) is bringing for the first time his partner Emma (Mia Maestro) and Sofia (Giulia Patrignani), her daughter, to meet her mother Teresa (Mariella Lo Sardo) who lives in an ancient villa surrounded by olive trees centenarians. The woman is said to be a healer, because she is capable of performing magical rites on people. One night Sofia is stung in her sleep by a tarantula, from this moment Emma and her daughter will witness increasingly disturbing events. So while the little girl quickly manifests serious signs of illness and possession, Emma begins to trust no one anymore. In a dizzying crescendo of tension, Emma will try to escape even if the bond around her and her daughter now seems indissoluble.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Mia Maestro, Mariella Lo Sardo, Giulia Patrignani, Federica Rosellini, Sebastiano Filocamo

title: Il legionario
synopsis: Daniel is the only policeman of African origin of the Rome mobile department and a busy building must clear in which 150 families live. Except that one of these is him. Daniel, Celerino among the occupants and occupying the Celerini, must choose: remain faithful to his police force or save his family from the eviction.
cast: Germano Gentile, Maurizio Bousso, Marco Falaguasta, Fèlicitè Mbezele

title: Il leone di S. Marco
synopsis: Venice, 17th century: the incursions of the Usocchi, ferocious pirates who infest the Adriatic, worry the government of the republic. Despite being destined by his father to a diplomatic career, the doge's son wages - under the guise of the "lion of St. Mark" - a personal war against privateers, at the head of a handful of daring men. His exploits will lead him to meet the beautiful Rossana, a commoner who has joined the Uskoks, and to fall in love with her ...
cast: Rik Battaglia, Gianna Maria Canale, Gordon Scott, Franca Bettoja

title: Il leone di Tebe
synopsis: Ramses wants to give the throne of Egypt to Helen, whom he welcomed to Thebes with Menelaus and the faithful Spartan Arion, fleeing from Troy. Tutmes kills the pharaoh and blames the Spartans, but Arion manages to escape him and restore peace and justice. Incredible historical-mythological fantasies of Ferroni, a talented documentary maker who has also written several honest genre films (A punctured dollar, 1965).
cast: Mark Forest, Yvonne Furneaux, Massimo Serato, Rosalba Neri, Pierre Cressoy, Enzo Fiermonte, Alberto Lupo, Nerio Bernardi, Carlo Tamberlani, Nello Pazzafini

title: Il letto in piazza
synopsis: The town is small, but Luca Reali has conquered all the women “on the square”, from the pharmacist to the barman's daughter. One day, Luca saves an American girl from suicide, but for once he refrains from seducing her, with the result that she falls in love with him. Attracted by the dollars of the girl's family, fellow citizens push for the wedding, but Luca has other plans ...
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Rossana Podestà, John Ireland, Franco Bracardi, Daniele Formica

title: Il loro Natale
synopsis: A journey through the everyday life of the women of the prisoners in Naples, in a symbolic moment of the year like Christmas: stories of loneliness and dignity, of daily difficulties. Maddalena and Mariarca, Titina and Stefania, days made of care for the home and for the children and marked by a further need, the attention for husbands who, even if "closed" in another place, are present at all times, with the their absence. The "package" is prepared, the money to be left "at the door" is found, solidarity is sought in neighborly relations and prepares for the tiring weekly interviews.
cast: Mariarca Di Vaio, Maddalena Sibilli

title: Il lumacone
synopsis: Gianni Rodinò (Ferro), a middle-aged cook, drowns the pain of abandoning his wife in wine. His only friend is Ginetto (Davoli), a thief who lives with him and who, after some disagreements, helps him realize his life's dream: to buy a disused railway carriage and turn it into a restaurant. Turi Ferro is an excellent, measured protagonist, Ninetto Davoli and Agostina Belli shine with friendly ease. Based on a screenplay by Ruggero Maccari, director Paolo Cavara has made a film that combines comic and dramatic elements.
cast: Turi Ferro, Ninetto Davoli, Agostina Belli, Francesco Mulè, Gabriella Giorgelli, Isa Danieli, Fioretta Mari, Liù Bosisio, Gianfranco Barra

title: Il lungo giorno del massacro
synopsis: Joe Williams, sheriff of a country on the old frontier, is exonerated from his post for the unorthodox methods with which he enforces the law. As if that were not enough, Joe is also unjustly accused of a double murder. He then sets off on the trail of the real culprit, the Mexican outlaw La Muerte, and routs him with all his gang.
cast: Peter Martell, Manuel Serrano, Luisa Baratto, Daniela Giordano, Glenn Saxon, Franco Fantasia, Ralph Yebb, Andrea Fantasia, Gaetano Imbrò, Ugo Adinolfi

title: Il lungo silenzio
synopsis: In an unidentified city, Carla's existence is dominated and conditioned by terror, aggravated by frequent threats, given that her husband is a judge engaged in a complex investigation into cooperation for development and arms trafficking. The investigation arose, in turn, from a previous investigation on business and bribes. When he is killed, she decides to continue her investigations firsthand, without fear of the consequences.
cast: Carla Gravina, Jacques Perrin, Alida Valli, Giuliano Montaldo

title: Il lungo, il corto, il gatto
