synopsis: Franco and Ciccio are the waiters of an eccentric noblewoman (Raspani Dandolo). She believes that the house cat is a reincarnation of her late husband. The two, constantly struggling with the animal, must obviously treat the cat as the deceased master ...
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Giusi Raspani Dandolo, Ivy Holzer, Ivano Staccioli, Daniele Vargas, Julie Menard, Elsa Vazzoler, Gianni Agus, Enzo La Torre, Andrea Scotti, Mirella Pamphili, Enzo Andronico, Ugo Fangareggi, Ignazio Leone

title: Il lupo
synopsis: The story of Luciano Liboni, the criminal nicknamed "Il Lupo" whose hiding place tragically ended in 2004, after a firefight with the carabinieri, near the Circus Maximus. As a child Franco, this is his real name, is shy and with serious difficulties in social relations. At one point he begins to commit small robberies, then assaults and drug trafficking, up to the heinous murder of a young carabiniere on duty.
cast: Massimo Bonetti, Enrico Montesano, Antonella Ponziani, Mirko Petrini

title: Il lupo della Sila
synopsis: Pietro and Orsola are in love, but due to the opposition of Rocco, the girl's brother, they must see each other in secret. After one of their "convict" appointments, Pietro is arrested on a murder charge. And he cannot excuse himself so as not to compromise Orsola. Jailed, he escapes from prison and is killed by the carabinieri. Years later, Rocco, Orsola's brother, welcomes young Rosalia (Pietro's sister) into his home and falls in love with her.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Silvana Mangano, Jacques Sernas, Vittorio Gassman, Luisa Rossi, Olga Solbelli, Dante Maggio, Michele Capezzuoli, Laura Cortese

title: Il lupo della frontiera
synopsis: A secret agent, accompanied by his trained dog, investigates the mysterious sabotage on a railway. He discovers that the culprits are the owners of a farm, who also intend to blow up a dam.
cast: Piero Lulli, Maria Frau, Tamara Lees, Tonio Selwart, Fausto Guerzoni, Amedeo Trilli, Renato Malavasi, Filippo Scelzo, Attilio Dottesio, Adalberto Roni

title: Il lupo di mare
synopsis: Sylvester is employed as a waiter on the Orient Express cruise ship. The maître of the same ship is Marco. The steamer is chartered by a cosmetics company for a cruise to Greece and Turkey in which all sales representatives will take part. What better occasion for the two Latin lovers to show off all their charm? And not only that.
cast: Andrea Roncato, Gigi Sammarchi, Kara Donati, Kerry Hubbard, Milly D'Abbraccio, Hege Stuen, Dodo Gagliarde, Serena Bennato, Margie Newton

title: Il lupo e l'agnello
synopsis: Leon de Paris was, in France, a hairdresser for dogs, but, after getting married in Italy, he became a "coiffeur pour dames". However, an escapade cost him a state of humiliating subjection to the women of the house (wife, mother-in-law, two daughters). Also, for "shop" reasons, he has to pretend to be gay. When a thug being chased by the police comes to his house, the two are victoriously communal. The idea was to put together the Serrault of the "Vizietto" with the "Monnezza" Tomas Milian. But the comedy only works in tears, with two characters who can't find a meeting point.
cast: Michel Serrault, Tomas Milian, Ombretta Colli, Enrico Luzi

title: Il macellaio
synopsis: Alina is a brilliant and full of initiative woman who directs an aviation art gallery in Palermo. Her husband Daniele, established conductor, cultured and intelligent, is not a fixed presence. One day, in accompanying Daniele to the airport, Alina warns a sense of emptiness. He will try to fill him with an always playful and prodigal butcher of erotic allusions that arouses a strong attraction in her.
cast: Alba Parietti, Miki Manojlovic, Lorenzo Majnoni, Rosa Pianeta, Giulio Base

title: Il maestro
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Alfredo Mayo, Mary Lamar, Marco Paoletti, Félix Fernández

title: Il maestro di Don Giovanni
synopsis: The two reckless friends Renzo and Raniero, son of the Duke of Sidona, return to their homeland, after various adventures but here they find a situation of overwhelm: the sneaky minister Pavoncello wants to take the place of the Duke. To get rid of the two young men, he has a ban issued, which requires all celibates in Spain to marry, putting Raniero and Renzo on the run.
cast: Errol Flynn, Gina Lollobrigida, Nadia Gray, Cesare Danova, Roldano Lupi, Alberto Rabagliati, Paola Mori, Silvio Bagolini, Renato Chiantoni, Riccardo Rioli

title: Il maestro di Vigevano
synopsis: Mombelli is an elementary school teacher who lives satisfied with his modest but decent condition. However, he ends up being conditioned and overwhelmed by the ambition of his wife Ada who, pushed by the idea of ??conquering easy riches, convinces him to abandon his career. The master invests his liquidation in a small artisan business and, at first, seems to accept his new condition.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Claire Bloom, Vito De Taranto, Guido Spadea, Ya Doucheskaya, Eva Magni, Piero Mazzarella, Lilla Ferrante, Ezio Sancrotti

title: Il maestro di violino
synopsis: Commendator Gaudenzi and the Countess of Sansevero commit themselves with their money to make the Moriacchi Conservatory of Perugia prosper. Giovanni Russo teaches violin and attracts the sympathies of his students and the affection of the girls. Agnese, the piano teacher Luciana Taddei and Margherita herself, countess of Sansevero, a widow for some time, aspire to marry him. The countess Laura, for her part, investigates the passaro of the teacher, while Margherita instructs him to follow her daughter during a tour in Israel.
cast: Domenico Modugno, Rena Niehaus, Juliette Mayniel, Elisabetta Virgili

title: Il magico Natale di Rupert
synopsis: Christmas' Eve. Nonna Porfilia sends Rupert to the attic to look for the tip of the Christmas tree, but the boy finds a box with the inventions left by the former tenant. The trouble begins when Rupert lights a strange lamp that emits signals that propagate through space and reach a passing spaceship ready to invade the earth ...
cast: Giammaria Corolla, Piera Cravignani, Renato Liprandi, Clara Droetto, Eugenio Allegri

title: Il magistrato
synopsis: The young magistrate Andrea Morandi must judge a longshoreman who killed a dishonest port manager. Meanwhile Luigi Bonelli, who rents the room to the judge, committed suicide following the ruin of his family ...
cast: José Suarez, François Périer, Massimo Serato, Jacqueline Sassard, Claudia Cardinale

title: Il magnate
synopsis: Clara, the wife of Furio Cicerone, engineer and president of Finsied, does not yield to the amorous proposals of Count Arienti. Cicero contracts a large debt with the count by signing an erotic mortgage on Clara as a guarantee, but he is certain to honor the financial commitment at maturity thanks to the coverage obtained by Bigerotti, the director of a bank. But the very powerful Arienti induces Bigerotti not to agree with Cicero. A thin farce but not all to be thrown away signed by Gianni Grimaldi, veteran screenwriter, rather than director, of comic and light films. It is one of the last appearances in the cinema of Rosanna Schiaffino.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Rosanna Schiaffino, Jean Pierre Cassel, Pier Paola Bucchi, Empedocle Buzzanca, Guido Cerniglia, Michele Cimarosa, Antonio La Raina, Renato Malavasi

title: Il magnifico avventuriero
synopsis: 16th century: goldsmith, sculptor and unrepentant womanizer, Benvenuto Cellini is forced to flee from Florence. Arriving in Rome, he wins the favors of Pope Clement VII, who appoints him head of the Mint: but he takes the opportunity to mint false coins and is imprisoned ...
cast: Brett Halsey, Bernard Blier, Claudia Mori, Françoise Fabian, Elio Pandolfi

title: Il magnifico cornuto
synopsis: Andrea Artusi (Tognazzi) is obsessed with his wife having a lover. The woman is actually faithful to him, but Andrea insists on spying on her and develops the belief that a friend is having an affair with her. Soon after, the jealous husband is injured in an accident; during his convalescence he is persuaded of his wife's fidelity, but she begins to meet the doctor.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Ugo Tognazzi, Gian Maria Volonté, Salvo Randone, Bernard Blier, Michèle Girardon, Paul Guers, Philippe Nicaud, Susy Andersen

title: Il magnifico gladiatore
synopsis: Zuddo, leader of the praetorians, plots a conspiracy against Hercules, son of the king of the Dacians and now hostage of the Romans. Weird as the names of the characters. Brescia will continue to work for decades, specializing in Neapolitan dramas. He died in 2001.
cast: Mark Forest, Marilù Tolo, Oreste Lionello

title: Il magnifico texano
synopsis: A corrupt judge guides terror in a Mexican town. A young man, in love with his daughter, will restore order and peace.
cast: Glenn Saxson, John Barracuda, Barbara Loy, Beny Deus, Gloria Osuna

title: Il malato immaginario
synopsis: In Rome, 1673: the wealthy Argante, seized by irresistible paranoia, refuses to leave the house and claims to be afflicted by a thousand different illnesses and ailments. Rather than arousing concern, the situation is exploited by almost everyone, starting from the wife who plays with other men, to the doctors who get rich. With the help of the faithful servant and loyal daughter, Argante, including the situation, will decide to get rid of all parasites.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Laura Antonelli, Bernard Blier, Vittorio Caprioli, Marina Vlady, Christian De Sica, Giuliana De Sio

title: Il male nella carne
synopsis: Some friends organize a séance and manage to have contact with the evil one, who - thus recalled - will then wander into the woods and cause many misfortunes.
cast: Omar Shanay, Frank Warren, Vera Wright, Steve Brooks, Samantha Jameson, Roxy Osbourne, Joyce Bee, Daniel Frevert, Irene Giordano, Mike Hudson

title: Il male oscuro
synopsis: With the regret of not having been able to give the last farewell to his father, a despotic marshal of the carabinieri, the writer Giuseppe Marchi sadly reached the threshold of middle age. After leaving the French widow Sylvaine, he gets pregnant and marries a girl much younger than him. Professionally very dissatisfied, he suffers from unknown and excruciating pains, he undergoes surgery for a non-existent ulcer and appendicitis and tries in vain to commit suicide ...
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Emmanuelle Seigner, Stefania Sandrelli, Vittorio Caprioli, Nestor Garay

title: Il mammasantissima
synopsis: Don Vincenzo Tramontano is a smuggler, but a gentleman and, as such, respected by all. He has two enemies, smugglers like him, but without moral codes: the "lawyer" and Don Salvatore. After unsuccessfully trying to steal the dominance of the "market" from him, they kidnap and kill his daughter forcing him to come out into the open. Don Vincenzo, however, manages to get them out and then surrenders himself to the law. Neapolitan drama with Mario Merola. Beyond any aesthetic evaluation.
cast: Mario Merola, Malisa Longo, Biagio Pelligra, Nunzio Gallo

title: Il mangiatore di pietre
synopsis: Cesare, a former smuggler and human trafficker, finds the murdered body of his nephew Fausto in a remote Piedmontese valley. It was Cesare himself who introduced his nephew to his criminal activities but the two ended up losing sight of each other after Fausto had decided to engage in drug trafficking from Italy to Switzerland, an activity that his uncle had #invece #rejected. . As soon as the police begin to investigate, Cesare finds himself among the suspects until Commissioner Sonja di Meo shows that he believes him. Something tender seems to be emerging between the two, but Cesare has only one thing in mind: to avenge Fausto's death at any cost.
cast: Luigi Lo Cascio, Vincenzo Crea, Bruno Todeschini, Ursina Lardi, Leonardo Nigro, Antonio Buil, Antonio Zavatteri

title: Il manoscritto del Principe
synopsis: Guido, an aristocratic intellectual of sixty, wants to meet Marco, a friend he hasn't seen for forty years, to give him back something that belongs to him. Marco appears hesitant and despite the commitment he has made, he does not show up for the meeting. Their story crosses in flashbacks that of Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa, and the manuscript of his most famous work, "Il gattopardo". Marco and Guido were two frequenters of the aristocrat's salon in the Palermo of the fifties.
cast: Michel Bouquet, Jeanne Moreau, Laurent Terzieff, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Il mantenuto
synopsis: The honest employee Stefano Gardelli becomes, despite himself and without realizing it, the friend and protector of a girl of easy virtue. The man is targeted by the real exploiters of the woman and placed under police surveillance. The agents were alarmed by Stefano's participation in a union meeting attended by some girls from the company where Gardelli works. Even the president of the company Stefano works for falls into the misunderstanding and fires him. Meanwhile, the former employee ends up in the clutches of a widow.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Ilaria Occhini, Grete Rabsham, Pinuccia Nava

title: Il marchio di Kriminal
synopsis: Of the map with the indications to recover two precious paintings, the bandit Kriminal owns only a part; the other is in the hands of Mara and Robson, two adventurers. The three reach an ephemeral agreement that as soon as the loot is recovered leads to a bloody showdown. At times the film tries to laugh at an irremediably conventional story.
cast: Glenn Saxon, Helga Liné, Andrea Bosic, Armando Francioli, Tomás Picó, Evi Rigano, Anna Zinnemann, Franca Dominici, Ugo Sasso

title: Il mare
cast: Umberto Orsini, Françoise Prevost, Dino Mele, Renato Scala

title: Il mare, non c'è paragone
synopsis: The sudden fishing crisis throws Liuciano into despair as he tries to get out of the impasse by going to work in the fishmonger run by his mother. The results are disastrous. The man urged by the insistence of his wife Maria gives himself to the transport of illegal immigrants from Albania. An awkward and tragic shipwreck puts him in a coma. What appears to be a drama could turn out to be lucky if Luciano wakes up during the connection of the "Superenaletto" show combined with the "Sveglia & Vinci" lottery.
cast: Eduardo Tartaglia, Sabrina Impacciatore, Gigi Savoia, Veronica Mazza

title: Il marito
synopsis: Alberto is a young building contractor fresh from marriage. The wife is not only jealous but also extraordinarily attached to her family of origin: in fact she forces Alberto to live with her mother-in-law and sister-in-law. Business is not going well and for Alberto salvation would be represented by a beautiful widow: but his wife, jealous, makes everything upset. Alberto changes jobs, he will become a confectionery salesman: so he can woo all the girls he wants, making his wife and mother-in-law happy at the same time.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Aurora Bautista, Carlo Ninchi, Marcello Giorda, Luigi Tosi, Alberto De Amicis, Delia Luna, Laly Blanch

title: Il marito bello
synopsis: Luciana would like her husband Marco to devote himself to more serious things than refereeing football matches on Sundays and so she gets him hired by an aeronautical company. However, Marco gets fired and, after yet another quarrel, separates from his wife. When he meets Giulia he believes he can rebuild a life, but the girl accepts his court only to favor her favorite team.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Giovanna Ralli, Giacomo Furia, Andrea Checchi

title: Il marito in collegio
synopsis: To take possession of the inheritance of her uncle Zanin, of modest origins but wealthy, the noble and poor Carlotta Madellis agrees to marry the gas station attendant Camillo Proietti. With the proviso that the marriage will not be consummated before the groom has acquired the manners of a refined person. So poor Camillo ends up in a Swiss boarding school to soften up, but in the meantime Carlotta risks falling into the traps of a dowry seeker, a self-styled baron.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Anna Proclemer, Silvia Dionisio, Mario Carotenuto, Bombolo

title: Il marito in vacanza
synopsis: The principal of an elementary school is meeting with other teachers in a not very elegant hotel. During the day the man works tirelessly for the union, while at night with the complicity of a janitor he goes wild with the procure teachers.
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Lilli Carati, Enzo Cannavale, Bombolo, Cinzia De Ponti

title: Il marito è mio e l'ammazzo quando mi pare
cast: Catherine Spaak, Hywel Bennett, Vittorio Caprioli, Hugh Griffith

title: Il maschio ruspante
synopsis: Romulus finds Rema, with whom he has been in love since kindergarten, at a village party. She invites him to follow her into her house, but only to take him as a waiter. Hybrid comedy melò with good character actors and, in a small part, Enrica Bonaccorti.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Barbara Bach, Ninetto Davoli, Marisa Merlini, Enrica Bonaccorti, Jacques Herlin, Didi Perego, Romano Malaspina, Alessandro Iacarella, Fausta Avelli, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Nello Pazzafini

title: Il massacro della foresta nera
synopsis: In the last years of the Roman Empire's greatness, the barbarians unleash a decisive attack on the heart of Rome. The Germanic troops manage to defeat the legionaries on their own ground and the Emperor Augustus runs for cover by sending reinforcements. The commander of the new troops, Aulo Cecina, has an idea to defeat the opponents, taking them from behind. But the war operations get complicated ...
cast: Cameron Mitchell, Antonella Lualdi, Beba Loncar

title: Il materiale emotivo
synopsis: Vincenzo dedicates his existence to his ancient Parisian bookcase, a small pearl lying in the center of a square in Paris, and his daughter Albertine, forced home because of an accident that took place a few years earlier. Vincenzo's life flows quietly, between love for his daughter and that for books, but calm cannot last forever, not even for those who have earned it by paying it at a very dear price. One day, Yolande, a distinct and exuberant girl, breaks into the shop. Fascinated by the woman's life force, Vincenzo begins to rediscover emotions for some time now, who will lead him to question himself about his melancholy and suspended way of dealing with life.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Bérénice Bejo, Matilda De Angelis, Clementino, Sandra Milo, Alex Lutz, Marie Philomène Nga

title: Il matrimonio
synopsis: The landowner Lomov goes to his doctor to ask for his daughter in marriage. On the way he meets a friend who begins to illustrate all the negative sides of marriage. Lomov is convinced and decides not to marry again, also because as soon as he sees his beloved, he quarrels.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Silvana Pampanini, Renato Rascel

title: Il mattatore
synopsis: Two cronies agree to cheat a certain Gerardo, but when the "bin" seems to have been successful, Gerardo himself unmasks the fraud. And here is the story of his professional curriculum. He can be called the king of scams: his whole life has been nothing more than a series of chameleonic "blows" scored with the most unthinkable disguises and the most ingenious mechanisms. Gassman, Gassman and again Gassman. In all sorts of ways, in full swing, the star, in fact, from one end to the other of the film designed to allow him to exhibit his histrionics.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Dorian Gray, Anna Maria Ferrero, Peppino De Filippo

title: Il mattino ha l'oro in bocca
synopsis: In the 70s, Marco Baldini works as a DJ in discos: he is noticed by the director of a private radio and begins to lead a successful program. Unfortunately, however, he discovers a passion for horse racing and loses a lot of money. Later, thanks to an audition at Radio Deejay, his life took a turn ...
cast: Elio Germano, Laura Chiatti, Martina Stella, Carlo Monni, Corrado Fortuna, Donato Placido, Antonio Buonomo, Dario Vergassola, Chiara Francini

title: Il medaglione insanguinato
cast: Richard Johnson, Joanna Cassidy, Evelyne Stewart, Nicoletta Elmi, Lila Kedrova, Ida Galli, Riccardo Garrone, Dana Ghia, Eleonora Morana, Edmund Purdom

title: Il medico dei pazzi
synopsis: Ciccillo, nephew of Felice Sciosciammocca, is supported by his uncle, making him believe he is studying as a doctor. When his uncle arrives in town he invents a ruse: he makes him believe that the customers of the pension where he lives are mad and furious entrusted to him. All in all, the attitude of the customers helps him: an intrusive widow, a man jealous of his cheerful wife, an irascible colonel, an actor who tries "Othello" all the time. The misunderstandings will then be clarified by Ciccillo's confession and by Felice's return to the countryside.
cast: Totò, Aldo Giuffré, Franca Marzi, Nerio Bernardi, Tecla Scarano, Maria Pia Casilio, Vittoria Crispo, Carlo Ninchi, Giacomo Furia, Nora Ricci

title: Il medico della mutua
synopsis: The promising and recent medical graduate Guido Tersilli discovers that he can earn much more by dealing with loans. At the beginning, business is not going well, but the death of the elderly Dr. Bui who "owns" two thousand three hundred loans, benefits his career: with the promise to take her to the altar, he seduces the widow and manages to pass under her care the patients of the late Dr. Bui. Now Tersilli works day and night, he is very rich and can abandon his widow to marry a young and rich girl, the daughter of a builder. In the meantime, his clients are growing out of all proportion, so much so that Tersilli can only dedicate them a few minutes per visit. Overwhelmed by a collapse, he ends up in the same hospital1 that had seen him as a volunteer assistant at the beginning of his career. Feeling threatened by his old colleagues who would like to take away his clients, he will make an advantageous decision.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Ida Galli, Bice Valori, Nanda Primavera, Franco Scandurra, Leopoldo Trieste, Sara Franchetti, Evelyn Stewart, Claudio Gora, Pupella Maggio

title: Il medico e lo stregone
synopsis: The young doctor Marchetti (Mastroianni) arrives to practice in a village perched on the mountains. Where "civilization" has not yet arrived. So much so that before his arrival, medicine was practiced by an elderly "healer" (De Sica). It will be the doctor who prevails, managing to persuade the inhabitants of the effectiveness of his medicines.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica, Marisa Merlini, Lorella De Luca, Gabriella Pallotta, Alberto Sordi, Virgilio Riento, Carlo Taranto, Ilaria Occhini, Riccardo Garrone

title: Il medico... la studentessa
synopsis: As a reward for the promotion, high school student Claudia Raselli gets permission from her father, Colonel Oreste, to go to London with friends. But when the stepmother Luisa induces the parent to revoke the consent, Claudia discovers that the woman is plotting to better cornify her husband with her lover, Doctor Filippo Cinti, and - with the help of her friend Daniela - she meditates revenge. ..
cast: Gloria Guida, Jacques Dufilho, Pino Colizzi, Susan Scott

title: Il medium
cast: Vincent Mannari Jr., Martine Brochard, Susan Buchanan, Philippe Leroy

title: Il mercante di pietre
synopsis: Ludovico Vicedomini, a Catholic converted to Islam, trades in precious stones with Afghanistan and Turkey: but behind the unsuspected facade, he hides his belonging to a "sleeping cell" of Al Qaeda. His mission is to seduce a girl to transform her into an unconscious vector of death: the chosen one is Leda, a successful thirty year old. But then...
cast: Harvey Keitel, Jane March, Jordi Mollà, F. Murray Abraham

title: Il mercante di stoffe
synopsis: Marco and Luisa are two young Italians who, fascinated by an ancient legend, leave for Morocco in search of an old medallion. Upon reaching their destination, the two discover that the jewel belonged to Najiba (Emanuela Garuccio), a young Berber woman who lived around the 1930s. They also learn that the Arab woman met the Italian Alessandro (Sebastiano Somma), a cloth merchant who arrived there for work, and that she lived an intense love story with him, contrasted by the differences imposed by the clash. cultural and religious between the Islamic world and the Western world.
cast: Sebastiano Somma, Emanuela Garuccio, Abdesselam Bouhasni, Marta Bifano, Antonio Campobasso, Philippe Boa, Luca Capuano, Ionis Bascir

title: Il mercenario
synopsis: Paco Roman, to fight against the troops called by the owner of a mine against which he and his family had rebelled, hires the mercenary Sergheij Kowalski, known as "the Pole", who manages to repel and defeat the attackers. The two make a pact: for two hundred dollars a day, Sergheij will help Paco make the revolution. During one of their exploits, to tell the truth, more thieving than revolutionary, a woman, Colomba, joins them. Falling in love with Paco, the woman warns him of Kowalski's greed. From a subject by Franco Solinas, a Latin-revolutionary spaghetti western according to fashion. The music is by Ennio Morricone.
cast: Franco Nero, Tony Musante, Franco Giacobini, Jack Palance, Giovanna Ralli

title: Il merlo maschio
synopsis: Niccolò Vivaldi is a cello that suffers from a strong inferiority complex, both for the scarce professional success, and for the very little consideration in which it is held by those with whom it comes into contact. When he discovers that his wife likes other men very much, he starts making her pose naked.
cast: Laura Antonelli, Lando Buzzanca, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Elsa Vazzoler, Gino Cavalieri, Luciano Bianciardi, Adolfo Belletti, Franco Bisazza, Gigi Bonfanti, Lino Toffolo

title: Il mestiere delle armi
synopsis: The fog, the cold, the snow of November 1526. The Lanzichenecchi of Charles V, emperor of the Alemanni, commanded by Zorzo Frundsberg, march towards Rome and Joanni de 'Medici, captain of a papal army, delays the advance and he opposes the enemy with his men in burnished armor - with black bands - to strike better in the dark, suddenly, with audacity and tactical intuition.
cast: Christo Jivkov, Sergio Grammatico, Sandra Ceccarelli, Giancarlo Belelli

title: Il microfono è vostro
synopsis: Maria Vanieri, daughter of a scientist, is engaged to Filippo an engineer, but her passion is music. The meeting with Bruno, composer of pop music, changes her life. The boy has put on a jazz band and learned that Maria can sing well asks her to join the group. During a radio show for amateurs, entitled "The microphone is yours", Maria proves to have a beautiful voice, but in order not to compromise her friends she decides to take on a stage name.
cast: Gisella Sofio, Enrico Luzi, Aroldo Tieri, Ada Dondini, Enrico Viarisio, Guglielmo Inglese, Mario Siletti, Rino Salviati, Franco Parenti, Nilla Pizzi

title: Il miele del diavolo
synopsis: Cecilia Ama Gaetano, young and transgressive saxophonist. After an accident, the man dies in the operating room and Cecilia seized Guido, the surgeon who considers responsible. He locks him in an isolated villa, chains him, submits it to humiliations and torture. Corinne Clery becomes a executioner, as a victim who was in "Histoire d'O.", in yet another, baroque proof of manipulation of the genres conducted by Fulci.
cast: Corinne Cléry, Brett Halsey, Blanca Marsillach, Stefano Madia, Paola Molina

title: Il minestrone
synopsis: At the beginning there are two "starving" who rummage through the garbage to get something to eat. Then, through multiple hardships, the group thickens, the attempts to eat as well, but the results are always marked by failure and frustration. You will end up, following a kind of holy man, among snowy peaks, listening to band music, but with still unsatisfied hunger. A "parable" about the hunger of the poor. Weird, poetic, unclassifiable, with a crazy cast, like all Citti films. There is also a three-part television version.
cast: Roberto Benigni, Franco Citti, Ninetto Davoli, Giorgio Gaber

title: Il ministro
synopsis: Franco Lucci (Gianmarco Tognazzi) is an entrepreneur on the verge of bankruptcy. The salvation of his company hangs on a large public contract that he could obtain thanks to the intervention of a minister (Fortunato Cerlino) with whom he became friends and whom he invited to dinner. Together with Michele (Edoardo Pesce), his partner and brother-in-law, Franco has organized the perfect evening: in addition to paying him a large bribe, the two make him find a girl willing to go to bed with him in exchange for a recommendation. All under the eyes of Rita (Alessia Barela), Franco's wife, who tries to indulge her husband in the last desperate attempt to obtain the millionaire contract. Because of the girl, the evening takes an unexpected turn.
cast: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Alessia Barela, Fortunato Cerlino, Edoardo Pesce, Jun Ichikawa, Ira Fronten

title: Il mio Paese
synopsis: Today's Italy crossed from South to North, marked by the economic crisis and the loss of international competitiveness. From the industrial Sicily of Gela and Termini Imerese to Melfi, where Fiat and the new models of agricultural development coexist; and then the district of Prato, grappling with the complex dynamics of Chinese immigration, and Porto Marghera, engaged in the conversion of its chemical center.

title: Il mio West
synopsis: On the border with Canada lies Basin Field, a quiet village nestled in the countryside. There is a saloon run by the seductive Mary, the post office, shops and stables. And there is Doc, a nonviolent doctor by nature, with his wife and son. The tranquility of the village is upset by the arrival of Jack Sikora, a bloodthirsty gunfighter who tries to fight his arch rival, Johnny Lowen.
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Harvey Keitel, David Bowie, Alessia Marcuzzi

title: Il mio amico Babbo Natale
synopsis: An industrialist from Northern Italy who does not believe in the values ??of life and Christmas will be "redeemed" by a Santa Claus from the Apulian accent.
cast: Lino Banfi, Vittoria Belvedere, Gerry Scotti, Gianluca Grecchi, Sergio Graziani, Daniela Morozzi, Isabella Cecchi, Stefania Spugnini, Emiiano Coltori

title: Il mio amico Babbo Natale 2
synopsis: Four days before Christmas, a thief dressed as Santa Claus steals toys in the department stores of Northern Italy. Ezekiel, by order of the Dean, begins the hunt for the thief, discovering that he grew up in the "Villa Felice" orphanage, where the evil director has canceled Christmas from her children's calendar.
cast: Lino Banfi, Gerry Scotti, Micaela Ramazzotti, Pamela Villoresi, Carlotta Mazzoleni, Sergio Graziani, Fabio Sartor

title: Il mio amico Benito
synopsis: Peppino Di Gennaro is an anonymous employee who aspires to the post of office manager. When a friend gives him a photograph in which he is portrayed in the trenches with Mussolini, he decides to use this medium as well to get what he wants. The misunderstandings follow one another; on the day of the declaration of war Peppino resigns. Comedy with flattened and fragmented satirical intentions. The film doesn't have enough nastiness, but Peppino De Filippo is a lot of fun. Particular also for Franchi and Ingrassia.
cast: Peppino De Filippo, Mario Carotenuto, Didi Perego, Riccardo Billi

title: Il mio amico Jekyll
synopsis: Giacinto Flora, tutor in a girls' boarding school, is kidnapped every night by Doctor Jekyll, who manages to transform him into a sadistic and vicious individual. Strange and inexplicable facts take place inside the college, until the intervention of a detective tries to put things right by solving the riddle.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Carlo Croccolo, Abbe Lane

title: Il mio amico Massimo
synopsis: Almost 70 years have passed since the birth of Massimo Troisi. To remember him with the right affection, many of his friends gathered in front of the camera to tell the life and artistic path of the Neapolitan actor and author. Carlo Verdone, Nino Frassica, Clarissa Burt, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Pippo Baudo and Renzo Arbore alternate with the respective testimonies of a light career, unfortunately lasting too little.

title: Il mio corpo con rabbia
synopsis: Silvia, raised in a wealthy family, has a deep grudge against her parents, and seeks "comfort" in drugs. The girl is hospitalized in a psychiatric clinic, but, despite the treatment she is subjected to, Silvia continues to hate her father and mother. Then one day he meets Paul, who has some unfinished business with justice.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Antonia Santilli, Silvano Tranquilli, Massimo Girotti

title: Il mio corpo vi seppellirà
synopsis: 1860, in the Kingdom of the two Sicilies, at the dawn of the landing of Garibaldi's troops, in a land still without law, four bandits called the Drude are looking for their personal revenge. And a lot of blood will flow.
cast: Miriam Dalmazio, Antonia Truppo, Margareth Madè, Rita Abela, Giovanni Calcagno, Guido Caprino, Filippo Pucillo, Giuseppe Schillaci

title: Il mio domani
synopsis: In Milan, Monica (Claudia Gerini) leads a quiet life despite a past that occasionally comes back to haunt her. Abandoned as a teenager by her mother and raised by a very religious and guilt-ridden father, she is now over forty, has a stable relationship with her boss, a married man, and is a company trainer who applies classical philosophy to the world of work, often finding themselves sweetening the pill for managers and employees of companies undergoing restructuring. The sudden death of the parent, however, leads her to question every professional and personal aspect, trying to recover her identity thanks to approaching her stepsister's son and distancing herself from an environment that uses her only as a tool to manipulate. employees and justify unethical choices.
cast: Claudia Gerini, Raffaele Pisu, Claudia Coli, Lino Guanciale, Paolo Pierobon, Enrico Bosco

title: Il mio miglior nemico
synopsis: Achille De Bellis, established top manager of an important hotel chain owned by his wife Gigliola and his brother-in-law Guglielmo, fires one of his employees, Annarita, for theft. Orpheus, Annarita's 23 year old son, convinced of his mother's innocence, decides to avenge her. Thus begins to follow Achilles everywhere to discover his weaknesses and ruin his existence ...
cast: Carlo Verdone, Silvio Muccino, Ana Caterina Morariu, Agnese Nano, Paolo Triestino

title: Il mio nome è Mallory 'M' come morte
synopsis: The famous gunslinger Mallory and the retired Northern Colonel Hasper buy a farm in which to spend their last years. A certain Jefferson who sold it is robbed and killed by two bandits. Hasper and Mallory confront them. Italian-style Western of series C and already a little out of time, but shot with some care.
cast: Robert Wood, Gabriella Giorgelli, Teodoro Corrà

title: Il mio nome è Nessuno
synopsis: Nobody is a young and skilled gunslinger, but more ready for mockery than the use of weapons. His idol is the legendary Jack Beauregard. When Nobody finally meets him he does everything to involve him in an exaggerated enterprise: to destroy the "Wild Bunch", a band of 150 gunmen who terrorize the Far West.
cast: Terence Hill, Henry Fonda, Jean Martin, Piero Lulli, Mario Brega

title: Il mio nome è Scopone e faccio sempre cappotto
synopsis: Gunman Dallas plays a rich poker legacy with beautiful Glenda. Comic Western that does not excite and does not entertain. Steffen is actually Antonio De Teffé.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Fernando Sancho, Gillian Hills, Ricardo Hundar

title: Il mio nome è Shanghai Joe
synopsis: Shanghai Joe is hired by a farmer to move cattle, but in reality it is contraband. In the end, the Chinese will succeed in vanquishing the shady trade. Movies of adventures and fights, as they used to do
cast: Chen Lee, Klaus Kinski, Carla Romanelli

title: Il mio nome è Thomas
cast: Terence Hill, Veronica Bitto, Guia Jelo, Andy Luotto, Lorenzo Gasperini, Giovanni Malafronte, Matt Patresi

title: Il mio nome è vendetta
synopsis: Holy was an assassin on behalf of the 'Ndrangheta, then decided to change his life and moved to a small city in Trentino-Alto Adige, where for twenty years he managed to remain hidden together with his wife and daughter Sofia. Their tranquility is brutally interrupted, one evening, when two criminals enter the house and kill Sofia's mother and uncle, revealing themselves after twenty years. In this brutal way, the girl discovers the past of her father and, albeit reluctantly, decides to ally with him to avenge the double murder.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Ginevra Francesconi, Remo Girone, Alessio Praticò, Marcello Mazzarella, Sinja Dieks, Gabriele Falsetta

title: Il mio uomo perfetto
synopsis: Does the perfect man exist? The only woman currently able to answer this question is Antonietta: 29 years old, Neapolitan, bartender, dreamer, creative and, above all, single in search of the ideal man. Alongside her in this quest: her best friend and "counter" companion, Mariano; her best friend, Patrizia; and, of course, his parents (his father from Naples, his mother from Verona). Every day Antonietta scrutinizes the behavior of men who go to sip a coffee or have a quick meal at the bar where she works: among them Dr. Stralti, brilliant manager of a company whose offices are located near the bar, and Federico, a young worker fascinated by the beautiful bartender. Which of them will be your ideal man?
cast: Nancy Coppola, Francesco Testi, Antonio Palmese, Eva Grimaldi, Nadia Rinaldi, Maria Del Monte, Antonio Fiorillo, Andrea Roncato, Mariano Catanzaro

title: Il mio viaggio in Italia
synopsis: Scorsese pays homage to a cinematography that, since his adolescence, he has learned to love and to know. Watching Italian films on television with his grandparents, parents and brother, the young Martin has elaborated a good part of the imagery that will characterize his future works. The film - which opens and closes with images of "Paisà" - reviews about 130 titles including, among others, milestones such as "Cabiria", "1860", "La corona di ferro", "Ossessione", "Senso", "Italian divorce" and many other unforgettable masterpieces.

title: Il mio vicino del piano di sopra
synopsis: Bruno Beretta and Claudia Gargiulo live in the same luxury building but can't stand each other. Claudia bought the penthouse and the super-attic which, however, is still inhabited by Bruno. He wants to make us a duplex, because he will soon get married to Mattia: it's a pity that Bruno refuses to leave his home. When Gea, Bruno's teenage daughter, reveals to him that his mother Susanna is about to remarry with Riccardo, a well-known dentist and former friend of Bruno, Bruno decides that he will have to be at that party. So he proposes an agreement to Claudia: if she agrees to accompany him to the wedding as his fiancée, he will leave the apartment. She accepts but only in exchange for a signature to be affixed to a contract, promptly drawn up for the occasion. However, Bruno's clumsy plan to impress his ex-wife takes an unexpected turn.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Barbora Bobulova, Gennaro Iaccarino

title: Il miracolo
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Tonio is run over by the young Cinzia, who runs away without helping him. Before he faints, he sees a wonderful light: when he wakes up from a coma, he begins to perform real miracles. For example, one night, while wandering around the hospital, he enters a room where there is a dying man: the electrocardiogram on the monitor is flat, but the touch of Tonio restarts the heartbeat ...
cast: Claudio D'Agostino, Stefania Casciaro, Carlo Bruni, Anna Ferruzzo

title: Il mistero dei tre continenti
synopsis: Professor Johansen, an eminent Swedish scientist has discovered a nuclear reaction equal to that of all power plants around the world. An experiment causes the destruction of the laboratory and the temporary paralysis of all the plants in Stockholm. The authorities decide to transfer the scientist and his Indian aide to a secret location. However, this does not prevent the two from being kidnapped.
cast: Martha Hyer, Carlos Thompson, Micheline Presle, Gino Cervi

title: Il mistero del lago
synopsis: Italy, early 1920s: the young governess Teresa is called to provide for the studies of little Flora and Milo at home. The previous governess, Mrs. Petri, was abruptly fired by Elia, a rude man to whom the two orphans were placed in foster care. The woman committed suicide on the day of Teresa's arrival, but only a few days later her disfigured body was found in the lake. From that moment, the newcomer witnesses a series of supernatural manifestations and, to defend the children, tries to solve the mystery that surrounds the house and its inhabitants, thus reliving the traumas of her childhood.
cast: Ana Caterina Morariu, Lorenzo Flaherty, Simona Borioni, Hary Prinz, Elisabetta Pellini, Luca Ward, Angelica Cinquantini, Gabriele Manfredi, Barbara Wussow, Sabina Began

title: Il mistero di Bellavista
synopsis: A porter and a street cleaner, intrigued by the passage of Halley's comet, ask Professor Bellavista to be able to observe the sky through his telescope. The two, instead of observing the comet, end up framing a window of the apartment opposite and believe they have discovered a crime. They set off in search of the body.
cast: Benedetto Casillo, Marina Confalone, Luciano De Crescenzo

title: Il mistero di Dante
synopsis: Since the nineteenth century, important scholars have tried to reveal the secret that lies behind the triplets of Dante, the great poet. Since then, various symbolic interpretations have followed, on which a group of eminent scholars tries to shed light on a journey that, from the orders of chivalry to the initiatory group of the fourteenth century "The faithful of love", suggests new paths.
cast: F. Murray Abraham, Silvano Agosti, Valerio Massimo Manfredi, Franco Zeffirelli, Christopher Vogler, Roberto Giacobbo, Gabriele La Porta, Taylor Hackford, Riccardo Di Segni

title: Il mistero di Laura
synopsis: Laura was the victim of a car accident, leaving her 38-year-old brother Davide in the throes of despair and the most gloomy depression. By agreeing to teach her violin lessons, Davide meets Costanza, an eighteen year old from a good family bored with everyday life. After the first lesson, Costanza runs into a mysterious thirty-year-old with whom he immediately makes friends and whom two days later, returning to Davide's house, he recognizes in a photo. Incredulous at his story, Davide reveals that Laura died three months earlier. After the disbelief of the moment, the two decide to understand how the meeting was possible, investigating something that will lead them on a mysterious and cathartic path.
cast: Massimiliano Varrese, Rossella Infanti, Olga Shapoval, Gianna Paola Scaffidi, Massimo Bonetti, Stefano Calvagna, Jonny Triviani, Emanuele Cerman, Alida Tarallo, Roberto Cardone

title: Il mistero di Lovecraft - Road to L.
cast: Gianluca Curti, Federico Greco, Roberto Leggio, Simonetta Solder

title: Il mistero di Oberwald
synopsis: A young queen was widowed on her wedding day and has lived in seclusion since that day, often changing abode and showing herself with her face covered with a black veil. Sebastian, a young anarchist poet, sneaks into the queen's apartment to suppress her. The resemblance between the bomber and the dead king is striking.
cast: Luigi Diberti, Monica Vitti, Franco Branciaroli, Paolo Bonacelli

title: Il momento della verità
synopsis: Arriving in Barcelona, ??where he hopes to free himself from the misery of the Andalusian countryside from which he comes, the young Miguel comes into contact with the circles of bullfights. The job of a bullfighter ensures notoriety and high earnings, and Miguel decides to take the risk: he attends a school, works his way up in the town arenas and finally manages to get noticed by an important businessman. Glory and wealth come, but the price to pay will be very high ...
cast: Miguel Mateo 'Miguelín, José Gomez Sevillano, Pedro Basauri 'Pedrucho, Linda Christian

title: Il momento di uccidere
synopsis: Two gunslingers, Lord and Bull, are tasked with finding 500,000 dollars in gold belonging to the Southern Confederation, hidden by a colonel who died defending them from the Northerners. Lord and Bull have the mighty Forrester family and the band of outlaws they hired against them.
cast: George Hilton, Walter Barnes, Loni Von Friedl, Renato Romano

title: Il momento più bello
synopsis: Doctor Pietro Valeri is a young doctor who enthusiastically dedicated himself to experimenting with new theories on painless childbirth. Pietro is engaged to Luisa, a nurse who works in his own hospital. On his return from Paris he discovers that his partner is expecting a baby. At this point the doctor panics; but it will be Luisa who will carry out Pietro's experiments on her own skin.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Giovanna Ralli, Marisa Merlini, Bice Valori

title: Il monaco di Monza
synopsis: In a small village, in the 17th century, Pasquale the cobbler (Totò), is unemployed and homeless, he can no longer feed his twelve children. Disguised as a friar, he finds lodging in a castle, which however is governed by a perfidious marquis who keeps his sister-in-law segregated. The attempts made by Pasquale to free her cause numerous accidents. As always, Totò's cinema starts from the parody, even if in this case the Manzonian story foreshadowed in the title has nothing to do with it. On the other hand, the whole Boccaccio côté that the "friar" Totò provokes by chasing the beautiful Fiorenza becomes fun. Celentano and Don Backy are two (fake) friars who begging to rock time.
cast: Totò, Nino Taranto, Lisa Gastoni, Erminio Macario, Mario Castellani

title: Il monastero
synopsis: A group of friends, during a journey by car, welcomes a self -lace, then stops in a Lazio village near an abandoned monastery and infested with ghosts.
cast: Francesco Venditti, Massimo Poggio, Armando De Razza, Rosa Pianeta, Massimiliano Buzzanca, Pietro Delle Piane, Daniel Ducruet, Fedro Francioni, Melania Maccaferri, Licia Nunez, Mila Rossi

title: Il mondo dei miracoli
synopsis: Marco, a young theater actor, leaves his girlfriend Laura and leaves for Rome to attempt a film career. He meets Sara who falls in love with him and offers him a film next to an American diva (she too falls in love with him). Shortly after, Laura also arrives in Rome who is still attracted to Marco. Among the three women he will choose ...
cast: Jacques Sernas, Virna Lisi, Vittorio De Sica, Amedeo Nazzari

title: Il mondo dell'orrore di Dario Argento
synopsis: Director Dario Argento talks to us about his cinema retracing his own artistic career. The documentary also shows unpublished backstage of the most famous works of the famous author.
cast: Romano Albani, Dario Argento, Fiore Argento, Urbano Barberini, Patrick Bauchau, Michael Brandon, Flavio Bucci, Clara Calamai, Stefania Casini, Jennifer Connelly

title: Il mondo di Yor
synopsis: It seems to be in the stone age, instead it is the one following a terrifying atomic catastrophe. In this context, Yor, a herculean protagonist with blond hair, fights against assorted enemies for the victory of Good against the Evil that rages. He will make it, along with his woman Ka-laa. Let us not be misled by appearances: behind the Anglophile pseudonym hides the very Italian Antonio Margheriti, who tells, in a film based on an Argentine comic and shot in economy, a naive story for a very "green" public (aged or tastes). And everything, from the dialogues to the costumes to the rest, is in tune.
cast: Red Brown, Corinne Cléry, Alan Collins, John Steiner

title: Il mondo fino in fondo
synopsis: Davide, eighteen-year-old gay, and his thirty-year-old brother Loris - unaware of Davide's homosexuality - live in Orta, a small town in northern Italy. Despite having no interest in football but needing to escape from his daily reality, Davide decides to join his brother Loris and other fans to attend an Inter match in Barcelona. In the Spanish city, however, Davide meets Andy, a Chilean boy passionate about ecology who decides to follow up to Santiago, Chile. Lost and in contact with real activists, Davide will try to integrate himself into the group of aware and committed peers he meets there up to when his brother Loris doesn't show up to take him home.
cast: Filippo Scicchitano, Luca Marinelli, Barbora Bobulova, Camilla Filippi, Alfredo Castro, Manuela Martelli, Diego Noguera, Umberto Pesce

title: Il mondo le condanna
synopsis: Renata is from Florence and works as a prostitute in Paris. After a raid by the French police she is repatriated with the obligatory travel document. Taken by despair, she tries to throw herself off the train, but, at the last moment, is held back by the industrialist Martelli. With the support of his wife, Renata finds work as a model in a large atelier. Destiny wants his past to return: his former protector, André, in fact, tries to exploit the situation with blackmail. To defend the girl there is Franco.
cast: Alida Valli, Amedeo Nazzari, Serge Reggiani, Franco Interlenghi

title: Il mondo porno di due sorelle
synopsis: Born of a woman who is perpetually divided between a kind husband and an impetuous lover, the twins Giovanna (Sherry Buchanan) and Emanuela (Paola Montenero) seem to interpret the two opposite aspects as character and physical. Giovanna, bourgeoisly married to a Roman "palazzinaro", is blond, polite and modest. The brunette Emanuela, on the other hand, has chosen to live in constant search of pleasure and freedom as best her nature suggests; so he decides to put together a brothel for sadomasochists.
cast: Sherry Buchanan, Paola Montenero, Marina Hedman, Brunello Chiodetti, Daniele Dublino, Catherine Zago, Ann Janette La Vorgna, Goetz Groh, Mauro Frittella

title: Il mondo sulle spalle
synopsis: Hundreds of people remain unemployed overnight. Between resignation and impotence, everyone gives up, except one: Marco. This is what life has put to the test so far due to the illness of the son, born with a heart malformation. Marco is the only one capable of risking everything: despite the lack of support from the banks, he invests all his savings, mortgages the house and hires old employees - saving them from unemployment and desperation - by taking back a slice of the market he had lost. He risks everything he has, even of being thrown out of the house by his wife Carla ...
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Sara Zanier, Andrea Pennacchi, Stefano Rossi Giordani, Alberto Basaluzzo, Gianluca Gobbi, Viola Sartoretto, Claudia Penoni, Gianluca Ferrato, Antonio Zavatteri, Olivia Manescalchi, Enrico Ianniello

title: Il mondo vuole così
synopsis: Accused by witnesses who portray him as dominated by his wife's aspirations for luxury, an honest banker is sentenced to five years in prison for theft. After serving his sentence, he is surprised that everyone thinks he is a millionaire: at first he plays along, but then ...
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Massimo Serato, Clara Calamai, Lauro Gazzolo

title: Il mondo è una prigione
synopsis: Rome, 1943. The hard days of the prison of a group of partisans arrested by the Germans.
cast: Raoul Grassilli, Giuseppe Angelini, Gianni Bertoncin, Armando Biagetti, Lando Buzzanca, Enrico Canestrini, Rodolfo Cappellini, Lydia Cordaro, Romolo Costa, Rocco D'Assunta

title: Il monello della strada
synopsis: The emigrant Carletto Po (Erminio Macario) gets married by proxy, from Argentina, to an Italian. After a few years he returns to his homeland and does not find his wife, who has died in the meantime, but her son, Paolo, who is also her son by law. Carletto is not enthusiastic and tries to get rid of the boy, but a woman (who looks extraordinarily like Anna) intervenes to make him change his mind. Weak film, even in its fantastic ending. The comparison with Chaplin's "Brat" is unthinkable.
cast: Erminio Macario, Luisa Rossi, Giulio Stival, Saro Urzì

title: Il moralista
synopsis: Augustine, the upright secretary of the International Office of Morality, is known by all for the relentless struggle he wages every day in favor of the common sense of modesty. In reality, the man is the head of a gang that "imports" night dancers by placing them on the prostitution market.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Franco Fabrizi, Maria Perschy

title: Il morbidone
synopsis: A rich and indolent playboy, always surrounded by women, meets a dynamic business girl determined to shake him from his torpor.
cast: Paolo Ferrari, Anouk Aimée, Sylva Koscina, Beba Loncar, Giuliana Lojodice, Margaret Lee, Loredana Nusciak, Tatjana Pavlova, Guido Alberti, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Gina Rovere, Jacques Herlin, Gigi Ballista

title: Il mostro
synopsis: Loris lives alone and carries on as best he can. The police discover, not far from his home, the body of a woman. It takes little to understand that the killer is the same one who hit other times. The police chief sets up a trap to capture the monster with the help of a female police officer. Unfortunately, Loris is the biggest suspect.
cast: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Michel Blanc, Jean Claude Brialy

title: Il mostro
synopsis: Theodore Bundy has always been considered an example of sympathy, availability and education and no one would suspect that behind this apparent respectability lies a dangerous killer. Doubts to the police, who are unsuccessfully investigating the disappearance of seven women, begin to come after the testimony of a girl who claims to have been approached by a mysterious individual named Ted. Thus began a real manhunt. Based on a news story, the film entrusts the role of the psychopath to Mark Harmon, known to the television audience for his appearances in numerous serials.
cast: Mark Harmon, Frederick Forrest, Glynnis O'Connor

title: Il mostro
synopsis: Valerio, a journalist in crisis, receives an anonymous note that heralds the murder of a TV star. At first he does not give importance to what, but when the character is promptly killed Valerio realizes he has a scoop in hand. The thing (letter and murder) repeats itself once again and Valerio marches on it and even seems to take pleasure in the coup when the murders become three and then four. At this point, however, the police begin to suspect him ...
cast: Johnny Dorelli, Sydne Rome, Renzo Palmer, Yves Beneyton

title: Il mostro dell'opera
synopsis: A theater company is engaged in very tight rehearsals in an abandoned theater. The situation takes a turn for the worse when a bloodthirsty creature who resided there is awakened and targets an actress of the company.
cast: Marco Mariani, Giuseppe Addobbati, Barbara Howard, Alberto Archetti, Carla Cavalli, Aldo Nicodemi, Jody Excell, Milena Vukotic, Gaby Black, George Arms

title: Il mostro della cripta
synopsis: It is 1988 and young Giò, a nerd little more than a teenager, leafing through the latest issue of his favorite comic, Squadra 666 - Il Mostro della Cripta, written and drawn by one of his idols, Diego Busirivici, notices some similarities between the story told in those pages and the atrocious events that are sowing death and terror in the village where he lives. A disturbing mystery will lead Giò and his bizarre group of friends on an adventure out of the ordinary.
cast: Tobia De Angelis, Pasquale Petrolo, Amanda Campana, Nicola Branchini, Chiara Caselli, Giovanni Calcagno, Eleonora De Luca, Alice Bortolani, Gianluca Zaccaria, Riccardo Livermore, Ludovico Girardello, Gisella Burinato

title: Il mostro di Firenze
synopsis: In Florence, a homicidal maniac attacks and kills couples of young lovers secluded in hidden places, raging with butcher techniques on the bodies of female victims. A writer decides to undertake a personal investigation: starting from the place where the last brutal double murder took place up to the first in order of time, which took place eighteen years earlier, he will be able to trace a psychological profile of the possible murderer but will not be able to nothing more than to note that the object of his research is a nocturnal animal that strikes without a trace and returns into the darkness.
cast: Leonard Mann, Bettina Giovannini, Gabriele Tinti, Francesca Muzio, Federico Pacifici, Alberto Di Stasio, Anna Orso, Lydia Mancinelli, Antonio Ballerio, Gil Baroni

title: Il motorino
synopsis: Daniela left Mario years before, tired of a life of hardship and the useless illusions of her husband, a singer with no luck. Today Daniela is back in charge because she wants her son Sal with her. Mario, however, rather than succumb to the blackmail of the woman, gives himself up to the underworld and ends up in prison. So Daniela gets the custody of her son who, in truth, only wants to own a moped.
cast: Mario Da Vinci, Sal Da Vinci, Eleonora Vallone, Nunzio Gallo

title: Il mulino del Po
synopsis: Berta Scarceni is betrothed to Orbino Verginesi and the engagement is celebrated on the floating mill of the Scarceni. Princivalle, Berta's brother, for fear of financial controls, sets fire to the mill. Thus began a period of misery and hatred for the two families, which resulted in tragedy and crime.
cast: Carla Del Poggio, Jacques Sernas, Leda Gloria

title: Il mulino del Po
cast: Raf Vallone, Giulia Lazzarini, Gastone Moschin, Renzo Montagnani, Elsa Merlini

title: Il mulino delle donne di pietra
synopsis: The student Hans von Harnmen is carrying out a research on Dutch folk art and thus comes into contact with Gregorius Wahl, a sculptor who owns an extraordinary carillon, of extraordinary dimensions, which at every hour parades a series of female statues of life-size. Soon Hans falls in love with Gregorius' daughter, Helfi, who will discover that she is particularly attached to that music box.
cast: Pierre Brice, Scilla Gabel, Wolfgang Preiss, Liana Orfei, Dany Carrel

title: Il muro di gomma
synopsis: On the evening of June 27, 1980 a civil aircraft from Itavia, flying from Bologna to Palermo, disappeared in flight. His remains are found near Ustica: eighty-one victims. The causes are mysterious, the news is contradictory. Some coincidences are suspicious: in Calabria, a few days later, a Libyan Mig is found, fallen or shot down. The highest authorities of the state deny everything. Marco Risi, son of Dino, has signed an unusual film-denunciation in the panorama of Italian cinema. No demagogic yielding, American-style rhythm, some good screenplay ideas (by Rulli, Petraglia and Andrea Purgatori). Music by Francesco De Gregori.
cast: Corso Salani, Angela Finocchiaro, Ivo Garrani, Laura Rossi, Antonello Fassari, Ivano Marescotti, Eliana Miglio, Mario De Candia, Sergio Fiorentini, Johnny Dorelli, Tony Sperandeo

title: Il muto di Gallura
synopsis: Among the mountains and woods of Gallura, between 1849 and 1856 there is a fierce feud between the Mamia, Pilers and Vasa families, which causes dozens of deaths. Among the architects there is Bastiano Tansu, called the Muto, who became the protagonist of a legend still, partly, wrapped in mystery.
cast: Andrea Arcangeli, Marco Bullitta, Giovanni Carroni, Syama Rayner, Aldo Ottobrino, Fulvio Accogli, Nicola Pannelli, Andrea Carroni, Fiorenzo Mattu

title: Il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu
synopsis: A right-wing mayor decides to block the rise of his now certain successor by involving him in a fake sex scandal. Since the progressive candidate does not give up, the mayor even has him jailed for murder. He reckoned without two women discovering his machinations.
cast: Annie Girardot, Bernard Fresson, Mireille Darc, André Falcon

title: Il nano erotico
synopsis: The landlady leaves the son with the new babysitter; The shy girl will be overwhelmed by a ferocious dwarf sadomasochist perverted fetishist, armed with rubber fouls, bras, ropes and video camera.
cast: Franco Coltorti, Dominique Saint Claire, Sabrina Mastrolorenzi, Serwan A. Hoshvar, Petit Loup

title: Il nemico
synopsis: Chief Inspector Pietro Stoll is investigating the murder of a servant in a luxurious country villa. Shortly thereafter, the gardener, who was about to reveal everything, is also killed. At that point the inspector finds a microphone connected to a radio transmitter hidden in a piano. Detective debut with an espionage aspect for Guglielmo Giannini, playwright and future founder of the "UOmo whatever" party.
cast: Evi Maltagliati, Paola Borboni, Luigi Pavese

title: Il nido
synopsis: Nineteen-year-old Cora sees her village change after a mysterious man arrives. Due to his presence, the harmony of the place quickly gives way to an atmosphere of suspicion as dark events resurface from the past.
cast: Ondina Quadri, Fabrizio Rongione, Diego Ribon, Sonia Gessner, Giovanni Franzoni, Luigi Diberti, Nello Mascia, Nicola Rignanese

title: Il nido del ragno
synopsis: Alan Whitmore, a young American researcher, goes to Budapest to visit Professor Roth, with whom he collaborates on a secret project called "Intextus". Arriving in the Hungarian capital, Alan finds Roth who, in a panic, hands him a black book which, according to him, should contain information of the utmost importance; alarmed, Alan tries to contact the professor again, but arrives too late: mysterious killers have already struck. The American thus initiates a personal and dangerous investigation, despite threatening warning signs that lead to fear of the worst ...
cast: Roland Wybenga, Paola Rinaldi, Stéphane Audran, William Berger

title: Il nome del figlio
synopsis: During a cheerful dinner with friends, the simple question about the name of the son that Paolo (Alessandro Gassman), an extroverted real estate agent, and Simona (Micaela Ramazzotti), author of a very spicy book, are about to have generates an endless discussion. Fierce differences, profound differences, ancient grudges, quarrels over sexual tastes and intimate revelations will end up uncovering unexpected secrets with tragicomic consequences.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Micaela Ramazzotti, Valeria Golino, Luigi Lo Cascio, Rocco Papaleo, Carolina Cetroli

title: Il nome della rosa
synopsis: In the autumn of 1327 the Franciscan William of Baskerville arrived in a majestic Italian monastery with the novice Adso for a meeting between Dominicans, Franciscans and papal delegates. Mysterious deaths follow one another and Guglielmo's investigations are hindered. The papal delegate proceeds with an inquisitorial method: for him heresy and murder are identified, but the solution lies elsewhere. From Umberto Eco's best seller, Annaud attempts a transposition that at least saves the fascination of Sherlock Holmes-like intrigue in the Middle Ages. More, honestly, could not be expected. Refined interpretation of Sean Connery.
cast: Sean Connery, F. Murray Abraham, Christian Slater, Michael Lonsdale, Valentina Vargas

title: Il nostro Rwanda
synopsis: In November 2005, a group of Roman students, after having raised the funds for a school and an aqueduct, crossed Rwanda together with Walter Veltroni.
cast: Luca Bergamo, Placidie Chaima, Cristina Comencini, Paul Kagame, Francesca Pasquini, Jean Léonard Touadi, Walter Veltroni

title: Il nostro generale
synopsis: The story of how General Carlo Alberto Dalla Chiesa led, in the 70s, his fight against the Red Brigades. From the Church he created the special anti -terrorism nucleus, a team chosen by young carabinieri who acted with innovative methods for the time. The clash was interpreted as a real war in defense of democracy, which saw the clandestine revolutionaries, ruthless and idealists opposed on the one hand and on the other the group at the service of the state arising from the Dalla Chiesa initiative.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Antonio Folletto, Teresa Saponangelo, Ascanio Balbo, Eleonora Romandini, Gianpiero Pumo, Flavio Furno, Alessandro Fiorucci, Carlo Tozzi

title: Il nostro matrimonio è in crisi
synopsis: On the same day in which he gets married, in the house that should host him and Alice for the rest of their lives, Antonio finds himself rejected by his wife still dressed in white. Packed up, Alice leaves, leaving the newlyweds alone. Antonio has nothing left to do but seek his ego by entrusting himself to the care of the "master" Makerbek.
cast: Antonio Albanese, Aisha Cerami, Shel Shapiro, Dino Abbrescia

title: Il nostro papa
synopsis: "I too am the son of migrants", says Pope Francis. With an attentive eye to current events and the increasingly pressing issue of immigration, the Pope himself repeatedly urges us to reflect on the significance of the phenomenon and on the more constructive approach that should be taken towards it. We would not even have Pope Bergoglio himself, if immigration to Argentina, at one time, had not treated Italians with respect and proactiveness. Starting from Piedmont, Pope Francis' grandparents and father moved to the port of Genoa to escape fascism and embark in the direction of Buenos Aires. But the ocean liner that they were supposed to take, and for which they had already bought tickets, Princess Mafalda, was the subject of the greatest Italian naval disaster ever, and killed all its passengers. The strange coincidence was exactly what the Bergoglio family wanted, held back by a mishap and unable to take that same ship at the last second.
cast: Iago Garcia, Manuela Fernández Vivian, Guillermo Auterio, Marcelo Saltal, Papa Francesco

title: Il padre d'Italia
synopsis: Paolo is 30 years old and leads a solitary life, almost wanting to hide from the world. His past is marked by a pain that he cannot overcome. One night, by pure chance, he meets Mia, a bursting and problematic girl of the same age in the sixth month of pregnancy, who turns her life upside down. Driven by the desire to take her back home, Paolo begins a journey by his side that will lead both to cross Italy and discover their irrepressible desire to live.
cast: Luca Marinelli, Isabella Ragonese, Anna Ferruzzo, Mario Sgueglia, Federica De Cola, Miriam Karlkvist, Esther Elisha, Sara Putignano, Filippo Gattuso, Franca Maresa

title: Il padre delle spose
synopsis: Riccardo, an Apulian farmer with solid moral principles, is in Spain as a taster for an international olive oil competition. Having finished his work, before returning to his homeland he decides to visit his daughter Aurora, who to his immense chagrin has left her native land and has been living in Barcelona for some time. When he arrives at the girl's house, he meets his roommates: Rosaria, a separated woman, and her child. But behind the apparent "normality" of this coexistence, there is a secret that could be fatal for the "sound principles" of father Riccardo: Aurora and Rosaria not only have an affair, but they even got married ...
cast: Lino Banfi, Rosanna Banfi, Mapi Galán, Lucia Sardo, Carles Arquimbau, Virginia Barrett, Antonio Stornaiolo, Tiziana Schiavarelli, Vittorio Viviani, Gianni Ciardo

title: Il padre di famiglia
synopsis: Two young urban planners, Marco and Paola, meet in Rome in the early postwar years. They marry with the commitment to dedicate themselves to the defense of the city from architectural destruction. Although the agreements were not these, the two have four children in the world. The problems related to modern education force Paola to abandon her job and thus make a first renunciation. Over the years Marco, exhausted by family obligations, seeks escape with another woman.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Leslie Caron, Claudine Auger, Ugo Tognazzi, Mario Carotenuto, Antonella Della Porta, Evi Maltagliati, Marisa Solinas, Sergio Tofano, Elsa Vazzoler, Giampiero Albertini, Valerio Degli Abbati, Raoul Grassilli, Gino Pernice

title: Il padre e lo straniero
synopsis: Diego (Alessandro Gassman), a Roman employee with a disabled son, meets Walid (Amr Waked), a very wealthy Syrian businessman who is also the father of a severely handicapped child. From the same suffering an unusual friendship arises and the two begin dating between Turkish baths, luxury shopping and a mysterious sister-in-law named Zaira. Together they go on a private flight to Syria to discover the piece of land Walid bought for his little son. Upon returning from that strange lightning-travel, the pain that prevented Diego and his wife (Ksenia Rappaport) from regaining their passion slowly vanishes, just as the mysterious Walid disappears chased by suspicion of terrorism. Followed by the secret services, in a suffocating and ambiguous Rome, Diego sets out in search of the man and instead discovers a shocking, moving, truth
cast: Amr Waked, Alessandro Gassmann, Nadine Labaki, Ksenia Rappoport, Leo Gullotta, Giorgio Gobbi, Matteo Reza Azchirvani, Mohamed Zouaoui, Lia Gotti, Leonardo Della Bianca

title: Il padrone e l'operaio
synopsis: Gianluca Tosi, owner of a faucet factory, is at the fruit: the management of the company is an overwhelming task, his wife and lover have exhausted him and drained him of energy. One of his workers, Luigi Carminati, is instead a fury: a monster of sexual vigor who has enormous success with women. Gianluca realizes this and embarks on a half friendship full of envy with him that will soon turn into a fierce confrontation, until he comes close to the exchange of roles.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Teo Teocoli, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Loris Zanchi, Walter Valdi

title: Il padrone sono me!
synopsis: Robertino, the American cousin Dolly and Zvanì, the farmer's son, spend their holidays in a country villa. Years pass and love grows between the two cousins ??...
cast: Myriam Bru, Paolo Stoppa, Pierre Bertin, Andreina Pagnani, Assunta Radico, Albino Cocco

title: Il paese del sesso selvaggio
synopsis: A fugitive flees to the Indochina forest to lose his tracks. Here he collides with a primitive tribe who, after having taken him prisoner, forces him to stay in place by marrying the chief's daughter.
cast: Ivan Rassimov, Me Me Lai, Prasitsak Singhara, Sulallewan Suxantat, Ong Ard, Prapas Chindang, Pipop Pupinyo, Tuan Tevan, Chit, Choi

title: Il paese delle persone integre
synopsis: In October 2014, the events in Ougadougou led to the fall of the dictator, after 27 years of power, with a coup d'état that would above all have the purpose of making the Burkina Faso resume in his hand the control of his economic development. During 2015, however, this change is difficult to happen, because - despite the first free vote in the history of the country - foreign companies continue to exploit its resources exactly the same way. In this context, which also makes the country also a fertile ground for the advancement of Al Qaeda and Isis, we follow a year of the director's life together with four inhabitants of Ougadougou: a revolutionary musician, a candidate engineer in the elections, a politically miner engaged and unemployed, a family mother who fights with poverty.

title: Il paese delle spose infelici
synopsis: In a small town in southern Italy, between disused ravines that have become the symbol of unhappy brides who try to end their lives there, the smoke of a factory that poisons the air and the rise of a local politician (interested more to his own pockets than to the well-being of his fellow citizens), the friendship of the two teenagers Veleno and Zazà, different from each other but companions in a local soccer team, is revolutionized by the meeting with Annalisa (Aylin Prandi), a wild girl with a painful past, about which the worst things are rumored and which both will inevitably fall in love with.
cast: Aylin Prandi, Nicholas Orzella, Luca Schipani, Rolando Ravello, Teresa Saponangelo, Nicola Rignanese, Valentina Carnelutti, Antonio Gerardi

title: Il paese dove gli alberi volano - Eugenio Barba e i giorni dell'Odin
synopsis: Fifty years have passed since Eugenio Barba founded the Odin Teatret research company in Scandinavia. In the summer of 2014, his past and future are celebrated in a large party-show in the small Danish town of Holstebro where the company has been residing for half a century. An unpublished portrait of Eugenio Barba emerges in a visionary atmosphere, no longer struggling with the staging of a show, but with the embodiment of the project of a life in an imaginary and evolving community. Teenagers and adults, actors, musicians, dancers, spectators and flying trees are part of the great experiment of Eugenio Barba who, behind the disorienting energy, aims straight at the construction of a unique, fragile and unrepeatable event.

title: Il palazzo
synopsis: In the heart of Rome a building stands. The owner, like a Renaissance patron, over the years has offered asylum to an eclectic community of friends, transforming his home into the perfect hiding place to cultivate artistic projects. Today fifty-year-olds, the ex-condoms meet following the premature death of the most emblematic of the group, Mauro, a visionary director who has never finished a film in his life. Mauro leaves an inheritance: hours of movies in which he directs the inhabitants of that community in the most extravagant roles, accomplices of an unfinished masterpiece. The vigil for his death awakens the memoirs of the time he was, shaking the downtown spirit of the group, in this grotesque novel of training out of time.
cast: Mauro Fagioli, Corrado Puccetti, Andrea Sanguigni, Alessandra Tosetto, Roberto De Francesco, Tiziana Della Rocca, Francesca Duscià, Simone Vricella, Virginia Zulli

title: Il papa buono
synopsis: Since the years in which he enters the seminary in Bergamo, Angelo Roncalli has shown that he has all the necessary characteristics that will help him from 1958 to 1963, during 5 short but intense years of pontificate under the name of John XXIII, to be remembered as the Good Pope . With humility and frankness, as a young man he learned to face enemies much greater than himself, such as Nazism, capitalism and the Cold War, putting himself on the side of the weakest and offering himself as a spiritual guide even in the darkest moments.
cast: Bob Hoskins, Carlo Cecchi, Roberto Citran, Fabrizio Vidale, Sergio Bini Bustric, Francesco Venditti, Rolando Ravello, John Light, Francesco Carnelutti, Lena Lessing

title: Il papà di Giovanna
synopsis: Bologna, 1930s: Michele, a failed painter, had to settle for a gray routine as a high school teacher. To redeem his frustrations and a worn-out marriage, he decided to invest everything in the role of father, to ensure an education and a future for his daughter Giovanna. And when the mentally unstable girl carries out an absurd and unpredictable murder, only he will remain close to her ...
cast: Silvio Orlando, Alba Rohrwacher, Francesca Neri, Ezio Greggio, Serena Grandi

title: Il paradiso del pavone
synopsis: On a winter day, Nena brings together the family in the house in front of the sea to celebrate her birthday. There are everyone: her husband Umberto, his sons Vito and Caterina with his cousin Isabella, the daughter -in -law Adelina and the former son -in -law Manfredi with her new girlfriend, Joana, her nephew Alma, the domestic Lucia with her daughter Grazia. And then there is Paco, Alma's peacock, which surprisingly falls in love with the doves painted in a picture of the living room: an impossible love that will question the feelings of the whole family.
cast: Dominique Sanda, Alba Rohrwacher, Maya Sansa, Carlo Cerciello, Fabrizio Ferracane, Leonardo Lidi, Tihana Lazovic, Yile Yara Vianello, Ludovica Alvazzi Del Frate, Carolina Michelangeli, Maddalena Crippa

title: Il partigiano Johnny
synopsis: After 8 September Johnny, a student of English literature, returns to Alba. Since he is a deserter he is forced to hide in a small house near the city. Johnny is convinced of the need to fight fascism, he just doesn't know how and, above all, with whom. His Anglophile background does not allow him to join the nascent communist gangs. Johnny leaves alone for the hills of the Langhe and joins the first group he meets. In a short time Johnny learns that the life of the partisan is not all that romantic ...
cast: Stefano Dionisi, Fabrizio Gifuni, Andrea Prodan, Chiara Muti, Claudio Amendola

title: Il passaggio della linea
synopsis: The documentary is a "journey" along Italy cadenced by the rhythm of long -distance expressed trains, long abandoned to a destiny of slow degradation, which cross the peninsula from south to north and vice versa, in a path that goes from night to night morning. A rundown of landscapes, architectures, faces, dialects and voices, lives that mix in a single body aboard the trains. Within the lifelines, the lives of passengers intertwine that often speak different languages ​​and bring distant stories with them. These are mostly commuters traveling to the North, young, foreigners, employed in precarious jobs, accustomed to traveling long distances using the most modest and accessible among the means of transport. Outside, besides the dirty and small windows, landscapes sometimes painfully marked by man's intervention follow one another, sometimes intact in their overbearing beauty. Inside, the weather is marked only by the varying of the light that illuminates the narrow corridors and reveals often tired and absorbed faces. Locked up in a space that is a meeting place and solitude, the life of those who travel appears as suspended, in a time outside the existence where everything still seems possible, in a continuous tension between past and future, between what it is State and what he has to come.
cast: Arturo Nicolodi, Ciro Esposito, Pasquale Ottaviano, Daniele Luongo, Gennaro Gotti, Rezcui Zouhair, Nicola Cutolo, Alfonso D'Avanzo, Abderraouf Fgaier, Francesco Grazioso

title: Il passato è una terra straniera
synopsis: Giorgio is the boy that every family would like to have. He's fine at university, he doesn't give any problems whatsoever and his future seems well designed. Then one evening he meets Francesco, a peer of his age who doesn't look like him at all, who goes to bad places and bad company and who gambles and cheats for a living. Giorgio is immediately attracted to them and a deep friendship is born between the two. The two thus begin to spend a lot of time together and Giorgio becomes in all respects an accomplice of Francesco, starting a path towards perdition.
cast: Elio Germano, Chiara Caselli, Michele Riondino, Valentina Lodovini, Daniela Poggi, Marco Baliani, Romina Carrisi Jr., Lorenza Indovina, María Jurado

title: Il pasticciere
synopsis: Achille Franzi (Antonio Catania) is a good and pure man, with a simple and honest character, passionate about his job as an artisan pastry chef, from which he stole secrets and recipes by observing his father (Emilio Solfrizzi) as a child. Thanks to the perfection of his sweets he hopes to make people happy but he doesn't know how much evil lurks outside the laboratory, inherited from his parent. However, his quiet life takes a different turn when he accidentally witnesses a murder, committed by an unscrupulous financier (Antonio Stornaiolo), starting a journey that leads him to leave Salento to go beyond the borders of Italy, where a very scrupulous commissioner police woman (Sara D'Amario) is investigating a deep mystery, and being sidetracked by the encounter with a woman with a difficult past (Rosalia Russo), dedicated to the slimy lawyer she accompanies (Ennio Fantastichini).
cast: Antonio Catania, Maria Rosaria Russo, Ennio Fantastichini, Sara D'Amario, Ivan Zerbinati, Antonio Stornaiolo, Silvana Bosi, Emilio Solfrizzi

title: Il pataffio
synopsis: In a Middle Ages full of hunger and famine, we strange characters such as Marconte Cagalanza, Marcontess Bernarda, fat and discontent, in a completely unfortunate and approximate court, with rusty and hungry soldiers and the most hungry peasants still. Hunger is never an end and unites peasants and ramshackle gentlemen.
