cast: Lino Musella, Giorgio Tirabassi, Viviana Cangiano, Giovanni Ludeno, Vincenzo Nemolato, Alessandro Gassmann, Valerio Mastandrea

title: Il pavone nero
synopsis: Dominican Republic, 1973. An Italian engineer (Chris Avram) comes from Milan to replace the mysteriously disappeared colleague while inspecting the construction of a dam. He travels with him Moglia Laura (Karin Schubert). Shortly afterwards, however, the two begin to be involved in the mysterious voodoo rites that are practiced on the island, led by Balaga (Don Powell), a wizard against the construction of the dam.
cast: Karin Schubert, Chris Avram, Don Powell, Franco Ressel, Luigi Angelillo

title: Il peccato degli anni verdi
synopsis: A rich playboy seduces a high school girl on vacation and cynically abandons her. Except that she is pregnant, and decides to ask the unrepentant seducer a sum as "compensation" for physical and moral damages. He is startled, then thinks about it again, maybe he really falls in love, maybe it's too late ...
cast: Alida Valli, Marie Versini, Corrado Pani, Maurice Ronet, Raffaella Pelloni

title: Il peccato di Lola
synopsis: Busty housekeeper Lola tries in every way to seduce teen Albert. When the boy finally lets himself go, a whirlwind of troubles begins for him, leading to tragedy.
cast: Peter Bomm, Scott Coffey, Donatella Damiani, Sandra Mantegna, Maurice Poli, Jacques Stany, Gabriele Tinti

title: Il peggio di noi
synopsis: A long monologue, accompanied by images of the casting, rehearsal and filming of _Palabras_ by Salani himself, in which the author puts the leading actress and the whole crew at a standstill. Guilty of not having understood the profound value that those moments had for him and the intense artistic and personal relationship that bound him to the interpreter, the collaborators turned the woman away from him.
cast: Corso Salani, Paloma Calle

title: Il peggior Natale della mia vita
synopsis: Paolo (Fabio De Luigi) and Margherita (Cristiana Capotondi) are expecting their first child. The pregnancy has almost come to an end when they decide to spend the Christmas holidays in a mountain castle, guests together with Giorgio (Antonio Catania) and Clara (Anna Bonaiuto), the parents of Margherita, of Alberto Caccia (Diego Abatantuono), the head of Giorgio, and his daughter Benedetta (Laura Chiatti), also pregnant. Despite the marriage, however, Paolo has not lost his devastating fury and what was supposed to be a peaceful vacation turns into a succession of troubles and misadventures, aggravated by an unexpected snowstorm.
cast: Fabio De Luigi, Cristiana Capotondi, Antonio Catania, Diego Abatantuono, Anna Bonaiuto, Laura Chiatti, Dino Abbrescia, Alessandro Besentini, Francesco Villa

title: Il pentito
synopsis: The mafioso Vanni Ragusa, belonging to one of the losing clans, having seen his son and brother killed, decides to collaborate with a magistrate. Even among the robes, however, there is no shortage of corrupt and colluding with the winning clans so that the danger looms more than before. This story is intertwined with that of the crack of the financier Spinola, in turn linked to the mafia whose capital he "cleans up".
cast: Franco Nero, Tony Musante, Max Von Sydow, Eric Estrada

title: Il perchè e il percome: colloqui sulla tossicodipendenza
synopsis: A series of touching interviews with interviews with guests of the recovery community for Villa Maraini drug addicts in Rome.

title: Il permesso - 48 ore fuori
synopsis: Four inmates, three men and one woman, are granted a 48-hour release permit from the prison by the Supervisory Judge. Luigi, fifty years old, convicted of double murder is tired and seeks peace, he will find the strength to act only thanks to the desire to give his son a different life. Donato, 35, is an innocent convict and is serving his sentence to cover up the real culprit. Anger will lead him to seek revenge against those who forced him to prison and distance from the woman he loves. Rossana, 25, daughter of a diplomat, arrested for international drug trafficking. She has never adapted to a life already designed. Her rebellion led her to the opposite of what her family wanted for her. Angelo, about 25 years old, is a village boy convicted of robbery, he studies in prison and tries to build a new life for himself driven by the desire to win back his ex-girlfriend.
cast: Claudio Amendola, Luca Argentero, Giacomo Ferrara, Valentina Bellè, Ivan Franek, Antonino Luorio, Valentina Sperlì, Alessandra Roca, Simone Liberati, Massimo De Santis, Silvia Degrandi, Stefano Rabatti, Andrea Carpenzano

title: Il pescatore di Posillipo - Piscatore 'e Pusilleco
synopsis: Salvatore is a young and honest fisherman with a pleasant voice. When Commendatore Morelli has the fishermen's boats confiscated to claim a debt, Salvatore, who is unemployed, is hired by a magazine company as a singer. In the meantime, Maria too, harassed by her sister's lover, is forced to abandon her birthplace.
cast: Giacomo Rondinella, Cristina Grado, Otello Toso, Beniamino Maggio

title: Il pesce innamorato
synopsis: Arturo has been writing short stories for children since he was ten. Now, at the age of thirty, he meets the daughter of a publisher who decides to publish "The Fish in Love", a story he had written as a child. Success comes lightning fast and for Arturo nothing is the same as before. In a luxurious hotel he meets Matilde and love at first sight is immediate.
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Yamila Diaz, Paolo Hendel, Gabriella Pession

title: Il pesce siluro è innocente - Per soli uomini
synopsis: Two films in one for an unpublished portrait of the Po and its people. In The catfish is innocent we meet two consummate eel fishermen in the Goro bag and a man dedicated to the collection of clams and mussels. Lives that take place along the Po, following its rhythm and seasons. But something is irretrievably lost. In For men only, three men engaged in fish farming resist in a corner of the world located along the Po di Maistra, in the extreme Po Delta, in one of the last fishing valleys.

title: Il peso dell'aria
synopsis: Anguished by the uncertainties of a precarious work, Carlo becomes a prey to an ambiguous financier who, leveraging his naivety, offers him an unexpected economic help. Carlo accepts, but he does not take much to understand that he has fallen into the trap of an unscrupulous usurer. Needless to escape and try to lose their tracks: the heavy threats and humiliations inflicted on his family will force him to commit an extreme gesture.
cast: Brunella De Nardo, Giampiero Lisarelli, Stefano Calvagna, Corinne Cléry, Claudio Angelini, Cinzia Mascoli, Francesca Antonelli, Crisula Stafida, Vincenzo Crocitti, Letizia Letza

title: Il petomane
synopsis: Joseph Pujol performs in a Parisian club enjoying great success thanks to his versatility in the emission of farts, accompanied by an orchestra composed of his five children. When one of them leaves the complex, Pujol organizes an audition to replace him. So he meets Catherine, and love is born between the two. It will be a very troubled story.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Mariangela Melato, Vittorio Caprioli, Ricky Tognazzi

title: Il pezzo mancante
synopsis: The social, economic and financial history of the city of Turin and of Italy itself inevitably intersects with the history of the automobile industry of Fiat and of the Agnelli dynasty, governed by a sense of duty and by rules (written and implicit) aligned with thought by Gianni Agnelli. Retracing the life of the lawyer, who died in 2003, the documentary focuses on the mysterious disappearance of his brother Giorgio, which took place in Switzerland in 1965, and on the suicide of his son Edoardo, found in the Cuneo countryside in 2000.

title: Il piacere
cast: Lilli Carati, Isabella Andrea Guzon, Steve Wyler, Laura Gemser, Dagmar Lassander

title: Il pianeta azzurro
synopsis: A journey into nature and man, in a small patch of land in the morainic hills of Lake Garda. It starts from the thaw and follows the evolution of a drop of water, you hear the sound of rain and the sprouting of a new life. The land is worked, men and women chase each other in the sun and then the frost returns, closing the cycle of the seasons. Piavoli has made his masterpiece with this film: a documentary that turns into a work of high poetry. Without a line of dialogue, without false music, even the sound is solely entrusted to the thousand, extraordinary "voices" of nature. And to think that someone shouted the news for "Microcosmos".

title: Il pianeta degli uomini spenti
synopsis: The Earth is threatened by the approach of a planet, operated by an alien computer. A fleet of flying saucers tries to annihilate human spaceships.
cast: Claude Rains, Bill Carter, Umberto Orsini, Maya Brent, Giuliano Gemma, Renzo Palmer, Carlo D'Angelo, Carol Danell, Jim Dolen, Joe Pollini

title: Il pianeta errante
synopsis: Planet Earth is rocked by a series of earthquakes and cataclysms. The cause seems to be a planet that has come out of its orbit and is headed unstoppably towards the globe. A space expedition is tasked with stopping the asteroid. The astronauts will have to land on its surface and penetrate inside to detonate an antimatter capsule and destroy it.
cast: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Ombretta Colli, Enzo Fiermonte, Halina Zalewska, Goffredo Unger, Pietro Martellanza, John Bartha, Marco Bogliani, Vera Dolen, Renato Montalbano

title: Il pianeta in mare
synopsis: In the second post-war Italy, Italy came out of poverty thanks to industrial development, which gave the country dreams and wounds. Today Italy is experiencing a profound economic crisis; what remains of that story? To understand this, Andrea Segre entered the heart of Marghera, the industrial area of ??Venice, one of the largest and most decayed in the country, a space of great aesthetic charm suspended between land and lagoon, where progress has often offended nature. Following the lives of workers, managers, truck drivers and the cook of the last restaurant in the area, the film tries to understand what is left of that great dream, now immersed in the global flow of the economy and migration.

title: Il piatto piange
synopsis: In Luino, in the Fascist period, the town is dozing and neither the squadriste bravado nor the desire to have fun of a small group of bulls can create the slightest confusion. On the other hand, the main personalities of the city find themselves in the clandestine gambling den managed by Berzi. The gambling den becomes the context in which the pettiness of individuals emerge.
cast: Aldo Maccione, Agostina Belli, Andréa Ferréol, Erminio Macario

title: Il piccolo Archimede
synopsis: An English scholar, an admirer of Dante, Leonardo and Giotto, in the Florence of the 1930s believes he has discovered a genius in a seven-year-old boy. Between cowardice, craving for possession and frustrations, little Archimedes will choose death. Based on a short story by Aldous Huxley, a film that explores the margin between culture and life, in a painful investigation of childhood that confirmed Amelio's extraordinary directorial awareness.
cast: John Steiner, Aldo Salvi, Shirley Carrigan, Laura Betti

title: Il piccolo diavolo
synopsis: An American priest, Maurizio (Matthau), is called to exorcise an elderly hairdresser named Giuditta. During the exorcism a little devil (Benigni) emerges from the woman's body, claiming to be Giuditta. A series of troubles begins for poor Maurizio, because the little devil sticks to him like a shadow. To justify his cumbersome presence, Maurizio decides to pass him off as his own nephew. But the poor priest's patience has a limit so, when the little devil falls in love with Nina (Braschi) and neglects him, Maurizio finally believes he has regained tranquility. But Nina is a she-devil sent to Earth to bring the fugitive home. The script is a canvas, the dead times are numerous, Matthau is not at ease. But the film obviously applies to the moments in which Benigni is freewheeling.
cast: Roberto Benigni, Walter Matthau, Stefania Sandrelli, Nicoletta Braschi

title: Il piccolo vetraio
synopsis: We are in 1815, in an unspecified village in Southern Italy. Pietro and Nino, two very poor boys, are sent by their father to work in France, employed by a greedy and sadistic glassmaker who mistreats his subjects making them almost slaves. The two boys manage to escape, but the younger dies of starvation. The return of Napoleon from the exile of Elba and a noble protector known in fortunate circumstances, allow them to return home.
cast: Massimo Serato, Balpêtré, Lionello Carrel

title: Il pirata - Marco Pantani
synopsis: The determination of the cyclist Marco Pantani leads him to win the Giro d'Italia and (the only Italian) the Tour de France, and also to overcome serious accidents. In 1999 he was certified with a hematocrit value beyond the permitted threshold: he began a descent that led him to depression and death from drugs.
cast: Rolando Ravello, Nicoletta Romanoff, Ivano Marescotti, Franco Mescolini, Omero Antonutti, Gianni Minà, Felice Gimondi, Gianfelice Facchetti, Massimiliano Franciosa, Solveyg D'Assunta

title: Il pirata del diavolo
synopsis: The bitter struggle between Marco Trevisan and the Turk Rabenek known by all as "the devil's pirate" in an imaginary city of Venetian rule temporarily occupied by privateers. After the first defeats, Marco manages to prevail thanks also to the decisive help of a woman, the daughter of a Turkish leader. The final showdown will be terrible and the "happy ending" is behind the door.
cast: Richard Harrison, Paolo Solvay, Walter Brandy, Annamaria Ubaldi

title: Il pirata sono io!
synopsis: In Santa Cruz, an island in the Caribbean, the Viceroy organizes a fake pirate raid just before the real ones arrive. A shy schoolmaster solves the situation. Erminio Macario in a production that was made problematic by the French bombing. Italy had just entered the war. The parody is light, with some flavor of the vintage variety.
cast: Erminio Macario, Dora Bini, Juan De Landa

title: Il pistolero dell'Ave Maria
synopsis: General Carrasco, returned home after fighting in the war, is killed by Thomas, a gunfighter who, taking advantage of his absence, took his wife Anna away from him. The murder was witnessed by Sebastian and Isabelle, the two sons of the general. The two, aided by the faithful nurse, managed to escape the murder. Years pass and brother and sister, now adults, decide that the time has come to take revenge.
cast: Leonard Mann, Luciana Paluzzi, Silvana Bacci, Enzo Fiermonte

title: Il pistolero segnato da Dio
synopsis: Gary is a skilled circus gunslinger who, however, a childhood trauma made him unable to cope with any violent situation. Fate puts him on the path of a boy who is the victim of the oppression of some ruthless outlaws. It won't be easy, but the sight of the boy being beaten will finally shake Gary's numbness. Mediocre film that wearily traces the canons of the spaghetti-western genre.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Richard Wyler, Ken Wood, Liz Barrett, Marco Stefanelli

title: Il più bel giorno della mia vita
synopsis: A family finds itself in a large villa on the outskirts of Rome. Around the head of the family, Irene, various more or less happy experiences of love meet. There is his daughter Sara, widowed and unable to live love again. Rita, on the other hand, is a perfect mother and a frustrated wife. And Claudio, who still doesn't know how to reveal his homosexuality.
cast: Virna Lisi, Margherita Buy, Sandra Ceccarelli, Luigi Lo Cascio, Marco Baliani, Marco Quaglia, Jean Hugues Anglade, Ricky Tognazzi, Gaia Conforzi, Francesco Scianna, Francesca Perini, Maria Luisa De Crescenzo, Andrea Sama, Giulio Squillacciotti

title: Il più bel secolo della mia vita
synopsis: Due to an absurd law Giovanni cannot know the identity of his biological parents before having turned one hundred years. To try to attract the attention of public opinion, he does everything to obtain Gustavo's complicity, the only centenary who, like him, has not been recognized at birth. But Gustavo does not collaborate.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Valerio Lundini, Carla Signoris, Antonio Zavatteri, Elena Lander, Marzio El Moety, Betti Pedrazzi, Sandra Milo

title: Il più comico spettacolo del mondo
synopsis: Tottons is a clown who works in a big circus. A terrible secret forces him to always keep his makeup on and makes him a slave to his impresario. His life is also complicated by the amorazzi he has in progress with the elephant tamer, with the trapeze artist, with the playmaker. Moreover, he must beware of the lion tamer and the acrobat, his partners in the show. Forced to dial the wild beasts, he is also seen chased by a real policeman. Parody of De Mille's "Greatest Show in the World", it is not one of Totò's best films but has at least a couple of classic numbers taken from his magazines (the mannequin, the masseur, the tamer). The serious "prayer" that shows the sadness of being a clown is a little out of place. Among the audience we can see Aldo Fabrizi, Peppino De Filippo, Silvana Mangano, Anthony Qiunn and others. Shot in 3D and in color with the photography of Karl Struss, Chaplin's operator.
cast: Totò, May Britt, Franca Faldini, Marc Lawrence, Tania Weber

title: Il più grande sogno
synopsis: Mirko, a Roman criminal who at 39 realizes that he has a "future to fill" in front of him, for himself and his family, possibly in an honest way, suddenly is elected President of the neighborhood committee with 77 % of votes. Life for Mirko changes radically. Irrationally, he pursues the dream of another existence for himself and for his township: no more dealing, no more violence, no more indifference, now there is a need to create a united community on the principle of mutual aid. We need to make the soup kitchen work for the poor and build a vegetable garden where ex-prisoners like him work. This is his dream. A dream, however, difficult to manage. Especially if your father is a criminal with megalomaniacal dreams and if in your family you try to import yourself as the father of your two daughters who have always been ignored. And your past always stays there. An easy door, very easy to reopen.
cast: Mirko Frezza, Alessandro Borghi, Vittorio Viviani, Milena Mancini, Ivana Lotito, Ginevra De Carolis

title: Il plenilunio delle vergini
synopsis: An amulet that makes its owner master of the world is the object that Franz searches for in Dracula's castle. However, he ends up becoming a vampire too, while his twin brother Karl continues the research in other ways.
cast: Mark Damon, Rosalba Neri, Gengher Gatti, Sergio Pislar, Esmeralda Barros, Francesca Romana Davila

title: Il poliziotto è marcio
synopsis: Domenico Malacarne is a corrupt commissioner. Together with his accomplice, the agent Garrito, he does business with a mafia gang devoted mainly to smuggling. However, when the criminal group asks him for coverage for arms trafficking, the commissioner decides to change his attitude and fight the criminals. The revenge of the mafia is not long in coming as his former accomplice Garrito decides to eliminate him to take his place.
cast: Luc Merenda, Richard Conte, Delia Boccardo, Vittorio Caprioli, Salvo Randone, Raymond Pellegrin, Gianni Santuccio, Rosario Borelli, Monica Monet, Gino Milli, Elio Zamuto, Loris Bazzocchi, Marcello Di Falco, Massimo Sarchielli, Marisa Traversi

title: Il pomicione
synopsis: Raffaele, Roman who lives in Trento, is married to Liliana who does not give him satisfactions. To let off steam he stretches his hands on the passenger buses.
cast: Francesco Mulè, Rosalba Neri, Gabriella Lepori, Venantino Venantini

title: Il ponte dei sospiri
synopsis: A captain of the Serenissima escapes from the Piombi and leaves for the war against the Turks ...
cast: Paola Barbara, Otello Toso, Mariella Lotti, Giulio Donadio, Elli Parvo, Virgilio Riento, Erminio Spalla, Adele Garavaglia, Giorgio Capecchi, Giacomo Moschini

title: Il porno shop della settima strada
synopsis: Two inexperienced robbers make a heist in a mafia-protected shop. They do not have time to take refuge in a country villa, taking the inhabitants hostage, that the boss's henchmen are already ready for the showdown.
cast: Annamaria Clementi, Brigitte Petronio, Maxmilian Vhener, Ernesto Colli, Peter Outlaw, Christian Borromeo

title: Il portaborse
synopsis: Luciano Sandulli, professor of literature, rounds off by writing books and articles for an author in crisis. One day he is summoned to Rome by Minister Botero, who hires him to write speeches and interventions. Sandulli hesitates, advised against by his girlfriend, but then accepts. After the first moment of infatuation with the environment and the boss, however, he realizes that Botero is a vulgar and unscrupulous politician, dedicated only to the cult of power. He will know how to abandon it and find his dignity again. A "premonitory" film, which gives Luchetti, Rulli and Petraglia (screenwriters) and Moretti the opportunity to brilliantly show us the hidden face of politics. Although a bit simple in its solutions and with an uncertain direction, it is a courageous and at times acute film.
cast: Nanni Moretti, Silvio Orlando, Angela Finocchiaro, Giulio Brogi

title: Il portiere di notte
synopsis: Vienna, 1957: a former SS officer is now a night porter in a hotel; unlike many veterans, he has a strong guilt complex for his past actions. One day he meets Lucia, a Jew who was imprisoned in her concentration camp and is now persecuted as an uncomfortable witness: a perverse erotic relationship arises between the two that culminates in tragedy ...
cast: Charlotte Rampling, Dirk Bogarde, Philippe Leroy, Gabriele Ferzetti

title: Il postino
synopsis: Mario, a postman from a small island in southern Italy where the exiled Chilean poet Pablo Neruda comes to live, establishes a friendship with him that initiates him into the fascinating secrets of poetry. Thanks also to this, Mario manages to marry Beatrice, then Neruda leaves and seems to forget his Italian friend. Who will be "beaten" to death during a political rally and will leave a son named Pablito.
cast: Massimo Troisi, Philippe Noiret, Maria Grazia Cucinotta

title: Il posto dell'anima
synopsis: Campolaro: Carair, an American multinational tire manufacturer, announces the imminent closure and consequent dismissal of all workers. The factory is occupied, an Internet site is born, the case acquires national resonance. The workers attempt an extreme gesture and travel to the Carair world headquarters to reach an agreement for a restructuring plan. Meanwhile, their existence continues: Antonio dreams of returning to live in his country of origin with Nina, his partner who now works in Milan; Salvatore, a trade unionist, has a conflictual relationship with his unemployed son; Mario seeks an alternative way to the factory by starting a production of fresh pasta with the wives of some of his companions ...
cast: Silvio Orlando, Michele Placido, Claudio Santamaria, Paola Cortellesi, Imma Piro, Flavio Pistilli, Maria Laura Rondanini

title: Il potere
synopsis: Times change but the cruel form of power management remains unchanged. Starting from this thesis, Augusto Tretti analyzes the control system of power in five different historical moments: the stone age, the Roman empire, the colonization of the West, the birth of fascism, and the modern context. Almost a documentary made with few means.
cast: Paola Tosi, Massimo Compostrini, Ferruccio Maliga

title: Il pranzo della domenica
synopsis: The life of Franca Malorni, an exponent of the Roman good bourgeoisie, suddenly changes when her husband (an established marriage lawyer) dies. Her attentions are thus poured out on her three daughters, all married, who are obliged every Sunday to go to her house for lunch with their respective families. One day, Franca falls and breaks her thigh bone. During his long and tiring hospitalization, the disagreements and disagreements that characterize three couples very different in terms of wealth, political ideas and ways of living that until now have hidden behind the facade of a perfect and happy family emerge.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Maurizio Mattioli, Barbara De Rossi, Elena Sofia Ricci, Galatea Ranzi, Giovanna Ralli, Rocco Papaleo

title: Il prato
cast: Michele Placido, Isabella Rossellini, Saverio Marconi, Giulio Brogi

title: Il prato macchiato di rosso
synopsis: Despite the disapproval of his wife Nina, professor Antonio Genovese often hosts young vagabonds and hippies in his luxurious villa in the Piacenza countryside. Behind the placid appearance, Genovese hides the intent to recover blood to be sold to the highest bidders, hiding a diabolical bloodletting device in the cellar. Suspicious, a United Nations agent begins to investigate.
cast: Enzo Tarascio, Marina Malfatti, Nino Castelnuovo, Claudio Biava, Dominique Boschero, Daniela Caroli, Lucio Dalla, Barbara Marzano, George Willing

title: Il prefetto di ferro
synopsis: Prefect Cesare Mori arrived in Palermo towards the end of the 1920s, with a reputation for inflexibility. During his mandate he proved his qualities, putting the local mafia organization on the ropes. However, when he discovers the decisive evidence that leads straight to Rome, to the federal fascist Galli, he is exonerated, elected senator and replaced by the very person he was about to indict.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Stefano Satta Flores, Francisco Rabal

title: Il premio
synopsis: The writer Giovanni Passamonte receives the Nobel Prize for Literature but has to go to Stockholm to collect it. Due to his uncontrollable fear of flying, Giovanni decides to leave by car accompanied by the strange assistant Rinaldo and his two children, Oreste (owner of a gym) and Lucrezia (compulsive and inconclusive blogger). Along the way, the group will meet curious characters and experience unexpected adventures, which will question family dynamics.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Alessandro Gassmann, Rocco Papaleo, Anna Foglietta, Matilda De Angelis, Marco Zitelli, Andrea Jonasson, Erika Blanc, Elettra Mallaby

title: Il presidente del Borgorosso Football Club
synopsis: Benito (Sordi), an obscure Vatican employee, inherits the Borgorosso team from his father, a winemaker. At first, his interest in the team is low. But, after several defeats, Benito takes matters into his own hands, replaces the coach personally, hires a "magician" of the South American football and wins back the fans. Written, performed and over-performed by Sordi, it is one of those films that lack air. Sure, he knows how to fill the scene, how to make himself nice, and he gets a lot of the right moves, but he eats the movie.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Margarita Lozano, Tina Lattanzi, Omar Sivori

title: Il prete bello
synopsis: It is the story of two friends, Sergio and Cena, who live in a popular neighborhood in Vicenza, and enter life with all their cheerful bravado, but through the wrong door. Don Gastone is the priest of the title, too much loved by the parish spinsters and the subject of scandal when he loses his head for the beautiful "professional" Fedora.
cast: Roberto Citran, Adriana Asti, Massimo Santella, David Torsello

title: Il pretore
synopsis: In the 1930s, Augusto Vanghetta divides himself between the profession of praetor in a small lakeside town, obtained thanks to the Mortara law, and his true passions: women and the theater. Not particularly attractive but sexually gifted, the praetor manages to attract women of all kinds while the relationship with his wife Evelina is now in crisis, so much so that the two now sleep in separate rooms. Intent on writing a play, to carry on his boring work and family practices, Vanghetta hires the young Mario Landriani, whose presence will end up distorting his life.
cast: Francesco Pannofino, Sarah Maestri, Mattia Zaccaro Garau, Eliana Miglio, Debora Caprioglio, Carlo Gabardini, Carlina Torta, Massimiliano Cavallari, Fabio Dossi, Eugenio Pigato

title: Il prezzo
synopsis: Romano, a former political militant, a former teacher who no longer wants to teach anyone anything, can't do without the bottle. Eight months after the end of their love story he asks Alba, an emerging photographer, to leave with him. With a broken liver and an uncertain future, Romano decided to go to the other side of the fence, into crime, involving (perhaps for revenge) the girl who hadn't believed in him.
cast: Stefano Dionisi, Chiara Caselli, Alessandro Repossi, Barbara Lerici

title: Il prezzo del potere
synopsis: President Garfield has big plans for the US but is killed in Dallas. They arrest an innocent, Willer, who escapes and discovers the real culprits. Romance on the case of J.F.K. in our own West. Disappointing, with Giuliano Gemma.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Warren Vanders, Maria Cuadra, Fernando Rey

title: Il prezzo della gloria
synopsis: During the last war the destroyer "Sagittario", returning from a long war mission, was once again used to transport fuel from Taranto to the North African coast. There is no bad blood between the very strict commander and the first officer, but when the captain is killed, the first officer will valiantly take his place until he too falls as a hero. Very modest film, both in terms of spectacularity and psychological definition of the characters. The direction is awkward, and the presence of actor Mike Bongiorno certainly does not raise the fortunes of the operation.
cast: Gabriele Ferzetti, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Pierre Cressoy, Mike Bongiorno

title: Il prigioniero di Santa Cruz
synopsis: A young woman wants to get married, but her father, who unintentionally killed the father of her future son-in-law years earlier, does not consent. The man's boss takes advantage of the situation to ask the girl to marry him. She is about to give in but her father, finally cleared of all charges, reunites the two lovers.
cast: Juan De Landa, Maria Mercader, Giuseppe Rinaldi, Carmen Navasqués, Enrico Glori, Amelia Chellini, Cesare Polacco, Giulio Donadio, Guglielmo Sinaz, Luis Gonzales

title: Il primo Natale
synopsis: Salvo lives in Palermo, a thief of sacred art, a convinced atheist. In Roccadimezzo Sicula, on the other hand, lives Father Valentino, a priest fascinated by the iconic power of the nativity scene. On the eve of the Christmas holidays, Salvo does not resist the temptation to appropriate a precious relic that is located in the church of the small village of Father Valentino. Discovered the theft, Father Valentino has no choice but to throw himself in the pursuit of the thief but, in doing so, by magic, or for whatever other reason, the two will find themselves catapulted into the Palestine of the year zero, a few days before. of the birth of Jesus.
cast: Salvo Ficarra, Valentino Picone, Massimo Popolizio, Roberta Mattei, Giacomo Mattia, Azelarab El Kaughat, Giovanni Calcagno, Hamdame Mohamed El Habib, Lalouz Maria, Massimo Cagnina, Giovanna Marchetti

title: Il primo Re
synopsis: Romulus and Remus are twins who live on the banks of the Tiber. Alone, in one the strength of the other, in an ancient and hostile world will challenge the implacable will of the Gods. From their blood a city will be born, Rome, the greatest empire that history remembers. Theirs will be a very strong bond, destined to become a legend.
cast: Alessandro Borghi, Alessio Lapice, Fabrizio Rongione, Massimiliano Rossi, Tania Garribba, Michael Schermi, Max Malatesta, Vincenzo Pirrotta, Vincenzo Crea, Lorenzo Gleijeses, Gabriel Montesi, Antonio Orlando, Florenzo Mattu, Martinus Tocchi

title: Il primo giorno d'inverno
synopsis: Valerio is a lonely teenager who looks at his peers with detachment. He has a sister a little younger than him, a battered scooter and two enemies who torment him. One day the case offers him the opportunity to fight with the same weapons as the two bullies, but the hypothetical equality will not spare him pain and despair.
cast: Lorenzo Pedrotti, Giuseppe Cederna, Mattia De Gasperis, Andrea Belletti, Fabio Chiovini, Alex Rogora, Michela Cova, Alberto Gerundo, Andrea Semeghini

title: Il primo giorno della mia vita
synopsis: A mature man who has lost his smile, two women exhausted by life and a boy are ready to put an end to their existence. However, the meeting with a mysterious man will rewrite their plans: the stranger will show them how the world will be like and without them.
cast: Toni Servillo, Sara Serraiocco, Margherita Buy, Valerio Mastandrea, Gabriele Cistini, Vittoria Puccini, Lino Guanciale, Giorgio Tirabassi, Lidia Vitale, Antonio Gerardi, Elena Lietti, Thomas Trabacchi, Davide Combusti

title: Il primo incarico
synopsis: 1953. Nena, a girl from South Italy, has to go to live away from home for her first job as a teacher. She is especially sorry because in her country she has an important love affair with a young man from the upper middle class who seems to sincerely reciprocate. He will find a remote school on a plateau, ungovernable kids, people with whom he has nothing in common, a hostile nature.
cast: Isabella Ragonese, Francesco Chiarello, Alberto Boll, Miriana Protopapa, Rita Schirinzi

title: Il principe abusivo
synopsis: Antonio (Alessandro Siani), a chronic penniless who lives in latch, finds himself in the presence of Letizia (Sarah Felberbaum), a spoiled princess in search of popularity, with whom he inevitably falls in love. In a world where the prejudices of the rich towards the poor are ingrained and difficult to eradicate, for the poor young man the only possibility to stay at court is to follow the advice of the chamberlain Anastasio (Christian De Sica). However, the roles between mentor and student are destined to reverse when Anastasio falls in love with Jessica (Serena Autieri), Antonio's cousin, and will need suggestions to mix with the people.
cast: Alessandro Siani, Christian De Sica, Sarah Felberbaum, Serena Autieri, Marco Messeri, Nello Iorio, Lello Musella, Salvatore Misticone, Alan Cappelli Goetz, Corrado Invernizzi

title: Il principe di Homburg
synopsis: Prince Friederich Arthur von Homburg, a cavalry officer, launches his squadron into battle before the agreed time, thus breaking the orders he had been given. Despite the victory achieved, the officer is sentenced to death. Faced with the death sentence, the prince, in terror, is first helped by the beautiful Natalia, but then refuses the pardon.
cast: Andrea Di Stefano, Barbora Bobulova, Toni Bertorelli, Anita Laurenzi

title: Il principe di Roma
synopsis: Rome, 1829. Bartolomeo (Marco Giallini) is a rich and greedy man who craves the noble title more than everything. In an attempt to recover the money necessary to shake a secret agreement with the Prince Considerabones to get his daughter's daughter in his wife, he will find himself in the middle of a surprising journey between the past, present and future. Accompanied by exceptional companions, he will have to deal with himself and conquer new awareness.
cast: Marco Giallini, Giulia Bevilacqua, Filippo Timi, Sergio Rubini, Denise Tantucci, Andrea Sartoretti, Giuseppe Battiston

title: Il processo
synopsis: An employee is arrested and charged with indefinable crimes in his eyes and those of the prosecution itself.
cast: Paolo Graziosi, Roberto Herlitzka, Mario Scaccia, Piera Degli Esposti, Milena Vukotic, Pier Luigi Zollo, Paolo Lombardi, Edoardo Torricella, Enza Giovine, Rosabianca Scerrino, Ivano Staccioli, Renato Pinciroli, Marzio Margine

title: Il processo di Verona
synopsis: In 1943, five members of the Fascist Grand Council voted on an agenda that defeated Mussolini. Among these there is also Galeazzo Ciano, son-in-law of the Duce. Indicted for rebellion, the five are jailed in Verona and put on trial. In vain, Ciano's wife tries to negotiate with the Germans to save her husband's life. Not even the request for pardon (which will never reach its destination) will be able to stop the machine of "justice". The director Lizzani has made with this film one of his best works and a chilling portrait of the fascist regime, seen through the family drama of Edda Mussolini Ciano.
cast: Silvana Mangano, Frank Wolff, Salvo Randone, Françoise Prevost

title: Il prode Anselmo e il suo scudiero
synopsis: A nobleman invents a fake relic and receives from his father the command over a group of volunteers about to leave for the crusade. Thanks to this expedient, he will be able to get everything he wants, especially from the young and beautiful wives of the Crusaders. The trick is discovered, but the noble manages to get away with blaming the dull squire.
cast: Alighiero Noschese, Enrico Montesano, Tamara Baroni, Renzo Montagnani

title: Il professor Cenerentolo
synopsis: Umberto (Leonardo Pieraccioni) in order to avoid the bankruptcy of his company, together with an employee (Massimo Ceccherini), attempted an awkward shot at the bank which only earned him four years in prison. At the end of his sentence, he works in the town library where, during a debate open to the public, he meets Morgana (Laura Chiatti), who ignores the fact that he is a prisoner. Umberto, taking advantage of the misunderstanding, begins to frequent her during working hours in the library. But every day by midnight, just like Cinderella, he must rush back to the facility to prevent the prison director (Flavio Insinna) from revoking his permit to work outdoors.
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Laura Chiatti, Davide Marotta, Sergio Friscia, Massimo Ceccherini, Nicola Acunzo, Flavio Insinna

title: Il profeta
synopsis: Pietro has lived for some time on Mount Soratte far from everyone, rejecting consumerism. One day he is tracked down by television and taken back to town. Here he becomes a public figure: his speeches, amplified by the mass media, are devoured by the spectators. Then luck is about to turn its back: then the ex-protester opens a luxury restaurant.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Ann Margret, Oreste Lionello, Liana Orfei, Yvonne Sanson

title: Il profeta del gol - Joahn Cruyff Story
Il profumo del tempo delle favole
synopsis: A man (Giorgio Pressburger) is searching, amidst doubts and torments, for the signs of his faith, exposing his experience, unhinging certainties and false hypocrisies, entering the most hidden folds of the human mind. He investigates childhood fears, the lies of adulthood, the illumination of grace and through the support of some traveling companions such as Dostoevsky and Kafka, his speech turns into a close confrontation with the question of evil and suffering.
cast: Giorgio Pressburger, Daniele Tenze, Antonio Cacace

title: Il profumo della signora in nero
synopsis: Silvia, director of a chemistry laboratory, killed her mother as a child. The crime, which remained buried in the woman's unconscious for years, is revoked by the sect of a Senegalese scholar who practices black magic. The purpose of the sect, which also includes Silvia's boyfriend, is to transplant some cannibalistic practices to Rome. The adepts drive Silvia to madness to induce her to commit suicide and thus be able to feed on her body.
cast: Mimsy Farmer, Maurizio Bonuglia, Mario Scaccia, Orazio Orlando, Aldo Valletti, Jho Jenkins, Nike Arrighi, Lara Wendel, Aleka Paizi, Renata Zamengo, Ugo Carboni, Carla Mancini, Luigi Antonio Guerra

title: Il prossimo tuo
synopsis: Rome, Paris, Helsinki. Three European capitals for as many stories whose common thread is fear and isolation. In Rome lives Maddalena, a painter who has lost hope and momentum. In Helsinki, Eeva, a hostess who shuns relations with others. In Paris Jean Paul, journalist, the only survivor of an attack during a reportage in a war zone. All three will have an encounter with a figure who will force them to look inside and review fundamental aspects of their life and their unresolved relationship with the Other.
cast: Maya Sansa, Diane Fleri, Jean Hugues Anglade, Esther Elisha, Laura Malmivaara, Vilma Melasniemi, Sulevi Peltola, Lena Reichmuth, Matti Ristinen, Fabrice Scott

title: Il provinciale
synopsis: Giovanni lands in Rome with the ambition of becoming a journalist. He touches a hard apprenticeship, during which he binds himself to a prostitute whom he will try to change his life. The boy from Monghidoro was not mistaken for the part of a provincial youth stunned by the impact with the city. But the bitter irony often slips alternately into pathetic or farcical.
cast: Gianni Morandi, Maria Grazia Buccella, Sergio Leonardi, Franco Fabrizi

title: Il pugile e la ballerina
synopsis: Enzo and Fabio are two very different men who share an apartment in Rome. The first is a gallery owner, the second is a boxer whose career turns to the end. As of more, Enzo is homosexual and loves Fabio, who instead is heterosexual. However, between the two there is harmony and respect and Enzo's impossible love does not upset their relationship. On the other hand, the relationship between the other protagonists of the film - Osho and Carletto, two corrupt policemen who make a series of small scams - where Osho has a dominant role and continuous abuse.
cast: Marcello Mazzarella, Peppino Mazzotta, Fabio Mattei, Vincenzo Mazzarella, Lena Reichmuth, Francesca Benedetti, Arturo Cirillo, Carla Cassola, Massimo Proietti, Ivan Sabetti, Emiliano Possenti, Bernarda Reichmuth

title: Il quarto re
synopsis: Alazhar is a passionate beekeeper peasant and finds himself involved in the journey that the Three Magi have undertaken leaving their land to celebrate the coming of the Savior. It is a journey that hides pitfalls, dangers and traps but in the end it turns out to be a wonderful discovery of the meaning of life. Alazhar leaves his home as a boy and returns as a man who has learned and learned from what he has seen. The three Magi know that without the help of the young man, who has abandoned his beautiful wife Izhira, they will never be able to reach their intended goal.
cast: Raoul Bova, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Daniel Ceccaldi, Joachim Fuchsberger

title: Il rabdomante
synopsis: Felice, a schizophrenic who lives on a farm near Matera, helps farmers find water. He attracts the ire of a criminal who controls everything. And the situation becomes complicated when Harja, the boss's young companion who intends to leave him, takes refuge at Felice's home.
cast: Pascal Zullino, Andrea Osvart, Riccardo Zinna, Antonio Gerardi

title: Il raccomandato di ferro
synopsis: The brilliant career of Augusto Zinconi, a braggart who, from a humble travet, becomes the manager of an oil company thanks to the vaunted credit of a high-level knowledge. Passing off as a friend of a politician and forging his signature, Augusto gets a job and then is even sent to Rome to plead a project of his company with the politician, who has now become a minister: but the knots will come to a head ...
cast: Mario Riva, Franca Marzi, Aroldo Tieri, Alessandra Panaro, Amedeo Nazzari

title: Il ragazzo che sapeva amare
synopsis: Roberto, waiter at the Europa Palace Hotel in Capri, falls in love with Francesca, a girl he met by chance and who is the goddaughter of the Countess De Cristoforis. She loves him too, but she rejects him because she promised another. Will the two lovers crowd their dream of love?
cast: Antonio Marsina, Vittorio Congia, Didi Perego, Nadia Scarpitta

title: Il ragazzo che sorride
synopsis: Livia does not want to follow her husband Giorgio, a freshly graduated engineer called to manage a mine in Kenya. The young man, suspicious, instructs a friend to find out if his wife is cheating on him. Indeed, Livia frequents a hotel in Rome, but it is only to be visited by a foreign luminary who takes care of her sterility. Meanwhile, Giorgio is fighting to improve the lives of black miners. Livia, now healed, joins her husband and reveals her secret to him.
cast: Al Bano, Rocky Roberts, Susanna Martinkova, Riccardo Garrone

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro
synopsis: A young boy sets out in search of his missing father in the Philippines. However, he must learn the art of karate from an old master to be able to defeat a powerful band of thugs. Shameless Italian remake of Karate Kid.
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Jared Martin, Janet Agren, Ken Watanabe

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro - Il ritorno di Joe Carson
synopsis: Miami, Florida. Larry Jones is celebrating with his friends the victory of his last fight. Meanwhile, his eternal enemy, Joe Carson comes out of reform school and introduces himself to Larry to challenge him to a kung fu match. Larry turns to the Japanese master Masura to prepare him for this latest challenge. Sixth episode of the series, as bad as everyone else.
cast: Christopher Alan, Richard Goon, Larry Jones

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 2
synopsis: Anthony, an American student, returns home after a stay in Manila. He is immediately challenged by the Tiger gang that dominates the college, to a karate match. Anthony accepts the challenge and beats the treacherous Dick who, humiliated, hires a former karate champion to challenge Anthony with the aim of killing him. However, after having escaped an ambush and thanks to the advice of his martial arts master, Kimura, he will have the better of the grim opponent.
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Amy Baxter, Christopher Alan

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 3 - Il texano
synopsis: Larry Jones, a boy living in Ohio, moves to a new school. Here dominates the gang of thugs headed by Joe Carson, a karate expert. Carson and his team's target is Gregg, a boy who has become friends with Larry. After yet another provocation, Larry challenges Joe to a karate match, from which, although technically inferior, he will emerge victorious. Self-sufficient version (and third in the series) of the boy's adventures inspired by the Karate Kid series. The ingredients of the story are always the same.
cast: Christopher Alan, Ron Williams, Dorian D. Field

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 4
synopsis: Larry, the "boy in the golden kimono", is celebrating the start of the school year in the restaurant of his friend and teacher Masura. Suddenly Bruce Lee Wang a charming and famous karate fighter enters the club: Larry's sister, Julie, is fascinated and begins to hang out with him. Of course this is a move by Wang determined to irritate Larry in order to challenge him. When the first episode came out it was rated as a lackluster Karate Kid parody. Despite this we have reached the fourth episode, a sign that the series has worked anyway.
cast: Christopher Alan, David Warbeck, Dorian D. Field, Ron Williams

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 5 - La sfida degli skinheads
synopsis: This time the enemy to beat is called Alabama Bull and it is a pit of negligence, but our Larry Jones, always supported by the Japanese master Masura, does not fear confrontation. How this series could have reached the fifth episode is a mystery.
cast: Christopher Alan, Katy Johnson, Dorian D. Field

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 6
synopsis: University students in Greece. Once in chaotic Athens, one of them is the victim of a scam by Yorgo: once the common fund has disappeared, without money and without tickets, the return journey becomes a problem ...
cast: Ron Williams, Dorian D. Field, Raffaele Exiana, Richard Goon

title: Il ragazzo del pony express
synopsis: The young Augustine, known as Ago, brilliantly graduated with full marks and honors. However, this does not allow him to quickly find a suitable job. At the suggestion of his girlfriend who already works that way, Ago accepts a job as a pony express, the motorized postman who delivers mail to big cities. During his first round the boy meets (or rather collides) with a dream woman ...
cast: Jerry Calà, Isabella Ferrari, Alessandro Benvenuti, Emanuela Taschini, Gabriella Saitta

title: Il ragazzo della Giudecca
synopsis: The story of the judicial affair that in the 90s upset the life of the singer - Sicilian but Neapolitan by adoption - Carmelo Zappulla, arrested on charges of mafia-type criminal association and murder, after the revelations of some repentants. Exonerated after 22 days of solitary confinement, he was sent to trial with a request for life imprisonment, but decided to go into hiding. Only after four years did the happy ending of the acquittal come.
cast: Carmelo Zappulla, Luigi Diberti, Tony Sperandeo, Franco Nero, Giancarlo Giannini, Chiara Iezzi, Mario Donatone, Enrica Pintore, Christian Stelluti, Loretta Rossi, Claudia Samaras

title: Il ragazzo invisibile
synopsis: Michele (Ludovico Girardello) is a thirteen year old boy like many others. Michele's life proceeds in the most absolute routine: he lives in a quiet seaside town with his mother Giovanna (Valeria Golino) and all he wants is to be noticed by Stella (Noa Zatta), the classmate who doesn't seem to see him. One day, however, Michele discovers that he has the gift of invisibility, starting to be the protagonist of the most incredible of adventures.
cast: Ludovico Girardello, Noa Zatta, Valeria Golino, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Ksenia Rappoport, Christo Jivkov, Aleksei Guskov, Enea Barozzi

title: Il ragazzo invisibile - Seconda generazione
synopsis: Difficult to return to normal life after discovering that you are "special". Michele Silenzi is sixteen and, like many boys of his age, lives an adolescence that is anything but serene: the girl of his dreams loves someone else and the relationship with adults is increasingly difficult. Michele finds himself more and more alone, unhappy and even a little angry with the world. All this until a mysterious girl named Natasha and her natural mother, Yelena, break into his life, two women who completely upset his existence, calling him to a new adventure from which he cannot escape.
cast: Ludovico Girardello, Ksenia Rappoport, Galatéa Bellugi, Ivan Franek, Dario Cantarelli, Emilio De Marchi, Noa Zatta, Valeria Golino, Katia Mironova

title: Il ragazzo più felice del mondo
synopsis: In 1997, the cartoonist Gipi was at the beginning of his career when he received a letter from a fifteen-year-old fan who, expressing all his love for his drawings and his stories, only asked him to send him a dedication that reads "To Francesco ". In 2017, Gipi discovered that this person had done the same with many other cartoonists by writing the same letter over the course of twenty years, always declaring fifteen years, showing the same love for each recipient and asking everyone the same thing. With three friends, he decides to go in search of the boy.
cast: Gianni Pacinotti (Gipi), Davide Barbafiera, Gero Arnone, Francesco Daniele

title: Il ragioniere della mafia
synopsis: Of Apulian origins, the thirty-year-old Angelo (Lorenzo Flaherty) moved to Milan where he exercises his profession as an accountant. At first reticent, Angelo found himself managing the illicit and worldwide affairs of a company formed by the major Italian criminal organizations. With the passage of time, Angelo begins to feel the thrill guaranteed by his new position of power and, in an attempt to further consolidate his position, he does not hesitate to go beyond his limits, putting his own existence in serious danger.
cast: Lorenzo Flaherty, Tony Sperandeo, Ernesto Mahieux, Nando Irene, Franco Neri, Ciro Petrone, Simona Borioni, Mario Donatone, Rosalinda Celentano, Luca Lionello, Salvatore Ruocco, Francesca Testasecca, Alessia Tedeschi

title: Il ratto delle sabine
synopsis: Professor Trombone, a provincial teacher full of presumption and arrogance, has the secret dream of becoming a playwright. He convinces a small company, frustrated by the chronic absence of an audience at the performances, to stage a comedy he wrote, "The Rape of the Sabine Women". The author should remain unknown, but the word spreads in the village and fellow citizens punish the professor's artistic ambitions by whistling the actors from the very first minute.
cast: Totò, Carlo Campanini, Olga Solbelli, Aldo Silvani, Clelia Matania

title: Il ratto delle sabine
synopsis: The first inhabitants of Rome tried in vain to bond with neighboring peoples. Romulus and his family then decide to resort to a stratagem: they offer a sumptuous banquet to the Sabine king Tito Tazio and then, at the end of the dinner, neutralize the men and kidnap the women, including the king's daughter. War is looming, but the birth of an heir will bring harmony back.
cast: Roger Moore, Mylène Demongeot, Scilla Gabel, Folco Lulli

title: Il re di Poggioreale
synopsis: A bold and generous man, Giuseppe Navarra, during the Second World War, worked hard to help the Neapolitan population, starving and impoverished. His exploits, often fictional, soon became legendary. Driven by a brigand and charitable instinct at the same time, Navarre devises the most original systems for stealing provisions from the allies. Giuseppe Navarra, awarded the title of king of Poggioreale, devises a plan: to steal the treasure of San Gennaro from the Vatican and bring it to Naples.
cast: Ernest Borgnine, Keenan Wynn, David Opatoshu, Yvonne Sanson

title: Il re si diverte
synopsis: Rigoletto is the court jester of the French king Francis I and is also his accomplice in his gallant adventures. One day some jealous courtiers decide to kidnap Rigoletto's daughter and offer her to the king. The revenge will be immediate and will be revolted
cast: Michel Simon, Rossano Brazzi, Maria Mercader, Doris Duranti

title: Il regista di matrimoni
synopsis: Franco Elica, a director by profession, goes into crisis when his daughter marries a fervent Catholic and is asked to shoot yet another version of the _Promessi sposi_. He then decides to leave, in search of inspiration, for Sicily: here he meets Prince Gravina di Palagonia, a penniless noble who asks him to shoot for the wedding of his daughter Bona. Franco immediately falls in love with the girl and does everything he can to make sure this wedding doesn't get busy ...
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Donatella Finocchiaro, Sami Frey, Gianni Cavina, Maurizio Donadoni, Ludovico Caldarera

title: Il respiro di Shlomo
synopsis: A deporte that was part of the Sonderkommando, those Jewish prisoners who in concentration camps were forced by the Nazis to work in the gas chambers, tells all the themes related to the Shoah from his point of view: uprooting from his own community of origin and places family members, the unsustainable pain of the loss of loved ones and the need to survive surrounded by death.

title: Il resto della notte
synopsis: Silvana, the wife of a provincial entrepreneur, has been suffering from nervous disorders for some time and is convinced that the Romanian maid, Maria, is carrying out thefts in her home. Without delay, and against the advice of his parents, he fires her. The young woman is forced to return to the home of her ex-boyfriend, Ionut, recently released from prison, who lives in a miserable apartment with her younger brother, Victor. Love seems to be reborn between the two, but Victor is jealous and tries to hinder them. At the same time, Ionut returns to small illicit trades with Marco, an Italian cocaine addict with various problems. Soon the latent tensions will explode, directing the aggression of the group of drifters towards the family where Maria worked.
cast: Sandra Ceccarelli, Aurélien Recoing, Stefano Cassetti, Laura Vasiliu, Victor Cosma, Costantin Lupescu, Veronica Besa, Valentina Cervi, Teresa Acerbis, Susy Laude, Bruno Festu

title: Il resto di niente
synopsis: The Neapolitan revolution of 1799 seen through the eyes of Eleonora Pimentel Fonseca, an apparently fragile woman, who seems to let herself be carried away by events, but who has great strength inside and possesses the ability to analyze events with extreme clarity. A person who with intelligence and firmness embraces revolutionary ideas because he feels their rightness, while understanding their limits and weaknesses.
cast: Maria De Medeiros, Rosario Sparno, Raffaele Di Florio, Imma Villa, Lucia Ragni, Riccardo Zinna

title: Il ribelle
synopsis: Through secret documents and unpublished films, the story of Guido Picelli is told, a point of reference in the history of Italy and Europe in the twentieth century and an uncomfortable and often forgotten hero. Guerrilla theorist, forerunner of Che Guevara and supporter of the idea of ??the "Popular Front", defeated with his 400 Arditi del Popolo almost 10,000 fascists during the battle of the 5 days of Parma and challenged the regime managing to hoist the red flag on the Italian parliament building.

title: Il ricatto di un padre
synopsis: The industrialist Guarnieri owes a large sum to a financial firm, owned by Alessandro Arlandi and his partner Serpieri. Guarnieri has issued them some bills, which he cannot pay upon maturity. The industrialist is a sick man; the agitation causes a severe heart attack, to which he succumbs.
cast: Vittorio Braschi, Roberto Bruni, Eduardo Cianelli, Barbara Francia

title: Il ricco, il povero e il maggiordomo
synopsis: In a high skyscraper in Milan, in the Porta Nuova area, there is the office of Giacomo, a rich and unscrupulous financier who lives on ease and wealth. At his service works the trusted butler Giovanni, passionate about martial arts and Japanese philosophy who, unbeknownst to his master, has a liason with the hot South American maid Dolores. Aldo, on the other hand, is an illegal salesman in the local market, who lives with his gruff and combative mother and who in his spare time trains a football team made up mostly of non-EU children. During a daring escape from the traffic police, Aldo is run over by Giovanni and Giacomo, who as compensation offers him a job in his villa. In addition to the turmoil brought about by the "poor", Giacomo sees his empire undergo an unexpected financial meltdown. Forced to find temporary accommodation, the rich man moves with the butler to Aldo's house, before hoping for the success of a new project.
cast: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Giuliana Lojodice, Francesca Neri, Sara D'Amario, Guadalupe Lancho, Massimo Popolizio, Rosalia Porcaro
director: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Morgan Bertacca

title: Il richiamo
synopsis: In Buenos Aires, two women of Italian descent question their lives by reviewing their roles and beliefs. Lucia (Sandra Ceccarelli), a middle-aged hostess, and Lea (Francesca Inaudi), a 30-year-old worker, meet in a moment of stalemate in their marital relations. Love breaks out between the two and an experience begins that on the notes of a tango leads them to discover how betraying oneself is only the beginning of the end.
cast: Sandra Ceccarelli, Francesca Inaudi, César Bordón, Guillermo Pfenning, Arturo Goetz, Hilda Bernard, Viviana Sacco, Julieta Cardinali, Juan Cresta, Lola Berthet

title: Il richiamo del lupo
synopsis: Jim is ten years old and is left alone with his sister Mary, after losing his father. After inheriting the newspaper, they must reach Dawson City in Klondyke but there are several obstacles they encounter. However, they find in the unexpected friendship with Buck, half dog and half wolf, a valid help in dealing with wild nature and human greed.
cast: Jack Palance, Joan Collins, Fred Romer, Elizabeth Virgili, José Canalejas

title: Il risoluto
synopsis: An eighty-seven-year-old Italian, on his retreat in the Vermont woods, meets a filmmaker and takes the opportunity to look back on his life. From the hitherto unspoken memories of the war, an unspeakable past as a soldier-child emerges, in the ranks of the Decima Mas, one of the most violent fascist militias. And a revelation about the fate of Mussolini's treasure, which he himself would have helped to conceal.

title: Il ritmo della vita
synopsis: Giulia inherited Open Dance, a highly accredited sports dance school from her mother. Already a professional dancer, after a bitter disappointment in love, she decides to retire from competitions to devote herself exclusively to teaching. But even the Open Dance is in crisis due to the Starlive, a new and modern structure with an adjoining ballroom dance school that opens its doors right nearby. The meeting with Antonio will convince her to get back in the game again, both in love and in dance ...
cast: Anna Safroncik, Antonio Cupo, Andrea Montovoli, Susanna Smit, Corinne Cléry, Adalberto Maria Merli, Katia Ricciarelli, Samuel Peron, Natalia Titova, Alice Bellagamba, Miriam Leone

title: Il ritorno
synopsis: Teresa is a young woman who lives with Pietro and their two -year -old son, Antonio, in a peripheral neighborhood of a city in Lazio. Like many boys of the same age, Teresa and Peter must deal with the lack of work and the consequent economic difficulties. Pietro then is not properly the most reliable person and Teresa must do everything alone, dividing himself between work, home and son. Pietro's behaviors, however, put her and Antonio at risk, and Teresa to defend her son comes to make an extreme gesture, which costs her prison. When he returns, Pietro and Antonio is welcomed, and the life he left ten years earlier.
cast: Emma Marrone, Fabrizio Rongione, Diego Capretta, Luca Capretta, Lorenzo Ciamei, Tihana Lazovic, Sandra Ceccarelli, Beatrice Schiaffino

title: Il ritorno del Monnezza
synopsis: Rocky Giraldi, son of the legendary policeman Nico, has followed in his father's footsteps and is an agent of the operational departments of the police. He is currently working on a seemingly easy case: the murder of an apartment thief. As the investigation proceeds, he discovers that behind there is an important round of drugs and laundered money ...
cast: Claudio Amendola, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Enzo Salvi, Kaspar Capparoni, Gabriella Labate

title: Il ritorno del gladiatore più forte del mondo
synopsis: Rome is experiencing its own decline in a traumatic way. The emperor fears conspiracies and palace plots, the Senate seems to want to pursue an autonomous policy, the legions have now conquered everything that could be conquered. But the hordes of barbarians have reorganized and are pushing to conquer the eternal city. To resolve the matter, a former gladiator intervenes who defeats the Roman traitor in league with the enemies.
cast: Brad Harris, John Barracuda, Maria Pia Conte

title: Il ritorno del piccolo Lord
synopsis: A few years have passed since Karl, a German industrialist, found Christian, his grandson whose existence he did not know, on the island of Ponza. The boy grew up, and after spending the winter in Germany at his grandfather's house, he returned to the island where his mother Gioia runs a medical institute. During the holiday Karl meets Veronica, a woman he feels attracted to and who begins to weave a skilful web to keep the loved ones away from the financier. In reality, the woman is an industrial spy who a multinational has put in the ribs of Karl. Man will find an unexpected ally in Christian.
cast: Mario Adorf, Catherine Spaak, Francesco De Pasquale, Antonella Ponziani

title: Il ritorno di Cagliostro
synopsis: Sicily, 1950s. The La Marca brothers, founders of a film production house, encouraged by a high prelate who sees cinema as the means for a new evangelization, try to create an ambitious work that will make them known throughout the world and allow them to recover economically. They then hire a Hollywood star, Erroll Douglas, who is on the decline. To complete their project, the two do not hesitate to get involved in shady Mafia trafficking.
cast: Robert Englund, Luigi Maria Burruano, Franco Scaldati, Pietro Giordano

title: Il ritorno di Casanova
synopsis: An established Italian director, reluctant to accept the passage of time, decides to tell Casanova in his latest film. During the filming he will notice that he is very similar to the character he stages, even more than he could imagine.
cast: Sara Serraiocco, Toni Servillo, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Natalino Balasso, Alessandro Besentini, Bianca Panconi

title: Il ritorno di Diavolik
cast: Thomas Lee, Peter Conway, Deborah Scott

title: Il ritorno di Don Camillo
synopsis: Don Camillo, parish priest of Brescello, was sent into exile in a mountain village. That removal should have been convenient for the Communist Mayor Peppone, his archenemy, and instead it is he who brings him back: he needs it to fight together with him against a landowner. Of course, the two do not spare the low blows, but when the Po overflows, they are side by side doing their utmost to help the local people: heart and concrete facts count more than divisions for ideas.
cast: Gino Cervi, Fernandel, Leda Gloria, Paolo Stoppa, Saro Urzì

title: Il ritorno di Ringo
synopsis: Two Mexicans have subjugated a small country with terror. Returning from the Civil War, Montgomery Brown discovers that all his possessions have been confiscated from him by criminals and, moreover, his wife, despite having remained faithful to him, has had to promise to become the bride of one of the two. During a fake funeral, however, Brown and his trusts defeat their enemies. An ironic and well-made Western that faithfully traces some passages of the "Odyssey" (the hero's homecoming) transporting it to the Far West.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Fernando Sancho, Hally Hammond

title: Il ritorno di Ulisse
synopsis: Ten years have passed since the end of the Trojan War and Ulysses, king of Ithaca, has not yet returned to his homeland. His wife Penelope and his son Telemachus are the only ones who believe that he is still alive and, amidst intrigues and clandestine struggles, they try to keep the pretedenti to the throne and to the woman's hand at bay. The expected return of Ulysses, however, will prove to be more difficult to manage than expected: troubled by the events he experienced, Ulysses has become a violent and suspicious man, unable to understand the feelings of those who love him.
cast: Alessio Boni, Caterina Murino, Niels Schneider, Bruno Todeschini, Karina Testa, Vittoria Scognamiglio, Joseph Malerba, Ugo Venel, Carlo Brandt, Augustin Legrand, Salim Kechiouche, Nicolas Robin, Jérémie Petrus

title: Il ritorno di Zanna Bianca
synopsis: The misadventures in Klondyke of little Bill, his grandfather John Tarwater and a wolf dog named White Fang, struggling with the evil Beauty Smith. The Jack London epic has nothing to do with this hodgepodge, made by Lucio Fulci with the waste of the western spaghetti.
cast: Franco Nero, Virna Lisi, John Steiner, Raimund Harmstorf, Renato Cestié

title: Il romanzo della mia vita
synopsis: Following polio contracted as a child, Luciano Tajoli remains physically handicapped. From an early age Luciano was noted for his beautiful voice. He is now a young man when he successfully participates in an amateur competition. His condition forbids him to attend the stage. He is forced to sing on the radio. Luciano achieves success and economic stability, but is not happy because of his condition. Then one day he meets Maria and love is born between the two.
cast: Luciano Tajoli, Antonella Lualdi, Giulietta Masina, Vittorio Sanipoli

title: Il romanzo di un giovane povero
synopsis: The frustration and insecurity of Vincenzo, a graduate for six years and still unemployed, now a slave to an increasingly less hidden defeatism, allow an elderly roommate to insinuate himself into his life with the proposal of a feral pact: for thirty million the young man should get rid of the old man's rich and bulky wife. When the woman is actually found dead Vincenzo is immediately suspected. From a somewhat odd idea developed without great inspiration, a livid and bitter film, which tastes of some yellow films of minor French cinema. The two protagonists are good: Sordi, in one of the few evil characters of his third age, is slimy and insinuating at the right point, and the newcomer Ravello. Isabella Ferrari was awarded at the Venice Film Festival.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Rolando Ravello, Isabella Ferrari

title: Il ronzio delle mosche
synopsis: A team of doctors and scientists is working on an ambitious project: to bring back the madness among people to fight boredom and depression and thus be able to live better. For this purpose, the last three madmen left on earth are taken. In a secret place, the three unfortunates are thoroughly studied to understand their reactions. Only Doctor Natalia seems to feel a little tenderness for them ...
cast: Greta Scacchi, Giorgio Colangeli, Raffaele Vannoli, Renzo Alessandri, Marco Baliani

title: Il rossetto
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Silvana De Carli (Vivaldi) falls in love, obviously not reciprocated, with thirty-year-old Gino (Brice), engaged to Lorella (Moll). While on the trail of her man, the girl sees him one day leave the house where a murder was committed. Gino confides to Commissioner Fioresi (Germi), who is dealing with the case, the annoying attention he has to undergo from Silvana. It is Damiani's first work, a yellow plot written with the collaboration of Zavattini. A good debut both for the psychological definition of the characters and for the portrait of the environment.
cast: Pierre Brice, Pietro Germi, Laura Vivaldi, Giorgia Moll

title: Il rosso e il blu
synopsis: In a Roman high school, run by the rigorous but modern headmaster Giuliana (Margherita Buy), personally involved in the story of a fourteen-year-old abandoned by her mother, a couple of boys - she a hooligan, he a Romanian - try to complete the path that it leads to maturity and growth, made up of personal anxieties, everyday problems and challenges with the rules of adults. Like all other students, they not only need scholastic notions but first of all need to find reference models within the teaching staff, in which a cynical professor of art history (Roberto Herlitzka) is highlighted, incapable of keep up with the times and the changing generations until he meets a former student who subverts his convictions, and a young substitute teacher of Italian (Riccardo Scamarcio) on his first assignment, who tries to close the distance with the students, approaching their world and trying to bring back a student who had dropped out of school.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Margherita Buy, Roberto Herlitzka, Lucia Mascino, Elena Lietti, Nina Torresi, Alexandru Bindea, Ionut Paun, Davide Giordano, Marco Casazza, Gene Gnocchi

title: Il rosso e il nero
synopsis: The son of a carpenter, the young Julien Sorel becomes a tutor with the De Renal family, a middle-class family from Besancon. Despite his humble origins, the determined and rebellious-looking boy begins his ascent to success. In a short time Mrs. De Renal falls madly in love with the young man and, immediately, in the village the rumors of the alleged affair between the two begin. Julien is forced to undertake an escape that will lead him, first, to enter the seminary and, then, to become secretary to the family of the Marquis De La Mole, one of the most prestigious families in Paris. Here he finds the love, reciprocated, of the young daughter of the Marquis, but the relationship is opposed on many sides. Julien will have to fight, for himself and for his ideals.
cast: Carole Bouquet, Kim Rossi Stuart, Judith Godrèche, Claude Rich, Bernard Verley, Constanze Engelbrecht, Francesco Acquaroli, Maurice Garrel, Rüdiger Vogler, Claudine Auger

title: Il rosso segno della follia
synopsis: John Arrington, helpless but successful paranoid, falls prey to a raptus in which he kills the wedding dressers who work for him. After his wife is also killed, he falls in love with a model who, however, is afraid of massacring ...
cast: Stephen Forsyth, Dagmar Lassander, Laura Betti, Jesus Puente

title: Il sangue dei vinti
synopsis: Inspired by the controversial book by Giampaolo Pansa, the film traces the story of a family torn by political divisions at the end of the Second World War: a son joined the partisan brigades and a daughter, instead, who joined the militia of the Republic of Salò.
cast: Michele Placido, Barbora Bobulova, Giovanna Ralli, Alessandro Preziosi, Stefano Dionisi, Philippe Leroy, Alina Nadelea, Daniela Giordano

title: Il santo patrono
synopsis: The patron saint of Ponteparadiso has always been San Satiro Vedovo, but a sensational decision by the bishop changes the cards. From now on, the citizens of the town will have to celebrate the feast of San Silvestro, whose statue is immediately put in place of that of the "predecessor". The population, together with the parish priest Don Arcadio, rebels.
cast: Lucio Dalla, Alberto Sorrentino, Tony Ucci, Gennaro Masini

title: Il saprofita
synopsis: Ercole is a seminarian forced to interrupt his path to the priesthood due to a sudden and unexpected disturbance: following a plot he seems to have lost his word. Recommended by his spiritual father, he finds employment at the home of Baroness Bezzi as a driver and personal nurse for his young son Parsifal, who is confined to a wheelchair. However, things take an unexpected turn: Hercules becomes the baroness's lover and causes her to send him to Lourdes along with Parsifal. In fact, he is counting along the way to go to Toulouse, where there is a specialist who is said to be able to make him speak again. During the train ride, however, the two meet a girl who will trigger a competition between males. With unexpected consequences.
cast: Valeria Moriconi, Al Cliver, Giancarlo Marinangeli, Janet Agren, Cinzia Bruno, Giancarlo Badessi, Clara Colosimo, Daniele Dublino, Rina Franchetti, Dada Gallotti

title: Il sasso in bocca
synopsis: Attempt to reconstruct the connivance between the Sicilian mafia and the Italian political power through a collage that assembles archive material, repertoire pieces, reconstructed sequences and film clips.
cast: Giuseppe Di Bella, Accursio Di Leo, Franca Asciutto, Carlo Hintermann

title: Il se peut que la beauté ait renforcé notre résolution - Masao Adachi
synopsis: With the help of Nicole Brenez, Sorbonne professor, director Philippe Grandrieux began a series of interviews aimed at portraying great heroic figures of little-known political avant-garde cinema. The first director to be interviewed is the Japanese Adachi Masao, who has returned to film after 27 years of silence.
cast: Masao Adachi, Naruhiko Onozawa

title: Il secondo tragico Fantozzi
synopsis: From Montecarlo where it inflates with water until it takes off like a balloon, to Genoa where the bottle of champagne destined for the launch of a ship crashes on its head, to Rome where a very ferocious Great Dane follows it, to Agrigento where it is shot as a circus bullet man, in Capri where he causes an earthquake by crashing into the Faraglioni ... the world is always against the unhappy accountant Ugo.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Anna Mazzamauro, Gigi Reder, Ugo Bologna, Antonino Faà Di Bruno

title: Il seduttore
synopsis: The modest employee Alberto has always dreamed of erotic adventures, unbeknownst to his wife, with all the women he knows. He has never succeeded in his intentions, but chance makes him suddenly succeed with three beautiful girls. His wife discovers everything and Alberto, unable to manage the situation, flees to South America, but ... From a comedy by Diego Fabbri, a Deaf of the heyday, with a little too much rein under the direction of Franco Rossi.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Lea Padovani, Jacqueline Pierreux, Lia Amanda, Denise Grey

title: Il segno del Coyote
synopsis: In 1860 California, the tyrannical and corrupt Governor Parker subjected the inhabitants of the Monterey Valley to all forms of harassment. With an edict, he forces all farmers to present their title deeds on the land, confiscating the farms from those who cannot. The mysterious knight called Coyote will protect the people.
cast: Fernando Casanova, Maria Luz Galicia, Jesus Tordesillas, Fernando Sancho, José Jaspe, Fernando Hilbeck, Félix Fernández, Paola Barbara, Mario Feliciani, Giulia Rubini

title: Il segno del comando
synopsis: Having come into possession of Lord Byron's secret diary, Professor Foster (Robert Powell) after a disconcerting discovery made in Paris, sees his life inextricably linked to the discovery of the `` sign of command '', a medallion that confers immortality. to its owner.
cast: Robert Powell, Elena Sofia Ricci, Michel Bouquet, Jonathan Cecil, Fanny Bastien, Sonia Petrovna, Paolo Bonacelli

title: Il segno di Venere
synopsis: Cesira and Agnese are two cousins ??who live together in the same house: the first is rather ugly, while the beautiful Agnese draws upon herself all the admiring glances of men. Cesira however continues to hope with conviction in the "charming prince". The reason for so much hope is that a fortune teller, consulted by her, told her that she was born "in the sign of Venus".
cast: Sophia Loren, Franca Valeri, Vittorio De Sica, Alberto Sordi, Raf Vallone, Peppino De Filippo, Tina Pica

title: Il segreto
synopsis: History of sentimental neuroses between people of the popular class against the backdrop of a peripheral Rome. Lucia, a waitress in a fast food restaurant and back from a suicide attempt, starts with a delivery boy who is in love with her. The girl seems to have been reborn through love: in reality the relationship is just a screen covering another relationship that Lucia has had for some time with a man much older than her. Maselli has signed an ambitious but unresolved film whose greatest merits are the photographic suggestions. Kinski is good but unlikely as a borgatara.
cast: Nastassja Kinski, Stefano Dionisi, Franco Citti, Chiara Caselli

title: Il segreto
synopsis: Every year in Naples, in mid-January, in many of the districts the rite of the memorial stone of Sant'Antonio is still celebrated. With the New Year now past, the kids go in search of abandoned Christmas trees. The Checco Lecco gang in the Spanish Quarters accumulates fir trees in a secret space created by a building that collapsed in the 1980 earthquake.

title: Il segreto del Sahara
synopsis: In 1925, the American archaeologist Desmond Jordan searches for the Talking Mountain in the Sahara. He will have to overcome terrible obstacles, pursued by Lieutenant Ryker of the Foreign Legion and the leader of the raiders of the desert. Massacre of the men of the Mountain, from which only Anthea, the queen, is saved, who with Jordan and the deserter Bear will finally reach the goal. The film is the reduction of a television original of pure and simple entertainment in an adventurous key, with a slightly dated exoticism.
cast: Miguel Bosé, Diego Abatantuono, Daniel Olbrychski, Delia Boccardo

title: Il segreto del bosco vecchio
synopsis: Colonel Sebastiano Procolo and little Benvenuto, his nephew, have inherited a mountain house and the surrounding woods. Benvenuto immediately gets in tune with the animals, the genes of the trees, the songs of the Matteo Wind and other metaphysical presences. His grandfather, on the other hand, thinks that the woods are only a source of income. And if the child is an obstacle to the realization of this gain, the worse for him ... A story by Dino Buzzati, photography by Dante Spinotti, a Paolo Villaggio in an unusual part and, in the direction, a "poet" like Olmi. But even poetry can be exceeded; and this is what happens here in Olmi, which is lost in delays and dolls, without being able to merge the fabulous dimension and the naturalistic one. Embarrassing dubbing.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Giulio Brogi, Riccardo Zannantonio, Lino Pais Marden

title: Il segreto del giaguaro
synopsis: "Romano de Roma" to the core, incurable maniac of the 70s and born optimist, er Piotta alias "the Jaguar" has its headquarters in a bar near Piazza Vittorio, a meeting point for bizarre characters from various generations. From time to time, some strange fact interrupts the routine, while the Jaguar teaches life and conquest lessons ...
