cast: Piotta, Antonello Fassari, Dario Ballantini, Lando Buzzanca, Isabella Biagini

title: Il segreto del successo
synopsis: Cico and Bob are two friends who act as actors for a living, but without success. One day they are given up for dead in the fire of their home. Enzo Iacchetti, a longtime friend, gives the news of their tragic death during "Striscia la storia". This is enough to spark media attention: suddenly the national press begins to take an interest in their works, lamenting the untimely death of two unfortunate as well as extraordinary actors. Cico and Bob are naturally alive and well and above all in the dark about everything. It is their manager who sees the possibility of exploiting the misunderstanding by turning it into a gold mine.
cast: Paolo Maria Veronica, Roberto Malandrino, Antonio Catania, Enzo Iacchetti

title: Il segreto delle rose
synopsis: The Dutch Marian, in a marriage crisis, arrives in Italy where he meets Alfredo, his compatriot and his former flame. Marian soon realizes that the past cannot return. The woman, who in the meantime has experienced various vicissitudes, just has to take the road back.
cast: Marian De Koning, Aldo Pensa, Mario Carotenuto, Dolores Palumbo

title: Il segreto delle tre punte
synopsis: The lawyer Massimo Del Colle returns to Sicily after having fought alongside the Garibaldini. The diligence is attacked by brigands, but a patrol of soldiers, which has arrived in the meantime, foils the attack. Among the occupants of the vehicle, however, one discovers a Bourbon emissary carrying important documents. He tries to escape, but is killed. Maximus takes the place of the emissary to steal the secrets of the Bourbon conspirators. Successful attempt to combine historical and patriotic plot with sentimental adventure in the film. A good craftsmanship swashbuckling, produced by the Sicilian Panaria Film (that of "Vulcano" and "La carrozza d'oro").
cast: Massimo Girotti, Tamara Lees, Umberto Spadaro, Arturo Bragaglia

title: Il segreto dello Sparviero Nero
synopsis: As often happens in the 18th century, the European colonial powers wage war on the seas through pirate ships. A noble Spanish hidalgo, known as "the Black Sparrowhawk", is in fact engaged in the "racing war" on the seas in the service of the very Catholic king and goes from one adventure to another to recover precious state documents.
cast: Lex Barker, Livio Lorenzon, Nadia Marlowa, Walter Barnes

title: Il segreto di Thomas
synopsis: 1942, the South of France is occupied by the Nazis. Thomas is a child prodigy and his mother, Maria von Gall, heads an organization that helps Jews leave the country. Maria is a woman of great charm and Thomas loves her. The child, on the other hand, does not know anything about his father, Maria never wanted to talk to him about it. Thomas is gifted with extraordinary intelligence and sensitivity, has a prodigious memory and is a formidable chess player. The boy will be chased by the clever Gregor Lämmle, professor of philosophy, who must help the Gestapo recover the great Jewish heritage kept by the von Gall family. On the trail of Thomas, in addition to the bloody Müller of the Gestapo, there is the group of French mercenaries hired by Lämmle and led by Monsieur Henri. Michele and Saverio, two of Maria's loyalists, in the end Lämmle manages to capture him. Maria von Gall then agrees to surrender herself to Lämmle in exchange for her son.
cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Thomas Sangster, Giorgio Pasotti, Claire Keim

title: Il seme dell'uomo
synopsis: Cino and Dora are leaving for the summer holidays but are stopped by the apocalypse: on the road a patrol of soldiers, busy piling up and burning corpses, advises them to find a safe place to take refuge. Cities are destroyed, a disease attacks the population, the Pope asks for forgiveness, meanwhile Cino and Dora find shelter in a house by the sea, adapting to the new lifestyle ...
cast: Marco Margine, Anne Wiazemsky, Annie Girardot, Rada Rassimov, Marco Ferreri

title: Il seme della discordia
synopsis: The ménage of Mario and Veronica, a married couple with no children in which both attach great importance to their careers, which are booming: he is a representative of a fertilizer company, while she has inherited from her mother a boutique that she wants renew and transform. However, things take an unexpected turn when she finds out she is pregnant. What should be good news, however, turns into a boomerang as he, almost at the same time, receives the results of the analyzes that say he is sterile ...
cast: Caterina Murino, Alessandro Gassmann, Martina Stella, Valeria Fabrizi, Isabella Ferrari, Monica Guerritore, Michele Venitucci

title: Il seminarista
synopsis: Tuscany, 1959. Guido is a ten-year-old boy when he enters the seminary, fascinated by the dream of becoming a priest. The world he encounters, however, is very different from what he imagined: inside the seminary it is necessary to yield to an unnatural education, made up of contempt for the course, obsession with sin, repression of instincts and feelings and injustices towards the weakest. A series of events will lead him, at the age of eighteen, to question his dream and the concept of religion he found himself facing.
cast: Gianluigi Tosto, Francesco Tasselli, Giorgio De Giorgi, Gianfelice D'Accolti, Stefania D'Amore, Emanuele Biagi, Luigi Bacci, Andrea Pelagalli, Andrea Anastasio, Francesco Del Puglia

title: Il senso della bellezza - Arte e scienza al CERN
synopsis: Inside CERN, the most prestigious and largest particle physics laboratory in the world, an unprecedented experiment is underway in which scientists from all over the world collaborate around the largest machine ever built by humans, the accelerator of LHC particles (Large Hadron Collider), to discover the mysteries of the universe. Creating a parallel between art and science, CERN scientists on the one hand and contemporary artists on the other guide us in their search for truth, all listening to an elusive sixth or seventh sense: beauty.

title: Il sepolcro dei re
synopsis: Having killed the rulers of Syria, the pharaoh Nemorat marries their daughter Shila, who despises him and loves a court doctor. Complicated court intrigues, potions and Egyptian pitfalls follow. Twisted and rough costumed feuilleton.
cast: Debra Paget, Ettore Manni, Corrado Pani

title: Il sequestro Soffiantini
synopsis: One evening, a group of Sardinian bandits break into the villa of the Brescia textile entrepreneur Soffiantini, looking for his son, but the man manages to make him escape. The criminals then kidnap him and drag him to the mountains. Investigations begin immediately. Meanwhile, Soffiantini experiences the harshness of imprisonment, aggravated by his precarious health conditions. In order to solicit negotiations, the bandits cut off an ear of the kidnapped and send it to the family. triggering the reaction of the wife and children will either lead to a "controlled payment" of the ransom, authorized by the judge, or they will proceed on their own.
cast: Michele Placido, Tony Sperandeo, Claudia Pandolfi, Claudio Santamaria, Anna Bonaiuto, Lino Capolicchio, Libero De Rienzo, Giulio Di Mauro, Elio Germano

title: Il sergente Klems
synopsis: In 1918, at the end of the battle of Artois, a young German officer, who had escaped the carnage, exchanged his uniform with that of a Frenchman who died in the trenches. Taken prisoner and deemed a spy, he is sentenced to be shot. He was saved by a former legionnaire, a deserter, destined for the same fate. Taking the name of Otto Klems, the German is sent to Morocco in the Foreign Legion. Impatient with the abuses of an officer, he deserted and was captured by the rebels.
cast: Peter Strauss, Tina Aumont, Pier Paolo Capponi, Howard Ross

title: Il sergente Rompiglioni
synopsis: Rompiglioni instructs the recruits by mixing, with curious effects, his two great passions: discipline and classical music. When he is entrusted with the components of the "Gli Alisei" complex, the sergeant uses an iron fist. The musicians, by means of a false letter, send Rompiglioni to the Castrocaro festival. As a punishment, here is the preparation of a "Nabucco" Verdi "without instruments". Franchi sezna Ingrassia in the footsteps of Colonel Buttiglione: at its worst.
cast: Franco Franchi, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Mario Carotenuto

title: Il sergente Rompiglioni diventa... caporale
synopsis: Mistakenly mistaken for an important person, Sergeant Francesco Garibaldi Rompiglioni (Franchi) upsets the NATO Headquarters with insane initiatives. Franco Franchi is unleashed in jokes without restraint, to the point of stifling even some not strange ideas such as the confusion of languages ??and races in the Babel of Born.
cast: Franco Franchi, Mario Colli, Maria Pia Conti, Luciano Pigozzi

title: Il servo ungherese
synopsis: August Dailermmann runs a concentration camp. When he meets Miklos, a Jewish servant but above all a refined intellectual, he begins to take an interest in art. In this way he selects painters and musicians from among the deportees and creates an orchestra, while his wife Franziska has a portrait made by seven painters. When August is transferred to Berlin, the command passes to the young and ruthless Lieutenant Tross ...
cast: Tomas Arana, Andrea Renzi, Chiara Conti, Edoardo Sala, Milica Djukic, Cesare Bocci

title: Il sesso aggiunto
synopsis: Alan is a drug addict adrift who, however, still retains a bit of self-preservation instinct: just enough to guide him towards a path of self-analysis destined to lead to the rediscovery of love.
cast: Giuseppe Zeno, Myriam Catania, Valentina D'Agostino, Lino Guanciale, Gigi Savoia, Cloris Brosca, Gioia Spaziani, Paco Reconti

title: Il sesso confuso. Racconti di mondi nell'era Aids
synopsis: A documentary that tells the changes and disturbances that determined AIDS, a disease that, at 25 years old from the first cases, cannot be treated only from a medical point of view, but, above all, as a social phenomenon. Divided in decades, from the "free" 70s to the generations of today, the film is a set of thoughts and stories of doctors, priests journalists, show characters.
cast: Andrea Adriatico, Fernando Aiuti, Adriana Ammassari, Stefano Benni, Paolo Bevilacqua, Guglielmo Campione, Vincenzo Capuano, Alessandra Cerioli, Giulio Maria Corbelli, Fiore Crespi

title: Il sesso degli angeli
cast: Bernard De Vries, Rosemary Dexter, Doris Kunstmann, Laura Troschel

title: Il sesso degli angeli
synopsis: Don Simone is a frontier priest, with a church always in difficulty and never frequented by the boys who rather prefer to be together of social media. Finally Don Simone receives fantastic news: an eccentric uncle has left him inherited a very bright activity in Switzerland who will be able to raise the economic fate of his always deserted oratory. But, arrived in Lugano, the priest discovers that he had inherited a brothel. Don Simone will give reason to the ramshackle uncle who has always doubted his faith, or will someone from above give him the right answers to take away any doubts?
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Sabrina Ferilli, Marcello Fonte, Massimo Ceccherini, Eva Moore, Gabriela Giovanardi, Maitè Yanes, Valentina Pegorer, Giulia Perulli

title: Il sesso della strega
synopsis: Sir Thomas Hilton is about to pass away, and he gathers all his heirs around him, the only excluded is Evelyn, his sister, for the hatred he has always shown for his family. While the heirs enjoy the pleasures of the castle together, Evelyn plots something very dangerous. The woman is aware of a secret that Thomas believes he has taken to his grave.
cast: Susanna Levi, Jessica Dublin, Sergio Ferrero, Camille Keaton, Franco Garofalo, Donald O'Brien, Gianni Dei, Augusto Nobile, Maurizio Tanfani, Marzia Damon

title: Il sicario
cast: Sergio Fantoni, Alberto Lupo, Sylva Koscina, Belinda Lee

title: Il siero della vanità
synopsis: Suddenly some famous personalities of Italian television disappear into thin air. The media are unleashed and the television guru Sonia Norton, owner of the show of the same name, does not hesitate to make the situation even more dramatic with her alarmist reports. Former police inspector Lucia Allasco with colleague Fabio Berradi investigate the case and discover that there is a direct link between Sonia Norton Show and the disappearances.
cast: Margherita Buy, Barbora Bobulova, Valerio Mastandrea, Francesca Neri, Rosario J. Gnolo, Marco Giallini, Ninni Bruschetta, Maddalena Maggi, Marco Cortesi, Nicola Paduano, Antonio Ianniello, Francesca Barone

title: Il signor Max
synopsis: The double life of the newsagent Gianni, aka Max, a self-styled aristocrat. Thanks to a free ticket, Max embarks on a cruise; he is mistaken for a noble and he naturally plays along. On the ship there is also the gallant affair with a noblewoman. Quintessence of the comedies of "white phones", directed by a Camerini of unrivaled class.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Assia Noris, Rubi Dalma, Umberto Melnati, Adonella

title: Il signor Quindicipalle
synopsis: From an early age Francesco knows that he will have to become a world champion in billiards also because it is his father who wants him. But one day while he is walking in a cemetery he meets the most shocking encounter of his life, he meets Sissi, a high-profile prostitute. The woman ends up completely changing his life.
cast: Francesco Nuti, Sabrina Ferilli, Novello Novelli, Antonio Petrocelli

title: Il signor Robinson. Mostruosa storia d'amore e d'avventure
synopsis: Roberto is married to Magda: when the two decide to take a vacation they end up arguing. Roberto would like to go by plane but Magda opts for a cruise, despite her husband hating sea travel. One night the alarm sounds on board but Roberto, convinced that it is an exercise, does not abandon the ship and ends up shipwrecked on a desert island. There he meets a beautiful native, but Magda is on her trail.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Zeudi Araya, Anna Nogara, Percy Hogan

title: Il signore della truffa
synopsis: Federico Sinacori, nicknamed "the lord of the scam" by the police in half of Europe, has mysteriously lost track of him for over twenty years and lives in a condominium in Verbania posing as Nicola Persico, retired finance general. The mocking fate brings him back to organize a new scam when the condominiums, in turn swindled by a financial institution and at risk of losing their homes, ask for his help.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Juan Diego, Maurizio Casagrande, Edoardo Leo, Lorenza Sorino, Giulia Lippi, Massimo De Lorenzo, Susy Laude, Clotilde Sabatino, Sandra Collodel

title: Il signore delle formiche
synopsis: The human story and the procedural case of Aldo Braibanti - partisan and thinker, as well as writer and poet - who was sentenced in 1968 for plagiarism (crime established by fascism, then canceled by the penal code), an indictment behind which was hidden an accusation of homosexuality, arousing in Italy of the times a large and profound debate and a lifting of the intellectuals who intervened in his defense.
cast: Luigi Lo Cascio, Elio Germano, Sara Serraiocco, Leonardo Maltese, Anna Maria Antonacci, Rita Bosello, Davide Vecchi, Maria Caleffi, Roberto Infurna

title: Il silenzio dell'allodola
synopsis: Belfast, 1970s. Like many boys his age, Bobby Sands frequents the IRA, the armed wing of Sinn Fein. When arrested, he is forced to confess to a crime he did not commit ...
cast: Ivan Franek, Marco Baliani, Flavio Bucci, Anna Maria Gherardi, Roberto Ceccacci

title: Il silenzio di Pelešjan
synopsis: Unknown in the West until the intervention of the French critic Serge Daney in 1983, the Armenian director Artavazd Pelešjan, born in 1938, tells about himself to Pietro Marcello in a meeting in Moscow, in which his elusive and intense figure acts as a link between the fragments of his works and unpublished materials of his biography.

title: Il silenzio grande
synopsis: Villa Primic, once a luxurious residence, now creaking mansion that seems to have come out of a story of ghosts, has been put on sale. A painful decision, taken by Mrs. Primic, Rose, and shared by the two heirs of the dilapidated fortune of the family, Massimiliano and Adele. The only one who is not happy at all is the head of the family, Valerio, who will discover that he has never really known his loved ones and, perhaps, not even himself, until he reaches the bitter awareness that living does not mean being alive.
cast: Massimiliano Gallo, Margherita Buy, Marina Confalone, Antonia Fotaras, Emanuele Linfatti, Roberto De Francesco

title: Il sindacalista
synopsis: A Sicilian emigrant rebels against his boss and becomes a union leader. He thus obtains notable improvements in working conditions, but it is all in vain: the boss, in the meantime, has sold the factory.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Isabella Biagini, Dominique Boschero, Renzo Montagnani

title: Il sindaco
synopsis: Antonio Barricano (Anthony Quinn), nicknamed the Mayor, is an important Italian American godfather of the 1930s. He lives in his immense villa with his wife Armida (Anna Bonaiuto) and their children and in the Italian community everyone respects him, following his orders without ever saying a word. Looking for help, Eddy (Raoul Bova) and Rita (Maria Grazia Cucinotta), a young couple expecting a baby, also turn to him. Eddy's father, however, refuses to obey Barricano's orders, sparking a bloody feud between families.
cast: Anthony Quinn, Anna Bonaiuto, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Raoul Bova, Romina Mondello, Franco Citti, Lino Troisi, Gaetano Amato

title: Il sindaco del rione Sanità
synopsis: Antonio Barracano administers the events of the Sanità district in Naples as a "man of honor" in a reversal of the legal system. Don Antonio avails himself of the help of the doctor Fabio Della Ragione who, with his work, prevents the results of the settlement of accounts that take place in the neighborhood from being brought to the knowledge of the law. The daily life of the Sanità is interrupted when Barracano clashes with Arturo Santaniello, a rich baker and arid father, giving rise to a conflict destined for a tragic ending.
cast: Francesco Di Leva, Massimiliano Gallo, Roberto De Francesco, Adriano Pantaleo, Daniela Ioia, Giuseppe Gaudino, Gennaro Di Colandrea, Lucienne Perreca, Salvatore Presutto, Viviana Cangiano, Domenico Esposito, Ralph P, Armando De Giulio, Daniele Baselice, Morena Di Leva, Ernesto Mahieux

title: Il sindaco pescatore
synopsis: On 5 September 2010, seven gunshots put an end to the life of Angelo Vassallo, the fisherman mayor. About twelve years earlier, Angelo, still only a fisherman, sickened by the degradation and neglect in which his country and its sea were sinking, had decided to commit himself personally, deciding to run for mayor. His simplicity, combined with an innate charisma had convinced the people of Pollica and Acciaroli to elect him. The program was simple "to go forward you had to go back", that is to recover the values ??of the past, to return Acciaroli to the splendor of the past. However, his policy of legality and respect for the environment had attracted speculators, entrepreneurs colluding with the underworld, drug dealers: the Camorra. Angelo takes sides against these powers in the first person, often alone. For this he is killed, leaving his wife, his children, his brothers, an entire community in despair.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Anna Ferruzzo, Renato Carpentieri, Andrea Di Maria, Lavinia Guglielman, Fabrizio Contri, Massimo De Matteo, Antonio Pennarella, Carlo Mileo, Teresa Saponangelo

title: Il soffio dell'anima
synopsis: In Imola lives Alex, a young man on dialysis who has not stopped fighting to prevent the disease from dominating his life. To cultivate his dream, he invents his own martial art which he calls "the breath of the soul", a discipline that does not have combat as its aim but to defeat his fears.
cast: Flavio Montrucchio, Lucrezia Piaggio, Dario Ballantini, Raffaello Balzo

title: Il sogno del maratoneta
synopsis: Carpi, 1905. The young Dorando Pietri (Luigi Lo Cascio), who presented himself with his brother Ulpiano (Thomas Trabacchi) at the selection of the athletes of a club managed by Artemisio Barbisio (Pippo Delbono), was rejected by him as he was not considered suitable. Disappointed by the refusal, Dorando has such a desire for revenge that it will lead him to challenge and even beat the local champion, Pericle Rondinella (Fabio Fulco). But his dream is to run in the Olympics.
cast: Luigi Lo Cascio, Laura Chiatti, Dajana Roncione, Alessandro Haber, Thomas Trabacchi, Fabio Fulco, Andy Luotto, Gerardo Mastrodomenico, Roberto Nobile, Pippo Delbono

title: Il sogno dell'alieno
synopsis: In 2012 Andrea Amaducci, artist and performer from Ferrara, joined together with three accomplices in a performative group called "the dream of the alien", built around the table to attract media attention. The group's goal is to provoke Italian politicians with its ironic performances with a social background and to make them subscribe - in a surreal atmosphere - to an agenda based on six points that can solve the Italian crisis.
cast: Andrea Amaducci

title: Il sogno della farfalla
synopsis: Massimo decided, when he was still a boy, to interrupt verbal communication with his peers. Now, in his early twenties, he is an actor by profession but, outside the stage, he continues to entrench himself in silence. Many, in the family and in other contexts, try to distort him from his purpose, but to no avail. Then, during a summer vacation on the island of Crete, an earthquake occurs ...
cast: Thierry Blanc, Bibi Andersson, Roberto Herlitzka, Simona Cavallari

title: Il sogno di Brent
synopsis: Brent Winters is 14 years old and has a great passion for motorcycles, passed on to him by his father, a former rider. One day, returning home, he has a serious accident and loses his legs from the knee down. Brent goes into depression until his teacher Dave urges him to fight back and join a wheelchair basketball team. Two years after the accident, Brent puts on prostheses and, after meeting Giusy, an athlete who trains for the Paralympics, decides to follow his example and compete, supported by friends, parents and his girlfriend Patty, Spike volleyball player Team.

title: Il sogno di Zorro
synopsis: The young Raimundo, Zorro's nephew, is so childish, shy and fearful that, after having screwed up the possible marriage, he decides to enter the convent. On the way, however, he is involved in a fight, and thanks to a providential blow to the head, he regains all his vigor and, with this, love.
cast: Walter Chiari, Delia Scala, Vittorio Gassman, Carlo Ninchi, Umberto Aquilino

title: Il sogno nel casello
synopsis: For Marco, a Neapolitan boy, the summer days pass monotonous and regular in his toll booth. His personal life is no longer exciting: he is shy and submissive, also due to a mother who dominates and harasses him. Then suddenly, a meeting: he is with the young woman across the street, Silvia. But fate lurks in the form of an eviction notice ...
cast: Pietro Pignatelli, Clotilde Sabatino, Carmen Scivittaro, Lucio Allocca, Raffaele Tullo, Raffaele Esposito, Mario Porfito, Ugo Fangareggi, Piero Pepe, Mimmo Sepe, Ernesto Lama

title: Il sol dell'avvenire
synopsis: Some witnesses and participants of the birth of the Red Brigades around the table of a tavern, recalling distant and sinister facts.
cast: Alberto Franceschini, Paolo Rozzi, Tonino Loris Paroli, Annibale Viappiani

title: Il sol dell'avvenire
synopsis: Giovanni (Nanni Moretti) is a director and less and less in tune with the world around him. At the moment it is engaged with the filming of a film set in 1956, the history of the secretary of the section of the Communist Party of a Roman neighborhood (Silvio Orlando) who does not know how to react to sending Soviet tanks to Hungary. The producer of the film is his wife Paola (Margherita Buy), who lately is thinking of leaving him even if Giovanni has no idea. The director is also writing another project taken from a novel and at the same time he dreams of shooting a film that tells you about the forty -year love story of a couple, with many Italian songs to act as a background.
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Nanni Moretti, Silvio Orlando, Barbora Bobulova, Margherita Buy, Jerzy Stuhr, Benjamin Stender, Elena Lietti, Blu Yoshimi, Flavio Furno, Beniamino Marcone, Francesco Rossini, Francesco Brandi, Rosario Lisma, Laura Nardi

title: Il solco di pesca
synopsis: Davide, photographer and former seminarian in crisis, and Viviane, uninhibited a wife of an actor, meet and is immediately sex. The young man specializes in portraying the buttocks of her (the "fishing furrow"); The intertwining continues between servants virgins and jealous husbands, with ending in ... convent.
cast: Gloria Guida, Martine Brochard, Alberto Terracina, Emilio Cigoli

title: Il soldato di ventura
synopsis: Ettore Fieramosca (Spencer), in 1503, humiliates the supposed French knights in the famous Challenge of Barletta. He is not Brancaleone, he is simpleton, but there is no lack of gags and funny jokes.
cast: Bud Spencer, Franco Agostini, Enzo Cannavale, Philippe Leroy, Andréa Ferréol, Jacques Herlin

title: Il soldato ignoto
synopsis: In the autumn of 1943, a group of Allied and Italian soldiers is trapped inside an abandoned villa. But soon all of them realize that they are dead and that the villa is nothing more than the starting point for their entry and subsequent journey into the afterlife. After the initial understandable bewilderment they begin to tell their stories and so they realize that they have died unjustly, sent to slaughter in a useless war. The youngest, whose wife is expecting a baby, is lucky enough to be able to temporarily return to the living to bring a message of peace.
cast: Giovanni Guidelli, Angelo Orlando, Aldo Sambrell, Leonardo Treviglio

title: Il sole anche di notte
synopsis: A young noble arrives at the court of Naples in the eighteenth century, determined to excel. When he discovers that his betrothed was the sovereign's mistress, he is shocked and becomes a monk. But even in the convent he does not give up the desire to excel: he becomes a hermit and acquires the reputation of a saint. The hermitage becomes a place of pilgrimage until, seduced by a young woman who came to ask for a miracle.
cast: Julian Sands, Nastassja Kinski, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Patricia Millardet, Margarita Lozano, Lorenzo Perpignani

title: Il sole buio
synopsis: Ruggero Villamarina-Bolt lived for over twenty years with his father in the United States. Now he returns to Palermo for a ceremony in honor of his dead mother who has placed a copious bequest in favor of a female juvenile prison. Here he meets the young Lucia, a former prostitute and now a drug dealer. He helps her when the girl's father is killed by the mafia, and she falls in love with him. Then the story gets complicated ... It can be said that, between cinema and TV, Damiani is a "regular" of Sicily and the mafia, but not all donuts have succeeded with the hole. Apart from the acting of the Italian-French-American Jo Champa, here she is saved just a little.
cast: Michael Paré, Jo Champa, Phyllis Logan, Luciano Catenacci, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Il sole dentro
synopsis: Yaguine and Fodé, two Guinean adolescents, wrote a letter on behalf of all African children and adolescents to be delivered to the leaders of the European parliament in which they ask for help in obtaining care, schools and food. With the letter in their pocket, they secretly board the trolley compartment of an airbus bound for Brussels. Ten years later, the thirteen-year-old Thabo tries to return to Zambia, to his small native village, accompanied by the fourteen-year-old Rocco from Catania. On the run from the apparently golden world of child soccer players, they cross Africa carrying a ball.
cast: Fallou Kama, Gaetano Fresa, Angela Finocchiaro, Francesco Salvi, Diego Bianchi, Giobbe Covatta

title: Il sole negli occhi
synopsis: Celestina, daughter of peasants, from the moment she was orphaned she moved to Rome to work as a housekeeper by the hour. Very young, ignorant and above all naive, she finds herself lost in the big city and her discomfort increases when her two brothers, whom she asked for help, decide to leave for Australia. But Celestina does not give up, she gets engaged to the plumber Fernando and with the help of the parish priest she finds work with two pensioners who promise to leave her a field. In this way Celestina arouses the ire of the relatives of the two old men and has to move again ...
cast: Irene Galter, Gabriele Ferzetti, Paolo Stoppa, Pina Bottin

title: Il sole nella pelle
synopsis: The sixteen-year-old daughter of a wealthy industrialist falls in love with Robert, a nineteen-year-old hippie. One day, the two lovers decide to take a trip on a sailing boat, unbeknownst to her father: having gone too far, they are shipwrecked on an islet. The disappearance of the girl, however, is interpreted by the police as a kidnapping of a sexual nature.
cast: Ornella Muti, Alessio Orano, Chris Avram, Luigi Pistilli, Roby Ruberti, Fortunato Arena, Stella Carnacina, Aristide Caporale, Antonio Piretti, Giulio Baraghini

title: Il sole nero
synopsis: Agata is linked by an intense love relationship to her husband Manfredi, a few years younger than her. But the dream of happiness of the two turns dramatically into a nightmare when Manfredi is murdered. The young woman, determined to take justice on her own, is thus forced to choose between forgiveness and revenge.
cast: Valeria Golino, Lorenzo Balducci, Remo Girone, Enrico Lo Verso

title: Il sole sorge ancora
synopsis: One of the few films that attempts a lucid, thorough and scrupulous analysis of the Italian liberation movement. Produced by the National Association of Partisans of Italy, the film starts the day after 8 September. The lives of those who choose the clandestine fight against Nazi-Fascism and the events of those who will soon adapt to a changed historical situation to safeguard their interests, are told with the merciless methods of the historical-social investigation.
cast: Vittorio Duse, Elli Parvo, Lea Padovani, Massimo Serato, Checcho Rissone

title: Il sole è di tutti
synopsis: Someone has summoned seven girls to Rome for the sharing of an inheritance. But, instead, it was a joke organized by some young men, including a singer who thus has the opportunity to make his artistic creations known. Second-rate musicarello, conceived as a vehicle for singer Dino. Only for fans of the trash-sculpt-camp.
cast: Dino, Luciana Gilli, Ave Ninchi, Carlo Delle Piane, Elio Pandolfi

title: Il solitario
synopsis: Leo Piazza and his accomplices rob another gang after a big blow but things go wrong and ends in a massacre. Only he is saved, who manages to escape with three billion lire and a beautiful assortment of ruthless killers on his heels ...
cast: Luca Magri, Francesco Siciliano, Francesco Barilli, Massimo Vanni, Giancarla Malusardi, Adriano Guareschi, Sara Alzetta, Ottaviano Dell'Acqua, Paolo Rossini, Andrea Zannoni

title: Il sommergibile più pazzo del mondo
synopsis: In a challenge between the American and Italian Navy, a fierce handful of soldiers capable of supporting the weight of the mission is chosen by a computer. By a mistake, however, at the crucial moment the most stupid, clumsy and deranged group of sailors possible is "caught". When Italian cinema wants to compete with Hollywood (The craziest plane in the world) in a humorous key, the pains begin. Especially if there are Anna Maria Rizzoli (who is a transsexual), Bombolo and Cannavale involved.
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Saverio Vallone, Roberto Caporali, Gianni Ciardo, Giorgio Ariani

title: Il sorriso del Capo
synopsis: Thanks to the countless films preserved in the archives of the Istituto Luce, the director Marco Bechis reinterprets the years of Benito Mussolini's power, from the rise to the fall of fascism. In particular, it highlights how the Duce has implemented innovative practices of research and construction of consensus, what tools he used to spread it and what consequences he encountered when his star began to disappear.

title: Il sorriso del grande tentatore
synopsis: The writer Roberto was sent by Monsignor Badenski to a convent to write a book on the relationship between the Church and Nazism. However, Roberto realizes that he has arrived in a strange place: in fact, the guests of the institute have particular personalities and for this reason they have been confined here by the Vatican. Father Moraldi is a worker priest who took part in the strikes, Monsignor Marcos supported Fidel Castro, while Monsignor Badenski himself is accused of having sided with the Nazis ...
cast: Glenda Jackson, Claudio Cassinelli, Lisa Harrow, Adolfo Celi

title: Il sorriso del ragno
cast: Thomas Hunter, Marilia Branco, Gabriele Tinti, Elena Nathanael, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Il sorriso della iena
cast: Hiram Keller, Jenny Tamburi, Silvano Tranquilli, Rosalba Neri

title: Il sorteggio
synopsis: Turin, 1977. Tonino, a Fiat Mirafiori worker with a passion for tango, is drawn for the popular jury of the first trial at the Red Brigades. Devoid of any political interest, he only gradually begins to realize the gravity of his position. As if that weren't enough to make matters worse, the girlfriend's decision to ditch him just before the wedding comes. Left alone and tormented by doubts and fear, will Tonino, an ordinary man, be able to fulfill the task of great civil commitment to which he has been entrusted?
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Gioia Spaziani, Giorgio Faletti, Ettore Bassi, Matilde Piana, Francesco Grifoni, Francesco Di Leva, Ignazio Oliva, Mimmo Mancini, Dario Costa

title: Il sospetto
synopsis: In 1934, a communist worker returned from France to fascist Italy, from which he had been expelled because he was accused of deviating from the party: in reality he was recalled to his homeland to investigate his comrades and identify an infiltrated spy ...
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Renato Salvatori, Annie Girardot, Gabriele Lavia, Felice Andreasi

title: Il sottile fascino del peccato
synopsis: Giada, a young writer, returns after a long time to her hometown in Puglia to attend the funeral of her mother, who committed suicide. The girl thus finds herself investigating the reasons why her mother took her own life, becoming involved in a world of black magic and religious sects, within which her mother had begun to suffer from persecution delusions. Overwhelmed by these disturbing revelations, Giada will find herself trapped in a web of intrigues that will shake any certainty about her future and that of her family.
cast: Milena Miconi, Nino Castelnuovo, Lorenza Guerrieri, Laura Troschel, Danny Quinn, Raffaello Turro, Nando Gazzolo

title: Il successo
synopsis: Determined to break through, a real estate official embarks on unclean speculation and compromise. He gets rich, but before he got into the "spin" he had a devoted wife and a very dear friend. Now he is left alone like a dog.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Anouk Aimée, Jean Louis Trintignant

title: Il sud è niente
synopsis: In a small town overlooking the Strait of Messina, Grazia lives with her young father Cristiano, a widower, who earns his bread by selling stockfish in a small suburban shop. Grazia never saw her older brother Pietro, who emigrated to Germany when she was 12, and was convinced by her father's words of his death. By now eighteen, Grazia has assumed masculine features as if to fill the void left by Pietro and, in Cristiano's eyes, has effectively taken her brother's place both in his life and in the fish shop.
cast: Miriam Karlkvist, Vinicio Marchioni, Valentina Lodovini, Francesco Colella, Andrea Belissario, Alessandra Costanzo, Giorgio Musumeci, Peppe Piromalli, Silvana Luppino

title: Il suo nome era Pot... ma... lo chiamavano Allegria!
synopsis: Pot, an outlaw with a light-hearted and mocking way, carries out a big blow against a bank, with the help of his brother, an old gravedigger and the ferocious bandit Steve. The latter, determined to keep the entire booty for himself, kills Pot's brother, but falls, in turn, a prisoner of Lobo. A western-spaghetti in a comic key, like others of the time, shot to try to revive the fortunes of a genre now in decline. He can't even make people smile.
cast: Peter Martell, Lincoln Tate, Daniela Giordano, Gordon Mitchell

title: Il suo nome faceva tremare... Interpol in allarme
synopsis: The Neapolitan delinquent Tony Breda, who wants to imitate the great criminals of his time, approaches the boss Frankie Diomede - for friends, modestly, God - who has recently returned to Genoa. The two, after some adventures, end up in jail together, but escape in search of revenge against the organization that killed a friend and a grill of Frankie.
cast: Lee Van Cleef, Tony Lo Bianco, Edwige Fenech, Jean Rochefort, Fausto Tozzi, Silvano Tranquilli

title: Il suo nome gridava vendetta
cast: Anthony Steffen, William Berger, Evelyn Stewart, Robert Hundar

title: Il suo nome è Donna Rosa
synopsis: The boatman Andrea has fallen in love with the beautiful Rosetta, daughter of a rich notable from Capri: but their love is thwarted because Don Antonio, Rosetta's father, would like to marry her to Giorgio, the dissipated son of Donna Rosa, of whom Don Antonio he is in love...
cast: Al Bano, Romina Power, Dolores Palumbo, Enzo Cannavale, Bice Valori, Pippo Baudo, Walter Brugiolo, Nicoletta Elmi, Anna Campori, Luciano Fineschi, Enzo Guarini, Lisa Halvorsen, Stelvio Rosi, Carlo Taranto

title: Il taglio del bosco
synopsis: Guglielmo (Volonté) is a young man who is already facing a terrible mourning: the death of his wife. For him, being a lumberjack, which leads him to a long absence from home, is more than a job: it is also a way to try to overcome pain and lack.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Domenico Bartoletti, Maris Olivi, Lisetta Sordi, Vittorio Gori

title: Il talento del Calabrone
synopsis: Steph, a fast-growing young radio DJ, has gained popularity on social media and hosts a radio program every night with a large following, during which he receives phone calls from fans. One evening, a call freezes him: on the other hand, a stranger announces that he intends to take his own life by blowing himself up in the middle of the city. Steph tries to handle the situation as best he can. In this way he tries to get his interlocutor to talk as much as possible to avoid the worst while a task force led by the resolute policewoman Rosa Amedei tries to trace the man to block a more complicated plan than what was communicated.
cast: Anna Foglietta, Lorenzo Richelmy, Sergio Castellitto, David Coco, Gianluca Gobbi, Guglielmo Favilla, Gabriele Greggio, Cristina Marino, Bianca Friscelli, Marina Occhionero, Viola Sartoretto

title: Il tallone d'Achille
synopsis: The knight Achille Rosso is about to commit suicide. The intervention of a shady businessman, Serafino, leads him to momentarily give up his plans for death. Serafino makes a proposal to the knight: Achille will sign an insurance policy in his favor and will live happily for a week, only to kill himself once the time expires. Achilles, however, after having spent seven days in the midst of revelries, no longer wants to die.
cast: Tino Scotti, Tamara Lees, Paolo Stoppa, Tecla Scarano

title: Il tassinaro
synopsis: Pietro is a taxi driver who travels the streets of Rome day and night on board his "Zara 87". At the end of the service he returns promptly to his little house in Ostia Antica where he lives with his old father, his wife, a university son (more interested in soap operas than in engineering degrees).
cast: Alberto Sordi, Marilù Tolo, Alessandra Mussolini, Anna Longhi, Silvana Pampanini

title: Il tempo degli assassini
cast: Joe Dallesandro, Martin Balsam, Magali Noël, Rossano Brazzi

title: Il tempo degli avvoltoi
cast: George Hilton, Frank Wolff, Pamela Tudor, Eduardo Fajardo

title: Il tempo dell'amore
synopsis: Love comes as unexpected as spring in the lonely life of Martha, an English woman living in turn-of-the-century colonial Africa. The spark breaks out one day when Martha is on her way to the front to find her brother and an unknown English soldier saves her life. A feeling of frustration builds inside Claire. Something broke between her and Gabriel and quarrels are the order of the day. Giuseppe is in a coma due to an accident. Summer is coming and those who usually went to see him leave, all except Naty.
cast: Ignazio Oliva, Natacha Régnier, Juliet Aubrey, Natalia Piatti

title: Il tempo si è fermato
synopsis: A student went up to the great dam to replace one of the two guardians, who had to go down to the valley following the birth of his son. Between the boy and the other guardian at first there is embarrassment and coldness, but during a night of storm between the two a sincere friendship is born.
cast: Natale Rossi, Roberto Seveso, Paolo Quadrubbi

title: Il tenente Giorgio
synopsis: A young lieutenant, during an expedition on the Sila, spends a night of love with a woman who cannot see her face. A few years later, having returned to Calabria as administrator of the Monserratos, he discovers that the mysterious woman of that night is the count's niece who had resorted to that expedient fearing he would be left without heirs. One of the classic melodramas of Matarazzo and certainly not the most successful.
cast: Massimo Girotti, Milly Vitale, Gualtiero Tumiati

title: Il tenente dei carabinieri
synopsis: Carabinieri lieutenant Duilio Cordelli (Montesano) is investigating a traffic of one hundred thousand counterfeit banknotes (they have also given him one). The investigation is intertwined with that of a billionaire theft. The lieutenant suspects (rightly) that the two cases are connected.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Nino Manfredi, Massimo Boldi, Marisa Laurito, Claudio Botosso

title: Il terribile ispettore
synopsis: Paolo De Angelis, a simple hospital porter, gets kicked out because he behaves like a doctor. His ambition that pushes him to become a real doctor, despite having no diplomas and a degree, pushes him to enter that environment that he likes so much. With his chutzpah and inventing all sorts of lies, he manages to get into the mutual fund management after having a friend's graduation certificate photocopied.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Francesco Mulè, Didi Perego, Agostina Belli

title: Il terrore dei barbari
synopsis: 568 AD: Alboin, king of the Lombards, subjugates northern Italy; the violence of its warriors causes unspeakable massacres, and the victims are countless. Among the few survivors is the Herculean Emilian, who gathers a handful of daring spirits animated by the proud intent of obtaining revenge ...
cast: Chelo Alonso, Andrea Checchi, Luciano Marin, Steve Reeves

title: Il terrore dei mari
synopsis: Escaped the massacre of the bucanieri operated by the astute and cruel Guzman, a corsair right arm of the governor of Maracaibo, Jacques, swears to take revenge. Collected by Rock, a valiant pirate known by everyone with the nickname "Il Braziliano", Jacques in turn becomes one of the most feared opponents of the Spanish Navy.
cast: Don Megowan, Emma Danieli, Silvana Pampanini, Livio Lorenzon

title: Il terrore dell'Oklahoma
synopsis: The border village called Rio Placido has its name in mind, such is the quiet life of its inhabitants. However, such peace is upset by the arrival of some outlaws, attracted by a rich gold mine located nearby. With the usual violent methods, the bandits try to induce the peaceful villagers to leave the place: but they do not intend to give in to blackmail and hire a skilled and determined gunslinger known as "The terror of Oklahoma" ...
cast: Maurizio Arena, Delia Scala, Alberto Bonucci, Valeria Moriconi, Mario Carotenuto

title: Il terrore della maschera rossa
cast: Lex Barker, Chelo Alonso, Liana Orfei, Livio Lorenzon, Riccardo Billi

title: Il terrorista
synopsis: In Venice in 1943, Renato Braschi, an exponent of the Action Party at the head of the partisans, chooses to continue his sabotage actions against the fascists despite the invitations of his superiors to be cautious and to suspend the attacks. But even among the most trusted companions, traitors can hide.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Philippe Leroy, Giulio Bosetti

title: Il terzo occhio
synopsis: Mino lives with his mother in a castle. Guest of the manor is Daniela, Mino's girlfriend who, however, arouses the jealousies of the boy's mother and of Marta, the housekeeper secretly in love with him. Given the situation Daniela decides to run away but ends up straight into the lake because someone sabotaged her car brakes. While Mino, who followed the woman is carrying the body home, he witnesses the murder of his mother.
cast: Franco Nero, Gioia Pascal, Diana Sullivan, Marina Morgan

title: Il terzo segreto di Fatima
synopsis: In the monastery of Coimbra, in Portugal, the elderly Sister Lucia has a vision that disturbs her and deeply upsets her; confiding in her confessor, she reveals to him that she has had the premonition of an imminent danger of death that would threaten the Pope. Faced with the skepticism of her interlocutors, the nun gives Sister Isabel, a novice assigned to her assistance, to go to Rome to deliver a letter to a monsignor of the Vatican Secretariat of State in which he implores him to persuade the Pontiff to examine the third secret of Fatima. Only in this way can the leader of Christianity be able to hope to save himself ...
cast: Mandala Tayde, Regina Bianchi, Venantino Venantini, Massimo De Lorenzo, Daniele Cecchi

title: Il terzo tempo
synopsis: Samuel (Lorenzo Richelmy), a teenager who has just come out of a juvenile detention institution, is entrusted to the care of Vincenzo (Stefano Cassetti), a social worker in an identity crisis after the death of his wife and coach of the rugby team, chaired by Teresa ( Stefania Rocca) and in which she played in the past. Alone, depressed and frustrated by the results obtained, Vincenzo tries to raise his daughter Flavia (Margherita Laterza) in the best possible way. The new life in a small provincial town puts Samuel at loggerheads with Vincenzo who, surprising him during a fight, blackmails him with the threat of sending him back to jail if he doesn't join his rugby team. At first reticent, Samuel proves to have unexpected qualities for the game and begins to integrate into the team. However, the difficult relationship between Samuel and Vincenzo is destined to explode when he discovers the bond created in the meantime between the boy and his daughter Flavia.
cast: Stefano Cassetti, Stefania Rocca, Lorenzo Richelmy, Margherita Laterza, Edoardo Pesce, Germano Gentile, Gianluca Vicari, Valerio Lo Sasso

title: Il tesoro della foresta pietrificata
synopsis: In the petrified forest are the golden sword and the treasure of the Nibelungs that the god Wotan has entrusted to the custody of Sigmund and Brunhilde. An army of Vikings leaves for the forest, led by Hunding, but in the end Sigmund, aided by the Valkyries, manages to repel the assault. Mythological series C, willing and unpretentious. Music by Wagner on the soundtrack!
cast: Gordon Mitchell, Ivo Payer, Eleonora Bianchi

title: Il testimone
synopsis: A man, presumed murderer, is about to be sentenced to death. The sentence came thanks to the testimony of a witness. But the latter, no longer sure of the infallibility of his testimony, retracted. Author of both the subject and the direction, Pietro Germi, in his first work, turns to noir atmospheres rather than neorealistic ones.
cast: Roldano Lupi, Marina Berti, Ernesto Almirante

title: Il testimone
synopsis: Marco's life is turned upside down when he witnesses the murder of an entrepreneur by the Camorra. He denounces the fact, but the consequences of the gesture are heavy: he is forced to change his identity and move, together with his family, with the support of the police.
cast: Raoul Bova, Ennio Fantastichini, Aisha Cerami, Dino Abbrescia, Pietro Bontempo, Massimo De Rossi, Vincenzo Crivello, Nino D'Agata, Sara D'Amario, Dario D'Ambrosi

title: Il testimone dello sposo
synopsis: On December 31, 1899, preparations were being made for Francesca Babini's wedding in a house in a small town in Emilia Romagna. The girl must marry a wealthy and elderly man who with his money is called to pay off the debts of the family. Everyone is waiting for Angelo, the best man who has emigrated to America, and Francesca understands that he can be her lifeline.
cast: Ines Sastre, Diego Abatantuono, Cinzia Mascoli, Valeria D'Obici

title: Il testimone deve tacere
synopsis: A big speculator silences a possible dangerous witness with an incredible series of intimidations (they rape his wife in front of his eyes). The film oscillates between the policeman and the drama, with a thousand effects.
cast: Bekim Fehmiu, Rosanna Schiaffino, Aldo Giuffré, Luigi Pistilli, Guido Leontini

title: Il testimone invisibile
synopsis: Adriano Doria (Riccardo Scamarcio), a successful young entrepreneur, wakes up in a hotel room locked from the inside next to the lifeless body of his lover, the charming photographer Laura (Miriam Leone). He is accused of murder but pleads innocent. To defend himself, he hires criminal lawyer Virginia Ferrara (Maria Paiato), famous for never having lost a case. The emergence of a key witness and the imminent interrogation that could definitively condemn him force Adriano and the lawyer Ferrara to prepare the strategy of his defense in just three hours and to seek proof of his innocence. Back to the wall, Adriano will be forced to tell the whole truth.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Miriam Leone, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Maria Paiato, Sara Cardinaletti, Nicola Pannelli, Sergio Romano, Paola Sambo, Gerardo De Blasio

title: Il tetto
synopsis: Luisa is a waitress and Natale is a bricklayer. They love and marry, but living in his relatives' house is a hell in which it is never possible to find a moment of intimacy. Luisa learns that in certain areas of the city it is possible to build an illegal house as long as it is built in one night and has a roof.
cast: Gabriella Pallotta, Giorgio Listuzzi, Gastone Renzelli, Angelo Bigioni

title: Il tifoso l'arbitro e il calciatore
synopsis: Two-episode film. In the first, a referee believes that his wife is cheating on him with a footballer, but then discovers that he is homosexual. In the second, a Roma fan pretends to be from Lazio to please his father-in-law; ends up being beaten by the ultras of both teams. The birth of twins will make things right in the family. Two strange stories, without rhythm and with good characters. The Romanist bar in Testaccio run by Carotenuto is quite cult.
cast: Alvaro Vitali, Carmen Russo, Pippo Franco, Mario Carotenuto

title: Il tiranno di Padova
synopsis: Caterina Bragadin is in love with Rodolfo, but the mayor of Padua wants to marry her at all costs. To get rid of his rival he has him condemned by the Council of Ten, the supreme organ of the republic of Venice. Rodolfo is imprisoned but manages to escape in a daring way; he thus collects the proofs of his innocence, unmasks his persecutor and finally marries Catherine. Based on a play by Victor Hugo, the film was made in the studios of Venice (used until recently by the Salò regime) immediately after the Liberation. It hit the screens a few years later, was unsuccessful and almost immediately disappeared from circulation.
cast: Elsa De Giorgi, Alfredo Varelli, Clara Calamai, Carlo Lombardi

title: Il toro
synopsis: Franco and Loris, the dismissed cow farm attendant and a small farmer on the brink of bankruptcy, are traveling from Northern Italy to Hungary, by truck, by train, on foot. They are accompanied by Corinth, the number five in the world, champion of artificial reproduction, which the two have stolen from the farm and want to sell. And its imposing and helpless rhythm is also the one on which the rhythm of the film is calibrated: smooth and unhurried, with long "ruminating" pauses during which Franco and Loris touch the sadness of war, the desolation of refugees, the arrogance of those who do business in the no man's land of former socialism. A right step for Mazzacurati, bitter, beautiful on the outside, accomplice in the night interiors.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Roberto Citran, Marco Messeri

title: Il tradimento - Passato che uccide
synopsis: Although innocent, he was convicted of the murder of a creditor and served many years in prison. Meanwhile, his daughter frequents dangerous environments. Here comes the alleged dead man who this time the protagonist kills in earnest. But for the law it will be self-defense. Inspired by a real fact, it is a drama d.o.c. crafted by the excellent Freda.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Caterina Boratto, Gianna Maria Canale, Camillo Pilotto

title: Il traditore
synopsis: Revenge and betrayals revolve around Tommaso Buscetta, "boss of two worlds". The story begins with the charismatic character of Cosa Nostra hunted in Brazil by the "Corleonesi" of Riina and passes through the friendship with the judge Giovanni Falcone and the testimony to the maxi trial that brought the mafia organization to its knees to end, after the accusations against Andreotti trial, with his death in 2000 in Miami, where Buscetta died of illness and not at the hands of the mafia.
cast: Pierfrancesco Favino, Maria Fernanda Cândido, Luigi Lo Cascio, Fabrizio Ferracane, Fausto Russo Alesi, Nicola Calì, Giovanni Calcagno, Goffredo Maria Bruno, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Ludovico Caldarera, Rosario Palazzolo

title: Il traduttore
synopsis: Andrei Bina is a Romanian student who, thanks to a scholarship, attends a specialization course in foreign languages ??and literature at the University of Rome. Since the purse money is low, in the evening he works in a pizzeria and during the day, sometimes, in the police station where he translates the interrogations and wiretaps of his compatriots. Thanks to his tutor, Andrei comes into contact with an antiquarian friend of his, Anna Ritter, who wants to have the diary of her German husband who recently passed away in tragic circumstances translated. With this delicate task Andrei is catapulted into a world that up to that moment he hasn't even dared to dream. The translation meetings give birth between the student and the young widow a great closeness that soon turns into a strong attraction, which Andrei decides to exploit when he discovers that the words of love in her husband's diary are not for her, but for a other woman.
cast: Claudia Gerini, Kamil Kula, Silvia Delfino, Piotr Rogucki, Anna Safroncik, Marcello Mazzarella, Marianna Januszewicz, Eva Grimaldi

title: Il trafficone
synopsis: The Neapolitan knitter Vincenzo Lo Russo, married to Angelina and father of three children, from one day to the next becomes a doctor and expert guide for couples in difficulty. Assuming a new identity, he calls himself Doctor Gaetano D'Angelo, "assisted" by his friend Gennaro, Vincenzo quickly meets an extraordinary success. Now he doesn't lack money or women, but overwork forces him to neglect his wife. To solve her problems, Angelina is persuaded by a friend to contact Dr. D'Angelo ...
cast: Carlo Giuffrè, Marilù Tolo, Tina Aumont, Lino Banfi, Enzo Cannavale

title: Il trapianto
synopsis: An American billionaire offers a thousand million to those who, with a transplant, will be able to restore his virility. A Roman employee is chosen, but a penniless Sicilian baron pretends to have been the "donor" to weave his sentimental plots undisturbed. Discovered the deception, the baron really suffers emasculation. Predictable and farcical humor.
cast: Carlo Giuffrè, Renato Rascel, Graziella Granata, Liana Trouché

title: Il trasformista
synopsis: A flood devastates the North. The flooding of the Po causes damage, exasperates the souls of ordinary citizens and uncovered a toxic waste pit. Viganò, an environmentalist with a more or less functional family, blocks the train on which the minister on duty travels to verify the extent of the damage. A television crew is also present at the lively confrontation. His face and his grit appear telegenic and someone notices it. He gets him contacted, nominates him, gets him elected to Parliament. In the Rome of the messengers, flanked by the councilor Lanzetta, he learns the rituals of the powerful and of the commissioned peons.
cast: Luca Barbareschi, Rocco Papaleo, Luigi Maria Burruano, Catherine Wilkening, Raffaele Pisu

title: Il tredicesimo è sempre Giuda
synopsis: In Sonora, a small village bordering Mexico, a group of people are preparing to celebrate the upcoming wedding of Ned Carter and Mary Bell: the realization that thirteen guests will be seated at the table leads one of those present to draw ominous omens ...
cast: Donald O'Brien, Maurice Poli, Dean Stratford, Attilio Dottesio

title: Il treno crociato
synopsis: A lieutenant is wounded on the eastern front in Russia. When he is hospitalized on a hospital train, the man remembers the love story that made him a father. An air alarm forces the train to stop, on the way back, in the lieutenant's hometown, where the once beloved and the never met son still live.
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Maria Mercader, Cesare Fantoni, Carlo Romano, Ada Dondini, Beatrice Mancini

title: Il treno va a Mosca
synopsis: In 1957 in Alfonsine, a small town in Romagna destroyed by war, the communist barber Sauro Ravaglia dreams of the Soviet Union. When the opportunity of a lifetime presents itself, that is to visit Moscow during the World Youth Festival, Sauro and three friends, armed with an 8mm camera, leave to film the great journey. In Moscow they are overwhelmed by the enthusiasm of the participants, but they observe some scenes for which they are not prepared: socialism is not the paradise they had imagined.

title: Il triangolo della paura
synopsis: There is a mole in the Narcotics Squad. To unmask her, a policeman is in turn infiltrated into a band of mercenaries who contend for the primacy of drug trafficking. American the model, American the setting; as expected (already seen and reviewed), the corpses flock.
cast: Lewis Collins, Lee Van Cleef, Donald Pleasence, Manfred Lehmann

title: Il triangolo delle Bermude
synopsis: An elderly archaeologist with his family is traveling aboard a yacht to the Sargasso Sea to do some studies. Entering the sea mirror that the title of the film the boat and its occupants begin to experience adventures to the limits of the paranormal that promptly end with terrible misfortunes. When at the bottom of the sea the archaeologist discovers the remains of an unknown city ...
cast: John Huston, Gloria Guida, Marina Vlady, Andrés García

title: Il trionfo dei dieci gladiatori
synopsis: The Roman proconsul of a region of Asia Minor subject to the Empire orders ten gladiators to kidnap the queen of a rival nation. Behind the mission, however, lies a trap devised by the prime minister for shady purposes of betrayal and power ...
cast: Dan Vadis, Helga Liné, Stanley Kent, Sal Borgese, Gianni Rizzo

title: Il trionfo di Maciste
synopsis: Tenefi, after having usurped the throne of Memphis, reigns over the city using violent and inhuman methods. His aim is to use terror to better govern the city. Citizens, tired of the constant harassment they are subjected to, turn to Maciste.
cast: Ljuba Bodine, Aldo Bufi Landi, Calisto Calisti, Carla Calò

title: Il trionfo di Robin Hood
synopsis: Robin Hood, in Sherwood Forest, fights his battle against the usurper to the throne and against the thugs of the Sheriff of Nottingham, who are tyrannizing the region. The battle continues until Richard the Lionheart returns from the Holy Land.
cast: Don Burnett, Germano Longo, Vincenzo Musolino

title: Il trono di fuoco - Il giudice sanguinario
synopsis: In seventeenth-century England, the perfidious judge Jefferies, to crush the conspiracy against King James II, burns the young Alicia Gray, guilty of witchcraft. His sister Mary, who is about to do the same, is saved by a lord. One of the delusional horror-adventurous-gothic-sadistic assemblages of the legendary Spanish director Jess Franco, magician of the Z series. Here the model is "The Grand Inquisitor" by Michael Reeves.
cast: Christopher Lee, Hans Hasse, Maria Shell, Margaret Lee

title: Il trovatore
synopsis: Azucena, daughter of a gypsy burned alive at the stake, kidnaps one of the sons of the count of Luna and raises him. When he becomes an adult, the young Manrico falls in love with Eleonora, betrothed to the surviving Count of Luna, that is, to her unsuspecting brother. The two collide and Manrico manages to escape, but gets captured again to save the woman he believes to be his mother from the stake. He is sentenced to death and executed, while Eleonora poisons herself; at that point, Azucena reveals the truth to the count of Luna. Cinematic version of Verdi's opera by the specialist Gallone. Known singers (Sinimberghi, la Pederzini), beautiful sets, immortal melodies.
cast: Gianna Pederzini, Gino Sinimberghi, Cesare Polacco

title: Il trucido e lo sbirro
synopsis: To arrest the dangerous criminal Brescianelli and free a kidnapped girl, who is also in urgent need of a kidney transplant, Commissioner Sarti thinks of enlisting the help of the thief Monnezza, and for this purpose he favors her escape.
cast: Tomas Milian, Claudio Cassinelli, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Henry Silva, Robert Hundar

title: Il tuffo
synopsis: Matteo, at the age of thirty, still lives with his parents in a quiet town in central Italy. During a very hot summer, to raise some money, he decides to give physics repetitions to two boys, Giulio and Elsa. The first is closed and insecure, the second is outgoing and temporarily free (her boyfriend is on vacation). In the end, both students and professors fall in love with her, but this feeling will bring about a real revolution, especially in Matteo's soul and life.
cast: Vincenzo Salemme, Carlotta Natoli, Gianni Cajafa

title: Il tunnel della libertà
synopsis: Mimmo and Gigi live in Berlin divided by the Wall; to try to free their friend Peter, stuck with his family in the eastern part of the city, they devise a plan to make him cross the border. After a failed escape attempt aboard a truck, Mimmo designs a 123-meter-long tunnel that from a disused factory to the west will emerge in a basement to the east. The two friends work tirelessly, digging continuously with rudimentary means for seven months, finally managing to complete the enterprise and save 37 people.
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Antonia Liskova, Paolo Briguglia, Viktor Dénes, György Gazsó, Emanuele Guerrini, Péter Horkay, Péter Janicsek, Szilvia Keviczky, Attila Király

title: Il tunnel sotto il mondo
synopsis: A murder in broad daylight in the town square unleashes a swarm of voices, sensations, visions. Between computers that study the essence of God in order to predict him and ineffable errant preachers, the only certainty always remains the same: the passage of time.
cast: Alberto Moro, Bruno Salviero, Pietro Rosati, Lello Maraniello, Luigi Cozzi, Anna Mantovani

title: Il tuo dolce corpo da uccidere
synopsis: Determined to get rid of his domineering wife Diana, Clive Ardington, a British diplomat, uses the complicity of his wife's lover to kill her. Once the crime has been completed and the body is placed in a suitcase, the man leaves for Tangier where he expects to make any trace of the crime disappear permanently in the acid pits of a tannery. But fate is lurking: Diana seems not to be dead and Clive also has to deal with the police who have set their sights on him.
cast: Georges Ardisson, Françoise Prevost, Orchidea De Santis, Eduardo Fajardo

title: Il tuo piacere è il mio
synopsis: A Florentine noble of the '500 offers a banquet to some illustrious guests. During the dinner some stories are told: A naïve marquise allows herself to a lustful abbot convinced that she is imitating the pious works of some saints in this; A cardinal deliberately entertains his guests at the table under the effect of a powerful purgative; a dyer has an affair with a friar; Francis I of France, although a prisoner of the Spaniards, consoles himself with two Iberian beauties; A prostitute risks disrupting the council of Constance; a nobleman cheats on his (unfaithful) wife with a prostitute. From Balzac's "Contes drolatiques", a scollacciato episodic film in sixteenth-century costume in the decamerotic vein.
cast: Ewa Aulin, Femi Benussi, Barbara Bouchet, Sylva Koscina, Lionel Stander, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Il tuo vizio è una stanza chiusa e solo io ne ho la chiave
synopsis: Oliviero, a failed writer, erotomaniac and alcoholic, who hates his wife Irene is suspected of killing his mistress. But thanks to an unexpected testimony from Irene, he is cleared of the charges. Some time later, in Oliviero's villa, someone kills the black maid. Fearing the consequences, the man, helped by his wife, walls the corpse in the cellar. A few days later the niece Floriana arrives, an unscrupulous girl, who becomes the lover of her aunt, Oliviero and the motorcyclist Dario. The girl becomes a witness to the hatred that divides the guests and unperturbed witnesses the murder of Oliviero.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Anita Strindberg, Luigi Pistilli, Ivan Rassimov

title: Il turno
synopsis: The penniless Baron Pepé loves Stellina. However, she marries Don Diego out of interest and in the hope of becoming a widow soon. So she marries the lawyer who gets her to get the marriage annulled. Meanwhile, Pepé continues to wait for his turn. Based on the novel of the same name by Luigi Pirandello with some vulgar trivialization.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Laura Antonelli, Paolo Villaggio, Bernard Blier

title: Il tuttofare
synopsis: Salvatore Toti Bellastella is a lawyer at the head of one of the most important law firms in Italy. Under his direction works Antonio Bonocore, a good practitioner that Salvatore uses as his handyman: Antonio does everything for him, from the bag holder to the cook, sometimes. To reward him for his dedication, when the young trainee finally passes the bar exam with excellent results, Salvatore makes him an unmissable job offer: a contract worth 10,000 euros a month at his studio, which also ensures his involvement. in the most important causes. There is only one small hitch: in exchange Antonio will have to marry Bellastella's lover, Isabel, an Argentine girl who needs Italian citizenship.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Elena Sofia Ricci, Clara Alonso, Luca Avagliano, Alberto Di Stasio, Beatrice Schiros, Mimmo Mignemi, Guglielmo Poggi, Daniele Monterosi

title: Il vagabondo
synopsis: Pippo the tramp doesn't have a penny in his pocket, but he doesn't have a worry on his mind either. He is there courting the maid of a noble house when he accidentally discovers that the betrothed of the owners' daughter is aiming exclusively for money. He reveals the news to his family and, instead of exploiting their gratitude, he leaves as always free and happy. Films tailored for Macario, but today it doesn't make anyone laugh anymore.
cast: Erminio Macario, Memo Benassi

title: Il vangelo secondo Mattei
synopsis: A cynical director and his assistant return to Basilicata, their homeland, in search of redemption. Having reached the age of 50 and having failed in their artistic ambitions, they decide to ride the dissent over oil extraction to put on a ramshackle investigative film entitled The Gospel according to Mattei, which will intertwine with the life of Pier Paolo Pasolini, author of the unfinished novel Petrolio and the cinematographic masterpiece The Gospel according to Matthew, shot in Basilicata in 1964. The two, driven by reasons of "marketing" rather than aesthetic, choose as the protagonist of their film an elderly Materano, Franco, seventy years old who as a child , in fact, he participated as an extra on Pasolini's film. For the elder Franco, who will have to play none other than the role of Jesus, this is the long-awaited opportunity for redemption. But the burning topic their film deals with, that is oil and the relationship with the earth, is beginning to annoy someone ..
cast: Flavio Bucci, Ludovica Modugno, Antonio Andrisani, Pascal Zullino, Antonio Stormaiolo, Riccardo Zinna, Andrea Osvart, Giovanni Ferreri, Marco Caldoro, Mimmo Calopresti, Gigi Angiulli, Enrique Irazoqui

title: Il varco
synopsis: Summer 1941, an Italian soldier leaves by train for the Soviet front. The fascist army is allied with the Nazi one, victory appears close. The convoy leaves amidst songs and hopes. The soldier's mind returns to the melancholy of the tales told him by his Russian mother. Unlike many young fellow soldiers, he has already known war, in Africa, and is not enthusiastic about it, on the contrary, he fears it. The train crosses half of Europe, venturing into the vast Ukrainian territory. With the arrival of winter, enthusiasm falls under the blows of the first dead, frost and snow. Desires are made simple: no longer victory, but a warm bed, food, a hug. The immense blizzard-swept steppe appears to be inhabited by ghosts. The soldier has only one faint hope: to go home.

title: Il vecchio testamento
synopsis: Reconstruction of pure fantasy of the guerrilla struggle that the tribes of Israel waged, in the second second century BC, against the Hellenistic rulers under the leadership of Judas Maccabee and his brothers. A canvas and a good director for all seasons: both when the "peplum" was in fashion, and, a decade later, with the western spaghetti.
cast: Brad Harris, Susan Paget, Mara Lane, Enzo Doria, Isarco Ravaioli

title: Il vedovo
synopsis: Commendator Alberto Nardi owes his good social position to his wife's large money. One day he receives the news of his life: his wife is among the victims of a train crash. Nardi thinks he has solved all his problems thanks to the inheritance, but the lady, alas, is more alive than ever.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Franca Valeri, Livio Lorenzon, Nando Bruno

title: Il vedovo allegro
synopsis: Bebè, a penniless magazine actor, tries to find the money necessary to have his beloved daughter treated by blackmailing his partner. Denounced, a sympathetic police commissioner will save him. The film is saved only for Dapporto in a semidrammatic role. The rest is to be forgotten.
cast: Carlo Dapporto, Isa Barzizza, Amedeo Nazzari

title: Il vegetale
synopsis: Fabio is a young graduate who can't find a job, struggling with a bulky father and a capricious and spoiled little sister. Both consider it a "vegetable". An unexpected event will suddenly change roles. Between comic situations and paradoxical ideas, Fabio will have to reinvent his life.
cast: Fabio Rovazzi, Luca Zingaretti, Ninni Bruschetta, Paola Calliari, Rosy Franzese, Barbara D'Urso, Marc Grosy

title: Il vegetariano
synopsis: Krishna, the son of a Brahmin, lives in Italy milking cows. Direct contact with animals brings him back to his childhood in India, characterized by a great respect for nature. When an unproductive cow has to be sent to slaughter, Krishna finds himself having to make a choice: accept the culture he lives in or follow his conscience?
cast: Sukhpal Singh, Marta Tananyan, Mudassar Ashraf, Luigi Monferrini

title: Il vendicatore mascherato
synopsis: Venice, 1500. Massimo Tiepolo, brave fighter at the invitation of Luca Badoer, is urged to take part in the conspiracy against the Doge Gradenigo. The man at arms does not feel like supporting the revolt and pulls aside. When the tyrant's thugs capture and torture Luca, Massimo shakes off his indifference and becomes the leader of the conspirators. Elena, Gradenigo's wife, jealous of being rejected by Massimo, denounces him and has him locked up in the Piombi. Following the passionate pleas of Caterina Ziani, the young man's girlfriend, she herself frees him from his cell.
cast: Guy Madison, Lisa Gastoni, Jean Claudio, Gastone Moschin

title: Il venditore di medicine
synopsis: Bruno (Claudio Santamaria) has reached the age of forty and works as a medical informant in a company that is going through a period of crisis. Faced with the forecast of some staff cuts, each medicine seller is closely monitored by a strict area manager (Isabella Ferrari) to decide which of them will continue to keep their jobs and who will not. With a family and a position to maintain, Bruno does not hesitate to act dishonestly and betray the trust of those around him, resorting to deception and corruption. The meeting with an old friend, reduced to poor conditions for having voluntarily acted as a guinea pig in some pharmaceutical experiments, however, will give him the opportunity to redeem himself.
cast: Claudio Santamaria, Isabella Ferrari, Marco Travaglio, Evita Ciri, Roberto De Francesco, Ignazio Oliva, Giorgio Gobbi, Vincenzo Tanassi, Leonardo Nigro, Ippolito Chiarello, Alessia Barela, Paolo De Vita, Pierpaolo Lovino, Beniamino Marcone, Roberto Silvestri

title: Il venditore di morte
cast: Gianni Garko, Gely Genka, Klaus Kinski, Luciano Lorcas

title: Il venditore di palloncini
synopsis: Maria, a variety dancer, runs away with Dimitri, leaving her husband Antonio and little Giacomino. After six years, Antonio is an alcoholic and Giacomino keeps him, despite his young age and frail constitution, by being a puppeteer. The child is undermined by a deadly form of anemia; his agony will make his father come to his senses and return his mother to his bedside, even if only an hour before death. After having signed some third-row spaghetti westerns as John Walker and having tried the path of detective and erotic horror, Gariazzo arrives at the family mélo. Easy tear leads to involuntary humor.
cast: Renato Cestié, Lee J. Cobb, Marina Malfatti, James Whitmore

title: Il vento mi ha cantato una canzone
synopsis: A commendatore, owner of a cosmetics factory, has signed a contract with Radio Sibilla for the evening broadcast of a musical program. But the program was not successful with the public and the Commander telephoned the radio to complain. Paul replies, that having to complain he can not help but agree with him. Unfortunately for him, he complains just as he has the radio director behind him, who fires him. At this point Paolo, who is a good musician, tries to be hired as a whole by the commander to revive the fortunes of the broadcast.
cast: Laura Solari, Alberto Sordi, Virgilio Riento, Pietro Bigerna

title: Il vento, di sera
synopsis: Marco leaves the station, takes his bicycle and rides home. Meanwhile, Paolo, from his home, talks on the phone with Luca, his partner who is waiting for dinner. Marco arrives in front of the door, but as soon as he opens two gunshots they kill him. On the way of the killer on the run, Luca accidentally appears and is fatally wounded. Among the people rushed there is also Paolo who, shocked, witnesses the arrival of the ambulance.
cast: Corso Salani, Francesca Mazza, Sergio Romano, Fabio Valletta, Ivano Marescotti

title: Il verificatore
synopsis: Crescenzio, a big boy of thirty, weighed down by an enormous body, works as a verifier at the gas company: he reads the meters house by house. He still lives with his family and has no friends. Giuliana is the secretary of an electronic repair laboratory, run by a violent old man who moves on the edge of legality, where Crescenzio's brother, Beniamino, vital and optimistic, also works. For Giuliana, shy and taciturn like him, Crescenzio almost nurtures an adoration, which however does not seem to be reciprocated. When the old man's attentions become insistent, the girl, who lives alone in the city, seeks protection in Beniamino The story of Incerti, also the author and screenwriter of the film, is one that Italian cinema usually does not tell. The protagonist Iuorio is very good, with his bulky and shy silhouette reminiscent of certain characters from Fassbinder.
cast: Antonino Iuorio, Roberto De Francesco, Elodie Treccani

title: Il vero e il falso
synopsis: Luisa is a teacher who is unjustly condemned for a crime of passion, which was never actually committed. Released for good behavior, Luisa decides to actually kill the woman for whose fake death she was incarcerated.
cast: Martin Balsam, Terence Hill, Paola Pitagora

title: Il vestito da sposa
synopsis: In a wedding dress atelier, Stella is trying on a sumptuous white dress. A few hours later, happiness gives way to terror. Suddenly Stella abandons the idea of ??getting married, pushes her boyfriend away, leaves university, cuts her hair and gets a job in a nearby town. This is where it all starts all over again.
cast: Maya Sansa, Andrea Di Stefano, Pier Paolo Lovino, Salvatore Lazzaro, Piera Degli Esposti, Mauro Marchese, Chiara Conti, Pietro Faiella, Lorenzo Branchetti

title: Il veterinario
synopsis: Gigi, a veterinarian, lives in a beautiful villa with his wife Gioia and their children Riccardo and Emanuela. He divides his time between the clinic and Sgnak, an animal feed factory owned by his father-in-law; within the company, he holds the position of head of the quality sector. Unexpectedly, Sgnak, and especially Gigi, are accused by consumers for the use of substances considered harmful to the health of puppies. The protest makes use of the decisive contribution of Olimpia, a forty-year-old assault journalist determined to shed light on the investigation and its protagonists. The story risks compromising Gigi's future ...
cast: Gigi Proietti, Anna Galiena, Edy Angelillo, Luigi Montini, Massimiliano Giovannetti

title: Il viaggio
synopsis: Adriana, the only daughter of a Sicilian bourgeois, married Count Antonio Braggi, but in her heart she has always loved her brother-in-law Cesare. On the death of her husband she closes in a very close mourning from which she only leaves to go to Palermo to consult a cardiologist. Based on a short story by Pirandello, the latest film directed by De Sica is unbearable and tearful, one of his worst.
cast: Sophia Loren, Richard Burton, Ian Bannen, Annabella Incontrera, Barbara Pilavin

title: Il viaggio
synopsis: Five people take the train of the Carpinone-Sulmona railway section before the suppression of the line that crosses suggestive and uncontaminated areas of Molise. There is the politician of pure soul, who detests the rural origins of his family and accepts money in black for his election campaign from an entrepreneur. There is an oenologist who does not believe in himself and regrets a youth love now far away. There is an actress who dreams of straightening his modest television career and despises the native land in which he has not set foot for years. There is a university assistant who goes to bed with the owner of the chair but is tired of compromising. Finally, there is an entrepreneur who has lost everything and feels a failed with his son and wife.
cast: Maurizio Santilli, Gaetano Amato, Angelo Orlando, Sergio Sivori, Fabio Ferrari, Danila Stalteri, Daniela Terreri, Giulio Maroncelli

title: Il viaggio clandestino
synopsis: San Gil seeks holiness through prayers and suffering. Instead, his spiritual partner, Ciccio Bavaria, obstinately seeks sin because only in this way does he find the way to spiritual life. Together the two embark on a journey that will lead the first to damn himself and the second to save himself, reincarnating in Buddha. Meanwhile, Christ, grappling with the modern world, has a hard life.
cast: Enzo Moscato, Enzo Vetrano, Donato Castellaneta, Elena Bucci

title: Il viaggio degli eroi
