synopsis: On the evening of 11 July 1982 in Madrid Italy won the World Cup, at the end of a path submerged by criticism and dissatisfactions for the tactical choices of Bearzot. The documentary traces the story of those seven games, with the narrative voice of Marco Giallini.
cast: Marco Giallini, Alessandro Altobelli, Giancarlo Antognoni, Antonio Cabrini, Bruno Conti

title: Il viaggio della signorina Vila
synopsis: Freely inspired by two texts that turn 100 years old in 2012 - Il mio Carso by Scipio Slataper and Irridentismo adriatico by Angelo Vivante -, the film tells through the narrative voice of Toni Servillo and Lucka Pockaj the love story in today's Trieste of a a man and a woman who have fallen from another time. In addition to being a tribute to the city and its adventurous past, it is also the story of an intellectual who confronts his real and literary past.
cast: Toni Servillo, Lucka Pockaj, Claudio Magris, Gillo Dorfles, Mauro Covacich, Luciana Castellina, Susanna Tamaro, Boris Pahor

title: Il viaggio della sposa
synopsis: A young noblewoman must be escorted from the Abruzzese convent, where she received a refined education, to her betrothed in the city of Bari. During the ambush set by a band of brigands, Countess Portia's large escort is exterminated. The only survivors, the young woman and Bartolo, a rough stable boy. It will be he who will accompany her along the streets of seventeenth-century southern Italy.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Carlo Mucari, Franco Javarone, Umberto Orsini

title: Il viaggio di Capitan Fracassa
synopsis: To reach the court of Paris, the penniless Baron de Sigognac joins a troupe of actors. It is the total initiation to life, to love, to the theater, which transforms him into the bold mask of Captain Fracassa. The walkers embark on an adventurous journey between the counties of that ancient world, and the noble baron renounces the house to devote himself exclusively to art.
cast: Vincent Perez, Massimo Troisi, Ornella Muti, Emmanuelle Béart, Tosca D'Aquino, Jean François Perrier, Ciccio Ingrassia, Lauretta Masiero, Claudio Amendola, Giuseppe Cederna, Toni Ucci, Massimo Wertmüller, Remo Girone, Marco Messeri, Naike Rivelli

title: Il vichingo venuto dal Sud
synopsis: Rosario Trapanese, a Sicilian with open views (he says), gets sent by his employer to direct the Danish branch of the company. He gets busy, with little success, as a "Latin lover", then marries the beautiful Karen. Except discovering, a little late, that his wife has a past as the protagonist of a "hard" short film. Bad money, with Buzzanca in his usual stereotype.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Pamela Tiffin, Renzo Marignano, Gigi Ballista

title: Il vigile
synopsis: Otello Colletti (Sordi) manages to get himself hired as a "big guy", but he gets into trouble one after the other, both when he has a broad sleeve (as with Sylva Koscina, in the role of herself), and when he decides to be strict and fiscal . He rigorously applies the highway code even towards the mayor (De Sica) and ends up receiving reprimands instead of praise.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Marisa Merlini, Mara Berni

title: Il villaggio di cartone
synopsis: An old priest (Michael Lonsdale) witnessed helplessly the evacuation of what for many years was the church where he officiated mass and blessed the faithful of a small village. Embittered and upset, with the help of the sacristan (Rutger Hauer), the prelate will soon realize how that desecrated building can be the lifeline for the souls of a group of illegal immigrants on the run, forced to fight with whoever he wants. at all costs to enforce the laws. In this way he will rediscover the true value of the house of God and of the priestly spirit.
cast: Michael Lonsdale, Rutger Hauer, Massimo De Francovich, Alessandro Haber, Elhadji Ibrahima Faye, Irma Pino Viney, Fatima Ali

title: Il vincente
synopsis: Antonio, a wealthy young bachelor, loves the good life and gambling, especially poker. His father, tired of supporting him and always having to fix his troubles, forces him to join a therapy group and find a job. Pretending to please him, Antonio instead continues to persevere in his vice, which has now become pathological. With his mind clouded by the adrenaline of easy winning and convinced that he can make a fortune, he searches for other gambling opportunities beyond the usual circle of old friends and joins a picturesque company of thugs. His routine is suddenly upset by the meeting with an extravagant gallery owner, Dalia, with whom he begins a romantic love story. The girl does not condemn her vice; indeed, intrigued, she lets herself be introduced into that unknown world that will overwhelm her.
cast: Luca Magri, Maria Celeste Sellitto, Michele Buttarelli, Marco Iannitello, Nina Torresi, Adriano Guareschi, Paolo Rossini, Giulia Bertinelli, Francesco Silva

title: Il vizio della speranza
synopsis: Along the river the time of Mary passes, the hood on her head and the resolute step. An existence spent one day at a time, without dreams or desires, taking care of his mother and serving a jeweled madame. Together with her brave-eyed pit bull, Maria ferries pregnant women across the river in what appears to be an endless purgatory. Hope will one day visit her again, in its most ancestral and powerful form, as miraculous as life itself: because remaining human has always been the greatest of revolutions.
cast: Pina Turco, Massimiliano Rossi, Marina Confalone, Cristina Donadio, Marcello Romolo

title: Il vizio di famiglia
synopsis: The old count is about to die and there is great agitation among his descendants. Fearing that the beautiful Ines can obtain the entire inheritance, relatives commissioned a former prisoner to conclude it and ruin the reputation. But erotic intrigues do not go as expected and involve all the members of the family. In the end, the reading of the testament will reserve a sad surprise for everyone.
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Edwige Fenech, Gigi Ballista

title: Il vizio di vivere
synopsis: Following a car accident, a girl is completely paralyzed and forced to live in a lung of steel. Among the dramatic consequences of this situation there is also the abandonment by her boyfriend. However, she manages to find the affection of a journalist.
cast: Carol Alt, Andrea Occhipinti, William Berger

title: Il vizio ha le calze nere
synopsis: A mysterious murderer sows panic in the provinces: the victims, all women, are brutally murdered. The police have no idea who might be hiding behind the crimes but it soon becomes evident that the victims are connected to a woman, dressed in black stockings ...
cast: John Richardson, Dagmar Lassander, Ninetto Davoli, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: Il volatore di aquiloni
synopsis: A man who lives in the mountains wants to see the sea at all costs and, despite the pleas of his mother, embarks on a long journey with his hang glider. Due to a strong cough he is forced to glide over Milan, and precisely on the San Siro football field. From here he will begin a series of bizarre adventures that will lead him to visit the Rinascente, La Scala, the streets of the center and the Milanese suburbs.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Massimo Boldi, Felice Andreasi, Piero Mazzarella, Gianni Cajafa, Karl Heinz Rummenigge, Vinicio Verza, Claudio Boldi, Vincenzo De Toma, Riccardo Mazzarella

title: Il volpone
synopsis: Ugo Maria Volpone, a very rich shipowner, tyrannizes his three best friends who are only waiting for his death to throw themselves into the inheritance. With the arrival of the new waiter, Bartolomeo, the game becomes even more poisoned. Finally, the two stage the great number of the death of the landlord. Inspired by Ben Johnson's comedy of the same name, the film is professionally directed by Ponzi. Compared to the original (to which the Joseph Mankiewicz of Masquerade also referred), this version overturns the parts and chooses to employ the waiter Bartolomeo as the engine and protagonist of the intrigue. synopsis: In Sanremo, in 1989, a slender female figure walks through the corridors that lead to the stage of the Ariston theater. It's Mia Martini on her return to the scene after years of neglect: "You know people are strange first they hate each other then they love each other" is the first verse of her new song, of her new life. Mimì, in a close interview with Sandra, a journalist who actually would like to meet Ray Charles in Sanremo and who considers Mia Martini only a fallback, retraces her life: the difficult beginnings of a bohemian; the complex relationship with her father who, while loving her, hinders her to the point of hurting her; a contrasted love story that overwhelms her, marking her sentimental destiny; the slander that sticks on her like the plague, conditioning her career with dizzying ups and downs; darkness, up to the new, more peaceful dimension of life.

And, thus, the powerful Numa will have to make himself available to those who have nothing, the least. Among these is Bruno, a young father who attends the center with his son, following an economic meltdown. The meeting would seem to offer both the opportunity for a rebirth in the name of good feelings and friendship. But there is money involved and a group of homeless people who, between morals and money, will tend to prefer money.

When Lorenzo arrives, he still has dinner. They chat while he eats his burger. They have different views on the complicity between sex and food. Then they finally get naked, kiss, laugh. They have been missed. They are lovers, they are twenty years old, they make love for a long time until they fall asleep.

synopsis: A second year high school student, Morino Hotaru has spent the last few years crushing on her classmate, Otaka Ren. Unable to find the courage to confess her feelings, Hotaru has become something of an expert in unrequited love. One day, while on a school trip with Ren and her best friend, Yamamoto Shiori, their bus gets into an accident. Blacking out for a bit, Hotaru wakes up to find a young man, dressed fully in black, standing over her. Shocked by his sudden appearance, Hotaru shoves him away but he refuses to leave. Introducing himself as Kuro, he announces that he’s a grim reaper and that Hotaru is dead. As if the news of her death wasn’t shocking enough, Kuro goes on to explain that she has 49 days in which to resolve the three lingering attachments she has to her past life. If she fails to resolve these lingering regrets within the given time, she’ll become a ghost, bound to this world, unable to rest in peace for all eternity. There’s just one problem, Hotaru has been asleep for a month and now has only nineteen days in which to resolve her regrets. Difficult as it seems, Hotaru sets out to free herself from the last, lingering attachments to her mortal life. With time running out, she must hurry, but saying goodbye is hard and saying “I love you” feels nearly impossible! Karlson is a poet of violence and as in a Jim Thompson novel he stages a psychologically gory party game, relentlessly pushing all his characters to the point of no return. Tough faces and varied locations - starting in the States, ending up in Mexico - are perfect ingredients for a hardboiled of cynical realism, where the dialogues are as fatal as guns. Little action but a lot of tension, for a gem that makes a virtue of necessity and takes full advantage of the little money in the budget. George E. Diskant's black and white photography is splendid.

Cyber-brains allow not only to connect to the web, but also to use one's memory with the same flexibility as that of a computer, deleting events, overwriting them, or even storing books with extreme ease. title: Kûkai
synopsis: During the Tang Dynasty, Chinese poet Bai Letian and Japanese monk Kukai join forces to investigate a demonic cat who, appeared out of nowhere, possessed a general's wife and wreaked havoc in the imperal court. The investigation, however, leads to gruesome and unexpected twists, revealing the mystery that lies behind the death, which took place decades earlier, of the beautiful concubine Yang Guifei.
cast: Xuan Huang, Shôta Sometani, Yuqi Zhang, Hao Qin, Hiroshi Abe, Libby Brien, Taishen Cheng, Brittany Falardeau, Brian Flaccus, Matt Fowler

title: Kûki ningyô
synopsis: The love story between a blow-up doll with a soul and a video store clerk.
cast: Du Na Bae, Jô Odagiri, Susumu Terajima, Kimiko Yo, Arata, Itsuji Itao, Sumiko Fuji, Mari Hoshino, Ryo Iwamatsu

title: Küf
synopsis: Basri is a 55-year-old man who works as a railway guard and every day he walks about 20 kilometers to check the state of the tracks. Punctually, every first and fifteen of the month he writes a letter to the police to have news about the disappearance of his son Seyfi, which mysteriously occurred eighteen years earlier, when the young man had just moved to Istanbul to study at the university. The only thing Besri knows is that her son was stopped by the police for anti-government activities before disappearing without a trace, even resulting in the death of his mother.
cast: Ercan Kesal, Muhammet Uzuner, Tansu Biçer

title: Küçük Esnaf
synopsis: As an honest locksmith scrambles to pay his late father's hefty debt to the mafia, he crosses paths with a woman in similar trouble and falls for her.
cast: İbrahim Büyükak, Zeynep Koçak, Gupse Özay, Cengiz Bozkurt

title: L
synopsis: A man in his forties, who lives aboard his car, spends his free time meeting his ex-wife and two children at set days and times, always within car parking areas, while earning a living by doing from driver and escort to a mysterious fifty-year-old. One day, however, when another driver shows up at the door of the fifty-year-old and shoots him, killing him, he finds himself involved in a metropolitan war between cyclists and motorists and forced to flee because no one is willing to believe his truth.
cast: Aris Servetalis, Makis Papadimitriou, Eleftherios Matthaios, Nota Tserniafski, Stavros Raptis, Thanassis Dimou, Christoforos Skamnakis, Yannis Bostantzoglou

title: L!fe Happens
synopsis: Kim (Krysten Ritter), Deena (Kate Bosworth) and Laura (Rachel Bilson) are three young women who live in harmony under one roof in Los Angeles. When, after a one-night stand, Kim rediscovers herself expecting a child, everything takes on a different aspect. With the support of Deena and Laura, Kim finds herself forced to confront the difficulties of being a young single mother and to review her ambitions and plans for the future, especially after the birth of the child does not allow her to have a love life. able to go beyond the first date.
cast: Krysten Ritter, Kate Bosworth, Rachel Bilson, Geoff Stults, Justin Kirk, Fallon Goodson, Andrea Savage, Kristen Johnston, Rhys Coiro, Seymour Cassel, Jason Biggs

title: L'Accademia Carrara - Il Museo riscoperto
synopsis: The Carrara Academy of Bergamo is one of the many treasures of Italy that remained closed to the public for a long time and, after seven years, finally returned to light. It has over 600 paintings in its collection, including those by Raphael, Mantegna, Bellini, Botticelli, but also many works by great artists from the Renaissance to the end of the nineteenth century. During the last year of restoration work, director Davide Ferrario has decided to tell the reopening of the art gallery with a cinematographic journey that also represents his personal reflection in images on the sense of looking.

title: L'Agnese va a morire
synopsis: Agnese, an illiterate washerwoman from the Comacchio valleys, lavishes her affection and her care on her husband Paolo, a convinced Marxist who, despite the handicap from which she suffers (is almost paralyzed), carries out clandestine political activities. When Paolo is deported and killed by the Germans, Agnes reacts by joining a group of partisans as a relay ...
cast: Ingrid Thulin, Stefano Satta Flores, Massimo Girotti, Michele Placido, Aurore Clément, Ninetto Davoli, William Berger, Flavio Bucci, Rosalino Cellamare, Alfredo Pea, Bruno Zanin, Eleonora Giorgi, Johnny Dorelli, Dina Sassoli, Gabriella Giorgelli

title: L'Amant d'un jour
synopsis: After a romantic breakup, a young woman in her twenties returns to her father. He discovers that the man is having an affair with a girl of his own age.
cast: Eric Caravaca, Esther Garrel, Louise Chevillotte

title: L'Ami, François d'Assise et ses frères
synopsis: At the dawn of the 13th century, in Italy, Francis of Assisi with his simple life and his spirit of brotherhood fascinated the poor and disturbed the powerful of the Church. Surrounded by his brothers and driven by intense faith, Francis struggles to have his vision of a world of peace and equality recognized after being refused by Innocent III to approve the first version of the Rule, which would put the brothers at the shelter from the threats that weigh upon them. Around him, among the companions of the first hour, the fraternal friend Elia da Cortona leads the difficult dialogue between the brotherhood and the Papacy: to obtain the recognition of the Order, Elia tries to convince Francis of the need to abandon the shown intransigence until then, accepting to draft a new Rule.
cast: Jérémie Rénier, Elio Germano, Yannick Renier, Olivier Gourmet, Alba Rohrwacher, Eric Caravaca, Thomas Doret, Marcello Mazzarella

title: L'Amour Fou
synopsis: Sébastien and Claire are happily married and are working on a play with Racine's "L'Andromaque" as its subject: Claire plays the role of Hermione while Sébastien, in addition to covering the role of Pyrrhus, is also the director of the play in which he is pouring out all his energies. Sébastien, however, demands from his partner a freer and more personal interpretation than the Alexandrian text, so much so that the girl does not think she is suitable for the role and decides to give up, also because annoyed by the omnipresent television crew that takes up rehearsals in an intrusive way. Sébastien thus replaces her with Marta, his ex-girlfriend, and intensifies the tests inevitably neglecting his wife and even going so far as to betray her. Claire for her part falls into a state of compulsive loneliness. Thus begins a delusional phase of their relationship, full of childish manifestations, flashbacks and desperate gestures that intertwines with the rehearsals of the theatrical representation, whose plot seems to have more than one point in common with the story of Sébastien and Claire. mad love that binds the two boys and that Sébastien manifests for the theater will perhaps remain unsatisfied forever.
cast: Bulle Ogier, Jean Pierre Kalfon, André S. Labarthe, Josée Destoop, Dennis Berry, Maddly Bamy, Étienne Becker, Yves Beneyton, Liliane Bordoni, Celia

title: L'Animale
synopsis: Riding their bicycles, 18-year-old Mati and her gang of male friends intimidate the whole neighborhood and harass the girls, keeping everyone and everything in check. But when her close friend Sebastian falls in love with her and her enemy Carla suddenly turns into a friend, Mati risks losing her dominant position in the group. Meanwhile, his parents must make an important decision as to what is best of appearances or reality.
cast: Sophie Stockinger, Kathrin Resetarits, Dominik Warta, Julia Franz Richter, Jack Hofer, Dominic Marcus Singer, Simon Morzé, Stefan Pohl, Gisela Salcher, Eva Herzig

title: L'Anno mille
synopsis: In a story that follows some lives and their respective reincarnations over time, Valerio is a prince in 1000 and a Sert doctor in 2000. Altea, on the other hand, is a princess, who after a thousand years was reincarnated as a university student who volunteers as a mission. and also operates in the same Sert. Their antagonist, in the past as well as in the present, is a man who was an alchemist and who is today the evil director of the same hospital where the Sert is located. by Valerio and Altea. A rather anomalous director, given that he takes advantage of the cover offered by his office to trade drugs in a big way. A fourth character is added to the three, Herrmugnen, who in the story embodies the mythological figure of the giant-hero.
cast: Giada Desideri, Marco Bonini, Edoardo Leo, Franco Oppini

title: L'Année sainte
synopsis: Two no longer young bandits go to Rome to recover the proceeds of an old coup. But they do not think they are well informed before arriving in the Eternal City, where the celebrations of the Holy Year are taking place. The two, however, know how to turn the situation to the best, wearing religious robes.
cast: Jean Gabin, Jean Claude Brialy, Danielle Darrieux, Nicoletta Machiavelli

title: L'Anticristo
synopsis: Young daughter of Roman nobles, Ippolita has been semi-paralyzed for years. Convinced of the psychic origin of the problem, a psychiatrist thinks he can solve it with the weapons of science. A family picture comes to light characterized by oedipal and incestuous relationships, but that is not enough: the girl must be freed from the devil.
cast: Carla Gravina, Mel Ferrer, Arthur Kennedy, Umberto Orsini, George Coulouris, Alida Valli, Mario Scaccia, Anita Strindberg, Remo Girone

title: L'Apparition
synopsis: Jacques is a journalist for a very popular daily newspaper in France. His reputation as an impartial and talented investigative journalist soon attracts the attention of the Vatican, which decides to recruit him for a special task: to take part in the commission called to verify the authenticity of a religious apparition in a small village. After his arrival, Jacques meets the young and sensitive Anna, the one who with her pure spirit would have witnessed the apparition of the Virgin Mary. Confronting the different points of view, Jacques will gradually discover what dark and hidden forces are at work, finding himself deeply shaken.
cast: Vincent Lindon, Galatéa Bellugi, Patrick D'Assumçao, Anatole Taubman, Elina Löwensohn, Claude Lévèque, Gérard Dessalles, Bruno Georis, Alicia Hava, Candice Bouchet

title: L'Apprenti Père Noël et le flocon magique
synopsis: Nicolas, a seven-year-old boy, has officially become the new Santa Claus and is about to embark on his first journey to bring gifts to the children of the world. Two days before leaving, however, Nicolas finds himself facing a terrible crisis: all over the world the magic of Christmas is disappearing and he is the cause. Before it's too late, Nicolas will have to find a solution as quickly as possible and thus save the upcoming party.

title: L'Arcangelo
synopsis: A mediocre lawyer willing to do anything is contacted by Gloria, a beautiful girl, who tells him that she has killed a rich man, her lover. In reality, the allegedly killed is alive and well and has concocted a plan with the girl to smuggle a lot of diamonds. Unknowingly, the lawyer acts as a courier, but that's not all: the role of the designated victim of a murder charge is in store for him. How will it end?
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Pamela Tiffin, Irina Demick, Adolfo Celi, Laura Antonelli, Corrado Olmi, Carlo Delle Piane, Carlo Pisacane

title: L'Aretino nei suoi ragionamenti... sulle cortigiane...
cast: Luciano De Ambrosis, Geraldine Stewart, Fiorella Masselli, Marisa Traversi

title: L'Art de la fugue
synopsis: Antoine is fed up with his family. The older brother Gérard, unemployed and with a marriage in disarray, lets himself be manipulated by the quarrelsome parents who own a clothing store. Louis, the younger brother, is unable to combine love and respect and, abandoned by his girlfriend Julie, he ran into his father's arms. Trapped between an absurd job, the emotional blackmail of his parents and a too perfect lover, Antoine tries to be of help to his parents as he can until the day when his friend Ariel intrudes on the unstable equilibrium of the family.
cast: Laurent Lafitte, Agnès Jaoui, Marie Christine Barrault, Guy Marchand, Benjamin Biolay, Nicolas Bedos, Bruno Putzulu, Elodie Frégé, Julien Baumgartner, Alice Belaïdi

title: L'Atalante
synopsis: Just married, Jean and Juliette set sail on his river boat, the "Atalante". On board the sailor Père Jules tries to seduce the woman, as will a tramp. Juliette's escape, Jean's despair, the woman's return. Vigo's latest film, which died the same year, poised between realism and poetry, between social and avant-garde gaze.
cast: Michel Simon, Jean Dasté, Dita Parlo, Gilles Margaritis, Louis Lefebvre

title: L'Atlantide
synopsis: A patrol of French soldiers, led by the young officer André Saint Avit, is suddenly attacked by a band of Tuareg in the desert. During the battle, Saint Avit saves the life of Lieutenant Morhange and the two become great friends. One day Saint Avit does not return from an expedition in the desert. Morhange, to repay his debt of honor, then decides to go in search of his friend and ends up discovering the fabulous kingdom of Atlantis ruled by the fascinating and dangerous Antinea.
cast: Tchéky Karyo, Christopher Thomson, Anna Galiena, Jean Rochefort

title: L'Ave Maria
synopsis: Nino, 25 years old, widower and father of little Ciro, sings at the wedding banquets. He meets the teacher Angela: between the two it is immediately love. Gaetano, a jealous and treacherous boyfriend, has Nino arrested accusing him of selling fake money. Released from jail, Nino is successful as a singer, he risks losing "Ciruzzo his" due to an accident, he catches Angela on the altar, while he is about to marry Gaetano.
cast: Nino D'Angelo, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Elena Valentino, Lino Crispo

title: L'Avventura
synopsis: Anna, daughter of a retired ambassador, and Claudia are invited to a trip to the Aeolian Islands aboard the yacht of Sandro, architect, Anna's boyfriend. Other friends of the couple also participate in the excursion, but none seem particularly enchanted by the superb seascape that surrounds them. After a fight with Sandro, Anna suddenly disappears. Sandro and Claudia, initially with the other members of the company, look for her in vain in various places; once they are left alone on the island, an ambiguous relationship is established between them, at first one of mutual tolerance. Then, as hopes of finding Anna fade, they indulge in love. It sounds like a solid story, but the man soon finds a way to indulge in an occasional fling with another woman. Claudia, after a moment of rebellion, resigns herself to forgive him. On a very thin story, Antonioni constructs an analysis of feelings of exceptional value, both in terms of content and form. It is the masterpiece that paves the way for the trilogy on incommunicability: "The night", "The eclipse" and "Red desert".
cast: Gabriele Ferzetti, Monica Vitti, Lea Massari, Dominique Blanchar, Esmeralda Ruspoli

title: L'Embarass du choix
synopsis: Everyone's life is marked by big and small decisions to be made. Juliette, however, is unable to decide on anything. At the age of forty, she still asks her father and two best friends to choose in her place. When on her way she meets Paul and Etienne, both fascinating but very different from each other, Juliette cannot delegate the choice to anyone else and for the first time she will have to figure out for herself what is best to do.
cast: Alexandra Lamy, Arnaud Ducret, Jamie Bamber, Anne Marivin, Sabrina Ouazani, Lionnel Astier, Jérôme Commandeur, Arnaud Henriet

title: L'Empereur de Paris
synopsis: Under Napoleon's reign, François Vidocq, the only man who managed to escape from the largest prisons in the country, is a legend in the Parisian slums. Considered dead after his last spectacular escape, the ex-convict tries to make himself be forgotten by living in the guise of a simple merchant. His past, however, reaches him anyway and, after being accused of a crime he did not commit, he makes an agreement with the head of security: in exchange for freedom, he will collaborate with the police in the fight against the underworld. His exceptional results will win him the hostility of fellow policemen and the fury of the criminals, who would do anything to see him out of the game.
cast: Vincent Cassel, Patrick Chesnais, August Diehl, Olga Kurylenko, Denis Lavant, Freya Mavor, Denis Menochet, James Thiérrée, Jérôme Pouly, Fabrice Luchini

title: L'Enfer
synopsis: Paul has finally managed to own a nice hotel and is now working at an exhausting pace to keep it going. But stress plays a bad joke on him: he gets it into his head that his wife is cheating on him with a garage owner. Paul's obsession worsens day by day, the man resorts to alcohol and sleeping pills. A doctor visits him and promises that the next day he will have him hospitalized ... Claude Chabrol achieved his most flattering results when he faced the nests of vipers hidden under an apparent flat calm. Here he creates a beautiful and terrible, elegant and anguished film, where the love-jealousy relationship is scary.
cast: François Cluzet, Emmanuelle Béart, Marc Lavoine, Nathalie Cardone

title: L'Enquête corse
synopsis: Detective Rémy François, aka Jack Paler, is commissioned by a mysterious notary to travel to Corsica to search for the missing Ange Leoni. On the island, Rémy discovers that the man is at the head of a group of separatist terrorists: after meeting Lea, Ange's sister, a series of interminable troubles begins for him ...
cast: Christian Clavier, Jean Reno, Caterina Murino, Didier Flamand, Pierre Salasca, Pido, Alain Maratrat, François Orsoni, Nathanaël Maïni, Albert Dray

title: L'Esorciccio
synopsis: During archaeological excavations in Iran an amulet was found that ends up in the hands of the ten-year-old son of the mayor of a small town in Lazio. The boy becomes a fiery amateur, and then resorts to the sorcerer Exorcise. And like him all those who, in turn, possess the amulet are unleashed in unseemly oddities. Every so often even the Devil himself appears, until Exorcise swallows the diabolical object.
cast: Ciccio Ingrassia, Lino Banfi, Didi Perego, Mimmo Baldi, Tano Cimarosa, Ubaldo Lay, Barbara Nascimben, Romano Sebenello, Luigi Bonos, Dante Cleri, Renato Malavasi, Franca Haas, Salvatore Baccaro, Ada Pometti

title: L'Evénement
synopsis: France, 1963. Anne is a bright young student with a promising future ahead of her. However, when she becomes pregnant, she fears that she will not be able to finish her studies and that she will not be able to escape from the constraints imposed by her original background. With final exams approaching and a growing belly, Anne decides to attempt an illegal abortion, even if it means facing shame, pain and perhaps even prison.
cast: Anamaria Vartolomei, Luàna Bajrami, Louise Orry Diquéro, Kacey Mottet Klein, Louise Chevillotte, Pio Marmaï, Sandrine Bonnaire

title: L'Extravagant voyage du jeune et prodigieux T.S. Spivet
synopsis: Twelve-year-old T.S. Spivet lives on a Montana ranch with a mother obsessed with cockroach morphology, a cowboy father born in the wrong historical period, and a 14-year-old sister who dreams of being elected Miss America. Despite his tender age, T.S. he is an expert in cartography and scientific inventions. One day, he receives an unexpected phone call from the Smithsonian Institute, announcing that he has won the Baird Prize for developing a perpetual motion device. After being invited to give a speech at the museum, T.S. unbeknownst to everyone, he decides to head to Washington on a freight train that crosses the United States. At the Smithsonian, however, everyone is unaware that T.S. he's just a baby.
cast: Kyle Catlett, Helena Bonham Carter, Callum Keith Rennie, Judy Davis, Niamh Wilson, Jakob Davies, Rick Mercer, Robert Maillet, Dominique Pinon, Julian Richings, Dawn Ford, Richard Jutras

title: L'Harem
synopsis: A woman gathers the three lovers around her. Surprisingly, the men join forces and force her into the role of housewife, progressively undermining her psyche to the point of driving her to suicide. Where the moral impulse does not arrive, the material one will be able.
cast: Carroll Baker, Gastone Moschin, Renato Salvatori, Michel Le Royer, William Berger, Clotilde Sakaroff

title: L'Histoire d'Adèle H.
synopsis: Victor Hugo's daughter Adele falls madly in love with a young English officer. After an initial interest he abandons her and she will begin a long pilgrimage to be close to him in all ways. Faced with the impossibility of love, Adele will go crazy.
cast: Isabelle Adjani, Bruce Robinson, Sylvia Marriott

title: L'Homme qui a vendu sa peau
synopsis: Sam Ali, a young Syrian as sensitive as he is impulsive, fled to Lebanon to try to escape the war. Clandestine, he cannot obtain a visa to travel to Europe, where his beloved Abeer lives. Surviving by serving cocktails in Beirut's art galleries, he meets Jeffrey Godefroi, a well-known American contemporary artist with whom he signs an agreement. He thus accepts to have a Schengen visa tattooed on his back as a work of art, unaware of how much this will forever undermine his freedom.
cast: Yahya Mahayni, Monica Bellucci, Dea Leane, Koen De Bouw, Wim Delvoye, Saad Lostan, Darina Al Joundi

title: L'Inchiesta
synopsis: In the year 33 in Rome, the Emperor Tiberius was upset by some supernatural events - an earthquake, an eclipse - and sent his trusted man, Tito Valerio Tauro, on the advice of astrologers, to investigate the facts of Palestine, where a man was killed whose disciples swear to be resurrected. Tauro will have to shed light and possibly find the body of Jesus the Nazarene, conducting an investigation that will lead him into contact with many characters, with their certainties and their ambiguities.
cast: Daniele Liotti, Dolph Lundgren, Mónica Cruz, Hristo Shopov, Christo Jivkov, Ornella Muti, F. Murray Abraham, Max Von Sydow, Anna Kanakis, Enrico Lo Verso

title: L'Inconnu de Brocéliande
synopsis: In the Paimpont forest, a charred body difficult to identify is found. Near the body, there is a thirteen-year-old boy, in shock and unable to speak. What was he doing there? To what extent is it connected to the story? Nobody knows who he is or who has reported his disappearance. Marie and Eric, the two gendarmes in charge of the case, try to clear up the mystery as quickly as possible, with the help of Romain, Marie's brother who specializes in child psychiatry.
cast: Claire Keim, Fred Bianconi, François Vincentelli, Carole Bianic, Yanis Richard, Stéphane Boucher, Feodor Atkine, Nadia Fossier, Francis Renaud, Anouck Montreuil

title: L'India vista da Rossellini
synopsis: The destination of my trip is India, which everyone defines as mysterious and which I personally consider absolutely not mysterious !, so said Rossellini before leaving. The result of his journey is this documentary that starts from Bombay to go into the most hidden territories of the nation to discover a world apart.

title: L'Inhumaine
synopsis: Claire Lecot is a real femme fatale and all men are at his feet. Among the sweepings of her there is also a young scientist, Einar Norsen. And when she makes fun of him one evening, he shocked abandoned the scene with a dramatic and final purpose: kill himself.
cast: Jaque Catelain, Léonid Walter De Malte, Philippe Hériat, Fred Kellerman, Georgette Leblanc, Marcelle Pradot, Prince Tokio

title: L'Italia s'è rotta
synopsis: After several job disappointments and a fair number of failures, Peppe, a Sicilian mechanic fired from the factory where he worked and his fellow countryman Nino and a Venetian girl picked up on the street leave Turin to return to the South. Along the way they try in every way to raise some money, but every initiative fails miserably. Once there they decide to go back.
cast: Dalila Di Lazzaro, Teo Teocoli, Mario Scarpetta, Mario Carotenuto, Duilio Del Prete, Alberto Lionello, Enrico Montesano, Orazio Orlando, Franca Valeri, Marisa Laurito, Clelia Matania, Sergio Di Pinto, Loris Bazzocchi

title: L'Italien
synopsis: Dino Fabrizzi, nicknamed "the Italian" because of his much-vaunted origins, has a very profitable job and a beautiful girlfriend, with whom he plans to get married as soon as possible. However, he runs into a major unexpected event when he finds himself having to manage a double life due to his true origins. Despite having made everyone believe that he is Italian, Dino is actually called Mourad Ben Saoud, he is of Muslim descent and, in order to satisfy a request from his seriously ill father, he is forced to observe the period of Ramadan, struggling between lies and expedients in order not to to discover his secret.
cast: Kad Merad, Valérie Benguigui, Roland Giraud, Philippe Lefebvre, Guillaume Gallienne, Sid Ahmed Agoumi, Farida Ouchani, Saphia Azzeddine, Tarek Boudali, Nathalie Levy Lang

title: L'Odyssée
synopsis: Summer 1946. The Cousteau family - Jacques, his wife Simone and their two children Philippe and Jean-Michel, live in their beautiful house by the Mediterranean. During the day Jacques dedicates himself to swimming and at night to gaze at the stars but he does not seem happy with his heavenly existence. He lives dreaming of an adventure at sea and believes in his progress. With his latest invention (the aqualung), the newly purchased Calypso boat and with a group of adventurers with an indomitable spirit, he decides to leave to sail the oceans. Ten years later, returning from the boarding school where he was sent with his brother, Philippe finds his father considerably changed: Jean-Jacques has become an international celebrity with the megalomaniacal dream of building aquatic cities for men. While his father does not yet realize it, Philippe also senses that progress and pollution have begun to devastate the underwater world and, despite their mutual affection, the two soon enter into conflict. To bring them closer will be the shared experience aboard the Calypso in the ice of Antarctica.
cast: Lambert Wilson, Audrey Tautou, Pierre Niney, Laurent Lucas, Benjamin Lavernhe, Vincent Heneine, Thibault De Montalembert, Roger Van Hool

title: L'Ordinateur des pompes funèbres
synopsis: Fred Malon, employed in an insurance company, is married to the arrogant and matriarchal Gloria. Exasperated by the situation, he decides to make a mistress and finds her in Charlotte, his secretary, and to take out his wife by organizing an accidental death in the bathroom. In the meantime he meets Louise, wife of his colleague Pierre and, also falling in love with her, he decides to kill her husband. Thus a ménage a trois is created and Fred is forced to double his salary and does not hesitate to get rid of his office manager.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Lea Massari, Mireille Darc, Bernadette Lafont

title: L'Oriana
synopsis: Enterprising and aggressive, controversial and feared, Oriana Fallaci was one of the most famous reporters in the world. His adventurous life began when, at the age of ten, he took part in the Resistance as a relay. Ten years later she began writing for the European Championship and, while her career took off, the young Oriana found herself at the center of the events that made the history of the twentieth century. He is at the forefront of the war in Vietnam, interviews the highest personalities of international politics, closely follows the landing on the moon, risks his life in the massacre of Piazza delle Tre Culture in Mexico City. Then, the tormented love affair with the young hero of the Greek Resistance, Alekos Panagulis. Until the controversial attacks on Islam in the aftermath of 11 September.
cast: Vittoria Puccini, Vinicio Marchioni, Stéphane Freiss, Francesca Agostini, Adriano Chiaramida, Maurizio Lombardi, Benedetta Buccellato, Yoon C. Joyce, Ilir Jacellari, Christian Mörner

title: L'Oro di Scampia
synopsis: In the district of Scampia, heavily oppressed by the yoke of the Camorra, Enzo Capuano pursues the goal of educating street children in various sports, teaching for free in a small gym. In particular, his willing son Toni proves to have a great talent in judo. Enzo's tenacity, however, does not go unnoticed by the mafia, who tries to put him in difficulty: the man, however, does not allow himself to be bent and, when the opportunity of a lifetime arrives for Toni, the Olympics, he does everything so that he does not let it escape. .
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Gianluca Di Gennaro, Anna Foglietta, Gaetano Bruno, Anna Bellezza, Nello Mascia, Ciro Petrone, Francesco Martino, Salvatore Striano, Anna Ammirati, Nunzia Schiano

title: L'Outsider
synopsis: 2008. The world is rocked by the worst financial crisis since the infamous one of 1929. A lonely young man is held responsible for a series of scandals that have troubled the financial markets: Jérôme Kerviel. Hired at a very young age as an employee of Société Générale eight years earlier, Jérôme dreamed of becoming a great trader, managing alone and in secret something like 50 billion euros.
cast: Arthur Dupont, François Xavier Demaison, Sabrina Ouazani, Mhamed Arezki, Sören Prévost, Ambroise Michel, Benjamin Ramon, Stéphane Bak, Sophie Charlotte Husson

title: L'Universale
synopsis: The story of three friends, Tommaso, Marcello and Alice, and their destinies that intertwine, leave each other and then tangle again, in a series of adventures that span three decades - from the fabulous Sixties to the "plastic" Eighties - and which embody the dreams, the amusement, the illusions and the defeats of a generation. But it is also the story of a cinema, where for a strange epochal, neighborhood and astral conjuncture, for a period the high, experimental and political culture of the student movement and the popular, sarcastic and disenchanted one of the Florentine district of San Frediano met, creating a wonderful short circuit that soon led to an unexpected and sparkling creative chaos.
cast: Francesco Turbanti, Matilda Anna Ingrid Lutz, Robin Mugnaini, Claudio Bigagli, Paolo Hendel, Vauro Senesi, Maurizio Lombardi, Anna Meacci, Margherita Vicario, Roberto Gioffrè

title: L'abbiamo fatta grossa
synopsis: Yuri Pelegatti (Antonio Albanese) is a theater actor who, traumatized by the separation, can no longer remember the lines on stage. Arturo Merlino (Carlo Verdone), on the other hand, is a penniless investigator who lives in the house of his old widowed aunt. Yuri wants proof of his ex-wife's infidelity and hires Arturo as a super detective. Arturo, however, does not make a fair one. The two, by mistake, will thus come into possession of a mysterious briefcase that contains one million euros.
cast: Carlo Verdone, Antonio Albanese, Anna Kasyan, Francesca Fiume, Clotilde Sabatino, Virginia Da Brescia, Federigo Ceci, Massimo Popolizio

title: L'abbuffata
synopsis: Who hasn't dreamed, living in the province, of going to Cinecittà to get hold of the secret of success, to tell their world and its people through the cinema? This is what happens to three Calabrian boys, bewitched by the charm of the great director in crisis and the charismatic actor in search of himself. Not all fairy tales, however, end in the same way ...
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Diego Abatantuono, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Donatella Finocchiaro, Nino Frassica

title: L'abri
synopsis: It is winter in a homeless shelter in Lausanne. Every evening, the usual entrance ritual takes place which often degenerates into clashes or violence. Those who work there have the difficult task of managing income: first the women and children and then the men. Although the capacity of the shelter is 100 places, only 50 'elected' will be allowed inside while for the others it will be a long night.

title: L'accabadora
synopsis: At the end of the Thirties, the thirty-five-year-old Annetta, a solitary and silent woman always dressed in black, lives in a small town in the Sardinian countryside. Keeping a terrible secret from the past, he spends his days waiting for a call and, when that happens, opens an old bag containing a wooden mallet, an old pillow and a cracked mirror. From that moment, something unexpected will bring her to Cagliari and change her life, making her discover that she can detach herself from her role as accabadora, a figure of Sardinian tradition whose job is to help the dying to pass away.
cast: Donatella Finocchiaro, Barry Ward, Carolina Crescentini, Sara Serraiocco, Anita Kravos

title: L'accompagnatrice
synopsis: In 1942 Sophie Vasseur, a young unemployed pianist, lives in German-occupied Paris. He has a strained relationship with his mother who is a piano teacher. One day she meets the beautiful and successful singer Irène Brice who hires her as an accompanist on the piano of her concerts.
cast: Richard Bohringer, Elena Sofonova, Romane Bohringer

title: L'acqua... il fuoco
synopsis: Turin: Stefania, separated, lives in a social housing in the suburbs, she is full of vitality and to keep herself beats the television scripts on the computer, until she decides to make a clean break with the past. Paris: Elena is saved by a tramp after she attempted suicide by jumping into the Seine; the two will spend a night together and start the new day with more hope. Luxembourg: Stella, a circus performer, tries to help her comrade David, completely drunk, to enter the scene, but he is not at all well ...
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Olivier Pages, Valérie Kaprisky, Eloise Eonnet, Giancarlo Giannini

title: L'addio a Enrico Berlinguer
synopsis: From the Comizio di Padova of 7 June 1984, when the Secretary of the PCI was struck by stroke right on stage, on the day of the funeral (June 13), about forty directors documents the heartfelt tribute of so many common people to Berlinguer, who died on 11 June 1984.

title: L'adieu à la nuit
synopsis: Muriel raises horses in France and runs an almond plantation with a business partner from the Maghreb. A confident woman with many years behind her in Algeria, Muriel appears to be living a harmonious and fulfilled existence when she receives a visit from her beloved nephew Alex, who grew up after her mother died in an accident. Alex is about to leave for Canada, where he presumably has a job. However, Muriel discovers that the boy has other plans and a much more dangerous destination ...
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Kacey Mottet Klein, Oulaya Amamra, Kamel Labroudi, Stéphane Bak

title: L'adolescente
synopsis: A Sicilian, married for interest, pours his sexual attentions elsewhere, the same goes for his wife. Between the two slips a busty niece who aims (for money) to separate her uncles. The girl will scandalize the country by telling everyone about the erotic "exploits" of the family.
cast: Daniela Giordano, Tuccio Musumeci, Sonia Viviani, Marcello Martana

title: L'adversaire
synopsis: 1993: On a gray January morning, Jean-Marc Faure exterminates his wife, children and parents. Motive: his family members had understood that, for over twenty years, he had invented a non-existent professional life ...
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Géraldine Pailhas, François Cluzet, Emmanuelle Devos, Bernard Fresson

title: L'affaire Dominici
synopsis: On 5 August 1952, on the Dominici estate in Provence, the bodies of three passing Englishmen were found: husband, wife and little daughter. No traces of violence or theft. The Dominici are notoriously leftist militants and a mysterious meeting was held in their home that very night. The two sons are immediately accused of the murder, but it is then the father who accuses himself. The trial proceedings dismantle the "evidence" by demonstrating its vanity; the man is sentenced to death on the basis of some clues, but then pardoned ...
cast: Jean Gabin, Paul Crauchet, Pierre Forget, Gérard Depardieu, Victor Lanoux, Henri Vilbert, Geneviève Fontanel, Alberto Farnese

title: L'affaire Maurizius
synopsis: Etzel von Andergast, son of a prosecutor general, discovers that twenty years before the father had unjustly condemned Léonard Maurizius to life imprisonment, for the murder of his wife. He is Maurizius' father who, telling him the facts, convinces him to reopen the case: then he hides the only witness to restore the truth, but the ending will be bitter.
cast: Daniel Gélin, Madeleine Robinson, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Charles Vanel

title: L'affaire SK1
synopsis: Paris, 1991. Franck Magne, a young inspector, takes his first steps in the investigation department at 36 quai des Orfèvres. His first investigation concerns the murder of a young girl and right away he is forced to confront the limitations of his work: lack of resources, long shifts and slow bureaucracy. According to his intuitions, the crime is connected to the serial killings he has been trying to shed light on for 8 years without much success. His path will soon cross with that of the lawyer Fréderique Pons, who is also determined to find out who is hiding behind the ruthless killer who terrorizes the Parisian east.
cast: Raphaël Personnaz, Nathalie Baye, Olivier Gourmet, Michel Vuillermoz, Adama Niane, Christa Theret, Thierry Neuvic, William Nadylam

title: L'affittacamere
synopsis: Giorgia and Angela, two sisters, inherit a villa with a garden near Bologna from a noble aunt. The building is dilapidated and in need of a radical restoration. To find the necessary money, the two women decide to transform the villa into a pension that soon becomes famous for the ease of Giorgia's costumes. Numerous clients arrive in search of adventures, but a severe magistrate, moralizer of morals, also focuses his eyes on the hotel. Too bad that among the customers there is also his wife with her lover ...
cast: Gloria Guida, Lino Banfi, Adolfo Celi, Enzo Cannavale, Vittorio Caprioli, Luciano Salce

title: L'afide e la formica
synopsis: Fatima is 16 years old and wears the veil. Her culture foresees her, and her mother Amina imposes her. Born in Calabria to Muslim parents, the girl lives all the conflicts and emotions typical of her age, but she feels she is not like her peers: she is closed in her solitude, constantly out of place. Until one day the physical education teacher, Michele Scimone, does not propose to his students to enroll in the Sant'Antonio marathon. For Fatima it is the first real opportunity to be seized. But for the teacher, a former shy and depressed runner, tormented by an unresolved past and by a failed relationship with Anna, the veil that Fatima wears is a source of prejudice. It will be the beginning of a relationship that will change their lives, while the race will be able to make them both free.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Valentina Lodovini, Cristina Parku, Nadia Kibout, Alessio Praticò, Annamaria De Luca, Ettore Signorelli

title: L'agenzia dei bugiardi
synopsis: The seductive Fred, the tech expert Diego and the narcoleptic apprentice Paolo are the components of a diabolical and brilliant agency that provides alibis to its clients and whose motto is "Better a good lie than a bad truth". Fred falls in love with Clio, champion of sincerity at all costs, to whom he therefore cannot reveal what his real job is. The situation becomes complicated when Fred discovers that Clio's father, Alberto, is a client of his, who has turned to the agency to hide an escapade with his young lover Cinzia from his wife Irene. Accidentally, due to a distraction from Alberto, they will all find themselves on vacation together: Carla, Clio, Alberto and Cinzia in an explosive situation. What will Fred and his friends come up with this time to create the perfect alibi and escape the truth once again?
cast: Giampaolo Morelli, Massimo Ghini, Alessandra Mastronardi, Carla Signoris, Paolo Ruffini, Diana Del Bufalo, Luigi Luciano (Herbert Ballerina), Paolo Calabresi, Nicolas Vaporidis, Antonello Fassari, Raiz

title: L'agnello
synopsis: Anita is sixteen and facing a difficult family situation. His mother died of leukemia and now his father Jacopo has also fallen ill: no therapy is giving significant results, the need for a bone marrow transplant is increasingly urgent, but the average wait for a donor is several months. Anita is not compatible and neither is Tonino, the shepherd grandfather who lives on the nearby plateau, next to a military polygon which, for better or for worse, has marked the life of the territory for decades. There would be uncle Gaetano, Jacopo's elder brother: the probability that he is compatible is higher, but Gaetano lives far away and is a person who cannot be trusted, a hothead who can barely support his wife and children. reselling scrap metal that he finds abandoned in the countryside. He and Jacopo have not seen or talked to each other for years, divided by an ancient grudge that they do not seem willing to forget. Gaetano seems unapproachable, even for his father Tonino. But Anita's rebellious and somewhat crazy character manages to scratch her armor, partially mend that ancient tear and convince him to carry out the analyzes that could save Jacopo's life.
cast: Nora Stassi, Luciano Curreli, Piero Marcialis, Michele Atzori

title: L'agression
synopsis: Paul is on vacation on the French Riviera with his wife and daughter. During a trip a gang of three motorcyclists comes to an argument with him. The affair degenerates and, after an accident, a fight breaks out. When he regains consciousness after passing out he finds that his wife and daughter have been raped and killed. So he decides to take justice for himself and sets out in search of the guilty. When he thinks he has identified some of the youngsters as members of the gang, he takes action, but ...
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Catherine Deneuve, Claude Brasseur, Philippe Brigaud, Milena Vukotic, Franco Fabrizi, Delphine Boffy

title: L'aigle à deux têtes
synopsis: In an imaginary kingdom lives a queen who has withdrawn from the world after the death of her husband, killed in an attack. During a great court ball, a wounded young anarchist swoops into the woman's room, whose purpose is to kill the queen: instead, love blossoms between the two, but the epilogue will be tragic. Cinematic version made by Cocteau of his play, from which in 1970 Antonioni will draw his "The mystery of Oberwald".
cast: Jean Marais, Edwige Feuillère, Jean Debucourt, Sylvia Monfort, Jacques Varennes, Ahmed Abdallah, Gilles Quéant, Maurice Nasil

title: L'aile ou la cuisse
synopsis: A meticulous food critic (Louis de Funès), aided by his son (Coluche), tries to unmask a swindler tycoon of prepackaged foods. The latter, who has many things to hide, tries to make canned meat out of them. The mimicry of the two great comic actors produces pearls, but the film itself is very little.
cast: Louis De Funès, Coluche, Claude Gensac, Vittorio Caprioli

title: L'air de Paris
synopsis: Dede, a young worker, arrives in the gym of the old boxer Le Garrec. It's a promise and Le Garrec counts a lot on it. Dedé starts well, but after a while he finds himself having to decide between his sporting career and his love for the young Corinne. A little feuilleton, a song by Montand and Jean Gabin (awarded in Venice): in short, a good ambient film, as solid as the fists of its protagonists.
cast: Jean Gabin, Arletty, Roland Lesaffre, Folco Lulli, Ave Ninchi

title: L'alba
synopsis: Karen owns a boutique in Milan; Massimo is a technician who often resides abroad for work. The two have been lovers for a long time, although their encounters are far from frequent. Karen is now waiting for Massimo in the hotel and in the room where they have continued to meet since the first time. He thinks back to their past, to their respective marital misadventures, to his decision to change his life, finally at Massimo's side. Between thoughts and memories the hours pass. When the switchboard announces a call from the man, Karen suddenly decides to break the bond and says she's already gone. Citto Maselli faces the eternal dilemma of what is the true relationship between passion and love. A psychodrama that subjected the emotional Nastassja Kinski to a particularly heavy tour de force
cast: Nastassja Kinski, Massimo Dapporto

title: L'albergo degli assenti
synopsis: An American billionaire mysteriously disappears on the French Riviera. The housekeeper goes in search of her with her boyfriend and discovers the existence of an organization that kidnaps unwelcome relatives from their respective families and keeps them locked up in a mysterious hotel. The two young men convince reluctant policemen to break into the house and end the segregation of the prisoners.
cast: Paola Barbara, Camillo Pilotto, Maurizio D'Ancora, Carla Candiani, Carlo Tamberlani, Dria Paola, Elio Steiner

title: L'albero dalle foglie rosa
synopsis: Little Marco is traumatized by the news of the separation of his parents. One day when he leaves the house he will be hit by a car.
cast: Renato Cestié, John Richardson, Carmen Scarpitta, Angela Goodwin

title: L'albero degli zoccoli
synopsis: Between the autumn of 1897 and the summer of 1898 four families apparently spent their life in a farmhouse in the Bergamo countryside in a quiet way. There is a deep bond between the members of this community that leads them to live together the good and bad things that life has in store for them. When it comes to paying the stern Mesagiù, the owner of the farm, two-thirds of the agricultural products everyone tries to cheat to earn a few pounds of flour. Together they kill the pig, separate the contenders and take part in village festivals and religious functions. One day in Menek a hoof breaks and in order to repair it, Papa Batistì is forced to cut a plant belonging to the owner without asking for permission.
cast: Francesca Moriggi, Luigi Ornaghi, Antonio Ferrari, Carmelo Silva

title: L'albero delle pere
synopsis: Fourteen-year-old Siddhartha lives with sweet, vague and elusive mother Silvia in Rome. She does not work, but makes an effort to cultivate elusive relationships. Her father Massimo, from whom Silvia is separated, is a kind of experimental director who is making a documentary about himself. Silvia also lived with Roberto from whom she had Domitilla. The little girl rummaging in her mother's bag pricks herself with an infected syringe and the drama begins for Siddhartha.
cast: Valeria Golino, Sergio Rubini, Stefano Dionisi, Niccolò Senni, Francesca Di Giovanni

title: L'albero di Adamo
synopsis: The car of the driven doctor (unmarried) is found, overturned and with irrefutable traces of a female presence, near the Adam's Tree, a place dedicated to amorous meetings. So word spreads quickly of an adventure between the doctor and the duchess just arrived from America (complete with an aristocratic husband). Not so, at least for the moment. Then, what comes from what ...
cast: Elsa Merlini, Antonio Gandusio, Renato Cialente, Dria Paola, Marcello Giorda, Olga Vittoria Gentilli, Margherita Bagni

title: L'albero di Guernica
synopsis: While in Villa Ramiro, a Spanish town former fiefdom of the Counts of Cerraibo, the people are celebrating the carnival and the end of hunger and oppression, a group of generals rebel against republican power and unleash civil war. A young peasant woman, Vandal, and Goya son of the Count of Cerraibo, who met by chance in Guernica, renounce their intention to reach France to take sides with the republican forces.
cast: Mariangela Melato, Ron Faber, Cosimo Cinieri, Franco Ressel

title: L'alcova
synopsis: A fascist officer returns from Africa bringing with him a 'prey of war': a beautiful color girl. The welcome of his wife is cold, but worse still is that of her secretary, a secret lover of his wife; An erotic and psychological battle comes between man and the three women.
cast: Lilli Carati, Annie Belle, Al Cliver, Roberto Caruso, Laura Gemser

title: L'aldilà! E tu vivrai nel terrore
synopsis: Year 1927: in a cursed hotel because it was built over one of the seven gates of hell, an angry mob kills a painter accused of witchcraft. 1981: Liza, fashion designer, inherits that same New York hotel. Despite being warned by a blind woman, Lise settles in the building thinking about how to renovate it. But his optimism is good and good ...
cast: Catriona MacColl, David Warbeck, Sarah Keller, Antoine Saint John, Veronica Lazar

title: L'alibi
synopsis: Vittorio, Adolfo and Luciano have been friends since they attended the Academy of Dramatic Art. Then their paths divided: Adolfo left for Brazil, Vittorio became a star of cinema and theater, Luciano, director and playwright, turned to politics. Only the illness of another friend, Luca, causes them to find themselves again.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi, Tina Aumont, Franco Giacobini
director: Luciano Lucignani, Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi

title: L'allegro fantasma
synopsis: The will of the old and wealthy Pantaleo reserves a surprise for all relatives. In fact, in the cards appear the natural children of the deceased with whom it will be necessary to share the inheritance. The search for the children, triplets, is long and leads to the discovery that the first is a vagabond, the second is a composer with no luck and the third is a circus juggler. How will they take the sudden wealth?
cast: Totò, Luigi Pavese, Paolo Stoppa, Franco Coop, Amelia Chellini, Isa Bellini, Wilma Mangini, Thea Prandi, Elli Parvo

title: L'allenatore nel pallone
synopsis: The coach Oronzo Canà is hired by Longobarda, a football team just promoted to Serie A. Oronzo is incapable and was chosen with the intention of immediately returning the team to B. Canà goes to Brazil and two fraudulent brokers. procure the striker Aristoteles. Surprisingly, the Brazilian turns out to be a champion and the championship will end in glory.
cast: Lino Banfi, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato, Licinia Lentini, Giuliana Calandra, Camillo Milli, Stefano Davanzati, Urs Althaus

title: L'allenatore nel pallone 2
synopsis: Oronzo Canà is a former football coach who retired to cultivate his olive groves regretting the glorious times in which "his" Longobard played in Serie A. One day the team is bought by a wealthy tycoon who wants Canà to coach it at all costs. yet. He will have to use the game module that made him famous ...
cast: Lino Banfi, Anna Falchi, Urs Althaus, Francesco Totti, Joanna Cecylia Moskwa, Giuliana Calandra, Andrea Roncato, Alessandro Del Piero, Gennaro Gattuso, Lucio Montanaro

title: L'alpagueur
synopsis: The French secret service recruits an experienced hunter to be part of a special anti-drug team. The new cop becomes very skilled, defeats a gang but finds a bloodthirsty criminal on his way. A new hunt begins for him: man ...
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Bruno Cremer, Patrick Fierry, Jean Negroni

title: L'altra donna
synopsis: Regina, an Ethiopian girl who emigrated to Rome (where she works as a waitress), meets Olga, a lonely and insecure bourgeois: a friendship is born between them, veiled by differences and influenced by their respective destinies ...
cast: Francesca De Sapio, Fantu Mengasha, Marisa Merlini, Edmund Purdom

title: L'altra donna
synopsis: The architect Simone and Fiammetta, a happy couple with their son, live a peaceful life and share dreams and passions. But one day, after Simone has appeared on TV, Fiammetta begins to receive anonymous phone calls, strange gifts, bunches of roses and a videotape that reproduces a cheerful family with a child ...
cast: Anita Caprioli, Alessio Boni, Monica Carmen Comegna, Edoardo Baietti

title: L'altra faccia del padrino
synopsis: Nick Buglione, imitator and singer by profession, is engaged to Angelica, goddaughter of the godfather Don Vito Monreale and is an involuntary witness to a murder, ordered by Don Vito himself. Fearing for his own safety, Nick turns to his godfather for protection. Don Vito uses him as his stunt double, but that doesn't prevent him from being killed anyway. Nick then ...
cast: Alighiero Noschese, Minnie Minoprio, Lino Banfi, Raymond Bussières, Fausto Tozzi, Elena Fiore, Stefano Satta Flores, Guido Leontini, Mario Pilar

title: L'altra metà del cielo
synopsis: In Fiumicino, among the passengers on a flight to Australia, there are a priest and a prostitute. The two meet and then find themselves in the continent of kangaroos in a mining town populated mostly by Italians: he is the new parish priest, she is away from work for the joy of the local males. Knowing this, the priest tries by all means to redeem the woman until he comes to blows with her protector. This forces him to return, but something has really changed in the woman's soul. The script leaves something to be desired and the uplifting duets between Celentano and Monica Vitti border on unbearable.
cast: Adriano Celentano, Monica Vitti, Mario Carotenuto, Glauco Onorato

title: L'altro Adamo
synopsis: In the not too distant future, Adam asks the advanced artificial intelligence of his computer to create a double that lives a short space of real life, made up of ideals, values, authentic passions. The computer pleases him and Adam will begin to live a true love story, however ...
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Marianna Jensen, Ottavia Fusco, Saverio Mastelloni

title: L'altro inferno
synopsis: # Unclear deaths occur inside a convent for women, to the point that Father Valerio (Carlo De Mejo #) is commissioned to shed light on the death of Sister Assunta (Paola Montenero #). Vincenza (Franca Stoppi #), mother superior, immediately showed an intolerant attitude towards the new guest and does not hide her reactionary behavior towards the nuns. Boris (Franco Garofalo #), extravagant gardener in charge of looking after the animals that gravitate around the monastery, seems indifferent to the events, linked to a fact of the past that involved Sister Vincenza herself: a birth that gave birth to Elisa, girl with telekinetic powers, disfigured in boiling water and secretly hidden in the basement of the convent.
cast: Franca Stoppi, Carlo De Mejo, Francesca Carmeno, Susan Forget, Franco Garofalo, Paola Montenero, Ornella Picozzi, Andrea Aureli

title: L'altrove
synopsis: Baghdad, 1571. An Arabic philosopher translates and transcribes some pages of the Necronomicon, the notorious book of the dead. Suddenly an invisible presence attacks man and kills him. 500 years later, the world is upset by an absurd war promoted by groups of madmen invaded against humanity. These are men and women owned by the great ancients, who want to eliminate once and for all the human race. A handful of soldiers will find himself struggling with an airy adventure made of nightmares, tortures and terrifying revelations about the origins of our world.
cast: Emanuele Cerman, Laura Coratti, Giuseppe Gobbato, Roberta Marrelli, Michael Segal, Massimo Storari, Caterina Zanca

title: L'amant
synopsis: A fifteen-year-old girl of French origin in Indochina in the 1920s meets a very rich and beautiful Chinese who is twice her age, and becomes his lover. He genuinely loves her, while she just seems attracted to the sexual side of the relationship. When, by order of the family, the man has to marry another woman and the girl has to return to France, she will discover the pains of love.
cast: Jane March, Tony Leung Ka Fai, Frédérique Meininger, Arnaud Giovaninetti, Melvil Poupaud, Lisa Faulkner, Xiem Mang, Philippe Le Dem

title: L'amant de Lady Chatterley
synopsis: Lady Chatterley, wife of an English nobleman unable to satisfy her because it is crippled, vents her sexual craving with the Guardian until it is pregnant. Her husband, aware, closes an eye, but reopens him when his wife asks that her lover recognize her unborn child ...
cast: Danielle Darrieux, Leo Genn, Erno Crisa, Berthe Tissen

title: L'amant de cinq jours
synopsis: Clara, the young wife of an archivist, meets Antonio during a fashion show in the house of her friend Maddalena. It is the classic love at first sight. Their relationship, however, is marked by mutual lies. Clara makes Antonio believe that she is rich and that she is married to a businessman too busy to care for her. Antonio, for his part, confesses that he is a man who has arrived. In reality, the man lives by exploiting the wealth of his lover Magdalene. Having discovered everything Maddalena intends to take revenge.
cast: Jean Seberg, Micheline Presle, Jean Pierre Cassel, François Périer

title: L'amant de poche
synopsis: Julien is a high school student and has not yet turned sixteen. He happens to meet Ellen, a high-class call girl, and fall madly in love with her. She returns the feeling passionately because she sees the lost purity in him. But then she realizes that for the boy's sake the relationship must be severed: she leaves him - so she says to Julien's father - because she loves him too much.
cast: Pascal Sellier, Mimsy Farmer, Andréa Ferréol, Madeleine Robinson, Bernard Fresson, Serge Sauvion, Stephane Jobert, Eva Ionesco

title: L'amant double
synopsis: Chloé is a fragile and depressed young woman who enters psychotherapy and falls in love with her analyst, Paul. A few months later, the two move in together but she discovers that her lover has hidden a side of his identity from her.
cast: Jérémie Rénier, Marine Vacth, Jacqueline Bisset, Myriam Boyer, Dominique Reymond

title: L'amant magnifique
synopsis: A beautiful woman who loves horses ends up falling in love with a stable boy. For the sake of his new partner, he leaves his comfortable life and agrees to run away with him who lives like a gypsy on the edge of the city. At the beginning things go well also because the woman madly in love with her new partner does not realize the great difficulties that this type of relationship can entail in the long run. The woman to follow her new love has decided to abandon the lover who has lived with her for years. But soon the coexistence ends up diminishing the wild passion at the origin of their new relationship. Eventually the woman is forced to leave the stable boy and at the same time refuses to return with her former lover who awaits her with open arms.
cast: Isabel Otero, Robin Renucci, Didier Agostini

title: L'amante
synopsis: Joelle (Malù) is a young and fascinating woman who has married a mature (Anthony Steffen) Conte semi -finalized and helpless. He will seek sexual satisfaction outside the marriage, becoming a lover of the gardener.
cast: Malù, Anthony Steffen, Kieran Canter, Barbara Blasko, Debora Calì

title: L'amante del vampiro
synopsis: A group of dancers rehearse the next show near a vampire-infested castle. Who promptly do not miss the opportunity.
cast: Hélène Remy, Tina Gloriani, Walter Brandi, Isarco Ravaioli, Gino Turini, Pier Ugo Gragnani, Brigitte Castor, Lut Maryk, Ombretta Ostenda, Bava Sanni

title: L'amante di Gramigna
synopsis: In Sicily in the second half of the nineteenth century, a farmer, who turned into a bandit to relieve himself of the conditions which the abuses forced him, died under the fire of the Piedmontese armies.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Stefania Sandrelli, Ivo Garrani

title: L'amante scomoda
synopsis: A professional aspires to a promotion, but having a beautiful lover in need of attention severely hampers his career opportunities. However, a killer enters the scene and tries to kill the girl: does the killer have a principal?
cast: Linda Carol, Frank Angelini, Antonio Zequila, Geoffrey Copleston

title: L'amaro caso della baronessa di Carini
synopsis: Sicily, early 19th century. An attractive young man arrives in the village and a betrayal is consummated, leading to a murder out of jealousy: almost three hundred years later, the bitter case of the Baroness di Carini is repeated.
cast: Ugo Pagliai, Janet Agren, Adolfo Celi, Guido Leontini, Paolo Stoppa, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Arturo Dominici, Enrica Bonaccorti, Biagio Pelligra, Maria Morales

title: L'ambizioso
synopsis: Out of a disgrace to Don Enrico, head of the Neapolitan underworld, the smuggler Aldo is forced to take refuge in Rome. Here, he becomes the lover of Lucia, a young saleswoman, and puts together a gang of men with whom he returns to Naples to face the boss. The two will find an agreement that provides for the sale to Aldo of half of Don Enrico's turnover.
cast: Joe Dallesandro, Raymond Pellegrin, Stefania Casini, Benito Artesi

title: L'ami de mon amie
synopsis: Shy Blanche and brilliant Lea become friends. Lea's boyfriend is very similar in character to Blanche, and in fact he will end up dating her. Lea, for her part, will console herself with her friend's ex-friend.
cast: François Eric Gendron, Emmanuelle Chaulet, Sophie Renoir, Eric Viellard, Anne Laure Meury

title: L'amica
synopsis: Lisa discovers that her husband Paolo is cheating on her. So she too invents a lover in the role of architect Raimondi, telling her adventures to Carla, her best friend. But Raimondi is actually Carla's lover, who can't resist ridiculing her friend. Lisa, to take revenge, makes both her lover and her husband and Carla's son fall in love with herself, before returning to Paolo.
cast: Lisa Gastoni, Gabriele Ferzetti, Elsa Martinelli, Frank Wolff, Ray Lovelock, Mita Cattaneo, Sergio Serafini

title: L'amica di Sonia
synopsis: Sonia, a color girl, lives on the outskirts of Rome. Her inseparable friend is Marina with whom she shares her passion for dance. Disappointed by the events of their life concerning both the sentimental sphere and that of friendship, they decide to move away towards a new path.
cast: Marina Hedman, Sonia Bennett, Guia Lauri Filzi, Fernando Arcangeli

title: L'amica di mia madre
synopsis: The seventeen year old Billy occupies only and blessed (with Mammà's money) a luxurious villa in an exotic location. The hallman boy drools for the uninhibited Andrea: but when the refined Parisian Barbara arrives at home, he definitively goes on tilt ...
cast: Barbara Bouchet, Carmen Villani, Roberto Cenci, Raul Martinez

title: L'amico d'infanzia
synopsis: Following the death of the previous presenter, Arnold Gardner, he obtained the direction of the television talk show "The twenty-fifth hour". But, here comes a distant schoolmate from the past who wants to ruin him because he harbors ancient grudges and who does not hesitate to commit atrocious murders. Television is the "medium" that records the conclusion. Pupi Avati returns to the United States and shoots a film definitely built on the rhythms and models of the most recent American products. An agonizing, agitated, technically flawless story. But he is not the best Avati, nor the best of thrillers.
cast: Jason Robards III, Amy Galper, Lee R. Sellars, Richard Grubbs

title: L'amico del cuore
synopsis: Roberto, a village doctor, is in danger of life because he is seriously ill with his heart. He must leave for the United States where he will have to undergo a delicate surgery which, however, leaves him with little hope of survival. Before leaving he asks his best friend Michele to fulfill his last wish: to allow him to make love with Frida, his beautiful Swedish wife.
cast: Vincenzo Salemme, Carlo Buccirosso, Maurizio Casagrande, Eva Herzigova

title: L'amico del giaguaro
synopsis: Alberto escapes from the orphanage and goes to Rome. Here he joins a band of lazy people who organize a pickpocket. The blow yields a good booty soon squandered, but the robbed recognizes Alberto and demands compensation. The boy is thus forced to look for a job to avoid prison.
cast: Walter Chiari, Gabriella Pallotta, Carlo Romano, Elke Sommer

title: L'amico di famiglia
synopsis: Geremia, a 60-year-old moneylender from a small town in the Agro Pontino, is unpleasant in appearance and character, but feels good and socially useful. He thinks he is saving the families he lends money to: but from the moment he agrees to "help" a couple who has to organize their daughter's wedding, his life will take an unexpected turn ...
cast: Giacomo Rizzo, Laura Chiatti, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Clara Bindi, Gigi Angelillo, Barbara Valmorin, Marco Giallini, Valentina Lodovini, Lucia Ragni, Antonella Salvucci

title: L'amico immaginario
synopsis: The inadequacy of the life of Dino, a fifty-year-old intellectual, is evident both in his relations with women and with his son. The death of Daniele, a close friend, should increase his loneliness, but, through this disappearance, Dino will cultivate a new form of presence, dedicating himself to an imaginary figure.
cast: Victor Cavallo, Valeria D'Obici, Nico D'Alessandria, Rocco Mortelliti

title: L'amministratore
synopsis: Umberto Montella is a Neapolitan condominium administrator. In the Neapolitan city, his days pass between meetings, meetings and daily problems of small and large scale. Like a new Charon, Umberto ferries the viewer between the different essences of Naples, from rich to poor neighborhoods, where a simple conflict with a neighbor becomes the relief valve to get by.

title: L'ammiratrice
synopsis: A young journalist, Francesca, focuses on an interview with Nino D'Angelo to win fame. Instead, it is the star who conquers Francesca who, despite the maneuvers of a jealous colleague, in turn manages to break into the heart of the singer and to spend a romantic getaway with him in Venice. Then he dies, putting an end in a riot of tears (and songs) to this soap opera in a single episode.
cast: Nino D'Angelo, Annie Belle, Marina Morra, Carmine Iorio, Vincenzo Di Troia, Enzo Berr, Gennaro Beneduce, Francesco Di Gennaro, Mariolina De Fano

title: L'ammutinamento
synopsis: In the 17th century, fifty British inmates from Newgate prison were sent to America to populate the colonies. The convicts aboard the Navesi rebel and set course for Tortuga. Among the passengers is Anna Midford who, lost her father, is traveling with her brother. The two must join an uncle in Virginia. Meanwhile, the ship at the mercy of the storm risks shipwreck and the leader of the mutineers thinks of throwing the women overboard, but a doctor convicted of political crimes rebels.
cast: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Edmund Purdom, Michèle Girardon, Armand Mestral, Ivan Desny, Franco Capucci, Renato Speziali, Franca Parisi

title: L'amore
synopsis: Film in two episodes, both focused on the greatness of Anna Magnani. The first ("The human voice", a respectful adaptation from Cocteau) is a long telephone monologue of a woman who converses with her lover ready to leave her. In the second ("Il miracolo", scripted and interpreted by Fellini) Magnani is a naive country girl who, meeting an unknown vagabond, mistakes him for Saint Joseph; man does not miss the opportunity ...
cast: Anna Magnani, Federico Fellini

title: L'amore a domicilio
synopsis: Sentimentally fearful, Renato has always kept away from relationships that really involved him. But when he discovers that Anna, known by chance, is being held in house arrest, he decides to indulge in the feelings he has always feared. In that house, where the only male actor is, he is convinced that he can control the situation. In love, however, there are no safe ways and soon the situation becomes complicated.
cast: Miriam Leone, Simone Liberati, Fabrizio Rongione, Anna Ferruzzo, Renato Marchetti, Luciano Scarpa, Antonio Milo, Valeria Perri, Eleonora Russo, Gerry Mastrodomenico, Andrea Mautone

title: L'amore breve
synopsis: A boy from a wealthy family ends up being on the run with his father and mother. He is in a relationship with a widow, but also, as a challenge, goes to a homosexual antiquarian. In the background, a Trieste in crisis, agitated by strikes at shipyards and political tensions.
cast: Joan Collins, Faith Domergue, Massimo Serato, Antonio Centa, Gaetano Imbrò, Antonio Cantafora, Lanfranco Cobianchi, Mathieu Carrière

title: L'amore buio
synopsis: At the end of a Sunday of sun, sea, diving and pizza, four kids rape Irene, also a teenager. One of them, Ciro, the next morning goes to report himself and the others. They are sentenced to two years of imprisonment. The two worlds, so opposite and different, will attract each other and even, perhaps, will meet and merge.
