cast: Irene De Angelis, Gabriele Agrio, Valeria Golino, Corso Salani, Luisa Ranieri, Anna Ammirati, Fabrizio Gifuni, Luigi Attrice, Loredana Simioli, Michele Scala

title: L'amore di Màrja
synopsis: 1970s, Scandinavia. During a march for peace, Màrja, a cheerful and optimistic twenty-year-old, meets Fortunato, a Sicilian contemporary, and falls madly in love with him. The two decide to marry and create a family based on their ideals, but when, a few years later, they have to deal with the collapse of their generation's dreams, they find two daughters, a precarious existence and an uncertain future. To follow her husband, Màrja agrees to move to a small town in Sicily.
cast: Vincenzo Peluso, Laura Malmivaara, Lucia Sardo, Veronica Visentin, Tiziana Lodato

title: L'amore difficile
synopsis: Four episodes to describe the changes in customs in Italy in the 1960s. A reporter might marry a tycoon's daughter, but he prefers an affair with a married woman. A lawyer gives up his lover out of avarice, while a soldier tries the approach by train with a widow. Finally, a German couple in search of adventures misses the point, but finds love again.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman, Catherine Spaak, Enrico Maria Salerno, Claudia Mori, Nadja Tiller, Gastone Moschin, Bernhard Wicki, Lilla Brignone, Adriano Rimoldi, Fulvia Franco, Lilli Palmer
director: Alberto Bonucci, Luciano Lucignani, Sergio Sollima, Nino Manfredi

title: L'amore e basta
synopsis: A journey to discover homosexual love through the stories and testimonies of nine gay and lesbian couples who live in Catania, Versailles, Paris, Sutri, Berlin, a town in the Lower Po Valley, Palermo and Barcelona.
cast: Luca Zingaretti

title: L'amore e la guerra
synopsis: The First World War, in the period between the retreat of Caporetto and the battle of Vittorio Veneto, is the backdrop to the tormented love between Countess Albertina Reggis (Martina Stella), at the front as a Red Cross nurse, and the sergeant of humble origins Rocco Parri (Daniele Liotti). The subtle plans of Captain Avogadro (Thomas Trabacchi), who sees in the countess the resolution of the problems represented by his gambling debts, and of his mistress Matilde (Helene Nardini).
cast: Martina Stella, Daniele Liotti, Thomas Trabacchi, Helene Nardini, Ludovico Fremont, Denis Fasolo, Marco Gambino, Emanuela Grimalda, Mauro Meconi, Chiara Pazzaglia, Andrea Tidona

title: L'amore fa male
synopsis: Germana (Stefania Rocca) is an unemployed actress and mother of a girl, who while having a relationship with a mature and wealthy Roman lawyer meets the charming Gianmarco (Paolo Briguglia), with whom she lives an intense love affair, despite he is already engaged to Antonia (Diane Fleri). To overcome the crisis with her husband Aldo (Stefano Dionisi), who is cheating on her with another man, her friend Elisabetta (Nicole Grimaudo) asks her to accompany her on a trip to Sicily, an opportunity that will strengthen their bond despite emerging raw truth they both never expected.
cast: Stefania Rocca, Nicole Grimaudo, Paolo Briguglia, Diane Fleri, Claudio Brigagli, Stefano Dionisi, Giovanni Corrado, Gianmarco Pozzesco, Tobias Helmreich, Nicholas Gallo, Federica Candelise, David Coco, Anna Luisa Capasa, Andre Watson

title: L'amore imperfetto
synopsis: Sergio works in a shopping center in Genoa. His wife Angela is expecting a child, who will live shortly, due to a brain malformation. They will give birth to him, to donate his organs to other children. Angela, from Spain, believes in the Virgin of Pilar, and hopes for a miracle. Meanwhile, Sergio must make his contribution to an investigation.
cast: Enrico Lo Verso, Marta Belaustegui, Federico Scribani, Francesco Carnelutti

title: L'amore in città
synopsis: An episodic film, directed by some of the main directors of Italian neorealism. In the first, Love that you pay, Lizzani interviews some prostitutes. In Pararadiso for four hours, Risi describes the ballrooms of the Italians. In Attempted Suicide Antonioni talks about the people who tried to take their own life. Fellini, on the other hand, shows the events of a marriage agency. Maselli and Zavattini ask Caterina to tell about her life. Finally, in Italians they turn around, Lattuada records the attitude of Italians towards beautiful sex.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Valeria Moriconi, Giovanna Ralli, Raimondo Vianello
director: Michelangelo Antonioni, Federico Fellini, Alberto Lattuada, Carlo Lizzani, Francesco Maselli, Dino Risi, Cesare Zavattini

title: L'amore molesto
synopsis: Amalia, a woman in her sixties, the separated wife of a poor man who makes a living painting marines and gypsies for the fairs and markets of the Neapolitan suburbs, is found dead at sea. She is wearing only a red lace bra, too youthful and expensive for her. The daughter Delia, who has long since left her hometown and lives in Bologna, returns to Naples to shed light on the mysterious death. She tries to reconstruct her mother's last days, retraces her life tormented by her husband's jealousy and encounters ambiguous men, inhabitants of a violent and prevaricating world. Less compact than "Death of a Neapolitan mathematician", this film is more risky, precisely because it stands on the dangerous limit of the stereotype
cast: Anna Bonaiuto, Angela Luce, Peppe Lanzetta, Licia Maglietta

title: L'amore nasce a Roma
synopsis: Lello and Mario arrived from their hometown in Rome in search of fortune. One is a painter, the other is a singer. The beginnings are not encouraging, because neither one nor the other show any particular artistic skills. The two young people meet Doretta and Silvia, two pretty florists in Piazza di Spagna and immediately fall in love with them, however reciprocated. One day, by chance, it turns out that Lello has a good voice and from a painter he ends up turning into a singer. Out of spite, Mario grabs his brushes and paints some pictures, which immediately find buyers.
cast: Claudio Villa, Antonio Cifariello, Valeria Moriconi, Rossella Como

title: L'amore necessario
synopsis: Two long-time spouses remain afloat, peppering the marriage with tolerated betrayals, until they make the acquaintance of a young couple in love. The vision of that perfection leads them to devise a malicious plan to pollute its purity which turns into a boomerang.
cast: Ben Kingsley, Marie Christine Barrault, Ann Gisel Glass

title: L'amore non basta
synopsis: Martina is an air hostess, she has a painful relationship with her boyfriend Angelo, a precarious bartender, especially emotionally. They also both have difficult family histories behind them. Angelo looks for a way out of the incommunicability between them through the medium that is most proper to him, that is writing.
cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Ivan Franek, Rocco Papaleo, Alessandro Tiberi, Alessandro Haber, Marit Nissen, Andrea Pietrantoni, Emanuela Scipioni, Carlo De Ruggeri

title: L'amore non basta
synopsis: Carola's bookstore is threatened by the owner of the shop opposite, who would like the place to rent to increase his turnover. In an attempt to seduce Carola, the well-to-do Luca takes his side, but his safety as a seasoned womanizer has little luck with the bookseller. Nearby there is Mario, who has a fruit and vegetable stand, and between a misunderstanding and another he becomes a friend and then in love with Carola. To complicate things, in addition to a new charge of Luca, a wolf in the guise of a repentant seducer ready for anything, even Mario's ex-girlfriend, a young and spirited taxi driver.
cast: Veronica Pivetti, Francesco Salvi, Cesare Bocci, Daniela Morozzi, Fabio Sartor, Eva Deidda, Glauco Onorato, Carlo Molfese, Silvana De Santis, Ivan Bacchi

title: L'amore non perdona
synopsis: An unusual love story between Adriana, a nearly sixty-year-old nurse, and Mohammed, a young Arab in her thirties, reflecting on the countless contemporary contradictions and on a completely uncertain future.
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Helmi Dridi, Francesca Inaudi

title: L'amore primitivo
synopsis: A beautiful anthropologist has collected, during a journey that lasted many years in all the most remote areas of the planet, a detailed documentation on the erotic customs of primitive populations. The material is shown during a congress that takes place in a hotel. The two waiters Franco and Ciccio secretly assist and demonstrate to the scholar that primitive erotic attitudes can occur even among the most advanced populations. Franco, Ciccio and the super-majored Jayne Mansfield interpret only the connecting scenes, for the rest the film is only a modest assemblage of mediocre documentaries a la Mondo cane.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Jayne Mansfield, Mickey Hargitay, Carlo Kechler, Lucia Modugno, Gaetano Quartararo, Alfonso Sarlo, Eugenio Galadini

title: L'amore probabilmente
synopsis: Sofia, a student of an acting school, is struck by the lecture _The invitation to lie_ that Mariangela Melato addresses to her disciples. According to her, being an actor means lying. Sofia, struck by these words, decides to experience the power of lies in life. He'll get endless trouble out of it. Distraught, Sofia finds herself on a train where she reads the title of an interview with Stefania Sandrelli in which she claims that in front of the camera it is impossible to lie. Sofia decides to always tell the truth, but once again she understands that saying what you think does not pay. All that remains is the illusion, entrusted to Alida Valli and an audition that the aspiring actress must support with a director and which becomes a journey of self-discovery.
cast: Sonia Bergamasco, Rosalinda Celentano, Fabrizio Gifuni, Teco Celio

title: L'amore ritorna
synopsis: Forty-year-old Luca Florio is an actor at the height of his career: there is no longer any trace in him of the provincial boy who fled the country by cutting ties with his family. But when, after an illness, he is hospitalized in a very luxurious clinic, he thinks back to his own existence, to the women he loved, to his closest friends, to his parents ... He thus regains possession of the culture of his land and rediscovers fantasies, beliefs, dreams with open eyes of the South that he left behind.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Margherita Buy, Sergio Rubini, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Mariangela Melato

title: L'amore ritrovato
synopsis: Mario, a banker by profession and married for some time, met Giovanna during a train journey in the years preceding the outbreak of the Second World War. The girl, of humble origins, lives in Livorno where she works as a manicure and is pointed out by the locals as an "easy" girl. A strong passion was born between the two that between quarrels and reconciliations continued until 1945.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Maya Sansa, Marco Messeri, Luisanna Pandolfi, Vania Rotondi

title: L'amore rubato
synopsis: Marina is a young mother who rushes to the ER with a broken arm. For her, love has always meant following the rules of Luigi, her husband, a respected professional and a control freak. But since there is Giacomo, her little one, Marina is discovering another form of love, deeper, more instinctive and that perhaps will save her. Francesca, on the other hand, is 14 years old and the carefree air of a teenager at the first crushes, between interrogations in high school and an afternoon at the beach, which however turns into a nightmare, when a group of classmates repeatedly abuse her , shooting it with a smartphone. Also along a beach, Angela and Gesuino meet on a September afternoon: she is a 50-year-old woman, her gaze is fascinating but crossed by loneliness, he is a shy man who spends his time training. Between them the understanding that is born is at the beginning romantic, delicate and unexpected, but the attentive attentions of the man soon turn into jealousy, continuous phone calls, outbursts of anger in front of friends to lead to a real aggression. Alessandra, then, lives in a suburban building with her grandmother and her little brother and works in a swimming pool as a cleaner, while Anna is chasing her dream, treading the stages of the most important theaters as an actress, but her happy days are about to become a memory. In fact, a few months ago she went to live with Il Moro, a very famous rock star. The two young women, diametrically opposed for lifestyles and interests, share an identical ferocious destiny: Alessandra, raped by her employer, will be forced to have an abortion, while Anna, sunk in a whirlwind of anger and beatings continue, he will slowly see his dreams and his future fade away.
cast: Gabriella Pession, Francesco Montanari, Stefania Rocca, Alessandro Preziosi, Elena Sofia Ricci, Massimo Poggio, Chiara Mastalli, Antonello Fassari, Elisabetta Mirra, Emilio Solfrizzi, Cecilia Dazzi, Antonio Catania, Daniela Poggi, Emanuel Casiero, Luisa De Santis

title: L'amore si fa così
synopsis: The designer Max Dupont is engaged to a pattern maker in a large tailor's shop. To get the vacant post of general manager of the fashion house, where his girlfriend works, he pretends to be an important stylist, Narciso Mimosa. Having obtained the post, he facilitates the career of his beloved and also manages to improve the company's business.
cast: Enrico Viarisio, Jacqueline Prévot, Luigi Almirante, Paolo Stoppa

title: L'amore è eterno finché dura
synopsis: ophthalmologist Gilberto, married to the psychologist Tiziana and father of Marta, is summoned to the barracks. The wife discovers that Gilberto has participated in a speed date. One of the participants, Stella, has disappeared and the carabinieri are investigating. The couple crisis is inevitable and the man asks his partner Andrea, who lives with Carlotta, for hospitality. Gilberto continues to see his daughter and from her he discovers that Tiziana has also been in a relationship for over two years ...
cast: Carlo Verdone, Laura Morante, Stefania Rocca, Rodolfo Corsato, Gabriella Pession, Antonio Catania

title: L'amore è imperfetto
synopsis: Elena (Anna Foglietta) works in a publishing house, lives alone and has long since stopped believing in love, as she was burned by a painful affair seven years earlier, in 2005, when she was still a university graduate and shared a house. with her friend Roberta (Camilla Filippi). At the time, she had met Marco (Giulio Berruti) and had lived with him for two years, until the day she discovered that he was cheating on her with another man. Pregnant, Elena wanted to have an abortion but Marco convinced her to change her mind and to entrust the baby to him as soon as she was born. Since then, she hasn't seen either of them again but the wound she carries inside has grown dramatically, to the point of preventing her from getting involved in other relationships. One day, however, Ettore (Bruno Wolkowitch), a charming mature man, and Adriana (Lorena Cacciatore), a vital and seductive eighteen year old, forcefully enter her life, involving her in an unexpected love circle.
cast: Anna Foglietta, Bruno Wolkowitch, Giulio Berruti, Camilla Filippi, Lorena Cacciatore

title: L'amore, il sole e le altre stelle
synopsis: Thanks to the new sex education lessons of Professor Russo (Anna Ferzetti), Primo (Edoardo Pagliai) and Michela (Elisa Visari), long-time friends, fed up of being considered by their parents and their friends still children, they decide to go to read together for the first time. The news upsets the already unsafe lives of their parents, starting with Corinne (Vanessa Incontrada), who is fed up with life as a housewife and is distracted from her routine chatting via the internet, and Pietro (Ricky Memphis), fearful and predictable, Primo's mother and father respectively. Michela's mother, Sabrina (Chiara Ricci), on the other hand, no longer has faith in her husband Andrea (Marco Bonini), an incurable traitor and eternal Peter Pan, and has thrown him out of the house. Meanwhile, Primo and Michela, having obtained the desired attention, have to deal with new sensations, new emotions which, like planets of the solar system, attract and repel each other. Will they be able to remain friends and find a new balance in this new relationship?
cast: Vanessa Incontrada, Ricky Memphis, Marco Bonini, Chiara Ricci, Anna Ferzetti, Edoardo Pagliai, Elisa Visari

title: L'amour braque
synopsis: After a robbery, Mickey, a bandit who wants to redeem an underage kept, Marie, meets Leòn on a train, a refugee with mental problems exiled from Hungary, and takes him with him. The young foreigner, who has to find relatives in the French capital, falls madly in love with the girl, and at the same time is coveted by his cousin Aglè, an actress who is setting up Chekhov's "The Seagull" with a company. Between ups and downs, Mickey kills Marie and Leon ends up mad.
cast: Francis Huster, Sophie Marceau, Tchéky Karyo, Michel Albertini

title: L'amour c'est gai, l'amour c'est triste
synopsis: The tailor Léon divides the Negozio apartment with his sister Marie, who pretends herself chiromante but in reality receives the men who send her the "boyfriend" Maxime by appointment. The respective customers cross; Meanwhile, Léon falls in love with Arlette ...
cast: Claude Melki, Bernadette Lafont, Chantal Goya, Jean Pierre Marielle

title: L'amour caché
synopsis: Danielle is psychologically unstable and on her third suicide attempt she is admitted to a clinic by her daughter Sophie. The woman gradually reveals to the analyst the heap of hatred, the sterile emptiness, the inviolable silence in which she has tried to confine herself for a long time ...
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Greta Scacchi, Mélanie Laurent, Olivier Gourmet

title: L'amour debout
synopsis: Martin, with a last gasp of hope, meets Leah in Paris. They are both 25 and have had their first love story together. Both are now looking to mature and grow.
cast: Paul Delbreil, Adèle Csech, Samuel Fasse, Jean Christophe Marti, Thibaut Destouches, Shirley Mirande, Pascal Cervo, Francoise Lebrun

title: L'amour dure trois ans
synopsis: Marc Marronnier, literary critic by day and worldly news journalist by night, is fully convinced that love with a capital a lasts only three years. The certainty comes from his experiences and from the marriage with his ex-wife Anne, from whom he has just divorced. He also wrote a manual to prove his thesis but is denied by the meeting with Alice who, becoming his mistress, calls into question everything he had already taken for granted about love, sex and emotional ties.
cast: Gaspard Proust, Louise Bourgoin, Joey Starr, Jonathan Lambert, Frédérique Bel, Nicolas Bedos, Elisa Sednaoui, Bernard Menez, Anny Duperey, Thomas Jouannet

title: L'amour en fuite
synopsis: Antoine married Christine, but their relationship is now at an end. The two divorce, but remain good friends. After various adventures (including love affairs) Antoine finds serenity with Sabine, a young saleswoman who seems to be genuinely in love with him.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Marie France Pisier, Claude Jade

title: L'amour flou
synopsis: Romane and Philippe separate. After ten years together, two children and a dog, they no longer love each other. Or, rather, they love each other in their own way, as happens to many couples. They then decide to "separate" by living in two separate apartments but communicating through the children's room. Can they live together separately? Can they start a new life without saying goodbye to the previous one?
cast: Romane Bohringer, Philippe Rebbot, Rose Rebbot Bohringer, Raoul Rebbot Bohringer, Brigitte Catillon, Aurélia Petit, Philippe Stange, François Picard, Matthieu Sampeur, Yves Storper

title: L'amour fou
synopsis: On the death of Yves Saint Laurent, his life partner Pierre Bergé decides to sell their private art collection. The sale is considered "the auction of the century" and each item tells the story of their personal life. This documentary, full of rare material and exclusive images of their homes and life in common, tells their story: a love story, in which art and the search for ethics have played an important role.
cast: Yves Saint Laurent, Pierre Bergé, Betty Catroux, Loulou De La Falaise, Jack Lang, Frédéric Chambre, Boujemaa Lahbali, Catherine Deneuve, Laetitia Casta, François De Ricqlès

title: L'amour violé
synopsis: Nicole (Nathalie Nell), a young nurse, lives in a provincial town. One evening four strangers kidnap and rape her. Much later, he meets - individually - his attackers.
cast: Nathalie Nell, Alain Fourès, Michèle Simonnet, Pierre Arditi, Daniel Auteuil, Bernard Granger, Alain Marcel, Gilles Tamiz, Tatiana Moukhine, Lucienne Hamon

title: L'amour à la mer
synopsis: A young Parisian (Geneviève Thénier) falls in love with a sailor (Daniel Moosmann) he knows on vacation. While summer brings them together, autumn divides them: they continue to write but lead separate lives, he first at Brest with his friends and above all with Guy (Guy Gilles), she in Paris waiting to see him again.
cast: Daniel Moosmann, Geneviève Thénier, Josette Krieff, Guy Gilles, Simone Paris, Lili Bontemps, Bernard Verley, Jean Pierre Léaud, Pierre Fabre, Martine Messager, Eric Goepfert, Monique Lejeune, Jacques Portet, Jean Daniel Simon, Jean François Faure, Patrick Jouané, Jean Claude Brialy, Sophie Daumier

title: L'amour à mort
synopsis: Elisabeth is united by an infinite and all-encompassing feeling to her husband Simon. When the death of the latter, which had already been announced on other occasions, comes final and irrevocable, Elisabeth progressively detaches herself from the world. The comfort of a couple of friends, Protestant pastors, is worth nothing: her only desire is to reunite with Simon through suicide.
cast: Sabine Azéma, Fanny Ardant, Pierre Arditi, André Dussollier

title: L'amour à vingt'ans
synopsis: Five cities, Rome, Paris, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, for five episodes directed by five directors to explore the love of twenty-year-olds lived on both sides of the world.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Marie France Pisier, Barbara Lass, Zbigniew Cybulski

title: L'amour, c'est mieux à deux
synopsis: Michel and Vincent have been great friends since childhood but have diametrically opposed ideas about women and love. Michel believes in pure and romantic love and expects the sudden love at first sight, as it was for his parents and grandparents. Vincent, on the other hand, argues that in the approach with the other sex the brain and feelings do not matter so much but that everything depends on the physical alchemy of the bodies. Both will change their minds, discovering the limits of their positions, when they meet Angèle and Nathalie.
cast: Clovis Cornillac, Virginie Efira, Manu Payet, Annelise Hesme, Laurence Arné, Shirley Bousquet, Jonathan Lambert, Laurent Lafitte, Sophie Vouzelaud, Emmanuel Suarez

title: L'amour, l'après-midi
synopsis: Frédéric is a married man; his wife is expecting the second child. Everything is fine between them. Then, from the past, Chloe, an old schoolmate, emerges. Chloe, so far from the tranquility of bourgeois life, represents for Frédéric the charm of transgression. For a while he plays at being a Don Juan; but, when the fantasies are about to become reality, he stops: it is with his wife that he will make love in the afternoon.
cast: Bernard Verley, Zouzou, Françoise Verley, Daniel Ceccaldi, Malvina Penne

title: L'amoureuse
synopsis: Marie and Antoine live together, are in love, but she wants to have a child and he doesn't feel ready at all. Marie meets Paul and after a first resistance he falls in love with him. He remains pregnant and the doubts arrive with the child: will he be the son of Antoine or Paul? Gorgeous test by Charlotte Gainsbourg, daughter of the great Serge. But the film suffers too much the intimate minimalism of its author, exponent of the French poetic that vaguely self -referential (and "umbilical") who opens up to considerable moments of cinema and then closes on verbosity and reflexivity at all costs.XXXV.O.S.T. XXX
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Yvan Attal, Thomas Langmann

title: L'anabase de May et Fusako Shigenobu, Masao Adachi et 27 années sans images
synopsis: The history of the Japanese Red Army is retraced through the experiences of its founder Fusako Shigenobu, his daughter May and director Masao Adachi who, after joining the Army, moved to Lebanon where he fought alongside the members for 28 years. of the Front for the Liberation of Palestine. Arrested first in Beirut and then in Japan, Adachi was also forbidden to go back behind the camera, thus abandoning the world of cinema that returns to be familiar to him after thirty years, when director Eric Baudelaire contacts him for a film about his life.

title: L'anatra all'arancia
synopsis: A rich bourgeois couple, after ten years of living together, finds new stimuli with the arrival of a young and distinguished foreigner. He, a well-known advertiser, gets jealous and brings in his secretary, a perfect happy goose. Thus begins a ménage of four where everyone thinks they are betraying someone else, but in which no betrayal is ever consummated.
cast: John Richardson, Barbara Bouchet, Monica Vitti, Ugo Tognazzi, Sabina De Guida, Antonio Allocca

title: L'anello matrimoniale
synopsis: The beautiful Monica, happily married to an illustrious plastic surgeon for seven years, does not know whether to remain faithful or to give in to the temptation embodied by the handsome neighbor Giorgio. When in doubt, the woman does not have too many scruples and decides to ask for a license directly from her spouse. Who, unexpectedly, gives her permission ...
cast: Carmen Villani, Ray Lovelock, Amparo Muñoz, Enzo Cannavale

title: L'ange
synopsis: In an indeterminate place (a sort of immense staircase) and in a suspended and eternal time, some figures perform mysterious and apparently absurd actions, culminating in a blinding explosion of light.
cast: Maurice Baquet, Jean Marie Bon, Martine Couture, Jacques Faure

title: L'angelo bianco
synopsis: The engineer Guido Carani had a son from his relationship with Luisa who then took the vows: the son died. Obsessed with this story, Guido contemplates divorcing his wife, but she and her daughter die in an accident. Years later Guido falls in love with Lina, a girl who resembles Luisa in an extraordinary way. Lina dies in prison after giving birth to a son. The film is regarded as the ideal sequel to "Nobody's Children". Matarazzo expands the usual subject matter of melodrama towards horizons that border on the fantastic and the unreal, passing through the theme of the splitting of the personality and the returning past.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Yvonne Sanson, Enrica Dyrell, Alberto Farnese, Flora Lillo, Philippe Hersent, Nerio Bernardi, Virgilio Riento

title: L'angelo con la pistola
synopsis: A police commissioner is disheartened: the crime bosses he had brought to trial are released for deadline, while the prosecution witnesses have been murdered. But even among the criminals there are victims who fall at the hands of a mysterious killer. The inspector is not long in discovering that this unpredictable "ally" of his is Lisa, a waitress in a bar that the inspector himself frequents. And the two, the man of the law and the girl who applies her own code of death, work from now on in full and mutual agreement.
cast: Tahnee Welch, Remo Girone, Eva Grimaldi, Sergio Fiorentini, Nicola D'Eramo, Francesco Sciacca, Antonino Iuorio, Jean Hébert, Cesare Bocci

title: L'angelo dei muri
synopsis: Pietro lives in an old apartment of an equally old building. The tired and solitary routine of him is broken by an eviction order. In order not to leave, it puts a secret strategy in place: it builds a wall at the bottom of the long corridor of the apartment, a real vertical hiding place behind which to disappear. The fear of being discovered becomes an obsession and everything makes him feel threatened. Then, one day, "the enemy" really arrives: he is a desperate mother who wants to guarantee a roof to her daughter. How will Pietro react? What form will he take his war?
cast: Pierre Richard, Iva Krajnc, Gioia Heinz, Arthur Defays, Paolo Fagioli, Zita Fusco

title: L'angelo di Sarajevo
synopsis: Sarajevo 1992. The Italian journalist Marco De Luca, sent to tell the horrors of war, will meet someone who will completely change his life: Malina, a ten-month old orphan.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Luca Angeletti, Thekla Reuten, Emanuela Grimalda, Radoje Cupic, Adnan Haskovic, Iva Nikolic

title: L'anglaise et le duc
synopsis: The diary book of the noblewoman Grace Elliott, mistress of the Prince of Wales, the future King George IV and of Prince Philip, Duke of Orléans, is the chronicle of her days and her life since 1790. Faithful to the king, opposed to the Revolution , moderate, Grace works to save a fugitive, comes and goes from Paris, tries to dissuade the duke from voting in favor of the guillotine for the king, faces searches, sees the angry crowd in the streets and squares, meets Robespierre, comments and he gets excited about the Terror.
cast: Lucy Russell, Jean Claude Dreyfus, François Marthouret, Léonard Cobiant

title: L'anima gemella
synopsis: In a small village in southern Italy, Tonino and Maddalena love each other with a pure and unconditional love. Magdalene's beauty, however, arouses the envy of Teresa, her cousin, daughter of a powerful man who got rich from the fish trade. The girl tries by all means to steal Tonino from Maddalena, even resorting to the charms of an old village witch. The son of the latter, a fraudulent barber, will be able to unravel, in spite of himself, the dense network of intrigues hatched by Teresa.
cast: Valentina Cervi, Violante Placido, Michele Venitucci, Sergio Rubini, Dino Abbrescia

title: L'animal
synopsis: The strange conquest of love of a stuntman who is called to act as a stunt double for an actor, his double, so tough in the fiction of the cinematographic part, as so feminine in real life ...
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Raquel Welch, Aldo Maccione

title: L'anniversario
synopsis: In an elegant villa on the outskirts of Rome, Anita desperately tries to reconstruct what happened the previous night. The night before, the woman had celebrated their wedding anniversary with her husband and some friends. For dinner he had invited his usual friends: identical couples, superfacial, too standardized and made sterile by a life that was too easy. The arrival of Daniela, a neighbor, troubled by a furious quarrel with her husband upsets the serenity of the party. The next day a body is found ...
cast: Laura Morante, Luca Zingaretti, Elena Fresco, Cinzia Mascoli

title: L'anno prossimo vado a letto alle dieci
synopsis: It is sunset on the last day of the year and Poldo is preparing to spend the evening in a quiet intimacy. Suddenly his friend Rosario falls into his house, in desperation because his girlfriend has left him. Pity, even if reluctantly, Poldo resigns himself first to take his friend with him to a party, then to accompany him out of town to his parents. A friend's favor kicks off a series of daring adventures, at the end of which Poldo and Rosario will be able to promise themselves a less eventful end of the year for the future.
cast: Angelo Orlando, Ricky Memphis, Claudia Gerini, Barbara Cupisti

title: L'année dernière à Marienbad
synopsis: Tempted by the incessant court of a stranger, who claims to have already met her again, a woman is disputed between the possibility of a sentimental escape and the precariousness of the relationship with her current partner, who does not feel her disturbances. She seems to be persuaded by the unknown, but the game remains open ....
cast: Delphine Seyrig, Giorgio Albertazzi, Sacha Pitoeff, Françoise Bertin, Luce Garcia Ville, Héléna Kornel, Françoise Spira, Karin Toche Mittler

title: L'année des méduses
cast: Valérie Kaprisky, Bernard Giraudeau, Jacques Perrin

title: L'antidote
synopsis: Jacques-Alain Marty, aka "Jam", is the head of the French multinational Vladis Entreprises, but for some weeks he has been suffering from panic attacks linked to a childhood trauma. André Morin is an accountant in a toy factory and owns some shares of the Vladis group. When the two meet at the shareholders' meeting, Jam realizes he has found what he was looking for: in the presence of André, he regains his usual confidence and for this he decides not to let it slip ...
cast: Christian Clavier, Jacques Villeret, Agnès Soral, Annie Grégorio, François Levantal, Thierry Lhermitte

title: L'antimiracolo
synopsis: The customs, traditions and problems of the people of a small village in the Gargano in the sixties, those of the economic and demographic boom. Scenes of everyday life for a documentary shot in a depressed country at the time when the Italian economy was growing dramatically and when everyone thought more about spending than saving.
cast: Riccardo Cucciolla

title: L'apetta Giulia e la signora Vita
synopsis: A small worker bee would like to lead a life different from the one for which it is destined, made of monotonous and stressful work in a honey factory. To change things, she is willing to fight: she goes to the queen bee and claims the right to have a proper name that she herself has chosen, Giulia. To please her, the queen bee begins to tell her a fairy tale about human beings every evening, from birth to old age. The protagonists are called Simone and Sarah.

title: L'apollonide
synopsis: Early twentieth century. A very beautiful prostitute lives in a brothel, but her face is disfigured by a terrible scar, which has immobilized her forever in a sort of tragic grimace. Around her the other girls live their existence: rivalry and friendships, joys and sorrows. However, it seems that very little of what happens outside arrives in the brothel: a closed house in name and in fact, inside which life has its own rhythms and rules.
cast: Hafsia Herzi, Adèle Haenel, Jasmine Trinca, Louis Do De Lencquesaing, Noémie Lvovsky, Céline Sallette

title: L'appartamento
synopsis: Mamud is a pizza chef in a Roman restaurant and, one day, after getting a permit, he goes to kidnap a very young girl. The child is particularly dear to him, since the man fills her with affection and attention. At this point Mamud is desperately looking for a place to go, but despite his best efforts he cannot find it and is therefore forced to break into an apartment vacated by a couple on vacation. Meanwhile Layla, who comes from the desolate outskirts of the East and who works as a cleaning lady to make a living, goes to the apartment where Mamud has taken refuge.
cast: Konya Rousseva Stefanova, Emad Ibrahim, Anita Laurenzi

title: L'appartement
synopsis: Max is captured by a memory that does not let him sleep soundly. He is about to get married and one day he thinks he recognizes the voice of Lisa, a girl he had loved a few years before and decides to go in search of her. At one point, even five characters come into play and turn Max's adventure into too dangerous a game.
cast: Monica Bellucci, Vincent Cassel, Romane Bohringer

title: L'appat
synopsis: Nathalie works as a shop assistant in a boutique and often happens to go to places frequented by professionals. The girl is looking for relationships that propel her higher on her social ladder. Then one day Eric, her boyfriend, like her from a wealthy background, introduces her to her friend Bruno and decides to use her to rob the rich professionals she gets to know every day. A hallucinating and clumsy hunt for the intended victim begins. Helped by another girl, she lures Laurent, but at the last moment things go wrong.
cast: Marie Gillain, Olivier Sitruk, Bruno Putzulu, Richard Berry

title: L'apprendistato
synopsis: Luca, a shy fourteen-year-old with a wild soul, must learn to respect the rules in order to survive in the hotel boarding school. The family pushed him to enroll in the institute so that he can learn the trade as quickly as possible and his character is forged. Luca comes from a mountain village in the Alps, he grew up looking after the family's livestock and walking around in the woods. The apprenticeship will lead the young person to come to terms with himself and with what he will have to do in life: how much will he have to sacrifice of his freedom and adolescence to work in the service of clients?
cast: Luca Tufano, Mario Burlone, Lorenzo Campani, Enrico Colombini, Cristian Dellamora, Damiano Oberoffer, Ernesto Alberti Violetti

title: L'appuntamento
synopsis: Adelaide, a particularly beautiful young woman, is employed in a Florentine company where the rest of the staff are almost exclusively male. It is therefore inevitable that all her colleagues, bachelors and not, try to seduce her. Of all the luckiest seems to be Adelmo who, one day, even manages to snatch an appointment from her. However, things get complicated quickly due to the improvised Don Juan who has to overcome a series of obstacles to get to the appointment with Adelaide in time ... For some time Montagnani has been the "commuter of laughter" between the two fixed stars of eroticism local: Bouchet and Fenech.
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Barbara Bouchet, Mario Carotenuto, Maria Pia Conti, Orchidea De Santis, Enzo Liberti, Mario Pachi, Antonino Faà Di Bruno, Laura Poli

title: L'après-midi d'un tortionnaire
synopsis: Frant Tandara, a former torturer of the Romanian prisons, more than ten years after the fall of the Ceausescu regime is ready to confess his crimes to a journalist and a former political prisoner, whom he welcomes with a bouquet of flowers. Between technical problems and the reticence of the interviewee, who speaks either too fast or too slowly, the interview finds it hard to get going. To curb the insistence of the journalists, Tandara's wife intervenes, asking them to stop torturing her husband!
cast: Gheorghe Dinica, Radu Beligan, Ioana Ana Macaria, Coca Bloos, Dorina Chiriac

title: L'arbitro
synopsis: The rise and fall of a corrupt football referee is intertwined with the events of two Sardinian football teams of the third and lowest level: Atletico Pabarile, the weakest of the entire division, and Montecrastu, at the helm there is Brai, a fazendero accustomed to harassing the peasants of the Pabarile as the master of the countryside. When the young emigrant Matzutzi returns to the village, the fortunes of the two teams are reversed: with his footballing prowess, Matzutzi allows Pabarile to win one game after another.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Geppi Cucciari, Jacopo Cullin, Francesco Pannofino, Alessio Di Clemente, Marco Messeri, Benito Urgu, Grégoire Oestermann, Franco Fais, Quirico Manunza, Marco Cadau, Andrés Gioeni, Gustavo De Filpo

title: L'arbitro
synopsis: The meeting will be refereed by Mr. Carmelo Lo Cascio from Acireale. And Mr. Lo Cascio is really a man of one piece, a maniac of impartiality and honor. All until one evening he meets the journalist Elena Sperani. Between the two begins a secret relationship that undermines Carmelo's physical integrity (forced to resort to amphetamines to referee) and above all the psychic one.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Joan Collins, Gabriella Pallotta, Ignazio Leone

title: L'arbre
synopsis: Simone is an 8-year-old girl who, together with her mother, Dawn, keeps a secret: her father's spirit speaks to her through the branches of a magnificent tree that faces their house. Simone is convinced that he went back to protect his family. Soon everyone in the family draws comfort from the presence of the tree. But the bond established between mother and daughter is threatened when Dawn starts dating George. Simone then runs away to a small house built on the tree and refuses to go down. And the tree itself seems angry: its branches and roots reach out towards the house, threatening it. But Dawn doesn't want to let the tree take control of their life.
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Marton Csokas, Aden Young, Penne Hackforth Jones, Tom Russell, Christian Byers, Arthur Dignam, Gillian Jones, Morgana Davies, Gabriel Gotting

title: L'arbre de Noël
synopsis: After school, Marcel, orphan of his mother, joins his father and leaves with him for the holidays. During a boat trip while Laurent is in the water, a military plane flying over the area explodes, dropping an atomic bomb with a parachute. Marcel remains contaminated ...
cast: William Holden, Virna Lisi, Bourvil, Madeleine Damien, Mario Feliciani

title: L'arbre, le maire et la médiathèque
synopsis: The mayor of Saint-Juire-en-Vandée, a country village, elected from the ranks of the Socialist Party has a grandiose project: he intends to equip the village with a cultural center that includes, in addition to a swimming pool and a theater, also a so-called media library. His relations with the politicians of Paris allowed him to find the necessary money and everything, according to his intentions, should go well. Except that...
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Arielle Dombasle, Clémentine Amouroux, Pascal Greggory

title: L'arcano incantatore
synopsis: 1750. Giacomo Vigetti, seminarian, must leave Bologna to avoid being sentenced for having a young girl pregnant and having an abortion. Through an old lady in the smell of witchcraft he obtains a safe conduct and leaves for Tuscany, to work in the service of a mysterious character: a former parish priest, removed from the Church for his experiments that earned him the definition of "arcane enchanter", condemned to live isolated with the only presence of the secretary. James must in fact replace the old scriptural who has just died. Having overcome the initial terror, the young man is convinced that his master's experiments are not at all demonic, and begins to support him in his studies on telepathic powers.
cast: Carlo Cecchi, Stefano Dionisi, Arnaldo Ninchi, Andrea Scorzoni

title: L'arcidiavolo
synopsis: In 1478, after a long hostility, Innocent VIII and Lorenzo de 'Medici make peace, which displeases Beelzebu & C. The archdevil Belfagor and his valet Adramelek are therefore sent to earth to remit tares among the powerful. Here is the marriage of Maddalena de 'Medici messed up at the last moment, here is the girl forced to show herself naked to the entire citizenry. For Belfagor it will be the stake, but ...
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Claudine Auger, Mickey Rooney, Ettore Manni

title: L'arciere di fuoco
synopsis: King Richard the Lionheart left for the crusade in the Holy Land and left to his brother, John Without Earth, the care of the Kingdom. The king is given up for dead and John, blinded by greed and the lust for power, subjects the country to a terrible tyranny. Against him rises the noble Henry of Nottingham who, assuming the name of Robin Hood, leads the rebellion against the usurper.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Silvia Dionisio, Mark Damon, Mario Adorf, Luis Davila, Lars Bloch, Manuel Zarzo, Nello Pazzafini, Pierre Cressoy

title: L'arciere nero
synopsis: Two cousins, the deformed Lodrisio and the handsome, but perverse, Ludovico, in order to seize the power held by their uncle Alvise, kill the count of Sant'Elia who suspects their plots. The son of these, Corrado, is forced to flee and, to avenge his father, he turns into a bandit.
cast: Gérard Landry, Federica Ranchi, Livio Lorenzon, Carla Strober

title: L'argent
synopsis: #Banker Saccard finds himself on the brink of bankruptcy and tries to re-emerge.
cast: Brigitte Helm, Pierre Alcover, Yvette Guilbert, Alfred Abel, Marie Glory

title: L'argent de poche
synopsis: The protagonists are some kids, caught by Truffaut in the transition from childhood to adolescence. One of them falls in love with the mother of a companion and sends her flowers, which she believes were sent by the boy's father. The first flirtations take place at the cinema and the summer colony will finally bring love.
cast: Nicole Felix, Chantal Mercier, Jean François Stévenin, Virginie Thévenet, Tania Torrens, René Barnerias, Katy Carayon, Jean Marie Carayon

title: L'argine
synopsis: The "passatore" (ferryman) from Romagna Zvani is attracted to an unknown woman who, following a road accident, was hosted for a night in his house. He leaves the country, his mother and the girl with whom he had a child, to follow the woman to Rome. He sees her again, but also realizes that for her that night was just a whim to quickly forget. Zvani then decides to return to the country.
cast: Luisa Ferida, Gino Cervi, Guglielmo Sinaz, Rubi Dalma, Olga Capri

title: L'aria del lago
synopsis: Amleto Selva is a Sicilian immigrant looking for a better life. In 1919 he arrived in Bellano, on Lake Como, where he met and married Cirene, the shy daughter of the deceased local butcher. But the marriage proves to be poor in satisfactions for the young Sicilian and the "air of the lake" pushes him to frequent a cheerful gang of young bulls and to become a frequent visitor to local brothels. Some small commercial feuds and his sexual turbulence shake the foundations of the quiet life of the Lario. Meanwhile, in the background, fascism is advancing.
cast: Mario Opinato, Ruggero Cara, Gebriele Mainetti, Gianfelice Facchetti, Cinzia Bregonzi, Marina Remi

title: L'aria salata
synopsis: Fabio, an educator who works with prisoners helping them to reintegrate into society, goes into crisis when he meets Sparti, a man with a very difficult character convicted of murder. Fabio's family past re-emerges overwhelmingly, breaking the balance achieved over the years.
cast: Giorgio Pasotti, Giorgio Colangeli, Michela Cescon, Katy Saunders, Sergio Solli

title: L'aria serena dell'Ovest
synopsis: Four characters, very different from each other, find themselves living in the same city: Milan. Their mutual certainties and habits are the only point in common. Suddenly, however, their tranquility is upset by a series of events, linked to a lost agenda, which bring about a change and put them in contact with each other. It's like testing yourself again.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Patrizia Piccinini, Antonella Fattori, Ivano Marescotti, Roberto Accornero, Cesare Bocci, Olga Durano, Silli Togni, Riccardo Magherini, Bruno Stori

title: L'arma
synopsis: A petty bourgeois leads a less than mediocre existence between a cheating wife and a rebellious daughter. Although he knows about marital infidelities, he doesn't care that much, but one day this gray and conformist man is struck by a bloody fact. During a police operation he sees an officer cynically shoot an unarmed young man. So the man buys himself a gun and carries it around, cuddles it, almost, until ...
cast: Stefano Satta Flores, Claudia Cardinale, Benedetta Fantioli, Dario Ghirardi

title: L'arma, l'ora, il movente
synopsis: Commissioner Boito must investigate a triple homicide. The murdered are Don Giorgio, a young priest stabbed in the church of a convent of nuns, Giulia, his mistress, and the husband of Orchidea, a charming woman with whom the priest was also having an affair. However, someone has seen it all, but when he decides to speak, he risks his skin in turn ...
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Bedy Moratti, Adolfo Belletti, Eva Czemerys

title: L'armata Brancaleone
synopsis: Brancaleone da Norcia, as ragged as he is grandiloquent, is about to participate in a tournament. Here he is approached by a small group of wretches in possession of a parchment which assures the knight who holds it the fief of Aurocastro. On the way they meet the Byzantine Teofilatto, occupy a country where the plague is raging, save an extravagant betrothed. Having reached their destination, they are attacked by the Saracens ...
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Catherine Spaak, Gian Maria Volonté, Enrico Maria Salerno, Maria Grazia Buccella, Barbara Steele, Carlo Pisacane

title: L'armata ritorna
synopsis: General Ariosto is in Albania in search of the remains of the Italian soldiers who fell there during the last war. Colonel Di Brenni's widow asked him to bring back her husband's remains at any cost; after finding them, the general learns that the man was killed by the mother of the teenager he raped.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Michel Piccoli, Anouk Aimée, Gerard Klein, Sergio Castellitto, Daniele Dublino, Carmine De Padova, Roberto Miccoli

title: L'arme à gauche
synopsis: A young and wealthy American widow who has arrived in the Caribbean to take possession of a yacht left to her by her husband, on arrival learns with surprise that the boat has been stolen. Together with the sea captain he had hired for a voyage, he sets out in search of the boat. The two find him stranded on a sandbar, but when they get on board they have the unwelcome surprise of finding him occupied by a gang of adventurers dedicated to arms smuggling.
cast: Lino Ventura, Sylva Koscina, Leo Gordon, Alberto De Mendoza

title: L'arminuta
synopsis: August 1975. A thirteen -year -old girl is returned to the family to whom she did not know she belongs. She suddenly loses everything she had with the adoptive family: a comfortable house and the exclusive affection reserved for those who are the only child. Thus he finds himself in a foreign world, just touched by progress, where he will have to share the restricted spaces of a small and dark house with five other brothers.
cast: Sofia Fiore, Vanessa Scalera, Fabrizio Ferracane, Elena Lietti, Carlotta De Leonardis, Andrea Fuorto, Stefano Petruzziello, Giovanni Francesco Palombaro

title: L'armée des ombres
synopsis: In October 1942, in German-occupied France, the leader of an underground group organized the flight to England of important people of the Resistance. In an attempt to save two comrades captured by the SS, the man gets caught in turn but manages to escape. He is informed that one of their companions is in the hands of the Gestapo. Will he resist torture? The only solution, however painful, is to eliminate it. It is a very hard, decidedly painful film about the dangers faced by the French partisans and above all about their difficult choices. The dry and nervous style, the threatening city environments, the interpretation (especially by Lino Ventura and a tragic Simone Signoret) make this Melville film a wonderful example of war 'noir'.
cast: Lino Ventura, Paul Meurisse, Jean Pierre Cassel, Simone Signoret, Claude Mann, Paul Crauchet, Christian Barbier, Serge Reggiani

title: L'armée du crime
synopsis: In Paris occupied by the Germans, the poet-operator Missak Manuchian leads a group of very young Jews, Hungarian, Poles, Romanians, Spanish, Italians and Armenians determined to fight to free France they love, that of human rights. The attacks of these foreign partisans will disturb the Nazis and collaborators on several occasions. Until the collaborationist French police do not decide to intervene en masse, punishing the rebels. In February 1944, twenty -two men and a woman will be sentenced to death. Thanks to the intervention of Nazi propaganda, the condemned partisans are falsely presented to the population as an army of criminals.
cast: Virginie Ledoyen, Simon Abkarian, Robinson Stévenin, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Lola Naymark, Ariane Ascaride, Grégoire Leprince Ringuet, Yann Trégouët, Ivan Franek, Olga Legrand

title: L'arnacoeur
synopsis: Alex and his sister have a rather special job: they deal with messing up relationships on behalf of third parties interested in having ties dissolved. They are hired by a rich man who does not want his daughter to marry her boyfriend: a rather demanding task, also because they have only one week to complete the assignment.
cast: Romain Duris, Vanessa Paradis, Julie Ferrier, Jacques Frantz, François Damiens, Jean Yves Lafesse, Andrew Lincoln, Héléna Noguerra, Olivier Schneider

title: L'arrivo di Wang
synopsis: The young Chinese interpreter Gaia is contacted for an urgent translation. In great secrecy, he must act as an intermediary between the secret agent Curti (Ennio Fantastichini), an unscrupulous man, and an individual called by all Mr. Wang. Since the interrogation is conducted in the dark, Gaia encounters considerable difficulties in translating but the discovery of the reasons that led to the absence of light will forever change her existence, finding herself in front of someone who has little of human, coming directly from a another planet and which does not seem to have warlike intentions.
cast: Ennio Fantastichini, Francesca Cuttica, Juliet Esey Joseph, Massimo Triggiani, Antonello Morroni, Jader Giraldi, Li Yong, Rodolfo Bandini, Furio Ferrari, Angelo Nicotra

title: L'arroseur arrosé
synopsis: The first "remake" in the history of cinema. In fact, it takes up the same subject shot two years earlier by Louis Lumière in the short short film with the same title.

title: L'art d'aimer
cast: Gaspard Ulliel, Judith Godrèche, François Cluzet, Élodie Navarre, Julie Depardieu, Frédérique Bel, Pascale Arbillot, Stanislas Merhar, Louis Do De Lencquesaing, Laurent Stocker

title: L'arte della felicità
synopsis: In the scenario of a Naples with dark, surreal and pre-apocalyptic atmospheres, the story of Sergio, a former pianist who became a taxi driver, unfolds. Sergio abandoned music when his older brother Alfredo, with whom he shared the same passion, left Naples to move to India. The discovery of the real reason for Alfredo's departure will lead Sergio to lock himself in his taxi, which becomes a microcosm in which his story meets that of the passengers, witnesses of an everyday life for a long time away from himself, thanks to which he will find a new way happiness.

title: L'arte della guerra
synopsis: Together with some Ukrainian colleagues guests at the Egyptian Museum, the restorer Chiara Tomaini, through the patronage of Chief Onlus, is working to save the history and memory of Ukraine.
cast: Anna Safroncik, Nadiya Biriyk, Edith Gabrielli, Christian Greco, Chiara Tomaini, Teresa Calvano, Micol Forti, Volodymyr Sheiko, Paolo Coen, Igor Poshyvailo

title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
synopsis: Rosario Scimoni, known as Sasa, does not believe in anything. At first he is secretary of the mayor of his city, as well as his nephew, but he betrays him on some compromising documents. Then he becomes the right arm of the Tuscan socialist. World War I breaks out and he pretends to be crazy, then marries an ugly but very rich woman. He adheres to fascism and, later, to communism, and so on ... Alberto Sordi dominates the portrait of the cynical protagonist (how many similar characters will he make in his career!). But the film doesn't always hold convincing. Alongside happily biting moments, there are also pauses and downtime.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Marco Guglielmi, Franco Coop, Luisa Della Noce

title: L'as des as
synopsis: Jo and Gunther, after having fought during the First World War, become close friends and meet a few years later in Berlin during the 1936 Olympics. In the meantime, Jo, having become a famous boxer, is induced, in spite of himself, to protect a child. Jew, whose grandparents are persecuted by the Nazis. His friendship with Gunther, who became general of the Reich, will help him protect the boy and his family. Thanks to the officer's help, the braggart Jo manages to bring everyone to the border between Austria and Switzerland. But an unexpected risk of messing everything up.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Frank Hoffman, Marie France Pisier

title: L'ascension
synopsis: When Samy Diakhate confesses his love to Nadia, the young girl jokingly invites him to climb Everest to experience his feelings. True to his word, Samy then leaves his home on the outskirts of Paris to climb the highest mountain in the world without any previous experience as a climber. His departure triggers a growing wave of enthusiasm throughout France, who follows his adventure with bated breath.
cast: Ahmed Sylla, Alice Belaïdi, Nicolas Wanczycki, Denis Mpunga, Moussa Maaskri, Romane Portail, Johannes Oliver Hamm, Rabah Nait Oufella, Jochen Hägele, Jean Dell, Oscar Copp

title: L'asino d'oro: processo per fatti strani contro Lucius Apuleius cittadino romano
synopsis: In ancient Mauritania, the young Roman Lucius Apuleius (Samy Pavel) and his friend Aristomene (John Steiner) run into a series of misadventures due to the transformation experiments of a witch, which lead Lucius to behave like a man while he has the likeness. of a donkey and of a donkey when he becomes a man again.
cast: Barbara Bouchet, Sami Pavel, John Steiner, Marisa Fabbri, Dada Gallotti, Paolo Poli, Leopoldo Trieste

title: L'assalto
synopsis: Giancarlo Ferraris, entrepreneur from the province of Milan and father of the recent engineering graduate Federica, sees his family business suffering the effects of the Italian economic crisis. Without help he can count on, Ferraris is approached by the 'Ndrangheta and accepts the conditions to avoid the failure of a job that has represented in the past a growth both for the person and for his region. His redemption will come unexpectedly when he will show that corruption and illegality can be fought with the courage of desperation and the principles of a people who have always been industrious and honest.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Camilla Semino Favro, Ninni Bruschetta, Paolo Mazzarelli, Luigi Maria Burruano, Thomas Trabacchi, Giorgia Senesi, Ugo Conti, Claudio Sterpone

title: L'assassin habite... au 21
synopsis: In Paris, murders are committed, all "signed" by a mysterious Monsieur Durand. Commissioner Wens, who has set out on the killer’s trail, arrives at the Mimosa boarding house at 21 Avenue Junot, in Montmartre. Here, among the diverse fauna of the tenants, the murderer hides.
cast: Pierre Fresnay, Suzy Delair, Jean Tissier, Pierre Larquey, Noël Roquevert, René Génin, Jean Despeaux, Marc Natol, Huguette Vivier, Odette Talazac

title: L'assassino
synopsis: The antique dealer Alfredo Martelli is stopped by the police on charges of killing his ex-lover for money reasons. The stay in the police offices makes Alfredo reflect on some unclean episodes of his life, and a sense of guilt emerges. Then the real murderer is discovered: Alfredo, released, ends up forgetting the anguish of those hours and returns to life as usual.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Salvo Randone, Micheline Presle

title: L'assassino ha le mani pulite
cast: Tom Drake, Femi Benussi, Virginio Gazzolo, Ernesto Colli, Isarco Ravaioli, Andrea Fantasia, Ivo Garrani, Valeria Ciangottini

title: L'assassino ha riservato nove poltrone
synopsis: Patrick Davenant is a noble and very rich Englishman who, on the occasion of his birthday, organizes an eccentric evening by summoning nine friends and acquaintances to his luxurious palace, and more precisely in the ancient theater that is part of it. An atmosphere of murky mystery hovers over the place, due to the fact that exactly a century earlier an entire family had been locked up and found their deaths there. But as soon as all the guests have entered the room, the doors are barred and a bloody chain of murders begins ...
cast: Janet Agren, Chris Avram, Gaetano Russo, Paola Senatore, Rosanna Schiaffino, Eva Czemerys

title: L'assassino nudo
synopsis: Controversial portrait of Muybridge.

title: L'assassino si chiama Pompeo
synopsis: Pompeo is a modest and shy employee, totally harmless. One evening a murder is committed of which only he seems to be the culprit and so Pompeo, even though he does not remember at all that he has committed anything, is convinced that he is.
cast: Riccardo Billi, Gino Bramieri, Ernesto Calindri, Mario De Simone, Valeria Fabrizi, Lucio Flauto, Ennio Girolami, Nuto Navarrini, Ave Ninchi, Gina Rovere

title: L'assassino è ancora tra noi
synopsis: A mysterious and elusive serial killer tortures and kills couples who imprudently exchange affection while in the car. Cristiana, a girl with a passion for criminology, is doing a thesis on this subject with her teacher. On the occasion of the umpteenth crime, the woman meets Alex, a doctor who at the Institute of Forensic Medicine is in charge of carrying out the autopsies. Despite being dissuaded by the police and by Alex himself, Cristiana begins to investigate.
cast: Mariangela D'Abbraccio, Giovanni Visentin, Riccardo Perrotti

title: L'assassino è costretto ad uccidere ancora
synopsis: An architect buried in debt sucks money from his rich wife, who is also cheating. When the woman refuses him yet another loan, the man decides to have her killed by a hitman. However, although he is expert and precise, he does not know that he is facing a very annoying unexpected event, which will force him to sow more corpses.
cast: George Hilton, Antoine Saint John, Femi Benussi, Cristina Galbó, Eduardo Fajardo, Tere Velázquez, Alessio Orano, Dario Griachi, Luigi Antonio Guerra, Carla Mancini

title: L'assassino è quello con le scarpe gialle
synopsis: Roberto decides to stage "Hamlet" in a theater where as a child he had seen a murder committed. He has almost completely removed the particular event, he remembers only one detail: the murderer was wearing strange canary yellow shoes. Except that at some point the killer of that time comes back to show up.
cast: Pino Insegno, Roberto Ciufoli, Francesca Draghetti, Tiziana Foschi

title: L'assassino... è al telefono
cast: Telly Savalas, Anne Heywood, Rossella Falk, Osvaldo Ruggieri

title: L'assaut
synopsis: On December 26, 1994, a group of four Islamic GIA terrorists attacked an Airbus leaving for Paris at the Algiers airport. 227 passengers are taken hostage and no one knows what the terrorists' real intentions are. After a series of negotiations with the authorities, which require the release of the armed brothers, the terrorists decide that the plane can leave with them on board and then stop in Marseille, where the French government is preparing in front of the television cameras. an assault by the special forces on the decision of the Ministry of the Interior.
cast: Vincent Elbaz, Grégori Dérangère, Mélanie Bernier, Philippe Bas, Aymen Saïdi, Marie Guillard, Antoine Basler, Fatima Adoum, Hugo Becker, Hugues Martel

title: L'assedio
synopsis: An ancient mansion in the heart of Rome, an island where two lonelinesses have been shipwrecked: he is English, white and a little crazy, while she is African, black and full of problems. Mr. Kinky, barricaded behind his piano, spends his time attending Bach, Mozart and Grieg. Shandurai comes from afar and has found in Mr. Kinky's house a suitable accommodation for her refugee status: she cleans the house in exchange for a room, while studying medicine at the university. Their lives are intertwined in a game of attractions, waste and secrets.
cast: David Thewlis, Thandie Newton, Claudio Santamaria, John C. Ojwang

title: L'assedio dell'Alcazar
synopsis: During the Spanish Civil War, a Francoist garrison took refuge in the Alcazar, a military academy. The siege by the republican forces lasts a couple of months and ends only with the arrival of Franco's nationalists. Regardless of the indefensible political structure, it is a narratively not simple film, which arouses particular interest in the curious mixture of different genres (the war film declined in bourgeois drama). He won the Mussolini Cup at the Venice Film Festival.
cast: Fosco Giachetti, Rafael Calvo, Mireille Balin, Maria Denis, Carlos Muñoz, Aldo Fiorelli, Andrea Checchi, Carlo Tamberlani, Silvio Bagolini

title: L'assedio di Siracusa
synopsis: Love, forced abandonment, ignored children, marriages of convenience, accidental deaths, travels: and so on and so forth. All to finally arrive at the siege of Syracuse, an ally of Carthage, by the Romans led by the consul Marcellus, rival (also in love) of the Syracusan scientist Archimedes.
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Tina Louise, Sylva Koscina, Enrico Maria Salerno

title: L'assistente sociale tutto pepe
synopsis: A particularly attractive social worker (Nadia Cassini) is sent to a disreputable neighborhood of a Roman village. Incredibly he will be able to put things right and find love too.
cast: Nadia Cassini, Renzo Montagnani, Irene Papas, Yorgo Voyagis, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Nino Terzo, Gigi Ballista, Giovanni Vannini, Elvira Cortese

title: L'assoluto naturale
synopsis: The natural absolute tells the chronicle of an impossible love story between a young photographer and a middle -aged woman from the Italian bourgeoisie. Taken from the novel of the same name by Goffredo Parise of 1967, it develops mainly in modernist interior abstracts and on sports machines launched on roads that seem not to take anywhere.
cast: Laurence Harvey, Sylva Koscina, Isa Miranda, Amalia Carrara

title: L'atelier
synopsis: La Ciotat, South of France, summer. Antoine has agreed to participate in a writing workshop where few young people have to write a thriller with the help of Olivia, a famous writer who acts as a coach. The writing process will recall the industrial past of the city, a form of nostalgia that Antoine is not particularly interested in. His interest focuses more on the fears of the modern world and this leads him to soon clash with the rest of the group and with Olivia, both alarmed and fascinated by Antoine's violence.
cast: Marina Foïs, Matthieu Lucci, Warda Rammach, Issam Talbi, Florian Beaujean, Mamadou Doumbia, Julien Souve

title: L'attentat
synopsis: Amin Jaafari is an Israeli-Palestinian surgeon, now fully integrated in the city of Tel Aviv and happily married to Sihem. He has a glittering career ahead of him when a suicide bombing in a city restaurant kills 19 people and the police inform him that his wife is responsible. At first incredulous, Amin rejects any accusation but the discovery of a letter written by Sihem before his death leaves no room for doubt. Destroyed by the revelation, he leaves Tel Aviv and, in search of answers to his thousand questions, he enters the Palestinian territories, where he immediately realizes that he is not welcome.
cast: Ali Suliman, Evgenia Dodena, Reymond Amsalem, Uri Gavriel, Dvir Benedek, Ruba Salameh, Karim Saleh, Ramzi Makdessi, Vladimir Friedman, Ezra Dagan

title: L'attentat
synopsis: Arab Sadiel, leader of the opposition in his country, is confined to Geneva, but is burning to return to his homeland. The opportunity presents itself to him when a journalist friend of his, François Darien, invites him to Paris for a television broadcast on the Third World. In fact, in the French capital, Sadiel plans to resume a series of contacts that should facilitate his return. In reality, however, he falls into the trap that Darien, blackmailed by the Gaullist secret service agents, helped set him.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Michel Piccoli, Jean Seberg, Gian Maria Volonté, Michel Bouquet, Bruno Cremer, Daniel Ivernel, Philippe Noiret, François Périer, Roy Scheider

title: L'attentatuni
synopsis: Two officials (Anna Granata and Angelo Branca) and six agents (Orso, Sarno, Riccio, Lotto, Chiesa and Noce): these are the names of the members of the team that the commissioner Cardine, director of the newly established Dia, formed to penetrate the the heart of organized crime and bringing to justice the principals and perpetrators of the Capaci massacre of 23 May 1992, in which Judge Falcone with his wife and three members of the escort had lost his life. From now on, the six men will dedicate themselves exclusively, 24 hours a day, to their mission: and the results - despite a new blow: the attack on Borsellino - will not be long in coming ...
cast: Veronica Pivetti, Massimo Popolizio, Tony Sperandeo, Claudio Amendola

title: L'attenzione
synopsis: On the plane that brings him back to Rome, a well -known journalist lets himself go to unbridled and a little melodramatic romance -erotic fantasies about his wife (with whom he is in crisis) and on her young daughter. Deadly and unwatchable transposition from Moravia which undeservedly overwhelms the two Sandrelli.
cast: Ben Cross, Stefania Sandrelli, Amanda Sandrelli, Arnoldo Foà

title: L'attesa
synopsis: Among the large rooms of an old Sicilian villa marked by time, Anna spends her days in solitude. Only the footsteps of the handyman Pietro break the silence when all of a sudden Jeanne, a young woman who claims to be the girlfriend of Giuseppe, Anna's son, appears. It was Giuseppe himself who invited her to Sicily to spend a few days together, but neither of the two women knows of the other's existence. Furthermore, Giuseppe is not present. Nobody knows where he went, even his things are all in his room and one thinks that maybe very soon he will be back. But the days pass, the two women slowly get to know each other and the whole town prepares the traditional Easter procession.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Lou De Laâge, Giorgio Colangeli, Antonio Folletto, Domenico Diele, Corinna Lo Castro, Giovanni Anzaldo

title: L'attico
synopsis: Daniela leaves the province to spend a day in Rome. It so happens that the girl misses the return bus and is thus forced to spend the night in an attic under construction. From that moment on, he will stay in the capital and meet various men, all disappointing, except the last one, the owner of the penthouse.
cast: Daniela Rocca, Tomas Milian, Walter Chiari, Philippe Leroy, Lilla Brignone, Mary Arden, Gino Pernice, Jean Jacques Delbo

title: L'attrazione
synopsis: Nadine, fashion photographer, accepts the singular chess challenge that the rich Victor Schneider proposed her. The stake is herself. Guerin aside, it is pure nonsense.
cast: Florence Guérin, Marino Masé, Martine Brochard

title: L'auberge espagnole
synopsis: Thanks to the Erasmus project, the young Frenchman Xavier moved to Barcelona to continue his economics studies. Here she shares an apartment with an Italian, an Englishwoman, an Andalusian, a German and a Belgian: at first she struggles not a little to integrate and feels a strong desire to go home, but over time she will get to know her roommates and the different cultures to which they belong. It will be an opportunity to question certainties and to embrace precariousness as a rule of life ...
cast: Romain Duris, Judith Godrèche, Audrey Tautou, Cécile De France

title: L'auberge rouge
synopsis: Pierre and Marie Martin run a small hotel in the high mountains. To "supplement" their meager income they get into the habit of killing and robbing their guests and thus making the corpses disappear. When a busker arrives, the usual crime occurs, but the arrival of a carriage prevents the two from disposing of the body. When a friar Marie arrives, he repents and confesses to the religious all his misdeeds ... Intelligent black comedy written by Aurenche and Bost and inspired by a tale by Balzac.
cast: Fernandel, Françoise Rosay, Marie Claire Olivia, Caussimon

title: L'automobile
synopsis: Now close to old age, a former prostitute left alone decides to buy a car, confident that this can make her independent and help her change her social status.
cast: Anna Magnani, Vittorio Caprioli, Christian Hay, Donato Castellaneta, Pupo De Luca

title: L'autre
synopsis: Hanane is a young woman of humble origins who tries to make her way in journalism. When he meets Adam, scion of the ruling and corrupt class, he is love at first sight: the two soon get married, but his mother - who has an exclusive affection for her son - immediately considers Hanane as a rival and tries to get rid of her. going so far as to ally with Fatih, the girl's terrorist brother ...
cast: Nabila Ebeid, Mahmoud Hemida, Hanan Tork, Hani Salama

title: L'avaro
synopsis: Arpagone, a rich Roman usurer, even creditor of the Pope, has a problem: Cardinal Spinosi wants to marry him his sister Isabella, well known for having already killed her previous husbands. Terrified, Arpagone declares that he has already committed himself to a young woman, so he sets out to look for a wife. His choice falls on Mariana, not knowing that she is engaged to her son Cleante. That Molière turned in the grave for this reduction of one of his most famous works is a secondary fact. That the spectators do not roll over in their chairs for the great laugh, but only for the great sleep is instead a serious problem. Indeed a deadly problem.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Laura Antonelli, Miguel Bosé, Lucia Bosé, Christopher Lee, Anna Kanakis

title: L'avenir
synopsis: Nathalie and Heinz, both philosophy teachers, have been married for a long time and have two adult children. Also a publisher, Nathalie dedicates her free time to her collection, to former students who have become friends and especially to her mother, a very possessive woman. One day, Heinz tells his wife that he has fallen in love with another, with whom he has decided to move in. For Nathalie it will be just the beginning of a new life that coincides with the first days of a long summer.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Edith Scob, Roman Kolinka, André Marcon, Marion Ploquin, Sarah Le Picard, Solal Forte

title: L'aventure c'est l'aventure
synopsis: Three French thugs and two Italians are looking for new ways to make a living from crime. The kidnapping of famous people seems to give good results: the singer Johnny Halliday, a Swiss ambassador, a South American general. Falling into the hands of justice, the five, elected as a symbol of the protest, are released by popular acclaim. Having fled to Africa, they will dedicate themselves to their most ambitious undertaking: kidnap the Pope.
cast: Lino Ventura, Jacques Brel, Charles Denner, Johnny Hallyday, Charles Gérard, Aldo Maccione, Nicole Courcel, Yves Robert, André Falcon

title: L'aveu
synopsis: A Czechoslovakian Communist is imprisoned and tortured at the time of Stalin's purges. A true story, very touching, but a bit boring.
cast: Yves Montand, Simone Signoret, Gabriele Ferzetti, Michel Vitold, Jean Bouise, Laszlo Szabo, Monique Chaumette, Guy Mairesse

title: L'avventura di un italiano in Cina
synopsis: Arriving in Beijing from Venice after an endless series of vicissitudes, Marco Polo falls out of favor with the sovereign's minister and is imprisoned. However, he will manage to escape and, once free, will join the ranks of the rebels ...
cast: Rory Calhoun, Yoko Tani, Robert Hundar, Camillo Pilotto, Pierre Cressoy

title: L'avventuriera del piano di sopra
synopsis: The lawyer Fabrizio Marchini has a jealous wife and an evening of freedom. Just that evening the tenant upstairs who had a fight with her husband happened to him. Fabrizio offers her the bed and goes to sleep on the sofa. The next morning the woman disappeared and with her a precious necklace. Cheerful Matarazzo, they laugh and have a happy ending with a great cast.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Clara Calamai, Giuditta Rissone, Carlo Campanini, Olga Vittoria Gentilli, Camillo Pilotto, Ernesto Almirante

title: L'avventuriero
synopsis: An old corsair in search of redemption takes refuge with two castellane, aunt and nephew. The young woman is afflicted by psychic disturbances, following a remote trauma, which the old buccaneer manages to heal. A young officer also arrives at the castle who asks the pirate for help on a difficult mission during which the old man finds a glorious death.
cast: Anthony Quinn, Rosanna Schiaffino, Rita Hayworth, Ivo Garrani, Mino Doro, Franco Fantasia, Richard Johnson, Luciano Rossi, Anthony Dawson

title: L'avventuriero della Tortuga
synopsis: Handsome privateer Pedro Valverde has discovered a less risky way than boarding to get the money home. He passes himself off as a Spanish noble, gets engaged to the richest girls in the Caribbean and, at the moment of the wedding, flies away with the dowry. However, he ends up falling in love with Princess Soledad, a beautiful Spanish girl who has arrived in Santa Cruz to take possession of a fabulous inheritance. Unfortunately for Soledad, Alfonso di Montelimar, governor of the island, has also set his sights on Soledad.
cast: Guy Madison, Ingeborg Schöner, Rik Battaglia, Nadia Gray, Andrea Aureli, Aldo Bufi Landi, Mino Doro, Linda Sini, Giulio Marchetti, Giulio Battiferri

title: L'avvertimento
synopsis: Commissioner Barresi discovers that an anonymous person has paid a hundred million into his account. No explanation, just a phone call: behave yourself in the course of an investigation to come. And the investigation actually arrives: one of his superiors was killed just as he was about to question a decisive witness. Barresi receives the assignment and immediately understands that it is a complex intertwining of drug trafficking and high finance ...
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Martin Balsam, Laura Trotter, Giancarlo Zanetti

title: L'avvocato De Gregorio
synopsis: The lawyer De Gregorio, elderly and unkempt, lives on the top floor of a dilapidated condominium in the Spaccanapoli district. On the walls of his only room there are only three yellowed photos that depict him as a young man, then in a lawyer's gown and then together with his wife. Next to the photos is a newspaper clipping accusing him of fraud. In fact, thirty years earlier De Gregorio had swindled a client to treat his sick son. Now try to get back on top ...
cast: Giorgio Albertazzi, Ciro Capano, Gabriele Ferzetti, Anna Tognetti

title: L'avvocato Guerrieri - Ad occhi chiusi
synopsis: The lawyer Guerrieri is contacted by the young and mysterious Sister Claudia to become a civil party in the trial filed by Martina Fumai against her ex-boyfriend, accused of continuing to persecute her. Since no other lawyer of the forum has accepted the assignment due to the identity of the boy, the son of a renowned judge, Guerrieri accepts the case but as the days go by he comes into possession of information that re-discusses the whole accusatory system.
cast: Emilio Solfrizzi, Chiara Muti, Margot Sikabonyi, Stefano Dionisi, Bianca Maria D'Amato, Flavio Bucci, Giovanni Esposito, Giovanni Moschella, Alex Van Damme, Roberto Nobile, Maria Pia Calzone

title: L'avvocato della mala
synopsis: The young lawyer Mario Gastali (Ray LoveLock) is hired by Pesti (Mel Ferrer), a powerful businessman, so that he acts as an intermediary in a sale of stolen paintings.
cast: Ray Lovelock, Mel Ferrer, Lilli Carati, John Steiner, Gabriele Tinti, Umberto Orsini, Orazio Orlando, Rosario Borelli, Romano Puppo, Gino Pagnani, Salvatore Puntillo, Dante Cleri, Alfredo Adami, Pino Salviani, Bruno Di Luia, Carmelo Reale, Gilberto Galimberti

title: L'aîné de Fercheaux
synopsis: A late-career boxer, Mandet, and a financier, Ferchaux, with unfinished business with bankruptcy justice, leave France together to try to rebuild a life in the United States. The difficult friendship between two desperate people will not stand up to the final test.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Charles Vanel, Michèle Mercier, Stefania Sandrelli

title: L'eau froide
synopsis: Both Christine's parents and Gilles' parents are divorced and the two boys cannot accept the rules of a society that, in practice, abandons them to their own painful, dramatic insecurities. Christine ends up in an institution, then escapes and joins Gilles. Together they leave for the South, spend a night together, but, in the morning, Gilles finds next to him only a blank page of notebook. Olivier Assayas, probably the most prominent personality of the young French cinema, tells his protagonists with participatory accuracy, with profound sensitivity (obtaining an admirable acting) and with great elegance of images.
cast: Virginie Ledoyen, Cyprien Fouquet, Laszlo Szabo, Jean Pierre Darroussin

title: L'ebreo errante
synopsis: Matthew, a wealthy selfish and nationalist Jew, refuses to help Jesus Christ because he holds him responsible for the failure to revolutionize the Roman yoke. For this he is therefore condemned to wander perpetually over the centuries and is denied any kind of rest, including that of the tomb. His sacrifice in the Nazi extermination camps will absolve him of the sin committed in antiquity.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Valentina Cortese, Harry Feist, Noelle Norman
