title: L'eclisse
synopsis: After a disappointment in love, Vittoria meets Piero, a cynical and easygoing stock broker. The two become lovers right after a stock market crash in which Vittoria's mother lost a lot of money in favor of Piero. This casts a shadow over their relationship which falls apart.
cast: Monica Vitti, Alain Delon, Francisco Rabal, Lilla Brignone, Louis Seigner, Rossana Rory, Mirella Ricciardi

title: L'edera
synopsis: The servant Annesa kills old Decherchi, who is also ill, in order to save the man she loves from economic ruin. But then he repents. A novel by Deledda in a telenovela version, shot with a distant and vaguely glossy style, in which the protesting force of the book is lost.
cast: Columba Dominguez, Roldano Lupi, Juan De Landa, Franca Marzi

title: L'educazione sentimentale di Eugenie
synopsis: The Duke of Missival entrusts Madame de Saint-Ange the sentimental education of his daughter Eugénie. Madame tries attraction for the girl, but is also interested in the marquis of Dolmancé. To achieve both its objectives, then the Marquis of Eugénie's cultural formation ...
cast: Sara Sartini, Antonella Salvucci, Valerio Tambone, Cristian Tambone, Cristian Stelluti

title: L'effet aquatique
synopsis: Samir, a lanky 40-year-old crane operator from Montreuil, falls in love with the spicy Agathe, whom he meets one evening in a bar. When he discovers that he has an expert swimming teacher from the municipal swimming pool in front of him, he decides to sign up for her courses to be close to her and get to know her better. When Samir's passion comes to the surface, Agathe tells him that she has to go on an official mission to Iceland and that she can't be with him. In desperation, Samir has no choice but to chase her.
cast: Florence Loiret Caille, Samir Guesmi, Didda Jónsdóttir, Philippe Rebbot, Esteban, Olivia Coté, Frosti Runólfsson, Johanna Nizard, Ingvar Eggert Sigurðsson, Stéphane Soo Mongo, Jóhannes Haukur Jóhannesson

title: L'effrontée
synopsis: The fourteen-year-old Charlotte Castang clashes with the reality that surrounds her (including a family that is certainly not ideal) after meeting with her peer Clara Bauman, a pianist for whom she has great admiration, and with little Lulu, who instead demonstrates in towards him a similar devotion ...
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Clothilde Baudon, Bernadette Lafont, Julie Glenn, Jean Claude Brialy

title: L'elisir d'amore
synopsis: Nemorino, a young farmer, fails to win over the rich and beautiful Adina. Thanks to a love potion from the charlatan Doctor Dulcamara, and a conspicuous inheritance, the lover finally obtains the longed-for object of his desires. Successful film translation of Gaetano Donizetti's masterpiece. Mario Bava directs photography.
cast: Nelly Corradi, Gino Sinimberghi, Tito Gobbi, Silvana Mangano, Gina Lollobrigida

title: L'emigrante
synopsis: Peppino Cavallo leaves from Naples and embarks for the United States, in search of his father who has been missing for years. Robbed by false friends, he becomes the bodyguard of a mafia boss, until he discovers that it was this man who killed his father. He gives up revenge, but runs into other adventures, until he returns to Italy, accompanied by a beautiful singer.
cast: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Lino Toffolo, Sybil Danning, José Calvo, Herbert Fux, Omero Capanna, Gigi Reder, Rosita Pisano, Giacomo Rizzo, Nino Vingelli

title: L'emmerdeur
synopsis: Two hotel rooms are connected by a connecting door. The first room houses Ralph Milano, a dangerous killer who must meet the man he is called to eliminate. In the second, however, François Pignon, an aspiring suicide after a disappointment in love, settled down. When François's suicide attempt goes decidedly wrong, Jean decides to come to his rescue. From that moment François will turn into his thorn in his side, making him almost lose sight of the reason for which he is in the hotel.
cast: Richard Berry, Patrick Timsit, Pascal Elbé, Virginie Ledoyen, Laurent Paolini, Michel Aumont, Cédric Chevalme, Laurie Lefret, José Paul, Stéphane Bierry

title: L'emmerdeur
synopsis: A killer is stationed in a hotel in Montpellier, in front of the court: he must eliminate a dangerous witness, but has the misfortune of finding himself as a neighbor a representative afflicted by marital troubles and with suicidal manias. Brilliant both in the detective genre and in the comedy, Molinaro intertwines them in a paradoxical, funny and excellently interpreted story by Lino Ventura and the singer-actor Jacques Brel. An American version of the film was made in 1982, (Buddy Buddy) by Billy Wilder, with Matthau and Lemmon.
cast: Lino Ventura, Jacques Brel, Caroline Cellier, Nino Castelnuovo

title: L'empereur
synopsis: A young penguin is about to embark on its first voyage. He is about to leave to follow the mysterious call that forces each one of his kind, upon the arrival of winter, to move towards an unknown destination. Doubts, uncertainties, fears and challenges will accompany his every step towards survival.

title: L'empire de la perfection
synopsis: Tennis player John McEnroe is at the peak of his career as a world champion. The images show his commitment to perfection but also the frustrations of a basically lonely man and the pain of the biggest defeat of his career at Roland Garros in 1984.
cast: John McEnroe

title: L'empire des Loups
synopsis: In the 10th Arrondissement, Captain Paul Nerteaux investigates the brutal murder of three women of Turkish origin. To carry out the investigation he must be able to infiltrate Turkish immigrants and the only person who can help him is Jean-Louis Schiffer, a retired colleague who has a reputation for being corrupt.
cast: Jean Reno, Arly Jover, Jocelyn Quivrin, Laura Morante, Philippe Bas, Didier Sauvegrain

title: L'emploi du temps
synopsis: What do you do in life? "The manager" would answer Vincent, father of a family, wealthy, good person. Yet he lies, because he has been fired for more than three months and now he has to justify his long absences from home. Another job, an international assignment to the UN, but it's all a lie. That sooner or later someone finds out.
cast: Aurélien Recoing, Karin Viard, Serge Livrozet, Nicolas Kalsch

title: L'emprise
synopsis: Alexandra, a mother of four, was arrested in March 2012 on suspicion of killing her children's father with a knife. During the three days of the trial, the details of the woman's everyday life emerge, a mother that society has never protected from the monster she loved.
cast: Odile Vuillemin, Fred Testot, Marc Lavoine, Sam Karmann, Lolita Chammah, Micky Sébastian, Raphaëlle Lubansu, Laura Sepul, Erico Salamone, Fabienne Mainguet

title: L'enfance nue
cast: Raoul Billerey, Maurice Coussonneau, Pierrette Deplanque, Linda Gutemberg

title: L'enfant
synopsis: Twenty-year-old Bruno and eighteen-year-old Sonia live thanks to her subsidy and the thefts committed by the boy and his gang. But when Sonia gives birth to Jimmy, Bruno - who until then had only cared about himself - must learn to be a father ...
cast: Jérémie Rénier, Déborah François, Jérémie Segard, Fabrizio Rongione

title: L'enfant d'en haut
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Simon (Kacey Mottet Klein) lives next to a luxurious ski resort near the Swiss mountains, in a location frequented by wealthy and high-ranking people. To meet the needs dictated by the state of poverty in which he lives, Simon makes do by stealing the equipment of tourists and then reselling them for a few pennies, useful to him and his sister Louise (Léa Seydoux). By pretending to be the son of wealthy parents, Simon manages to win the trust of tourists and, in particular, of an English family who lets themselves be won over by his kind ways. After being out of work, Louise begins to depend more and more on her brother's money, who swaps it for little attention and affection.
cast: Léa Seydoux, Kacey Mottet Klein, Gillian Anderson, Martin Compston, Johan Libéreau, Jean François Stévenin, Yann Trégouët, Magne Håvard Brekke

title: L'enfant de nuit
cast: Jean Claude Bouillon, Stefano Satta Flores, Agostina Belli, Antonio Cantafora

title: L'enfant sauvage
synopsis: In 1798 some French peasants captured an 11-year-old boy in the woods. He grew up in solitude and left to himself. A Parisian doctor who takes care of deaf and dumb children is interested in his animalistic state. Despite the prejudices that surround him, it will be he who will awaken the spark of intelligence in the boy.
cast: Jean Pierre Cargol, Françoise Seigner, François Truffaut

title: L'enfer
synopsis: Three sisters, Sophie, Céline and Anne, had their childhood marked by a family tragedy. Now adults, each lives her own life until the appearance of a man gives each of them the opportunity to reconnect with the other and to accept their own difficult past.
cast: Emmanuelle Béart, Karin Viard, Marie Gillain, Guillaume Canet, Carole Bouquet, Jacques Perrin, Jean Rochefort

title: L'enfer d'Henri-Georges Clouzot
synopsis: The attempt of the great French director Henri-Georges Clouzot, in the early 60s, to complete a project cherished for many years: _Inferno_, a study on jealousy starring Romy Schneider and Serge Reggiani. The American production partner, Columbia, guaranteed the author an unlimited budget. Clouzot engaged in a difficult process of technical experimentation, with the intention of creating an innovative cinematographic language based on the visual and sound art in vogue at the time. But with the start of filming, the first insurmountable problems also arose.
cast: Romy Schneider, Bérénice Bejo, Serge Reggiani, Jacques Gamblin, Dany Carrel, Jean Claude Bercq, Mario David, André Luguet, Maurice Garrel, Catherine Allégret

title: L'ennemi intime
synopsis: Algeria, 1959. As the conflict between the French army and the rebels of the Front de Libération Nationale intensifies, Lieutenant Terrien is assigned to command a section of the army to fight in the hot zone of the mountains of Kabylia. There he meets Sergeant Dougnac, a veteran of the Indochina War. Terrien, deeply idealist, is confronted with the harsh reality of a war propagated at home as an act of pacification, but carried out with ferocity amidst reprisals and torture.
cast: Benoît Magimel, Albert Dupontel, Aurélien Recoing, Marc Barbé, Eric Savin, Mohamed Fellag, Lounès Tazairt, Abdelhafid Metalsi, Vincent Rottiers, Lounès Machene

title: L'ennemi public no 1
synopsis: Joe Calvet is a quiet man with thick glasses, but, due to an unfortunate raincoat, he is mistaken for a gangster. But he will know how to adapt and, like a real tough guy, he will evade the gang not only by conquering blonde Lola, but even convincing her to a life as an ordinary chicken farmer.
cast: Fernandel, Zsa Zsa Gabor, Louis Seigner, David Opatoshu, Alfred Adam

title: L'ennui
synopsis: Martin is a professor in the throes of depression after breaking up with his wife. His crisis takes a new turn when he meets Cécilia, a girl who is said to have caused the death of a painter and with whom Martin begins to develop a morbid relationship made only of sex.
cast: Charles Berling, Sophie Guillemin, Arielle Dombasle, Robert Kramer

title: L'equilibrio
synopsis: Giuseppe, a Campanian priest who was already a missionary in Africa, works in a small diocese in Rome. In crisis in his Faith, he asks the Bishop to be transferred to a town in his land, and so he is moved to a small village in the Neapolitan area. Giuseppe will take the place of the parish priest of the neighborhood, Don Antonio, a man of great charisma and magnificent eloquence, listened to and respected by all because he fights a battle against the illegitimate burial of toxic waste. Don Antonio for acquired merits is about to be transferred to Rome. Before leaving Don Antonio introduces Giuseppe into the harsh reality of the neighborhood. Once left alone, the priest gets busy trying to help the community in all ways, until he discovers the real uncomfortable reality of that place. Giuseppe decides to follow his spiritual path without fear but despite his great tenacity and courage, he will collide with a very hard reality that will put him in the corner.
cast: Mimmo Borrelli, Roberto Del Gaudio, Astrid Meloni, Paolo Sassanelli, Francesca Zazzera, Giuseppe D'Ambrosio, Lucio Giannetti, Vincenza Modica, Autilia Ranieri

title: L'era legale
synopsis: Naples, 2020. Starting from the bottom of the Spanish Quarters, Nicolino Amore manages to get himself elected mayor of Naples and, like almost all of his predecessors, thinks only of his own economic well-being until a sudden crisis opens his eyes, leading him to take an interest the well-being of the city and its inhabitants, who have always been at the mercy of the Camorra. To beat the underworld, he has a brilliant idea: legalize drugs and treat addicts as sick. In this way, it reduces the revenues of the Camorra, which has its back to the world, and in a short time Naples becomes one of the most efficient cities in the world.
cast: Patrizio Rispo, Cristina Donadio, Pietro De Silva, Franco Gargia, Rita Corrado, Natalia Cretella, Renzo Arbore, Isabella Rossellini, Bill Emmott, Pietro Grasso, Marcelle Padovani, Giancarlo De Cataldo, Carlo Lucarelli, Tano Grasso, Vincenzo Macrì

title: L'erba proibita
synopsis: In the subtitle, the numerous accomplices of this incredible editing work train (i) anus before shooting all the rods in the world: "Everything you ever wanted to know about hemp and they never told you". Well said. Why: did you know that in the States in the 1930s they were showing insane propaganda films against the use of marijuana? And that, after the end of the second conflict, the seven sisters of oil declared war on hemp used as an ecological fuel? And that Italy, until the 1950s, was the second country in the world in the cultivation of the same? And that, again with hemp, ropes, nets, paper and various oils are obtained? These and other answers are delightfully reported in the fun, very upbeat, punctual, political and scientifically "tested" docufilm.

title: L'erede
synopsis: Bruno, a radiologist from Milan, on the death of his father discovers that he is the only heir to an estate, immersed in the green of the Apennines, of which he was not aware. Intrigued, the man goes to the place to check the conditions and take possession of it but immediately runs into Paola, a suspicious neighbor. The woman lives with her two children Giovanni and Angela, the only witnesses of a mysterious past that will involve the doctor in an unexpected and violent way.
cast: Guia Jelo, Davide Lorino, Maria Sole Mansutti, Alessandro Roja, Tresy Taddei

title: L'eredità Ferramonti
synopsis: The beautiful and unscrupulous Irene married Pippo Ferramonti, son of the rich Gregorio. Greedy for money, Irene points to the old man's inheritance. Therefore she first becomes the lover of her brother-in-law, and then of Gregory himself, who names her his heir.
cast: Fabio Testi, Anthony Quinn, Dominique Sanda, Gigi Proietti

title: L'eredità dello zio buonanima
synopsis: Franco, a modest employee with a large family, lavished hypocritical attention on his wealthy uncle Calogero who, dying, left him heir universal. But the swag is immediately cleared of heavy debts. True, there would be millions more, but they are deposited in a bank that has gone bankrupt in the meantime. Rude and bungled farce, from a comedy by Russo Giusti. Franco Franchi protagonist without Ingrassia and without brakes, is surrounded by unknown and very bewildered actors.
cast: Franco Franchi, Grazia Di Marzà, Maria Bosco, Patrizia Gori

title: L'eredità dello zio buonanima
synopsis: Two families are fighting over an inheritance. The one who believes himself chosen by the deceased spends and spreads for a mind-boggling funeral, but the will hides a trap that gets him into trouble. However, a second will is found, which seems to put everything in order, except the bank where the money of the deceased is kept ...
cast: Angelo Musco, Elsa De Giorgi, Adolfo Geri, Zoe Incrocci, Enrico Marroni, Rosina Anselmi, Sandro Del Signore, Lulu Marinelli

title: L'eroe
synopsis: Giorgio is a mediocre but ambitious thirty-year-old journalist. His life changes abruptly when the editor of the newspaper decides to transfer him to a provincial editorial office. Just when he believes he has found his new dimension in life, the newspaper editor announces his dismissal to Giorgio. Only the shocking kidnapping of the nephew of the most important local entrepreneur at the hands of unknown persons will return Giorgio to his job as a correspondent.
cast: Salvatore Esposito, Cristina Donadio, Vincenzo Nemolato, Marta Gastini, Enrica Guidi, Fabio Ferrari, Paolo Sassanelli

title: L'eroe della strada
synopsis: Felice, unemployed, is accused of stealing a barrel organ. Saved by the testimony of Gaetano, a swindler who pretends to be a partisan, Felice falls in love with a cigarette seller whose husband is missing; he finds work, but the climate is difficult and he is fired. The strike causes his arrest. Released from jail, Gaetano procures him a barrel organ, but this only plays fascist hymns ...
cast: Erminio Macario, Delia Scala, Carlo Ninchi, Folco Lulli, Arnoldo Foà

title: L'eroe sono io
synopsis: Righetto is an ice cream seller and has a small stature complex. To impress Silvia, he pretends to be a photo novel actor.
cast: Renato Rascel, Delia Scala, Marisa Merlini, Geppa, Enzo Biliotti

title: L'esclave blanc
synopsis: During the French domination in Somalia, the classic triangle of jealousy between two men and a woman takes place. A situation that is repeated even among the black servants, in a conflict that will spread into the forest, during the satanic dance Mudundu ...
cast: Jeannette Ferney, Luisa Garella, Egisto Olivieri, George Rigaud

title: L'escluso
synopsis: Tony Grasso is a poor and marginalized boy, obsessed, all his life, by his impossible love for his schoolmate, Patricia Karver. The years pass, the little girl of the snack times grows up, gets married and has two children. When Patricia and her family are brutally murdered, Tony is charged with the murder. Lawyer Ralph Barolo will shoulder the burden of defense.
cast: Kevin Isola, Franco Nero, Vanessa Redgrave, Eli Wallach

title: L'esercito più pazzo del mondo
synopsis: The adventures of a group of newly enlisted soldiers take place in the barracks of an unspecified town. It begins with a clumsy flag-raising and an equally clumsy attempted kidnapping by a conscientious objector and a friend of his. The two ask to be able to escape to the Caribbean, but, once they have the necessary money, they will in turn be mocked.
cast: Felice Andreasi, Massimo Boldi, Andy Luotto, Giorgio Ariani, Leo Gullotta

title: L'esercito più piccolo del mondo
synopsis: The Swiss Guard at the time of Pope Francis. Leo and René are respectively a forester and a student of theology of the Aargau, who have decided to be part of the Pontifical body born in the time of Julius II. Leo is a simple boy, happy to have an educational experience in the Eternal City. René is a Catholic intellectual who wants to understand: what does wearing a 16th century dress mean in our days? Be part of a colorful but in many ways anachronistic military body, especially in relation to a "revolutionary" figure like that of the Holy Father who came from afar? The young soldier tries to find an answer for himself and his comrades in arms.

title: L'esigenza di unirmi ogni volta con te
synopsis: Giuliana's story begins on a morning like any other. Like every day, the woman goes to work in the supermarket where she works as a cashier but fate has a surprise in store for her: two thieves, with their faces covered, suddenly break into the shop and take her hostage, overturning her existence. . Falling in love with the policeman who saves her, she will create a daring escape with him following the precipitate of events.
cast: Marco Bocci, Claudia Gerini, Marc Duret, Antonio Iuorio, Luca Cirasola

title: L'esodo
synopsis: Italy 2012, Monti technical government. Francesca, a 59-year-old woman, is an exodus with no income with her granddaughter Mary, a teenager who despises the misery she suddenly falls into with her grandmother. Finding no solution to her serious economic condition, Francesca ends up begging in Piazza della Repubblica in Rome, with a sign in front of her identifying her. Passers-by are struck by the image of the woman who, despite the gesture she now performs daily, retains the appearance of a distinct person. In doing so, Francesca knows many people but things get complicated when her granddaughter surprises her while she begs in the square during a demonstration.
cast: Daniela Poggi, Rosaria De Cicco, David White, Kiara Tomaselli, Carlotta Bazzu, Christian Marazziti, Simone Destrero, Patrizia Olivieri, Cinzia Mirabella, Fabio Farronato, Veronica Rega, Ilir Jacellari, Emanuela Tittocchia

title: L'espoir
synopsis: In 1937, during the Spanish Civil War, the Republicans fought in Teruel against Franco's fascist army. Their means are poor, but the spirit that animates them is great ...
cast: Andres Mejuto, NicolÃ¡s RodrÃ­guez, José Sempere, Julio PeÃ±a

title: L'esquive
synopsis: Suburbs of Paris. Lydia was chosen to act in the end-of-year show and parades through the streets with the eighteenth-century costume repeating the text of Marivaux's _Game of chance and love_. When Krimo, the tough guy from the neighborhood, sees her, he falls madly in love with her. To woo her he accepts a part in the comedy ...
cast: Osman Elkharraz, Sara Forestier, Sabrina Ouazani, Nanou Benhamou

title: L'estate
synopsis: Sergio is an industrialist who lives separated from his wife and has been living for years with Adriana, Elisa's mother, a young woman little more than a teenager. The bond between Sergio and Adriana begins to show cracks even if it is Sergio who is intolerant, while the woman seems to be more willing to send the relationship. During the summer holidays, Elisa returns home from the Swiss boarding school she attends and goes on a cruise to Sardinia with her parents. Due to the strong disagreements between Sergio and his mother, Elisa seduces Sergio and becomes his lover.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Nadja Tiller, Carlo Hintermann, Mita Cattaneo, Mita Medici, Gordon Mitchell

title: L'estate addosso
synopsis: Marco is 18 years old and is about to graduate from high school but in the face of life's fatal choices he is terribly distressed by absolute uncertainty about his future. The summer of maturity suffers a sudden twist when, following an accident with the scooter, Marco receives compensation from the insurance that will allow him to leave for San Francisco. To his great disappointment, however, even Maria, a schoolmate nicknamed "the Nun" by everyone, will leave for her own destination, a guest of the same couple of friends contacted by her classmate Vulcano. Two guys, Matt and Paul, are waiting for them at the San Francisco airport. What Vulcan did not say is that Matt and Paul live together and are a gay couple. Irritation and prejudice manifest themselves immediately and Marco distances himself even further from Maria. Despite the premises, in the following days the four friends will begin to know each other, laying the foundations to build an unexpected and surprising friendship and the days will begin to pass fast and new for all of them.
cast: Brando Pacitto, Matilda Anna Ingrid Lutz, Taylor Frey, Joseph Haro, Guglielmo Poggi, Jessica Rothe, Scott Bakula, Ludovico Tersigni

title: L'estate d'inverno
synopsis: In an anonymous Danish motel, the solitude of two people takes place. Two Italians, a man and a woman, he a boy from a good family, she a prostitute by choice. Both are on the run from something (or someone) because they themselves have been abandoned.
cast: Pia Lanciotti, Fausto Cabra

title: L'estate del mio primo bacio
synopsis: Like every year, 14-year-old Camilla spends her summer holidays on the Argentario with her family. In addition to finding her old friends, this time she meets Adelmo, a handsome and gloomy 17-year-old, who takes care of the maintenance of the swimming pool ...
cast: Laura Morante, Neri Marcoré, Regina Orioli, Raffaella Lebboroni, Andrea Renzi, Gabriella Bellisario, Jacopo Petrini

title: L'estate di Bobby Charlton
synopsis: A young elementary teacher who is preparing the exam for the state competition "kidnaps" his two children, taking them from a villa in the Po valley where the children have lived with their mother since the couple separated. Unable to be without them, he loads the two little ones on a Beetle and heads to his grandmother's house in Salento. Much (too much) of young Italian cinema is characterized by an often unbearable "cuteness". This is not the case with Guglielmi's film, intense and tormented. As for the title, for those who find it incomprehensible, contact the so-called "experts" of football.
cast: Giulio Scarpati, Agnese Nano, Carlotta Natoli, Enrico Guglielmi, Francesco Saverio Guglielmi

title: L'estate di Davide
synopsis: Davide is an eighteen year old like many others who lives in his brother's house in Turin and who, to scrape together a few lira, goes to wash the cars in a large car wash every Saturday. Behind him he has a disastrous family, a hardly reached maturity, a certain introversion and in front of him the decision to spend the holidays with his uncles in the Polesine. Here Davide lives his initiation rites to life; he knows love and his pains with a local girl and makes a close friendship with a young Bosnian who supports himself by being a bartender and selling drugs. The two rip off the girl's rich lover of a huge amount of drugs that they hope to resell in Puglia, but things never work as they should and Davide will find himself in front of his usual life, but now he is ready to face it.
cast: Stefano Campi, Patrizia Piccinini, Tony Bertorelli, Semsudin Mujic

title: L'estate di Giacomo
synopsis: On a hot summer afternoon in the north-eastern Italian countryside, Giacomo, a deaf 19 year old, after passing high school and waiting for the surgery that will change his life, takes his friend Stefania for a picnic on the banks of a river. The two, pushing themselves away from the road they know, end up getting lost. Thus they find themselves in a small paradise corner, where they can finally be free for their games, seasoned with innocent sensuality, until they realize that the adventure they have just experienced is only the memory of a time now gone and marks the beginning of the transition to adulthood.
cast: Giacomo Zulian, Stefania Comodin, Barbara Colombo, Stephane Lehembre

title: L'estate di Martino
synopsis: It is the tragic summer of 1980: the tragedy of Ustica on June 27 and the attack on the Bologna station on August 2 are the background to the love story of Martino (Luigi Ciardo) with the beautiful Silvia and that of friendship with the Captain Clark (Treat Williams), a military seconded to one of the American bases in the Mediterranean. A friendship from which each of the two will learn to face their ghosts. The story is intertwined with the fable of "Dragut", a prince who challenged the sea for love: Dragut will have to go beyond the rainbow, into the depths of the sea, and find a magical jar. If he succeeds, the world will no longer know the pain of violent deaths.
cast: Treat Williams, Simone Borrelli, Matilde Pezzotta, Matteo Pianezzi, Pietro Masotti, Luigi Ciardo

title: L'estate sta finendo
synopsis: To break the routine and try to relax before the start of the new year of lessons at the university, Domenico and Fabrizio organize with their group of student friends in their twenties a last weekend to spend in a villa by the sea. Domenico, however, is forced to bring along Guido, his loser cousin. The boyish and carefree atmosphere of the group of boys is broken by an accident that is needed by one of them. Forced to mature quickly and take on sudden responsibilities, friends will find themselves living an endless nightmare, jeopardizing even the unity of the group itself.
cast: Andrea Miglio Risi, Nathalie Rapti Gomez, Antonello Fassari, Nina Torresi, Fabio Ghidoni, Ilaria Giachi, Marco Rossetti, Giuseppe Tantillo, Stefano Fardelli, Lucia Mascino

title: L'estate sta finendo
synopsis: A fifteen-year-old weaves relationships between kids, sleeping bags, motorbike rides. His father, worried, is the pawn for Italy.
cast: Fiorenza Tessari, Leonardo Ferrantini, Angelo Infanti, Valeria Ciangottini

title: L'eterna catena
synopsis: Back in Naples after a long voyage, the naval officer Walter meets Maria, the fiancée of his brother Sandro, on whom, however, the shipowner Lanza has also set his sights. Charmed by the girl, Walter discovers that she reciprocates, but ...
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Gianna Maria Canale, Umberto Spadaro, Carlo Croccolo, Marco Vicario

title: L'etrange couleur des larmes de ton corps
synopsis: A woman suddenly disappears. To try to understand what happened to her, if she simply left him or if she died, her husband begins to investigate the dynamics of a disappearance that he considers somewhat mysterious. As he proceeds with his research, the man will find himself immersed in a nightmare and extremely violent world that revolves around an Art Nouveau building.
cast: Klaus Tange, Jean Michel Vovk, Sylvia Camarda, Sam Louwyck, Anna D'Annunzio

title: L'etrusco uccide ancora
synopsis: In Spoleto, during the Festival dei due Mondi, an archaeologist, friend of an orchestra conductor and especially of his wife, discovers in a tomb a fresco depicting a human sacrifice in honor of the ancient demon Tuchulca. Soon a chain of crimes, inspired by the sepulchral discovery and accompanied by Verdi's _Messa da Requiem_, involves the protagonists: Commissioner Giuranna will unravel the intricate skein.
cast: Alex Cord, Samantha Eggar, John Marley, Enzo Tarascio

title: L'età d'oro
synopsis: After decades of misunderstandings and quarrels with his mother Arabella (Laura Morante), due to a way of seeing and facing life that he could not accept as a child, Sid is called to return to his roots. From Savoyard Turin he is forced to move to the cheerful and naive Apulian community where Arabella is located. The real journey into the life and memories of his mother (and of the friends who colored the days of his childhood) will make him understand that a mother's love can have a thousand shades and that Arabella herself was one, ten , a hundred different women, all generous, all valiant. She was the director, the femme fatale, the friend, the founder of the cinema arena and its festivals, the soul of the village in which she has lived for years. Sid, however, knew and understood the true nature of that bewitching and brilliant figure too late. Yet Arabella will not behave trivially even in this case. Indeed, she will be the one to tease, scold and guide her son to the discovery of that much-fought and multifaceted figure.
cast: Laura Morante, Giulio Scarpati, Dil Gabriele Dell'Aiera, Eugenia Costantini, Pietro De Silva, Gigio Alberti, Giselda Volodi, Stefano Fresi, Elena Cotta, Adriano Aprà

title: L'età di Cosimo de' Medici
synopsis: There are three stages that Roberto Rossellini identifies as fundamental in the representation of an age full of cognitive anxieties and crossed by even contradictory thrusts. The first, which corresponds to the first episode of the long work made for Italian television, is entitled _L'exilio di Cosimo_. The second, _The power of Cosimo_, describes the coming to power of the Florentine nobleman Medici and the beginning of a new era, flourishing also from a cultural and artistic point of view. The third, _Leon Battista Alberti_, analyzes the role of the artist and intellectual against the historical background dominated by the figure of Cosimo.
cast: Marcello Di Falco, John Stacy, Mario Erpichini, Virginio Gazzolo

title: L'età imperfetta
synopsis: In a quiet city in Northern Italy, Camilla lives, a seventeen-year-old like many others and a bit special like many others. She has excellent grades at school, a conflictual relationship with her little sister Francesca and a dream that her mother (Eastern woman, pragmatic and hardworking) does not understand, but her father (more "maternal") does. Camilla wants to become a ballet dancer and the audition, which she has to hold shortly after to enter an important academy, is a great opportunity. In his life, however - overbearing as a summer wind - comes Sara, also an aspiring dancer. Sara has just turned eighteen, a wealthy father and an absent mother; she is charismatic and sensual. Between disturbing outbursts of affection, crises, direct decisions and twists, their relationship will take unpredictable paths, marking Camilla's life forever.
cast: Marina Occhionero, Paola Calliari, Anita Kravos, Anna Valle

title: L'ex de ma vie
synopsis: Ariane and Nino have never been a traditional couple. They did not marry in the white dress but in jeans and lived happily in an unconventional way. Nino teaches in a small elementary school near Rome while Ariane travels the world as a violinist until their differences begin to overwhelm love. Two years later, Ariane wants to marry and move to America with acclaimed conductor Christen but must first divorce Nino. While in Italy for a divorce it takes five years, in France it takes only eight days and this prompts Ariane to propose to Nino to get a divorce in France. Nino accepts on one condition: they will spend that week in Paris to experience that honeymoon they never had.
cast: Géraldine Nakache, Kim Rossi Stuart, Pascal Demolon, Catherine Jacob, Sophie Cattani

title: L'executrice
synopsis: A policewoman, following a thorough investigation, sends an affiliate of the Parisian mafia to prison. The son of the latter decides to take revenge and kidnaps the sister of the police officer, asking in exchange for the release of his mother. At this point the policewoman tries a coup but her sister dies. The policewoman's anger will lead to a massacre of the mafia clan.
cast: Brigitte Lahaie, Pierre Odry, Michel Modo

title: L'exercice de l'État
synopsis: Serving the state, dedicating your best years to it, putting aside your interests and affections to devote yourself only to carrying out your duties: more than a job it seems to be a mission, with a very high cost to bear. Bertrand Saint-Jean, minister of transport, is well aware of this when he is woken up in the middle of the night to resolve an emergency. A bus has crashed into a ravine and only he can coordinate relief efforts.
cast: Arly Jover, Zabou Breitman, Michel Blanc, Olivier Gourmet, François Vincentelli, Laurent Stocker, Abdelhafid Metalsi, Brice Fournier, Scali Delpeyrat, Stéphan Wojtowicz

title: L'extraordinaire Voyage du Fakir
synopsis: Aja, a poor but talented Indian fakir, leaves for Paris in search of his father. The events take him instead to an Ikea center, where he falls in love with Marie, a beautiful French-American with whom he befriends. His hopes for love are cut short, however, when he is accidentally locked up in a closet and sent on a trip to Europe.
cast: Dhanush, Bérénice Bejo, Barkhad Abdi, Abel Jafri, Erin Moriarty, Gérard Jugnot, Ben Miller, Sarah Jeanne Labrosse, Stefano Cassetti, Seema Biswas, Hearty Singh

title: L'ha fatto una signora
synopsis: Luca is a taxi driver who finds himself an abandoned newborn on the seat of his car. He decides to take him home, arousing the wife's ire that he thinks is the result of an extramarital relationship.
cast: Michele Abruzzo, Rosina Anselmi, Tina Pica, Virgilio Riento, Nino Taranto, Alida Valli

title: L'hermine
synopsis: Xavier Racine is the feared president of a criminal assize court. Nicknamed "the double-digit president" for his sentences never shorter than ten years, Racine suddenly changes when she finds Birgit on a jury called upon to judge an alleged murderer. Six years ago, Racine loved Birgit almost in secret and perhaps she is the only woman he has ever loved.
cast: Sidse Babett Knudsen, Fabrice Luchini, Berenice Sand, Claire Assali

title: L'heure d'été
synopsis: During the summer, in their country house, Adrienne, Frédéric and Jérémie in the company of their children celebrate the 75th birthday of their mother, Hélène, who dedicated her life to the work of her uncle, the painter Paul Berthier. The death of Hélène will force them to deal with the bulky objects of their past, with some secrets hitherto scrupulously guarded but also, inevitably, on the continuous alternation of intimacy and distance that marks each individual and the relationships with the members of the family of origin. Everyone will take leave of the old house as well as from his precious objects that will end up in an illustrious museum.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Charles Berling, Jérémie Rénier, Edith Scob, Dominique Reymond, Valérie Bonneton, Isabelle Sadoyan, Kyle Eastwood, Alice De Lencquesaing, Emile Berling

title: L'heure de la sortie
synopsis: Professor Capadis throws himself out of his classroom window in front of his students' eyes. Most of the students are terrified, with the exception of six of them, who remain strangely impassive. Pierre Hoffman, the French alternate, notes the strange behavior of the six who, unusually intelligent and precocious, spread hostility and fear throughout the school. Gradually, Pierre finds himself obsessed with their anger and his life turns into a nightmare when he discovers how extreme and dangerous their goal is.
cast: Laurent Lafitte, Emmanuelle Bercot, Gringe, Pascal Greggory, Gregory Montel, Thomas Scimeca, Luàna Bajrami, Victor Bonnel, Thomas Guy, Matteo Perez, Leopold Buchsbaum

title: L'histoire très bonne et très joyeuse de Colinot Trousse-Chemise
synopsis: The film tells the adventures of a young boy from the Middle Ages who, on the trail of his beauty, kidnapped by a squire, does not disdain the favors of various maidens and ladies. There is no real story, just a parade of trivia and beauties in historical clothing. The only peculiarity of the film is that it was the last film starring Brigitte Bardot.
cast: Nathalie Delon, Francis Blanche, Brigitte Bardot, Bernadette Lafont, Ottavia Piccolo, Alice Sapritch, Jean Claude Brouaut

title: L'historie de Richard O.
synopsis: In a summer Paris, Richard O., a slave to his libido and intent on exploring his most extreme erotic obsessions, investigates the sinuous mysteries of eroticism and women, adopting sex as a privileged means of connection between himself and the rest of the world. world.
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Ludmila Ruoso, Stephane Terperaud, Ma&Atilde, &macr, Anh Le, Tiara Comte, Rhizlaine El Cohen, Alexandra Sollogoub, Caroline Demangel, Valèrie Bert, Elise Receveur, Lucie Borleteau, Anissa Feriani, Marianne Costa

title: L'homme blessé
synopsis: Henri (Anglade), eighteen, met Jean (Noon) at the station. Indeed in the station toilets while Jean was beating up an elderly man. From fear, to attraction, to obsession, the step is not very short, but Henri takes it. Jean tries to discourage him, to distance him from his world, almost to protect it. Then he gives in, even physically, and that's the end.
cast: Jean Hugues Anglade, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Lisa Kreuzer, Roland Bertin, Annick Alane, Sophie Edmond, Claude Berri, Gérard Desarthe, Hammou Graïa, Armin Mueller Stahl, Roland Chalosse

title: L'homme de Rio
synopsis: Adriano returns home on leave and discovers that his girlfriend Agnese has just been kidnapped. After a chase, he joins the kidnappers at the airport and takes their own plane, bound for Rio de Janeiro. Here, after amazing adventures, he frees Agnes and reveals the criminal machinations behind the affair, linked to the discovery of an ancient civilization and its precious finds. Very lively yellow-pink directed by De Broca; for Belmondo it will be increasingly difficult to break away from the role of which the character of Adriano is the prototype. At his side the beautiful and unfortunate elder sister of Catherine Deneuve, Françoise Dorléac.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Françoise Dorléac, Jean Servais, Simone Renant

title: L'homme de la cave
synopsis: A Parisian couple decides to sell a basement present in their building. A very orderly and anonymous man, Mr. Fonzic, presents himself to buy it. There would be nothing anomalous if the man did not move to the cellar and transformed it into his residence. The couple then tries to cancel the sale but without any success. This is how Fonzic slowly will turn into a threat to their family by making friends with their teenage daughter and exercising a bad influence on her.
cast: François Cluzet, Bérénice Bejo, Jérémie Rénier, Jonathan Zaccaï, Antoine Levannier

title: L'homme du train
synopsis: A stranger arrives in a small town in the Ardèche department in southern France. Over time, the stranger makes friends with a local: in reality the first is a bandit who is about to rob a bank, the second an elderly professor who has to undergo surgery. Day after day, their relationship becomes closer and closer ...
cast: Jean Rochefort, Johnny Hallyday, Edith Scob, Jean François Stévenin

title: L'homme est une femme comme les autres
synopsis: Simon (Antoine de Caunes) is the last heir of a family of Jewish bankers. His uncle (Michel Aumont) promised him his fortune on the condition that he marry a Jewish girl. Problem: Simon is gay, he has never touched a woman, and he has also turned his back on family traditions. But his mother (Judith Magre) forces Simon to meet Rosalie Baumann (Elsa Zylberstein), born in New York in the Hasidic tradition. She falls madly in love and Simon has to find compromises.
cast: Antoine De Caunes, Elsa Zylberstein, Gad Elmaleh, Michel Aumont, Maurice Bénichou, Judith Magre, Catherine Hiegel, Stéphane Metzger, Edwin Gerard, Noëlla Dussart

title: L'homme orchestre
synopsis: The impresario Evans imposes a strict sentimental diet, as well as food, on the girls of his ballet. A dancer, who has broken the rules, forces him to nurse his baby, convincing him that the baby is the illegitimate son of Filippo, nephew and assistant of the impresario himself. Then the newborns in the arms of the impresario become two: and this time it is precisely a son of Filippo.
cast: Louis De Funès, Noelle Adam, Olivier De Funès, Daniel Bellus, Max Desrau, Tiberio Murgia, Vittoria Di Silverio, Martine Kelly, Paola Tedesco

title: L'homme pressé
synopsis: A possession-obsessed Parisian antiquarian is about to finally become a father but neglects his pregnant wife in pursuit of a rare piece of an art collection. Morbidly driven by having the object of desire at all costs, he challenges fate and tragically loses his game.
cast: Alain Delon, Mireille Darc, Monica Guerritore, Marie Déa, Christian Barbier, Michel Duchaussoy

title: L'homme qu'on aimait trop
synopsis: In 1976, after the failure of her marriage, Agnès Le Roux returned from Africa to return to her mother Renée, owner of the Casino Le Palais de la Méditerranée in Nice. In France, Agnés fell in love with Maurice Agnelet, her mother's confidant and a charming lawyer ten years older than her. While Maurice had other relationships, Agnès was totally crazy about him and wanted to sell her share of the casino stock to become independent but met with her mother's rejection. However, a series of events connected to the world of the mafia and the boss Fratoni put Agnès's life in serious danger, leading her to mysteriously disappear in October 1977. Thirty years later, Maurice is still the number one suspect in Agnès' death, although neither the body of the young woman nor any evidence against her have ever been found, and Renée fights with all her strength to see him condemned.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Guillaume Canet, Adèle Haenel

title: L'homme qui a perdu son ombre
synopsis: Paul (Dominic Guard) is a journalist who is always in close contact with the worst stories of our world and who can't take it anymore. He has a wife, Anne (Valeria Bruni-Tedeschi) and a secure job, yet he decides to leave them both, without explanation. Anne is worried and angry and starts looking for an ex of her husband (Angela Molina) to find out if she knows where she may be.The woman decides to help her find him and finally they find him in Spain, in a town along the coast, committed to long motorbike rides and equally long chats with Antonio (Francisco Rabal), an old civil war fighter.
cast: Francisco Rabal, Dominic Gould, Angela Molina, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Jean Gabriel Nordmann, Marc Lawton, Cécile Tanner, Jocelyne Maillard, Asunción Balaguer, Loli Pérez Álvarez

title: L'homme qui aimait les femmes
synopsis: Bertrand Morane, an impeccable engineer from Montpellier, spends his free time admiring, looking for, chasing women. He is not a Don Juan, he is not a viveur or a psychopath. He does it simply because he feels comfortable with women and, above all, he feels alive. One day, on Christmas Eve 1976, to follow a woman, he crosses the street and dies. The long theory of his "widows" parades over his grave.
cast: Charles Denner, Brigitte Fossey, Leslie Caron

title: L'homme qui marche
synopsis: Paris, first half of the 1970s. A photographer is struck by a man he has just met: it is Victor Atemian, emaciated and gloomy. The mysterious character has a story behind him to tell: he improvises himself as a writer obtaining a great success, then goes through success and finally ends up adrift on the road ...
cast: César Sarachu, John Arnold, Judith Henry, Mireille Perrier, Florence Loiret Caille, Miglen Mirtchev, Gilles David, Françoise Meunier, Anne See, Guillaume Allardi

title: L'homme qui ment
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Sylvie Bréal, Zuzana Kocúriková, Catherine Robbe Grillet, Dominique Prado

title: L'homme qui voulait vivre sa vie
synopsis: Paul Exben is a successful man: he has a great job, a charming wife and two wonderful children. Only this is not the life he has always dreamed of. A moment of madness will force him to take on a new identity that will allow him to live his life fully.
cast: Romain Duris, Marina Foïs, Niels Arestrup, Branka Katic, Catherine Deneuve, Rachel Berger, Eric Ruf

title: L'horologer de Saint-Paul
cast: Philippe Noiret, Jean Rochefort, Jacques Denis, Julien Bertheau

title: L'humanité
synopsis: Pharaon De Winter, a police lieutenant, is a humble and simple man who is used to taking the suffering of others upon himself. Pharaon speaks to a few people and does not address anyone. A bachelor, in his thirties, he lives with his mother in the town of Bailleul. He becomes friends with Domino, a 23-year-old worker, and soon falls in love with her. But Domino has a partner, Joseph. It is with the two of them that Pharaon unleashes his melancholy. Also because he has to investigate the murder of a child ...
cast: Emmanuel Schotté, Severine Caneele, Philippe Tullier, Ginette Allegre

title: L'hypothèse du tableau volé
synopsis: A collector of paintings and their reproductions, invites us to discover the reason for the scandal linked to the canvases of the painter Tonnere, active in the second half of the nineteenth century. The hypothesis that a painting from the collection has been stolen is also inserted in the story.
cast: Jean Rougeul, Gabriel Gascon, Carlos Asorey, Alfred Baillou

title: L'héritier
synopsis: Following the mysterious death of his father, Bart suddenly finds himself heir to a mighty industrial complex. Back home from the United States, where he lives with his family, he entrusts a detective with the task of shedding light on the parent's end. Determined to renew the management of the company, Bart realizes that someone is plotting against him: after having escaped various attacks, he discovers that the strings of the plot are pulled by his father-in-law Galeazzi, an exponent of the far right. The investigations, meanwhile, reveal burning truths ...
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Carla Gravina, Jean Rochefort, Charles Denner

title: L'idiot
cast: Edwige Feuillère, Lucien Coëdel, Jean Debucourt, Gérard Philipe

title: L'idole
synopsis: An elderly and refined Chinese cook and a young Australian actress meet in an old Parisian building. The day the girl confesses to the elderly gentleman that she wants to commit suicide because of a love disappointment, he tries to dissuade her by proposing a pact: he will cook for her every day until the fateful date. Thus an ambiguous friendship is born, looked upon with suspicion by the other inhabitants of the building.
cast: Leelee Sobieski, James Hong, Jalil Lespert, Jean Paul Roussillon

title: L'iguana dalla lingua di fuoco
synopsis: A serial killer is unleashed in Dublin. Inspector Lawrence believes that the right lead is for an embassy which, of course, is protected by diplomatic immunity. So Lawrence calls Norton, an ex-detective now banned, but with his hands all over the place to collaborate.
cast: Luigi Pistilli, Dagmar Lassander, Anton Diffring, Arthur O'Sullivan, Werner Pochath, Dominique Boschero, Renato Romano, Sergio Doria, Ruth Durley, Valentina Cortese

title: L'illazione
synopsis: A group of friends meet in a country house. Among them there is also a prosecutor who, between pleasant chatter and a glass of wine, sets up a trial against a doctor (Lelio Luttazzi), victim of anonymous complaints. From the words of the judge, the figure of the doctor is overturned to the point of transforming him into guilty, highlighting how a distorted use of justice can change the perception of reality.
cast: Lelio Luttazzi, Cinzia Bruno, Annabella Incontrera, Gaby Marini, Mario Valdemarin, Alessandro Sperli, Anny Degli Uberti

title: L'illusionniste
synopsis: In France in 1959, they meet an elderly illusionist in decline, overshadowed by the growing fame of rock bands, and a young Scottish girl. Enchanted by his sleight of hand, she decides to follow him on his journey in search of new stages and together with him he will become great ....

title: L'image manquante
synopsis: For many years, director Rithy Panh searched for a photograph taken between 1975 and 1979, when the Khmer Rouge held power in Cambodia. Convinced that a photograph, despite not being concrete evidence of a mass murder, allows us to think about many things, to meditate and rewrite history, he searched in vain for it in the archives, among old documents and in the countryside of Cambodia, arriving to the conclusion that it has been lost. He thus decided to resort to cinema, not returning a shot or the search for a single photograph but the image of a search.

title: L'imbalsamatore
synopsis: Peppino is of very small stature and is a taxidermist in a locality on the coast of Caserta. When he meets the young Valerio, he does everything to take him to work with him, forming an increasingly ambiguous relationship with him. The balance between the two is broken by Deborah, a girl fired from a mechanical workshop ...
cast: Ernesto Mahieux, Valerio Foglia Manzillo, Elisabetta Rocchetti

title: L'imbranato
synopsis: The industrialist Maranotti (Duilio Del Prete), to cover up an escapade, lends his identity to the employee Sperandio (Pippo Franco), who will have to replace him for a period at a tourist club in Sardinia. In Sperandio they happen to be of all kinds, until they are kidnapped in place of the principal. Having solved the misunderstanding, he agrees with the bandits to kidnap the real Maranotti, but things will turn badly boring farce, seasoned with profanity and populated by the inevitable specks of disheartening productions of this genre: Luciana Turina, Bombolo , Enzo Cannavale. At these levels, even the good Pippo Franco gasps.
cast: Pippo Franco, Laura Troschel, Bombolo, Sergio Leonardi, Duilio Del Prete, Teo Teocoli, Luciana Turina, Oreste Lionello, Enzo Cannavale, Giancarlo Magalli, Paola Arduini

title: L'imbroglio nel lenzuolo
synopsis: In Sicily in the early twentieth century, Federico, a young medical graduate seduced by the magic of cinema, leaves his studies to pursue a career as a director. The client of his first film requires that there be a female nude scene and he, to please him, decides to shoot a version of the biblical episode of Susanna and the Elders. The actress's search seems to lead him to Beatrice, a sophisticated and emancipated writer from the north. But the woman cannot compete in terms of naturalness and innocence with Marianna, a villager who works in her service. She will be the chosen one, against her will and with many consequences.
cast: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Primo Reggiani, Geraldine Chaplin, Anne Parillaud, Miguel Ángel Silvestre, Angélica Aragón, Giselda Volodi, Pep Munné, Ralph Palka, Ernesto Mahieux

title: L'immensità
synopsis: Monica and Dario are engaged. Dario plays in a symphony orchestra while Monica is passionate about beat music. Misunderstandings often arise between the two. One day Monica and some friends steal guitars to be able to do a concert, right in the warehouse where Dario's brother works. Monica realizes she has done a bad deed and returns the guitars. The two engaged couples reconcile. In turn, Dario begins to appreciate beat music. On a plot that is so thin as to be almost evanescent, a series of singing performances by singers and ensembles then (1968) on the crest of the wave are grafted.
cast: Don Backy, Gunj Marchesi, Caterina Caselli, Piero Mazzarella

title: L'immensità
synopsis: Rome, seventies. In a period of great social and cultural changes, the young Borghetti family has just moved to one of the many condominiums just built in the city. However, the choice proves to be sweet and sour. Despite the splendid and large views of the city from their top floor apartment, the family is no longer as united as it once was. Clara and Felice are no longer in love but they can't leave each other. Clara finds refuge from solitude in the relationship with her three children. Arianna, the largest, is only 11 years old but introduces herself to the peers of the neighborhood as a boy, pushing family ties towards a breakage point.
cast: Penélope Cruz, Vincenzo Amato, Filippo Pucillo, Aurora Quattrocchi, Giuseppe Pattavina, Alvia Reale, Elena Arvigo, Rita De Donato, Carlo Gallo, Laura Nardi

title: L'immorale
synopsis: Sergio Masini is a married violinist, father of a family. His sixth son is about to be born; the mother is ... the second of his mistresses. In reality, Masini is in love with three women and for this reason he is unable to interrupt this complicated and extremely expensive ménage from the point of view of physical energy. A priest to whom he addresses in the confessional gives him advice, which the man does not accept. The sincere attachment to his three women can only lead to an inevitable fatal heart attack.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Stefania Sandrelli, Renée Longarini, Maria Grazia Garmassi, Gigi Ballista, Sergio Fincato, Marco Della Giovanna, Ildebrando Santafe, Riccardo Billi, Carlo Bagno

title: L'immoralità
synopsis: On the run and injured after raising and killing a teenager, Federico is rescued in a forest from Simona, a twelve year old who lives in a house not far from his parents. The father, forced Siulla wheelchair, spends his days in solitude surrounded by his passions (weapons and watches), while his true mother tries to escape this lethal routine giving proof of great seductive capacity. Between the fugitive, Simona and his true mother will be established a complex game to the massacre.
cast: Lisa Gastoni, Howard Ross, Karin Trentephol, Mel Ferrer, Andrea Franchetti, Angela Luce, Wolfango Soldati

title: L'immortale
synopsis: In the Gulf of Naples, Ciro is sinking in the dark waters and, as his body sinks hit in the chest by his best friend Genny Savastano, memories of the past surface in his mind. Thus we return to Naples in 1980 when after an earthquake under the rubble we hear the cry of a newborn still alive: it is Ciro di Marzio, from that day on everyone will call him the Immortal. Years later, that same adult child also survives that fateful shot: then it is true what they say, the Immortal does not kill anyone.
cast: Marco D'Amore, Giuseppe Aiello, Salvatore D'Onofrio, Giovanni Vastarella, Marianna Robustelli, Martina Attanasio, Gennaro Di Colandrea, Nello Mascia, Aleksei Guskov, Nunzio Coppola, Salvio Simeoli

title: L'immortel
synopsis: Charly Matteï has closed his account with justice. For three years he has led a regular life, dedicated to his wife and two children. But his efforts are not rewarded: one morning he suffers an ambush and is found dying with 22 bullets in his body. Against all odds, however, it does not die ...
cast: Jean Reno, Kad Merad, Claude Gensac, Venantino Venantini, Richard Berry, Marina Foïs, Gabriella Wright, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Fani Kolarova, Joséphine Berry

title: L'immortelle
synopsis: The passion between N and the mysterious L ends when she disappears.
cast: Françoise Brion, Jacques Doniol Valcroze, Guido Celano, Sezer Sezin, Ulvi Uraz, Belkis Mutlu, Catherine Blisson, Catherine Robbe Grillet

title: L'imperatore di Capri
synopsis: Everyone is struck by the resemblance of the waiter Totò to an Arab prince. The mistaken identity makes Totò very popular on the island of Capri, where his oddities appear snobbish in the eyes of wealthy vacationers. When Totò is about to be crowned emperor of the island, his wife and the real prince arrive. The misunderstanding will clear up, but ...
cast: Totò, Yvonne Sanson, Marisa Merlini, Aldo Giuffré, Mario Castellani, Alda Mangini, Laura Gore, Nerio Bernardi, Enrico Glori

title: L'imperatore di Roma
synopsis: Gerry, drug addict with experience in a mental hospital, wanders under the bridges of Rome and among the lowest pensions, the squalid shores of his wandering. In the delirium of a sleepless night, he imagines himself to be a Roman emperor who has returned to bring life after the end of the world.
cast: Gerardo Sperandini, Nadia Haggi, Giuseppe Amodio, Agnese De Donato, Fulvio Meloni

title: L'impiegato
synopsis: Nando, a modest employee of a real estate office, spends his monotonous existence between the office and the flat shared with a single sister. She makes up for this flatness with beautiful dreams until an energetic director swoops into the office and sets up new work systems. Nando is so upset that he dreams of killing her but, deep down, he is in love with her.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Andrea Checchi, Gianrico Tedeschi, Gianni Bonagura, Cesare Polacco, Pietro De Vico, Franco Giacobini, Anna Campori, Ignazio Leone, Polidor

title: L'important c'est d'aimer
synopsis: Actress Nadine Chevalier was once very famous. Now everyone has forgotten her and she, in order to live, is forced to interpret pornographic films. So Mons, an attack photojournalist, when he accidentally meets her, he almost doesn't recognize her. But then he falls in love with her and gets into debt in order to provide her with adequate writing. Zulawski has a reputation as a visionary, but in reality he limits himself to being baroque to the point of boredom. Here he even manages to waste Romy Schneider.
cast: Romy Schneider, Fabio Testi, Klaus Kinski, Jacques Dutronc, Claude Dauphin, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Guy Mairesse, Katia Tchenko

title: L'importante è non farsi notare
synopsis: The Russian scientist Penkosky, the custodian of terrible military secrets, settles in Rome. The secret services of half the world then send their best elements on his trail. Three agents arrive from America who, disguised as a woman, try to go unnoticed. But the three Russian spies, three beautiful girls, soon make Americans forget their duties.
cast: Neil Hansen, Mauro Bronchi, Tito Leduc, Maria Grazia Buccella, Laura Trotter, Gianni Musy, Marilda Donà, Roberto Della Casa, Gabriele Villa, Francesco De Rosa

title: L'imprevisto
cast: Tomas Milian, Anouk Aimée, Jeanne Valerie, Raymond Pellegrin

title: L'inafferrabile 12
synopsis: A woman, already a mother of eleven children, gives birth to twins. The superstitious husband decides to get rid of the thirteenth child and entrusts him to an orphanage. When he grows up, the foundling unintentionally guesses a five in the lottery, triggering a whole series of misunderstandings and personal exchanges that also involve "number 12", or his twin, who is even the power of Juventus!
cast: Walter Chiari, Isa Barzizza, Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Campanini, Aroldo Tieri

title: L'incantevole nemica
cast: Silvana Pampanini, Robert Lamoureux, Carlo Campanini, Pina Renzi, Buster Keaton

title: L'incanto della foresta
synopsis: The teddy bear Pichissò one day decides to leave his family and go for a stroll through the forest. He goes to the wise owl who advises him to look for the poppy that will allow him to become an adult. In his wandering he can thus admire the struggle of the praying mantises, the spider that weaves its web, the dragonfly that gets rid of its shell and the industrious ants busy at work. Then a thunderous storm breaks out and ...

title: L'incendio di Roma
synopsis: The mad and bloody emperor Nero has ordered the leader of the praetorians to exterminate the Christians. The consul Marco Valerio, a very popular military commander returning from so many victories, was commissioned to materially carry out the order, but he had serious doubts about the pretexts used for the persecution. The perplexities are transformed into certainties when, during the raid in a catacomb, he finds the woman he loves there. Will he be able to prevent the death of his beloved?
cast: Lang Jeffries, Cristina Gaioni, Mario Feliciani, Moira Orfei, Luciano Marin, Evi Maltagliati, Franco Fantasia, Massimo Carocci, Riccardo Pizzuti, Vladimir Medar

title: L'inceneritore
synopsis: In a city dominated by a gigantic incinerator, mysterious crimes are committed. However, the bodies of the victims are not found; in their place appears a trinket: the famous three monkeys of which one does not see, the other does not hear and the third does not speak.
cast: Flavio Bucci, Ida Di Benedetto, Alexandra Delli Colli, Pietro Francescato, Janet Agren, Richard Benson

title: L'inchiesta
synopsis: The disappearance of the body of Jesus from the tomb after the crucifixion becomes a state affair and the emperor Tiberius sends two magistrates to investigate. Even after the "investigation", however, the mystery remains, thanks above all to the misdirections put in place by Pilate. An international cast grappling with a subject written years earlier by Ennio Flaiano. What is missing is the director's wrist.
cast: Keith Carradine, Phyllis Logan, Harvey Keitel, Lina Sastri

title: L'inchiesta
synopsis: The events of Giuliano Sartori, correspondent from Genoa for a newspaper in the capital, involved in a complicated investigation set in a psychiatric clinic.
cast: Claudio Camaso, Joel Barcellos, Anne Wiazemsky, Christoph Bantzer, Hans Caninenberg, Paolo Bonacelli

title: L'inconnu du lac
synopsis: Franck spends summer afternoons on the edge of a lake known for being a place of casual encounters, splitting up between two different men. While with Henri she develops a strong and completely chaste friendship by giving up sex, with Michel Franck she establishes a relationship that is based on strong physical attraction and passion. Franck, however, also saw Michel assassinate his former lover.
cast: Pierre Deladonchamps, Christophe Paou, Patrick Dassumçao, Jérôme Chappatte, Mathieu Vervisch, Gilbert Traina, Emmanuel Daumas, Sébastien Badachaoui, Gilles Guérin, François Labarthe

title: L'incorrigible
synopsis: Fresh out of the jail, the light-hearted Victor Vautier is animated by an uncontrollable energy: always in constant movement, changing his name and appearances and is constitutionally unable to tell the truth. What's more, his fixed idea is to make enough money to build a protective wall around Mont-Saint-Michel! Social worker Marie-Charlotte intrigues him: but when Victor discovers that his parents are the curators of the Senlus museum, the temptation to use her to get hold of a very precious triptych by El Greco is irresistible ...
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Geneviève Bujold, Capucine, Andréa Ferréol

title: L'incredibile storia de L'Isola delle Rose
synopsis: Spring 1968. In the year of the student protest, a young engineer, Giorgio Rosa (Elio Germano) with a great dream and a visionary genius decides to build an island off the coast of Rimini, outside the territorial waters, and proclaims it an independent state. It is an island where individual freedom is the absolute value: there are no rules. In this impossible undertaking, Giorgio will have a heterogeneous group of accomplices at his side: his best friend, a young entrepreneur more inclined to revelry than his father's company, a mysterious castaway looking for a landing place, an entertainer of Romagna nights in search a new life and a romantic 20-year-old looking for work. And then there is Gabriella (Matilda de Angelis), the passionate woman that Giorgio drags into his ambitious adventure and into his life. The Isola delle Rose soon attracted the interest of the press and especially of throngs of young people from all over the world, turning into a myth, in the international case and into an almost insurmountable political problem for the Italian government that cannot tolerate the foundation of a new Been in such close waters.
cast: Elio Germano, Matilda De Angelis, Leonardo Lidi, Thomas Wlaschiha, Alberto Astorri, Violetta Zironi, François Cluzet, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Luca Zingaretti

title: L'industriale
synopsis: Nicola is a forty-year-old man from Turin who inherited a company full of debt and on the verge of bankruptcy from his father. The world seems to want him down, but Nicola holds out and struggles with his teeth. But another front of crisis seems to open: that of the marriage with his wife Laura, which he cares very much about. Between them - also due to Nicola's concerns - a distance seems to have fallen that was not there and Nicola feels helpless. He begins to suspect her, he follows her, he doesn't trust her. Then everything explodes: the German financiers who had to intervene withdraw, Laura asks for separation. Nicola seems to go to the bottom. But not everything is decided.
cast: Carolina Crescentini, Pierfrancesco Favino, Francesco Scianna, Eduard Gabia, Elena Di Cioccio, Elisabetta Piccolomini, Andrea Tidona, Mauro Pirovano, Gianni Bissaca, Roberto Alpi

title: L'infermiera
synopsis: An industrialist is dying from a heart attack. The heirs are negotiating the sale of the factory, but their relative does not decide to die. They then recruit a beautiful nurse with the aim of giving him the decisive heart attack. But the nurse really cares for him and seduces the other males of the family: thus the man heals and marries her. Immediately after the marriage, the woman is widowed and rich.
cast: Ursula Andress, Mario Pisu, Daniele Vargas, Duilio Del Prete, Carla Romanelli, Marina Confalone, Stefano Sabelli, Luciana Paluzzi, Lino Toffolo, Jack Palance

title: L'infermiera di notte
synopsis: Nicola Pischella, a dentist by profession, is an unrepentant attacker on the virtue of his patients. His attempts, however, are always frustrated by the watchful presence of his wife Lucia. One day Lucia's billionaire uncle arrives who, old and sick, is entrusted to the "care" of the young and beautiful nurse Angela. Nicola immediately tries to seduce Angela ...
cast: Gloria Guida, Lino Banfi, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Alvaro Vitali, Leo Colonna, Mario Carotenuto, Annamaria Clementi, Lucio Montanaro, Jimmy Il Fenomeno

title: L'infermiera nella corsia dei militari
synopsis: What is a singer disguised as a nurse doing in a psychiatric clinic populated by patients who think they are famous generals? She is looking for stolen pictures on behalf of her theatrical impresario who asked her for a similar "duty" to make her debut in his show. The patients, crippled in mind but not in their aggressive virility, put the singer to the test, but the worst comes from the director of the clinic, a professor equally thirsty for sex.
cast: Nadia Cassini, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Nieves Navarro, Paolo Giusti, Karin Schubert, Elio Zamuto, Carlo Sposito, Renato Cortesi, Enzo Andronico, Carmen Russo, Jimmy Il Fenomeno

title: L'infermiera... di mio padre
synopsis: Both Don Gualtiero, prince of Lueca (formerly a frequenter of the town's brothel, now paralyzed in a wheelchair), and his inept son Filippo Maria are horned as much as possible by their respective spouses, notably with a fake general and a stable boy . Thanks to the loving care of a German nurse, the two will take their revenge: Don Gualtiero recovers, but continues to pretend to be ill and disguises himself as a ghost to terrify his wife's lover and make him dislodge; for his part, Filippo Maria will surprise everyone by showing off an unexpected courage ...
cast: Daniela Giordano, Enzo Monteduro, Francesco Mulè, Bianca Toccafondi

title: L'inferno
cast: Salvatore Papa, Arturo Pirovano, Giuseppe De Liguoro, Augusto Milla

title: L'infiltré
synopsis: The eighties. Abu Nidal is the head of a Palestinian terrorist organization that has carried out a series of bloody attacks across Europe. Considered by all to be the most ruthless of Palestinian leaders, in 1985, with the help of Libyan intelligence, Abu Nidal carried out two of his most infamous actions with the attacks on the El Al ticket offices in the airports of Rome and Vienna, threatening to iron and fire also France. To find him, Michel Carrat, a French intelligence officer, manages to infiltrate the organization and destabilize it through the manipulation of a young idealist who is part of the group.
cast: Jacques Gamblin, Mehdi Dehbi, Salim Daw, Laurent Lucas, Cristiana Capotondi, Jean François Balmer, Hélène De Saint Père, Bertrand Constant, Martin Sochor, Scali Delpeyrat, Hichem Rostom, Fethi Haddaoui

title: L'infinita fabbrica del Duomo
synopsis: The story, over the course of a calendar year, of the life and restorations of the Milan Cathedral, one of the largest churches in the world, an artistic and historical monument, a religious and civic institution, subjected to an extraordinary series of restorations in terms of quantity, complexity and variety.

title: L'inganno
synopsis: Lucia has a guaranteed future in the cinema. In fact, she is shooting the film that will consecrate her to the eyes of critics and the public. One day, however, she offers a ride to a homeless man, who steals a precious brooch from her. Lucia follows her tracks and finds herself in a homeless shelter run by some nuns. Is your life about to change?
cast: Nicole Grimaudo, Gianni Cavina, Alessio Di Clemente, Melanie Gerren

title: L'ingenua
synopsis: A rather awkward young man distressed by a rather aggressive girlfriend, a variety actress, two fresh spouses who are far from faithful and a fake dumb saleswoman: all of them involved - victims and not - in a scam concerning a villa.
cast: Ilona Staller, Georges Ardisson, Daniele Vargas, Ezio Marano

title: L'ingorgo - Una storia impossibile
synopsis: A businessman and his secretary get stuck in their Jaguar in a large traffic jam near the Roman highway surrounded by individuals of different social origins: a Neapolitan family, an elderly married couple traveling for the 30th anniversary of wedding, a young man who would like to meet his girlfriend, four armed men in a Mercedes, a feminist with her guitar and an ambulance operator. At first, everyone tries to organize themselves as best they can to endure the unexpected but with the passing of the hours the situation degenerates, giving way to prejudice, selfishness and violence.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Marcello Mastroianni, Ugo Tognazzi, Annie Girardot, Fernando Rey, Angela Molina, Stefania Sandrelli, Miou Miou, Ciccio Ingrassia

title: L'innocent
synopsis: Abel learns that the sixty -year -old mother is about to get married to a man who is in prison. Frightened and convinced that he had to avoid in any way that this happens, he gets help from his best friend Clémence to look for a way to protect his mother from what he considers a serious mistake. He will then have to begin to change his mind, when he will get to know man.
cast: Louis Garrel, Anouk Grinberg, Noémie Merlant, Roschdy Zem, Souleymane Touré

title: L'innocente
synopsis: Rome, late nineteenth century: Tullio and Giuliana Hermil are a couple from the Roman upper class, together for years, but without love. He is an unrepentant Don Juan, but despite this she is faithful to him. At a certain point, however, the fascinating writer Filippo d’Arborio appears in the woman's life: Giuliana gives herself to him and conceives a child. On Christmas night, when the whole family is in church, Tullio exposes the "son of guilt" to freezing ...
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Laura Antonelli, Jennifer O'Neill, Rina Morelli, Massimo Girotti, Marc Porel, Didier Haudepin, Marie Dubois, Roberta Paladini, Claude Mann, Elvira Cortese

title: L'innocente Casimiro
synopsis: In order to leave the college to which she just cannot adapt, a student makes the director believe that she is expecting a child and that the father of the unborn child is a professor of the college itself. To avoid the scandal, the girl is sent home, accompanied by the alleged seducer. Later the truth emerges and, of course, also the love between the two which is a prelude to orange blossom.
cast: Erminio Macario, Lea Padovani, Enzo Biliotti, Alberto Sordi, Ada Dondini, Lauro Gazzolo, Olinto Cristina, Baby Donall, Adriana Facchetti

title: L'innocenza di Clara
synopsis: Maurizio and Giovanni, two forty-year-old friends, grew up together, live in the countryside and love to go hunting together in the Lunigiana woods. Maurizio has invested all his money in a Carrara marble quarry while Giovanni, less ambitious, leads a boring life with his wife Luisa and young daughter Angela. The balance of their friendship undergoes a change when Maurizio meets the young and charming Clara, a woman who has just arrived in their small village. After their marriage, Maurizio is forced to do more of the work in the quarry, leaving his wife at home alone. Without many friends, Clara begins to hang out with Giovanni, fascinated by his charm, while some secrets of his past emerge little by little, causing events to precipitate.
cast: Chiara Conti, Luca Lionello, Alberto Gimignani, Rosanna Gentili, Irena Goloubeva, Giulio Beranek, Alfredo Piano, Bobo Rondelli

title: L'inquilina del piano di sopra
synopsis: Professor Arturo is instructed by the tenants of the building in which he lives to deliver an ultimatum to the rough Aurora. The woman will have to make a choice: stop "disturbing" or leave. Arturo, on the other hand, takes a liking to her and offers to fuck her with Pygmalion.
cast: Lino Toffolo, Silvia Dionisio, Pippo Franco, Enzo Cannavale, Liana Trouché, Mario Maranzana, Maria Antonietta Beluzzi, Pino Ferrara, Loredana Martínez, Teo Teocoli

title: L'insegnante
synopsis: In hot (in every sense) Sicily, the young Franco, the son of a feared local squire, proves to be very good in "sexology" but poor in all other subjects. To convince his parents to hire the beautiful repetition teacher (Edwige Fenech), the boy pretends to be effeminate, so that the teacher is forced to probe his sexual tastes.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Vittorio Caprioli, Mario Carotenuto, Carlo Delle Piane, Enzo Cannavale, Alfredo Pea, Stefano Amato, Alvaro Vitali, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Francesca Romana Coluzzi

title: L'insegnante al mare con tutta la classe
synopsis: Mario Cubetti, the son of a building speculator, was postponed to September. The father decides to call a teacher: the official purpose is that of repetitions, the secret one is instead the desire to have an adventure with her. All together they go to the sea. The affairs do not, however, spin according to the wishes of the lewd parent. The Guardia di Finanza resolves the situation: the builder is arrested for tax fraud and Mario can replace the parent.
cast: Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Anna Maria Rizzoli, Marco Gelardini, Gisella Sofio, Franco Diogene, Gino Pagnani, Jimmy Il Fenomeno, Francesca Romana Coluzzi

title: L'insegnante balla... con tutta la classe
synopsis: In a high school, gymnastics teacher Claudia Gambetti (Nadia Cassini), wreaks havoc thanks to her attractiveness and her particular teaching method, based on dance. Then he heals the school's finances (squandered by the principal) by winning an acrobatic rock competition. Yet another variation on the scholastic-erotic theme.
cast: Nadia Cassini, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Mario Carotenuto, Renzo Montagnani

title: L'insegnante di violoncello
synopsis: A group of friends goes to the sea with a clear goal in mind: to kill girls. The most coveted prey is the Junoesque Margherita, who teaches music and disturbs the sleeps of her adolescent pupils. But it will be the father of one of them who covets her, while the son ...
cast: Serena Grandi, Leo Gullotta, Michel Rocher, Antonio Caffari, Dodo Gagliarde, Miriam Baldi, Lorena Vottero, Danilo Verde

title: L'insegnante va in collegio
synopsis: Obsessed with kidnappings, an industrialist from the North moves to the South and starts living by pretending to be a bum. The old habits die hard so that, despite being married, he does not stop dating his lover and even tries with his son's English teacher. In this way, although disguised, it begins to attract attention.
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Gianfranco D'Angelo

title: L'insegnante viene a casa
synopsis: Luisa, who moved from Milan to Lucca to stay close to the man she loves, the city councilor Ferdinando, realizes that she has not chosen the best time: the elections are approaching and the presence of her lover can be harmful to the political career of the candidate for mayor. So, while everyone is drooling for her, Luisa will choose who really loves her.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Marco Gelardini, Carlo Sposito, Gisella Sofio, Clara Colosimo, Lucio Montanaro, Gianfranco Barra

title: L'insoumis
synopsis: A lawyer who sympathizes with the Algerian cause is kidnapped in Algiers on behalf of the OAS by a deserter from the Foreign Legion who falls in love with her and frees her.
cast: Alain Delon, Lea Massari, Maurice Garrel, Georges Géret, Viviane Attia, Robert Castel

title: L'instant infini
synopsis: Mary, a young and pretty wife, believes herself responsible for the death of the little daughter. To keep your mind busy and not think of the terrible event, it develops an dependence on self -induced sexual pleasure.
cast: Jennifer Rihouey, Damien Dorsaz, Mathieu Chardet, Maria Metral, Robert Nortik, Claire Thomas, Annie Nagat

title: L'insulte
synopsis: While renovating a building in Beirut, Toni, a Lebanese Christian, and Yasser, a Palestinian refugee, collide over a silly plumbing problem. An argument ensues and Yasser ends up insulting Toni. Wounded in his dignity, Toni decides to file a complaint thus starting a spiral of hell with the beginning of a long process destined to make people talk about himself.
cast: Adel Karam, Rita Hayek, Kamel El Basha, Christine Choueiri, Camille Salameh, Diamand Bou Abboud

title: L'interrogatorio
synopsis: The young Aldo (Benjamin Lev) is found in spite of himself in a murder case. Exchanged for the killer, he is brought to the police headquarters and questioned by the commissioner (Paolo Gozlino) up to an unexpected epilogue.
cast: Benjamin Lev, Paolo Gozlino, Brigitte Skay, Giacomo Furia, Nerina Montagnani

title: L'intervallo
