synopsis: Due to a sgarro to the Camorra boss of her neighborhood, the sixteen-year-old Veronica is taken hostage and held inside an abandoned building on the far outskirts of Naples, waiting to be punished. Watching her, albeit reluctantly, is Salvatore, a shy and clumsy peer with whom Veronica establishes a relationship of complicity and affection in the hours of waiting, thanks to the degree of trust achieved through long chats in which both confide their dreams and theirs. fears.
cast: Francesca Riso, Alessio Gallo, Carmine Paternoster, Salvatore Ruocco, Antonio Buil, Jean Yves Morard

title: L'intrepido
synopsis: Antonio Pane (Antonio Albanese), forty years old separated with a twenty year old son a musician, while waiting to find a real job he strives to be a "replacement": in practice, for a few pennies, he replaces those who need to be absent for a few hours from their job. work and does not want to be discovered. Ready for any occupation and to always grasp the positive side of any work experience, Antonio will have to deal with a new pain before he can find his smile again.
cast: Antonio Albanese, Livia Rossi, Gabriele Rendina, Alfonso Santagata, Sandra Ceccarelli

title: L'intrus
synopsis: On the eve of a heart transplant, a long-ill man decides to leave the mountain where he lives isolated to embark on a sort of initiatory journey in the footsteps of his past and of a son he abandoned thirty years earlier in Polynesia.
cast: Michel Subor, Béatrice Dalle, Grégoire Colin

title: L'intrusa
synopsis: Seduced and abandoned, Luisa loses the child she was expecting and attempts suicide. The doctor who helps her takes pity on her and ends up marrying her. But the old lover comes back and causes a crisis between Luisa and the doctor, from which however their union will emerge strengthened.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Lea Padovani, Cesco Baseggio, Rina Morelli

title: L'intrusa
synopsis: On the outskirts of Naples, the sixty-year-old Giovanna runs a reception center with passion, creating around herself a supportive community with its own rules and a strong identity. One day, an intruder arrives at the center: Maria, the young wife of a Camorrista who for mysterious reasons needs to hide but who, with her mere presence, is destined to disrupt the already difficult everyday life.
cast: Raffaella Giordano, Valentina Vannino, Anna Patierno, Gianni Vastarella, Marcello Fonte, Martina Abbate

title: L'invenzione di Morel
synopsis: Shipwrecked on a desert island, a man finds himself in contact with some strange and cyclical presences. Later he discovers that it is all the result of the diabolical invention of Doctor Morel, creator of a machine that guarantees immortality. Good film, full of tension, based on a classic of Argentine literature by Adolfo Bioy-Casares, perhaps a little too cold and cerebral.
cast: Giulio Brogi, Anna Karina, John Steiner, Anna Maria Gherardi, Ezio Marano, Margareth Clémenti, Roberto Herlitzka, Claudio Trionfi, Laura De Marchi

title: L'inverno
synopsis: Two couples, Leo and Marta, Gustavo and Anna, meet on the edge of a post-industrial metropolis in the north. Leo is a writer in crisis, his partner hides contradictions trying to create an art gallery. Gustavo is an industrialist who has a crude and perverse relationship with his woman. It will be Anna who seduces Leo with her femininity, thus making the problems of the apparently more solid couple re-emerge.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Valeria Golino, Fabrizio Gifuni, Yorgo Voyagis

title: L'invincibile cavaliere mascherato
synopsis: Second half of the 17th century. To escape the plague, the usurper Don Luis, after killing the legitimate representative of the government, takes refuge in his castle. At the same time, a masked knight appears in the village intent on protecting the weak.
cast: Daniele Vargas, Pierre Brice, Massimo Serato, Hélène Chanel

title: L'invitation
synopsis: Rémy obtained a two-month leave following the death of his mother. After selling the house in the city, he buys a beautiful country villa with a park and invites his colleagues and superiors to a party. In the course of the party the formalities and inhibitions are dissolved little by little; a slight madness circulates in the air, until the young Aline performs an improvised striptease ... Goretta gives us a ferocious portrait of Swiss conformity; an irreverent representation of the mediocrity that the director sees in the behavior of his compatriots. The film was one of the first successes of the Swiss school of the 1970s.
cast: Jean Luc Bideau, Jean Champion, Michel Robin, François Simon, Cécile Vassort, Corinne Coderey, Pierre Collet, Neige Dolsky, Jacques Rispal, Rosine Rochette

title: L'invité
synopsis: With three years of inactivity from work and unemployment insurance running out, 50-year-old Gérard must once again use his wits when offered a job in Indonesia. To win the sympathy of the new employer, she decides to invite him to dinner at her house. Never a mistake will prove more fatal: thinking that he is not up to the situation, his wife Colette asks for the help of his neighbor Alexandre, who in the space of 24 hours will upset the life of the family to better welcome the guest.
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Valérie Lemercier, Thierry Lhermitte, Hippolyte Girardot, Artus De Penguern, Pascale Dinizani, Mar Sodupe, Marianne Viard, Ludovic Berthillot, Michel Gondoin

title: L'ira di Achille
synopsis: Under the walls of Troy, only the intervention of Achilles and Patroclus saves the Greeks from the attack of the besieged enemies. But Achilles was offended by Agamemnon and retreats indignantly to his tent. Patroclus, putting on the weapons of Achilles, is recognized and killed by the Trojan hero Hector. Only then, Achilles, furious, throws himself into the fray and avenges his friend by killing Hector.
cast: Gordon Mitchell, Jacques Bergerac, Cristina Gaioni, Ennio Girolami, Gloria Milland, Eleonora Bianchi, Edith Peters, Tina Gloriani, Piero Lulli, Erminio Spalla, Nando Tamberlani

title: L'ira di Dio
synopsis: The film tells the terrible revenge of Mike Barnett who stole everything and killed his girlfriend as well. He may have his reasons, but what does it matter to us?
cast: Montgomery Ford, Dana Ghia, Fernando Sancho, Howard Ross, Wayde Preston

title: L'isola
synopsis: Turi and Teresa are the sons of a fisherman and live on a small island. Turi is a shy and reserved teenager destined to grow up quickly: his father makes him participate in the slaughter of tuna. Teresa is 10 years old and would like to go fishing with her brother, but in the summer she finds a job as a waitress in the marina bar. The story of the two children is intertwined with the life of the island: the work, the effort, the rituals and habits of the fishermen.
cast: Veronica Guarrasio, Ignazio Ernandes, Marcello Mazzarella, Erri De Luca, Anna Ernandes

title: L'isola alla deriva
cast: Delia Boccardo, Bernardo Olivieri Passeri, William James, Marina Moresco Cascales

title: L'isola degli uomini pesce
synopsis: Lieutenant Claude De Ros, after the sinking of the ship bound for Cayenne with a load of deportees, luckily lands with some of them on an unknown island. As they wander around in search of food, Claude and two surviving inmates end up as prisoners of Edmond Rackham. He lives in a lonely villa where he is fully served by beefy black men and by Shakiva, a Haitian who, when not trafficking with witchcraft, has the task of keeping an eye on Amanda, the daughter of Professor Marvin. He was commissioned to create amphibious men capable of recovering the treasure of the mythical Atlantis. Adventure film that looks more like an obvious cartoon.
cast: Barbara Bach, Claudio Cassinelli, Richard Johnson, Joseph Cotten

title: L'isola dei morti viventi
synopsis: An expedition of adventurers shelters on a Caribbean islet, ignoring that just a few centuries before, the Spanish conquistadors made a massacre of natives. The ancient inhabitants of the place therefore decide to return to life, and not to welcome new arrivals.
cast: Yvette Yzon, Gaetano Russo, Alvin Anson, Ydalia Suarez, Jim Gaines, Thomas Wallwort, Gary King Roberts, Curtis Carter, Miguel Franco, Arash Donadoni

title: L'isola del tesoro
synopsis: Before dying, an old pirate entrusts to little Jim Hawkins the treasure map that belonged to a famous and feared buccaneer: Captain Flint. The boy gives it to two gentlemen of his friends, Knight Trelawney and Doctor Liversey, who decide to arm a ship, the Hispaniola, and set out in search of the treasure. The command is entrusted to Captain Smollet and with it the three set sail for the South Seas. The cook on board, however, Long John Silver was once in the crew of Captain Flint ...
cast: Kim Burfield, Orson Welles, Lionel Stander, Rik Battaglia

title: L'isola del tesoro
synopsis: Captain Bones leaves, thanks to a fortuitous conclusion to a young English boy Jim, the map of an immense treasure hidden on an island. Those who hid it is Captain Flint with the belief of being able to recover it some time later. On the trail of the treasure there is also Long John Silver and his crew of pirate fierce. After so many vicissitudes Jim will also find two important friends in addition to the treasure and will understand that, Avolte, the width is worth more than a treasure.
cast: Jack Palance, Patrick Bergin, Kevin Zegers, Christopher Benjamin

title: L'isola dell'isola
synopsis: In the community of Carloforte, on the island of San Pietro, Sardinia, scenes from the daily life of the local people: from shepherds to salt workers, from sailors' wives to "white widows". A choral and human portrait, made up of hopes and fears, fatigue and fun, tradition and innovation, past and present.
director: Anna Lajolo, Guido Lombardi, Alfredo Leonardi

title: L'isola delle svedesi
synopsis: Manuela, abandoned her boyfriend Maurizio after a hard quarrel, reaches Eleonora, a divorced friend, on a wild island of meditarreaneo. Between the two women a morbid feeling was born that not even Maurizio's arrival, who came to recover his wife, seems capable of interrupting. Fought among the attraction for the friend and love for Maurizio, Manuela seems to decide to follow her husband, but Eleonora is not willing to yield.
cast: Catherine Diamant, Ewa Green, Nino Segurini, Wolfgang Hillinger

title: L'isola di Arturo
synopsis: Fifteen-year-old Arturo, orphan of his mother, lives on the island of Procida where he awaits his father's return with trepidation. When he finally shows up together with his new wife, the very young Nunziata, he causes a dry disillusionment in the boy who, moreover, falls in love with his stepmother. At a certain point, Tonino also enters the game, a bad guy who has just come out of the island's prison.
cast: Vanni De Maigret, Reginald Kernan, Key Meersman, Luigi Giuliani, Gabriella Giorgelli, Elvira Tonelli, Luigi Zerbinati, Michele Barone, Aldo Vinci, Ireneo Petrucci, Ornella Vanoni

title: L'istruttoria è chiusa: dimentichi
synopsis: Involved in a car accident, a young architect ends up in jail for manslaughter. But thanks to money and knowledge, release from prison doesn't seem far away ...
cast: Franco Nero, Riccardo Cucciolla, Georges Wilson, John Steiner, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Antonio Casale, Daniele Dublino, Piero Nuti, Luigi Zerbinati, Turi Ferro

title: L'italiano che inventò il cinema
synopsis: For some, Filoteo Alberini may have "invented" cinema a year before the Lumière brothers. The reconstruction of the life of the Italian pioneer becomes an opportunity for a reflection on the birth of Italian cinema and more generally on the Seventh Art and its nature of "magnificent obsession", accompanied by an exceptional narrator: Georges Méliès, the tutelary deity of the forgotten of the cinema.
cast: Massimo Zanuzzi

title: L'ivresse du pouvoir
synopsis: The investigating judge Jeanne Charmant Killman is entrusted with a case of extortion and transfer of funds, in which the president of an important industrial group is involved. The woman realizes that the more the investigations proceed, the more her power increases, at the expense of her private life ...
cast: Isabelle Huppert, François Berléand, Patrick Bruel, Marilyne Canto

title: L'occhio del ragno
synopsis: Plot in preparation
cast: Klaus Kinski, Antonio Sabato, Van Johnson, Lucretia Love, Fredy Unger

title: L'occhio dietro la parete
synopsis: Ivano, a particularly rich and vicious elderly invalid, begins to spy on the young neighbor Arturo and his gallant encounters. Since the vision of these with other women does not fully satisfy him, Ivano convinces his daughter to go to bed with Arturo. Unfortunately for everyone, Arturo seems to hide a terrible habit behind his handsome man's appearance.
cast: John Phillip Law, Fernando Rey, Olga Bisera, José Quaglio, Jho Jhenkins, Roberto Posse, John P. Dulaney, Enzo Robutti, Mónica Zanchi

title: L'occhio nel labirinto
synopsis: Julie (Rosemary Dexter), following the disappearance of her lover Luca (Horst Frank), a psychiatrist from Milan, goes to Maracudi, a small town on the sea. There, collecting some clues, she comes into contact with strange characters: Frank (Adolfo Celi) directs her to the villa of Gerda (Alida Valli), where the woman lives with some artists, and where it seems that Luca also spent his time. People answer #Julie's questions in a very evasive way: everyone seems to know the truth and have something to hide.
cast: Rosemary Dexter, Adolfo Celi, Alida Valli, Horst Frank, Sybil Danning, Franco Ressel, Michael Maien, Benjamin Lev, Gigi Rizzi, Peter Kranz

title: L'occhio selvaggio
cast: Philippe Leroy, Delia Boccardo, Gabriele Tinti, Giorgio Gargiullo

title: L'odeur de la papaye verte
synopsis: Mui, a ten-year-old farmer, leaves her loved ones to go to the city, where she begins to work as a maid with a family. He soon discovers, thanks to the old maid Ti, the drama of the family he works for. But just as old Ti tells this story to Mui, the father abandons his family again, taking away the family's savings. Repressing her despair, her mother courageously provides for the sustenance of her three children, Trung, Lam and Tin.
cast: Tràn Nu Yén Khé, Lu Man San, Truong Thi Loc, Nguyen Anh Hoa, Wuong Hoa Hoi

title: L'odore del sangue
synopsis: Carlo is divided between his wife Silvia, with whom he shares an apartment in Rome, and the young lover Lù, with whom he lives from time to time in his house in the countryside. The man does not keep his relationship hidden from his wife and indeed accepts that Silvia may have lovers. During a phone call, she discovers that a young man is courting her. From now on he will have their meetings told in detail and he will no longer have peace.
cast: Michele Placido, Fanny Ardant, Giovanna Giuliani, Sergio Tramonti

title: L'odore della notte
synopsis: A group of robbers from the far outskirts of Rome specializes in assaulting uptown neighborhoods. The boss is Remo, a policeman stationed in Turin, totally identified in his role by having developed an effective criminal technique: he follows his victims on the street by following them in the car, and then having the doors of their home open ...
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Alessia Fugardi, Giorgio Tirabassi, Francesca D'Aloja

title: L'oeil du malin
synopsis: In Germany for a reportage, the journalist Albin Mercier is hosted by a famous writer, Andreas Hartman, and by his wife, Hélène. The harmony that reigns in the couple arouses Albin's jealousy, who first tries in vain to conquer the woman, and then, discovering her marital infidelity, reveals everything to her husband. Distraught, Andreas strangles his wife and constitutes himself.
cast: Jacques Charrier, Stéphane Audran, Walther Reyer, Erika Tweer, Michael Münzer, Claude Romet, Louis Le Pin, Jean Davis, Daniel Boulanger, André Badin

title: L'oeuvre au noir
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Anna Karina, Sami Frey, Philippe Léotard

title: L'ombra del gigante
synopsis: An isolated fortress, a mysterious prisoner, a sparse guard, the commander and his family. Here there is no expectation of an attack from the outside but that of the death of the prisoner that no one has ever seen in the face, locked up in an insurmountable cell. Through the sound of his violin, the man establishes an unstoppable empathy with the commander's wife who begins to duet with him on the piano, but everyone in the fortress is ensnared by the mystery of this Pied Piper of Hamelin.
cast: Margherita Buy, Arnaud Arbessier, Marisa Solinas

title: L'ombra del giorno
synopsis: In Ascoli Piceno, in 1938 and therefore just before the outbreak of the Second World War, Luciano is the owner of a restaurant and, like many Italians, a sympathizer of the fascist regime. One day, however, a girl arrives in her life, Anna, who manages to be hired in the restaurant and who brings a secret with him. Luciano, who until then believed he could have his life, is suddenly located in front of a new element: love.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Benedetta Porcaroli, Valeria Bilello, Waël Sersoub, Lino Musella, Sandra Ceccarelli, Vincenzo Nemolato, Antonio Salines, Costantino Seghi

title: L'ombra del lupo
synopsis: Nico is a violent policeman, who has returned to his country after years to say goodbye to his mother Eleonora, who fell ill suddenly. In the same days some corpses are found in the woods, put on display as in a macabre warning. Yet the traces indicate that the murders were not carried out by human hand but by a huge beast. The police are convinced that Nico is connected to the crimes, and he himself begins to have doubts about himself because he feels "changed". After rummaging through Eleonora's house in search of some explanation, Nico discovers a terrible truth about his father. Thanks to Professor Moreau, an old acquaintance of the family, Nico will try to get in touch with his true nature.
cast: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Christopher Lambert, Raniero Monaco Di Lapio, Marianna Di Martino, Elisabetta De Vito, Massimiliano Vado

title: L'ombra di Caravaggio
synopsis: In Italy of 1610 Caravaggio is one of the brightest and most appreciated painters, although his subjects do not respect the canons dictated by the Church. After being informed that Caravaggio portrays prostitutes, thieves and vagabonds, Pope Paul V orders the Vatican secret service to investigate to decide whether or not to grant the painter the clemency useful to avoid the death penalty for the murder of a rival in love. The person in charge simply known as "the shadow", thus starts an investigation that will lead him to discover the conflicting vices and virtues of the artist whose life - or death - is in his hands.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Louis Garrel, Isabelle Huppert, Michele Placido, Micaela Ramazzotti, Vinicio Marchioni, Lolita Chammah, Maurizio Donadoni, Erika D'Ambrosio, Gianfranco Gallo, Gianluca Gobbi, Lorenzo Lavia, Moni Ovadia, Alessandro Haber, Brenno Placido

title: L'ombra nera del Vesuvio
synopsis: In Naples, an aspra war between two Camorra families is fighting underground; Sometimes some symptoms (a car bomb, an attack) emerges on the surface, while the clans are slowly going to decim.
cast: Claudio Amendola, Marcel Bozzuffi, Alberto Capone, Sacha Darwin, Larry Dolgin, Sophie Duez, Nunzio Gallo, Carlo Giuffrè, Danika La Loggia, Lino Murolo

title: L'ombre des femmes
synopsis: Pierre and Manon make low-budget documentaries and make a living from odd jobs. When Pierre meets the young trainee Elisabeth, she becomes his mistress, despite the man refusing to leave Manon. Shortly after, Elisabeth discovers that her rival also has a lover and tells Pierre about it. He then decides to return to Manon, the woman he truly loves. Feeling betrayed, he tries to win her back by neglecting Elisabeth ...
cast: Stanislas Merhar, Clotilde Courau, Lena Paugam, Vimala Pons, Mounir Margoum, Jean Pommier, Thérèse Quentin, Antoinette Moya

title: L'ombrellone
synopsis: Like every summer weekend, the mature engineer Enrico joins his wife Giuliana by the sea. At first he is distracted by new and somewhat goliardic friendships, but then he discovers that his wife, which he believes to be more than faithful, neglected for too long, makes sweet eyes to one of the many young hunks who haunt the coast.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Sandra Milo, Daniela Bianchi, Jean Sorel

title: L'onorata società
synopsis: Saruzzo Messina and Rosolino Trapani (Franco Franchi and Ciccio Ingrassia) are in the sights of the honored company for having seduced the two daughters of a powerful mafia boss. The assassins charged with killing them find them in Rome, where our heroes have in the meantime become engaged to two other girls, also daughters of a Sicilian; he would be happy to see them settled with the marriage, given their not very commendable past.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Domenico Modugno

title: L'onorevole Angelina
synopsis: Angelina Bianchi (Anna Magnani) is a leader. When something is wrong with her neighborhood, she is always in the front row. In the end they also convince her to throw herself into politics, but it ends badly. A part built to measure for Magnani, in a small comedy with an inconsistent polemical vein.
cast: Anna Magnani, Ave Ninchi, Nando Bruno, Ernesto Almirante

title: L'onorevole con l'amante sotto il letto
synopsis: The teacher of a provincial private school, who has lost her job for having abruptly taken back the mayor's children, goes to Rome to ask the honorable boyfriend for help, and discovers that he is actually already married.
cast: Lino Banfi, Janet Agren, Alvaro Vitali, Marisa Merlini, Lory Del Santo

title: L'ora di punta
synopsis: Filippo Costa's life is governed by a very strong ambition. An agent of the financial police, he despises his humble origins, and is willing to do anything to make his social rise. With the help of Caterina, a beautiful, cultured and rich woman, she manages to make her entrance into the world of high finance, and to reach the heights of the social ladder by banishing all scruples.
cast: Fanny Ardant, Michele Lastella, Giulia Bevilacqua

title: L'ora di religione
synopsis: Ernesto, an accomplished painter, learns that they want to make his mother a saint. Kept in the dark about everything by his family, he is particularly struck because the story contrasts with his world as an artist and as a free and atheist man. The initiatives to take part in the beatification process are becoming more and more pressing, while the memory of the mother opens a chasm that pushes him to rework the past and to live the present differently.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Jacqueline Lustig, Chiara Conti, Gigio Alberti

title: L'ora legale
synopsis: In a small town like so many in the south, accustomed to dishonest mayors who reapply for elections as if nothing had happened, in view of the local elections, the civic list of a professor who declares war on all forms of illegality is making its way. In town, voters are confronted with the idea of ??legality and acting according to the rules. Even Salvo and Valentino, managers of a small joint kiosk, take sides on opposite sides for the sole purpose of obtaining a "favor" from whoever becomes mayor.
cast: Salvo Ficarra, Valentino Picone, Leo Gullotta, Vincenzo Amato, Tony Sperandeo, Sergio Friscia, Antonio Catania, Eleonora De Luca, Ersilia Lombardo, Alessia D'Anna, Francesco Benigno, Alessandro Roja

title: L'orafo
synopsis: Three robbers introduce themselves to the country house of an elderly couple to plunder their goldsmith's laboratory. They will discover on their skin that the two old men are far from harmless and will end up experimenting with the most terrifying experience of their life.
cast: Stefania Casini, Stefano Fregni, Tania Bambaci, Giuseppe Pambieri, Gianluca Vannucci, Matteo Silvestri, Andrea Porti, Matthias Cavallo, Mike Cimini, Federico Graziani, Valentina Carbone, Antonio Cortese

title: L'orchestra di piazza Vittorio
synopsis: Born on the initiative of Mario Tronco (the keyboardist of Avion Travel) and Agostino Ferrente, the musical band named "Orchestra di Piazza Vittorio" takes its first steps in the homonymous district of Rome, hosting the stories and experiences of young people who arrived from all over the world in search of new opportunities.

title: L'ordine del tempo
synopsis: One summer evening some friends who have known each other for a lifetime have gathered in the villa by one of them to celebrate a birthday. At a certain point they discover that the world could end up there at a few hours and from that moment, for everyone, the weather will begin to flow differently, determining their destiny for better or for worse.
cast: Angela Molina, Claudia Gerini, Richard Sammel, Valentina Cervi, Alessandro Gassmann, Kseniya Rappoport, Edoardo Leo, Francesca Inaudi, Fabrizio Rongione, Angeliqa Devi, Alida Baldari Calabria

title: L'ordine delle cose
synopsis: Corrado, a policeman from the European task force responsible for immigration control, receives a post in Libya. During a night patrol ride in the desert, Corrado meets Swada, a young Somali woman who has left her war-torn country to try to reach Europe. Corrado gives her something to eat and drink before she resumes her journey. From that moment, however, their destinies are linked and Corrado will soon find himself faced with a choice: to respect his orders and the law or to save Swada's life.
cast: Paolo Pierobon, Giuseppe Battiston, Valentina Carnelutti, Olivier Rabourdin, Fabrizio Ferracane, Yusra Warsama, Roberto Citran, Fausto Russo Alesi, Hossein Taheri

title: L'ordre
synopsis: Riflessal Analysis on lepers and their condition of imprisoned from the rest of the world on the island of Spinalonga, in the Mediterranean.
cast: Raimondakis, Philippe Sollers
director: Malo Aguettant, Maurice Born, Jean Daniel Pollet

title: L'ordre et la morale
synopsis: On April 22, 1988 in Ouvéa, a French colony in New Caledonia, a group of Kanaki dissidents attack a police barracks, killing three officers and taking thirty others hostage. Not remaining helpless, the French government sends an army of professional soldiers, equipped with the latest generation weapons and led by Captain Philippe Legorjus, who tries to negotiate with the rebels for ten days in a row. As presidential elections are increasingly looming and the fate of the possible winner depends on the liberation of the police, the army is forced to go hard.
cast: Mathieu Kassovitz, Sylvie Testud, Philippe Torreton, Malik Zidi, Marc Robert, Mathieu Lardier, Alexandre Steiger, Xavier Jozelon

title: L'orgia dei morti
cast: Stan Cooper, Maria Pia Conte, Dianick Zarakowska, Leonora Vargas

title: L'origine du mal
synopsis: Since Stephane's family is completely destroyed by jealousies and discontent, when she meets a rich and powerful man who would like to be able to fascinate, decides to invent a completely different and brilliant life that does not make her disfigure, especially in the eyes of the other women who surround it.
cast: Laure Calamy, Suzanne Clément, Doria Tillier, Dominique Blanc, Naidra Ayadi, Jacques Weber, Clotilde Mollet, Céleste Brunnquell, Véronique Ruggia

title: L'orizzonte degli eventi
synopsis: Max, a researcher by profession, works in the nuclear physics and astrophysics laboratory excavated inside the Gran Sasso and is responsible for the Helios project, which could revolutionize the world of his discipline. This is an opportunity to be recognized by the scientific community: but when he comes into conflict with his colleagues, the situation becomes critical for him ...
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Gwenaëlle Simon, Francesca Inaudi, Giorgio Colangeli

title: L'oro dei Bravados
synopsis: Two adventurers are hiding gold bars, they will have to wait for the end of the Civil War to recover them. Mediocre example of an Italian western.
cast: Georges Ardisson, Linda Veras, Rick Battaglia

title: L'oro del mondo
synopsis: Carlo, a modest university student, is engaged to the beautiful Lorena, the daughter of a small industrialist, but Giorgio, the son of a rich entrepreneur, has plans for the girl and forces her to become engaged to him, threatening to cause his father to fail. Carlo learns of the trick and confronts his rival, inflicting a sound lesson on him.
cast: Al Bano, Romina Power, Carlo Giordana, Linda Christian, Nino Taranto

title: L'oro di Cuba
synopsis: On the occasion of the fiftieth anniversary of the Cuban revolution, a documentary that summarizes the past of the nation that above all embodied the revolutionary ideal - with all the contradictions that history has highlighted - and which examines the present through the testimonies of young people, their dreams and their frustrations, trying to imagine the future that awaits the Caribbean island.

title: L'oro di Napoli
synopsis: Il guappo: Totò victim of the abuse of a Camorra. "Pizzas on credit": Sophia Loren saves her adultery in extremis. "The players": De Sica, a forbidden noble, challenges the child of the building's goalkeeper to broom. "Il funeralino": a poor child died; that at least has a worthy funeral path. "Teresa": the prostitute Silvana Mangano gets married. "The professor": Eduardo teacher of pernacchio. From the book of the same name by Giuseppe Marotta, six sketches, between comedy and drama, told with intense participation and skilful elegance. Great performers employed at their best (Totò, Eduardo and Loren at their best) for a kaleidoscope of life scenes with many flavors.
cast: Totò, Sophia Loren, Vittorio De Sica, Silvana Mangano, Eduardo De Filippo, Tina Pica

title: L'oro di Roma
synopsis: Fifty kilos of gold to be collected in 24 hours to avoid deportation to Germany. The Roman Jewish community manages to put together the quantity imposed by the SS major Kappler, but is still sent to the extermination camps.
cast: Anna Maria Ferrero, Jean Sorel, Gérard Blain, Paola Borboni

title: L'orologio di Monaco
synopsis: History of a Central European family in which the names of the greatest protagonists of the history of the last two centuries converge (Marx, Heine, Mendelssohn, Husserl, etc.) The narrator relives, through a research that is intertwined between present and past, the memories and human events that led him to discover "what it really means to belong to the human community of the living and the dead".

title: L'orribile segreto del Dr. Hichcock
synopsis: In an English villa, in 1885, Dr. Hichcock kills his wife Margareta with an overdose of anesthetic. Years later he returns home with a new wife, Cynthia, and discovers that Margareta is not dead. Dr. Hichcock lets himself be entangled by her again to the point of trying to restore her old youth using Cynthia's blood. The intervention of a friend and the burning of the villa will prove to be providential. The reference to Hitchcock is not accidental: there are echoes of "Rebecca, the first wife" and even the glass of milk from "The suspect". Freda insists more on sexual perversions and makes one of the best films of her career.
cast: Robert Flemyng, Barbara Steele, Maria Teresa Vianello, Silvano Tranquilli

title: L'orso di peluche
synopsis: A gynecology "guru", married but unrepentant Don Juan, receives an anonymous phone call threatening him with death. After the threatening warning he receives a teddy bear that belonged to one of his nurses, seduced and abandoned by him, and who for this reason had put an end to his days by committing suicide. For the doctor it is the beginning of a nightmare ... The well-established Delon-Derey couple destroys and trivializes a Simenon novel with a story that goes round in circles and touches the ridiculous moment by moment. The presence of Dellera, then, will cancel any hope.
cast: Alain Delon, Francesca Dellera, Regina Bianchi, Paolo Bonacelli, Laure Killing

title: L'osceno desiderio - Le pene nel ventre
synopsis: A woman marries the last descendant of the rich Orsomandi family. Illibata, she is destined to remain so for a long time, wondering what her husband's problem is. Thanks to an exorcist priest he discovers that his consort is the recipient of a satanic curse that hangs over his family and that could generate a child of the devil.
cast: Marisa Mell, Chris Avram, Lou Castel, Laura Trotter, Paola Maiolini, Javier Escrivá, Víctor Israel

title: L'ospite
synopsis: Thirty-eight-year-old Guido and thirty-three-year-old Chiara, unexpectedly finding themselves having to choose whether to have a child, make opposite decisions that will lead them to separate. The phases of their removal are followed through the gaze of Guido, who in front of the first hesitation of his girlfriend, in the hope of making her change her mind, decides to leave the house where they have lived together for years and to ask for hospitality on the sofas of the people closest to him . Thus begins a strange journey that soon leads him to find himself witnessing the events of others from a new point of view, that of the guest. In a moment of bewilderment, assailed by a thousand existential questions, he finds himself noticing completely new aspects of the intimacy of the relationships and lives of the people closest to him. Precisely this new look will allow him to accept the idea that sometimes even great pains can give the strength for a new beginning.
cast: Daniele Parisi, Silvia D'Amico, Anna Bellato, Thony, Milvia Marigliano, Sergio Pierattini, Daniele Natali, Guglielmo Favilla

title: L'ospite
synopsis: A writer, having obtained permission to attend a psychiatric hospital to prepare his next novel, notes several medical and social deficiencies in the treatment of patients, but his criticisms are not well received by doctors. The scholar also has the opportunity to meet Anna, a woman now healed, who is entrusted to her brother. However, reintegration into the family and into society proved difficult and Anna, terrified of an aggressive approach by a young man, flees to the house of her deceased uncles. There she relives the past in a fantastic way, before being taken over by the police.
cast: Lucia Bosé, Peter Gonzales, Glauco Mauri, Giancarlo Maio

title: L'ospite segreto
synopsis: Hadì is a young man who tries to save enough money to leave his country. Failing to do so, he reached desperation and dives into the sea and after an exhausting swim he is recovered from the ship led by Emanuele Lari Alliano. Without thinking too much, the captain decides to hide the fugitive in his cabin. Thus was born a deep friendship between two men extremely different in culture, age, ethnicity.
cast: Corso Salani, Ludgero Fortes Dos Santos, Ben Gazzara, Romina Mondello, Spiros Focas

title: L'ossessa
cast: Stella Carnacina, Cristea Avram, Lucretia Love, Ivan Rassimov

title: L'oubliée d'Amboise
synopsis: Not far from Leonardo da Vinci's tomb is found the corpse of a well -known violinist, in an unusual position. The police captain of Orléans, Alban Dretre, must join forces with those of the agent Bérénice Amarillo to resolve the case.
cast: Philippe Bas, Pauline Bression, Edouard Montoute, François Eric Gendron, Jean Marie Winling, Lucia Passaniti, Olivier Chantreau, Anton Rival, Agathe De La Boulaye, Victor Lalmanach, Viviana Mattei, Laurent Seron Keller, Clément Bertani, Hélène Stadnicki, Olivia N'Ganga, Catherine Bayle

title: L'ours
synopsis: The cute little bear Youk, who has been orphaned, is "adopted" by the gigantic and lonely Kaar who gradually teaches him everything necessary for survival. Written by Gérard Brach (who stumbles in numerous passages, "L'orso" is a honeyed and feeble ecological parable, played by real bears but also by puppets and mimes.
cast: Tchéky Karyo, Jack Wallace, André Lacombe

title: L'ubov Vtrojom
synopsis: We are in the years of NEP, Lenin's New Economic Policy. A young man of good hopes arrives in Moscow from the province and takes up residence in the house of a young couple. A relationship between the three soon begins which becomes terribly complicated when the woman discovers she is expecting a baby.
cast: Nikolaj Batalov, Ljudmila Semjonova

title: L'uccello dalle piume di cristallo
synopsis: In Rome, a young American writer, Sam Dalmas, witnesses the stabbing of a woman. Knowing that perhaps it is a serial killer who already has three murders behind him, Sam begins personal investigations. The killer targets him: in extremis the police save Giulia, Sam's girlfriend; then when the writer-detective seems to have solved the case, there is a breathtaking final surprise.
cast: Tony Musante, Suzy Kendall, Enrico Maria Salerno, Eva Renzi, Mario Adorf

title: L'uccello migratore
synopsis: Andrea Pomeraro, a history teacher, has an affair with a student who then blackmails him. Recovered the photos that accused him, ours becomes the leader of the student revolt and ends up in jail. Satirical film without art or part.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Rossana Podestà, Gianrico Tedeschi, Dominique Torrent, Paolo Carlini

title: L'udienza
synopsis: A man, Amedeo, wants at all costs to be received in a private audience by the pope. Thus begins a process at the Vatican bureaucracy that will bring him into contact with a series of incredible characters and paradoxical situations. In vain, a commissioner of the Vatican police first tries to dissuade him from the intention, then helps him by putting him in contact with fixers and exponents of the black aristocracy, but always to no avail.
cast: Enzo Jannacci, Claudia Cardinale, Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Piccoli, Vittorio Gassman

title: L'udienza è aperta
synopsis: A right-wing sympathetic court of appeal judge, his side judge, a 40-year-old left-wing judge and a famous Neapolitan criminal lawyer, in moments of pause, discuss the most common current issues and the situation of justice in Italy.

title: L'ultima carrozzella
synopsis: A Roman coachman is accused by a famous variety artist of having exchanged the ring she had forgotten in the wheelchair for a fake one. The coachman, however, is innocent. The Fabrizi-Magnani couple repeats the success of the previous "Campo de 'Fiori". The screenplay is by Federico Fellini and Fabrizi himself.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Anna Magnani, Lauro Gazzolo, Tino Scotti, Olga Solbelli

title: L'ultima chance
synopsis: A jewelry thief happens what he never expected: hiding in a motel after a successful heist, he is in turn robbed by the owner's handsome nephew. A deadly mechanism is therefore triggered that claims numerous victims even among people unrelated to the affair. Yellow all'italiana with an international cast wasted by the direction not to the height
cast: Ursula Andress, Fabio Testi, Barbara Bach, Massimo Girotti

title: L'ultima donna
synopsis: Jean, an engineer separated from his wife and with a child in tow, finds himself on compulsory holidays because his company has few orders. At the boy's kindergarten he meets Valeria who leaves her boyfriend for him. The two go to be together, but after the euphoria (even sensual) of the first moment, the relationship breaks down even without a specific reason. Things get complicated when Jean's ex-wife and a new flame reappear. Tortured by (psychological) powerlessness to manage his love life, Jean castrates himself.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Ornella Muti, Michel Piccoli, Renato Salvatori

title: L'ultima estate
synopsis: The friendship and love between two boys, Paolo and Ilaria, who belong to two different worlds. Paolo, the son of a man who is in prison awaiting trial on a murder charge, runs an illegal workshop, where he repairs mopeds and mini cars by stealing spare parts. Ilaria, who recently lost her father, attends a completely different circle: upper middle class, rich and depraved boys. Together with some friends they will leave for the island of Lampedusa. And they will discover that they are bound by a mocking destiny.
cast: Daniela Poggi, Roberto Farnesi, Daniele Formica, Francesca Ferrazzo, Michela Carpente, Gabriele Penteriani

title: L'ultima lezione
synopsis: A great economist, Federico Caffè, disappears without leaving a trace. He moves away from his home in Monte Mario in Rome and vanishes into thin air. It is April 14, 1987 and that professor loved by his students, esteemed by many of his university colleagues, an appreciated supporter of a science of economics not separated from ethics, decides to leave the scene. Suicide? Terroristic attack? Retreat to the convent? Federico Caffè's remains a mystery.
cast: Roberto Herlitzka, Ignazio Oliva, Chiara Monti, Paolo De Vita

title: L'ultima neve di primavera
synopsis: Little Luca has lost his mother and suffers from a lack of paternal affection. He lives in a boarding school while his parent, a successful lawyer, is taken up solely by his career and by his love for Veronica, the girl he is romantically attached to. Veronica will be able to remove the boy from his isolation, but it will be for a short time: Luca is in fact ill with leukemia.
cast: Bekim Fehmiu, Agostina Belli, Renato Cestié, Nino Segurini

title: L'ultima notte
synopsis: After many years, a woman returns to her family home in the Modena countryside. There still live, in semi-isolation, the brother and the sister: a dark and traumatic past returns violently to the surface.
cast: Susanna Ferretti, Giovanni Funiati, Marco Marzaioli, Luca Mazzamurro, Prince Obi, Francesca Pignatti, Pablo Riccardi, Beatrice Schiros, Giuseppe Sepe, Francesca Turrini

title: L'ultima notte di Amore
synopsis: The evening before retiring, the police lieutenant Franco Amore is blocked to follow the investigations relating to the murder of a dear friend and colleague: Dino was killed during a robbery and love will have to face the case with help of his wife Viviana.
cast: Pierfrancesco Favino, Katia Mironova, Francesco Di Leva, Linda Caridi, Antonio Gerardi

title: L'ultima orgia del Terzo Reich
synopsis: Lise, a Jewish girl, arrives on July 26, 1943 at the Lieben Camp together with other young people intended for the pleasures of the Nazi soldiers. The field is dominated by the figures of the commander Konrad and Kapò Wagma. Both, affected by Lise, who would like to die, strive to bend it to pain and despair ...
cast: Marc Loud, Daniela Levy, Maristella Greco, Antinesca Nemour

title: L'ultima preda del vampiro
cast: Lyla Rocco, Walter Brandi, Maria Giovannini, Alfredo Rizzo, Tilde Damiani, Anoine Nicos, Corinne Fontaine, Leonardo Botta

title: L'ultima ruota del carro
synopsis: Ernesto (Elio Germano) begins to be a truck driver during the sixties. Dealing with transport, he travels far and wide across Italy, meets people of various kinds and experiences tragicomic experiences against the backdrop of the country's socio-cultural changes. From the first black and white televisions to the advent of Berlusconi in politics, Ernesto through the window of his vehicle is a witness to forty years of scandals, ill repute, dreams and hopes, remaining faithful to his wife Angela (Alessandra Mastronardi), to his friend Giacinto (Ricky Memphis) and his ideals.
cast: Elio Germano, Alessandra Mastronardi, Ricky Memphis, Sergio Rubini, Virginia Raffaele, Alessandro Haber, Ubaldo Pantani, Francesca Antonelli, Maurizio Battista, Francesca D'Aloja, Massimo Wertmüller, Elena Di Cioccio, Luis Molteni, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Matilda Anna Ingrid Lutz, Enrico Antognelli

title: L'ultima violenza
synopsis: Andrea, the town's new doctor, falls in love with Lisa, daughter of the engineer Carani, a wealthy landowner in the area. Lisa has an older sister, Anna, and a brother, Giorgio, who lives in the city instead. The dissipated life that Giorgio leads and his cynical and unscrupulous attitude pain the engineer, negatively affecting his poor health. One day, Giorgio reveals to Anna that he has discovered that Lisa is not their blood sister and that he is determined to cause a real scandal ...
cast: Yvonne Sanson, Dario Michaelis, Lorella De Luca, Alberto Lupo, Riccardo Garrone

title: L'ultima volta
synopsis: Two thugs, young and lovers of luxury and women, organize a big coup. But the victim of the theft takes revenge and kills one of the two.
cast: Joe Dallesandro, Eleonora Giorgi, Massimo Ranieri, Pino Colizzi, Marisa Mell, Giancarlo Badessi, Luigi Casellato, Dominique Demarest, Gianfranco De Grassi, Severino Saltarelli

title: L'ultima volta che siamo stati bambini
synopsis: Difficult to be children if the world is involved in a war around you. Cosimo, Italo and Vanda know something about it, who during the Second World War are just ten years old. Their only certainty is to have to leave for a rescue mission when a friend disappears.
cast: Alessio Di Domenicoantonio, Vincenzo Sebastiani, Carlotta De Leonardis, Lorenzo McGovern Zaini, Marianna Fontana, Federico Cesari, Claudio Bisio, Antonello Fassari

title: L'ultima volta insieme
synopsis: Paolo, the son of a high Neapolitan magistrate, is hired at the law firm of a friend of his parent's. The young man believes he has lost his mother, but the woman, who has long since left her family, is now the lover of the boss of the shop racket. Escapes from prison, blackmail, killings, trials, recognition at the last minute between mother and child: more than a brightly colored mélo, a real cartoon.
cast: Massimo Ranieri, Enrico Maria Salerno, Anna Orso, Dedi Savagnone

title: L'ultimo Capodanno
synopsis: On the night of New Year's Eve, on the Via Cassia, the residential complex "Le isole" is the scene of a series of episodes spiced with sex, drugs, desperation and violence.
cast: Monica Bellucci, Marco Giallini, Francesca D'Aloja, Antonella Steni

title: L'ultimo Decameron - Le più belle donne del Boccaccio
cast: Beba Loncar, Femi Benussi, Angela Covello, Marina Malfatti

title: L'ultimo Papa Re
synopsis: Rome, 22 October 1867: the barracks of the Zouaves, the mercenaries of Pope Pius IX, are blown up by three young patriots to support Giuseppe Garibaldi's attempt to enter Rome with his army and put an end to the temporal power of the Church , the last bastion against the definitive unification of Italy. The investigation into the serious attack on the Pope's army, which kills 25 Zouave soldiers, is entrusted to Monsignor Colombo da Priverno, a cardinal who oversees the Papal Police, but who is also one of the twelve judges of the supreme court of the Sacred Consultation. Columbus, however, a correct man with liberal views, is in strong contrast with the powerful "Black Pope", the Belgian Joseph Beckx, head of the Jesuits and black soul of the Church, who manipulates the weak Pope Pius IX at his pleasure and fights for maintaining the "status quo". Beckx, in fact, orders General Kanzler, leader of the Zouaves, an act of retaliation for the attack of the patriots, causing him to carry out a massacre at the Ajani wool mill, headquarters and weapons depot of the Roman conspirators, where also women and children perish. Monsignor Colombo, an enlightened clergyman, reacts badly to the violent initiative of the Belgian Jesuit and declares all his dissent for the state of siege of the Zouaves, who continuously harass the Roman population with the approval of the Black Pope. Despite this, Columbus faithfully carries out his duty and, having identified the three responsible for the attack, has them arrested for trial. But the countess Flaminia Ricci, a beautiful woman of about fifty, reveals to him that Cesare Costa, one of the three attackers, who officially turns out to be her young lover, is actually their son, the result of a relationship that took place twenty years. first during the Roman Republic. Colombo, caught off guard by the revelation, enters a crisis.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Sandra Ceccarelli, Domenico Diele, Marco Cassini, Greta Scarano, Roberta Mattei, Francesco Venditti, Duccio Camerini, Paola Tiziana Cruciani, Giovanni Scifoni

title: L'ultimo Pulcinella
synopsis: The story of the often traumatic relationship between a Neapolitan boy who is looking for new creative stimuli far from his city, and a father, a street artist, who earns his living with difficulty by continuing to sing and act in the squares of Naples "the stories of Pulcinella "...
cast: Massimo Ranieri, Domenico Balsamo, Adriana Asti, Jean Sorel, Valeria Cavalli, Antonio Casagrande, Margot Dufrene

title: L'ultimo amante
synopsis: Cesare Monti, who works in a newspaper, leads a disordered life. One evening, while at the police station looking for news, he finds Maria, a girl he had met in a gambling house in Tunis, during the war. The woman had taken care of him after a bombing. Caesar has her released and with the help of a friend has her welcomed into a House of Redemption. Reunited with an old lover, however, Maria would like to escape, but a serious heart disease does not allow her to do so. Only feeling close to death, the woman asks Cesare to marry her ...
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, May Britt, Nino Besozzi, Frank Latimore

title: L'ultimo bacio
synopsis: Carlo is a thirty year old in full emotional and existential crisis, as are his four friends, Adriano, Paolo, Alberto and Marco. It is true that he is marrying the twenty-seven-year-old and romantic Giulia, but when he meets the eighteen-year-old Francesca he goes into crisis. Anna, Giulia's mother, fifty years old with twenty-nine years of marriage behind her, is afraid of getting old and cannot resign herself to the fact that her youth is over forever.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Stefania Sandrelli, Marco Cocci, Giorgio Pasotti

title: L'ultimo ballo
synopsis: A good lady, taken by the fear of getting old, gives herself to the frivolities of worldly life. She has an affair and is about to commit nonsense with her lover. A daughter intervenes who convinces her of the squalor of her belated ambitions and directs her back to the right path. Taken from a play by the Hungarian Ferenc Herczeg, the subject is so forbidden that not even a capable director like Camillo Mastrocinque, here in the early years of a very long activity, is able to enliven it. The cast lines up numerous beautiful names in Italian cinema and theater. Note Elsa Merlini in the double role of Baroness Marcus and her daughter.
cast: Elsa Merlini, Amedeo Nazzari, Renato Cialente

title: L'ultimo cacciatore
synopsis: Captain Morris, while on leave, is in a Saigon brothel with his friend Steve and the black soldier Washington. Steve is desperate for the disappearance of Carol, the girl he is in love with. In a moment of madness he kills a man and then shoots himself. Morris soon after sets off on a suicide mission beyond enemy lines. He has to find a traitor.
cast: David Warbeck, Tisa Farrow, Bobby Rhodes, John Steiner, Tony King, Margie Newton, Massimo Vanni, Luciano Pigozzi, Dino Conti

title: L'ultimo crodino
synopsis: The (true) story of the "daring blow" scored by two inhabitants of Condove, a village in the Val di Susa: stealing the coffin of the great old man of Italian finance, Enrico Cuccia, former president of Mediobanca, who lay buried after his death in the Meina cemetery, on the shore of Lake Maggiore. All to ask for a ransom (from the wrong person).
cast: Serena Autieri, Enzo Iacchetti, Marco Messeri, Ricky Tognazzi, Dario Vergassola

title: L'ultimo dei Corleonesi
cast: David Coco, Stefano Dionisi, Marcello Mazzarella, Emilio Bonucci, Federica De Cola, Giuseppe Lo Console, Siddharta Pristinari, Raffaella Rea, Vincent Riotta, Gaetano Bruno

title: L'ultimo gattopardo: Ritratto di Goffredo Lombardo
synopsis: The life and career of Goffredo Lombardo, one of the most illustrious producers of the Italian cinema scene, reconstructed thanks to a series of prestigious film sequences from the Titanus Library with period and contemporary testimonies of actors, directors, screenwriters and Italians than foreigners.
cast: Renzo Arbore, Dario Argento, Pippo Baudo, Alberto Bevilacqua, Carlo Bixio, Cristiana Capotondi, Patrizia Carrano, Suso Cecchi D'Amico, Fabrizio Costa

title: L'ultimo giorno di scuola prima delle vacanze di Natale
synopsis: Emilia Romagna, 1944. A group of women and Athos a poor student from a working class took their seats on board a rickety bus, reduced to a wreck that puffs at every bend on the Apennine roads. The bus is stopped by the republicans, two men and a woman, unleashed fascists, collaborators of the Germans. All the members of the group are killed, including Athos who is found abandoned and naked on the banks of a stream.
cast: Luca Bonicalzi, Riccardo Cucciolla, Delia Boccardo, Lino Capolicchio

title: L'ultimo gladiatore
synopsis: Naor, a slave with superhuman strength, is made to fight as a gladiator. The strongman rebels against Messalina who decides to have him killed. Emperor Claudius, her husband, will save him by ordering the arrest of the woman who plotted to overthrow Caligula.
cast: Richard Harrison, Lisa Gastoni, Marilù Tolo, Livio Lorenzon

title: L'ultimo killer
synopsis: The wealthy Barret owns a mortgage on Ramon's lands and, just as Ramon prepares to pay it, orders his men to rob him. From this begins a long series of vendettas involving Ramon's father, a business partner of Barrett himself, and Raza, a professional killer. You won't believe it, but Ramon is the only one in the end to stay alive.
cast: George Eastman, Anthony Ghidra, Daniele Vargas, Dana Ghia

title: L'ultimo mundial
synopsis: Gianantoniomaria Casarotti is a center forward who, in an attempt to put the ball into the net, while trying to watch a beautiful girl passing by on the sidelines, crashed into the goal post. Many tried to wake him up, but only the girl succeeds in the enterprise. Suddenly back to life, the striker begins to tell meaningless stories.
cast: Angelo Orlando, Armando De Razza, Alessandro Haber, Francesca Ponziani

title: L'ultimo padrino
synopsis: Roberto Sanna (Daniele Pecci), at the head of a police squad called Gruppo Duomo, tries to capture the old boss Bernardo Provenzano (Michele Placido), the most wanted criminal in Italy.
cast: Michele Placido, Daniele Pecci, Micaela Ramazzotti, Marco Leonardi, Raffaele Vannoli, Gaetano Amato, Ninni Bruschetta, Nino Frassica, Imma Piro, Francesco Benigno

title: L'ultimo paradiso
synopsis: In 1958, in a small town in southern Italy, Ciccio (Riccardo Scamarcio) is a 40-year-old farmer. He is married to Lucia (Valentina Cervi) and they have a 7 year old son. Ciccio dreams of changing things and fights with his fellow villagers against those who have always exploited the weakest. He is secretly in love with Bianca (Gaia Bermani Amaral), the daughter of Cumpà Schettino (Antonio Gerardi), a treacherous and feared landowner who has been exploiting peasants for years. Ciccio would like to run away with her but, as soon as Cumpà Schettino becomes aware of their relationship, a series of events will start to upset everyone's life and nothing will be the same again.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Gaia Bermani Amaral, Antonio Gerardi, Valentina Cervi, Anna Maria De Luca, Federica Torchetti, Mimmo Mignemi, Donato Demita, Matteo Scaltrito

title: L'ultimo pastore
synopsis: Forty-year-old Renato Zucchelli is the last remaining shepherd in the Milan area. He spends the summer with his sheep in the Bergamo valleys and returns to the outskirts of the Lombard capital to spend the winter. Renato has only one big dream: to reach the city center and bring his flock to the children of the city, to whom he can transmit his idea of ??freedom. The opportunity to transform the dream into reality is manifested thanks to the explicit request of an elementary school.
cast: Renato Zucchelli, Piero Lombardi, Lucia Zucchelli, Patrizia Frisole, Hedy Krissane, Barbara Sorrentini

title: L'ultimo piano
synopsis: An off-site student apartment in the Tor Marancia district of Rome: three young people and a more mature ex-punk bassist intertwine their lives.
cast: Marilena Annibali, Simone Liberati, Yuliia Sobol, Francesco Acquaroli, Francesco Tiburzi, Aglaia Mora, Andrey Maslenkin, Astrid Meloni, Paolo Giovannucci
director: Giansalvo Pinocchio, Marcello Caporiccio, Francesco Di Nuzzo, Francesco Ferrari, Luca Iacoella, Giulia Lapenna, Giulia Cacchioni, Sabrina Podda, Alessandro Carchedi

title: L'ultimo re
synopsis: After years of sieges and war, the city of Troy has finally capitulated and the Athenians wreak havoc on the inhabitants, killing their men and enslaving the women. Andromeda, Ettore's wife, will have a cruel fate of suffering and resignation. After seeing her husband die, she will also have to watch helplessly in the murder of her son Astianatte, launched outside the city walls at the behest of Ulysses, intent on not giving new lineage to Priam's lineage. The woman will be forced to repress her pain, with no choice.
cast: Isabel Russinova, Moni Ovadia, Maria Monti, Edoardo Siravo, Antonio Martinelli, Alessio Vassallo, Jun Ichikawa, Hafedh Khalifa, Domenico Balsamo

title: L'ultimo sapore dell'aria
synopsis: Diego is a boy with some problems. Harassed at school, the family does not find a better atmosphere oppressed as it is by his mother and stepfather who put his younger half-brothers before him. Tired of the situation, Diego decides to leave and finds a job at a sporting club where he can train secretly in swimming, his great sporting passion. Here he also finds a couple of affectionate friends, older than him, who adopt him almost like a child. But fate has a bitter sentence in store.
cast: Carlo Lupo, Maurizio Rossi, Angela Goodwin, Jacques Sernas

title: L'ultimo squalo
synopsis: A shark terrorizes a Californian town. The special effects are laughable. Does the plot remind you of anything?
cast: James Franciscus, Vic Morrow, Micaela Pignatelli

title: L'ultimo terrestre
synopsis: The aliens have just announced that their landing on Earth is a few days away, in a small town in Tuscany, but no one seems to give weight to the news, underestimating the event. The only one who shows concern is Luca Bertacci (Gabriele Spinelli), a lonely man whose only distraction is working in a bingo hall. Growing up without a mother and strongly afraid of women, he will take advantage of the time before the invasion to oppose everything that is wrong in his life, routine and loneliness, also trying to conquer the neighbor, of which he has always been secretly in love.
cast: Gabriele Spinelli, Anna Bellato, Roberto Herlitzka, Paolo Mazzarelli, Teco Celio, Luca Marinelli, Sara Rosalia Losilla, Vincenzo Illiano

title: L'ultimo treno della notte
synopsis: On the occasion of the Christmas holidays, Elisa Stradi, the sixteen-year-old daughter of a surgeon, leaves Germany to travel to Italy with her cousin Margareth. In Austria, due to an attack, the two traveling companions are forced to change trains. On a semi-deserted convoy bound for Verona they become victims of two young delinquents and a middle-class lady. Thrown from the moving train, Margareth dies. The three get rid of Elisa in the same way. When they get off the train, they run into their father who takes his revenge.
cast: Flavio Bucci, Macha Meril, Enrico Maria Salerno, Franco Fabrizi, Gianfranco De Grassi, Marina Berti, Irene Miracle, Laura D'Angelo

title: L'ultimo ultras
synopsis: Journey into the controversial world of organized supporters, with the participation, in the unusual capacity of actor, of the popular footballer Andriy Shevchenko.
cast: Stefano Calvagna, Mauro Meconi, Rossella Infanti, Federica Famea, Andriy Shevchenko, Mattia Sbragia, Giancarlo Lombardi, Francesca Antonelli, Giulia Elettra Gorietti

title: L'ultimo uomo della Terra
synopsis: Scientist Robert Morgan is the last man on Earth: in the sense that the rest of the human race has been wiped out by a terrible epidemic, which has turned everyone into hideous vampires. The lonely Morgan is forced to organize a personal resistance: at night he barricades himself at home between garlic and mirrors, during the day he wanders around the city in search of basic necessities, armed with ash stakes ...
cast: Vincent Price, Franca Bettoja, Emma Danieli, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: L'ultimo weekend
synopsis: Alberto, a despotic entrepreneur and an overly strict father, invites Luigi and Marcella, his two closest collaborators, to spend a weekend with him in his villa many kilometers from the first town to celebrate his birthday. The two accept the proposal, unaware of the fact that Alberto has discovered that one of the two has stolen company funds, and leave together with their respective companions. Chiara, the eighteen-year-old daughter of Alberto, full of hatred towards her father, also appears surprisingly at the villa. Soon, everyone will be forced to confront an unexpected reality.
cast: Alberto Gimignani, Chiara Conti, Mirko Petrini, Ilaria De Laurentiis, Lorenzo Patané, Cristina Puccinelli, Wladimiro Perrini, Flora Canto, Alessandro Zanetti

title: L'umanoide
synopsis: Some inhabitants of Metropolis (helped by a mysterious child) fight the evil Brother of the Night who wants to transform everyone into humanoids.
cast: Corinne Cléry, Richard Kiel, Leonard Mann

title: L'uomo che ama
synopsis: Roberto has been dating the charming Sara for a few months and would like to start a cohabitation; at his proposal, however, the woman pulls back and confesses that she still has feelings for her ex. Roberto is unable to accept the breakup and looks back with nostalgia on his previous relationship with Alba, which he had left precisely because he did not feel ready for the big step ...
cast: Pierfrancesco Favino, Monica Bellucci, Ksenia Rappoport, Marisa Paredes, Piera Degli Esposti, Arnaldo Ninchi, Fausto Maria Sciarappa, Glen Blackhall, Michele Alhaique

title: L'uomo che aveva picchiato la testa
synopsis: Bobo Rondelli, leader of the Eighth Pavilion in the 90s (like the psychiatry department of the Livorno hospital), together with whom he achieved success with the song _Ho beat my head_, goes through a bad period: his wife closes him out of the house and the singer-songwriter misses the professionally important appointments, organized for him by his musician friends.
cast: Bobo Rondelli, Carlo Monni, David Riondino, Francesco Bruni, Nada

title: L'uomo che cavalcava nel buio
synopsis: Teaching to ride was his life, but Rocco's brilliant career was cut short by an infamous conviction for sports fraud and manslaughter: Fabrizio, his pupil, was thrown off a horse during a competition which was then doped. cast: Terence Hill, Francesca Cavallin, Marco Cocci, Luciano De Luca, Emilio De Marchi, Ivo Garrani, Marta Gastini, Alberto Gimignani, Barbara Livi, Marcello Mazzarella

title: L'uomo che comprò la luna
synopsis: A couple of Italian secret agents receives a tip from the United States: it seems that someone, in Sardinia, has become the owner of the moon. Which, from the point of view of the Americans, is unacceptable, given that they were the first to set foot there and plant the national flag. The two agents therefore recruit a soldier who, behind the false name of Kevin Pirelli and a marked Milanese accent, hides his Sardinian identity: his name is in fact Gavino Zoccheddu and Sardinia has it inside even if he doesn't know it. To transform him into a true Sardinian, a sui generis cultural trainer is hired. At this point all that remains is to solve the case: who bought the moon? And why?
cast: Jacopo Cullin, Benito Urgu, Stefano Fresi, Francesco Pannofino, Lazar Ristovski, Angela Molina

title: L'uomo che guarda
cast: Francesco Casale, Katarina Vasilissa, Cristina Garavaglia, Franco Branciaroli

title: L'uomo che non voleva morire
synopsis: A gang of thieves organizes a theft against a villa where there are paintings of valuable paintings. Caught on the fact by the hosts, the fools react by attacking them. While the wife is raped, the husband manages to hit one of the thieves with a shoe in his head, which agonizing is dragged away by his companions and abandoned between the woods. Managed to survive, these will meditate revenge.
cast: Martine Brochard, Keith Van Hoven, Gino Concari, Lino Salemme, Igor Zalewsky, Stefano Molinari, Peter Pitsch, Raffaella La Vecchia, Jacques Sernas, Daniela Franchi

title: L'uomo che ride
synopsis: Cesare Borgia, the evil Duke Valentino, has a disfigured acrobat subjected to facial plastic and for this he performs with his face covered by a mask. The acrobat thus becomes the perfect double of Prince Astorre Manfredi, bitter rival of the Borgia. The purpose of the plot is of course the elimination of Manfredi, but the acrobat, having discovered the deception, goes to the side of the prince and foils the plots of the evil one. From the novel by Victor Hugo, an attempt at Corbucci's costume drama off the ropes.
cast: Jean Sorel, Lisa Gastoni, Ilaria Occhini, Edmund Purdom, Linda Sini, Gianni Musy

title: L'uomo che sfidò l'organizzazione
synopsis: An airport employee gets his hands on a drug shipment and, thanks to the intrepid girlfriend, sells it abroad for a billion. The swindled criminal organization, however, gets on the heels of the two, who can momentarily count on the support of an inspector. Italian action comic that recalls the ingredients and structures of the old spaghetti wetern with punches, shots, escapes and chases.
cast: Howard Ross, Karin Schubert, José Calvo, Stephen Boyd, Alberto Dalbes

title: L'uomo che sognava con le aquile
synopsis: Rocco Ventura (Terence Hill) is a former lawyer who at some point in his life felt the need to retire to the Aspromonte mountains to lead a solitary existence. Here, he dedicated himself to the production of a local cheese according to an ancient family recipe that has been handed down from generation to generation. On his land, however, gravitate the interests of Bortolotti, an avid building contractor who would like to use the possessions to build a tourist complex, in league with the mayor who uses the directives of the European Community to have the Ventura cheese declared out of standard and impose on him new production techniques. Without ever giving up and with the help of the local population, Rocco wages a legal battle during which he will have the opportunity to run into Giulia (Michelle Bonev) and her son Roberto, a child who needs the mountain air to recover from a serious disease from which he is recovering.
cast: Terence Hill, Michelle Bonev, Mattia Cicinelli, Andrea Tidona, Alberto Molinari, Pier Luigi Misasi, Stefania Bogo, Mariolina De Fano, Antonio Faa, Kim

title: L'uomo che sorride
synopsis: A rich widower would more than willingly get rid of his grumpy daughter (Noris), but it seems she does it on purpose to screw up every possible opportunity. Until, one day, Pio Fardella (De Sica) enters the scene, accepting the "risk" of the wedding and appeasing his wife. The text was not excelled in the theater, and the film version leaves it more or less the same.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Assia Noris, Umberto Melnati, Enrico Viarisio

title: L'uomo che verrà
synopsis: Winter 1943. Martina is 8 years old, lives on the slopes of Monte Sole, not far from Bologna, she is the only daughter of a peasant family who, like many others, struggles to survive. Years ago, she lost a little brother for a few days and has since stopped talking. In December, the mother becomes pregnant again. The months pass, the baby grows in the mother's womb and Martina lives waiting for the baby to be born, while the war approaches and life becomes more and more difficult. In the night between 28 and 29 September 1944, the baby is finally born. Almost simultaneously the SS unleashed an unprecedented roundup in the area, which will go down in history as the Marzabotto massacre.
cast: Maya Sansa, Claudio Casadio, Alba Rohrwacher, Vito, Eleonora Mazzoni, Timo Jacobs, Tom Sommerlatte, Diego Pagotto, Raffaele Zabban, Orfeo Orlando

title: L'uomo dagli occhi di ghiaccio
synopsis: Eddie, a young Albuquerque reporter who works for the local newspaper "The Sentinel," has serious doubts about the Mexican sentenced to death for the murder of Mr. Roberts, a local senator and financier. Escaping various attacks, he finds a precious witness and ...
cast: Antonio Sabato, Barbara Bouchet, Faith Domergue, Victor Buono

title: L'uomo dai calzoni corti
synopsis: Little Salvatore "Pagnottella" escapes from a Sicilian orphanage to look for his mother. He will chase her, between one adventure and another, in Naples, Milan, Venice. Picaresque trip to Italy with pathetic brushstrokes and many obvious things.
cast: Alida Valli, Edoardo Nevola, Francisco Rabal

title: L'uomo dal fiore in bocca
synopsis: During a rainy night in summer, in the appearance room of a railway station in Sicily, there are two people. One is "the man with a flower in his mouth", who faces and threatens a mysterious woman who waits for him out of the station. The other is "The Pacific Adventor", who instead lost the train because of the gift packages he made to the women of his family. This is how he meets the man from the flower in his mouth, who arrives in his rescue and who immediately establishes a relationship of great trust and complicity with him. The two tell each other their life, but while the peaceful patron talks about his frustrations at home, the other seems to want to direct everything towards a single topic: death.
cast: Gabriele Lavia, Michele Demaria, Rosa Palasciano

title: L'uomo dalla bocca storta
synopsis: The life and career of Luciano Salce, one of the most complete showman of the second half of the twentieth century, who died in 1989: from his debut as a theatrical actor with the "Gobbi", to the resounding success with the cinematographic direction of _Fantozzi_, passing through the television varieties and radio magazines.
cast: Emanuele Salce, Luciano Salce, Paolo Villaggio, Catherine Spaak, Giorgio Albertazzi, Franca Valeri, Paolo Ferrari, Alessandro Gassmann, Alberto Pezzotta

title: L'uomo dalla croce
synopsis: In the summer of 1942, a chaplain following the Italian army in Russia decides to stay next to an intractable wounded man even when the rest of the unit is ordered to move. The two are taken prisoner. Roberto Rossellini shoots the film in Ladispoli with non-professional actors. The question is still open: propaganda film or impressive prelude to neorealism? Probably both.
cast: Alberto Tavazzi, Roswita Schmidt, Attilio Dottesio

title: L'uomo del colpo perfetto
synopsis: Agent Steve Norton investigates the disappearance of a shipment of diamonds en route from Lebanon to Amsterdam. The manager looks like a French colleague of his, but the gang leader is actually someone else. A film devoid of originality and that minimum of rhythm necessary to not fall asleep.
cast: Richard Harrison, Alida Chelli, Luis Davila

title: L'uomo del grano
synopsis: Lives, thoughts and works of Nazareno Strampelli, an Italian agronomist and geneticist who lived between the 19th and 20th centuries, who studied wheat for a long time.
cast: Carlo Greco, Denis Fasolo, Cosimo Piccini, Leonardo Baudena, Consuelo Ciatti, Anna Valeria Dini, Stefano Venturi, Massimo Avella, Ilva Fontana, Daniele De Martino, Alessandra Battaglia

title: L'uomo del labirinto
synopsis: Samantha Andretti was kidnapped one winter morning on her way to school. Fifteen years later, she wakes up in a hospital room without remembering where she has been or what has happened to her in all that time. Next to her is a profiler, Dr. Green: he claims that he will help her recover her memory and that together they will capture the monster. But he warns her that the hunt won't take place out there in the real world. But in his mind. Bruno Genko, on the other hand, is a private investigator. Fifteen years earlier he was hired by Samantha's parents to find their daughter. Now that the girl has reappeared, he feels he owes her a debt and will try to capture the faceless man who kidnapped her. But Genko's is also a fight against time: a doctor told him that he has two months to live. And, by a twist of fate, those two months expired on the very day Samantha came back from the dark. Who will come to the truth first: the investigator or the profiler? But are we sure that, in the end, there is only one truth? This, after all, is not an investigation like any other: someone has a secret, someone is lying. And somewhere out there is a labyrinth full of doors. And behind each one there is an enigma, a deception
cast: Toni Servillo, Dustin Hoffman, Valentina Bellè, Vinicio Marchioni, Caterina Shulha, Filippo Dini, Orlando Cinque, Sergio Grossini, Carla Cassola, Sergio Leone (II), Marta Richeldi, Stefano Rossi Giordani, Riccardo Cicogna, Diego Facciotti, Luis Gnecco

title: L'uomo del vento
synopsis: Massimo, a young air force pilot who, due to an accident, caused the wounding of some elementary school children, abandons the body. The man resumes his psychology studies that he had prematurely interrupted and becomes a support teacher in the class victim of the disaster. The parents suspect nothing of Massimo's past and entrust him with their children still in shock. The situation will get complicated when Alida, a young widowed mother of Giulio who has since been unable to speak, begins to suspect him. Then one day the truth comes out ...
cast: Alessio Boni, Tosca D'Aquino, Niccolò Branchi, Sophia Lewis, Matteo Malfetti

title: L'uomo della carità - Don Luigi di Liegro
synopsis: Luigi di Liegro, since he was a child on the side of the weakest, was ordained a priest. In the 1950s, in Belgium, he worked as a miner alongside Italian immigrants; in the 1960s, he faces misery in Janus; in the 1970s, he discovers the bestial conditions in which the sick are found in shelters and lays the first stone of Caritas ...
cast: Giulio Scarpati, Carlo Giuseppe Gabardini, Simone Gandolfo, Chiara Gensini, Ugo Conti, Claudia Coli, Flavio Pistilli, Moira Grassi, Marcello Arnone, Renato Carpentieri

title: L'uomo della fortuna
synopsis: Every morning Antonio interprets the dreams for the numerous patrons of a lottery shop, where he works, in the popular district of Naples. One night he saves the life of a mysterious old man who is about to be run over by a van. The man to repay him gives him the numbers written on a piece of paper. In numbers they come out and get Nicola, lucky player, chronically unemployed and friend of Antonio, a win of five billion. From this moment the life of the two undergoes a sharp turn.
cast: Sergio Assisi, Giovanni Esposito, Burt Young, Tony Sperandeo

title: L'uomo della strada fa giustizia
synopsis: During a robbery, the little girl of the engineer Vannucchi is accidentally killed by a gunshot. After being attacked with his wife, the desperation of the violence suffered leads Vannucchi to swear revenge. The police, however, do little and so the engineer decides to investigate on his own.
cast: Henry Silva, Luciana Paluzzi, Silvano Tranquilli, Claudio Gora, Raymond Pellegrin

title: L'uomo della valle maledetta
synopsis: Despite her father's ban, Gwen marries the Indian Torito and follows him to his camp. When the latter is attacked by an enemy tribe, the girl is kidnapped: however, she manages to escape and is saved by Johnny, a lonely cowboy ...
cast: Ty Hardin, Iran Eory, Peter Larry, José Nieto

title: L'uomo delle stelle
synopsis: Joe Morelli is an enterprising character, but not very clear: he pretends to be the discoverer of new talent for cinema. Around the miserable villages of post-war Sicily, he harangues the inhabitants at the megaphone, promising a brilliant career at Cinecittà to those who pass an accurate audition. Joe is the man who can perform the miracle of transforming a poor, marginalized and miserable existence into a rich and admired life. So everyone falls for it: immature girls, frustrated women, shepherds, carabinieri, fishermen. "The man of the stars" is a story of fascination, of illusions, of lies. A celluloid scam that allows, by going beyond its own intentions, to bring to the surface thoughts never expressed, hopes, nuanced sensations and nostalgia. Focused on the murders of five schoolgirls, now mothers of families, killed one by one by the ghost of a vengeful nun, it is based above all on splatter effects and thunderous soundtrack. Devoid of anti-clerical ambitions, the film is a simple game of massacre, disengaged like many US counterparts: in fact it works as long as there is blood on the stage. The tension subsides, unfortunately, when the dialogues are not very incisive, despite some flash of metacinematographic irony that amuses the cinephile. Shot in English, and only later dubbed in Spanish, it seems made to be sold abroad, winks at Robert Rodriguez's The Faculty and James Wong's Final Destination.
cast: Belén Blanco, Oriana Bonet, Anita Briem, Teté Delgado, Natalia Dicenta, Alistair Freeland, Manu Fullola, Paulina Gálvez, Lola Marceli, Cristina Piaget

title: La Napoli di Marotta
synopsis: Documentary on the Neapolitan writer Giuseppe Marotta: the personal vision of his city, the passion for cinema and interviews with critics and filmmakers.
cast: Cesare Zavattini, Vittorio De Sica, Carlo Bernardi, Domenico Rea, Giovanni Artieri, Belisario Randone

title: La Niña
synopsis: A former Colombian guerrilla fighter faces challenges as she reintegrates into society and tries to overcome her traumatic memories.
cast: Ana María Estupiñán, Sebastian Eslava, Juan Sebastián Aragón, Diego Vásquez, Carlos Velazquez, Marcela Benjumea, Melisa Caceres, Michelle Orozco, Alberto Cardeño, Constanza Camelo, Fernando Arévalo

title: La Notte
synopsis: The union of the writer Giovanni and his wife Lidia has now come to a standstill. Between boredom, sketchy flirtations and aimless wanderings, the two, sometimes together, sometimes separated, spend a gray day, gripped by their inner malaise. The dawn of the next day, however, surprises them in a fleeting moment of happiness.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Jeanne Moreau, Monica Vitti, Bernhard Wicki, Rosy Mazzacurati, Maria Pia Luzi

title: La Notte del mio primo amore
cast: Claudia Venturini, Damiano Verrocchi, Alice Visconti, Luca Bastianello

title: La Nouvelle Guerre des Boutons
synopsis: March 1944. While the world is torn apart by the Second World War and the Germans have occupied France, another great little conflict is taking place between the children of Longeverne and Velran, two neighboring villages. The battles involve winning children tearing the buttons of their clothes off the losers to leave them naked and suffer further punishment from their parents when they return home. At the head of the Longeverne gang is the thirteen-year-old Lebrac, who guides the actions of his friends and who finds himself in love when Violette, a little girl from the city, arrives at the guest village in the house of aunt Simone. Violette's appearance, however, raises the suspicion that she is of Jewish origin and, when this becomes certain, Lebrac does his utmost to ensure that she is not reported to the authorities.
cast: Laetitia Casta, Guillaume Canet, Kad Merad, Gérard Jugnot, Jean Texier, Clément Godefroy, Théophile Baquet, Louis Dussol, Harold Werner, Nathan Parent, Ilona Bachelier, Thomas Goldberg

title: La Novia
synopsis: The bride, tormented and unhappy, prepares for the wedding with the fiancé she does not love in the middle of a white desert. An invisible thread, fierce and impossible to break, will however connect her to Leonardo, with whom she had a history in the past.
cast: Manuela Velles, Leticia Dolera, Inma Cuesta, Asier Etxeandia, Álex García, María Alfonsa Rosso, Ana Fernandez, Carlos Álvarez Novoa, Verónica Moral, Mariana Cordero

title: La Novizia
