synopsis: Called to assist an old dying libertine, a nun, on modest and fearful paper, but all too willing to undress her cassock, she is the object of the morbid attentions of the sick nephew, who in the end will be killed by the young woman's mother as guilty of his renunciation of votes.
cast: Gloria Guida, Gino Milli, Femi Benussi, Fiore Altoviti, Beppe Loparco, Maria Pia Conte, Pino Sciacqua, Vera Drudi, Lionel Stander

title: La Nuée
synopsis: Virginie lives on a farm with her children Laura and Gaston, raising grasshoppers for their high protein content. However, things do not go as he would like, money is scarce, practical problems are increasing, tensions with children are on the agenda and discussions with neighbors are not lacking. But everything changes the day he discovers that grasshoppers have a strange passion for blood.
cast: Suliane Brahim, Nathalie Boyer, Sofian Khammes, Victor Bonnel, Marie Narbonne, Raphael Romand

title: La Odisea de los Giles
synopsis: Argentina, 2001. A group of inhabitants of a small town collects their savings for a dream project and entrusts them to a local bank. An unscrupulous lawyer, in league with the director, takes advantage of the situation and robs them of everything. Months later, gossip spreads about where the money might be hidden. The group then gathers, waiting for the right moment to act and recover the money.
cast: Ricardo Darín, Chino Darín, Luis Brandoni, Andrés Parra, Rita Cortese, Verónica Llinás, Carlos Belloso, Daniel Aráoz

title: La Palmira - Ul film
synopsis: The Palmira with its decisive pace, which does not betray its age, wanders the streets of Mendrisio. Meanwhile, a clown tries to amuse the director of the circus Beck, who has just arrived in the town. Palmira is looking for her husband Geni, who does not give up an extra glass of wine, and her sister-in-law Miglieta, who only aims to read the scriptures in church. Don Giovanni, the parish priest who arrived a couple of years ago and assisted by Ersilia, the perpetual who feeds on soap operas and TV broadcasts, prevents him from doing so. She is so nosy that she wonders why Don Giovanni changes parish every two years. And what is your relationship with Elisabetta, the assistant to the circus director? Two different worlds oppose each other: the simpleton on one side and the crafty ones on the other, who are ready to do anything to revive the fortunes of the circus on the brink of failure. The discovery of a Picasso in the Miglieta room will be decisive, capable of inducing unpredictable actions.
cast: Rodolfo Bernasconi, Germano Porta, Valerio Sulmoni, Flavio Sala, Diego Bernasconi, Francesca Bernasconi, Federico Caprara, Simona Bernasconi, Michael Betti, I Legnanesi

title: La Panthère des neiges
synopsis: The director Marie Amiguet places her room on the Tibetan plateau accompanied by the naturalist photographer Vincent Munier and the writer Sylvain Tesson. Their goal is to be able to capture the Nevi leopard.

title: La Passion Béatrice
synopsis: In the early 1300s a French gentleman left his castle to go to war. Little François doesn't have time to greet the parent who catches his mother in bed with her lover. The kid doesn't think twice and kills the man. Grown up, François goes to war, accompanied by his son Arnaud, leaving his wife and daughter Beatrice at home. The two, after four years of imprisonment, return home and François, who falls in love with his daughter, rapes her.
cast: Bernard Pierre Donnadieu, Julie Delpy, Niels Tavernier, Monique Chaumette

title: La Patota
synopsis: Paulina decides to abandon her career as a lawyer in Buenos Aires to return to her native country, on the border between Argentina, Paraguay and Brazil, and work in a humble neighborhood. After two weeks of activity, however, she is brutally attacked by a gang. After the episode, instead of retracing her steps, Paulina will cling to her beliefs to move forward and not be overwhelmed.
cast: Dolores Fonzi, Oscar Martínez, Esteban Lamothe

title: La Pattuglia dell'Amba Alagi
synopsis: Following the defeat of Amba Alagi in Abyssinia, only Luciano survived his patrol and, after a long imprisonment, he manages to return to Italy. Here she makes a pilgrimage around the country fulfilling her promise to find the families of her fellow soldiers. Arriving in Milan he discovers that Mario, who had deserted just before the battle and, missing, had been given up for dead, has actually survived, but is in trouble with some smugglers. Luciano will try to help him get out of it.
cast: Luciano Tajoli, Milly Vitale, Giorgio De Lullo, Aldo Silvani, Dante Maggio, Carla Calò, Anna Campori, Annette Ciarli, Tina Lamar, Greta Mandrà, Nino Pavese, Olga Solbelli

title: La Petite Mort II
synopsis: The owners of the infamous Maison de la petite mort are grappling with their heinous daily work. But no one can ever imagine what the new owner, Monsieur Matheo Maxime, is capable of. Torturing for money will this time reach its maximum expression.
cast: Annika Strauss, Yvonne Wölke, Mika Metz, Micaela Schäfer, Gabriela Wirbel, Nicole Neukirch, Isabelle Fitzgerald, Bea La Bea, Ivana Konovic, Armin Barwich

title: La Pica sul Pacifico
synopsis: Adelaide, who has a craze for scientific experiments, discovers that she has inherited from her husband, who has abandoned her for years, an island in the South Seas. She moves there with the intention of continuing her studies. But when she arrives there with the firm intention of taking possession of what is due to her, she has to contend with a castaway who pretends to be the son of her deceased husband and with a fugitive convict, who have already made arrangements with the chief of the tribe that inhabits the island. to keep it away.
cast: Tina Pica, Memmo Carotenuto, Ugo Tognazzi, Elke Sommer

title: La Piloto
synopsis: Dreaming her whole life of becoming a pilot, Yolanda finds work as a flight attendant, unaware she'll soon be thrust into a drug smuggling operation.
cast: Livia Brito, Juan Eduardo Colucho, Arap Bethke, María Fernanda Yépes, Alejandro Nones, María De La Fuente, Verónica Montes, Natasha Domínguez, María Fernanda García, Mauricio Aspe, Stephanie Salas, Tommy Vasquez, Macarena Achaga

title: La Plaga
synopsis: Five people work on the outskirts of Barcelona and their streets cross daily. Iurie, a Moldovan wrestler awaiting Spanish documents, works as a farmer for Raul. Raul took over the company from his parents but an insect infested his fields threatening to ruin the harvest. Respiratory problems forced Maria, Raul's 90-year-old neighbor, to move to a retirement home where she meets Rosemarie, a Filipino nurse. Every day, Rosemarie goes to work on foot and catches a glimpse of Maribel, a woman who, by prostitution, tries to earn some money for herself and her unemployed son.
cast: Raül Molist, Maria Ros, Rosemarie Abella, Iurie Timbur, Maribel Martí

title: La Planque
synopsis: Kiko, Gilles and Pera rob a bank and escape with 45 million euros hidden in three Louis Vuitton bags. On leaving the building, however, they discover that Titi, the driver of the gang, has disappeared along with his Fiat Panda. To escape arrest, Kiko, the thinking mind of the trio, then suggests that his companions take refuge in a police station.
cast: Jalil Naciri, Gilles Bellomi, Ahcen Titi, Guillaume Verdier, Samira Lachhab, Dany Verissimo Petit, Kamel Laadaili, Marco Locci, Antoine Basler, Ali Yaya

title: La Pointe-Courte
synopsis: Sète, a fishing village. While the inhabitants are grappling with daily problems, a man and a woman wonder about the meaning of their relationship.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Silvia Monfort

title: La Polinesia è sotto casa
synopsis: Stefano is a young man who could declare himself satisfied: he has a good job, a girlfriend, a house ... But inside him there is an unbearable need for elsewhere, as if he wanted to free himself from the relationships he feels are false and from his choices that he feels inadequate. to his real needs. It will be returning to his old love, surfing, that he will be able to take a journey within himself, in search of what really matters to him.
cast: Gianluca D'Ercole, Giulia Bellucci, Alessia Raccichini, Fabiana Baldinelli, Alessandro Gimelli, Tommaso Benvenuti, Pierfrancesco Pesaola

title: La Principessa e il povero
synopsis: King Hamil and his wife cannot have children; they will be able to get one thanks to the magic of Gamesh, the wizard-child. But the great sorcerer Epos, angry with the apprentice, intervenes and so the King finds himself the father of a little girl, Mirabella, who is actually the daughter of the peasant Sariba, while her son is raised in the house of the two poor farmers. together with another brother. Neither Gamesh nor Epos, however, know which of the two children, Leonardo and Ademarco, is the real son of the King. The lives of the three young people will always be in the hands of the magicians Epos and Gamesh who, while not being able to influence their feelings, nevertheless manage to change the events of their destiny ...
cast: Mathieu Carrière, Anna Falchi, Nicholas Rogers, Thomas Kretschmann

title: La Prière
synopsis: Thomas, 22, is a drug addict. In an attempt to end his habits, he joins a community of ex-junkies who live isolated in the mountains and use prayer as a cure. Reluctant at first, Thomas gradually agrees to marry a Spartan life of discipline, abstinence, hard work and constant prayer. In this way he will discover faith but also love and a new kind of torment.
cast: Anthony Bajon, Damien Chapelle, Alex Brendemühl, Louise Grinberg, Antoine Amblard, Maïté Maillé, Magne Havard Brekke, Hanna Schygulla

title: La Rabbia Di Pasolini
synopsis: From the published and unpublished materials used by Pier Paolo Pasolini for his documentary _La rabbia_, Bertolucci, from an idea by Tatti Sanguinetti, assembles a new updated and reasoned version.
cast: Giorgio Bassani, Valerio Guttuso, Valerio Magrelli, Giuseppe Bertolucci

title: La Reina del Sur
synopsis: This compelling show tells the story of the legendary Teresa Mendoza, a courageous woman who is perceived as conquering the world of drug trafficking.
cast: Kate Del Castillo, Cristina Urgel, Alberto Jiménez, Juan José Arjona, Humberto Zurita, Dagoberto Gama, Christian Tappán, Miguel De Miguel, Salvador Zerboni, Carmen Navarro, Santiago Meléndez, Juan Carlos Solarte

title: La Reine Margot
synopsis: The marriage, dictated by reason of state, between Margaret of Valois, sister of Charles IX of France and daughter of Caterina de 'Medici, with the Huguenot Henry of Navarre; the hideous court intrigues; the massacre of the Huguenots on the night of San Bartolomeo (1572); the love between Margot and La Motte, who escaped the monstrous massacre of his parents; the passage of Margot herself in the camp of the oppressed ... Dumas father's novel finds in Chéreau's film a sumptuous but unsatisfactory version, "fictional" in the most superficial sense of the term, which sacrifices many big-name actors and "cast" Isabelle Adjani. Palme d'Or in Cannes for Virna Lisi.
cast: Isabelle Adjani, Daniel Auteuil, Jean Hugues Anglade, Virna Lisi, Asia Argento

title: La Robe De Mariage Des Cieux
synopsis: It was with much difficulty that Ai Qing was able to save enough money and arrive in her dream place, Paris. As a result, she was extremely happy about this. At the same time, Zi Hao is also in Paris receiving an international fashion award, the grand prize. They both got into a big argument at a small artistic shop over a small wooden horse that they both fell in love with. In the end, with the owner's consent, Ai Qing is able to obtain the wooden horse. The accidental meeting at the airport and on the plane, cause the two of them to have an even more unfavorable impression of each other. Both were rejoicing at the fact that after this trip, they would never have to see each other again. However, who would have expected that these two people's destinies are forever intertwined tightly together. (Source: Lunardreamz)
tags: Fashion Designer, Older Man/Younger Woman, Enemies To Lovers, Boss-Employee Relationship, Female Chases Male First, Rich Man/Poor Woman, Unrequited Love, Filmed Abroad, Love Triangle, Sports
cast: Cyndi Wang, Leon Jay Williams

title: La Robe De Mariee Des Cieux
synopsis: After a chance encounter that ends on bad terms, two clashing strangers soon cross paths again as their fates become inevitably intertwined.
cast: Cyndi Wang, Leon Jay Williams, Chu Chung Heng, Michael Tao, Ming Dao, Jacky Chu, Ehlo Huang, Terri Kwan

title: La Ronde
synopsis: The prostitute and the soldier; the soldier and the maid, who then ends up with the master's son. A young wife refuses to betray her husband who, on the other hand, does not have too many scruples in the face of the occasion. A poet, an actress, a count ... After a troubled night, the latter courts the prostitute of the beginning. Between one meeting and another, the images of a riding school and the melody of a waltz and a carillon that looks so much like the cinema machine. Passionate encounters without tomorrow, in a Vienna of other times. From Arthur Schnitzler's comedy, a sparkling film, staged by a Max Ophüls in a state of grace and starring an absolutely extraordinary cast of actresses and actors. A reflection on death, time and cinema, with a sumptuous style that has made school.
cast: Anton Walbrook, Simone Signoret, Gérard Philipe, Danielle Darrieux, Daniel Gélin, Jean Louis Barrault, Isa Miranda

title: La Rosa de Guadalupe
synopsis: This series responds to the need to believe in miracles, dreams, love stories and happy endings, with positive characters.
cast: Milia Nader, Francisco Avendaño, Diego Lara, Sandra Itzel, Marisol Del Olmo, Aleyda Gallardo, Gerardo Murguía, Roxana Saucedo, Emmanuel Orenday, Maru Dueñas

title: La Roue
synopsis: A driver of the French railways finds among the wreckage of a derailed train a little girl who is still alive and who has lost her parents in the accident. Despite being a widower and father of a male child (and therefore the only one to take care of the family), he decides to keep her for himself and, to avoid problems related to an impossible adoption, he passes her off as his daughter. Fifteen years later he will find himself so in love with the child that he became a woman, which will lead him to become a drunkard who goes mad with jealousy when the girl (also courted by her stepbrother) falls in love with an engineer who marries her.
cast: Séverin Mars, Ivy Close, Gabriel De Gravone, Pierre Magnier, Max Maxudian, Georges Térof, Gil Clary

title: La Région Centrale
synopsis: In an absolutely wild place, in the mountains of Québec, the camera moves on itself, in a continuous 360-degree panorama, with variations on the vertical axis and in the focal distance of the lens, controlled from a distance. An "extreme" film conceived as an eye without a body, which floats in space in a seamless environmental research.

title: La Résistance de l'air
synopsis: Vincent is champion in shooting from 300 meters. He lives an orderly existence with his wife and daughter when he is forced to house his sick father, an intrusive and harmful man, at least for the time needed to find him a new home. To offer him moments of relief will be the meeting with Renaud, a fifty-year-old with a friendly gaze who will offer him a "particular" contact, capable of triggering an increasingly dangerous mechanism.
cast: Reda Kateb, Ludivine Sagnier, Tchéky Karyo, Johan Heldenbergh, Pascal Demolon, Laure De Clermont Tonnerre, Mathéo Capelli

title: La Révolution
synopsis: In a reimagined history, a mysterious disease besets 18th century France, culminating in a brutal clash between rebels and the aristocracy.
cast: Amir El Kacem, Marilou Aussilloux, Lionel Erdogan, Isabel Aimé Gonzalez Sola, Julien Frison, Doudou Masta, Dimitri Storoge, Amélia Lacquemant, Coline Beal, Laurent Lucas, Gaia Weiss, Chiara Tantimonaco, Nina Tantimonaco, Pierre Andrau, Philippine Martinot, Jérémie Covillault

title: La Sacra famiglia
synopsis: Mary and Joseph meet in Jerusalem and embark on a journey to Nazareth, which will lead them to get to know each other and slowly love each other, even if both hardly admit their feelings. The most reticent is Joseph, who has already had a wife and is the father of two sons and a girl, and feels too old for Mary.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Ana Caterina Morariu, Brando Pacitto, Massimiliano Varrese, Franco Nero, Angela Molina, Dino Abbrescia, Gian Luca Belardi, Giacomo Gonnella, Stefano Guerrieri

title: La Sapienza
synopsis: The architect Alexandre, who has lost all inspiration after the death of his eight-year-old daughter suffering from trisomy, goes in search of the reasons that in the past, fascinated by the Baroque of Guarini in Turin and Borromini in Rome, pushed him to take up that profession. Traveling with his wife Alienor, in Stresa he has the opportunity to meet a couple of brother and sister, Goffredo and Lavinia. While the girl is suffering from a rare disease of nervous origin, Goffredo is about to undertake architecture studies.
cast: Fabrizio Rongione, Christelle Prot, Arianna Nastro, Ludovico Succio

title: La Señal
synopsis: It was a great success in Argentina, where it hit the box office and racked up prizes. Nostalgic detective story, set in 1952, during the last days of Eva Perón's life, La Señal is a dark detective story, a dark reinterpretation of the noir according to Tourneur. Project with a difficult birth: based on a novel by Eduardo Mignogna, also author of the transposition, who should have directed the film, is taken over by the protagonist Ricardo Darín (seen in XXY) after the sudden death of the author. A co-director, Martin Hodara, a second screenwriter and several assistants put their hand to work: luckily the result is compact, even if the story already knows. Quotations are wasted, with the sad faces of Darín and Diego Peretti as a stylistic code and the usual ineffable femme fatale to give a hard time to the anti-heroes whose destiny is already marked from the start. Bitter ending on the notes of a splendid soundtrack.
cast: Ricardo Darín, Diego Peretti, Julieta Diaz, Andrea Pietra, Vando Villamil, Carlos Bardem

title: La Sfida
synopsis: Vito manages, with violence, to place his products on the fruit and vegetable market, where a powerful Camorra player is the undisputed master. To avoid harmful consequences, the two come to terms. Some time later, Vito is now rich and, trusting too much in his new condition, he makes the mistake of challenging his opponent once again.
cast: Rosanna Schiaffino, José Suarez, Nino Vingelli, Decimo Cristiani, José Jaspe, Tina Castigliano, Elsa Valentino Ascoli, Pasquale Cennamo, Nello Ascoli, Salvatore Cafiero

title: La Sicilia rivisitata
synopsis: The film, originally divided into four episodes, is produced by Rai. Although presented without interruption, the scan impressed on the work by the author remains, which returns after more than twenty years from the first film dedicated to the island. The first part concerns swordfish fishing, from new techniques to indiscriminate hunting. Then he moves to the Aeolian Islands devastated by mass tourism and building speculation. The third stage is divided into two: on one side the sulfur mines, in the past a source of livelihood for thousands of Sicilians and today almost completely closed; on the other hand, today's Easter celebrations contrasted with the ceremonies of the 1950s. The fourth episode closes this moving and austere, dismayed and rigorous reconnaissance, with the rite of wheat harvesting and tuna fishing in Favignana.

title: La Sirga
synopsis: Alicia cannot get out of the eyes the images of the war he has lived on his own skin. Only and lost, she decides to go far from the places that recall her the terrible memories of her and she decides to manage the Sigra, a dilapidated pension on the banks of a small lagoon among the high mountains of the Andes. The pension, however, belongs to his only family member, the elderly and lonely Oscar, with whom he has the opportunity to clash several times. When Alice seems to buy light -heartedness and serenity, the shadow of a new war manifests himself on the horizon bringing fear and terror in his life.
cast: Joghis Arias, Julio César Roble, David Guacas, Heraldo Romero, Floralba Achicanoy

title: La Solita Commedia - Inferno
synopsis: 2015: Hell is in chaos. A host of new sinners arrive every day to crowd the offices of Minos. But Hell is an old, antiquated structure: the new sinners, not finding a right place, are dispersed among the groups. Lucifer is received directly by God, who seeks a solution. The winning idea is a cataloging of the new sins on Earth. And who to entrust the task to if not Dante Alighieri, who already once, in his time, carried out this task with excellent results? Dante is thus catapulted into a large Italian city, and finally finds his guide, the one who will accompany him in search of "new sins": Demetrio Virgilio, a precarious thirty-year-old who is preparing, like every morning, to face another "day" of Hell ".
cast: Francesco Mandelli, Fabrizio Biggio, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Marco Foschi, Paolo Pierobon, Tea Falco, Daniela Virgilio, Giordano De Plano
director: Francesco Mandelli, Fabrizio Biggio, Martino Ferro

title: La Stella della porta accanto
synopsis: Matteo, a ten-year-old boy who grew up far from Italy and lost his mother, lives with his father who is forced to travel a lot for work. But one day Matteo arrives in Rome with his parent and his sister Giulia. Conflicts break out between the three and rancor resurfaces ...
cast: Bianca Guaccero, Giorgio Lupano, Stefania Orsola Garello, Sergio Fiorentini, Emanuele Guerrini, Rodolfo Laganà

title: La Strada
synopsis: Gelsomina is a candid girl who has a strange relationship, made of love and awe, with Zampanò, a rough wanderer who earns his living with circus acts. One day he kills the "Fool", another globetrotter to whom Gelsomina has become friends. The girl, upset, goes mad. Zampanò abandons her but, later, on hearing of his death, he bursts into tears.
cast: Giulietta Masina, Anthony Quinn, Richard Basehart

title: La Stratégie de la poussette
synopsis: Thomas (Raphaël Personnaz), in his thirties with little desire to take responsibility, let Marie (Charlotte Lebon) go away without doing anything to keep her. A year later, still inconsolable, Thomas finds himself with a baby in his arms. He will use the newborn to try to win back the love of his life.
cast: Raphaël Personnaz, Charlotte Le Bon, Jérôme Commandeur, Camelia Jordana, Julie Ferrier, François Berléand, François Civil, Clément Michel

title: La Tempesta
synopsis: On vacation in the tropics with his wife, the entrepreneur Aldo De Serio disappears after a tsunami. Nobody manages to contact him and his presence is necessary both in his ceramics company and to welcome the newly adopted Belarusian child at the Natoli airport. Since we need to find someone to replace him, the most eligible is his brother Paolo, a big kid who pretends to be a photographer with the aim of picking up the models. Before anyone notices the difference, Paolo must be transformed into a perfect father / manager but, luckily, the young worker Manuela, who despite hating Paolo loves little Natoli, helps him out.
cast: Giovanni Scifoni, Nicole Grimaudo, Nino Frassica, Leonardo Della Bianca, Ennio Fantastichini, Anna Bellato, Stefano Fresi, Gianantonio Martinoni, Giovanni Maria Buzzatti

title: La Tendresse
synopsis: Frans and Lisa have been separated for fifteen years but find themselves forced to go on a two-day trip together to join their son, who is hospitalized in a hospital abroad following a skiing accident. Although a long time has passed and they pretend indifference, the two former spouses still feel resentment and jealousy and the trip offers them the opportunity to find themselves in close contact. From Brussels to the Alps, they will have the opportunity to discuss and discover that there is still some affection between them that unites them.
cast: Olivier Gourmet, Marilyne Canto, Adrien Jolivet, Margot Chatelier, Sergi López

title: La Terra Trema
synopsis: The fisherman 'Ntoni Valastro and his family live and work in Aci Trezza, exploited, despite their profound misery, by wholesale fish traders. Tired of suffering the abuses of wholesalers, 'Ntoni incites the other fishermen to rebel against the oppressive situation which has now become intolerable. Colleagues, convinced by 'Ntoni's proposal, cause riots to break out. Determined to go out on his own, 'Ntoni mortgages the house and buys a boat of his own. From "I Malavoglia" by Verga, Visconti draws a film that borders on the documentary (the actors are real fishermen who speak in dialect) and accentuates the "political" tones of the story, divided between realism and contemplative pessimism, leading neorealism to refined aestheticism.
cast: Antonio Arcidiacono, Maria Micale, Sebastiano Valastro

title: La Terre et le Sang
synopsis: Saïd owns a sawmill deep in the Ardennes, which he decides to sell to ensure a better future for his 18-year-old daughter Sarah. He does not know, however, that one of the former convicts and young offenders he used to hire was cornered by his brother and forced to hide a large amount of cocaine within the business. When the cartel to which the drug belongs shows up, Saïd quickly realizes the dangerous situation he and his daughter are in.
cast: Sami Bouajila, Eriq Ebouaney, Samy Seghir, Carole Weyers, Sofia Lesaffre, Eric Kabongo

title: La Tierra y la Sombra
synopsis: An old farmer returns to his home but is completely alienated from his family and the village where he grew up. Amidst the vast sugar cane fields, danger looms on all sides and industrial progress is bringing profound transformations to the world of the poor countryside.
cast: Haimer Leal, Hilda Ruiz, Marleyda Soto, José Felipe, Edison Raigosa

title: La Tortue rouge
synopsis: A man abandoned on a desert island tries desperately to escape. But one day, he meets a strange turtle that will change the rest of his life forever.

title: La Tosca
synopsis: Rome, 1800. Mario Cavaradossi, Tosca's lover, hides Angelotti, an escaped patriot. Scarpia, head of the papal police, through the woman discovers the refuge of the fugitive, who kills himself. Tosca and her lover are locked up in Castel Sant'Angelo and the policeman has the opportunity to end all his perfidy in view of the tragic epilogue.
cast: Monica Vitti, Gigi Proietti, Umberto Orsini, Aldo Fabrizi

title: La Vacanza
synopsis: Valerio (Antonio Folletto) is a thirty year old who seems to be able to live his life just trying to destroy it. Carla (Catherine Spaak) is still a beautiful woman, a former magistrate who is beginning to show the first symptoms of Alzheimer's but with an overwhelming will to live. Valerio and Carla are two tormented souls, who find in an unexpected friendship the strength to deal with the pains and secrets of their past. They are both related to Anneke (Veruschka), a mysterious woman. Theirs is the journey of two people so far away, yet so close, in the most painful emotions that will lead them to discover a new way to love.
cast: Antonio Folletto, Catherine Spaak, Veruschka Von Lehndorff, Carla Signoris, Luca Biagini, Martina Klier, Gianluca Cammisa

title: La Vacanza
cast: Vanessa Redgrave, Franco Nero, Leopoldo Trieste, Corin Redgrave

title: La Vallée
synopsis: La vallèe is a road movie in pure 1970s spirit set in New Guinea, which deals with the theme of freedom and the escape from the Western system by a group of hippies.
cast: Jérôme Beauvarlet, Monique Giraudy, Michael Gothard, Jean Pierre Kalfon, Valerie Lagrange, Bulle Ogier

title: La Venere dei pirati
synopsis: Sandra, daughter of Captain Mirko, is embarked on a slave ship by a wicked duchess. Having become a privateer, in the end she obtains justice and something more. Trivial and unimaginative adventure.
cast: Gianna Maria Canale, Massimo Serato, Livio Lorenzon, Scilla Gabel, Paul Müller

title: La Venere di Cheronea
synopsis: Wounded during the war against the Greeks, the Macedonian captain Luciano is rescued by Iris, a beautiful model who poses for the sculptor Praxiteles: the girl admits Luciano to the artist's home, and soon love breaks out between her and the warrior. . This arouses the irrepressible jealousy of Praxiteles, who in the face of the escape of the two lovers does not hesitate to report them to some Greek soldiers who were his guests at that time. Luciano and Iride are chased and joined: the first, hit by an arrow and believed dead, is abandoned, while Iris is led back to Praxiteles' study. But...
cast: Belinda Lee, Jacques Sernas, Massimo Girotti, Maria Frau, Luigi Tosi, Claudio Gora, Elli Parvo, Camillo Pilotto

title: La Vida y Nada Más
synopsis: Regina, a single mother, lives in North Florida with her children. In a context of social inequality, his life is made up of struggles to make ends meet, routine difficulties, behavioral problems of the child and the desire to become an integral part of the surrounding society.
cast: Andrew Bleechington, Regina Williams, Roberto Williams, Ry'Nesia Chamberszz

title: La Vie de Bohème
synopsis: Marcel, Shaunard and Rodolfo are respectively a writer, a pianist and a painter. Or rather, they try to be. They know and make friends in the name of the same miserable loneliness, the same disordered nonconformity. The three penniless live by expedients, but have not lost the taste for irony, the profound sense of friendship, the ability to cultivate hope and to believe that one day it will come true.
cast: Matti Pellonpää, Evelyne Didi, André Wilms, Kari Väänänen

title: La Virgen de Agosto
synopsis: In the hot summer months, when most of Madrid's residents leave the city to escape the sweltering heat, the city center is almost deserted. Only the tourists remain, those who are unable to leave and those who, like the charming thirty-year-old Eva, don't have a destination to grab and let themselves go to fleeting encounters and unexpected adventures.
cast: Itsaso Arana, Vito Sanz, Joe Manjón, Isabelle Stoffel, Mikele Urroz, Luis Alberto Heras

title: La Viuda Negra
synopsis: Beautiful and ruthless Griselda Blanco, known as the queen of cocaine, becomes Pablo Escobar's boss and governs a world of deceit and death.
cast: Ana Serradilla, Julián Román, Ramiro Meneses, Juan Pablo Gamboa, Eileen Moreno, Luis Alfredo Velasco, Margarita Reyes, Alexander Gil, Luis Roberto Guzmán, Raúl Méndez

title: La Vénus à la fourrure
synopsis: Playwright Thomas (Mathieu Amalric) intends to stage a play inspired by a text by Sacher Masoch but, after a long day of auditions, he cannot find the actress to entrust the role of the protagonist. Convinced that she is perfect for the part, Vanda (Emmanuelle Seigner), one of the aspiring protagonists who, with her vulgar and bizarre being, represents everything Thomas hates, comes to him by surprise and tries to show him that no one else is as suitable as she is. . During the audition, Vanda will demonstrate that she perfectly knows the text of the work and the attraction that Thomas will develop towards it will soon turn into an obsession.
cast: Emmanuelle Seigner, Mathieu Amalric

title: La Zona
synopsis: Alejandro, a boy from a good family, lives in the Zona, a neighborhood in Mexico City that is a real ghetto for the rich, guarded by private policemen. One night, three young men from the poor suburbs enter it to carry out a robbery that ends up in blood. The lone survivor is captured but, instead of handing him over to the police, the inhabitants decide to subject him to a summary trial ...
cast: Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Daniel Tovar, Maribel Verdú, Carlos Bardem, Marina De Tavira, Mario Zaragoza, Andrés Montiel, Blanca Guerra, Enrique Arreola, Gerardo Taracena

title: La antena
synopsis: In the Voiceless City, silence reigns supreme. Citizens have been reduced to mute beings whose only job is to watch the images of televisions controlled by Mr TV, a powerful tycoon who also manages the distribution of consumer products. Not satisfied with his power and domination over the population, Mr TV kidnaps La Voce, a famous singer who is left with the ability to pronounce words and whose son is a boy who cannot see, but who shares the rare gift with his mother of the voice. He is entrusted with the hope of citizens to thwart Mr TV's plans and return to normal.
cast: Valeria Bertuccelli, Alejandro Urdapilleta, Julieta Cardinali, Rafael Ferro, Florencia Raggi, Sol Moreno, Jonathan Sandor, Raúl Hochman, Ricardo Merkin, Carlos Piñeiro

title: La baby-sitter
synopsis: Michelle, a girl who moved to Rome to study sculpture, supports herself by babysitting. She ends up involved in the kidnapping of Booth, the son of Franklin, a wealthy industrialist. The plan is orchestrated by the rich man's secretary and implemented by Ann, an actress who had once been the mistress of the captain of industry. Segregated with the kidnapped in a villa, Michelle tries unsuccessfully to escape to warn the police and the searches for her boyfriend are also in vain. But unexpected help will come.
cast: Maria Schneider, Sydne Rome, Renato Pozzetto, Nadja Tiller, Clelia Matania

title: La badessa di Castro
synopsis: In 1600 Elena, it sucks, brought her repressions into the convent of Castro making use of the authority that her position gives her. Becoming abbess, he manages to subtract a friar surprised in unequivocal attitudes with a nun from punishment. The abbess offers to help them in escape, but cannot prevent the two, surrounded by the bishop's forces, take their lives. Sister Elena waiting for a child from the bishop, is put under investigation by the inquisition and tortured to death.
cast: Barbara Bouchet, Pier Paolo Capponi, Evelyn Stewart, Antonio Cantafora, Mara Venier

title: La baie des anges
synopsis: Thanks to a colleague, a young bank employee from Paris discovers the evil charm of roulette. At the Casino of Nice he meets and falls in love with a charming lady (Jeanne Moreau, here unusually blonde) who has abandoned her family for a passion for gambling. A strong attraction arises between the two, often questioned by the vice of gambling, especially by women. In the end, however, it seems that she too wants to accept that new bet which is love.
cast: Jeanne Moreau, Claude Mann, Paul Guers, Henri Nassiet, André Certes, Nicole Chollet, Georges Alban, Conchita Parodi, Jacques Moreau, André Canter

title: La balena di Rossellini
synopsis: In May 1971 the director Roberto Rossellini made a trip to Chile to make an interview-portrait of Salvador Allende. Back from Santiago de Chile, he then read in a newspaper the news of a whale stranded near the coast of a very poor fishing village. The result was then a cinematographic subject for an apologue on wealth and poverty, whose shooting he wanted to entrust to the very young pupil Claudio Bondi. However, the project failed and 39 years later Bondi traces the events through memories and testimonies.
cast: Roberto Rossellini, Renzo Rossellini, Emidio Greco, Adriano Aprà, Enrico Ghezzi, Roberto Herlitzka, Franco Ferrarotti

title: La balia
synopsis: Doctor Mori, a silent and isolated neuropsychiatrist, is married to Vittoria. Their existence seems peaceful, but the birth of a child causes the crisis to explode. The newborn refuses the mother's milk and this causes in Vittoria a sort of refusal of the child. Mori is forced to hire Annetta a nurse with an instinctive character who will plunge Vittoria into a deep crisis.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Maya Sansa, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio

title: La ballade des Dalton
synopsis: The four Dalton brothers, the most dangerous outlaws in the West, escape from prison to take out the jurors who sentenced an old uncle to death. But cowboy Lucky Luke stands in the way of the fearsome quartet's plans ...
director: René Goscinny, Henri Gruel, Morris, Pierre Watrin

title: La ballata dei gusci infranti
synopsis: At the foot of the Sibillini Mountains, in the Marche Apennines, stories of different characters are intertwined who must all deal with the consequences of the earthquake. Jacopo is the madman of the village, a friend of the young African parish priest who recently arrived in the city. Her parents, the actress Alba and the playwright Dante are organizing a show on Dante's paradise. Lucia, Jacopo's friend, is abandoned by her husband and finds herself dealing with the family farm. In a nearby village, David and Elisabetta await the birth of their first child, anguished by a thousand fears.
cast: Caterina Shulha, Simone Riccioni, Paola Lavini, Miloud Mourad Benamara, Barbara Enrichi, Lina Sastri, Giorgio Colangeli, Samuele Sbrighi

title: La ballata dei lavavetri
synopsis: At the end of the 1980s, a Polish family from Radom landed in Rome waiting to obtain a visa for Canada. At the beginning, all the members of the family work to make ends meet: Janusz, the head of the family washes the windows of the cars at a traffic light together with his brother Zygmunt and Rafal, while Helena, his new partner and daughter Justyna are hired as a maid. But one day Janusz disappears and Pope Woityla appears to Zygmunt, now desperate.
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Agata Buzek, Olek Mincer, Eljana Nikolova Popova

title: La ballata dei mariti
synopsis: Giulio and Armando, married respectively to Franca and Susi, to attempt an escape from their gray and flat married life, make their women believe they are engaged in a delicate and dangerous mission. Arriving in the Sila they meet two girls and are involved in the theft of a necklace so they end up in the police station. Reached by their spouses they see their sentimental adventure fade but they manage to hide the attempted escapade from their wives.
cast: Memmo Carotenuto, Aroldo Tieri, Marisa Del Frate, Margaret Lee, Xenia Valderi, Luciano Marin, Umberto Raho, Franco Giacobini, Evi Marandi

title: La ballerina e il buon Dio
synopsis: Having escaped from the home of his adoptive parents, little Marietto (Angeletti) chooses Camilla (Cecova), a dancer seen in the photograph, as his mother. He manages to track her down and be hosted for a night, but then he realizes that he is in her way and walks away. It will be the girl, troubled by his escape, to set out on his trail with her boyfriend. The little one is found and the three begin a life together.
cast: Vera Cecova, Marietto Angeletti, Vittorio De Sica, Gabriele Ferzetti

title: La bambina che non voleva cantare
synopsis: Gabbro, province of Livorno, 1960. Nada is just seven years old when in church, during the choir rehearsal, Sister Margherita realizes that the girl has to sing. Gabbro is a small world populated by important people for Nada: the peasant father, taciturn and decisive, the ironic grandmother and the protective older sister; the doctor led protagonist of the fantasies of his mother Viviana; the bar of the daring Nora, who wears pants and has Cher in the juke box. But her mother Viviana is the most important of all and she knows that her daughter's talent is the occasion of her life. This certainty, however, is shaken by the dark times in which Viviana sinks into depression. Nada is convinced that her song can heal her and makes it her mission; for this he does not miss a lesson by the maestro Leonildo who plays the successes of Mina and Ornella Vanoni on the piano. Growing up Nada realizes that not even her voice can cure Viviana and she doesn't want to sing anymore. The singing, however, is stronger than everything and at fourteen he wins his first singing competition. It will be an impresario to convince Viviana that Nada is ready for the stage in Sanremo and there the "chick of Gabbro" sings frowning and grumpy But how cold it is, leaving everyone breathless. Nada's life changed forever; Viviana isn't convinced it was good, but Nada knows it's just the beginning of a happy adventure.
cast: Carolina Crescentini, Sergio Albelli, Paolo Calabresi, Tecla Insolia, Giulietta Rebeggiani, Paola Minaccioni, Massimo Poggio, Nunzia Schiano, Daria Pascal Attolini, Giulia Battistini

title: La bambina dalle mani sporche
synopsis: An incorruptible journalist investigates the shady handling of the industrialist Cucchi. Thus he gets to know his assistant: Wanda, childhood friend and first girlfriend of the journalist. A relationship of complicity is immediately established between the two, however, undermined by the working relationship (and perhaps not only such) between the woman and the entrepreneur.
cast: Sebastiano Somma, Ornella Muti, Michelle Bonev, Remo Girone, Giuliano Gemma, Bruno Bilotta, Maurizio Trombini, Eleonora Martinelli, Nicola Di Pinto, Vincent Schiavelli

title: La bambola di Satana
synopsis: The young Elizabeth inherits the castle of the very rich uncle, but once on the spot he learns that the place is bewitched. Fortunately there is already a possible buyer, Mr. Reynaud. But Elizabeth wants to see us clearly.
cast: Erna Schurer, Roland Carey, Aurora Bautista, Ettore Ribotta, Lucia Bomez, Manlio Salvatori, Franco Daddi, Beverly Fuller, Eugenio Galadini, Giorgio Gennari

title: La bambolona
synopsis: The mature lawyer Giulio Broggini, an unrepentant womanizer and bachelor who has no shortage of opportunities, sets his sights on the very young Ivana, who however turns out to be not easy prey. Giulio feels so attracted to her that he introduces himself to his parents, asking to be able to see her. Accustomed to quick conquests, the man realizes that Ivana is instead a very demanding type ...
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Isabella Rei, Lilla Brignone, Corrado Sonni, Roy Bosier, Marisa Bartoli, Margherita Guzzinati, Susy Andersen, Filippo Scelzo, Grazia Fei

title: La banca di Monate
synopsis: In order to defend his interests, a confectionery industrialist from Monate decides to found a bank in his country and to put the accountant Pigorini in charge. Juggling between the constant infidelities of his wife, a gang of bandits who threaten the bank and a risk of bankruptcy escaped in extremis, in the end Pigorini will manage to become the owner of the company thanks to the connivance with a powerful mafia exponent. The film is based on a story by Piero Chiara, who did not deserve to be mistreated in this way.
cast: Walter Chiari, Magali Noël, Vincent Gardenia, Paolo Bonacelli, Lia Tanzi, Quinto Parmeggiani, Giorgio Del Bene, Gian, Gigi Ballista, Luigi Diberti

title: La banda
synopsis: Story of friendship and betrayal between a group of young people from the same suburban neighborhood who call themselves "the gang". Five twelve-year-olds, full of dreams and fantasies: Dado is the boss and Rocco his best friend. Each of them has a wish to fulfill. Lele loves painting. Mirko studies racing car engines and knows how to repair everything. Dado loves courageous Captains, capable of extreme acts and gestures. Manolo is a shy introvert and dreams of a wife and children. Rocco is looking for a strong father figure who is almost a comic book hero. The little men grow up, betraying intentions and ambitions, until the situation turns into tragedy
cast: Claudio Vanni, Edoardo Leo, Ivan Lucarelli, Lele Vannoli

title: La banda Casaroli
cast: Renato Salvatori, Jean Claude Brialy, Tomas Milian, Gabriele Tinti

title: La banda Grossi
synopsis: In 1860, central Italy was governed by the State of the Church: the law of the Pope was in force for the entire territory of Lazio, Umbria, Marche and Romagna, with its own regulations and policies. In this historical context, a very poor farmhand named Terenzio Grossi, tired of being harassed by his bosses, gathers a gang of outlaws. With the complicity of a poor and hungry people, he will try to subvert the new authority. In two years of robberies, violence and murders against the powerful and bourgeois, the brigands will experience triumph and fortune in the face of an impotent, inadequate and cowardly public force. But there is a soldier who fights on the battlefield without cowardice and cowardice, he is a Brigadier of the Royal Carabinieri and is determined to carry out his task: to capture Terenzio Grossi and his gang of criminals. Righteous and incorruptible, he will have to deal with his conscience in the face of the poor reality of the Marche proletariat and when the law compromises to put an end to the crime, his integrity will be tested.
cast: Camillo Ciorciaro, Roberto Marinelli, Leonardo Ventura, Rosario DiGiovanna, Cristian Marletta, Mateo Cili, Manuel D'Amario

title: La banda J. & S. Cronaca criminale del Far West
synopsis: Jed Trigado is a bandit who only steals from the rich and keeps, with the proceeds of his businesses, his brother and all his gang. He supports Jed in his exploits Sonny, a resourceful girl with an easy gun. The frequent robberies induce Sheriff Franciscus to promise amnesty for all those who manage to capture them dead or alive. Regardless of the unleashed manhunt, Jed and Sonny enter the party organized by Garcia Moreno and his wife Linda and kidnap the woman.
cast: Tomas Milian, Susan George, Telly Savalas, Eduardo Fajardo

title: La banda Vallanzasca
synopsis: Escaped from Regina Coeli, Roberto is recruited by a criminal organization. In charge of kidnapping Antonella, he falls in love with her.
cast: Enzo Pulcrano, Gianni Diana, Stefania D'Amario, Antonella Dogan, Franco Garofalo, Paolo Celli, Liliana Chiari, Enrico Maisto, Franco Marino

title: La banda degli onesti
synopsis: The janitor Antonio Bonocore gets together with two friends to print counterfeit banknotes, but his son, a financier by profession, receives the task of discovering the gang. Now ready to try to sell their first "creature", the improvised counterfeiters accidentally use good paper money, which served as a model for the others. Crime is definitely not the bread for the teeth of Bonocore and his companions ...
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Gabriele Tinti, Giulia Rubini, Giacomo Furia, Yoka Berretty, Luigi Pavese, Annette Ciarli, Lauro Gazzolo, Salvo Libassi, Mario Meniconi

title: La banda dei Babbi Natale
synopsis: On the night of Christmas Eve, Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo - united by their passion for bowls - end up in the police station, accused of being three thieves. The interrogation, with a severe and maternal police inspector, becomes the starting point to tell about their complicated lives and the way they would like to change them: Aldo, an inveterate gambler, is temporarily unemployed; Giovanni, an unreliable veterinarian, is consumed in a multiple love life; Giacomo, a doctor by profession, has been living for too long in the memory of a missing wife. It strikes midnight ... will they be able to prove their innocence or will they end up behind bars?
cast: Antonia Liskova, Aldo Baglio, Angela Finocchiaro, Giorgio Colangeli, Massimo Popolizio, Giovanni Storti, Lucia Ocone, Giacomo Poretti, Giovanni Esposito, Silvana Fallisi, Mara Maionchi

title: La banda dei tre
synopsis: Claudio Bambola is an undercover narcotics agent. After two years of hard work is he about to carry out a roundup of those that make the news and that he will finally allow him? to change your life. The seizure of a twenty-kilo batch of pure cocaine. But a few days before the raid, the Makarovic brothers, a gang of Russian mobsters, intervene and all plans are blown. Where will he stay after a shooting? killed one of the brothers, unable to ask for help if not psychological to his boss Di Gaetano, Bambola will be seen? forced to resort to the same people he first had to frame, namely the Nano and Silvano.
cast: Marco Bocci, Francesco Pannofino, Carlo Buccirosso, Aldo Marinucci, Francesca Della Ragione, Roberta Mattei, Mirko Frezza, Ivan Franek, Matteo Branciamore

title: La banda del Gobbo
synopsis: Back from a long hiding, the bandit Vincenzo Marazzi, known as "the Hunchback" organizes a robbery. The shot succeeds, but his three accomplices, Sogliola, Perrone and Albanese, shoot him to eliminate him. The Hunchback, however, is saved and is hidden by a prostitute. He immediately carries out his revenge against his comrades, but the police are on his trail and, thanks to the help of his twin brother, they find him. The Hunchback tries to escape, but his car swerves and ends up in the river ...
cast: Tomas Milian, Pino Colizzi, Isa Danieli, Guido Leontini

title: La banda del Trucido
synopsis: Commissioner Ghini is the new head of the Antirapine Squad to replace Taddei, who died on the field. The case Ghini is working on is that of a Sicilian criminal, a certain Belli, who committed a massacre in an attempt to rob jewelry representatives. Lending a hand to Ghini will be "Monnezza", a criminal who has good reasons to take revenge on Belli ...
cast: Luc Merenda, Tomas Milian, Elio Zamuto, Franco Citti, Katia Christine

title: La banda del brasiliano
synopsis: Among the factories on the outskirts of Prato, the body of a ten-year-old child, who had previously disappeared, is found. The next day, a fifty-year-old employee is kidnapped from his office by a group of boys. Inspector Brozzi, near the pension, is in charge of following the case, together with the young and inexperienced Vannini. Suspicions fall on the "Brazilian gang", which previously unsuccessfully attempted to kidnap other people. The kidnappers are four boys in their thirties: the Biondo, the Mutolo, the Randagio and the Brazilian. The motive for the kidnapping will prove to be decidedly unusual.
cast: Carlo Monni, Luke Tahiti, Luca Spanò, Gabriele Pini, Alberto Innocenti, Luigi Milo

title: La banda del buco
synopsis: One day in Morbidone, the leader of a gang of rogues, a strange guy appears who claims to be his guardian angel. He begins to make speeches that are unusual for him: he speaks to him of honesty and righteousness. In short, he proposes to redeem him. Will he succeed?
cast: Claudio Villa, Maria Pia Casilio, Elio Crovetto, Mario Carotenuto

title: La bande des quatre
synopsis: Claude, Anna, Joyce and Lucia live together in a house in the north of Paris and all study drama. One evening Anna is saved from an attack by the intervention of a stranger who from that moment on begins to go around the house. There is a secret hidden in that house and there is a risk that the friendship between the girls will be shattered. The film is long, wordy and full of theatrical pieces (especially Racine) played by the girls, but it is also absolutely fascinating: Rivette, one of the boys of the nouvelle vague, has this great gift. If you accept his pace (which isn't overwhelming), you won't be able to do without him anymore.
cast: Bulle Ogier, Laurence Cote, Ines De Medeiros, Irène Jacob

title: La bande à Bonnot
synopsis: 1911: Paris is turned upside down by a handful of anarchists led by Jules Bonnot, who leads them in a series of car robberies. But the fate of Bonnot and his people (including his partner Maria-la-Belge, the poet Octave Garnier and the "philosopher" Raymond-la-Science) will be tragic.
cast: Bruno Cremer, Jacques Brel, Annie Girardot, Anne Wiazemsky

title: La baraonda - Passioni popolari
synopsis: Federico Salvi is a sports doctor on duty at the Six Days Cycling which is taking place at the Palasport in Milan. During the demonstration he is stalked by Erminia, a girl from Romagna, who a couple of years earlier had had a flirtation with him. The man not only does not remember having had that adventure, but he refuses to recognize the child born of the relationship. Erminia, exasperated by the situation, decides to leave with the baby. Vancini sketches a thin story without ever getting to deepen it.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Edy Angelillo, Wanda Aschel Bacciella, Marisa Bonati, Enrico Grazioli

title: La barbe bleue
synopsis: Adaptation of the famous Perrault fairy tale.
cast: Daphné Baiwir, Lola Creton, Dominique Thomas

title: La baronessa di Carini
synopsis: Sicily, 1860. Laura, a young noblewoman who grew up in a convent, is given in marriage to the baron of Carini, Don Mariano La Grua, an overbearing and lustful man. The young woman's life seems destined for unhappiness until she meets Luca Corbera, who comes to Carini in search of her origins. Accompanied by Enzo Santelia, his old friend, Luca learns of the story that took place three hundred years earlier in the abandoned castle where the then baroness was killed by her father after being discovered in the company of her lover. The tragic story seems to haunt Laura, prey to nightmares that poison her existence.
cast: Vittoria Puccini, Luca Argentero, Enrico Lo Verso, Lando Buzzanca, Alessandro Dieli, Simone Gandolfo, Lucia Sardo

title: La bataille de San Sebastian
synopsis: Chihuahua (Mexico), 1750: the bandit León Alastray is saved from being chased by the police by a priest, Father José. Shortly after, the priest was sent as punishment to the village of San Sebastián, in full Indian territory. On the death of Don José, killed by a bandit, it will be Leon who takes his place.
cast: Anthony Quinn, Anjanette Comer, Charles Bronson, Sam Jaffe, Silvia Pinal, Jorge Martínez De Hoyos, Jaime Fernandez, Rosa Furman, Leon Askin

title: La bataille du rail
cast: Tony Laurent, Lucien Deagneaux, Robert Leray, Jean Clarieux

title: La battaglia d'Inghilterra
synopsis: A group of German saboteurs infiltrates the Allies during the Dunkirk retreat: their aim is to disable the radar system on British soil to allow the bombing of London. Discovering the enemy plan by chance, Captain Stevens must identify the saboteurs, one of whom has even managed to settle in his house.
cast: Frederick Stafford, Van Johnson, Francisco Rabal, Luigi Pistilli, Renzo Palmer

title: La battaglia dei Mods
synopsis: Ricky, the son of a businessman, flees Liverpool due to a gang war that kills his girlfriend. Once in Rome, the boy has an affair with his father's lover ...
cast: Ricky Shayne, Joachim Fuchsberger, Enzo Cerusico, Solvi Stubing

title: La battaglia del deserto
synopsis: A captain and some English soldiers are sent into the desert to place mines on the roads that the German armored troops will travel: but a tank attack decimates the squad and forces the survivors to flee ...
cast: Robert Hossein, George Hilton, Frank Wolff, Rick Battaglia, Ivano Staccioli, Evely Stewart

title: La battaglia dell'ultimo panzer
synopsis: In a French town after the Normandy landings, the commander of the only German tank that survived an attack does not want to give up. Some civilians taken as hostages assure him a truce; with a clever maneuver he even manages to blow up an enemy crawler but not all will go well.
cast: Stan Cooper, Erna Schürer, Guy Madison, Rubén Rojo

title: La battaglia di Algeri
synopsis: Ali La Pointe, a simple former convict until 1954, was conquered by the ideals of the anti-colonial revolution. Three years later he headed the increasingly active National Liberation Front. But in 1957 Paris sent Colonel Mathieu's paratroopers, whose repression dismantled the resistance until Ali himself was liquidated.
cast: Brahim Haggiag, Jean Martin, Yacef Saadi, Tommaso Neri

title: La battaglia di Maratona
synopsis: Athens is at war with Darius, king of the Persians. Philippides, who has just won the Olympic Games, puts himself at the service of his homeland, led by Miltiades. Philippides will resist the flattery of the pro-Persian party, until, with the intervention of Sparta, the war ends in the historic battle of Marathon.
cast: Steve Reeves, Mylène Demongeot, Daniela Rocca

title: La beauté du diable
synopsis: Doctor Faust, now an elderly man, is nostalgic for the juice of life that only youth can make you taste. So he accepts the pact with Mephistopheles: in exchange for the soul he is transformed into Henri, a beautiful boy.
cast: Gérard Philipe, Michel Simon, Nicole Besnard, Carlo Ninchi

title: La bella Antonia prima monica e poi dimonia
synopsis: The painter Claudio Fornaci loves love: on the one hand he amuses himself with the women of the village, on the other he helps two lovers, Antonia and Folco, whose union is hindered by their respective fathers.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Piero Focaccia, Riccardo Garrone, Dada Gallotti

title: La bella Lola
synopsis: Antonio, an aristocrat with a stench under his nose, is betting with his friends that he will be able to seduce Lola, a singer in a café chantant in Madrid. Love is born between the two and Antonio, despite the strong opposition of his mother and the environment, announces his engagement with the girl. Antonio tries to introduce her to society where, however, she is coldly received. At this point the aristocrat's mother intervenes and tries to persuade Lola to abandon her son. The singer can't stand the pressure and ends up giving herself to alcohol.
cast: Sara Montiel, Antonio Cifariello, Luisa Mattioli, German Cobos

title: La bella Otero
synopsis: When Carolina Otero began performing as a dancer in the small Andalusian village where she was born, no one could imagine that she would quickly become the most sought-after artist of the Paris theaters. Many men went crazy for her and tried to win her heart, but the only love of her life was the impossible one with a helpless businessman. After the successes came the bitter days of decadence, which Otero will still be able to live with great dignity. Scripted in episodes of Spanish origin, with many Italian actors and above all with Harvey Keitel, the appreciated protagonist of Piano Lessons, it also has a longer television version.
cast: Angela Molina, Harvey Keitel, Lina Sastri, Aurore Clément, Vittorio Caprioli, Mimsy Farmer, Cochi Ponzoni, Luciano Salce, Luca Barbareschi, David Brandon

title: La bella addormentata
synopsis: The misadventures of a maid seduced and abandoned by a young solfataro. A film written by three writers: too heavy for the cinema. Good interpretation of Ferida.
cast: Luisa Ferida, Amedeo Nazzari, Osvaldo Valenti, Teresa Franchini, Pina Piovani, Margherita Bossi, Giovanni Dolfini, Guido Celano, Angelo Dessy, Fiorella Betti

title: La bella di Lodi
synopsis: Roberta is the young and rich daughter of Lombard landowners, Franco is a penniless mechanic who works in a garage on the Autostrada del Sole. They meet on the beach of Forte dei Marmi and they fall in love. In spite of the disparity of characters, the two seem to get along well: they leave on Roberta's Alfetta for a journey that, amid disagreements and reconciliations, takes them around the Italy of the economic boom. From the famous novel of the same name by Alberto Arbasino, a film that attempts to combine bitter tones with those of comedy.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Angel Aranda, Elena Borgo, Gianni Clerici

title: La bella di Mosca
synopsis: Irina comes from the countryside, and moves into the Moscow of the communist twilight becoming the lover of a regime intellectual. Her presence causes scandals in high places, and she is indicted, but manages to become a famous supermodel. Among other things, she ends up acting in an underground film in which, dressed in an Olympics tunic, she sets fire to the statue of Lenin.
cast: Ralitza Baleva, Igor Kostolevsky, Ivana Monti, Angelo Maresca

title: La bella di Roma
synopsis: Nannina, a young and beautiful commoner, is engaged to a penniless boxer, named Mario. One day, during a fight, he hits a policeman and ends up in prison. The woman, who is looking for a job, asks Oreste for help, a mature widower who takes her as a cashier in his bar. His hiring is encouraged by the upholsterer Gracco, a friend of Oreste, who does not hide his passion for beautiful women. Oreste ends up falling in love with Nannina who suggests that he open a restaurant on the Janiculum in partnership.
cast: Antonio Cifariello, Alberto Sordi, Silvana Pampanini, Paolo Stoppa, Lina Volonghi, Gigi Reder, Luisella Beghi, Bice Valori

title: La bella estate
synopsis: In Turin of 1938, the sixteen year old Ginia faces how the adolescence and the prospect of a future on which the shadows of the war is mounted in Europe can affect. The girl finds love in a young painter Bohémien who introduces her to the artistic community of the city. In this new environment Ginia knows Amelia, thanks to which he begins to feel emotions that he is not sure he can give a name. Being truly himself is a perspective in some ways terrifying.
cast: Yile Yara Vianello, Deva Cassel, Nicolas Maupas, Alessandro Piavani, Adrien Dewitte, Cosima Centurioni, Gabriele Graham Gasco, Anna Bellato, Andrea Bosca

title: La bella gente
synopsis: Husband and wife, bourgeois and progressive, a weekend in the countryside. When she decides to offer shelter to a Romanian prostitute, taking her almost by force from the street, the balances gradually jump.
cast: Antonio Catania, Myriam Catania, Iaia Forte, Elio Germano, Giorgio Gobbi, Monica Guerritore, Victoria Larchenko

title: La bella mugnaia
synopsis: The governor of a Neapolitan province got mad at the miller's beautiful, flirty and busty wife. As a consequence, she offers various facilities to her husband and relieves him of the payment of the taxes. Then the miller realizes that the game becomes dangerous, fears a marital betrayal and wants to pay tit for tat to the governor's wife.
cast: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica, Paolo Stoppa, Yvonne Sanson, Mario Passante, Carlo Sposito, Virgilio Riento, Elsa Vazzoler, Angela Lavagna

title: La bella società
synopsis: Giuseppe and Giorgio (David Coco and Marco Bocci) are two Sicilian brothers who go to Turin because one of them has to have eye surgery. In the Piedmontese capital they meet a woman, involved in the murder of a Fiat executive by a gang of terrorists. In the background, Italy in the twenty years between the 1960s and 1980s, with all their load of transformations and social impulses, including violent ones.
cast: Antonella Lualdi, Franco Interlenghi, Ricky Memphis, Claudio Santamaria, Caterina Murino, Enrico Lo Verso, Marco Bocci, Giancarlo Giannini, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Raoul Bova, David Coco

title: La bella stagione
synopsis: Documentary that traces the most glorious vintage in the long sporting history of Sampdoria. In the 1990-1991 season, the team led on the pitch by Gianluca Viallli and Roberto Mancini lives his moment of grace, managing not only to dominate and win an unexpected Scudetto, but also to demonstrate the team capable of expressing the most beautiful game. Parallel to the story of that championship, the film also proposes the journey of the Italian national team to the victory of the European Championships of 2021, with the nucleus of that unforgettable Sampdoria sitting on the bench to try to repeat the magic.
cast: Gianluca Vialli, Roberto Mancini

title: La bella vita
synopsis: When Bruno (Bigagli) and Mirella (Ferilli) got married in 1989, Piombino was a city in full prosperity. Then Ilva, the steel mill where he works, knows the crisis Bruno goes into layoffs with the real danger of a future loss of his job. Mirella, who works as a cashier in a supermarket, in the meantime has entered into a relationship with Gerry Fumo (Ghini) popular host on local television; when he decides to interrupt the relationship, Bruno has now learned of everything. The couple then decide to separate, but, after some time, a tender and affectionate correspondence runs between them. The film skilfully combines the private aspect of the story with the social problems in which they are inserted, presenting situations and characters of convincing depth. Good actors, wonderful Ferilli.
cast: Claudio Bigagli, Sabrina Ferilli, Massimo Ghini, Giorgio Algranti

title: La belle & la bête
synopsis: 1810. Belle (Léa Seydoux) is one of the six children of a merchant who, fallen from grace, lost all his possessions and wealth. Unlike her other sisters, Belle is a kind-mannered, humble, and kind-hearted girl who never cared about money. However, Belle's fate is in the hands of her father who makes a lucrative deal with the Beast (Vincent Cassel), a horrible cursed man in search of love and redemption who lives in an immense castle. What begins as a story of obligations and constraints dictated by materialism and money will soon turn into a great love story, capable of seeing and going beyond appearances.
cast: Vincent Cassel, Léa Seydoux, André Dussollier, Eduardo Noriega, Myriam Charleins, Audrey Lamy, Sara Giraudeau, Jonathan Demurger, Nicolas Gob, Louka Meliava, Yvonne Catterfeld

title: La belle captive
synopsis: Sara, leader of the organization, entrusts Walter a mysterious mission that has to do with a senator considered in danger of death. The agent, however, is diverted by the task due to the intervention of Marie-Ange, an enigmatic woman with a bewitching charm that drags him into a fantastic world.
cast: Daniel Mesguich, Cyrielle Claire, Daniel Emilfork, François Chaumette, Gabrielle Lazure, Gilles Arbona, Arielle Dombasle, Jean Claude Leguay, Nancy Van Slyke, Denis Fouqueray

title: La belle endormie
synopsis: The Carabosse fairy cuts the umbilical cord of a newborn, a girl named Anastasia. Three careless young fairies appear, red in the face from running. Too late, says Carabosse, at the age of sixteen the little girl will prick her hand and die. The young fairies burst into tears, their delay did not deserve such punishment. Now they will have to mitigate the fatal spell. They can only predict that instead of dying, Anastasia will fall asleep for a hundred years. Sleeping for a whole century is very boring, so they will allow you to wander far and wide in a dream during these hundred years of sleep.
cast: Carla Besnaïnou, Julia Artamonov, Kérian Mayan, David Chausse

title: La belle et la bête
synopsis: To make a gift to the daughter, Bella's father collects a rose of the beast garden, without knowing that they are forbidden and untouchable flowers. Offense, the beast asks to be rewarded. To save the father, Bella agrees to go and live in the castle of the beast.
cast: Jean Marais, Josette Day, Mila Parély, Nane Germon, Michel Auclair, Raoul Marco, Marcel André, Janice Felty, John Kuether, Ana María Martinez

title: La belle histoire
synopsis: A man and a woman met two thousand years ago. He is called Jesus, she is Odona. Today he is a gypsy who bought a Ferris wheel for an amusement park; Odona is a bad guy who redeems herself thanks to an auctioneer. Life is complicated and happiness almost impossible to find but in the end Jesus and Odona cross paths in an airport and they understand that they have always loved each other.
cast: Marie Sophie L., Gérard Lanvin, Béatrice Dalle, Vincent Lindon, Patrick Chesnais, Jacques Gamblin, Paul Préboist, Elie Chouraqui, Constantin Alexandrov, Denis Charvet, Amina Annabi, Jean Michel Dupuis

title: La belle personne
synopsis: The sixteen year old Junie changes school mid -year after his mother's death. Thus she finds herself in the same class of her cousin Mathias, who introduces her to her friends of her. All the boys would like to go out with her but Junie chooses the silent, eight Cleves. Immediately after, however, he meets the great love of his life, Nemours, his Italian teacher. However, their passion is condemned: Junie refuses to give in to her feelings and persists in denying happiness, which in her eyes is simply illusory.
cast: Louis Garrel, Léa Seydoux, Grégoire Leprince Ringuet, Esteban Carvajal Alegria, Simon Truxillo, Agathe Bonitzer, Anaïs Demoustier, Valerie Lang, Jacob Lyon, Jean Michel Portal

title: La belle saison
synopsis: In 1971, in Paris, Delphine met Carole. The first is a young peasant daughter who moved to the capital in search of economic independence. The second, on the other hand, lives in couple with Alexandre the beginnings of the feminist frond. While Delphine is reserved and knows she loves women, Carole is unaware that she can feel such attraction. The meeting, however, will forever change the course of their lives, forced to confront reality.
cast: Cécile De France, Izia Higelin, Noémie Lvovsky, Kévin Azaïs, Patrice Tepasso, Laetitia Dosch

title: La belle époque
synopsis: Victor, a disillusioned 60-year-old, sees his life upset the day when Antoine, a brilliant entrepreneur, offers him something completely new: by mixing theatrical artifices and historical reconstruction, he has the opportunity to go back in time, to the period he prefers. Victor then chooses to relive the most memorable week of his life: the one in which, 40 years earlier, he met his great love ...
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Guillaume Canet, Doria Tillier, Fanny Ardant, Pierre Arditi, Denis Podalydès, Tobias Licht, Sébastien Corona, Frédéric Sandeau, Emmanuel Ménard

title: La belle équipe
synopsis: Five unemployed people live a life of expedients until they buy a lottery ticket from the company; they win ten thousand francs and decide to use them to build a small hotel. However, various contrasts immediately arise.
cast: Jean Gabin, Viviane Romance, Charles Vanel, Micheline Cheirel

title: La bellezza del somaro
synopsis: Marcello (Sergio Castellitto), and Marina (Laura Morante), are two parents in their fifties who are particularly anxious about aging and therefore very eager to continue to appear young. During a weekend in the countryside in their home in Tuscany, what appears to be good news arrives: Rosa, their daughter, has broken off her engagement with a boy they did not like. However, the surprises are not over and the events that follow will closely show the different aspects of the generational conflict.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Laura Morante, Barbora Bobulova, Marco Giallini, Lola Ponce, Erika Blanc, Gianfelice Imparato, Lidia Vitale, Emanuela Grimalda, Enzo Jannacci, Renato Marchetti, Nina Torresi

title: La bellezza di Ippolita
synopsis: Ex variety dancer she, gas station attendant him, fall in love and get married. She, Ippolita, lets herself be wooed by passing motorists for fun; he, Luca, gets jealous. One day she discovers that he has betrayed her and meditates revenge: she will return to her "conjugal duties" only when she has had the opportunity to return Luca to the pariglia
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Enrico Maria Salerno, Milva, Carlo Giuffrè, Lars Bloch, Franco Giacobini, Ariel Mannoni, Angela Portaluri, Franco Balducci

title: La bellissima estate
synopsis: Vittorio, an industrialist with a passion for car racing, is killed during a race. The wife keeps the matter hidden from her son: she only tells him that after the holidays they will not return to Milan. Gianluca, however, will dramatically discover the truth. Pretentious melodrama that remains suspended in a surface elegance.
cast: Senta Berger, John Richardson, Alessandro Cocco

title: La belva
synopsis: Leonida Riva (Fabrizio Gifuni) is a dark and lonely war veteran, with a past as First Captain in the Army Special Forces. Life and work have led Riva further and further away from the family. His eldest son, Mattia, has never forgiven him, while his daughter Teresa adores him unconditionally. But a tragic event will force Leonidas to transform himself again into something he believed to be buried in his past.
cast: Fabrizio Gifuni, Lino Musella, Monica Piseddu, Emanuele Linfatti, Andrea Pennacchi, Giada Gagliardi

title: La belva
synopsis: John Laster, an unscrupulous individual, attempts to carry out a robbery against Powers, a wealthy landowner. When Powers reveals to John that the entire sum raised from the deal is deposited in the bank, the angry bandit kills him. Later, with the help of two bandits, he kidnaps Powers' niece.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Gabriella Giorgelli, Steven Tedd, Paul Sullivan

title: La belva col mitra
synopsis: Nanni Vitali, handsome and crazy, is at the head of a gang of escapees who returns to sow terror after a period in prison. Commissioner Giulio Santini tries to stop the overflowing violence of the beast, blinded by the thirst for revenge towards those who have betrayed him.
cast: Helmut Berger, Marisa Mell, Richard Harrison, Marina Giordana

title: La bestia in calore
synopsis: Dr Kratsch, an army officer of the Third Reich, has succeeded in her perverse aim: to create a huge beast in the laboratory, which in her plans represents an important step in the creation of the perfect race.
cast: Macha Magall, Gino Turini, Edilio Kim, Xiro Papas, Salvatore Baccaro

title: La bestia nel cuore
synopsis: Sabina has everything to be happy: she is beautiful, she has a job she likes and a partner she loves. But for some time she has been plagued by strange nightmares. When she becomes pregnant, Sabina looks back on her childhood spent in a middle-class family and brings back a distressing secret ...
cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Luigi Lo Cascio, Alessio Boni, Stefania Rocca, Angela Finocchiaro, Francesca Inaudi, Giuseppe Battiston

title: La bestia nello spazio
synopsis: Captain Larry Madison sets out on a space mission to the planet Lorigon. The aim is to verify if Antalium is found on the planet, a mysterious and very precious material. Once arrived, Larry and his team soon discover that the Antalium present on Lorigon is essential to power a super computer in charge of controlling the inhabitants of the planet. Larry and his family will thus have a much more onerous task than the one supported so far: their real problem will in fact be able to escape from Lorigon.
cast: Sirpa Lane, Vassili Karis, Claudio Undari, Venantino Venantini

title: La bestia uccide a sangue freddo
synopsis: Hans takes his wife Ruth to a clinic for mentally ill women. There a mysterious man wanders who carries out a series of heinous murders, assaulting Ruth among others. The director of the clinic and his assistant fear that the clinic may be closed and therefore try to sidetrack the investigation. Once they understand their mistake, they turn to an inspector who sets to work to succeed in capturing the fearsome killer.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Margaret Lee, Rosalba Neri, Jane Garret, John Karlsen, Gioia Desideri, John Ely, Fernando Cerulli, Sandro Rossi, Giulio Baraghini

title: La bicicletta e il Badile - In viaggio come Hermann Buhl
synopsis: Maurizio Panseri and Marco Cardullo, mountaineers and cyclists, decide to retrace the itinerary that in 1952 brought Hermann Buhl, by bicycle, to a weekend, from Innsbruck to the north-east wall of the Badile lace, scaled in the first lonely through via Cassin via Cassin , in about four hours.

title: La bimba di Satana
synopsis: The Aguilars live in a luxurious villa. The husband, jealous and violent, kills his wife, whose evil spirit is incarnated at night in the body of his daughter to carry out a long and atrocious revenge on all the inhabitants of the building.
cast: Jacqueline Dupré, Mariangela Giordano, Aldo Sambrell, Joe Davers, Giancarlo Del Duca, Alfonso Gaita, Marina Hedman

title: La bisbetica domata
synopsis: Back from America where he made his fortune, Pietruccio takes the daughter of the town tailor, Catina, as his wife. She has a very, very independent temper, so much so that everyone considers her indomitable. But her husband, pretending to indulge her and actually subjecting her to bullying and abuses, manages to reduce her to reason and docility. At this point, it will be full happiness for the young couple. Modernized (and very free, in an openly farcical key) reinterpretation of the famous play by Shakespeare. The direction sets a good pace, the actors give it their all.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Lilia Silvi, Lauro Gazzolo, Rossana Montesi

title: La bisbetica domata
synopsis: Caterina, daughter of a rich merchant from Padua, has a rebellious character. This is why her father fears he will not be able to find her a husband. Petruccio is an inveterate Don Juan who prides himself on being irresistible with women. The passion arises between the two which, given their respective characters, leads to a perpetual quarrel until Caterina is "softened" by her husband and discovers the pleasure of being more feminine.
cast: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, Cyril Cusack, Lino Capolicchio, Michael Hordern, Alfred Lynch, Alan Webb, Giancarlo Cobelli, Vernon Dobtcheff, Michael York

title: La blonde de Pékin
synopsis: Agents from East and West seek Erica for contacts with a Chinese rocket scientist. The Americans find it and entrust it to Mark Garland. Then it turns out that the girl is not the right one, between murders and to and fro from East to West things get even more complicated due to the appearance of a huge stolen sapphire in the story. Nicolas Gessner translates a James Hadley Chase novel with the humor, ease and cast of beautiful women needed.
cast: Mireille Darc, Claudio Brook, Edward G. Robinson, Giorgia Moll, Françoise Brion, Jean Jacques Delbo, Pascale Roberts, Yves Elliot, Carl Studer

title: La bocca
synopsis: Alessandra is a young restorer waiting to get married with Fabio. He agrees to restore an important fresco in a Tuscan villa inhabited by the Rospigliosi counts. Giulio, deaf-mute son of the countess, falls in love with Alessandra and she ends up reciprocating him, to the point of sending her boyfriend away when he comes to visit her. But the passion between the two young people cannot last: the elderly Countess Bianca will not allow it.
cast: Tahnee Welch, Rodney Harvey, Claudine Auger, Alida Valli, Monica Scattini, Valeria Cavalli, Enrico Papa, Giuditta Del Vecchio, Massimo Bonetti

title: La bocca del lupo
synopsis: A man returns home after a long absence. He scrambles off a train in a livid port city. He crosses it, looking for the places of the past, now abandoned, which come to the memory in their ancient splendor. In the small house in the ghetto of the old city, a cold dinner and the companion of a lifetime has been waiting for her for years. Mary in the street and Enzo in prison have expected and wanted since the time of their meeting behind bars, when silent messages were still sent, recorded on hidden cassettes.
cast: Vincenzo Motta, Mary Monaco

title: La boda de Rosa
synopsis: On the point of turning 45, Rosa realizes that he has always lived for others and decides to radically change his life, taking the reins of his destiny with a very special commitment: getting married to herself. However, she will soon discover that her father, brothers and her daughter have other plans in mind and that it is not easy to detach himself from the past when she is not at the center of family events.
cast: Candela Peña, Sergi López, Nathalie Poza, Paula Usero, Ramón Barea, Xavo Giménez, Maria José Hipólito, María Maroto

title: La bohème
synopsis: Paris, mid-nineteenth century. Four young friends - the poet Rodolfo, the painter Marcello, the musician Schaunard and the philosopher Colline - spend a happy life, despite little money. They are satisfied with art, youth and love. But it will be above all through this - and through the relationships of Rodolfo and Marcello with Mimì and Musetta - that life will present its account.
cast: Nicole Cabell, Boaz Daniel, Stéphane Degout, Ioan Holender, Anna Netrebko, Rolando Villazón

title: La bohème
synopsis: Faithfully inspired by the famous work of Puccini, taken from the book by Henri Murger "Scenes from the life of bohème", the film traces the stories of friends Marcello, a painter, and Rodolfo, a poet, who live in an attic in Paris. In the attic next door lives Mimì, with whom Rodolfo falls in love while Marcello has a troubled affair with Musetta. Poverty, however, is stronger than feelings and, moreover, Mimi is sick with tuberculosis, the evil of the century that does not forgive ...
