cast: Barbara Hendricks, Luca Canonici, Gino Quilico, Angela Maria Blasi, Richard Cowan, Francesco Ellero D'Artegna, Federico Davià, Ciccio Ingrassia, Massimo Girotti

title: La bomba
synopsis: Nino and Sergio have always dreamed of becoming actors. Together they decide to go to New York for an audition at the Actor's Studio. Here they meet Gaetano, also an aspiring actor, who works in a restaurant as a waiter. Nino and Gaetano pass the audition while Sergio, rejected, takes the place of Gaetano at the restaurant in order to keep his friends at the Actor's Studio. At the Sergio restaurant he has to deal with the Chinese owner every day. So one evening, Nino and Gaetano decide to make a joke: they call the restaurant pretending to be mafia.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Rocco Papaleo, Chiara Muti, Vittorio Gassman, Shelley Winters

title: La bonne
synopsis: Vicenza 1956. Anna's life spends in absolute boredom. Her husband Giacomo, engaged in politics, spends long hours in the city council. Fortunately, Angela is at home, an exuberant girl who comes from the province and who was hired to take care of the house. Between the two women, a strange relationship of complicity begins to establish themselves, which leads them to attend a whale together, looking for men. But things get complicated ...
cast: Florence Guérin, Trine Michelsen, Cyrus Elias, Benito Artesi, Ida Eccher, Rita Savagnone, Silvio Anselmo, Lorenzo Lena

title: La bonne année
synopsis: Simon, a gentleman thief, while preparing a robbery, falls in love with the beautiful antiquarian Françoise. When he tries the shot he goes wrong and ends up in jail. After six years in prison he finds the woman again, but she has changed a lot. Will Simon be able to win her back?
cast: Lino Ventura, Françoise Fabian, Charles Gérard, André Falcon, Mireille Mathieu, Lilo, Claude Mann, Frédéric De Pasquale, Gérard Sire, Silvano Tranquilli

title: La bottega dell'orefice
synopsis: Four young Poles, after a long period of engagement, get married on the eve of the Nazi invasion. The life of the two couples is marked by war events and only one of the two couples will be able to emigrate to Canada. Here too there are problems to overcome, but finally the family settles down. And the children will think about continuing the tradition.
cast: Burt Lancaster, Daniel Olbrychski, Ben Cross, Andrea Occhipinti, Jo Champa, Olivia Hussey, Melora Hardin, Jonathan Crombie, Francesca Bregni

title: La boum
synopsis: Vic, the thirteen-year-old daughter of a couple close to separation, faces her own difficult adolescence amidst sentimental worries, school troubles and family troubles.
cast: Sophie Marceau, Claude Brasseur, Brigitte Fossey

title: La boum 2
synopsis: Repeating the vicissitudes of the previous film, we find Vic, in love with Philippe, who does everything to make him jealous; the father who quarrels with his mother and leaves home to achieve success in his work; the little sister Samantha, now grown up, who has her own adventures and finally the great-grandmother Poupette who, at the last moment decides not to marry her handsome widower anymore. The film no longer even has the pimp grace of the first episode.
cast: Claude Brasseur, Sophie Marceau, Brigitte Fossey, Lambert Wilson

title: La boîte noire
synopsis: After a serious car accident, where he is convinced he has killed a boy, Arthur Seligman falls into a coma for several hours and wakes up in the hospital, suffering from confusion syndrome and unable to remember the moments before the accident. The nurse records on tape the words pronounced by Arthur in a state of consciousness: the man will thus try to shed light on the origins of the accident, trying to extricate himself from ghosts, memories and hallucinations.
cast: Bernard Lecoq, José Garcia, Marion Cotillard, Michel Duchaussoy

title: La brutta copia
synopsis: A girl tries to make her partner become 'normal'; three madmen escape from the asylum and pursue a politician believing him to be an alien.
cast: Massimo Ceccherini, Rocco Papaleo, Carlo Monni, Ambra Gullà, Aldo Pellegrini, Barbara Enrichi

title: La bruttina stagionata
synopsis: Marilina is on the threshold of forty, and one cannot say very satisfied: she is a spinster, sloppy, repressed at home and at work. The meeting with a gigolo begins to stir something in her: with Berto she sets up, secretly, a relationship based on sex. Then it's the turn of Jan, the manager of a porn shop, whose friendship further helps her in the emancipation process. Until Nicky arrives: handsome, rich, distinguished. The journey from spinster to man eater was a sales champion thanks to the pen of Carmen Covito. The action moved from Milan to Padua. The actors are good, but it's the script that limps: comedy doesn't have the courage to push on the accelerator to overcome genre stereotypes. Excessive do-goodness affects the result.
cast: Carla Signoris, Edi Angelillo, Fabrizio Gifuni, Isabella Biagini

title: La buca
synopsis: Bitten by a shaggy dog, Oscar (Sergio Castellitto), a gruff lawyer constantly looking for scam ideas, would like to take advantage of the situation and try to sue Armando (Rocco Papaleo), the unfortunate owner of the animal. However, when he discovers that Armando is actually a wretch just out of thirty years of unjust prison, Oscar changes his mind and raises the stakes, deciding to sue the state. Looking for evidence and clues, Oscar and Armando create an unlikely friendship, which also includes Carmen (Valeria Bruni Tedeschi), a bartender with a sensitive soul.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Rocco Papaleo, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Jacopo Cullin, Ivan Franek, Teco Celio, Sonia Gessner, Lucia Ocone, Giovanni Esposito, Fabrizio Falco

title: La buena vida
synopsis: Tristán, a 15-year-old budding writer with early sexual urges, has always enjoyed the comforts his family has built for him. But the accidental death of his parents forces him to face life differently ...
cast: Fernando Ramallo, Lucía Jiménez, Luis Cuenca, Isabel Otero, Joel Joan, Victoria Peña, Jordi Bosch

title: La bugiarda
synopsis: Maria, a beautiful and casual girl, pretends to be a stewardess to make herself more attractive in the eyes of her male prey. He begins dating two unwitting men, dividing between them and inventing mountains of lies until his game is discovered. Maria does not lose heart and tries to involve them in a ménage à trois.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Enrico Maria Salerno, Marc Michel, Riccardo Cucciolla

title: La buona battaglia. Don Pietro Pappagallo
synopsis: The heroic enterprise of a priest who managed to save hundreds of people, Jews, Christians, Italian officers and partisans hunted by the SS and the Black Brigades in the dramatic winter of 1943-44 in Rome, but who was then captured and slaughtered in the Pits Ardeatine.
cast: Flavio Insinna, Ana Caterina Morariu, Paolo Briguglia, Ignazio Oliva, Vanni Corbellini, Paola Tiziana Cruciani, Max Mazzotta, Sergio Fiorentini, Pierpaolo Lovino, Alberto Gimignani

title: La buona uscita
synopsis: Putting her nymphomaniac drives aside, Professor Lucrezia Sembiante decides to marry a much younger boy than her to overcome the fear of old age and loneliness. However, the last meeting with Marco Macaluso, an unscrupulous entrepreneur and her longtime bed friend, forces her to face with greater violence the nature of her fears, her choices and her future.
cast: Marco Cavalli, Gea Martire, Andrea Cioffi, Enzo Restucci, Pino Iadanza, Gennaro Maresca, Luca Saccoia, Giuseppe De Vincentis, Rita Corrado

title: La bête
cast: Sirpa Lane, Lisbeth Hummel, Pierre Benedetti, Marcel Dalio

title: La caccia
synopsis: Lorenzo, a respectable man, runs a jewelry shop with his wife Marta, is the father of little Luca and is awaiting the arrival of his second daughter. His peaceful life, however, is upset by the raid in his room of a thief, who suddenly shooting kills Marta and Luca. Tired of the slowness of the investigations by the authorities, Lorenzo decides to take justice on his own and go on the trail of the criminal, concentrating his suspicions on Pietro, a mechanic with a small criminal record.
cast: Claudio Amendola, Alessio Boni, Simona Cavallari, Andrea Osvart, Nicola Di Pinto, Loredana Cannata, Kaspar Capparoni, Bed Cerchiai, Sara D'Amario, Gianluca Grecchi, Ernesto Mahieux, Stefano Molinari, Antonio Serrano

title: La caccia
synopsis: Family drama that follows the story of four brothers, three males and a female, who meet, after several years of distance, for the sudden death of the father.
cast: Laura Chiatti, Filippo Nigro, Paolo Pierobon, Pietro Sermonti

title: La caduta degli angeli ribelli
synopsis: A good lady takes a crush on a runaway terrorist and ends badly. It is the second film by Marco Tullio Giordana and already leaves something to be desired.
cast: Clio Goldsmith, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Yves Beneyton, Alida Valli

title: La cage
synopsis: The ex-wife summons Julien to his isolated villa with the excuse that she wants to sell it to him, but imprisons him in a basement and forces him to a long awareness of the failure of their marriage. Psychological symbolic drama supported by the good performance of the two protagonists.
cast: Lino Ventura, Ingrid Thulin, William Sabatier

title: La cage aux folles 3
synopsis: Renato (Tognazzi) and Albin (Serrault), the two cohabitants of Vizietto 1 and 2, have some financial difficulties with their club "La cage aux folles". But here is Albin receiving a rich inheritance from a deceased uncle in Scotland. Or rather, he will come into possession of the enormous sum if he marries and has an heir. Not easy, given the ... premises. Assorted vicissitudes, then everything works out. "A good game does not last long". Our wise ancestors knew this and they even made us a proverb. "Who wants too much, etc., etc.". In short, the third episode of the Vizietto is a poor thing that does not stand up, does not make you laugh and only bores.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Serrault, Antonella Interlenghi, Saverio Vallone

title: La cagna
synopsis: Giorgio is fifty years old and draws comics. Feeling uncomfortable in Paris, where he lives, he moves to a sparsely inhabited island with his dog named Melampo. One day Lisa lands, who is immediately intolerant of the dog and kills it to take the place of him in listening to Giorgio's monologues. They will try to get back together in Paris ...
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Catherine Deneuve, Corinne Marchand, Michel Piccoli, Claudine Berg, Dominique Marcas, Luigi Antonio Guerra, Valérie Stroh

title: La caja
synopsis: Hatzin, a teenager from Mexico City, is on a journey to retrieve his father's remains, found in a mass grave in the vast skies and empty landscapes of northern Mexico. But the chance encounter with a man who physically resembles his father fills him with doubts and hopes as to where he really ended up.
cast: Hatzín Navarrete, Hernan Mendoza, Cristina Zulueta

title: La caja 507
synopsis: Bank manager discovers a document showing that his daughter's death years earlier was not entirely accidental. He swears revenge.
cast: Dafne Fernández, Antonio Resines, Miriam Montilla, Félix Álvarez, Javier Coromina, Antonio Mora, Jordi Amat, Juan Fernandez, Sarina Röhr, Younes Bachir

title: La calda vita
synopsis: A summer of the early 60s: on a remote Sardinian island a disturbing teenager seduces two peers by putting them in competition, and then indulges herself with a more mature man: envy upsets the more sensitive of the two boys whose anger will lead to a tragic epilogue.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Jacques Perrin, Gabriele Ferzetti, Fabrizio Capucci

title: La califfa
synopsis: The troubled love story between an industrialist and the young widow of a worker ends badly. He repents and gives the factory to the workers, while the other industrialists take it badly and have him killed. The film is also problematic: to be avoided because it is by Bevilacqua, but there is Romy Schneider. Mediocre.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Romy Schneider, Marina Berti, Massimo Serato, Roberto Bisacco, Enzo Fiermonte, Guido Alberti, Gigi Ballista, Luigi Casellato

title: La cama
synopsis: Sixty-year-old Jorge and 59-year-old Mabel spend the last 24 hours together as a couple locked up in their family home. They eat, have sex, cry and laugh. They dismantle their home just like they do their relationship.
cast: Alejo Mango, Sandra Sandrini

title: La cambiale
synopsis: An industrialist (Tieri) runs over two poor people (Totò and De Filippo). To compensate them, he gives them a bill of exchange for one hundred thousand lire, but they don't know it is open. In the meantime, however, they manage to pass it on to their landlord (Pavese), who passes it in turn, starting a path that will then be redone in reverse.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Sylva Koscina, Ugo Tognazzi, Giorgia Moll, Peppino De Filippo, Totò, Raimondo Vianello, Paolo Ferrari, Aroldo Tieri, Lia Zoppelli, Macario

title: La cameriera
synopsis: In a family of baronial origin of southern Italy the harmony is broken by the arrival of Mary, alarm clock and the attractive service woman who arrived from Veneto. The girls are immediately concentrated on the girl, the attention of the males of the country but also those of her employer, who remained widowed, and the son.
cast: Daniela Giordano, Mario Colli, Enzo Monteduro, Carla Calò, Rosemarie Lindt, Annamaria Tornello, Anna Melita, Giacomo Furia

title: La cameriera nera
synopsis: Several tenants live in a building in Rome: they range from Major Galeazzo to Chancellor Enea, from goalkeeper Placido to Dr. Muller, from journalist Antenore to Paolo who still lives with his parents. Everyone is conquered by the maid Mariolina, who will be undermined by the black Amita ...
cast: Carla Brait, Femi Benussi, Al Capri, Gianni Dei, Magda Konopka

title: La cameriera seduce i villeggianti
synopsis: Orazio and Marina, managers of a pension, have some bills outstanding with the spouses Amedeo and Pucci Ferretti. Between the four a series of seductions and escapades is triggered, in which a drug trafficker, a gangster, a brigadier and the clumsy waitress Guendalina are involved ...
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Carlo Giuffrè, Giorgio Bracardi, Pippo Santonastaso, Raf Luca, Isabella Biagini

title: La campagnola bella
synopsis: In a village of central Italy, all the most important exponents, starting with the mayor Cirillo, think of anything except to govern properly. One of the favorite victims of their interests is the prostitute Felicetta, who will soon have the opportunity to take revenge thanks to the beautiful Letizia.
cast: Femi Benussi, Franca Gonella, Gianni Dei, Filippo Torriero, Carla Calò

title: La canarina assassinata
synopsis: A film producer, known for his unscrupulousness and lack of scruples, "luckily" finds a cheap location for a film to be directed by a director who is no longer young but with an immaculate conscience: a splendid villa surrounded by a park from Viterbo. When the producer, together with some actors and the director, moves into the villa to prepare the film, he meets the owner, Anna, a sophisticated woman, no longer very young but still very beautiful, who lives alone in the villa in the company of her enigmatic butler, Raffaele. The fiction of the world of cinema reverberates in the attitudes and relationships of its protagonists, mercilessly revealing its unfortunate baseness. But the "real life", the one that should be represented by Anna and Raffaele, will prove to be no less fake than the cinematographic one: the "cinema" guests are not there by chance. Behind their presence there is a revenge waiting to be carried out, and which will certainly take place at the expense of the intended victim.
cast: Ignazio Oliva, Bruno Armando, Emilio Bonucci, Remo Remotti, Vanni Bramati, Chiara Francini, Chiara Conti, Michele De Virgilio, Paolo De Vita, Caterina Vertova, Lorenzo Monaco

title: La canzone del cuore
synopsis: Lucia, widowed, with her little daughter Ornella who is not in good health, sings in a night club to get by. The mother-in-law, always opposed to the wedding, does not want to know about the sister-in-law and granddaughter. One day a theft is committed in the night club, Lucia is blamed and arrested. Sandro, childhood companion of Lucia's deceased husband, who had sought a rapprochement between Lucia and her mother-in-law, takes advantage of his imprisonment to take Ornella to her grandmother.
cast: Marisa Merlini, Milly Vitale, Alberto Farnese, Dante Maggio

title: La canzone del destino
synopsis: Claudio and Cesare, two half-brothers, are both in love with Elena who, of the two, prefers Claudio, the more extroverted and exuberant. At the outbreak of the Great War, the two young men are enlisted but, while Cesare ends up on the front line, Claudio goes into hiding. Elena also volunteers as a Red Cross nurse. Taken by remorse, Claudio gets to go to the front where he finds Cesare and Elena. Long-hidden feelings come to the surface and the war takes it upon itself to "fix" things.
cast: Claudio Villa, Milly Vitale, Marco Guglielmi, Carlo Campanini

title: La canzone dell'amore
synopsis: Alone and with a little brother to support, the young Lucia is forced to give up the love of Enrico, an honest but poor young man. Her sacrifice will be rewarded and the girl will be able to reunite with her beloved. It is the first sound film released in Italy, based on the novel "In silence" by Pirandello and interesting precisely for the experimental use of sound. "Just for you, Lucia" is sung.
cast: Dria Paola, Elio Steiner, Isa Pola, Mercedes Brignone, Camillo Pilotto, Olga Capri, Nello Rocchi

title: La captive
synopsis: The beautiful Ariane lives with the young and wealthy Simon in a large Paris apartment. The man is so obsessed with her that he subjects her to incessant questions, constantly checks her, makes her accompany him when he decides to go out. But Ariane leads - even sexually - a double life, which only exacerbates Simon's pain and desire ...
cast: Sylvie Testud, Stanislas Merhar, Olivia Bonamy, Aurore Clément, Liliane Rovère

title: La captive du désert
synopsis: A young European girl is a prisoner in the Sahara of a tribe of nomads, as a hostage for a cause she does not know. No one ever speaks to her, only, in rare moments, the children playing. The woman escapes, wanders in the desert and is brought back to the tribe by a little boy who has found her, exhausted. Days, weeks, months go by, until she is told that the next day she will be released. From a real story, Depardon has written and directed a film that is a difficult bet: almost no action, almost no words, the rigorous visualization of a dramatic loneliness. With Sandrine Bonnaire, a winning bet.
cast: Sandrine Bonnaire, Dobi Kore, Dobi Achinke, Atchi Wahi Li

title: La cara oculta
synopsis: Adrian, the young conductor of the Bogota Philharmonic Orchestra, arrives in the Colombian capital with his girlfriend Belen. The two seem very much in love but with the passing of the days Belen has reason to suspect that Adrian is betraying her and thus decides to disappear without leaving any trace. Distraught, Adrian finds consolation in the music and in the arms of the waitress Fabiana, in a whirlwind of passion that begins to crack when strange noises begin to appear in the house that bring out the first doubts about the real disappearance of Belen.
cast: Quim Gutiérrez, Clara Lago, Martina García, Marcela Mar, Alexandra Stewart, Juan Alfonso Baptista, Humberto Dorado

title: La carbonara
synopsis: In the old inn "La carbonara" they eat traditional Roman dishes, sing, play politics, love, watch history (we are in 1825, on the northern border of the States of the Church). There are the real and inexperienced carbonari, the repentant former carbonaro who has become a friar, the brigands led by Lupone with a necklace of chillies, the cardinal and the priests. And there is the beautiful owner of the inn, Cecilia, whom everyone desires and calls, with quivering imagination, as the symbol dish.
cast: Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Valerio Mastandrea, Nino Manfredi

title: La carne
synopsis: Paolo is a municipal employee and in the evening he plays in a piano bar. One evening, in the club, he meets the beautiful and provocative Francesca: it is love at first sight. The two take refuge in Paolo's little house on the Roman coast where, having filled the fridge with food, the two spend their days passing from one embrace to another. When Francesca announces her departure, Paolo kills her, dissects her and keeps her in the refrigerator to eat.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Francesca Dellera, Philippe Léotard

title: La carovana bianca
synopsis: The story of a lockdown lived in a very particular way by those who - by choice and vocation - is nomad by definition: the artists of the circus. The camera thus follows four circus families who, due to the pandemic emergency, are blocked on the outskirts of Naples, abandoned by the institutions, forced to immobility in a non -place and with a fixed thought: they will return to work and travel ?

title: La carrière de Suzanne
synopsis: The young Susanna meets Guillaume and Bertrand, both students, the first lucid and rational, the second impetuous and spirited. The girl is at the center of the speeches with which the two students contrast and compare their respective philosophies. With Bertrand's complicity, Guillaume takes Susanna to bed, but then ...
cast: Catherine See, Philippe Beuzen, Christian Carrière, Diane Xilkinson

title: La carrozza d'oro
synopsis: In the eighteenth century Camilla, the prima donna of a theatrical enterprise, thanks to the incredible success of her company, was invited to court by the viceroy of Peru. Who falls in love with her, in turn fought over by a bullfighter and a knight. To conquer her, the nobleman gives her a golden carriage, which she will put at the service of the people and the Church.
cast: Anna Magnani, Duncan Lamont, Georges Higgins, Odoardo Spadaro, Nada Fiorelli, Ralph Truman, Dante, Gisella Mathews, Raf De La Torre

title: La casa 3 - Ghosthouse
synopsis: Six young people investigate the hidden mysteries of an old villa abandoned for over twenty years. The whole family (father, mother and a little girl) who lived there had been exterminated in the villa and no one had ever managed to identify and arrest the culprit. The sextet enters the house in search of clues, but strange supernatural presences begin to manifest themselves ...
cast: Lara Wendel, Greg Scott, Ron Houck, Mary Sellers, Donald O'Brian

title: La casa 4
synopsis: In an old building on an islet, the spirit of an ancient witch wanders, who committed suicide to escape capture and burning. Its victims are those who have the misfortune of falling into the old house. In trouble will be a young researcher of occult sciences, her photographer friend, a family who would like to buy the building and the female architect who accompanies them.
cast: Catherine Hickland, Linda Blair, David Hasselhoff, Annie Ross, Hildegard Knef, Leslie Cumming, Robert Champagne, Rick Farnsworth, Michael Manchester

title: La casa 5
synopsis: Protestant pastor Peter settles with his family in a long-abandoned house. Strange phenomena and macabre visions make him understand that the house is frequented by demonic presences. Investigating, he discovers that in the past some women who worshiped the demon Amet had lived there. The priest decides to perform an exorcism. No connection with the series made in the United States by Sam Raimi: Clyde Anderson is the very Italian Claudio Fragasso, who copies with a certain talent the clichés of the most recent horror.
cast: David Brandon, Gene LeBrock, Barbara Bingham, Stephen Brown, Michael Paul Stephenson, Theresa Walker, Mary Coulson

title: La casa con la scala nel buio
synopsis: Bruno, author of soundtracks, is commissioned by a horror film director to compose the music for his new film. To create the right atmosphere, the woman makes him stay in the villa of a mutual friend. Strange murders take place in the house.
cast: Andrea Occhipinti, Michele Soavi, Annie Papa, Valeria Cavalli

title: La casa dalle finestre che ridono
synopsis: In charge of restoring a fresco painted by a suicidal painter in a town in the Ferrara area, Stefano witnesses disturbing events and deaths, investigating which he discovers (and reveals to us) all the murky and sordid that stir in the deep folds of the province.
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Francesca Marciano, Gianni Cavina, Vanna Busoni, Giulio Pizzirani, Bob Tonelli, Pietro Brambilla, Ferdinando Orlandi, Andrea Matteuzzi

title: La casa de las muertas vivientes
synopsis: Oliver is convinced that he killed his wife Helen in that house in the park near the cemetery. He tried to escape as much as possible from the place of horrors and death, but he is as if fatally attracted to the house. After his escape, the house was rented by new people, who behave somewhat ambiguously with Oliver. The restlessness turns to terror when the first corpses begin to be found.
cast: José Antonio Amor, Daniela Giordano, Nuria Torray, Gioia Desideri

title: La casa de las palomas
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Sandra, a student in a girls' boarding school run by the nuns, is attracted to the playboy Fabrizio. The situation becomes complicated when the Don Juan also begins to court Arianna, the girl's mother. Who will win between the two contenders?
cast: Ornella Muti, Lucia Bosé, Caterina Boratto, Glen Lee, Carmen De Lirio

title: La casa de papel
synopsis: Eight thieves take hostages and lock themselves in the Royal Mint of Spain as a criminal mastermind manipulates the police to carry out his plan.
cast: Úrsula Corberó, Itziar Ituño, Álvaro Morte, Paco Tous, Enrique Arce, Pedro Alonso, María Pedraza, Alba Flores, Miguel Herrán, Jaime Lorente, Esther Acebo, Darko Peric, Kiti Mánver

title: La casa dei bambini
synopsis: In the immediate postwar period, the British Army's brigade of Jewish engineers, Solel Boneh, managed to rescue hundreds of children who had escaped the terror of the death camps. For three years, from 1945 to 1948, a small Lombard municipality named Selvino became their home. Orphans of their respective families of origin, lost in that tragedy, the "children of Selvino" slowly managed to find moments of serenity and resumed a normal life. Between 1946 and 1949, most of the "children of Selvino" were embarked on the Rondine Enzo Sereni motor ship. Almost all of them were welcomed into Eretz Israel, kibbutz Tze'elim and Hanita. They still live there together as a big family, replicating their happy Selvino model.

title: La casa del buon ritorno
synopsis: Jacob Luca, returns with his girlfriend Margit to his childhood home. The air of the countryside and the silence attract him a lot. But the house hides a secret: about twenty years earlier, during a party of kids, Luca made his peer Lola, a pretty little girl he fell in love with, fall from the terrace. Memories inevitably reappear, to the point that, little by little, Luca becomes obsessed. He sees Lola everywhere and even seems to meet her. Horror signed by Beppe Cino ("Diceria dell'untore") that drags itself towards a predictable end.
cast: Amanda Sandrelli, Stefano Gabrini

title: La casa del piacere
synopsis: Lord Sutton and his young wife are on their honeymoon (and business) in the Philippines but she lets herself be conquered by the oriental textile industrialist who hosts them. Encouraged to cheat, the woman is spied on by her husband, who takes a kind of perverse pleasure in watching her have sex with casual lovers.
cast: Irina Kramer, Nick Nicholson, Marc Gosálvez, Andrea Ruiz, Liezl Santos

title: La casa del sorriso
synopsis: La Casa del Sorriso is a hospice for the elderly. Among the guests there is also Adelina who, despite her age, would still be open to love, but her rivals, disappointed and envious, wickedly take their revenge by stealing her magnificent dentures.
cast: Ingrid Thulin, Dado Ruspoli, Enzo Cannavale, Maria Mercader, Nuccia Fumo, Lucia Vasini, Francesca Antonelli, Elisabeth Kaza

title: La casa del sortilegio
synopsis: To try to escape the nightmares that haunt him, Luca takes refuge in a country house. Here he runs into a blind pianist and his granddaughter. She is a witch who haunts the guests of the villa.
cast: Andy J. Forrest, Marina Giulia Cavalli, Sonia Petrovna, Maria Stella

title: La casa del tappeto giallo
synopsis: A young lady of the good bourgeoisie has nights and sleeps tormented by nightmares of an Oedipal nature. Nightmares have a common denominator in a yellow carpet that the woman owns and that she now sets about selling, thus convinced to free herself from her phobias. The potential buyer, however, seems to accentuate his fantasies so much that the woman, after having been "questioned" by the client, ends up killing him.
cast: Erland Josephson, Béatrice Romand, Vittorio Mezzogiorno

title: La casa dell'amore
synopsis: Bianca is a transsexual who has chosen to prostitute herself for work. Thirty-nine, he lives in Milan in the popular quarter of Quarto Oggiaro in an apartment on the third floor of a building built in the seventies. Daughter of a well-known sculptor, she has an old model of cell phone and to meet her she can be contacted on the meeting sites. For this reason, Bianca must always stay at home: not replying to a message would mean losing a customer. The house is therefore one of the two fixed points of his life. The other is Natasha Da Castro, his historical partner for sixteen years and a Japanese transsexual who is divided between Milan and Brazil.

title: La casa dell'orco
synopsis: Little Cheryl is threatened in a dream by an ogre. Years later Cheryl herself, who became a writer, is working on a horror story: suddenly she realizes that the Italian castle in which she is spending the holidays in the company of her husband and son is the same as her nightmare, monster including ...
cast: Virginia Bryant, Sabrina Ferilli, Paolo Malco, Stefania Montorsi

title: La casa della follia
synopsis: A writer in crisis sees in his wife the cause of all his failures. Human problems, however, do not come from the outside but from the walls of a house capable of assimilating the vibrations of the tenants.
cast: Luigi Pistilli, Olga Karlatos, Renato Mori, Sasi Conte, Remo Remotti

title: La casa delle anime erranti
synopsis: A hotel in the Alps is haunted by the usual ghosts that do not leave those who have rented rooms quiet.
cast: Joseph Alan Johnson, Stefania Orsola Garello, Matteo Gazzolo

title: La casa di famiglia
synopsis: Four brothers - Alex, twins Oreste and Giacinto and Fanny - grew up in comfort in a beautiful family villa in the countryside. However, they couldn't be more different from each other. To help Alex, in serious economic difficulty, they decide to resort to the only possible solution: to sell the paternal house. However, none of them can imagine that, the day after the notary's signature, the unthinkable could happen: their father Sergio, in a coma for many years, wakes up. Doctors are categorical: for a good recovery it is essential that he return to his daily life surrounded by the affection of his children, memories and objects dearest to him. And now? The four brothers have only one thing left to do: pretend the villa has never been sold and quickly recover furniture, family heirlooms and even the beloved dog.
cast: Lino Guanciale, Stefano Fresi, Libero De Rienzo, Matilde Gioli, Luigi Diberti, Nicoletta Romanoff

title: La casa dove abitava Corinne
synopsis: Doriana Polis, prosecutor of the republic, has just taken possession of her Roman apartment when she learns that a girl had been killed there some time before and that the murder went unpunished. Doriana receives strange messages and, moreover, she discovers that the police commissioner who dealt with the case has resigned without giving explanations. The new investigation is fraught with dangers. To say that the story is supported by an iron logic would be excessive.
cast: Barbara De Rossi, Massimo Ranieri, Gottfried John, Giada Desideri

title: La casa lobo
synopsis: Maria is a young woman who escapes from a German colony to avoid being punished. Thus he finds shelter in a house in the woods, where everything has no shape or stability.

title: La casa muda
synopsis: Laura and her father Wilson settle in a country house with the aim of renovating it and then putting it back on sale. They get ready for the night after deciding they would start construction the next morning. All is well until Laura hears a strange and growing noise coming from outside the house that seems to be coming from the roof. Father Wilson decides to go up to the top floor to understand what happens, while Laura waits for him on the ground floor.
cast: Gustavo Alonso, Florencia Colucci, Abel Tripaldi

title: La casa nel tempo
synopsis: Three boys sneak into a house inhabited by two elderly people, kill them and not happy they even take out the gardener. But the three "resurrect" and sow terror.
cast: Keith Van Hoven, Paolo Paoloni, Karina Huff

title: La casa nel vento dei morti
synopsis: In the 1940s, to return to the glories of the past, Attilio (Luca Magri), a fascinating actor who has fallen from grace, organizes a robbery of a post office together with a group of three other desperate people. After the blow, with the aim of escaping arrest and not giving up their dreams, they seek refuge in the rugged woods but find themselves imprisoned in an endless nightmare, during which they rediscover their instinct for survival.
cast: Luca Magri, Francesco Barilli, Nina Torresi, Sara Alzetta, Marco Iannitello, Paola Crecchi, Valeria Colombo, Annalisa Schettino, Adriano Guareschi, Loredana Piedimonte, Fabio De Caro

title: La casa sfuggita
synopsis: Together with his girlfriend Rita, the writer Alex visits an abandoned house and defeat in the Venetian countryside. In the past, the building housed a hotel, the inn to the crossroads, and was the scene of mysterious deaths, which took place in inexplicable circumstances. Alex, equipped with notes and a detailed map, wants to write a book on the house and his mysteries, forcing his partner, despite his protests, to spend the night in the ruin. But something frightening still lives in the old inn. The events of some old guests - a writer, a violinist, a mathematician - resume life and return from the past mixing with those of the two young people, in a whirlwind of horror, blood and violence.
cast: Giuseppe Lorusso, Federica Quaglieri, Emanuele Cerman, Silvia Ferreri, Michael Segal, Cristiana Vaccaro, Nicolò Viganelli, Nicoletta Verri, Claudio Viganelli, Roberta Marrelli

title: La casa sperduta nel parco
synopsis: Alex and Ricky are not doing well at all. The first is a sex maniac who has committed rapes while the second accuses a mental riot. The two receive an invitation to a rich house, owned by a certain Tom, where other boys are present. The invitation has a "hidden" reason: Tom wants to entertain his friends with the presence of the two disturbed boys. However, the situation quickly degenerates and even Tom reveals his psychopathic nature. In the end, however, the roles will be reversed and there will be a shocking revelation.
cast: David Hess, Annie Belle, Christian Borromeo, Giovanni Lombardo Radice, Marie Claude Joseph, Gabriele Di Giulio, Brigitte Petronio, Karoline Mardeck, Lorraine De Selle

title: La casa stregata
synopsis: Around the year 1000, two lovers caught in adultery are transformed into salt statues. The spell will dissolve if, a thousand years later, two spouses find themselves in the same place for their first night of love. Thus we come to our days and to the real estate troubles of Giorgio, a modest banker, eager to find a home to be able to marry his girlfriend, Candida. Unlikely but amusing vicissitudes will lead them at the right time, in the right place, to do the right thing.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Gloria Guida, Lia Zoppelli, Yorgo Voyagis, Marilda Donà, Angelo Pellegrino, Rita Forzano, Leo Gavero, Angelo Nicotra

title: La casa sulle nuvole
synopsis: Michele and Lorenzo, two brothers, live alone in the large house just outside Rome left to them by their father Dario, who passed away 12 years ago. One day, however, surprising news arrives: the house has been sold, and therefore Dario is alive. The two brothers then decide to go and look for him, thanks to some information, they arrive in Morocco, in Marrakech, where a complex but stimulating process of family reunification awaits them.
cast: Adriano Giannini, Emanuele Bosi, Emilio Bonucci, Paolo Sassanelli, Manuela Spartà, Tara Haggiag

title: La casa è di chi la abita - Porta Pia occupata
synopsis: A building in the center of Rome has long been occupied by people with more disparate origins (Africa, South America, Rome itself) and with a very different experience. The documentary reconstructs their struggle path to claim the right to public home.

title: La cattedra
synopsis: Professor Dal Mario, a university professor of philosophy, has two arguments, big and big and Parini, who hope to exploit his prestige to make a career. When Mario is hit by a stroke, the two have the opportunity to reveal the worst side of their character. If Parini reveals himself hypocritical, big in the long run of his behavior, so much so that he obtained the forgiveness of the professor, finally put back. Despite the presence of actors who usually stand out for their comic registers - from Riondino to Sabina Guzzanti - this film is a bitter description of a group of birds of prey. Too bad that, he can't take off.
cast: Giulio Brogi, Claudio Bigagli, David Riondino, Sabina Guzzanti, Enrica Maria Modugno

title: La cave se rebiffe
synopsis: An improvised gang tries the big shot: to implement it, it avails itself of the help of Ferdinand, known as the "King of counterfeiters", who leaves on purpose from Montevideo for Paris. But this one ...
cast: Jean Gabin, Martine Carol, Frank Villard, Françoise Rosay, Bernard Blier

title: La caviglia di Amelia
synopsis: One evening in the life of a young writer, at work on his second book. An opera that will be set at the turn of the century, will have melodrama tones and will be influenced by the real events that happen in the author's life. A life that is certainly not what he would like.
cast: Amelia Aragona, Roberto Gigante, Daniele Passaro, Gisella Asmundo

title: La caza
synopsis: For a group of former Spanish civil war fighters, a quiet day of rabbit hunting turns into a sort of tight surrender of existential and political accounts.
cast: Ismael Merlo, Alfredo Mayo, José Maria Prada, Emilio Gutierrez

title: La caza del oro
synopsis: Former hauler Jonathan Carver, who has been in jail for twenty years for making a large amount of gold from the Mining Company disappear, is released. His cellmate, Paco, and the lone gunslinger Trash, help him escape the hunt for four tough guys and Travers of the Company. Carver dies however before recovering the gold, Paco and Trash will have to fend for themselves.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Daniel Martin, Tania Alvarado, Manuel Guitian, Fernando Sancho, Raf Baldassarre, Luis Induni, Gustavo Re

title: La cena
synopsis: In the Antico Grottino, a Roman restaurant, the events of the usual patrons take place. There is the owner of the club who decides not to leave with her great love, a mother who discovers her daughter's vocation, a girl who makes an appointment with four boyfriends together, a professor who forces her very young lover to leave him and a charlatan who turns into an authentic magician.
cast: Fanny Ardant, Stefania Sandrelli, Vittorio Gassman, Giancarlo Giannini

title: La cena delle beffe
synopsis: The rivalry between Giannetto Malespini and Neri Chiaramontesi is long-standing. Giannetto manages to have Neri imprisoned on charges of being mad and hastens to steal his lover, Ginevra. Neri manages to escape, runs to Ginevra's house well-intentioned to take revenge and kills the man who is with her, who is her brother, led there by the cunning of Giannetto. At that point Neri really goes crazy.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Clara Calamai, Osvaldo Valenti, Elisa Cegani, Alfredo Varelli, Valentina Cortese, Memo Benassi, Piero Carnabuci

title: La cena di Natale
synopsis: As Christmas approaches, in Polignano a Mare, the famous Apulian town which for once is unusually covered in snow, everyone is more agitated than usual. The most upset is Matilde who receives an emerald ring from Don Mimì, her husband, "guilty" of having neglected it too much in recent times. Matilde gets excited to the point of improvising a dinner for that same evening in their large house, modestly nicknamed the "Petruzzelli", where you move with the lift and where a four meter high Christmas tree dominates. Matilde's goal is clear: to challenge in front of everyone her sister-in-law Ninella, her husband's great childhood love. And Ninella does not let herself be intimidated, even if she made a mistake in the color by opting for a little successful "blond Kidman" and is very annoyed by the presence of Aunt Pina. That evening, at the same table set, among others: Chiara, pregnant with 8 months, and her husband Damiano, who maybe got two pregnant with women; Nancy, seventeen-year-old obsessed with virginity; and Orlando, a gay lawyer who is trying to give a baby to his best lesbian friend, Daniela, while being courted by Mario .
cast: Laura Chiatti, Riccardo Scamarcio, Michele Placido, Maria Pia Calzone, Veronica Pivetti, Antonella Attili, Eugenio Franceschini, Antonio Gerardi, Eva Riccobono, Dario Aita, Giulia Elettra Gorietti, Uccio De Santis

title: La cena per farli conoscere
synopsis: To attract attention, Sandro Lanza - a television actor in decline - stages a suicide on Christmas Day that is almost fatal. Hospitalized, he is joined by his three daughters, hitherto ignored ...
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Vanessa Incontrada, Violante Placido, Ines Sastre, Francesca Neri

title: La cena perfetta
synopsis: Carmine, a Camorist with a good heart, manages a restaurant to recycle dirty money, and finds himself collaborating with Consuelo, a chef in search of perfection. The love for food and the dream of conquering a Michelin star will give both a second chance and an opportunity for redemption.
cast: Greta Scarano, Salvatore Esposito, Gianluca Colucci, Gianfranco Gallo, Antonella Attili, Antonio Grosso

title: La cento chilometri
synopsis: Cesare doesn't have a penny and has to pay the carpenter: the only hope is to win the Cento Kilometer organized by a running club. The lawyer Corsetti signs up due to a lost bet, a former champion instead in order not to disappoint his own son.
cast: Massimo Girotti, Mario Carotenuto, Marisa Merlini, Elio Pandolfi, Riccardo Garrone, Yvonne Monlaur, Nando Bruno, Raffaele Pisu, Geronimo Meynier, Edoardo Nevola, Carlo Taranto

title: La cerimonia dei sensi
synopsis: Gravely wounded, a "stunt performer" dreams of being Jesus and relives some episodes of the Gospel in a modern key.
cast: Franco Pugi, Camillo Besenzon, Dina Castigliego, Valerio Fiorino, Piero Fraticelli, Filippo La Neve, Luca Emiliani, Mario Monetti, Sergio Fiore Pisapia, Ornella Grassi

title: La certosa di Parma
synopsis: In the spring of 1815, the young and idealist Fabrizio Del Dongo (Rodrigo Guirao Diaz) decides to join the troops that Napoleon gathered after fleeing the island of Elba. The only one who shares this choice is his aunt Gina (Marie-Josée Croze), the charming younger sister of the Marquis Del Dongo (Mattia Sbragia); who, discovering the flight of his son and fearing to be accused of treason by the Austrians, reports him to the police.
cast: Marie Joseé Croze, Rodrigo Guirao Díaz, Hippolyte Girardot, Alessandra Mastronardi, François Berléand, Mattia Sbragia, Ralph Palka, Stefano Abbati, Barbara Ronchi, Francesco Stella, Ruggero Cara, Enrico Beruschi, Delphine Serina

title: La ch'tite famille
synopsis: A Paris fashion designer from a Northern worker family shamefully hides its origins. Misunderstandings and complications will derive.
cast: Dany Boon, Pierre Richard, François Berléand, Line Renaud, Valérie Bonneton, Laurence Arné, Guy Lecluyse

title: La chair de l'orchidé
cast: Bruno Cremer, Charlotte Rampling, Simone Signoret

title: La chambre ardente
synopsis: What is the cause of the death of the owner of the ancient castle? It seems like a heart attack, but the grandchildren, greedy for the inheritance, blame each other. For them too, fate is black: for centuries they have been victims of the vengeful curse of the ancient landowner, a marquise denounced for witchcraft and burned alive. The informer was her lover and there is no mercy for any of her descendants.
cast: Jean Claude Brialy, Claude Rich, Edith Scob, Nadja Tiller

title: La chambre bleue
synopsis: A man and a woman, two lovers both already romantically engaged, love each other in the secret of a room and desire each other like never before. After making love, they exchange some harmless words. At least this is what the man believes, soon at the center of circumstances that are not entirely clear.
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Léa Drucker, Laurent Poitrenaux, Stéphanie Cléau, Mona Jaffart

title: La chambre des morts
synopsis: One night in December, in Dunkirk, two unemployed computer technicians overwhelm a man who appeared out of nowhere, killing him. The man was carrying a bag with two million euros and the two decide to keep the money, getting rid of the body. The next day, in a warehouse not far from the accident, the police find the body of Melody, a blind girl held hostage. That same evening, another child is kidnapped but this time it is a diabetic girl. At the police station the countdown begins to find her before it is too late: next to Moreno there is Lucie (Mélanie Laurent), a young sergeant of 26 years on her first investigation.
cast: Mélanie Laurent, Eric Caravaca, Gilles Lellouche, Jonathan Zaccaï, Céline Sallette, Laurence Cote, Jean François Stévenin, Nathalie Richard, Stephane Jobert, Antoine Oppenheim

title: La chambre verte
synopsis: 1930s, French province. A widowed journalist refuses to accept the death of his wife and restores an old ruined chapel to honor the memory of the woman and all her deceased friends. Not even the love of a young woman will be able to distract him from his obsession.
cast: François Truffaut, Nathalie Baye, Jean Dasté, Jean Pierre Moulin, Antoine Vitez

title: La chartreuse de Parme
synopsis: After joining the Napoleonic army, Fabrizio Del Dongo joins his aunt, the Duchess of Sanseverina, in Parma, who is burning with passion for him. Arrested due to a duel, he falls in love with Clelia, the daughter of the governor of the prison.
cast: Gérard Philipe, Maria Casarès, Maria Michi, Tina Lattanzi, Louis Salou, Tullio Carminati, Renée Faure

title: La chasse aux papillons
synopsis: The elderly Marie-Agnès, assisted by her cousin Solange, lives in a large castle in the French countryside. A bizarre lawyer, his neighbor, would like to have him sell it to the Japanese. When Marie-Agnès dies she leaves everything to her sister Hélène, who lives in Russia. This comes with her daughter Olga and sells. Iosseliani shows us his point of view on how the world now goes with melancholy skepticism. A ferocious fresco of the French province and of all humanity: no one is saved, but it is better to rely on derision rather than give in to anguish. In 1989 "A fire seen from afar" and in 1996 "Briganti briganti" obtained the special Grand Prix of the jury, but not the Golden Lion. In receiving the prize, Iosseliani himself underlined, with an ironic joke, this singular situation of his. And besides, this delightful and cruel fable, in the typical Georgian director's style, is a little gem.
cast: Narda Blanchet, Pierrette Pompom Bailhache, Lilia Olivier

title: La chasse à l'homme
synopsis: Antoine (Jean Claude Brialy) is a breezy young man who is about to get married with Gisele, a rich and spoiled girl. Frightened by the particularly frustrating outcome of the weddings of friends Julien and Fernand (Jean-Paul Belmondo), Antoine uses one of his honeymoon airline tickets to escape to Greece the day before the wedding and end up in the arms of an adventurer. Light but pleasant comedy.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Jean Claude Brialy, Claude Rich, Françoise Dorléac, Marie Laforêt, Catherine Deneuve, Marie Dubois, Hélène Duc, Bernadette Lafont

title: La chatte
synopsis: Cora, known as "La Gatta", is part of a partisan group. Her lover pretends to be a Swiss journalist, but in reality he is a German officer whose job is to dismantle the resistance in that region. When Cora realizes how things stand, it's too late: her comrades are all arrested and she is killed for cheating.
cast: Françoise Arnoul, Bernard Blier, Bernhard Wicki, Kurt Meisel, André Versini, Roger Hanin, Louison Roblin, Harald Wolff, Michel Jourdan

title: La chatte à deux têtes
synopsis: In the red light cinema "La chatte à deux têtes" the patrons, including a group of regular transvestites, meet in the darkness of the room and participate in impromptu sexual encounters. Meanwhile, the cashier of Italian origins tells her life and her sentimental past to the young projectionist and a middle-aged customer.
cast: Frédéric Longbois, Jacques Nolot, Vittoria Scognamiglio, Olivier Torres, Sébastien Viala

title: La chiave
synopsis: Venice, the eve of the declaration of the Second World War. An elderly English professor, director of the art biennial is married to Teresa. Both are looking for novelties in their sexual relationship. One day the husband independently leaves the key to the floor of her study that opens the drawer in which she keeps the diary hidden where she tells her most secret erotic fantasies. Teresa finds the key, opens the drawer and begins to read avidly.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Frank Finlay, Maria Grazia Bon, Franco Branciaroli

title: La chica nueva
synopsis: Jimena goes to Rio Grande, on the island of Terra del Fuoco, in the extreme south of Argentina, to reach the Marian half -brother. He has almost no money but he manages to get there hoping to have a better life in that manufacturing region. The wind, the cold and the complex economic crisis constitute the background in which Jimena will develop empathy for the people around her and a feeling of belonging to a place where she will learn to get to know each other better.
cast: Mora Arenillas, Rafael Federman

title: La chiesa
synopsis: In the Middle Ages a group of knights chase a witch and live the walls in a pit together with some plague victims. The action changes and passes to the present day, with the young restorer Lisa working on a painting in a gothic cathedral. The work is marred by strange episodes, and a tragic fate falls to the librarian Evald whom Lisa falls in love with. The secret lies in a large stone in the basement of the cathedral, the same as that of that distant massacre.
cast: Tomas Arana, Barbara Cupisti, Asia Argento, Micaela Pignatelli, Hugh Quarshie, Feodor Chaliapin Jr., Antonella Vitale, Giovanni Lombardo Radice, Roberto Caruso

title: La chispa de la vida
synopsis: An accident that occurred in a Roman amphitheater blocks the advertiser Roberto in a situation of extreme danger, for some time looking for a job that will allow him to improve the economic conditions of his family and his beloved wife Luisa (Salma Hayek). Since no one seems able to save man, the mass media rush to the scene, monitoring the story minute by minute. Taking advantage of the situation, the man decides to release an exclusive interview with a prime time program in return for a great reward in which he will tell the last details that separate his life from death.
cast: Salma Hayek, José Mota, Santiago Segura, Carolina Bang, Blanca Portillo, Nacho Vigalondo, Nerea Camacho, Guillermo Toledo, Javier Gutiérrez, Fernando Tejero, Juanjo Puigcorbe

title: La chute de la maison Usher
synopsis: In the Usher house the owner paints the portrait of his wife Madeline, and it is as if the woman lived in the painting. When she dies, her husband absolutely does not want her coffin sealed, but only covered with a very thin veil. One stormy night, however, in the tomb, the coffin falls to the ground, the candles are overturned, setting fire to the house and Madeline appears. While the devastating flames devour everything, in the painting the female figure has mysteriously disappeared.
cast: Jean Debucourt, Marguerite Gance, Charles Lamy, Fournez Goffard

title: La chèvre
synopsis: Marie, a rich girl but haunted by bad luck, is kidnapped as soon as she arrives in Mexico. In charge of the research is the detective Campana, who flounders without success. Things change when he is joined by an assistant haunted by bad luck. All sorts of things happen, but in the end the magnet of the common bad luck works. Hugely successful French comedy, entrusted to the inspiration of the two protagonists (who will be together in two other films). It was the film that was screened at the Statuto cinema in Turin when the fire occurred.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Pierre Richard, Michel Robin, Corynne Charbit, Pedro Armendariz Jr., Maritza Olivares, André Valardy, Jorge Luke, Sergio Calderón

title: La cicala
synopsis: La Cicala is a hotel bar with an adjoining petrol station run by Annibale Meneghetti and his wife Wilma. But it is also the name of a gypsy who is Wilma's last passionate fan since she was a singer. The place is very unsophisticated and mainly frequented by truckers, but the biggest pitfalls for Wilma come from the anger of her daughter Saveria. Lattuada, just so as not to take himself seriously, has defined his melodrama as a cinematic photo novel. It is actually a passionate melodrama full of flesh, cravings and tears. Virna Lisi (voiced when she sings by Carla Boni) is amazing.
cast: Anthony Franciosa, Virna Lisi, Clio Goldsmith, Renato Salvatori, Barbara De Rossi

title: La cicatrice intérieure
synopsis: The wandering of a woman, two men and a child on a distant and icy planet.
cast: Nico, Philippe Garrel, Ari Boulogne, Daniel Pommereulle, Pierre Clementi, Balthazar Clémenti, Jean Pierre Kalfon

title: La cieca di Sorrento
synopsis: Beatrice was blind, as a child, the night a bandit killed her mother. When she grows up she undergoes an operation that restores her sight. The doctor who performs the important and delicate operation is the son of the alleged bandit.
cast: Dria Paola, Claudio Racca, Anna Magnani, Dino Di Luca, Mario Steni, Giulio Tempesti, Diana Lante, Miranda Bonansea

title: La cinquième saison
synopsis: A mysterious calamity unfolds, prolonging the winter longer than the long one. Spring refuses to arrive, the landscape and the animals continue to hibernate. Alice, Thomas and Octave, three kids from a small Belgian village in the heart of the Ardennes forests, struggle to make sense of the collapsing world around them. While Alice and Thomas are in love, Octave watches what happens from the wheelchair he is forced into. The passing of the months leads to days of a missed summer in which the violence of the other inhabitants of the village is ready to explode and an ephemeral joy reappears thanks to the passage of a beekeeper. But when every form of civilization risks disappearing, a pagan rite will seem to be the only solution.
cast: Aurélia Poirier, Django Schrevens, Sam Louwyck, Gill Vancompernolle

title: La cintura
synopsis: Vittorio meets Bianca. The two can't stand each other, they continue to quarrel and take offense: that's why they go to live together. The ménage is a disaster, until the two discover that by beating up their relationships improve. Thus they slip into a sado-maso tunnel that ends with an abortion for her and a trial for mistreatment for him. It was Francesca Archibugi who drew this unspeakable mess from a Moravian text. The same year Brigliadori should have presented the Zecchino d'oro, but its performances tied to the bed head put it in a bad light in the modest eyes of the organizers.
cast: Eleonora Brigliadori, James Russo, Giuliana Calandra, Anna Bonaiuto, Karen Moore, Lidia Broccolino, Riccardo Salvino, Delia D'Alberti, Claire Hardwick, Ivano Marescotti

title: La cintura di castità
synopsis: Called to the Crusades before having succeeded in consummating the marriage, the noble Guerrando imposes a chastity belt on his wife Boccadoro. However, she is not willing to wait for him in the castle and so decides to follow him to the Holy Land. The journey and the search for the bridegroom are not immune from dangers for the woman who nevertheless finally reaches her goal: to have her hateful "garment" taken off. Not as trivial as the title and plot might suggest, it nevertheless falls into that historical genre - comedian who had a moment of popularity between the end of the sixties and the beginning of the seventies in the wake of the successful L'armata Brancaleone (1965).
cast: Monica Vitti, Tony Curtis, Nino Castelnuovo, Ivo Garrani, Gabriella Giorgelli, Hugh Griffith, John Richardson, Francesco Mulè, Umberto Raho, Lauro Gazzolo

title: La ciociara
synopsis: Cesira, a woman of the people, runs a grocery store in Rome, but when the allies bomb the capital, she takes refuge, together with her teenage daughter, in her country of origin, in Ciociaria. When the danger seems to have been averted, the two women return to Rome; along the way some Moroccan soldiers rape them. De Sica, helped by the screenplay by Cesare Zavattini, translates Moravia's novel with sensitivity and vigor. The dominant character is that of Cesira, the mother, played with passion by a memorable Loren awarded with an Oscar and at the Cannes Film Festival.
cast: Sophia Loren, Eleonora Brown, Jean Paul Belmondo, Raf Vallone, Andrea Checchi, Carlo Ninchi, Pupella Maggio, Emma Baron, Bruna Cealti, Antonella Della Porta, Mario Frera

title: La ciociara
synopsis: Cesira and her daughter Rosetta, a young girl, after a bombing were displaced from Rome in the mountains of Lazio. When the allies break through the front, the two women are surprised by a patrol of Moroccans, who rape both of them. Thirty years later (and now with the right age) Loren reprises for TV the character with which she had an Oscar in the film directed by Vittorio De Sica in 1960, Palme d'Or at Cannes. The story is still that of Moravia's novel, but the outcome had been better three decades earlier, even if the protagonist puts all the determination at her disposal. More than Risi takes.
cast: Sophia Loren, Sydney Penny, Andrea Occhipinti, Robert Loggia, Carla Calò, Leonardo Ferrantini, Dario Ghirardi, Tommy Givogre, Ilza Prestinari, Pino Quartullo

title: La circostanza
synopsis: For everyone there is a circumstance capable of changing, even imperceptibly, the course of people's entire existence. Laura Liberti, a spirited career woman, meets by chance a young motorcyclist involved in a road accident. Her husband, an industry executive, ends up being fired due to industrial modernization. And also for their children, Silvia, Beppe and Tommaso, there will be a special moment, a crucial "circumstance". This is how Olmi had begun, with an almost subdued cinema, very modern, but light. Then he too got lost. His old films were much better. Small, small.
cast: Ada Savelli, Gaetano Porro, Raffaella Bianchi, Mario Sireci, Barbara Pezzuto

title: La città del sole
synopsis: The story of Tommaso Campanella, philosopher and revolutionary of the seventeenth century, who described his utopia in The city of the sun and who in the name of that utopia even ended up before the Inquisition. It is the second feature by Gianni Amelio, shot for TV. Don't expect a romantic TV drama, rather a kind of philosophical documentary.
cast: Giulio Brogi, Daniel Sherrill, Umberto Spadaro, Bedy Moratti, Giancarlo Palermo, Ernesto Colli, Riccardo Mangano

title: La città delle donne
synopsis: Snaporaz, a middle-aged man, gets off the train on which he is traveling with his wife to follow a mysterious woman. He finds himself first in a hotel where wild feminists hold a tumultuous conference (of which he understands nothing), then in the castle of a certain Katzone, a guru of eroticism, then in a court where women condemn him and in an arena where he must be lynched. Unbridled fantasy, highly inventive iconography for what appears to be the attempt to exorcise once and for all a fundamental Fellini "taboo": the woman. But, with a tiring and tangled path, an effort of little construct. Perhaps the director's least successful film.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Ettore Manni, Anna Prucnal, Bernice Stegers

title: La città di Zeno
synopsis: Director Franco Giraldi investigates the life and works of the Trieste writer Italo Svevo, asking questions to his relatives and acquaintances and interviewing cultural personalities of the Julian capital. Likewise, he composes a portrait of the social, historical and cultural reality of the city of Trieste, between the Austro-Hungarian past and the Italian present perhaps not yet metabolized.

title: La città dolente
synopsis: After the Treaty of Paris, the city of Pula was annexed to Yugoslavia and almost all Italians abandon it. Among the few who choose to stay is Berto, who is promised that he will be the owner of the workshop where he is a worker. But these are the lies of the Communists, because the machinery is confiscated by the state and the work languishes. Berto rebels and is locked up in a concentration camp; manages to escape and tries to reach Italy with a boat, but is killed by the Yugoslavs. Anti-communist propaganda that fails to be convincing nor to move despite the screenplay being also signed by Fellini.
cast: Luigi Tosi, Barbara Costanova, Elio Steiner, Gianni Rizzo, Constance Dowling, Attilio Dottesio, Anita Farra, Gustavo Serena, Raimondo Van Riel, Milly Vitale

title: La città gioca d'azzardo
synopsis: Luca Altieri (Luc Merenda) is a professional cheater and tries to conquer Milan. He finds the protection of a big shot of the underworld, but also the hatred of his son, who persecutes him because of a woman loved by both of them. Gambling dens, drugs, violence, love affairs, pursuits and death: the city seen from its slums is really a sewer.
cast: Luc Merenda, Dayle Haddon, Corrado Pani, Lino Troisi, Enrico Maria Salerno, Franco Javarone, Salvatore Puntillo, Carlo Alighiero, Piero Palermini, Carlo Gaddi

title: La città ideale
synopsis: Michele Grassadonia (Luigi Lo Cascio), a militant ecologist, leaves Sicily to go and live in Siena, an ideal city where it is possible to coexist with nature in a harmonious relationship. Here, he has been trying to live without using electricity and running water for a year. After one night an accident harnesses him in a situation from which he can no longer get out, he finds himself questioning all his convictions and confronting officials, politicians and judges with ambiguous behavior.
cast: Luigi Lo Cascio, Roberto Herlitzka, Catrinel Marlon, Luigi Maria Burruano, Silvia Luzzi, Massimo Foschi, Alfonso Santagata, Barbara Enrichi, Aida Burruano, Manuel Zicarelli

title: La città invisibile
synopsis: Luca and Lucilla are two students of the medical course at the University of L'Aquila and for them too, as for all the inhabitants of the Abruzzo capital, the earthquake of April 6, 2009 marks a radical change. Despite their differences, both, despite the collapse of the University, decide to stay and help as volunteers: a commitment that will help them see many things and that will help to bring them closer.
cast: Alan Cappelli Goetz, Barbara Ronchi, Nicola Nocella, Gabriele Cirilli, Riccardo Garrone

title: La città prigioniera
synopsis: After the liberation from the Nazis, Athens became the scene of clashes between opposing partisan factions. Meanwhile, a handful of British soldiers under the orders of Major Peter Whitfield guard the Zeus hotel: among them, however, a traitor lurks. But despite his best efforts, the hotel suffers a siege and is eventually mined. Whitfield then tries to save himself and the few survivors ...
cast: David Niven, Lea Massari, Ben Gazzara, Martin Balsam, Michael Craig

title: La città sconvolta: caccia spietata ai rapitori
synopsis: Masked bandits, who carry out their criminal actions on behalf of unsuspected financiers from the North, kidnap little Antonio Filippini, the son of a wealthy engineer, and also Fabrizio, a playmate of his who intervened in his defense. The kidnappers, who came out after a period of silence, negotiate with the secretary of the engineer and ask for the ransom of Antonio, ten billion. Filipinos at first balk, but the kidnappers kill Fabrizio ...
cast: Luc Merenda, James Mason, Irina Maleeva, Marino Masé

title: La città si difende
synopsis: Four bandits steal the takings from a football match and run away. One dies trying to take refuge in Corsica. Another kills himself out of desperation. A third is arrested with the complicity of his ex-lover. And the fourth threatens to throw himself out of a building and then thinks about it. Germi has always loved black American cinema. Here he packs an episode from the series "Il delitto doesn't pay".
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Fausto Tozzi, Renato Baldini, Paul Müller, Tamara Lees

title: La cité des enfants perdus
synopsis: In a surreal future world, the terrible and monstrous Krank cannot dream. Thus he decides to kidnap the children of the nearby town to steal their dreams. One day he kidnaps little Denree, One's adoptive brother, a man not very intelligent, but extremely good. One sets out on the boy's trail and discovers the evil Krank's plans.
cast: Ron Perlman, Daniel Emilfork, Judith Vittet, Dominique Pinon

title: La ciudad maldita
synopsis: In the Old West, the small town of Personville has become unlivable due to the regime of lawlessness and crime that has taken over. Don Wilson, a wealthy tycoon, therefore decides to turn to a private detective agency, which sends its best agent to handle the situation. Since his arrival he will have to contend with corruption and blackmail as well as with the murder of Wilson himself.
cast: Chet Bakon, Diana Lorys, Roberto Camardiel, Daniel Martin, Nat Greenwood, Adolfo Thous, Luciano Pigozzi, Eduardo Bea, Francisco Clement, Francisco Casares

title: La classe degli asini
synopsis: In Turin in the mid-1960s, Mirella is a teacher and her dream is to become a principal, but she is also a mother of two children, Flavia and Roberto. Flavia has a severe handicap caused by a meningitis she contracted when she was only two years old. Soon, Mirella meets a little boy, Riccardo, who has recently moved to Turin from Calabria. Riccardo often uses the dialect, at times he is violent and quarrels with his classmates. So, after a test with a psychologist, the school decides to transfer him to a special class. For Mirella, those classes were set up by the Ministry precisely to help those kids with problems like Riccardo. For Felice, on the other hand, who is also a teacher, those classes are only ghettos, which in fact keep children away from school and contribute to widening the gap between the children of the good middle class and the children of peasants or workers. Through vicissitudes and contrasts, Mirella will discover, even on her own skin, that the school needs to change profoundly, requiring integration and the ability to understand others.
cast: Vanessa Incontrada, Flavio Insinna, Fabio Troiano, Monica Dugo, Aurora Giovinazzo, Giovanni D'Aleo, Roberto Accornero, Linda Messerklinger, Manuel Zicarelli

title: La classe non è acqua
synopsis: After teaching abroad for many years, Professor Guido Marinelli (Citran) returns to Italy to take possession of his new chair in a high school in Rome. Arriving at Termini station, an unconscious and frightened girl hands him a bag containing ... a child. Once the newborn is fixed, the man is faced with a new problem. In fact, someone, more, so to speak, appreciated by the Superintendent, has seen fit to snatch his chair. First work by a former teacher halfway between "La scuola" by Luchetti-Starnone and "Classe mixed 3A" by Moccia che. The starting point is "realist", the development of an Italian comedy updated at the time of "I Ragazzi del muretto", while "The fleeting moment" is only a faded memory. Bravo Catania in the role of the silent homosexual. Essential, Mastandrea.
cast: Roberto Citran, Valerio Mastandrea, Barbara Livi, Antonio Catania

title: La classe operaia va in Paradiso
synopsis: Ludovico Massa, known as Lulù, a rough metalworker and scab, is the perfect archetype of the worker without a class conscience. Skilled at work, he struggles to support his wife and lover. Completely changed, following an accident at work that made him lose a finger, he takes sides against the piecework mechanism.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Mariangela Melato, Mietta Albertini, Salvo Randone, Gino Pernice, Luigi Diberti, Flavio Bucci, Corrado Solari, Donato Castellaneta, Renata Zamengo

title: La clinica dell'amore
cast: Mario Colli, Ria De Simone, Flavia Fabiani, Gino Pagnani, Dario De Grassi

title: La clinique de l'amour
synopsis: Directed by their father David, the Marchal clinic is a place of work and love for John and Michael, two surgeon brothers. Both worked in tandem and in harmony until the day when Michael, inconsistent and inconstant, marries Priscilla, the blonde nurse whose sensitive and romantic John is madly in love. Disappointed, John emigrates to Canada but is forced to return to France when Michael leaves Priscilla for Samantha, a sexy nurse, and takes advantage of her father's subsequent heart attack to turn the clinic into a plastic surgery center on the brink of bankruptcy.
cast: Bruno Salomone, Héléna Noguerra, Artus De Penguern, Natacha Lindinger, Dominique Lavanant, Michel Aumont, Eric Godon, Sofia Essaïdi, Yvonne Gradelet, Eric Larcin

title: La coda dello scorpione
synopsis: Lisa Baumer loses her husband in a mysterious plane crash and receives a large inheritance. The insurance agent assigned to the case is not convinced of the woman's innocence and investigates the affair, but must change his mind when Lisa is also murdered. The agent finds himself involved in spite of himself in the chain of murders that will follow.
cast: George Hilton, Anita Strindberg, Evelyn Stewart, Luigi Pistilli

title: La cognatina
synopsis: Young and provocative, the little sister-in-law Monica - just out of boarding school - arrives in the village; all men lose their minds for her, who in any case does not spare herself to please as much as possible: she is not intimidated even in front of an entire football team.
cast: Karin Well, Greta Vayan, Robert Woods, Carlo Micolano, Pupo De Luca, Mimma Monticelli, Alfredo D'Ippolito, Jill Pratt, Gaetano Germana, Tino Carbona

title: La collegiale
synopsis: Daniela after being locked up in a college for a few years he decided to return to the family. So he discovers that his father worries exclusively about money, his mother thinks only of putting his horns, his aunt is a nymphomaniac and his cousin is a blackma with blackmail. The girl at the beginning is scandalized by the "new" balances within her family. Given the situation to Daniela, all that remains is to go to bed with the gardener and then run away with the new mother's man.
cast: Martha Katherin, Nino Castelnuovo, Sofia Dionisio, Femi Benussi

title: La collera del vento
synopsis: We are in Andalusia, in the early years of the century. A landowner hires two brothers to kill the leaders of a clandestine trade union organization that has called a laborers' strike that has had the support of all the workers of the land. In carrying out their mission, however, the two find themselves taking sides on opposite sides: while one does not question the orders of the master, the other begins to reflect on the reasons of the strikers and goes to their side. Thus a fratricidal confrontation is looming.
cast: Terence Hill, Mario Pordo, Carlo Alberto Cortina

title: La collina degli stivali
synopsis: A young gunslinger, wounded in a fight, is hidden and cared for by the performers of a circus. The man is pursued by outlaws who want to appropriate his gold concession. The revenge of the bandits hits an acrobat, but from that moment the gunfighter and his new circus friends go on the counterattack. The showdown will take place during a show, with the help of local miners. The famous couple in a pre-Trinity western, where the first parody temptations already find their way. Colizzi administers stereotypes without particular flashes.
cast: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Woody Strode, Glauco Onorato, Lionel Stander, Victor Buono, George Eastman

title: La colline où rugissent les lionnes
synopsis: Qe, Li and Jeta, three friends, do not see any future perspective in front of them. To change their daily existence, they decide to create a gang. However, the excitement of independence will prove to be dangerous.
cast: Luàna Bajrami, Andi Bajgora, Flaka Latifi, Era Balaj, Urate Shabani

title: La colomba non deve volare
synopsis: In July 1943, one hundred thousand Italian and German soldiers were encircled in Sicily by the Anglo-Americans. To make their situation less desperate, there is only one means: to interrupt the supply of fuel to the allied forces, destroying the oil wells on the island of Bahrain. The task is entrusted to the air squadron of Major Ridolfi, who moves to the island of Cyprus. Since the planes need to be refueled in the middle of the desert, the major finds a valuable help in Pablo ...
cast: Horst Buchholz, Sylva Koscina, William Berger, Riccardo Garrone

title: La colonna infame
cast: Francisco Rabal, Helmut Berger, Vittorio Caprioli, Lucia Bosé, Salvo Randone, Sergio Tofano

title: La colt era il suo Dio
synopsis: A group of bandits, led by the Mexican Manuel, terrorize the town of Landford. The sheriff asks for the help of the army, which sends Captain Mike Jackson to see what is happening in his hometown and to search for a missing government agent in that area. Before long, Jackson finds himself at the center of brawls and shootings with outlaws who, in addition to harassing local farmers, force Mary, the woman the captain once intended to marry, to work in a saloon.
cast: Jeff Cameron, Krista Nell, Sophia Kammara, Donald O'Brien

title: La commare secca
synopsis: The corpse of a prostitute is found on the banks of the Tiber. The police interrogate the various suspects, or even just witnesses of the crime, who make up a sample of small humanity often bordering the law. Accused of murder by a tramp, two boys run away. One of the two, during the escape, drowns.
cast: Francesco Ruiu, Giancarlo De Rosa, Vincenzo Ciccora, Alvaro D'Ercole, Alfredo Leggi, Gabriella Giorgelli, Santina Lisio, Carlotta Barilli, Ada Peragostini, Clorinda Celani, Marisa Solinas

title: La commessa
synopsis: Renato Morriconi is greatly appreciated by the unleashed customers of the beauty institute in which he works. Due to a Spanish with a bodyguard, however, he risks losing his virility ...
cast: Femi Benussi, Tiberio Murgia, Enzo Pulcrano, Renato Cecilia, Yvonne Harlow, Fortunato Cecilia, Sarah Ceccarini, Giorgio Rocco, Paola D'Egidio, Linda Hintermann, Miriam Gravina, Rita Moscatelli

title: La compagna di banco
synopsis: A new student has arrived at the "Mamiani" high school in Trani: beautiful and rich. Naturally, everyone loses their minds for her, but Mario D'Olivo has the greatest chances, a true Don Juan of III B, who has already broken more than one female heart. The other girls, however, more out of envy than altruism, warn the new arrival from the class cock, but between the two, during the school party for the fifteen years of teaching of prof. Cacioppo ...
cast: Lilli Carati, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Alvaro Vitali, Francesca Romana Coluzzi

title: La compagna di viaggio
synopsis: A fallen noble decides to organize a theft on the Rome-Paris train. Instead of hiring a robber he gets help from a busty actress who is supposed to distract the victims thanks to her ... thanks. Unexpected events coming up.
cast: Marina Frajese, Anna Maria Rizzoli, Gastone Moschin

title: La compagnia della Teppa
synopsis: The Compagnia della Teppa is a group halfway between the goliardic and the militant that was formed in Milan during the Napoleonic domination. The Gonfaloniere himself sees the group with favor partly out of intimate and secret conviction, partly because his son is the leader. Father and son, then, are also united by love for a young singer, even if she naturally prefers the young one. It is one of the 71 Italian films produced in 1941, the year of autarky, a period in which a lot was produced, but without going too far. D'Errico, former film critic of the regime, died the same year.
cast: Maria Denis, Adriano Rimoldi, Clelia Matania, Nicoletta Parodi, Corrado Racca, Giorgio Costantini, Dina Perbellini, Erminio Spalla, Carlo Duse, Fausto Guerzoni

title: La comunidad
synopsis: Julia, a real estate agent, accidentally got her hands on a $ 6 billion loot found hidden under a tile in a dead man's apartment. The condominiums, having learned of the fact, are ready for everything, from seduction to murder, as long as Julia does not leave the building with her suitcase full of pesetas.
cast: Carmen Maura, Eduardo Antuña, Jesús Bonilla, Paca Gabaldón

title: La comédie du bonheur
synopsis: Worried about his philanthropy, which risks squandering his assets, the heirs of the banker Jourdain have him interned in an asylum. Jourdain escapes and decides to try other paths: hired three actors, leads them to a boarding house and directs them in a performance that has as many unhappy protagonists who live there, who will come out transformed. Then, caught back, he returns without regrets to the asylum. In this comedy, to whose vaguely surreal atmospheres Cocteau's dialogues contribute, one can read in transparency an indication of the transfiguring potential of cinema. The script is enhanced by a handful of great actors.
cast: Michel Simon, Ramon Novarro, Micheline Presle, Jacqueline Delubac, Sylvie, Louis Jourdan, André Alerme, Ève Francis, Magdeleine Bérubet, Marcel Vallée

title: La concessione del telefono
synopsis: Late nineteenth century. Filippo Genuardi, a small wood merchant from Vigata, asks the prefect to be able to install a telephone line between his warehouse and his father-in-law's home. Not getting an answer several times, he then turns to the exponent of the Vigatese mafia, unleashing a series of dangerous misunderstandings.
cast: Alessio Vassallo, Thomas Trabacchi, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Corrado Guzzanti, Corrado Fortuna, Federica De Cola, Dajana Roncione, Ninni Bruschetta, Michele Di Mauro, Antonio Alveario, Sergio Vespertino, Emmanuele Aita, Alessandro Schiavo, Francesco Brandi, Giuseppe Provinzano, Giugiu Gramaglia

title: La condanna
synopsis: The young Sandra gets lost in a museum and remains locked inside; a man appears to her and accompanies her through the halls and seduces her. When the two go out and she finds out that he had the keys to the place, she accuses him of rape. At the trial the Public Prosecutor, who is experiencing a moment of marital crisis and therefore calling into question a number of things, asks for a sentence for him. The usual Marco Bellocchio paired with his psychoanalyst Fagioli, aimed at demonstrating that in sexual intercourse the woman's consent should not be demanded: after all, the rapist is her ideal man, and she should be grateful to him. No comment. Silver bear in Berlin.
