cast: Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Claire Nebout, Andrzej Seweryn, Grazyna Szapolowska

title: La confession
synopsis: During the German occupation, in a small French town, the arrival of a new priest arouses the interest of all the local women. Even Barny, a young Communist and atheist woman, is not entirely indifferent. Driven by curiosity, the skeptical young girl goes to church to challenge Father Léon Morin. Usually confident in her presence, she is destabilized by her seductive intelligence. Thanks to their exchanges of views, he will question his deepest beliefs.
cast: Romain Duris, Marine Vacth, Solène Rigot, Anne Le Ny, Lucas Tavernier, Amandine Dewasmes

title: La congiuntura
synopsis: Giuliano, a Roman prince, is persuaded by a beautiful girl to take a trip to Switzerland using his comfortable car with a diplomatic plate. In reality, the girl is thinking of taking a large amount of money abroad rather than a vacation. Only after crossing the border Giuliano understands the trick.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Joan Collins, Jacques Bergerac, Hilde Barry

title: La constellation Jodorowsky
synopsis: Who is really Alejandro Jodorowsky? Can he define himself as the complete artist since he is a director, writer, actor, cartoonist, mime artist, puppeteer, psycho-magician and clown? To provide an answer are Jodorowsky himself but also some of the famous people who have been close to him: the designer Jean "Moebius" Giraud, the singer Peter Gabriel, Fernado Arrabal and the karate champion Jean-Pierre Vignau.
cast: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Fernando Arrabal, Peter Gabriel, Marcel Marceau, Jean Giraud, Jean Pierre Vignau, Louis Mouchet

title: La contessa Castiglione
synopsis: Countess Castiglione on a diplomatic mission to Paris on behalf of her cousin, the Count of Cavour, reunites with an old flame. The countess thus finds herself having to choose between fidelity to the commitment made and the temptation to re-establish the old relationship. In the end, the Reason of State wins. There is neither flesh nor blood in this Calzavara film. In a very short role, the young Gabriele Ferzetti.
cast: Doris Duranti, Andrea Checchi, Luigi Allodoli, Alessandra Adari

title: La contessa azzurra
synopsis: An elderly silent film star recalls her past. She remembers when she was an unknown girl whom a director chose (instead of a recalcitrant diva) to make a film, entitled "The Blue Countess", which achieved great success. A love story was also born between the two, however, but since the beginning of the First World War. Produced by Achille Lauro and interpreted by his protégé Elly Davis, a gentle sentimental comedy that is also a passionate homage to the city of Naples, to its cinematographic and variety tradition.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Zsa Zsa Gabor, Paolo Stoppa, Elly Davis

title: La contessa di Castiglione
synopsis: In Florence, during a theatrical performance, he makes an attempt on the life of the Grand Duke. The culprit, the anarchist Lucio, is helped by Virginia, Cavour's nephew and betrothed to the Count of Castiglione. The young woman accompanies her uncle and her new husband to Paris, on a diplomatic mission, and for this reason Lucio tries to exploit the situation: his aim is to kill Napoleon III.
cast: Yvonne De Carlo, Georges Marchal, Lea Padovani, Rossano Brazzi, Paul Merisse, Lucienne Legrand, Georges Lannes, Michel Etcheverry, Tamara Lees, Roldano Lupi

title: La controfigura
synopsis: Giovanni, a failed architect, married Lucia but during a vacation he seduces his mother-in-law Nora. Both women are attracted to Giovanni, a hippy who is one day found murdered dead.
cast: Jean Sorel, Ewa Aulin, Lucia Bosé, Silvano Tranquilli, Sergio Doria

title: La convocazione
synopsis: Milan, Palace of Justice. Sixty citizens, drawn by lot from a computer system, take their places in the courtroom where the trials of the second section of the Court of Assizes of Appeal are held. Lucky candidates, the sixty will spend a whole day among the onyx-clad walls, waiting to know if, beyond their own will, they will be chosen by the President of the Court to rise to a role that many did not even know existed, the role of popular judge.

title: La cordillera
synopsis: Hernán Blanco, the president of Argentina, is faced with a crucial decision. He is attending a three-day meeting with the leaders of the various Latin American countries that is being held in Chile. During the summit, he will have to resolve a difficult personal issue that can affect both his public and private life.
cast: Ricardo Darín, Paulina Garcia, Elena Anaya, Alfredo Castro, Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Erica Rivas, Dolores Fonzi, Gerardo Romano

title: La corona di ferro
synopsis: In the imaginary kingdom of Kindaor, Sedemondo usurped his brother's throne by killing him and ordering the death of his nephew Arminio. The latter, however, is raised by ferocious beasts thus managing to save himself. But once an adult, he tries to get justice for himself.
cast: Massimo Girotti, Gino Cervi, Elisa Cegani, Rina Morelli, Luisa Ferida, Osvaldo Valenti, Paolo Stoppa, Primo Carnera

title: La corrispondenza
synopsis: A young university student spends her free time as a stunt double for television and film. His specialty is the action scenes, the suspenseful acrobatics, the dangerous situations that in fictional stories inevitably end with the death of his double. It would seem a mania dictated by the passion for risk, in reality it is the obsession in which the athletic girl deludes herself to sublimate a horrible sense of guilt: that of being responsible for the tragic death of her great love. A wound that never healed. A suspended account. A shadow that no light will ever be able to dissolve. It will be her astrophysics professor to help her find the lost existential balance.
cast: Jeremy Irons, Olga Kurylenko, Simon Johns, James Warren, Shauna Macdonald, Oscar Sanders, Paolo Calabresi

title: La corruzione
synopsis: Stefano wants to become a priest but his father, a successful publisher, introduces him to a charming and helpful woman. The vocation is reduced, but the inner conflicts do not end so quickly.
cast: Rosanna Schiaffino, Jacques Perrin, Alain Cuny, Isa Miranda

title: La corsa dell'innocente
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Vito's family is exterminated in an ambush the day after his father killed two shepherds. The child then takes refuge with a brother, in the mountains, but here he discovers that a peer of his age, Simone, who died of hardship, has been held hostage. Vito picks up the small victim's backpack and, facing endless risks and vicissitudes, runs away to reach Simone's distant family. The first film by the young Carlei, the film describes a fairly plausible situation, but using an excessively effective narrative, with overly complacent calligraphic elegance. Still interesting.
cast: Manuel Colao, Federico Pacifici, Sal Borgese, Lucio Zagaria, Francesca Neri, Jacques Perrin

title: La corta notte delle bambole di vetro
synopsis: Prague, years of the Cold War. Reporter Gregory Moore (Jean Sorel) is found dead and taken to the morgue. However, the man is not really dead: although he cannot move, his mind is still active: he tries to understand how he ended up in that situation and, through a series of flashbacks, we discover that Moore had a girlfriend, Mira (Barbara Bach) who had disappeared at a party and on whose trail Moore had launched himself, making a series of important discoveries.
cast: Ingrid Thulin, Piero Vida, Jean Sorel, Mario Adorf, Barbara Bach, Fabijan Sovagovic, José Quaglio, Relja Basic, Daniele Dublino, Sven Lasta

title: La cortigiana di Babilonia
cast: Rhonda Fleming, Tamara Lees, Roldano Lupi, Ricardo Montalban

title: La cosa
synopsis: Nanni Moretti makes a trip to Italy of the sections of the former PCI during the debate on Occhetti's proposal to change the name. A precious document that delves into the emotions of the militants and their historical memory.

title: La cosa buffa
synopsis: The love of the modest Antonio and Maria, heir to a billionaire heritage, is opposed by her parents who want to safeguard their assets and their daughter's illibità. The mother surprises the young before the irreparable happens.
cast: Gianni Morandi, Ottavia Piccolo, Angela Goodwin, Fabio Garriba, Claudia Giannotti, Nino Formicola, Rosita Torosh, Luigi Casellato, Riccardo Billi

title: La cosa giusta
synopsis: Eugenio Fusco and Duccio Monti are two policemen with a very different character who find themselves investigating an Arab, Khalid Amrazel, released after months of detention in prison on suspicion of supporting a terrorist cell. Released, but awaiting a definitive sentence, a clear truth about his case. Between the two, after even bitter conflicts, a certain understanding seems to be born. In the meantime, they also begin to get to know the suspect, who reserves a surprise for them.
cast: Paolo Briguglia, Ennio Fantastichini, Ahmed Haflene, Camilla Filippi, Anis Gharbi, Samya Abbary, Gianni Vattimo, Younis Tawfik, Riccardo Forte, Francesco Rossini, Gaetano Piazza

title: La cosa sulla soglia
synopsis: Daniel Upton and Edward Derby, a couple of friends, find themselves after a few years with great enthusiasm. However, the young Edward begins to have a strange behavior, as if he were obsessed with the presence of his wife's ghost. Edward confides himself with his friend Daniel and from that moment on strange coincidences begin to occur.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Fiorenza Marchegiani, Mattia Sbragia, Daniela Surina, Bruno Cattaneo, Elisabetta Carta, Paolo Poiret

title: La costanza della ragione
synopsis: The sentimental and political maturation of Bruno Santini. The influence of a Communist friend and the tragic relationship with a girl will convince him to accept a job in the factory. And so his uncompromising nature is forced to change gradually, compromise after compromise.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Sami Frey, Enrico Maria Salerno, Andrea Checchi, Norma Bengell, Valeria Moriconi, Glauco Mauri, Sergio Tofano

title: La cotta
synopsis: Andrea, an intelligent fifteen-year-old but a bit listless in his studies, loses his head for Janine. The boy is under the illusion that it is the true and eternal passion: but at the first setback, he is ready to fall in love with another girl, this time however much more mature than him ...
cast: Luciano Piergiovanni, Renata Carniglia, Giovanna Claudia Mongino

title: La course du lièvre à travers les champs
synopsis: Tony, witness to a crime committed by a group of gypsies, receives a large sum from the victim, just before the latter dies. But the gypsies want the loot back and chase Tony to get it back ...
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Robert Ryan, Lea Massari, Aldo Ray

title: La cripta e l'incubo
synopsis: The Karnstein Castle holds ancient scrolls that hide a mystery. Laura, the daughter of Count Ludwig, suffers from nightmares and suspects she is the reincarnation of one of his ancestors. Then a series of crimes begins to occur and it turns out that there is no mystery, but simply a culprit who is also the most unsuspected of all. Foray into the horror genre of Camillo Mastrocinque, a director once famous thanks to the films with Totò. Christopher Lee is one of the most famous mercenaries in the history of cinema. He has worked with everyone regardless of the quality of the films and in this case he would have done better to decline the offer.
cast: Christopher Lee, Adriana Ambessi, Pier Ana Quaglia, José Campos, Ursula Davis, Véra Valmont, Carla Calò, Nela Conjiu

title: La crise
synopsis: Victor, a brilliant Parisian lawyer, experiences a double set of fortunes on the same day: he is left by his wife and fired from the legal department where he works. None of his friends help him, taken as they are by their many problems. Only a tramp, Michou, a bit like a friend and a bit like a freeloader, sticks to his ribs.
cast: Vincent Lindon, Patrick Timsit, Zabou, Maria Pacome

title: La croce dalle sette pietre
cast: Marco Antonio Adinolfi, Annie Belle, Gordon Mitchell, Paolo Fiorino

title: La croisade
synopsis: Abel, Marianne and her thirteen -year -old son Joseph live together in Paris. Their daily existence is shocked on the day when parents discover that Joseph has unbeknownst to them sold some valuable objects taken from the house to finance a mysterious ecological project that with his friends carries on in Africa with the aim of saving the planet.
cast: Louis Garrel, Laetitia Casta, Joseph Engel, Ilinka Lony, Julia Boème, Lazare Minougou, Farid Bouzenad

title: La cuccagna
synopsis: Rossella (Turri) wants to leave a family that is a concentration of impossible people. At first a typist, then the secretary of an unreliable businessman, she then works with an advertiser who also tries to take advantage of her. Other vicissitudes at an ambiguous photo agency and with a moody lawyer. In the meantime, Rossella met Giuliano (Tenco), an angry protester more in words than anything else, but who almost convinces her to commit suicide.
cast: Donatella Turri, Luigi Tenco, Umberto D'Orsi, Liù Bosisio, Anna Baj, Emilio Barrella, Fernando Cerulli, Elvira Cortese, Gianni Dei, Jimmy Il Fenomeno

title: La cueva
synopsis: Three city boys and two city girls go on vacation to a paradise island. After renting motorcycles, they go around the most beautiful and hidden places until they stop in the woods near a cliff, where they get drunk and swim in the sea. The next day, however, they enter a deep and labyrinthine cave from which they can no longer get out. Without water and food, in order to survive they will suffer the most extreme and inhumane experience a person can ever go through.
cast: Marcos Ortiz, Marta Castellote, Eva García Vacas, Jorge Páez, Xoel Fernández

title: La cugina
synopsis: From the most tender age Enzo and Agata, two cousins, have explored each other in a series of erotic games, which have become increasingly compromising as they grew up. However, love in the family does not blossom and Agata ends up in the marriage of a wealthy man. However, the erotic tension between the two cousins ​​is not dormant.
cast: Massimo Ranieri, Dayle Haddon, Stefania Casini, Christian De Sica, Loredana Martínez, Jole Fierro, Stefano Oppedisano, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, José Quaglio, Laura Betti

title: La culpa
synopsis: In the 1970s, Gloria, a nurse and single mother of a six-year-old girl, was in dire financial straits. The gynecologist friend Ana Torres proposes to help her: Gloria will move with her little daughter to her and in exchange she will assist her in the operations of her clinic. But in addition to deliveries, Torres also practices clandestine abortions. One day Gloria discovers she is pregnant with her new partner, Javier, and Ana convinces her to put an end to the pregnancy: the doctor's intentions are anything but disinterested and the story will have tragic consequences.
cast: Nieve De Medina, Montse Mostaza, Alejandra Lorenzo, Mariana Cordero, Asunción Diaz

title: La cura
synopsis: Particular reinterpretation of the novel The plague of Albert Camus, shot in a deserted Naples in full Covid-19 emergency.
cast: Francesco Di Leva, Peppe Lanzetta, Cristina Donadio, Alessandro Preziosi, Francesco Mandelli

title: La cura del gorilla
synopsis: Sandrone known as Gorilla suffers from a split personality: one cheerful, boorish and ironic and the other rational, cold and violent. Since he suffers from insomnia, Sandrone decides to become a private detective, an activity that fits perfectly with his nightlife ...
cast: Claudio Bisio, Stefania Rocca, Ernest Borgnine, Gigio Alberti, Fabio Camilli

title: La curée
cast: Jane Fonda, Michel Piccoli, Peter McEnery, Tina Aumont, Jacques Monod

title: La cérémonie
synopsis: Documentary that combines rigorous staging and interviews to conduct an impartial reflection and at the same time participated on the erotic Sadomaso rituals of the dominatrix Jeanne De Berg (aka Catherine Robbe-Grillet, former wife and muse of the writer and director Alain Robbe-Grillet), today an elderly lady But still sought, in mutual relationships between submissive (both men and women) and maitresse, beyond any prejudice and moralistic conception.
cast: Catherine Robbe Grillet, Beverly Charpentier, Dominique Corringer, Claude Helleu, Christian Hersant

title: La dama bianca
synopsis: The lawyer Giulio Gualandi and Consort are guests of a high mountain hotel where every night a woman with a veiled face visits the men's rooms giving them a kiss. The lawyer who is a Dongovanni takes taste to the thing, at least until he comes the suspicion that he may be his wife.
cast: Elsa Merlini, Nino Besozzi, Enrico Viarisio, Ada Cristina Almirante, Vincenzo Scarpetta, Paolo Stoppa, Arnaldo Martelli, Giuliana Gianni, Ivana Claar

title: La dame d'onze heures
synopsis: Dr. Pescara receives numerous anonymous letters of threat, but despite this he does not want to turn to the police. A friendly friend of him, the explorer Stanislao Ottavio Semichon, nicknamed S.O.S. Dr. Pescara's son, who managed to individuals the source of the anonymous letters in Normandy, is the first victim of a long series of murders that make the "case" increasingly intricate and increasingly dramatic. Taken from the novel of the same name by Pierre Apesteguy, the film is conducted with a robust hand that skillfully supports the complex intrigue. Interpreters and pack of good level.
cast: Paul Meurisse, Micheline Francey, Jean Tissier, Pierre Renoir

title: La dame dans l'auto avec les lunettes et un fusil
synopsis: Danny discovers a dead body in the car left by his boss. The clues against her accumulate alarmingly and she begins to doubt her own mental faculties, then discovers the plot. The robust thrilling unfortunately declines in the second half of the film. It's Litvak's latest film.
cast: Samantha Eggar, Oliver Reed

title: La dame dans l'auto avec un fusil et des lunettes
synopsis: She is the most beautiful, the most shortsighted, the most perplexed, the most stubborn, the most unreliable and the most problematic of heroines. The lady in the car has never seen the sea and, after having accompanied the boss to the airport, decides to go south. Soon on the run from the police and with anyone who seems to know her, she keeps repeating that she is not crazy but no one seems to believe her.
cast: Freya Mavor, Stacy Martin, Elio Germano, Benjamin Biolay, Charles François, François Dominique Blin

title: La dame de pique
synopsis: After stealing an anecdote from friends about a three-card game secret by which a countess has won, a man is devoured by ambition and obsessed with the desire to wrest the secret of success from the old lady. He managed to break into her house and scares her to the point of causing her death without having extorted the revelation from her. From that moment on, the ghost of the countess haunts the young man, showing him three cards.
cast: Dita Parlo, Michel Subor, Simone Bach, André Charpak, Jean Negroni, Katharina Renn, Philippe Lemaire, Franz Hubler, Bernard Tiphaine, Jacqueline Monsigny

title: La damigella di Bard
synopsis: Maria Clotilde of Bard, noblewoman now in misery, lives in the attic of a Turin palace once owned. She has only one memory of the past: her correspondence of her with Count Nigra. The administrator of the building would like to evict it. Two young people are successfully opposed to these maneuvers, one of whom will be the grandson of Maria Clotilde gave dispersed many years before the tragic death of the parents.
cast: Emma Gramatica, Amalia Chellini, Armando Migliari, Luigi Cimara, Carlo Tamberlani, Cesare Bettarini, Luigi Pavese, Achille Majeroni, Mirella Pardi

title: La dannazione della sinistra: Cronache di una scissione
synopsis: On January 21, 1921 in Livorno an epochal event took place: during the congress held in the Goldoni theater, the Italian Socialist Party is divided and loses its communist component. The splitters decide to move towards another theater in the Livorno city, the San Marco, and found the Italian Communist Party. A hundred years after that historic split, Ezio Mauro takes a journey to Italy by telling the atavistic evil of the left, a damnation that releases in that year and still today makes its effects on Italian politics: the impossibility for the Left to promote the fraternity between the peoples while remaining united inside, generating a paradox still current today. The narrative winds through the interviews of Ezio Mauro in illustrious witnesses (Massimo D'Alema, Fausto Bertinotti, Luciana Castellina, Achille Occhetto) who characterized the history of the left until 1991, the year in which the PCI changes its name. The story is enriched with images and films of repertoire and visits to the places symbol of the events, from the Goldoni Theater in Livorno to the headquarters of the PCI in via delle Botteghe Dark in Rome, from the Sivori cinema of Genoa to Palazzo d'Accursio in Bologna to the workshops Great repairs of Turin, and still important institutions such as the Nuvol Querci Foundation, the Gramsci Onlus Foundation in Rome and the Giangiacomo Feltrinelli Foundation in Milan.
cast: Ezio Mauro

title: La danse du scorpion
synopsis: Finch Palmer, a musician by profession, is hired by the gangster Edouard de Vito to show himself around with his wife Camille, thus providing him the opportunity to file for a divorce. The trap clicks, but when de Vito is murdered, suspicions inevitably fall on Finch ...
cast: Kim Coates, Roberta Weiss, Ronald Guttman, Béatrice Benscik

title: La danza dei milioni
synopsis: The secretary of the president of an important bank has a graduate but unemployed friend; He convinces him to bring him to the office by making him pass for an employee. Soon the skill and resourcefulness of the young man are noticed and rewarded with the employment and marriage to the president's daughter.
cast: Nino Besozzi, Carlo Campanini, Jole Voleri, Miretta Mauri, Armando Migliari

title: La daronne
synopsis: Patience Portefeux works as an Arab interpreter for the French police and has specialized in telephone interceptions for the anti -drug unit. Her is a hard and poorly paid job but the commander is fascinating. One day, while listening to refined drug dealers, Patience discovers that one of them is the son of the fantastic woman who takes care of her mother. By deciding to protect him, he will end up being overwhelmed by the situation and to transform himself into the largest dealer in the area. From his he will have the experience on the field and the information he gets through his work.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Hippolyte Girardot, Liliane Rovère, Pierre Rousselet, Kamel Guenfoud, Iris Bry, Farida Ouchani, Carl Ernouf, Marcelo De Souza, Youssef Sahraoui

title: La dea Fortuna
synopsis: Alessandro and Arturo have been a couple for over fifteen years. Although passion and love have turned into an important affection, their relationship has been in crisis for some time. The sudden arrival in their lives of two children left in their custody for a few days by Alessandro's best friend, could however give an unexpected twist to their tired routine. The solution will be a foolish gesture. But on the other hand, love is a state of pleasant madness.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Edoardo Leo, Jasmine Trinca, Serra Yilmaz, Filippo Nigro, Sara Ciocca, Barbara Alberti, Edoardo Brandi, Cristina Bugatty, Pia Lanciotti

title: La decima vittima
synopsis: In an unspecified remote future, warfare is abolished but the aggression of human beings is discharged into a particular sport: legalized hunting of other men. Ursula Andress, famous American "hunter", a creature born from artificial fertilization and therefore very efficient in her work, has already killed nine other hunters. The woman flies to Rome to confront (and kill, she believes) Marcello, an indolent example of "homo romanus" with family problems.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Ursula Andress, Elsa Martinelli

title: La demoiselle d'honneur
synopsis: Petra is beautiful and fatal: at a wedding, the young Philippe is struck by it and the passion grows in him day after day. As proof of love, the girl asks that they both kill a stranger: he thinks it's a joke, but the girl seems deadly serious ...
cast: Laura Smet, Benoît Magimel, Aurore Clément, Bernard Lecoq, Philippe Duclos

title: La demora
synopsis: Maria, a forty-year-old mother already overwhelmed by the care she has to give to her three children, is forced to turn to the social security office to prove that she is too poor to also provide for elderly father Agustin, suffering from senile dementia and brought back home. from a friend after an escape attempt to reenter his old home. However, she discovers that she is still considered too rich to have access to the benefits provided by the law and that she has to find a solution on her own.
cast: Carlos Vallarino, Roxana Blanco, Oscar Pernas, Cecilia Baranda, Julieta Gentile, Facundo Segovia, Thiago Segovia

title: La dentellière
synopsis: Béatrice, young and awkward, lives with her mother in Paris, works as a hairdresser and has a friend who is a little too exuberant. This takes her with her to Normandy, on vacation. Here Béatrice falls in love with François, a middle-class student. Back in Paris, the two get together, but he soon gets tired. Abandoned, Béatrice ends up in an asylum, where she spends her time silently embroidering.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Yves Beneyton, Florence Giorgetti

title: La dernière séance
synopsis: Bernard has just retired. He is 63 years old, lives only with his two cats and decides to move to a new home, the one in which he will live the last chapter of his novel. Preparing the boxes, start making a selection: what do I leave here, what do I carry? Bernard is my master and I am his slave. His last lover. I help him put his whip in a box, among the crumbs of his memory, the memories of the loves that AIDS torn from his arms, the traces of an adoptive family that rejected him, of rigid education that He forged her, of a mother and father who has never known. Our sexual games are the opportunities for meeting two generations: between a whipping blow and a Harness of leather we discuss love, death, the epidemic of AIDS in the 1980s, of his new life project, of us. The wounds and the funeral kit of a survivor, a cry of life in the light of sexual drives.

title: La destinazione
synopsis: Emilio, an unemployed young man from Rimini, joins the Carabinieri. In Rome, during his training, he meets Costantino, a Sardinian boy of few words. At the end of the course Emilio indicates Sardinia as the third option for the destination and there he is sent, to Coloras, a remote village of Barbagia. As a first assignment he must investigate the murder of a shepherd killed in front of his son Efisio who, hidden behind a bush, was able to see the hitman in the face. Little by little, between difficult investigations and a conflicted love story with Giacomina, a local girl, Emilio realizes that he has ended up in a world that is profoundly different from the one he is used to.
cast: Roberto Magnani, Elisabetta Balia, Salvatore Mele, Gisella Vacca, Antonio Moro

title: La diagonale du fou
synopsis: Challenge between two Russian chess geniuses, the old sick champion and the challenger, a young escaped man, who is also a mortal clash of opposing ideologies and worlds. Really exciting, with a great Michel Piccoli. 1984 Oscar for best foreign film.
cast: Michel Piccoli, Alexandre Arbatt, Leslie Caron, Liv Ullmann

title: La dignidad de los nadie
synopsis: Stories and testimonies about the social resistance in Argentina that tackles unemployment and hunger. There are Martín, hit by a stray bullet, Toba who helps him, Antonia and Chipi who feed over two hundred people every day in a neighborhood on the outskirts of Buenos Aires ...

title: La diligencia de los condenados
synopsis: A stagecoach transports the man who must testify against a dangerous criminal, Anthony Stevens, who is being held awaiting trial for murder. An accomplice of these, Ramon the Aztec, intercepts the vehicle and kidnaps the passengers, leading them to a post house guarded by a certain Robert Walton. The bandit threatens them to discover the identity of the witness, but there is a twist: Walton is actually called Wayne Sonnyer and is a former gunfighter, who has some unfinished business with Stevens. At first the man saves the hostages: then the clash with the old enemy will be inevitable.
cast: Richard Harrison, Fernando Sancho, Erika Blanc, Bruno Corazzari, Gustavo Re, Fernando Rubio

title: La diosa del asfalto
synopsis: A woman from a tough neighborhood outside Mexico City comes home a rock star, inadvertently provoking a confrontation with the ghosts of her past.
cast: Ximena Romo, Mabel Cadena, Alejandra Herrera, Nelly González, Samantha Orozco, Axel Arenas, Esteban Caicedo, Paulina Goto, Raquel Robles, Baby Bátiz, Pascacio López, Juán Carlos Torres, Javier Oliván, Claudia Lobo, Giovanna Zacarías

title: La direzione del tempo
synopsis: A professor tests 5 boys and proposes that they live as if they were the scientists of the five equations that changed the world: Newton, Bernoulli, Faraday, Clausius, Einstein. The boys are thus catapulted into another dimension: it is no longer those boys sitting at the bar or on a low wall who pass the time, but five scientists who are about to change the world. Once the spell is over, they return to the real. The boys find themselves sitting in their usual desks, but none of them are the same anymore. Every young person has an equation capable of solving their own discomfort, their own insecurities.
cast: Lucrezia Di Michele, Gabriele Berti, Maurizio Bousso, Jesus Emiliano Coltorti, Chiara Vergassola, Daniela Poggi, Rocco Barbaro, Manuela Parodi

title: La discesa di Aclà a Floristella
synopsis: The very blond Aclà was born into a large and poor family, so much so that, when he was eleven, he was "sold" for eight years as a "caruso" to a pickaxe in the Floristella sulfur mine. Hard work, homosexuality among the workers (who stay in the mine even at night), blows at work and blows at home: Aclà escapes from the solfatara. First work by Grimaldi, author of the novel "Mery per semper". Aesthetizing and pleased, a film with "high" ambitions and no morality of gaze.
cast: Francesco Cusimano, Tony Sperandeo, Luigi Maria Burruano

title: La discoteca
synopsis: A pizza chef leaves from Positano to work in a hotel in the North and while traveling he meets Romy, an Italian-German girl. The hotel manager seems tough, but then he lets himself be moved by the touching songs of the Neapolitan employee. Nino tries to re-establish contact with his fiancée Maria, who has remained in the village, but Carlo, his rival in love, manages to prevent him, also insinuating the worm of jealousy in the girl's heart.
cast: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Cinzia Bonfantini, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Maurizio Boni, Marco Mastantuono, Walter D'Amore

title: La discrète
synopsis: Antoine, a young writer, goes into crisis when he is abandoned by his woman. To take revenge, and find a new starting point, he accepts the proposal of his editor friend: he will have to seduce the first girl he meets, and then abandon her, in the meantime writing the chronicle of this adventure. The victim is an ugly typist, Catherine, who, however, manages to win over Antoine and turn the situation around.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Judith Henry, Maurice Garrel, Marie Bunel

title: La disparition des lucioles
synopsis: A sleepy industrial town, tucked away in a small bay, doesn't offer young Léo many possibilities to fulfill herself. Léo hates life with his mother and stepfather and romantically fantasizes about his distant father. However, the meeting with the shy guitarist Steve will manage to get her out of her lethargy.
cast: Pierre Luc Brillant, Marie France Marcotte, François Papineau, Luc Picard, Karelle Tremblay

title: La disparue de Deauville
synopsis: Detective Jacques Renard (Christopher Lambert), in crisis after his wife's untimely death, is approached one evening by a mysterious woman (Sophie Marceau) who invites him to investigate the strange activities of the Hotel Barriere, begging him to visit room 401. Upon his arrival, however, Renard discovers that the owner of the hotel has been missing for 48 hours in a rather suspicious way and that the management of the structure has passed into the hands of his son, whose mother had died in circumstances never cleared up 36 years earlier, who he insists on repeating that there is no room 401 in the hotel. Renard discovers, however, a series of strange clues that lead to something very sinister.
cast: Christopher Lambert, Sophie Marceau, Nicolas Briançon, Simon Abkarian, Robert Hossein, Marie Christine Barrault, Judith Magre, Marilou Berry, Magali Woch, Jacques Boudet

title: La distrazione
synopsis: Television investigation on the theme of free time.

title: La disubbidienza
synopsis: Venice, end of the Second World War. Luca is seventeen years old and is in contrast with the bourgeois and fascist family and actively participates in the partisan struggle with the hope of building, after the victory, a better world. But Luca's expectations are destined to be shattered because the world doesn't want to change its rules. Everything is as before, even worse than before and Luca, suffering from pneumonia, wants to die. But the intervention of a governess and, later, a nurse make him change his mind.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Teresa Ann Savoy, Mario Adorf, Marie Jose Nat, Karl Diemunch

title: La dolce arte di esistere
synopsis: In a world where psychosomatic invisibility is supposed to exist, which leads people with relationship discomforts to become literally invisible in certain situations, Roberta and Massimo meet. While Roberta is a girl who disappears if no one pays attention to her, Massimo is an anxious young man who, on the contrary, disappears if he feels too much attention on himself.
cast: Francesca Golia, Pierpaolo Spollon, Anita Kravos, Paolo Sassanelli, Francesca Cuttica, Rolando Ravello, Sara Putignano, Pietro Bontempo, Salvatore Esposito

title: La dolce casa degli orrori
synopsis: Two children decide to avenge their parents' death by killing the gardener who was responsible for the murder. The uncles, however, make a terrible discovery, the children are possessed and call an exorcist.
cast: Jean Christophe Brétigniere, Cinzia Monreale, Pascal Persiano

title: La domenica del diavolo
synopsis: Taranto. In a family villa, three female athletes (Borghi, Virgili and Como) do not know they are hosting three escaped refugees (Coby, Crocitti and Prete) for the weekend. The latter will end badly, but when the girls think they have gotten away with it they will have a bitter surprise.
cast: Antonio Cantafora, Vincenzo Crocitti, Christiana Borghi, Elisabetta Valgiusti, Monica Como, Giancarlo Prete, Dirce Funari, Vittorio Sgorlon

title: La domenica della buona gente
synopsis: The film develops into the story of three distinct but parallel episodes which take place simultaneously on a football Sunday. A former footballer sees his hopes of finding a new job fade, his wife almost leaves him, but his daughter saves the marriage. A retiree makes plans believing he has done thirteen at the football pools, but he is wrong. At the stadium, the young Julius meets a woman who is contemplating killing her lover and makes sure that this does not happen.
cast: Maria Fiore, Sophia Loren, Carlo Romano, Vittorio Sanipoli, Renato Salvatori, Ave Ninchi, Alberto Talegalli, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Piero Palermini, Turi Pandolfini, Laura Tiberti

title: La domenica specialmente
synopsis: A German tourist is attracted to a girl, but she morbidly prefers his semi-deficient brother. Strange complicity between a bride and the mother-in-law who spies on her amorous effusions with her son. A shoemaker-barber can't get rid of a dog with a blue spot on its face. A simpleton is fascinated, in the turmoil of the holiday Rimini, by three boats from which chanting voices come. Four directors for as many stories by Tonino Guerra. Some more elegant than incisive, others of greater consistency, but it is the project that does not work. Thanks also to a talented Maddalena Fellini, Federico's sister, the episode of Giordana is the most successful.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Ornella Muti, Bruno Ganz, Jean Hugues Anglade, Nicoletta Braschi, Maddalena Fellini, Chiara Caselli, Sergio Bini Bustric, Andrea Prodan, Ivano Marescotti, Josse De Pauw
director: Giuseppe Bertolucci, Marco Tullio Giordana, Francesco Barilli, Giuseppe Tornatore

title: La donna che venne dal mare
synopsis: Gibraltar, World War II. The Italian secret service considers the fortress a strategic point to be dismantled, but the British have made the whole area impenetrable. To succeed in conquering the British fortress, the Italian military hired a particularly handsome spy, charged with using the deadly weapon of seduction against the enemies.
cast: Sandra Milo, Vittorio De Sica, Peter Lynn, Pedro Gimenez, Juan Calvo

title: La donna degli altri è sempre più bella
synopsis: Five episodes populated by shrewd lifeguards, jealous husbands with or without a lover, capricious or unfaithful wives, runaway girlfriends, tenacious boyfriends and mature satyrs. Many banalities, redeemed at times by some interpretative flicker.
cast: Walter Chiari, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mario Carotenuto

title: La donna del fiume
synopsis: The beautiful and busty Nives, very much courted by the smuggler Gino, surrenders to him during an eventful party. However, the man, having become her lover, mistreats her. Nives, who is expecting a child from him, has him arrested. Two years later Gino escapes and goes to the woman to take revenge. Nives, however, has lost the baby, drowned in a ditch and is watching over him. Gino moved promises to marry her.
cast: Sophia Loren, Rik Battaglia, Gérard Oury, Lise Bourdin, Enrico Olivieri

title: La donna del lago
synopsis: Bernard is a writer who returns to a hotel to see Tilde, the maid he fell in love with. They tell him that she committed suicide, but little by little she realizes that someone has killed her. Bernard initially suspects Enrico, the owner of the hotel and his son Mario, alleged lovers of Tilde. Eventually, however, he receives a decisive confession from Irma, Mario's sister. But that's the truth? From a novel by Giovanni Comisso, a film that favors the typical yellow solutions of a dreamlike atmosphere linked to the fact that the protagonist is a writer and that his investigations start from imaginative conjectures.
cast: Peter Baldwin, Salvo Randone, Valentina Cortese, Virna Lisi

title: La donna della domenica
synopsis: The murder of a well-known architect, Dr. Garrone, upsets the world of the Turin bourgeoisie and aristocracy of the early 1970s. Commissioner Santamaria, recently transferred to Turin from southern Italy, through investigations with his deputy De Palma, southern like him, will discover the vices of the wealthy classes of the rich and industrious north. University professors who help gallery owners to sell fake paintings, aristocrats who "play" to threaten their friends with death because they are bored with their life and the banality of an existence in which they themselves no longer know how to find joy, industrialists who evade taxation, adulterers as if it were the norm and loves that blossom between prostitutes on the margins of society and members of the intellectual elite. The commissioner, a man of a thousand shadows, will also live a tormented love, with Anna Carla Dosio, "the most beautiful woman in Turin", the woman to whom all the investigative leads lead, indicating her as the main suspect. Torn between a sense of duty and the law of his own feelings, Santamaria has to face the most delicate case of his career and the greatest love of his life.
cast: Andrea Osvart, Giampaolo Morelli, Ninni Bruschetta, Franco Castellano, Roberto Zibetti, Fabrizio Bucci, Sergio Friscia, Giuseppe Antignati, Roberto Accornero, Laura Curino, Mario Zucca, Sara Tommasi

title: La donna della domenica
synopsis: Commissioner Santamaria (Marcello Mastroianni), from Rome but working at the Turin Police Headquarters, investigates the crime of an engineer. Day after day he realizes the corruption and ambiguities that characterize the Turin bourgeoisie. His superiors invite him to be careful, but Santamaria discovers the culprit and the motive: it is not a crime of passion, its roots are rooted in a ...
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Jacqueline Bisset, Jean Louis Trintignant, Pino Caruso, Aldo Reggiani, Maria Teresa Albani, Omero Antonutti, Gigi Ballista, Fortunato Cecilia, Claudio Gora, Franco Nebbia

title: La donna della luna
synopsis: Angela (Scacchi) is the American daughter of a Sicilian emigrant. While waiting for the ferry to take her to Sicily, she meets Salvo, a boy who says he is being chased by the mafia. Once landed in Sicily, the two continue the journey together, but it soon becomes clear that the mafia has nothing to do with it and that the boy is simply trying. Angela lets herself be conquered and shortly after Salvo is accidentally killed. The film contemplates an inexhaustible series of clichés and obviousness. The only thing to save is of course Greta Scacchi. But why does he get caught up in such weak films?
cast: Greta Scacchi, Luca Orlandini, Tim Finn, Marcello Perracchio, Mike Magistro, Pasquale Spadola, Mario Nobile, Giorgio Guerrieri

title: La donna della mia vita
synopsis: Leonardo (Luca Argentero) and Giorgio (Alessandro Gassman) are two very different brothers. As much the first is reliable and sensitive, as the second is inconstant and womanizer. And yet the two have always been united. At least until the day when Giorgio discovers that his brother's new girlfriend is none other than Sara (Valentina Lodovini), with whom he has had one of his turbulent extramarital affairs. It will therefore be up to his mother Alba (Stefania Sandrelli) to restore the family order and it will do so not without surprises and twists that will cause a great confusion.
cast: Luca Argentero, Alessandro Gassmann, Stefania Sandrelli, Valentina Lodovini, Sonia Bergamasco, Giorgio Colangeli, Gaia Bermani Amaral, Lella Costa

title: La donna della montagna
synopsis: After his girlfriend's death, a young engineer is courted by another woman in love with him. He marries her, but the agreement between the two does not last; after separation, the man retreats to the mountains. Here his wife will join him again and agree to be close to him "submissive" to the memory of the deceased. A new crisis will finally lead the couple to clarification and a new happy life. Powerful and shot in evocative backgrounds, the film was left unfinished due to the war and came out in a patched version in '45. Beautiful photography by Massimo Terzano; music by Nino Rota.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Marina Berti, Maurizio D'Ancora, Corrado Racca, Fanny Marchiò, Maria Jacobini, Carlo Mengoli, Oscar Andriani, Carlo Giustini

title: La donna dello smartphone
synopsis: A sick old man finds a smartphone. Inside there are videos that tell the life of a woman who moves from a small town in southern Italy to work as a teacher in a city that turns out to be hostile and incomprehensible: Rome.
cast: Silvana Porreca, Mariagrazia Casagrande, Fabio Del Greco, Chiara Pavoni, Hanad Sheik, David Formilli, Roberto Alessandrini, Paolo Di Gialluca

title: La donna giusta
synopsis: Terry, an American reporter in Rome in an existential crisis, decides to ditch the three women he's dating to find the right girl for him.
cast: Karen Black, Margot Kidder, Virna Lisi, Marie France Pisier

title: La donna invisibile
synopsis: Laura, married to Andrea, a professor who has ended up in the crosshairs of the dispute, realizes that her husband no longer loves her and that she has become invisible to him. The woman is still deeply in love with him but he seems more interested in Delfina another woman who lives at home with them. In vain Laura tries to attract his attention by confessing to him a betrayal but all is useless. One day during a hunting trip Andrea accidentally kills her.
cast: Giovanna Ralli, Carla Gravina, Anita Sanders, Silvano Tranquilli

title: La donna lupo
synopsis: Giulia calls herself with different names (Viviana and Alessandra) but her true identity is that of Woman Lupo. He has exceeded anxieties and inhibitions to fully accept his desires. If during the day he has a normal life, at night he turns the city in search of his prey. To the males I catch asks and only wants sex. When he meets Valerio, the youngest and most naive of his victims, he understands that it will not be like this.
cast: Loredana Cannata, Arturo Paglia, Pascal Persiano, Francesco Di Leva

title: La donna nel mondo
synopsis: Usual intercontinental raid by documentary maker Jacopetti in search of strong sensations, contrasts and curiosities (possibly macabre) on a fixed theme. Here the female condition. As in the other similar films by the same author ("Africa addio", the two "Mondo cane") the desire to hit below the belt also frustrates the few good intentions.
director: Gualtiero Jacopetti, Paolo Cavara, Franco Prosperi

title: La donna più bella del mondo
synopsis: The beautiful singer from Trastevere Lina Cavalieri makes her debut by replacing her sick mother on the stage of a popular theater. Here he meets Prince Sergio Bariatine, generous with aid. Lina studies singing and follows her teacher to Paris, but then separates from him. Her life is a climb to success, full of fame, of suitors, also marked by some dramas, but finally crowned by the love of the prince ...
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Vittorio Gassman, Robert Alda, Anne Vernon

title: La donna scimmia
synopsis: Antonio Focaccia discovers a woman entirely covered in hair in a monastery and marries her to be able to exhibit her as a phenomenon. On the occasion of a Parisian tour, however, the two really fall in love; when Maria, the "phenomenon", becomes pregnant, Antonio complies with her desire to have the baby.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Annie Girardot, Achille Majeroni, Elvira Paoloni

title: La donna velata
synopsis: The beautiful model Laura moves to Turin, in the home that once belonged to her grandmother. While weaving a passionate relationship with the painter Cesare Orsini, the woman discovers the presence of a mysterious Veiled Woman in the house. The puzzle deepens when Laura discovers the bodies of two people slaughtered.
cast: Evelina Manna, Enrico Lo Verso, Francesco Siciliano, Anne Valerie Le Fevre, Barbara Wussow, László Kish, Chiara Francini

title: La donna è una cosa meravigliosa
synopsis: Episode film: in the first, "A sweet sweet woman", a lady who would like to have children decides to treat her husband as a child to grow up, overturning her maternal instinct on him. In the second, "The White Whale", a dwarf falls in love with a dwarf but has a big problem with his wife: the cannon woman.
cast: Vittorio Caprioli, Sandra Milo, Tinto Brass, Arnaldo Fabrizio

title: La donna, il sesso e il superuomo
synopsis: Richard is kidnapped by Fantabulous Inc. which has devised a process to transform a normal man into a superman. The man is taken to the company's headquarters in Geneva and transformed into Fantabulous by Beethoven, a mad scientist. He begins to enter into negotiations to try to sell it to the great powers. Unfortunately, the supere has seen his fiancée again and this has blown some of his complex electrical circuits. Awakened from the lethargy in which he had sunk Richard manages to destroy the electronic brain that controlled his movements.
cast: Richard Harrison, Adolfo Celi, Judi West, Enzo Fiermonte, Giacomo Furia, Gustavo D'Arpe, Fabienne Fabre, Arturo Dominici

title: La donzelletta
synopsis: Anna is a young drug addict who loves reading Leopardi and Homer. Tired of life in a small village on the Madonie, she leaves the village to go and live in Palermo with Pino, a drug dealer. After the latter is arrested and incarcerated, Anna returns to the village and decides to stop shooting herself ...
cast: Costanza Bonarelli, Piero Lipani

title: La doppia ora
synopsis: The meeting between Sonia, a maid from Ljubljana, and Guido, an ex-policeman who is now a private guard, is fatal. Their attraction is immediate and their early days seem to promise great love. But suddenly Guido dies, killed in the course of a robbery in the villa he guarded. Sonia is thus unexpectedly faced with bereavement rather than falling in love. Things get complicated when someone begins to suspect that his story with Guido was a cover to hide very different purposes and very different intentions.
cast: Ksenia Rappoport, Filippo Timi, Giorgio Colangeli, Roberto Accornero, Chiara Nicola, Gaetano Bruno, Fausto Russo Alesi, Andrea Zirio, Stefano Saccotelli, Giampiero Judica

title: La doppia vita di Natalia Blum
synopsis: Marco has an apparently happy life: he has a beautiful girlfriend who adores him and travels around Italy to present his book. Arriving in Bari he meets Natalia, a young writer, when she gives him her incomplete autobiographical writing. A serial killer faces the story.
cast: Emilio Solfrizzi, Pilar Abella, Anita Caprioli, Paolo De Vita, Pia Lanciotti, Lidiya Liberman, Mimmo Mancini, Bianca Nappi

title: La dottoressa Giò - Una mano da stringere
synopsis: Giorgia Basile, known as Giò, is a doctor in the gynecology department of the Sandro Pertini hospital in Rome. A young pregnant drug addict, Benedetta, is hospitalized in her ward. This arouses the ire of some of his colleagues, the head physician and the girl's neighbor. Meanwhile, the doctor is also expecting a child. One day, however, in settling a quarrel between Benedetta and a drug dealer, Giorgia loses her son. It is a pilot film for a television series that is expected to kick off next season. The film sees some young sons of art lined up together with some old glories of Italian theater and cinema.
cast: Barbara D'Urso, Flavio Bucci, Riccardo Cucciolla, Fabio Testi, Sergio Abbagnato, Luciano Mazzi, Paolo Calissano

title: La dottoressa ci sta col colonnello
synopsis: While recruit Arturo Mezzancolla puts his virile might to good use, his colonel, Anacleto Punzone, is poorly gifted in this regard. When, by the American doctor Eva Russel, the opportunity arises for the officer to exchange, without the soldier's knowledge, the two ... apparatuses, the transplant is carried out. But the results are not what the colonel hoped for.
cast: Nadia Cassini, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Malisa Longo

title: La dottoressa del distretto militare
synopsis: The doctor is temporarily unable to carry out his service at the Military Hospital so that he is replaced by his disturbing assistant (Fenech). In front of the woman in the smock, numerous young men parade, determined above all to avoid the naja by inventing the most incredible ailments. The doctor, intransigent and incorruptible from a professional point of view, is however not insensitive to the attractions of the most attractive of the rebellious boys.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Alfredo Pea, Carlo Delle Piane, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Grazia Di Marzà, Alfonso Tomas, Nino Terzo, Mario Carotenuto, Lucio Montanaro

title: La dottoressa di campagna
synopsis: The arrival of a provocative doctor in a provincial town puts the entire male population in turmoil, in perennial tail in front of the clinic. Taking advantage of the situation, the mayor tries to give a lesson to the local playboy ...
cast: Marina Frajese, Antonella Antinori, Mark Shanon, Nino Terzo

title: La dottoressa preferisce i marinai
synopsis: Cicca and Gianni are sent to do the cleaning in a large Roman hotel. Here they witness a murder (or so it seems to them) and from this moment they find themselves in a whirlwind of paradoxical situations, between the killer who hunts them, an officer who wants to hide the presence of his lover from his wife, a waiter who must deliver medicine and other messes.
cast: Alvaro Vitali, Gianni Ciardo, Paola Senatore, Renzo Montagnani

title: La dottoressa sotto il lenzuolo
synopsis: This time it is a group of university students who go to the "big maneuvers": a prosperous doctor, but very chaste, attracts their hungry attention (we are in Pisa and the tower stands out: is the metaphor clear?). As if that were not enough, a nurse played by Orchidea De Santis also gets involved!
cast: Karin Schubert, Gastone Pescucci, Orchidea De Santis, Eligio Zamara, Alvaro Vitali

title: La double vie de Véronique
synopsis: Veronika is a 20-year-old from Krakow, with a wonderful voice. Singing is her main passion, so much so that she leaves the boy she loves to devote herself entirely to singing. And die on stage from a heart attack. Véronique is identical to the other, but she is French, and when she realizes that the malformation in her heart could be fatal, if she continues to sing, she gives up art and takes refuge in love. Two parallel lives, two different fates.
cast: Irène Jacob, Halina Gryglaszewska, Kalina Jedrusik, Aleksander Bardini, Philippe Volter, Wladyslaw Kowalski, Jerzy Gudejko, Janusz Sterninski, Sandrine Dumas

title: La doublure
synopsis: Billionaire Pierre Lavasseur risks being framed by a photo that reveals his extramarital affair with a famous model. The only solution for him is to deny everything, explaining that the girl, in reality, was in the company of another man who appears in the photo: to make the story credible, however, he must make sure that the two really date. ..
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Gad Elmaleh, Kristin Scott Thomas, Virginie Ledoyen, Alice Taglioni, Richard Berry, Dany Boon, Karl Lagerfeld

title: La douleur
synopsis: 1944. France is under the German Occupation and the writer Robert Antelme, a leading figure in the Resistance, is arrested and sent to Buchenwald. This represents the beginning of an unbearable wait for his wife, Marguerite Duras, a slow and silent agony in the midst of the chaos of the liberation of Paris.
cast: Melanie Thierry, Benoît Magimel, Benjamin Biolay, Shulamit Adar, Grégoire Leprince Ringuet, Emmanuel Bourdieu

title: La drôlesse
cast: Claude Hébert, Madeleine Desdevises, Paulette Lahaye, Juliette Le Cauchoix

title: La décade prodigieuse
synopsis: Théo Van Horn tyrannizes his wife Hélène and adopted son Charles. The two have a relationship, but the boy lives it with great feelings of guilt. He asks his philosophy professor for help, but the latter's intervention cannot resolve the situation, which is now headed for a Greek tragedy ending.
cast: Anthony Perkins, Michel Piccoli, Marlène Jobert, Orson Welles, Guido Alberti, Ermanno Casanova, Mathilde Ceccarelli, Tsilla Chelton, Vittorio Sanipoli

title: La délicatesse
synopsis: Nathalie (Audrey Tautou) has everything to be happy: she is young, beautiful and, above all, in love with her husband with whom she lives a perfect existence. Suddenly, his death wipes every smile from her face. For years, she only devotes herself to work, vowing to herself never to let go of love again. Destiny, however, has other plans in store for her, bringing on her path Markus (François Damiens), an unusual colleague and apparently far from her universe, thanks to which Nathalie embarks on a path of rebirth, at the expense of envy and discontent of other colleagues.
cast: Audrey Tautou, François Damiens, Audrey Fleurot, Pio Marmaï, Ariane Ascaride, Joséphine De Meaux, Mélanie Bernier, Bruno Todeschini, Christophe Malavoy, Marc Citti, Olivier Cruveiller

title: La dérobade
cast: Miou Miou, Maria Schneider, Niels Arestrup, Jean Benguigui

title: La désintégration
synopsis: In the suburbs of Lille, Ali, Nasser and Nicolas, three young people in their early twenties and in disarray, meet Djamel on their path, older than them by about ten years. In the eyes of the three, Djamel appears confident, charismatic and with very clear ideas and it comes naturally to them to rely on his guide, but they end up involved in a crescendo of radicalism and extreme acts, which lead to the disintegration of their lives.
cast: Yassine Azzouz, Kamel Laadaili, Rachid Debbouze, Ymanol Perset, Mohamed Achit

title: La educación del Rey
synopsis: Fleeing his criminal baptism, Reynaldo Galindez, aka Rey, breaks into the patio of the house inhabited by Carlos Vargas, a retired security guard. Vargas then offers him an agreement: if he repairs the damage caused to his home, he will avoid reporting him. The teachings the teenager will receive from the guard will give rise to a relationship reminiscent of that of a king with his mentor. The balance created by the two, however, will eventually crack when Rey's robbery companions begin to approach them.
cast: Matías Encinas, Germán De Silva, Jorge Prado, Martín Arroyo, Mario Jara

title: La endemoniada
synopsis: An old witch, who committed suicide so as not to fall into the hands of the police, in revenge takes possession of the body of the young daughter of the minister of the interior.
cast: Julian Mateos, Marián Salgado, Fernando Sancho, Lone Fleming, Ángel Del Pozo, Kali Hansa, Daniel Martin, Tota Alba, Roberto Camardiel, María Kosty

title: La enfermedad del domingo
synopsis: One Sunday afternoon a mother is supposed to come home, but she doesn't, neither that day nor ever again. The feeling of anticipation experienced that day becomes something that will accompany the life of those who awaited his return forever.
cast: Susi Sánchez, Bárbara Lennie, Richard Bohringer, David Kammenos, Bruna González, Miguel Angel Sola, Greta Fernández, Monica Van Campen, Manuel Castillo, Abdelatif Hwidar

title: La estrategia del caracol
synopsis: The owner of a public housing estate in Bogota intends to throw out the tenants; they try to avert the danger by legal means, but the law is not on the side of the weak. All that remains is to make a virtue of necessity and organize the clandestine and complete emptying of the building to which everyone, according to their abilities, collaborates, with the external support of some trusted friend. A "political" film under the disguise of a paradoxical story, a bit fragile in some forcing of a sometimes simplistic Manichaeism (with Brechtian ambitions?), Even if perhaps acceptable.
cast: Frank Ramírez, Fausto Cabrera, Florina Lemaitre, Humberto Dorado

title: La fabbrica dei tedeschi
synopsis: A documentary on the terrible fire at the ThyssenKrupp factory in Turin, which between 5 and 6 December 2007 resulted in the death of seven people.

title: La fabuleuse aventure de Marco Polo
synopsis: The young Marco Polo, heir to a dynasty of Venetian merchants on the brink of ruin, participates with his father and uncle in a mission to the East. The mission was entrusted to them by Pope Gregory X who intends to enter into negotiations with the spiritual leader of the East: Kubilai Khan. The journey turns out to be for Marco the source of wonderful and dangerous adventures that he overcomes thanks to his courage. Made with extensive use of means, the film, however, turns out to be weak on a historical and narrative level, ending up being simply a walk through folklore.
cast: Horst Buchholz, Elsa Martinelli, Gregoire Aslan, Robert Hossein, Akim Tamiroff, Omar Sharif, Anthony Quinn, Orson Welles, Massimo Girotti, Folco Lulli, Bruno Cremer

title: La faccia violenta di New York
synopsis: Sergio, a Mexican boy with a pure soul but out of habit addicted to violence decides to try his luck leaving his city and emigrating to the slums of New York. It soon falls into the hands of the "Brotherhood of Latin America", an organization that exploits illegal immigrants with blackmail and violence. The Mexican falls in love with the boss's slave girl and with her decides to flee to Mexico. The betrayed boss will go after them.
cast: Mimsy Farmer, Sergio Jimenez, Luigi Pistilli, Fernando Rey

title: La faille
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Piccoli, Mario Adorf, Adriana Asti

title: La fame e la sete
synopsis: An elderly person dies in a remote Sicilian town. At the bedside his son Alex, his wife Mara, cousins, nephews and brothers-in-law. In those days Alex must attend a photographic exhibition organized by the councilor for culture of the municipality. The funeral looms and Alex telephones his twin brother Salvatore, who has long since emigrated to the North to tell him the sad news. But unexpectedly the third Pacific twin appears out of nowhere that everyone had forgotten about.
cast: Antonio Albanese, Lorenza Indovina, Aisha Cerami, Rosa Pianeta

title: La fameuse invasion des ours en Sicile
synopsis: It all begins on the day when Tonio, son of the bear king, is kidnapped by hunters in the mountains of Sicily. Taking advantage of a severe winter that threatens a great famine, the king decides to invade the plain where men live. With the help of his army and a wizard, he manages to win and find Tonio. But he soon realizes that bears are not meant to live in the land of men.

title: La famiglia
synopsis: Carlo, an elderly retired teacher, recalls the saga of the bourgeois family of which he is the last patriarch, from the early twentieth century to the present day. Through various small pictures, with History as the background to the personal events and feelings of a well-characterized gallery of characters.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Stefania Sandrelli, Fanny Ardant, Ottavia Piccolo, Renzo Palmer, Athina Cenci, Carlo Dapporto, Philippe Noiret, Sergio Castellitto, Andrea Occhipinti, Jo Champa, Massimo Dapporto

title: La famiglia Brambilla in vacanza
synopsis: Ms. Brambilla has great ideas for her daughter's future. A young man without means, what the girl dotes on, is not exactly what the lady has in mind. So she forces her husband to go into debt to spend the holidays on a luxury beach. However, the suitors she meets are not all reliable. Not too funny routine movie. The thing that saves him is the presence of actors like Girotti and Stoppa, not to mention Cavalier Baseggio.
cast: Cesco Baseggio, Massimo Girotti, Elena Lüber, Paolo Stoppa, Amelia Chellini, Giulio Stival, Vita Bandini, Umberto Cocchi, Jole Ferrari

title: La famiglia Brandacci
synopsis: The life of Pio Brandacci, a delicatessen and a restless father, is turned upside down by his daughter's sudden decision to marry Ricky, a dumb-looking boy fanatic of Madonna and the son of two bourgeois hippies.
cast: Silvio Spaccesi, Mara Venier, Leo Gullotta, Annabella Schiavone

title: La famiglia Buonanotte
synopsis: Canada, 1957. Ten-year-old Michelangelo observes the community of emigrants in which he lives. Giulia, the mother, is a point of reference for everyone. Sister Eva cheats on her husband with a priest. Fiorello lives in a basement, he got a girl pregnant but he can't get married before his older brother. Upstairs we love and argue. The grandfather dies, the world changes too quickly and the boy wants to leave.
cast: Lina Sastri, Kim Cattrall, Giancarlo Giannini, Tony Nardi, Kim Coates, Peter Boretski, Chris Britton, David Calderisi, Daniel DeSanto

title: La famiglia Passaguai
synopsis: Beach portrait, with a few happy touches, of a small Italian bourgeoisie that has now overcome the trauma and difficulties of the war. Directed and performed by Aldo Fabrizi.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Peppino De Filippo, Tino Scotti, Giovanna Ralli, Carlo Delle Piane, Luigi Pavese, Nyta Dover, Enrico Luzi, Giovanni Grasso, Maria Donati

title: La famiglia Passaguai fa fortuna
synopsis: The cav. Valenzi has lost his job and his family is having a bad time. One day, mistaken by a former fellow soldier for the owner of a luxury car not his own, he makes big plans with his friend. One thing leads to another and the knight gets to sign a bad check for a large sum, but this illegal move is the beginning of luck instead of ruin. Whether Aldo Fabrizi was an actor, comedian or dramatic, everyone knows. Here he tries again the direction of direction (after a first "chapter" of the previous year with the same characters) and it always turns out to be a bit tricky.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Erminio Macario, Giovanna Ralli, Luigi Pavese, Virgilio Riento, Marisa Merlini, Carlo Delle Piane, Carlo Rizzo, Nino Pavese

title: La familia
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Pedro spends all day with friends on the outskirts of Caracas between poverty and mutual support. After Pedro kills another boy in self-defense, single father Andrés decides they have to flee for obvious life and death matters. Pedro, however, is full of anger and determined to go back as he could pay his friend Johnny for his act.
cast: Giovanni García, Reggie Reyes

title: La famille Bélier
synopsis: In the Bélier family, they are all deaf except for 16-year-old Paula, who acts as an interpreter for her parents and for the management of their farm. One day, pushed by the music teacher who has discovered her singing skills, Paula decides to participate in the competition organized by Radio France. This choice of life for her, however, would mean moving away from the family and approaching adult life.
cast: Karin Viard, François Damiens, Eric Elmosnino, Louane Emera, Roxane Duran, Ilian Bergala, Luca Gelberg, Stéphan Wojtowicz, Bruno Gomila

title: La famille Ouf
synopsis: When dealing with problems that all families face, the Odd Family can't help but try to solve them in the Odd way. With them, daily life is an on-going adventure. In each episode, the twins... See full summary »

title: La fanciulla che ride
synopsis: Jack Clementi by chance reading an article in "Time" discovers that there is a fake, a perfect copy of the precious masterpiece of Etruscan goldsmithing, known as "La fanciulla che ride". The reporter attributes ownership of the piece to the Houston Museum which received it as a gift from the late Texas billionaire and collector Jim Carson. To Jack, the statuette is owned by the feudal lords of Roccaferro, who have kept it in their castle for two centuries, with an insurance coverage of 800 thousand pounds ...
cast: Bud Spencer, Ursula Andress, Mylène Demongeot, Raimund Harmstorf

title: La fantarca
synopsis: In 2250 the universe is divided into two warring parts: the world of the rectangle and that of the triangle. A final battle destroys the world, and the spaceship Fantarca can choose whether to proceed towards Saturn or to refound the Earth ...
cast: Lino Puglisi, Alvinio Misciano, Teodoro Ravetta, Laura Zannini, Riccardo Cucciolla, Ugo Trama

title: La farfalla granata
synopsis: A very young footballer who plays in the ranks of the Turin team, Gigi Meroni meets Cristiana Uderstadt, daughter of carousels, in a bar, fleeing from a married husband for family imposition. Love is born between them, despite the fact that she risks the accusation of adultery, and the feeling goes hand in hand with the career of Gigi, also known for his nonconformist character.
cast: Alessandro Roja, Alexandra Dinu, Roberto Accornero, Caterina Vertova, Francesco Pannofino

title: La faute de l'abbé Mouret
synopsis: The parish priest of a remote village in the deep French province is Serge Mouret, a very young priest and very devoted to an image of the Madonna which he himself purchased. The son of a bigot and a drunkard, the young priest has a very particular religious sense that makes him recite very sensual prayers and subject him to senseless privations. When, due to an excess of fasting, he risks dying, he is lovingly assisted by Albine, a girl without a family, with whom he ends up falling in love.
cast: Francis Huster, Tino Carraro, Gillian Hills, Fausto Tozzi, André Lacombe, Margo Lion, Lucien Barjon, Silvie Feit

title: La faute à Voltaire
synopsis: Jallel, a Tunisian illegal immigrant in Paris, passes himself off as an Algerian refugee. He knows a beautiful "beur" which, however, plants him at the altar. Jallel then ends up in a psychiatric clinic where he falls in love with a nymphomaniac with whom he tries to rebuild a life.
cast: Sami Bouajila, Elodie Bouchez, Bruno Lochet, Aure Atika

title: La favolosa storia
synopsis: Experimental triptych which includes the episodes: _The Etruscan vase_, on affections and feelings; _Il Bestiario_, for projection on four superimposed screens; _The dream of Constantine_, about death, nature and resurrection.

title: La favolosa storia di Don Chisciotte della Mancia e del suo scudiero...
synopsis: The crazy adventures of Don Quixote della Mancia (Gigi Proietti), a wandering knight with a sad figure, dedicated to the protection of the weak and the fight against the abuses together with the trusted Scudiero Sancio Panza (Claudio Remondi), in a series of five episodes that unites the Spaces of the staging, actors, spectators, musicians and "behind the scenes", documentation and fiction.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Sabina De Guida, Zoe Incrocci, Mariella Zanetti, Stefano Satta Flores, Ciro Giorgio, Antonio Meschini, Giancarlo Palermo, Claudio Remondi, Sandro Dori, Roberto Lerici, Alberto Ricca, Magda Mercatali, Luigi Uzzo, Giorgio Gaslini, Enzo Scoppa, Bruno Tommaso, Bruno Biriaco, Antonio Salines, Bruno Alessandro, Giovanni Filidoro, Mario Laurentino, Elena Magoia

title: La favorita
synopsis: Fernando falls in love with a beautiful unknown lady, glimpsed in the church where he is praying. The woman, who even demonstrates that she reciprocates Fernando's feelings, declares to him that any relationship between them is impossible. Covered with glory in war, Fernando gets the hand of Leonora from the king, the woman whose identity and, above all, the role he continues to ignore. It is, in fact, the favorite of the king himself.
cast: Sophia Loren, Franca Tamantini, Paolo Silveri, Gino Sinimberghi, Miriam Di Giove, Alfredo Colella, Giorgio Costantini, Palmira Vitali Marini, Piero Sardelli

title: La febbre
synopsis: Mario Bettini, a provincial surveyor, is a thirty-year-old full of ideas and enthusiasm. His dream is to open a place with friends, but when he is unexpectedly hired by the Municipality he understands that the new job contrasts with his entrepreneurial spirit. It will be the meeting with a girl to make him glimpse new existential perspectives ...
cast: Fabio Volo, Valeria Solarino, Cochi Ponzoni, Gisella Burinato, Massimo Bagliani, Arnoldo Foà

title: La feldmarescialla. Rita fugge... Lui corre... Egli scappa
synopsis: An American pilot who parachuted near Florence finds refuge in the restaurant run by Rita which also hosts Giuliano, a professor engaged in research on a newly conceived rocket. Explosive mixture, it must be said, since Rita by mistake causes an explosion that forces the three to flee with the Germans at the ribs. Double happy ending with the arrival of the American lines and the idyll between Rita and the professor.
cast: Rita Pavone, Francis Blanche, Terence Hill, Aroldo Tieri, Jess Hahn, Michel Modo, Teddy Reno, Giampiero Littera, Claudio Trionfi

title: La felicità non costa niente
synopsis: To upset the life of Sergio, a married architect, with a lover and many friends, is a car accident. It is the trigger that makes him question his life. Sergio abandons all his certainties and embarks on a lonely wandering in which he meets Sara. A deceptive and fleeting encounter that will leave him alone again. At this point it will be Gianni, an old employee of his, to guide him towards the conquest of happiness.
cast: Mimmo Calopresti, Francesca Neri, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Vincent Perez

title: La felicità è un sistema complesso
synopsis: Enrico Giusti (Valerio Mastandrea) approaches for work totally incompetent and irresponsible executives who risk ruining the companies they run every time. He frequents them, becomes friends with them and finally convinces them to leave, thus avoiding the bankruptcy of companies and the consequent loss of thousands of jobs. It's the strangest and most useful job he could come up with and he never misses a beat, ever. But one morning a car crashes into a lake and everything changes. Filippo and Camilla, two brothers aged 18 and 13, are orphaned by an important entrepreneur couple. Enrico is called with the task of preventing two adolescents from becoming the managers of an industrial group of national importance. It should be the easiest case, the culmination of a career but everything gets complicated and the unexpected arrival of his brother's foreign girlfriend makes things even more difficult. In reality it will be the case that Enrico has been waiting for for a long time, the one that will change everything, forever.
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Giuseppe Battiston, Hadas Yaron, Paolo Briguglia, Teco Celio, Maurizio Donadoni, Filippo De Carli, Camilla Martini

title: La femme aux bottes rouges
synopsis: The millionaire Perrot, a fake patron and enemy of art, hosts some artists in his villa, with the secret purpose of sowing discord and pitting them against each other. One day he accidentally meets Françoise Leroi, young author of the literary essay "Secrets" and invites her to his villa to write her autobiography. The woman, already torn between the love she feels for the painter Richard and the publisher Marc, enters the heart of the battle when she sees them appear in front of her. But Perrot will have the worst ...
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Fernando Rey, Laura Betti, Jacques Weber, Emma Cohen, Adalberto Maria Merli, José Sacristan

title: La femme d'à côté
synopsis: Bernard (Depardieu) and Mathilde (Ardant), both married, find themselves neighbors after having once been lovers. The two are again overwhelmed by passion and Mathilde will end up on the verge of depression. The woman then decides to kill Bernard and commit suicide. A film about love fou, but without bombast. It is a passion of everyday dimensions, yet no less terrible for this. The sentiment erupts, bringing devastation to two quiet suburban families. Ardant, who makes her debut here in Truffaut's cinema, is perhaps the first woman in her films to possess a "hot" body and bring it to the stage. Faced with a subject of burning banality, Truffaut devises a form of estrangement: it is Odile, the tennis club keeper, who makes us retrace the tragic story in flashbacks. Under simple appearances, a film of great dramatic power.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Fanny Ardant, Henri Garcin

title: La femme de Gilles
synopsis: 1930s. Elisa takes care of the children and the house while waiting for the return of Gilles, her man, who works in the blast furnaces. Her sister Victorine often comes to visit her, but Elisa, pregnant again, begins to suspect that there is an affair between her and her husband ...
cast: Colette Emmanuelle, Emmanuelle Devos, Clovis Cornillac, Laura Smet

title: La femme de Rose Hill
synopsis: A Mauritian girl married by mail order to a Swiss landowner realizes she will never love him. She does not cooperate in the running of the house and refuses to have contact with her husband. One day she meets the son of a wealthy industrialist and with him, instead, it is overwhelming love. But the young man's father hinders their relationship in every way. Until the tragedy. More interesting, because more "subtle", in the first part, the film is still a noble indictment against racism, exemplified in a story that scratches the backward respectability of a community that fiercely defends its privileges.
cast: Marie Gaydu, Jean Philippe Ecoffey, Denise Péron, Roger Jendly

title: La femme de chambre du Titanic
synopsis: A so-called stroke of luck happens to Horty, a worker in a sad Lorraine foundry, he wins an invitation to participate in the party organized in Southampton on the occasion of the departure of the Titanic. On that occasion, Horty meets Marie, a young waitress who is about to board the ship.
cast: Aitana Sánchez Gijón, Olivier Martinez, Romane Bohringer, Giorgio Gobbi, Aldo Maccione

title: La femme de l'aviateur
synopsis: There is something tender between Anne and the student François; but the latter, who is a little younger than her, has taken it into his head that there is still something between Anne and the "aviator", one of her exes. To find out more, she stalks the man with the complicity of Lucie, a cute and cute teenager. But Anne realizes this and decides to feed François's doubts and jealousy ...
cast: Philippe Marlaud, Marie Rivière, Anne Laure Meury, Mathieu Carrière

title: La femme de la plaque argentique
synopsis: Stephane, a former fashion photographer, obsessively works on an old nineteenth-century photographic technique, which is said to give eternal life to the souls of the people he immortalized. Jean, a young man desperate for inspiration, becomes Stephane's assistant and soon feels charmed by Marie, the photographer's only daughter and model. After Marie falls victim to a mysterious fall one evening, it will become very difficult for Jean to distinguish between reality and fantasy.
cast: Tahar Rahim, Mathieu Amalric, Olivier Gourmet, Constance Rousseau, Malik Zidi

title: La femme du 5è
synopsis: After divorcing his wife and losing his job at university, American writer Tom Ricks moves to Paris to be closer to his daughter Chloé. Penniless, he agrees to work at night on behalf of a small boss but the occupation leaves him a lot of free time that he can spend writing something to dedicate to his daughter. The intention, however, is put aside when the mysterious Margit enters his life, a widow from the East with whom he begins an anomalous relationship that involves only two meetings a week in the woman's house, always at the same time and with the obligation of don't ask her about her past life. Suddenly a dark force seems to descend around Tom, claiming victims among his friends and acquaintances and soon the police suspect that he is the material author of the crimes, especially since the alibis adduced reveal that Margit's house has been uninhabited for over. fifteen years.
cast: Kristin Scott Thomas, Ethan Hawke, Joanna Kulig, Samir Guesmi

title: La femme du boulanger
cast: Raimu, Ginette Leclerc, Fernand Charpin, Robert Vattier, Charles Blavette

title: La femme défendue
synopsis: Francois is thirty-nine years old and married, Muriel is twenty-two years old, she is beautiful and has a sly face. She tries in every way to resist the ruthless court that François makes, she evades. Of course it will eventually capitulate.
cast: Isabelle Carré, Philippe Harel, Nathalie Conio, Sophie Niedergang

title: La femme en bleu
synopsis: The crisis of an affirmed and fascinating musicologist facing an evanescent and mysterious "woman in blue" who appears and disappears from his life. Solid film directed by Deville with gorgeous actors
cast: Michel Piccoli, Lea Massari, Michel Aumont, Simone Simon, Marie Lasas, Amarande, Geneviève Fontanel, Sabine Glaser, Patricia Lesieur

title: La femme et la pantin
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Antonio Vilar, Jess Hahn, Espanita Cortez, Claude Godard

title: La femme publique
synopsis: Ethel, an aspiring Parisian actress in her twenties, strips for a living for alleged artistic photos. He auditioned for the film of possessive and genius director Lucas Kiesling, stateless and visionary. Initially accepted, she was fired for incapacity, while remaining the director's occasional lover. On his way he also meets Milan, a Czech refugee, with whom he has contrasting relationships and acrobatic passion. Inserted in a game bigger than her, between conspiracies and murders, she will become a star returning to the set and playing Liza in "The Demons".
cast: Valérie Kaprisky, Francis Huster, Lambert Wilson, Patrick Bauchau

title: La festa
