synopsis: Together with nine classmates, Giulia Crespi participates in a party in the country villa of one of them. Since that day, the group has been lost and no one knows what happened to the boys. Very soon a video delivered to family members will show what happened, revealing in a disturbing way a macabre elimination game linked to a story that happened many years ago.
cast: Lavinia Longhi, Marco Nugnes, Riccardo Cicogna, Simone Riccioni, Matilde Maggio, Thomas Cibelli, Roisin Grieco, Romolo Guerreri, Micol Donghi, Niccolò Gentili, Alessandra Sartania, Susanna Giaroli, Andrea Consonni, Vittoria Bocca Gelsi, Cinzia Monreale, Karl Zinny

title: La fiamma che non si spegne
synopsis: Giuseppe Manfredi, the least son of a county, decides to enlist in the carabinieri and, before leaving for the First World War, marries his girlfriend Maria. Giuseppe dies at the front of him leaving his wife and newborn son luigi alone, who becoming an adult follows in the footsteps of his father, enlisting himself. With the outbreak of the Second World War he is sent to the African front. Sick, Luigi is transferred with the rank of brigadier to the station close to his hometown. Just in time to protect the fellow villagers from the tyrannies of the Nazi occupiers.
cast: Gino Cervi, Maria Denis, Leonardo Cortese, Carlo Campanini, Tino Buazzelli

title: La fiancée de Dracula
synopsis: A magician and his assistant try to free a castle from the influence of a group of vampires, with poor results. Even if to tell the truth, the appearances of the manor are less macabre than expected, but much more ... attractive.
cast: Cyrille Iste, Brigitte Lahaie, Jacques Régis, Thomas Smith, Jacques Orth

title: La fidanzata di papà
synopsis: Barbara and Matteo are two Italian guys who live in Miami, managing a small restaurant overlooking the sea. Barbara is pregnant and the happy event brings their respective parents to Miami: Massimo, Matteo's father, who has recently been widowed and has a hotel in Cortina, and Angela, Barbara's mother, who instead has a restaurant chain. and is separated from her husband. In the beginning, the incompatibility is skyrocketing between the two. Then, while events, misunderstandings and intertwining of various kinds revolve around them, the ice slowly begins to break and the affinities emerge when the two are committed to restoring peace between their children, who have entered into crisis due to the birth of the little girl. .
cast: Massimo Boldi, Simona Ventura, Elisabetta Canalis, Natalia Bush, Martina Pinto, Nino Frassica, Enzo Salvi, Biagio Izzo, Bruno Arena, Davide Silvestri

title: La fidélité
synopsis: To renew the image of his publishing group, Lucien Macroi, the great Canadian magnate of tabloid newspapers, hires Clelia, a young and capable photographer. Clève, an honest editor who pays attention to the literary quality of her editions, falls in love with her. The woman, attracted by his way of doing, agrees to marry him. But one day Clelia meets Nemo, a photographer, who attracts her attention.
cast: Sophie Marceau, Pascal Greggory, Guillaume Canet, Magali Noël

title: La fiera y la fiesta
synopsis: A director faces ever greater challenges while trying, decades later, of completing the unfinished work of the Dominican filmmaker Jean-Louis Jorge.
cast: Geraldine Chaplin, Udo Kier, Luis Ospina, Jaime Piña, Jackie Ludueña

title: La figlia del Corsaro Verde
synopsis: Under a false name, the son of the governor of a Spanish colony manages to enter the ranks of the pirates who rage with their banditry actions, in order to defeat them. But, after passing many tests, he is unmasked and sentenced to death. The daughter of the deceased Green Corsair, in love with the daring young man, will take care of freeing him and helping him until the final victory. Based on a novel attributed to Salgari, the film is full of action, but today it is almost pathetic for how naive and childish it is. He saves himself for a certain elegance in the setting and for the commitment of the performers. In a small part the boxer Primo Carnera.
cast: Doris Duranti, Fosco Giachetti, Camillo Pilotto, Mariella Lotti

title: La figlia del capitano
synopsis: The young and noble standard bearer Piotr has been assigned to a frontier department in a remote garrison in the heart of Siberia. During the voyage he saves a Cossack from death, then, having reached the fort, he falls in love with Mascia, the daughter of Captain Mironov, attracting the hatred of a rival who for years has been asking in vain for the girl's hand. Meanwhile, the rebel Cossacks are about to storm the fort ... The Lux production company had a long tradition of period films, which is filmed here at its highest level. Pushkin's novel is freely adapted, with a sense of action.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Irasema Dilian, Cesare Danova, Vittorio Gassman, Aldo Silvani, Ave Ninchi, Ernesto Almirante, Olga Solbelli, Carlo Ninchi, Gualtiero Tumiati

title: La figlia del capitano
synopsis: Late eighteenth century. The reckless noble Pjotr ??is sent by his father, as punishment, to the front. Here he meets the beautiful Masa, daughter of a captain, whose popular extraction does not allow any connection with Pjotr. Love breaks out between the two, opposed by the young officer Svabrin. Meanwhile, the revolutionary Pugachev, a friend of Pyotr, is preparing a popular uprising.
cast: Vanessa Hessler, Primo Reggiani, Nini Salerno, Ludovico Fremont, Francesca Chillemi, Andrei Slabakov, Teodora Duhovnikova, Stefan Shterev, Christo Jivkov, Edwige Fenech

title: La figlia di Mata Hari
synopsis: Elyne, a talented dancer, performs at the Java Academy. Prince Anak struck by her beauty and sensuality proposes to her to perform in his club. The noble, who is preparing the revolt, does not know that Elyne is the daughter of Mata Hari.
cast: Ludmilla Tchérina, Erno Crisa, Frank Latimore, Milly Vitale

title: La figliastra
synopsis: A few decades ago in Sicily there was a custom: to link the collection of a conspicuous inheritance to the demonstrations of virility. This is what happens to a widower, who for this reason risks not getting hold of a large sum of money. The man remarried but cannot have children, even if not because of his fault. It will be thanks to the intervention of his stepdaughter who will solve the situation.
cast: Sonia Jeanine, Lucretia Love, Bruno Scipioni, Nino Terzo

title: La fille au bracelet
synopsis: Sixteen-year-old Lise is accused of killing her best friend. Her parents are by her side, as is naturally expected. Once the process begins, Lise's secret life will gradually be revealed to everyone. Who is Lise really? Do we fully know the people we love?
cast: Melissa Guers, Anaïs Demoustier, Chiara Mastroianni, Roschdy Zem, Annie Mercier, Pascal Garbarini

title: La fille coupée en deux
synopsis: The beautiful Gabrielle aspires to climb the social ladder by exploiting her charm: she finds herself married to Paul, a psychologically jealous billionaire, but she is in love with Charles, an ambiguous and perverse writer ...
cast: Ludivine Sagnier, Benoît Magimel, Mathilda May

title: La fille de Brest
synopsis: In Brest, in the hospital where she works, a pulmonologist discovers the direct link between some suspicious deaths and state-approved medical treatment. Alone, she will go through a long battle to bring the truth to light.
cast: Sidse Babett Knudsen, Benoît Magimel, Charlotte Laemmel, Isabelle De Hertogh, Lara Neumann, Patrick Ligardes, Gustave Kervern

title: La fille de D'Artagnan
synopsis: 1654. Eloise, daughter of D'Artagnan, is locked up in a convent. When she witnesses the Mother Superior being killed by the evil Duke of Crassac, she suspects the crime is part of a plot against the future King Louis. He runs to Paris where he tries to convince his father to intervene. But D'Artagnan is no longer what it once was: he is tired, embittered, indifferent. So Eloise embarks on the adventure alone. Only at the end, thanks to his example, will the ancient quartet of musketeers take the field. Freda, an Italian master of adventure cinema, at 86 was about to get back to work with this new film, but he quarreled with Marceau and the story was then directed by Tavernier. Freda would surely have given the action a more pressing pace. Tavernier, on the other hand, faithful to his own style, has favored the psychological characterization of the characters.
cast: Sophie Marceau, Philippe Noiret, Sami Frey, Gigi Proietti

title: La fille de l'eau
cast: Pierre Champagne, Charlotte Clasis, André Derain, Van Doren

title: La fille de nulle part
synopsis: Michel, a lonely mathematics professor who has retired and in the throes of loneliness, saves Dora, a mysterious homeless man, from a dangerous situation. The presence of the young woman inside his apartment fascinates the professor but quickly becomes the cause of the occurrence of strange events, such as the sudden movement of objects without any rational explanation: phenomena behind which a disconcerting truth is hidden.
cast: Jean Claude Brisseau, Virginie Legeay

title: La fille du 14 juillet
synopsis: Hector met Truquette at Louvre on July 14th. To find and seduce her, he decides to spend the summer holidays at the sea, in the company of his friend Pattor and his girlfriend Charlotte. With the inevitable Bertier in tow, the group is preparing starting in August when, due to the economic crisis, the government decides to anticipate the return to everyone's work. Hector, however, does not give up from his purpose and together with the trio of scruffy friends he begins a daring journey along a country literally split in two.
cast: Vimala Pons, Vincent Macaigne, Grégoire Tachnakian, Marie Lorna Vaconsin, Thomas Schmitt, Albert Delpy, Bruno Podalydès

title: La fille inconnue
synopsis: Jenny, a young general practitioner, feels guilty for not opening her office door to a girl who was found dead soon after. Upon learning from the police that the victim's identity is unknown, Jenny decides to find out who he is. In his quest, he will slowly trace back to the truth.
cast: Adèle Haenel, Olivier Bonnaud, Jérémie Rénier, Louka Minnella, Christelle Cornil, Nadège Ouedraogo, Olivier Gourmet, Thomas Doret, Pierre Sumkay, Yves Larec, Fabrizio Rongione, Marc Zinga

title: La fille seule
cast: Virginie Ledoyen, Benoît Magimel, Dominique Valadié, Véra Briole

title: La fille sur le pont
synopsis: At night on a bridge overlooking the Seine a girl, Adèle, is about to throw herself, but Gabor, a knife thrower, who is passing by by chance, convinces her to give up. The man proposes to the girl to make a steady couple with him and the union of these two desperate destinies will unpredictably become a winning choice. The two tour the circuses in the area with their number and seem to have a good success. But luck will be with them only as long as they are together.
cast: Vanessa Paradis, Daniel Auteuil, Luc Palun, Demetre Georgalas

title: La fin du monde
synopsis: An astronomer makes his terrifying discovery public: threatened by the imminent impact with a comet, the Earth now seems to have reached the end of its existence ...
cast: Abel Gance, Jeanne Brindeau, Colette Darfeuil, Victor Francen

title: La fine del gioco
synopsis: Leonardo (Valentino) is a little boy locked up in a correctional house in the deep south. A television director (Gregoretti) decides to enter the correctional institution and chooses him, among all the others imprisoned, to submit him to an interview.
cast: Gianni Amelio, Ugo Gregoretti, Luigi Valentino

title: La fine del mondo nel nostro solito letto in una notte piena di pioggia
synopsis: In 1968 a communist journalist (Giannini) falls in love with an American feminist, chases her to the US and marries her. Ten years later, the two blame each other for the mutual disappointment of desires and ideals. Written and directed by a particularly verbose and melodramatic Wertmüller.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Candice Bergen, Michael Tucker, Mario Scarpetta, Lucio Amelio, Massimo Wertmüller, Anny Papa, Anne Byrne Hoffman, Flora Carabella, Jill Eikenberry

title: La fine dell'innocenza
synopsis: The young Annie, who remained orphaned by childhood, leaves the college in which he has always lived together with his lover Michael, an ambiguous individual who passes through his father. Once you arrive in Hong Kong, the man is arrested during a party on charges of being a currency trafficker. Staying alone, Annie ends up under the protection of Angelo and Linda, a wealthy and unscrupulous couple who begins to the world of sex and swingers. After a series of murky adventures, Annie finds refuge at a Buddhist convent where he will be able to find in herself the strength to get rid of his torturers.
cast: Annie Belle, Felicity Devonshire, Ciro Ippolito, Charles Fawcett

title: La fine della notte
synopsis: Two friends who live in neighboring towns in the Lombardy province, quarrel with a farmer and decide to make him pay. A good night begins for them, made up of crimes, chases, thefts and oppressions.
cast: Claudio Bigagli, Dario Parisini, John Sayles

title: La fine è nota
synopsis: A popular lawyer (Bentivoglio), while returning to the house, is touched by the body of a man who falls from the fourth floor of the building, that is, from the apartment of the lawyer himself. Who was the man, whom the lawyer had never seen or known? The lawyer undertakes his own personal investigation, parallel to the official one entrusted to a magistrate. The surprises will be many and of great importance. In her third film, Cristina Comencini transposed the story of an American novel by Geoffrey Holliday Hall to Italy, but the resulting screenplay has many gaps, which fatally reverberate on the structure of the story.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valérie Kaprisky, Carlo Cecchi, Mariangela Melato

title: La finestra di fronte
synopsis: Giovanna and Filippo have been married for eight years and have two children. She is the true driving force of the family and this forced her to harden in emotional relationships and give up her dreams. He allows himself only a small secret habit: spying on a young man who lives in the building opposite his. One day, by chance, the two meet and become accomplices in trying to unravel the mystery of the identity of a very old man who no longer remembers anything ...
cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Raoul Bova, Massimo Girotti, Filippo Nigro

title: La finestra sul luna park
synopsis: After the death of his wife, a man returns from Kenya where he had moved to work. He has to think about the future of his son, little Mario, whom he has practically never met. So he thinks of entrusting the child to an orphanage and leaving again, then he discovers that Mario does not attend school but lingers with Richetto, a second-hand dealer who is very fond of the little one. After a first fight, Richetto makes the parent aware of his duties as a father and the latter decides not to leave anymore and take care of the child in the first person.
cast: Giulia Rubini, Gastone Renzelli, Giancarlo Damiani, Pierre Trabaud, Calina Classy, Gisella Mancinotti, Luigi Russo, Remo Galli, Lina Galli

title: La fièvre monte à El Pao
synopsis: In the penal colony on the island of Ojeda, largely reserved for political prisoners sentenced to forced labor, the governor is killed by a subordinate who then goes into hiding. While waiting for his successor, the reins of the prison pass to Ramón Vasquez, secretary of the murdered, a young idealist eager to "change things from within". Ines, the governor's widow, falls in love with Ramón and seduces him. When the government sends its new emissary, the woman feels lost: it is in fact a former lover who is able to blackmail her. Knowing from Ramón that the detainees intend to organize a revolt, the woman makes sure to be away from the island with the new governor so that he is dismissed and the place passes permanently to Vasquez. But fate has a more bitter ending in store for her.
cast: Gérard Philipe, Maria Felix, Jean Servais, Victor Junco, Roberto Canedo, Andrés Soler

title: La fleur du mal
synopsis: A woman is acquitted, despite her guilt, at the end of the Second World War: this is the starting point for following the vicissitudes of the Charpin-Vasseur, leading exponents of the Bordeaux bourgeoisie. Their history is marked by a series of mysterious deaths, as if the guilt were a hereditary defect that is transmitted from generation to generation. A crime committed in the past, and not atoned for, can therefore have repercussions on the descendants ...
cast: Bernard Lecoq, Nathalie Baye, Benoît Magimel, Suzanne Flon, Mélanie Doutey

title: La flor
synopsis: A film-tribute to the history of cinema, through six episodes inspired by the different forms of cinematographic art. Each episode is characterized by a different genre. The first is reminiscent of B series films, those that Americans once shot with their eyes closed and now seem to no longer know how to do. The second is a kind of musical with a touch of mystery. The third is a spy movie. The fourth is difficult to describe. The fifth is inspired by an old French film. The last, set in the nineteenth century, tells the story of some women, held prisoner by the Indians, who return from the desert after many years.
cast: Elisa Carricajo, Pilar Gamboa, Valeria Correa, Laura Paredes

title: La flor de mi secreto
synopsis: Talented as a writer of sentimental novels and very unlucky as a wife, Leo is on the verge of the abyss: she is unable to face the fact that her marriage is about to end and hides behind illusions, as well as for the books she writes she hides behind. a fake name. Her friend Betty gets her an interview with a new publisher, and Leo decides to write a destructive critique of her books, hiding behind a new pseudonym.
cast: Marisa Paredes, Juan Echanove, Joaquim Cortez, Rossy De Palma

title: La flûte à six schtroumpfs
synopsis: A bandit steals a magic flute from the Smurfs that has the ability to relentlessly push anyone who listens to it to dance. Cartoon version of the puppets created by the Dutch designer Peyo. Pleasant and well done, it was also broadcast as a pilot of a TV series.

title: La folie Almayer
synopsis: Borneo, late 1950s. Malaysia is still under British rule and the discontent of the local population is growing dramatically, fueling winds of independence. The Dutch Dain arrived in a small village, near a river always agitated and far from any tumult: driven by the desire for wealth he is ready for anything, agreeing to work for his compatriot Almayer intent on searching for the hidden treasure of his father-in-law Lingard. Unfortunately, however, Dain sets his sights on Nina, the daughter on whom Almayer has placed every hope to improve her financial situation.
cast: Stanislas Merhar, Marc Barbé, Aurora Marion, Sakhna Oum, Solida Chan, Sun Yucheng, Bunthang Khim

title: La folie des grandeurs
cast: Louis De Funès, Yves Montand, Alice Sapritch, Karin Schubert

title: La foresta di ghiaccio
synopsis: Pietro (Domenico Diele), a young specialized technician, arrives in a small Alpine town to repair a fault in the high-altitude power plant when he is faced with a sudden and strange disappearance. The event generates a series of unpredictable consequences that lead the young man to clash with two brothers from the area (Emir Kusturica and Adriano Giannini) who seem to be hiding something. Then when he realizes the origin of the secrets hidden in the valley, the accumulated tension explodes to create a climate of suspicion that involves everyone, including Lana (Ksenia Rappoport), the zoologist expert on bears.
cast: Emir Kusturica, Ksenia Rappoport, Domenico Diele, Adriano Giannini, Giovanni Vettorazzo, Maria Roveran, Rinat Khismatouline, Danilo Panzeri, Marco Tenti

title: La fornarina
synopsis: In Renaissance Rome a young commoner modeled the famous painter Raffaello Sanzio for several paintings with sacred subjects and ended up becoming his lover. A powerful noblewoman, jealous of their relationship, has the girl kidnapped, thus arousing the desperation of Raphael who does not rest until he can find her.
cast: Lida Baarova, Walter Lazzaro, Anneliese Uhlig, Luigi Pavese, Loredana, Amilcare Pettinelli, Ugo Sasso, Giorgio Costantini, Vinicio Sofia, Cesare Fantoni

title: La fortuna di Laura
synopsis: Laura is a successful surge who raised her daughter Emma alone, vizing as much as possible and sending her to study abroad. When the clandestine relationship that Laura entertains with her husband of her most important client, the woman loses in one fell swoop, home and reputation is discovered. To help her is her former maid Agnese, who hosts her at her house. To repay, Laura proposes to Agnese to replace her in the work of a cleaning woman.
cast: Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Andrea Pennacchi, Emanuela Grimalda, Ilaria Rossi, Astra Lanz

title: La fortuna di essere donna
synopsis: By chance, Antonietta (Loren), a young girl from a modest family, becomes a cover girl. Corrado, the photographer who discovered her, falls in love and she makes him jealous by attending Count Senetti, who "scorns" her by teaching her good manners. The nobleman gives Antonietta a fur coat and promises to marry her, but, at a lunch, the legitimate consort of the count shows up ...
cast: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Charles Boyer, Nino Besozzi

title: La fortuna viene dal cielo
synopsis: A thief steals a very precious jewel from the young and pretty Anna Illes, girlfriend of the lawyer Pap. Hunted by the police, he gets rid of the stolen goods, leaving the jewel on the table of a prostitute (Zizì) with financial problems. She thinks it's a gift from heaven and she doesn't take long to show it around. Zizì's behavior naturally creates a series of misunderstandings in which the lawyer and his girlfriend fall first, even reaching a sentimental crisis. However, new loves also arise until everything falls into the initial order.
cast: Anna Magnani, Vera Carmi, Roberto Villa, Sandro Ruffini, Franco Coop, Guglielmo Sinaz, Romolo Costa, Giulio Battiferri, Claudio Ermelli

title: La forza bruta
synopsis: Fred, a trapeze artist, teaches his art to the young Diana. The man fatally falls in love with the girl, causing her colleague and former lover, Maria to go on a rampage. The latter draws on her rival by badmouthing her. Fred, worried and upset by the situation, is seriously injured when he falls from the trapeze.
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Ernesto Calindri, Juan De Landa, Maria Mercader, Germana Paolieri

title: La forza del passato
synopsis: Forty-year-old Gianni Orzan is satisfied with the world he has built for himself. He lives with his wife Anna, a very sweet woman, and with their son Francesco. The meeting with a strange stranger who says he knows things about his father, a fascist soldier, puts Gianni's balance in crisis forcing him to make a lucid analysis of what he is and what he wanted to become.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Bruno Ganz, Sandra Ceccarelli, Mariangela D'Abbraccio, Valeria Moriconi, Sebastiano Moise, Giuseppe Battiston

title: La fracture
synopsis: One evening when a great event is underway in Paris, Raf and Julie - a couple on the brink of breakage - end up in an emergency room that is almost collapse for the turnout. Overwhelmed staff and angry demonstrators will shatter every certainty or prejudice of the two women, not to mention their meeting with Yann, one of the injured protesters. While the voltage rises out, the hospital is under siege and the night that arrives is very long to pass.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Marina Foïs, Pio Marmaï, Jean Louis Coulloc'h, Aissatou Diallo Sagna, Caroline Estremo, Camille Sansterre

title: La freccia azzurra
synopsis: It is the night of the Epiphany: the perfidious Scarafoni, assistant to the Befana, with the excuse of treating her from an annoying flu, is actually poisoning the old woman because he does not want her to give the toys, but to sell them. But they rebel and run away, finding the solidarity of a poor child, who wants the Freccia Azzurra at all costs, a train complete with locomotive. Three years of work and five billion to make the first European co-production cartoon. The film, based on a short story by Gianni Rodari and scripted by the director with Umberto Marino, is built on an educational story (the consumerism of sedan gifts), on a non-trivial drawing (the characters have a trait reminiscent of Tintin's) and on beautiful music by Paolo Conte. To design the town he took inspiration from the topography of Orbetello, while Dario Fo reinterpreted the dialogues.

title: La freccia nel fianco
synopsis: Nicoletta Dossena, happily married, abandons her husband to become the lover of a pianist, her distant childhood love, whom she has met again at a concert. When she discovers that she is a hindrance to the artist's career, the woman kills herself.
cast: Mariella Lotti, Leonardo Cortese, Roldano Lupi, Alanova, Cesare Barbetti, Galeazzo Benti, Enzo Biliotti, Paola Borboni, Liliana Laine, Emilio Petacci, Sandro Ruffini

title: La frontiera
synopsis: 1916: Emidio Orlich, a young officer of the Austro-Hungarian army of Dalmatian origin, after a dramatic crisis of conscience decides to desert and join the Italian ranks. He will end up on trial. 1941: Franco Velich, a fascist officer also born in Dalmatia, spends a period of convalescence on the island where he was born, during which he becomes aware of the violence inflicted by Axis troops on the occupied populations.
cast: Raoul Bova, Marco Leonardi, Omero Antonutti, Vesna Tominac

title: La frontière de l'aube
synopsis: Carole is a star who often lives alone, neglected by her husband, and who meets a young photographer, François, with whom she falls in love and with whom she begins a relationship. Returning from a business trip, the husband discovers them and the two are forced to interrupt their menage. Carole slips into depression and kills herself. A year later, a few hours before his marriage to another woman, François has a vision. It is Carole who calls him, from another dimension.
cast: Louis Garrel, Laura Smet, Clémentine Poidatz, Vladislav Galard

title: La frusta e il corpo
synopsis: #She sinister and cruel Kurt returns after a long absence to the grim family castle, where he finds his ex-lover and cousin Nevenka married to his brother. Everyone blames him for the death of his other cousin: the young woman had committed suicide after being seduced and planted by Kurt, who then left without remorse. Family and relatives hate him and barely tolerate his presence. In particular, the girl's mother wants to kill him to avenge her daughter's death. As if by a projection of her hatred, the cruel seducer is murdered in a mysterious way. But this is not enough to put an end to it.
cast: Daliah Lavi, Christopher Lee, Tony Kendall, Ida Galli, Harriet Medin, Gustavo De Nardo, Luciano Pigozzi, Jacques Herlin

title: La fuga
cast: Giovanna Ralli, Anouk Aimée, Maurizio Arena, Enrico Maria Salerno

title: La fuga
synopsis: Saverio Salesi robs a bank and, while escaping, playing various intercoms at random, ends up at the home of Micol, an escort. After an initial embarrassment, Saverio decides to pay Micol to stay with her all day and even night. Unfortunately, running up, Saverio bumps into Nilde, a tenant of the building, who recognizes him when they send her photo on television and calls the police. Inspector Dollorenzo, Inspector Sfaragara, Agent Filieri and Inspector Madanìa follow in the footsteps of Saverio.
cast: Sveva Cardinale, Claudio Vanni, Stefano Ambrogi, Mietta, Massimo Bonetti, Stefano Calvagna, Daniele Trombetti, Niccolò Calvagna

title: La fuga - Girl in Flight
synopsis: Silvia is an eleven-year-old girl whose life at home is consumed by her mother's clinical depression. When she realizes that no one will be able to help her fulfill her dream of visiting Rome, Silvia runs away with the intention of seeing the city alone. On a tremor, he meets Emina, a Roma girl, and decides to follow her through the streets of the capital.
cast: Donatella Finocchiaro, Filippo Nigro, Lisa Ruth Andreozzi, Maddalena Halilovic, Andrea Atzei, Alessio Spagnoli, Dario Andreozzi

title: La fuga degli innocenti
synopsis: 1941, a group of girls from Eastern Europe is on the run from the catastrophe of war and the Nazi raids; From Slovenia the group finds shelter in the Emilian hinterland, to be able to penetrate Swiss land.
cast: Ken Duken, Jasmine Trinca, Ennio Fantastichini, Toni Bertorelli, Eliana Miglio, Alfredo Pea, Andrea Tidona, Ana Caterina Morariu, Nino Frassica, Thomas Trabacchi, Max Von Sydow

title: La fuggitiva
synopsis: Delfina, an orphan of both parents, brings a little girl who has run away from home to her father. Having failed her marriage due to a jealousy outbreak of her fiancé, she is hired as a housekeeper by the girl's family; later he falls in love with his father who everyone thinks is a widower. When happiness seems close at hand, his wife, a variety artist, who had moved away from home years earlier, unexpectedly reappears. Delfina therefore takes refuge with her grandfather in the mountains. The little girl tries to reach her and falls ill.
cast: Jone Voleri, Anna Magnani, Renato Cialente, Clelia Matania, Anna Carena, Mariù Pascoli, Annibale Betrone, Nino Crisman, Stefano Sibaldi

title: La fuitina sbagliata
synopsis: The story of Romeo and Juliet is exactly the opposite: two families, the Casisa and the Vitrano, who adore each other, and the two children, Anna and Claudio, off-site students and historical boyfriends, who hate each other and don't want to be together. When they return home, the two find an idyllic situation: the friendship between their families is cemented to the point that they have even joined in business. The Casisa, producers of ricotta and the Vitrano, producers of cannoli peels, will put on sale "the cannoli of lovers", of which Claudio and Anna will be the unwitting testimonials. Dirty that picture is so difficult that the two will not only not have the courage to say that they broke up but, seized by an increasingly childish fear, they will complicate things by telling big lies: not only do they announce the marriage but also the next birth of a child. From here starts a hilarious game of misunderstandings, which will lead them to make the wrong fuitina.
cast: Claudio Casisa, Annandrea Vitrano, Barbara Tabita, David Coco, Stefania Blandeburgo, Paride Benassai, Maurizio Marchetti, Francesco Guzzo, Alessandro Bolide, Luca Lombardi, Vito Zappalà, Ernesto Maria Ponte

title: La furia dei Kyber
synopsis: Captain Miller and Lieutenant Cullen find themselves shoulder to shoulder on the British expedition to India that seeks to capture the rebel Tantiah. But Miller would like to exterminate them all, Cullen has more humanitarian feelings. A very low level Italian-Spanish co-production.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Alan Steel, Antonio Mayans, Luis Barboo

title: La furia dei barbari
synopsis: In the 6th century AD, the Lombard raids on Italian soil were punctuated by oppression. The killing of a village chief's wife triggers a spiral of revenge.
cast: Edmund Purdom, Rossana Podestà, Livio Lorenzon, Carla Calò, Daniele Vargas, Andrea Fantasia, Vittoria Febbi, Ljubica Jovic, Luciano Marin, Raffaella Carrà

title: La furia di Ercole
synopsis: While traveling through the territories of the king of Nisia, his old friend, Hercules of Thebes is informed by Daria, the handmaid of Queen Cnidia, that the king has long since died and his daughter, Cnidia, has seized power and it is united with the violent Menisto, who does nothing but oppress the people with the help of mercenary troops. Hercules will do all he can to thwart their plans. Naive, spectacular and populist, according to the canons of the genre. Brigitte Corey is actually Luisella Boni.
cast: Brad Harris, Brigitte Corey, Mara Berni, Serge Gainsbourg

title: La fête est finie
synopsis: Céleste is 19 years old and a drug addict. Admitted to a detoxification center, she arrives - in full withdrawal crisis - on the same day as Sihem, older than her and mysterious, refusing any kind of contact. Despite their differences, Céleste finally breaks the ice. The two young women make friends and become inseparable. They are discharged from the center, left to themselves, but they always remain together, with the risk of missing out on their possibility of redemption.
cast: Zita Hanrot, Clémence Boisnard, Marie Denarnaud

title: La fête à Henriette
cast: Dany Robin, Michel Auclair, Hildegarde Neff, Michel Roux

title: La gabbia
synopsis: Hélène has left to visit her grandmother who lives outside Paris and so Michael finds himself alone. This is how he meets Marie, a woman loved by the sea many years before and immediately abandoned afterwards. Michael goes to see Marie and has no qualms about spending the night with her, but the next morning he wakes up and finds himself tied to the bed. There was a period in which Patroni Griffi managed to collect some success with these completely meaningless erotic-existential dramas. Today, thank goodness, this doesn't happen anymore. In two minor roles the Marsillach sisters are almost tender.
cast: Tony Musante, Laura Antonelli, Florinda Bolkan, Blanca Marsillach, Cristina Marsillach

title: La gabbianella e il gatto
synopsis: Cats are a group of old friends weighed down by years and too many treats; the mice, on the other hand, are expanding their power by taking advantage of the gentrification of cats. On the other hand, seagulls suffer the consequences of man-made pollution more than any other animal; a dying seagull therefore leaves a cat with its first egg, which will also be the last. The cats will raise the seagull that will soon be born, the mice will try in every way to eat it.

title: La garçonnière
synopsis: Giulia suspects that her husband Alberto, a building builder from Rome, has a lover and follows him. As happened in the past, his doubts turn out to be well founded: the man is dating the young model Laura. Seeing both of them sneak into a building, Giulia decides to confront the other woman. Troubled by the meeting, Laura will make an unexpected decision.
cast: Raf Vallone, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Gordana Miletic, Nino Castelnuovo, Franca Marzi, Renato Baldini, Maria Fiore, Clelia Matania, Ennio Girolami, Marisa Merlini

title: La gatta da pelare
synopsis: Mara, a journalist in search of success, and Stefano, a cartoonist, live together, but between the two things are pretty bad. Mara thinks of solving her problem by going to Professor Maraldi, a well-known psychoanalyst, their neighbor. Stefano, jealous of the latter, threatens him and takes revenge on him by killing him in the comics he draws.
cast: Pippo Franco, Janet Agren, Daniela Poggi, Orso Maria Guerrini

title: La gatta in calore
cast: Eva Czemerys, Silvano Tranquilli, Anthony Fontane, Renato Pinciroli

title: La gente che sta bene

With a steadily growing career, a strong-willed wife (Margherita Buy) and a large bank account to dispose of, Umberto is an arrogant and self-centered being who soon finds himself facing an unexpected situation: fired from his firm in where he works, he will do everything not to give up his privileges, trusting the promises of a bright future made to him by a cynical business lawyer (Diego Abatantuono).

title: La gerla di papà Martin
synopsis: Father Martin, a porter at the port of Le Havre, was able to secure a peaceful old age by saving on everything and working to an old age and was able to have his son study at the University of Paris. The boy, however, is easily misled by bad company and, having indulged in gambling and revelry, ends up signing bills ...

title: La giacca verde
synopsis: A young and already successful conductor, Walter Salvini, interrupts the rehearsals of Giuseppe Verdi's "Otello" which he is conducting in 1946. The boy recognized the timpanist Romualdi among the orchestras, who had shared with him a refuge in a mountain village. At the time, the timpanist passed for an important conductor and this had allowed the young man to enjoy the graces of a former diva of the regime.
cast: Jean Pierre Cassel, Renzo Montagnani, Senta Berger, Vittorio Sanipoli

title: La gifle
synopsis: Isabella (Adjani) is twenty years old, she studies medicine and has problems in her family. The parents are divorced, the mother (Girardot) lives with someone else, and the father (Ventura) is not an affable character. Great success in France, Pinoteau's film rests on Ventura's imperturbable face and Adjani's youthful freshness.

cast: Jean Sorel, Lea Massari, Jeanne Valerie, Rik Battaglia, Valeria Ciangottini, Isabelle Corey, Paolo Stoppa, Marcella Valeri, Luigi Giacosi, Enrico Glori

title: La giusta distanza
synopsis: A beautiful and emancipated teacher moves to a small village in the Po delta, arousing the attention of the inhabitants: the sticky one of the enriched tobacconist like the discreet one of a Tunisian mechanic, with whom she befriends. But when she is about to leave, the young woman is found killed and the criminalization of the different is inevitable: a young boy, a budding journalist, will have the task of restoring the truth.

title: La gondola del diavolo

The girl's arrival upsets the balance of the family, made up of the elderly and widower Leopoldo, his son Casanova, the dumb daughter-in-law, the two grandchildren and the maid Jana. This is precisely the first victim of the situation because she is fired (because of the housekeeper) and, returning home, dies in a train accident.

synopsis: When DDT, a dangerous invention of Professor Bacterio, is stolen by Calimero, the ruthless dictator of Tirania who intends to use it for criminal purposes, the government tries to recover it at all costs. title: La gran final
synopsis: A group of hunters from Mongolia, a Tuareg caravan in the Ténéré desert, some Indians from the Amazon rainforest. They all have one goal: to attend the 2002 World Cup final, which is held in Japan and pits Brazil and Germany against each other.

title: La gran vida
synopsis: For Martin, the thirty -year -old crisis arrives violent: the existence, marked by the alienating rhythm of his work, becomes intolerable to him. To put an end to such an indecorous situation, he decides to commit suicide; Before doing this, however, one million dollars for an unforgettable party lends himself to the stoves. The meeting with Lola, a Mexican waitress, makes him change his mind: now the problem is like returning the money to the usurers ...
cast: Carmelo Gomez, Salma Hayek, Fernando Valverde, Alicia Agut

title: La grande bellezza
synopsis: After "The human apparatus", the only novel he published as a young man and which gave him fame, Jep Gambardella (Toni Servillo) has not written anything anymore. However, he became a journalist and often frequents Roman high society. His life is a succession of meetings, appointments and eccentric celebrations that make him a witness to the crisis of society. The atmosphere that reigns in the capital is in fact no longer what it used to be: powerful, attendants, countesses and real estate developers have taken over, giving way to a slow but continuous process of degradation that transforms men into monsters. During a hot summer in Jep, now cynical and intolerant sixty-five, all that remains is to fish in the memories and, disappointed by the present, relive his passionate and lost youth, marked by the memory of an innocent love. Maybe it's time for him to start writing something new.

synopsis: First they try them all to hide when the others attack, but then they will die as heroes so as not to betray their homeland in the face of the enemy. Indovinatissima mixture of tragedy and comedy. Amazing Deaf and Gassman.

title: La grande guerra del Salento
synopsis: After the war, the competition between the inhabitants of two villages of Salento, Supersano and Ruffano is unleashed, where the rivalry between the football teams is a mirror of that of the presidents of the two clubs: Ernesto, agricultural entrepreneur and patron of Supersano and Alfredo, general in Pension and manager of Ruffano.

title: La grande illusion
synopsis: Scenes from a German POW camp during the Great War. A French officer of aristocratic origin sacrifices himself to facilitate the escape of two of his subordinates of popular origin. Mirror of the French is the German commander of the camp, also old-fashioned, undermined in physique and morale. Both embody a world destined to disappear while the fugitives are a metaphor for the new society. A masterpiece of anti-militarist cinema, a melancholy and pacifist manifesto of a generation in danger of extinction.
cast: Pierre Fresnay, Erich Von Stroheim, Jean Gabin, Gaston Modot, Dita Parlo, Marcel Dalio

title: La grande luce - Montevergine
synopsis: Forced to flee to Argentina because accused of a murder he did not commit, a blacksmith from the village of Montevergine finally sees his innocence recognized. He is about to return to his homeland when he unjustly ends up in jail. After ten years the dream of repatriation comes true, but ...

title: La grande notte di Ringo
synopsis: In a cell in Carson City, they find Broken Arm and Jack. The second would like to know where are the two hundred thousand dollars that, according to Judge Elian, Broken Arm would have hidden after a bloody robbery. Jack escapes and travels to Tombstone disguising himself as a federal agent. In the town he meets one by one all the other members of the Braccio Rotto gang and risks his life several times.

title: La grande rabbia
synopsis: In the space of a day, the friendship between two young people is consolidated: Benny and Matteo, who in twenty-four hours will set their lives forever. Benny has black skin, adopted in swaddling clothes by a couple from Veneto who moved to Rome, was orphaned and only became a fighting champion for clandestine matches, where with bets in one fell swoop you can earn lots of zero figures. Benny decides to invest all his savings in one last meeting, the one that will allow him to start a new life, despite his passion has already cost him prison. Matteo is white, works in a pub and was born in Rome, where he lives with his retired father and younger brother who support him.
cast: Maurizio Matteo Merli, Miguel Gobbo Diaz, Ydalia Suarez, Edoardo Purgatori, Simone Sabani, Nicole Cadeddu, Cinzia Carrea, Flavio Bucci, Claudio Fragasso, Giulio Base

title: La grande scrofa nera
synopsis: The Mazzara family consists of 5 brothers, 4 males and a female, as well as by his widowed father and his grandmother, convinced that the family is "a large black sow" and that all its members are unequivocally of the pigs.
cast: Mark Frechette, Rada Rassimov, Alain Cuny, Flora Robson, Francisco Rabal, Claudio Camaso, Rik Battaglia, Antoine Saint John, Marcella Michelangeli, Liana Trouché

title: La grande speranza
cast: Lois Maxwell, Renato Baldini, Carlo Bellini, Aldo Bufi Landi

title: La grande strada azzurra
synopsis: Squerciò uses explosives to fish. For a long time he manages to get away with it, then, preparing a bomb, he remains dry. Pontecorvo's debut was not very successful.

title: La grande séduction
synopsis: Germain, a resident of Saint-Marie-La Mauderne, a small fishing village who lives only thanks to government aid, decides to take matters into his own hands and help his fellow citizens. A small factory could be opened in the village, but there needs to be a doctor. When a young doctor shows up to spend an entire month in Saint-Marie, Germain collects information about him to be able to satisfy his every wish. And so all the inhabitants make every effort to ensure that man decides to settle in the village.
cast: Raymond Bouchard, David Boutin, Benoît Brière, Bruno Blanchet, Pierre Collin

title: La grande vadrouille
synopsis: An English plane is shot down over Paris by the Nazi anti-aircraft. The three crew members jump with parachutes landing more or less luckily in the French capital. Here, aided by an orchestra conductor and a house painter, they begin an escape through occupied France. After a thousand ups and downs and a good dose of luck, they manage to save themselves. Huge success for a play with a perfect rhythm, remade by the French a hundred more times. The trio of comedians works great.
cast: Louis De Funès, Bourvil, Terry Thomas

title: La guerra degli Antò
synopsis: The Antò are four twenty-year-old punks who live in Montesilvano, they are all called Antonio and to distinguish themselves they have chosen nicknames: Antò lu Zombi who is a postman, Antò lu Malatu who is a nurse, Antò lu Zorru who is a journalist in a local newspaper and Antò lu Purk, the largest of the group. The four spend their days at the Zagreb bar or trying to ruin the parties given by the Treves twins in their villa. Then one day Antò lu Purk decides to go to Bologna to register for Dams, then to Amsterdam.
cast: Flavio Pistilli, Paolo Setta, Regina Orioli, Danilo Mastracci

title: La guerra dei Vulcani
synopsis: Entirely based on archive footage, the documentary reconstructs the biggest scandal of the Italian film jet set, the love triangle that in 1949 involved Italy's most loved actress (Anna Magnani), the most popular Italian director in Hollywood (Roberto Rossellini ) and the most famous actress in the world at that time (Ingrid Bergman). The Aeolian islands are the background to a story of intense love, anger and suffering: on the one hand the island of Stromboli, where Rossellini directs Bergman in Stromboli - Terra di Dio; on the other hand, the island of Vulcano - where Anna Magnani out of spite against Rossellini agrees to shoot a similar film, Vulcano.

title: La guerra dei cafoni
synopsis: In Torrematta, a village in Salento, war breaks out every summer between the sons of the rich, the gentlemen, and the sons of fishermen and peasants, the peasants. At the head of their respective "armies" Francisco Marinho and Scaleno. The hatred between the two is naive but indomitable: it will be the arrival of Cugginu, expression of a new social class, that will transform the clash into a real war of conquest.

title: La guerra dei topless - Donne e diavoli
cast: Nunzio Filogamo, Luciano Fineschi, Steve Lang, Giovanni Vari

title: La guerra di Mario
synopsis: Mario, nine years old, was entrusted by the Juvenile Court to Giulia and Sandro, a forty-year-old couple from the educated and well-to-do bourgeoisie. Giulia is perfectly at ease as a putative mother, while Sandro is intimidated by the presence of the child. Mario finds himself living in a completely different world from the one he has known up to that moment, torn between his new family and his real mother ...
cast: Valeria Golino, Marco Grieco, Andrea Renzi, Rosaria De Cicco, Anita Caprioli

title: La guerra di Troia
synopsis: At the death of Hector, the Trojan camp is divided by two factions: that of Paris and that of Aeneas. Paris treacherously kills Achilles and imprisons Aeneas, who thus witnesses the fall of the city without being able to do anything. His wife is killed during the fighting, but he manages to escape to Italy.
cast: Steve Reeves, Edy Wessel, John Drew Barrymore, Juliette Mayniel, Lidia Alfonsi, Warner Bentivegna, Luciana Angiolillo, Arturo Dominici, Mimmo Palmara, Nerio Bernardi

title: La guerra segreta
synopsis: A Russian officer flees East Berlin and seeks refuge with the American command in Germany. Before being killed by some hitmen, he uncovers a plot of some Soviet spies who want to destroy two American submarines and kidnap a nuclear scientist. A merciless clash opens between Paris, Djibouti and Rome.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Henry Fonda, Annie Girardot, Robert Ryan, Bourvil, Georges Marchal, Peter Van Eyck, Mario Adorf, Maria Grazia Buccella, Jacques Sernas
director: Terence Young, Carlo Lizzani, Christian Jaque

title: La guerre des boutons
synopsis: Boys from two rival French schools battle it out. Up for grabs: the buttons of the jackets. A childhood classic by Louis Pergaud successfully adapted by Robert.
cast: André Tréton, Michel Isella, Martin Lartigue, Jacques Dufilho, Michel Galabru, Yvette Etiévant, Michèle Meritz, Jean Richard, Pierre Tchernia

title: La guerre du feu
synopsis: In the Stone Age, the Ulam paleantropic tribe is attacked by a clan of Neanderthals. The fight causes the fire to go out, and three members of the Ulam move in search of the precious element: during the journey they help a woman, who teaches them the technique to light the flame ...
cast: Everett McGill, Ron Perlman, Nicholas Kadi, Rae Dawn Chong, Gary Schwartz, Naseer El Kadi, Franck Olivier Bonnet, Jean Michel Kindt

title: La guerre est déclarée
synopsis: Juliette and Romeo live their great love story, they love each other as if it were still the first day and their story became even more beautiful when they had their first child, Adam. But the awakening from the dream will be traumatic, everything will turn into nightmare and chaos, in an unequal war against the disease that will afflict the child. The two young people will have to learn to support each other, with all the strength and courage they are capable of. They will become adults quickly, in their bodies of devastated youth.
cast: Valérie Donzelli, Jérémie Elkaïm, César Desseix, Gabriel Elkaïm, Brigitte Sy, Elina Lowensohn, Michèle Moretti, Philippe Laudenbach, Bastien Bouillon

title: La guerre est finie
synopsis: Diego Mora, who for twenty-five years has lived in exile in Paris following Franco's victory in Spain, is sent back to his homeland with the task of directing an anti-regime trade union action. At the border, however, an accident occurs and Mora is forced to return to Paris to prevent a comrade from getting into trouble. But, once he returns, the organization of the exiles puts him under accusation. Mora goes into crisis and the meeting with some young people with terrorist intentions sharpens her doubts. The exhibition complexity of Resnais is the narrative tool for a film (written by Jorge Semprun) of strong civil tension in the analysis of a political-existential crisis. Excellent interpreters.
cast: Yves Montand, Ingrid Thulin, Michel Piccoli, Geneviève Bujold

title: La gueule de l'autre
synopsis: Mr Perrin is head of a large party, but during the election campaign he learns that a certain Richard Krauss, a criminal, has escaped and intends to kill all the accomplices of a dirty deal consumed in Gibuti. Among the accomplices there is also the Hon. Perrin who, who died of fear, pretends to be sick, then runs away, hides, disguises himself and, in public events, has a failed cousin, who resembles him perfectly, replaced by the cousin Brossard. Funny comedy that has the merit of not taking advantage of the easy rough situations. Serrault plays with seriousness and comedy the two characters of Perrin and Brossard.
cast: Michel Serrault, Jean Poiret, George Geret, Curd Jürgens

title: La gueule ouverte
cast: Hubert Deschamps, Monique Mélinand, Philippe Léotard, Nathalie Baye

title: La haine
synopsis: In a suburb of a French city like many others, made up of misery, more or less assorted ethnic groups and various types of crime, the wind of revolt is blowing. The occasion that makes her explode is the brutal interrogation to which the police subject a sixteen year old boy. In the struggle, the difficulties and the different personalities of all the young people who have been involved emerge. It won't be good for everyone. To support the message there is a compelling story, with a strong impact, in which the relationships between the characters are rendered effectively, the developments are never trivial and the rhythm knows no falls.
cast: Vincent Cassel, Hubert Koundé, Said Taghmaoui, Abdel Ahmed Ghili

title: La hija de todas las rabias
synopsis: Maria is an eleven -year -old girl with a very vivid imagination that he pulls to live with his mother Lilibeth in a great landfill in Nicaragua, a place always covered by fog. Some dogs live with them with a whole series of puppies that Lilibeth is about to sell. One day, however, Mary accidentally poles the puppies and Lilibeth relies reluctantly to force her to work on a recycling site, leaving her there to live alone, in the company only of other children like her.
cast: Noe Hernandez, Diana Sedano, Ara Alejandra Medal, Virginia Raquel Sevilla Garcia, Carlos Gutierrez

title: La hija del engaño
synopsis: Don Quintin suddenly comes home and finds his wife in bed with a man. He drives her out of the house and takes her little daughter away, which she entrusts to a family until she grows up. Many years later, Don Quintin will try to find his daughter, who in the meantime has grown up.
cast: Fernando Soler, Alicia Caro, Fernando Soto, Rubén Rojo, Nacho Contla, Amparo Garrido, Lily Aclemar, Álvaro Matute, Roberto Meyer, Conchita Gentil Arcos

title: La historia oficial
synopsis: Buenos Aires, 1983. Alicia, a teacher, begins to suspect that her adoptive daughter's parents are disappeared. In fact, her husband hides a terrible truth from her. One of the most disturbing films on the tragedy of the disappeared and its aftermath in democratic Argentina. It gets a little rough in development, but it remains very effective and honest. Award in Cannes for the protagonist Aleandro. Oscar for best foreign film.
cast: Norma Aleandro, Hector Alterio, Chela Ruíz, Hugo Arana, Chunchuna Villafañe

title: La hora de los hornos
director: Fernando E. Solanas, Octavio Getino, Santiago Álvarez

title: La horde
synopsis: In the Parisian banlieue, four corrupt policemen decide to avenge a friend who has been murdered by terrible criminals who lock themselves up in an abandoned public building. As soon as they arrive on the scene, the policemen's personal revenge turns into a nightmare. Trapped by the enemy, they expect to be killed at any moment, when the unthinkable happens: hordes of bloodthirsty creatures besiege the palace and attack them with rare violence. Taking refuge on the roof, the survivors are amazed to discover that the world has plunged into chaos. Hundreds of corpses form a shapeless mass in the streets that extends to the horizon, revealing a burning capital. Alone and wounded, fed by mutual hatred, cops and thugs have no choice but to join forces and try to survive. Thirteen small planes devastated and invaded by voracious creatures await them. But the greatest threat is not what is believed.

synopsis: Determined to save his son, suffering from a serious pathology, Professor Kaufmann tries everything for everything and transplants the boy's heart, replacing him with that of a gorilla. However, it has not expected complications and a dramatic and horrible transformation begins soon.

title: La horse
synopsis: Auguste directs his family and business with iron fist. His nephew Henri is part of a network of drug traffickers. By chance Augustte discovers a hiding place where Henri has hidden a drug game and destroys it. The gang of traffickers reacts by setting fire to a hay shed and massacre with cattle. Auguste does everything to keep the family calm because he does not give in to pressure. However, the war is now unleashed.

title: La iena
synopsis: Emy is a beautiful woman who is a professional modeling. For some years she has been married to Max, a successful businessman, with whom she lives in Los Angeles. However, he always leads a life on the move and during one of his many business trips, she, who is alone in the house, is kidnapped by a criminal. Besides, the man has already taken Emy's sister prisoner ...

title: La ilusión viaja en tranvía
cast: Lilia Prado, Carlos Navarro, Fernando 'Mantequilla' Soto, Agustín Isunza

title: La influencia
synopsis: Ms. Rivero is a bewildered and vulnerable woman, burdened by the thousands of problems of everyday life and much more: her assets have been seized, her cosmetics shop closed and her children forced to attend public school. The vitality of the two children is in stark contrast to the apathy of the mother, who slowly plunges into a state of deep depression. Seeing their mother lacking the strength to face difficulties, Romeo and Jimena are driven by circumstances to adopt adult behaviors to change the state of things.

title: La influencia
synopsis: Alicia returns to her childhood home to help her sister care for her sick mother. However, he will find himself facing a dark force from the past, which now threatens his daughter.

title: La invencion de la carne
synopsis: In a hospital, two disturbed and lonely young patients form an impossible relationship. Anguished and deprived of affection, Maria meets Mateo, mysterious medical student subject to nocturnal panic attacks, cold and absent, Only the water manages to catalyze his attention and reassure him: the young man in fact spends long hours in the pool, hypnotized by the waves and by the small participants in the neonatal aquatic course. Looking for someone to accompany and support him on a long journey whose purpose is silent, Mateo turns to Maria who, idle, accepts the proposal. Little by little, during a mostly silent journey, Mateo and Maria begin to get to know each other and to open up to each other.

title: La isla misteriosa y el capitán Nemo
synopsis: In the midst of the Civil War, five prisoners manage to escape from prison. Castaways, they end up landing on an island that appears to be deserted. This is actually Captain Nemo's refuge. Small budget for a small transposition from the novel "The mysterious island" by Jules Verne.

title: La isla mínima
synopsis: Deep South of Spain, 1980. A series of brutal murders of teenage girls in a remote and forgotten city brings together two very different homicide detectives. Despite their polar opposite ideologies, Juan and Pedro must put aside their differences in order to capture the killer who for years has terrorized the entire community in the shadow of a general contempt for women, rooted in a misogynistic past.
cast: Raúl Arévalo, Antonio De La Torre, Nerea Barros, Javier Gutiérrez, Manolo Solo, Jesús Carroza, Jesús Castro, Salvador Reina, Cecilia Villanueva

title: La jalousie
synopsis: A thirty-year-old lives in a small but well-stocked apartment with his partner whom he loves madly. The father of a little girl who was had by a woman he later abandoned, he is a very poor theater actor and his partner, who was once a rising star, has no job offer in sight. While he does everything he can to get her a role, she cheats on him and then leaves him. Left alone, he attempts suicide but fails, receiving a visit from his sister in the hospital and realizing that he has to rely only on her and on the theater.
cast: Louis Garrel, Anna Mouglalis, Rebecca Convenant, Olga Milshtein, Esther Garrel, Emanuela Ponzano, Arthur Igual

title: La jaula de oro
synopsis: 15-year-old Chauk is a Tzetzal Indian living in southern Mexico, he doesn't speak Spanish and has no documents. Sixteen-year-old Juan, who instead lives in Guatemala, has no reason to stay in his land after his brother's murder and runs away with Sara and Samuel. Chauk and the three boys meet on a freight train that crosses Mexico to head north and, despite their differences, they discover the value of fraternity and poetry.
cast: Rodolfo Dominguez, Brandon López, Ramón Medína, Carlos Chajon, Karen Martínez

title: La jefa
synopsis: When a girl who works in the world of fashion comes into crisis at the thought that her career can be cut down by a pregnancy, her capable offers to adopt the unborn child.
cast: Aitana Sánchez Gijón, Pedro Casablanc, Cumelen Sanz, Younes Bachir, Alex Pastrana, Vanesa Rasero, María Fernández Prat

title: La jeune fille sans mains
synopsis: In difficult times, a miller sells his daughter to the Devil. Protected by her purity, the young woman runs away but is deprived of her hands. Away from the family, he meets the water god, a kind gardener and a prince in his castle. His will be a long journey towards the light.

title: La jungle
synopsis: Two 30-year-olds accept a bet that could cancel all their debts: survive for 7 days in Paris with 7 euros in their pockets.
cast: Patrick Mille, Guillaume Gallienne, Olivia Magnani, Sophie Cattani, Guy Bedos, Anémone, Antoine Oppenheim, Élise Otzenberger, Yvon Martin, Olivia Dessolin

title: La kermesse héroïque
cast: Françoise Rosay, Micheline Cheirel, Lyne Clevers, Maryse Wendling

title: La kryptonite nella borsa
synopsis: Naples, 1973. Little Peppino (Luigi Catani) is seven years old and his existence is marked by a series of bizarre adventures and heavy events that mark his growth, such as the death of his cousin Gennaro, called Superman due to the habit of go around with a suit and cape on his shoulders to stop buses, in search of the legendary kryptonite. Due to the depression that hit her mother Rosaria (Valeria Golino) who, after discovering that her husband Antonio (Luca Zingaretti) is cheating on her with a younger lover, is being treated by a psychoanalyst recommended by his grandmother, Peppino is entrusted to Titina (Cristiana Capotondi) and Salvatore (Libero De Rienzo), the two crazy twenty-year-old uncles, who will lead him on a continuous wandering among colorful parties in basements, feminist movements, sex, smuggled cigarettes, drugs and alcohol. To keep him company, there will always be the ghost of the cousin.
cast: Luigi Catani, Valeria Golino, Cristiana Capotondi, Luca Zingaretti, Libero De Rienzo, Massimiliano Gallo, Nunzia Schiano, Antonia Truppo, Giulia Pica, Vincenzo Nemolato, Fabrizio Gifuni, Monica Nappo

title: La ladra
synopsis: Whistle, a little rascal without a family, is entrusted by a dishonest lawyer to Nino, a criminal, who wants to use him for a heist. Something, however, goes wrong: Whistle is injured when he falls from a chimney, while Nino runs away with the rich booty. Anna, Nino's woman, will come to Whistle's aid, pretend to be his mother, and save him from prison. But when the police find all the stolen goods hidden in the woman's house, they will have no hesitation in holding her responsible ...
cast: Fausto Tozzi, Carlo D'Angelo, Lise Bourdin, Memmo Carotenuto, Piero Giagnoni

title: La lama nel corpo
synopsis: Inside a psychiatric clinic run by Dr. Vance where alienated women are locked up, the new assistant Giséle witnesses the serial killings carried out by a mysterious killer with a razor. When Giséle discovers that Vance is hiding his wife, horribly disfigured by an accident that occurred during the construction of the clinic, suspicions begin to build up on him.
cast: William Berger, Françoise Prevost, Mary Young, Barbara Wilson, Philippe Hersent, Harriet Medin, Germano Longo, Massimo Righi, Delfi Mauro, Anna Maria Polani

title: La lectrice
cast: Miou Miou, Maria Casarès, Pierre Dux, Patrick Chesnais, Régis Royer

title: La legge dei gangsters
synopsis: The former convict Rino organizes with the help of a fence, two jewel thieves and an unemployed man, a five hundred million lire heist. Once the coup is over, Rino and the others have to contend with Renier, the financier of the robbery who would like half the loot.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Franco Citti, Hélène Chanel, Maurice Poli, Nello Pazzafini

title: La legge della camorra
synopsis: In New York, the Italian-American underworld clans Liguori and Miceli are fighting each other with no holds barred. The leader of one of the two camps, Gaetano Liguori, is dying, and his attendant visits Carolina Miceli, daughter of the boss Calogero, to reconstruct what happened. Hostile to the drug trafficking advocated by brothers Gaetano and Tony Liguori, Don Calogero had also put in place his political support. But the successful elimination of Gaetano does nothing but fuel a perverse spiral of reprisals ...
cast: Jeff Cameron, Raffaele Di Mario, Mariangela Matania, Silvio Noto

title: La legge della tromba
synopsis: Celestino, a clumsy robber, ends up working in a trumpet factory. Once the company is closed, he is forced to look for another job in order not to end up in prison. He is hired by a rocket builder but an explosion will shoot him into orbit.
cast: Maria Boto, Angelo Paccagnini, Eugenia Tretti

title: La legge della violenza
synopsis: Jack Sparrow has been in jail for a couple of years for a crime he didn't commit and is now back in Red Rock with the intention of taking revenge. The sheriff who had arrested him ends up badly and, in his place, Jack puts the meek Chris. This is because Jack has intentions of exploitation towards the peaceful town. Eventually Chris takes courage and confronts him. Usual Italian-Hispanic co-production with actors with fake names, fake-looking scenarios and banally plagiarized stories.
cast: George Greenwood, Igli Villani, Angel Aranda, Ugo Adinolfi

title: La legge è uguale per tutti... forse
synopsis: Cosimo and Damiano are brothers-in-law but their way of dealing with the world of justice is exactly the opposite. While Cosimo lives on tricks and religious scams against tourists, Damiano is a criminal lawyer. By a series of unfortunate coincidence, Cosimo finds himself the only suspect in a case, which forces the two brothers-in-law to juggle the troubles of their private life and legal vicissitudes.
cast: Ciro Ceruti, Ciro Villano, Gianluca De Gennaro, Carolina Marconi, Marzio Honorato, Gianni Ciardo, Riccardo Garrone, Gino Cogliandro, Lucio Pierri, Floriana De Martino, Ester Glam

title: La leggenda del bandito e del campione
synopsis: The cyclist Costante Girardengo is in Paris on the eve of an important race. He retraces his life and his deeds.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Simone Gandolfo, Raffaella Rea, Sarah Maestri, Giuseppe Lo Console, Gaetano Aronica, Paolo Pierobon, Anna Ferruzzo, Vincenzo Peluso, Alfredo Pea

title: La leggenda del pianista sull'Oceano
synopsis: They found him as soon as he was born in a hidden basket aboard the Virginian and he never got off from there. The Virginian is a steamer that crosses the ocean on the route from Europe to America and back. It is the trumpet player, his longtime friend, Max Tooney, who tells us his story. The ship for the twentieth century represents everything. Self-taught he learned to play the piano and allows himself the luxury of challenging the famous jazz player Jelly Roll Morton.
cast: Tim Roth, Pruitt Taylor Vince, Bill Nunn, Clarence Williams III

title: La leggenda del rubino malese
synopsis: Malaysia. The former Yankee captain has found a way to make money: together with an old friend he accompanies bored and thrill-seeking billionaires in the jungle with his motor boat. Usually the trip ends with a fake assault by the natives for the "joy" of the tourists. One day Warren suggests that he accompany Maria Yanez, director of a Colombian museum, in search of a fabulous ruby ??which, according to legend, has exceptional powers. Yankee agrees, but is soon forced to deal with Da Silva, a shady arms dealer.
cast: Christopher Connelly, Lee Van Cleef, Marina Costa, Alan Collins

title: La leggenda del santo bevitore
synopsis: Andreas Kartak, a former Silesian miner expelled from his country for an involuntary murder, now lives an alcoholic under the bridges of Paris. One day a distinguished gentleman who says he is indebted to Saint Therese of Lisieux offers him two hundred francs which Andreas will have to return to the statue of the saint in the church of Batignolles. From that moment on, in Andreas's alcoholic floating world, which has begun to end, it is a succession of encounters and small miracles that prevent him from paying off his debt.
cast: Rutger Hauer, Anthony Quayle, Sandrine Dumas, Dominique Pinon, Sophie Segalen, Jean Maurice Chanet, Cecile Paoli, Francesco Aldighieri, Joseph De Medina

title: La leggenda di Al, John e Jack
synopsis: New York, 1959. A famous boss commissions three decidedly atypical gangsters to kill a certain Frankie. The three miss the mark and find themselves in a dramatic situation: they must face the wrath of the boss who entrusts their fate to the dice. Thanks to a good dose of luck, the three manage to escape, but to save their lives they must complete a new delicate mission: to protect a person very dear to the boss. It goes without saying that once again the three unlikely bodyguards, following a "trivial" accident, put their lives in danger again.
cast: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Aldo Maccione, Antonio Catania, Ivano Marescotti
director: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Massimo Venier

title: La leggenda di Bob Wind
synopsis: Anna, a French journalist at the peak of her career, gives up everything to get on the trail of a little story. A man of the theater, crazy and creative, who died in the Eighties, ignites in her passions and dormant doubts. Do you find yourself in a city like this? Marche, where his research on Roberto Cimetta began. That light-hearted and rootless artist, eternally traveling to European festivals, and his story involve Anna to the point that she imagines scenes, relives situations and suggestions, trying to put her past in order.
cast: Lavinia Longhi, Corrado Fortuna, Ivan Franek, Paolo Briguglia, Nicolò Ausili, Fabio Balasso, Veronica Baleani, Andrea Bruschi, Cristina Cirilli, Elisabetta De Vito

title: La leggenda di Fra' Diavolo
synopsis: Second half of the 18th century: Michele Pezza, known as "Fra 'Diavolo", is a brigand who opposes the French invasion of the kingdom of Naples, ruled by the fearful Ferdinand of Bourbon. Although the latter has appointed him colonel, Fra 'Diavolo must beware of the numerous enemies that plot behind him and returns to the bush; but when Napoleon's troops launch the decisive attack, his valor and courage will not be enough to avoid defeat and death by hanging.
cast: Tony Russell, Amedeo Nazzari, Haya Harareet, Mario Adorf

title: La leggenda di Kaspar Hauser
synopsis: Prince Kaspar Hauser (Silvia Calderoni), after being made to disappear by his enemies at an early age to prevent him from ascending the throne, suddenly appears on a beach in Sardinia, in a strip of land populated only by very few people. In fact, here live the coarse Grand Duchess (Claudia Gerini) who has become queen in the meantime, her humble servant Drago (Marco Lampis), the Dark Man drug dealer (Vincent Gallo) who has an affair with the Grand Duchess, the Priest (Fabrizio Gifuni), the Seer (Elisa Sednaoui) and the Sheriff (Vincent Gallo). Taken into custody by the latter in his fort, Kaspar will learn firsthand who among the five is his friend and who instead wants nothing more than his death.
cast: Silvia Calderoni, Vincent Gallo, Claudia Gerini, Elisa Sednaoui, Fabrizio Gifuni, Marco Lampis

title: La legione dei dannati
synopsis: In 1944, to prepare for the Normandy landings, an allied commando was tasked with blowing up a powerful cannon placed on the French coast. But the raiders are easily defeated by the enemies and Colonel Anderson, who initially only had to clear a stretch of sea with some divers, decides to complete the mission with his men.
cast: Jack Palance, Tom Hunter, Robert Hundar, Wolfang Preiss, Curd Jürgens, Helmuth Schneider, Guido Lollobrigida, Aldo Sambrell, Diana Lorys, Franco Fantasia

title: La lengua de las mariposas
cast: Fernando Fernán Gómez, Manuel Lozano, Uxía Blanco, Gonzalo Uriarte

title: La lettera
synopsis: Everything falls apart in Margherita's carefree life when her father is arrested on suspicion of being involved in Tangenotopoli. Left alone, the girl takes refuge in a small town in the Aspromonte where she teaches in elementary schools. One day, he and his pupils write a letter in English in response to a request for correspondence chosen at random from an American newspaper. After a few weeks the answer arrives: to write it is George, a young red man imprisoned on death row.
cast: Vittoria Belvedere, Gianni Federico, Dino Abbrescia, Timothy Martin

title: La ley de Herodes
synopsis: Following the brutal 1949 murder of a small Mexican town's mayor, genteel and humble janitor Juan Vargas is appointed his successor.
cast: Damián Alcázar, Pedro Armendáriz Jr., Delia Casanova, Juan Carlos Colombo, Alex Cox, Guillermo Gil, Ernesto Gómez Cruz, Leticia Huijara, Luis De Icaza, Eduardo López Rojas, Manuel Ojeda, Salvador Sánchez, Evangelina Sosa, Isela Vega

title: La ley del deseo
synopsis: Pablo Quintero, the famous gay director very close to his sister Tina, falls in love - not reciprocated - with Juan, to whom he writes ardent letters. Thus begins to attend Antonio, extremely possessive and jealous, arousing the ire of Tina, who hopelessly loves the same man. When Antonio discovers the letters Pablo sent to Juan, he has a disproportionate reaction ...
cast: Eusebio Poncela, Carmen Maura, Antonio Banderas, Bibí Andersen, Miguel Molina

title: La lezione
synopsis: Born as a project within the middle and high schools to investigate the difficult scourge of bullying, increasingly rampant due to the lack of role models in the adult world, the documentary tells the difficult passage that leads a teenager to become an adult. Through the direct story of both those who have been victims and those who have been torturers, the director also investigates aspects related to youth, the difficulty of growing up and the desire to be accepted as part of a group.

title: La libertad
synopsis: The day of a young lumberjack, from the exploration of the forest in search of the best cuts to the sale.
cast: Misael Saavedra, Humberto Estrada, Rafael Estrada, Omar Didino

title: La liceale
synopsis: Loredana is an uninhibited student who enjoys fooling classmates and professors. She has little sympathy for books, but she is very beautiful and provocative and causes havoc wherever she goes. It will be a collaborator of her father the only one who knows how to take full advantage, deceiving her and then abandoning her ...
cast: Gloria Guida, Giuseppe Pambieri, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Alvaro Vitali

title: La liceale al mare con l'amica di papà
synopsis: Married for twenty years, Massimo and Violante can't stand each other anymore. Massimo also has a lover, Laura, who he takes with him on holiday to the sea disguised as a nun. Two bandits kidnap Massimo, but Violante does not pay the ransom. Then they kidnap the woman and finally Massimo can enjoy the company of his lover, but it doesn't last long. Squalid little comedy like a hundred others in the vein.
cast: Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Marisa Mell, Gianni Ciardo

title: La liceale nella classe dei ripetenti
synopsis: Angela (Guida) studies in the same high school where her father (Banfi) teaches. She is a beautiful girl and although her boyfriend Tonino (Vitali) is not exactly an Adonis, she insists on being faithful to him. But when she discovers that she has been betrayed repeatedly, she decides to take revenge by giving herself to Carlo, who has been in love with her for a lifetime.
cast: Gloria Guida, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Rodolfo Bigotti, Sylvain Chamarande, Carlo Sposito, Nello Pazzafini, Jimmy Il Fenomeno

title: La liceale seduce i professori
synopsis: Angela is not devoured by the thirst for knowledge but, since there is a high school where her uncle is the principal, she enrolls. However, her relationship with the school head does not make things easier, especially with the young, but particularly severe, history teacher. Angela then decides to make him fall in love and she does it so well that love becomes mutual.
cast: Gloria Guida, Alvaro Vitali, Fabrizio Moroni, Lino Banfi

title: La liceale, il diavolo e l'acquasanta
synopsis: A guardian angel falls in love with a beautiful dancer, who, however, prefers an earthly love to him. A policeman sees his wife threatened by a transvestite who has converted to heterosexuality. A dental technician sells his soul to the devil, but he is not satisfied: he also wants his body. Three episodes for three regular performers of the scollacciata comedy: the blonde Gloria Guida and the wild Banfi and Vitali. None of the three, however, is in great shape and the jokes full of double meanings and vulgarity hardly ever make you laugh.
cast: Gloria Guida, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Tiberio Murgia, Pippo Santonastaso, Ernst Thole, Rosanna Salviati, Claudio Saint Just

title: La ligne
synopsis: Martha, after having beaten her mother, was subjected to a restrictive order that for three months prevents her from approaching the woman and the house: however, living only two hundred meters, this period of forced distance ends up only to make her desire grow in her to be with the family.
cast: Dali Benssalah, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Benjamin Biolay, India Hair, Stephanie Blanchoud, Elli Spagnolo

title: La linea
synopsis: Salazar, the head of an influential drug trafficking cartel in Tijuana, is ill and about to die. His likely successor is the unstable and violent Pelon, who gives rise to a heated internal struggle for power. When the latter does not follow Salazar's advice and attempts to do business with a group of Afghan terrorists - giving them access to drug dealing in the United States in exchange for heroin - the US government secretly enlists the infallible hitman Mark Shields to eliminate him. ..
cast: Ray Liotta, Andy Garcia, Esai Morales, Armand Assante, Valerie Cruz, Jordi Vilasuso, Kevin Gage, Bruce Davison, Joe Morton, Danny Trejo

title: La linea gialla - Bologna, 2 agosto
synopsis: Bologna, 2015. A girl, who arrived by train from Tuscany and headed for Lake Garda, loses the connection and, for reasons that are not entirely clear, decides to stay in the city until the following day. During his short stay in the Emilian capital he will meet various people, all linked by the same, tragic memory: that of the massacre that took place on August 2, 1980.
cast: Valentina Lodovini, Olga Durano, Ivano Marescotti, Bob Messini, Tommaso Ramenghi, Rolando Ravello

title: La lingua del Santo
synopsis: Willy, called Alain Delon, looks at the lagoon, the only place where his mind becomes clearer. He, a former representative of luxury stationery, separated from Patrizia, the only woman in his life with whom he lived for 23 years and three months, has slipped to the bottom and can no longer go up. He shares his destiny as a forty-year-old in retreat with Antonio, a rugby player, now only good at shooting set pieces. Together they hang out in a seedy bar and form a clean, clumsy pair of thieves. When, by chance, they find a relic of Saint Anthony in their hands, their life seems destined to change thanks to a billionaire ransom.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Antonio Albanese, Isabella Ferrari

title: La locanda della maladolescenza
synopsis: The orphaned Laura (Marcella Petrelli), after an experience in a religious institute, is located for a guest necessity of Marta (Paola Montenero), a former estate of a brothel now converted to the hotel. Forced to prostitute himself and to accept the most rough situations, Laura finds unexpected help in a client of the hotel, Andrea (Carlo De Mejo), without knowing that these, under liability to investigate, is actually his half -brother.
cast: Marcella Petrelli, Carlo De Mejo, Andrea Aureli, Paola Montenero, Guia Lauri Filzi, Spartaco Battisti, Maria Cafiero, Alessandro Marino, Erminio Bianchi Fasani, Giuseppe Curia

title: La locandiera
synopsis: Mirandolina, who runs an inn on the mainland near Venice, is disputed by some nobles who appreciate both her physical appearance and her qualities of extroverted sympathy. However, she seems intent on conquering a misogynistic and grumpy knight.
