After jealousies, spite and various complications, Mirandolina confesses that she joked a bit with everyone: she only loves her meek and honest waiter. Chiarini, the most accredited Italian film theorist of his time, manages to avoid many of the pitfalls of "filmed theater" while struggling with the theatrical masterpiece of Carlo Goldoni. The actors are excellent.
cast: Luisa Ferida, Armando Falconi, Osvaldo Valenti, Camillo Pilotto

title: La locandiera
synopsis: Mirandolina runs an inn in the Veneto region in the eighteenth century. Among the patrons there is the rough knight of Ripafratta, declared an enemy of women; but Mirandolina's charms make him change his mind. However, it is a deception, as the woman is promised to another lover.
cast: Claudia Mori, Adriano Celentano, Paolo Villaggio, Gianni Cavina, Marco Messeri, Lorenza Guerrieri, Milena Vukotic, Camillo Milli, Paolo Baroni, Lucio Montanaro, Roberto Della Casa

title: La loi
synopsis: The law of the title is the unwritten one, but to which everyone is subject, which governs the life of the small community of a Corsican village. The head of the village is Don Cesare, who lives in a large house surrounded by women. Among these, Marietta, daughter and granddaughter of servants of Don Cesare's house, stands out for her beauty, but also for the independence of her character. An agronomist from the continent falls in love with her, but other eyes have also rested on her ...
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Pierre Brasseur, Marcello Mastroianni, Yves Montand

title: La loi c'est la loi
synopsis: In a border village, divided by the war between France and Italy, the Italian smuggler Giuseppe La Quaglia finds himself in constant battle with the French gendarme Fernand Pastorelli. Then one day it is discovered that Fernand was also born in Italy and then the troubles begin for him: disbarred from the weapon, investigated because bigamous and other similar things due to the legislative differences existing between the two countries.
cast: Totò, Fernandel, Nino Besozzi, Leda Gloria, Noël Roquevert, Nathalie Nerval, Luciano Marin, Albert Dinan, Anna Maria Luciani, Henri Cremieux

title: La loi de la jungle
synopsis: Marc Châtaigne, ministerial intern, is sent to Guyana to bring the Guyaneige construction site into compliance, the first ski slope in the Amazon, destined to revive tourism in the area. Here, he has the opportunity to meet Tarzan, a beautiful intern who works at the national forest office, with whom he will be able to get lost in the jungle and experience an adventure that will take him far away.
cast: Vimala Pons, Vincent Macaigne, Pascal Legitimus, Mathieu Amalric, Jean Luc Bideau

title: La loi du marché
synopsis: 51-year-old Laurent, after 20 months of unemployment, starts working as a security guard in a supermarket. But he is soon faced with a moral dilemma when asked to spy on his colleagues.
cast: Vincent Lindon, Karine Petit De Mirbeck, Matthieu Schaller

title: La lotta dell'uomo per la sua sopravvivenza
synopsis: Series of twelve films that Rossellini and his son Renzo made for Rai, taking a valid means of exploring the social, civil and political aspects of our culture on the small screen. In reality it was Rossellini jr. (Under the supervision of the father, who had written the script) to turn the episodes, whose fundamental traits are summarized by the master himself in a brief introduction.
cast: Roberto Rossellini, Massimo Sarchielli, Pino Caruso, Pino Locchi, Franco Aloisi, Lidia Biondi, Conrad Andersen, Consalvo Dell'Arti, Valentino Macchi, Giulio Donnini, Giuseppe Mannajuolo, Corrado Olmi, Stefano Sibaldi

title: La lucida follia di Marco Ferreri
synopsis: A journey into the unique cosmos - both supernatural and earthly - by Marco Ferreri, a man who abandons his veterinary studies but never animals, choosing to deal mainly with the human being in his bodily and desiring essentiality. With the help of clips from his films, the controversial director can also be heard reflecting on the reputation of "provocateur" who has always followed him, always accompanied by censorship, scandals, disputes, poisonous accusations. Then there are the ironic and cutting answers, his and his most famous and loyal supporters, and new, illuminating testimonies on his way of directing the actors, offered by the protagonists who have given the breath of life to his characters.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Roberto Benigni, Hanna Schygulla, Ornella Muti, Sergio Castellitto, Andréa Ferréol, Dante Ferretti

title: La luna e il lago
synopsis: Elsa's husband, in love with another woman, left his wife and two children, Andrea and Rossana during the All Saints weekend in the holiday home on the Sila. Little Andrea will be able to make friends with Luca, a neighbor of his, who has a secret to hide.
cast: Matthieu Legavre, Angelo Pardo, Elena Russo, Luigi Maria Burruano, Francesco Scianna

title: La luna su Torino
synopsis: Since he was sixteen, forty-four-year-old Ugo (Walter Leonardi) has inherited a house in the Turin hills following the premature death of his parents, rich left-wing bourgeois. It is here that Ugo finds himself hosting Maria (Manuela Parodi), a young saleswoman from a travel agency, and Dario (Eugenio Franceschini), a 20-year-old university student and precarious. Between poetic and comic digressions, all three are looking for their place in the world.
cast: Walter Leonardi, Manuela Parodi, Eugenio Franceschini, Daria Pascal Attolini, Guido Ottobrino, Benedetta Perego, Franco Maino, Stefano Scherini

title: La lune dans le caniveau
synopsis: In the slums of the port of Marseille, Gerard is in a perennial and desperate search for the man who raped and killed his sister. Loretta, beautiful and rich, wanders around with her Ferrari, in love with the rough Gerard. He is attracted by the idea of ​​marrying her, but Bella, his woman, mad with jealousy, hires a cheap killer to kill him. The murder fails but Gerard forgives and stays with Belle. After the first, refined Diva, Beneix deepens all his idea of ​​cinema in this second film of his. Vanity: the car runs idle, weighed down by ambitions. Detail for Rosa Comic, Crazy Horse diva.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Nastassja Kinski, Victoria Abril

title: La lunga cavalcata della vendetta
cast: Richard Harrison, Anita Ekberg, Rik Battaglia, Men Fury, Georgie Wang

title: La lunga corsa
synopsis: Giacinto was born and raised in prison next to his mother. For him, the prison is home. It is where he learned to walk and run. One fine day, still a child, Giacinto is let out of prison, where he finds a pretine full of energy and patience that accompanies him in a family home to which he feels not to belong. For this reason he continues to run to find his mother in prison as often as he can; And for this, once he grew up, he returns to the fold becoming prison police officer.
cast: Adriano Tardiolo, Giovanni Calcagno, Nina Naboka, Barbora Bobulova, Maksim Kostyunin, Orest Syrvatka, Aylin Prandi, Stefano Cassetti, Gianluca Gobbi

title: La lunga notte dei disertori
synopsis: During the war in Africa, four British soldiers try to return to their lines; to these are added three auxiliaries and a German prisoner. The group is intercepted by a tribe of nomads, who force them to follow them: the chief's son needs urgent care. During the crossing, the group is trapped in a fort and besieged by the Germans. After a very hard night, the decisive attack is triggered, with the British also helped by the nomads. War movie without too many frills, respectful of the rules: no show of ingenuity but good rhythm and authentic setting.
cast: Ivan Rassimov, Monica Strebel, Kirk Morris, Marcella Michelangeli, Aldo Bufi Landi, Giuseppe Castellano, Jessy Maxwell, Joanna Sanders, Youssef Chaban, Paola Natale

title: La lunga notte del '43
synopsis: We are in the autumn of 1943, in Ferrara. The fascist Aretusi has the moderate consul Bolognesi assassinated, accuses the anti-fascists and then leads the reprisal: eleven shot in the house of the pharmacist Barillari, including the father of Anna's lover, Barillari's wife. After the massacre, Anna leaves Ferrara and her lover goes to Switzerland. In the summer of 1960 the latter returns to the city and meets Aretusi, who compliments him; the two shake hands.
cast: Belinda Lee, Gabriele Ferzetti, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gino Cervi, Andrea Checchi, Nerio Bernardi, Isa Querio, Raffaella Carrà, Loris Bazzocchi

title: La lunga ombra del lupo
synopsis: The partisan Marco, hunted by the Germans, takes refuge in the hidden house where his wife, son and sister-in-law live. The task of finding him and flushing him out is entrusted to his friend Andrea, who plays in the opposing field, but who has no intention of betraying him. Indeed, he will refuse to shoot him during a retaliatory action.
cast: John Manera, Aliza Adar, Ivano Davoli, Lucy Chevalier

title: La lunga spiaggia fredda
synopsis: Husband and wife, visibly in crisis, are on vacation in an isolated villa by the sea. Four motorcyclists break in and beat him up and repeatedly rape her; the woman, however, even seems to take a liking to us and soon something is born between the victim and an executioner.
cast: Robert Hoffmann, Mara Maryl, Riccardo Salvino, Walter Maestosi, Joshua Sinclair, Claudio Trionfi, Fabian Cevallos

title: La lunga strada del ritorno
synopsis: Using repertoire materials, Alessandro Blasetti collects the testimonies of the Italian veterans of the Second World War, combining the story of the conflict with that of the events of the men engaged at the front.

title: La lupa
synopsis: A woman who lives in a small town is nicknamed the "Lupa" for her unscrupulous attitudes. Many men fall in love with her but it is Nanni, a soldier who came to town on the feast day of Sant'Agata, who becomes her lover. The man also knows Maricchia, the woman's daughter, who arouses in him a feeling of sincere love, among other things reciprocated: the two get married. The "Lupa" tries in vain to divide them. Rereading Verga's dark drama, Lattuada updates it and moves it to post-war Lucania, keeping above all the melodramatic aspects of the novel.
cast: Kerima, May Britt, Ettore Manni, Mario Passante, Giovanna Ralli

title: La lupa
synopsis: Gna 'Pina in the village called her "La lupa" because she never seemed to be satisfied with anything. Women, when they saw her, shunned her, while all men were obsessed with her. Maricchia, a girl little more than a teenager, suffered the loneliness and isolation to be the daughter of the "Lupa". So no one in the village dared to approach her. One day "La lupa" falls madly in love with the young Nanni, who confesses that he prefers Maricchia to her, because she is young and virgin. In order to be close to him, the woman agrees to Nanni's wedding with Maricchia.
cast: Monica Guerritore, Raoul Bova, Alessia Fugardi, Michele Placido, Giancarlo Giannini

title: La lupa mannara
synopsis: Countess Daniela is a "devourer" of men in the literal sense: in fact, afflicted by lycanthropy, she tears them to pieces after seducing them.
cast: Annik Borel, Howard Ross, Dagmar Lassander, Tino Carraro, Elio Zamuto, Osvaldo Ruggieri, Andrea Scotti, Frederick Stafford, Felicita Fanny, Isabella Rosa

title: La luz prodigiosa
synopsis: Joaquin, a miserable child from the countryside of Granada, found himself saving a republican shot by the Francoists in August 1936. In 1980 he sets out on his trail, and finds him a tramp with no memory. The twist is that the homeless man is none other than Federico Garcia Lorca, the great poet who was given up for dead in 1936, who would instead wander into foreign Spain at the end of Francoism.
cast: Alfredo Landa, Nino Manfredi, Kiti Manver, José Luis Gomez

title: La légende de Parva légende de Parva
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Parva was born at the same instant that a block of the purest sapphire collided with the earth. For this Parva has special powers and is linked to the fate of Prince Shiva who lives thousands of kilometers away. One evening the girl runs into an abandoned dog and decides to take care of it. The dog is actually a messenger who will take her to the island of Kiam where the prince is a prisoner of the tyrant Malaw.

title: La macchina ammazzacattivi
synopsis: Celestino, a modest village photographer, was given, by S. Andrea to whom he is very devoted, the possibility of exterminating the wicked simply by re-photographing a photographic portrait of them. He tries, at the expense of some greedy people who want to deprive three poor people of the country of a legitimate inheritance. A curious aesthetic-political apologue, made practically without a script, by dint of improvisations, and ended three years after the start of filming. The result, although not without its moments, is excessively fragmentary. Subject by Eduardo De Filippo and Giuseppe Marotta.
cast: Gennaro Pisano, Marilyn Buferd, William Tubbs, Helen Tubbs, Giovanni Amato, Clara Bindi, Giacomo Furia, Joseph Falletta, Aldo Giuffré, Carlo Giuffrè

title: La macchina delle immagini di Alfredo C.
synopsis: In 1945 in Albania, freed the previous year by the fascist occupation by the new communist regime, 27,000 Italians were still held between veterans and civilians. Among them there is also a film operator. Alfredo C.: Fascist propaganda operator, he shot Albania for five years with his camera. First, for almost twenty years, he immortalized the capillary machine of the regime. Now, from one day to the next, he must do the same, but for a communist regime. Closed in his warehouse, surrounded by thousands of films, Alfredo C. reviews what he shot on an old motive. His own story. It is his film what we see. And perhaps, not just his.
cast: Pietro De Silva

title: La macchinazione
synopsis: During the last months of his life, Pier Paolo Pasolini (Massimo Ranieri) works on the editing of the controversial Salò or the 120 days of Sodom and is writing the novel Petrolio when he starts dating Pino Pelosi, a boy from the village in which he begins to move. the first steps of the criminal organization of the Banda della Magliana. After the removal of the negative of his film from Technicolor in August 1975, Pasolini will face a well-organized death trap that will reach its peak at the Idroscalo on the night between the first and the second of November.
cast: Massimo Ranieri, Libero De Rienzo, Roberto Citran, Milena Vukotic, Matteo Taranto, Alessandro Sardelli, François Xavier Demaison

title: La machine
synopsis: With an imaginary machine of his own invention and following a failed experiment, Dr. Marc Lacroix, a psychiatrist, finds himself in the brain of Zyto, a dangerous psychopath and vice versa. In a society that only pays attention to appearances, it is difficult for the doctor to find someone who can believe him. After all, even his wife does not seem to notice the exchange that has taken place.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Didier Bourdon, Nathalie Baye, Erwan Baynaud

title: La madama, l'agente Minchiello e il caso Patacchioni
synopsis: Agent Vito Mincchiello is forced by the circumstances to investigate a difficult case of murder. The girlfriend, a journalist and a prostitute will help him solve the intricate mystery.
cast: Christian De Sica, Ines Pellegrini, Ettore Manni, Gigi Ballista, Grazia Maria Spina, Lorella De Luca, Alessandra Panaro

title: La madre
synopsis: Nowadays, in the Roman district of Eur, the young priest Paolo (Stefano Dionisi) finds himself torn between the passion for the beautiful Agnes (Laura Baldi) and religious faith on the one hand and the morbid obsessions of Mother Magdalene (Carmen Maura ) on the other side. The night before Easter, in the church where Paul will have to celebrate mass the next day in front of the whole neighborhood, there will be the tragic and terrible epilogue of this story of love and passion.
cast: Carmen Maura, Stefano Dionisi, Luigi Maria Burruano, Laura Baldi

title: La maestra... di sci
synopsis: The usual uncle of America dies, and his fabulous inheritance should in theory go to his niece Celia, a model by profession. The condition is that prof. Thompson ascertains that the girl's conduct is morally flawless, and seeing that Celia is - let's say - a little lively, her friend Carla thinks well of making her change jobs and finding her a job as a ski teacher at an alpine hotel. The idea works until the paparazzo Franco discovers Celia's real identity, and in order not to reveal the truth, he requires a sexy photo shoot as a counterpart ...
cast: Carmen Russo, Cinzia De Ponti, Andy Luotto, Sonia Otero, Daniele Vargas

title: La mafia mi fa un baffo
cast: Renato Cecilia, Femi Benussi, Yvonne Harlow, Tiberio Murgia

title: La mafia non è più quella di una volta
synopsis: A journey into the mafia and the anti-mafia to take stock of what Palermo is and what it is becoming. Among others, the photographer Letizia Battaglia and her counterpart Ciccio Mira, impresario of neo-melodic singers, offer their point of view.

title: La mafia uccide solo d'estate
synopsis: Palermo, the seventies. Little Arturo is eight years old but he tries everything to win the heart of Flora, his beloved snobbish and rich classmate who he sees as an unattainable princess. While he grows up and goes to meet his civil and sentimental education, without ever ceasing to court Flora (Cristiana Capotondi), Arturo (Pierfrancesco Diliberto) is a witness to the news events that upset his city, including the terrible mafia attacks that for twenty years, almost always in summer, make Palermo the protagonist of one of the darkest pages in the history of Italy.
cast: Pierfrancesco Diliberto, Cristiana Capotondi, Claudio Gioè, Ninni Bruschetta, Alex Bisconti, Ginevra Antona, Barbara Tabita, Rosario Lisma

title: La maglietta rossa
synopsis: December 1976, Davis Cup final: the Italians Panatta and Bertolucci take the field against the Chile of the Pinochet dictator with a red shirt. A political provocation remained in history.
cast: Adriano Panatta, Paolo Villaggio

title: La maison Tellier
synopsis: Every evening, six or eight habitual customers, always the same, meet in the usual place, the Maison Tellier. Here, in a familiar and discreet environment, they are looking for some fun with five "girls" little shy to forget the monotony of family life. One evening, with them disappointment, they find the door closed. Accompanied by the girls, Madame Tellier went to visit a cousin for the communion of his nephew. In the village, they all behave as high -class lords and young ladies and good family. Upon returning, they will be ready for a night of celebration and inconceivable complacency.
cast: Arlette Didier, Olivier Mathot, Françoise Blanchard, Michel Tugot Doris, Antonio Mayans, France Lomay, Muriel Montossé, Elena Álvarez, Anna Ricco, Nani Rodon, Lydie Fordios, Jean Tolzac, Anouchka, Henri Lambert, Gilbert Servien, René Douglas, Julian Atienza, Antonio Jover

title: La maison de jade
synopsis: Jane Lambert, a forty-year-old writer, falls in love with Bernard, a much younger boy than her. The two leave for a holiday in the south of France with friends but Bernard has to go away on business. It is actually an excuse: Bernard has another woman from whom he can have those children that Jane cannot give him. Jane then attempts suicide.
cast: Jacqueline Bisset, Vincent Perez, Véronique Silver, Yves Lambrecht, Fred Personne, Pascal Decolland, Serge Marquand, Étienne De Balasy, Jean Noël Brouté

title: La maison de la radio
synopsis: Nicholas Philibert, director and creator of images, has always been fascinated by the radio, the "blind" medium capable of igniting the imagination and uniting millions of people by providing the backdrop to daily activities and bringing the world into homes. The documentary, born as a tribute to the creators of radio, is a journey into the heart of Radio France to discover what usually escapes the eye, behind the scenes of the mysteries of the medium itself, of media and of sound.

title: La maison sous les arbres
synopsis: American scholar in Paris is blackmailed by a spy organization that kidnaps two children. The suspicions fall on the wife a bit 'out of her mind.
cast: Faye Dunaway, Frank Langella, Barbara Parkins, Karen Blanguernon

title: La mala educación
synopsis: Madrid 1980. The 27-year-old Enrique Goded, an established director, seeks inspiration from the news for his fourth film. Suddenly an attractive young man arrives at his house who claims to be his schoolmate Ignacio Rodríguez. Enrique does not recognize him immediately, but realizes that 17 years have passed. Although he doesn't know it yet, the story for his next film is right in front of his eyes. In fact, Ignacio gives him a story entitled "The visit" which is inspired by their childhood in the boarding school: the problems with the priests and in particular with the father director, repression, football, hypocrisy, masses in Latin and cinema. .
cast: Gael García Bernal, Fele Martinez, Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Javier Cámara, Francisco Boira, Lluís Homar, Francisco Maestre, Juan Fernandez, Nacho Pérez, Raúl García Forneiro, Alberto Ferreiro, Petra Martínez

title: La mala ordina
synopsis: A boss of the bad American is convinced that the Sicilian pimp Luca Canali has made a few billion worth of heroin disappear. To do so he sends the killers Frank Webster and David Catania to Milan, where the man lives. The assassins, backed by Don Vito, kill Luca's wife and daughter. His revenge will be terrible.
cast: Mario Adorf, Henry Silva, Woody Strode, Adolfo Celi, Luciana Paluzzi

title: La malavita attacca... la polizia risponde!
synopsis: Returning from Switzerland to Rome, the boss Salviati, known to all by the nickname of "the prince", finds the square ruined by Rudy, a local bandit full of presumption and men with easy assassinations. Between the two litigants enters the commissioner Baldi, who avails himself of the help of Rampelli, a former colleague. Thanks to his collaboration, Baldi reopens the case of the killing of three gang bosses found dead in the house of Mario Olivieri, who in turn disappeared into thin air.
cast: Leonard Mann, John Steiner, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Ettore Manni

title: La maman et la putain
synopsis: The sentimental education of the young Parisian Alexandre divided between two girls: Veronika, a nurse in a hospital, and Marie, the owner of a small boutique. Wanderings, sleepless nights, walks in the Latin Quarter, conversations between the philosophical and the banal in cafes, tenderness and anguish in the bedroom ...
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Bernadette Lafont, Francoise Lebrun, Isabelle Weingarten

title: La mandragola
synopsis: The pleasure-seeker Callimaco wants at all costs to make his very honest wife of Messer Nicia, a credulous notary. With the help of the parasite Ligurio and the corrupt friar Timoteo, a plot will be hatched that will lead Callimaco to become the lover of Lucrezia, who will throw away the honesty for which she was famous.
cast: Rosanna Schiaffino, Philippe Leroy, Romolo Valli, Nilla Pizzi, Totò, Jean Claude Brialy, Armando Bandini, Pia Fioretti, Jacques Herlin, Donato Castellaneta, Ugo Attanasio

title: La mano che nutre la morte
synopsis: Due to an accident, a group of people are staying in the home of Dr. Nijinski (Klaus Kinski), a luminary with an ambiguous behavior and a wife whose face no one can see. Some time ago the woman was the victim of a fire and Nijinski is obsessed with the idea of ??restoring her beauty, performing horrible transplants with the help of the assistant Vania. Very soon, guests will discover firsthand just how grisly what happens within those walls is.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Katia Christine, Marzia Damon, Carmen Silva, Stella Calderoni, Romano De Gironcoli, Alessandro Perrella, Carla Mancini, Luigi Bevilacqua, Bruno Arié

title: La mano de un hombre muerto
synopsis: In a Swiss village, an effective series of murders of young and beautiful women who remember those turned fifty years earlier by Baron von Klaus. The suspicions fall on Count Max (Howard Vernon), descendant of him, who leads a mysterious nightlife.
cast: Ana Castor, Howard Vernon, Paula Martel, Georges Rollin, Hugo Blanco, Gogó Rojo

title: La mano della morta
synopsis: A little girl was picked up by a gypsy from the corpse of her mother, whose hand had been cut off. The culprit is a nobleman, Count Altieri, and his name is revealed to the girl who was raised by the gypsies under the name of Satanella. The girl makes Altieri's son fall in love with himself and reduces him to poverty; in this way he also ruins the daughter of the enemy, who must marry a usurer. Effective version of a well-known popular novel by Carolina Invernizio. Drama of undeniable grip.
cast: María Martín, Carlo Ninchi, Adriano Rimoldi, Renato De Carmine, Germana Paolieri, Saro Urzì, Marisa Mari, Ernesto Sabbatini, Raffaele Pindinelli

title: La mano dello straniero
synopsis: Roger, the son of a British major, has an appointment with his father in a hotel in Venice. At the appointed time, however, the father does not show up and a long adventure begins for the child. Graham Greene wrote and co-produced this film shot in Italy, which re-proposes the themes and atmospheres of "Broken Idol" (the child) and "The Third Man" (the international conspiracy). It falls short of the two, although the odd hybrid is not without its charm.
cast: Trevor Howard, Alida Valli, Richard Basehart, Eduardo Ciannelli, Richard O'Sullivan, Stephen Murray, Arnoldo Foà, Guido Celano, Giorgio Costantini

title: La mano indemoniata
synopsis: A man has to fight in a duel and asks a magician to give his hand superpowers. Magic works, but the man does not pay the necessary and therefore the spell will end up turning against him.
cast: Gabriele Ferzetti, Cochi Ponzoni, Veronica Lario, Massimo Boldi, Guido Alberti, Ugo Bologna, Franco Ferri, Franco Tuminelli

title: La mano nera - prima della mafia, più della mafia
cast: Lionel Stander, Michele Placido, Rosanna Fratello, Corrado Gaipa

title: La mano spietata della legge
cast: Philippe Leroy, Klaus Kinski, Silvia Monti, Tony Norton

title: La mansión de la niebla
synopsis: A couple, lost in a dense fog, takes refuge in an ancient villa next to a cemetery. And just once inside the house, the two are witnesses of supernatural phenomena.
cast: Evelyn Stewart, Analía Gadé, Lisa Leonardi, Andres Resino, Franco Fantasia, Alberto Dalbes, Yelena Samarina, George Rigaud, Ingrid Garbo, Eduardo Fajardo, Jos Luis Velasco, Saturno Cerra, Emilia Rubio, José Félix Montoya, Magoya Montenegro, Maria Reniu

title: La mansión de los Cthulhu
synopsis: Some young offenders, after a car theft gone badly, need a place to hide. They ask for hospitality from Chandu the magician and his daughter. Unfortunately for them, Chandu is in contact with evil forces from the afterlife that he is about to release into our world. The creatures, however, have no obligation to the wizard and so no one is safe ...
cast: Frank Finlay, Marcia Layton, Luis Fernando Alvés, Brad Fisher, Melanie Shatner, Kaethe Cherney, Paul Birchard, Frank Braña, Ronald Faval, Pascal Mudazi

title: La marche de l'empereur
synopsis: A documentary about emperor penguins: love, drama, courage and adventures in the heart of the Antarctic where, every year, they leave the water and face a long march on the ice to reach the ice floe and reproduce.

title: La marge
cast: Sylvia Kristel, Joe Dallesandro, Mireille Audibert, André Falcon

title: La mariée est trop belle
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Micheline Presle, Louis Jourdan, Jean François Calvé

title: La mariée était en noir
synopsis: Five time wasters accidentally cause the death of a poor fellow who just got married. Within a few years, however, they were all killed one by one. Responsible is the widow who, after attempting suicide, decided to pursue her personal revenge.
cast: Jeanne Moreau, Michel Bouquet, Jean Claude Brialy, Michael Lonsdale

title: La marque des anges - Miserere
synopsis: In Paris, Lionel Kasdan, a retired commissioner, investigates a bizarre murder: a choir director was found dead inside a parish, with broken eardrums and without anyone seeing anything. Frank Salek, an Interpol agent under observation by his superiors for often excessive behavior, is instead investigating a secret organization specializing in child abductions. When Salek learns of the choir director's death, he thinks there is a link to his investigation and agrees to cooperate with Kasdan. As the two try to shed light on each other, clues to a secret emerge that date back to the darkest moments of World War II.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Joey Starr, Héléna Noguerra, Marthe Keller, Thierry Lhermitte, Rüdiger Vogler, Mathieu Carrière, Thom Hoffman, Jimmy Jean Louis, Corinne Masiero

title: La maschera
synopsis: The noble Leonardo wastes his existence between play and drunkenness. During the performance of a theater company in the park of his villa (we are in the eighteenth century, not far from Venice), he falls in love with the prima donna and tries a brutal approach. Rejected (and so also the next day), he follows the girl in her movements with her face, however, always hidden by different masks. Will he be able to break through the beauty's heart?
cast: Michael Maloney, Helena Bonham Carter, Roberto Herlitzka, Feodor Chaliapin

title: La maschera del demonio
synopsis: 1830: Stopping in a ruined chapel deep in the woods, Dr. Chomas and his assistant Gorobec discover a sarcophagus that holds the mummified remains of the witch Asa, executed two centuries earlier. She, incidentally coming into contact with Chomas's blood, comes back to life and resumes her victims in the family of her great-granddaughter Katia, who lives in a nearby castle with her father, brother and an old servant ...
cast: Barbara Steele, John Richardson, Ivo Garrani, Andrea Checchi

title: La maschera del demonio
country: Italy, Spain, West Germany, France, Portugal
synopsis: A group of boys, during a holiday in the mountains, accidentally finds a frozen body in the ice. They are still unaware that she is a witch executed three centuries earlier, whose curse has survived over time. The girlfriend of one of the boys is a descendant of the witch, however, and soon the mystery will be revealed.
cast: Giovanni Guidelli, Debora Caprioglio, Stanko Molnar, Mary Sellers, Alessandra Bonarotta, Laura Devoti, Michele Soavi, Stefano Molinari, Ron Williams, Eva Grimaldi

title: La masseria delle allodole
country: Bulgaria, France, Italy, Spain, Great Britain
synopsis: Of the Avakian brothers, one remained in Armenia, the other emigrated to Italy. In 1915, the two organize to find themselves in their homeland, but the war prevents the reunification and both end up getting involved in the genocide of their people by the Turks ...
cast: Paz Vega, Moritz Bleibtreu, Angela Molina, Alessandro Preziosi, Tchéky Karyo, Yvonne Sciò

title: La matassa
synopsis: Paolo and Gaetano are cousins, but they haven't spoken to each other for twenty years to respect the silence imposed by a furious quarrel that involved their respective fathers in the past. Due to an unpredictable series of events, the two find themselves embroiled in big trouble, with the mafia on their heels. Forced by circumstances, to save their skin they begin an arduous reconciliation ...
cast: Salvo Ficarra, Valentino Picone, Pino Caruso, Claudio Gioè, Anna Safroncik
director: Salvo Ficarra, Valentino Picone, Giambattista Avellino

title: La matriarca
synopsis: Widowed while still young, the beautiful Margherita, known as Mimmi, discovers that her deceased husband was an unrepentant Don Juan. Shocked by this revelation, the woman wants to take revenge and finds nothing better than to beat him on her own ground, giving herself to several men. One of these, a doctor, falls in love with her. Mimmi marries him, but even after the wedding she continues in her ... revenge. Upon its release, the film was promoted as an attempt to tell a story on the woman's side. In reality, the story does not go beyond the farce with excellent actors.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Jean Louis Trintignant, Gigi Proietti, Luigi Pistilli, Paolo Stoppa, Renzo Montagnani

title: La mazurka del barone, della santa e del fico fiorone
synopsis: The Romagna baron Anteo Pellacane owns a large estate inside which stands a fig tree considered miraculous. The tree is linked to the cult of Saint Jerome to whom the local populations are devoted. The baron, however, is an atheist and disbeliever and tries in every way to get rid of the fig. When a couple of prostitutes deceive them into believing in a miracle of Saint Jerome, the baron is converted and becomes a bigot.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Paolo Villaggio, Delia Boccardo, Gianni Cavina, Lucio Dalla, Patrizia De Clara

title: La mazzetta
synopsis: In Naples, Sasà Jovine makes ends meet by illegally passing himself off as a "lawyer". When the industrialist Michele Miletti offers him a large "bribe" to track down his daughter Giulia, who has run away from home, and to retrieve some compromising documents, Sasà - not particularly gifted with neither nose nor guts - gets to work. However, the corpses begin to flock: and what's more, Nicola Casali, partner and enemy of Miletti, in turn interested in the matter, also comes into play ...
cast: Nino Manfredi, Paolo Stoppa, Ugo Tognazzi, Marisa Merlini

title: La meglio gioventù
synopsis: The story of an Italian family from the late 1960s to today. At the center the stories of two brothers, Nicola and Matteo who at first share dreams, hopes, readings and friendships until the meeting with Giorgia, a psychically disturbed girl, will not mark the fate of both: Nicola will decide to become a psychiatrist, Matteo di drop out of school and join the police. Next to them are their parents, Angelo and Adriana and two sisters: Giovanna, who entered the judiciary very young and Francesca, the youngest, who will marry Carlo, Nicola's best friend, destined for an important role at the Bank of Italy and for this reason in the sight of terrorists during the years of lead.
cast: Luigi Lo Cascio, Fabrizio Gifuni, Maya Sansa, Sonia Bergamasco, Jasmine Trinca, Alessio Boni, Adriana Asti

title: La memoria degli ultimi
synopsis: What is memory? And what happens when this seems to fade away? Starting from today's difficult moment in our country, the story sinks into the memory of the war and the Resistance, through the lives and gazes of seven ex-partisans fighting. A physical journey in search of the last survivors of the Resistance and their places, which ends up becoming an emotional journey into the emotions, memories and feelings of an entire generation.

title: La memoria del muerto
synopsis: Alicia is devastated by the death of the beloved husband Jorge, who thanks to her paranormal powers had foreseen everything by warning her. Before dying, Jorge left her instructions to bring him back to her life and Alice plans to follow her to her letter, organizing a ritual in which her closest friends of her participate. Presented as safe and without consequences, the rite foresees a journey into the kingdom of the dead but everyone will not be able to survive until the next morning.
cast: Lola Berthet, Gabriel Goity, Rafael Ferro, Luis Ziembrosky, Jimena Anganuzzi, Ana Celentano, Flora Gró, Matías Marmorato, Pamela Rementería, Lorena Vega

title: La mentale
synopsis: After serving a four-year sentence, Dris, a petty thug from the banlieu, decides to settle down with Lisa, a girl he met before his incarceration. But Yanis, an old friend who has achieved some fame in the world of evil, forces his hand and involves him in a robbery.
cast: Samuel Le Bihan, Samy Naceri, Clotilde Courau, Marie Guillard

title: La meravigliosa avventura di Antonio Franconi
synopsis: One evening, before going to sleep, a child finds in the attic of his house a trunk full of old toys that reproduce a circus and an army of lead riders. Alongside these, there is also a book that, once opened, introduces him to the figure of Antonio Franconi (Massimo Ranieri), a skilled Italian horseman who in the eighteenth century founded his own circus company in Lyon and then created the famous Cirques Olympique in Paris.
cast: Massimo Ranieri, Orso Maria Guerrini, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Sonia Aquino, Ernesto Mahieux, Laura Marinelli, Ruggero Monstert Manciati, Valentina Beotti

title: La messa è finita
synopsis: For Don Giulio, returning to Rome after having been parish priest on an island in the Tyrrhenian Sea is full of bitter surprises. Friends have changed: one is under investigation for terrorism, another has exhaustion, yet another is living squalid homosexual adventures. And even in the family there is no good news: the father has run away, the mother kills herself, the sister wants to have an abortion. In addition, the parish is deserted by the faithful. Don Giulio puts all his effort into it ...
cast: Nanni Moretti, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Marco Messeri, Enrica Maria Modugno, Margarita Lozano, Eugenio Masciari, Luisa De Santis, Pietro De Vico, Vincenzo Salemme, Dario Cantarelli, Mauro Fabretti, Giovanni Buttafava

title: La meute
synopsis: In the midst of a desolate snowy landscape, Charlotte loads the hitchhiker Max and together they stop at a trucker restaurant when Max never returns after being in the bathroom. At first, Charlotte leaves to continue her journey but in the night she goes back to try to understand what happened to the man. But waiting for her, she finds the bartender ready to wait for her, with more than evil intentions. Charlotte discovers that the woman is Max's mother and that she uses the bar as a gimmick to kidnap human beings to feed her children, a group of bloodthirsty undead. Alone and in the middle of nowhere, Charlotte thus realizes that she has become the lunch of the day and that she must fight with all her strength to escape the danger.
cast: Yolande Moreau, Emilie Dequenne, Benjamin Biolay, Philippe Nahon, Matthias Schoenaerts, Ian Fonteyn, Georges Lini, Philippe Résimont, Brice Fournier, Nicolas Leroy

title: La mezza stagione
synopsis: In a small town, where every possibility of change seems destined to fail, three different stories are punctuated by sounds and noises. Cesare, whose aspiration is to live on music, draws inspiration from them to rework them creatively. Giovanni, who works at night and would like to sleep during the day, is instead bothered to death. Sissi, then, is called to perform a bizarre ritual to free herself from the haunting voice of reproach of her now dead father.
cast: Espedito Chionna, Michela Di Napoli, Francesco Giannico

title: La mezzatinta
synopsis: An architect who is restoring a villa in Torre del Greco receives a mid -mid -midthane (a type of engraving) from a mysterious art merchant on the same villa. During the night, the press is transformed by letting discover the tragic history of the disappearance of a child who took place many years earlier.
cast: Sergio Fantoni, Sergio Fiorentini, Bruno Cattaneo

title: La mia banda suona il pop
synopsis: The Russian tycoon Ivanov dreams of a reunion in Petersburg of his favorite Italian musical group, Popcorn, very famous in the Eighties. The manager of the band, Francok who lives between Italy and Russia, is contacted in this regard by a certain Olga, Ivanov's trusted woman. Franco tries to dissuade him because he basically hates Popcorns and prefers to counter-propose alternatives in his opinion much more valid: with Ivanov, however, there is no discussion, he wants Popcorn and so it will be. However, the four members of the band, each for a different reason, refuse the offer to pursue more palatable dreams and goals. But evidently it is written that the reunion takes place because the aforementioned "dreams and objectives", as in a mocking game of fate, all suddenly fail, inducing the old comrades to accept the bizarre proposal. #The artists, a little rusty, are ready for the new adventure, depressed but ready. Between costume rehearsals, sound checks, quarrels, old loves and old grudges, the four discover with amazement that they have to act as a trojan horse for a colossal robbery against Ivanov designed by Olga. Their resistances are useless: perplexities soon turn into feelings of opposite polarity. The four see in the criminal project a saving potential for the lives of all. So what if they try to steal that money from them? Why not groped the coup?
cast: Christian De Sica, Massimo Ghini, Angela Finocchiaro, Paolo Rossi, Diego Abatantuono, Natasha Stefanenko, Rinat Khismatouline, Fabrizio Nardi, Nico Di Renzo, Giulio Base, Massimo Bagnato, Tiberio Timperi

title: La mia bella famiglia italiana
synopsis: After two decades of leaving Puglia following an accident of unknown causes, Paolo is forced to return from Germany due to his mother's serious health conditions. Accompanied by his wife Martina, with whom he is in crisis, Paolo discovers that his mother's illness was just an excuse devised by his younger brother Totò to make him go home and help the family's difficult economic situation. Gradually regaining contact with his native land, Paolo will rediscover family ties and meet Gina, a girl who hides a secret linked to him.
cast: Alessandro Preziosi, Tanja Vedhorn, Peppino Mazzotta, Karin Proia, Nunzia Schiano, Nicola Rignanese, Michele De Virgilio, Elmar Gehlen, Franco Paltera, Chiara Paoli, Patrick Mölleken, Umberto Sardella

title: La mia casa è piena di specchi
synopsis: Life of Sophia Loren, between artistic path and sentimental life. Rise of one of the most famous and talented divas of Italian cinema, up to the present day.
cast: Sophia Loren, Enzo De Caro, Nicola Di Pinto, Margareth Madè, Francesco Paolantoni, Xhilda Lapardhaja, Raffaele Esposito, Carla Cassola, Antonella Di Monte, Gea Martire

title: La mia classe
synopsis: In the multiethnic district of Pigneto in Rome, emigrants and foreigners of all ages who learn Italian meet in a school class. The individual stories of the students intersect with those of a teacher (Valerio Mastandrea) who, aware of the role he has in building the Italy of the future, lets himself be involved and finds the strength to face his illness.
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Bassirou Ballde, Mamon Bhuiyan, Gregorio Cabral, Jessica Canahuire Laura, Metin Celik, Pedro Savio De Andrade, Ahmet Gohtas, Benabdallha Oufa, Shadi Ramadan

title: La mia famiglia a soqquadro
synopsis: Martino is an 11-year-old boy who, entering the new world of middle school, is faced with an unexpected reality: he is the only one in the class who still has his parents together! He will envy his companions the sumptuous travels and gifts received by parents and their respective new partners who compete to win the affection of their children. Hence the diabolical idea of ??having his parents separate so that he too can enjoy the same benefits as his companions.
cast: Gabriele Cappio, Bianca Nappi, Marco Cocci, Elisabetta Pellini, Eleonora Giorgi, Ninni Bruschetta, Luis Molteni, Max Nardari, Raniero Monaco Di Lapio, Roberta Rossi, Lorenzo Viola Di Campalto

title: La mia generazione
synopsis: In 1983 a captain of the carabinieri (Orlando) escorts an imprisoned terrorist (Amendola) from Sicily to Milan: they gave him permission for a series of talks with his girlfriend (Neri), whom he has not seen for three years. The journey becomes, for the terrorist and the escort officer, an opportunity to know and compare motivations and values ??that remain irreconcilable. The "irreducible" such they are and such they remain; at the cost of living.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Claudio Amendola, Francesca Neri

title: La mia mamma suona il rock
synopsis: Cristiano and Franco, owners of an established fashion house, are a couple of homosexuals in their forties. Sicilian the first and a true Roman the second, they break up when, exasperated by Cristiano's desire to have a child, Franco leaves him. In the throes of despair and depression, after a night of alcohol, Cristiano is found and taken home by Massimo, the leader of a rock group. At that moment, the idea flashes in Cristiano's mind to kidnap his savior, take him to his home and take care of him, making him become the son he always wanted.
cast: Alessandro Paci, Massimo Ceccherini, Enzo Salvi, Antonio Fiorillo, Cristina Del Basso, Lallo Circosta, Nino Celeste, Emanuela Aureli, Valeria Marini

title: La mia ombra è tua
synopsis: This is a love story, which began forty years ago and never ended. It is also the story of a journey through Italy undertaken by a strange couple aboard an old Jeep: Emiliano, a twenty -five year old just graduated with full marks in ancient letters, and Vittorio Vezzosi, a grunt sixty -year -old writer who has been led for years A life as a hermit following the publication of his only book, indelible planetary success in everyone's memory. The two are directed in Milan, at the Fair-Market of the eighties and nineties, on a journey full of daring and fun showers greedily followed live from the social world, randomly stimulated by an influencer. Vezzosi has in fact agreed to keep a speech by breaking a silence that lasted more than twenty years. Milena, the lost love of the writer, and an oceanic crowd slorail to listen to Vezzosi to deal with his past, and above all with the gaze of our country, gripped by the nostalgia and lost in the memory of himself, await them.
cast: Marco Giallini, Giuseppe Maggio, Sidy Diop, Anna Manuelli, Massimo Molea, Isabella Ferrari

title: La mia seconda volta
synopsis: Eighteen years old, vital and creative, a talent still to be addressed: this is Giorgia. She burns with the desire to finish the fifth artistic high school and escape from the province where she grew up, the same one in which Ludovica retired to study at the Academy of Fine Arts. She is twenty-three years old and already knows what she wants: to become a set designer. Getting to know each other through Giorgia's brother, they will discover the unpredictability of destiny, between deep friendships, unexpected loves and dreams of escape ignited by a colorful caravan on the shores of a lake. They will find the courage to face the consequences of their choices because no one is an island and everyone's gesture, for better or for worse, is reflected in everyone else.
cast: Mariachiara Di Mitri, Aurora Ruffino, Luca Ward, Simone Riccioni, Yuri Napoli, Isabel Russinova, Ludovica Bizzaglia, Federico Russo, Pietro Sarubbi, Paola Sotgiu, Daniela Poggi, Ettore Belmondo

title: La mia signora
synopsis: An exasperated husband kills the canary to which his wife is very attached, then proceeds to do the same thing with the woman. A builder ingratiates himself with a minister with the favors of a prostitute. A man who has been sick for a long time is reprimanded by his "loved ones". A man and a woman waiting at the airport are hoping that their spouses will crash on the plane. A man worries about the car, but not about his wife's betrayal.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Silvana Mangano, Claudio Gora, Elena Nicolai, Laura Durell, Marisa Fiorio, Mario Conocchia, Elena Fabrizi, Mino Doro, Lamberto Antinori
director: Tinto Brass, Luigi Comencini, Mauro Bolognini

title: La mia vita a stelle e strisce
synopsis: The quiet cottage of Lando, a farmer in the Tuscan countryside, is about to undergo a shocking invasion: Aunt Giuly arrives from America with a lot of husband, former colonel of the Marines, daughter of breathtaking beauty and pestiferous nephew. Poor Lando is thus forced to undergo all kinds of harassment (from the parabolic hoisted on the roof of the cottage to the pumpkins in the field carved for Halloween) and his protests are of little value.
cast: Massimo Ceccherini, Victoria Silvstedt, Novello Novelli, Manuela Magherini, Cyrus Elias

title: La mina
synopsis: Stefano, a fisherman, arrives in the small port of San Biagio to sell his boat. There he falls in love with young Lucia, but Nicola, an influential love rival, and the Ardito, an armless poaching fisherman, do not make his life easy: the former will surrender, the latter will end up killed by a mine in the attempt to disassemble it.
cast: Antonio Cifariello, Elsa Martinelli, Julia Caba Alba, Conchita

title: La minorenne
synopsis: Valeria returns home after growing up in the college. To welcome her there is her Catholic family but the girl's main thought is to lose virginity and have fun. Soon, however, he discovers the mother's betrayal against his father and the perverse intentions of his brother.
cast: Gloria Guida, Rosemary Dexter, Marco Guglielmi, Luciano Roffi

title: La mirada del otro
synopsis: Black sheep of a high-class Madrid family, bored by psychoanalysts and in search of her Mr. Goodbar, Begonia falls in love with "Owl", a Japanese devilry that records images and sounds instantly reprogramming them in a written word.
cast: Laura Morante, Miguel Bosé, José Coronado

title: La misma luna
synopsis: Carlitos is a 9-year-old Mexican boy who lives in his country with his grandmother, while his mother works as a waitress in Los Angeles, hoping to one day be reunited with her son. However, when the grandmother dies unexpectedly, the child decides to travel to join his mother.
cast: Kate Del Castillo, Eugenio Derbez, Mário Almada, Adrian Alonso, Isaac Bravo, Ernesto D'Alessio, Los Tigres Del Norte, Julie Dove, America Ferrera, J. Teddy Garces

title: La misura del confine
synopsis: On the edge of the territory, a small mountain town on the border between Italy and Switzerland is found, buried in the ice, the mummy of a man. Due to the lack of clarity on the exact location of the border between the two states, the mummy is disputed, also because it is hoped that the discovery - and the construction of a special museum - will attract tourism. Two topographers are called - one Swiss, the other Italian - who must clarify the precise path of the border line. But their precise investigations reveal more than might have been expected.
cast: Paolo Bonanni, Peppino Mazzotta, Thierry Toscan, Beatrice Orlandini, Giovanni Guardiano, Massimo Zordan, Adriana Ortolani, Tommaso Spinelli, Luigi Iacuzio, Rolando Alberti, Lorenzo Degli Innocenzi, Gianluca Buonanno, Silvio Mondinelli, Rolando Sperandio

title: La moglie del prete
synopsis: Valeria is a former singer of Neapolitan origin saved from an attempted suicide. She discovers that the voice she had listened to on the phone of "Voce amica" and that had deeply affected her was that of a priest, Don Mario. She falls in love with him and, little by little, he too falls in love with her. But, called to Rome and become monsignor, he will have to make a choice.
cast: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Pippo Starnazza, Venantino Venantini

title: La moglie del sarto
synopsis: Rosetta (Maria Grazia Cucinotta) moved from the Aeolian Islands to a small town in Calabria after marrying Edmondo, who with his talent set up a tailor's shop for men only, achieving considerable artistic and economic success. When Edmondo dies, Roberta and her beautiful daughter Sofia (Marta Gastini), left alone by friends and family struggling with everyday difficulties, have to take over the reins of the atelier, attracting a swirl of rumors and gossip about which both the profession they both carry out with the clients, always strictly male, that they continue to receive. After some time, to appease the gossips, her friend Adelina (Aurora Quattrocchi) proposes to Sofia to marry Salvatore (Alessio Vassallo), a young street artist, but the marriage has no beneficial effect and the disaster for the tailoring seems to be behind the corner.
cast: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Marta Gastini, Alessio Vassallo, Ernesto Mahieux, Salvatore Puntillo, Tony Sperandeo, Aurora Quattrocchi, Ninni Bruschetta, Giacomo Battaglia, Gigi Miseferi, Pino Torcasio

title: La moglie dell'amico è sempre più buona
synopsis: Giulio is married to Mirella, a militant feminist; Romano with Giustina, deputy of a Catholic party. The two, still young, are tired of being neglected by their respective spouses and think it well to have fun with some "happy" girl: it will end with a couple swap.
cast: Carlo Delle Piane, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Sydne Rome, Carlos Larranaga

title: La moglie di mio padre
synopsis: A mature businessman in Northern Italy is discovered impotent in relations with the beautiful and young second wife. He manages to express his virility only with occasional and paid meetings. When he realizes that his wife intertwined a relationship with the first bed son, the tragedy will crack.
cast: Carroll Baker, Adolfo Celi, Cesare Barro, Luigi Pistilli, Gabriella Giorgelli, Dada Gallotti, Caterina Barbero, Carla Spessato, Femi Benussi, Jenny Tamburi

title: La moglie giapponese
synopsis: The accountant Taddei, called to replace his colleague Ferrante who fell ill suddenly, is forced to undertake a business trip to the Far East. Retracing the route that Ferrante used to follow, Taddei passes from Tokyo to Hong Kong, from Saigon to Calcutta. The journey gradually turns into a nightmare: thrown into a world different from his own, the accountant comes into contact with a depressing reality that will make him reflect on the meaning of his life.
cast: Gastone Moschin, Paul Esser, Michiko Iwasaki

title: La moglie in bianco... l'amante al pepe
synopsis: Gianluca, son of the dentist baron Patané, exhibits unmanly attitudes. The old grandfather, shortly before dying, places as a condition for the collection of the inheritance that Gianluca marries and, above all, that he has a child in a very short time. After a series of mouthful ups and downs, Gianluca marries a former stripper and becomes a father.
cast: Lino Banfi, Pamela Prati, Marisa Porcel, Susan Scott, Mario Carotenuto, Vittorio Caprioli

title: La moglie in vacanza... l'amante in città
synopsis: An industrialist from Parma has a relationship with the beautiful Giulia, who would like to have him all to herself. Wanting to avoid the costs of divorce, the industrialist favors his wife's relationship with a self-styled count. The four are found by chance in Courmayeur, where the knots finally come to a head.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Lino Banfi, Renzo Montagnani, Barbara Bouchet

title: La moglie ingenua e il marito malato
synopsis: He (Rey) is an elderly professor; she (Sandrelli), is the tender wife, much younger than her husband. One day a rumor begins to circulate around the country which, although unconfirmed, certainly does not please the professor: his sweetheart would be cheating him. From here begins a series of gossip and misunderstandings that will put a strain on their union. Based on an excellent novel by Achille Campanile, difficult to adapt to the screen, this TV movie is a successful bet, thanks above all to superlative interpreters, a good script and Monicelli's solid experience.
cast: Fernando Rey, Stefania Sandrelli, Carlo Giuffrè

title: La moglie più bella
synopsis: Francesca Cimarosa is the beautiful sixteen year old daughter of a poor farmer. Vito, a small Mafia boss, falls in love with her, and in the face of her refusal, he does not hesitate to kidnap and rape her. The girl, however, takes revenge.
cast: Ornella Muti, Alessio Orano, Tano Cimarosa, Joe Sentieri

title: La moglie vergine
synopsis: Between Giovanni and Valentina the marriage is at a standstill. He is helpless, and he also has to put up with the complaints of her mother-in-law and her uncle. The situation becomes complicated with the arrival of two friends, authentic sexual maniacs: Gianfranco and his German wife Brigitta. Paradoxically, Giovanni will find satisfaction only with his mother-in-law.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Carroll Baker, Ray Lovelock

title: La moglie è uguale per tutti
synopsis: The lawyer De Papis, a specialist in the causes of marriage separation and a convinced advocate of individual freedom, has a nephew who thinks differently. To induce him to give up on this, the lawyer invites his nephew to spend an entire day in his office. During his stay, the young man meets a beautiful lady who is asking for divorce driven by the jealousy of her second husband who cannot bear the idea that the ghost of the first appears to her in a dream.
cast: Nino Taranto, Nadia Gray, Renato Vicario, Paolo Panelli, Lea Padovani, Mario Riva, Tina Pica

title: La momia azteca
synopsis: To prove to the scientific world that his theories on reincarnation are correct, Dr. Almada carries out a time regression experiment with his wife Flora. This comes to remember her past life when, an Aztec virgin destined for sacrifice, she was discovered together with the warrior Popoca. He was buried alive and cursed, the young woman sacrificed. In Almada all that remains is to follow the traces indicated by Flora to find out if it is fantasy or reality ...
cast: Ramón Gay, Rosa Arenas, Crox Alvarado, Luis Aceves Castañeda, Jorge Mondragón, Arturo Martínez, Emma Roldán, Julián De Meriche, Salvador Lozano, Jaime González Quiñones

title: La monaca di Monza
synopsis: Virginia de Leyva, daughter of the Spanish feudal lord of Monza, is forced to take vows from her father: the nobleman wants the family inheritance to go to the only male offspring. Virginia, who became vicarious nun, proves to be very severe towards her pupils. One day, he surprises a girl in conversation with Gianpaolo Osio and asks the abbess to take action against him. Osio, madly in love with Virginia, begins to court her: after trying in vain to resist, the nun gives in to her offers ...
cast: Giovanna Ralli, Gabriele Ferzetti, Lilla Brignone, Elisa Cegani

title: La monaca di Monza
synopsis: Virginia de Leyva, benefactress and mother superior of a convent in Monza, is persuaded by the chaplain to give refuge to Giampaolo Osio, a young noble famous throughout Lombardy for his arrogance and his amorous adventures. One evening the man breaks into Sister Virginia's cell and rapes her. The nun forgets the rape immediately and becomes Osio's lover. The birth of a child forces the nuns, who are also not exempt from sins of any kind, to elect a new mother superior.
cast: Anne Heywood, Antonio Sabato, Carla Gravina, Tino Carraro, Luigi Pistilli

title: La monaca nel peccato
synopsis: Susanna Simonin is raped by her father, who then closes her in a convent to avoid scandals. The mother superior, troubled, kindly protects her, however provoking the anger of the sisters, who begin to experiment macabre erotic games on her body ...
cast: Eva Grimaldi, Karin Well, Maria Pia Parisi, Gilda Germani, Aldina Martano

title: La montagna del dio cannibale
synopsis: Harry Stevenson is an ethnologist who has decided to go to an island in New Guinea to explore a mountain considered taboo. His wife Susan and his brother-in-law Arthur, worried that there has been no news of Harry for some time, set out in search of him. They are accompanied by Edward Foster, a friend of Harry and some local porters. The expedition into the forest is immediately revealed to be full of danger and devastated by the appearance of mysterious savages.
cast: Claudio Cassinelli, Ursula Andress, Antonio Marsina, Stacy Keach

title: La montagna di luce
synopsis: The rajah of Punjab, determined to get hold of the fabulous diamond called "the mountain of light" that shines on the forehead of a statue, instructs the adventurer Allan Foster to carry out the theft. Together with Sitama, Allan succeeds thanks to an ingenious plan to take possession of the precious stone. However, he does not intend to share the spoils with others and seeks refuge in the English protectorate.
cast: Richard Harrison, Luciana Gilli, Wilbert Bradly, Daniele Vargas

title: La montaña sagrada/The Holy Mountain
synopsis: Nine bizarre characters (a young thief and six powerful Lords, each representing a planet of the solar system, plus a mystic and his assistant who act as their guide) undertake the ascent to the Holy Mountain, at the top of which they hope to access the revelation of the secret of immortality by the Nine Sages. But having reached their destination ...
cast: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Valerie Jodorowsky, Ramona Saunders, Horácio Salinas

title: La mort dans ce jardin
synopsis: A Brazilian citizen wages a fight against the mining company that wants to nationalize the fields. A priest, a prostitute, an adventurer and a miner take refuge in the jungle to escape the police. Violence between the members of the group explodes uncontrolled: they will kill each other.
cast: Simone Signoret, Georges Marchal, Charles Vanel, Michel Piccoli

title: La mort de Belle
synopsis: Bella Shermann, a young and desirable American student who attends the University of Geneva, is murdered in the home of her host family. In the home of the Blanchons on the night of the murder there was only Stéphane, a history professor who had stayed at home to correct his pupils' homework and finish a job on the lathe. Suspicions immediately fall on him: but was it really the peaceful professor who killed the girl? And, above all, was Bella Shermann that candid and innocent girl that the Blanchons believed?
cast: Jean Desailly, Alexandra Stewart, Monique Mélinand, Yvette Etiévant, Jacques Monod, Marc Cassot, Jacques Pierre, Yves Robert, Louisa Colpeyn, Van Doude

title: La mort de Louis XIV
synopsis: Returning from hunting, Louis XIV feels severe pain in his leg. A fortnight later he is bedridden in Versailles. It will be the beginning of the slow agony of the greatest French sovereign, who must also organize his succession, surrounded by his faithful: his doctor, his favorite Madame de Maintenon, his surgeon, his first servant ...
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Filipe Duarte, Patrick D'Assumçao, José Wallenstein, Irène Silvagni, Bernard Belin, Philippe Crespeau, Marc Susini

title: La mort de Mario Ricci
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Mimsy Farmer, Heinz Bennent, Magali Noël

title: La mort en direct
synopsis: Katherine is diagnosed with late stage cancer; a television producer offers her a contract to exclusively film her death. She first accepts, but then runs away. Tavernier's philosophical science fiction; it is actually a meditation on audiovisual civilization and sensational information. An alarmed warning, but also a drama of great lyrical strength.
cast: Romy Schneider, Harvey Keitel, Harry Dean Stanton, Max Von Sydow, William Russell, Vadim Glowna, Bernhard Wicki, Eva Maria Meineke, Thérèse Liotard

title: La mort qui tue
synopsis: After the alleged death of Juve in the explosion of Lady Beltham's villa, Fandor continues to investigate alone. Meanwhile, the painter Dollon, accused of the crime of Baroness de Vibray (actually killed by Fantômas), is murdered in a cell by the guard Nibet, an accomplice of the bandit ...
cast: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, André Luguet

title: La mortadella
synopsis: Maddalena Ciarrapico, a worker in a sausage factory, leaves her job and Italy and leaves for the United States to join her boyfriend in New York. Once in the United States, however, the customs authorities do not give her permission to leave the airport, because Maddalena has a mortadella with her, and American law prohibits the importation of sausages.
cast: Danny DeVito, Sophia Loren, Gigi Proietti, William Devane

title: La morte accarezza a mezzanotte
synopsis: Valentina is a model, and they offer her to reconstruct, with the help of drugs, the murder of a woman. The experiment succeeds, but trouble begins for Valentina because the killer sets out on her trail and, in addition, the police do not listen to her as they continue to consider the case closed, classified as suicide. Second film by Luciano Ercoli starring Susan Scott, aka Nieves Navarro after Death walks in high heels. This is also a low-quality soft thriller.
cast: Nieves Navarro, Simon Andreu, Peter Martell, Ivano Staccioli, Carlo Gentili, Claudio Pellegrini, Luciano Rossi, Claudie Lange, Roberta Cifarelli

title: La morte al lavoro
synopsis: The young Alex (Pacifici), completely foreign to the world of cinema, discovers its charm through a direct experience: the suicide of an actor who lived in the apartment where the protagonist goes to live.
cast: Federico Pacifici, Eva Axen, Giovannella Grifeo, Fausta Avelli

title: La morte bussa due volte
synopsis: Hidden in the dark, far from each other, two men watch, unseen, a man's attempt to suffocate a woman. The murder attempt was made on the beach overlooking the night club "Estrella". One of the two witnesses is the keeper of the restaurant, Riccardo; the other is Amato, one of the owners. The next day the woman is found dead and her husband has nothing left but to call the police. Bob is called on the spot and begins to investigate Francesco's complex personality.
cast: Dean Reed, Fabio Testi, Riccardo Garrone, Adolfo Celi, Anita Ekberg

title: La morte cammina con i tacchi alti
synopsis: Nicole Rochard's (Scott) father was killed on the train to France shortly after carrying out a diamond theft. Nicole is a stripper and she knows nothing about that story, but there is someone who is convinced that, before dying, her father entrusted the diamonds to her. In the Italian yellow genre, Ercoli's works do not shine either for originality or for mastery. Shot in co-production with the Spaniards, this is just a very weak film.
cast: Susan Scott, Frank Wolff, Simon Andreu, Carlo Gentili

title: La morte civile
cast: Carlo Ninchi, Dina Sassoli, Renato Cialente, Elio Steiner, Tina Lattanzi

title: La morte ha fatto l'uovo
synopsis: Two wealthy owners of a chicken farm are targeted by the diabolical and awake niece, who wants to eliminate her aunt by putting the blame on her uncle. But the man, trying to disintegrate the woman's corpse in the machine that grinds the ground, ends up in it. Surprise ending.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Gina Lollobrigida, Ewa Aulin, Giulio Donnini

title: La morte ha sorriso all'assassino
synopsis: At the beginning of the 1900s, Greta, a young woman with no memory due to an accident with her carriage, was hosted by a couple in their villa. The couple, Walter and Eva, are drawn to the mysterious woman, whose past is murky and mysterious. Eva, jealous, walls Greta alive in a dungeon of the villa, presumably causing her to die. But Greta returns, even if at times with a monstrous face, and kills. The experiments on the life and death of Dr. Sturges seem to have something to do with the strange situation.
cast: Ewa Aulin, Klaus Kinski, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Angela Bo

title: La morte legale
synopsis: Boston, Massachusetts, 1920. Two Italians, Nicola Sacco and Bartolomeo Vanzetti, are condemned to death, their only fault is to be anarchist. The whole world rebels, the squares are filled, only the lives of two men are not at stake, but the ideals they represent. Millions of voices are raised in dozens of different languages. They ask for justice for Sacco and Vanzetti, but nothing can save their lives. On August 23, 1927 Nicola Sacco and Bartolomeo Vanzetti are delivered to the executioner and executed in the electric chair, becoming martyrs of injustice and a symbol of freedom. Almost fifty years later, in 1971, the director Giuliano Montaldo made a film about their incredible story. The title is Sacco and Vanzetti and immediately becomes a manifesto against intolerance, injustice, the death penalty. Thanks to the film, a rehabilitation committee is formed and in 1977 Michael Dukakis, governor of Massachusetts, proclaims the rehabilitation of Nicola Sacco and Bartolomeo Vanzetti, declaring their total innocence to the whole world. In 2017, 90 years after the execution and 50 from the rehabilitation, Montaldo's film reviews the light in a restored version. On this occasion, the director exhibits the reasons for a courageous choice and reveals the entire artistic/productive path.
cast: Giuliano Montaldo

title: La morte negli occhi del gatto
synopsis: In Dragstone Castle, the curse that weighs on the MacGrieffs seems to be fulfilled: the members of the family are killed one after the other. Young Corringa MacGrieff suspects her cousin. Minestrone between yellow and horror, with a sprinkle of eroticism, written and directed by Antonio Margheriti.
cast: Jane Birkin, Hiram Keller, Françoise Christophe

title: La morte non conta i dollari
synopsis: Lawrence Wright returns to the town of Owel Rock where his father died, reportedly killed by Doc Lester. The man finds his sister Jane who pushes him to avenge the death of his parent, but Lawrence is hesitant.
cast: Mark Damon, Luciana Gilli, Pamela Tudor, Alan Collins, Pedro Sanchez

title: La morte non ha sesso
cast: John Mills, Luciana Paluzzi, Roberto Hoffmann, Renata Kashe, Carlo Hintermann, Tullio Altamura

title: La morte risale a ieri sera
synopsis: Donatella is a young and beautiful girl, but mentally handicapped. Precisely because of her attractiveness she is kidnapped and sent into prostitution. The father then turns to a good commissioner, but the kidnappers, feeling hunted, kill the girl. The cops still manage to find the culprits, but Donatella's father has already done justice. Based on a thriller by Giorgio Scerbanenco, the film is set in a Milan of drifters and, although it favors the melodramatic aspect, it has a modern and lively edge. The actors are confidently directed.
cast: Raf Vallone, Frank Wolff, Gigi Rizzi, Beryl Cunningham

title: La morte scende leggera
synopsis: A underworld boss returns home from a 'work' trip and finds his wife killed in bed. Not being able to exploit his real alibi, he asks for help from an honorable who offers him a safe place to stay together with the lover waiting for the real culprit to be found. However, another blood begins to flow.
cast: Stelio Candelli, Patrizia Viotti, Veronika Korosec, Rossella Bergamonti, Tom Felleghy, Antonio Anelli, Marcello Di Martire, Mathily Doria, Fernando Cerulli, Franco Marletta

title: La morte sull'alta collina
synopsis: The young Loring Van der Velt and Parker, a mysterious individual, after allowing the Mexican Valiente and his gang to rob the bank of Two Arrow, manage to seize the loot and hide it waiting to be able to share it. Braddock, who commissioned the robbery, instructs Valiente to track down Loring.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Louis Dawson, Tano Cimarosa, Agnès Spaak

title: La morte viene dal pianeta Aytin
synopsis: The fearsome inhabitants of the extraterrestrial people Atyn invade the Earth with the aim of eliminating the human race.
cast: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Renato Baldini, Ombretta Colli, Enzo Fiermonte

title: La morte viene dallo spazio
cast: Paul Hubschmid, Fiorella Mari, Madeleine Fischer, Ivo Garrani

title: La morte è di moda
synopsis: Arriving completely by chance in an isolated villa that has been uninhabited for over twenty years, an attractive model finds herself witnessing a murder. The police are very dubious about his version, which they attribute to the violent shock, but little by little disturbing details emerge.
cast: Marina Giulia Cavalli, Anthony Franciosa, Theresa Leopard

title: La mossa del cavallo - C'era una volta Vigata
synopsis: Montelusa, 1877. The forty-year-old Giovanni Bovara (Michele Riondino) is the new chief inspector of the mills, in charge of enforcing the tax on the ground. Sicilian by birth, he is now Ligurian by adoption as he moved with his family to Genoa as a child. He thinks and talks like a man from northern Italy and does not understand the mafia and conspiratorial dynamics that regulate the Sicilian land. His intransigence immediately gives him several enemies. His investigations lead him to discover first an ingenious system by which the millers are left free to evade the tax on the ground and then the existence of a clandestine mill in the land of the most powerful man in the city. Little by little the coils of the "system" tighten around him and when he arrives by chance at the murder site of the parish priest of the city, Bovara finds himself in spite of himself entangled in something much bigger than himself. In a complicated system of misdirection and power games, his opponents will try to eliminate him and it will be only by entering the mentality of his tormentors and resorting to their own strategies that Bovara will be able to save his life. But will justice be able to triumph?
cast: Michele Riondino, Ester Pantano, Antonio Pandolfo, Maurizio Bologna, Maurizio Puglisi, Filippo Luna, Giancarlo Ratti, Giuseppe Schillaci, Giuseppe Lanino, Cocò Gulotta, Giovanni Carta

title: La mossa del pinguino
synopsis: Rome, 2006. Despite being married to Eva and already having a child, at the age of thirty Bruno is not resigned to the idea of ??growing up. A classic example of the Peter Pan syndrome, he is unable to keep a job and spends his days between inconclusive projects and playing table football with his friend Salvatore. The lack of money and the increasingly tense relationship with Eva pushed him one day to conceive a new bizarre idea: to form a curling team with which to reach the Winter Olympics in Turin, involving as well as Salvatore also Neno, a gambler who lives by tricks , and Ottavio, a retired traffic cop.
cast: Edoardo Leo, Ricky Memphis, Ennio Fantastichini, Antonello Fassari, Francesca Inaudi, Sergio Fiorentini, Elisa Di Eusanio, Vittorio Emanuele Propizio, Barbara Scoppa

title: La moustache
synopsis: Marc decides to cut his mustache after wearing it for over a decade, but no one seems to notice the difference. What seems like a joke becomes a "nightmare" when everyone claims that Marc never had a mustache ...
cast: Hippolyte Girardot, Vincent Lindon, Mathieu Amalric, Emmanuelle Devos

title: La muerte busca un hombre
synopsis: Forsythe, who uses his woman as a decoy, has earned a reputation as a ruthless bounty hunter. But when his game backfires and Gladys is killed, he meditates revenge by finding the help of a mysterious gunslinger.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, George Forsythe, Stan Cooper, Malisa Longo

title: La muerte de un burócrata
synopsis: A Cuban worker accidentally dies and, sadly, is buried with his union card in his pocket. Without that piece of paper, the widow is unable to collect the pension money and attempts to have the body exhumed. The young nephew, in order to obtain permission to unearth his uncle, recover the document and then rebur him, begins a long struggle against the bureaucracy.
cast: Salvador Wood, Silvia Planas, Manuel Estanillo, Omar Alfonso, Tania Alvarado, Pedro Pablo Astorga, Alicia Bustamante, Gaspar De Santelices, Rafael Díaz, Roberto Gacio

title: La muerte llama a las diez
synopsis: Coveted by her boss Ronald, but intending to remain faithful to her fiancé Michael, the young designer Darin Faster rents an attic in London. Michael, who is in Vietnam as a war correspondent, has not shown up for over four months; Suddenly, however, strange things happen to Darin: at first he thinks he catches a glimpse of Michael in the chaotic city traffic, then he hosts two men, both named John, the first of whom a corpse will be found on the asphalt. And the mysteries don't end there ...
cast: Gillian Hills, Ángel Del Pozo, Bruno Corazzari, Orchidea De Santis

title: La muerte viviente
synopsis: On the island of Kulabai, Captain Labiche tries to stop the activity of a mad scientist. Boris Karloff, now semi-paralyzed, in one of his latest films.
cast: Boris Karloff, Julissa, Carlos East

title: La mujer de Benjamín
cast: Eduardo López Rojas, Arcelia Ramirez, Malena Doria, Juan Carlos Colombo

title: La mujer de la tierra caliente
synopsis: Traveling through Latin America, an indigenous young woman and an American engineer, traveling as self -cleaning players, exchange their most intimate memories.
cast: Laura Gemser, Stuart Whitman, Pilar Velazquez, Gabriele Tinti

title: La mujer murciélago
synopsis: The corpse of a wrestler is found in the Acapulco waters. The crime seems similar to others that have taken place in different areas of the world: other athletes who found dead and deprived of the liquid contained in the pineal gland. Help with Bat Woman (Maura Monti) is asked, under whose costume hides the beautiful billionaire Gloria, skilled in every sport. The traces seem to lead to the boat of the mysterious Dr. Williams, a scientist with the ambition to create fish men.
cast: Maura Monti, Roberto Canedo, Héctor Godoy, David Silva, Crox Alvarado, Armando Silvestre

title: La mujer sin cabeza
synopsis: A woman absent-mindedly drives on the freeway and hits something, but doesn't stop to look. From the next day she begins to behave strangely and seems to no longer recognize the relationships that bind her to people and things. One night she confesses to her husband that she believes she killed someone in the accident. The two return to that stretch of the highway and find only the carcass of a dead dog. Even the police, when questioned, confirm that there is no news of accidents. Everything seems settled until a new, disturbing discovery is made.
cast: Guillermo Arengo, César Bordón, Claudia Cantero, Inés Efron, Daniel Genoud, María Onetto, María Vaner, Pía Uribelarrea, Alicia Muxo

title: La mula
synopsis: Three months before the end of the Spanish Civil War, Juan Castro (Mario Casas), a young muleteer enlisted on the nationalist front, finds a wandering white mule in the middle of a battlefield one afternoon. He gives her the name of Valentina and decides to take her with him and keep her even after the end of the conflict, trying to make her go unnoticed in the eyes of others. To give him a hand will be Chato, childhood friend, accomplice of an unusual and delusional adventure that highlights the paradoxes of a war in which Juan, rather than thinking about fighting, is concerned about the mule and winning the love of most beautiful girl I've ever met (Maria Valverde).
cast: Mario Casas, Maria Valverde, Daniel Grao, Luis Callejo, Antonio Gil, Secun De La Rosa, Pepa Rus, Eduardo Velasco, Jesús Carroza, Alfonso Begara

title: La musica più comica del mondo - Prima parte
synopsis: Several meetings with various musicians, starting from a tribute to Coltrane, to the splinters with the musicians Ciprì and Ferrara, up to the Sicilian-American clarinetist Tony Scott.

title: La muta di Portici
synopsis: In Naples of 1647, the viceroy imposes gabelles that affect the minute people and create widespread discontent. Tommaso Aniello, called Masaniello, a young fisherman of Portici, fosters the rebellion and the police try to capture him. He lives with his sister Lucia, who is in love with Alfonso without knowing that it is the viceroy's son. The historical fact of the Naples revolt headed by Masaniello is an opportunity for a naively fictional reinterpretation and put in images with absolute mediocrity.
cast: Doris Duranti, Marcello Mastroianni, Floria Mariol, Anna Maria Ferrero

title: La mécanique de l'ombre
synopsis: Duval is the perfect employee. Thoughtful, persistent, efficient and committed to performing his duties at best, after an unforeseen event he has some difficulty in finding a new job. So when a mysterious businessman offers him to work for his security company, Duval can't turn down the offer. Turning a blind eye to the boss's eccentricity and the illegality of the task entrusted to him (transcribing a series of private recorded phone calls), Duval can't rest easy when one of the calls results in murder. Unaware that his existence will be completely upset, he will find himself at the center of a deadly conspiracy that leads to the upper echelons of the French government.
