cast: François Cluzet, Alba Rohrwacher, Denis Podalydès, Sami Bouajila, Simon Abkarian, Tom Adjibi, Adonis Danieletto, Jean Pierre Demarke, Alexia Depicker, Fabrice Godfroid, Javier Pinto

title: La mélodie
synopsis: Simon, a distinguished yet disillusioned violinist, finds himself teaching in spite of himself in a Parisian class-orchestra. His rigid methods make teaching music to the pupils of the magnanimous Farid hard and difficult. Arnold is fascinated by the violin, its gestures and its sounds. In contact with Arnold's raw talent and the cheerful energy of the rest of Farid's class, Simon gradually reconciles with the joys of music. Will he find the energy needed to overcome the obstacles that threaten his promise to take the children to the Philharmonic?
cast: Kad Merad, Samir Guesmi, Renély Alfred

title: La métamorphose des cloportes
synopsis: Alphonse, known as Lo Scaltra, specialized in the theft of works of art, takes part in a coup together with three thieves who are his friends: Arthur, Edmond and Rosso. The blow fails miserably due to manifest ineptitude, but only Alphonse is caught by the police and sentenced to five years in prison. Released from jail, for Alphonse it will be a question of revenge against his ex-accomplices, who in the meantime have had a good time. We are on the safe side, given that we are dealing with a typical French noir of the 60s. Valid not so much for the story, as for the quality of the performers, with Lino Ventura a true icon of the French crime scene of those years.
cast: Lino Ventura, Charles Aznavour, Irina Demick, Maurice Biraud

title: La môme
synopsis: The life of Edith Giovanna Gassion, better known as Edith Piaf, from 1915 to 1963: from a difficult childhood (she was abandoned by her mother, grew up in a brothel, was forced to perform on the street with her father) to success in France and New York. Then there is the unfortunate love story with boxer Marcel Cerdan, the serious health problems, the abandonment of the scenes ...
cast: Marion Cotillard, Sylvie Testud, Gérard Depardieu, Emmanuelle Seigner, Pascal Greggory

title: La naissance de l'amour
synopsis: The actor Paul is married to Fanchon and has children: however, he is secretly in love with Ulrika, who does not love him back. His friend Marcus, a writer, on the other hand, has a good relationship with his wife Hélène, but she dumps him ...
cast: Lou Castel, Jean Pierre Léaud, Johanna Ter Steege, Dominique Reymond

title: La nana
synopsis: Raquel celebrates her birthday in the family where she has been serving for over twenty years. She raised the couple's children and has the illusion that she has become an integral part of the family. This is why he experiences the arrival of new helpers as a threat and systematically puts them on the run. However, it will be Lucia, a younger waitress, who will help her understand that perhaps her life is elsewhere.
cast: Catalina Saavedra, Claudia Celedón, Alejandro Goic, Andrea García Huidobro, Mariana Loyola, Agustín Silva, Darok Orellana, Sebastián La Rivera, Mercedes Villanueva, Anita Reeves

title: La nave bianca
synopsis: The crew of a warship, hit by a cannon shot during an action, is rescued by a hospital ship: the white ship. On this, with tireless dedication, they are cared for and cared for by the volunteer Red Cross women, who make them rediscover some of their lost serenity. It was the first film, also edited with archive images, by Rossellini in which we can already glimpse some elements of what Neorealism will be, even if the proximity is more than anything else with the setting of the naval films of Francesco De Robertis, his "anti-rhetoric" was basically not so unwelcome to the regime.
cast: Attori Non Professionisti

title: La nave delle donne maledette
synopsis: Isabella, the wife of a high dignitary of the kingdom of Spain, was guilty of infanticide. To avoid the scandal, the relatives induce cousin Consuelo to accuse herself of the crime. On the ship that is taking her into exile, there is a lawyer determined to prove her innocence.
cast: Kerima, Ettore Manni, Tania Weber, May Britt, Elvy Lissiak

title: La nave dolce
synopsis: In August 1991, in the port of Bari, a ship from Albania that was supposed to transport sugar landed more than 18,000 refugees in Italy in search of a better fate than the one offered by the country of origin. Twenty years later, the documentary collects the voices of both those illegal immigrants and those who welcomed them that day and helped them integrate into the new social and working reality.

title: La neve nel bicchiere
synopsis: Thirty years of life of a peasant family from the Lower Po Valley between the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries: Nullo, the head of the family and his sons, Venanzio and Ligio, scariolanti, build canals and embankments to save those lands from the swamp. Their personal stories, their daily hardships and pains are intertwined with the first social and political struggles to improve living conditions, which culminated in 1914 in the "Red Week". The Great War arrives: Ligio will not return from the front. His place, in the work of the fields, is taken by the sons of Venanzio, Giovanni and Giuseppe. At the end of the conflict, social conflicts rekindle more bitter and Venanzio sees his dreams of a more just future fade away. Mussolini takes power. Venantius cannot give up hope: Angiolino, his third son, will incarnate it.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Anna Teresa Rossini, Antonia Piazza, Luigi Mezzanotte, Teresa Ricci

title: La niebla y la doncella
synopsis: The body of a young man appears in a wood on the small island of La Gomera, in the Canary Islands, but without finding a responsible person it is immediately filed away. Three years later, two officers are sent to the island to reopen the case, accompanied by the last person to see the boy alive. Investigations lead to suspicion of a powerful local politician.
cast: Verónica Echegui, Aura Garrido, Quim Gutiérrez, Roberto Álamo

title: La nipote
synopsis: At the end of the fifties, in a villa in the Veneto region, the fifty-year-old engineer Luigi lives, who, married in second marriage to a much younger woman, has an affair with the maid. With the arrival of his wife's son and granddaughter for the summer holidays, the situation will be destined to take an unexpected turn.
cast: Francesca Muzio, Daniele Vargas, Annie Edel, Ezio Marano

title: La nipote Sabella
synopsis: For a strange testamentary question, a land under which an oil field is hidden, will be entitled by right to those who, between two married couples, will first have a daughter who must be given the name of her grandmother. Between the two couples rivalries, deceptions and endless spite break out.
cast: Tina Pica, Renato Salvatori, Sylva Koscina, Peppino De Filippo

title: La nipote del prete
synopsis: The priest's granddaughter arrives in town: she is Swedish, young, blonde and uninhibited. Each male instantly loses his head for her, which for his part reciprocates with the utmost innocence left and right.
cast: Crippy Yocard, Luigi Bonos, Giancarlo Zanetti, Corrado Lojacono, Beryl Cunningham, Roberto Proietti, Alessandro Acerbi, Vittorio Sancisi, Maria Bellingeri, Rossana Bevilacqua

title: La niña de tus ojos
synopsis: Spain, 1938. The civil war is in full swing. In an attempt to strengthen the collaboration between Franco and Hitler, Germany invites a group of Spanish producers, close to the new regime, to shoot the two versions of "The girl of your dreams" (one in German and one in Spanish) in Ufa studios. of Berlin. But the hospitality of the propaganda minister Goebbels has to do with the charm of the leading actress, Macareña Granada.
cast: Penélope Cruz, Antonio Resines, Neus Asensi, Jesús Bonilla

title: La niña santa
synopsis: In Salta, northern Argentina, some teenage mystics question the role of the divine in their lives. An otolaryngology congress brings Dr. Jano, a famous middle-aged doctor to town. Amalia, one of the girls, is convinced that her mission is to save him from his sins: little by little, the man's certainties are shattered in front of the young woman's determination ...
cast: María Alche, Carlos Belloso, Mercedes Morán, Alejandro Urdapilleta

title: La noche
synopsis: Martin moves to Buenos Aires at night. Meet guys, go to clubs, use drugs and have sex. Sometimes, it does so by paying. Other times, however, he is invited by his prostitute transsexual friend to join her in threesome sex.
cast: Edgardo Castro, Federico Figari, Paula Ituriza, Luis Leiva, Dolores Guadalupe Olivares, William Prociuk

title: La noche de 12 años
synopsis: 1972. One autumn evening, nine political prisoners are taken from their cells to be isolated in new small cells, where they spend most of their time with a hood on. Among them, there is also Pepe Mujica, destined to become president of Uruguay some time later.
cast: Antonio De La Torre, Alfonso Tort, Chino Darín, Soledad Villamil, Sílvia Pérez Cruz, Luciano Ciaglia, David Landatxe

title: La noche de Walpurgis
synopsis: Elvira travels with her friend Genevieve through the French countryside in search of the tomb of a countess who lived in the Middle Ages and suspected of being a murderous vampire. The two friends find the tomb at Waldemar Daninsky Castle, who invites them to stay in the residence for as long as they wish. Accidentally, however, Elvira provokes the return to life of the countess, hungry more than ever.
cast: Paul Naschy, Gaby Fuchs, Barbara Capell, Patty Shepard, Andres Resino, Yelena Samarina, José Marco, Betsabé Ruiz, Barta Barri, Luis Gaspar, Ruperto Ares

title: La noche de enfrente
synopsis: Don Celso is one step away from retirement. While he worries about his possible killing, he is confronted with the idea of ??death but, if on the one hand leaving the world scares him, on the other he tries to imagine the arrival of the final moment. Walking through a city that is half real and half fantastic, he evokes some scenes from his childhood and youth, sometimes real and sometimes invented, remaining suspended between dream and nightmare, between present and past.
cast: Christian Vadim, Sergio Hernández, Valentina Vargas, Chamila Rodríguez, Pedro Vicuña, Cristián Gajardo, Santiago Figueroa, Pedro Villagra, Josè Luis Lopez

title: La noche de las gaviotas
synopsis: With this chapter, the saga of the blind resurrected ends, this time arriving in the village, riding across the beach.
cast: Víctor Petit, María Kosty, Sandra Mozarowsky, José Antonio Calvo, Julia Saly, Javier De Rivera, Pilar Vela, Fernando Villena, María Vidal, Oscar Phens

title: La noche de los asesinos
synopsis: Everything revolves around the death of Lord Archibald Percival, killed by a masked assassin. His conspicuous inheritance is at stake, to which various relatives aspire, most of whom, however, die in the course of the investigation. The dead man is not actually the real Lord, who instead is taking revenge on his snake relatives. Low-cost thriller with truly delusional moments, it's a classic example of Franco's trashy surrealism.
cast: Alberto Dalbes, Evelyn Scott, William Berger, Maribel Hidalgo

title: La noche de los brujos
synopsis: Mombasa, 1910. A white woman is tortured and beheaded by a tribe of indigenous people, then exterminated by a group of English explorers. Years later, a scientific expedition reaches the area of ​​the massacre, on which a local myth hovers that concerns the "leopard women" and strange beings who rise from the tombs.
cast: María Kosty, Simon Andreu, Kali Hansa, Bárbara Rey, Jack Taylor, José Thelman, Loreta Tovar

title: La noche de los girasoles
synopsis: Three young people go to a small Spanish village. Two of them - Pedro and Esteban - are speleologists, the third is Gabi, Esteban's girlfriend. The purpose of the trip is to explore certain recently discovered caves. But when the two, after having lowered themselves into the cave, come out again in the light of day, they find Gabi terrified who says she has suffered an attempted rape by a man. It will then be Gabi herself who believes she can identify him as a farmer, on whom his friends' anger and desire for revenge will be unleashed.
cast: Carmelo Gomez, Judith Diakhate, Celso Bugallo, Manuel Morón, Mariano Alameda, Vicente Romero, Walter Vidarte, Cesáreo Estébanez, Fernando Sánchez Cabezudo, Petra Martínez

title: La noche de los lapiles
synopsis: In Argentina, in 1975, some students from La Plata who had participated in a protest disappeared in military prisons, where they were tortured for months. A bit rough from a cinematographic point of view, the film evokes in a realistic, but at times insistent, way, with the tragedy of the disappeared and the techniques of repression and extermination.
cast: Alejo Garcia Pintos, Vita Escardo, Pablo Novarro, Pablo Machado

title: La noche de los mil gatos
synopsis: Millionaire playboy Hugo in his private helicopter flies over the city of Acapulco to locate sexy young women to approach and take to his secluded residence. After eating, drinking and spending pleasant moments in their company, with the help of the mute servant Dorgo, he usually decapitates them and keeps their heads in some glass containers while their bodies are fed to an army of a thousand thirsty cats. of blood and hungry for flesh.
cast: Hugo Stiglitz, Gerardo Zepeda, Anjanette Comer, Zulma Faiad, Christa Linder, Tere Velázquez, Barbara Angely, Jorge Russek, Delia Peña Orta, John Kelly

title: La noche del terror ciego
cast: Lone Fleming, Cesar Burner, Helen Harp, Joseph Thelman

title: La noche que mi madre mató a mi padre
synopsis: Isabel would like to feel appreciated as an actress but is plagued by her insecurities, fear of aging and anxiety. One evening she decides to organize a special dinner: her husband Angel, screenwriter, and Susana, the ex-wife of Angel director, want to convince the great Argentine actor Diego Peretti to take the lead role in the film they wrote. To everyone's surprise, an unforeseen event will upset the continuation of the dinner.
cast: Belén Rueda, Eduard Fernández, María Pujalte, Diego Peretti, Patricia Montero, Fele Martinez

title: La noia
synopsis: Dino, having discovered his inability to communicate with people, indulges in complete idleness in the company of Cecilia, a model for whom he feels only sexual attraction. This relationship, too, could lead to boredom if Dino did not learn that the girl is cheating on him. In order to keep the woman tied to him, Dino asks her to marry him. Shocked by the girl's refusal, he attempts suicide.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Horst Buchholz, Bette Davis, Isa Miranda

title: La noire de...
synopsis: The young Diouana is attracted to France by a bourgeois couple who takes her as a waitress and keeps her segregated in her apartment. The continuous humiliations of her make Diouana literally lost her voice.
cast: Mbissine Thérèse Diop, Anne Marie Jelinek, Robert Fontaine, Momar Nar Sene, Ibrahima Boy, Bernard Delbard, Nicole Donati, Raymond Lemeri, Suzanne Lemeri, Philippe, Sophie, Damien, Toto Bissainthe, Robert Marcy, Sophie Leclerc, Ousmane Sembène

title: La nonna Sabella
synopsis: Raffaele, a Neapolitan student, is suddenly recalled to his native village by the news of a serious illness that has struck his grandmother Sabella. Since Raffaele has been missing for years, it is difficult to recognize people and places, but there is also another reason: the terrible old woman has subjugated the town and everyone does what she wants.
cast: Tina Pica, Sylva Koscina, Peppino De Filippo, Paolo Stoppa, Dolores Palumbo, Renato Salvatori

title: La nostra quarantena
synopsis: Like every morning, Professor Maria Mercadante goes to the university. Salvatore, on the other hand, is a young student who is making a report on a group of fifteen Moroccan sailors stuck in the port of Cagliari on strike because they have been without a salary for nine months. In the clash of opinions on the condition of workers, the concrete condition of young Italians emerges: without work, with an uncertain future, many are thinking of leaving Italy. The Kenza ship, together with the sailors constantly in quarantine, will remain under seizure, while Salvatore and Maria, "forced" to reflect more deeply, will find themselves in a state of confusion.
cast: Francesca Neri, Moise Curia, Giancarlo Catenacci, El Moudden Ahmed, M'Kaddem Abdellatif, Piero Pia, Ayad El Houcine, Chajire Azeddine

title: La nostra terra
synopsis: Nicola Sansone (Tommaso Ragno), owner of a farm stolen from the Bonavitas in the seventies, the day he is arrested entrusts his land to Cosimo Bonavita (Sergio Rubini). Becoming faithful guardian, Cosimo continues to cultivate that land illegally even when it is confiscated by the state and assigned to a cooperative that fails to start the business. For this reason, Filippo (Stefano Accorsi), who has been working in the anti-mafia office for years, is sent to help the members of the cooperative. Unprepared to face the issue "on the field", Filippo will find himself facing obstacles and fears that will increase when Nicola is granted house arrest.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Sergio Rubini, Tommaso Ragno, Maria Rosaria Russo, Iaia Forte, Nicola Rignanese, Giovanni Calcagno, Silvio Laviano, Massimo Cagnina, Giovanni Esposito, Michel Leroy, Debora Caprioglio, Bebo Storti

title: La nostra vita
synopsis: A worker is struck by a devastating grief: the death of his wife who leaves him alone with their two children.
cast: Elio Germano, Raoul Bova, Luca Zingaretti, Isabella Ragonese, Stefania Montorsi, Giorgio Colangeli, Awa Ly, Alina Madalina Berzunteanu, Marius Ignat, Emiliano Campagnola

title: La note bleue
synopsis: 1846. In a country villa, George Sand and Fryderyk Chopin spend a summer like many others, together with several friends, including Delacroix, Turgenev and Dumas the son. Secretly, in the course of the day, Chopin discovers the love of George's daughter, Solange, which fails to materialize, while, from the countryside, mysterious shadows appear, and Fryderyk is torn apart by his perennial illness, consumption, which does not prevent him. but to compose excessively all the time.
cast: Janusz Olejniczak, Marie France Pisier, Sophie Marceau, Noemi Nadelmann

title: La nottata
synopsis: Two unscrupulous Milanese girls met by chance in a toilet where they found a very precious jewel. They would like to sell it and for this they rely on a taxi driver who accompanies them in the slums in search of a fence. But the buyer is found dead.
cast: Sara Sperati, Susanna Javicoli, Giorgio Albertazzi

title: La notte brava
synopsis: It all happens overnight. Two burgatari, Scintillone and Ruggeretto make a theft and soon after they get their money stolen by two prostitutes. After trying in vain to track down the occasional companions they try to make up for another theft: they try to steal a camera from a car, but the owner intervenes with two friends and ends up in a fight. All together, at the end of the quarrel, they go to celebrate in the villa of the rich man victim of the theft. The two scoundrels still steal: they appropriate two hundred thousand lire.
cast: Jean Claude Brialy, Rosanna Schiaffino, Elsa Martinelli, Laurent Terzieff, Franco Interlenghi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Tomas Milian, Mylène Demongeot, Antonella Lualdi, Maurizio Conti

title: La notte breve
synopsis: After twenty-five years, the lawyer Lara Degli Esposti finds the son she had abandoned at birth. A murder puts mother and child on the same path. A simple bonfire on the beach turns, unbeknownst to everyone, into a tragedy. After a fight between Barbara and Fausto, the girl disappears and is found, dead, the next morning. The young man is the prime suspect, as the last to have seen her. Fausto's family hires Lara as a lawyer who, from this moment on, has to deal with Giulio Lensi, the commissioner in charge of investigations and his partner for three years. Giulio is adamant, even when Matteo, Lara's son, gets involved in the affair. Meanwhile, during a robbery, the inspector is wounded in the head and goes into a coma, leaving Lara alone to prove the innocence of Fausto and her newly found son.
cast: Giuliana De Sio, Enrico Silvestrin, Giuseppe Sanfelice, Emiliano Coltorti, Francesca Romana Messere, Camilla Filippi, Anna Maria Ghirardelli, Maria Paiato, Antonella Laganà, Marco Di Stefano

title: La notte che Evelyn uscì dalla tomba
synopsis: In his castle, Sir Alan Cunnigham is haunted by the memory of his wife Evelyn, whom he himself had killed after catching her in bed with another. Therefore, it regularly hosts red-haired prostitutes that it kills with brutality. Low-grade Italic horror.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Marina Malfatti, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: La notte dei dannati
synopsis: Jean, a journalist known for his skill in solving puzzles, receives a message from his friend Guillame of Saint-Lambert. The prince makes him understand that he is in danger. Going to the noble's castle, he learns that Guillame, dying and assisted by his wife, is hit by a curse. All members of his family died at the age of 35. Searching through his papers, Jean discovers that three centuries earlier a Saint-Lambert had sent a witch to the stake.
cast: Pierre Brice, Patrizia Viotti, Angela De Leo, Mario Carra

title: La notte dei diavoli
synopsis: Nicola discovers what arcane spell transforms the peasants of a rural area into grim living dead. A witch's hand is involved, but no one believes the bizarre truth. Thus Nicola finds himself marginalized by everyone, then locked up in an asylum, where in the grip of delirium he will kill his girlfriend.
cast: Gianni Garko, Agostina Belli, Mark Roberts, Cinzia De Carolis

title: La notte dei serpenti
synopsis: The mayor, the hotelier, a prostitute, the sexton and even the lieutenant of the local police: everyone in the Mexican village plots against the orphan Manuel to whom his father bequeathed ten thousand dollars. Luke is hired to eliminate the intended victim (without knowing that he is predestined to hang, so as not to arouse suspicion). Instead, things are completely different. The attempt to revive a worn-out pattern with complicated gimmicks proves insufficient to save the film. Not at all enjoyable example of spaghetti-western.
cast: Luke Askew, Luigi Pistilli, Magda Konopka, Chelo Alonso

title: La notte dell'alta marea
cast: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Anthony Steel, Annie Belle, Hugo Pratt, Pam Grier

title: La notte di Pasquino
synopsis: In Rome, in September 1870, the statues "speak": to give them a voice, addressing pungent anticlerical rhymes addressed in particular to the powerful Cardinal Renzi and his henchmen, is the mysterious epigrammist Pasquino. In the turn of the same night, Pasquino will be involved both in the search for a child kidnapped from the Jewish ghetto and in the rescue of the young revolutionary Andrea. This will put him in conflict with none other than Prince Galeazzo della Gensola, Renzi's cousin and instigator of the kid's kidnapping: with the help of Andrea and Jenny, an American painter already a lover of Galeazzo, Pasquino will try to get out of the way. .
cast: Nino Manfredi, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Giovanni Lombardo Radice, Giacomo Piperno, Antonia Liskova, Giacomo Gonnella

title: La notte di San Lorenzo
synopsis: The night of San Lorenzo is that of August 10, when the stars fall and wishes are expressed. The story unfolds around this day and the facts narrated really happened: the authors themselves were protagonists in childhood. We are in 1944, and the Tuscan town of San Miniato is occupied by the Germans in the mood for reprisals; a group of peasants sets out to escape the encirclement. Despite the atrocity of the war, the story is seen with the dreamy eyes of children, while the landscapes of the Tuscan countryside are of fundamental importance in the articulation of the story. The film won many awards, including the Grand Jury Prize at Cannes.
cast: Omero Antonutti, Margarita Lozano, Claudio Bigagli, Dario Cantarelli, Massimo Bonetti, Norma Martelli, Enrica Maria Modugno, Sabina Vannucchi, Paolo Hendel, Antonio Prester, Laura Mannucchi, Rinaldo Mirannalti

title: La notte e il momento
synopsis: A writer, who is fame of great seducer, is invited by a French noblewoman in his castle. In the evening, when the other guests retired to their rooms, the writer shows up in the Marquise Chamber. From that moment on, a series of amorous skirmishes, of fertilizers and denials, of stories begins. From the novel of the same name of Crébillon Fils, screenplay by Jean-Claude Carrière, photography by Giuseppe Rotunno, editing of Ruggero Mastroianni, Music by Morricone. More Dafoe, Lena Olin, Miranda Richardson. Everything is of a unique boredom.
cast: Willem Dafoe, Lena Olin, Miranda Richardson, Jean Claude Carrière

title: La notte non fa più paura
synopsis: The earthquake in Emilia was above all the earthquake of the factories; the dead were for the most part the workers: people who came from the south, from abroad or from the province itself, people buried alive in the rubble of warehouses, industries, factories. They paid the highest price in the earthquake in Emilia. From this reflection, the story of the already precarious, frustrating and tiring life of four young people and a generation destroyed by an earthquake is born. The earthquake has been in their lives before and destroys them later.
cast: Giorgio Colangeli, Stefano Muroni, Walter Cordopatri, Valeria Romanelli, Silvana Spina, Rosario Petix, Ivan Alovisio, Piero Cardano

title: La notte più lunga dell'anno
synopsis: In the long night of the winter solstice in Potenza four stories are intertwined: a politician one step away from the abyss, a cubist who decided to change his life, a boy involved in a relationship with a woman much bigger than him and three twenty -year -olds without ambitions in search of strong emotions. In the background, Sergio's tired and benevolent gaze, the elderly petrol station that -in the open refueling station all night -wakes on this small world. Fifteen hours of uninterrupted darkness in which human destiny becomes exceptional, since the night makes the anchoring of the day lose and the events suddenly suffer an acceleration.
cast: Mimmo Mignemi, Ambra Angiolini, Luigi Fedele, Francesco Di Napoli, Michele Eburnea, Nicolò Galasso, Massimo Popolizio, Alessandro Haber, Anna Ammirati, Antonio Petrocelli, Massimo De Francovich, Aglaia Mora, Matteo Carlomagno, Pascal Zullino

title: La notte è piccola per noi
synopsis: In a large ballroom, a band plays live while the stories of the patrons cross over during the evening: a woman in her fifties awaits her man, after years of separation; a man and a woman had a blind date after months of chat but both lied about many things, starting with age; a boxer, now in disgrace, wishes to conquer the singer of the group; a father of a family, intent on celebrating the wedding anniversary with his wife and children, sees with little pleasure a marshal of the carabinieri, his old acquaintance; six professors celebrate their change of role; an eighty-year-old couple is struggling with a crisis of jealousy.
cast: Michela Andreozzi, Francesca Antonelli, Cristiana Capotondi, Riccardo De Filippis, Tommaso Lazotti, Barbara Livi, Teresa Mannino, Lucrezia Paulis, Francesco Pizzuti, Francesca Reggiani, Ruben Rigillo, Rino Rodio, Andrea Sartoretti, Thony, Giselda Volodi, Alessandra Panaro, Philippe Leroy

title: La novia esangrentada
cast: Simon Andreu, Alexandra Bastedo, Monteserrat Julió, Maribel Martín, Ángel Lombarte

title: La nuit a dévoré le monde
synopsis: One morning, when Sam wakes up in the apartment where a party was held the day before, he has to face reality: he is alone and the streets of Paris are full of living dead. Terrified, he will have to protect and organize himself to continue surviving. However, he may not be alone in escaping the pandemic.
cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Golshifteh Farahani, Denis Lavant, Sigrid Bouaziz

title: La nuit américaine
synopsis: Director Ferrand is shooting the film _This is Pamela_ in the studios of the Victorine in Nice. The subject is based on the story of a young Englishwoman just married to an equally young boy. The woman ends up falling in love with her father-in-law, who after running away with her is killed by her betrayed son. The private stories of the protagonists are intertwined with the making of the film.
cast: François Truffaut, Jacqueline Bisset, Valentina Cortese, Jean Pierre Léaud, Jean Pierre Aumont, Dani, Alexandra Stewart, Jean Champion, Nike Arrighi, Nathalie Baye, Bernard Menez

title: La nuit de Varennes
synopsis: It is June 21, 1791 and a group of nobles find themselves traveling in diligence the stretch of road between Paris and Verdun where, just a few hours earlier, Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette were captured by the Jacobins. The stagecoach is in fact stopped in Varennes, where the royal family is kept under arrest. None of the passengers understand that they are witnessing a fact that marks the end of an era. Two years later some wanderers show the images of that day with a "world niovo", that is one of the many ancestors of the cinema.
cast: Michel Piccoli, Jean Louis Barrault, Marcello Mastroianni, Hanna Schygulla

title: La nuit des rois
synopsis: A young man is sent to La Maca, a prison in the middle of the Ivorian forest ruled by his prisoners. As the red moon rises, he is designated by the Chief as the new "Roman" and must tell a story to the other prisoners. Learning what fate awaits him under the rules of La Maca, Roman has no choice but to make his story last until dawn.
cast: Koné Bakary, Steve Tientcheu, Rasmane Ouedraogo, Issaka Sawadogo, Digbeu Jean Cyrille, Abdoul Karim Konaté

title: La nuit des étoiles filantes
synopsis: A young London woman arrives at an isolated castle to visit relatives she hasn't seen for some time and to read her father's will. After a while she discovers that everyone is actually dead and her decision to live with them turns into a nightmare. Unable to run away, he will find himself at the center of a macabre world of satanic rituals and sacrifices.
cast: Christina Von Blanc, Britt Nichols, Rosa Palomar, Anne Libert, Howard Vernon, Jesús Franco, Paul Muller
director: Jesús Franco, Jean Rollin, Pierre Quérut

title: La nuit du 12
synopsis: One day Yohan, who works in the judicial police and has just become the head of the criminal brigade of Grenoble, comes across a case that seems to hit him particularly, even if he does not understand the reason. To investigate this crime, relating to the death of a certain Clara, Yohan gets help from a colleague named Marceau.
cast: Bouli Lanners, Anouk Grinberg, Bastien Bouillon, Mouna Soualem, Pauline Serieys, Sylvain Baumann, Alexandre Ionescu

title: La nuit du carrefour
cast: Pierre Renoir, Georges Térof, Winna Winifried, Georges Koudria

title: La nuit où j'ai nagé
synopsis: Snow covers the mountains of Japan. Each night, a fisherman makes his way to the town market. The departure wakes the six-year-old son, so it is then impossible to go back to sleep. In the house shrouded in silence, the child draws a drawing which he then puts in his folder. On his way to school, still asleep, he moves away from his path and enters the snow, towards the city.
cast: Kogawa Takara, Kogawa Keiki, Kogawa Takashi, Kogawa Chisato

title: La nuora giovane
synopsis: Franco, a wealthy Don Juan entrepreneur, has problems with his wife and for this reason he approaches his young and uninhibited daughter-in-law. The son, in turn, seduces the sister-in-law ...
cast: Simonetta Stefanelli, Philippe Leroy, Maurizio Bonuglia, Didi Perego, Marcel Dalio, Renzo Montagnani

title: La orca
synopsis: Plot in preparation
cast: Rena Niehaus, Gabriele Ferzetti, Flavio Bucci, Carmen Scarpitta, Bruno Corazzari, Piero Faggioni, Piero Palermini, Michele Placido, Miguel Bosé, Otello Toso, Jacopo Tecchi, Vittorio Valsecchi, Enzo Consoli

title: La otra
cast: Dolores Del Rio, Agustín Irusta, Victor Junco, José Baviera

title: La pacifista
synopsis: Barbara, a politically disengaged television journalist who professes to be a pacifist, carries out her work in a city in turmoil due to youth protest and the violence of extremists on the other. The woman is the victim of a gang of motorcyclists who, during a service, snatch the recorder from her hand and burn her car. But Barbara is troubled by the mysterious and dark presence of a young man who follows her everywhere, suddenly appearing and disappearing.
cast: Monica Vitti, Pierre Clementi, Peter Pasetti, Piero Faggioni

title: La pagella
synopsis: Gennarino, all ten in the report card for the repetitions of the good Amelia, is killed during the robbery in the goldsmith's shop where dad was about to buy him a gift: a watch. Dad is Salvatore, a good mechanic and friend of Inspector Saliani. Shocked by what happened, Salvatore ends up in a crazy ride of big motorcycles to be rigged at the head of which (but Salvatore doesn't know) is Angelo, Gennarino's killer. Scripted genre, it is a bloodless imitation of the films with Mario Merola directed by Alfonso Brescia. Good feelings and little melodrama.
cast: Mario Trevi, Marc Porel, Massimo Deda, Rosalia Maggio, Marisa Laurito

title: La palestra
synopsis: The Beautiful Center is a sports center equipped with every comfort: gym, swimming pool, sauna and turkish bath. Between the treadmills and an aerobics class takes place the story of the actress Angela who has an affair with her producer Bonetti, Liuba's husband. The woman, in turn, has an affair with her aerobics instructor, Michel who is engaged to Valentina, the beautiful Latin American dance teacher. All under the eyes of Maurizio, manager of the club and of his nephew Luca who has literally lost his mind to an unreachable star.
cast: Valeria Marini, Andrea Roncato, Pamela Prati, Jean Michel Danquin, Francesca Nunzi

title: La paranza dei bambini
synopsis: Naples 2018. Six 15-year-olds - Nicola, Tyson, Biscottino, Lollipop, O'Russ, Briatò - want to make money, buy designer clothes and new scooters. They play with weapons and ride scooters to conquer power in the Rione Sanità. With the illusion of bringing justice to the neighborhood, they pursue good through evil. They are like brothers, they do not fear prison or death, and they know that the only possibility is to gamble everything, immediately. In the unconsciousness of their age they live in war and the criminal life will lead them to an irreversible choice: the sacrifice of love and friendship.
cast: Francesco Di Napoli, Ar Tem Tkachuk, Viviana Aprea, Pasquale Marotta, Mattia Piano Del Balzo, Ciro Vecchione, Ciro Pellecchia, Alfredo Turitto, Luca Nacarlo, Carmine Pizzo

title: La parmigiana
synopsis: Dora lives with an uncle who is a priest. He seduces a seminarian on vacation and then goes with him to Riccione. Thus begins a sentimental pilgrimage that leads her into the arms of several men. When he decides to return with the one he really feels a little love for, he discovers that it is being maintained by an older woman. Dora then chooses the path of prostitution.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Nino Manfredi, Didi Perego, Salvo Randone, Lando Buzzanca

title: La parola amore esiste
synopsis: Angela is thirty years old, she is rich, neurotic and unfriendly and is looking for love that is able to put an end to all her phobias. The mother, a refined upper-class woman, endures the whims of her daughter who seems to have found in Marco, a cellist, the love of her life. The only problem is that he, in his forties, separated and the father of a fifteen-year-old girl, didn't notice anything.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Gérard Depardieu, Marina Confalone

title: La parrucchiera
synopsis: Rosa is a beautiful girl from the Spanish districts of Naples who works in Lello and Patrizia's hairdressing shop. Lello is attracted to her to the point of obsession but, when the advances become too heavy, Rosa is forced to run away and quit. Patrizia, who has always considered Rosa as a daughter, feels betrayed and takes her husband's side, leaving the girl without a job. At this point Rosa, with the help of her best friends Micaela, a passionate and enterprising woman, and Carla, a sensitive and maternal transsexual, attempted the great challenge of opening her own salon. Dreams soon come true: Rosa's shop not only establishes itself but even rivales that of Lello and Patrizia, and Salvatore, who has always been her great love, also reappears in the girl's life. Things seem to be going for the best, until a mysterious event changes the fate of the salon and their lives. That will be the moment when Rosa, her friends and Patrizia herself will really show what heart the women of Naples have.
cast: Massimiliano Gallo, Pina Turco, Cristina Donadio, Arturo Muselli, Lucianna De Falco, Stefania Zambrano, Francesco Borragine, Giorgio Pinto, Tony Tammaro

title: La part du soupçon
synopsis: Alice lives a normally happy life, until her partner, the love of his life Thomas as well as father of his son, is not suspected of being none other than Antoine Durieux-Jelosse, the man who fifteen years earlier has made news and caused a sensation to disappear after killing his whole family.
cast: Kad Merad, Laurence Arné, Géraldine Pailhas, Gaspard Pasquet, Aladin Reibel, Jean Philippe Puymartin, Julie Anne Roth, Raphaël Quenard, Steve Achiepo, Isa Mercure, Vincent Berger, Ludmila Mikhailova, Mustapha Abourachid, Martine Coste, Léonore Confino, Olivier Faliez, Sylvette Le Nevé, Damien Le Délézir

title: La partida
synopsis: In Cuba, young Reiner is obsessed with the need to look after his child, his teenage wife and his wife's grandmother, and to raise money he works as a rented boy. When in his Havana neighborhood he falls in love with Yosvani, a football partner, Reiner finds himself living a situation that is new but at the same time difficult for him. As Yosvani is engaged to the daughter of a delinquent moneylender, the two soon have to fight hard to survive on the streets of the city and lead their life together.
cast: Toni Cantó, Mirta Ibarra, Luis Alberto Garcia, Milton García, Reinier Diaz

title: La partita
synopsis: We are in 1700 in Venice. After a long exile, the noble Francesco Sacredo returns to the city. Thus he learns that all the huge family fortune has been lost in the game by his father in grueling games with the Countess Matilde Von Wallenstein. The countess, who fell in love with the young Francesco, offers him a pact: to gamble all the assets, in exchange for the total availability of his life in case of loss. The Vanzinas try to get out of the realm of comedy, and adapt an adventure novel by Alberto Ongaro. The result is pure kitsch, which burns a luxury cast.
cast: Matthew Modine, Jennifer Beals, Faye Dunaway, Corinne Cléry

title: La partita
synopsis: Claudio, a coach who has never won, is the coach of a football team of boys from the outskirts of Rome of which Antonio is the captain and spearhead. The boy, a footballer convinced that he dreams of Serie A, will find himself having to choose what kind of man to be. The father, in fact, has staked a large sum on the result of the last game of the championship, asking Antonio to give him a hand to collect the winnings. But also Italo, the president of the company, has bet his entire life on that same final. Thus, the economic future of the boy's family, that of the sports club and the very life of many people will be played in a fatal game.
cast: Francesco Pannofino, Alberto Di Stasio, Gabriele Fiore, Giorgio Colangeli, Fabrizio Sabatucci, Stefano Ambrogi, Lidia Vitale, Veruska Rossi

title: La pasión turca
synopsis: Desideria Oliván, aka Desi, has everything she wants from life, a caring husband, a nice house in Huesca and good friends. The only flaw in her relationship is a rather lukewarm sex life. During a vacation in Istanbul with his life partner, Desi has a hot relationship with Yaman, the tour guide who has the task of accompanying them on excursions. The woman, stunned by passion, does not realize that by relying body and soul on Yaman she will be dragged into a sea of ??troubles.
cast: Ana Belén, Georges Corraface, Ramon Madaula, Silvia Munt

title: La passante du Sans Souci
synopsis: Max Baumstein, industrialist and president of an organization for the protection of human rights, kills the ambassador of Paraguay. Max's wife and collaborators are shocked, but at the trial - where Max pleads guilty - the truth emerges: the ambassador was a former Nazi officer who had persecuted Jews, including Max and his family. And Nazism is not dead yet. It is the latest film starring Romy Schneider. Too bad that the realization, while not effective, is also a bit messed up.
cast: Michel Piccoli, Romy Schneider, Helmut Griem, Mathieu Carrière, Wendelin Werner, Gerard Klein, Dominique Labourier, Maria Schell

title: La passeggiata
synopsis: Paolo Barbato is a young provincial who moves to Rome to teach the National College. On the Janiculum he accidentally meets a young girl of life with whom he falls madly in love. Despite learning of the young woman's not blameless conduct, Paolo clumsily tries to redeem her, ending up making a fool of himself with his work colleagues and arousing the anger of his direct superior, who decides to fire him. For his directorial debut Rascel chooses a short story by Gogol, but it is a task beyond his strength.
cast: Renato Rascel, Valentina Cortese, Giuseppe De Martino, Enzo Maggio

title: La passion de Jeanne d'Arc
synopsis: Accused of heresy, Joan of Arc appears before the ecclesiastical tribunal. At the end of interrogations and torture, Giovanna gives in and signs the abjuration: but then withdrawn and therefore sentenced to death. Her hair is cut, the stake awaits her. But when the flames rise, the crowd rises ...
cast: Renée Falconetti, Eugène Sylvain, Antonin Artaud, Michel Simon

title: La passione
synopsis: After fifty years, being an emerging director becomes a problem. Gianni Dubois, who hasn't made a film in years, knows something about it, and now that he would have the chance to direct a young TV star, he can't come up with a story. In addition, a water leak in his apartment in Tuscany has ruined a fresco of the sixteenth century in the adjacent church. To avoid a complaint, Gianni must accept the bizarre proposal of the mayor of the town: to direct the sacred representation of Good Friday in exchange for impunity. So he finds himself spending a week in the deepest Tuscany trying to set up a kind of Via Crucis, with the apostles, Pontius Pilate, the crucifixion and a bad local actor in the part of Christ.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Cristiana Capotondi, Kasia Smutniak, Stefania Sandrelli, Giuseppe Battiston, Corrado Guzzanti, Marco Messeri, Djibril Kébé

title: La passione di Anna Magnani
synopsis: The parable of the legendary actress Anna Magnani is retraced through archival films, often unpublished, which allow you to immerse themselves in the history of Italian cinema.

title: La passione di Giosuè l'ebreo
synopsis: In 1492 Queen Isabella expelled Jews and Muslims from Spain, which she wanted Catholic. The anti-Jewish hatred crosses all of Europe and the young Giosuè with his family takes refuge in Naples and then in Sicily, where he lives in a village of Jews forced to convert to Catholicism and where his erudition and his mystical tension they lead to inevitable sacrifice.
cast: Anna Bonaiuto, Leonardo Cesare Abude, Marcello Mazzarella

title: La patata bollente
synopsis: Worker and trade unionist in the Enicem factory, Bernardo Mambelli is the spokesperson for his colleagues at the superiors, by whom he is particularly esteemed. One day he saves a certain Claudio from a beating by neo-fascists and takes him to his house. Claudio, however, is a homosexual and this wreaks havoc in Bernardo's life: the neighbors suspect him, his colleagues mock him. His fiancée marries him to silence the gossips.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Edwige Fenech, Massimo Ranieri

title: La pattuglia sperduta
synopsis: We are in March 1849, when Carlo Alberto is about to resume the war against the Austrians. Volunteers from all over Italy arrive in Piedmont determined to fight for independence from Austria. On the morning of March 20, a patrol is cut off in enemy territory, while the battle of Novara is about to begin: a dangerous adventure that will last three days and will end on the field where it was bitterly fought.
cast: Sandro Isola, Giuseppe Aprà, Giorgio Luzzatti, Annibale Biglioni

title: La paura
synopsis: Irene has a husband with whom she works, a lover, a blackmailer and an underlying anguish that threatens to lead her to suicide.
cast: Ingrid Bergman, Mathias Wieman, Renate Mannhardt, Kurt Kreuger

title: La paura fa 90
synopsis: Carlo Maltivoglio, singer in a magazine company, is forced to spend a night in a castle. Carletto does not know that the manor is inhabited by the ghost of the Duke of Boffignac, captain of the king's musketeers, killed by a betrayed husband. The ectoplasm is doomed to roam forever until it avenges its violent death. The comedian of the company, having learned of the story, disguises himself as a ghost and at midnight precisely makes his appearance in the halls of the castle. Unfortunately for her, she runs into the real ghost ...
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Silvana Pampanini, Franca Marzi, Carlo Croccolo

title: La paura numero uno
synopsis: A man lives obsessed with the fear of the third world war, to the point that he does not even leave his daughter Evelina to get married to his beloved Mariano. The man's wife, with a stratagem, makes him believe that the conflict has burst, so that he finally relaxes and agrees at the wedding. To which, however, Mariano's mother is now opposed, also convinced of the outbreak of the war.
cast: Eduardo De Filippo, Luisa Conte, Maria Teresa Lauri, Carla Comaschi, Carlo Giuffrè, Lida Ferro, Glauco Onorato, Clara Bindi, Orazio Orlando, Maria D'Ajala

title: La pazza della porta accanto - Conversazione con Alda Merini
synopsis: Alda Merini tells about her life, oscillating between public and private and dwelling on the most significant chapters of her existence: childhood, femininity, loves, motherhood and the relationship with children, madness and lucid reflection on poetry and on art. The poet's face and the details of her eyes, hands and body make up a portrait that does not hide the contradictions of one of the most important and well-known literary figures of the twentieth century.
cast: Alda Merini

title: La pazza gioia
synopsis: Beatrice is a self-styled countess, talkative and billionaire, who likes to believe she is intimate with leaders around the world. Donatella is a young and quiet tattooed woman, closed in her own aura of mystery. Both are admitted to a mental institution and subject to pre-trial detention measures. Together they form an unpredictable friendship that leads them to escape the constraints of treatment for an adventure in search of fun and love in that open-air asylum that is the world of healthy people.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Micaela Ramazzotti, Valentina Carnelutti, Tommaso Ragno, Bob Messini, Sergio Albelli, Anna Galiena, Marisa Borini, Marco Messeri, Bobo Rondelli

title: La peau douce
synopsis: A writer falls madly in love with a beautiful hostess. For her he decides to leave his wife and children but the girl, instead of accepting a cohabitation, refuses him. The writer decides to return to his family. His wife, however, blinded by jealousy, causes a tragedy.
cast: Françoise Dorléac, Jean Desailly, Nelly Benedetti

title: La peccatrice
synopsis: Sicily, 1950s. The owner of a zolfatara harasses the employees in every way and especially Turi. His intention is to take away Debora, his beautiful black wife (whom the beguines of the city consider a witch).
cast: Zeudi Araya, Franco Gasparri, Ettore Manni, Clara Calamai, Francisco Rabal

title: La peccatrice
synopsis: Seduced and abandoned, she gives birth to a child who dies almost immediately. A young man is interested in her, but having known her past, she hunts. For her the world of vice opens up; only the death of an unfortunate companion will make her return home to her mother.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Paola Barbara, Gino Cervi, Fosco Giachetti

title: La pecora nera
synopsis: The figure of the honorable Mario Agosti is immaculate and untouchable. Much less that of his twin brother Filippo who, exploiting the similarity, manages to sneak into the world of politics and finance and combine excellent deals, while his brother Mario ends up in an asylum.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Lisa Gastoni, Adrienne La Russa

title: La pecora nera
synopsis: Nicola is a boy born in the "fabulous 60s": a difficult boy, a black sheep, with many problems at school and in life, due to the difficult family environment in which he grew up: a strict father, a closed mother with psychiatric problems in an asylum and a peasant grandmother. Nicola will soon be considered crazy and, in his solitude, he just has to create an imaginary friend.
cast: Ascanio Celestini, Maya Sansa, Giorgio Tirabassi, Luisa De Santis, Barbara Valmorin, Nicola Rignanese, Luigi Fedele, Alessia Berardi, Alessandro Marverti, Mauro Marchetti

title: La peggior settimana della mia vita
synopsis: Against the backdrop of Lake Como, Paolo (Fabio De Luigi) and Margherita (Cristiana Capotondi) are waiting for the moment when they will finally be able to crown their dream of love with the fateful yes. Their wedding is now only a week away but, amid the chaos of the last preparations, they run the risk of ruining everything due to Paolo's extraordinary ability to transform any evidence of approaching future and rigid in-laws into disaster (Antonio Catania and Monica Guerritore), who do not take kindly to his being an eternal child and the overprotective nature of his daughter, always ready to find justifications for any eventuality. The father (Andrea Mingardi) and his best friend (Alessandro Siani) also complicate the precarious situation of the future husband.
cast: Fabio De Luigi, Cristiana Capotondi, Monica Guerritore, Alessandro Siani, Antonio Catania, Gisella Sofio, Nadir Caselli, Andrea Mingardi

title: La pelicula del Rey
synopsis: A director wants to bring to the screen the story of a man who in 1700 was proclaimed king of Patagonia by the Indians. As the man approaches the south of Argentina with the crew he remains alone. The producer steps away and with him the money. The filmmaker is thus forced to continue alone. Abandoned by everyone, even by the actors, he is forced to shoot in impossible conditions. In the end he plays the part of the adventurer himself, surrounded by mannequins who take the place of the actors.
cast: Ulisse Dumon, Julio Chavez, Villanueva Cosse

title: La pelle
synopsis: Based on one of Curzio Malaparte's most famous novels, it is the story of a descent into the hellish circles of Naples in '44. General Cork, commander of the American Fifth Army, is completely involved in negotiations with the Camorra Marzullo who demands a payment per kilo to deliver 112 Germans. The intermediary to conduct the negotiations is Curzio Malaparte who, to please the aviator wife of a senator, has to organize a sumptuous Renaissance-style dinner. Meanwhile, in the lowlands, mothers sell their children to Moroccans.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Burt Lancaster, Claudia Cardinale, Ken Marshall, Alexandra King, Carlo Giuffrè

title: La pelle dell'orso
synopsis: In the fifties, the introverted and wild Domenico lived in a small town in the Dolomites with his father Pietro, fifty years old consumed by loneliness and wine, who for a living does odd jobs employed by Toni Crepaz, an unscrupulous entrepreneur. The boy's relationship with his parent is harsh and difficult enough to make them seem like strangers. For some time the tranquility of the place has been severely tested by the presence in the valley of a ferocious bear that kills and inspires superstitious terror. One evening at the tavern, in a fit of pride, Pietro challenges Crepaz and declares that he will be the one to kill the bear in exchange for money. The following day, at dawn, Pietro sets off and Domenico decides to follow him. They immerse themselves in the woods, deeper and deeper, until they are inevitably transformed.
cast: Marco Paolini, Leonardo Mason, Lucia Mascino, Maria Paiato, Paolo Pierobon, Mirko Artuso, Valerio Mazzucato, Giuliana Musso, Silvio Comis, Massimo Totola

title: La perfezionista
synopsis: Giselda eats a green apple every day at the same time, she doesn't arrive late, she always orders tea in the same bar and tries to foresee everything, even her funeral. Unfortunately she does not foresee the disease affecting her husband ...
cast: Aurora Mascheretti, Rinaldo Rocco, Alessandra Ventimiglia, Luigi Grilli, Sandra Milo

title: La perla
cast: Pedro Armendariz, María Elena Marqués, Fernando Wagner

title: La permanence
synopsis: The director Alice Diop spends a year at the service of asylum seekers at the Avicenne Hospital, near Paris. Reduced to a state of both physical and mental exhaustion, applicants are often traumatized by what they lived and come to be cured with medicines and with a little human comfort.

title: La petite Lili
synopsis: Summer on an island in Brittany. Lili, a young actress, leaves Julien, a boy studying to become a director with whom Jeanne-Marie is in love, to throw herself into the arms of Brice, an established director. The latter then leaves Mado, an actress who remains faithful to him.
cast: Ludivine Sagnier, Nicole Garcia, Bernard Giraudeau, Jean Pierre Marielle, Robinson Stévenin, Julie Depardieu

title: La petite apocalypse
synopsis: A party is taking place in Barbara's and Henri's house, during which the couple's friends and former petitioners who have shared the years of protest meet. The most intimate of the couple is Jacques, known to all by the nickname of Jack, then one of the busiest, while today he is undoubtedly the most nostalgic. Between one course and the next, Stan, a Polish emigrant, Barbara's first husband, mistakenly considered by all to be an aspiring suicide, also appears.
cast: Jiri Menzel, Pierre Arditi, André Dussollier, Chiara Caselli, Anna Romantowska

title: La petite vendeuse du soleil
synopsis: From time immemorial the sale of newspapers on the streets of Dakar has been in the hands of very young newsboys, children of the many unemployed in the popular neighborhoods. Sili is a twelve-year-old girl, forced to walk with the help of crutches. She and her friends beg and sell magazines and newspapers to passers-by, but one day they are "ousted" by a group of boys. Pushed, Sili falls to the ground. She feels humiliated, laughed at, but she doesn't give up. And the next day she makes the decision: she alone will sell the newspapers on that street corner.
cast: Lissa Baléra, Tairou M'Baye, Oumy Samb

title: La petite voleuse
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Didier Bezace, Simon De La Brosse, Clotilde De Bayser

title: La pianiste
synopsis: In an attempt to escape from her obsessive mother, Erika Kohut - a woody and super-bourgeois piano teacher from Vienna - attends porn halls and peep shows, unleashing a sexuality made of voyeurism and sadomasochistic perversions. Walter, a young and talented student of hers, takes it into her head to seduce her ...
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Annie Girardot, Benoît Magimel, Susanne Lothar

title: La piazza della mia città - Bologna e Lo Stato Sociale
synopsis: Bologna, June 2018. The concert in Piazza Maggiore of Lo Stato Sociale, the band that brought the Italian indie to the Sanremo Festival. Designed from the stages of the whole country, the group proves to be in a documentary directed by Paolo Santamaria, telling of its precious relationship with the square and the magic city that moves around. Among the interviews with characters such as Matilda De Angelis, Gianni Morandi and Luis Sal, combined with archive images selected by the Bolognese directors Mellara and Rossi, music becomes the protagonist of an unforgettable show at the center of one of the most iconic squares in Italy. In the background, the red city that transforms and teems with life.

title: La piel que habito
synopsis: Plastic surgeon Ledgard (Antonio Banderas) lost his wife in a fire caused by a car accident and spends 12 years experimenting with a type of synthetic leather that could have saved her. To achieve his goal he has no qualms about overcoming the ethical limit of transgenesis, even if this will not be his only crime.
cast: Antonio Banderas, Elena Anaya, Marisa Paredes, Blanca Suárez, Eduard Fernández, Fernando Cayo, José Luis Gomez, Jan Cornet, Bárbara Lennie, Isabel Blanco

title: La pietà di novembre
synopsis: Luca is an ambitious young man. If desired in everyone's memories, he tries to kill a famous man.
cast: Giorgio Albertazzi, Anna Proclemer, Diana Torrieri, Augusto Mastrantoni, Carlo Sabatini

title: La pioggia che non cade
synopsis: The Roman songwriter-folk band of the Inverso is composed of the voice Carlo (also guitarist and piano), the bassist Vincenzo, the drummer and percussionist Mauro, the accordionist Simone, the saxophonist Enzo and the cellist Anna. At the end of one of their usual concerts in the clubs of the city, the Inverso are noticed by Luca, who offers them to enter the "important" musical environment. Despite appearing skeptical, the boys set the date that could change their life forever, even if it involves some risk in the sentimental sphere.
cast: Carlo Picone, Anna Russo, Mauro Fiore, Vincenzo Picone, Simone Pletto, Vincenzo Citriniti, Viviana Colais, Francesca Nunzi, Elisabetta Ventura, Angela Curri, Lucia Centorame, Philippe Guastella, Marco Paparella

title: La pirate
synopsis: Torn between love for her husband Andrew and a never-subsided passion for another woman, Carol, Alma oscillates between the two objects of her desire, unable to escape her own suffering. Not even escape seems to remedy it.
cast: Jane Birkin, Philippe Léotard, Maruschka Detmers, Andrew Birkin

title: La piscine
synopsis: Jean Paul, a failed writer, spends a few days of vacation in a luxurious villa with his partner Marianne, a journalist. Harry, an old friend of Jean Paul's, arrives with his 18-year-old daughter, Penelope. Thanks to a party, a couple game begins in which the mature Harry woos Marianne with some chance and Jean Paul, perhaps out of spite, becomes interested in Penelope. However, it is the latter who soon leads the dance until Jean Paul and Harry collide to death. In the end, only three leave the villa as the police investigate an accident that could be a crime. The film has some limitations. Eighteen-year-old Jane Birkin, no.
cast: Alain Delon, Romy Schneider, Jane Birkin, Maurice Ronet, Paul Crauchet

title: La pivellina
synopsis: Little Asia, only two years old, is abandoned in a park and found by Patti, a circus artist who lives with her husband Saabel in a camping area in San Basilio, on the outskirts of Rome. With the help of Tairo, a boy who lives with his grandmother in a nearby camper, Patti sets out to look for the girl's mother, who in the meantime stays with her and Saabel.
cast: Patrizia Gerardi, Walter Saabel, Tairo Caroli, Asia Crippa

title: La più bella coppia del mondo
synopsis: Due to a misunderstanding Walter and Paola, presenters of the Cantagiro, are given up for secretly married. Both of them would like to deny it, but Paola has a fiery Sicilian suitor she wants to get rid of while Walter could sign a fabulous advertising contract as long as he is ... married. The fiction goes on like this, between smiles in public and furious quarrels in private between the two presenters who, in reality, hate each other.
cast: Walter Chiari, Paola Quattrini, Aldo Giuffré, Fracesco Mulè, Elio Pandolfi

title: La più bella del reame
synopsis: In a hotel in Deauville, Marina Ripa di Meana (Alt) is typing a book about her life. With this pretext, we are witnessing an anthology of spicy episodes that come from his past: from a sleeping car to a swimming pool to a bathtub. The only emotional relationship that is not here is that with Jeremy (Finch), an elderly homosexual. The film is based on the book of the same name written by Marina herself. Or rather, it is based on two things: the presence of Carol Alt and the scandal that normally accompanies the name of Ripa di Meana ex Lante della Rovere. Critics generally lash out (with good reason) against this type of film, but in this case, the audience wasn't enthusiastic either.
cast: Carol Alt, Jon Finch, Sergio Vastano, Mirella Banti, Helmut Berger

title: La più bella serata della mia vita
synopsis: The Italian industrialist Alfredo Rossi is in Switzerland to illegally deposit a large sum in a local bank. The bank is closed, and not finding any open hotels, he obtains hospitality in a castle, with four retired magistrates. They set up, partly as a joke, partly not, a fake trial against Rossi, guilty of killing his predecessor in the company. Based on a good short story by Dürrenmatt, Scola's film is full of ambitions that it can only partially support. Too bad, if only for the excellent quartet of old French glories in the parts of the judges.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Michel Simon, Charles Vanel, Claude Dauphin, Pierre Brasseur

title: La più grande avventura di Ufo Robot: Goldrake all'attacco
synopsis: Duke Fleed, star prince in exile, fights the invaders of Vega who want to invade the Earth, helped by his space robot Grendizer and his faithful friend Alcor / Koji Kabuto.

title: La più grande rapina del West
synopsis: A gang organizes a bank robbery with a tally of half a million dollars. Thanks to the collaboration of a false clergyman, the coup succeeds perfectly and the group finds themselves in a city near Mexico which, waiting for a guide, the bandits take control. A sheriff tries to stop them but leaves us the feathers, his brother will decide to avenge him by allying himself with the leader of the gang who would like the whole loot for himself.
cast: George Hilton, Hunt Powers, Walter Barnes, Sarah Ross, Erika Blanc

title: La poison
synopsis: Exasperated by an alcoholic, vulgar and filthy consort, Paul Braconnier turns to lawyer Aubanel, pretending to have already eliminated the hag and asking him to find the appropriate legal quibbles. Then take action ...
cast: Michel Simon, Germaine Reuver, Jean Debucourt, Jeanne Fusier Gir

title: La polizia accusa: il Servizio Segreto uccide
synopsis: A series of tragic deaths that could be linked. Apparently random accidents, the disappearance of a major, a colonel and a general are the subject of a careful investigation by Commissioner Solmi. Who, helped by a journalist friend, manages to connect the various clues and to compose the puzzle by putting the various tiles one after the other. His investigation leads him to verify the existence of a clandestine training camp with which the Secret Services are involved.
cast: Luc Merenda, Mel Ferrer, Delia Boccardo, Paola Tedesco

title: La polizia brancola nel buio
synopsis: A model is killed in a villa where she was called for a service by the owner, a physically handicapped and rather ugly individual. Giorgio, a journalist and friend of the victim, goes to the scene of the crime to discover the culprit who is not, as everything would suggest, the frustrated landlord.
cast: Joseph Arkim, Francisco Cortez, Richard Fielding, Gabriella Giorgelli, Elena Veronese

title: La polizia chiede aiuto
synopsis: Silvia, a girl in desperation, is found hanged in the attic behind an anonymous report. At first it seems that the girl committed suicide, but some elements in the hands of Commissioner Valentini and his colleague Silvestri make the investigation take another turn. Silvia was induced to do so by her exploiters who ran a ring in which the daughter of Commissioner Valentini also seems to be involved. At the head of the organization there seems to be Professor Beltrame ...
cast: Giovanna Ralli, Claudio Cassinelli, Mario Adorf, Franco Fabrizi

title: La polizia ha le mani legate
synopsis: In Milan, a bomb suddenly explodes in a hotel. Commissioner Rolandi begins to investigate managing to discover the identity of some of the characters involved, but these are let out of the scene just before being able to speak with Rolandi ...
cast: Claudio Cassinelli, Arthur Kennedy, Franco Fabrizi, Valeria D'Obici

title: La polizia incrimina, la legge assolve
synopsis: Between Genoa and Marseille, two rival gangs compete for drug trafficking. Inspector Belli is on their trail. He arrests "the Lebanese", but some hitmen kill him because he doesn't speak. Belli, suspecting that a well-known industrialist is hiding behind the traffic, asks his superior (who already has a rich dossier on the suspect) to be able to frame him.
cast: Franco Nero, Fernando Rey, Delia Boccardo, Silvano Tranquilli, James Whitmore

title: La polizia interviene: ordine di uccidere!
synopsis: Faced with the crime of two colleagues, Commissioner Murri wants to see clearly, because the situation is hot. He decides to conduct an investigation parallel to the official one and is convinced that behind the double murder there is a black plot that leads to the strategy of tension. Unbeknownst to him, the fascist organization also involves unsuspected characters.
cast: Leonard Mann, James Mason, Enrico Maria Salerno, Antonella Murgia, Janet Agren

title: La polizia ordina: sparate a vista
synopsis: In Istanbul there are two very valuable artifacts, two very precious Buddhas, one part of a private collection, the other kept in a museum.The two Buddhas are the target of a thief, Davis, who tries to secure them both: the first theft, in the collector's house, hits the mark. But the second reveals some unexpected events.
cast: Beba Loncar, Irfan Atasoy, Gordon Mitchell, Jean Pierre Blanchard, Cesare Nizzica, Albertina Capuani, Salvatore Carrara, Michelle Leite Costa

title: La polizia ringrazia
synopsis: Two boys attack a jewelry shop, but the owner puts them on the run: one of the robbers reacts, however, by killing both the owner of the shop and a worker who tried to stop them. The investigations are assigned to Commissioner Bertone: the latter moves immediately amidst many difficulties (he is also put under investigation by the deputy prosecutor), which however does not prevent him from setting out on the trail of an "Anonima anticrimine" which also includes the former commissioner and other authorities ...
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Mariangela Melato, Mario Adorf

title: La polizia sta a guardare
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Lee J. Cobb, Jean Sorel, Gianni Bonagura, Claudio Gora, Ennio Balbo

title: La polizia è al servizio del cittadino?
synopsis: In Genoa, Commissioner Sironi identified the head of the ferocious racketeering that controls port activities. But the law restrains his action, and he transforms himself into an executioner. Even in times of revaluation of the Italian black, Guerrieri's film is not among the best.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Daniel Gélin, Giuseppe Pambieri, John Steiner, Venantino Venantini, Claudio Nicastro, Enzo Liberti, Alessandro Momo, Marie Sophie Persson

title: La polizia è sconfitta
synopsis: A cruel band of looters makes life impossible for the traders of Bologna. Valli, one of the bandits, turns out to be the most ruthless and meanest of the bunch. Valli does not hesitate to take out a Tunisian who would also like to join the circle. Thanks to the precious collaboration of investigator Grifi, the police set up a special team and go into action. The gang leader is eventually caught mingling with bus travelers.
cast: Marcel Bozzuffi, Riccardo Salvino, Claudia Giannotti, Vittorio Mezzogiorno

title: La poliziotta
synopsis: Gianna Abbastanzi is fed up with everyday life, suffocated by a loafer boyfriend and an employer who exploits her. She wins a competition as a policeman in a small town in Lombardy and proves to be severe and inflexible. A corrupt local industrialist who has strong political support enters its sights. Soon the scandal became national. Removed from office, Gianna leaves for Sicily in the company of the praetor who has been close to her in her inquiries.
cast: Mariangela Melato, Mario Carotenuto, Orazio Orlando, Renato Pozzetto

title: La poliziotta a New York
synopsis: Mac Caron (Renzo Montagnani), the most stupid and inept of New York cops, is grappling with two gangs of drug dealers fighting each other. Reinforcements from Italy (Edwige Fenech and Alvaro Vitali) arrive to his aid. The two replace, respectively, the lover and the bodyguard of the boss Big John and in the end, after various chases, misunderstandings and fist fights, they solve the case.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Renzo Montagnani, Aldo Maccione

title: La poliziotta della squadra del Buon Costume
synopsis: A policewoman, in order to solve a case of white trafficking, gets hired as a stripper in a nightclub. An ordinary film like its performers.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Sal Borgese, Gianfranco Barra

title: La poliziotta fa carriera
synopsis: Gianna Amicucci, the young daughter of a porter, works in the home of a commissioner. Thanks to the recommendation of the senior official, she manages to fulfill her lifelong dream: enlisting in the women's police. Initially the apprenticeship is not the happiest, but, following three brilliant actions against the underworld, it ends up earning the unconditional approval of colleagues and authorities.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Mario Carotenuto, Alvaro Vitali, Giuseppe Pambieri

title: La porta del cannone
synopsis: In the autumn of 1938, the Germans entrusted Cloro, an Italian lieutenant of the intelligence service and, separately, one of their agents, with the task of eliminating the inconvenient leader of the Resistance in Czechoslovakia. In contact with two partisans - a Czech Jew and an Italian - Cloro has a crisis of conscience and unexpectedly passes over to their side.
cast: Gianni Garko, Irina Demick, Gianna Serra, Marijan Lovric, Tony Santaniello, Boris Cavazza, Tom Felleghy, Jovan Bitenz, Vladimir Medar, Ilija Ivezic

title: La porta del cielo
cast: Marina Berti, Maria Mercader, Roldano Lupi, Massimo Girotti, Carlo Ninchi, Giovanni Grasso

title: La porta delle sette stelle
synopsis: David lost his anthropologist mother in India when he was a child, and despite being a prodigy pianist he is now a pilot of military aircraft. Contacted by a shady boss of the third sector, he gives up everything and starts to fly his private plane. He becomes involved in Raimondo's shady circle of women, and then meets another genius child, this time of computers, thanks to the computer infractions of which he becomes a billionaire.
cast: Stefano Dionisi, Pilar Abella, Luca Buratto, Sabrina Colle, Cosimo Fusco

title: La porta sul buio. Il tram
synopsis: A police commissioner investigates the violent murder of a young woman, which took place in the carriage of a tram during a night run.
cast: Enzo Cerusico, Robert Hoffmann, Aldo Reggiani, Marilù Tolo, Laura Belli, Riccardo Salvino, Paola Tedesco, Mara Venier, Pierluigi Aprà, Gianfranco D'Angelo

title: La porta sul buio. Il vicino di casa
synopsis: Luca and Stefania, a young couple with their newborn son, move into their new apartment late at night: a remote farmhouse on the Lazio coast without electricity. The couple, however, are unaware that their neighbor has just killed his wife. A nightmare experience begins for them ...
cast: Aldo Reggiani, Laura Belli, Mimmo Palmara

title: La porta sul buio. La bambola
synopsis: The police are on the trail of a psychopath who has escaped from a psychiatric institution, accused of the murder of a woman. Meanwhile, a girl, engaged in the theft of a doll, is approached by a stranger.
cast: Robert Hoffmann, Mara Venier, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Erika Blanc, Maria Teresa Albani

title: La porta sul buio. Testimone oculare
synopsis: While driving in the middle of the night on a country road, Roberta sees a female figure thrown out of a car. Examining what has all the appearance of a corpse, Roberta notices some bullet holes and rushes to the police: but when the agents arrive, the body has disappeared without a trace ...
cast: Marilù Tolo, Riccardo Salvino, Glauco Onorato, Altea De Nicola

title: La portatrice di pane
cast: Vivi Gioi, Carlo Ninchi, Jean Tissier, Nino Bernardi, Gabriel Cattand

title: La portiera nuda
synopsis: Since her mother, a concierge in a Roman building, was injured, the very young Gianna came to temporarily take her place from the province. The tenants of the building represent a real sample of various humanity. They range from the braggart film producer and up to his neck in debt, to the crazy psychoanalyst and the shy and clumsy Mr. Virgili.
cast: Irene Miracle, Erika Blanc, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Mario Carotenuto

title: La posta in gioco
synopsis: On the trail of the assassins of Renata Fonte, Nardò's councilor for culture, a commissioner and a prosecutor "sniff" the big guns behind the crime. But the investigations are blocked "at the top". Investigative film on a real blood event from 1984, it disappoints for its devoid of imagination and devoid of imagination directing.
cast: Lina Sastri, Turi Ferro, Vittorio Caprioli, Pier Palo Capponi, Flavio Bucci

title: La preda
synopsis: A couple now in crisis lives in Colombia: Daniel falls in love with a local girl, Nagaina, while Betsy is now a chronic alcoholic. Daniel wants to run away with his new lover, and to get the money he steals some jewels from a money lender. He gets help from a prisoner who, in turn, falls in love with Nagaina.
cast: Zeudi Araya, Renzo Montagnani, Franco Gasparri

title: La première étoile
synopsis: Jean-Gabriel is a black man, married to a white woman and father of three children, but he hasn't put his head right: he shuns family responsibilities, makes do by living by his wits and spends his time betting on horses.
cast: Firmine Richard, Lucien Jean Baptiste, Anne Consigny, Jimmy Woha, Ludovic François, Loreyna Colombo, Bernadette Lafont, Michel Jonasz, Gilles Benizio, Astrid Berges Frisbey

title: La presidentessa
synopsis: Yvette, an avant-garde dancer, is mistaken for the wife of a severe and irreproachable judge by the Minister of Grace and Justice on a visit to Vicenza. Falling in love with the dancer, the honorable member does not notice how she turns it to her advantage. Between one favor and another, Yvette will even make her debut at La Scala, with results that are nothing short of disastrous.
cast: Johnny Dorelli, Mariangela Melato, Vittorio Caprioli, Gianrico Tedeschi

title: La presidentessa
synopsis: The modest president of the court of a provincial town closes the place where the casual Gobette performs. Seeking revenge, the latter enters the house of the magistrate, who is forced to present her as his wife to the unexpected minister of justice. Of course there is an authentic spouse and the matter is gradually getting complicated ...
cast: Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Dapporto, Ave Ninchi, Luigi Pavese, Franco Coop, Aroldo Tieri, Ernesto Calindri

title: La pretora
synopsis: The inflexible magistrate of a Venetian city is hated by lawyers regularly defeated in court. To knock her out, the rivals invite her twin sister, who is a porn star. And as a coup de grace they decide to have their rude twin photographed and to show the photographs to everyone. Faced with the fraud, the magistrate reacts decisively.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Gianni Agus, Giancarlo Dettori

title: La prima Angélica
synopsis: When Luis, a man of only middle age, goes from Barcelona to Segovia to bury his mother in the family tomb, he finds temporary accommodation with his aunt Pilar, in the old house where he spent the summer of 1936. There he meets his cousin Angelica , his first love, who now lives on the first floor with her husband and daughter, so it is natural for him to have a series of memories related to his childhood and the Spanish Civil War, as well as reflections on how it all relates to his current life.
cast: José Luis López Vazquez, Lina Canalejas, Fernando Delgado, María Clara Fernández De Loaysa, Pedro Sempson, María De La Riva, Marisa Porcel, Antonio Canal, Pedrín Fernández, Trinidad Rugero

title: La prima cosa bella
synopsis: Bruno, a professor of literature in Milan, returns to his Livorno after the worsening of his mother Anna's illness. The encounter brings him back to childhood and adolescence, to the relationship with a beautiful and vital mother, enthusiastic about life even when she is betrayed by it.
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Micaela Ramazzotti, Stefania Sandrelli, Claudia Pandolfi, Marco Messeri, Aurora Frasca, Giacomo Bibbiani, Giulia Burgalassi, Francesco Rapalino, Isabella Cecchi, Dario Ballantini

title: La prima donna
synopsis: Original and unpublished documents, textual, photographic and sound, and precious images of important national and foreign archives, tell the forgotten, found and sensational story of Emma Carelli: absolute diva of the opera theater, praised all over the world in the early twentieth century , And one of the first Italian managers, director of the Costanzi Theater (today's theater of the Opera di Roma) from 1912 until 1926. Soprano acclaimed in Italy, in Europe, to South America, he managed to triumph also as an impresaria in a Environment dominated exclusively by men bringing to his theater, for the first time in Italy, Picasso, Russian ballets and futurists. Very popular and at the same time innovative, indomitable, free, emancipated character, she from a young age she manifested an adole that she kept her head held for more mature colleagues, to the competitors of the other theaters, even to the maximum and feared authority of the master Arturo Toscanini. And to the head of the new regime, Benito Mussolini. Much, so much, too much, for a woman in those years. Arrived at the Zenith of public consideration, Emma Carelli begins during fascism to suffer back to the private and political sphere. In 1926 the government suddenly enhanced her from the direction of her theater, because - recited a report drawn up by the fascist secret police - "as a woman has developed an independent character that makes her assume superiority attitudes towards anyone". In Italy that heads towards the authoritarian regime Carelli sees the end of his theater, his marriage, his part of the protagonist in the world of entertainment. He died bloody in 1928, the year that records the most suicide women in the history of Italy.
cast: Licia Maglietta

title: La prima linea
synopsis: Sergio known as Segio, the "Sirio commander" of the Red Brigades, is engaged to Susanna Ronconi. Both are part of Prima Linea, an armed band that operated in Italy in the years of lead. The film traces the story of the two lovers, baptized as the "boyfriends of terrorism", accused of twenty-one murders in the 1980s and united in rebellion against the system.
cast: Michele Alhaique, Francesca Cuttica, Awa Ly, Lucia Mascino, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Fabrizio Rongione, Riccardo Scamarcio, Daniela Tusa

title: La prima luce
synopsis: Marco, a young and ruthless lawyer, lives in Bari with the South American Martina and Martin, their 5-year-old son. Following irremediable disagreements with her partner and feeling hunted by the law, Martina decides to escape. He manages to return to his country of origin, together with the child and to lose his tracks.
