Marco cannot live without his baby and, after having made a series of holes in the water in an unsuccessful attempt to find them, he decides to leave for Latin America.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Daniela Ramirez, Gianni Pezzolla, Luis Gnecco, Alejandro Goic, Paulina Urrutia, Maria Eugenia Barrenechea

title: La prima neve
synopsis: Michele (Matteo Marchel) is an 11-year-old who recently lost his father, who lives in the mountains of South Tyrol and has a difficult relationship with his mother (Anita Caprioli). Dani (Jean-Christophe Folly) is an African boy from Togo who is hosted in a shelter after a traumatic sea voyage, has a young daughter and struggles to be a father. By meeting, their lives will become complementary, each seeking to fill the void in the other's life and allowing both to overcome the pain of the common experience of a tragic loss.
cast: Matteo Marchel, Jean Christophe Folly, Anita Caprioli, Giuseppe Battiston, Peter Mitterrutzner

title: La prima notte
synopsis: Isabella, a young adventurer on vacation in Venice, passes herself off as a wealthy billionaire: in reality, her aim is to frame a handsome rich man to take to the altar. Attracted by her incredible jewelry collection, swindler Alfredo and the painter Gérard hatch a plan to rob her. Everything works perfectly, except that Gérard loses his head for the girl and retraces his steps. Not so Alfredo, who wants to score the blow of his life ...
cast: Martine Carol, Jacques Sernas, Vittorio De Sica

title: La prima notte del dottor Danieli, industriale col complesso del... giocattolo
synopsis: Carlo Danieli, a Sicilian industrialist with an intense love life, discovers that the girl he married wanted to remain untouched until the wedding. He receives such a shock that he is totally inhibited in his sexual abilities, turning the honeymoon into a real disaster. It will be the mother-in-law, given all the attempts useless, to resolve the situation by putting a prostitute in his bed.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Françoise Prevost, Katia Christina, Saro Urzì

title: La prima notte di quiete
synopsis: Daniele is a young professor of literature, who is doing a substitute in a high school in Rimini. Author of a book of poems dedicated to a girl who died at the age of sixteen, he now lives with Monica. Daniele is indifferent to the dispute that slowly takes hold in his class. Without an authentic vocation for teaching, and with a keen propensity for play, the professor falls in love with Vanina, one of his students.
cast: Alain Delon, Giancarlo Giannini, Sonia Petrova, Renato Salvatori, Lea Massari, Adalberto Maria Merli

title: La prima pietra
synopsis: It's a normal school day, just before the Christmas holidays, and everyone is excited about the upcoming play. A child, intent on playing with others in the schoolyard, throws a stone breaking a window and slightly injuring the janitor. It is a Muslim child and the incident will give rise to a debate, full of twists, which will see the principal (Corrado Guzzanti), the teacher (Lucia Mascino), the janitor and his wife (Valerio Aprea and Iaia Forte) as protagonists. ) and of course the baby's mother, together with her mother-in-law (Kasia Smutniak and Serra Y? lmaz).
cast: Kasia Smutniak, Corrado Guzzanti, Lucia Mascino, Valerio Aprea, Iaia Forte, Serra Yilmaz

title: La prima volta
synopsis: Alberto, a health care physician and maniac of order, has been separated for ten years and is dedicated to his fifteen-year-old daughter Bianca. One day his organized existence is upset by reading a page in the girl's diary, in which Bianca writes that she is about to make love for the first time. Determined to ensure that this does not happen, Alberto organizes a dinner with a dear friend of his gynecologist Marina, who from the height of her experience in a clinic should make Bianca desist from her purpose. At the dinner, however, Giovanni, Marina's inappropriate husband, and Irene, a psychologist whom Alberto detests, are added unwanted. All of them thus find themselves talking about their first times, obtaining a very different result from what Alberto expected.
cast: Riccardo Rossi, Benedetta Gargari, Anna Foglietta, Stefano Fresi, Fabrizia Sacchi

title: La prima volta
synopsis: A trip to the Rome subway is an opportunity for a group of young people to remember their first sexual experience. There is Elena, who yields to her boss's insistence without reacting; Federico, an introverted boy who lets himself be seduced by his brother's girlfriend; Norma, an orphan who lives in the suburbs and falls in love with a neighborhood bully who sells drugs for a living; Davide and Giovanna, boyfriends who have decided to go to bed together only after marriage: a choice that especially his father is unable to accept ...
cast: Alessia Fugardi, Micaela Ramazzotti, Max Malatesta, Francesca Chiarantano

title: La prima volta, sull'erba - Danza d'amore sotto gli olmi
synopsis: At the beginning of the century, three families met in a pension in Tyrol: the neurologist Hans and his son Franz, the painter Margherita, his daughter Lotte and Hella, an aspiring actress girl with vanished parents. Both Hans and Margherita have very liberal ideas and encourage their respective children to have an uninhibited relationship. Franz and Lotte, however, are unable to give free rein to their instincts because in the meantime the neurologist and the painter have become lovers. Their block is overcome as soon as the two decide to separate.
cast: Anne Heywood, Claudio Cassinelli, Mark Lester, Monica Guerritore

title: La primavera della mia vita
synopsis: After the breakdown of their professional partnership and a long period of silence, the musician Antonio (Dimartino) contacted the former colleague and friend Lorenzo (Colapesce) for a new project wrapped in mystery. This time the music has nothing to do with it, but the stakes are high enough to defuse Lorenzo's distrust. At the same time, however, the deadlines are so close that they end up draging the two friends into a reckless race against time.
cast: Lorenzo Urciullo 'Colapesce, Antonio Di Martino 'Dimartino, Brunori Sas, Stefania Rocca, Roberto Vecchioni, Demetra Ballino, Corrado Fortuna

title: La primera entrega
synopsis: Two idle young men decide to carry out a theft against Mrs Martin, who lives in an isolated villa on the outskirts of Madrid. In a completely random way, the woman will find out who is the instigator of the robbery.
cast: Franco Citti, Green Lee, Bruno Corazzari, Lola Sordo, Emma Penella, Pilar Bardem, Rosa De Alba, Fernando Guillen, Gemma Cuervo

title: La princesse de Montpensier
synopsis: The story of the Duke of Guise's passion for Maria de Mézières, who survived the marriage she was forced to with the Prince of Montpensier and who instead loved the Duke of Guise since childhood, without ever losing her feeling over the years .
cast: Gaspard Ulliel, Melanie Thierry, Lambert Wilson, Florence Thomassin, Raphaël Personnaz, Philippe Magnan, Michel Vuillermoz, Olivier Loustau, Nathalie Krebs, Christine Brücher

title: La principessa Sissi
synopsis: The story of Elisabeth of Bavaria, known as Sissi, who became Empress of Austria after her marriage to her cousin Francesco Giuseppe. Educated by her mother Ludovica not to be proudly aristocratic and to neglect excessive formalisms, Sissi immediately clashes with the rigid atmosphere of the Vienna court. Soon he falls ill because of the distance from home and the dislike that, due to his bourgeois origins, the members of the court feel towards him. Even the relationship with the archduchess Sofia (who tries to educate her firmly to the dynamics of the palace) does not work, throwing the young woman more and more into despair.
cast: Cristiana Capotondi, David Rott, Martina Gedeck, Fritz Karl, Licia Maglietta, Franziska Sztavjanik, Christiane Filangieri, Xaver Hutter, Herbert Knaup, Friedrich Von Thun

title: La principessa del sogno
synopsis: Elisabetta (Dilian), a guest of an orphanage, built a dream world in which he imagines meeting the Prince Charming and becoming his happy bride. In fact, he knows a real prince (Centa), he falls in love with it and, despite his external opposition, he manages to marry him. Melense and flat fairy tale.
cast: Irasema Dilian, Antonio Centa, Maria Melato, Annibale Betrone

title: La principessa delle Canarie
synopsis: The Spaniards, in 1450, set out to conquer the Canary Islands. Among them is Don Diego, an officer of his majesty, who falls in love with Almadena, the daughter of the indigenous king. War is inevitable, but love is stronger. Matroianni before success, in a very mediocre imitation adventure film.
cast: Silvana Pampanini, Marcello Mastroianni, Gustavo Rojo, Elvira Quintilla

title: La principessa nuda
cast: Ajita Wilson, Tina Aumont, Rosa Daniels, Luigi Pistilli, Jho Jhenkins

title: La principessa sul pisello
synopsis: The fairy tales of Cinderella and Snow White magazines in a erotic-demented key.
cast: Marisa Bertoni, Marcello Bonini Olas, Rossana Canghiari, Tiziana Casoli, Bruna Cealti, Jocelyne Chaouat, Liliana Chiari, Adriano Cornelli, Gianfranco De Angelis, Antonio De Martino

title: La prise du pouvoir par Louis XIV
cast: Jean Marie Patte, Raymond Jourdan, Giulio Cesare Silvani, Katharina Renn

title: La prisonnière
synopsis: The young Josée, wife of the sculptor Gilbert, meets the gallery owner Stanislas Hassler, who loves to photograph women in humiliating or sapphic poses. Josée, at first troubled, ends up under the spell of Stanislas and takes part in a photo session. The woman, who in the meantime has fallen in love with Stanislas, attempts suicide out of desperation when she discovers she has been left. Upon hearing the truth, Gilbert tries to kill the gallery owner. At the last moment, however ...
cast: Elisabeth Wiener, Laurent Terzieff, Bernard Fresson, Dany Carrel

title: La prochaine fois je viserai le coeur
synopsis: For several months, between 1978 and 1979, residents of a quiet province of France find themselves immersed in fear and terror over a furious maniac who targets young women. The assailant escapes capture by the investigators and no one imagines that he is a shy model cop with a normal life.
cast: Guillaume Canet, Ana Girardot, Jean Yves Berteloot, Patrick Azam, Arnaud Henriet, Douglas Attal, Piérick Tournier, Alexandre Carrière, François Dominique Blin, Franck Andrieux, Arthur Dujardin, Alice De Lencquesaing, Jean Paul Comart, Cédric Le Maoût, Laura Giudice

title: La professoressa di lingue
synopsis: Michele, the son of a wealthy family, suffers from stuttering and this leads him to be sent back to English and French. For the September exams, he will have to study all summer with Pamela, a sexy and beautiful teacher who will find a way to help him as he tries to defend himself from the special attentions of the other family members.
cast: Femi Benussi, Mirella D'Aurela, Pupo De Luca, Daniela Pastorelli, Walter Romagnoli, Pietro Tordi

title: La professoressa di scienze naturali
synopsis: To replace the seasoned high school science teacher, the pharmacist from a Sicilian town suggests an attractive recent graduate who wreaks havoc not only among the students, but also among their parents. It is the pharmacist's son, Andrea, who conquers the girl.
cast: Lilli Carati, Michele Gammino, Alvaro Vitali, Giacomo Rizzo

title: La profezia dell'Armadillo
synopsis: Zero is twenty-seven years old, lives in the suburb of Rebibbia, more precisely in the Tiburtina Valley, land of Mammuth, acetate suits, recluse bodies and big hearts, where everything is missing but nothing is needed. Zero is a draftsman but not having a steady job, he struggles by giving repetitions of French, timing the check-in lines at the airport and creating illustrations for independent punk bands. His life always flows the same, between days spent on board public transport crossing half of Rome to reach the various workplaces and visits to the Mother. But once he returns home, his critical conscience awaits him: an Armadillo in flesh and blood, or rather in plaques and soft tissues, which with conversations bordering on paradoxical constantly updates him on what is happening in the world. #To keep him company in his daily adventures, in the constant struggle to keep himself afloat, is the childhood friend Secco. The news of the death of Camille, a schoolmate and his teenage love never declared, forces him to deal with life and to face, with his irreverent spirit, the incommunicability, the doubts and the lack of certainties of his generation of "cut off".
cast: Simone Liberati, Pietro Castellitto, Laura Morante, Valerio Aprea, Claudia Pandolfi, Teco Celio, Diana Del Bufalo, Sofia Staderini

title: La proie
synopsis: Franck Adrien (Albert Dupontel), convicted of a bank robbery to six months in prison, shares a cell with apparently weak Jean Louis Morel. Not long after Morel's release, Franck discovers that Morel is actually a sadistic serial killer to whom he has revealed many details of his private life. Fearing for the sake of his loved ones, Franck must break out of prison, track down Morel and at the same time evade the teams of French police specialists who hunt him down.
cast: Albert Dupontel, Alice Taglioni, Stéphane Debac, Sergi López, Natacha Régnier, Serge Hazanavicius, Zinedine Soualem, Caterina Murino, Lucien Jean Baptiste, Jean Marie Winling

title: La promessa
synopsis: Marat, Lika and Leonidik, who survived the atrocities of the Second World War, meet by chance and force each other.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Anna Maria Guarnieri, Giulio Brogi

title: La promesse
synopsis: In today's very sad Belgium, a boy manages a trafficking of immigrants with an unscrupulous father ready to beat him if he catches his son in an attitude of solidarity towards them. On the visit of some emissaries from the emigration office, an African falls from a scaffolding in an attempt to escape the controls. At the point of death, the man asks the young man to take care of his wife and daughter still in diapers. To do so, he will have to send the ugly parent to the devil and start an ordeal to hide from the woman the true end of the unfortunate husband. The dry first work of the Dardenne brothers resumes their path developing it towards fiction. The two know exactly what to show us and what to cut: the observation is, at the same time, anthropological and melodramatic. The firm style allows the actors to appear as if taken from the street. Intense and burning with anger.
cast: Jérémie Rénier, Olivier Gourmet, Assita Ouedraogo

title: La promesse de l'aube
synopsis: The future writer Romain Gary lives his youth in Lithuania, from where he is forced to flee due to the advent of Hitler's power in Germany. After moving with his whole family to the south of France, he will begin his career in the air forces of Free France.
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Pierre Niney, Didier Bourdon, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Finnegan Oldfield, Catherine McCormack, Pawel Puchalski, Nemo Schiffman

title: La propera pell
synopsis: On the roof of a shelter for minors, a teenager who has no recollection of his loved ones threatens to jump on deaf ears if he is subjected to a family recognition test. The educator Gerard joins him on the roof reassuring him and convincing him that the memories will sooner or later resurface in his mind. Ana, Gabriel's mother, and Enric, the brother of Gabriel's dead father, show up for the test and recognize the boy as Gabriel, who has long since disappeared. Back home with his family, Gabriel begins to behave in a strange way, so much so that as the days go by Ana begins to realize that she is not in the presence of her son. However, the two decide to make a sort of pact, based on mutual lies.
cast: Sergi López, Emma Suarez, Àlex Monner, Bruno Todeschini, Igor Szpakowski, Mikel Iglesias, Greta Fernández, David Arribas, Pablo Rosset, Guillem Jorba

title: La prophétie des grenouilles
synopsis: At the edge of the world, Ferdinand, a retired sailor, has just moved with his wife Juliette and adopted son Tom to a quiet cottage on top of a hill. The Lamottas, the new neighbors, are leaving for Africa where they have to take a pair of crocodiles. During their absence, Juliette and Ferdinand offer to take care of their only daughter, Lili. But on the evening when the Lamottas have to leave, they are alarmed by a strange forecast: they will have to face a forty-day long deluge.

title: La proprietà non è più un furto
synopsis: Total, a young bank employee, is allergic to money, it disgusts him to touch it and despises those who own it. Convinced that the world is made up of thieves, those who profess themselves as such and those who enrich themselves behind the backs of others, he believes he has identified a member of the second category in a butcher who is a client of the bank he works for. He decides to target him.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Flavio Bucci, Daria Nicolodi, Mario Scaccia

title: La prova generale
synopsis: Two years later _A mosca cieca_, in which he re-elaborated some ideas taken from Camus's _The stranger_ in a modernly jagged style, Scavolini ventured into this collective and "untold" film, in which life and acting - as the title suggests - intertwine and blend seamlessly.
cast: Lou Castel, Frank Wolff, Maria Monti, Leopoldo Trieste, Carlo Cecchi

title: La provinciale
synopsis: During the years of the economic boom, Gemma, a young and attractive woman, is tired of the boredom and dullness of provincial life. He therefore decides to try the social climb through a marriage of interest with a shy professor and an extramarital affair with a rich and powerful man. She will end up involved in the mysterious murder case of a countess. Is she the culprit?
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Stefano Dionisi, Enzo Decaro, Barbara Bouchet, Lisa Gastoni

title: La provinciale
synopsis: Gemma falls in love with Paolo, but discovers that he is her mother's adulterous son. She then marries Franco, a professor, but is ensnared by Countess Elvira, a procuress who convinces her to become the lover of a certain Tittoni. After this relationship, the procuress tries to blackmail Gemma, who has a physical confrontation with her. Explanation with her husband, expulsion of the countess and triumph of conjugal love. From Moravia's novel, Soldati draws a film that is psychologically incomplete (as the book is) but very well-finished, often elegant. Silver ribbon to Ferzetti; Lollobrigida, as a dramatic actress, does what little she can.
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Gabriele Ferzetti, Alda Mangini, Franco Interlenghi

title: La prunelle de mes yeux
synopsis: Elise and Théo live in the same building, share the same elevator and both love music. But Elise is blind and Théo never noticed. This misunderstanding causes them to hate each other until a last affront unites them, but in the end, putting everything at risk.
cast: Mélanie Bernier, Bastien Bouillon, Swann Arlaud, Antonin Fresson, Chloé Astor, Thierry Gibault, Jean Charles Clichet

title: La pupa del gangster
synopsis: Giorgio Capitani, known in the milanese world as "Charlie Colletto", is the boss of the "Anonima mignottari", assisted by his accomplice Chopin. Accidentally met one of his "employees", Charlie - infatuated with Rita Hayworth - sees in her a strong resemblance to the diva and elects her to his Pupa, but at the same time he betrays her with Anna: and at the accidental death of the latter, the things get complicated ...
cast: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Aldo Maccione, Dalila Di Lazzaro

title: La putain du roi
synopsis: The French Countess Jeanne de Luynes, wife of the Count of Verrua, resists the "advances" of Vittorio Amedeo I of Savoy until she is convinced that everyone, even her husband, wants her to yield. She will be a despotic lover towards the court, slave and ruler of the sovereign. He falls ill with smallpox, flees to France and then returns one last time when the king has abdicated and is in very poor health. High-sounding topic, named actors, spectacular scenographic splendor. But the (Austrian) director fails to blend everything into a coherent and functional whole. Disappointing result for a film as expensive as it is, in practice, unrealistic.
cast: Timothy Dalton, Valeria Golino, Stéphane Freiss, Margaret Tyzack

title: La quattordicesima domenica del tempo ordinario
synopsis: Bologna, 1970s. Marzio, Samuele and Sandra are very young and everyone has his dream to be realized. The two boys, friends for the skin, found a band called legend and dream of success. Sandra is of a dazzling beauty and aspires to become a model. A few years later, in the fourteenth Sunday of ordinary time, Marzio and Sandra get married while Samuele plays the organ for them. Thirty -five years later they make the final balance of their lives, their relationships and, above all, their dreams.
cast: Gabriele Lavia, Edwige Fenech, Massimo Lopez, Lodo Guenzi, Camilla Ciraolo, Nick Russo, Cesare Bocci

title: La quietud
synopsis: After years of absence and following her father's stroke, Eugenia returns to La Quietud, the family estate near Buenos Aires where she is reunited with her mother and sister. the three women are thus forced to confront the emotional traumas and dark secrets of their past, experienced against the backdrop of the military dictatorship. Old jealousies then come back to light, amplified by the shocking physical resemblance between the two sisters.
cast: Bérénice Bejo, Martina Gusman, Graciela Borges, Edgar Ramirez, Joaquín Furriel

title: La rabbia
synopsis: It is a two-part story of the events that characterized the period between the 1950s and 1960s. They range from the death of Pius XII, and subsequent election of John XXIII, to the death of Marilyn Monroe. From the invasion of Hungary in '56 to the flight of Gagarin, from the coronation of Queen Elizabeth to the arrival of Ava Gardner in Rome or to the visit of Sophia Loren in the flooded Polesine. The curious formula compared an author on the right (Guareschi), and one on the left (Pasolini). The two parts are also very different from a stylistic point of view; revised today may be interesting. The most beautiful part, however, remains Pasolini's "filmed poem" dedicated to Marylin Monroe.
cast: Voci Di Renato Guttuso, Giorgio Bassani, Carlo Romano, Gigi Artuso

title: La rabbia
synopsis: A young director is desperate for the money to produce his own film. But the support of his mentor, an elderly director with a habit of alcohol, is of no help. The young man ends up robbing a bank to finance himself and, with great difficulty, manages to shoot the film. The producer he is addressing, however, is not willing to distribute it, so the director decides to give a definitive turn to his career.
cast: Lou Castel, Corso Salani, Faye Dunaway, Franco Nero, Philippe Leroy, Nico Rogner, Gregorio Napoli, Barbara Enrichi, Asia Cibelli, Tinto Brass, Giorgio Albertazzi

title: La race des 'seigneurs'
cast: Alain Delon, Sydne Rome, Claude Rich, Jeanne Moreau, Jean Marc Bory, Louis Seigner

title: La radice del male
synopsis: Plot in preparation
cast: Luca Elmi, Lionello Gennero, Zora Kerova, Petra Keslerova, Giancarlo Previati, Peter Shepherd

title: La rafle
synopsis: The reconstruction of the terrible mass roundup that took place in Paris in 1942, when 13,000 Jews were locked up in the Vélodrome d'Hiver, only to be taken to some detention camps in France, before being sent to German concentration camps.
cast: Jean Reno, Mélanie Laurent, Gad Elmaleh, Raphaëlle Agogué, Hugo Leverdez, Joseph Weismann, Oliver Cywie, Mathieu Di Concerto, Romain Di Concerto, Sylvie Testud

title: La ragazza Carla
synopsis: Carla is the youngest daughter of the widow Dondi, a woman of the lower middle class who makes slippers to support the meager family budget. The girl is enrolled in a vocational school for typists. At school, he does what he has to do, without real passion or strong determination. In his head he has other thoughts, other dreams and a great fear of throwing himself into the fray. After school Carla found a job at the Transocean Limited Import Export Company, a small company in Piazza del Duomo. It is directed by the mysterious Mr. Praték, who does not seem to have great regard for his employees and who even makes explicit advances to poor Carla. Which runs away horrified by her mother to tell her that she no longer wants to know about that job. But the mother makes it clear that finding a job is not easy these days, and the daughter cannot afford to lose it.
cast: Elio, Carla Chiarelli

title: La ragazza americana
synopsis: Susan (Vanessa Hessler), an American girl from Kentucky, inherits an ancient ruined castle in the province of Arezzo from a distant relative of her duke. His arrival in Italy, however, is not well liked by the inhabitants of the place, who do not want to see the goods that the duke left them in usucapion taken away. Although the country is lined up against her, Susan has no intention of giving up, finding herself against the young lawyer Nilde (Samanta Piccinetti), engaged to the farrier Vasco (Giulio Berruti). Between Vasco and Susan it will soon be love.
cast: Vanessa Hessler, Giulio Berruti, Ilaria Occhini, Samanta Piccinetti, Giovanni Guidelli, Danila Stalteri, Sacha Dominis, Sergio Pierattini, Pier Francesco Poggi, Bruce McGuire

title: La ragazza che sapeva troppo
synopsis: Nora Davis, an English girl on vacation in Rome, finds herself at the center of a frightening series of murders. The trouble is, no one believes her.
cast: John Saxon, Leticia Roman, Valentina Cortese

title: La ragazza con la pistola
synopsis: Assunta, a Sicilian girl very attached to traditions, agrees to be kidnapped by a man from her country, Vincenzo, with whom she is secretly in love, hoping for a shotgun wedding. The next day, however, the seducer, to avoid the consequences of his gesture, flees to England. Assunta, determined to defend her honor, pursues him armed with a pistol. Here she finds Vincenzo's address, but he manages to escape her. While on her trail, Assunta meets a doctor. He takes his case to heart and, little by little, manages to change his mentality. Now it is Vincenzo who, struck by the girl's change, wants to marry her. Bubbly comedy with a very funny part set in Swinging London. He launched Vitti as a comic actress.
cast: Monica Vitti, Stanley Baker, Carlo Giuffrè, Stefano Satta Flores, Anthony Booth, Corin Redgrave

title: La ragazza con la valigia
synopsis: Aida is a dancer with a stormy past. Lorenzo is a serious student from a good family. Despite everything conspiring against the possibility of their union, Lorenzo decides to invite Aida to join him in Parma, where he also pays his support. At a certain point Lorenzo's mathematics professor intervenes and convinces Aida of the ruin to which this union will inevitably lead the boy. Aida in spite of herself realizes that the professor (as well as a priest) is right and decides to leave. Good screenplay for a film in which Zurlini investigates the provincial environment and gives us a sharp and not superficial cross-section of Italian moralism. A small masterpiece.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Jacques Perrin, Romolo Valli, Corrado Pani, Gian Maria Volonté

title: La ragazza dal pigiama giallo
synopsis: A married woman (Di Lazzaro) is divided between two lovers: a doctor and a worker. Determined to leave her husband, she is rejected by the doctor and beaten by her spouse. She then falls back on the worker, by whom she is eventually killed. It will be up to the police to shed some light on the case.
cast: Ray Milland, Dalida Di Lazzaro, Michele Placido, Mel Ferrer

title: La ragazza dalla pelle di luna
synopsis: A young married couple, the Italian Alberto and the English Helen, fashion photographer, allow themselves, during a business trip, an unexpected holiday in the Seychelles. "The last paradise", which should resolve the marriage crisis of the two, ends up aggravating it when Alberto falls in love with Simon, a splendid local girl. Bitten by the worm of jealousy, Helen seeks solace in the arms of a failed writer.
cast: Ugo Pagliai, Beba Loncar, Zeudi Araya, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: La ragazza dei lillà
cast: Laurent Terzieff, Mario Adorf, Mimsy Farmer, Memé Perlini, Pascale De Boysson

title: La ragazza dei miei sogni
synopsis: P. is a dissatisfied young man in his thirties. There are many situations that heavily influenced his life and prevented him from living as he would like: the death of his parents; the aseptic newsroom where he works; Mario, his roommate, as easy as he is superficial; Margherita, the girl he is in love with and to whom he cannot declare himself. One day P. meets in the office an old friend of his from high school, Alessandro, a brilliant IT consultant by day and a wild electronic musician by night, who opens the doors to a fantastic and secret world. When P. meets Sofia, sweet and intriguing, resembling the girl he dreamed of every night, an irrepressible feeling explodes between the two and he finally seems to have found the girl of his dreams. Little by little, a world will be revealed to P. whose existence he was unaware of, which will force him to make great sacrifices to survive and to completely change his vision of life and love.
cast: Primo Reggiani, Miriam Giovanelli, Nicolas Vaporidis, Remo Girone, Chiara Gensini, Marco Rossetti, Nicola Nocella, Jessica Paglialunga

title: La ragazza del Palio
synopsis: An American tourist, winner of a television quiz, and a penniless Sienese prince meet and fall in love. Deceived by appearances, they believe each other very rich, but the reality is quite different. After a long series of misunderstandings, they discover the truth, but they accept each other anyway. Zampa did better.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Diana Dors, Franca Valeri, Tina Lattanzi, Bruce Cabot

title: La ragazza del bersagliere
synopsis: A group of Bersaglieri arrives in a small town in Emilia for the great maneuvers. Among them is Salvatore Caputo who falls in love with Anita in return. The two are already planning the wedding but Antonio takes a bath in the river and dies. The girl tries to console herself with other suitors, but Antonio's ghost puts them all on the run: Anita will join him in the afterlife. Curious and impalpable comedy of theatrical origin, suspended between realism and surrealism.
cast: Graziella Granata, Antonio Casagrande, Tony Renis, Leopoldo Trieste

title: La ragazza del lago
synopsis: The body of the beautiful Anna, a young hockey player, is found naked on the shores of a lake in the province of Friuli. The case is entrusted to Commissioner Giovanni Sanzio, plagued by doubts and personal and family tragedies. Little by little, with perseverance and tenacity, Sanzio begins to unravel a mystery that presents several gray areas ...
cast: Toni Servillo, Fabrizio Gifuni, Valeria Golino, Marco Baliani, Denis Fasolo, Omero Antonutti, Anna Bonaiuto, Nello Mascia, Giulia Michelini

title: La ragazza del metrò
synopsis: Nino (D'Angelo) is a piano bar pianist; he meets a beautiful girl, Val, whom he falls in love with, loved back. But she is rich and doesn't want to let him know. Andrea, Val's ex-boyfriend, does everything to divide them and, in league with the underworld, even has the girl kidnapped, after humiliating Nino to get him out of the way. After several vicissitudes, however, the happy end inevitably arrives. D'Angelo, blond reuccio of the Neapolitan drama, goes through the most incredible situations unscathed.
cast: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Ninetto Davoli, Bruno Stori

title: La ragazza del mondo
synopsis: Giulia's is an ancient and suspended world, made up of rigor and sacred texts, which ferociously excludes those who do not belong to it. Libero's world is the world of everyone else, of those who make mistakes, of those who make do with looking for another possibility and of those who love without conditions. When Giulia meets Libero she discovers that she can have another destiny, all to choose from. Theirs is a pure and inevitable love story and for the two boys an intense period of life together begins, a choice that will result in Giulia being totally excluded from the world of Jehovah's Witnesses to which she belongs.
cast: Sara Serraiocco, Michele Riondino, Pippo Delbono, Marco Leonardi, Lucia Mascino, Stefania Montorsi

title: La ragazza del vagone letto
cast: Silvia Dionisio, Werner Pochath, Zora Kerova, Carlo De Mejo, Venantino Venantini

title: La ragazza di Bube
synopsis: Immediately after the war, in Tuscany, Mara (Cardinal) falls in love with Bube, a young ex partisan forced into hiding because he is implicated in a political murder. Long separated from the man she loves, while her companions try to organize her escape abroad, Mara finds work in the city and meets Stefano, a good boy who proposes to marry him. She is about to accept when she receives the news that Bube has been arrested. Comencini tells the dramas of the post-war period without rhetoric, the bitterness of the former partisans disappointed in their political-social hopes. It is one of the best interpretations of the Cardinal.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Georges Chakiris, Marc Michel, Emilio Esposito

title: La ragazza di Cortina
synopsis: A charming young woman sees the resurgence of the ghosts of a disturbing past from which she was convinced she had finally escaped ...
cast: Vanessa Gravina, Isabel Russinova, Stefano Abbati, Paolo Calissano

title: La ragazza di Piazza San Pietro
synopsis: The Conforti family has a souvenir kiosk in St. Peter's Square. In reality it is only Lucia who keeps up with the business, since her brother is an amateur boxer, the other brother Paolino is in boarding school and dad Armando runs after the tourists. Paolino risks being thrown out of boarding school and so Linda goes to talk to the professor. The result is that they fall in love. It is always nice to see De Sica being the "tombeur de femmes" and Chiari the somewhat clumsy teacher. But it is not enough to make the film a barely dignified thing.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Walter Chiari, Johnny Dorelli, Dolores Palumbo

title: La ragazza di Trieste
synopsis: Complicated love story between Dino, a comic artist, and a mysterious girl named Nicole. The mystery lies in the fact that the girl is a guest of a psychiatric institution from which she goes out from time to time for short periods. The relationship ends dramatically. Pasquale Festa Campanile transcribes his book for cinema with disappointing results.
cast: Ornella Muti, Ben Gazzara, Mimsy Farmer, Andréa Ferréol

title: La ragazza di latta
synopsis: An employee of a large industry falls in love with a colleague who seems to share dreams and ideals with him. But he'll soon be disappointed in her conformism, who just wants to settle down.
cast: Sydne Rome, Roberto Antonelli, Elena Persiani, Simone Mattioli

title: La ragazza di nome Giulio
synopsis: A girl who in memory of her dead father bears the name Giulio lives in Venice with her rich and not very understanding mother. As a teenager she had a homosexual experience with the housekeeper Lia, who taught her to hate men. Over time, the girl manages to escape the relationship with her lover and becomes engaged to Lorenzo. But Giulio is convinced that she does not know how to love.
cast: Silvia Dionisio, Gianni Macchia, Anna Moffo, Esmeralda Ruspoli

title: La ragazza di via Millelire
synopsis: Betty is thirteen years old, she immigrated from the south and lives, with a large family in disrepair, in the infamous Via Millelire in Turin. His is a continuous escape: from the family, from the degraded environment, from the assistance centers and from the reformers. For you, "difficult" girl, there can be no peace. Gianni Serra, "specialist" in social issues, makes a film of vibrant denunciation.
cast: Oria Conforti, Maria Monti, Mario Orlando, Lisa Policaro

title: La ragazza di via Veneto
synopsis: Two boyfriends of modest conditions want to see their aspirations realized at all costs: she wants to become a model and an actress, he a boxing champion. Fortune initially seems to smile more at the girl, who is noticed by a producer, but the future husband puts a spoke in the wheel ...
cast: Anna Maria Moneta Caglio, Carlo Giustini, Giulio Calì, Arturo Bragaglia, Carlo Delle Piane, Gisella Monaldi

title: La ragazza e il generale
synopsis: World War I, after the Italian defeat in Caporetto: the soldier Tarasconi (Orsini) captures an Austrian general (Steiger) and tries to bring him to his command; he would get the gold medal, a prize of one thousand lire and a license. Ada (Lisi), a smart and enterprising peasant woman, also intervenes, but the conclusion holds neither glory nor gratification. A "war tale", with a rather weak screenplay in its conspicuous inconsistencies and which is based more on the profession of interpreters.
cast: Virna Lisi, Rod Steiger, Umberto Orsini, Valentino Macchi

title: La ragazza fuoristrada
synopsis: Giorgio, an advertiser in a large agency, during a stay in Nubia to advertise a car brand, meets Maryam with whom he falls madly in love. He takes her with him to the city where he lives and, fighting with his parents against the wedding, marries her. The simplicity of her character and her sincerity clash with the hypocrisy of the hypocritical and racist province that immediately judges her badly. Maryam is targeted by two of Giorgio's friends and by a former mistress of her husband who does everything to get her away from the man she once loved.
cast: Zeudi Araya, Luc Merenda, Martine Brochard, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: La ragazza ha volato
synopsis: Nadia is an "uncomfortable" teenager who lives in Trieste, a border city between many cultures, a place swept by a powerful wind. Here, Nadia grows up cultivating a loneliness from which she will come out unexpectedly.
cast: Alma Noce, Luka Zunic, Rossana Mortara, Massimo Somaglino, Livia Rossi

title: La ragazza in vetrina
synopsis: Together with a group of Italians Vincenzo emigrated to Holland to work in a coal mine. His first experience in the bowels of the earth is traumatic. In fact, he remains imprisoned underground by a sudden collapse and, with difficulty, is freed by the rescue teams. Determined to return home, he is instead persuaded to stay by his friend Federico. The boy accompanies him to the famous street where prostitutes offer themselves from the windows of the houses. Here Vincenzo meets and falls in love with Els.
cast: Lino Ventura, Marina Vlady, Magali Noël, Bernard Fresson

title: La ragazza nella nebbia
synopsis: The night is freezing and foggy in Avechot, a village nestled in a deep valley in the shadow of the Alps. Perhaps it is precisely because of the fog that Special Agent Vogel's car has fallen into a ditch. Vogel is in shock: he does not remember why he is there and how he got there. And who does the blood on his clothes belong to? Of one thing he is certain: he should not have been in that place. In fact, two months have already passed since a girl in the village disappeared into the fog; from simple disappearance to kidnapping, the case came under the spotlight. This is precisely Vogel's specialty: manipulating the media, attracting cameras, conquering the front pages of newspapers and, finally, finding the monster. We need someone like him: unscrupulous, confident in his methods, someone capable of making sure that crime has what it deserves: a solution and an audience.
cast: Toni Servillo, Alessio Boni, Lorenzo Richelmy, Jean Reno, Galatea Ranzi, Michela Cescon, Lucrezia Guidone, Jacopo Olmo Antinori, Greta Scacchi, Ekaterina Buscemi

title: La ragazza sotto il lenzuolo
synopsis: In the crypt of an ancient castle transformed into a hotel, a thief, who pretends to be an archaeologist, discovers the ghost of Princess Maria Celeste d'Aragona Cortez. In an attempt to escape the intruder, the princess loses the sheet that made her invisible to human eyes. The complicity between the beautiful ectoplasm and the thief turns into love and for the woman he gets back on the right path. Except for the always glamorous Chelo Alonso, in the role of the princess, the film goes unnoticed. The cast is completed by the Cetra Quartet performing "Con il sob".
cast: Chelo Alonso, Walter Chiari, Carlo Delle Piane, Raimondo Vianello

title: La ragazzina
synopsis: Gorgeous 16-year-old Monica is coveted by both schoolmates and mature men. A peer also tries to pay her but she refuses, because she fell in love with a professor.
cast: Gloria Guida, Colette Descombes, Andres Resino, Gianluigi Chirizzi, Lucia Catullo, Gianni Bortolotti, Piera Vidale, Umberto Scaglione, Gian Carlo Cosma, Luigi Antonio Guerra

title: La raison d'état
synopsis: A French biologist discovers that a prominent government member is involved in international arms trafficking. He would like to report him, but he gets out of the way first. His battle is completed by an Italian friend who discovers the truth about his death.
cast: Jean Yanne, Monica Vitti, Michel Bouquet, François Périer, Jean Claude Bouillon

title: La rançon de la gloire
synopsis: Towards the end of the seventies of the twentieth century, in the small Swiss town of Vevey, on the shores of Lake Geneva, the forty-year-old Belgian Eddy after being released from prison is welcomed by his friend Osman. The two have made a deal that Osman will let Eddy stay in his shed and in return Eddy will take care of Samira, his friend's seven-year-old daughter, while her mother is in the hospital. As Christmas approaches, Eddy is rather embittered by the poverty in which he lives when the television announcement of Charlie Chaplin's death gives rise to a bizarre idea in him: to steal the body of the famous actor and director and demand a ransom from his. family.
cast: Benoît Poelvoorde, Roschdy Zem, Seli Gmach, Chiara Mastroianni, Nadine Labaki, Peter Coyote, Dolores Chaplin, Eugene Chaplin

title: La razzia, 16 ottobre 1943
synopsis: On October 16, 1943, the Nazi forces arrested over 1250 Jews in the city of Rome. Victims must pack their bags and leave their homes within minutes. On 18 October they are taken to Tiburtina station, herded into twenty-eight cattle wagons and deported to the Auschwitz-Birkenau extermination camp. Only sixteen will return. Seventy-five years after the raid of 16 October 1943, one of the most tragic pages of Italian history is retraced through the voices of those who lived it.

title: La rebelión de las muertas
cast: Paul Naschy, Romy, Mirta Miller, Maria Kosti, Aurora De Alba

title: La rebelión de los bucaneros
synopsis: The Queen of England gives the island of Horn, known as the island of sharks, to a group of former buccaneers, to whom she has forgiven the misdeeds, who want to live in peace by cultivating the land and fishing the pearl oysters of which the island she is rich. On the island, however, a shady French trader had also set his sights, aided by a corrupt English officer, trying in every way to prevent the operation. The so-called swashbuckling genre has experienced a season of success that is certainly not ephemeral: thanks, as in this film, to continuous twists and turns of the head, duels to the death, betrayals and victory of the hero.
cast: Stan Cooper, Charles Quiney, Maria Pia Conte, Isarco Ravaioli

title: La reconstruccion
synopsis: Eduardo, an impeccable worker with an obsessive and secret character, leads a solitary existence, enclosing his entire history in one of the rooms where he lives in Rio Grande. Faced with a request for help from an old friend, Eduardo decides to leave, letting the meeting with those who need him begin his personal reconstruction.
cast: Diego Peretti, Claudia Fontán, Alfredo Casero, Maria Casali, Eugenia Aguilar, Ariel Pérez

title: La recta provincia
synopsis: Once upon a time there was a man. He lived with his mother, worked on a large farm. One day he found a bone and played it like a flute. Together with his mother, the man began to look for the other bones to give a name and a burial to those bones. Following in the footsteps of God and those of the Devil, the two saw what they saw and lived many stories. They never told them, but others did it for them.
cast: Belgica Castro, Ignacio Aguero, Hernan Vellejos, Ángel Parra, Javiera Parra, Carolina Cuturrufo, Poli Délano, Carlos Flores, Elvis Fuentes, Augusto Góngora, Sebastián Layseca

title: La red
synopsis: Antonio and José are two outlaws. After a robbery they take refuge on an abandoned Mexican beach with José's girlfriend with whom Antonio falls in love. When Josè notices jealousy, things precipitate: Antonio kills the woman and then is killed by the police. Josè drowns with the corpse of his beloved in his arms.
cast: Rossana Podestà, Armand Silvestre, Crox Alvarado, Giullermo Cramer

title: La regina degli scacchi
synopsis: Maria Adele, a talented young chess player who lives in Ancona with her father, has recently lost her mother in an accident. During a chess match she meets Emilio sports reporter who asks her for an interview. While rummaging in a trunk to look for a photo to give to the journalist, Maria discovers a letter addressed to her mother, in which the father says he is willing to adopt a son. The thought of having been adopted makes its way into the mind of the girl who begins to investigate.
cast: Barbora Bobulova, Ettore Bassi, Toni Bertorelli, Massimo De Rossi

title: La regina degli uomini pesce
synopsis: While fleeing their city, sacked by barbarians, two teenagers accidentally meet Socrates, a man who leads them to a small tropical island dominated by a queen as beautiful as she is evil, who uses a hybrid race of fish-men to terrorize. the population and subject it to their will ...
cast: Ramona Badescu, Giuliano Gensini, Michael Velez, Natascia Castrignano, Donald Hodson

title: La regina dei Tartari
synopsis: With Igor dead, his pupil Tania takes his place as head. Malok, pretender to the throne, does not use force to seize it because he is in love with her. Pseudo-historical paper mache of the lowest quality.
cast: Jacques Sernas, Folco Lulli, Chelo Alonso, Mario Petri

title: La regina delle amazzoni
synopsis: The muscular Glaucus, the cunning Pyrrhus and some soldiers are lured by deception to the Amazon Island, who are used to using men to perpetuate the species and then kill them. But the dictatorship of women is short-lived. The strength of one and the cunning of the other pierce the hearts of the two women destined to become queens and save the unfortunate company. The film is dull and badly shot. The actors are also subdued.
cast: Rod Taylor, Dorian Gray, Gianna Maria Canale, Ed Fury, Alberto Farnese, Ignazio Leone, Daniela Rocca, Alfredo Varelli

title: La regina di Casetta
synopsis: Gregoria is the only girl who lives in Casetta, a remote village in the Apennines with only 10 inhabitants. You follow her during the last year she lives there: in September 2018 she will have to move to the valley to go to high school.

title: La regina di Saba
synopsis: Fearing an attack from the kingdom of Sheba, King Solomon sends his son Roboam to Sheba, in disguise. He saves the life of the king's daughter and immediately falls in love with her. When the king dies, the girl ascends the throne, but with a clause: she must remain a virgin until the god Atar Samani has decided who she will marry for. Quite boring and ragged historian.
cast: Gino Cervi, Leonora Ruffo, Gino Leurini

title: La región salvaje
synopsis: Alejandra, a young mother and housewife, raises her two children with her husband Angel in a small town. His brother Fabian, on the other hand, works as a nurse in a hospital. Their provincial lives are shattered by the arrival of the mysterious Veronica. However, sex and love can be fragile in some regions where strong family values, hypocrisy, homophobia and machismo exist. Veronica also convinces them that in the nearby woods, inside an isolated house, there lives something from another world, which could be the answer to all their problems.
cast: Simone Bucio, Ruth Jazmin Ramos, Edén Villavicencio, Jesús Meza

title: La regola d'oro
synopsis: Ettore is a young soldier of the Italian army kidnapped in Lebanon. Freed and brought back to Italy, he finds an entire country in fibrillation waiting for him. Everyone considers him a hero and the Army wants him to show up at the Taormina Festival. Ettore is entrusted to Simone, a television writer, to prepare him for the show. On stage, he will have his moment of popularity.
cast: Edoardo Pesce, Simone Liberati, Barbora Bobulova, Hadas Yaron

title: La reina de España
synopsis: 1956. Macarena Granada, a great "American" diva of Spanish origins, returns to her homeland to play Queen Isabella of Castile. Learning of his return, Blas Fontiverso, who has not returned to Spain since he moved to Berlin eighteen years earlier for the La niña of your dreams project, decides to return home and reconnect with some of his old friends. . His arrival, however, triggers a series of events that will test the filming of the film starring Macarena.
cast: Penélope Cruz, Cary Elwes, Mandy Patinkin, Juan Antonio Bayona, Santiago Segura, Javier Cámara, Clive Revill, Carlos Areces, Jorge Sanz, Aida Folch, Chino Darín

title: La religieuse
synopsis: France, 1760. Born into a middle-class family, Suzanne (Pauline Etienne) dreams of being able to continue to indulge her natural talent for music and to integrate into the social context but her parents cut off all her aspirations by taking her to a convent to become a nun. Intolerant of the rules of seclusion, Suzanne discovers that she is the illegitimate fruit of her mother's extramarital affair and tries in every way to dissolve her vows but, when the loving mother superior dies, she finds herself undergoing oppression and humiliation by her deputy, Sister Christine (Louise Bourgoin). Upon request, Susanne gets the transfer and lands in the convent of Saint Eutrope, where the mother superior (Isabelle Huppert) develops an almost morbid and embarrassing attention for her.
cast: Pauline Etienne, Isabelle Huppert, Louise Bourgoin, Francoise Lebrun, Martina Gedeck, Agathe Bonitzer, Alice De Lencquesaing, Gilles Cohen, Marc Barbé, François Négret, Lou Castel, Pierre Nisse

title: La rentrée
synopsis: Among the boys of the Ortica band, the Chiodo, the Denti, the Franchino, Mario Gibellini, known as "Danseur", stands out. He grew up in the gyms of an anonymous hinterland shooting boxing and soon got into trouble with the law. After jail, he tries to rewind the threads of a dream, that of the ring, not to mention that from certain environments it is difficult to leave with intact bones. Too bad, because his wife Teresa loves him, yes, but she is not cracked and has a name that too closely recalls the roughness of the Buscaglione girls.
cast: Francesco Salvi, Livia Bonifazi, Nando Gazzolo, Pasquale Anselmo

title: La repubblica di San Gennaro
synopsis: We are in 2013 and Italy is divided in two. In the Northern Republic, southerners are deported or locked up in special ghettos complete with high-voltage Friesian horses. In Milan, poor Strummolo tries everything to become a citizen of the North: he boasts German origins and calls himself Strumm and speaks with an unlikely Milanese accent. Neighbors treat him like a collaborator, relatives pity him, authorities persecute him.
cast: Gianfelice Imparato, Anna Ammirati, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Vincenzo Peluso

title: La resa dei conti
synopsis: After clearing the whole of Texas of thugs, Jonathan Corbett (Van Cleef) is offered a candidacy for the Senate by a big capitalist. First, however, he must capture Cuchillo (Milian), a Mexican bum accused of rape and murder. It will not be an easy task, nor will there be no surprises. Justice will be done, to the detriment of the real culprits.
cast: Lee Van Cleef, Tomas Milian, Walter Barnes, Nieves Navarro, Luisa Rivelli, Fernando Sancho, Roberto Camardiel, Tom Felleghy, Gérard Herter, Pietro Ceccarelli, Maria Granada

title: La residencia
synopsis: In Avignon, towards the end of the 19th century, the mysterious disappearance of some girls in a gloomy girls' boarding school unleashes fear. Then when the bodies of the girls, horribly battered, are found, the terror is total. Madame Fourneau, the strict director, then decides to see clearly and - with the help of some of the girls - she undertakes on her own the investigations aimed at uncovering who the killer is.
cast: Lilli Palmer, Cristina Galbó, John Moulder Brown, Maribel Martín, Mary Maude, Candida Losada, Pauline Challoner, Tomas Blanco, Víctor Israel, Teresa Hurtado

title: La revanche des mortes vivantes
cast: Kathryn Charly, Anthea Wyler, Veronik Gathy, Sylvie Noak

title: La ribelle
synopsis: Enza (sixteen) with her sister Rosaria (seventeen) one day, in a supermarket, trying to steal a wallet they are pinched. The judge sentenced them to a period of imprisonment in a religious institute run by nuns. During the leave Enza meets Sebastiano: she falls in love with him and, to be with him, runs away from the institute. But things are not going as she thought. It will be only another man, Franchino, to give her a glimmer of hope. Grimaldi drew this interesting "La rebelle" from his novel "Storia di Enza", a mix of melodrama and denunciation shot with determination. Excellent la Cruz: alone is worth the film.
cast: Penélope Cruz, Stefano Dionisi, Laura Betti, Marco Leonardi

title: La rieducazione
synopsis: Marco spends his days doing voluntary work in the parish. One day his father decides to make him face the responsibilities of life by sending him to work on a construction site, but the boy will find himself in serious difficulty.
cast: Marco Donatucci, Denis Malagnino, Pablo Sallusti, Gianluca Tiberi, Daniele Malagnino

title: La riffa
synopsis: Francesca, a fresh widow, falls from the stars to the stables. She doesn't fit in and, in agreement with a friendly lawyer, is giving herself away in a sort of lottery: four years with her for the lucky draw. A raffle with 20 tickets for sale at a price of 100 million each. He also has an affair with a penniless and rather interested young man. The raffle scandal is about to break out, but Francesca will be able to come out rich and free.
cast: Monica Bellucci, Giulio Scarpati, Massimo Ghini, Elena Cantatore

title: La rimpatriata
synopsis: A group of friends in their 35s find themselves, after having lost sight of each other for some time, for a "good night" of freedom and revelry. They are all married, with dependent families and professionally settled. Gradually, the initial euphoria gives way to the knowledge that a certain time of their existence has irremediably passed and that this was probably their last meeting. The evident intentions of costume criticism are partly thwarted by the structural weakness of the film, which concedes too much to the tones of the play.
cast: Walter Chiari, Francisco Rabal, Leticia Roman

title: La ripetente fa l'occhietto al preside
synopsis: After a love misadventure, Angela Pastorelli, daughter of a rich industrialist from the North, resumes her interrupted studies. Among the classmates there is the handsome Carlo Lucignani whom the girl would like to hook up, but who received from her father, an employee of Pastorelli, the veto to get busy with Angela. And still many other amenities on matters of the heart, possible or impossible, lucky or not. Perhaps the film is a tad above the average of other similar by-products. However, we are always at the level of a joke.
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Carlo Sposito

title: La risaia
synopsis: Pietro (Lulli) recognizes among the mondine hired to work in his rice fields, his natural daughter, Elena (Martinelli), born from the relationship with a woman he has abandoned. Elena is in love with Gianni (Battaglia) and is threatened by Mario (Auclair), Pietro's nephew. The father has the opportunity to sacrifice himself for the girl, after having revealed the truth to her. Matarazzo, author of major cinematographic melodramas, proposes the same setting as De Santis's "Riso amaro", but with less successful results. The story does not always convince and the interpretation is at times lacking, but Matarazzo takes his idea of ??melodrama to the extreme technicolor consequences: in fact the "matarazziani" doc have made it a cult.
cast: Elsa Martinelli, Folco Lulli, Michel Auclair, Rick Battaglia

title: La ritournelle
synopsis: Breeders in their fifties, Brigitte and Xavier run a medium-sized farm in the Vexin region. After the grown children decided to leave, the two were left alone. Trapped in a routine that weighs much more on her than on him, as a symptom of her inner malaise, Brigitte shows signs of eczema that continues to grow on her neck. One day, a party of young Parisians in the house next door will only accelerate the couple's latent crisis.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Michael Nyqvist, Pio Marmaï, Audrey Dana, Anaïs Demoustier, Marina Foïs, Clement Metayer

title: La rivale
synopsis: The Marquis Roberto, major of the cavalry, returns to Italy after a long stay abroad. In the past the officer made a close court to Agnes, a married lady. The woman, after the first hesitation, had ended up giving in. When the woman becomes a widow, Roberto would be ready to marry her, except that he knows Barbara, a girl courted by all her colleagues, in particular by Ugo.
cast: Gérard Landry, Anna Maria Ferrero, Maria Mauban, Roberto Risso

title: La rivincita
synopsis: Vincenzo (Michele Cipriani), due to a check protested by his brother Sabino (Michele Venitucci), loses any possibility of bank credit and, in the meantime, the land is expropriated in exchange for a negligible compensation. Sabino, on the other hand, is the victim of the oddities of his wife Angela (Sara Putignano), always without money. Due to their infinite misfortunes and, having no other choice available, the two brothers, sons of peasants from the Apulian Murge, end up in the hands of loan sharks. In order to pay the accumulated debts and indulge his wife Marta's (Deniz Ozdogan) desire for motherhood, Vincenzo decides to have his blood removed for a fee and also plans to sell a kidney.
cast: Michele Cipriani, Michele Venitucci, Sara Putigliano, Deniz Ozdogan, Domenico Fortunato, Francesco De Vito, Franco Ferrante

title: La rivincita di Ivanhoe
synopsis: While the King of England Richard the Lionheart is engaged in the Crusades, his opponents Hastings plot intrigues to seize power. In favor of the king and therefore against them the noble Ivanhoe is fighting. When Rowena, his betrothed, is forced into marriage to one of the Hastings, Ivanhoe storms the castle and frees her. The occasion is opportune because other feudal lords and the people, tired of the Hastings' antics, also rise up.
cast: Clyde Rogers, Gilda Lousek, Andrea Aureli, Duilio Marzio

title: La rivincita di Natale
synopsis: Fifteen years after the Christmas Eve card game in which he lost 550 million lire, Franco Mattioli returns to Bologna because he learned that his friend Lele - a film critic by profession, present at the fateful game (he had managed to win 500 thousand lire) - has an incurable disease. In all these years Franco has continually thought about the game and now he knows that the time has come for a rematch. For this he decides to convince the people present in 1986 (as well as Lele, Ugo Cavara, Stefano Bertoni and Antonio Santelia) to play again.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Carlo Delle Piane, Alessandro Haber, Gianni Cavina, George Eastman, Edoardo Romano, Osvaldo Ruggieri, Carlo Reali, Eliana Miglio, Augusto Zucchi, Nino Fuscagni, Vanessa Gallipoli

title: La rivolta dei barbari
synopsis: Undercover, a Roman consul is sent to a province to find out where the soldiers' wages go. He soon discovers that the thief is the corrupt governor and nails him to his responsibilities. Once the dishonest was handed over to the Roman authorities, he was appointed governor in his place.
cast: Roland Carey, Maria Grazia Spina, Mario Feliciani, Gabriele Antonini, Andrea Aureli, Susan Sullivan, Gaetano Scala, Franco Beltramme, Gilberto Galimberti

title: La rivolta dei gladiatori
synopsis: The tribune Marco Numidio is sent to Armenia to defeat the perfidious Amira who plots against Rome and organizes a revolt for the independence of his country.
cast: Gianna Maria Canale, Ettore Manni, Mara Cruz, Georges Marchal

title: La rivolta dei pretoriani
synopsis: The government action of the emperor Domitian is influenced by the beautiful and perfidious Artamne and by the devious Soter, leader of the gladiators. Valerio Rufo, who leads the praetorians, tries in every way to oppose corruption, the unjust and bloody actions with which the emperor oppresses the people.
cast: Richard Harrison, Moira Orfei, Giuliano Gemma, Piero Lulli

title: La rivolta dei sette
synopsis: Unjustly imprisoned and tortured by Milo, a tyrant of the city of Sparta and traitor of the Achea League, Keros manages to enter the ranks of the rebels, unmasks the evil in front of the Athenians and then kills him. One of the many noisy "peplums", but also quite imaginative.
cast: Tony Russell, Massimo Serato, Nando Gazzolo, Livio Lorenzon

title: La rivolta delle gladiatrici
cast: Lucretia Love, Pamela Grier, Paul Müller, Margaret Markov

title: La rivoluzione sessuale
cast: Marisa Mantovani, Ruggero Miti, Riccardo Cucciolla, Laura Antonelli

title: La roccia incantata
synopsis: Lucia, a nice mountain woman, is the keeper of an alpine refuge on the Gran Sasso. One day Aldo arrives at the refuge, a young Roman architect, who is forced to spend some time there due to a distortion. Love is born between the two.
cast: Dina Sassoli, Mirko Ellis, Irene Genna, Anna Maestri, Riccardo Cucciolla, Vira Silenti

title: La romana
synopsis: Beautiful but poor, Adriana finds work as a model for a painter. She becomes the lover of a chauffeur who promises to marry her, but then turns out to be already married. She improvises as a prostitute, falls in love with Gino, a good guy who ends up in jail for anti-fascist activities. Released after confessing the names of his companions, Gino kills himself, and Adriana finds herself alone again and expecting a child.
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Daniel Gélin, Franco Fabrizi

title: La romana
cast: Francesca Dellera, Gina Lollobrigida, Tony Lo Bianco

title: La rosa di Bagdad
synopsis: Princess Zeila, daughter of Caliph Oman III, is about to review the nobles who aspire to his hand. The sinister prince Jafar plots in the shadows: the young musician Amin will think about making love triumph, with the help of the Genius of the lamp ...

title: La rosa rossa
synopsis: After the First World War, General Paolo Balzeri goes to visit Koper with his cousins ??Piero and Ines. Among the fragments that unravel on the thread of memory, the soldier guards with particular affection the memory of the red roses that a mysterious woman used to leave in her room.
cast: Alain Cuny, Elisa Cegani, Giampiero Albertini, Antonio Battistella

title: La rose de fer
synopsis: During a walk, a young couple ends up making love in a cemetery by being trapped in the gloomy place at night.
cast: Françoise Pascal, Hugues Quester, Natalie Perrey, Mireille Dargent, Michel Delesalle, Jean Rollin

title: La rossa
synopsis: Amelia, nicknamed "the red", returns to her country after a few years of absence. She is accompanied by Pierre, a convict accused of theft of jewels, whom the woman met in Paris, the city where she lived. To escape the police he uses a local fisherman who, having understood the catch, refuses to help them.
cast: Fulvia Franco, Aldo Bufi Landi, Virna Lisi, Riccardo Garrone

title: La rossa
synopsis: Francisca abandons her lover and husband and goes to Venice where she meets Patrick, a very rich Englishman who had played a double game during the Second World War between the British and the Germans. Today Patrick wants to take revenge on the German officer who reported him to his bosses and uses the girl as bait. The director is German, the actors and settings are Italian, the result is a disaster.
cast: Giorgio Albertazzi, Ruth Leuwerick, Rossano Brazzi, Gert Fröbe

title: La rossa dalla pelle che scotta
synopsis: The Red is a beautiful woman who lives together with a penniless painter. The only paintings he manages to sell are the nudes of his partner. However, well conscious of his attractiveness, he does not hesitate to betray his partner, arousing his fatal jealousy.
cast: Farley Granger, Erika Blanc, Krista Nell, Ivana Novak, Venantino Venantini, Aydin Terzel, Umberto Di Grazia, Giorgio Dolfin, Fatma Karanfil, Filippo Perrone

title: La route de Corinthe
synopsis: American radar installations in Greece suffer an attack, and an undercover NATO agent - who was investigating the disturbances generated by a central communications center in the Mediterranean - is killed. The suspicions fall on Shanny, the latter's widow, who in an attempt to prove her innocence will find herself embroiled in an international conspiracy ...
cast: Jean Seberg, Maurice Ronet, Christian Marquand, Michel Bouquet, Saro Urzì, Claude Chabrol

title: La rupture
synopsis: An unscrupulous businessman hires a rogue scoundrel to tarnish the reputation of his daughter-in-law and thus prevent her from divorcing her husband, the son of the industrialist and a writer of little fame ...
cast: Stéphane Audran, Jean Pierre Cassel, Michel Bouquet

title: La règle du jeu
synopsis: A rich marquis leaves his lover to win back his wife, whom many men pay court to. The merry-go-round of the masters' loves are countered by those of the servants. All filmed in the country estate of the Marquis, where a group of nobles gathers for the rite of hunting the hare.
cast: Marcel Dalio, Nora Grégor, Roland Toutain, Jean Renoir, Gaston Modot

title: La répétition
synopsis: Louise and Nathalie are two teenagers who live everything in symbiosis: friendship, passions such as acting, life in short. An emotional inattention of Nathalie causes in her friend a great unhappiness which leads to a suicide attempt and causes a detachment that lasts several years. Then by chance they find themselves at the theater, Nathalie as the protagonist on stage while Louise married and became a dental technician, sitting in the armchair admires her and a little envies her. The two women meet again and resume the passionate and neurotic relationship for which Louise throws even her marriage to the winds and after a grueling tiraemolla they will still find themselves divided and unhappy, but this time each has a piece of life that the other would like for herself .
cast: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Emmanuelle Béart, Pascale Bussières, Sami Bouajila

title: La révolution n'est pas un dîner de gala
La sai l'ultima su... i matti?
synopsis: In a clinic for the mentally ill, a new patient arrives, named Caciotta, who tears off the panties of all the women he meets. It is August, and the head physician of the clinic is leaving for vacation. To replace him comes the beautiful doctor Lelli, who immediately becomes the object of the attentions of Caciotta and the rest of the patients.
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Giorgio Porcaro

title: La salamandre
cast: Jacques Denis, Bulle Ogier, Jean Luc Bideau, Véronique Alain

title: La sanguisuga conduce la danza
cast: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Femi Benussi, Krista Nell, Patrizia Webley

title: La santa
synopsis: Dante, Gianni, Agostino and Diego, four Neapolitan thugs, go to a small town in Salento to steal the statue of a saint. Pursuing a desperate dream of redemption, the one they will encounter will make them realize that they have committed the biggest mistake of their life: in a place where religious faith and ferocious superstition coexist in a precarious balance, the reactions of the community will be completely unpredictable. and very violent.
cast: Massimiliano Gallo, Gianluca Di Gennaro, Francesco Siciliano, Michael Schermi, Marianna Di Martino, Lidia Vitale, Renato Marchetti

title: La santa piccola
synopsis: Mario and Lino are two friends, born and raised in the Neapolitan health neighborhood. Theirs is a monotonous existence until the day Annaluce, Lino's sister, convinces the place of the place that he had made a miracle and she begins for this to be venerated like a saint. The fate of his family inevitably change and both boys discover they are different from what they thought: Mario realizes that he is homosexual and in love with Lino, who instead does not notice and tries to escape the routine of his life.
cast: Francesco Pellegrino, Vincenzo Antonucci, Sophia Guastaferro, Alessandra Mantice, Gianfelice Imparato, Pina Di Gennaro, Sara Ricci

title: La sbandata
synopsis: After thirty years of hard work as a cobbler and shoe, the elderly Salvatore leaves the United States to return to Sicily. Full of money and with a desire to find a woman who can satisfy her senile crafts. To offer him hospitality I am his brother Raffaele and his wife Rosa, but Salvatore's instincts awaken is the bursting Mariuccia. Tacitly agree with the mother, the girl adapts to indulge the uncle's erotic games, with the aim of pushing him a lot of money.
cast: Domenico Modugno, Eleonora Giorgi, Pippo Franco, Luciana Paluzzi

title: La scelta
synopsis: That of Laura and Giorgio could be a story of normal daily happiness, if only a sudden violence did not upset the balance, bringing to light their character differences. Then, when Laura discovers she is pregnant, the doubt about the paternity of the child tests their love, forcing the couple to face every fear and to make a choice.
cast: Raoul Bova, Ambra Angiolini, Valeria Solarino, Michele Placido, Manrico Gammarota, Monica Contini, Gennaro Diana, Marcello Catalano, Mejdi El Euchi, Vito Signorile

title: La scelta di Maria
synopsis: Rome, November 4, 1921: after a long journey by train, which became the embrace of the entire country, the remains of an unknown soldier who fell in the Great War, are buried at the Victorian in Rome, during a public ceremony. To choose the body between the eleven who represent the fallen on the different fronts of the war of Italy, a woman was called, Maria Bergamas, mother of Antonio, a young lieutenant who died on the battlefield and never found. A week earlier, on October 28, during a heartbreaking celebration in the Basilica of Aquileia, she is asked to Mary, on behalf of all mothers, to choose which body among eleven to bury at the altar of the homeland in Rome, as a symbol of all the fallen young people who had not been possible to give a name. It will become the unknown soldier.
cast: Sonia Bergamasco, Alessio Vassallo, Cesare Bocci, Alessia Franchin, Valentina Munafò, Carla Manzon, Marco Maria Casazza, Massimo Sangermano, Federico Pieri

title: La scelta impossibile
synopsis: By choosing to collaborate with justice, Ivan Coletta helps the police forces to defeat his former gang of criminals. In doing so, he will await him a long and tortuous inner path with new knowledge, intense experiences and strong emotions that will put his character, his sensitivity and his feelings to the test. But the past will resurface in a thousand ways and Ivan, finding himself at a crossroads, will have to deal with a precise choice.
cast: Giuseppe Di Giorgio, Nathalie Caldonazzo, Marco Di Stefano, Enzo Stasino, Manuela Malaga, Lorenzo Marangon, Marco Savio, Cesare Biondolillo, Tommaso Basili, Valentina Carrino

title: La sceriffa
synopsis: A western village is extorted by a gang of outlaws. The sheriff, an old Southern soldier, tries in vain to impose legality, but is killed. Then his widow, Carmela, a pugnacious old woman of Neapolitan origin, takes the field who, a little with strong manners, a little with tarallucci and wine, restores justice.
cast: Tina Pica, Tina De Mola, Livio Lorenzon, Ugo Tognazzi, Tino Scotti

title: La schiava io ce l'ho e tu no
synopsis: Demetrio Cultrera (Buzzanca), called Dedé, is the prototype of the Sicilian male; plus he is rich and single. Rosalba Giordano, daughter of the local king of tuna, manages to make him fall in love and marry him. The woman tries to acculturate him, but Dede feels enslaved. To distract himself he becomes a lover, but this too haunts him. So he goes to the Amazon and buys a native woman to be his slave.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Catherine Spaak, Adriana Asti, Gordon Mitchell

title: La sciantosa
synopsis: Early twentieth century. A singer from the café chantant falls in love with a young soldier who is about to leave to fight the First World War.
cast: Anna Magnani, Massimo Ranieri, Rosita Pisano, Nico Pepe

title: La science des rêves
synopsis: Arriving in Paris to work in a company that produces calendars, Stéphane Miroux leads a monotonous life which he compensates with his incredible dreams. One day he meets Stéphanie, his neighbor, and falls in love with her: but it won't be an easy relationship ...
cast: Gael García Bernal, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Alain Chabat, Miou Miou

title: La scimitarra del saraceno
synopsis: The pirate Dragut kidnaps Bianca, the daughter of the governor of Rhodes. The latter instructs Captain Drago, an adventurer out of jail, to retrieve his daughter. Drago defeats Dragut, frees the girl and falls in love with her. Sword and cloak also lower than the Italic medai.
cast: Lex Barker, Chelo Alonso, Massimo Serato, Graziella Granata

title: La scomparsa di Patò
synopsis: What happened to Antonio Patò (Neri Marcoré), an impeccable bank employee? This is the question that in 1890 the whole Sicilian town of Vigata was faced with an unusual event that occurred during the representation of the Passion of Christ on Good Friday: the accountant Patò, who was in the role of Judas, was seen the last time on the stage of the theater before disappearing with the stage clothes. Nobody seems to have seen anything but a mysterious writing, which appeared on a wall, instills a doubt: is the man dead or has he disappeared voluntarily? To shed light on the story, Elisabetta (Alessandra Mortelliti), Patò's wife, turns to the authorities. The investigations conducted by the Public Security, led by the delegate Bellavia (Maurizio Casagrande), and by the Royal Carabinieri, under the orders of Marshal Giummàro (Nino Frassica), seem to give no answers due to the rivalry between the two forces while the fellow citizens begin to formulate hypotheses more and more imaginative about the destiny of man.
cast: Nino Frassica, Maurizio Casagrande, Neri Marcoré, Alessandra Mortelliti, Gilberto Idonea, Flavio Bucci, Simona Marchini, Danilo Formaggia, Roberto Herlitzka, Manlio Dovì, Guia Jelo, Francis Pardeilhan, Angelo Maria Sferrazza

title: La sconosciuta
synopsis: Irena, a Ukrainian girl who has already lived in Italy for many years, arrives in a northern city to look for work as a waitress. She gets hired as a cleaning lady in a barracks located opposite the house of a family of goldsmiths: her goal is to spy on their movements ...
cast: Ksenia Rappoport, Michele Placido, Margherita Buy, Pierfrancesco Favino, Claudia Gerini, Piera Degli Esposti

title: La scoperta dell'alba
synopsis: Rome, 1981: Professor Mario Tessandori is killed with seven revolver shots by two Red Brigades, in the courtyard of the university and for all to see. He dies in the arms of Lucio Astengo, his friend and colleague. A few weeks later, Lucio Astengo disappears into thin air. Thirty years later ,. Caterina and Barbara Astengo, who were six and twelve years old when their father passed away, put up for sale the family's house by the sea, now abandoned for some time. In the house there is still a telephone which Caterina picks up the receiver, discovering that it gives a free signal. The phenomenon is inexplicable, the line is disconnected, she tries to dial numbers but the phone remains silent: for fun, she thinks of trying to dial their town house thirty years ago and on the other side she hears ring. A child's voice answers her: it is she, at twelve, a week before her father's disappearance. Destiny gave her a second chance: if not to save her father, at least to find out the truth.
cast: Margherita Buy, Sergio Rubini, Susanna Nicchiarelli, Lina Sastri, Gabriele Spinelli, Lino Guanciale, Sara Fabiano, Anita Cappucci Scudery, Renato Carpentieri

title: La scorta
synopsis: Judge De Francesco (Cecchi), starting from an investigation on water supplies, enters the sights of the mafia and clashes with his own colleagues. His escort faithfully follows him, and someone will pay with their life. Tognazzi, who was Sergio Leone's assistant director, creates a film that tells dramatically plausible facts according to an "American" narrative. And all the interpreters, for their part, assist him in the best possible way.
cast: Claudio Amendola, Enrico Lo Verso, Carlo Cecchi, Ricky Memphis, Leo Gullotta, Tony Sperandeo

title: La scoumoune
synopsis: Robert ("the excommunicated", in the Marseille environment), trying to save his friend Xavier from prison, confronts the gangster Villanova, kills him and thus takes over the shady dealings of the dead. Captured after a bloody confrontation with a gang of blacks, he is sentenced to twenty years in prison. After the war, Robert resumes his business, always with a thousand risks, but now more and more alone. A well-structured gangster-movie, which idelizes the evil of the past. Belmondo is a fascinating "tough guy", the others are a suitable crown.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Michel Constantin, Gérard Depardieu

title: La sculacciata
synopsis: After only six years, the marriage of Carlo and Elena goes into crisis as the man, desperate, finds himself helpless. Spouses are unable to remedy the sudden decline in desire; all their efforts to rekindle the dormant sexual passion, following the advice of a female rotogravure and resorting to sophisticated erotic games, seem to be useless ...
cast: Antonio Salines, Sydne Rome, Vincenzo Crocitti, Gino Pernice, Paolo Gozlino

title: La scuola
synopsis: A rainy October morning. Professor Majello, a dull woman, no longer enthusiastic, is preparing the lesson timetable. Among the many colleagues, Professor Vivaldi stands out, entirely absorbed in teaching, and the energetic and aggressive vice-principal Sperone. An interminable school year passes; but the frenzy of the latest questions and the anguish of the ballots have removed from Vivaldi the attraction he has always felt for Majello.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Anna Galiena, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Antonio Petrocelli

title: La scuola cattolica
synopsis: In a residential neighborhood in Rome stands a well -known male Catholic school where the boys of the best bourgeoisie are educated. Families feel that in that context their children can grow protected from the riots who are going through society and that that rigid education will be able to open the doors of a bright future. In the night between 29 and 30 September 1975, however, something breaks and that fortress of unassailable values ​​collapsed under the weight of one of the most heinous crimes of the time: the crime of the Circeo. The managers are in fact former students of that school also attended by Edoardo, who tries to tell what has unleashed a lot of blind violence in those minds enhanced by distorted political ideas and by an irrepressible desire for supremacy.
