cast: Benedetta Porcaroli, Giulio Pranno, Emanuele Maria Di Stefano, Giulio Fochetti, Leonardo Ragazzini, Fabrizio Gifuni, Valeria Golino, Riccardo Scamarcio, Jasmine Trinca, Valentina Cervi, Fausto Russo Alesi, Edoardo Carbonara, Alessandro Cantalini, Andrea Lintozzi, Guido Quaglione, Federica Torchetti, Luca Vergoni, Francesco Cavallo, Angelica Elli, Gianluca Guidi, Corrado Invernizzi, Beatrice Spata, Giulio Tropea

title: La scuola d'estate. Luca Ronconi a Santa Cristina
synopsis: The eighty-year-old Italian theater director Luca Ronconi, having reached the peak of his career, decides to create a new laboratory experience, aimed at the very young, isolated in the wilderness of Umbria: the Santa Cristina Theater Center. In a sort of "artistic imprisonment" the time of the students is engaged in the study of the texts that they face now alone, now gathering in small groups, to prepare for collective moments in the rehearsal room with the Master.

title: La scuola più bella del mondo
synopsis: Filippo Brogi (Christian De Sica), impeccable principal of a Tuscan middle school, scrupulously prepares a twinning with a school in Accra, Ghana. Due to a research error, the clumsy janitor Soreda (Lello Arena) sends the invitation to Acerra, making sure that the one that will arrive in San Quirico d'Orcia is a tribe of Neapolitan urchins, led by professor Gerardo Gergale (Rocco Papaleo) .
cast: Christian De Sica, Rocco Papaleo, Angela Finocchiaro, Miriam Leone, Lello Arena, Nicola Rignanese, Ubaldo Pantani, Daniela Terreri, Massimo De Lorenzo, Vittorio Edet, Ciro Nacca, Leonardo Esposito

title: La scuola è finita
synopsis: Istituto Pestalozzi, Rome: students and professors share the same boredom and exhaustion. The moments of joy are distributed by Alex Donadei for a fee in the form of colored tablets. Saving someone like Alex seems like an almost impossible undertaking, yet Daria and Talarico, two professors who are not really a model, try.
cast: Valeria Golino, Vincenzo Amato, Fulvio Forti, Marcello Mazzarella, Antonella Ponziani, Alfio Sorbello, Gianluca Belardi, Paola Pace, Silli Togni, Gea Martire, Marina Biondi, Vittoria Piancastelli, Erika Urban, Sergio Meogrossi, Paolo Giovannucci, Marco Zongardi

title: La seconda moglie
synopsis: In the very hot summer of 1957, in Tuscany, the truck driver Fosco returns to the country with his single mother Anna, found in Sicily and chosen as second wife after an early widowhood. Both Fosco is sanguine and visceral, as Anna is shy. Because Fosco is jealous and Livio, the son of the first bed, is inexorably attracted to the woman.
cast: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Giorgio Noé, Lazar Ristovski, Jessica Auriemma

title: La seconda notte di nozze
synopsis: Italy, end of the Second World War: Lilliana, widow, is forced to leave Bologna with Nino due to serious economic problems. The two move to Puglia near their brother-in-law Giordano, brother of Lilliana's husband, who had been madly in love with her in his youth ...
cast: Antonio Albanese, Katia Ricciarelli, Neri Marcoré, Angela Luce, Marisa Merlini, Patrizio Pelizzi

title: La seconda ombra
synopsis: 1961: freshly appointed, Franco Basaglia takes up service at the psychiatric hospital in Gorizia. Disguised as an attendant, he observes the inhuman conditions in which the patients find themselves: electric shocks, lobotomies, straitjackets, beatings, bars on the windows ...
cast: Remo Girone, Victoria Zinny, Eva Mauri

title: La seconda volta
synopsis: Professor Alberto Sajevo has been living for twelve years with a bullet in the head. Lisa, the former terrorist who shot him, serves his sentence in semi-release. A chance encounter causes their destinies to cross again. She doesn't recognize him, he does and approaches her with a fake name. But elapsed time does not change identities, and neither explains the past nor can it make up for it. Calopreste's film does not want to talk about terrorism, but about the impossibility of fully understanding a "black hole" in our history: not a film about ideologies, but about sadness, loneliness, the relentless repression to be exercised in the present. Calopreste has the courage not to do a "political" work (in the traditional sense) and to conclude with pessimism. Too bad he didn't have the courage to dig deeper into the (reversible) executioner-victim game.
cast: Nanni Moretti, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Valeria Milillo, Roberto De Francesco, Marina Confalone, Francesca Antonelli

title: La seconda volta non si scorda mai
synopsis: While visiting an apartment with some clients, Giulio, a brilliant real estate agent, meets Ilaria. For him it is love at first sight: too bad she is about to marry an older man. Giulio does not rest until, unexpectedly, the girl invites him to her house. The man runs to the appointment, ignoring that fate will hold him several surprises.
cast: Alessandro Siani, Elisabetta Canalis, Marco Messeri, Fiorenza Marchegiani

title: La seconde vérité
synopsis: The lawyer Pierre Montaud is accused of the murder of a certain Olivier Lacat, killed with a gun owned by the lawyer. The accusation is reinforced by the fact that Nathalie, a former partner of Lacat, is now Montaud's mistress. Despite the weight of the clues, however, Montaud was acquitted at the trial amid general disbelief.
cast: Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Jacques Castelot, Bernard Tiphaine

title: La sedia della felicità
synopsis: A beautician (Isabella Ragonese) and a tattoo artist (Valerio Mastandrea), two guys who, not being able to rely only on their own strength, are waiting for a stroke of luck that will change their lives, will find themselves involved in an absurd and crazy story.
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Isabella Ragonese, Giuseppe Battiston, Antonio Albanese, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Silvio Orlando, Katia Ricciarelli, Raul Cremona, Marco Marzocca, Milena Vukotic, Roberto Citran, Lucia Mascino, Mirco Artuso, Roberto Abbiati, Natalino Balasso, Maria Paiato

title: La seduzione
synopsis: Back in his native Catania, the journalist Giuseppe Laganà meets again Caterina, an old flame of his. The widowed woman has a teenage daughter, Graziella, whose bitter charm Giuseppe will not be able to resist ...
cast: Lisa Gastoni, Maurice Ronet, Jenny Tamburi, Barbara Marzano

title: La semana del asesino
synopsis: Marcos (Vincente Parra), a butcher, commits a ferocious crime due to an altercation with a taxi driver. This accidental murder, the result of a raptus, is only the first of a long and unstoppable chain of crimes. The subsequent victims of his murderous fury are therefore people close to him, with whom he had confided: his girlfriend, his brother and his partner, his father. Using his work, Marcos then hides the bodies of the corpses - after having torn them to pieces - in the slaughterhouse, without imagining being observed by a tenant, residing on the thirteenth floor of a building near the slaughterhouse.
cast: Vicente Parra, Emma Cohen, Eusebio Poncela, Charly Bravo, Fernando Sánchez Polack, Goyo Lebrero, Vicky Lagos, Ismael Merlo, Rafael Hernández, José Franco, Valentín Tornos, Antonio Orengo, Antonio Corencia, Antonio Del Real, José Félix Montoya, Ángel Blanco, Manuel Calvo, Emilio Hortela

title: La sepolta viva
synopsis: In a villa in the surroundings of Naples, still Bourbon, but for a short time, the greedy count Federico kills his mother and holds the stepsister Eva imprisoned, guilty of being a fervent watter of the hero of the two worlds, as well as having fallen in love with one of the his officers. The Garibaldini, however, conquered Sicily, are preparing to land on the peninsula. They will be their victory to save the situation. In the tradition of Feuilleton, the film shows off a cumbersome intertwining, a decisive simplification of the characters in favor of the succession of the events and strong melodramatic colors, accentuated by acting. It was a success.
cast: Milly Vitale, Paul Müller, Evi Maltagliati

title: La setta
synopsis: Myriam teaches in a Frankfurt school. One day he meets a strange old man who was injured in a car accident. The man, who behaves in an unusual way, reveals to her that he is the priest of a sect that awaits the birth of the Antichrist. Myriam is the one predestined to give birth to him. Raped by a strange animal, Myriam wakes up at midnight ... pregnant.
cast: Kelly Curtis, Herbert Lom, Mariangela Giordano, Tomas Arana

title: La settima donna
cast: Florinda Bolkan, Ray Lovelock, Flavio Andreini, Sherry Buchanan

title: La settima stanza
synopsis: Edith Stein, born Jewish but converted to Catholicism in 1922, is a world-renowned scholar, assistant to the philosopher Husserl. While political tension increases in Germany, Edith's religious vocation matures up to the decision to become a Carmelite nun. Meanwhile, outside, the Nazi persecutions against the Jews are getting harder and harder. Edith, as a Jew, is also deported to Auschwitz to meet her terrible fate.
cast: Maia Morgenstern, Adriana Asti, Jan Novicki, Elide Melli

title: La settimana al mare
synopsis: Carlo is the only child of a mother who tries to protect him from the pitfalls of women and of a father who would like him to give himself a little more to do. Taken by the latter on holiday in a tourist village in Sicily with a friend with the aim of introducing him to the joys of love conquests, the young man proves that he knows how to do more than his own "guides". Comedy not the worst, shot in Bagheria with the most classic of cast. If you want, you can also laugh, especially at the jokes of Bombolo street vendor.
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Andrea Occhipinti, Enzo Cannavale, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Bombolo

title: La settimana bianca
synopsis: A company outing on the snow sees participants engaged in playboy feats; the competition aims to conquer the beauty of the group (Rizzoli). In moments of pause our heroes try their hand at barracks jokes or console themselves for their failures in the arms of a complacent waitress.
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Enzo Cannavale, Bombolo, Giacomo Furia, Paolo Giusti, Graziella Polesinanti, Carmen Russo, Vincenzo Crocitti

title: La settimana della sfinge
synopsis: A beautiful waitress, expert in puzzles, falls in love with a playboy antenna player and follows him everywhere. However, he considers it a passing conquest and snubs it. Eventually he gives in, but then she dumps him. Pleasant and minimal, one of Luchetti's best films, around an unprecedented Adriatic Italy. Very good Margherita Buy.
cast: Margherita Buy, Paolo Hendel, Silvio Orlando, Delia Boccardo

title: La sfida degli implacabili
synopsis: The terrible and ferocious Gringos brothers, known throughout the West by the nickname "Relentless", are determined to kill the hated Joe as soon as he is released from prison. The rivalry between the prisoner and the Gringos brothers gives rise to bloody struggles for supremacy in the city. Joe, one way or another, always manages to get away with it and take the skin home.
cast: George Martin, Audrey Amber, Katya Loritz, John McDouglas

title: La sfida dei giganti
synopsis: Ercole ran to save Xanto who is held prisoner from Gea, goddess of the earth. Taking advantage of the absence of him Anteo, son of Gea, dominates the city of Syracuse. But Hercules won't waste time. Once freed, Xanto runs to Syracuse, destroys the city and also kills Anteo. Pelplum particularly poor and without ideas. Lucidi signs Maurice Bright.
cast: Reg Park, Luigi Barbini, Gia Sandri, Giovanni Cianfriglia

title: La sfinge d'oro
synopsis: An archaeologist organized an expedition to Upper Egypt to track down the tomb of Pharaoh Aposis. However, he has to deal with two adventurers who join the expedition to seize the treasure. The two manage to secure the complicity of a collaborator of the archaeologist, but in the end they will not be able to enjoy the fruit of their misdeeds.
cast: Robert Taylor, Anita Ekberg, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Remo De Angelis

title: La siciliana ribelle
synopsis: On November 5, 1991, 17-year-old Rita Atria denounces the murderers of her father and brother, both mafia. Threatened, she flees to Rome under the protective wing of Paolo Borsellino. The massacre of via D'Amelio puts Rita in front of the excess of her battle.
cast: Gérard Jugnot, Veronica D'Agostino, Marcello Mazzarella, Lucia Sardo

title: La signora della notte
synopsis: Simona, a young aerobic teacher, discovers the pleasures of extramarital sex, but in the end she returns to her husband. The only intent of the film is to show the abundant Serena Grandi struggling with various and fiery lovers. There is a masturbation with the barrel of a rifle.
cast: Serena Grandi, Fabio Sartor, Francesca Topi, Stanko Molnar

title: La signora delle camelie
synopsis: The story of the difficult and unhappy love story between Margherita, the most beautiful courtesan in Paris, and Armando Duval. Confronted in the name of good petty-bourgeois rules, their relationship is heading towards a tragic ending, despite Margaret showing redemption and great nobility of soul.
cast: Rossella Falk, Massimo Foschi, Gastone Piperno, Arturo Dominici, Gabriella Gabrielli, Luciano Zuccolini, Gianna Giachetti, Claudio Gora, Alfredo Bianchini, Elsa Albani

title: La signora di Wall Street
synopsis: Brenda is beautiful and unscrupulous. To make a career in the world of high finance, he does not hesitate to exploit his attractiveness, giving his body to powerful men. However, all happens unbeknownst to her husband.
cast: Tara Buckman, Charlie Edwards, Louie Elias, Paul Van Gent, Dan Smith, Sashin Sardot, Julia Howard, Bill Wall, Richard Frank Sume, Robert Alberta

title: La signora di tutti
synopsis: Gaby Doriot is a saleswoman who kills hearts and once a professor, even married, has taken his own life for her sake. Now Gaby attends the home of an industrialist, when he declares his love to her, his wife, pinned to a wheelchair, falls down the stairs and dies. The man then marries Gaby and for her he goes into debt until bankruptcy and prison. In the meantime, she becomes a movie diva. Flamboyant and intellectual melodrama by Max Ophuls who on this occasion finds himself, for the first and only time, at work in Italy. From a novel by Salvator Gotta, Ophuls makes refined and all over the top variations, forcing tones and events up to the pure visionary.
cast: Isa Miranda, Memo Benassi, Tatjana Pavlova, Federico Benfer, Nelly Corradi

title: La signora gioca bene a scopa
synopsis: Matteo, of Neapolitan origins but owner of a shoe shop in Parma, is an inveterate poker player and well-known libertine. Having accumulated heavy gambling debts, he begins to demand from his women, obtaining it, money for his "benefits". The troubles begin when Matteo, forced into an erotic overwork by increasingly heavy losses, asks for help from his clerk, Tonino; for a while it works, but soon the assistant starts ... on his own.
cast: Carlo Giuffrè, Edwige Fenech, Didi Perego, Franca Valeri, Oreste Lionello

title: La signora in nero
synopsis: A mysterious woman dressed in black appears on the threshold of a church on a wedding day and disrupts the party. From a French comedy, an escape short film with a good Carlo Ninchi and Gandusio on his shoulder.
cast: Carlo Ninchi, Laura Redi

title: La signora senza camelie
synopsis: Clara Manni, ex-saleswoman, makes her fortune in the world of cinema. A producer falls in love with Clara: he marries her and sets up a "Joan of Arc" for her, which is a fiasco and leads him to economic ruin. After helping him by playing a commercial film, Clara runs away with a diplomat, but even this love story ends badly and the woman, to re-enter the world of cinema, has to adapt to the silly parts that they offer her. Antonioni implements a healthy lesson in cynicism by turning his careful and cruel eye on the world of cinema: his studies. A young and beautiful Lucia Bosé and a series of other extraordinarily characterized figures are lost in this mechanism.
cast: Lucia Bosé, Gino Cervi, Andrea Checchi, Ivan Desny, Alain Cuny

title: La signora è stata violentata!
synopsis: Good bourgeois unwittingly start a drug party, during which the landlady is raped without recognizing the aggressor. Both she and her husband go into crisis and try to figure out who it might have been. The truth comes out slowly, and it is unexpected.
cast: Pamela Tiffin, Carlo Giuffrè, Enrico Montesano

title: La sindrome di Antonio
synopsis: On September 18, 1970, the twenty-year-old Antonio left Rome with his mother's Fiat 500 to reach Athens. His is not a simple vacation: Antonio has the myth of Plato and is convinced, or at least he hopes, that in Greece he will find the cave of shadows, the place beyond which the knowledge narrated by the Greek philosopher lives. Of course, "to fully understand a man and his ideas, it is absolutely necessary to go to the places where that man and those ideas originated", Antonio thus embarks on a training journey, which will also lead him to get to know himself better, discovering a reality still unknown to him and meeting characters with complex and mysterious stories such as Vassilis, the owner of the inn where Klingsor is staying, the silent painter who paints pictures and looking at the sea awaits the return of his missing partner. In Greece Antonio will also find love, sharing an adventure with Maria that will remain unforgettable. Yet Maria, as her friend Gino will tell him after many years, is anything but a simple student.
cast: Biagio Iacovelli, Queralt Del Greco, Antonio Catania, Remo Girone, Giorgio Albertazzi, Mingo De Pasquale, Moni Ovadia

title: La sindrome di Stendhal
synopsis: While groups of visitors contemplate the paintings at the Uffizi Museum in Florence, a girl, in front of Bruegel's "Flight of Icarus", faints and falls into a state of hallucination: she suffers from "Stendhal's syndrome", a disorder that occurs right in front of particularly suggestive works of art. Anna is a policewoman and is investigating a series of heinous murders that took place in Rome ...
cast: Asia Argento, Paolo Bonacelli, Thomas Kretschmann, Marco Leonardi

title: La sirène du Mississippi
synopsis: Louis Mahé (Jean-Paul Belmondo) lives on the island of Réunion and married Julie (Catherine Deneuve) after meeting her by correspondence. She is much more beautiful than in the photographs and justifies herself by saying that she sent him those of a neighbor, to test him. In reality, she is a scammer and murderer named Marion who, after breaking up Louis' bank account, escapes. But the man is now in love with her. The escape of Louis and Julie / Marion is also an uncompromising escape from civilization and its rules and rightly does not end on the last frame: the viewer's imagination is left with the task of imagining a conclusion. Film idolized by cinéphiles, it mixes melodrama and detective genre and makes use of the presence of a dazzling Deneuve and a fascinating Belmondo. Based on a novel by Cornell Woolrich.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Jean Paul Belmondo, Nelly Borgeaud, Martine Ferrière, Marcel Berbert, Yves Drouhet, Michel Bouquet, Roland Thénot

title: La sirène rouge
synopsis: Little Alice, on the run from her mother who traffics in snuff movies, reports the murder of her babysitter to police inspector Anita Staro. The policewoman decides to take up the case despite the opposition of her boss who fears the economic and political power of the woman. Meanwhile Alice, to avoid being sent home, hides in Hugo's car. The latter is nothing more than an unscrupulous killer who, however, decides to help the child by accompanying her on the journey in search of her father, who has retired to Portugal.
cast: Jean Marc Barr, Asia Argento, Frances Barber, Andrew Tiernan, Alexandra Negrao

title: La smania addosso
synopsis: Sicilian friends Totò and Nicola rape Rosaria. Later, neither of them intends to "make amends" with the marriage. To convince at least one of them to act as a remedial one, everyone goes there: parents, carabinieri, mafia, luminaries of the forum and so on. Totò and Nicola end up in prison, but two well-known lawyers manage to prove that Totò had been provoked and that Nicola is afflicted with psychic impotence. In the meantime, Totò and Rosaria really fall in love and Nicola enters into a relationship with Carmelina, thus denying, in fact, her lawyer ...
cast: Gérard Blain, Annette Stroyberg, Nino Catelnuovo, Vittorio Gassman

title: La societé du spectacle
synopsis: Derived from the book of the same name, the best-known operation among the cinematographic encroachments of one of the most lucid and acute "cultural provocateurs" of the last twentieth century: oscillating between seriousness and parody, the accumulation and "détournement" of visual materials (clips of fictional film) tends to distort and overturn its original meaning.

title: La soldatessa alla visita militare
synopsis: In the military, a surprise disturbs the quiet routine of everyday life. The new doctor has arrived, and it is a beautiful woman. Everyone flirts with her or, more prosaically, spies on her while she's taking a shower. But only a handsome, slightly rebellious soldier will be able to have a relationship with her: the others have to console themselves with a group of auxiliaries who replace the doctor when she gets married. One of the many films with a fixed cast (Montagnani in the role of the dirty graduate, Vitali who takes the slaps, Gammino who plays the beautiful tenebrous) that revolve around the generous shapes of the Fenech.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Michele Gammino

title: La soldatessa alle grandi manovre
synopsis: Eva Marini, a graduate in medicine, has the task of drawing up a secret report on the sexual behavior of the soldiers of the barracks commanded by Colonel Fiaschetta. Here, apart from the embarrassments, the jokes and the vulgarities she encounters, the valiant doctor also finds a way to help Don Pagnotta in his work in favor of a group of orphans ...
cast: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Renzo Montagnani, Michele Gammino

title: La solitudine dei numeri primi
synopsis: Mattia and Alice are boys whose life was marked in their youth by tragic events. She was lame in a ski accident, he lost - with serious responsibility - his autistic little sister. They know each other in high school where they unite their loneliness and continue in a form of friendship over the years and through various and complex events.
cast: Alba Rohrwacher, Luca Marinelli, Martina Albano, Arianna Nastro, Isabella Rossellini, Filippo Timi

title: La sombra de la ley
synopsis: In 1921 the city of Barcelona was plagued by gangs of Catalan mercenaries and anarchists. On the outskirts, an anonymous group of gunmen break into a military train full of weapons and ammunition. Inspector Anibal Uriarte is tasked by the federal police to find the culprits before the theft leads to further deaths and suffering.
cast: Luis Tosar, Michelle Jenner, Ernesto Alterio, William Miller, Fernando Cayo, Manolo Solo, Adriana Torrebejano, Paco Tous, Jaime Lorente, Vicente Romero

title: La sonate à Kreutzer
synopsis: Poznyecev (Éric Rohmer) decides to get married so as not to feel humiliated, but the relationship with his wife (Françoise Martinelli) does not work and goes on only by means of a courtesy of facade. However, the man is overcome by the most blind jealousy when she has an affair with the violinist Trukhacevskij (Jean-Claude Brialy).
cast: Eric Rohmer, Françoise Martinelli, Jean Claude Brialy, André Bazin, Charles L. Bitsch, Claude Chabrol, Jean Luc Godard, Marc Laferrière, François Truffaut

title: La sonnambula
synopsis: Lisa is jealous of sweet Amina, in love with and betrothed to Alvino. When he realizes that his rival is sleepwalking and discovers her in the room of a foreign count who has just arrived in the village, he tries to discredit her in the eyes of his beloved. At first Amina is estranged from everyone, but then, thanks to the count, she manages to prove her innocence.
cast: Gino Sinimberghi, Paola Bertini, Alfredo Colella, Franca Tamantini

title: La sorella di Satana
synopsis: A young woman is driving alone near a lake when a sudden accident causes her to skid and fall into the muddy waters. There awaits the spirit of a girl killed in the 18th century by the inhabitants of the neighboring village, who takes possession of her body to transform it into a machine of revenge.
cast: Barbara Steele, John Karlsen, Ian Ogilvy, Mel Welles, Joe 'Flash' Riley, Richard Watson, Edward B. Randolph, Peter Grippe, Lucretia Love, Ennio Antonelli

title: La sorella di Ursula
synopsis: After the death of their father, the two sisters Dagmar and Ursula arrive in a luxurious hotel on the Riviera to overcome the moment of discouragement and get on the trail of their mother. Meanwhile, a mysterious killer begins to kill the girls in the area, all linked by a rather unusual circumstance: before being murdered, they had had sexual intercourse ...
cast: Barbara Magnolfi, Marc Porel, Stefania D'Amario, Vanni Materassi, Antinisca Nemour

title: La source des femmes
synopsis: In a village between North Africa and the Middle East, tradition has it that women go to get water from the spring, even in summer, with the sun going down and all that way to go. Leila, a newly married girl, proposes to her companions an original strike, the only one that is possible for them: they will no longer make love with their husbands until they go to the source.
cast: Hafsia Herzi, Leïla Bekhti, Zinedine Soualem, Sabrina Ouazani, Malek Akhmiss, Saad Tsouli

title: La souriante Madame Beudet
synopsis: Madame Beudet is an intelligent woman trapped in a loveless marriage. Since her husband plays a stupid game in which he holds an unloaded gun, threatening to shoot himself, she decides one day to put a real bullet in the magazine without his knowledge. The consequences of this gesture will be unpredictable.
cast: Germaine Dermoz, Alexandre Arquillière, Jean D'Yd, Yvette Grisier, Madeleine Guitty, Raoul Paoli, Armand Thirard

title: La spacconata
synopsis: A gold digger with a dependent child fights and wins against the boss of a small town on the Canadian border. Unwatchable.
cast: Robert Wood, Franca Gonella

title: La spada della vendetta
synopsis: While the governor of Milan, Don Gonzalo de Cordova, is besieging the city of Casale, the deputy governor tyrannizes the people to win the sympathy of the Spanish rulers. Since Diana, a noble girl, will come into possession of a huge fortune at the time of the wedding, the deputy governor plans to marry her with the help of the noble's sister, Elizabeth. But Diana is in love with Marco, a soldier of fortune so when the deputy governor plans to kidnap her she will have to deal with the military ...
cast: Frank Latimore, Patricia Luz, Gian Luigi Marianini, Franco Trompeo

title: La spada e la croce
synopsis: In Pontius Pilate's Palestine, Maria di Magdala (De Carlo) is disputed between the Roman Caio Marcello (Mistral) and the indigenous Anan (Serato). Struck by the preaching of Christ, the Magdalene repents and tries in vain to save him. He will be present at the Crucifixion. Characters and situations from the Gospels as a pretext for a rather heavy peplum.
cast: Yvonne De Carlo, Jorge Mistral, Massimo Serato, Rossana Podestà

title: La spada normanna
synopsis: In the year 1000, on the death of King Henry, Stephen Cunningam took the crown of England and Scotland by force. Ten years later, the young Norman Ivanhoe, returning from the Holy Land, is imprisoned for his opposition to the usurper. An absolutely mediocre film in terms of reconstruction, script and interpretation.
cast: Mark Damon, Luis Davila, Krista Nell, Manolo Zarzo, Linda Sini

title: La spettatrice
synopsis: Valeria, closed and lonely, meets Massimo, a charming forty year old. The two do not know each other, but the girl spies on him from her home and is willing to change city, job, life just to be close to him. But Flavia, the man's companion, is also involved.
cast: Barbora Bobulova, Andrea Renzi, Brigitte Catillon

title: La spia che viene dal mare
synopsis: While a conference is taking place in Geneva, the American counter-intelligence suspects that an organization is taking advantage of it to carry out an attack. The intended victim is the atomic scientist Lindstrom. Special Agent 027 is sent to investigate.
cast: John Elliot, Simone Mitchell, Hector Ribott, Jeanine Raynaud

title: La spiaggia
synopsis: Anna Maria is a prostitute who went on vacation to the sea with her little daughter Caterina. In the hotel where she is, she is well liked by everyone, but of course no one knows who she really is. When she rejects the attentions of someone who knows her, it causes scandal. Anna Maria risks being banned, but here comes a billionaire who has fallen in love with her ... The comedy of manners dissolves in the fairy tale to increase the strength of his morale. A bitter and explicit comedy against the moral hypocrisy of the Italian bourgeoisie of the time. The staging with a skilful use of color is very refined. Screenplay by Cahrles Spaak, Rodolfo Sonego, Luigi Malerba. Still breathtaking Valeria Moriconi teenager in the shower.
cast: Martine Carol, Raf Vallone, Mario Carotenuto, Valeria Moriconi

title: La sposa americana
synopsis: A young Italian literature teacher meets young Edith in the United States, where he teaches, and marries her. But he soon falls in love with her sister, Anna, who is married to the homosexual Sacha. The two become lovers consuming adultery practically under the eyes of Edith who seems, at times, to indulge her husband's adventure. But one day Edith reveals that she is suffering from an incurable disease. Based on the novel of the same name by his father Mario, Giovanni Soldati stages a sentimental story for four which, however, seems only the pretext to show a series of genuine erotic performances by his wife Sandrelli.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Thommy Berggren, Trudie Styler, Harvey Keitel

title: La sposa era bellissima
synopsis: From the village of Cammarata many heads of families have embarked on the road to Germany which has offered them a job. Among these the husbands of Carmela and Maria. Maria is courted by the dentist of which she is assistant. This triggers the jealousies of the child of the woman who would like to know his real father. When the sick woman dies, the son goes to Germany to kill his father. It is unfortunate that Pal Gabor, one of the great Hungarian directors ("Angi Vera"), has let himself be entangled in this melodrama which often borders on ridicule.
cast: Angela Molina, Massimo Ghini, Stefania Sandrelli, Marco Leonardi

title: La sposa non può attendere
synopsis: Alfonso is running to get married. Along the way, he lingers to help a pregnant girl who wants to commit suicide. Arriving late at his wedding, his relatives do not believe what has happened and consider him an unfaithful liar who has tried to abdicate his responsibilities.
cast: Gino Cervi, Gina Lollobrigida, Odile Versois, Giacomo Furia, Ave Ninchi

title: La sposina
cast: Antenisca Nemour, Carlo De Mejo, Magda Konopka, Riccardo Garrone

title: La stagione dei sensi
synopsis: Summer is ending and four girls and two boys are taking a trip. Running out of petrol, they take refuge in an ancient castle. In the manor lives Luca who has just strangled his lover by throwing her body into a well.
cast: Ugo Adinolfi, Laura Belli, Edda Di Benedetto, Udo Kier, Andreina Paul

title: La stagione della caccia - C'era una volta Vigata
synopsis: At the end of the 19th century, in the small Sicilian town of Vigata, Alfonso la Mattina, known as Fofò, returns, intending to continue the work of his father Santo. Before being killed, Santo tended a sort of miraculous garden for the wealthy Peluso family, a garden whose flowers and fruits seem to have beneficial healing effects. Using his father's magical herbs, Fofò opens a pharmacy but strangely soon afterwards suspicious deaths begin to occur in the bosom of the Peluso family ...
cast: Francesco Scianna, Miriam Dalmazio, Tommaso Ragno, Donatella Finocchiaro, Ninni Bruschetta, Giorgio Marchesi, Alessio Vassallo, Alice Canzonieri, Orio Scaduto, Gioia Spaziani, Bruno Torrisi, Michele Ragno, Lollo Franco, Alessandro Schiavo, Roland Litrico, Julia Barbara Rizzuto

title: La stanza
synopsis: The morning when Stella decides to take her own life, a stranger knocks on her door who seems to know her all too well. When Sandro, the man who broke Stella's heart, also arrives at the house, an already complicated situation quickly turns into chaos: Giulio, the stranger, seems intent on bringing to light all the secrets of the house. Who is Giulio? What are Stella and Sandro hiding?
cast: Guido Caprino, Camilla Filippi, Edoardo Pesce

title: La stanza del figlio
synopsis: Giovanni, a psychoanalyst from Ancona, is summoned by the principal of his son Andrea's school, accused of stealing a fossil. At home, the man discusses with his wife Paola about the responsibility of the son, who denies the theft and mends the break with his parents in advance. Some time later Andrea dies during a dive and the life of Giovanni, Paola and the second daughter Irene is shattered.
cast: Nanni Moretti, Laura Morante, Giuseppe Sanfelice, Jasmine Trinca

title: La stanza del vescovo
synopsis: A young heartthrob meets Mr. Temistocle Mario Orimbelli, his shrewish wife Cleofe and his beautiful sister-in-law in a villa on Lake Maggiore. He falls in love with the latter, but retires when Themistocles, a widower, wants to marry her. It turns out then that Themistocles' widowhood is not accidental but deliberate: it is he who got rid of his wife, drowning her. Based on the homonymous story by Pietro Chiara, the film delves into the hidden aspects of the respectable bourgeoisie. One hundred and twenty film by Tognazzi, accompanied by a rising Muti and by Patrick Dewaere, a French actor who died prematurely.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Ornella Muti, Lia Tanzi, Patrick Dewaere, Gabriella Giacobbe, Piero Mazzarella

title: La stanza dello scirocco
synopsis: It is 1936 and the Marquis of Acaquafurata who has lived for years in Paris returns to Sicily to take possession of a building that his cousin left him. But the woman has placed a constraint, the building must become the seat of the Casa del Fascio.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Tiziana Lodato, Paolo De Vita, Francesco Benigno

title: La stanza numero 13
synopsis: An old professor who has spent his life on ancient texts returns after 50 years to the town of Benevento and to the hotel where he had prepared his exams as a student. Thus he finds the old manager but not his now dead sisters. There is not even room number 13, the one it occupied before: of it only the closed door remains, from which at night you can hear songs, laughter and tears.
cast: Tino Scotti, Franco Angrisano

title: La stazione
synopsis: Domenico, stationmaster in a small southern town, is a meticulous little man who spends his time between small daily tasks. But one night a beautiful blonde in an evening dress comes to him with some problems. Domenico confronts the woman's disreputable companion, who has come to take her back to bring her back with him, and establishes a tender relationship with her.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Margherita Buy, Ennio Fantastichini

title: La stella che non c'è
synopsis: Vincenzo Buonavolontà, responsible for the maintenance of the Bagnoli steel plant, is entrusted with the sale of the blast furnace to a Chinese company. When he realizes he has sold a faulty car, Vincenzo leaves for Shanghai where, accompanied by the young interpreter Liu Hua, he tries to locate the plant to repair the car.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Tai Ling, Angelo Costabile, Hiu Sun Ha

title: La stella dei re
synopsis: In the year of the birth of Jesus, Eastern Persia is devastated by an army of predes commanded by the cruel and ruthless Balthasar. The little Nabu comes across their way ...
cast: Mansour Badri, Abdesselam Bouhasni, Isabella Briganti, Ariadna Cabrol, Jan Cornet, Nicola Di Pinto, Leo Gullotta, Mohamed Jasny, Benjounnes Megri, Abdellah Oukseh

title: La stella del cinema
synopsis: A young debut actress suddenly becomes famous. But her boyfriend does not accept this situation: he too would like to establish himself as an actor.
cast: Grazia Del Rio, Elio Steiner, Sandra Ravel, Fulvio Testi, Giuseppe Masi, Nino Marchesini, Giovanni Onorato, Franco Coop, Olga Capri, Turi Pandolfini

title: La steppa
synopsis: The discovery of the world and the spiritual initiation of a Russian child coincides with a long journey undertaken together with his uncle. Measured and evocative transposition from a story by Checov, with a great international cast. Lattuada engages with the great European production but does not lose the touch and signs an excellent product.
cast: Daniele Spallone, Marina Vlady, Charles Vanel

title: La stoccata vincente
synopsis: The true story of the prodigy of fencing Paolo Pizzo, two times world champion in the sword specialty (in 2011 and 2017), who as a child had to face the most important challenge of his life: fight against a brain cancer. A battle won thanks also to the support and unconditional love of the father, true coach of Vita as well as his first fencing teacher.
cast: Alessio Vassallo, Flavio Insinna, Elena Funari, Chiara Cavaliere, Mario Ermito, Samuele Carrino, Carlotta Ventimiglia, Svetlana Kevral, Egle Doria, Maciej Robakiewicz

title: La stoffa dei sogni
synopsis: A ship carrying a company of theaters and dangerous criminals is shipwrecked on the coasts of Asinara, the prison island in the middle of the Mediterranean. Soon, it will become difficult to distinguish the actors from the criminals and the picaresque adventures of the castaways will be the backdrop for a reflection on the need for art in human life and on universal themes such as that of guilt, redemption and forgiveness.
cast: Sergio Rubini, Ennio Fantastichini, Renato Carpentieri, Teresa Saponangelo, Francesco Di Leva, Ciro Petrone, Gaia Bellugi, Nicola Di Pinto, Anna Paglia

title: La storia
synopsis: The dramatic story - which began in 1941, in the middle of the Second World War - of Ida and her son Useppe, born from a rape by a German soldier.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Lambert Wilson, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Maria Teresa Albani, Silvana De Santis, Tobias Hoesl, Caroline Lang, Antonio Degli Schiavi, Andrea Spada, Francisco Rabal

title: La storia di Kitty
synopsis: Kitty Dodds is serving a long sentence for uxoricide: the fact that her husband has subjected her and her children to constant harassment and violence for years did not move the jury. Realizing that she has no hope, Kitty plans and implements her escape from prison. During the inaction she meets a man, who shows her a lot of attention and with whom she ends up falling in love. The two decide to get married and live happy moments, even if the lack of children makes the woman terribly suffer. One day, the police, who have never stopped looking for her, track her down, capture her and take her back to prison.
cast: Veronica Hamel, Kevin Dobson

title: La storia di Lady Chatterley
synopsis: The beautiful young Joelle has married a mature earl, who is, however, semi-paralyzed and helpless. Driven by sexual desire, she looks for a way to satisfy it outside of marriage, becoming the lover of the gardener.
cast: Malù, Carlo Mucari, Maurice Poli, Micaela, Patrice Chéron, José Davì, Carmen Di Pietro, Gino Lana, Luca Sportelli, Bruce Williams

title: La storia di Laura
synopsis: Laura seems to lack nothing: she is a beautiful, intelligent and sensitive woman, she has a job that satisfies her and a family that she loves and that makes her happy. Apparently for no reason, Laura falls victim to a cocaine addiction that at first forces her to create a double life and subsequently leads her to lose control of her life along with everything she has. Forced to investigate the origins of her frailty and inability to be happy, Laura will discover that she is not alone.
cast: Isabella Ferrari, Vincenzo Amato, Ivana Monti, Monica Dugo, Andrea Gherpelli, Angela Baraldi, Natascia Macchniz

title: La storia vera della signora delle camelie
synopsis: Immortalized in the novel and theatrical text by Dumas son as Margherita Gauthier and in Verdi's melodrama as Violetta Valéry, "La traviata", Alphonsine Plessis (Huppert) is prematurely initiated by her father into prostitution and, still a teenager, arrives in Paris from the province determined to win a place in the beautiful world of the capital. Worker for a short period, she begins her climb by passing from one "gentleman" to another, but is undermined by the consumption that will crush her at the age of 23. Bolognini lets himself be carried away by the taste for reconstruction of the environment. A cast of international celebrities, but the best is our Volonté. Detail for Carla Fracci.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Gian Maria Volonté, Fernado Rey, Bruno Ganz

title: La strada al chiaro di luna
synopsis: A woman is killed in the night, how and why it will be discovered thanks to three different testimonies: that of the son, her husband and herself through a medium.
cast: Mario Valdemarin, Eva Axen, Franco Angrisano, Walter Ricciardi, Angela Sacchi, Armando Landolfi, Rodolfo Traversa, Sara Manuelli, Barbara Nay, Luigi Caracciolo

title: La strada dei Samouni
synopsis: In the rural outskirts of Gaza City, a small community of farmers, the Samouni family, is preparing to celebrate a wedding, the first party since the end of the war. Amal, Fouad, their brothers and cousins ??have lost their relatives, their homes. The neighborhood is now being rebuilt, olive trees are being planted and the fields destroyed by bombing are being worked on but the most difficult task is another: to reconstruct their memories.

title: La strada dei giganti
synopsis: In 1860 the Grand Duchess of Parma, Maria Luisa, wanted to equip her small state with a railway, despite the handling of Count Muller and some courtiers. The noble brings the engineer Farrel with whom she falls in love from America. The governor of Milan also put a spoke in the wheel. The handsome engineer is forced to suffer acts of sabotage by a group of men hired by Muller.
cast: Don Magowan, Chelo Alonso, Hildegarde Neff, Ivo Garrani

title: La strada di Levi
synopsis: In 1945 Primo Levi, author of "If This is a Man", was freed from the Auschwitz concentration camp. After ten months, numerous detours, delays and hundreds of kilometers, he returns to Turin. During the journey he crossed Poland, Ukraine, Moldova, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, Austria, Germany to finally arrive in Italy. His journey is told in the book "The truce". Sixty years later, Davide Ferrario and the writer Marco Belpoliti retrace the same itinerary in post-communist Europe.

title: La strada di Paolo
synopsis: Paul travels with his truck to a hospital in Jerusalem. On the way he meets people who bring him closer to the themes of the Holy Scriptures.
cast: Marcello Mazzarella, Philippe Leroy, Valentina Valsania, Milena Miconi

title: La strada dritta
synopsis: 1956. The engineer Fedele Cova, CEO of the Autostrade Company, is commissioned to build a 750 km long motorway connecting the north to the south of Italy, going from Milan to Naples. To support him in the epic undertaking, full of obstacles and difficult moments, will be the engineer Giovanni Nigro, the architect Bruna Alessi and the worker Gaetano De Angelis.
cast: Ennio Fantastichini, Giorgio Marchesi, Anita Caprioli, Carmine Recano, Valeria Bilello, Raffaella Rea, Tony Sperandeo, Dario Aita, Simone Gandolfo, Thomas Trabacchi, Nunzia Schiano

title: La strada nel bosco
synopsis: Three love stories, in each of which three characters are captured during a journey, a drift, a shift.
cast: Elena Bucci, Marco Sgrosso, Giulietta De Bernardi, Antonella Paolini

title: La strada per Fort Alamo
synopsis: Mistaken for military because of the uniform, an outlaw takes command of a caravan of soldiers ...
cast: Ken Clark, Jany Clair, Michel Lemoine, Adreina Paul, Alberto Cevenini, Antonio Gradoli, Gustavo De Nardo

title: La strada più lunga
synopsis: Michele fought in Ethiopia, Spain, Albania and Greece. After September 8 he returns home: he has always been a fascist, he believed in the causes for which he has fought, but now he is tired. However, the war is not over, indeed it has been tightened. His comrades still want him with them, but the social republic, once wandered, who now comes imposed by the SS weapons does not convince him. Michele refuses to return with the fascists, but the situation does not allow to remain neutral. The time has come for choices. Michele makes contact with the partisans, he manages to overcome his diffidence. In the end he embraces the ideals and joins them in the mountains.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Graziella Galvani, Giampiero Albertini, Augusto Mastrantoni, Teresa Ricci

title: La strada segreta
synopsis: Mauro, a young jazz musician who lives in the Emilia province, is the victim of a very serious accident. Lucy, her twin sister who is an astronomer by profession, arrives at his bedside from Rome. The sister in telepathic relationship with her brother senses that it was not a normal accident.
cast: Irene Ferri, Toni Bertorelli, Francesco D'Ignazio, Franco Trevisi

title: La strada verso casa
synopsis: The destinies of Michelangelo, Antonio and Giulia, three apparently distant people, are destined to cross when their lives are in a delicate phase of stalemate, in search of a light that shows them which direction to take. Michele, who has always dreamed of becoming an established writer, reviews his projects after the death of his father due to an accident at work, dealing with the fate of his mother and sister Chiara. The rich industrialist Antonio, on the other hand, finds himself with clipped wings when his wife Marta proves unable to overcome the death of their beloved daughter, who disappeared some time before, while the young Giulia spends day and night at her husband's bedside in the hospital, hoping that awakens from a coma to give a name to their child, born a few days after the accident that reduced him to that state.
cast: Giorgio Colangeli, Alessandro Marverti, Cecilia Albertini, Roberta Caronia, Maria Teresa Bax, Rita Montes, Massimo Triggiani

title: La strage dei vampiri
synopsis: During their first wedding night, a marriage pair finds himself having to defend himself from the threats of a bloodthirsty vampire.
cast: Walter Brandi, Graziella Granata, Luigi Batzella, Dieter Eppler, Edda Ferronao, Carla Foscari, Gena Gimmy, Maretta Procaccini, Alfredo Rizzo

title: La strana storia di Olga O.
synopsis: Olga in crisis with her husband Paolo tries to get out of the depression tunnel with the help of Carlo, a psychologist who is a friend of the family. On the advice of Paolo, the woman returns to her hometown and starts dating Sheila and Isabelle, friends of the past. She sets foot at the "Blue Parrot", the place where she performed as a girl. It is in that city that Olga's nightmares re-explode. The woman feels persecuted by Emil, a mysterious character who the storm of anonymous phone calls and slowly precipitates into a tremendous mental confusion. He no longer understands the difference between reality and fiction. Inspector Michael comes to his aid.
cast: Serena Grandi, Stephane Ferrara, Daniela Poggi, Florinda Bolkan

title: La strana voglia
synopsis: Jeff, theatrical director and musician, collects a young homeless man on the street, who becomes the object of his desire. Soon, Jeff's ex -girlfriend discovers the new tree of the ancient lover and, out of spite, decides to seduce her.
cast: Malù, Ángeles López Barea, Giancarlo Teodori, Zvonco Zrncic
director: Pasquale Fanetti, Roberto Francesconi, Fedor Skubonia

title: La stranezza
synopsis: In 1920 Luigi Pirandello, in Sicily for a few days, by chance he knew two scapegrated theater actors, Onofrio Principato and Sebastiano Vella, who are trying to put on a show. The meeting will have unexpected implications.
cast: Toni Servillo, Salvo Ficarra, Valentino Picone, Luigi Lo Cascio, Donatella Finocchiaro, Renato Carpentieri, Galatea Ranzi, Aurora Quattrocchi, Fausto Russo Alesi

title: La straniera
synopsis: Turin: Naghib, a forty-year-old Arab architect walks into a bar. He is looking for Amina, a young Moroccan prostitute he met by chance one winter evening. An intense but platonic love was born between them. The two are constantly looking for each other but Naghib does not have the courage to admit his feelings for Amina: his culture does not allow him to love a prostitute. The situation worsened when the police arrested the girl who was transported to a reception camp ready to be repatriated. Naghib's research is at a turning point and the decisions he has to make will be decisive for him.
cast: Kaltoum Boufangacha, Ahmed Haflene

title: La strategia degli affetti
synopsis: Portrait of interior in bourgeois family. Paolo, the father, is a successful man. Matteo, his son, does not have the same strong-willed and ambitious character. For Paolo it is a problem, because he does not recognize himself in his son. For Matteo it is a problem because the communication with his father, so desired, is interrupted. It will be the unexpected arrival of a woman in the family that will blow up the mechanisms. And for Matteo it will be the moment of a real revelation.
cast: Paolo Sassanelli, Marta Iacopini, Nina Torresi, David Nebbia, Dino Abbrescia, Remo Remotti

title: La strategia della maschera
synopsis: Briano Teo Calvani is the director of the archaeological museum of Camarina, in the province of Ragusa. The discovery of some masks upsets the small town, but the thrill of the discovery does not last long. The discovery of a papyrus that specifies the exact number of masks (thirty and not twenty) leads the archaeologist to hypothesize that some were stolen during the excavations.
cast: Rocco Mortelliti, Andrea Camilleri, Beatrice Macola, Pino Micol

title: La strega in amore
synopsis: Behind a generous reward Sergio, a journalist in a sentimental crisis, agrees to tidy up the library of an elderly and mysterious lady. He therefore goes to the building where the woman lives and here, between endless rooms and dusty old codes, he meets the fascinating Aura. But the young woman, with whom he immediately falls in love, is only the incarnation of the old landlady.
cast: Rosanna Schiaffino, Gian Maria Volonté, Richard Johnson, Sarah Ferrati

title: La supertestimone
synopsis: An inveterate spinster (Vitti) has an unfinished business with a protector (Tognazzi) of prostitutes. he therefore accuses him of murder and supports the fiction in front of the judges. The man is convicted, but she repents and gets the case reopened. After fixing things she marries him, but soon after he throws her on the sidewalk. Pecoreccio all'italiana with the former muse of Antonioni's incommunicability. Dated and exhilarated, despite the good comedians.
cast: Monica Vitti, Ugo Tognazzi, Orazio Orlando, Véronique Vendell

title: La supplente
synopsis: Called to replace a recently deceased teacher, a young and uninhibited substitute teacher wreaks havoc among the students, but initially prefers that of a colleague to their attention. However, disrespected by the competition of her younger sister, she thinks about it. Exhaustive and sloppy sample of an itchy repertoire then in vogue. He gave the opening to a very rich (?) Final.
cast: Carmen Villani, Dayle Haddon, Eligio Zamara, Gisela Hahn

title: La supplente va in città
synopsis: Rubina, a village teacher, was "seduced and abandoned" by his boyfriend Carlo. In Rome Rubina traces Carlo and sends him to jail on charges of violence then he gets hired as a maid by a family of merchants where, in skillfully exploiting the art of sex and weaknesses of each of his masters, he takes control of the house and the shop.
cast: Carmen Villani, Francesco Mulè, Vincenzo Crocitti, Josele Roman, Maria Luisa Ponte

title: La svastica nel ventre
synopsis: The young Jewish Anna ends up in the brutal hands of the SSs. Waiting to be transferred to a concentration camp, he finds himself in a cottage for military. Here, thanks to its beauty, it has the relative fortune to conquer the interest of an officer, who makes its lover before entrusting her with the direction of a "maison" for high poppies of the militia.
cast: Sirpa Lane, Giancarlo Sisti, Roberto Posse

title: La svergognata
synopsis: Nino, a Milanese industrialist, arrives on the island of Ischia for a holiday with his wife Clara and daughter Ornella. Several people stay in the same hotel, among which Fabio stands out, a writer in a depressive crisis who was already a lover of Mrs. Bernardi five years earlier and now a faithful companion of the actress Silvia. Ornella, also stimulated by her friend Giusi, soon gets tired of the meetings with the boys of their company.
cast: Philippe Leroy, Leonora Fani, Stefano Amato, Barbara Bouchet

title: La svolta
synopsis: Spentated by life and without the courage to be himself, Ludovico lives entrusted in the old grandmother's apartment, to cradle dreams that believes unrealizable. The world is bad, out there. But one night, that bad world comes to visit him and is sagged in his house, to stay there. That world is called Jack, a boy of the age of Ludovico, but with the opposite character: hard, determined, perhaps criminal. The forced coexistence of two human beings that most different from each other could not appear, turns into an initiation path to adulthood, to discover their real characters, into an alternation of comedian and dramatic, of joy and pain. And when the hard reality that tries to ruthless them comes to present the bill, they will have to face it, strong of a new awareness and an unexpected courage.
cast: Andrea Lattanzi, Brando Pacitto, Ludovica Martino, Max Malatesta, Chabeli Sastre, Federico Tocci, Tullio Sorrentino, Cristian Di Sante, Aniello Arena, Filippo Contri, Grazia Schiavo, Claudio Bigagli, Marcello Fonte

title: La syndicaliste
synopsis: The true story of Maureen Kearney, union representative of the CFDT (Confédération Française Démocratique du Travail) at the Areva, a multinational one operating in the field of nuclear and renewable energies. In 2012 a secret of state was aware that involves the nuclear industry and would upset France, but she is alone against everyone and must fight against ministers and industrialists to make the news known and thus defend more than fifty thousand employees in the sector.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Alexandra Maria Lara, Yvan Attal, Benoît Magimel, Marina Foïs, Grégory Gadebois, Pierre Deladonchamps, Geno Lechner, Gilles Cohen, François Xavier Demaison, Aloïse Sauvage, Yves Heck, Andréa Bescond, Antoine Basler, Sébastien Corona, Radostina Rogliano, Cedric Cirotteau, Xavier Desmoutiers

title: La taglia è tua... l'uomo l'ammazzo io
synopsis: El Puro is an alcoholic gunslinger unable to defend himself. On his head hangs a bounty of ten thousand dollars that is very tempting to a group of men led by Gipsy ...
cast: Robert Woods, Maurizio Bonuglia, Mario Brega, Mariangela Giordano

title: La tana
synopsis: In the summer of his eighteen years, Giulio decided not to leave: he will spend the holidays at home, to help his parents with the work in the garden. In the house next door, uninhabited for some time, comes Lia, a twenty year old girl. Giulio would like to meet her, but she is surly and introverted. One day Giulio is bathing in the lake and Lia tries to drown him for fun. Giulio is a good boy, sensitive and far too polite. Attracted by her, he begins to think about her day and night. Lia initiates him into strange, increasingly dangerous "games". The girl, however, does not talk about herself. She said she came alone to spend the holidays in the old family home, where she hasn't returned since she was a child. Lia, however, hides secrets and does not allow anyone to set foot in the old abandoned house.
cast: Irene Vetere, Lorenzo Aloi, Helene Nardini, Elisa Di Eusanio, Federico Rosati, Paolo Ricci

title: La tarantola dal ventre nero
synopsis: The clients of a beauty center are killed with a chilling ritual: first paralyzed with a pin, then gutted. In charge of the investigation is a policeman who takes the case lightly, until it is his wife who risks her life ...
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Claudine Auger, Barbara Bouchet, Stefania Sandrelli, Rossella Falk

title: La tavola dei poveri
synopsis: The time comes for the annual banquet offered to the poor and there is a large sum of money that everyone thinks comes from the Marquis Isidoro. Which is only partially true: the sum was only entrusted to him and he will have a hard time repaying it. Single act by Raffaele Viviani, written by Viviani himself together with Mario Soldati. The theatrical structure is therefore evident, but the direction of Blasetti feels the same. In any case, an extraordinary filmed document of Viviani's art.
cast: Raffaele Viviani, Leda Gloria, Salvatore Costa, Camillo Pilotto, Memo Benassi

title: La tecnica e il rito
synopsis: On the eastern edge of the Roman Empire a new leader rises, Attila. He manages to impose his dominion on the Huns through a series of wildly irrational ceremonies. He will complete his ascent by killing his brother. Produced for Rai, on the theme of dictatorship; built with great visual expertise but with some didactic pretensions too.
cast: Jozsef Madaras, Marco Guglielmi, Adalberto Maria Merli, Luigi Diberti

title: La telenovela errante
synopsis: In six days, a group of telenovelas actors put in place scenes that ironize on the accents and models of language in Chile, where the inhabitants often speak without using verbs or subjects making the topic of the speech understandable to foreigners. In this way, it is highlighted how reality is literally Baudrillard's idea on the simulacrum.
cast: Luis Alarcon, Maricarmen Arrigorriaga, Fernando Bordeu, Consuelo Castillo, Roberto Chignoli, Valeria Chignoli, Marcial Edwards, Liliana García, Leticia Garrido, Mario Lorca

title: La tempesta
synopsis: Empress Catherine of Russia, offended by the behavior of the cadet Piotr Grinjeff, severely punishes him by exiling him in the fortress of Oremburg located on the extreme border of the empire. During the journey, Piotr, who is accompanied by the faithful Savelic, saves the life of a half-sided Cossack. Piotr realizes that his punishment is excessive, but his bitterness is redeemed by the love of Masha, daughter of the captain of the fortress.
cast: Silvana Mangano, Van Heflin, Viveca Lindfors, Geoffrey Horne

title: La tenda nera
synopsis: At first an elderly woman denounces the disappearance of her cats. Then the parish priest of the Romagna town where the action takes place has a fatal accident and cannot make the important revelations promised to the carabinieri captain, Leonardi (who replaces a dead colleague in mysterious circumstances). The corpse of a cat is found in the church -plated waterstrack. And it's not that the beginning ...
cast: Luca Barbareschi, Anna Kanakis, Valeria Cavalli, Gianni Musy

title: La tendre ennemie
synopsis: During the engagement dinner of Mrs. Dupont's daughter, with a man she does not love, the shadows of the husband and the lady's lover appear, fraternizing and telling each other their adventures. Then, here is a third shadow, that of a young man who killed himself for his opposed love for the same woman. A comedy by André-Paul Antoine that Ophüls himself had already staged in the theater, full of "gags" in the silent film genre; a comic, ironic, uncertain dialogue of the dead. As in life, Ophüls himself says.
cast: Simone Berriau, Catherine Fonteney, Georges Vitray, Marc Valbel

title: La tenerezza
synopsis: Lorenzo, who in the past was a famous lawyer, lives in a beautiful old building in the center of Naples. After a few professional injuries, Lorenzo has fallen from grace and his family life has also been affected, apparently making him deny his affection to his children Saverio and Elena without reason. Selfish and brusque, the only companion of his nephew Francesco who takes away from school to educate him in his own way, Lorenzo finds himself changing thanks to the arrival of Fabio and Michela in the apartment opposite his, a young couple with two small children who arrives from North. In short, Lorenzo puts aside his grumpy and suspicious being to become like one of the family until one evening something happens that will upset everyone's existence.
cast: Elio Germano, Micaela Ramazzotti, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Greta Scacchi, Renato Carpentieri, Arturo Muselli, Giuseppe Zeno, Maria Nazionale

title: La terra
synopsis: Luigi Di Santo, a university professor in Milan, returns to his country of origin in Puglia after many years to resolve a dispute related to the inheritance left by his father. He finds his three brothers, Mario, Aldo and Michele and, with them, also the incurable conflicts that had pushed him to abandon his land.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Paolo Briguglia, Massimo Venturiello, Emilio Solfrizzi, Giovanna Di Rauso, Sergio Rubini, Claudia Gerini

title: La terra buona
synopsis: On the border with Switzerland, in Val Grande, there is the largest "wild" area in Europe, where there are no roads, shops, villages, light poles or signs of man. One last person still lives in this uncontaminated nature: Father Sergio, a Benedictine monk over 80 years old who spent almost his entire life in an old cabin that he himself rebuilt. Gianmaria also lives with the monk, a small, squat man with a good attitude, who has been assisting him in all his needs for several years. Returning from the nearest village for provisions, a 4-hour walk in the mountains, Gianmaria shows up with two people she has never seen before. They are two desperate and absolutely very worried guys. They are exhausted with fatigue from the long journey and strangely they are not there to meet the old monk. Instead, they are looking for another person who, in great secret, has been a guest of Father Sergio for over a month, to whom the two newcomers present a request (for life or death) that cannot wait. Their arrival will upset and forever jeopardize the peace and serenity of one of the last corners of Heaven left on Earth.
cast: Fabrizio Ferracane, Lorenzo Pedrotti, Viola Sartoretto, Cristian Di Sante, Orfeo Orlando, Giulio Brogi, Sergio Albelli, Stefano Eirale, Paolo Manassero, Mattia Sbragia

title: La terra dei figli
synopsis: The end of civilization has come. A father and his son, a fourteen-year-old boy, are among the few survivors: their existence, on a stilt house by a lake, is reduced to a struggle for survival. There is no longer any society, any encounter with other men is dangerous. In this regressed world, the father entrusts his thoughts to a notebook, but those words are indecipherable signs for his son. On the death of his father, the boy decides to embark on a journey into the unknown in search of someone who can reveal the meaning of those mysterious pages. Only in this way will he perhaps be able to discover the true feelings of his father and a past he does not know.
cast: Leon De La Vallée, Paolo Pierobon, Maria Roveran, Fabrizio Ferracane, Maurizio Donadoni, Franco Ravera, Alessandro Tedeschi, Valerio Mastandrea, Valeria Golino

title: La terra dei santi
synopsis: Vittoria (Valeria Solarino) leaves the North to begin her career as a magistrate in Calabria with the aim of fighting the 'Ndrangheta. Assunta (Daniela Marra), on the other hand, has to stay in the 'Ndrangheta and, after losing her murdered husband, she is forced to marry her brother-in-law Nando. Helped by her sister Caterina (Lorenza Indovina), in turn married to the fugitive Alfredo Raso, Assunta desires more than anything else the good of her two children. Vittoria has a goal: to unhinge the silence of women towards that patriarchal system that is the basis of the most influential criminal organization in the world. Investigations and arrests are useless weapons for the purpose; to win her battle, the only possibility is to remove parental authority from all mothers who send their children to die.
cast: Valeria Solarino, Daniela Marra, Lorenza Indovina, Ninni Bruschetta, Tommaso Ragno, Marco Aiello, Giuseppe Vitale, Piero Calabrese, Francesco Colella

title: La terra dell'abbastanza
synopsis: Mirko and Manolo are two young friends from the outskirts of Rome. They are two good guys until the moment when, driving late at night, they run over a man and decide to escape. The tragedy turns into an apparent stroke of luck: the man they killed is a repentant of a local criminal clan and by killing him, the two boys have earned a role, respect and the money they never had. Theirs is an entrance ticket to hell that they take for a pass to heaven.
cast: Andrea Carpenzano, Matteo Olivetti, Milena Mancini, Max Tortora, Luca Zingaretti, Demetra Bellina, Michela De Rossi

title: La terra e il vento
synopsis: Leonardo is 25 years old and is already a high-level mountaineer, who has in his palmarés peaks of exceptional importance in the Himalayan massif and which has already been the subject of media attention. His passion is such as to induce him to give up his studies, against the will of his family. Instead, he is about to leave for a new business when a request for help arrives from his half-brother Riccardo, who asks him for help in resolving a thorny inheritance issue after the death of his common father. Leonardo agrees and joins him in Tuscany, where his stepbrother offers him to enter into partnership with him to lead the family farm. The seduction of ties, of the land, of origins - to which must be added the infatuation for Chiara, Riccardo's sister he met in Tuscany - is strong and Leonardo will have to make difficult choices and overcome conflicts that are becoming more acute.
cast: Lorenzo Richelmy, Robin Mugnaini, Chiara Martegiani, Laura Gigante, Margherita Vicario, Christiane Filangieri, Vijaya Bechis Boll, Giacomo Tarsi, Lina Bernardi, Pietro De Silva

title: La terrazza
synopsis: We are in Rome on a terrace where a group of friends and acquaintances, all belonging to the bourgeoisie, gathers to spend the summer evenings. There is Enrico, a screenwriter in crisis, Amedeo, a film producer who made himself from scratch, absolutely devoid of culture. Then there is Galeazzo, who returned from Venezuela to find friends and a job, and Mario, a deputy from the Communist Party.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman, Jean Louis Trintignant, Stefania Sandrelli

title: La terza madre
synopsis: The discovery of an ancient urn near the cemetery of Viterbo triggers a series of mysterious events: it contains the tunic of the "Mater Lachrimarum", the only survivor of a legendary triad of witches. The young restorer Sarah Mendy, assistant and companion of Professor Pierce, is involved in the escalation of violence, without suspecting that what is happening affects her very closely ...
cast: Asia Argento, Philippe Leroy, Daria Nicolodi, Moran Atias, Valeria Cavalli, Clive Riche, Udo Kier, Cristian Solimeno, Franco Leo

title: La terza stella
synopsis: In a small village, preparations are underway for the event of the year: the living chess game against the neighboring village. Each inhabitant has his role, including Ale (a poised and thoughtful man, owner of the Belvedere hotel) and Franz (a prison guard by profession, moody and dazed). The two are brothers-in-law and their relationship is not the simplest.
cast: Alessandro Besentini, Francesco Villa, Petra Faksova, Marica Coco, Pippo Santonastaso, Francesca Giovannetti

title: La terza verità
synopsis: A young and ambitious journalist investigates a serial killer operating in central Italy. The zealous girl goes back to a series of disturbing coincidences that would frame an esteemed Perugian doctor. But the truths - the factual, the procedural and the journalistic - overlap, converge and diverge continuously.
cast: Enzo De Caro, Anna Kanakis, Bianca Guaccero, Marco Falaguasta, Leandro Amato, Flavia Astolfi, Olga Balan, Massimiliano Benvenuto, Sebastiano Bianco, Franco Bottone

title: La teta asustada
synopsis: Fausta is a Peruvian woman who contracted a strange syndrome transmitted by the breast milk of women who were raped during the war in Peru: a disease that "stole her soul" and that, despite the war is over, continues to present her fear. It will be another tragic event, the death of her mother, to force her to confront her fears and the secret she hides within herself.
cast: Magaly Solier, Susi Sánchez, Efraín Solís, Marino Ballón, Antolín Prieto

title: La teta y la luna
synopsis: Tete is an imaginative little boy who feels overshadowed by the birth of his little brother. Estrellita and Maurice "the petomaniac" arrive with their show in the city. While Estrellita is dressing for the scene, Tete, hidden, observes her fascinated breasts. And he falls in love with it. But he runs up against a more dangerous suitor: Miquel, an electrician who works at the campsite where Estrellita lives.
cast: Mathilda May, Gérard Darmon, Miguel Poveda, Biel Duran

title: La tigre dei sette mari
synopsis: A pirate known by all as "La Tigre", who flies the seas with the "Santa Maria", decides to leave the command of the ship. It will be a duel between a man of the crew and William to decide the successor. The latter wins, but at the same time is left by his girlfriend, who, among other things, is the daughter of the Tiger. It turns out that the loser is none other than a traitor in the service of a Spanish governor. Depressing adventure movie despite the six hands script. In the cast there is also Ernesto Calindri, out of part.
cast: Anthony Steel, Gianna Maria Canale, Ernesto Calindri

title: La tigre e la neve
synopsis: The poet Attilio De Giovanni is madly in love with Vittoria. Since her sentiment is unrequited, Attilio is willing to do anything to win her: even to follow her to Iraq, at the very beginning of the conflict wanted by the Americans to oust Saddam Hussein ...
cast: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Jean Reno, Emilia Fox, Steven Beckingham, Jonah Lotan

title: La tigre venuta dal fiume Kwai
synopsis: On the death of his young American friend, a Thai tries to deliver some precious items to the parents of the deceased, but the company will be tough. Italian-style adventure films, without interest.
cast: George Eastman, Krung Sirvilai, Kan Won Long

title: La tigre è ancora viva: Sandokan alla riscossa!
synopsis: The beloved Marianna is dead, the island of Mompracem is lost, handed over by the British to their evil puppet, Sultan Abdullah. Sandokan is in India, in the wild. Encouraged by his followers, aided by the jungle head cutters, flanked by the faithful Yanez, Kammamuri and Tremal Naik, the pirate decides to take Mompracem back. Meanwhile, on the island, the surviving tigers do their part.
cast: Kabir Bedi, Philippe Leroy, Massimo Foschi, Adolfo Celi

title: La torta in cielo
synopsis: A giant cake falls from the sky. The army, arms manufacturers and even a chocolate company try to turn the episode in their favor, but the children rebel. Film for children, is a heavily didactic allegory based on a novel by Gianni Rodari.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Didi Perego, Umberto D'Orsi, Daniela Minniti

title: La tortura della speranza
synopsis: After being thrown into the secrets pending the stake, a rabbi condemned by the Inquisition finds an unexpected glimmer of hope. Eudging the monks who are around for the dark corridors, among the screams of heretics and witches, a bell sound guides him in a church. All the ancient doubts grip in one: God have fun? Or is it the inquisitor that presents the last temptation to him? However, it will be able to face their destiny worthily.
cast: Julian Beck, Bruno Corazzari, Piera Degli Esposti, Daniele Dublino, Renato Carpentieri

title: La tour de Nesle
synopsis: Margaret of Burgundy, who received the powers of the regency during an absence of Louis X, uses them in the worst possible way. In fact, he indulges in the most incredible debauchery and spares no lover after lover. Only like a mantis, after love he makes them kill. Enter a vicious circle of death and tragedy, from which it is difficult to escape. Subjugated by the power of murder, she has two young men sentenced to death, only to discover later that they were her children.
cast: Pierre Brasseur, Silvana Pampanini, Paul Guers, Michel Bouquet

title: La tourneuse de pages
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Mélanie seems well disposed towards the piano and tries the competition for admission to the conservatory, but fails. Deeply disappointed by the casual attitude of the commission president, a famous pianist, she decides not to play anymore. A decade later, Mélanie ends up working in a law firm, headed by the husband of the woman who changed the course of her life ...
cast: Déborah François, Catherine Frot, Pascal Greggory, Xavier De Guillebon

title: La tragedia di un uomo ridicolo
synopsis: An agricultural industrialist, proud of his success, suffers a psychological meltdown when his son is kidnapped for the purpose of extortion. It is in fact torn between the affection for the young and the attachment to well-being accumulated in a life of hard work. Then the son, believed to have been killed, suddenly comes out in strange circumstances.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Anouk Aimée, Laura Morante, Ricky Tognazzi

title: La trasgressione
synopsis: The erotic hallucinations of a university student, complex and dedicated to drugs, which has been rejected the degree thesis. Insiend film with Milly D'Abbraccio not yet "silicone" nor become one of the most famous Italian pornstars. Rosanna Banfi, Lino's daughter of Lino.
cast: Milly D'Abbraccio, Rosanna Banfi, Pierfrancesco Campanella

title: La tratta delle bianche
synopsis: Alda, pregnant, takes part in a dance marathon to pay the lawyer to her boyfriend Carlo with the prize. He was sent to prison by Manfredi, who wants to lead Alda to the sidewalk. Manfredi, in fact, practices the "white trade" and, to get rid of Carlo who discovered his shady traffic, he had him arrested. However, Carlo manages to escape, he has time to see Alda dying for the last time, then captures Manfredi, but, instead of handing him over to the police, with some friends he improvises a sort of popular court that tries the criminal. Bloody and risque melodrama, written with Antonio Pietrangeli and performed by a cast of stars.
cast: Eleonora Rossi Drago, Ettore Manni, Mark Lawrence, Vittorio Gassman, Silvana Pampanini, Tamara Lees

title: La trattativa
synopsis: An investigation into the mysteries of the most recent history of Italy, which reveals the secrets of the thorniest affair of the second Republic: the State-Mafia negotiation.
cast: Enzo Lombardo, Sabina Guzzanti, Sabino Civilleri, Filippo Luna, Franz Cantalupo, Michele Franco, Nicola Pannelli, Claudio Castrogiovanni, Sergio Pierattini, Maurizio Bologna, Ninni Bruschetta

title: La traversée
synopsis: In a disastrous village, in an unspecified Eastern European location, a family is forced to flee. Kyona and Adriel, the two older children, soon separate from parents in front of the road alone. Thus begin a heroic journey that will see them grow in search of refuge, peace and hope for their family. Crossing a continent torn by the war and the persecution of migrants, they will survive incredible challenges before reaching a new world, where they will finally be free.

title: La traversée de Paris
synopsis: World War II: Paris is under German occupation. Martin, a former taxi driver, has to cross the city to deliver a few suitcases full of pork purchased from the black market. In the enterprise, the man brings with him a wanderer, Grandgil, who later turns out to be a renowned painter. The path will be full of obstacles and unexpected events ...
cast: Jean Gabin, Bourvil, Louis De Funès, Jeannette Betti, Robert Arnoux

title: La traviata
synopsis: From "The Lady of the Camellias" by Dumas, the tragic and impossible love between the noble Alfredo and the courtesan Violetta, who abandons him believing she is doing him good only to see him again at the point of death. Verdi's opera interpreted by two glories of national bel canto, Anna Moffo and Gino Bechi. Director the same husband of the soprano.
cast: Anna Moffo, Gino Bechi

title: La traviata
synopsis: The luxury socialite Violetta Valéry is now alone and near death due to consumption, the disease of the nineteenth century. In flashback she thinks back to her love for Alfredo Germont, the only man she truly loved but abandoned precisely so as not to tarnish his reputation. Only now does Alfredo, who witnesses the woman's agony, understand the purity of Violetta's sentiment.
cast: Teresa Stratas, Placido Domingo, Cornell MacNeill, Alan Monk

title: La tregua
country: Italy, France, Great Britain, Sweden, Germany
synopsis: A group of Italian veterans from Auschwitz, freed by the Russians, embark on a long march to reach their homeland. First of all, this is the occasion to observe with new eyes the surprising reality of Europe freed from Nazism and to get back in touch with one's own body, friendship and love.
cast: John Turturro, Massimo Ghini, Rade Serbedzija, Stefano Dionisi, Claudio Bisio, Teco Celio, Roberto Citran, Andy Luotto, Agnieszka Wagner, Lorenza Indovina, Marina Gerasimenko

title: La tribu
synopsis: Virginia, who works as a cleaning lady but whose true vocation is to be a street dancer, finds the son she had given up for adoption, Fidel, an executive who has lost everything, even his memory. Together with the dance group that Virginia has formed with her extravagant classmates, mother and son will discover that, although accustomed to different worlds, the same blood and the same rhythm flow in their veins.
cast: Paco León, Carmen Machi, Julián López, Rebeca Sala, Luis Bermejo, Bárbara Santa Cruz, Alfonso Lara, Julián Teurlais, Arlette Torres, Javier Perdiguero

title: La trincea
synopsis: Carso, November 14, 1915. The war between Italians and Austrians stagnates in an exhausting trench conflict. Time passes, between intimate memories of the soldiers and strategic discussions.
cast: Aldo Giuffré, Roberto Bertea, Carlo Giuffrè, Sergio Bargone, Carlo Enrici, Vittorio Battarra, Attilio Duse, Maurizio Guelfi, Marcello Di Martire, Antonio Rais

title: La trinchera infinita
synopsis: Spain, July 1936. Higinio Blanco is a man who for fear of reprisals remains locked up at home. He does not suspect that the first time it will come out will be only 33 years later, in 1969.
cast: Antonio De La Torre, Belén Cuesta, José Manuel Poga, José María Del Castillo, Carlos Bernardino, Esperanza Guardado, Vicente Vergara, Antonio Romero, Javi Mena
director: Aitor Arregi, Jon Garaño, Jose Mari Goenaga

title: La tristezza ha il sonno leggero
synopsis: In Naples, in 1989, Erri Gargiulo, who grew up with two fathers, two mothers and several brothers, is on the threshold of forty but still cannot fully express his emotions, ending up somatizing them. One day, however, his wife Matilde decides to leave him and for Erri the time comes to face his destiny and the great challenges he has always put off.
cast: Marco Maria De Notaris, Stefania Sandrelli, Serena Rossi, Eugenia Costantini, Gina Amarante, Ciro Priello, Roberto Caccioppoli, Gioia Spaziani, Tonino Taiuti, Marzio Honorato

title: La troisième guerre
synopsis: Fresh out of training, Leo gets his first assignment.
