This is a surveillance operation that sees him wandering the streets of Paris without doing anything other than staying on alert for potential threats. Given the task of controlling a massive anti-government demonstration, Leo finds himself immersed in the heart of a rioting crowd. Here, all the fury and pressure that has built up in the previous weeks is on the verge of exploding.
cast: Anthony Bajon, Karim Leklou, Leïla Bekhti

title: La trovatella di Pompei
synopsis: Indicted for a crime she did not commit, Maria discovers she is the illegitimate daughter of the Public Prosecutor who supports the prosecution at the trial. A melodrama directed at the least worst and interpreted in a more than mediocre way.
cast: Alessandra Panaro, Antonio De Teffé, Massimo Girotti, Carlo Giustini

title: La truite
synopsis: Young Frederique (Isabelle Huppert) lives in a country town, works in the family trout farm and is trapped in a boring marriage with Galuchat. Tired of provincial life, she decides to abandon everything and everyone to move to the city and enter the financial sector. However, he ends up in a ruthless corporate universe, where he relies on his predatory fascination with men to move forward.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Jean Pierre Cassel, Jeanne Moreau, Daniel Olbrychski

title: La tua vita per mio figlio
synopsis: Former mobster Francesco Accardo left his city to move to Milan where he successfully dedicated himself to trade. The economic tranquility means that Francesco can keep his wife Maria and little son Gennarino without problems. But the serenity in the Accardo house does not last long because the mammasantissima of the family to which Francesco belonged forces him to kill Sante belonging to a rival family. To make the request to Francesco more convincing, Gennarino is kidnapped.
cast: Mario Merola, Antonio Sabato, Maria Fiore, Rik Battaglia

title: La tulipe noire
synopsis: June 1789. In a village in the French province, ruled by the cruel Marquis de Vigone, someone attacks the aristocrats who try to escape from the specter of the Revolution. This is Guillaume de Saint Preux, whom de Vigogne believes to be very trustworthy. And when Guillaume is wounded (and therefore recognizable) his place will be taken by a brother-double. Then comes July 14th.
cast: Alain Delon, Virna Lisi, Dawn Addams, Akim Tamiroff, Francis Blanche, José Jospe, Adolfo Marsillach, Robert Manuel

title: La tumba de los muertos vivientes
synopsis: An expedition in search of a treasure that should have been hidden by the Nazis in the African desert during the war must contend with a horde of Nazi zombies guarding hidden fortunes.
cast: Manuel Gélin, France Lomay, Jeff Montgomery, Myriam Landson, Eric Viellard, Caroline Audret, Henri Lambert

title: La tête contre les murs
synopsis: François's psyche is "cheated" and his father locks him up in an asylum. The boy escapes but is recovered and his escape companion commits suicide. Try again, and for a while she finds refuge with her friend Stéphanie. A touching story that is both a still effective denunciation of the psychiatric totalitarian universe and a visionary hymn to freedom, supported by an extraordinary cast.
cast: Jean Pierre Mocky, Charles Aznavour, Anouk Aimée, Paul Meurisse, Pierre Brasseur

title: La tête en friche
synopsis: Forced to leave the school he attended as a child, fifty-year-old Germain (Gérard Depardieu) grew up semi-illiterate and lives alone in a caravan, parked at the bottom of his mother's garden, with whom he does not have excellent relations. His days all pass anonymously, always repeating the same actions: a meeting with his girlfriend, a visit to friends at the bar and a stop at the park to feed pigeons and ducks. But man's routine will break when on a bench he meets the elderly Margueritte (Gisèle Casadesus), a former agronomist researcher, a lover of travel and good literature. Their friendship, made up of stories and reports of experiences, will soon take the form of a delicate platonic love relationship.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Gisèle Casadesus, Maurane, Patrick Bouchitey, Jean François Stévenin, François Xavier Demaison, Claire Maurier, Sophie Guillemin, Mélanie Bernier, Matthieu Dahan

title: La tête haute
synopsis: Abandoned by his mother, from 6 to 15 years old Malony is constantly in and out of juvenile prison. Fortunately, the attentions of Florence, a magistrate on the road to retirement, and Yann, a social worker who also had a difficult childhood, rest on him. The two try to save Malony from perdition by sending him to a very rigorous educational center where he has the opportunity to meet Tess. Very special girl, Tess will show him how there are still valid reasons to get on the right path.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Benoît Magimel, Sara Forestier, Ludovic Berthillot, Rod Paradot

title: La vache
synopsis: Fatah is a simple man of good nature, as he is in his father's lineage, which makes him the object of ridicule in the Algerian village where he lives. Though he loves his wife and two little daughters dearly, Fatah has found his twin friend in the cow Jacqueline, with whom he hopes to compete in a major livestock competition taking place in Paris. Thus he leaves with the animal for France between unexpected encounters and the search for dignity.
cast: Lambert Wilson, Jamel Debbouze, Fatsah Bouyahmed, Julia Piaton, Malik Bentalha, Hajar Masdouki, Abdellah Chakiri, Amal El Atrache

title: La vache et le prisonnier
synopsis: A French soldier, taken prisoner by the Germans and assigned to a farm as a worker, decides to escape with an unusual stratagem: he will walk towards France carrying the cow he takes to pasture and no one will be able to suspect his true intentions. Between dramatic adventures, but above all comic, he crosses the whole of Germany. An excellent starting idea, which, however, would have required a more "dry" screenplay and a more biting direction. However, Fernandel also manages to make up for the slow pace of the film.
cast: Fernandel, Pierre Louis, Ellen Schwiers, Inge Schoner

title: La valigia dei sogni
synopsis: The knight Omeri was a silent film actor: now he is satisfied, after having collected some films of the time, to go around the squares showing clips of that cinema. However, a fire destroys all the material but, thanks to the help of a producer, Omeri will have the means to create a cinema museum.
cast: Umberto Melnati, Maria Pia Casilio, Roberto Risso, Pietro De Vico

title: La valigia sul letto
synopsis: Achille works as a night watchman on the construction site of the new subway line. It is a job he does not like and which, moreover, is putting his relationship with his wife in crisis. To change his life, Achille has a brilliant idea: to transform his surname, Lo Chiummo, into Lo Ciummo and thus fictitiously become a relative of a dangerous Camorra and therefore be included in the protection program for the families of repentants. A journey to a new city will begin ...
cast: Eduardo Tartaglia, Veronica Mazza, Biagio Izzo, Alena Seredova, Maurizio Casagrande, Nunzia Schiano, Marjo Berasategui, Ernesto Mahieux, Peppe Miale, Francesco Procopio

title: La valle dell'eco tonante
synopsis: Princess Farida wants to take over the "land of green pastures" which, by the will of the prophets, belongs to the Gamaly family, led by Selina. The region is also protected by the Echo Men, a wild population with catastrophic sonic powers. The Gamalys find a precious ally in Maciste. Thanks to him, they will be able to defeat the Echo Men, eliminate Farida and reach the coveted pastures. History has no rhyme or reason; the characters do not go beyond the most abused stereotypes; the direction (by Amerigo Anton alias Tanio Boccia, the "Italian Ed Wood") is a pure formality. The end result is even funny in its total improbability.
cast: Kirk Morris, Hélène Chanel, Spela Rozin, Alberto Farnese

title: La valle di pietra - Kalkstein
synopsis: In the last century, in Bohemia, a land surveyor who works for the government catches a glimpse of a priest who intrigues him at a dinner. Finding themselves years later in a stony valley, the two men are bound in a deep friendship: the elderly priest will tell the other about his youth and the friend will discover, after the priest's death, the great generosity of spirit of the churchman, ignored by all. From the novel of the same name by Adalbert Stifter, Ermanno Olmi and the director have drawn a script that is profound and alien to gratuitous spectacle, which Zaccaro then covered with modest, highly suggestive images.
cast: Charles Dance, Aleksander Baldini, Fabio Bussotti, Klara Neroldova

title: La vallée close
synopsis: A place (the resurgence of the Sorgue river in Fontaine-de-Vaucluse in Provence), a geography book, a painting by Giorgione, the memoirs of Lucretius, a poem by Petrarch ... elements that, in a circular system of echoes and resonances, form _a closed valley _...

title: La vampire nue
cast: Olivier Martin, Maurice Lemaître, Caroline Cartier, Ly Lestrong

title: La vanité
synopsis: David Miller wants to die and chooses assisted euthanasia. He designed everything: where, when and how to die. However, nothing goes as it should. With Esperanza, a member of the association who should help him, and Treplev, a young prostitute, David embarks on the journey of his final night.
cast: Ivan Georgiev, Patrick Lapp, Carmen Maura

title: La variabile umana
synopsis: After the death of his wife three years earlier, the Milanese inspector Monaco (Silvio Orlando) lost interest in his work. Refusing to go back to the streets for investigations, he prefers to stay in the office to leaf through documents and analyze photographs and clues in order to avoid contact with people. One night, however, in addition to dealing with the case of the murder of Mr. Ullrich, he finds his daughter Linda (Alice Raffaelli) in the police station, arrested for having a gun. The political and private interests involved in the crime are such that Monaco is forced to question himself as a policeman and as a father, deciding to take part in the investigation and return to the street together with Levi (Giuseppe Battiston), his pupil and friend, for a long night of revelations and discoveries.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Giuseppe Battiston, Sandra Ceccarelli, Alice Raffaelli, Renato Sarti, Arianna Scommegna, Giorgia Senesi, Dafne Masin, Mao Wen, Davide Tinelli

title: La vedova
synopsis: A young Venetian marries a scion of the good bourgeoisie, against the will of his parents. Then she remains a widow and she begins a difficult coexistence with her in-laws. Taken, without too much fluency, from a play by Renato Simoni.
cast: Isa Pola, Leonardo Cortese, Osvaldo Valenti, Emma Gramatica, Cesco Baseggio

title: La vedova del trullo
synopsis: Maddalena, a square widow of Nicola, lives in the last trullo left free of a Apulian village. The woman arranges himself making the nurse at Calogero's house, where he tries to keep his son Marco at bay. When the impersonator of the deceased arrives ...
cast: Rosa Fumetto, Mario Carotenuto, Carlo Giuffrè, Renzo Montagnani

title: La vedova inconsolabile ringrazia quanti la consolarono
synopsis: After the death of her very rich husband Salvatore, the beautiful Caterina is preparing to collect a fabulous inheritance. But there is a problem: since the deceased has not made a will, the wife will be able to benefit from the bequest only if, within the three hundred days established by law, she gives birth to a child. Knowing this, Tano and Rico - Salvatore's brothers, who would pocket the billions if Caterina did not fulfill this condition - organize an armed guard at the villa where the widow lives with her mother Teresa, blocking the way to any male individual. . But the unexpected puts a hand in it ...
cast: Edwige Fenech, Carlo Giuffrè, Didi Perego, Guido Leontini, Pino Ferrara

title: La veduta luminosa
synopsis: A strange couple, a director and the assistant of an absent producer, leave Rome to reach Tübingen, entering the Black Forest in search of the places of the poet Friedrich Holderlin.
cast: Alessandro Carlini, Catarina Wallenstein

title: La vela incantata
synopsis: During Fascism, two brothers, Angelo and Tonino, wandering cinematographers, return to the town, in the Lower Po Valley. But everything has changed, around and within them. Angelo reconnects an old relationship and tries to open a cinema, Tonino turns to politics, risking arrest. The portrait of two brothers that becomes that of the Italy of fascism and of the laceration (like that of the cinema screen) that separates them.
cast: Massimo Ranieri, Monica Guerritore, Lina Sastri

title: La velocità della luce
synopsis: Mario is a prestigious car thief who works on commission, with great dexterity, according to a well-established script. His next "victim" is a luxurious Bentley Continental R in which a mysterious character travels. To carry out his deception, Mario uses the unwitting help of a telephone operator in a call center, from whom - with a trick - he is able to find out the man's telephone number. But the contact between the three characters turns out to be explosive and the encounters that will ensue, consummated between motorways and motorway restaurants, will prove destined for some of them.
cast: Patrick Bauchau, Peppino Mazzotta, Beatrice Orlandini

title: La vena d'oro
synopsis: Maria lives with her sixteen year old son Corrado in a villa near Rome. Widowed at a young age, she dedicated her entire life to her son and leads a retired life. One day Corrado meets the engineer Manfredi, an archelogue who is following excavations in the vicinity of the villa. The two make friends and Corrado takes the opportunity to invite him to his house. Love is born between Maria and the archaeologist. This new feeling ends up making the widow's son jealous, who runs away from home on New Year's Eve.
cast: Terence Hill, Bianca Maria Ferrari, Marta Toren, Richard Basehart

title: La vendetta
synopsis: A quiet village in the Corsican hinterland is shaken by the sudden death of the mayor. His deputy, at the head of a political faction in the country, and the relatives of the deceased, who lead another camp, immediately come forward to contend for the succession. The political brawl soon turns into armed war as the factions in the field call on American criminals of local origin and outlaw "doc" respectively for reinforcement. In the end, between the two quarrels ...
cast: Louis De Funès, Francis Blanche, Marisa Merlini, Mario Carotenuto

title: La vendetta dei Tughs
synopsis: Tremal Naik, the famous tiger hunter, ends up as a prisoner of the bloodthirsty Tughs warriors in an attempt to free Ada, his woman. Discovered, he is sentenced to death, but a column of soldiers under the command of Colonel Kennedy is moving to his rescue. The military operation is successful. Naik clashes with the leader of the sect and kills him in a duel, after which, with Ada, he is finally free. The film is inspired by the characters of Salgari's novels: the Venturini Productions specialized at the time in the sector. An Italian B-movie for the most popular consumption.
cast: Lex Barker, Enzo Fiermonte, Fiorella Mari, Paul Müller

title: La vendetta di Ercole
synopsis: The son of Hercules falls in love with Thea, the daughter of the king of Hecalia, but an ancient curse that hangs over his head complicates things. Illo, son of Hercules, falls in love with Thea, the pupil of the king of Ecalia who does not look favorably on the relationship. And the very strong demigod also has to deal with an ancient curse that hangs on his head.
cast: Mark Forest, Broderick Crawford, Gaby André, Wandisa Guida

title: La vendetta di Lady Morgan
synopsis: Susan Morgan, a young English scion of a noble family, awaits the arrival of her beloved, the architect Pierre Brissac, with whom she plans to get married. However, when crossing the English Channel, the man is thrown into the sea and given by everyone for dead. Susan will have to resign herself to the wedding with Sir Arold, who, however, aims only at the inheritance of the young woman and has already concocted a plan with his mistress. Driven to madness, Susan kills herself by throwing herself from the tower of her home. However, his spirit will return in search of revenge.
cast: Barbara Nelli, Erika Blanc, Gordon Mitchell, Paul Muller, Michel Forain, Carlo Kechler, Edith MacGoven

title: La vendetta di Ursus
synopsis: Zagro, king of Cadia, wants to marry Sira, daughter of the king of Lycia. He does not love the girl, but has organized the wedding only to have the kingdom after which he plans to get rid of her. Too bad that the very strong Ursus is in love with the princess, who accompanies her in Cadia and thwarts Zagro's machinations.
cast: Samson Burke, Livio Lorenzon, Gina Rovere, Roberto Fantasia

title: La vendetta è il mio perdono
synopsis: Durango is a former law man who has thrown the toga to nettles because in the West the only jurisprudence that matters is that of the guns. A bad day his girlfriend is brutally killed by a group of bandits. Ugly day for the criminals because Durango, determined to make himself justice by himself, launches himself on their tracks.
cast: Tab Hunter, Erika Blanc, Piero Lulli

title: La vendetta è un piatto che si serve freddo
synopsis: After the Indians have exterminated his family, Jim lives only to annihilate them, until the day he discovers that the truth is very different.
cast: Leonard Mann, Elizabeth Eversfield, Ivan Rassimov, Klaus Kinski

title: La venexiana
synopsis: During the feast of Thanksgiving, a foreign gentleman arrives in Venice and immediately finds a way to impress two women: the widow Angela, hot with desires in the role of mourning, and the young Valeria, whose husband is temporarily absent. Thus the stranger will satisfy them both. In Bolognini, no one has ever been able to deny elegance, but here, grappling with the comedy of an anonymous man of the sixteenth century, all the salt of the original text is sacrificed to an aestheticism of a manner.
cast: Laura Antonelli, Monica Guerritore, Jason Connery, Claudio Amendola, Clelia Rondinella

title: La venganza de Clark Harrison
synopsis: A cowboy, accused of killing the owner of a gold mine, is found guilty on the basis of some false testimony and sentenced to hard labor. After serving his sentence, the man decides to return to his country to find out who he wanted to frame him. Here a real gang of outlaws are in charge of the murder for which the cowboy was convicted.
cast: Jim Reed, Martha Dovan, Pat Greenhill, Charles Otter

title: La venganza del Dottor Mabuse
synopsis: Doctor Farkas, as he now calls himself Doctor Mabuse, and his friend Hermann, steal moonstones necessary for the construction of a beam that has the power to remotely control a human being. The experiments involve young and cute strippers kidnapped by the monster Andros. Inspector Thomas will have to step in to resolve the case.
cast: Fred Williams, Ewa Stronberg, Jack Taylor, Roberto Camardiel

title: La venganza del Zorro
synopsis: The man behind whose mask Diego de La Vega is hiding, this time is called to restore peace and justice in a territory occupied by the Yankees. The difficulties he encounters are many but his courage and resourcefulness will allow him to fight to the death. Will he succeed in his enterprise?
cast: Frank Latimore, Mary Anderson, Ralph Marsch

title: La vera leggenda di Tony Vilar
synopsis: What happened to Antonio Ragusa, a poor Calabrian emigrant who left Genoa in 1952 for Argentina and later became Tony Vilar, the most famous melodic singer in South America in the early 1960s? A distant relative, a young singer-songwriter who grew up with the myth of his cousin Antonio / Tony, starts looking for him.
cast: Peppe Voltarelli, Roy Paci, Dario De Luca, Saverio La Ruina, Totonna Chiappetta, Cristina Mantis

title: La vera madre
synopsis: Chiara, a woman in Trentino is the mother of two children, Claudio and Giovanna. Over the years, due to the health of the smallest of the two, Claudio, the girl was forced to spend a lot of time in the hospital. Di Giovanna, inevitably left alone, has dealt with her father and Eleonora, a dentist who lives in the same condominium. The woman is very happy to take care of the girl, because, not being able to have children, she manages, in this way to satisfy her desire for motherhood. When Claudio is finally discharged from the hospital and Chiara tries to resume control of her family life, she realizes that Eleonora has now completely replaced.
cast: Carlotta Natoli, Stefania Orsola Garello, Marco Bonini, Giulia Petito, Leonardo Mirabilia

title: La vera storia della monaca di Monza
synopsis: The very young Marianna is forced by her family to take vows, and becomes a nun with the name of Virginia Maria. The convent, however, is a place of lust and perdition, where the chaplain has a good time with the novices and Virginia entertains a liason with the rich local lord Gianpaolo Osio.
cast: Zora Kerova, Mario Cutini, Franco Garofalo, Paola Corazzi, Paola Montenero

title: La vera vita di Antonio H.
synopsis: The life of Antonio Hutter, actor, according to Antonio Hutter. Childhood in Israel, youth in Verona, then Rome. The first roles in the cinema, the meeting with Orson Welles, the love story with Giuliana De Sio, the call to Hollywood to be De Niro's brother in "Raging Bull", then gradually until today, with the failure to commit suicide final and, once again, a phone call from the Mecca of cinema ...
cast: Alessandro Haber, Giuliana De Sio, Ennio Fantastichini, Massimo Ghini

title: La vergine di Norimberga
cast: Rossana Podestà, Georges Rivière, Christopher Lee, Jim Dolen

title: La vergine, il toro e il capricorno
synopsis: He gets busy with all women. She takes pains and tries to make him jealous with a false betrayal, but he doesn't fall for it. So she goes to Ischia with the intent of consummating a betrayal, this time real. He finds the young Patrizio, loves him and takes him back to Rome. Of course, the husband does not flinch and consoles himself with some secretary. Farsaccia more elaborate than usual, with Lionello and above all the playboy loser Maccione rather funny.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Alberto Lionello, Aldo Maccione, Alvaro Vitali

title: La verità sta in cielo
synopsis: On 22 June 1983 Emanuela Orlandi, a fifteen-year-old Vatican citizen, daughter of a papal messenger, disappeared from the center of Rome. After dozens of investigations, obscure hypotheses, involvement of strong powers, misleading of all kinds, one thing is certain: Emanuela has never returned home. Urged by the "Mafia capital" scandal that gripped Rome thirty years later, an English television network decided to send a journalist of Italian origin (Maya Sansa) to the capital to tell where it all began many years earlier. With the help of another journalist (Valentina Lodovini), correspondent of a well-known Italian television program who has discovered a new lead, a disturbing character enters the scene: Sabrina Minardi (Greta Scarano). She is the lover of Enrico De Pedis (Riccardo Scamarcio), better known as Renatino, the boss who managed better than any other the underworld of the capital, then ended up under the blows of the rival Magliana gang. Despite his past, Renatino will be buried in the Basilica of S. Apollinare, in the heart of Rome, right next to the music school attended by Emanuela. Minardi decides to tell what she claims to know about the kidnapping of the girl.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Maya Sansa, Greta Scarano, Valentina Lodovini, Shel Shapiro, Tommaso Lazotti, Luciano Roffi, Alberto Cracco, Paul Randall

title: La verità su La dolce vita
synopsis: Towards the end of 1958 Federico Fellini crosses a complicated professional period. He has already won two Oscars on the street and the nights of Cabiria but no producer wants to carry out his new project: a story written by him, Ennio Flaiano and Tullio Pinelli, entitled The Dolce Vita. Only a man, Giuseppe Amato, already a very famous manufacturer of masterpieces such as Umberto D., four steps between the clouds, Francesco Gerla di Dio and Don Camillo, includes the extraordinary nature of the subject. Amato seems to be really the only one to imagine, and say, that the script that has in his hands contains a masterpiece. With his thirty years of experience he also senses that the operation will be very risky but no obstacle can prevent him from carrying out a project he believes in. The story of the making of the film begins with a journey to San Giovanni Rotondo, where loved, as a very religious man, goes to obtain the blessing of Padre Pio himself, to start the job. Amato did not make mistakes in any of his intuitions: from there the story of the most popular Italian film ever will start abroad, a mythical and iconic film, with a very troubled realization: the most expensive production until then in Italy. Amato convinces the magnate and his historical partner Angelo Rizzoli to co-finance the work, which will cost the double of what has been estimated and agreed with the director. The processing will suffer quarrels, setbacks, outbursts, threats. The contrasts between Fellini and the production will be hard. The first mounted, lasting four hours, for Rizzoli is not distributable in cinemas. International co -producers don't even consider it. The film will be the cause of the breaking of the twenty -year association between Amato and Rizzoli. And a golden palm will be worth in Cannes, an extraordinary success at the box office, one of the most controversial controversies ever recorded in Italian and international newspapers and eternal glory to the film.

title: La verità vi prego sull'Amore
synopsis: San Valentino, home of Elizabeth and Michelangelo. The two have been together for two years even though their relationship begins to falter. With them are Giulia and Gabriele, an apparently happy couple and then Monica who loves Lorenzo, Lorenzo who loves Olga, Olga who loves Luca ...
cast: Francesco Apolloni, Carlotta Natoli, Veronika Logan, Pierfrancesco Favino

title: La verità, vi spiego, sull'amore
synopsis: The life of Dora (Ambra Angiolini) ends upside down when her partner Davide (Massimo Poggio) leaves her after seven years of relationship and two small children, Pietro of five years and Micol of just one. Dora refuses to elaborate her sentimental 'mourning' until, put at loggerheads by a 'hateful' psychologist, she realizes that the time has come to tell the truth to Pietro. Spurred on by her friend Sara (Carolina Crescentini), she finally finds the strength to react but the real rebirth will come when she finally understands that the answers to her questions must be sought within her.
cast: Ambra Angiolini, Carolina Crescentini, Massimo Poggio, Edoardo Pesce, Pia Engleberth, Maurizio Di Carmine, Arisa, Giuliana De Sio

title: La veritàààà
synopsis: An eighty-year-old man escapes from the asylum in which he is locked up without even getting rid of his white shirt. Dressed like that, he begins to go around people and talk to everyone about what is wrong with the world. He even talks about it to the pope and sends his message on TV, but no one is willing to listen to the ravings of an old madman. He therefore decides to "commit suicide" by holding his breath.
cast: Cesare Zavattini, Pietro Barreca, Vittorio Amendola, Piero Zardini, Bombolo

title: La vespa e la regina
synopsis: Renato is a young man who directs a homosexual culture magazine and who has made diversity a pride and a profession. But he is forced to promise his dying grandmother that at least once in his life he will try to go with a woman. The boy thus undertakes to conquer a provocative blonde, Ginevra, who, surprise !, is an irreducible lesbian, leader of the rock group the Fuckin 'Girls.
cast: Claudia Gerini, Pere Ponce, Ana Risueño, Luigi Petrucci, Cosimo Cinieri, Armando De Razza, Paolo Sassanelli

title: La veuve Couderc
synopsis: Fresh from the Cayenne, where he was imprisoned for murdering two politicians, the anarchist Jean Lavigne reaches France and finds work on the farm of the widow Couderc. The age difference does not prevent Jean from becoming the woman's lover, arousing considerable gossip in the village and a great concern of the widow's greedy brothers-in-law who report the presence of the fugitive to the police thus determining the tragic end of the story.
cast: Simone Signoret, Alain Delon, Ottavia Piccolo, Monique Chaumette, Jean Tissier, Bobby Lapointe

title: La veuve de Saint-Pierre
synopsis: 1848, while in Paris the Republic leads an uncertain life, in a French islet in Canada Neel Auguste kills an old man in a state of drunkenness. Offender I confess, he is sentenced to death, but the guillotine (the "widow" in jargon) does not arrive. The wife of the captain of the garrison sees the signs of goodness in him and "adopts" him. Neel Auguste integrates himself into the community even performing heroic deeds, but unleashing the hatred of notables. When the guillotine arrives, it is a sad day for the whole population, but especially for the captain, who must order the execution.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Daniel Auteuil, Emir Kusturica, Michel Duchaussoy

title: La via degli angeli
synopsis: We are in rural Italy in the years of fascism, when the arrival of spring on the Bolognese Apennines was an event. On the first Saturday of the season, the dances began in Castel del Vescovo, in Edgardo Osti's dance hall: starting from that day, men and women began to dream of the meeting of their life. Ines also goes there, hoping to find the one who could change her existence forever. The girl falls in love with the son of an antiquarian ...
cast: Valentina Cervi, Gianni Cavina, Carlo Delle Piane, Eliana Miglio

title: La via dei babbuini
synopsis: Fiorenza and Orazio live in Rome, they are married but their marriage is not going well at all. Suddenly Fiorenza has to leave for Somalia to assist her father, whom she had never met and who shows up at the point of death. He finds him dead now but begins to get curious and to rebuild the life he led there; and discovers a way of life completely different from what she is used to. Orazio tries to get her back on the decision but Fiorenza is adamant: she will leave to walk the path of the baboons, a mythical path in the savannah. Faint anti-bourgeois satire, dull like many Magni films.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Pippo Franco, Fabio Garriba, Lionel Stander, Ada Pometti

title: La via del petrolio
synopsis: The journey of oil that starts from the extraction in Persia and the mountains of Iran to refining in Old Europe.
cast: Giulio Bosetti, Nino Castelnuovo, Riccardo Cucciolla, Nino Dal Fabbro, Mario Feliciani, Mario Trejo

title: La via della droga
synopsis: Mike, the head of the Interantional Narcotic Bureau in Rome, decides to infiltrate his own man in the evil of the capital, a city at the center of the distribution of drugs throughout Europe. The agent is called Fabio and to gain the trust of the criminals, he gets arrested in Fiumicino with a pack of drugs on him. Thus he meets Gillo and Vera who introduce him into the undergrowth of Roman petty criminals. In this way he will hook Le Roy, the boss of an American organization which, hidden behind a pharmaceutical institute, distributes the treated goods in an underground laboratory ...
cast: Fabio Testi, David Hemmings, Sherry Buchanan, Wolfango Soldati, Massimo Vanni, Angelo Ragusa, Romano Puppo, Sergio Ruggeri, Joshua Sinclair, Leonardo Scavino

title: La via della prostituzione
synopsis: Photojournalist Emanuelle and her friend Susan are invited for a safari by Prince Aurozanni and the dangerous gangster George Lagnetti. The two women then begin to investigate the trafficking of girls forced into prostitution. Emanuelle therefore decides to pretend to be a prostitute, to investigate the case better and more thoroughly.
cast: Laura Gemser, Ely Galleani, Gabriele Tinti, Venantino Venantini, Pierre Marfurt, Gota Gobert, Bryan Rostron, Manuela Romano, Nicola D'Eramo, Anna Toffoli

title: La viaccia
synopsis: Amerigo, Stefano's son, goes to Florence to work in his uncle Nando's shop. In a rendezvous house he meets and falls in love with Bianca. To raise the money needed to continue seeing her, Amerigo has no qualms about stealing money from his uncle. The boy, caught in the act, is thrown out of the house and is forced to return home. But the father does not want to hear reasons and takes him back to Florence. Once again chased by his uncle, Amerigo, who continues to see Bianca, is stabbed by a friend of the woman.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Claudia Cardinale, Romolo Valli

title: La vida después
synopsis: Samuel and Rodrigo begin a journey in search of their mother, who disappeared in a strange way after leaving a message saying that she had to go away. As the two brothers travel through a desert landscape that brings back old childhood memories, their relationship will become increasingly strained and close to fracturing.
cast: Américo Hollander, Rodrigo Azuela, María Renée Prudencio

title: La vida secreta de las palabras
synopsis: Hanna is a lonely nurse who, during the holidays, accepts a replacement on a platform where she takes care of Joseph, temporarily blind and scarred by numerous and severe burns on his body. Together, the two will face painful memories ...
cast: Sarah Polley, Tim Robbins, Javier Cámara, Eddie Marsan, Steven Mackintosh

title: La vida útil
synopsis: A famous Montevideo film library, overwhelmed by debt, is forced to close its doors. Jorge worked there for twenty-five years, organizing meetings and reviews, and dedicating himself to the promotion of film culture. At the moment of leaving that place, where he has spent most of his life, the man feels awe. Beginning to circulate in the outside world, however, he discovers the thrill of real life. Which, at times, is just like a movie.
cast: Jorge Jellinek, Manuel Martinez Carril, Paola Venditto

title: La vie amoureuse de l'homme invisible
cast: Howard Vernon, Fernando Sancho, Francis Valladares, Brigitte Carva, Isabel Del Rio

title: La vie d'Adèle
synopsis: Adele, a seventeen-year-old high school girl, is waiting for great love and one day she glimpses it in Thomas, a dark but friendly young man. But theirs is a story destined not to be fully lived: on the same day Adele also met a mysterious blue-haired girl who every night becomes the protagonist of her most intimate dreams and desires. Refusing at first the dream experiences, Adele tries to indulge in Thomas but realizes that she cannot be completely hers and that she is attracted to the girls. Thanks to a friend who goes to the gay clubs of the city, he has the opportunity to track down the blue-haired girl and let himself be overwhelmed by her feverish, chaotic and passionate sentiment.
cast: Léa Seydoux, Adèle Exarchopoulos, Salim Kechiouche, Mona Walravens, Jérémie Laheurte, Alma Jodorowsky, Aurélien Recoing, Catherine Salle, Fanny Maurin, Benjamin Siksou, Sandor Funtek, Aurelie Lemanceau, Karim Saidi, Baya Rehaz

title: La vie d'une autre
synopsis: 25-year-old Marie has just met Paul, the man of her dreams, but one morning fate plays a trick on her by making her wake up fifteen years later. Unable to explain how this happened and to recognize her own life, Marie (Juliette Binoche) finds herself in the middle of a marriage crisis with Paul (Mathieu Kassovitz) and a son to manage. He will have four days ahead of him during which he can try to win back his dearest affections, making up for the mistakes he made in a past he has not yet lived through.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Mathieu Kassovitz, Aure Atika, Danièle Lebrun, Vernon Dobtcheff, Yvi Dachary Le Béon, François Berléand, Massimo Brancatelli, Claude Breda, Yvi Dachary

title: La vie de Jésus
synopsis: Life without hope for the young people of a small town in Flanders. A boy desperately loves a girl: for him, love is capable of going beyond any social convention, of ignoring the intimately racist and xenophobic nature of the French province. But it is so only for him: and, in the end, this diversity of his backfires.
cast: David Douche, Marjorie Cottreel, Geneviève Cottreel, Kader Chaatouf

title: La vie de château
synopsis: The wife of a well-off and comfortable husband lives in a castle in Normandy not spared, in 1944, from the visit of Nazis and partisans. The wife believes her husband is disinterested in the political events of the war and for this reason she is interested in the sentimental ones of the leaders of the opposing factions. Until the American Salvation Army parachutes from the sky and will give her husband the opportunity to redeem himself with heroic gestures.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Catherine Deneuve, Pierre Brasseur, Mary Marquet

title: La vie des morts
synopsis: The relatives of a boy who has attempted suicide, Patrick (who is in a coma in the hospital) find themselves in the house of their cousin's provincial town. Living together is difficult and tense while waiting for a phone call from the hospital ... A film kept constantly on the inclined plane of emotions without falling into anger or manner. The young Desplechin (later author of "La sentinelle") already demonstrates all his talent.
cast: Thibault De Montalembert, Emmanuelle Devos, Roch Leibovici, Marianne Denicourt

title: La vie devant soi
synopsis: The Jewish Madame Rosa (Signoret) experienced the Nazi horror, then got on with prostitution, finally looking after the children of former "life" colleagues. She ends up poor and sick, with only the affection of two children, Moses and Momo.
cast: Simone Signoret, Samy Ben Youb, Claude Dauphin

title: La vie domestique
synopsis: Juliette, Betty, Marianne and Inès live near the Cassan park. They all have children to grow, houses to take care of, husbands who return late from work and, in some cases, a job to complete. Like every morning, they are engaged in the thought of everything they have to do during the day but the moment will come when they will stop to reflect on what they have done of their lives.
cast: Emmanuelle Devos, Julie Ferrier, Natacha Régnier, Héléna Noguerra, Laurent Poitrenaux

title: La vie est un long fleuve tranquille
synopsis: The life of 12-year-olds Momo Groseille and Bernadette Le Quesnoy changes dramatically when it is discovered that all this time they have been raised and raised ... by the wrong family! The fact is that the Groseille and Le Quesnoy have very different social backgrounds: the former proletarian and coarse, the latter wealthy and refined. The two clans agree (economically) for Bernadette to stay with her adoptive parents, but for both her and Momo the new situation is somewhat unsettling ...
cast: Benoît Magimel, Valérie Lalande, Tara Romer, Daniel Gélin, Emmanuel Grendrier

title: La vie est un roman
synopsis: Forbek, shocked by the horrors of the Great War, gathers all his friends in the castle he had begun to build. His goal is to give them some happiness and to achieve his goal he distributes a potion that can erase memories. In this way everyone will be children again. Livia, Forbek's woman, decides not to drink the potion by rebelling against the crazy project. A group of scholars get together to participate in a seminar on "Education for the imagination". Only four of them will retain their identity.
cast: Fanny Ardant, Vittorio Gassman, Pierre Arditi, Sabine Azéma

title: La vie est à nous
synopsis: The film is divided into three parts. In the first, an elderly worker is threatened with being sacked because he is no longer able to keep up his pace of work. In the second, a peasant family whose assets have been foreclosed manage to profit from their sale to the highest bidder. In the third, a young unemployed engineer struggles in vain to find work.
cast: Jean Dasté, Jacques B. Brunius, Simone Guisin, Teddy Michaud
director: Jacques Becker, Jacques B. Brunius, Henri Cartier Bresson, Jean Paul Le Chanois, Maurice Lime, Pierre Unik, André Zwoboda, Jean Renoir

title: La vie et rien d'autre
synopsis: In 1920 Major Dellaplane was charged with identifying the unnamed French fallen of the recent conflict; the government, meanwhile, must choose the unknown soldier to honor. Irène is looking for the body of her missing husband. Between her and Dellaplane, so different and hostile at first, an understanding will be born that only two years later (perhaps too late) the disillusioned officer will decide to admit. Intense interpretation of Sabine Azéma and Noiret in this painful return to post-war normality.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Sabine Azéma, Pascale Vignal, Maurice Barrier

title: La vie nouvelle
synopsis: Seymour (Zachary Knighton), a young American licensed soldier, accompanies Roscoe (Marc Barbé) near Sofia to buy prostitutes from Mephistophelian male trafficker Boyan (Zsolt Nagy). Having made the choice, the two go to a gigantic hotel-brothel in the capital: here, between lap dance shows and ample female availability, Seymour is fatally ensnared by Melania (Anna Mouglalis), a beautiful and elusive girl in Boyan's pay. The young soldier wants to redeem the woman and take her with him at any cost, even if it means betraying Roscoe.
cast: Zachary Knighton, Anna Mouglalis, Marc Barbé, Zsolt Nagy, Raoul Dantec, Vladimir Zintov, Georgi Kadurin, Simona Huelsemann, Josh Pearson, Salvador Gueorguiev

title: La vie promise
synopsis: Sylvia is a prostitute with a 14 -year -old daughter. One day, to defend her mother, the girl stabs her protector who is beating her ...
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Pascal Greggory, Maud Forget, André Marcon, Fabienne Babe

title: La vie rêvée des anges
synopsis: Isa is twenty years old, a backpacker and a very fatalistic cheerful philosophy. She arrives in Lille after other stops in search of a job to help her make ends meet. In a tailor's shop she meets Marie, twenty years old too, alone, hypersensitive and closed in her revolt against everything and everyone. A friendship is born that resembles a mutual adoption and that leads them to make new friends and pursue new loves.
cast: Elodie Bouchez, Natacha Régnier, Grégoire Colin, Agnes Godart

title: La vie scolaire
synopsis: Samia, a young woman in her first important job, arrives as a consultant in a school in her region which everyone considers "difficult". Here, he discovers the pupils' recurring discipline problems, the social reality of the neighborhood and the difficulties, but also the vitality and humor of the students and colleagues. Her complicated personal situation brings her ever closer to Yanis, an insolent student she wants to give a better future to.
cast: Zita Hanrot, Liam Pierron, Moussa Mansaly, Soufiane Guerrab, Leïla Seghir, Alban Ivanov, Adèle Galloy, Tamara Kozo

title: La vie sexuelle des belges
synopsis: Jan lives in a small village with her parents, a little sister and an aunt. The boy is a reserved type who, during the summer holidays, suffers his first love disappointment. Grown up, he goes to Brussels and, when he thinks the right time has come, he gets married. But his marriage fails and, at the end of the day, Jan is torn between the belief that it is difficult to bear women and the inability to do without them. Bucquoy, known as a "cultural provocateur", made his debut in the cinema with a film with anarchic traits both in content and form, capable of saying very serious things.
cast: Jean Henri Compère, Noé Francq, Isabelle Legros, Sophie Schneider

title: La vie à l'envers
synopsis: Jacques suddenly sees his life as a comedy in which he no longer wants to act. He loses his job, his partner and, now alone and happy, tells him about him at the magnetophone.
cast: Charles Denner, Anna Gaylor, Jean Yanne, Yvonne Clech

title: La vie, l'amour, la mort
synopsis: François Toledo, happily married and loving family man, is a model worker in an automobile factory. However, his past is weighed down by a very heavy shadow: the murder of three prostitutes, two in Paris and one in Nîmes. Soon, thanks also to an identikit drawn on the basis of the testimony of the friend of one of the victims, the circle of the police tightens around François, who is arrested, tried and sentenced ...
cast: Amidou, Caroline Cellier, Marcel Bozzuffi, Janine Magnan, Lisette Bersey, Nathalie Durrand

title: La vieille dame indigne
synopsis: The seventy -year -old Mrs. Berthe (Sylvie), upon the death of her husband, finds herself alone and with quite limited means but which finally allow her after so many deprivations, to live her life without obligations or conditioning. Thus she refuses to go and live with her children to enjoy the years that they still remain with this decision, the scandal and disapproval of the right -thinking, family members including her.
cast: Sylvie, Victor Lanoux, Malka Ribowska, François Maistre, Etienne Bierry, Pascale De Boysson, Jean Louis Lamande, Lena Delanne, Jeanne Hardeyn, Pierre Meffre

title: La vieille fille
synopsis: Muriel, single and with a few years on her shoulders, decides to spend a holiday in a tourist resort. Due to a breakdown in his car Gabriel, unmarried, also no longer young, is forced to a forced stop. The arrival of the unexpected guest wreaks havoc in Muriel's heart.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Annie Girardot, Marthe Keller, Maria Schneider

title: La vierge du Rhin
cast: Jean Gabin, Andrée Clément, Élina Labourdette, Renaud Mary, Nadia Gray

title: La villa
synopsis: Scampia, Naples. In the heart of the neighborhood, between buildings and cement expanses, there is a large public park. Flowers, palm trees and trees of different types make it a real natural oasis. While from afar the police sirens resonate and the rhombus of helicopters that patrol the area, the municipal villa of Scampia offers to the inhabitants as a refuge: a place in itself, enclosed by a high surrounding wall, where people are looking for one space of freedom.

title: La villa
synopsis: Near a small bay near Marseille is the charming villa owned by an elderly person. Around the man, in his last days of life, his three children are reunited: Angela (an actress who lives in Paris), Joseph (who has just fallen in love with a young woman who is half her age) and Armand ( the only one who remained in Marseille to take care of the business of the small family restaurant). The time has come for the three to come to terms with the ideals inherited from their father and with the spirit of community that he has created in that magical place. The arrival of a group of people on the boat will upset their thoughts, bringing agitation and concern.
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Gérard Meylan, Anaïs Demoustier, Robinson Stévenin

title: La villa dei misteri
synopsis: The Countess De Fonseca is found murdered and all the clues bring to the lover of her husband, Egle, a make -up artist just fired by Cinecittà; The girl moves under dishes to the adjacent villa that of the crime in order to personally investigate the facts. But it seems that the villa is bewitched and you live there in the spirit of the Marquis Giustini Lo Bello.
cast: Tomas Arana, Alberto Castagna, Pier Maria Cecchini, Massimo Ciavarro, Corinne Cléry, Anita Ekberg, Gabriel Garko, Eva Grimaldi, Orso Maria Guerrini, Paola Quattrini, Francesca Rettondini

title: La villa del venerdì
synopsis: Stefano and Alina are married and really love each other, but they have chosen to be an "open couple". While Stefano's trespasses are occasional and temporary, Alina ends up binding to Paolo in an increasingly intense sadomasochistic relationship. At this point Stefano becomes jealous and, while respecting the agreements, he no longer knows what to do.
cast: Julian Sands, Joanna Pacula, Tchéky Karyo, Lara Wendel, Marco Di Stefano

title: La villa delle anime maledette
cast: Beba Loncar, Jean Pierre Aumont, Annarita Grapputo, Georges Ardisson

title: La ville des pirates
synopsis: An impossible love is born between a servant and a child who has committed a murder. Meanwhile, on the island where this dark story unfolds, a mysterious character wanders, probable "alter ego" of the child.
cast: Anne Alvaro, Melvil Poupaud, Hugues Quester

title: La ville est tranquille
synopsis: Marseille. Michèle works in a factory that sells fish to retailers. The work is tiring, but the homecoming is no better because the woman has to fight to get her daughter out of the drug tunnel. Paul betrayed his workmates, he was a longshoreman at the port, to become a taxi driver. Abderramane, transformed out of prison, tries to help his brothers. Viviane can no longer stand her husband and his leftist views. Sarkis has a dream: to have a grand piano.
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Gérard Meylan, Pascale Roberts, Alexandre Ogou

title: La villeggiatura
synopsis: Professor Rossini (Merli) refused to swear allegiance to the fascist regime and for this reason he was sent to confinement on a small southern island. of the concern shown by the commissioner (Celi) towards the protagonist. The story overshadows an acute analysis of the behavior of Italian culture during Fascism, of class separations, of the understanding between Church and regime (with a chronological shift of the Concordat). A lucid film in its political significance, and well interpreted.
cast: Adalberto Maria Merli, Adolfo Celi, Milena Vukotic, John Steiner

title: La vingt-cinquième heure
synopsis: We are in the forties and a Romanian peasant, overwhelmed by the storm of war, ends up in a concentration camp. In the following months, due to a series of fortuitous circumstances, he was transferred to many other fields, in half of Europe.
cast: Anthony Quinn, Virna Lisi, Michael Redgrave, Serge Reggiani

title: La violenza: quinto potere
synopsis: The construction of a dam in Sicily triggers unconfessable interests and appetites that find immediate repercussions in a feud between two mafia gangs who support two different power groups. After a long series of crimes of which not only some members of the rival gangs are the victims, but also many innocent ones, we arrive at the trial that sees the accused representatives of major and minor prominent members of the two clans. The skill of the lawyers and the retractions, the silences, the silence mean that, in the end, only two picciotti pay for everyone.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Gastone Moschin, Riccardo Cucciolla, Mariangela Melato, Mario Adorf, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aldo Giuffré, Michele Abruzzo, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Turi Ferro, Guido Leontini, Elio Zamuto, Julien Guiomar, Georges Wilson, Mico Cundari

title: La virgen de la lujuria
synopsis: Mexico, 1940s. "El Mikado" is a taciturn and lonely waiter. He spends his days between Caffé Ofelia and its collection of pornographic photos. His life changes dramatically when he meets Lola, a sweet, unpredictable and self-destructive Spanish prostitute. A sadomasochistic relationship is established between the two, but "El Mikado" is capable of anything to win the love of the woman.
cast: Ariadna Gil, Luis Felipe Tovar, Patricia Reyes Spindola, Juan Diego, Julian Pastor

title: La virgen de los sicarios
synopsis: After an absence of thirty years, the writer Fernando Vallejo returns to Medellin, the city that has seen him grow. There is not much left of what he had left: his relatives are all dead, a part of the city has been demolished, the Medellin cartel sows terror. In a gay dating house he meets and becomes friends with Alexis, a sixteen-year-old boy who works as a hitman for drug traffickers in a country where human life is worth nothing.
cast: German Jaramillo, Anderson Ballesteros, Manuel Busquets, Juan David Restrepo

title: La visione del Sabba
synopsis: The court instructs a psychiatrist to examine a mentally ill, accused of murder, who believes she is a witch. The doctor is overwhelmed by the visions and the turbid charm of the woman. One of the most encrypted and distressing stages of that long filmic self-analysis which is the work of director Marco Bellocchio.
cast: Béatrice Dalle, Daniel Ezralow, Corinne Touzet, Omero Antonutti

title: La visita
synopsis: Pina is 36 years old and lives alone in San Benedetto Po, in the Lower Mantua area. She placed a wedding announcement in the newspaper to which Adolfo, a salesman from Rome, replied. After a series of letters, the man goes to see her. They spend a day together during which however Pina discovers that a life together would be impossible.
cast: Sandra Milo, François Périer, Mario Adorf, Gastone Moschin

title: La vispa Teresa
synopsis: A guy from a good family falls in love with a manicure. Parents opposed to the relationship send their son to Cortina. The lover brings with him the girl who, on the same day of arrival, leaves the young man to follow another man.
cast: Vera Carmi, Antonio Gandusio, Carlo Ninchi, Roberto Villa, Lilia Silvi

title: La vita agra
synopsis: Sacked by the mining company for which he worked, Luciano goes to Milan determined to blow up the headquarters. Here he meets Anna and goes to live with her. Turning out to be an advertising genius, he is hired by the same company where he was previously employed. His intentions of revenge are now forgotten and so his wife and son left in the province.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Giovanna Ralli, Giampiero Albertini, Nino Krisman

title: La vita appesa a un filo
synopsis: A blind old Chinese musician and singer believes he will regain his sight. This will happen, according to him, only when for the thousandth time the string of his "qin", a traditional instrument, will be broken. The old storyteller has a pupil, who is also blind and also possesses a magical "qin". The pupil, however, is more impatient and therefore shows greater haste in waiting for destiny to take its course.
cast: Liu Zhongyuan, Huang Lei, Xu Qing

title: La vita cambia
synopsis: Anna was released after a dramatic six-month kidnapping. Her husband Luca managed to pay the ransom and save her despite Viola, the deputy prosecutor, having imposed a freeze on assets. During the interrogations she is subjected to, Anna shows that she is confused and too often falls into contradiction. Viola, who has had to deal with many kidnappings, puts her under pressure with the belief that the woman is hiding something. Luca, for his part, is unable to accept that their life is no longer the same as it was before and Anna is tormented by a horrible secret that does not allow her to live peacefully.
cast: Isabella Ferrari, Mariangela Melato, Urbano Barberini, Antonello Fassari

title: La vita che vorrei
synopsis: Laura, thirty years old, is chosen as the protagonist to shoot a costume film set in the 19th century that tells of an unfortunate love story. So she meets Stefano, an established actor who returns to acting after a failure. A relationship is born between the two that traces the story recited on the set ...
cast: Luigi Lo Cascio, Sandra Ceccarelli, Galatea Ranzi, Fabio Camilli, Roberto Citran

title: La vita come viene
synopsis: A dentist who spends his weekends participating in simulated fights provokes his partner's reaction. Exasperated, the woman slips a real gun into her bag. To cover gambling debts, two elderly people improvise as child kidnappers. A librarian finds the courage to confess her love to the mother of the kidnapped children. A professor charms his students by discussing what is important in life, but then he finds no one to spend his birthday with.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Lorenza Indovina, Alessandro Haber, Stefania Rocca, Stefania Sandrelli

title: La vita davanti a sé
synopsis: Madame Rosa, an elderly Jewish woman and former prostitute, albeit reluctantly, agrees to take care of Momò, a turbulent 12-year-old from the street of Senegalese origins. The two are different in everything and for this reason at the beginning their relationship is very conflicting, but unexpectedly their relationship will turn into a deep friendship. In fact, they will soon realize that they are kindred souls, linked by a common destiny that will change their lives forever.
cast: Sophia Loren, Ibrahima Gueye, Renato Carpentieri, Iosif Diego Pirvu, Massimiliano Rossi, Abril Zamora, Babak Karimi

title: La vita degli altri
synopsis: Mariano who has always respected the rules of the Camorra and Luisa, a lonely, exploited and disillusioned girl, are united by a deep sense of defeat. He, betrayed by his parents and rejected by his only daughter, lives in a sort of hermitage on the slopes of Vesuvius; she, a young researcher at the Vesuvian Observatory, hides her loneliness and emotional emptiness in her work. The two come into contact when it appears that the volcano is about to erupt.
cast: Renato Carpentieri, Teresa Saponangelo, Patrizio Rispo

title: La vita facile
synopsis: Mario Tirelli is a successful surgeon who, however, feels he has to change his career and his life by going to Africa to help his old friend Luca Manzi, who has built a hospital there. The friend, however, is unaware of Mario's choice, as is Ginevra who is Mario's wife, known precisely at the time of the friendship between the two. Mario's decision will inevitably involve them and will bring up a series of unspoken things and choices not made.
cast: Stefano Accorsi, Pierfrancesco Favino, Vittoria Puccini, Camilla Filippi, Angelo Orlando, Eliana Miglio, Ivano Marescotti, Souleymane Sow, Max Tardioli

title: La vita in comune
synopsis: In the town of Disperata, a poet and depressed mayor (Gustavo Caputo) finds consolation in the attacks of all the councilors - including Eufemia (Celeste Casciaro) with whom he is secretly in love - by volunteering in prison. Right in the prison he will find Pati Rrunza, prejudiced, feared and respected in the country, ex-husband of that Euphemia with whom he is madly in love. Between dream and neorealism, the bad Pati, diligent pupil of the mayor, suddenly converts to poetry.
cast: Gustavo Caputo, Antonio Carluccio, Claudio Giangreco, Celeste Casciaro, Davide Riso, Alessandra De Luca, Francesco Ferrante, Antonio Pennarella, Tommasina Cacciatore

title: La vita oscena
synopsis: After losing his parents, a young teenager (Clement Metayer), to escape the pain and waiting for an end that never seems to come, lets himself go on a hallucinated path that alters his vision of reality. Between drug experiences and extreme sex and linked to the figure of an absent and metaphorized mother (Isabella Ferrari), she will move towards adult life and rebirth.
cast: Clement Metayer, Isabella Ferrari, Roberto De Francesco, Duccio Camerini, Andrea Renzi, Anita Kravos, Miriam Giovanelli, Iaia Forte, Eva Riccobono, Valentina Bellè, Vittoria Schisano

title: La vita possibile
synopsis: Anna and her son Valerio run away from a man and from Rome before ending up in the columns of a newspaper, news among the news. She is shattered in body and soul, he is closed, fragile, full of resentment. But "possible life" exists. Rebelling is necessary and sometimes it is also a duty. Anna and Valerio know this, they are convinced they can return to live and they want it with all their strength. They are thus welcomed in Turin in the home of Carla, a longtime theater actress and friend of Anna. The two try to adapt to their new existence amid so many difficulties and misunderstandings, but the help of Carla and the unexpected help of Mathieu, a French restaurateur who lives in the neighborhood, will make them find the strength to start over.
cast: Margherita Buy, Valeria Golino, Caterina Shulha, Andrea Pittorino, Bruno Todeschini, Eugenio Gradabosco, Enrica Rosso, Stefano Dell'Accio, Tatiana Lepore, Dario Delpero

title: La vita ricomincia
synopsis: After years of absence, a veteran from captivity (Giachetti) finds the serenity of existence with his wife (Valli) and son. But during the absence of her husband, the woman went through a dramatic moment which is now reaching its tragic conclusion. However, the man finds the strength to forgive and reunite with his woman. Rhetorical melodrama but also absolutely sincere, starting from the harsh post-war reality but with pathetic thrusts (and Chopin's music on the soundtrack). The best is given by the presence of the Giachetti-Valli couple.
cast: Alida Valli, Fosco Giachetti, Eduardo De Filippo, Nando Bruno

title: La vita rubata
synopsis: Graziella, a lively and enterprising seventeen year old, began working in the dyeing plant of her village, Villafranca, in the province of Messina. On the evening of December 12, 1985, however, he suddenly disappears. At first we think of a "fuitina" with Franco, her suitor, but the reality is much more painful: her body is found, a few days later, crushed by five rifle shots. It will be above all the elder brother Pietro, a young carabiniere, to make his way through hypocrisy and falsehood to find the killers of his beloved sister and the shady reasons that led them to kill her.
cast: Giuseppe Fiorello, Alessio Vassallo, Larissa Volpintesta, Aurora Quattrocchi

title: La vita semplice
synopsis: The daily routine of Marco and Bepi, two gondoliers from Giudecca, is turned upside down by a factory located nearby. It will be the love between Marco's daughter and the industrialist's son to put everything back in place ...
cast: Giulio Stival, Luciano De Ambrosis, Anna Bianchi, Maurizio D'Ancora

title: La vita è bella
synopsis: A penniless noble and idler runs out of money and thinks about suicide. A professor promises him money in exchange for a risky favor: to undergo an injection of an unknown serum to check its effects. The experiment will have to take place after ten days. In the meantime, the noble understands the value of existence, of work and also knows a girl who could love him. Rabagliati was a good singer; the classic light comedy plot is enriched by very Bragaglian fantastic ideas and by the mild anti-aristocratic polemic, very common at the time.
cast: Maria Mercader, Anna Magnani, Alberto Rabagliati, Carlo Campanini

title: La vita è bella
synopsis: Antonio Murillo fought for a long time in Angola against the independence guerrillas (the action took place before the Portuguese revolution of 1975). Back in Lisbon he works as a taxi driver and falls in love with Maria, ignoring the fact that the girl is a member of a left wing group. Attending the girl costs him arrest, but Antonio manages to escape and join the revolutionaries, among whom he finds Maria. Confused and misinterpreted Italian-Soviet co-production, directed by a post-Stalinist director (The ballad of a soldier).
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Ornella Muti, Enzo Fiermonte, Stefano Madia

title: La vita è bella
synopsis: Goldsmith Guido, waiter and then bookseller in Italy in the twenties, married a rich teacher, and is Jewish. Just like her old uncle, and like the Goldsmith Giosué, her child. Like all Jews, the three were loaded onto a truck, then onto a train, and taken to a concentration camp. Where Guido, with the courage of a lion, invents a game, so that Giosué does not get scared and, perhaps, manages to survive.
cast: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Giorgio Cantarini, Giustino Durano

title: La vita è un gioco
synopsis: Bartolomeo is a Florentine marquis who has now fallen with the family vice of gambling. Never, however, before him had lost the entire heritage, including the historic villa. Colonnino, Ciotolino and Postcard are three young people of today, Bartolomeo's three friends playing, betting, betting and roulette companions. Coordinated by Bartolomeo, determined to reclaim his villa, they collect the necessary money and try their luck at the Casino of San Vincent.
cast: Bebo Storti, Sabina Began, Niki Giustini, Graziano Salvadori

title: La vita è una cosa meravigliosa
synopsis: Four stories that intertwine and, along the way, come together. The glue is the story of Cesare (Enrico Brignano), a policeman who deals with wiretapping and who is perpetually intent on spying on the lives of others. For example, that of Antonio (Vincenzo Salemme), president of an important banking group, from which politicians insistently ask for black funds to finance their hindrances. Among the characters in sight that Antonio forages is the owner of a clinic where Claudio (Gigi Proietti) works, a surgeon married to Elena (Nancy Brilli), who will also end up indirectly overwhelmed by the investigation. Also involved in the investigation will be Vanessa (Virginie Marsan), Antonio's daughter, together with Marco (Emanuele Bosi), a young electrician. As well as Laura (Luisa Ranieri), a masseuse who falls in love with Cesare without knowing that he is a policeman.
cast: Enrico Brignano, Luisa Ranieri, Vincenzo Salemme, Gigi Proietti, Nancy Brilli, Virginie Marsan, Orsetta De Rossi, Emanuele Bosi, Federico Torre, Gennaro Cannavacciuolo, Anis Gharbi, Carlo Fabiano

title: La vita è una sola
synopsis: The trio of filmmakers Eugenio, Massimo and Fabio succeeds in making a low-cost film, entitled _Il masatore _...
cast: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata
director: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata

title: La vita, a volte, è molto dura, vero Provvidenza?
synopsis: A cultured and very penniless bounty hunter, Provvidenza captures the Hurricane Kid for the umpteenth time. Then it has to do with a girl who goes fast, a rascal sheriff, a criminologist, a group of pious pioneers ...
cast: Tomas Milian, Gregg Palmer, Janet Agren, Dieter Eppler, Stelio Candelli, Hans Terofal

title: La vittima designata
synopsis: Stefano lives in luxury thanks to his wife's money, but when he falls in love with a model, Count Tiepolo offers him a deal ...
cast: Tomas Milian, Pierre Clementi, Katia Christine, Luigi Casellato, Marisa Bartoli

title: La viuda negra
synopsis: In a Mexican town, the Orphan Matea (Isela Vega) helps the parish priest, Father Feliciano (Mario Almada). After refusing the advances of the Pueblo doctor (Sergio Jiménez), he begins to spread the voice on the existence of a relationship between the woman and the priest. The population is disdained that he leaves that he leaves, but the priest hides it and the two begin an open relationship.
cast: Isela Vega, Mário Almada, Sergio Jimenez, Hilda Aguirre, Juan Ángel Martínez, Ana Ofelia Murguía, Leonor Llausás, René Casados, Eduardo Alcaraz, Veronica Arteaga, Victoria Arteaga, Jorge Fegán, Beatriz Marín

title: La vocation suspendue
synopsis: An abbot experiences his vocational choice with difficulty due to some theological disputes, such as that between Jesuits and followers of the Virgin.
cast: Didier Flamand, Pascal Bonitzer, François Simon, Edith Scob

title: La voce - Il talento può uccidere
synopsis: A very skilled but somewhat problematic imitator is exploited by the Italian secret services to make telephone calls with the voice of a minister who died of a heart attack. After a perfect first phone call, others will follow more and more compromising and dangerous that lead the way to an inevitable and tragic ending.
cast: Rocco Papaleo, Antonia Liskova, Augusto Zucchi, Giulia Greco, Franco Castellano, Mattia Sbragia, Augusto Fornari, Riccardo Polizzi

title: La voce - Infanzia e giovinezza di Madre Teresa di Calcutta
synopsis: Teresa, aka Agnese Gonxha of Bjoaxhiu, was born in 1910 and lived through one of the most dramatic eras in the history of humanity, passing through the First World War, which barely touched her, and then above all for the subsequent great world catastrophe. After moving to Calcutta, she dedicated herself to assisting the sick and the marginalized.
cast: Marisa Belli, Bekim Fehmiu, Margaret Mazzantini, Rossano Brazzi

title: La voce Stratos
synopsis: Thirty years have passed since his death, but the voice of Demetrio Stratos continues to arouse enthusiasm and emotions. The documentary deals with a multiplicity of themes and levels: a discourse on the voice that also contains a piece of Italian history and customs of the 60s and 70s, a cross with the beat and atmosphere of the late 60s, an encounter with the international artistic avant-gardes of those years and, at the same time, a rediscovery of the Mediterranean cultural and musical tradition, updated and contaminated.

title: La voce del silenzio
synopsis: A group of men meet, as every year, in a convent for a course of spiritual exercises. However, a thief who tries to hide himself in this way from police searches has also sneaked in among them. The defendants all have spiritual problems to solve and each will come to terms with their conscience and their past. Subject by Zavattini, directed by a former master like Pabst. but the result is a squeeze of heavy Catholic ideology.
cast: Aldo Fabrizi, Jean Marais, Paolo Panelli

title: La voce della luna
synopsis: Bassa Padana: the dreamer Ivo Salvini hears the voices from the wells lit by the moon and looks for the ideal woman. He has little adventures with slightly crazy characters, until he meets the former prefect Gonella, who sees conspiracies everywhere. Together they break into a disco, witness the "capture" of the moon on live TV. Only the two of them, out of love or anguish, can "listen" to the silence of the night.
cast: Roberto Benigni, Paolo Villaggio, Nadia Ottaviani, Angelo Orlando

title: La voce di Fantozzi
synopsis: The accountant Ugo Fantozzi, considered the most original mask of post-war Italian culture, is the most famous employee in Italy. He was born in 1967 by the actor Paolo Villaggio, who among radio appearances, books and films, contributed to making him immortal. 50 years after its debut, among others the Nobel Prize winner Dario Fo, the Oscar winner Roberto Benigni, Renzo Arbore, Neri Parenti and the Village itself speak of Fantozzi.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Dario Fo, Roberto Benigni, Renzo Arbore, Neri Parenti, Fabio Volo, Domenico De Masi

title: La voce di Pasolini
synopsis: On the reading of Pasolini's texts by Toni Servillo and Graziella Chiarcossi, the film traces the Italian history of the Pasolini years through archive images, photographs, amateur films, cinema, testimonies on the Porno-Teo-Kolossal project and above all for the voice of the Friulian writer.
cast: Pier Paolo Pasolini, Toni Servillo, Graziella Chiarcossi

title: La voglia matta
synopsis: The Milanese engineer Antonio Berlinghieri is on his way to visit his son at boarding school for the weekend. Along the way he meets a group of boys heading to the sea, who first target him with their jokes and then invite him to spend Sunday together. Antonio accepts and ends up falling in love with a sixteen year old. But Sunday soon ends, and with her the last illusion of youth. It is the film with which Salce made his debut in the comedy of manners. Tognazzi is perfectly in part; the very young Spaak, in her role of impossible prey, is all pepper. Although not among the best Italian comedies of the period (the description of the young sons of fathers is superficial), it remains very enjoyable and bad, with sincere traces of the air of the time.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Catherine Spaak, Gianni Garko, Franco Giacobini

title: La voglia matta di vivere
synopsis: One hundred years after the birth of Ugo Tognazzi, the whole enlarged family meets to remember films, anecdotes, life, friendships, while in particular Ricky retraces the life path as an actor and as a father.

title: La voie de l‘ennemi
synopsis: After 18 years in prison in New Mexico, William Garnett (Forest Whitaker) has only one thing in mind: to re-enter society and resume a normal life. Emily Smith (Brenda Blethyn), the officer predisposed to his oversight, is at his side to support him but Garnett's past struggles to abandon him. Sheriff Bill Agati (Harvey Keitel) intends to make him pay dearly for the death of his deputy twenty years earlier.
cast: Forest Whitaker, Brenda Blethyn, Harvey Keitel, Luis Guzmán, Ellen Burstyn, Dolores Heredia, Tim Guinee, Sarah Minnich, Michael Stone

title: La voie lactèe
synopsis: Two vagrants (Frankeur and Terzieff) go from France to the sanctuary of Santiago de Compostela, Spain, sent by a strange man in a cape and hat. Between encounters, stories, re-enactments, apparitions and other narrative devices, theirs becomes a journey through twenty centuries of Christianity, of doctrinal conflicts, of disquisitions, of heresies, of anathemas, of miracles, in a curious and unscrupulous assemblage. The "atheist by the grace of God" Buñuel (with the help of Jean-Claude Carrière for the screenplay) offers a very personal reinterpretation of the history of the Church, conducted with witty manipulation of doctrinal sources. A clear and brilliant meta-historical journey, of an old surrealist who has never repented.
cast: Paul Frankeur, Laurent Terzieff, Alain Cuny, Edith Scob, Pierre Clementi

title: La volta buona
synopsis: Bartolomeo is sixty years old and has a career as a sports agent behind him. Life hasn't been too generous with him, the habit of gambling has made him lose money and family and now he gets by as he can, spending his days in the suburbs in search of the new Messi, but luck is certainly not on his side. . Always struggling to stay afloat, one day he receives a phone call, a small sign of destiny, and this is the right time: in Uruguay there is a very young phenomenon, Pablito, who absolutely must come to Italy and break into the world of football. . The meeting between Bartolomeo and Pablito will compare two realities, two stories and two different but similar desperations.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Ramiro Garcia, Max Tortora, Francesco Montanari, Gioia Spaziani, Massimo Wertmüller, Antonio Gerardi, Alessandro Forcinelli

title: La vérité
synopsis: Dominique Marceau is tried for the murder of her lover, Gilbert Tellier, who is engaged to her sister, Annie. The trial is opposed by the thesis of the prosecutor Eparvier, who supports the death penalty, and the defense lawyer Guérin, convinced of the crime of passion. Dominique, subjected to lynching by the jury, retraces all the stages of history.
cast: Marie Jose Nat, Brigitte Bardot, Sami Frey, Paul Meurisse, Charles Vanel

title: La vérité
synopsis: Fabienne is a French film diva who is surrounded by men who love and admire her, from her ex-husband to her agent. When he publishes his memoirs, his daughter Lumir (who moved to the United States to escape from her oppressive mother) returns to France with her family. The meeting between the two women is destined to quickly turn into a clash: untold truths will emerge, unresolved accounts will be settled and love and resentments will be confessed.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Juliette Binoche, Ethan Hawke, Clémentine Grenier, Manon Clavel, Alain Libolt, Christian Crahay, Roger Van Hool, Ludivine Sagnier, Laurent Capelluto, Jackie Berroyer

title: La vérité si je mens !
synopsis: Edouard Vuibert, a man without work and without a family, is "adopted" by a wealthy Jewish merchant who mistakenly mistook him for a "brother". The young man soon became the first right hand man, then the owner of the hut, also because he aims to marry the daughter of his naive pygmalion.
cast: Richard Bohringer, Amira Casar, Richard Anconina, Anthony Delon

title: La vérité sur Bébé Donge
synopsis: Admitted to the clinic, the wealthy businessman François Donge is on the verge of death. According to the "official" version, it would be a food poisoning: but in reality it is his wife Bebe who organized everything ...
cast: Danielle Darrieux, Jean Gabin, Jacques Castelot, Daniel Lecourtois

title: La zia d'America va a sciare
synopsis: Following a financial crisis, the elderly Tecla Cammarano, who had emigrated to America for some time, returns to Italy with her two granddaughters, pretty marriageable girls. The secret purpose of the trip is to get the girls to marry some rich scion and, to this end, Tecla settles in a ski resort frequented by high bourgeois.
cast: Tina Pica, Franca Rame, Virgilio Riento, Bice Valori, Isabella Biagini

title: La zuppa del demonio
synopsis: A look at the great themes that characterized the industrial development of the twentieth century: from the great works of the 1910s to the race to electrification for the development of large-scale industry, fascism and FIAT's war production, post-war reconstruction and development of new industries in the 1950s, the city in the factory and the Piedmontese FIAT and Olivetti models, the search for new energy sources in Italy and abroad in the 1960s up to pioneering in the field of information technology and nuclear power.

title: La Última Fiesta
synopsis: Three best buddies are thrown into a wild chase for a priceless painting that was stolen from a house they used to throw a huge party.
cast: Nicolás Vázquez, Alan Sabbagh, Benjamín Amadeo, Eva De Dominici, César Bordón, Julian Kartun, Paula Carruega, Luciano Rossi, Ezequiel Campa

title: La última muerte
synopsis: As a storm approaches, Jaime takes refuge in his hut when he discovers an injured and unconscious young man. An intern in a hospital, Jaime realizes that the boy suffers from amnesia and, after doing some research, realizes that his identity does not appear in any world database. This alerts the authorities, who immediately begin to persecute them. In an attempt to help the unfortunate, Jaime will not realize what dangers he will expose his family and friends to.
cast: Kuno Becker, Alvaro Guerrero, Carlos Bracho, Claudette Maillé, Alexandra De La Mora, Manolo Cardona, Carlos Kaspar, Kendra Santacruz, Julian Sedgwick, Guillermo Larrea

title: La última señora Anderson
synopsis: Under a false identity, the sister of one of Arthur Anderson's three wives, who died under unclear circumstances, approaches the widower to find out the truth, while the police also investigate. International dtile thriller shot with discreet professionalism by the Spaniard Martin, horror specialist.
cast: Carroll Baker, Michael Craig, Marina Malfatti, Enzo Garinei, Miranda Campa, José Luis López Vazquez, Phillip Ross, Alberto Fernández, Manuel Gallardo

title: La última tarde
synopsis: After 19 years without seeing each other, a former couple of radical leftist militants meet to finalize the divorce proceedings. Among the memories of a past in which they shared love and politics, they end up confessing their secrets to discover how much the situation in which their country finds itself and the ideals in which they believe still have a weight in their lives.
cast: Katerina D'Onofrio, Lucho Cáceres

title: Laaga Chunari Mein Daag - Journey of A Woman
Laaga chunari mein daag
synopsis: The beautiful Vibha decides to move to Mumbai to find work and help her family. A friend convinces her that it will not be difficult to work in the world of cinema: illusions, however, do not take long to reveal themselves as such, and the only solution that lies ahead is to become a luxury prostitute. Built an alternative identity kept secret from all, within a few months she established herself as one of the most sought after and paid escorts in the city. Business is good, but the guilt is great: things go downhill when a sister of Vibha also arrives in Mumbai to study and discover the truth ...
cast: Rani Mukherjee, Abhishek Bachchan, Konkona Sen Sharma, Jaya Bhaduri, Kunal Kapoor, Anupam Kher, Hema Malini, Bharati Achrekar, Tinnu Anand, Harsh Chhaya

title: Laal Rang
synopsis: Eager for cash, Rajesh joins his friend Shankar's blood-theft operation. As Rajesh's greed grows and the cops close in, Shankar is poised to explode.
cast: Randeep Hooda, Piaa Bajpai, Jaihind Kumar, Akshay Oberoi, Rajneesh Duggal, Ashutosh Kaushik, Meenakshi Dixit, Shreya Narayan, Rajendra Sethi

title: Laatu
