synopsis: A man who hopes to bring light to his village must compete with an officer from the electricity department to win over the love of his life.
cast: Gagan Kokri, Aditi Sharma, Karamjit Anmol, Sardar Sohi, Anita Devgan, Ashish Duggal, Nisha Bano, Harby Sangha, Rahul Jungral, Prakash Gadhu

title: Laavor et hakim
synopsis: Michal is 32 years old. For twelve years she has embraced faith in God and is now getting married. A month before the big event, during the wedding preparations, the groom-to-be confesses that he is not in love with her. Michal is upset but for no reason wants to go back to the single life, full of dating and disappointments. On the contrary, she sees this as an opportunity for change and believes she will be helped by God who is good and sweet. She has one month to test her faith and fulfill her dream of getting married.
cast: Noa Koler, Amos Tamam, Oz Zehavi, Irit Sheleg, Roni Merhavi, Dafi Alpern, Oded Leopold, Udi Pers, Jonathan Rozen

title: Labbra di lurido blu
synopsis: The nymphomaniac Ely and the homosexual Marco are two people deeply disturbed by childhood trauma. They decide to get married, perhaps to find together a way out of their problems and support each other. The marriage, however, does not resolve their traumas, nor does the unexpected return of George, an English antiquarian already "friend" of Marco, who is now struggling to snatch him from Ely, facilitate them.
cast: Lisa Gastoni, Corrado Pani, Jeremy Kemp, Hélène Chanel, Silvano Tranquilli, Antonio Casale, Daniela Halbritter, Gino Santercole, Margareta Veroni, Giulio Baraghini

title: Labbra rosse
synopsis: The teenage daughter of a serious family man goes missing on a trip. The parent starts looking for her in the youth circles frequented by the girl. It is a world absolutely unknown to him made of unscrupulousness and even a pinch of madness. Accompanying him in what for him is a real "descent into hell" is a friend of his daughter whose man ends up falling in love ...
cast: Gabriele Ferzetti, Jeanne Valerie, Christine Kaufman, Giorgio Albertazzi

title: Laberinto de pasiones
synopsis: Sexilia, the daughter of a gynecologist who specializes in artificial insemination, goes to the analyst because she is a bit of a nymphomaniac. Riza Niro, son of the former emperor of Tiran, pursued by the empress Toraya, has a gay history with Sadec. The laundry girl, systematically raped by her father, swaps places with Sexilia to everyone's satisfaction. Eventually Riza and Sexilia flee to Contadora. If you think the plot is vulgar, then you haven't heard the song, sung by the director himself, "Suck It to Me". It is Almodóvar's second film and belongs to the happy period when he didn't know how to make movies, but he was absolutely crazy.
cast: Imanol Arias, Cecilia Roth, Antonio Banderas, Helga Liné, Marta Fernández Muro, Fernando Vivanco, Ofelia Angélica, Ángel Alcázar, Concha Grégori, Cristina Sanchez Pascual

title: Labor Day
synopsis: Thirteen-year-old Henry (Gattlin Griffith) is the little man of the Wheeler household. As he struggles every day with the turmoil of adolescence, Henry goes to great lengths to take care of his mother Adele (Kate Winslet) and not make her feel the absence of her father. One day, on their way home, Henry and Adele run into Frank Chambers (Josh Brolin), a menacing-looking but in need of help, who convinces them to welcome him into their home. Mother and son ignore that Frank is a fugitive and are preparing for a long weekend for Labor Day with him, during which the lives of the three will change forever.
cast: Kate Winslet, Josh Brolin, Tobey Maguire, Gattlin Griffith, Dylan Minnette, James Van Der Beek, Clark Gregg, Maika Monroe, Brooke Smith, Elena Kampouris, Tom Lipinski, Sarah Fischer, Alexie Gilmore

title: Labor Pains
synopsis: Thea works as a secretary at a publishing house and, despite a domineering boss, is doing everything to keep her job tight, which allows her to help her sister get to college. Threatened to lose her job, she invents on the spot that she is pregnant, to the astonishment of the whole office; Forced to carry on her fiction, Thea embarks on a series of unlikely gimmicks to simulate the progress of her pregnancy ...
cast: Lindsay Lohan, Luke Kirby, Chris Parnell, Aaron Yoo, Bridgit Mendler, Tracee Ellis Ross, Kevin Covais, Bonnie Somerville, Cheryl Hines, Creed Bratton

title: Labor of Love: the Arlette Schweitzer Story
synopsis: Christa Schweitzer is fifteen when, thanks to a gynecological examination, she discovers that she was born without a womb. The little girl is upset, but finds the comfort of her mother Arlette (Jillian) who promises her that one day she will help her. Years pass, Christa gets married and the day arrives: Arlette will carry Christa's son in her womb, but to do so she will have to overcome many more obstacles than expected. There is one thing that differentiates this film from the usual, dull drama TV-movies: screenwriter Susan Baskin has the good idea of ??not letting the two leading women lose their sense of humor. And it is not cheap.
cast: Ann Jillian, Tracey Gold, Bill Smitrovich, Donald Logue

title: Laboratorio teatrale di Luca Ronconi
synopsis: In Prato, rehearsals are held for the theatrical staging of Pier Paolo Pasolini's Calderon according to Luca Ronconi, who exposes - together with other collaborators - the reasons and choices of direction for Pasolini's text centered on bourgeois power.
cast: Luca Ronconi, Miriam Acevedo, Marisa Fabbri, Antonello Fassari, Tullio Valli, Gabriella Zamparini, Gae Aulenti, Ugo Tessitore

title: Labou
synopsis: Fed up of being bullied at school, Toddster, Emily and Gavin try to prove their courage by searching for the legendary treasure of the pirate Lerogue, whose ship sank in the Louisiana bay after a hurricane. Struggling with the ghost of the pirate and with a small and curious creature, the three friends will end up joining forces against the oil tycoons, who for profit aim to destroy the swamps in the area.
cast: Bryan James Kitto, Darnell Hamilton, Marissa Cuevas, Rose Magri, Eric Pollard, Bud Richardson, Copely Davis, Elizabeth Coulon, Barnie Duncan, Dylan Kippes

title: Labyrinth
synopsis: In Jim Henson's fantasy, teen Sarah embarks on a life-altering quest to rescue her little brother from the clutches of a treacherous goblin.
cast: David Bowie, Jennifer Connelly, Frank Oz, Kevin Clash, Anthony Asbury, Dave Goelz, Brian Henson, Ron Mueck, Karen Prell, Shari Weiser

synopsis: Three young people travel back in time to the moment they were in a movie theater just before closing time. They will thus witness the terrible last days of the Japanese feudal era, the drama of the front in China and the atomic bombing of Hiroshima on August 6, 1945.

Her killer, arrested at the crime scene, is a 25-year-old practicing Jew. The investigation of the murder soon reveals a dark and frightened world, in which the attack has matured, fueled by hysterical rhetoric, paranoia and political intrigue.
cast: Yaël Abecassis, Yogev Yefet, Miki Varshaviak, Mali Levy, Liron Levo, Tomer Sisley

title: Le Deuxième Souffle
synopsis: Criminal Gu Minda escapes from prison. Meanwhile, his former cronies wage gang war in Marseille to gain control of the local cigarette smuggling. Commissioner Blot, who follows the case, tries to frame Gu, who is preparing the expatriation together with his friend Manouche. First, however, he participates in a robbery that ends in carnage. Blot frames him and passes him off as an informant. The moment of reckoning comes.
cast: Lino Ventura, Paul Meurisse, Raymond Pellegrin, Marcel Bozzuffi

title: Le Diable et les dix commandements
synopsis: Seven episodes to illustrate the Ten Commandments. In the first, two religious confide their youthful adventures. In the second, the husband of a stripper rediscovers his wife's beauty. In the third, a young man is looking for his real mother. In the fourth a madman believes himself to be God. In the fifth a woman becomes the lover of her best friend's husband. In the sixth, a seminarian lets himself be killed by a trafficker to have him sentenced to death. In the seventh, a bank employee tries alone to recover the stolen stolen goods.
cast: Françoise Arnoul, Charles Aznavour, Fernandel, Louis De Funès, Alain Delon, Lino Ventura, Micheline Presle, Michel Simon, Danielle Darrieux

title: Le Discours
synopsis: Adrien is thirty -five years old and is in the middle of the middle -aged crisis. Embarrassing and hypochondriac, one evening takes part in a family dinner that seems endless and, as if that were not enough, his girlfriend wants to break with him. In addition, the future brother -in -law asks him to prepare a speech for the imminent marriage. Could you go even worse?
cast: Benjamin Lavernhe, Sara Giraudeau, Kyan Khojandi, Julia Piaton, François Morel, Guilaine Londez, Sébastien Chassagne, Sarah Suco

title: Le Divorce
synopsis: Isabel comes from California to Paris to help her half-sister Roxeanne in her eighth month of pregnancy. But, shortly after her arrival, the woman is left by Charles-Henri, a painter husband who prefers a Russian dancer to her. Meanwhile, Isabel embarks on a relationship with a man much more mature than her.
cast: Naomi Watts, Kate Hudson, Melvil Poupaud, Leslie Caron, Thierry Lhermitte

title: Le Doulos
synopsis: Maur, just released from prison, kills Gilbert who killed his friend. Then, at the home of his mistress Thérèse, he plans, with his friend Silien, a robbery which, however, fails. Maur is now suspicious of Silien, especially after Thérèse was killed. Arrested, Maur will discover the truth only when he is released from prison: too late because an unstoppable mechanism of death has now been triggered.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Serge Reggiani, Jean Desailly, Fabienne Dali

title: Le Démantèlement
synopsis: Gaby has a farm where she raises lambs and is the father of two adult daughters, who she raised as princesses and who live in a distant big city. When the eldest daughter asks him to help her financially to avoid losing her home, Gaby - whose paternity feeling has grown to the edge of madness - decides to dismantle her business and, selling everything, goes to live in a small apartment in a nearby town.
cast: Gabriel Arcand, Gilles Renaud, Lucie Laurier, Johanne Marie Tremblay, Sophie Desmarais, Dominique Leduc

title: Le Eumenidi
synopsis: The film is titled as the third tragedy of Orestea; narrates the persecution of the Erinyes against Orestes up to the trial against him, which culminates with his acquittal thanks to the vote of Athena. The story revolves around the last night of a Roman upper-class boy: after committing a crime, he wanders aimlessly, escapes from invisible demons, awaiting judgment.
cast: Valerio Santucci, Gian Marco Ceccaranelli, Matteo Tomassini, Mattia Vita, Benedetta Fasano, Marco Santucci, Maurizio Marchetti

title: Le Fantôme de Canterville
synopsis: Against the backdrop of legendary Brittany, the ghost of Aliénor de Canterville is doomed to haunt the family castle and frighten all new residents. Aliénor fulfills her duty perfectly, aided by the faithful servant Gwilherm. But when the Parisians Otis buy the residence, it will not be easy for Aliénor to confront a family of the 21st century. Only 15-year-old Virginia will find a way to break her curse.
cast: Audrey Fleurot, Michaël Youn, Michele Laroque, Lionnel Astier, Julien Frison, Mathilde Daffe

title: Le Fidèle
synopsis: When they meet on the track, between the gangster Gino and the indomitable driver Benedicte it is love at first sight. Proud and loyal, the two fight for their love against destiny but also against reason and their own weaknesses. How far can they resist? How far can they go to save what may already be lost?
cast: Matthias Schoenaerts, Adèle Exarchopoulos, Jean Benoît Ugeux, Kerem Can, Sam Louwyck, Stefaan Degand, Corentin Lobet, Igor Van Dessel

title: Le Franc
synopsis: A somewhat eccentric character, half clown and half poet, to make ends meet, he lives for the day by giving alms and playing his congoma on the streets of the city. One day luck smiles at him. He wins a large sum in the lottery but paradoxically cannot collect anything, because his winning ticket has been attached to the door so well that he cannot detach it without risking tearing it. So the man takes the door on his shoulders and starts walking around the city. He crosses a Dakar choked with garbage and debris to reach the sea, where he hopes to be able to dissolve the glue with salt water.
cast: Dieye Ma Dieye, Aminta Fall, Demba Bâ

title: Le Gang
synopsis: After the Second World War, the son of a famous gangster from the 1930s decides to follow in his father's footsteps. Recruit some trusted accomplice and set up a gang specializing in robberies. "The gang" has a characteristic: it steals but with kindness, without unnecessary bloodshed, following the code of honor of the underworld of the past. In any case, the police are hardly moved ...
cast: Alain Delon, Raymond Bussières, Laura Betti, Xavier Depraz

title: Le Garçu
synopsis: Antoine, son of Sophie and the "big Gégé", lives with his mother in Paris, where his father also lives but with occasional presence in the apartment. Because Gégé is not exactly a model of marital fidelity, he keeps up stories with other women and, as for his son, tries to make friends with him with more or less clumsy initiatives. Gégé's father dies ("le garçu" is the dialectal voice for "le garçon") ... A very human father-son relationship (also because it is very "messed up"), with a Depardieu who finds the "feeling" with the its director Pialat (of which the small, spontaneous Antoine is the son).
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Géraldine Pailhas, Antoine Pialat, Dominique Rocheteau

title: Le Grand Bal
synopsis: For over 27 years, in the month of July, in the countryside of the Borbonese, people have been dancing for seven days and seven nights, whether it rains or is sunny. More than two thousand people of all ages, from the youngest to the 80s, gather from all over the world to dance, laugh, cry, play and live.

title: Le Grand Bleu
synopsis: Jacques and Enzo spent their childhood diving in the Mediterranean. The death of Jacques' father, an expert diver, ends their friendship. Years pass: Jacques, following an expedition to Peru, agrees to immerse himself in the waters of a frozen lake to allow scientists to collect data on his physical condition; for his part, Enzo has become a champion of freediving. Soon the paths of the two will cross again ...
cast: Paul Shenar, Jean Bouise, Rosanna Arquette, Jean Reno, Jean Marc Barr

title: Le Grand Jeu
cast: Marie Bell, Pierre Richard Willm, Françoise Rosay, Charles Vanel

title: Le Grand Restaurant
synopsis: The president of the United States disappears while having lunch in a luxury restaurant in Paris: the manager of the restaurant, Monsieur Septime, will have to extricate himself from policemen, secret agents and political opponents who believe him responsible for the kidnapping ...
cast: Louis De Funès, Bernard Blier, Maria Rosa Rodriguez, Venantino Venantini

title: Le Grand partage
synopsis: During a harsher than usual winter, the French government issues a decree to ask the luckiest citizens to welcome their fellow citizens in precarious circumstances into their homes. This will bring panic to every floor of a luxurious building in the capital.
cast: Karin Viard, Didier Bourdon, Valérie Bonneton, Michel Vuillermoz, Josiane Balasko, Patrick Chesnais, Sandra Zidani, Anémone, Jackie Berroyer, Firmine Richard, Priscilla Adade

title: Le Guetteur
synopsis: Inspector Mattei (Daniel Auteuil) is on the trail of the members of a band of robbers, who have become sadly famous for the violence with which they land their shots and for being helped by a mysterious sniper. Vincent (Mathieu Kassovitz), the leader of the gang and the sniper, is arrested by the police following an anonymous report. However, he manages to escape from prison and from that moment on he will not rest until he finds out the identity of the partner who betrayed him.
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz, Olivier Gourmet, Francis Renaud, Nicolas Briançon, Violante Placido, Luca Argentero, Arly Jover, Christian Hecq, Michele Placido, Hocine Choutri, Géraldine Martineau, Flavien Tassart

title: Le Guide de la famille parfaite
synopsis: Do we live in a society where parents pay too much attention to their children? This is the question posed by a couple from Quebec, staging with irony the difficulty and complexity of growing up in a society aimed at "ultra performance", fed by parents who want only the best for their children, but who like this they end up suffocating them.
cast: Emilie Bierre, Louis Morissette, Holden Wong, Louise Portal, Thomas Vallieres, Catherine Chabot, Fayçal Azzouz, Gilles Renaud, Frank Marrs, Jean Carl Boucher

title: Le Havre
synopsis: Marcel Marx, a shoemaker from Le Havre, spends a modest but peaceful existence alongside his wife. He does not know, however, that the woman is harboring a serious disease that she has hidden from him up to that moment. When the woman realizes she can no longer lie, the blow is very hard for Marcel. Thus, while he is wandering upset through the port of Le Havre, he meets an African boy, an illegal immigrant who is threatened to be expelled at any moment. Marcel becomes attached to the boy and thus takes it into his head to protect him.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Kati Outinen, Jean Pierre Darroussin, André Wilms, Elina Salo, Evelyne Didi, Blondin Miguel

title: Le Hussard sur le toit
synopsis: France 1832. After the Napoleonic wars and the revolutionary uprisings of 1820-21, we are in full restoration. Provence has become a land of asylum for the Piedmontese Carbonari, hunted by the Austrian police and decimated by a cholera epidemic. The brave rebel Angelo Pardo renounces the escape to help his companions, and during the fight against enemies and illness he meets the young aristocrat Pauline. It is love immediately, but the woman, married and in search of her missing husband, will not immediately succumb to passion. Loosely based on the novel by Jean Giono, "The hussar on the roof" confirms Rappenau's profession. Beautiful costumes, unforgettable Provencal landscapes, rhythm, spectacularity and historical facts as the setting for a poignant story of love and heroism. La Binoche is intense and measured; the sex symbol Martinez is as dark as befits a romantic hero.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Olivier Martinez, Claudio Amendola

title: Le Joli Mai
synopsis: Images and interviews with ordinary people on the streets of France in May 1962, just after the Algerian war.
cast: Chris Marker, Yves Montand, Simone Signoret

title: Le Jour se Lève
synopsis: Paris, 1930s. François, a quiet and honest worker, falls madly in love with a young flower girl to the point of killing Valentin, the man who has long haunted her. After the murder, François barricades himself at home, surrounded by the police forces, and spends the whole night thinking about the events that led to this dramatic circumstance. In this way, his entire past life flows slowly.
cast: Jean Gabin, Jules Berry, Arletty, Mady Berry, René Génin, Jacqueline Laurent, Bernard Blier, Arthur Devère, René Bergeron

title: Le Journal d'une femme en blanc
cast: Maria José Nat, Jean Valmont, Claude Gensac, Robert Benoît

title: Le Jun Kai
synopsis: Le Jun Kai is a man who lives his life trying to foster a hatred for his enemy and devising ways to seek revenge for his former lover and unborn child. He decides to marry his enemy's daughter, Le Yi, and then proceeds to mistreat her and make her life as miserable as possible, but yet she bears this without retaliation. A problem arises, when Le Jun Kai begins to realize he might have feelings for Le Ye Zi. (Source: IMDB, MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the short story "Le Jun Kai" (乐俊凯) by Fei Wo Si Cun (匪我思存).
tags: Abusive Male Lead, Revenge, Web Series, Antihero, Obsessive Male Lead, Possessive Male Lead, Unexpected Pregnancy, Flashback To Past, Meet Again, Enemies To Lovers
cast: Peter Ho, Janine Chang

title: Le K Benzema
synopsis: After a blackmailing scandal and being sidelined from the French national team, Real Madrid forward Karim Benzema tells his side of the story.
cast: Karim Benzema

title: Le Livre d'Image
synopsis: Nothing but silence. Nothing but a revolutionary song. A story in five chapters like the five fingers of a hand.

title: Le Louvre sous l'Occupation
synopsis: Through the story of two extraordinary men - Jacques Jaujard (director of the National Museums during the Second World War) and Count Franz Wolff-Metternich (responsible from 1940 to 1942 for the conservation of the artistic heritage) - we tell of the anomalous collaboration between two enemies but collaborators called to preserve the treasures of the Louvre and many of the works stolen from the Jews by the Nazi madness. Their story is also the background to a reflection on the relationship between art and power, on the museum as a vital place for civilizations and on the language of art itself.
cast: Louis Do De Lencquesaing, Benjamin Utzerath, Vincent Nemeth, Johanna Korthals Altes, Andrey Chelpanov, Jean Claude Caer

title: Le Maestro
synopsis: Alone, a man stubbornly dedicates himself to a mission of universal significance: to search for, track down and perform every piece of music composed in the concentration camps of the Second World War. This is Francesco Lotoro, a pianist and composer from Barletta who, guided by his intuition and the clues collected, sets out on journeys whose outcome he never knows in advance, alternating surprises with disappointments, discoveries and intense encounters. From the flea market in Prague to the archives of the fields, in the attics of the composers' heirs and within the collections of museums, crossing Europe, America and the East, its purpose is to recover and archive a heritage of humanity forgotten for 70 years.

title: Le Mans
synopsis: Michael arrives in Le Mans to participate in the 24 Hours, one of the most treacherous and grueling car races. His desire to compete in a good race is held back by the fact that Belgetti's widow is in the audience, a driver who died the previous year on the same track following an accident in which he was involved. The race begins and Delaney immediately takes the lead, but another accident seems to compromise his race.
cast: Steve McQueen, Elga Andersen, Siegfried Rauch, Ronald Leigh Hunt

title: Le Mans - Scorciatoia per l'inferno
synopsis: The car champion John Scott after an accident with many victims at Le Mans no longer races but raises other drivers and becomes a manufacturer. His protégé, Dustin Rich, looks promising, but also tries to replace him in his wife's heart. When Dustin wins a car built by John, everything will work out for the best. Trivial copying of films that are "American" by definition (in the sense that they know how to make them and the others don't): weak in suspense, modestly spectacular, almost childish in the definition of the characters. More than a sprint film, a film that runs on charcoal.
cast: Lang Jeffries, Erna Schurer, Maurizio Bonuglia, Edwige Fenech, Franco Borelli, Roberto Messina, Franco Pesce, Paola Iacopucci, Marcello Di Paolo

title: Le Mataf
synopsis: Three crime professionals Frank, Bernard and Basilio are mocked by a mysterious gang as they try to secure the loot deposited on the Trans Europa Express. A few months pass and the three realize that they have been filmed while they were scoring the blow. The soul of the blackmail is the lawyer De Borde, who wants to force them to attempt the theft of a precious microfilm containing the secrets of a shipyard. The three are forced to accept.
cast: Michel Constantin, Adolfo Celi, Georges Géret, Annie Cordy

title: Le Million
synopsis: A penniless Parisian painter has forgotten a lottery ticket in his vest sold to a second-hand dealer. Now that ticket is worth a million: thus begins a frantic ticket hunt that will end happily. A sort of light and fun Parisian musical, shot in the early years of sound making the most of the potential of the new technique.
cast: René Lefèvre, Annabella, Paul Olivier

title: Le Miroir à deux faces
synopsis: Pierre, an elderly high school teacher, meets Marie José, thanks to an advertisement in a newspaper, a woman with a deformed and ridiculous nose. Despite this physical defect Pierre convinces the woman to marry him. Due to a car accident, Pierre is forced to spend a long period in the clinic of Dr. Bosc, a well-known cosmetic surgeon. Unbeknownst to her husband, Marie undergoes the operation. The sudden and unexpected transformation provokes a blind grudge in Pierre. The man no longer wants to live with a woman who is totally different from the one he had chosen and separates.
cast: Michèle Morgan, Bourvil, Ivan Desny, Georgette Anys, Candida

title: Le Mémoire du Sang
synopsis: Henry is a legendary hitman who lives in a secluded cabin near a lake in the Canadian wilderness. When his loneliness is cut short by the arrival of a young woman who survived a serious snowmobile accident, Henry must decide whether to risk his life to save the stranger's.
cast: Jean Reno, Joe Anderson, Sarah Lind, Anna Butkevych, Robert Feldman, Kateryna Bursikova

title: Le Notti Bianche
synopsis: Mario meets Natalia who, like every evening, is waiting to meet a man she is madly in love with. It seems that a feeling must arise between the two, when the stranger really appears.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Maria Schell, Jean Marais, Clara Calamai

title: Le Pacha
synopsis: After forty years of service, Police Commissioner Joss is on the verge of retirement. In the course of a colossal jewelry theft, followed by a carnage, an elderly inspector, his great friend, is also killed. The commissioner then forgets the professional ethics and turns into a ruthless avenger.
cast: Jean Gabin, Dany Carrel, Jean Gaven, André Pousse, Louis Arbessier, Gérard Buhr, Robert Dalban, Maurice Garrel

title: Le Passé
synopsis: Married, Iranian Ahmad (Ali Assafa) and Frenchwoman Marie (Bérénice Bejo) have an unstable and problematic life. Tired of the clashes with his wife, Ahmad decides one day to leave her to return to his native Iran. Some time later, Marie meets a new love (Tahar Rahim) and, after deciding to stay with him, she writes to her husband asking for a divorce. At his request, Ahmad returns to France after four years of absence and discovers that Marie has a bad relationship with her daughter Lucie. Efforts to improve the bond between the two will, however, reveal a secret from the past.
cast: Bérénice Bejo, Tahar Rahim, Ali Mosaffa, Pauline Burlet, Elyes Aguis, Jeanne Jestin, Sabrina Ouazani, Babak Karimi, Valeria Cavalli

title: Le Petit Prince
synopsis: A little girl, prepared by her mother for the adult world, befriends the eccentric Aviator, her neighbor with a heart of gold. The Aviator will take her to an extraordinary universe, where anything is possible and which was shown to him long ago by the Little Prince. Thanks to the magical and exciting journey she will experience, the little girl will rediscover her childhood and what matters most in life.

title: Le Peuple Loup
synopsis: In 17th-century Ireland, County Kilkenny falls to English settlers after a bloody siege. On Oliver Cromwell's orders, young apprentice huntress Robyn Goodfellowe and her father Bill arrive from England to track down and kill the last of the wolves living in the Irish woods. Adventurous and rebellious, Robyn sneaks into the forest and discovers a world quite different from the one known to date. He thus has the opportunity to meet Mebh, a wild girl raised by wolves, and to befriend her. He will then understand how the real enemy is different from what he believed.

title: Le Plaisir
synopsis: The sufferings of the wife of a viveur who hid advanced age under a mask in order to obtain more love conquests. Madame Tellier's "house" closes one day to allow guests to attend a first communion: sacred and profane. A model attempts suicide after she is planted by her painter lover; he will marry the woman now immobilized forever in a wheelchair. Three short stories by Maupassant adapted by the great Ophüls. Superb mastery of narrative virtuosity (with the best of the French cinematic firmament of the time in the cast) in a masterful balance of refined lyricism and controlled, but caustic irony. When cinema is a pleasure.
cast: Gaby Morlay, Madeleine Renaud, Jean Gabin, Daniel Gélin

title: Le Pont du Nord
synopsis: As soon as she gets out of prison, Marie travels to Paris in a truck. In the city she meets Baptiste, a sort of guide who transports her through the streets of the capital. Marie's boyfriend Julien appears and disappears to the woman as if he were a ghost. In the latter's purse, stolen by Baptiste, there are mysterious documents relating to political murders and various public scandals. The two women find on the body of a corpse a map of Paris on which various points are indicated. A game of goose in which the two women participate ...
cast: Bulle Ogier, Pascale Ogier, Pierre Clementi, Jean François Stévenin, Benjamin Baltimore, Steve Baës, Joe Dann, Mathieu Schiffman, Antoine Gurevitch, Julien Lidsky

title: Le Poulpe
synopsis: Investigator without masters or customers to whom to realize, Gabriel Lecouvreur (Jean-Pierre Darroussin), called "Le Poulpe" because of his long arms, is on the trail of a killer who puts rubber masks with his victims. The investigation reaches a deadly point (literally) and Gabriel, persuaded by the irresistible companion Chéryl (Clotilde Couurau), part for Morsang, where the tombs of her grandparents have been uncovered and sacked. But, arrived at the place, the two soon realize that in addition to the desecration of the sepulchres there are many other cats to peel. For "Le Poulpe" it is the beginning of a new and daring adventure.
cast: Jean Pierre Darroussin, Clotilde Courau, Stéphane Boucher, Julie Delarme, Aristide Demonico, James Faulkner, Jean François Gallotte, Nicolas Jouhet, François Levantal, Bruno Lochet

title: Le Premier cri
synopsis: Docu-fiction on the path of birth - from gestation to childbirth - in the various cultures of the world.

title: Le Père Noël
synopsis: On Christmas Eve, Antoine, a six-year-old boy, has only one thing on his mind: meet Santa and take a ride in his sleigh. So when someone magically swoops on his balcony, Antoine is amazed to have an anomalous Santa Claus in front of him, that is, a masked thief who steals jewels from uptown apartments. Despite all the efforts to get rid of Antoine, the alleged Santa Claus will form an unlikely duo with him for a walk on the rooftops of Paris.
cast: Tahar Rahim, Victor Cabal, Annelise Hesme, Michaël Abiteboul, Philippe Rebbot, Amélie Glenn

title: Le Rat d'Amérique
synopsis: Carlo, who is experiencing an economic crisis, emigrates to Paraguay. He soon realizes that it will be difficult to overcome misery in that country too: he decides to engage in smuggling, but it goes badly to the point that in order not to end up in jail he has to reach Chile ...
cast: Charles Aznavour, Franco Fabrizi, Marie Laforêt

title: Le Redoutable
synopsis: Paris, 1967. Jean-Luc Godard, director of the nouvelle vague, is shooting The Chinese with the woman he loves, Anne Wiazemsky, twenty years younger. Happy, charming and in love, the two get married but the welcome given to the film by the critics triggers a profound examination of conscience in Godard. The events of May 1968 will amplify his doubts, giving rise to a crisis of conscience that will shake the director and his convictions.
cast: Stacy Martin, Louis Garrel, Bérénice Bejo, Grégory Gadebois, Micha Lescot

title: Le Renard et l'enfant
synopsis: On an autumn day, a little girl living in the mountains of eastern France encounters a fox as she travels through the forest. The animal runs away, but from that moment the girl will spend as much time as possible in the forest looking for the creature that hit her.
cast: Bertille Noël Bruneau, Isabelle Carré, Thomas Laliberté

title: Le Rendez-vous
synopsis: Pierre Larivière - writer divorced from Madeleine, with whom he had a son - has remarried to Edith, daughter of the oil tycoon Kellerman. The latter's other daughter, Daphne, has entered into a relationship with photographer Daniel, who is also Madeleine's lover. When Daniel is found murdered, Kellerman demands that Pierre create an alibi for Daphne, who had actually been with Daniel that night but claims she is innocent. Pierre accepts, but in doing so he compromises Madeleine, who was with him on the fateful night ...
cast: Philippe Noiret, Annie Girardot, Michel Piccoli, George Sanders

title: Le Roi des Ombres
synopsis: After the death of the father, two half brothers find themselves against each other in a conflict that could destroy everything and have tragic consequences.
cast: Kaaris, Alassane Diong, Carl Malapa, Assa Sylla, Issaka Sawadogo, Hassam Ghancy, Mareme N'Diaye, Tatiana Rojo, Jonas Dinal, Mylène Wagram, Josée Schuller, Aksel Ustun, Fahmi Guerbaa, Thibault Cathalifaud, Anas Mennou, Edea Darcque, Hadidiatou Sakho, Cheikh Oumar Sow

title: Le Samouraï
synopsis: Jeff Costello is a killer who, having carried out the murder commissioned to him, escapes arrest with the help of his lover. His life hangs by a thread, hunted by the police and their principals. Frank decides to take an extreme solution. The original title gives a good idea of ??the film, an intense and bitter meditation on destiny and loneliness. Those of Melville are anti-heroes, his times are meticulous and dilated, his suspense is entirely moral. Delon's unperturbed mask serves the purpose perfectly. A masterpiece of style.
cast: Alain Delon, Nathalie Delon, François Périer, Cathy Rosier, Catherine Jourdan, Jacques Leroy

title: Le Sel des larmes
synopsis: The young provincial Luc goes to Paris to pass an entrance exam in a large school. Here, he meets Djemila, a young worker with whom he has a short fling. Back home to his father, Luc reunites with Geneviève, an old acquaintance with whom he reconnects, but when he decides to move in with her, Djemila arrives. He will thus find himself torn between two passions, the will of his father and his dreams.
cast: Logann Antuofermo, Oulaya Amamra, André Wilms, Louise Chevillotte, Souheila Yacoub, Martin Mesnier, Teddy Chawa, Aline Belibe

title: Le Sens de la fête
synopsis: Max has been in catering for thirty years and is almost at the end of his career when he finds himself taking care of the wedding of Pierre and Héléna in a 17th century castle. As usual, he organized everything: he recruited his brigade of waiters and cooks, recommended a photographer, arranged the floral decorations and booked an orchestra. However, the night of preparations could turn into a disaster due to a series of contingencies.
cast: Jean Pierre Bacri, Jean Paul Rouve, Gilles Lellouche, Vincent Macaigne, Hélène Vincent, Suzanne Clément, Judith Chemla

title: Le Tour du monde en 80 jours
synopsis: Passepartout, a naive but lively pygmal monkey, has always dreamed of leaving for a great adventure. The right opportunity is presented to him thanks to Phileas Frog, explorer and scammer, with his multimilionary bet: to establish the record of the world of the world in 80 days. From the warm deserts to the mysterious jungles, Passepartout will discover when the world is vast, wonderful and crazy.

title: Le Tour, prends garde!
synopsis: During the kingdom of the weak Louis XV the war against Austria burst out. An actor who has distinguished himself for acts of heroism is appointed knight of the king. But a court conspiracy put him as a murderer of a nobleman. The man is forced to escape.
cast: Eleonora Rossi Drago, Jean Marais

title: Le Tout nouveau testament
synopsis: God really exists and is a person like many others who lives in Brussels. Deprived of his divine aura, he is a pathetic and hateful coward with his family. Ea, his daughter, is bored at home and, unable to bear to be shut up in a small and ordinary city apartment, one day decides to rebel against her father, tampering with his computer and revealing her date of death to anyone. In this way it will cause a sudden and total chaos, during which everyone will start thinking about what to do with the days, months and years, that they have to live.
cast: Benoît Poelvoorde, Yolande Moreau, Catherine Deneuve, Pili Groyne, Laura Verlinden, Johan Leysen, Viviane De Muynck, Johan Heldenbergh, François Damiens, Romain Gelin, Marco Lorenzini

title: Le Transporteur - Héritage
synopsis: Frank Maltin, aka 'the Transporter', follows three simple rules: no names, no questions, no renegotiation of the contract. During one of his missions, Frank finds himself embroiled in revenge staged by four young women with nothing to lose. Engaged in a race against time, he will have no choice but to break the rules he had set for himself.
cast: Ed Skrein, Loan Chabanol, Lenn Kudrjawizki, Tatiana Pajkovic, Radivoje Bukvic, Ray Stevenson, Anatole Taubman, Gabriella Wright, Mikael Buxton, Cédric Chevalme, Noémie Lenoir

title: Le Trou
synopsis: Mahu, Roland, Geo, Vasselin and Gaspard, held for common crimes, decide to evade trial by trying to escape. After making a hole in the floor of their cell, the five dig a tunnel that allows them to go outside. From a novel by José Giovani, Becker's latest film, shot with absolute economy of means of expression (the noise of tools digging the hole) and an unsustainable tension from beginning to end. With its interplay of relationships and looks that recall Bresson and anticipate Jean-Pierre Melville, the film is transformed, by virtue of thematic coherence and rigorous staging, into a desperate song of freedom.
cast: Michel Constantin, Jean Kennedy, Philippe Leroy, Raymond Meunier

title: Le Vendeur
synopsis: Marcel Levesque is the best car dealer in his small Canadian country: people trust his advice but for him it seems time for retirement, due to the severe economic crisis that threatens to close the main car factory. In truth, however, Marcel has no intention of leaving his job which, together with his daughter Maryse and his nephew Antoine, is his only reason for living. On a winter's day, François Paradis, a worker who has in mind the purchase of a pick-up truck, appears in front of him, and Marcel will have to deal with an unexpected tragedy and the consequent sense of guilt that will radically change his World vision.
cast: Jean François Boudreau, Jean Robert Bourdage, Nathalie Cavezzali, Pierre Leblanc, Gilbert Sicotte, Jeremy Tessier

title: Le Venerable W.
synopsis: In Burma, the "venerable W." is a respected and influential Buddhist monk. Meeting him, one finds oneself immersed in the heart of racism and observes how Islamophobia and hate speech turn into violence and destruction. Yet, he lives in a country where 90% of the population has adopted the Buddhist religion, founded on a peaceful, tolerant and non-violent lifestyle.

title: Le Voyage de Fanny
synopsis: 1943. Germany is occupying France when 13-year-old Fanny and her little sisters are sent by their parents to a foster home for Jewish children. When the Nazis arrive on Italian territory, the center is forced to organize the departure of the boys for Switzerland. Fanny and her sisters are part of the group of eleven children who must cross the border alone and will do everything to get to their destination and survive.
cast: Léonie Souchaud, Cécile De France, Stéphane De Groodt, Fantine Harduin, Juliane Lepoureau

title: Le Week-End
synopsis: Nick (Jim Broadbent) and Meg (Lindsay Duncan) are a long-married British couple who decide to revisit Paris, for the first time decades after their honeymoon, in an attempt to revitalize their marriage. In the French capital, however, they run into Morgan (Jeff Goldlum), an old friend of Nick, and the meeting offers the couple a new vision of what life and marriage can be.
cast: Jim Broadbent, Lindsay Duncan, Jeff Goldblum, Olly Alexander, Judith Davis

title: Le acrobate
synopsis: The little girl Teresa has lost a tooth and needs a special place to let it rest forever. Southern Maria is turned off by an everyday life marked by dull routine: unknowingly unhappy, potentially capable of climbing mountains. Elena del Nord is a chemist very good at mixing formulas for cosmetics, but undisciplined with her own life (from) separated: a lover without the courage of confrontation, empty like a day spent watching TV. To heal every urgency, it rains from the sky full of rain, Anita: an angel, probably. Soldini's cinema has a steady, cold, lucid gaze. But in this film of suspended and astonished women, the priorities seem to focus on feelings, the ice seems to melt under the blows of scandalous tenderness.
cast: Valeria Golino, Licia Maglietta, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Roberto Citran

title: Le affinità elettive
synopsis: In a villa in the Tuscan countryside, in the Napoleonic era, four people meet: the spouses Edoardo and Carlotta, their friend Ottone and the eighteen-year-old daughter of Carlotta's previous marriage, Ottilia. The initial harmony is shattered when the "elective affinities" begin to act, revealing new attractions and creating unpredictable grooves. Refined, thoughtful, flawless in respect of Goethe's novel, the film is too cold, and does not convey the sense of drama. The operation remains elegant, but useless and inexplicable.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Isabelle Huppert, Jean Hugues Anglade, Marie Gillain

title: Le affinità elettive
synopsis: During the Napoleonic era at the end of the nineteenth century, in a large estate in Tuscany, the barons Edoardo and Carlotta retired to their splendid villa, after the late wedding, which took place following the fortuitous meeting in a museum, which reunited them after years of uncertainty. On the occasion of the arrival of his friend Capitano (friend of Edoardo) and Ottilia (eighteen-year-old goddaughter of Carlotta who grew up in boarding school, shy and without malice) the villa becomes the fulcrum of amorous magnetisms regulated by the laws of nature. The days follow one another calmly with dissertations on "elective affinities" (phenomenon for which in nature some substances are divided in the presence of extraneous elements to create subsequent couplings). It seems that such "elective affinities" also tend to occur among the guests of the villa: Edoardo feels he is attracted by Ottilia's grace, while the Captain has an attraction for the enigmatic Carlotta. Passion takes over and fate gets in the way.
cast: Francesca Archibugi, Nino Castelnuovo, Filippo De Gara, Paolo Graziosi, Veronica Lazar, Lucia Poli

title: Le ali
synopsis: Mogadishu, 2 July 1993: second lieutenant Gianfranco Paglia, a volunteer on a peace mission, miraculously escapes an attack in which some fellow soldiers are killed. In an attempt to save his companions' lives, Paglia is hit by three bullets, one of which cuts off two vertebrae. The immediate diagnosis is that of tetraplegia. Transported to Italy, Gianfranco has to face a dramatic period, afflicted by the suffering of immobility but supported by the unshakable hope of starting to live again next to Giovanna, the woman he loves. After a long rehabilitation process, he will be able to win his toughest battle.
cast: Ciro Esposito, Raffaella Rea, Sergio Frisca, Tosca D'Aquino, Remo Girone

title: Le ali della vita
synopsis: Late 1950s. Rosanna (Sabrina Ferilli) returns to teach music in the claustrophobic convent of nuns from which she fled as a young girl. His unconventional teaching methods, his cheerfulness and his deep love for music fascinate the young doctor Vithold but greatly irritate Alberta (Virna Lisi), the hard and rigorous mother superior.
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Virna Lisi, Tobias Hoesl, Marisa Merlini, Ute Maria Lerner, Azzurra Antonacci, Emanuela Aurizi, Giulia Bagella, Paolo Bonanni, Paolo Buglioni

title: Le ali della vita 2
synopsis: Italy, early 1960s. After winning her personal battle against grim Sister Alberta's harsh methods, Rosanna has been expelled from all schools and is unable to teach music. However, the two women meet again and Sister Alberta seems to have changed profoundly. One of the reasons for this transformation is to be pointed out to the love he has for Fabrizio, the violent and retarded son of the engineer Villoresi. However, not everything goes as it should and Rosanna, after taking care of Fabrizio and having discovered the past, finds herself facing a trial for plagiarism.
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Virna Lisi, Pierluigi Coppola, Rita Del Piano, Lia Tanzi, Giovanna Di Rauso, Giulio Bonucci, Glauco Onorato, Marisa Merlini, Ilenia Lazzarin

title: Le amanti del mostro
synopsis: Doctor Alex Nijinski (Klaus Kinski) and his wife move into their father-in-law's house, where they come across a secret laboratory. Belonging to a scientist who with his experiments was trying to investigate life after death, the laboratory with the secrets it keeps soon becomes the cause of a split in personality that leads Alex to turn into a furious killer.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Katia Christine, Marzia Damon, Stella Calderoni, Romano De Gironcoli, Alessandro Perrella, Carla Mancini, Luigi Bevilacqua, Bruno Arié, Osiride Pevarello

title: Le amiche
synopsis: Disembarked in Turin for work, the young Roman Clelia meets Rosetta in dramatic circumstances (the girl has in fact just attempted suicide for love) and later her friends, variously involved in critical sentimental events that seem to deal with the utmost ease. The ease that Rosetta lacks: she will try to take her own life a second time. Clelia, at first inclined to stop in Turin, returns to Rome.

title: Le amiche del cuore
synopsis: Sixteen-year-old Claudia sleeps with anyone who can help her make a career as a TV valet. Morena is studying as a nurse and looks after her former drug addict mother. The introverted Simona (Asia Argento) lives an incestuous relationship with her father, separated from his wife. He meets Lucio and falls in love with him, but dad (Michele Placido), jealous, summons the boy.
cast: Asia Argento, Carlotta Natoli, Claudia Pandolfi, Michele Placido

title: Le amorose notti di Ali Baba
synopsis: Ali Babà is an unrepentant womanizer. To convert him to a life away from women, his father summons Professor Freuch. However, it will not be easy.
cast: Alan Barker, Krista Nell, Pierre Mirat, Ivana Novak, Colette Castel

title: Le avventure dell'incredibile Ercole
synopsis: Hercules, a beefy demigod, must find the seven bolts of Zeus to save the Earth from the devastating impact against the Moon.

synopsis: The incurable passion for the women of the greatest seducer in history relived by him when, arrested by the Spanish inquisitors, he is forced to remain in prison. As soon as he comes out contrite, he will soon resume the habit.
cast: Gabriele Ferzetti, Marina Vlady, Corinne Calvet, Nadia Gray

title: Le avventure di Mandrin
synopsis: The favorite of Louis XV wants the death of the fascinating smuggler Mandrin. The outlaw is saved by the daring lover. Discreet setting, professional direction, two sex symbols of Italy in the 1950s as protagonists.

title: Le avventure di Mary Read
synopsis: Mary Read, believed by all to be a man, met Peter in prison, the son of a lord, who spent a night in prison as a bet. The woman manages to escape, and upon learning of the true identity of Peter, whom she has fallen in love with, she realizes that she has been made fun of. To try to forget him, he enlisted as a ship's boy but in a short time became the leader of a group of privateers who regularly plunder English ships. Peter is sent to put an end to their exploits.

synopsis: It is the story, told with discreet fidelity to Collodi's original, of the wooden puppet, born from the plane of master Geppetto, who in the end turns into a real child. The film, shot with two lire and without much imagination, also sees the presence of Gassman in the role of the Green Fisherman.

synopsis: Made by the carpenter Geppetto, the puppet Pinocchio comes to life thanks to a spell of the Blue Fairy, to whom he promises to be a respectful and diligent child. But good intentions are soon forgotten ...

title: Le avventure e gli amori di Scaramouche
synopsis: While Jacobin France is clamoring for the heads of the nobles and the abolition of ancient privileges, Scaramouche takes the opportunity to continue his amorous adventures. It ends up pissing off all the husbands in Paris. To escape their ire he agrees to pass himself off as a barber employed by Napoleon. Mistaken for an attacker, he is forced, together with his friend Whistle, to volunteer among the soldiers leaving for Italy. Also because of his passion for women he ends up unleashing a war between the Austrian and Russian troops.

title: Le baccanti
synopsis: To appease the wrath of Minerva, who dried the wells of Thebes, the king of the city Pentheus decides to make a human sacrifice. The choice falls on Manto, the young daughter of the blind soothsayer Tiresias: but Dionysus, pitying, intervenes in person and saves the girl. Meanwhile, Pentheus learns that the young servant Lacdamo, who loves Manto, is designated by a prophecy to become king. Penteo does not resign and orders the guards to arrest him, but fate must be fulfilled ...
cast: Taina Elg, Alberto Lupo, Akim Tamiroff, Pierre Brice, Alessandra Panaro

title: Le baiser de Tosca
synopsis: The elderly opera singers guests of the Milanese retirement home designed for them by Giuseppe Verdi tell their life on stage. An original and effective docudrama, enhanced by the palpable emotional charge invested by the old bel canto lions.
cast: Sara Scuderi, Giovanni Puligheddu, Leonida Bellon, Salvatore Locapo

title: Le bal des folles
synopsis: In the nineteenth century, the young passionate Eugénie discovers that he has the special power to hear the dead. When her family learns of her secret, she Eugénie is brought to the hospital La Pitié Salpétrière without the possibility of escaping her destiny. The hospital, directed by the famous pioneer of Charcot neurology, is a Parisian neurological clinic where women are interned to which hysteria, madness, egomania, epilepsy and other types of physical and mental diseases are diagnosed.

Giovanna plans the elimination of that peasant husband of her, but does not conclude. How to be delivered, for erotic purposes, by a monsignor his nephew. A "vacation" for four directors, under the banner of vulgarity rather than comedy. Franco Rossi (third episode) is saved as staging, and the profession of actors. The rest is to be forgotten.

synopsis: Baron Jerome Antoine wins a yacht from the Marquis of Villamayor at the game, finds an old flame of his and leaves with her from Holland to reach Monte Carlo by navigating the canals that cross France. Stopped by a breakdown, they wait a long time for the Marquis's check to pay for the damage.

synopsis: The jokes are about everything and everyone: love, sex, friendship, marriage, death, history ... We thus pass from Spain to the North Pole, from Michelangelo to the Queen of England. But there is also room for extraterrestrials, doctors, lawyers, junkies, farmers, vacation convicts ...

synopsis: During the rehearsal of a play (Strindberg's Hell), two actors get acquainted. One is Henrique, who plays the role of God, and the other is Jean de Dieu, who plays Lucifer; the two are joined by a certain Max Monteiro, obsessed with female sex, and the mysterious Arianna.

title: Le battant
synopsis: Jacques Dernay is one of the old guard. He recently got out of jail and, in the midst of the new gangsters of the technological age, we never meet again. Among other things, the new gangsters use their relentless methods even towards Jacques' friends. The problem is that everyone would like to know where are the diamonds for which Jacques went to prison and which have not yet been found. Alain Delon, in 1982, was 47 years old, a slew of films behind him as an actor and only one test as a director. This is his second film and it doesn't add much to his reputation as a tough guy. Least of all to his fame as a director.
cast: Alain Delon, François Périer, Pierre Mondy, Anne Parillaud, Marie Christine Descouard, Andréa Ferréol, Michel Beaune

title: Le beau mariage
synopsis: The unique and all-encompassing aspiration of the student and antiques dealer Sabine is to bring the "right" person to the altar. At first she has to settle for a sporadic relationship with a married man, but at some point she decides to get serious and sets out in search of a full-blown husband. He thinks he has identified him as a young lawyer, but he does not take it for granted. But Sabine is not discouraged, and one day, on the train ...
cast: Béatrice Romand, André Dussollier, Feodor Atkine, Arielle Dombasle

title: Le belle famiglie
synopsis: "Four episodes. Sicilian girl becomes a nun so as not to marry the man imposed on her by the family. To make her husband jealous, she hires a Vietnamese waiter; the consort will prefer the latter to his wife. 'other. Donna divides herself between sick husband and lover; they recover and she chooses the doctor, injured in an accident. With the collaboration of Steno in the screenplay, Ugo Gregoretti makes his contribution to the satire of costume, but lets himself go to farce the more he ran. "
cast: Totò, Sandra Milo, Annie Girardot, Jean Rochefort, Adolfo Celi, Nanni Loy, Susy Andersen

title: Le bellissime gambe di Sabrina
synopsis: A particular mark on a thief's leg is the only clue to catch a gang. Teo photographs the sign on Sabrina, a model with a hobby of theft. As the thieves try to prevent the police from seeing the photo, a feeling arises between Leo and Sabrina.

synopsis: "The film is in eight episodes: The Savior: a suicide for TV; The voice of blood: wife and daughter sold for a contract; The fakir: a more greedy relationship than the public; A beautiful family: dishonesty and wealth; Chance special: corruption and suicide; The chinchilla: lover source of money; The surgeon: the revenge of a scalpel baron; Trial behind closed doors: incestuous and triumphant. Some of the episodes no longer have the consistency of a joke. demeaning level for banality and vulgarity. "

title: Le bon et les méchant
synopsis: France, late thirties: Jacques and his companion Simon, of Jewish origin, make ends meet by carrying out petty thieves and scams, constantly hunted down by the obstinate and tireless policeman Blanchot. But after the outbreak of the war, during the German occupation, criminals and law enforcement (assisted by the beautiful Lola) will find themselves on the same side of the barricade, putting their respective skills at the service of the Resistance ...
cast: Marlène Jobert, Jacques Dutronc, Jacques Villeret, Bruno Cremer, Brigitte Fossey, Serge Reggiani

title: Le bon plaisir
synopsis: Claire, an established designer, had a son of a prominent politician ten years earlier, who has now become Head of State. One evening the purse in which she keeps the letter revealing the scandal is stolen. From here starts a chain of dramatic events in which the naive good faith of those who believe in the value of truth and the shady interests of those seeking their own advantage are confused. The film would like to be a denunciation of the intrigues and cynicism of the Power, but the results give the feuilleton. The superficiality of the approach gives space to the good job of the interpreters.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Jean Louis Trintignant, Michel Serrault

title: Le bon roi Dagobert
synopsis: We are in the middle of the Middle Ages. Dagobert, king of the Franks, goes on pilgrimage to Rome, to ask the Pope for forgiveness for his dissolute life. The Roman intrigues, however, placed a double of the true Pope on the chair of St. Peter; Dagobert realizes this and unmasks the usurper, but on the way back he is treacherously killed by his advisor, the monk Otarius, thirsty for power and corrupted by Roman idleness. Together with Ugo Tognazzi there is the late Coluche, a highly talented comedian and acclaimed in France, who never achieved the deserved success in Italy. Scenography by Dante Ferretti. Apart from that, it must also be said that the Middle Ages are not in the strings of our Dino Risi.
cast: Coluche, Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Serrault, Carole Bouquet, Isabella Ferrari, Michael Lonsdale, Venantino Venantini, Karin Mai, Francesco Scali

title: Le bonheur des uns...
synopsis: Léa, Marc, Karine and Francis are two pairs of longtime friends. Each of them plays a very specific role in the harmony of the group but everything cracks when Léa, the most discreet of them, reveals that she has written a novel, which soon turns into a bestseller. Far from rejoicing, others indulge in small jealousies and great cowardice that let it emerge that among friends the happiness of one is not always shared by the others.
cast: Bérénice Bejo, Vincent Cassel, François Damiens, Florence Foresti, Daniel Cohen, Stephen Manas, Big John, Caroline Piette

title: Le bonheur est dans le pré
synopsis: Francis lives a difficult and neurotic existence, squeezed between the strikes of his employees and the hysteria of an unbearable wife. His friend Gérard, cynical and uninhibited, is the only one who understands him and gives him serenity. After a heart attack Francis spends a few days stopped at home, and witnessing a transmission like "Who has seen it", he discovers the existence of his double, who has been missing for years and is desperately sought by a loving wife. Gérard convinces him to replace the deceased: it is the beginning of a new life and a new serenity, even if built on misunderstandings.
cast: Michel Serrault, Eddy Mitchell, Carmen Maura, Sabine Azéma

title: Le bossu

Having become a friend and bodyguard to the Duke of Nevers for his skill with the sword, Lagardere finds himself at the center of a family intrigue hatched by Count Gonzaga, the Duke's cousin. Unjustly accused of the Duke's death, Lagardere manages to save his little daughter, while the Duchess, mad with grief, is guarded by the perfidious Gonzaga.

title: Le bossu
synopsis: Isabella of Caylus, secretly married to Philip of Nevers, is threatened by the sinister prince Gonzaga and must entrust their little Aurora to her husband. Gonzaga kills Philip, who, before dying, entrusts the child to his friend Henri de Lagardère. It is only the beginning of a series of dramatic events that will end, years later, with the punishment of the wicked and the victory of the deserving.

title: Le boucher
synopsis: The butcher Popaul, severely marked by the experience of the war, believes he will find a partner in the village teacher Hélène, but she refuses to commit to a relationship that goes beyond simple friendship. When the bodies of some young women are found, Hélène realizes that the killer is Popaul. The story of the protagonists, entrusted to excellent interpreters, emerges against the background of a valid portrait of daily life in the province. Chabrol stages the eternal story of Beauty and the Beast in a distressing and moving film.
cast: Jean Yanne, Stéphane Audran, Antonio Passalia, Roger Rudel

title: Le braghe del padrone
synopsis: Vittorio, a very modest window cleaner, lives without his luck at work and in private life. One day he is hired by "Supreme Edizioni" where the president is forced to hire 2000 employees to optimize production. Lost in the macroscopic company, Vittorio is approached by the Devil himself, who pushes him to take up the social ladder. The young man begins by removing Dr. Verzelli from his golden seat.

title: Le brio

A brilliant young woman dreams of becoming a lawyer when, enrolled at the University of Ussas, she follows the course of the renowned but provocative Professor Pierre Mazard. Soon, a clash between the two will end up allowing Neïla, assisted by her mentor as tyrannical as she is benevolent, to dive into the world of puns, rhetoric and excellence.

title: Le bruit des moteurs

title: Le buttane

Their lives, their profession, the relationships with their customers, the inconveniences, the dramas.

synopsis: Add a Plot

title: Le cadeau
synopsis: A poor banker, Grégoire, frustrated by the routine of the workplace, seizes the early retirement opportunity offered by the bank. With the money received he decides to go on a trip and thus give a shock to his gray life. Unbeknownst to him, his work friends give him a surprising gift: they find a call girl, Barbara, who accompanies him on his trip to Venice.

title: Le calde notti di Caligola
synopsis: During the feast of Priapus, when Caligula proves his manhood, he finds himself helpless. To remedy the shame he relies on several experts; first a German doctor, then a gym teacher, finally a sect of sadistic priestesses try to cure him ... Only the vision of his wife's backside will save him, which will make him recover his lost virility. From that moment on, however, Caligula finds himself attracted to all kinds of posterior, male or female ...

synopsis: Don Giovanni is expelled from Seville for having dishonored the wife and daughter of a local noble. The wolf loses its fur but not its vice: first it seduces a nun, then a Berber princess.

title: Le cameriere
synopsis: Giovanna, a maid with a wealthy family, is accused of having stolen a necklace belonging to her mistress. Innocent, but unable to prove it (she should tell a story that her boyfriend might misinterpret), she is denounced. Then her colleagues who work in the building enter the scene and, thanks to a ruse, the real culprit is unmasked. The idea of ??a group of maids engaging in the unusual role of detective is not bad. We don't go much beyond this, but the narrative hold is discreet and, all in all, the film is quite funny.

Greedy and liar, swindler and obsessed with sex, he stops at nothing to achieve his goal and destroy the old bank system, put aside its historical shareholder and get rid of the previous president. In a universe where hunger for power and thirst for money are the only commandments, however, he will find himself forced to face an American hedge fund that operates with even more sluggish methodologies than his own.

title: Le caporal épinglé

The project fails because the latter is forced to stop to look for the lost glasses. The corporal does not resign and with the trusted Dede gives life to a series of attempts, but luck does not assist them and each time they are caught again. One day Dupont meets a girl who is willing to help him by providing him with civilian clothes. Little senile Renoir, who returns with levity to themes and environments dear to him (see "The great illusion"); minor, but delicious.
cast: Jean Pierre Cassel, Claude Brasseur, O. E. Hasse, Claude Rich

title: Le casse
synopsis: With a very audacious shot and scored with extremely sophisticated systems, two thieves steal a huge amount of diamonds. At the moment of escaping, however, a mishap blocks them in the port of Athens. A greedy Greek policeman hunts them down, but only to get his hands on the loot.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Omar Sharif, Robert Hossein, Dyan Cannon, Renato Salvatori

title: Le castagne sono buone
synopsis: Luigi, a young director, unscrupulous and womanizer, meets Carla, an innocent student. He tries, she doesn't give in because she only believes in lasting feelings. He then introduces her to his parents, but when he finally could have her he prefers to disappear in order not to disappoint her. Some time later he meets Carla's sister, back from a love disappointment and a suicide attempt. At the thought of Carla, Luigi understands her emptiness and returns to her, determined to put his head right.
cast: Gianni Morandi, Stefania Casini, Patricia Allison, Milla Sannoner

title: Le celluloid et le marbre
synopsis: Numerous contemporary artists (Pierre Klossowsky, Iannis Xenakis, Victor Vasarely, Claude Simon) tell how their work has changed in relation to cinema and its cultural innovations.
cast: Pierre Klossowsky, Cesar Baldaccini

title: Le cercle des passions
synopsis: Returning to Sicily from the United States, where he lives, Anthony Tursi meets Count Carlo di Villafratti who invites him to his property. Here Anthony meets Elisa, the count's daughter, and falls in love with her. The woman, however, will drag him into an absurdly dramatic plot. A melodrama only partially redeemed by beautiful photography and beautiful music.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Max Von Sydow, Assumpta Serna

title: Le cerveau
synopsis: The brilliant architect of the famous robbery to the Glasgow-London train is still free and ready to hit again. This time he agrees with an American gangster, Frankie Scannapico, to take possession of five million NATO pounds. The blow succeeds but there are two intruders, Arturo and Anatolio, dark French thieves. For a period the money will be in their hand, then Scannapico will recover it and refuse to divide it with the partner. But in the end nobody can enjoy the booty. Many stars for a predictable curreduction film, but which has been very successful in the public.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Bourvil, David Niven, Eli Wallach, Silvia Monti, Raymond Gérôme, Jacques Balutin, Henri Attal, Yves Barsacq

title: Le chagrin des oiseaux
synopsis: Once a city of tolerance, Timbuktu is now in the hands of a group of extremists, who govern with laws that prohibit music, football and smoking, and impose a strict dress code for women. For Kidane, however, it is the right time to enjoy life with her family away from the city. A quiet man living on the banks of the Niger River, Kidane works as a shepherd aided by a 12-year-old named Issan. But when Amadou, the mad fisherman who lives nearby, shoots his flock, Kidane is forced to try to protect his work, life and family, accidentally killing his rival and making his inevitable fate run fast.
cast: Ibrahim Ahmed, Toulou Kiki, Abel Jafri, Hichem Yacoubi, Kettly Noël, Fatoumata Diawara, Mehdi AG Mohammed, Layla Walet Mohammed, Adel Mahmoud Cherif, Salem Dendou

title: Le chant des mariées
synopsis: Tunis, 1942. Two girls, close and friends since childhood, share the same house in a modest neighborhood where Jews and Muslims live in harmony. Each wants to live the life of the other: while Nour, a Muslim, would like to have the opportunity to go to school like the other, Myriam, a Jew, dreams of love and envy Nour and her romantic love stories with Khaled. When the German forces enter Tunis in November 1942, the Nazis subject the Jewish community to humiliating treatments, Myriam's mother loses her right to work and, unable to do anything else, decides to promise her daughter in marriage to a wealthy doctor, making the romantic love dreams of young daughter.
cast: Simon Abkarian, Olympe Borval, Lizzie Brocheré, Najib Oudghiri

title: Le chant du loup
synopsis: In the near future, a French submarine finds itself in a crisis situation. Commander Grandchamp, Deputy D'Orsi and Chanteraide, an expert in acoustic systems, try to find a solution when the origin of the crisis becomes more and more mysterious. A sound difficult to identify puts Chanteraide in a position to disobey the orders of the superiors to investigate its origins.
cast: François Civil, Omar Sy, Reda Kateb, Mathieu Kassovitz, Paula Beer, Etienne Guillou Kervern, Nicolas Van Beveren

title: Le charme discret de la bourgeoisie
synopsis: Two spouses, her sister, an ambassador and another couple: they are the main characters of this "fairy tale" with which Buñuel, now elderly but always with a poisoned tooth against the institutions and myths of the bourgeois world, satirizes the society of respectability official. The unifying element of the story is the attempt, always frustrated by the most unpredictable hitches, to have a lunch with friends. Around this idea, other significant figures and a series of collateral events give life to a painting that is as elegant as it is "ferocious". Ironic and hopeless, clear and complex in its narrative development, the film won the Oscar for best foreign film (obviously Buñuel did not go to collect it).
cast: Jean Pierre Cassel, Fernando Rey, Delphine Seyrig, Bulle Ogier, Stéphane Audran, Paul Frankeur, Julien Bertheau, Milena Vukotic, Maria Gabriella Maione, Claude Piéplu, Michel Piccoli

title: Le chat
synopsis: An old couple lives in an old house destined for demolition: Julien, a retired printer, and Clémence, a former circus acrobat. Their relationship is now dead. The two have no children and Julien ends up becoming fond of a cat picked up on the street. Clémence is so jealous that she kills the animal. The man then decides to go to a small hotel where, in the past, he consumed squalid adulterers. The mistress, Nelly, constantly urges him to go home, where his wife is very ill.
cast: Jean Gabin, Simone Signoret, Annie Cordy, Jacques Rispal

title: Le chat et la souris
synopsis: Madame Richard, a beautiful middle-aged lady, has just been widowed: unfortunately for her, however, the stubborn Inspector Lechat is convinced that it was she who got rid of her husband ...
cast: Michèle Morgan, Serge Reggiani, Jean Pierre Aumont, Philippe Léotard

title: Le chemin des écoliers
synopsis: Paris, 1944: students Antoine and Paul face their first sentimental experiences, at the same time tinkering with the equivocal world of the black market. But while Paul's father is perfectly aware of his son's business, Antoine's parents are in the dark. So when Antoine asks permission to go and spend a few days in Paul's villa (actually with the aim of preparing a shot), his parents raise no objection. At least until the arrival of a disastrous report card raises the first suspicions ...
cast: Françoise Arnoul, Bourvil, Lino Ventura, Alain Delon, Jean Claude Brialy

title: Le chiavi di casa
synopsis: Fifteen-year-old Paolo is handicapped from birth due to complications that occurred during childbirth, in which his mother lost her life. The boy was raised by his uncles because his father Gianni, upset by the tragedy, abandoned him. But when Paolo has to go to Berlin for some specialist visits, one of the uncles manages to convince Gianni to accompany him ...
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Andrea Rossi, Charlotte Rampling

title: Le choc du futur
synopsis: In the Paris of 1978 the old formulas no longer fascinate listeners and the radios had to make room for a new type of music. In a male-dominated industry, Ana uses her electronic devices to make her voice heard, creating a new sound that will mark the decades to come.
cast: Alma Jodorowsky, Clara Luciani, Philippe Rebbot, Nicolas Ullmann, Elli Medeiros, Laurent Papot, Corine

title: Le choix des armes
synopsis: Noël falls, tragically, into the circle of the underworld hosting a fugitive. History of hatred, fidelity and friendship as in the rhetoric of the French underworld; great actors and tight editing.
cast: Yves Montand, Gérard Depardieu, Catherine Deneuve, Michel Galabru

title: Le château de verre
synopsis: Evelyne, a young wife of a mature Swiss lawyer, during a stay on Lake Como know Remy, a fascinating Parisian boy, and falls in love with it. The boy invites her to Paris where the woman goes with an excuse. At first repentant of his gesture, Evelyne lets herself win by love. During the return to Bern, the plane flies on.
cast: Michèle Morgan, Jean Marais, Jean Servais, Fosco Giachetti, Elisa Cegani, Élina Labourdette, Giovanna Galletti, André Carnège

title: Le ciel attendra
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Sonia has failed to "guarantee" her family a place in paradise. Melanie, 16, lives with her mother, loves school and her friends, plays the cello and wants to change the world when she falls in love with a "prince" on the internet. They are normal French teenagers but one day their path crosses that of terrorist recruitment, ending up enlisted in the jihad and ready to leave for Syria.
cast: Sandrine Bonnaire, Noémie Merlant, Clotilde Courau, Naomi Amarger, Yvan Attal, Zinedine Soualem, Sofia Lesaffre

title: Le ciel de Paris
synopsis: Suzanne, who has found a job in Paris, shares an apartment with Marc, a young homosexual. In their free moments, the two go to a swimming pool where they meet Lucien. The boy feels attracted to Suzanne and falls in love with her. But unfortunately for him, Marc has also set his sights on him. However, Marc also feels attracted and rejected by Lucien.
cast: Sandrine Bonnaire, Marc Fourastier, Paul Blain, Eveline Bouix

title: Le ciel est à vous
synopsis: Villeneuve, France, 1930s. The garage owner Pierre has an irrepressible passion for flying, shared with his wife Thérèse. The two commit all the family assets to give life to their dream: to break the female record for flying in a straight line.
cast: Madeleine Renaud, Charles Vanel, Raymond Vernay, Jean Debucourt

title: Le cinque giornate
synopsis: Milan, March 18-22, 1848: Cainazzo is a thief who becomes involved in the insurrection by chance, just like the baker Romolo. The two become friends during the construction of the barricades, the attacks of the rioters and the reprisals of the Habsburgs. Romulus, however, when the celebrations for the victory break out, intervenes to stop the violence of a revolutionary, thus marking his own destiny.
cast: Adriano Celentano, Enzo Cerusico, Marilù Tolo, Luisa De Santis

title: Le cinque giornate di Milano
synopsis: Fiction and history mixed in the re-enactment of the famous Milanese days of struggle during which the city rose up, driving out the garrison of the Austrian army led by General Radetzky.
cast: Fabrizio Gifuni, Chiara Conti, Giuseppe Soleri, Ana Caterina Morariu, Daniela Poggi, Richard Sammel, Giancarlo Giannini, Fabio Troiano, Alberto Di Stasio, Michele Nani

title: Le cinque stagioni
synopsis: Set in a retirement home, the film studies the behaviors, the manias, the small and big dramas, of boarders.
cast: Concetta Barra, Roy Bosier, Clelia Matania, Tino Carraro, Elsa Merlini, Carlo Romano, Gianni Santuccio, Alberto Sorrentino, Laerte Ottonelli, Andrea Municchi, Tino Scotti, Renato Pinciroli, Tiberio Murgia, Giorgio Bixio, Mario Carrara

title: Le cinquième element
synopsis: Korben Dallas with his flying car is a taxi driver in New York in 2259 and finds himself having to recover four ancient stones, which symbolize the four natural elements (air, water, earth and fire), whose union creates the fifth element: the life. In addition to Korben, however, the forces of Evil, led by the evil Zorg, are also willing to take possession of the precious stones.
cast: Bruce Willis, Gary Oldman, Milla Jovovich, Ian Holm, Luke Perry, Chris Tucker, Brion James, Tom Lister Jr., Lee Evans, Charlie Creed Miles, Tricky, John Neville, John Bluthal, Mathieu Kassovitz, Christopher Fairbank

title: Le coeur des hommes
synopsis: Alex, Antoine, Jeff and Manu have been dating for over 25 years, ever since they played for the same soccer team in the Parisian suburbs. A series of crises leads them to confide in each other and question each other. At the center of all their conversations is the relationship with women.
cast: Gérard Darmon, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Marc Lavoine, Bernard Campan, Ludmila Mikael, Fabienne Babe

title: Le coeur noir des forêts
synopsis: Nikolai, sixteen, has long lived in a family home. Lonely and persecuted by the origins of his he abandoned for which he won the nickname Mowgli, he dreams of building the family he has never had. When Camille arrives in the community, a fifteen -year -old girl rebellious and intriguing, he convinces her to escape to go and live together in the forest.
cast: Elsa Houben, Quito Rayon Richter, Charles François

title: Le collectionneur
cast: Maude Guérin, Luc Picard, Lawrence Arcouette, Charles André Bourassa

title: Le colonel Chabert
synopsis: A man shows up at the office of the solicitor Derville: he says his name is Chabert, former commander of a garrison of cuirassiers and given up for dead at the Battle of Eylau ten years earlier. This may seem unlikely, but the lawyer agrees to represent him. But the one who ten years earlier was Madame Chabert, believing herself a widow, has rejoined the Count Ferraud, who aspires to the title of peer of France. For the latter, Chabert's reappearance is convenient, as the current marriage is a hindrance to his ambitions. It is with his wife herself, apparently greedy and shrewd, but ultimately vulnerable, that Chabert has to deal with. Second film version of a story by Balzac (the first was in 1943). Angelo's direction is correct: leave it to Depardieu and Luchini, who overshadow all the others, Ardant included.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Fabrice Luchini, Fanny Ardant

title: Le colt cantarono la morte e fu... tempo di massacro
synopsis: Tom responds to the call of Carradine, an old friend of the family and decides to return to the town he left as a child. Here he finds his brother Slim brutalized by alcohol, his family's farm and every business in the hands of Scott, a brutal landlord surrounded by an army of men who obey him in every way. Tom immediately tries to get first-hand information from Silm, who insists on keeping silent, and then from Carradine, who is exterminated with the whole family by Scott's men.
cast: Franco Nero, George Hilton, Nino Castelnuovo, Lynn Shayne

title: Le comiche
synopsis: "Pursued by a locomotive in the film screening in a hall, two comedians leave the screen in search of escape. But in real life they combine trouble with devastating clumsiness, and after a series of ruinous exploits they find themselves having to flee from the emissaries of the mafia who they want to kill them, having mistaken them for two mobsters, so they decide it is better to go back to the screen.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Renato Pozzetto, Enzo Cannavale, Fabio Traversa, Alessandra Casella, Gian, Tiziana Pini, Renato D'Amore, Giampaolo Saccarola, Sal Borgese

title: Le comiche 2
synopsis: Paolo Villaggio and Renato Pozzetto are the protagonists of thunderous misadventures of all kinds around the world ...
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Renato Pozzetto, Roberto Della Casa, Paul Müller, Loredana Romito, Angelo Pellegrino, Alfiero Toppetti, Antonio Allocca, Giulio Donnini

title: Le comiche di Charlot
cast: Charles Chaplin, Edna Purviance, Mark Swain, Phyllis Allen

title: Le complexe de Philémon
synopsis: Elena and Francesco have been happily married for twelve years. When Elena discovers the beauties of psychoanalysis, she suspects that her husband's fidelity hides who knows what horrible tragedies. He then decides to test him ...
cast: Fernandel, Sandra Milo, Jean Pierre Marielle, Yvonne Clech

title: Le complot
synopsis: In Warsaw, Father Alec, a sympathizer of Solidarity and a supporter of human rights, is persecuted and finally murdered by the police. Inspired by the real events of Father Popieluzko, the film has its own weakness in a kind of uncontrolled ideological fury from which Ed Harris' interpretation is characterized and as a strong point. Mediocre, however, Christopher Lambert.
cast: Christopher Lambert, Ed Harris, Joanne Whalley

title: Le comte de Monte Cristo
synopsis: Edmond Dantes manages to escape from prison after being unjustly incarcerated. He thus sets out in search of those who have betrayed him.
cast: Pierre Richard Willm, Michèle Alfa, Aimé Clariond, Marcel Herrand

title: Le comte de Monte Cristo
synopsis: Four-part miniseries based on the novel by Alexandre Dumas. Edmond Dantes, unjustly imprisoned, after eighteen years tries to take revenge on those responsible for this crime using any device.
