cast: Gérard Depardieu, Ornella Muti, Jean Rochefort, Pierre Arditi, Sergio Rubini, Florence Darel, Christopher Thompson, Stanislas Merhar, Julie Depardieu, Hélène Vincent, Mattia Sbragia, Renato Scarpa

title: Le comtesse aux seins nus
cast: Lina Romay, Alice Arno, Jack Taylor, Gilda Arancio, Jean Pierre Bouyxou

title: Le concert
synopsis: During the Soviet period, an acclaimed conductor of the Moscow Bolshoi is turned away for refusing to fire Jewish musicians. Twenty-five years later the man still works in the theater as a caretaker and helps his wife to stir up fake ex-communist pride displays. One day he intercepts an invitation to the Chatelet theater in Paris and decides to redeem himself from humiliations with deception, accepting the engagement instead of the official orchestra. Thus he brings together his old concert mates and some unlikely new entries.
cast: Aleksei Guskov, Mélanie Laurent, Dmitri Nazarov, Valeri Barinov, François Berléand, Miou Miou, Lionel Abelanski, Jacqueline Bisset, Laurent Bateau

title: Le concile de pierre
synopsis: For some weeks now, nightmares and hallucinations have plunged Laura Siprien into uncontrollable anguish: the woman begins to wonder who the adopted son Liu-san really is and what the birthmark suddenly appeared on her chest means. A few days before he turns seven, the child is kidnapped: convinced that she knows where he is, Laura throws herself headlong into a journey to the limits of the extraordinary ...
cast: Monica Bellucci, Catherine Deneuve, Moritz Bleibtreu, Sami Bouajila

title: Le concours
synopsis: At Fémis, the Paris film school, daily life is marked by a specific republican ideal of excellence, which can be summed up in one sentence: everyone is equal but only the best are admitted. Through the entrance exams, the one-year course and the diploma exams, the relationship with excellence in the art world and one of the most prestigious art schools in France, a place of culture in which several generations mix.

title: Le confessioni
synopsis: In Germany, a G8 of economy ministers is about to meet in a luxury hotel ready to adopt a secret maneuver that will have very serious consequences for some countries. With the men of government, there are also the director of the International Monetary Fund, Daniel Roché, and three guests: a famous writer of children's books, a rock star, and an Italian monk, Roberto Salus. However, a tragic and unexpected event happens and the meeting has to be suspended. In an atmosphere of doubt and fear, the ministers and the monk take on an ever tighter challenge around secrecy. In fact, the ministers suspect that Salus, through the confession of one of them, has managed to find out about the terrible maneuver they are about to launch, and they urge him in every way to say what he knows. But things do not go so smoothly: while the monk - a paradoxical and unsettling man, in many ways elusive - becomes the immovable guardian of the secret of confession, the men of power, assailed by remorse and uncertainty, begin to waver.
cast: Toni Servillo, Daniel Auteuil, Lambert Wilson, Connie Nielsen, Pierfrancesco Favino, Marie Joseé Croze, Moritz Bleibtreu, Togo Igawa, Richard Sammel, Johan Heldenbergh, Aleksei Guskov, Stéphane Freiss, Andy De La Tour, John Keogh

title: Le confessionnal
synopsis: In 1952 Hitchcock filmed in Canada, in Quebec, "I confess" and a girl, who was cleaning in the church chosen as a set, became pregnant, confessing only to the confessor the name of the man who had made her a mother. Shortly after the baby was born, the young woman committed suicide. In 1989, that "bastard" tries to discover the identity of his unknown father, involving, in his search, his stepbrother who has just returned from China. First film by a Québec director with extensive experience in theater and TV, the film is built on a very complex "plot", with daring narrative solutions and ambitious images, even if at times the outcome appears uneven.
cast: Lothaire Bluteau, Patrick Goyette, Lean Louis Millete, Suzanne Clément

title: Le conseguenze dell'amore
synopsis: Titta di Girolamo, a distinguished fifty, has lived for eight years in a hotel room in a small town in Italian-speaking Switzerland. He apparently spent all this time without working, spending his days at the hotel bar between cigarettes. The only element that disturbs this routine is the arrival, once a month, of a suitcase that is deposited in front of his door. What secrets does it hide?
cast: Toni Servillo, Olivia Magnani, Adriano Giannini, Angela Goodwin, Raffaele Pisu

title: Le convoi
synopsis: Seven men, with four cars, have to transport 1300 kilos of cannalibis from Malaga, in southern Spain, to Creil, on the outskirts of Paris. For Alex, Yacine, Majid and the others, it is a routine mission but the ride takes a different turn when their convoy is joined by Nadia, a young tourist who returns home from Morocco and is dragged on their adventure. For one night, Nadia will witness the violent reality of international drug trafficking.
cast: Benoît Magimel, Reem Kherici, Tewfik Jallab, Foed Amara, Mahdi Belemlih, Rashid Debbouze, Leon Garel, Sofian Khammes

title: Le coppie
synopsis: Gavino and Adelina Puddu, two Sardinian spouses who emigrated to Turin decide to buy a refrigerator in installments. When the time has come to settle the bill, Gavino loses the money. He will get the money with a very special expedient. A metalworker and his wife want to celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary in a luxury hotel, frequented by sovereigns and industrialists. The welcome given to them is anything but hospitable. Two lovers find themselves locked in their room by a lion who has escaped from a circus, which blocks the door of the house.
cast: Monica Vitti, Alberto Sordi, Enzo Jannacci, Rossana Di Lorenzo
director: Mario Monicelli, Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica

title: Le corniaud
synopsis: Marechal, a small French trader collects a Cadillac from Naples to take to Paris, but ignores the load: drugs and jewelry. Remotely controlled and harassed by a gang bent on seizing the precious cargo, Marechal is close to completing his mission when he realizes he has been involved in a shady deal. With subtle cunning he then manages to unmask the bandits and make them fall into the hands of the police, earning a conspicuous cash prize for the considerable contribution made to the recovery of the stolen goods.
cast: Bourvil, Louis De Funès, Venantino Venantini, Beba Loncar, Saro Urzì

title: Le corps de mon ennemi
synopsis: François Leclerc has spent his last seven years in prison, accused of the murder, which he did not commit, of Cajac and his wife Karine. Now regained his freedom he returns to Cournai, the town from which he was forced to leave. The double murder of which he was accused had as its theater the night that François directed. Aided by Gilberte and his old partner Raphael, the ex-prisoner tries to reconstruct the truth about his case and to track down the culprits. François discovers that he was at the center of a huge and lucrative drug trade in the place he ran.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Marie France Pisier, Bernard Blier, Daniel Ivernel

title: Le cose belle
synopsis: In 1999 Fabio and Enzo were just twelve years old while Adele and Silvana were fourteen. They live in Naples and, when interviewed for a television program, they show their disenchantment with the improvements that the passage of time can bring to the city and to their very lives. Thirteen years later, now adults, the four boys can take stock of the changes in the city, talk about the difficulties of their growth and make a comparison with their past life.
cast: Enzo Della Volpe, Fabio Rippa, Adele Serra, Silvana Sorbetti

title: Le cose che restano
synopsis: A family that confusedly resists and painstakingly recomposes itself, symbol of an entire country in search of a new identity.
cast: Paola Cortellesi, Claudio Santamaria, Ennio Fantastichini, Vincenzo Amato, Lorenzo Balducci, Antonia Liskova, Francesco Scianna

title: Le cose in te nascoste
synopsis: Fabrizio and Chiara meet by chance one evening, thanks to a storm. He has a precarious job, she is a committed. They know each other, they like each other, they fall in love. But Fabrizio is married and his wife Ada, who until now has been everything to him, is a fragile, hypochondriac woman. Is pregnant. The new relationship distorts the established order and leads them "beyond". Up to concocting a radical and overwhelming plan.
cast: Lea Mornar, Luigi Iacuzio, Elena Bouryka, Giovanni Izzo, Francesca De Sapio, Franco Trevisi

title: Le couperet
synopsis: Bruno Davert, manager of a paper mill, is fired, but since he is still young he thinks he has no problems finding a new job in a short time that will allow him to maintain his current standard of living. When, after three years, he finds himself still unemployed, he decides to take action by physically eliminating his competitors ...
cast: José Garcia, Karin Viard, Ulrich Tukur, Olivier Gourmet, Yvon Back, Thierry Hancisse

title: Le cousin
synopsis: The "cousin" of the title is Nounours, a small drug dealer who has a special agreement with the cops: he spills everything he knows, they give him 10% on the drugs raked thanks to his tips. However, the wind begins to change when Inspector Maurin - who personally kept in touch with Nounours - commits suicide: his colleague Gérard Delvaux takes his place, around whom Judge Lambert is tightening the circle regarding a circle of corrupt policemen ...
cast: Alain Chabat, Patrick Timsit, Agnès Jaoui, Marie Trintignant, Samuel Le Bihan, Caroline Proust

title: Le couteau dans la plaie
cast: Sophia Loren, Anthony Perkins, Gig Young, Yolande Turner

title: Le coût de la vie
synopsis: In Lyon the stories of various characters intertwine: an irreducible stingy, an overly generous restaurateur who gets ruined by dint of investing, a mysterious woman, an entrepreneur who sells out his factories after a heart attack, a young heiress who wants to be loved regardless of his possessions ... You think you are talking about money, in reality, feelings are at stake.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Vincent Lindon, Camille Japy, Géraldine Pailhas, Isild Le Besco

title: Le cri du couer
synopsis: Little Moctar must leave his Mali village to reach, together with his mother, his father who has been emigrating for some time in France and finally able to keep them. Once arrived, he cannot settle in the new country. He has a recurring nightmare: a hyena that hunts him.
cast: Richard Bohringer, Saïd Diarra, Félicité Wouassi, Alex Descas

title: Le cri du hibou
cast: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Christophe Malavoy, Mathilda May, Jacques Penot

title: Le crime de Monsieur Lange
synopsis: The head of a publishing house disappears and his employees, who harbored a cordial hatred for him, start running the company in a cooperative. The success is such that in the end, when the boss returns, the employees have a clear idea of ??what to do. Jovially anarchic film written by Prévert.
cast: René Lefèvre, Jules Berry, Sylvia Bataille, Florelle, Marcel Lévesque, Odette Talazac, Henri Guisol, Maurice Baquet, Jacques B. Brunius

title: Le crime est notre affaire
synopsis: Bélisaire and Prudence Beresford rest in their small castle overlooking Bourget Lake but, while Bélisaire is happy, Prudence gets bored when she begins to dream of a good fairy who leads them on adventures full of mysteries. The fairy appears to her in the guise of Belgian aunt Babette, who witnesses a horrific crime from a train window. Despite Bélisaire's skepticism, Prudence sets out in search of the body, getting hired as a cook in a disturbing castle inhabited by a curious family and adorned with authentic sarcophagi.
cast: Catherine Frot, André Dussollier, Claude Rich, Chiara Mastroianni, Melvil Poupaud, Alexandre Lafaurie, Christian Vadim, Hippolyte Girardot, Yves Afonso, Annie Cordy

title: Le daim
synopsis: Georges leaves the suburb where he lives and goes to great lengths to try and buy the jacket of his dreams. The purchase costs him all his savings and soon turns into an obsession. The relationship of possessiveness and jealousy that Georges will have with the jacket will plunge him into a criminal vortex.
cast: Jean Dujardin, Adèle Haenel, Albert Delpy, Pierre Gommé, Laurent Nicolas, Coralie Russier, Stephane Jobert, Franck Lebreton, Marie Bunel, Panayotis Pascot

title: Le dernier combat
synopsis: In a Paris devastated by a nuclear catastrophe, a man walks around trying to build a plane to get away from it all. To take possession of the vehicle he collides with other survivors who, like him, survive in the midst of abandoned cars. The man struggles with a villain, is injured and hospitalized, meets a girl and tries to save her.
cast: Pierre Jolivet, Fritz Wepper, Jean Bouise, Jean Reno, Christiane Krüger

title: Le dernier coup de marteau
synopsis: Fourteen-year-old Victor lives with his mother on a beach in the south of France. Victor has never met his father and pretends he can do without him. However, when he discovers that the man, the conductor, is engaged in some rehearsals nearby, Victor decides to meet him to create a relationship with him.
cast: Romain Paul, Clotilde Hesme, Candela Peña, Grégory Gadebois

title: Le dernier des injustes
synopsis: During the Second World War, Nazi propaganda led the public to believe that Theresienstadt was a model ghetto for Jewish settlement when in fact it was the last step before the gas chamber. Benjamin Murmelstein, the last president of the Jewish Council of Theresienstadt condemned in exile, from 1938 until the end of the war was forced to negotiate day after day with Eichmann. Despite being the one who knew Eichmann more than anyone else, Murmelstein was never called to testify during the trial against one of the most terrible Nazi executioners. Director Lanzmann met Murmelstein in Rome in 1976 for a long conversation and for the first time he is showing his images.
cast: Claude Lanzmann, Benjamin Murmelstein

title: Le dernier gang
synopsis: In Paris, in the mid-1970s, Simon and the men of his gang swiftly move from petty neighborhood thefts to planning major bank robberies, with the help of Mohamed Badawi, a criminal known in prison. Always miraculously managed to escape police arrest, Simon and Mohamed squander their money on trips to the Tropics and vices, trying to reconcile love with the hits they hit successfully. On their trail, however, there has long been the policeman Milan, obsessed with their capture and pushed by Commissioner Brevard to stop the gang even with the use of force.
cast: Vincent Elbaz, Gilles Lellouche, Sami Bouajila, Clémence Poésy, Pascal Elbé, Patrick Dell'Isola, Grégory Gadebois, Guillaume Viry, Matthieu Boujenah, Gabriella Wright

title: Le dernier loup
synopsis: In 1969, in the midst of the cultural revolution, Chen Zhen, a young student from Beijing, was sent to the interior of Mongolia to teach a nomadic tribe of shepherds. In contact with a reality different from the one he had known up to now, in a boundless desert and breathtaking beauty, Chen discovers that he is the one who has a lot to learn: about existence, about community, about freedom, about the sense of responsibility and about the wolf, the most revered creature of the steppes. Seduced by the complex and almost mystical bond that the shepherds have with the wolf and fascinated by the animal's cunning and strength, Chen captures a puppy and decides to tame it. However, the strong relationship between the two will be threatened by a government official's decision to eliminate all wolves in the region at any cost.
cast: William Feng, Shawn Dou, Ankhnyam Ragchaa, Yin Zhusheng, Basen Zhabu, Baoyingexige

title: Le dernier saut
synopsis: George Garal, a rude paratrooper sergeant and former combatant in Algeria, kills his unfaithful wife and obtains an iron alibi. The police, convinced of his innocence, arrest the woman's young lover as an alleged murderer. Commissioner Jaurin, an introverted man who has just been transferred from Marseille to the province as punishment, is leading the investigation. When Jaurin, who had no doubts about Garal's innocence, fears he will have to change his mind on the basis of some clues that have emerged in the course of the investigation ...
cast: Maurice Ronet, Michel Bouquet, Caty Rosier, Eric Penet

title: Le dernier trappeur
synopsis: In the Yukon Mountains, the life of one of the last hunters, Norman Winther, and his wife, Nebaska, an Indian Nahanni. A documentary film about an existence now as rare as a diamond and the severe and spectacular nature of the Rocky Mountains.
cast: Norman Winther, May Loo, Alex Van Bibber, Ken Bolton, Denny Denison

title: Le dernier vide-grenier de Claire Darling
synopsis: The first day of summer is also the last day of Claire Darling's life. At least this is what the woman is convinced of, who has decided to sell her things on the lawn of the house. While a horde of onlookers and neighbors grab something for a few coins, each object carries with it the echo of Claire's tragic and flaming existence.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Chiara Mastroianni, Alice Taglioni, Samir Guesmi, Laure Calamy, Olivier Rabourdin, Johan Leysen, Colomba Giovanni

title: Le dernier vol
synopsis: French Sahara, 1933. Setting out in search of the man she loves, who disappeared during the flight from London to Capetown, the adventurer and aviator Marie Vallières de Beaumont (Cotillard) is forced to land near a French outpost in the middle of the desert of To keep. They will find the help of Lieutenant Antoine Chauvet and together they will discover a truth for which they were not prepared.
cast: Marion Cotillard, Guillaume Canet, Guillaume Marquet, Frédéric Epaud, Saïdou Abatcha, Michaël Vander Meiren, Swann Arlaud, Halimata Graille, Nabil Imtital, Mohamed Ixa

title: Le dernier voyage
synopsis: Year 2050. The temperatures have reached unbearable levels, most animal species have disappeared, hundreds of millions of people have become climatic refugees and oil, coal and gas reserves are completely exhausted. The sixth mass extinction is no longer a mere hypothesis: it is a reality. While the mysterious Red Luna approaches dangerously to the planet Earth, there is only one man who will be able to save the world: it is Paul W.R., the most talented astronaut of his generation. But, a few hours after the great mission that awaits him, Paul disappears.
cast: Hugo Becker, Jean Reno, Paul Hamy, Lya Oussadit Lessert, Philippe Katerine, Bruno Lochet, Emilie Gavois Kahn, Jean Luc Couchard, Darius Garrivier, Jean Baptiste Blanc

title: Le deuxième souffle
synopsis: Gu Minda, a dangerous criminal, escapes from prison to recover his beloved Manouche and flee far away. The codes of the Underworld and those of the law, however, will make it very difficult even for a tough guy from the past like Gu.
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Monica Bellucci, Michel Blanc, Jaques Dutronc, Eric Cantona, Daniel Duval

title: Le diable au corps
synopsis: WWI. While her husband is fighting at the front, Marthe, a nurse in a military hospital, meets and falls in love with François a much younger student than her. The two, defying all social conventions, become lovers. Their only concern is to be happy and to live their passion freely. Then one day Marthe realizes she is expecting a baby.
cast: Gérard Philipe, Micheline Presle, Jean Debucourt, Jacques Tati

title: Le diable probablement
synopsis: Charles is a Parisian student who lives on his own. He is nonconformist, pacifist and ecologist. While other young people gather to discuss politics, raise awareness or raise public awareness, he understands that all of this is useless because the evil of the world is inextricable and men travel on a ship of fools. Having bought a gun, he asks a drug addict friend to kill him, at night, in the "Père Lachaise" cemetery in Paris.
cast: Antoine Monnier, Tina Irissari, Henri De Maublanc

title: Le diciottenni
synopsis: All the girls in the college are in love with the physics professor Andrea Della Rovere and their diaries, kidnapped by the director, confirm this. After all, the teacher is also pining in secret for one of his students. Who will achieve happiness in love?
cast: Marisa Allasio, Virna Lisi, Anthony Steffen, Luisella Boni, Rina Morelli, Pietro De Vico, Carlo Micheluzzi, Adriana Benetti, Ave Ninchi

title: Le dindon
synopsis: Monsieur de Pontagnac fell in love with a rather young woman. It is Victoire, that he did not know how to be Vatelin's wife, a notary of him friend of him. Monsieur de Pontagnac takes it quite well but not Victoire, which by nature is not so simple to manage: the falling in love has become the subject of discussion in their circle of acquaintances and has given birth to different differences in mutual fidelity. When Rediop, spasimante of Victoire, and Suzy, ex -flame of Vatelin, also come up, the situation becomes even harder to manage.
cast: Holt McCallany, Dany Boon, Alice Pol, Guillaume Gallienne, Laure Calamy, Henri Guybet, Ahmed Sylla, Camille Lellouche, Elisa Ruschke, Esteban

title: Le diner de cons
synopsis: Every Wednesday a group of serious professionals belonging to the upper middle class of Paris must show up for a dinner with a person who can be described as a perfect idiot. Publisher Pierre Brochant believes he identified the victim as François, an accountant at the finance ministry. But on the day of dinner Pierre gets stuck. From the moment François sets foot in the Brochant house, all sorts of things happen.
cast: Jacques Villeret, Thierry Lhermitte, Francis Huster, Catherine Frot

title: Le dolci zie
synopsis: An anarchist grandfather has his free nephew in custody, but three aunts, of which two still likes, obtain the help of a priest and the carabinieri. Thus they take possession of the child and cover it with lust.
cast: Marisa Merlini, Femi Benussi, Pascale Petit, Orchidea De Santis, Mario Maranzana, Jean Claude Vernè, Patrizia Gori, Pupo De Luca

title: Le donne non vogliono più
synopsis: Luca would like a child with his partner Francesca, but she disagrees and therefore the couple falls apart. At a sperm bank, where he wants to leave his in the guarantee of being able to procreate, Luca meets two lesbians, Ricky and Claudia, who want a baby. Agreement made between the three and everything seems to be finally successful; but there is a surprise lurking around the corner.
cast: Pino Quartullo, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Francesca Reggiani, Antonella Ponziani, Jane Alexander (II)

title: Le dossier noir
synopsis: A young magistrate looks for a compromising file for many notables of the provincial town where he was assigned; the dossier had been compiled by his predecessor, who died under suspicious circumstances. Director André Cayatte came to film from the legal profession and has often dealt with issues related to justice and its administration in his films. Here the atmosphere is charged with suspicions and fears for an investigation that digs under the crust of official respectability. Excellent narrative rhythm, which creates a notable dramatic tension (with some twists), and the work of the interpreters.
cast: Bernard Blier, Antoine Balpêtré, Danièle Delorme, Lea Padovani, Jean Marc Bory, Daniel Cauchy, Nelly Borgeaud, Jacques Duby, Noël Roquevert

title: Le doudou
synopsis: Michel lost his daughter's teddy bear at the airport. He then places an ad to find him and offers a reward. Sofiane, an airport employee, sees there an opportunity to earn some money by claiming to have found the puppet. Once he comes out, together with Michel he will set out on the bear's trail, an operation which will prove more complicated than expected and which will teach him a lot about life.
cast: Kad Merad, Malik Bentalha, Romain Lancry, David Salles, Guy Marchand, Isabelle Sadoyan, Lou Chauvain, Enya Baroux

title: Le dritte
synopsis: Ofelia, Erna and Rina are three friends who usually meet occasionally. Different in temperament and character, however, they nurture the same feelings and, above all, the same aspirations. Ofelia, cerebral and sophisticated, is the owner of a fashion boutique; Erna, simple and with a strong maternal sense, is a nurse; Rina, on the other hand, is a housewife. All three wish to get married and set their sights on Hamlet, Hercules and Lello. But the three are terrified of the idea of ??marriage ...
cast: Franco Fabrizi, Sandra Mondaini, Bice Valori, Monica Vitti, Memmo Carotenuto

title: Le droit d'aimer
synopsis: Helene gets permission from prison to see her husband. During the visit, he pretends not to recognize his wife to induce her to leave him. She understands the deception but by now the man, believing that he no longer saw her, gets killed.
cast: Omar Sharif, Florinda Bolkan, Pierre Michael, Jacques Dhéry

title: Le due facce del dollaro
synopsis: Three men and a girl land a smash hit at Fort Henderson; the group, however, is attacked by a gang commanded by Sinclair, a former officer of the garrison, who knows the woman of the quartet well. Insipid spaghetti western, shot by a veteran of Italian Serie B cinema.
cast: Maurice Poli, Jacques Herlin, Gabriella Giorgelli, Gérard Herter, Andrea Bosic, Tom Felleghy, Mario Maranzana, Andrea Scotti, Valentino Macchi, Ferruccio Viotti

title: Le due orfanelle
synopsis: On the threshold of the Revolution, two Parisian adoptive sisters - Enrichetta and Luisa Girard - have to face the hardships of life. The first is kidnapped by a perfidious noble and jealous of his nephew, the second, blind, is exploited and forced to beg by a slut.
cast: Myriam Bru, Milly Vitale, Franco Interlenghi, André Luguet

title: Le due orfanelle
cast: Alida Valli, Maria Denis, Osvaldo Valenti, Roberto Villa, Otello Toso

title: Le due tigri
synopsis: The fanatic leader of the bloodthirsty Indian tribe of the Thugs kidnaps a girl to make her the priestess of the goddess Kali. The father of the unfortunate woman asks Sandokan for help who, with the "tigers", goes in search of her. After various vicissitudes, the decisive battle takes place in the temple of the goddess: fight to the death, extermination of the Thugs and salvation of the girl. Salgari's novel of the same name was one of the cult of adventure literature for those who were, at the time, the right age. Simonelli does all he can to maintain, with the non-pharaonic means at his disposal, the epic and exotic charm.
cast: Massimo Girotti, Luigi Pavese, Sandro Ruffini, Alanova

title: Le due vite di Mattia Pascal
synopsis: Forced by a reversal of fortune to marry a woman he does not love, Mattia Pascal has a troubled marital relationship. After yet another quarrel with his wife, he goes to Monte Carlo where he wins a large sum at the casino. Taking advantage of news that mistakenly gives him for dead, the man settles in Rome under a new identity. But not even this second existence of his will be propitious to him. Neither the choice of having actualized the story nor the choice of having opted for a grotesque dimension that softens the charge of bitterness helps this new transposition of Pirandello's novel for the screen. The film is based on pure craft, by Monicelli and Mastroianni.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Laura Morante, Flavio Bucci, Laura Del Sol

title: Le déclin de l'empire américain
synopsis: Four men and four women from the university environment of French Canada meet for a party in a beautiful country house. The men prepare the food in the kitchen, the women do gymnastics in the gym, and in the meantime we chat. And from the speeches the vanity of useless existences emerges, aimed only at the satisfaction of pleasures while around the world the world collapses. Desolate message of a film that uses the pedal of the grotesque and counterpoint with some beautiful exteriors the useless chatter of characters pervaded by the "great cold" of feelings. The title is ironic, the decline is of the Western world as a whole.
cast: Dominique Michel, Dorothée Berryman, Louise Portal, Pierre Curzi, Rémy Girard, Yves Jacques, Geneviève Rioux, Daniel Brière, Gabriel Arcand, Évelyn Regimbald

title: Le déjeuner sur l'herbe
synopsis: Professor Alexis is a staunch advocate of artificial insemination. Having met the waitress and peasant Nenette, he lives with her a satisfying love story in Provence. A few months later, when he learns she is pregnant, he marries her.
cast: Paul Merisse, Catherine Rouvel, Fernand Sardou, Jacqueline Marane

title: Le départ
synopsis: Marc, an aspiring hairdresser crazy for speed, tries them all to be able to drive a racing car: the night before the race, however, the beautiful Michèle will make him understand that love also exists.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Catherine Duport, Jacqueline Bir, Paul Roland

title: Le désordre et la nuit
synopsis: Inspector Valois is in charge of investigating the death of a nightclub owner. The best lead is Lucky Fridel (Tiller), the victim's girlfriend, a German drug addict. Valois falls in love with her and draws the disapproval of bosses who consider her unprofessional behavior. But Valois is right: the track is right.
cast: Jean Gabin, Danielle Darrieux, Nadja Tiller, Paul Frankeur

title: Le evase - Storie di sesso e di violenze
synopsis: Four women, including a terrorist who as such receives help from outside, manage to escape from a prison. Gravely wounded the terrorist's brother, the fugitives seize a bus bound for a tennis tournament and loaded with a women's team, the president and the driver. The whole group takes refuge in a judge's villa and everything happens in that sort of microcosm of our society. Almost destroying the thin margin between good and bad, the escaped and the hostages or the owners of the house give themselves to embraces, killings, lesbian intercourse, injuries. Finally, all the girls, drunk from the whiskey down, take part in a dramatic orgy in which many people perish.
cast: Lilli Carati, Ines Pellegrini, Zora Keer, Filippo Degara, Franco Ferrer, Dirce Funari

title: Le fabuleux destin d'Amélie Poulain
synopsis: Amélie, a twenty-year-old girl who comes from Montmatre, one day discovers she has a mission to fulfill: to alleviate the pain of others. Even minimal pains and frustrations: the loneliness of the neighbor, left by his partner, or that of the elderly parent who wishes the dwarf of the garden long journeys to exotic countries, the ones he has always dreamed of. At one point Amélie falls in love with someone like her, a guy who fell from the moon who collects fragments of passport photos thrown away. Will prince charming and his fairy live happily ever after?
cast: Audrey Tautou, Mathieu Kassovitz, Rufus, Yolande Moreau, Dominique Pinon, Serge Merlin, Jamel Debbouze, Clotilde Mollet, Claire Maurier, Urbain Cancelier, Maurice Bénichou

title: Le fantôme de la liberté
synopsis: In the prologue, in the year 1808, we witness the shooting of patriots and a grave-profaner officer. Then we move on to the present, and here is a man who shows two little girls "obscene" photos of the monuments of Paris, a murderer set free, the repression of a demonstration that praises the chains ... The social conventions of the bourgeoisie, wickedly overturned , reveal all their absurdity. One of the clearest and most entertaining films of the late Buñuel, which recovers an irreconcilable bitterness together with an Olympic simplicity. The last image is a close-up of a surreal and distant ostrich.
cast: Jean Claude Brialy, Julien Bertheau, Adriana Asti, Michael Lonsdale, Michel Piccoli, Monica Vitti, Jean Rochefort, Milena Vukotic, Bernard Verley, Claude Piéplu, Hélène Perdrière, Paul Frankeur, François Maistre

title: Le faremo tanto male
synopsis: The brothers Marco and Ruggero, the first park ranger, the second gas station attendant, live in a large green reserve in Abruzzo and dedicate their time to protecting nature. Federica Biki, former Italian film star, hosts the program "Occhio al pelo!" on a private broadcaster. The broadcast is a masked teleshopping sponsored by a major fur brand. The two decide to kidnap her and as a ransom they ask for the closure of the lager factory and the release of the animals still alive. But no one believes in the kidnapping, because Federica, to keep the attention on her character alive, has invented scandals, false kidnappings and accidents.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Pino Quartullo, Ricky Memphis, Rocco Barbaro

title: Le farò da padre
synopsis: The young Roman lawyer Saverio Mazzacolli has great ideas on how to speculate in construction, but little money to implement them. He wants to build a tourist village for rich people and to do this he tries to exploit the knowledge of the wealthy Countess Raimonda Spina. Determined to want her money at all costs, he kidnaps her retarded daughter. But passion is around the corner.
cast: Irene Papas, Gigi Proietti, Teresa Ann Savoy, Isa Miranda, Bruno Cirino

title: Le fate
synopsis: "Sabina, a hitchhiker, proves insatiable despite three rapes. Armenia courts a health care doctor but, at the right moment, she slips away. Elena cheats on her husband with a guest, who, however, was perhaps at the same time betrayed by his wife. Marta. , wife of a famous surgeon, loses all inhibitions when she has drunk and gives herself over to the waiter; only to forget everything when she becomes sober. The names (of the directors, of the female and male performers) are certainly not to be thrown away, but the thickness of the episodes doesn't go much beyond that of jokes. And the characters have, more or less, the consistency of shadows. You save your job. "
cast: Monica Vitti, Raquel Welch, Capucine, Claudia Cardinale, Enrico Maria Salerno, Anthony Steel, Gastone Moschin, Jean Sorel, Alberto Sordi
director: Mauro Bolognini, Mario Monicelli, Antonio Pietrangeli, Luciano Salce

title: Le fate ignoranti
synopsis: A young couple, obviously well-off, perhaps happy, but with a somewhat flattened harmony in the bon ton. He dies suddenly and Antonia isolates herself in a broken silence until she discovers that he had a mistress. But who turns out to be a lover, a man, Michele, as heartbroken as she is and much more resentful. Antonia comes into contact with the "ignorant fairies", a group of bizarre, different (not only homosexuals), refugees, sick (of AIDS and love), who animate Michele's "family".
cast: Margherita Buy, Stefano Accorsi, Gabriel Garko, Erika Blanc, Serra Yilmaz, Andrea Renzi, Koray Candemir, Lucrezia Valia, Filippo Nigro, Ivan Bacchi

title: Le fatiche di Ercole
synopsis: The strong-willed Hercules does all he can to bring Jason, the legitimate ruler of the kingdom of Thessaly to the throne, defeating the perfidious usurper Pelias. In order to officially consecrate him king, he also helps him recover the fabulous Golden Fleece, the official symbol of royal power. Hercules finds his personal reward in the love for the beautiful Jole, daughter of Pelias, who goes away with him.
cast: Steve Reeves, Sylva Koscina, Gianna Maria Canale, Gabriele Antonini

title: Le faux magistrat
synopsis: Fantômas is sentenced to life imprisonment in Belgium, where there is no death penalty. However Juve, convinced that his diabolical opponent can escape at the first opportunity, decides to make him flee and then capture him as soon as he returns to France. But Fantômas has other plans ...
cast: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, Mesnery, Laurent Morléas

title: Le favole iniziano a Cabras
synopsis: A journey within one of the most famous and at the same time mysterious Mediterranean islands: Sardinia. The fascinating island is told by some of its most representative artists as well as by some other personalities who have made not only their profession but also their purpose of the art of life: of the poets, of the musicians, a solitary navigator, a famous sculptor , of the actors of experimental theater, but also a famous designer and a naturalist photographer. Through their gaze, Sardinia is discovered not only but also what perhaps is at the origin of the art itself: beauty, passion and desire to live.
cast: Antonello Grimaldi, Antonio Marras, Pinuccio Sciola, Gaetano Mura, Gavino Murgia

title: Le favolose
synopsis: The disavowal of one's identity remains a second death for many trans, that of their memory. Families are ashamed and so funeral, ceremony and burial take place secretly between a few close, hastily tampered with in the aesthetics, and Gianna becomes Gianni, Luciana Luciano, Francisca Francisco. In this way nobody can recognize them anymore. Their name as a man is printed on the plaque, in an identity that will never be the one that they chosen during them the earthly life. This is what happens to Antonia, buried with her name of baptism, Giampaolo, in the indifference of the most. Twenty years later, the discovery of a letter pushes his best friends, Porpora and Nicole, to organize a meeting place for the memorable royal family, the group of elected in the boundless trans constellation, to relive a whole day all together in the historical apartment , as they did in the fabulous weekends of many years earlier. Although at the beginning they keep it hidden, the truth of the meeting is to organize a spirit session that allows Antonia to return temporarily to Earth. Only in this way will it be possible to give it a worthy burial: a joyful funeral, where the songs and prayers are replaced with tears and dances, and where Antonia will finally be able to return to wearing her green dress. A party that will also be a revenge for her and for all those people of whom there is nothing more than a vague memory, lost, pulverized in the bare earth, under plague that do not belong to anyone.

title: Le feu follet
synopsis: Alain, intoxicated by alcohol and tired of his own existence, has only two days left to live. Meetings with friends give him the exact feeling of the absolute strangeness between himself and the rest of the world. Exasperated, Alain takes refuge from his friend Dubourg, who advises him to find someone who can understand his drama. The meeting with Jeanne confirms his inability to live, and not even Solange is able to allay his anguish. At this point Alain is left with only one desperate solution.
cast: Maurice Ronet, Jeanne Moreau, Lena Skerla, Yvonne Clech

title: Le fiamme del paradiso. Le flame del paradis
synopsis: Between the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, against the backdrop of the majestic natural scenery of the Val di Non, the mountaineers entrusted themselves to the care of Zappina, a young farmer who lives with her goat and knows the virtues of medicinal herbs. And it is on her, free and generous, that the wickedness of the villagers converge ...
cast: Roberta Fattor, Massimo Paoli, Miriam Rossi, Andrea Castelli

title: Le fils
synopsis: In an institute for the recovery of children who have come out of the reformatory, the educator Olivier anxiously welcomes sixteen-year-old Francis, assigned to the carpentry. The man spies on him, establishes a close relationship with him, then talks about it to his ex-wife and everything becomes dramatically clear ...
cast: Olivier Gourmet, Morgan Marinne, Isabella Soupart

title: Le fils
synopsis: Angel, a gangster of Corsican origin, is reached in New York by the news that his mother is seriously ill with the heart. Back in his hometown, which he has been missing for ten years, he feels the old feeling for his ex-girlfriend Maria is reborn. Little by little he discovers that his father's death was not accidental and that a conflict of interest hides behind his disappearance. Meanwhile, two hit men are waiting for the right moment to kill him ...
cast: Yves Montand, Lea Massari, Marcel Bozzuffi, Germaine Delbat

title: Le fils de Jean
synopsis: Mathieu is 35 years old, lives in Paris and has never met his father. His mother has always told him that he is the result of a chance encounter but, one day, Mathieu discovers through a phone call that his father was Canadian and that he has just died. He also discovers that he has two half-brothers and decides to go to his parent's funeral to meet them. Once in Montreal, however, he realizes that no one is aware of his existence nor is interested in him. He thus finds himself alone in an environment that is completely hostile to him.
cast: Pierre Deladonchamps, Gabriel Arcand, Pierre Yves Cardinal, Romane Portail, Catherine De Léan, Marie Thérèse Fortin, Patrick Hivon, Valérie Cadieux, Jean Pierre Andréani, Martin Laroche

title: Le fils de Joseph
synopsis: A young man sets out in search of the father he has never known. He identifies it in a cynical and Machiavellian publisher in Paris. After trying to assassinate him, he finds the paternal love he never knew in his uncle Joseph, thanks to which he is able to recreate an ideal family that has his pivot in his father surrogate.
cast: Victor Ezenfis, Fabrizio Rongione, Natacha Régnier, Mathieu Amalric, Maria De Medeiros, Jacques Bonnaffé, Dominique Blanc

title: Le fils de l'autre
synopsis: Joseph prepares to do military service for the Israeli army when he discovers he is not the biological son of Orith and Alon, the parents he never doubted. At the time of birth, he was exchanged for Yacine, a newborn baby from a Palestinian couple living in the West Bank. The discovery of what happened that day brutally interrupts the tranquility of both families, forced to reconsider their identities, their values ??and the things they have always believed in.
cast: Emmanuelle Devos, Pascal Elbé, Bruno Podalydès, Jules Sitruk, Mehdi Dehbi, Ezra Dagan, Areen Omari, Khalifa Natour, Mahmoud Shalabi, Tamar Shem Or

title: Le finte bionde
synopsis: In the perennial search for social promotion, some couples of the Roman middle class are preparing to move from their popular neighborhood to a more chic one. Their only occupation and obsession is to "be there": at cocktails, at parties, in Cortina as well as on the Costa Smeralda. The girls form groups and go to the same hairdresser (where they get oxygenated) and where they spend their time gossiping. The film would like to be a satire of a certain Roman environment where appearance triumphs over substance. In reality, the complaint is immediately lost in the aping of behaviors that soon become specks.
cast: Cinzia Bonfantini, Alessandra Casella, Massimo Wertmüller, Sergio Vastano, Guido Nicheli, Cinzia Leone

title: Le flic de Belleville
synopsis: Born in Belleville, Baaba Keita has become a police inspector, determined to stay in his neighborhood out of the desperation of his girlfriend, who wants to finally set up a home with him. Baaba is struggling to get away from her invasive mother when one night Roland, a childhood friend of hers, is killed in front of her eyes. Roland worked for the French Consulate in Miami and was in Paris on an investigation into drug trafficking. To find her killer, Baaba flies to the United States with her mother, who she cannot leave alone. Here, he can count on the help of Ricardo, a policeman who is as tired as he is irascible.
cast: Omar Sy, Luis Guzmán, Franck Gastambide, Eriq Ebouaney, Paulina Gálvez, Joseph Velez, Diana Wiswell, Edson Jean, Tatum Price, Justin Smith

title: Le fond de l'air est rouge
synopsis: From the Vietnam War to the coup in Chile: eight voices comment on the discarded sequences of a film, alongside images abused and swallowed up by television communication.

title: Le formiche della città morta
synopsis: Simon Pietro is a drug addict rapper who lives in Rome, is without a job and has a big debt to the violent Alfio. His days pass between drug dealing and drug use and memories of a life and a love now belonging to the past. Around Simon Peter in a ruthless city moves a community of equally desperate people, a microcosm of characters who like him to make a living.
cast: Simon Pietro Manzari, Rachele Romano, Nina Torresi, Gaia Mottironi, Alfio Pileggi

title: Le foto di Gioia
synopsis: In the villa of Gioia, owner of a magazine for men only, a model is murdered, witness a paralyzed boy who lives in the adjacent house. The first murder is followed by others, accompanied by photographic messages and threats against Gioia. The police suspect Flora, the owner of a competing magazine, but the reality is quite different and it will be the paralytic neighbor who will resolve the situation at the last minute.
cast: Serena Grandi, Capucine, Daria Nicolodi, Sabrina Salerno, Vanni Corbellini, David Brandon, George Eastman, Trine Michelsen, Karl Zinny, Lino Salemme

title: Le foto proibite di una signora per bene
synopsis: The young minou is married to Pierre, industrial on the verge of bankruptcy. The girl is persecuted by a maniac, which blackmail her claiming that the consort is a murderer. To snatch the alleged proof of the crime, the woman is forced to submit to her cravings, but the situation only makes worsen: now the blackma with the photographic tests of Minou's betrayal. Exasperated, the woman confesses the truth to her husband, who, however, does not believe in her story, nor to the existence of the blackmailed. By now on the verge of madness, Minou discovers that the diabolical intrigue has been hatched by Pierre himself, who wants to use the maniac to get rid of her and pocket the life insurance prize.
cast: Dagmar Lassander, Pier Paolo Capponi, Simon Andreu, Osvaldo Genazzani, Salvador Huguet, Nieves Navarro

title: Le frise ignoranti
synopsis: Luca is part of the "Ignorant Frize", a musical group made up of ramshackle young people who come together to share joys and sorrows. The Frize will leave for a picaresque journey on the roads of Puglia and Basilicata in search of Mimmo, Luca's father, who disappeared after learning he had a tumor.
cast: William Volpicella, Nicola Nocella, Davide Donatello, Giorgio Gallo, Dario Bandiera, Lino Banfi, Rosanna Banfi, Eva Riccobono, Francesco Pannofino, Federica Cifola, Rosanna Sparapano, Federica Sarno

title: Le frisson des vampires
cast: Sandra Julien, Jean Marie Durand, Jacques Robiolles, Marie Pierre Tricot

title: Le gai savoir
synopsis: The student Emile Rousseau was hit by a bullet fired by a paratroop unit but saved by a copy of the Cahiers du Cinèma that he kept under his jacket while Patricia, on the other hand, is a recently hunted Citroen worker. The two decide to start a life together again.
cast: Juliet Berto, Jean Pierre Léaud

title: Le gamin au vélo
synopsis: Cyril is only 12 years old and has a fixed idea: to find his father who has temporarily left him in a children's home. On his way he accidentally finds Samantha, who has a hairdressing shop and accepts that he stays with her on the weekends. However, Cyril is unable to appreciate and understand the love that this woman offers him, blinded by anger and feelings of abandonment.
cast: Cécile De France, Thomas Doret, Jérémie Rénier, Olivier Gourmet

title: Le gendarme en balade
synopsis: Marshal Cruchot and five colleagues discharged from the gendarmerie of Saint Tropez cannot bear the new life of retirees. When one of the group loses his memory, with the excuse of making him return as before, the others decide to wear the uniform again (and illegally). It is inevitable that these attempts are also accompanied by some "environmental" disasters.
cast: Louis De Funès, Jean Lefebvre, Guy Grosso, Michel Modo

title: Le gendarme et les extra-terrestres
cast: Louis De Funès, Michel Galabru, Maurice Risch, Jean Pierre Rambal

title: Le gendarme se marie
synopsis: The sergeant of the gendarmerie Cruchot falls in love with the widow of a colonel who pushes him to ask for a change of rank. For a computer breakdown, Cruchot is promoted and can bully former superior Gerber, but the parties are turned upside down when the mistake comes to light. Another series of misunderstandings will then allow the sergeant to capture a fugitive and obtain, together with the promotion, the hand of the ambitious beloved. Louis De Funès, with his extraordinary grumpy mask, was the most popular French comedian of the seventies, rarely indulged, as in this case, by screenplays at the height of his potential.
cast: Louis De Funès, Jean Lefebvre, Geneviève Grad, Christian Marin, Yves Vincent, Guy Grosso, Michel Modo, Maurizio Bonuglia, Mario David

title: Le gendarme à New York
synopsis: The Brigadier Cruchot, of the French gendarmerie of Saint Tropez, is invited to New York together with some colleagues for an international conference of police bodies. Despite his ban, in the American metropolis he follows him in incognito his daughter Nicole, a true champion in the art of ficca in trouble.
cast: Louis De Funès, Michel Galabru, Christian Marin, Guy Grosso

title: Le gendre de ma vie
synopsis: Stéphane and Suzanne are the parents of three young women. Everything in their lives proceeds for the best but Stéphane has always regretted the regret of not having had a male child. To fill his frustration, he easily binds to his boyfriends of his daughters. So, when his younger daughter Alexia decides to leave Thomas (magnificent rugby player and father's idol) for a young doctor he can't stand, Stéphane will have some difficulties in accepting the situation.
cast: Kad Merad, Pauline Etienne, Julie Gayet, François Deblock, Zabou Breitman, Guillaume Labbe, Chloé Jouannet, Louise Coldefy, Jérémy Lopez, Zoé Marchal

title: Le genou de Claire
synopsis: On the eve of the wedding, Jérome meets Claire, identifies in her knee the "magnetic pole" of his desire and tries in every way to caress it. He does not hesitate to tell her that he has seen her boyfriend, Gilles, with another woman and, in the moment of despair of Claire, here is the famous caress. Jérome deludes himself that he has managed to separate Claire from Gilles, whom he deems unsuitable for her. One of Rohmer's most fascinating films for its thematic richness, for its narrative elegance and for the subtle perfidy that runs through it in the analysis of the behavior of the characters, especially adults, of their fragile and transient certainties.
cast: Jean Claude Brialy, Aurora Cornu, Béatrice Romand, Laurence De Monaghan

title: Le gentleman d'Epsom
synopsis: Richard, a former cavalry officer and horse enthusiast, now lives on petty cheating and scams against the naive racers. One day when he is completely broke he meets an old friend, and just to make a good impression ...
cast: Jean Gabin, Madeleine Robinson, Louis De Funès, Franck Villard

title: Le giraffe
synopsis: Roberta and Michela Tiberi - the first from Rome, the second from Milan - almost accidentally discover that they are sisters, daughters of the same father (recently deceased, at whose bedside they meet) and of different mothers. Michela is going through a difficult time from a financial point of view, and for her the hospitality offered by Roberta is a breath of fresh air. The relationship between the two will not be easy, and surprises - especially in the finale - will not be lacking ...
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Veronica Pivetti, Alessandro Di Carlo, Paola Tiziana Cruciani

title: Le gitan
synopsis: For more than two years, Hugo Sennart, "the Gypsy", leader of a gang of robbers in league with Jo and Jacques, his escape companions, has kept Commissioner Blot and the police in check. Novello Robin Hood, decides to take revenge for the injustices committed against his people by donating the fruit of his robberies to nomads ...
cast: Alain Delon, Annie Girardot, Marcel Bozzuffi, Paul Meurisse, Renato Salvatori, Maurice Barrier, Michel Fortin, Bernard Giraudeau

title: Le glaive et la balance
cast: Anthony Perkins, Jean Claude Brialy, Renato Salvatori, Pascale Audret

title: Le grand alibi
synopsis: Henri Pages is an influential politician who receives guests at his country house one weekend with his wife Elaine. Among these are Pierre Collier, a psychoanalyst, and his unhappy wife Claire, as well as many others, variously linked to each other also by present or past romantic relationships. Pierre is found dead in the pool, with Claire holding the still smoking gun. Yet Lieutenant Grange is by no means certain that the case is as simple as it appears. And perhaps many other guests had good reasons for wanting the psychoanalyst dead.
cast: Miou Miou, Lambert Wilson, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Pierre Arditi, Anne Consigny, Mathieu Demy, Caterina Murino, Maurice Bénichou, Céline Sallette, Agathe Bonitzer

title: Le grand bain
synopsis: Bertrand, a depressed 40-year-old, finds a new meaning in his life when he decides to join a men's synchronized swimming team. For each of the components, the workouts represent an outlet and a safe haven. Together, they feel stronger and stronger and this leads them to want to grab a crazy goal: participation in the world championships.
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Guillaume Canet, Philippe Katerine, Benoît Poelvoorde, Jean Hugues Anglade, Alban Ivanov, Balasingham Thamilchelvan, Virginie Efira, Leïla Bekhti, Marina Foïs, Noée Abita, Jonathan Zaccaï, Mélanie Doutey

title: Le grand bazar
synopsis: After being fired from a mechanical mower factory, our heroes plan to help Émile, a small shop owner, save himself from competition from a nearby supermarket. Of course they will combine all the colors.
cast: Les Charlots, Michel Galabru, Michel Serrault, Gérard Rinaldi

title: Le grand blond avec une chaussure noire
synopsis: A violinist one day unexpectedly wears two different types of shoes, something that does not escape the espionage that makes him the object of a fight between two French bigwigs.
cast: Pierre Richard, Bernard Blier, Jean Rochefort, Mireille Darc

title: Le grand cahier
synopsis: During the final stages of World War II, people in large European cities are at the mercy of air strikes and starvation. A desperate young mother leaves her thirteen-year-old twin sons in the countryside in the home of their alcoholic and cruel grandmother. Called by the inhabitants the witch for having poisoned her husband some time before, the woman raises the boys in an inhuman and absurd environment where the only resource for them to survive is to learn to become insensitive and ruthless. To fortify body and spirit, the two brothers begin reading the Bible, learning foreign languages ??and practicing endurance exercises, holding their hands over the fire, cutting themselves with a knife and learning not to hear insults. In addition, they also keep a detailed diary of the war events they witness, a text in which every word is deprived of emotional charge and subjective evaluations.
cast: András Gyémánt, László Gyémánt, Piroska Molnár, Ulrich Matthes, Ulrich Thomsen, Lajos Kovács, Orsolya Tóth, János Derzsi, Miklós Székely B., Diana Kiss, Péter Andorai, Gyongyver Bognar

title: Le grand chariot
synopsis: Three brothers carry on the family puppet theater together with his grandmother and father. When the latter dies, just during a show, all the others are busy to keep the business standing.
cast: Louis Garrel, Esther Garrel, Aurélien Recoing, Francine Bergé, Léna Garrel, Mathilde Weil, Asma Messaoudene, Damien Mongin

title: Le grand chef
synopsis: Antonio and Paolo are two poor people who make a living by washing cars. To raise some money and open a gas station, they decide to kidnap the son of an industrialist. Helped by two friends (the determined Paola and the shy Antonia), they successfully succeed in their intent. The child, however, turns out to be very pestiferous: the two then decide to get rid of him as soon as possible, demanding his ransom, but the parents do not wish to take him back. Desperate, the kidnappers come to a compromise ...
cast: Fernandel, Gino Cervi, Jean Jacques Delbo, Noelle Norman

title: Le grand escogriffe
synopsis: Emilio, theatrical impresario several times imprisoned for fraud, this time aims high. With the complicity of a young partner and an actress, he kidnaps the son of an oilman, replacing him with a nice urchin: but this time too the plan goes up in smoke, because the oilman prefers to keep the new child much more sympathetic than the legitimate one, while accomplices understand that life is not for them. Comedy of good feelings and poor results directed by the future director of Il tempo delle mele.
cast: Yves Montand, Agostina Belli, Claude Brasseur, Adolfo Celi, Aldo Maccione, Valentina Cortese, Guy Marchand, Ely Galleani, Gianni Cavina

title: Le grand jour
synopsis: The big day of the test is approaching. Four little heroes know that that special day will change their lives forever and that the ordeal will decide not only their fate but also the fate of their families. After so much effort, attention and persistence, they know they are about to make their dreams come true. Despite the adverse conditions in which they found themselves, they now have only one goal: success.

title: Le grand rôle
synopsis: Maurice Kurtz gets the role of Shylock in the Merchant of Venice that director Rudolph Grichenberg came to shoot in Paris. When he informs his girlfriend Pearl of the news, she reveals that she has only a few months left to live. Maurice makes her believe he has accepted the role, in reality he wants to dedicate himself only to her.
cast: Stéphane Freiss, Bérénice Bejo, Peter Coyote

title: Le grand voyage
synopsis: Mustapha, an elderly Moroccan living in France, asks his son Réda to accompany him on the ritual journey to Mecca that every Muslim must make at least once in their life. The two set off together by car for a journey of 5000 km which will represent for them the opportunity for a confrontation that had been missed until then.
cast: Nicolas Cazalé, Mohamed Majd, Jacky Nercessian, Kamel Belghazi

title: Le grida del silenzio
synopsis: A group of young people from "Roma bene" organizes a "wild" weekend with the aim of spending two days in the midst of nature. Each of them has a very specific purpose to disconnect a little from the city and from the daily routine. They are apparently happy and satisfied with their life, but nothing is as always, reality is never what it appears. It all stems from a bet by the two leaders of the group, Daniel and Luca: the beautiful Cuban Karhrina is up for grabs. The others are the homosexual couple formed by Desirée and Sophie and the one formed by Alice, a dreamer girl linked to nature, the wind and distant worlds, and Manuel, a practical and precise ex boy scout. But an omen hangs over the seven boys. That night, in fact, will change their lives forever.
cast: Alice Bellagamba, Luca Avallone, Manuela Zero, Roberto Calabrese, Ana Cruz Martina Carletti, Luca Molinari, Sasha Alessandra Carlesi, Lucia Batassa, Giuseppe Milazzo Andreani, Gegia, Ivan Castiglione, Cosetta Turco, Beppe Convertini, Patrizia Pellegrino, Giuseppe Cantore, Roberta Garzia

title: Le guignolo
synopsis: Released before his time because he promised to find a job, Alexandre Dupré, who as a profession has chosen to be a thief and a swindler, embarks on a cruise ship full of billionaires disguised as a sailor. Among the wealthy tourists he spots a young and beautiful widow. When he discovers that the woman does the same job as her, he decides to ally with her. It is a film made to measure for Belmondo, who wallows in the story.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Michel Galabru, George Geret, Carla Romanelli

title: Le gôut des autres
synopsis: Castella is a wealthy businessman deeply bored by the monotonous life he leads with his wife, an interior designer. In order to close a deal, he has to take English lessons from a teacher. The lessons and the woman turn out to be too boring, and so Castella decides to quit. But one evening, dragged by force to the theater, he is shocked by an actress and by the lines of Racine's _Bérénice_. Castella is so upset that he takes it into his head to be an actor: and when he discovers that the interpreter who has struck him is none other than his English teacher, he decides to return to attend her ...
cast: Jean Pierre Bacri, Agnès Jaoui, Anne Alvaro, Alain Chabat, Brigitte Catillon

title: Le hasard et la violence
synopsis: The criminologist Laurent Berman became famous with an essay entitled "Le hasard et la violence" which had a resounding success with the public and critics. Now Laurent is on the French Riviera where he divides his time between a well-deserved rest, work on his next book and his relationship with Dr. Constance Weber. Then a homicidal maniac takes care of his life.
cast: Yves Montand, Katharine Ross, Antonio Casagrande, Catherine Allégret, Sergio Fantoni, Jean Claude Dauphin, Giuseppe Addobbati, Riccardo Mangano, Massimo De Rossi, Corinne Puccar

title: Le huitième jour
synopsis: Harry, accomplished at work, but with a precarious family situation, accidentally meets Georges, a Down boy who has escaped from an institution. The man invites him to his home and grows fond of him. Between the two, different from every point of view, a very deep bond is born. Thanks to this meeting, Harry's life will change radically.
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Pascal Duquenne, Miou Miou, Isabelle Sadoyan

title: Le hérisson
synopsis: Paloma and Renée live in an elegant Parisian palace inhabited by upper-class families. The first is a mature twelve-year-old daughter of a minister and determined to commit suicide; the second a concierge, considered by all to be sloppy, uneducated and couch potato, but in reality a refined self-taught, expert in Japanese art, philosophy and culture. Thanks to the mysterious Mr. Ozu, the two will get to know each other: an encounter that will change their lives.
cast: Josiane Balasko, Garance Le Guillermic, Togo Igawa, Anne Brochet, Ariane Ascaride, Wladimir Yordanoff, Sarah Lepicard, Jean Luc Porraz, Gisèle Casadesus, Mona Heftre

title: Le héros de la famille
synopsis: Gabriel, the elderly owner of the Blue Parrot night club in Nice, dies suddenly and leaves the place as an inheritance to his sons Nino and Marianne, who return to the city followed by their respective mothers, devoured by a rivalry that has never subsided. The two half-brothers will have to struggle between the fierce parents and the management of a place they have never wanted ...
cast: Gérard Lanvin, Catherine Deneuve, Emmanuelle Béart, Miou Miou, Michael Cohen, Géraldine Pailhas, Claude Brasseur, Valérie Lemercier, Pierrick Lilliu, Gilles Lellouche

title: Le impiegate stradali - Batton story
synopsis: Gathered in a cell by a police round-up, three prostitutes decide that the time has come to defend their rights. Once out, they gather some 'colleagues' and found the trade union of the category. Those who lose out are obviously the protectors, who in turn form a team.
cast: Femi Benussi, Marisa Merlini, Daniela Giordano, Gianni Dei, Toni Ucci, Giorgio Caldarelli, Gianni Cajafa, Mariangela Giordano

title: Le infedeli
synopsis: The decision of an industrialist to have his wife stalked, in the hope that some infidelity of his will offer him the pretext for obtaining a divorce and he can therefore marry a model he has fallen in love with, is the move from which the description of a context of illicit relationships, blackmail, theft, silence and suffocated scandals. The culmination of this situation will be murder.
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Anna Maria Ferrero, Pierre Cressoy, May Britt

title: Le inibizioni del dottor Gaudenzi, vedovo con il complesso..
cast: Carlo Giuffrè, Françoise Prevost, Saro Urzì, Katia Christine

title: Le insaziabili/Femmine insaziabili
synopsis: In America, the journalist Paolo meets Giulio, an old friend: the latter's mysterious murder will lead him to start a private investigation, which will lead him to discover details that are anything but edifying about the past of the murdered. Meanwhile, Paolo weaves an ambiguous relationship both with an attractive lady and with her daughter, a teenager eager to forge the stages of her sexual initiation.
cast: Robert Hoffman, Dorothy Malone, John Ireland, Romina Power

title: Le intermittenze del cuore
synopsis: A director prepares a film about the life of Proust. while the writing work proceeds, the man reviews some salient moments of his life: the abandonment of the partisan struggle, falling in love with a woman who, years later, does not even recognize, the relationship with his twenty-year-old son ...
cast: Clément Sibony, Hector Alterio, Assumpta Serna, Florence Darel

title: Le italiane e l'amore
synopsis: The film consists of eleven episodes inspired by real events and taken from some letters sent to the column of the small post of the weeklies. The intent of the directors, among others, Marco Ferreri, Dino Risi and Vancini, was to testify to the condition of women in the years of the economic boom.
cast: Attori Non Professionisti
director: Nelo Risi, Lorenza Mazzetti, Piero Nelli, Francesco Maselli, Giulio Questi, Gianfranco Mingozzi, Marco Ferreri, Florestano Vancini, Carlo Musso, Giulio Macchi, Gian Vittorio Baldi

title: Le jeu avec le feu
synopsis: The banker De Saxe, blackmailed for the not yet kidnapping of his daughter Caroline, listens to the advice of a member of the gang and hides her in a luxury pension. Wandering through the halls, the girl discovers that she is a prisoner of a luxury rendezvous house where young kidnapped women are locked up. Meanwhile, the banker gets in touch with Commissioner Laurent to set a trap for the kidnappers.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Philippe Noiret, Anicée Alvina, Sylvia Kristel

title: Le jeu de la mort
synopsis: A sample of 80 French is selected to take part in the quiz «La zone Xtrême», unaware that it is a total staging. The participants, seated on a comfortable armchair complete with a colored button, are entrusted with the sadistic task of punishing, with electric shocks, the wrong answers given by the fake competitor. The more the stakes are raised, the more the intensity of the shock grows, up to 450 volts. There will be those who will hesitate and those who will oppose but in the end 80% of the participants will come to press the fatal button.

title: Le jeune Ahmed
synopsis: In modern-day Belgium, Ahmed is a young fanatic of Maghrebi origin who, fresh out of childhood, intends to kill his teacher in the name of his religion. How can the love of life overcome his desire to cause someone's death?
cast: Idir Ben Addi, Olivier Bonnaud, Myriem Akheddiou, Victoria Bluck, Claire Bodson, Othmane Moumen

title: Le jeune Karl Marx
synopsis: At 26, Karl Marx leads his wife Jenny on the roads of exile. In 1844 in Paris he met the young Friedrich Engels, the son of a factory owner who studied the birth of the English proletariat. The dandy Friedrich helps to give Karl the missing piece of the puzzle that constitutes the new reading of the world. Together, between censorship and police raids, they will be able to implement the greatest theoretical and political transformation since the Renaissance.
cast: August Diehl, Eric Godon, Vicky Krieps, Rolf Kanies, Olivier Gourmet, Hannah Steele, Stephen Hogan, Denis Lyons, Stefan Konarske, Aran Bertetto

title: Le jouet
synopsis: François Perrin, a journalist looking for a long-time permanent job and professional achievement, is sent for a report at a toy department store. As he wanders around the place looking for ideas for his article, he is noticed by Eric, the capricious son of Pierre, the billionaire who owns the weekly that François works for. The brat demands the journalist as a personal gift, who is then packed and sent to the family villa.
cast: Pierre Richard, Michel Bouquet, Fabrice Gréco, Suzy Dyson

title: Le jour attendra
synopsis: Milan and Victor once knew each other well. Owners of some Paris nightclubs, for many years they cut off all contacts until they are forced to change their minds. Serki, the man they had sent to jail in Mexico for an illegal business that went wrong, is back on the loose and intends to take revenge. Milan and Victor have no alternative but to join forces and seek a solution during an eventful night traveling around a changed world compared to how they remembered it. With dangers on every street corner and Serki at their ribs, the two old friends face the reasons that led to their separation and the lies that poison their lives, making irreversible choices that call 30 years of their lives into question.
cast: Jacques Gamblin, Olivier Marchal, Carlo Brandt, Reda Kateb, Igor Skreblin, Francis Renaud, Anne Charrier, James Kazama, Laure Marsac, Sophie Meister

title: Le jour de gloire
synopsis: A former child king, Adrien had great ambitions for his future. However, as he approaches thirty, he sees his life going in a different direction than he had anticipated. In addition to a non-existent love life, he is kicked out of his home and forced to return to his parents. With an acting career never taken off and morale low, Adrien meets pretty young Lea at a police station and overhears her about auditioning to play Charles de Gaulle as a young man.
cast: Vincent Lacoste, Emmanuelle Devos, Christopher Lambert, Noée Abita, Vincent Furic, Pierre Léon Luneau

title: Le jour et l'heure
synopsis: During the German occupation, a French widow falls in love with an American paratrooper that resistance tries to make expatriate in Spain. Crudeness and feelings that touch the melodrama.
cast: Simone Signoret, Stuart Whitman, Michel Piccoli

title: Le journal d'une femme de chambre
synopsis: First half of the 1920s. The Parisian Célestine finds a job as a waitress with a wealthy provincial family. She is forced to face the advances of the fetishist landlord, among other things she discovers that the gardener Monteil is a maniac who kills little girls. The social rise of the woman is accomplished when she manages to marry a doting officer.
cast: Jeanne Moreau, Georges Géret, Michel Piccoli, Françoise Lugagne

title: Le juge et l'assassin
cast: Philippe Noiret, Michel Galabru, Isabelle Huppert, Jean Claude Brialy

title: Le lac des morts vivants
synopsis: In a small village in France, German soldiers, murdered by the Resistors and thrown into a lake ten years earlier during the Second World War, come back to life to take revenge on the mayor, who ordered their execution. Journalist Katya Moore is interested in the story and the attacks of the Nazi zombies.
cast: Howard Vernon, Pierre Marie Escourrou, Anouchka, Antonio Mayans, Lynn Monteil, Youri Radionow, Bertrand Altmann, Gilda Arancio, Marcia Sharif, Yvonne Dany

title: Le leggi del desiderio
synopsis: Giovanni, acrobatic motivational trainer, to demonstrate the truthfulness of his theories accepts the challenge of bringing three lucky people to success, thus realizing their deepest desires. Except that with Matilde, one of his three students, the meeting will take an unexpected path that will change the lives of both.
cast: Silvio Muccino, Nicole Grimaudo, Paola Tiziana Cruciani, Maurizio Mattioli, Carla Signoris, Luca Ward, Bebo Storti, Federica Sarno

title: Le legioni di Cleopatra
synopsis: The inevitable clash between the two former triumvirs Antonio and Ottaviano has been looming for some time. The first has long since settled in the palace of Cleopatra, the queen of Egypt. Here the centurion Curridius arrives incognito and has the task of avoiding the conflict. However, his mission fails and, in the great battle of Actium, the Egyptian army is annihilated.
cast: Linda Cristal, Ettore Manni, Georges Marchal, Corrado Sanmartin

title: Le lion
synopsis: Kenya, 1950s: Patricia is ten years old and lives with her parents John and Sybil in the nature reserve administered by her father. Always used to playing carefree with the wild animals of the savannah, Patricia has developed a special relationship with King, a huge lion who over time has become her inseparable companion ...
cast: Alain Delon, Ornella Muti, Anouchka Delon, Heino Ferch, Putla Sehlapelo

title: Le lion
synopsis: To help him find his lost girlfriend, Romain, doctor of a psychiatric hospital, has no choice but to let Léo Milan run away, one of the patients who claims to be a secret agent. However, he is not sure he made the right decision: is Léo really a secret agent known with the nickname "Leone" or is he just a great liar?
cast: Dany Boon, Philippe Katerine, Anne Serra, Samuel Jouy, Sophie Verbeeck, Stana Roumillac, Olivier Sa, Benoît Pétré, Christian Diaz

title: Le locataire
synopsis: A modest employee of Polish descent, Trelkovski, is looking for an apartment in Paris. He finds one of a girl, Simone Choule, who attempted suicide by jumping out of the window. Trelkovski goes to the hospital where the girl is dying. Having taken possession of the room, he begins to be subjected to a series of harassment by the tenants (almost all elderly with a disturbing appearance).
cast: Roman Polanski, Isabelle Adjani, Melvyn Douglas, Shelley Winters

title: Le loup et le lion
synopsis: Upon his grandfather's death, Alma, a twenty -year -old pianist, returns to the house where he spent his childhood, on a remote island of Canada. Here, everything changes when a wolf puppy and one of lion in difficulty appear in her life. He chooses to keep them both to save them and it is then that something unthinkable happens: the two animals grow together and love each other as brothers. Their bucolic universe will be endangered the day when they are secret.
cast: Molly Kunz, Graham Greene, Charlie Carrick, Evan Buliung, Derek Johns, Kurtis Bayford, Rebecca Croll, Rhys Slack

title: Le lunghe notti della Gestapo
cast: Ezio Miani, Fred Williams, Corrado Gaipa, Francesca Righini

title: Le lycéen
synopsis: Lucas is seventeen and must understand what way to take, among all the challenges that life presents him. His brother moved to Paris to live alone, while he, who remained with his mother, between mourning, school and the temptation to give up is completely in disarray.
cast: Paul Kircher, Juliette Binoche, Vincent Lacoste, Christophe Honoré, Xavier Giannoli, Wilfried Capet, Isabelle Thevenoux, Jean Philippe Salerio

title: Le magasin des suicides
synopsis: For years, little Alan's parents ran a shop that, in the most miserable desolation, sold all the equipment needed to perform the perfect suicide. Customers from all walks of life turned to them, people full of all kinds of problems and unable to smile. Growing up, however, little Alan has become a cheerful child full of joie de vivre, capable of infecting customers with his optimism and undermining the business of the family business.

title: Le magnifiche sette
synopsis: Seven officers, all women, belonging to an international police organization are on the trail of a man involved in the white trade. The main suspects are a writer, a former French colonel and Baron Orso della Portella. Rare case of a film starring Dapporto; actually, a missed opportunity.
cast: Carlo Dapporto, Valeria Fabrizi, Alberto Bonucci, Ave Ninchi

title: Le magnifique
synopsis: François Merlin is the author of a series of novels starring the agent Bob Saint-Clair, with whom the writer identifies himself to the point of mixing reality and fantasy: the "transference" is projected above all on the relationship between François himself and the beautiful neighbor ...
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Jacqueline Bisset, Vittorio Caprioli, Monique Tarbès, Hans Meyer, Mario David, Bruno Garcin, Raymond Gérôme, Jean Lefebvre

title: Le mani di una donna sola
synopsis: A writer in crisis and his wife decide to stay in a luxurious villa. Here she is seduced by a vicious countess.
cast: Vanni Materassi, Marina Frajese, Bibi Cassanelli, Cristiana Borghi

title: Le mani forti
synopsis: Claudia, a young psychoanalyst at the beginning of her career, has been treating Tancredi for about three months. In the course of a session, the man, a correspondent for a news agency, tells her that he witnessed a serious crime in Bosnia. The woman is shocked and disturbed by the precision of the details. When, in subsequent sessions, Tancredi returns to the subject, adding more and more precise details each time, Claudia's doubts become suspicious. Franco Bernini, screenwriter for Mazzacurati, Luchetti, Piccioni and Salvatores, defines his first work as a "philosophical mystery". Among excellent corpses, abstract Petri-like atmospheres of "Buone Notizie" and a very declared desire to retrace the happy path of the cinema of civil commitment, "Le mani forte" (those of occult and eternal powers ...) insinuates itself into life daily routine of a novice analyst. The construction moves elegantly between flash-forward and flash back, the purposes are noble (we want to talk about the massacres) the acting moves with alternating current, the defects float above all (paradoxically?) Right on the script.
cast: Francesca Neri, Claudio Amendola, Enzo Decaro, Toni Bertorelli

title: Le mani sporche
synopsis: In a state of central Europe, during the war, a young man introduced himself as secretary in the house of a left -wing politician. By order of the Communist Party, the young man must kill the politician, suspected of a strategy made of compromises with other parties.
cast: Giovanni Visentin, Giuliana De Sio, Anna Maria Gherardi, Bruno Pagni, Omero Antonutti, Marcello Mastroianni, Pietro Biondi, Massimo Foschi, Giorgio Trestini, Umberto Verdone

title: Le mani sulla città
synopsis: A Neapolitan city councilor, Eduardo Nottola (militant of a right-wing party) and building developer is forced to retire from political life due to the collapse of a building he built. After changing party (he moves to the center) he manages to get himself elected again and to start a gigantic speculative project.
cast: Rod Steiger, Salvo Randone, Guido Alberti, Angelo D'Alessandro

title: Le marginal
synopsis: Commissioner Jordan has arrived in Marseille from Paris to wipe out a powerful gang of drug traffickers. Jordan, known in the world as "le marginal" for his unorthodox but very effective methods, points towards the head of the organization, the unreachable and super protected Mecacci. The commissioner, however, is removed from office and is sent to a suburb of Paris. But there he will be able to capture valuable elements that will help him capture the dangerous boss.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Henry Silva, Pierre Vernier, Maurice Barrier

title: Le mari de la coiffeuse
synopsis: As a kid, Antoine was secretly in love with a busty hairdresser and never missed an opportunity to spend a few hours in his shop spying on her. As an adult he remained with an erotic obsession with that woman, perhaps also because she had died suddenly in the prime of her age. Now Antoine has married a busty hairdresser and spends most of the day in the shop in erect skirmishes with his wife between a shampoo and a haircut for customers. Here, too, fate lurks. Well acted and excellently directed, it is the film that confirmed Rochefort's international stature and revealed Anna Galiena's talent. Very pleasant.
cast: Anna Galiena, Jean Rochefort, Roland Bertin, Maurice Chevit, Philippe Clévenot, Jacques Mathou, Claude Aufaure, Albert Delpy, Henry Hocking

title: Le masque de fer
synopsis: Louis XIV is too ill to take the throne, and is forced to turn to his twin brother imprisoned on an island. Henri, as the twin is called, has a mask on his face that prevents anyone from recognizing him. To secure a king for France, D'Artagnan (Jean Marais) frees him from his captivity. When the king's health begins to improve, Henri, who in the meantime has fallen in love with Isabella, becomes unavailable, disappearing into anonymity.
cast: Jean Marais, Jean François Poron, Sylva Koscina, Jean Rochefort

title: Le massaggiatrici
