synopsis: Two Milanese fixers go to Rome to secure the contract for an institute dedicated to welcoming young women to "get back on track". Marisa who, together with her friends Milena and Iris, practices the profession of fake masseuse, for a series of events, is presented to the president of the organization as the wife of one of the two, Parodi; however, when the real Signora Parodi arrives in Rome, the situation becomes tangled, causing a chain of misunderstandings.
cast: Sylva Koscina, Cristina Gaioni, Valeria Fabrizi, Marisa Merlini, Ernesto Calindri, Laura Adani, Luigi Pavese, Nino Taranto, Philippe Noiret, Louis Seigner

title: Le maître est l'enfant
synopsis: Alexandre Mourot, director and young father, observes his daughter experimenting and getting to know the world. Asking questions about his formation of her, he decides to go to the oldest Montessori school in France and to follow a class of children aged 3 to 6 for a year. In a welcoming classroom, children live in a surprisingly quiet atmosphere, free to perform their activities alone or with others.
cast: Anny Duperey, Christian Maréchal, Alexandre Mourot

title: Le meilleur reste à venir
synopsis: Following a huge misunderstanding, two friends decide to take back all the time they lost and enjoy the best of the days to come.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Patrick Bruel, Zineb Triki, Pascale Arbillot, Martina García
director: Matthieu Delaporte, Alexandre De La Patellière

title: Le meraviglie
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Gelsomina lives with her sisters and father in a perfect balance in contact with nature and animals. One fine day, however, in Gelsomina's life a little boy named Martin enters, a young German criminal in rehabilitation who upsets the harmony of his family, while the area where he lives faces the incursion of a television prize contest, conducted by the white fairy Milly Catena (Monica Bellucci).
cast: Maria Alexandra Lungu, Sam Louwyck, Alba Rohrwacher, Sabine Timoteo, Luis Huilca, Agnese Graziani, Monica Bellucci, André Hennicke, Margarete Tiesel, Eva Morrow, Maris Stella Morrow

title: Le meraviglie di Aladino
synopsis: In fabulous Baghdad, the reckless Aladdin dreams of experiencing the most adventurous vicissitudes, and in the meantime he combines one more than the devil. But when the unsuspecting mother gives him an oil lamp inside which a powerful genius is imprisoned, the boy's life changes: and it will be the new and very powerful friend to get out of his way in a complicated story populated by good, beautiful principles. princesses and wicked viziers.
cast: Donald O'Connor, Michèle Mercier, Vittorio De Sica, Aldo Fabrizi

title: Le mie ragazze di carta
synopsis: At the end of the 70s, in the Treviso area, the period of rapid expansion of the cities also invests the Bottacin family, made up of Primo, Anna and Tiberio. For them, and in particular for the young Tiberius, the change from peasant life to an urban context will be quite tumultuous.
cast: Maya Sansa, Andrea Pennacchi, Alvise Marascalchi, Cristiano Caccamo, Alessandro Bressanello, Giuseppe Zeno, Neri Marcoré, Christian Mancin, Marta Guerrini

title: Le milieu de l'horizon
synopsis: Summer 1976. Europe is crossed by an implacable heat wave and is experiencing one of the worst droughts of its history. On the parents' farm, the thirteen year old Gus spends the summer holidays reading comics, helping his father in the chicken coop and running free with Mado, the wild child of the village. Slowly, however, his reassuring and familiar universe begins to crumble: his mother, until then tender and sweet presence, begins to move away and spend much more time with the hypnotizing Cécile while the father finds himself fighting alone against the devastation of drought. In a short time, Gus will have to grow and leave behind the innocence of the childhood ...
cast: Luc Bruchez, Laetitia Casta, Clémence Poésy, Thibaut Evrard, Fred Hotier, Patrick Descamps, Guillaume Lemarre, Lisa Harder

title: Le milieu du monde
synopsis: Paul (Léotard) managed to make a career, now he is a manager of a small company and is a candidate in the municipal elections. During a meeting he meets Adriana (Carlisi), an Italian emigrant who works in a bistro: alone and independent. Paul falls in love with her and makes her his mistress, with the result that he ultimately loses the election. When Paul then asks Adriana to marry him, she refuses and goes to work in the factory: freedom, first of all. Social difference and feelings at the crossroads in a film "as beautiful as a winter landscape", set in Switzerland, in Eligoz, a natural watershed between the Mediterranean basin and that of the North Sea. As always, Alain Tanner prefers that no man's land where different cultures meet and often end up colliding.
cast: Philippe Léotard, Olimpia Carlisi, Juliet Berto, Denise Péron

title: Le mille e una notte... e un'altra ancora
cast: Vinicio Sofia, Angela Bo, Dada Gallotti, Mario Brega, Enrico Miotti

title: Le mille et une voix - La musique de l'Islam
synopsis: The director of _Traversées_, of Tunisian origin but active in France for some time, travels the boundless universe-Islam (from Egypt to Tunisia, from Turkey to Senegal, up to the Indian subcontinent) documenting the many musical expressions that animate him. A good opportunity to dispel numerous and deeply rooted clichés.

title: Le miserie del signor Travet
synopsis: Royal clerk Ignazio Travet has never had a promotion in the office because his section head dislikes him. A widower, he remarried a still young woman who makes him weigh his condition as a bankrupt, and also flirts with another superior. The day Ignazio finally rebels, he is immediately fired and ends up as an accountant in a bakery.
cast: Carlo Campanini, Vera Carmi, Gino Cervi, Luigi Pavese, Alberto Sordi

title: Le missionnaire
synopsis: Mario is finally free, after serving seven years in prison for theft of jewels. On the run from the underworld, with whom he still has an unfinished business, he hides from his brother Patrick in a small village in the Alps. Here, due to a misunderstanding, the villagers will mistake him for the replacement of the old parish priest, who has recently died. Mario, waiting for the waters to calm down, decides to play the game ...
cast: Jean Marie Bigard, David Strajmayster, Thiam Aïssatou, Jean Dell, Michel Chesneau, Benjamin Feitelson

title: Le moine
synopsis: Spain, 17th century. Abandoned at birth in front of the door of a monastery, Ambrosio (Vincent Cassel) is raised by the friars free and far from all temptation, becoming a Capuchin prior famous for his fervor and feared for his intransigence. The arrival at the monastery of the young Valerio, however, shatters all the certainties of Ambrosio, tempted by the diabolical sensuality of the novice who, in reality, is hiding behind a wax mask that she is the mysterious Mathilde. By yielding to his flattery, Ambrosio knows the sins of the flesh and, setting out on the road to perdition, the desire to possess other women is born in him. After abusing the innocent Antonia, he discovers that it is his sister and, having ended up in prison, he sells his soul to the devil to save her.
cast: Vincent Cassel, Déborah François, Joséphine Japy, Sergi López, Catherine Mouchet, Jordi Dauder, Geraldine Chaplin, Roxane Duran, Frédéric Noaille, Javivi

title: Le moine
synopsis: In a Madrid dominated by the power of the Inquisition, the prior of the convent of the Capuchin friars, a preacher of inflexible moral rigor, sells his soul to the devil to possess a girl and stains himself with the most heinous crimes.
cast: Franco Nero, Nathalie Delon, Nicol Williamson, Nadja Tiller, Eliana De Santis, Agnès Capri, Denis Manuel, Maria Machado, Philippe Clévenot, Louise Chevalier

title: Le monache di Sant'Arcangelo
synopsis: The cloistered monastery of Sant'Arcangelo in Irpinia hosts numerous nuns forced into monastic life by their respective illustrious families. The death of the abbess puts in competition the elderly mother Lavinia, mother Giulia di Mondragone and mother Carmela. To achieve power, Mother Giulia (who has an affair with Sister Chiara) accepts the help of a local squire.
cast: Anne Heywood, Luc Merenda, Ornella Muti, Martine Brochard

title: Le monachine
synopsis: An overhead line passes over a peaceful convent, compromising the quiet of the place and also the integrity of a fourteenth-century fresco preserved there. Two nuns set off for Rome and decided to convince the engineer on whom the jet path depends to change the route. But a change of route would cost dearly in terms of fuel: the agreement seems impossible.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Sylva Koscina, Amedeo Nazzari, Didi Perego, Umberto D'Orsi, Sandro Bruni, Annie Gorassini, Alberto Bonucci, Lando Buzzanca, Ugo D'Alessio

title: Le monde après nous
synopsis: When he meets Elisa, the penniless and young Labidi writer knows he is the right woman. But Paris is still a city too dear to him.
cast: Louise Chevillotte, Aurélien Gabrielli, Léon Cunha Da Costa, Jacques Nolot, Saadia Bentaïeb

title: Le monde du silence
synopsis: The research vessel Calypso, with Commander Cousteau and his crew on board, goes for a walk in exotic seas showing breathtaking sequences and underwater footage never shown before in color.

title: Le monde est à toi
synopsis: François, a small trader, has a dream: to become the official distributor of a brand of popsicles in the Maghreb. Everything fades the day he learns that Dany, his mother, has spent all of her savings. Putin, the extravagant head of the city, then proposes a plan to make up for himself in Spain. But when a childhood sweetheart, a former father-in-law just out of prison, two young conspirators and his mother (leader of a gang of pickpockets) are involved, nothing will go as planned.
cast: Karim Leklou, Isabelle Adjani, Vincent Cassel, Oulaya Amamra, Norbert Ferrer, Sofian Khammes, Audrey Langle, François Damiens

title: Le monde selon Monsanto
synopsis: Between 2005 and 2008, the French journalist Marie-Monique Robin investigated the activities of the multinational Monsanto, an American giant in the chemical industry and practically monopolist of the world market for GMOs. The result of this work is collected in a book called "The world according to Monsanto" and this documentary (originally intended for TV) is an adaptation of it.

title: Le motorizzate
synopsis: A casual nun (Ninchi) collides with a car and then hits the three passengers because they are communists. A prostitute, all home and work (in the sense that she works in her trailer), gets stuck in a quagmire. Urbano Cacace (Totò) pretends to be vigilant in order to pocket the money from the fines. A poor guy tries to make money by being invested, but ends up in the hospital and doesn't get a penny.
cast: Totò, Ave Ninchi, Bice Valori, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Sandra Mondaini, Riccardo Billi

title: Le mouton enragé
synopsis: Nicolas Mallet, a bank employee, is the embodiment of the classic travet that everyone bypasses and no one considers. In an attempt to shake him, his friend Claude Fabre - a moderately successful writer - prepares a plan to revolutionize his life: the first step will consist in submitting his resignation, after which he will have to devote himself body and soul to the seduction of beautiful and high-ranking women. Nicolas follows Claude's instructions to the letter and the fruits are not long in coming, but then he ends up going too far ...
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Romy Schneider, Jane Birkin, Jean Pierre Cassel, Florinda Bolkan, Henri Garcin, Georges Wilson, Estella Blain

title: Le mur
synopsis: Turkey: in Ankara prison some inmates rebel against the terrible conditions of prison life, with the aim of being transferred to a more humane prison. Their hopes will be disappointed: the life of the prisoners is not worth more than that of the beasts.
cast: Tuncel Kurtiz, Ayce Emel Mesci, Malik Berrichi, Nicolas Hossein

title: Le mura di Bergamo
synopsis: Bergamo, March 2020. The city, inside its walls, is a sick body. The Covid-19 epidemic broke out violently and unexpectedly. The roads emptied, the exchanges zeroed, the prohibited meetings. After the nightmare, the survivors awaken in an unknown Bergamo. The body of the city is a devastated organism that tries to react: doctors, nurses, patients, volunteers and even those who have not directly experienced the pain of the disease, all seek their own role in the collective healing process.

title: Le mystère Henri Pick
synopsis: A publisher discovers a novel that she considers a masterpiece in a library whose peculiarity is to collect manuscripts rejected by publishers. The text is signed by a certain Henri Pick, a Breton pizza maker who died two years earlier. However, according to his widow, the man has never read a book in his life and wrote nothing but the shopping list. Beyond the mystery, the novel becomes a bestseller. A famous literary critic then decides to go back to the key with the unexpected help of the daughter of the enigmatic Henri Pick.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Camille Cottin, Alice Isaaz, Bastien Bouillon, Josiane Stoléru, Astrid Whettnall, Marie Christine Orry, Vincent Winterhalter, Annie Mercier, Hanna Schygulla

title: Le mystère Picasso
synopsis: In his Victorine studio in Nice, the famous painter Pablo Picasso offers himself to the camera in the act of painting. The technique is to work a particular ink that is imprinted so deeply on the canvas as to allow the painting to be taken upside down during its execution. From drawing to watercolor to oil painting: the first film on pictorial creation. Not a documentary, nor a biography, nor an illustration, but a unique experiment, a sort of "animated drawing". Special Jury Prize in Cannes in 1956.
cast: Pablo Picasso

title: Le mystère de la chambre jaune
synopsis: Charged by his newspaper to deal with the attempted murder of Miss Mathilde, daughter and collaborator of the illustrious Professor Stangerson, Joseph Rouletabille goes to the castle of Glandier accompanied by his friend and photographer Sainclair. Here the shrewd reporter will engage in a detective skill challenge with the infamous Inspector Larsan to solve the case: who attacked Mathilde Stangerson? For what reason? How did the bomber escape from the hermetically sealed chamber?
cast: Denis Podalydès, Jean Noël Brouté, Claude Rich, Scali Delpeyrat, Sabine Azéma, Michael Lonsdale, Julos Beaucarne, Olivier Gourmet, Pierre Arditi, Isabelle Candelier

title: Le mépris
synopsis: In Rome, screenwriter Paul Javal is adapting the "Odyssey" for a film by Fritz Lang. Meanwhile, his marital relationship with Camille (Brigitte Bardot) cracks and finally breaks up on the set of the film, in Capri, when she leaves goes with the manufacturer Prokosch.
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Michel Piccoli, Jack Palance, Giorgia Moll, Fritz Lang

title: Le métis de Dieu
synopsis: The true and incredible story of Jean-Marie Lustiger, the son of Jewish Poles who kept his cultural identity intact even when he converted to Catholicism at an early age and then took his vows. Rising rapidly in the ecclesiastical spheres, Lustiger was appointed archbishop of Paris by Pope John Paul II and found a way to make his dual identity - Jewish and Catholic - coexist by creating enemies in both creeds. When the Carmelite nuns decide to settle in a convent within the cursed walls of Auschwitz, Lustiger will be called upon to choose which side to take.
cast: Laurent Lucas, Aurélien Recoing, Audrey Dana, Pascal Greggory, Grégoire Leprince Ringuet, Alex Skarbek, Vincent Furic, Henri Guybet, Aurélien Heilbronn, Zbigniew Jankowski

title: Le nain rouge
synopsis: Lucien L'Otte is a dwarf in Trentino. He is an employee in charge of drawing up the letters of insults in cases of divorce of a law firm. Not being able to dream of the marriage, he dedicates himself with vindictive ardor to destroy that of others. But one day, in a very hot afternoon, encouraged by the voluptuous lyric singer Paola Bendoni, she will dare those long -suffocated gestures of love.
cast: Jean Yves Thual, Dyna Gauzy, Anita Ekberg, Carlo Colombaioni

title: Le ninfee di Monet. Un incantesimo di acqua e luce
synopsis: The story of the birth of one of the greatest works of art of the 20th century, indeed of 300 masterpieces that revolutionized subsequent art. The story of a visceral passion that will become a true obsession and of the man who let himself be devoured by this obsession: Claude Monet. The Giverny mansion is the most expensive villa in the area but it still lacks something. As soon as he moved there, in fact, Monet immediately decided to get to work: he wanted to create a garden "for the pleasure of the eyes" but he soon realizes that this wonderful natural palette can offer him countless subjects for his painting. In this way, attracting the ire of his neighbors, he uproots all the fruit trees, destroys the vegetable garden and begins to create his atelier en-plein-air. The historic Latour-Marliac nursery still stands in the south of France, where Monet bought the exotic flowers he fell in love with at the 1889 Paris Universal Exposition. 6 water lily bulbs: 4 yellow and two white. Despite the many difficulties, in 1895 Monet placed the easel on the shore of the lake. For the first time a water lily flower comes to life from his brushes.
cast: Elisa Lasowski, Sanne De Wilde

title: Le nombril du monde
synopsis: In the years in which Tunisia is freeing itself from the French protectorate, the unscrupulous Bajou tries in every way to look after his own interests and become "someone" ...
cast: Marie Jose Nat, Delphine Forest, Roger Hanin, Thomas Langmann, Michel Boujenah

title: Le notti del terrore
synopsis: Great Britain: a group of people gathers in a luxurious building near an Etruscan cemetery previously desecrated by the excavations of a strange professor, who summoned his guests precisely to divulge the results of the excavations and show them the finds. However, the guests, after spending the night in the villa, will find themselves facing ravenous zombies escaping from the desecrated tombs.
cast: Karin Well, Gianluigi Chirizzi, Simone Mattioli, Antonella Antinori, Roberto Caporali, Peter Bark, Claudio Zucchet, Anna Valente, Raimondo Barbieri, Mariangela Giordano

title: Le notti di Cabiria
synopsis: Cabiria (Masina) is a prostitute who has achieved a certain well-being and who, despite the life she leads, retains a fund of goodness and candor, so much so that she is still in search of true love. But hers is a ruthless world: a man seems sincerely in love with her and intending to marry her, but, during a trip to Lake Bracciano, he manifests his true intentions. Cabiria, however, is in the end still available to reconcile with life.
cast: Giulietta Masina, Franca Marzi, François Périer, Amedeo Nazzari

title: Le notti di Lucrezia Borgia
synopsis: In the service of Cesare Borgia and coveted by Lucrezia, the brave Federico degli Alberici falls in love with Diana D'Alba and joins her in the rebellion against tyrants. Pseudo-historic mess directed by a prolific craftsman.
cast: Belinda Lee, Jacques Sernas

title: Le notti erotiche dei morti viventi
cast: Laura Gemser, George Eastman, Mark Shannon, Dirce Funari

title: Le nouveau
synopsis: Benoit, serial number of a Parisian college, is a victim of bullying by a group of arrogant boys who make its integration difficult. In order not to let him have won, Benoit organizes a big party and invites the whole class. On the evening of the great event, however, only three students present themselves: to make matters worse, they are the most marginalized in the whole school.
cast: Raphaël Ghrenassia, Joshua Raccah, Géraldine Martineau, Guillaume Cloud Roussel, Johanna Lindstedt, Max Boublil, Eytan Chiche, Gabriel Nahum

title: Le nouveau testament
synopsis: Jean discovers that his wife is having an affair with the son of their best friends, the Worms. So he invites them to dinner, doesn't show up, and sends a stranger to deliver his freshly drawn will, in which he claims he has a secret daughter and that his wife is cheating on him with young Worms. But nothing is as it seems.
cast: Sacha Guitry, Jacqueline Delubac, Christian Gérard, Betty Daussmond, Charles Dechamps, Marguerite Templey, Pauline Carton, Louis Kerly, Marguerite Pierry

title: Le nozze di Laura
synopsis: Laura is the young daughter of a lemon and orange farmer. Sent by her father to Rome with the hope that even not feeling beautiful she will be able to create an emotional life for herself, Laura ends up in the arms of a boy who deceives her and leaves her pregnant. When she returns home, her father sends her to his own land to pick citrus fruits. Here, however, he meets Karimu, an African immigrant who is actually a noble prince of Chad, with whom a love story is born. A real and unexpected miracle will upset their two lives.
cast: Marta Iagatti, Valentino Aguru, Nicola Rignanese, Alessandro Sperduti, Rita Abela, Lina Sastri, Neri Marcoré

title: Le nuove comiche
synopsis: A covered truck. On the tarpaulin the writing "Generator Group". The tarpaulin falls and he discovers some cyclists pedaling all together spinning a giant bicycle wheel which in turn turns the dynamo fixed to the tire. It is the most silent and sympathetic gimmick of Neri Parenti's "New Comics". First, a ballet without electricity and a magistrate in need of an escort pay the price. Or it is they themselves, Villaggio and Pozzetto, who damage each other in order to compete for a girl at the campsite. The inspiration of the protagonists is inversely proportional to the number of lines they pronounce. The imitation of silent cinema therefore gives the happiest results.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Renato Pozzetto, Ramona Badescu

title: Le occasioni di Rosa
cast: Marina Suma, Angelo Cannavacciuolo, Sergio Boccalatte, Gianni Prestieri

title: Le olimpiadi dei mariti
synopsis: Two journalists left alone in the city attempt a gallant adventure with some German girls, in Rome for the Olympics. At the best, however, the wives return home and from there a geometric series of lies is triggered with a final bang.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Delia Scala, Sandra Mondaini

title: Le ombre rosse
synopsis: "Cambiare il mondo" is a social center obtained from the dilapidated premises of an old cinema in Rome. A famous intellectual goes there who, struck by the enthusiasm and ferment that animate the place, decides to give life to a great cultural project that immediately receives an enormous media consensus. But so much hype is counterproductive and the situation ends up getting out of hand.
cast: Ennio Fantastichini, Arnoldo Foà, Lucia Poli, Roberto Herlitzka, Valentina Carnelutti, Ricky Tognazzi

title: Le opere e i giorni
synopsis: An inexorable peregrination in a mental and visionary archeology. Not real encounters, but ghostly iridescences, enticements in a game of reflections.
cast: Pier Giovanni Anchisi, Lisa Bencivenni, Franco Brocani, Veronica Esposito, Nico Garrone, Brigitte Grueninger, Antonia Recchia, Riccardo Reim, Giorgia Sartini, Maurizia Scapin

title: Le ore dell'amore
synopsis: After three years of living together, Gianni and Maretta decide it's time to get married. But the marriage turns their life into an oppressive routine that soon puts a strain on Gianni's endurance and thwarts Maretta's efforts to save the day. The solution? Go back to making lovers.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Emmanuelle Riva, Barbara Steele, Brunello Rondi

title: Le ore nude
cast: Rossana Podestà, Philippe Leroy, Keir Dullea, Umberto Spadaro

title: Le orme
synopsis: Alice works as a translator and is afflicted by a psychosis: after seeing experiments conducted by a scientist on TV, she is tormented by the recurring nightmare of an astronaut abandoned on the Moon. She also realizes that she has significant gaps in memory and so decides to investigate and discover the disturbing details concerning her.
cast: Florinda Bolkan, Peter McEnery, Caterina Boratto, Lila Kedrova, Klaus Kinski

title: Le otto montagne
synopsis: A story of friendship, fathers and children and the choices we make in the life that is given to us, against the background of mountains to be scaled physically and psychologically. A universal story about the inexorable research that pushes us to know ourselves and at the same time to be faithful to others.
cast: Alessandro Borghi, Luca Marinelli, Filippo Timi, Elena Lietti

title: Le pacte des loups
synopsis: The beast of Gevaudan: a legend that still makes one tremble with fear. Louis XV, over whose reign the sun is already setting, sends a knight and his Indian aide to the impervious region of France to solve the riddle. Who is thirsty for the blood of virgins? A man or a devil as the nobles of the Ancien Régime would have us believe?
cast: Monica Bellucci, Vincent Cassel, Samuel Le Bihan, Emilie Dequenne, Mark Dacascos, Jérémie Rénier, Jean Yanne, Jean François Stévenin, Jacques Perrin

title: Le pacte du silence
synopsis: Sarah is a Carmelite nun who lives in Brazil and that - Proprio as he is about to be transferred to France - begins to accuse strange pain. The doctor Joachim Ferrer visit and does not encounter any physical problems in her and then begins to investigate her private life. So he discovers that Sarah has a twin sister just released from prison after taking a long sentence for killing a child to whom he served as a babysitter. A terrible secret binds the two women with each other.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Elodie Bouchez, Carmen Maura, Isaac Sharry, Tsilla Chelton, Estelle Larrivaz, Anne Le Ny, Wojciech Pszoniak, Isabelle Candelier, Hervé Pierre, Manuela Gourary, Philippe Du Janerand, Charlotte Bonnet, Marie Sohna Conde

title: Le papillon
synopsis: Elsa is an eight-year-old girl who dreams of spending her free time at the cinema with her mother. Instead, he will find himself accompanying the elder Julien on a scientific expedition in search of a rare butterfly. During the day the two will make a beautiful friendship.
cast: Claire Bouanich, Michel Serrault, Nade Dieu, Françoise Michaud

title: Le parc
synopsis: On a summers day, a teenage boy and girl have their first date in a park. At first shy and hesitant, they slowly discover each other, they approach and fall in love. But the evening is looming and for them the time to say goodbye is approaching.
cast: Naomie Vogt Roby, Maxime Bachellerie, Sessouma Sobere

title: Le parfum d'Yvonne
synopsis: Summer 1958. Victor Chamara, blue blood and no money, meets Yvonne Jacquest, with ambitions as an actress. The elderly homosexual René Meinthe always gravitates around her and warns Victor about the girl's character. In fact Yvonne leaves him for a ski champion playboy. A few years later, Victor returns to the places of his passion, and will witness René's spectacular suicide. From the novel by Patrick Modiano "Villa triste", the director and screenwriter Patrice Leconte attempts an operation of subtle recreation of a time and an atmosphere. But the operation fails and the film turns into a presumptuous exercise in style.
cast: Jean Pierre Marielle, Hippolyte Girardot, Sandra Majani, Richard Bohringer

title: Le parfum de la dame en noir
synopsis: Mathilde Stangerson and Robert Darzac, recently married, go on vacation to their friends Edith and Arthur Rance at the Castle of Hercules. But Larsan reappears on their way, terrifying the beautiful Mathilde. Inspector Rouletabille, with the help of faithful Sainclair, investigates to find out how Larsan managed to break into the castle.
cast: Denis Podalydès, Sabine Azéma, Jean Noël Brouté, Pierre Arditi, Isabelle Candelier

title: Le parfum vert
synopsis: An actor is poisoned and dies on stage in the middle of a representation. Martin, a member of the troupe and friend of the victim, becomes the main suspect, while he is chased by a mysterious organization called "The green perfume".
cast: Sandrine Kiberlain, Vincent Lacoste, Léonie Simaga, Rüdiger Vogler, Jenna Thiam, Arieh Worthalter, Pascal Reneric, Thomas Chabrol, Lucie Gallo, Olivier Broche, Vincent Brousseau, Claïna Clavaron, Simon Guélat, Isabelle Bats, Etienne Beurier, Gwenaëlle Simon, Alexandre Steiger, Baptiste Sornin

title: Le parole a venire
synopsis: Between an engineer, owner of a small outboard factory in Fiumicino, and his workers, a series of intimate bonds arise that affect the various members of their respective families.
cast: Natalino Longo, Mario Cellupica, Ennio Di Stefano

title: Le parole di mio padre
synopsis: Young Zeno, who was unable to overcome the trauma of his parent's death, comes into contact with the family of Giovanni, Anna's father, Ada, Alberta and Augusta. Zeno falls in love with Ada, who at first reciprocates his affection but then pushes him away, then gets involved in Alberta's game of seduction. The suicide attempt of the latter induces him to leave: a year later Augusta will reveal her feelings to him.
cast: Fabrizio Rongione, Chiara Mastroianni, Toni Bertorelli, Mimmo Calopresti

title: Le passage du Rhin
synopsis: In the spring of 1940 the French army was overwhelmed by the Wehrmacht; long lines of French prisoners are thus sent to the prison camps in Nazi Germany. On a bridge that crosses the Rhine, two Frenchmen meet by chance, very different in terms of conditions and ideas: Jean Durrieu, a brilliant journalist, convinced interventionist, and Roger Balland, a mild-mannered pastry chef with no particular ambitions. The two are sent to a farm and while Roger adapts quickly, fraternizing with the German peasants, Jean does nothing but think about escaping. In fact, one day Jean manages to escape, taking refuge in England to resume the fight. Roger, on the other hand, as time passes, finds himself better and better in the German village, where life becomes more and more difficult but where everyone is friends. He forms an affectionate relationship with Helga, a girl left alone, who sees in Roger the only support and help. After the war, life in Paris resumed a normal rhythm. Jean is back with his partner Florence and has become editor of his newspaper. But suddenly her situation becomes difficult: it turns out, in fact, that Florence was a collaborator of the Nazis. Jean resigns from the newspaper to stay close to her, but the woman leaves spontaneously, frightened by a life of poverty. Roger has also returned to Paris, but his wife shows him no affection. He then decides to return to the German village, to go and live with his friends from across the Rhine.
cast: Charles Aznavour, Georges Rivière, Nicole Courcel, Cordula Trantow

title: Le passager clandestin
synopsis: Lotte comes from Paris, works in a nightclub in Panama and is leaving for Tahiti because that is where perhaps René lives, her former lover, who has suddenly become heir to a fortune. But Lotte isn't the only one looking for him. On René's footsteps there are the notary who must notify him of the inheritance, an adventurer and a gangster animated by not so friendly intentions. The four board a steamer where a sailor falls in love with Lotte. After the notary was killed, a furious fight broke out among the survivors, at the end of which ...
cast: Martine Carol, Karlheinz Böhm, Serge Reggiani, Arletty, Roger Livesey, Reg Lye, Maea Flohr

title: Le passager de la pluie
synopsis: A stranger arrives in a small town on the French coast on a rainy day. The young Mélie suddenly finds herself in front of him; he stuns and rapes her, but the woman manages to kill him. He gets rid of the body by throwing it into the sea. Some time later a mysterious American, on the trail of the man, provides Mélie with the evidence of his murder. Once the body is recovered, however, the terrible past of the woman also comes to light. A film full of twists and turns, of raw realism in the first part, more atmospheric in the second, it combines the classic yellow story with a certain study of the French province.
cast: Charles Bronson, Marlène Jobert, Gabriele Tinti, Jill Ireland

title: Le pays des sourds
synopsis: Led by Professor Jean Claude Poulain, expert in sign communication, the film takes us into the universe of the deaf, on a journey through some strong moments of their relationship with the "outside" world: school, work, socialization of the handicap. Successfully presented at the Locarno Film Festival, Nel Paese dei Sordi is a film that reconciles with documentarism and captivates like a novel. While poisoning itself with non-professional actors, authentic interpreters of themselves, the film avoids both the glossy pity of Hollywood and the shallows of the uplifting "holy card".
cast: Attori Non Professionisti

title: Le pecore di Cheyenne
synopsis: Story of the shepherd Cheyenne Daprà and her daily work over four days, one for each season.

title: Le petit Nicolas
synopsis: Nicolas (Maxime Godart) is a child who cannot ask for anything better from life: his parents (Valérie Lemercier and Kad Merad) satisfy him in all his needs, he has many friends who love him, with whom he has a lot of fun. But when one day, he discovers that his mother is expecting another child, the fear of losing everything he has takes over. In fact, a little brother would completely change his life, the attention would no longer be all for him and so he is convinced that his parents can abandon him at any moment, just as happened to Tom Thumb.
cast: Maxime Godart, Valérie Lemercier, Kad Merad, Sandrine Kiberlain, François Xavier Demaison, Michel Duchaussoy, Daniel Prévost, Michel Galabru, Anémone, François Damiens

title: Le petit Poucet
synopsis: War broke out in the town where Tom Thumb lives with his family. His parents abandon him with his brothers in a forest. It will not be easy for them to find their way home also because the little ones are forced to suffer from hunger, to fight ravenous wolves and to escape from the Orc devouring children. Tom Thumb will resort to a ruse to help him and his brothers find a way out of the pitfalls of the woods.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Romane Bohringer, Nils Hugon, Pierre Berriau, Dominique Hulin

title: Le petit baigneur
synopsis: While "Il Merluzzetto", a boat designed by Castagnier, wins an international regatta, a similar vessel, also designed by him, collapses during launch under the weight of the champagne bottle. When a sumptuous offer arrives at the yard to build many more "Merluzzetti", the owner of the yard, who has to win the competition from the Italian Cacciapuoti, makes a false attempt to have Castagnier with him again.
cast: Louis De Funès, Robert Dhéry, Colette Brosset, Franco Fabrizi

title: Le petit lieutenant
synopsis: Antoine is an ambitious young man who, despite a wife in Le Havre, asks to be assigned to Paris at the end of the police school. Here comes Caroline Vadieu, a former alcoholic, to take over. An encounter between two solitudes and a dry and unconventional representation of life in the police. Best European film of the Venice Days in 2005.
cast: Nathalie Baye, Jalil Lespert, Roschdy Zem, Antoine Chappey

title: Le petit locataire
synopsis: Nicole, now close to fifty, believes that all the symptoms that have been ruining her days for some time are due to a latent menopause when she discovers with some disappointment that she is pregnant. Milestone of an extravagant and slightly out of control family, Nicole must digest the news before announcing it to the others and then discussing with them how to proceed. Each member of the family has their own idea but Nicole will have to decide for the first time what she really wants to do with her life.
cast: Karin Viard, Philippe Rebbot, Manon Kneusé, Hélène Vincent, Antoine Bertrand, Stella Fenouillet, Raphaël Ferret, Côme Levin

title: Le petit prince a dit
synopsis: Divorced Adam and Melanie spend little time with Violette, their young daughter. The girl accuses severe pain in the head and, after appropriate investigations, she is diagnosed with a brain tumor that leaves her a few months to live. Adam decides to leave with Violette on a journey that will remind him of forgotten values.
cast: Richard Berry, Anémone, Marie Kleiber, Lucie Phan, Mista Préchac, Claude Muret, Jean Cuenoud, John Gutwirth, Baptiste Adatte, Huguette Bonfils

title: Le petit soldat
cast: Michel Subor, Anna Karina, Henry Jacques Huet, Laszlo Szabo

title: Le petit théâtre par Jean Renoir
synopsis: Presented by the director himself, who stages himself with a strong dose of smug and amusing irony, four stories built on the figure of the paradox: the marriage condition that has become too accommodating, the intrusiveness of appliances that transform the house into a dangerous jungle and more. yet.
cast: Jean Renoir, Jeanne Moreau Marguerite Cassan

title: Le petit voleur
synopsis: The life of S., 18 years old from Orléans, is elsewhere: it does not include the bakery where the young man kneads baguettes as an apprentice baker. Those interior nights between the oven and a desolate bar in which to drink a beer are no longer enough for him. He wants to escape, to have a lot of money at his disposal, to escape the humiliation of any love when he steals the salary of a girl who has hosted him. His life goes on in the warm light of Marseille in a world of apartment thieves.
cast: Nicolas Duvauchelle, Yann Trégouët, Martial Bezot

title: Le peuple migrateur
synopsis: In spring, from the northern hemisphere, migratory birds take flight to the Arctic lands, to reproduce in the same places where they were born. Some fly non-stop, night and day, while others arrive at their destination stop after stop. How the flocks manage to reach precise locations thousands of kilometers away remains a mystery ...

title: Le piacevoli notti
synopsis: Three Boccaccio episodes set in the Renaissance. In the first a noble libertine becomes the lover of a married woman; in the second, a false pope encourages a girl's erotic dreams; in the third Lucrezia Borgia is caught in flagrant adultery by her husband.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman, Gina Lollobrigida, Adolfo Celi, Eros Pagni

title: Le piccole idee
synopsis: Four different episodes tell the effects of the economic crisis on the middle social classes. In the first, a university professor, separated from his wife, tries to respect the promise made to his little daughter to give her a pink bicycle; in the second, two parents, with their father unemployed, find themselves having to face the dreams of their teenage daughter, endangered by the non-payment of some installments of the school canteen; in the third, an entrepreneur, forced to close his factory due to lack of orders, organizes a barbecue with employees on layoffs; in the latter, a computer technician, out of work after thirty years, does not adapt to too much free time available and family members are looking for a solution.
cast: Luca D'Alessandro, Gea Dell'Orto, Mario Vigiak Bugara, Teresa Scozzi, Armando Cardarilli, Giulia Cardarilli, Luisa Mauri, Angelo Giotta, Mara Romani

title: Le pillole di Ercole
synopsis: Driven into adultery with an American client by a drug served to him by his colleagues in the mood for jokes, a young doctor gets into trouble. The husband of the seduced patient in fact confronts him energetically demanding satisfaction: the doctor will have to induce his wife, with whom he is very much in love, to spend a night of love with the American.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Sylva Koscina, Vittorio De Sica

title: Le pistole non discutono
synopsis: Bill the lonely, inveterate outlaw, and his brother George, who is a novice, attack a bank and steal thirty thousand dollars and then take refuge in Mexico. Sheriff Garrett sets out on their trail and catches them across the border. The three then clash against Mexican "bandidos", eager to seize the loot. Western spaghetti more sober and less smashing than the average.
cast: Rod Cameron, Dick Palmer, Angel Aranda, Vivi Bach, Luis Durán

title: Le placard
synopsis: François Pignon is a boring accountant who risks losing his job; Félix Santini is the macho colleague who haunts him; Belone is François's neighbor, who gives him the brilliant idea to save himself: pretending to be homosexual. In fact, the company produces condoms, and will never dare to fire a gay ...
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Gérard Depardieu, Thierry Lhermitte, Michel Aumont, Jean Rochefort

title: Le planète sauvage
synopsis: A world upside down in this beautiful animated film. On a remote planet, men, divided into "domestic" and "wild", are subjected to the will of the Draag, a much more evolved population. Among the "servants", however, there is a child who is able to access the knowledge of the Draag. Science fiction film among the most distressing and black in the history of cinema, it is a masterpiece of European animation, dreamlike and metaphorical.

title: Le plus beau jour de ma vie
synopsis: Lola decides that the time has come to ask her boyfriend Arthur for proof of love: marriage. Despite the heated and declared nonconformity, the beloved gives in to the female arts of Lola. But between her dreams and the ceremony in full regalia that the family wants, the organization of what should be the best day of her life becomes more complicated than expected.
cast: Hélène De Fougerolles, Jonathan Zaccaï, Marisa Berenson, François Berléand

title: Le plus vieux métier du monde
synopsis: Six episodes develop the theme of love in all eras, starting from the Stone Age to get to the future, passing naturally through the "Belle Époque".
cast: Michèle Mercier, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gabriele Tinti, Elsa Martinelli

title: Le pont des Arts
synopsis: Paris, 1979. Sarah is a talented opera singer engaged in a new disc recording of Monteverdi's Lamento della Ninfa. Although she proves to be up to the project by completing it, her production manager does nothing but mistreat and humiliate her, so as to push her into a catatonic state from which even her boyfriend Manuel cannot shake her. On the other hand, however, Pascal is a young graduate in philosophy who has not yet completed his thesis because he is distracted by Michelangelo's art and by the complicated relationship with his girlfriend Christine. When she leaves him, Pascal falls into depression and contemplates suicide but listening to a copy of Sarah's record gives him a new lease on life.
cast: Adrien Michaux, Natacha Régnier, Alexis Loret, Denis Podalydès, Olivier Gourmet, Camille Carraz, Jérémie Rénier, Christelle Prot, Benjamin Lazar, Manuel Weber

title: Le ponts de Sarajevo
country: Bosnia and Herzegovina, France, Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Portugal, Bulgaria
synopsis: 13 European directors, from different generations and backgrounds, have as their theme the city of Sarajevo, what it represented in the European history of the twentieth century and what it embodied in Europe in the 2000s.
cast: Gaetano Bruno, Emanuel Caserio, Fortunato Leccese, Emiliano Masala, Giovanni Ortoleva, Andrea Meneghello, Hans Gottardi, Laurent Gjeci, Paolo Iezzi, Angelo Spadaro
director: Jean Luc Godard, Ursula Meier, Sergei Loznitsa, Cristi Puiu, Aida Begic, Angela Schanelec, Isild Le Besco, Kamen Kalev, Vincenzo Marra, Leonardo Di Costanzo, Vladimir Perisic, Marc Recha, Teresa Villaverde

title: Le pornographe
synopsis: Jacques, author of more than forty red light films before the decline and retirement, finally agrees to go back behind the camera for economic reasons, in shabby productions. Meanwhile, he has to deal with his own personal life: a son who gets closer but never meets, a wife who loves him but wants to get away from.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Jérémie Rénier, Ovidie, Thibault De Montalembert, Catherine Mouchet, André Marcon, Alice Houri, Laurent Lucas, Ségolène Savoff

title: Le porte del silenzio
synopsis: Melvin Devereux is driving home when his attention is drawn to a hearse that passes him and slows down right in front of his car. Any attempt to overcome it is in vain and the only tangible result is the mockery suffered by the bizarre driver. The return home of Melvin will continue between strange encounters and omens of death until a disturbing discovery that will subvert any logical and temporal plan.
cast: John Savage, Sandi Schultz, Richard Castleman, Jennifer Loeb

title: Le porte dell'inferno
synopsis: During an expedition some speleologists discover a terrifying reality hidden in the bowels of the earth. Attempt to revive the great tradition of Italian horror, out of time.
cast: Pietro Genuardi, Barbara Cupisti, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Mario Luzzi

title: Le premier cercle
synopsis: Milo Malakian, boss of a family that got rich from bad business, lives on the Côte d'Azur, from where he occasionally moves for some "big shot". A tough, one-piece, thirsty cop chases him of revenge against the one who killed a colleague ...
cast: Jean Reno, Gaspard Ulliel, Vahina Giocante, Sami Bouajila, Isaac Sharry, Alberto Gimignani, Eric Challier, Julian Negulesco, Franco Trevisi, Albert Goldberg

title: Le premier homme
synopsis: In the 1950s, Jacques Cormery (Jacques Gamblin), a French man in his forties, returned to Algeria, where he grew up. The African land, at the time still a French colony, overwhelms him with the memories of his childhood: his school, his mother, his classmates. In the meantime he confronts the Algerians' yearnings for independence and understands their reasons, which puts him, as a Frenchman, in serious contradictions.
cast: Jacques Gamblin, Maya Sansa, Catherine Sola, Denis Podalydès, Ulla Baugué, Nicolas Giraud, Nino Jouglet, Abdelkarim Benhabouccha, Hachemi Abdelmalek, Djamel Said, Jean Paul Bonnaire, Jean François Stévenin

title: Le premier venu
synopsis: Camille and Cyril meet and love each other. He is the first to come. He has a wife and daughter and now tries to push her back, but Camille doesn't give up and begins her endless siege.
cast: Clémentine Beaugrand, Gérald Thomassin, Guillaume Saurrel, Gwendoline Godquin, Jany Garachana, François Damiens, Noémie Herbet, Alice Paulicevich, Anne Paulicevich, Cyril Billard

title: Le prestige de la mort
synopsis: A filmmaker with declining fame accidentally stumbles upon a corpse: he exchanges his documents with those of the dead person to relaunch his career with the scoop of his untimely death ...
cast: Luc Moullet, Antonietta Pizzorno, Claire Bouanich, Iliana Lolitch

title: Le prime bande
synopsis: Based on the testimonies of Nardo Dunchi, Guido Quazza, Nuto Revelli and numerous other protagonists, the Turin documentary maker Paolo Gobetti reconstructs the birth of the first partisan groups in the period between 8 September 1943 and March 1944, illustrating it with some original films of the time.

title: Le prince oublié
synopsis: Djibi lives alone with Sofia, his 8-year-old daughter so every night he invents a story to make her fall asleep. When Sofia finally sleeps, the stories come to life: in an imaginary world, knights, pirates and other dragons move to save the princess (who is always Sofia) and to be of help or hindrance to the brave prince (who is no other. that Djibi). Three years later, Sofia's entry into high school marks the end of her childhood and Djibi's stories no longer have a reason to exist. While in reality Djibi will have to resign himself to Sofia's growth, in the world of fairy tales her prince will have to face the most epic of her adventures.
cast: Omar Sy, Bérénice Bejo, François Damiens, Sarah Gaye, Keyla Fala, Neotis Ronzon, Théo Hellermann, Maxence Huet, Manon Koltès, Isabelle Katz Liza Pivert

title: Le prix à payer
synopsis: Odile, a wealthy upper-middle-class lady, has no other worries in life than shopping, going to beauty salons and keeping her husband Jean-Pierre's insistent advances at bay. For his part, the latter - frustrated by the separate rooms imposed on him by his wife and the lack of intimacy - accepts the advice of his driver and decides to renegotiate the marital menage according to a new principle: "No sex, no money" ...
cast: Christian Clavier, Nathalie Baye, Gérard Lanvin, Géraldine Pailhas, Patrick Chesnais, Anaïs Demoustier, Maud Buquet, Francis Leplay, Jean François Robin, Josselin De Tonquedec

title: Le procès
synopsis: Joseph, an unnamed bank employee, learns that a trial is underway on him. At first he thinks of a joke, then he realizes that they are being serious. And without anyone ever revealing the charges to him. Welles, with the help of a hallucinatory photograph and an impeccable crowd of actors, composes one of his best films. Based on Kafka's novel, which Welles betrays and rereads (especially in the finale).
cast: Anthony Perkins, Jeanne Moreau, Romy Schneider, Orson Welles, Elsa Martinelli, Suzanne Flon, Akim Tamiroff, Madeleine Robinson, Arnoldo Foà, Fernand Ledoux, Michael Lonsdale, Max Buchsbaum

title: Le professionel
synopsis: Joss Beaumont, an agent of the French secret services, is entrusted with the task of assassinating Njala, president of an African country. At the last moment, however, the political scenario changes and Joss is handed over by his own superiors to the local authorities, who condemn him to a long prison sentence. But after a successful escape attempt, Joss returns to his homeland and deliberately informs those who betrayed and framed him of his intention to eliminate Njala, who has just arrived in France on an official visit anyway.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Jean Desailly, Robert Hossein, Cyrielle Claire

title: Le promeneur du champ de Mars
synopsis: The story of the end of a reign and the end of a life: that of François Mitterrand. A passionate journalist approaches the President fighting his latest battle against the disease to extract a universal lesson on life, politics and history, love and literature ... But Mitterrand doesn't have much to give because for him the moment has come when past, present and future are confused in a time inhabited by doubts, the one in which all men are equal: the time of those who are close to death.
cast: Michel Bouquet, Jalil Lespert, Philippe Fretun, Anne Cantineau, Sarah Grappin

title: Le prénom
synopsis: Vincent, a brilliant forty-year-old who is about to become a father for the first time, is invited to dinner in the quaint apartment of his sister Elisabeth and brother-in-law Pierre. Claude, his dear old childhood friend, also participates in the evening. While waiting for his partner Anna, constantly late, to join their company, Vincent is subjected to a fire of questions about the imminent fatherhood but, when he reveals the name of the future unborn child, an uproar with unexpected consequences breaks out in the family. .
cast: Patrick Bruel, Valérie Benguigui, Charles Berling, Guillaume De Tonquedec, Judith El Zein, Françoise Fabian, Yaniss Lespert
director: Alexandre De La Patellière, Mathieu Delaporte

title: Le père Noël a les yeux bleus
synopsis: In Narbona, Daniel (Jean-Pierre Léaud) commits small thefts with faded friends. In the Christmas period he decides to work together with a photographer (René Gilson) by disguising himself as a Santa Claus and selling the photos to passers -by, in order to buy a Montgomery coat soon, with whom he believes he can make a better figure in society and with girls. However, he realizes that with them he managed to have positive approaches only dressed as a Santa Claus.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Gérard Zimmermann, Henri Martinez, René Gilson, Michèle Maynard, Carmen Ripoll, Maurice Domingo, Jeanne Delos, Noëlle Baleste, Alain Derboy

title: Le père Noël est une ordure
synopsis: Christmas night: two employees are bored in the office of a friend's telephone line. The quiet will not last: a woman trapped in the lift of the palace, a pregnant girl fleeing by her violent man and a disguise in search of company are about to plunge in the sleepy evening.
cast: Anémone, Josiane Balasko, Marie Anne Chazel, Christian Clavier, Gérard Jugnot, Thierry Lhermitte, Bruno Moynot, Martin Lamotte, Jacques François, Claire Magnin

title: Le père de mes enfants
synopsis: Grégoire Canvel is a happy man, life smiles at him: a wife he loves, three delightful children and a job he adores. Grégoire is in fact a film producer and devotes all his attention and energy to his work, obtaining great personal satisfaction from it. But slowly things slip: energy becomes hyperactivity, dedication obsession. And too many projects end up overlapping. Grégoire takes the longest step, and accumulates risks, debts, fatigue. Until being submerged.
cast: Eric Elmosnino, Chiara Caselli, Michaël Abiteboul, Alice De Lencquesaing, Louis Do De Lencquesaing, Manelle Driss, Sandrine Dumas, Dominique Frot, Alice Gautier, Valerie Lang

title: Le quattro giornate di Napoli
synopsis: The film tells the humble and heroic epic of the Neapolitan citizenship who, without bosses and without pre-ordered tactics, finds themselves united in September 1943 to fight an improvised battle. Despite a "ridiculous" and rudimentary weaponry, thanks to the courage of the children of the reformatory and the elderly and the involvement of women, the insurgents manage to free the city from the Nazis, before the arrival of the allied troops.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Lea Massari, Georges Wilson, Aldo Giuffré

title: Le quattro verità
synopsis: "Death and the executioner": a musician who works on street corners, tired of life, tries to commit suicide. A woman and a man intervene and make him change his mind. "The two pigeons": love breaks out between a man and a woman who were closed by pure chance in an apartment. "The crow and the fox": a man jealous of his wife enters into business with those who would like to take her away from him. "The hare and the game": a woman undergoes various vicissitudes in order to win back her unfaithful husband.
cast: Hardy Krüger, Charles Aznavour, Michel Serrault, Monica Vitti
director: Luis Garcia Berlanga, René Clair, Hervé Bromberger, Alessandro Blasetti

title: Le quattro volte
synopsis: An old shepherd lives his last days in a peaceful medieval village perched in the mountains of Calabria. He took his goats very high, to an area abandoned by the villagers. He is ill and believes he has found a cure in the dust that accumulates on the church floor and that he drinks every day along with water. A kid has just been born. We follow his first steps and his first games, until he is strong enough to go out to pasture. Elsewhere, a majestic tree moves with the mountain breeze and slowly changes colors with the seasons.
cast: Giuseppe Fuda, Bruno Timpano, Nazareno Timpano

title: Le ragazze dello swing
synopsis: Television miniseries produced by Casanova Multimedia and originally broadcast by Rai Uno. The vocal performances are by the Italian group Blue Dolls (Angelica Dettori, Viviana Dragani and Irene Valvolo).
cast: Andrea Osvart, Sergio Assisi, Lotte Verbeek, Elise Schaap, Giuseppe Battiston, Luca Canale Brucculeri, Gualtiero Burzi, Viviana Dragani, Giovanni Ferreri, Sylvia Kristel, Maurizio Marchetti, Marina Massironi, Alessandro Bertolucci

title: Le ragazze di Miss Italia
synopsis: While he is spending a holiday at the luxurious Grand Hotel Terme, a professor over seventy is witnessing the vicissitudes that animate the hectic days of the two hundred aspirants to the title of queen: the make-up, acting, dance and catwalk tests alternate with friendships and sympathies, envies and jealousies, anxieties, dreams, illusions, loves that break, families in crisis, spite, recommendations ... Little by little, the elderly teacher becomes a sort of confidant of the participants; but in addition to the guests in the hotel there is also Rosa, the owner, and it will be with her that the fateful spark will strike.
cast: Gabriele Ferzetti, Christiane Filangeri, Simona Marchini, Nadia Bengala, Gianfranco D'Angelo

title: Le ragazze di Piazza di Spagna
synopsis: Three dressmakers, who work in the center of Rome, but live in the township, have different love stories: Marisa, engaged to a worker, must choose between being in love and a career as a model. What will he choose? Elena, after a disappointment in love, even thinks about suicide. Luckily for her she soon meets a good young man, who is a taxi driver, who reconciles her with life. Lucia finally accepts the court of a suitor she has constantly rejected.
cast: Lucia Bosé, Marcello Mastroianni, Cosetta Greco, Ave Ninchi

title: Le ragazze di San Frediano
synopsis: Andrea known as Bob, a young mechanic, holds up "stories" with five girls at the same time. One of them, Gina, expresses suicidal intentions and Bob, who feels guilty, becomes engaged to her. But here is that Tosca claims to have been seduced by the Don Giovanni, the friend whom Silvana stole from, crushes him and Mafalda leaves him. Bob would only have to leave for the Riviera with Bice, but ...
cast: Antonio Cifariello, Rossana Podestà, Giovanna Ralli, Corinne Calvet

title: Le ragioni dell'aragosta
synopsis: The actors of the television program _Avanzi_ meet, after 15 years, in a small village in Sardinia for a show in support of the cause of fishermen. This is how they met Gianni Usai, a former Fiat worker and former trade unionist ...
cast: Sabina Guzzanti, Pierfrancesco Loche, Francesca Reggiani, Cinzia Leone

title: Le rapace
synopsis: Mexico, 1938. A foreigner was hired by the revolutionaries to kill the President. Skillfully, the killer overcomes all checkpoints and settles in the house where he must wait for the set time. Having completed the mission with the help of the young Miguel, the new danger is the revolutionaries themselves who want to eliminate the man. Lino Ventura is the real trump card of the film, skilled as he is at building a well-rounded character, more than the evident attempts of the director to build a climate of tension, only partially successful. Although José Giovanni, he tells with a good pulse.
cast: Lino Ventura, Xavier Marc, Rosa Furman, Aurora Clavel

title: Le rayon vert
synopsis: Delphine cannot decide where she will spend her holidays: the sea makes her bored, the mountain makes her sad. A boy manages to convince her to spend a few days in a fishing village: here they will witness the revealing phenomenon of the "green ray". Rohmer in its purest form: lightness and freedom. Improvisation in the dialogues, distant inspiration from a novel (of the same name) by Jules Verne. Golden Lion in Venice.
cast: Marie Rivière, Béatrice Romand, Amira Chemakhi, Sylvie Richez, Rosette, Vincent Gauthier, Basile Gervaise, Marcello Pezzutto

title: Le refuge
synopsis: Louis (Melvil Poupaud) is a young man from a wealthy Parisian family who has fallen into a drug spiral. Together with Mousse (Isabelle Carré) she spends an evening of love and excess in her apartment. The next morning he died of an overdose and she is unconscious. This is how Louis's mother finds them, who had no idea what ink her son took. Soon after, it is revealed that Mousse became pregnant with Louis. The girl, frowned upon by Louis's mother, decides to move away from Paris and, against all advice, to keep the baby.
cast: Isabelle Carré, Louis Ronan Choisy, Pierre Louis Calixte, Melvil Poupaud, Claire Vernet, Jean Pierre Andréani, Marie Rivière, Nicolas Moreau, Emile Berling, Maurice Antoni

title: Le repas des fauves
synopsis: In a French town occupied by the Nazis, some friends meet for dinner. The commander of the SS introduces himself and demands, in retaliation, the delivery of two among those present, chosen at random. Everyone thus begins to accuse each other.
cast: Francis Blanche, Antonella Lualdi

title: Le repos du guerrier
synopsis: A wealthy young lady, bored by her high-ranking environment, scandalizes the decent family by becoming the mistress of an alcoholic drifter with suicidal impulses. Will the woman be able to save him from his attempts to take his own life?
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Robert Hossein, Macha Meril, James Robertson Justice

title: Le retour de Casanova
synopsis: The years have passed inexorably, and Giacomo Casanova's love career has come to an end: to the ravages of time is added the penalty for exile from Venice, and now only memory remains. But the elderly amateur does not resist the challenge of one last conquest and tries to overcome the resistance of the beautiful and young Marcolina. Casanova still has a few arrows in his bow, and the cunning of age suggests that he should resort to darkness ...
cast: Alain Delon, Fabrice Luchini, Elsa Lunghini, Delia Boccardo, Wadeck Stanczak, Philippine Leroy Beaulieu, Alain Cuny

title: Le retour de Martin Guerre
synopsis: In a small village in the France of the sixteenth century, the farmer Martin disappears after getting married very young. After many years, an individual shows up at his wife's house claiming to be Martin and shortly thereafter another man arrives saying the same thing. The story ends in court, where the woman is convinced of the sincerity of one of the two.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Nathalie Baye, Roger Planchon, Bernard Pierre Donnadieu

title: Le retour du fils prodigue/Humiliés
synopsis: After Workers, peasants, this diptych tackles again the novel Le donne di Messina by Elio Vittorini (1948-'49). Interested more in the profound substance of a text than in its narrative surface, Straub and Huillet, as always, derive from it a choral and "alienated" reading. Music by Edgar Varèse (Arcana).
cast: Rosalba Curatola, Aldo Fruttuosi, Romano Guelfi, Enrico Achilli, Martina Gionfriddo

title: Le retour du héros
synopsis: France, 1809. Captain Neuville, a great seducer, asks for the hand of the young Pauline, under the suspicious gaze of her elder sister Elisabeth. Soon, Neuville is called to the front and Pauline is left alone, letting go. With her sister increasingly emaciated, Elisabeth begins an epistolary correspondence with Pauline pretending to be Neuville and making him a true war hero. However, the captain will return and Pauline will see nothing in him of the image of the man that has built up over time.
cast: Jean Dujardin, Mélanie Laurent, Noémie Merlant, Feodor Atkine, Laurent Bateau, Evelyne Buyle, Jean Michel Lahmi, Christian Bujeau

title: Le rideau cramoisi
synopsis: A young officer is staying with a bourgeois family. Albertine, daughter of the couple, has a haughty attitude and the young man falls in love with her.
cast: Anouk Aimée, Marguerite Garcya, Jim Gérald, Jean Claude Pascal

title: Le roi danse
cast: Benoît Magimel, Boris Terral, Tchéky Karyo, Cécile Bois, Claire Keim

title: Le roi de l'évasion
synopsis: Armand Lacourtade, 43, is fed up with his homosexual single life. And so when he meets Curly, a teenager, he suddenly changes trends. Overcoming many difficulties, the two end up creating a rather strange couple. But is this really the life Armand dreamed of?
cast: Hafsia Herzi, Ludovic Berthillot, Pascal Aubert, Luc Palun, Bruno Valayer, Jean Toscan, Pierre Laur, François Clavier

title: Le roi du village
synopsis: Moses, a foundling, is raised by the villagers and grows up good and strong, especially popular with everyone. The little boy, growing up, attracts the sympathies of Agnese, a girl in her same condition. One day four girls from Paris arrive in the village for a short vacation and with their frenzied behavior shock Moses and the villagers. The inhabitants of the town, not at all accustomed to city excesses, do everything to make the girls escape who, terrified, return to the City of Light. Moses, deceived by their kindness, decides to follow them, much to Agnes' chagrin. Thus he will find himself in Paris, a great city full of pitfalls, unsuitable for a pure heart like his.
cast: Henry Tisot, Luisa Mattioli, Catherine Rouvel, Anna Maria Pace

title: Le roman d'un tricheur
cast: Sacha Guitry, Serge Gave, Pierre Assy, Marguerite Moreno

title: Le roman de Renard
synopsis: In the kingdom of animals, a fox, Renard, lives by tricks by deceiving other animals with his cunning. Having reached the ears of the Noble Lion King many complaints about it, he decides to imprison Renard and establishes the law that all animals will no longer have to eat each other. However, Renard will manage to get out of trouble by gaining the king's trust.

title: Le roman de Werther
synopsis: Young Werther works at the Walheim courthouse; he meets the beautiful Charlotte and falls in love with her, without knowing that she is already betrothed. The future husband is Werther's superior. Forced to step aside, the young man indulges in a dissipated life; summoned to order by his superiors and urged by Charlotte, he comes to his senses but briefly. Desperate, Werther eventually decides to kill himself.
cast: Pierre Richard Willm, Annie Vernay, Jean Galland

title: Le rose del deserto
synopsis: Summer 1940: the Department of the Health Section camps in the Libyan desert. All the soldiers are convinced that the war is almost over and that they will soon be returning home. Commander Strucci spends his time writing love letters to his wife Lucia, Lieutenant Salvi goes around taking pictures ... As the months go by, theirs becomes a humanitarian mission: but the fate of the war is reversed.
cast: Alessandro Haber, Giorgio Pasotti, Michele Placido, Fulvio Falzarano, Tatti Sanguineti, Claudio Bigagli, Moran Atias

title: Le rouge est mis
synopsis: In Paris, Louis il Biondo (Jean Gabin), gangster author of numerous successful robberies with the complicity of Pepito (Lino Ventura), Fredo and Raymond, welcomes his brother Pierre, who has just come out, in the garage he manages during the day as a cover. from a turbulent relationship with Helene (Annie Girardot). Immediately after his arrival, however, Louis is arrested by the police and Pepito tries to convince the others that the fault lies with Pierre, a propable spy and traitor towards whom to direct his revenge.
cast: Jean Gabin, Paul Frankeur, Marcel Bozzuffi, Albert Dinan, Antonin Berval, Thomy Bourdelle, Serge Lecointe, Jean Pierre Mocky, Jo Peignot, Lucien Raimbourg

title: Le rouge et le noir
synopsis: The protection of Abbot Chelan opens the doors of the house of Rénal to the young Julien Sorel, the son of a carpenter, where he enters as a tutor. Despite his humble origins, Julien, animated by an inordinate ambition, arrives to woo the romantic Madame de Rénal. An anonymous letter denounces the affair to her husband and Julien is forced to leave the house. At this point the boy is undecided whether to join the army or the seminary. Julien is convinced that the best thing is to enter the seminary, but he will stay there for a short time.
cast: Gérard Philipe, Danielle Darrieux, Antonella Lualdi, Jean Mercure

title: Le révélateur
synopsis: The life of a young couple is strongly conditioned by the presence of a child at an early age. The little one seriously risks undermining the delicate relationship between his parents, but, at the same time, he highlights its dramatic complexity.
cast: Stanislas Robiolles, Laurent Terzieff, Bernadette Lafont

title: Le saint prend l'affût
synopsis: Although dedicated to unlawful activities, the English adventurer Simon Templar never forgets good manners. His generosity is such as to push him to bail out a friend who is in dire straits and is involved in an intrigue of American and German spies. And the daughter is also involved ...
cast: Jean Marais, Raffaella Carrà, Jess Hahn, Daniel Evenou

title: Le salaire de la peur
synopsis: In an oil field located in a remote Latin American country, the company hires four desperate people - the Corso Mario, the French Jo, the German Bimbo and the Italian Luigi - to transport a cargo of nitroglycerin needed to close a well. on fire. The quartet then divides into two crews driving as many trucks, and the risky journey begins ...
cast: Yves Montand, Charles Vanel, Folco Lulli, Peter Van Eyck, Véra Clouzot, Antonio Centa, William Tubbs, Dario Moreno

title: Le salamandre
synopsis: Morocco. Between two girls, lovers and co-workers (a photographer and her model), a man enters who is convinced that he can take at least one to bed.
cast: Anthony Vernon, Tony Carrel, Antonio Casale, Beryl Cunningham, Alain N. Kalsyj, Erna Schurer, Michelle Stamp

title: Le sang d'un poète
synopsis: Inspired by the director's dreams and obsessions, a poet (Enrique Rivero) tries to get rid of a mouth that has remained imprinted on the palm of one hand, after he had tried to erase it from the canvas of one of his paintings, having become animated. Inspired by a statue (Elizabeth Lee Miller) he begins a journey strewn with unconscious symbolism beyond a mirror, up to the reminiscences of childhood and the knowledge of the tremendous boredom of the immortality of glory.
cast: Enrique Rivero, Elizabeth Lee Miller, Pauline Carton, Odette Talazac, Jean Desbordes, Fernand Dichamps, Lucien Jager, Féral Benga, Barbette, Jean Cocteau

title: Le sang à la tête
synopsis: In La Rochelle, a strict and closed city in Brittany, Mr. Cardinaud has made his way without much scruples and, still young, is a rich man, feared and hated. He spends his life as a well-to-do bourgeois, a lover of order and domestic peace. Taken by business, he does not realize that success and wealth push him to neglect his wife, who slowly moves away from him to go and live with a childhood partner.
cast: Jean Gabin, Paul Frankeur, Claude Sylvain, Georgette Anys

title: Le saut de l'ange
synopsis: The Orsini clan of Marseille is hindered by an occult and powerful enemy. In fact, in the Provencal city, the business world allies itself with an emerging clan to defeat the "family" that holds power. At stake is a procurement package. Louis Orsini thus finds himself at war while the police are just waiting to collect the corpses.
cast: Jean Yanne, Senta Berger, Sterling Hayden, Giancarlo Sbragia, Raymond Pellegrin

title: Le sauvage
cast: Yves Montand, Catherine Deneuve, Luigi Vannucchi, Dana Wynter

title: Le sauveur
synopsis: We are in 1943, during the German occupation. In a small and remote village in the French countryside, Nanette, a 14-year-old girl, rescues an injured paratrooper who claims to be an Englishman who has lost contact with the resistance. The girl, who is fascinated by the man and falls in love with him, helps him hide and establishes a relationship with him. The man, however, is in fact a German infiltrator who intends to discover the names of the dissidents and who intends to use the girl to achieve his goal. He will succeed thanks to the naive devotion of Nanette. Many years later, when the man returns to the country to revisit the places of his dirty action, Nanette, now aged and weighed down in the figure and with the weight of that distant guilt on her shoulders, will thus have the opportunity and opportunity to carry out her revenge. .
cast: Horst Buchholz, Muriel Catala, Hélène Vallier, Roger Lumont, Henri Vilbert, Danièle Ajoret, Michel Delahaye, Jean Pierre Sentier, Frédéric Norbert, Yves Hugues

title: Le scandale
cast: Anthony Perkins, Maurice Ronet, Yvonne Furneaux, Stéphane Audran

title: Le scaphandre et le papillon
synopsis: On December 8, 1995, Jean-Dominique Bauby - journalist and father of two - suddenly falls into a coma. When he wakes up he is immobilized, struck by what medicine defines as "locked-in syndrome": he can only move his left eyelid, which becomes his link with the world ...
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Emmanuelle Seigner, Marie Joseé Croze, Max Von Sydow

title: Le scarpe al sole
synopsis: With Italy's entry into the war in 1915, a veteran of Libya and two young men, including one just married, are recruited to defend the borders of the homeland. The hard life in the trenches, between assaults, retreats, moments of stalemate and tragic losses, will deeply mark the three men.
cast: Camillo Pilotto, Cesco Baseggio, Carlo Ludovici

title: Le schiave di Cartagine
synopsis: Giulia Marzia is jealous of the love between the tribune Marco Valerio and a Carthaginian slave, Lea. A series of political intrigues leads to the indictment of Christians for the murder of the proconsul (killed by Flavio Metello): Lea and Marco are imprisoned. But Marco's friends free him and prevent the massacre. Lea and Marco get married. Historical reconstruction and sentimentality intertwine in the adventurous story.
cast: Gianna Maria Canale, Jorge Mistral, Marisa Allasio, Luisa Peluffo

title: Le schiave esistono ancora
synopsis: The film starts from the assumption that forms of slavery still exist in the world and goes to their research focusing above all on the Middle Eastern geographical area. Here the camera enters the princely harems, places of destination for modern slaves. Even some European girls try "luck" in those countries trusting in their attractiveness. It is a documentary film with vague claims of social denunciation. It actually became a good excuse to sneak in and peek into Arab harems. So much so that Folco Quilici, originally involved in the project, took off his signature in controversy with the result.

title: Le scomunicate di San Valentino
synopsis: The love between two young people is prevented by her family, who locks the girl in a convent. However, the boy manages to enter stealthily, but he will have to fight against an evil abbess and a mysterious trail of blood that spreads along the corridors of the monastery.
cast: Françoise Prevost, Jenny Tamburi, Paolo Malco, Franco Ressel, Corrado Gaipa, Gino Rocchetti, Pier Giovanni Anchisi, Calisto Calisti, Aldina Martano, Bruna Beani

title: Le secret
synopsis: A madman escaped from the criminal asylum attempts to escape the mountains and finds refuge in a hut where he stays a married couple. The intertwining runs on the edge of ambiguity: what is the true history of man?
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Marlène Jobert, Philippe Noiret, Jean François Adam

title: Le secret
synopsis: A thoughtfully selfish husband and a two-year-old child: this is Marie's world, a woman in the midst of the critical ford between thirty and forty, a door-to-door seller of encyclopedias who loves her work and thinks she pleases the husband making another child. The chance encounter with a man who is where he shouldn't, collapses that castle of false harmony that hides a boring and monotonous family life, punctuated by ritual appointments such as a child's bath or a game of tennis with her husband. The other is an American black dancer who swapped his Parisian apartment with a friend. Storyteller, charming, sexually vigorous, she represents everything that her husband is not or is no longer and Marie gives in, putting her world in jeopardy. An insinuating passion envelops her and leads her to her lover, regardless of the consequences.
cast: Anne Coesens, Michel Bompoil, Tony Todd, Quentin Rossi

title: Le secret d'Hélène Marimon
synopsis: Hélène, married to a soldier, cheats on her husband with one of his comrades. Their relationship is so short that Hélène will be seized with remorse for the rest of her life. A few years pass: the woman meets her former lover again and the flame is rekindled ...
cast: Isa Miranda, Frank Villard, Carla Del Poggio, Jean Debucourt, Louis De Funès

title: Le secret des banquises
synopsis: Madly in love in secret with the brilliant and selfish Professor Quignard, shy Christophine has been attending his PhD research laboratory for eight years. The professor and his team are about to make a discovery that will shake the world of science and medicine: they have identified in penguins a miraculous protein capable of guaranteeing universal immunity. All that's missing to start human trials is lender approval. With a mad gesture aimed at attracting the attention of the beloved, Christophine injects the compound suddenly becoming the fulcrum of all man's attention.
cast: Guillaume Canet, Charlotte Le Bon, Anne Le Ny, Patrick D'Assumçao, Damien Chapelle

title: Le sei mogli di Barbablù
synopsis: Antonio Esposito (Totò) is forced to marry a hag, but after the ceremony he escapes abroad. Back undercover, he is mistaken for famous detective Nick Parker who is investigating a dangerous killer who has already killed five men and kidnapped their wives. Unmasked, Totò is forced to continue in the fiction to allow the real Parker to remain in the shadows and to allow an American journalist who pretends to be his wife to lure Bluebeard.
cast: Totò, Isa Barzizza, Carlo Ninchi, Mario Castellani, Tino Buazzelli, Luigi Pavese

title: Le seminariste
synopsis: The marquis Daniela is sent by her father to her hometown, in the Lecce area, to participate in a seminar in which twenty-four boys take part. While the boys try to evade the surveillance of their assistants, the town's notables struggle to secure the miraculous water of the patron saint. Their intention is to use it for spas and to produce a liqueur. Daniela is the first to notice the intricacies linked to her family and that of her uncle deputy mayor.
cast: Gabriele Di Giulio, Daniela Doria, Gisela Hahn, Raf Baldassarre

title: Le sens de la famille
synopsis: One morning, Morel wake up with a big problem: they discover that the spirit of everyone finds themselves blocked in the body of another member of the family. Chacha, six years old, has the body of the father, the father that of the teenage son, the boy that of the older sister, this of the mother and the woman that of Chacha. Nobody understands us anything anymore and it will be only the beginning of a situation destined to escape them from hand.
cast: Franck Dubosc, Alexandra Lamy, Rose De Kervenoaël, Mathilde Roehrich, Nils Othenin Girard, Artus, Jackie Berroyer, Maud Druine, Christiane Millet, Sabrina Lopez Leonard, Gil Alma, Philippe Uchan

title: Le septième ciel
synopsis: Brigitte, a very rich widow, owner of the famous Three Star Beer industry, lives in a sumptuous castle. Lestrange lives with her, a friend who is very much in love with her. Thanks to her advice, Brigitte dedicates herself to charitable works. To procure the funds she needs to do good, Brigitte invites dishonest financiers to her home, steals huge sums from them and kills them. Portal, a man who is reputed to be rich but actually thrives on his wits, is also targeted by Brigitte.
cast: Danielle Darrieux, Paul Meurisse, Noël Noël, Gérard Oury, Alberto Sordi

title: Le septième juré
synopsis: A man responsible for the murder of a prostitute finds himself on the jury of a trial that discusses a similar case to his own. Shocked by pangs of conscience, he will lose control of the situation.
cast: Bernard Blier, Francis Blanche, Jacques Riberolles, Jacques Monod

title: Le serment des Hitler
synopsis: This documentary retraces the footsteps of Adolf Hitler's mysterious nephew and explores what became of the Hitler family line.

title: Le serpent
synopsis: Photographer (and divorced father) Vincent Mandel sees his life on the verge of an end due to a plan organized by a former schoolmate of his. Allegations of murder, concealment of evidence and blackmail will lead Vincent on a descent to hell. The only possibility for man seems to be that of challenging the enemy to his own game.
cast: Yvan Attal, Clovis Cornillac, Pierre Richard, Simon Abkarian, Minna Haapkylä, Olga Kurylenko, Gérald Laroche, Jean Claude Bouillon, Veronika Varga, Pierre Marzin

title: Le serpent
synopsis: An adviser from the Russian embassy in Paris asks for political asylum and begins to make revelations, involving unsuspected characters, about the Soviet spy network in the West. The counsel's testimonies provoke a chain of suicides, resignations and "torpedoes". An extraordinary cast for a good product that, fed with documented facts, takes you back to the incredible but true intrigues of the cold war.
