cast: Yul Brynner, Henry Fonda, Dirk Bogarde, Philippe Noiret, Michel Bouquet, Virna Lisi

title: Le sette folgori di Assur
synopsis: After the Assyrians have killed her parents, the beautiful Myrrh is taken to Nineveh, at the court of Sardanapalo. Soon between the girl and Shammash, the king's brother, passion arises: but Sardanapalo, who in turn has his eye on Mirra, intends to play his cards ...
cast: Jackie Laine, Luciano Marin, Howard Duff, Giancarlo Sbragia, Arnoldo Foà

title: Le sette sfide
synopsis: In the presence of the Khan, a quarrel breaks out between the Circassian Ivan and the Kyrgyz Amok. The Khan decides to end this rivalry: the winner of seven challenges will have supremacy over the rival. Ivan, defeated by deception in the seventh match, contemplates revenge.
cast: Ed Fury, Furio Meniconi, Roldano Lupi, Gabriele Antonini, Bella Cortez

title: Le sette vipere
synopsis: The Italian industrialist Lorenzo lives in Argentina where he married Erika, of Austrian origin. After some disagreements, the latter - advised by her friends and supported by local law - manages to have her husband's assets seized and to be entrusted with the two children born of the marriage. After trying (in vain) to oppose, Lorenzo returns to Italy taking his children and his affectionate secretary with him, but here too he has to deal with the law. Meanwhile, Erika has also arrived from Argentina and takes her husband to court ...
cast: Vincenzo Cascino, Lisa Gastoni, Umberto D'Orsi, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aroldo Tieri, Gloria Paul

title: Le signe du Lion
synopsis: Pierre, a penniless musician, is about to become rich thanks to an inheritance. To celebrate the event, he borrows some money from his friends and throws a big party. Then the inheritance goes to his cousin and then Pierre is left alone to wander in a summer and deserted Paris, getting acquainted with the homeless, getting drunk in the bars. It is in one of these that the news reaches him: his cousin died in an accident.
cast: Jess Hahn, Van Doude, Jean Luc Godard, Stéphane Audran

title: Le signore
synopsis: A crowd of women, husbands and especially lovers gravitate around a hairdresser named René and his beauty salon. The situations that arise and the dynamics in which René offers his generous collaboration are predictable.
cast: Nadia Gray, Bice Valori, Enrico Maria Salerno, Paolo Ferrari

title: Le signorine dello 04
synopsis: "Five stories of five women who work at a state telephone switchboard. Of different ages and social status, each has desires, aspirations or secrets that move life. One, the daughter of a worker, is waiting for Prince Charming; one gets engaged with a student who had come to the brink of suicide, another runs after a rich widower trying to catch him by the ... throat, another, finally, has to endure the constant betrayals of her husband. a little sad, a little funny and a little colorless.
cast: Franca Valeri, Antonella Lualdi, Giovanna Ralli, Marisa Merlini, Peppino De Filippo, Tina Pica

title: Le silence de Lorna
synopsis: Lorna is a young Albanian girl who lives in Belgium and who, in order to have citizenship and be able to realize her little dream with her boyfriend, Sokul, agrees to submit to a plot hatched by a little good, Fabio: to marry a young drug addict Belgian, Claudy. Fabio will then proceed to kill Claudy by simulating an overdose and Lorna will then have to marry a Russian mobster, willing to pay very well for having Belgian citizenship in turn.
cast: Arta Dobroshi, Jérémie Rénier, Fabrizio Rongione, Alban Ukaj, Morgan Marinne, Olivier Gourmet, Anton Yakovlev, Grigori Manoukov, Mireille Bailly

title: Le silence de la mer
synopsis: Werner von Ebrennac is a young German officer stationed in a small village in the French countryside. With a noble soul and refined tastes (in civilian life he composes music), he manages to obtain the silent esteem of the old man and the girl who have been forced to give him accommodation. After a leave in Paris, disgusted by the attitude of his fellow soldiers, however, he asks to be sent to the front. It is Melville's debut feature film. Taken from the novel of the same name by Vercors, considered a sort of sacred text by those who had made the Resistance, it is an interesting example of contrast with a literary text and an exciting film. Shot in the real house of Vercors.
cast: Howard Vernon, Jean Marie Robain, Nicole Stéphane

title: Le silence est d'or
synopsis: In the Paris of the Belle Époque, an elderly film director, hailing from variety, continually boasts his female conquests, relentlessly propagating his belief in libertinism. But when he falls in love with the same girl he fell in love with, his assistant sacrifices himself in favor of the young colleague and indeed teaches him the right strategy to break through the girl's heart.
cast: Maurice Chevalier, Marcelle Derrien, François Périer, Dany Robin

title: Le silencieux
synopsis: Haliakof, a member of a Soviet delegation visiting a thermonuclear plant in London, is kidnapped by the British counter-intelligence, which to cover the operation spreads the news of his death in a car accident. The kidnappers, who want to use him to break into the Russian secret services, know everything about his life: his real name is Clement Tibère and he is married to an Italian; he then emigrated to the Soviet Union, where he became a highly regarded researcher ...
cast: Lino Ventura, Lea Massari, Leo Genn, Suzanne Flon, Pierre Michel Le Conte

title: Le soldatesse
synopsis: Albania, World War II. A soldier is assigned to escort some prostitutes who have sold themselves to the Italian occupation army. During the journey some will die, others will be killed, one will become aware and join the partisans in the mountains. The military thus knows the most squalid and inhuman aspects of war.
cast: Mario Adorf, Anna Karina, Lea Massari, Marie Laforêt, Valeria Morriconi

title: Le soleil des voyoux
synopsis: Denis is a former robber torn from a quiet middle-class life by Jim, a friend in trouble with drug traffickers. The two rob a bank, Jim's enemies kidnap Denis' wife for the loot. Relentless thriller supported by a very solid cast, with a Margaret Lee (Betty) cat interpreter and worthy of the best tradition of film noir.
cast: Jean Gabin, Robert Stack, Suzanne Flon, Margaret Lee

title: Le solitaire
synopsis: Police Commissioner Stan (Belmondo) and his friend Inspector Simon, during a normal patrol tour, come across Schneider, a dangerous wanted man. The unsuccessful attempt to arrest the delinquent causes a gunfight in which Simon is killed. It takes two years for Stan to track down Schneider and bring him to justice. The film is tailor-made for Belmondo who, once again, plays the role of the lonely policeman who fights against bureaucracy but who, at the same time, practices a kind of private violence.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Michel Creton, Michel Beaune, François Dunoyer

title: Le sorelle
synopsis: The young Diana leaves Rome and the work to see her sister Marta, married for two years with Alex. While in love with her husband, affectionate and kind, passionate farmer of exotic flowers, Marta however seeks a diversion in the arms of another man, with whom she meets, regularly, in a hut. Diana realizes that in that marital union, apparently so solid, there is an incineration, and takes advantage of it to try to regain that relationship of exclusive and morbid affection he had with his sister before his marriage.
cast: Susan Strasberg, Massimo Girotti, Nathalie Delon, Giancarlo Giannini, Lars Bloch

title: Le sorelle Macaluso
synopsis: Maria, Pinuccia, Lia, Katia and Antonella are sisters born, raised and aged in an apartment on the top floor of a building on the outskirts of Palermo. Theirs is a house that bears the signs of the passing of time like those who grew up there and those who still live there.
cast: Alissa Maria Orlando, Laura Giordani, Rosalba Bologna, Susanna Piraino, Serena Barone, Maria Rosaria Alati, Anita Pomario, Donatella Finocchiaro, Ileana Rigano, Eleonora De Luca, Simona Malato, Viola Pusatieri

title: Le sorelle Materassi
synopsis: Two elderly sisters live in Florence. But an exuberant and casual grandson bursts into their house. The two women are squeezed and humiliated. Based on a novel by Palazzeschi, the film is based on the interpretation of two well-known theater actresses, sisters also in life: Emma and Irma Gramatica. The acting of the two is very dated, but the staging is of supreme elegance.
cast: Irma Gramatica, Emma Gramatica, Massimo Serato, Paola Borboni, Olga Solbelli

title: Le sorprese del divorzio
synopsis: Exasperated by his mother-in-law's impossible character, a wealthy young man gets a divorce; after which, determined not to have anything to do with the category of mother-in-law, he marries the daughter of an elderly widower. However, unbeknownst to everyone, one day he takes a wife again: who is none other than ...
cast: Armando Falconi, Sergio Tofano, Bice Parisi, Filippo Scelzo

title: Le sorprese dell'amore
synopsis: The shy Ferdinando is engaged to the exuberant and extrovert Didì, his enterprising friend Battista with the shy and romantic Marianna. Maybe it would be better to swap boyfriends, the two girls think. Hence the maneuvers to make the unsuspecting young men fall in love with each other's girlfriend. The matter presents some complications, but in the end, somehow, everything works out.
cast: Walter Chiari, Sylva Koscina, Franco Fabrizi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Dorian Gray, Silvana Pampanini

title: Le souffle au coeur
synopsis: Dijon, 1954: Laurent Chevalier, a 15-year-old from a good family, is initiated into sex by his mother Clara and experiences a series of experiences that abruptly propel him into adulthood.
cast: Benoît Ferreux, Lea Massari, Daniel Gélin, Michael Lonsdale

title: Le soulier de satin
synopsis: At the time of the Spanish colonization of Latin America, the love of the young Rodrigo for Donna Prodezza (who is married) and whom he pursues throughout his life: from Spain to Latin America to Africa. Claudel that de Oliveira transfigures through cinema: fixed floors, theatrical acting, stylized sets. The title refers to the fact that Donna Prodezza gives her satin slipper to the statue of the Virgin.
cast: Luis Miguel Cintra, Patricia Barzyk, Anne Consigny, Anne Gautier, Bernard Alane, Jean Pierre Bernard, Marie Christine Barrault, Jean Badin, Isabelle Weingarten, Henri Serre, Jean Yves Berteloot, Catherine Jarret, Anny Romand

title: Le souper
synopsis: In the acrid candlelight, on the night between 6 and 7 July 1815, two men sit at a richly laid table for a dinner, which will prove decisive for the destinies of France. The two are the former archbishop and diplomat Talleyrand and the Jacobin revolutionary and former police minister of Bonaparte Fouché. Shortly after the defeat of Waterloo, the two ("the vice in the arm of crime", as the voiceover recalls) will hand over France to the new king.
cast: Claude Brasseur, Claude Rich, Tichy Holgado, Yann Collette

title: Le sourire
synopsis: The well-known psychiatrist Dr. La Clainche (Marielle), a great petticoat, decides to indulge in one last erotic adventure, even if the doctors tell him that his heart is in dangerous disorder. So, accidentally meeting Odile (Seigner), he follows her through a tortuous and ambiguous path of circumstances until he manages to take her to bed. The ending is, fatally, fatal. It is not the ambition that Claude Miller lacks, but here there is too much clutter in the script and too many cerebral conundrums. The palm among the interpreters goes to Bohringer, the slimy stripteaseures manager.
cast: Jean Pierre Marielle, Richard Bohringer, Emmanuelle Seigner

title: Le spie amano i fiori
synopsis: Martin Stevens, her British Majesty's secret agent, has completed a difficult assignment. In just forty-eight hours he recovered the gamma electro-meter, a newly developed electronic device, which had been stolen in London. But the mission is not yet complete, Martin must in fact eliminate three individuals who took part in the theft. Not infamous Italian spy, directed by a young Lenzi.
cast: Roger Browne, Emma Danieli, Dan Vargas, Marino Masé

title: Le spie uccidono a Beirut
synopsis: Soviet and American secret services compete for precious microfilms with no holds barred. Apotheosis of the Cold War, with a hint of humor.
cast: Richard Harrison, Dominique Boschero

title: Le spie uccidono in silenzio
synopsis: A mysterious organization kills the daughter of an English researcher in Beirut, guilty of not succumbing to threats to stop him from investigating cancer treatment. Agent Michael is sent to deal with the affair.
cast: Lang Jeffries, Emma Danieli, Erika Blanc, Andrea Bosic, José Bodalo

title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
synopsis: Two Sicilian hotel porters are mistakenly commissioned by a CIA agent to unmask the plans of Dr. Goldfoot, who wants to conquer the world by causing a conflict between Americans and Russians. For his plan he uses beautiful girls who eliminate the generals of both sides one by one. Then it should launch a bomb on Moscow causing a chain reaction. But the two awkwardly manage to derail the plan, even if they end up prisoners in Siberia. Two cult names of fantastic cinema, Mario Bava and Vincent Price, go along with Franchi and Ingrassia in a childish and funny farce.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Vincent Price, Laura Antonelli, Francesco Mulè

title: Le stagioni del nostro amore
synopsis: The forty-year-old journalist Vittorio Borghi is experiencing a phase of rethinking caused by the crisis in his relationship with Elena, a much younger woman than him. Plus there's his failed marriage to Milena. In search of himself he returns to the Mantuan countryside, where he finds faces and places of his youth.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Anouk Aimée, Jacqueline Sassard, Gian Maria Volonté, Gastone Moschin

title: Le stanze aperte
synopsis: Naples Secondigliano, Judicial Psychiatric Hospital. A documentary maker asks to enter to make a report: the inmates and inmates housed in the facility tell “live” the personal story and daily life, which flows between various forms of activity and aggregation. Among these unfolds the story of the protagonist, Vincenzo Arte known as the master, a deliberately contradictory character in which the dream of a fervent creative and artistic imagination, the reality of the hard refusal by the family of origin and the "lucid" madness coexist. of those who have lost their identity but find it again, like a child, returning home.
cast: Vincenzo Merolla, Giuliana Del Pozzo, Tina Scatola, Elena Scarnato, Raffaele Niola, Angela Civile, Sonia Buonuomo, Federica Capuozzo

title: Le streghe
synopsis: Five episodes for as many directors with Silvana Mangano (then married to producer De Laurentiis) protagonist. 1: An actress tries to overcome her hypochondria with some friends. 2: A woman picks up a wounded man to ... make the love date first. 3: A widower with a half-foolish son "invents" a strange creature. 4: To make her lover jealous, a woman pretends to have another lover, but he reacts very badly. 5: Tired of a passionless relationship, a woman dreams of a fiery husband.
cast: Silvana Mangano, Annie Girardot, Francisco Rabal, Alberto Sordi, Clint Eastwood, Totò, Massimo Girotti, Véronique Vendell, Elsa Albani, Clara Calamai, Marilù Tolo, Nora Ricci, Dino Mele
director: Luchino Visconti, Mauro Bolognini, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Vittorio De Sica

title: Le strelle nel fosso
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Gianni Cavina, Carlo Delle Piane, Roberta Paladini

title: Le suicide d'Emma Peeters
synopsis: After ten years of tests and attempts in Paris, Emma Peeters has to face reality: he will never be an actress. She then decides to commit suicide for her 35th birthday. However, he meets Alex, an employee of funeral pumps.
cast: Monia Chokri, Fabrice Adde, Andréa Ferréol, Stephanie Crayencour, Jean Henri Compère, Hervé Piron, Aran Bertetto, Anne Sylvain, Romain David, Jean Noël Delfanne

title: Le tableau
synopsis: In a painting, left unfinished by a painter and depicting a castle, gardens and a wood, three categories of characters coexist. While the Suits are entirely painted, the Incomplete are colorless and the Sketches are merely sketched. Believing themselves superior, the Suits take possession of the castle, drive out the Incomplete and subdue the Sketches. To restore harmony to the painting, the incomplete young Ramo decides to leave the painting and set out in search of the painter to invite him to finish the work. He is also joined by the Piuma sketch and the complete Lola for an adventure that leads them to discover the reasons that prompted the painter to leave everything in suspense.

title: Le tardone
synopsis: Episode film: a widow takes revenge for the jokes she suffers; two killers kill the husband instead of the wife; an actress pretends to be younger thanks to a trick; a mature woman wins the competition of a girl; an industrialist drives an employee into adultery with his wife. Classic comedy with episodes; but it is worth seeing it to find some forgotten actresses (especially Franca Marzi).
cast: Didi Perego, Ave Ninchi, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello

title: Le tatoué
synopsis: Count Jean-Louis de Montignac, a former colonel of the foreign legion, has a Modigliani tattooed on his back. An antique dealer would like to take possession of it, indeed he has already sold the count's skin before he even took possession of it. In exchange, however, de Montignac wants the merchant to restore his house in the countryside, which is actually a huge ruined castle.
cast: Jean Gabin, Louis De Funès, Paul Marcey, Yves Barsacq

title: Le temps de l'aventure
synopsis: In a pause between two performances of the show she is staging in Calais, Alix (Emmanuelle Devos) takes a train that takes her to Paris the same day. On the way, he meets a mysterious Irish man (Gabriel Byrne). Irremediably attracted to him, Alix follows him and loves him for a few hours, before confronting what could be a new life for her.
cast: Emmanuelle Devos, Gabriel Byrne, Gilles Privat, Aurélia Petit, Laurent Capelluto

title: Le temps du loup
synopsis: When Anna and her family arrive at the house where they are to spend their holidays, they find it occupied by poor, aggressive and hungry refugees. Confronting these unknown individuals is the beginning of a painful process of knowledge.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Patrice Chéreau, Béatrice Dalle, Olivier Gourmet, Rona Hartner, Maurice Bénichou, Brigitte Roüan, Lucas Biscombe, Hakim Taleb, Anaïs Demoustier, Serge Riaboukine

title: Le temps qui reste
synopsis: Romain, thirty years old, is a photographer. One day he discovers that he is suffering from an incurable disease: he has only a few months left to live. As he nears the end he becomes more and more cruel to his partner, hateful to his sister and parents ...
cast: Melvil Poupaud, Jeanne Moreau, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Marie Rivière, Daniel Duval, Christian Sengewald, Louise Anne Hippeau, Henri De Lorme, Walter Pagano, Violetta Sanchez, Ugo Soussan Trabelsi, Alba Gaïa Kraghede Bellugi, Victor Poulouin, Laurence Ragon, Thomas Gizolme

title: Le temps retrouvé
synopsis: On his deathbed, in 1922, Marcel Proust is looking at some photographs and retraces his life with his memory. But the characters of reality end up mixing with those of fiction. As if projected by a stereoscope on the walls of his room, the characters in his book begin to populate his memories and come to life in the closed world of his small apartment in rue Hamelin.
cast: Marcello Mazzarella, John Malkovich, Catherine Deneuve, Emmanuelle Béart, Vincent Perez, Chiara Mastroianni

title: Le tentazioni del dottor Antonio
synopsis: What happens to the old sexophobe who tears off the "risque" covers of newspapers from newsstands if a billboard with the busty Anita Ekberg in full carnal splendor suddenly stands right in front of his house? In the course of his battle against the cartel's "immorality", the professor even receives (in a dream) a visit from the woman.
cast: Peppino De Filippo, Anita Ekberg

title: Le testament d'Orphée
cast: Jean Cocteau, Maria Casarès, François Périer, Jean Marais, Nicole Courcel

title: Le testament du docteur Cordelier
synopsis: Dr. Cordelier is a famous psychiatrist completely absorbed in research. In his will he names a certain monsieur Opal as sole heir, unknown even to the doctor's faithful friend, Joly. Meanwhile, bloody events take place near Cordelier's home ...
cast: Jean Louis Barrault, Michel Vitold, Gaston Modot, Jacques Catelain

title: Le tigre aime la chair fraiche
cast: Roger Hanin, Maria Mauban, Daniela Bianchi, Roger Dumas

title: Le tigri di Mompracem
synopsis: After the evil maharaja Varauni has exterminated his whole family, the brave Sandokan decides to retire to the island of Mompracem to meditate a terrible revenge against him.
cast: Ivan Rassimov, Claudia Gravy, Andrea Bosic

title: Le tonnerre de Dieu
synopsis: The veterinarian Leandro lives in his castle with his wife Marie, whom he neglects to devote himself to dogs and horses. The man, who is used to returning home after heavy drinking full of strays, beggars and beggars, one evening introduces a young prostitute, Simone, to his resigned wife. The girl accepts the hospitality offered by the couple and gives herself to her soul to defend it from the protector who demands her "restitution".
cast: Jean Gabin, Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Lilli Palmer

title: Le train
synopsis: May 1940, the Nazis advance and Julien (Trintignant) flees in front of them, with his family, along with many other Frenchmen. On the train heading south, constantly threatened by air raids that force him to stop for a long time, he meets Anna (Schneider) a German Jew. The two love each other briefly, then he returns to his wife. Three years later, the Gestapo reunites the two former lovers.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Romy Schneider, Nike Arrighi, Regine, Franco Mazzieri, Maurice Biraud

title: Le tre spade di Zorro
synopsis: The masked defender of the oppressed ends up in the evil governor's prisons. His son Diego, having become an adult, collects the inheritance, but is in turn captured. C2 series adventure movie.
cast: Guy Stockwell, Michela Wood, Gloria Milland, Franco Fantasia

title: Le triomphe de Michel Strogoff
synopsis: Assigned to protect Prince Sergius during an expedition against a rebel tribe, Strogoff succeeds in the enterprise. Negligible adventure film.
cast: Curd Jürgens, Capucine, Pierre Massimi, Valéry Inkijinoff

title: Le troiane
synopsis: The terrible fate of the women of Troy - Andromache, Cassandra, Hecuba and Helen - who became slaves of the Greeks after the fall of the city.
cast: Luisa Aluigi, Lia Angeleri, Annamaria Chio, Vittoria Dal Verme, Piera Degli Esposti, Sarah Ferrati, Cesarina Gheraldi, Maddalena Gillia, Anna Maria Guarnieri, Roldano Lupi

title: Le trois couronnes du matelot
cast: Jean Bernard Guillard, Philippe Deplanche, Jean Badin, Nadège Clair

title: Le tue mani sul mio corpo
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Erna Schürer, Colette Descombes, Daniël Sola, José Quaglio, Elena Cotta

title: Le tueur
synopsis: The killer George Gassot has escaped from the prison where he was held. In his footsteps, as on other occasions, Commissioner Leguen sets out. The brisk methods of the latter collide with the more scientific ones of the new director of police, Tellier, and it works to the advantage of Gassot who piles up murder after murder. The situation seems so hopeless, but then the unexpected happens.
cast: Jean Gabin, Fabio Testi, Uschi Glas, Bernard Blier, Gérard Depardieu, Jacques Richard, Ginette Garcin, Philippe Vallauris, Sady Rebbot, Jacques Debary

title: Le tueur
synopsis: Paris, Christmas Eve. Leo Zimmerman is a businessman who loves his daughter above all else. In the eyes of all, his is an exemplary life but, when Dimitri Kopas walks into his office pretending to be a regular customer, Leo realizes that he is there to kill him. Overcoming the anxiety and paranoia that characterize him, Leo decides to go to meet his killer and offer him a strange deal.
cast: Gilbert Melki, Grégoire Colin, Mélanie Laurent, Sophie Cattani, Xavier Beauvois, Jeanne Allard, Vincent Baretta, André Bellaiche, Aygalent David, Augustine Diabakana

title: Le témoin
synopsis: The Roman painter Antonio Berti goes to Reims for a restoration. Casually witnesses the murder committed by a friend of his, Robert, but does not report him to the police. Robert is killed for other reasons but police suspicions fall on the Italian painter who is sentenced to death. No one believes his attempts to have the trial reviewed, also because Robert's relatives manipulated the evidence to save the family's reputation.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Philippe Noiret, Roland Dubillard

title: Le ultime 56 ore
synopsis: The lives of two men - both faithful servants of the homeland on two different fronts - cross against the backdrop of a story linked to the Kosovo war and its aftermath. On the one hand, there is Colonel Moresco who, under the pressure of Dr. Ferri (whose husband, a veteran of Kosovo, is in agony), sets up a commission of inquiry to try to establish the causes of the many cancers reported by those who fought on that front. On the other hand, Deputy Chief Manfredi, an experienced police officer and skilled psychologist, whose family life is in crisis, also as a result of his dedication to work.
cast: Barbora Bobulova, Luca Lionello, Primo Reggiani, Nicole Murgia, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Libero De Rienzo, Luigi Maria Burruano, Simona Borioni, Francesco Venditti, Diego Guerra

title: Le ultime cose
synopsis: Three simple stories intertwine at the Banco dei Pegni in Turin on the thin line of moral debt with individuals in search of their own redemption. Through the relationships with objects, the portrait of a place emerges which is a metaphor for a society based on the eternal clash between debtor and creditor.
cast: Alfonso Santagata, Fabrizio Falco, Roberto De Francesco, Cristina Rosamilia, Maria Eugenia D'Aquino, Salvatore Cantalupo

title: Le ultime lettere di Jacopo Ortis
synopsis: Adaptation of the epistolary work by Ugo Foscolo scripted by Del Monte with Nico Garrone and directed for RAI. Del Monte delves into the intimate torment of the young Jacopo, played by Stefano Oppedisano, and highlights the traits that unite him to the characters and poetics that the director will develop in subsequent films.
cast: Stefano Oppedisano, Ornella Ghezzi, Sergio Tofano, Carmen Scarpitta, Maria Michi, Pierluigi Aprà, Leopoldo Trieste, Enzo Tarascio

title: Le ultime ore di una vergine
synopsis: Enrico is a photojournalist who takes photos of the complaint. However, the editorial staff of a journalist friend of his is not interested in this kind of photo. Meanwhile, his girlfriend is expecting a baby. Enrico falls into a crisis from which he will not be able to get out even with the help of a kind of psychoanalyst clown. Bad movie. And not even the shadow of virgins.
cast: Massimo Farinelli, Don Backy, Sydne Rome, Sebastiano Amara

title: Le vacances de Monsieur Hulot
synopsis: On board his old car, Hulot leaves for the longed-for Brittany seaside holiday; regardless of the comments of the people he meets on the street, he finally arrives at his destination. The family-run pension is full of clients (a girl who kills hearts, a businessman who can't help but think about work, children playing, an army commander who thinks he is dealing with his subordinates). Despite himself, Hulot puts everyone in an uproar.
cast: Jacques Tati, Louis Perrault, Nathalie Pascaud, Michèle Rolla

title: Le vacanze del signor Rossi
synopsis: Compilation of short films made by Bruno Bozzetto and starring the now very famous character of Mr. Rossi, that is the typical average Italian, dreamer, couch potato, likeable, a little bungler, entered the national and international imagination. Invented in the early 1960s, Mr. Rossi became in Bozzetto's imagination the preferred tool for a biting and apparently good-natured satire aimed at all the clichés of the time: economic boom, mass tourism, the myth of the automobile, etc. Mr. Rossi is the first real "character" to appear in the history of Italian animation cinema.

title: Le vacanze del sor Clemente
synopsis: Sor Clemente, who married an authoritarian countess, pretends to be ill in order not to take part in an underwater fishing trip with his wife's friends. Left alone in the villa he gives himself to mad joy in the company of a friend and a butler. Unfortunately he is deceived by a couple of swindlers who make him squander the little money left by his wife. Eventually he is forced to rent the villa to a self-styled commission, which, in reality, is a gang of adventurers. And finally, mistaken for a criminal he is arrested.
cast: Alberto Talegalli, Virgilio Riento, Fiorenzo Fiorentini

title: Le vele scarlatte
synopsis: Juliette, daughter of a veteran of the Great War and Orphan of Mother, lives alone in the north of France with her father, Raphaël. Passionate about music and singing, the girl - very lonely - meets a summer a magician who makes it a prophecy: one day of the sails Scarlatte will bring her away from the village. From that moment Juliette will never stop believing that the prophecy will one day come true.
cast: Juliette Jouan, Louis Garrel, Raphaël Thiéry, Noémie Lvovsky, Yolande Moreau, Ernst Umhauer, François Négret

title: Le vent de la nuit
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Daniel Duval, Xavier Beauvois, Jacques Lassale

title: Le vere false teste di Modigliani
synopsis: In July 1984, extraordinary news bounced around the world: three boys from Livorno found a head sculpted by Amedeo Modigliani in the ditch of the city of Livorno. All the critics agree in the attribution of the find, visitors, journalists and television crews come to Livorno to document the exceptional nature of the circumstance. Some time later, however, the three boys, including the artist Angelo Froglia, declare that it was a joke and that the head was nothing more than the fruit of their nocturnal creation, triggering an unprecedented uproar that risks undermine the assets of the art universe.

title: Le verità
synopsis: Returning from India after a business trip, the young entrepreneur Gabriele Manetti feels that his life is about to take a different direction than it has always had. His world, the certainties that his social condition has allowed him to have, the same relationship with his girlfriend and his friends no longer satisfy him. He realizes, however, that he has come back from his trip with something else too: by chance he discovers, in fact, that he has acquired the ability to “see” beyond appearances, to be able to foresee the future.
cast: Francesco Montanari, Nicoletta Romanoff, Fabrizio Nevola, Anna Safroncik, Luigi Diberti, Massimo Poggio, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Lino Guanciale

title: Le vie del Signore sono finite
synopsis: Since Vittoria left him, Camillo has been paralyzed. The disease is clearly psychosomatic, says her doctor, so much so that at the news that Vittoria broke up with her new boyfriend, he immediately starts moving again. Meanwhile, fascism came to power, Camillo went to jail for a joke about the Duce and Vittoria went to live in Paris. Camillo, however, now knows how to move.
cast: Massimo Troisi, Jo Champa, Marco Messeri, Massimo Bonetti, Enzo Cannavale, Clelia Rondinella

title: Le vieil homme et l'enfant
cast: Michel Simon, Roger Carel, Paul Préboist, Alain Cohen, Jacqueline Rouillard

title: Le vieux fusil
synopsis: In 1944, Julien Dandieu worked as a surgeon in the hospital of Montauban, France. He is a convinced pacifist and helps the partisans by treating them secretly. Worried and frightened by the arrival of the German army, he asks his friend Francois to take his wife and daughter to his country house, an ancient castle. When he decides to join them a week later, the Germans have already occupied the entire area and massacred everyone, including his wife and daughter. Julien thus decides to take action and take revenge.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Romy Schneider, Jean Bouise, Joachim Hansen, Robert Hoffmann, Karl Michael Vogler, Caroline Bonhomme, Catherine Delaporte, Madeleine Ozeray, Daniel Breton

title: Le viol
synopsis: In 1974, in the calanques of Marseille, two young Belgian tourists are attacked and raped by three men. For four years, the two women and their lawyers will fight for justice. Since rape is still only considered a crime, the lawyer and feminist Gisèle Halimi goes to great lengths to attract public attention, bring the rapists to the Aix-en-Provence Court of Assizes and have the rape recognized as a federal crime.
cast: Clotilde Courau, Bérangère McNeese, Camille Santerre, Hippolyte Girardot, Pierre Andrau, Stéphane Rideau, Baudoin Cristoveanu, Sam Karmann, Romane Bohringer, Yannick Choirat

title: Le vite possibili
synopsis: Female faces that speak and a director who films them, listens to them and imagines them. Between Moldova, Israel, Romania and Gibraltar.
cast: Allison Benayoun, Eva Budai, Anette Dujisin, Siobhan Hernandez, Chantal Ivanovic, Inta Lange, Clara Ocauroka, Ramona Piele, Susana Tello, Maria Lourdes Valdez

title: Le voci bianche
synopsis: Meo, a young populace of Rome, to try to escape the great misery that afflicts him, decides to become a musician. In reality, the boy, who in the meantime has bought the complicity of a surgeon, can embark on his particular and coveted career, making use exclusively of his singing skills. But his secret is too big to remain so and soon the rumor of the bluff spreads among the ladies of the Roman aristocracy.
cast: Paolo Ferrari, Anouk Aimée, Graziella Granata, Sandra Milo

title: Le voci di dentro
synopsis: Alberto Saporito, one night, dreams of his neighbors in the act of killing a mutual friend and hiding his body. The dream is so clear that the man decides to report the neighbors' family to the police station, but when he realizes that it was only the fruit of his own imagination, he tries to retract but ends up worsening the situation, in a crescendo where everyone they end up accusing each other.
cast: Toni Servillo, Peppe Servillo, Daghi Rondanini, Gigio Morra, Antonello Cossia, Maria Angela Robustelli, Marcello Romolo, Francesco Paglino, Marianna Robustelli, Rocco Giordano, Lucia Mandarini, Elisabetta Pedrazzi

title: Le voleur
synopsis: Paris, late 19th century: to take revenge on his guardian who prevents him from marrying Carlotta, Georges chooses to pursue the career of the thief and organizes a theft. Given the success of the shot and with the help of a false abbot who taught him the tricks of the trade, in a short time he became a burglary specialist. Also because Carlotta introduces him to the living rooms that matter, where it is easy for Georges to gather useful information for his business.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Geneviève Bujold, Marie Dubois, Julien Guiomar

title: Le voleur d'enfants
synopsis: In 1925 Paris, the former Argentine colonel Bigua built a kind of hostel for abandoned children. Thus he manages to have those children that his wife Desposoria cannot give him. They find food, warmth, tranquility and even a home. It all ends when Gabrielle arrives, a little girl in need of affection too, but far too beautiful. A French / Italian / Spanish co-production for a confused and pretentious film. Virginie Ledoyen is actually too beautiful and Mastroianni a little too over the top.
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Angela Molina, Michel Piccoli, Virginie Ledoyen

title: Le voleur des crîmes
synopsis: Jean Girod, married and father of two children, is a deeply bored man and when chance makes him witness the strange suicide of a woman he thinks he is taking the blame and sends an anonymous letter to the newspapers. Jean is not satisfied with a single letter, he sends others and enjoys the interest that the case arouses among his friends. All of a sudden, however, public opinion and the press, advised by the police, stop dealing with the case. Later he meets Florinda, a model lover of a painter friend of his, with her in the car he returns to the place of suicide and suddenly feels overcome by a strange desire ...
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Robert Hossein, Florinda Bolkan, Giorgia Moll

title: Le voleur invisible
synopsis: A strange guy buys a tiny edition of the novel "The Invisible Man" by H. G. Wells, which also contains the recipe for the magic potion "for the invisibility of bodies". By testing the recipe, it incredibly becomes truly invisible. He then takes off his clothes and begins to carry out some thefts, until some policemen realize that something is wrong.

title: Le volpi della notte
synopsis: The foxes of the title are a special police squad made up of three women: Miryam, Anna and Elena. The first has a child and is married to a naive writer who always has dazzling ideas for novels that ... already exist. In addition to the gun, Anna has the weapon of seduction. Dynamic and sporty, on the other hand, is Elena. The investigation into the murder of a model and the mysterious disappearance of her beauty case is entrusted to the three foxes. To discover the killer, the three girls improvise as models.
cast: Viola Valentino, Fabrizia Carminati, Pamela Prati, Enzo Cannavale, Gianfranco Manfredi

title: Le voyage au Groenland
synopsis: Thomas and Thomas face multiple problems. Both in their thirties, actors and from Paris, they decide one day to go to Kullorsuaq, one of the most remote villages in Greenland, where Nathan, the father of one of them, lives. Within the small Inuit community they will discover the joys of local traditions and strengthen their friendship.
cast: Thomas Blanchard, Thomas Scimeca, François Chattot, Ole Eliassen, Adam Eskilden, Benedikte Eliassen, Mathias Petersen, Judith Henry, Martin Jensen

title: Le voyage du ballon rouge
synopsis: Suzanne is a busy Parisian: she has two children, Susan and Louise, who she has raised alone since her husband left her, teaches and, on top of that, runs a puppet show. So, to get help and find some time for himself, he decides to take home an au pair, Song Fang, a Taiwanese govan who studies at the university. Soon the girl begins to share with Simon, who is only 7 years old, a strange imaginary world, while a red balloon follows them wherever they go, becoming a symbol full of meanings.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Simon Iteanu, Fang Song, Hippolyte Girardot, Louise Margolin, Anna Sigalevitch

title: Le voyage du prince
synopsis: An adult monkey runs on an unknown beach. Wound and lost, he is rescued by the twelve -year -old monkey Tom and welcomed by his parents, a couple of scientists who have been banned from their community because they believe in the existence of other civilized monkeys. With the help of Tom, the elderly monkey discovers a society of which he knows nothing while parents decide to use it to demonstrate the correctness of their theories.

title: Le voyage extraordinaire
synopsis: In 1902 Georges Méliès made the first science fiction film in the history of cinema, The Journey to the Moon: the story of six university professors, members of an astronomy club, who flee from the moon after arriving there thanks to a rocket fired from a giant cannon and having discovered the existence of the Selenites. With the help of great directors and actors of the 21st century, Serge Bromberg and Eric Lange reconstruct the genesis of one of the first masterpieces in the history of cinema, investigating its weight in subsequent cinematography and following the complex restoration work to which the work went to meet for a new release in theaters.
cast: Costa Gavras, Jean Pierre Jeunet, Michel Gondry, Michel Hazanavicius, Nicolas Ricordel, Eric Lange, Tom Burton, Tom Hanks, Georges Méliès

title: LeVampire de Düsseldorf

But the old Eduard has no intention of being dissuaded from his plans and Adele finds herself, in spite of herself, leaving for a long journey in the personal memories of her grandfather, but also in History. And to close the film, the last story of Pirandello written twenty days before dying: "The nail" where the young Bastianden, torn in Sicily by the arms of the mother and forced to follow the father beyond the ocean, cannot To heal the wound that pushes him to an senseless gesture.
cast: Fabrizio Ferracane, Matteo Pittiruti, Dora Becker, Massimo Popolizio, Dania Marino, Claudio Bigagli, Nathalie Rapti Gomez, Roberto Herlitzka, Francis Pardeilhan, Giulio Pampiglione, Michael Schermi, Elvio La Pira, Achille Marciano, Federico Tocci, Martina Catalfamo, Jessica Piccolo Valerani

title: Leopoldo Trieste, un intruso nella fabbrica dei sogni
synopsis: The life and artistic story of Leopoldo Trieste, interpreter of mythical characters in the history of cinema.
cast: Vittorio Boarini, Mimmo Calopresti, Tullio Kezich, Vincenzo Mollica, Moraldo Rossi, Giuseppe Tornatore, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Lepanto - O último cangaceiro
synopsis: Brazil hosted two major events between 2014 and 2016, whose impact on local populations is the subject of research by director Enrico Masi for a PhD thesis in Pedagogy. Mike Wells, after losing his home for the London Olympics in 2012, distances himself from Maria to become the narrator of the documentary on the Brazilian situation. The life of both takes over the editing of the documentary. Mike thus becomes the last cangaçeiro, historical figure of Brazilian brigand defender of the oppressed, postmodern hero adventuring in a hypothetical landscape that represents the subconscious.
cast: Michael J. Wells, Marie Billegrav, Enrico Masi, Inalva Mendes Brito, Paulo Thiago De Mello, Ash Ashaninka, Urutau Guajajara

title: Leprechaun
synopsis: In Ireland, Dan O'Grady finds the gold of the "leprechaun", a sort of evil wood elf. Back home, the man locks the creature in the cellar and tries to burn it, but he dies of a heart attack; ten years later, J.D. and his daughter Tory buy Dan's house, unaware of what is hiding there ...
cast: Warwick Davis, Jennifer Aniston, Ken Olandt, Mark Holton

title: Leprechaun 2
synopsis: After a thousand years, an evil creature called Leprechaun decides to take a wife, but without success. A millennium later he tries again, kills people left and right and kidnaps young Bridget: Cody, the girl's boyfriend, intervenes, but killing a Leprechaun is a difficult task ...
cast: Warwick Davis, Charlie Heath, Shevonne Durkin, Adam Biesk

title: Leprechaun 3
synopsis: Transformed into a statuette but accidentally "awakened" by the careless (and unfortunate) owner of a pawnshop in Las Vegas, the evil Leprechaun tries to recover at any cost a magical gold coin that ended up in the hands of the unsuspecting student Scott .. .
cast: Warwick Davis, John Gatins, Lee Armstrong, Caroline Williams

title: Leprechaun 4: In Space
synopsis: This time the evil creature called Leprechaun kidnaps Zarina, a princess from a distant planet: her aim is to seize her powers to try to conquer the universe. To counter it, a commando of human beings ready for anything is sent into space ...
cast: Warwick Davis, Tim Colceri, Guy Siner, Jessica Collins, Rebekah Carlton

title: Leprechaun Returns
synopsis: The girls of sisterhood Alpha Upsilon decide to become respectful of the environment and use an old well for water supply. In doing so, they involuntarily awaken a small monster, the lethal leprechaun. Desire of these is to get your hands on a golden pot buried near the girls's seat and is willing to do anything to do it.
cast: Taylor Spreitler, Pepi Sonuga, Sai Bennett, Linden Porco, Mark Holton, Leon Clingman, Oliver Llewellyn Jenkins, Heather McDonald, Ben McGregor, Emily Reid

title: Leprechaun in the Hood
synopsis: The three young rappers Stray Bullet, Butch and Postmaster P enter the studio of producer Mack Daddy and discover that the latter owes its success to a magical flute. Obviously they get hold of it, but they will have to contend with Mack's vengeful ally: the evil Leprechaun ...
cast: Ice T, Warwick Davis, Coolio, Anthony Montgomery, Rashaan Nall, Red Grant

title: Leprechaun: Origins
synopsis: Crossing the lush Irish countryside with backpacks on their shoulders, two couples of young people discover the chilling secret that holds a town. Ben, Sophie, David and Jeni realize that the surrounding idyllic landscape is not what seems apparently when the inhabitants of the town offer them hospitality in an old shack on the edge of the forest, realizing that one of the most famous legends in Ireland It is a terrifying reality.
cast: Stephanie Bennett, Andrew Dunbar, Melissa Roxburgh, Brendan Fletcher, Garry Chalk, Teach Grant, Bruce Blain, Adam Boys, Mary Black, Emilie Ullerup

title: Leroy
synopsis: Leroy, a boy with a German mother and an African father, falls in love with Eva, whose family members are all neo-Nazi skinheads: the acceptance process will be very complicated ...
cast: Alain Morel, Anna Hausburg, Constantin Von Jascheroff, Günther Kaufmann, Eva Mannschott, Arnel Taci, Afrob, Paul Maaß, Julius Jellinek, Andreas Schulz

title: Leroy & Stitch
synopsis: Stitch, Jumba and Pleakley are offered seats in the Galactic Alliance but refuse them to stay on Earth with Lilo. Lilo, however, realizes that the time has come for the alien friends to return to their world and say goodbye. In the meantime, however, Gantu has left Earth and Dr. Jacques Von Hamsterbiel has been released from prison, intending to create a clone called Leroy with the intention of taking over the entire galaxy.

title: Les 1001 nuits
synopsis: The Baghdad caliph has a brutal habit, every night he marries a different woman and kills her after possessing her. But one day on his way the caliph meets a girl who will have the courage to rebel. It is the beautiful Shéhérazade who escapes the fate of the other concubines by telling the king about an enchanted lamp. The Genius who lends a hand to the brave girl lives in London in the nineties and gets in touch with her using his television.
cast: Thierry Lhermitte, Gérard Jugnot, Catherine Zeta Jones

title: Les 4 Charlots mousquetaires
synopsis: The writer Dumas decides to tell a dark episode of the legend of the "musketeers". D'Artagnan, Porto, Aramis and Atos, in fact, had four doubles which they often replaced. Too bad that the four doubles were as bungling as the ... Charlots!
cast: Les Charlots, Josephine Chaplin

title: Les 400 coups
synopsis: Antoine Doinel (the director's alter ego in this and many other films) is a lonely, unwanted and misunderstood boy. To rebel, he skips school and steals here and there. When with his friend René he steals a typewriter to pay for a trip to the beach, they catch him and put him in the reformatory.
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Albert Rémy, Claire Maurier

title: Les 7 jours du talion
synopsis: Bruno Hamel is a surgeon on the threshold of his 40s and lives with his wife Sylvie and Jasmine, their eight-year-old daughter. His is a happy life without any inconvenience whatsoever until, on a beautiful autumn afternoon, his little daughter is raped and murdered. The world of the Hamel family collapses and when the murderer is captured, the idea of ??kidnapping the monster and making him pay for the horrible crime he has committed takes hold.
cast: Claude Legault, Rémy Girard, Martin Dubreuil, Fanny Mallette, Rose Marie Coallier, Alexandre Goyette, Dominique Quesnel, Pascale Delhaes, Maxime Bessette, Pascal Contamine

title: Les Affamés
synopsis: In a small, remote Quebec village, things are changing rapidly. The inhabitants are no longer the same: their bodies are slowly falling apart and showing a certain attraction for the flesh.
cast: Marc André Grondin, Monia Chokri, Charlotte St Martin, Micheline Lanctot, Marie Ginette Guay, Brigitte Poupart, Édouard Tremblay Grenier, Luc Proulx, Didier Lucien, Robert Brouillette

title: Les Aiguilles rouges
synopsis: September 1960: While France is at war with Algeria, Patrick and his scout friends are on vacation in the Chamonix Valley. Attracted by risk and dangerous games, the boys infuriate their boss, who assigns them three days of punishment: their mission is to climb the Brevent massif, in front of Mont Blanc ...
cast: Jules Sitruk, Damien Jouillerot, Jonathan Demurger, Pierre Derenne, César Domboy, Jules Angelo Bigarnet

title: Les Amandiers
synopsis: Late 80s. Stella, Victor, Adéle and Etienne are a group of twenty -year -olds and are presenting themselves to the examination of the famous acting school founded by Patrice Cherreau and Pierre Romans at the Théatre des Amandiers in Nanterre. Driven by an incredible dose of passion and love, they will all experience what will represent a turning point in their lives, but at the same time they will live their first existential tragedy.
cast: Sofiane Bennacer, Clara Bretheau, Baptiste Carrion Weiss, Alexia Chardard, Louis Garrel, Léna Garrel, Liv Henneguier, Sarah Henochsberg, Oscar Lesage, Micha Lescot, Farida Rahouadj, Vassili Schneider, Nadia Tereszkiewicz

title: Les Amants du Pont-Neuf
synopsis: Alex (Denis Levant) is a young homeless man on whose body, when he lies dead drunk in the center of the boulevard Sébastopol, the cars of middle-class couples pass happily. With horror, Michéle (Binoche) approaches him, a painter with a colonel father and a bastard boyfriend whom, one day, she will shoot. Between Alex and Michéle, homeless out of necessity or desperation on the Pont-Neuf closed to the public for work, "amour fou" is born.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Denis Lavant, Klaus Michael Grüber, Crichan Larson

title: Les Apaches
synopsis: Aziz, Hamza, François-Joseph and Jo, four friends between the ages of 17 and 19, spend the summer in Porto Vecchio, Corsica. On a boring evening, Aziz takes the other three to the house where his father works as a maintenance agent. Because Aziz knows how to get in, the group spends part of the night in the still uninhabited luxurious mansion and, before leaving, takes away some worthless items and two shotguns. A few days later, the owner arrives from Paris and complains about the burglary with an acquaintance, a young local boss ...
cast: François Joseph Culioli, Aziz El Addachi, Hamza Mezziani, Joseph Ebrard, Maryne Cayon, Andréa Brusque, Henry Noël Tabary, Danielle Arbid, Michel Ferracci

title: Les Apparences
synopsis: Against the background of the narrow French community who live in Vienna, the story of a young and well -sighted couple unfolds, the one formed by éve and Henri. Parents of little Malo, have all the requirements to live a happy existence. Henri is in fact the director of the Opéra orchestra while he works at the Institut Français. Everything seems to proceed without shaking until the day Henri gives in to the charm of the teacher's teacher.
cast: Karin Viard, Benjamin Biolay, Lucas Englander, Laetitia Dosch, Pascale Arbillot

title: Les As de la Jungle
synopsis: Maurice is a penguin but believes he is a tiger. Raised from an early age by a tiger as his own cub, Maurice has become a kung fu pro. With his friends he intends to restore order and justice in the jungle he lives in, as his adoptive mother did before him. Igor, a devilish koala surrounded by not very intelligent mercenary baboons, has other plans.

title: Les Baliseurs du désert
synopsis: A teacher sets off to reach a village in the desert where he will have to settle as an educator. But the new experience, lived in contact with the wild nature of the desert, will turn into an inner journey to the center of the enigmas of existence.
cast: Nacer Khemir, Soufiana Makni, Chedi Ben Hadj, Hassiba Rochdi

title: Les Biches
synopsis: Following a chance meeting, a morbid friendship arises between the young Why, who earns a living by painting fawns on the sidewalks of Paris, and Frederique, a rich and bored shipyard owner. Her guest in a splendid villa in Saint Tropez, Why meets Paul, an architect with whom she falls in love. Frederique, jealous of her friend's new conquest, manages to become Paul's lover. Why, however, takes it in the best way by serenely accepting to love both of them.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Jacqueline Sassard, Stéphane Audran

title: Les Bienheureux
synopsis: Algiers, a few years after the civil war. Amal and Samir have decided to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary at the restaurant. On the way, they both evoke Algeria, each in their own way. Meanwhile, their son Fahim, with friends Feriel and Reda, wanders around the city, in an Algiers that gradually seems to withdraw into itself.
cast: Sami Bouajila, Nadia Kaci, Amine Lansari, Lyna Khoudri

title: Les Bleus - Une autre histoire de France, 1996-2016
synopsis: This documentary charts 20 years of the French national soccer team, Les Bleus, whose ups and downs have mirrored those of French society.
director: Pascal Blanchard, Sonia Dauger, David Dietz

title: Les Bonnes Femmes
synopsis: Four young salespeople work with half-closed eyes and looking at their dreams. One would like to become a singer, another doesn't know whether to accept a marriage proposal; the third lives for the day and easily becomes attached to men, the last naively relies on a boyfriend who seems sincere, but who ...
cast: Bernadette Lafont, Clotilde Joano, Stéphane Audran, Lucile Saint Simon

title: Les Cahiers
synopsis: Maia, a single mother of Montreal, thought she had closed with her past when she receives an unexpected Christmas present: a handful of notebooks, audioils and photographs of the eighties. It is all the material she had sent to her best friend of her when she, teenager, she was preparing to leave Beirut to escape with her family from the war. The more Maia tries to hide the content of what has received the most Alex, the teenage daughter, seek answers. This is how Maia's past will resurface.
cast: Rim Turki, Manal Issa, Paloma Vauthier, Isabelle Zighondi

title: Les Caprices d'un Fleuve
synopsis: An eighteenth-century French aristocrat, Jean Francois de la Plaine, decides to take a trip to the West African desert. After an agreement with a tribal chief, he receives "as a gift" a young ten-year-old slave whom he begins to raise as a daughter. But after a few years the girl, Amelie, stops being just a child but is captured by a hostile tribe of natives who would like to force her into slavery again.
cast: Anna Galiena, Bernard Giraudeau, Richard Bohringer

title: Les Carabiniers
synopsis: During a war in an imaginary nation, unscrupulous soldiers recruit poor peasants with the promise of an easy and happy life. Two of these peasants - Ulysses and Michel-Ange - are sent to Italy where they commit war crimes. Their return home gives them hope that the day of the expected rewards they promised is near, but the end of the war will reveal very different scenarios.
cast: Marino Masé, Albert Juross, Geneviève Galéa, Barbet Schroeder

title: Les Caïds
synopsis: Nineteen year old Jock, guilty of killing two people, escapes from the police and takes refuge in a country house. He soon falls in love with Cecile, the daughter of the man who hides him. Together with an old man, the two lovers try a shot. But things go wrong and they end up behind bars. They manage to escape, but the police are on their heels without giving respite and leading to despair.
cast: Serge Reggiani, Juliet Berto, Jean Bouise, Michel Constantin, Patrick Bouchitey, Christian De Tillière, Luce Garcia Ville, Françoise Giret, Françoise Fleury, Robert Lombard

title: Les Charlots contre Dracula
synopsis: A spell, formulated by the deceased mother, prevents Dracula jr. to emulate the famous parent. A double of the woman is needed to break the spell, and to find her the count hires the detective Gaston, who kidnaps Ariane at the flea market and takes her to Transylvania: but her boyfriend Phil and friends Jean and Gérard run into his rescue ...
cast: Les Charlots, Amélie Prévost, Andréas Voutsinas, Gérard Jugnot, Vincent Martin, Dora Doll

title: Les Charlots font l'Espagne
synopsis: The long-awaited summer holidays have arrived. A group of friends leave Paris and join a group that is about to take a tour of Spain. After running out of money and adapting to any kind of job, they will become bullfighters by accident.
cast: Les Charlots, Gérard Croce, Jacques Legras, Yves Barsacq

title: Les Choses humaines
synopsis: A young man is accused of raping a girl. But who are the two? Is he really guilty or is he innocent? Is there really a victim or is it just a desire for revenge, as the accused says? Is there only one truth or are there different shades that the ruthless mechanics of the underestimated modern judicial machine?
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Mathieu Kassovitz, Pierre Arditi, Ben Attal, Suzanne Jouannet, Audrey Dana, Benjamin Lavernhe, Judith Chemla, Camille Razat, Laëtitia Eïdo, Franz Rudolf Lang, Romain Barreau

title: Les Cordier, juge et flic: Angela
synopsis: After an evening spent in Lucia's company, Commissioner Cordier is on his way home when he stops at the scene of a tragedy. According to the first elements he collects, Cordier discovers that a policeman has committed suicide and, very shaken by the case, wishes to know what gestures have pushed him to such despair. What Cordier ignores is that two officers, noticing that their colleague had been killed, decided to alter the crime scene.
cast: Pierre Mondy, Bruno Madinier, Charlotte Valandrey, Antonella Lualdi, Laura Quintyn, Julien Chatelet, Rosemarie La Vaullée, Jean Claude Adelin

title: Les Cordier, juge et flic: Cours du soir
synopsis: Savignard escapes from the prison where he was serving a sentence for attacking an armored van and goes to visit his wife Violaine and little son Aurelien. In the aftermath of his escape, the body of Boisgelot, a teacher who loves Violaine, is found, and the police are sure that Savignard himself, moved by anger and jealousy, murdered him. Commissioner Cordier, however, during his investigation discovers some important clues that suggest that the resolution of the case is not so obvious.
cast: Pierre Mondy, Bruno Madinier, Antonella Lualdi, Luc Thuillier, Pierre François Pistorio, Pierre Arnaud Juin, Laura Quintyn, Julien Chatelet, Stéphanie Vicat, Nathalie Cerda, Adam Douieb

title: Les Cordier, juge et flic: L'argent des passes
synopsis: Three criminals land a robbery against a fence when he shows up at the bank for his weekly deposit. Vincent, one of the three robbers with a seriously ill sister, decides to keep the money to himself in the hope of financing the intervention that could save the girl. Wounded in the blow, Vincent escapes the bank by taking a woman and her baby hostage. Miriam, the journalist daughter of Cordier, has no problem locating the thief's hiding place but ends up putting herself in danger. Commissioner Cordier and his son Bruno will do everything to save her life.
cast: Pierre Mondy, Bruno Madinier, Charlotte Valandrey, Antonella Lualdi, Tansou, Gérard Sergue, Pierre Cassignard, Diane Pierens

title: Les Cordier, juge et flic: Née en prison
synopsis: Judge Bruno Cordier is about to marry Laura Vialli, the beautiful wine expert he is in love with. Everyone shares his happiness until his father Pierre finds himself investigating the suspected death of the merchant of Paul Denuzières. Inspector Cordier's flair leads to the unexpected discovery of Laura's dark past that her son Bruno finds it hard to believe.
cast: Pierre Mondy, Bruno Madinier, Charlotte Valandrey, Jean Pierre Bouvier, Astrid Veillon, Jauris Casanova, Antonella Lualdi, Julien Chatelet, José Paul

title: Les Cordier, juge et flic: Portrait au scalpel
synopsis: A car accident left Lucia Cordier totally disfigured. To face the world again and reappear in the eyes of her friends, Lucia then decides to turn to Marc Singer, one of the most important plastic surgeons in Paris. As Lucia enters the clinic accompanied by relatives, a noise puts everyone on alert: one of the patients has been murdered and Singer is the first to be suspected of the murder. The Cordiers thus find themselves having to face the ambiguities of the doctor, who seems to hide a double personality behind the apparent charisma.
cast: Pierre Mondy, Antonella Lualdi, Bruno Wolkowitch, Marie Nicolas, Isabelle Petit Jacques, Bruno Madinier, Carole Bouvier

title: Les Cordier, juge et flic: Trahie par les siens
synopsis: Silva, a dangerous criminal, robs a bank with his accomplice Moretti. Both can count on the discreet help of the cashier Orsini and everything goes smoothly until one of the guards tries to intervene, being seriously injured. Silva and Moretti shortly after decide to flee by pretending to take Orsini hostage. Traumatized by the bloody turn of events, Orsini threatens to reveal everything to the police and leads Silva to kill him in cold blood. The investigation into the robbery inevitably ends up in the hands of Commissioner Cordier and his son Bruno, who first of all have the task of informing Patricia, Orsini's daughter, of the murder of her father.
cast: Pierre Mondy, Bruno Madinier, Barbara Kelsch, Charlotte Valandrey, Julien Maurel, Vincent Martin, Stephane Ferrara, Antonella Lualdi

title: Les Cousins
cast: Gérard Blain, Jean Claude Brialy, Juliette Mayniel, Claude Cerval

title: Les Cowboys
synopsis: On a vast prairie in eastern France, Alain is a central figure for the entire community. Everything proceeds with glee when suddenly Kelly, the man's sixteen-year-old daughter, mysteriously disappears. To find her, Alain embarks on an endless search for distant, dark and disturbing places, with the only support of his son Kid, who sacrifices everything to accompany him.
cast: John C. Reilly, François Damiens, Finnegan Oldfield, Agathe Dronne, Dani Sanchez Lopez

title: Les Crevettes pailletées
synopsis: Matthias, a late-career Olympic champion, indulges in a homophobic statement during a television appearance. As a punishment, he is forced to coach a waterpolo team of homosexuals who have only one thing in mind: to qualify for the Gay Olympics in Croatia, in which LGBT athletes from all over the world compete.
cast: Alban Lenoir, Nicolas Gob, Geoffrey Couet, Michaël Abiteboul, David Baiot, Romain Lancry, Thomas Croisière, Roland Menou, Felix Martinez, Romain Brau

title: Les Dalton en cavale
synopsis: The Daltons break out of prison and Sheriff Lucky Luke follows their trail to Canada, where the brothers manage to escape once again by finding refuge with their mother. Once captured, the Daltons are granted probation under the supervision of Lucky Luke but it is difficult for them to overcome the fears of the population.
director: Joseph Barbera, William Hanna, Morris, Ray Patterson

title: Les Dames du Bois de Boulogne
synopsis: A rich bourgeois, Hélène, makes her ex-lover fall in love with a girl who makes "life" just to be able to support her old mother. The former lover, Jean, falls seriously in love with the young woman and Hélène, who feels doubly betrayed, decides to reveal the woman's "profession" to him. Despite this, the relationship between the two does not change.
cast: Maria Casarès, Paul Bernard, Elena Labourdette, Lucienne Bogaert, Jean Marchat, Yvette Etiévant, Marcel Rouzé

title: Les Enfants Terribles
synopsis: Paris, 1920s. Elisabeth and Paul are brother and sister and still live together, in the house of their very sick mother. Their relationship, however, is all too close, bordering on incest, and the death of their mother only exacerbates their isolation from the world and their closure in an almost symbiotic bond.
cast: Nicole Stéphane, Edouard Dermithe, Renée Cosima, Jacques Bernard, Melvyn Martin, Maria Cyliakus, Jean Marie Robain, Maurice Revel, Adeline Aucoc, Jean Cocteau

title: Les Enfants d'Isadora
synopsis: After the accident that caused the death of her two children in April 1913, the legendary dancer Isadora Duncan staged a solo entitled The Mother, in which a mother, with gestures of great sweetness, caresses and cradles her baby one last time before letting it go. In 2018, four different women are confronted each in their own way with the choreography.
cast: Agathe Bonitzer, Manon Carpentier, Marika Zizzy, Elsa Wolliaston

title: Les Enfants d'Okura
synopsis: Add a Plot

title: Les Estivants
synopsis: Anna arrives with her daughter for a few days' vacation in a large and beautiful property on the Côte d'Azur, in a place that seems timeless and protected from the outside world. Amidst family, friends and employees, Anna has to deal with a recent romantic breakup and a new film to write.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Pierre Arditi, Valeria Golino, Riccardo Scamarcio, Noémie Lvovsky, Yolande Moreau, Laurent Stocker, Bruno Raffaelli, Marisa Borini, Oumy Bruni Garrel

title: Les Fantomes d'Ismaël
synopsis: Ismael Vullard makes films and is shooting one about Ivan, an atypical diplomat inspired by his brother. Together with Bloom, his teacher and father-in-law, Ismael still mourns the disappearance of Carlotta, which occurred twenty years earlier. But he started a new life with Sylvia, who is his light. However, Carlotta suddenly reappears, calling everything into question.
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Marion Cotillard, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Louis Garrel, Alba Rohrwacher, Laszlo Szabo, Hippolyte Girardot

title: Les Félins
synopsis: Marc, a fraudster and cheater by profession, is chased by the hit men of an American gangster. To escape his killers, Marc takes refuge in the villa of two beautiful and rich Americans, Barbara and Melinda. The man realizes that someone else is hiding in the villa. It is Vincent, Barbara's lover and also forced into hiding. Vincent killed Barbara's husband and now the police are looking for him. Passion breaks out between Barbara and Marc and this arouses Vincent's jealousy.
cast: Alain Delon, Jane Fonda, Lola Albright, Sorrell Booke, André Oumansky

title: Les Gardiennes
synopsis: During the First World War, Hortense, a tireless worker at a time when all men are involved in the conflict, hires Francine, a young maid of the Public Assistance, to help her daughter Solange, who became pregnant, with her agricultural possessions. . Between Hortense and Francine from the beginning there is mutual respect and gratitude. To save the family unit, Hortense will have to sacrifice Francine and send her away, condemning her to find in herself the strength to go on and fight.
cast: Nathalie Baye, Laura Smet, Olivier Rabourdin, Yann Bean, Cyril Descours, Iris Bry, Ophélie Marion Debiais

title: Les Girls
synopsis: Joy, Angela, Sibilla and Barry, interpreters of "Les Girls", a musical comedy that has been around Europe, find themselves reunited in London, after many years, in a courtroom. A legal proceeding is underway following a libel suit that the French Angela filed against Sibilla. The latter has published a book of memories in which she mentioned the relations of the manager with each of the three actresses who were part of the company.
cast: Gene Kelly, Mitzi Gaynor, Kay Kendall, Taina Elg, Jacques Bergerac, Leslie Phillips, Henry Daniell, Patrick Macnee, Stephen Vercoe

title: Les Glaneurs et la glaneuse
synopsis: Gleaning is the agricultural activity of researching and harvesting the ears left in the field after the harvest, but - translating - it can be extended to define any survival activity that operates starting from recycled materials. It is on this broader meaning that the documentary by the Belgian director focuses, who travels through the countryside as well as through the cities in search of all those who practice gleaning.
cast: Bodan Litnanski, Agnés Varda, François Wertheimer

title: Les Gouts et Les Couleurs
synopsis: Simone has been in a relationship with Claire for three years but has never told her Jewish family that she is a lesbian. Between a crazy mother, a traditionalist father and two brothers who are always trying to marry her with men, it is difficult for Simone to live his homosexuality openly. So when she feels attracted to Senegalese chef Wali, she will find herself having to make difficult choices.
cast: Sarah Stern, Julia Piaton, Jean Christophe Folly, Richard Berry, Catherine Jacob, Arié Elmaleh, Stéphane Debac, Clémentine Poidatz, Lionel Lingelser, Yoli Fuller, Sophie Mounicot

title: Les Granges brûlées
synopsis: After the discovery of the atrociously devastated body of a young woman, the investigating judge Pierre Larchais arrives in the countryside from Paris and starts the investigation: his sights immediately enter mother Rose and her children Paul and Louis, owners of a nearby farm. ..
cast: Alain Delon, Simone Signoret, Paul Crauchet, Renato Salvatori, Pierre Rousseau, Bernard Le Coq, Miou Miou, Christian Barbier, Dany Jacquet

title: Les Hirondelles de Kaboul
synopsis: In Kabul under the Taliban regime, the lives of two couples who live in two different neighborhoods intertwine. The first is formed by the conservatives Atiq and Mussarat, married for over twenty years and deeply attached to Afghan traditions. While Atiq works as the head of the guards in the women's prison, Mussarat is very ill and fights to stay strong until the end. The second couple is instead composed of Zunaira and Mohsen, who are against the traditions shared by Atiq and Mussarat. Zunaira and Mohsen have both lost their jobs - he is a lawyer and she is a lecturer at the university - and they have great problems making ends meet. While forced to sell their meager possessions to buy food, they are determined to maintain their modern values ??at any cost.

title: Les Héritiers
synopsis: Anne Gueguen is more than just a high school history teacher. She really cares about the toughest students in the city where she teaches. Frustrated by their materialism and lack of ambition, Anne has asked to participate in a national competition in which children are taught what it is to grow up as teenagers in a Nazi concentration camp. By testing the limits of her students, Anne and her project will forever change the lives of the boys, helping them find their way.
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Geneviève Mnich, Ahmed Drame, Stéphane Bak, Noémie Merlant

title: Les Innocentes
synopsis: Mathilde Beaulieu is a young doctor who works in 1945 with the French Red Cross, helping French survivors of German concentration camps. One day, while working in a hospital in Poland, a nun begs her to follow her to the convent. Here, Mathilde discovers that several nuns are pregnant and that they are called to a tragic choice: accept motherhood or abandon the children of sin.
cast: Lou De Laâge, Agata Kulesza, Agata Buzek, Vincent Macaigne

title: Les Interprètes
synopsis: Qiao Fei is a French postgraduate, who dreams of becoming a famous interpreter. Her education in Paris puts her right in a college where she coincidentally meets a professional French Interpreter, Cheng Jia Yang, and the two start their mentorship on the wrong foot. cast: Gérard Jugnot, François Berléand, Jean Baptiste Maunier, Jacques Perrin, Kad Merad

title: Les choses de la vie
synopsis: Pierre (Michel Piccoli) has been living with his lover Hélène (Romy Schneider) for some time. His relationship begins to go into crisis when the man finds himself still fond of his ex-wife and son. He writes a letter to Hélène to say goodbye, but soon after has a fatal accident. The wife will not say anything to the woman so as not to grieve her.
cast: Michel Piccoli, Romy Schneider, Lea Massari, Gérard Lartigau, Jean Bouise, Dominique Zardi, Hervé Sand

title: Les cinq diables
synopsis: Vicky lives with her mother Joanne and her father Jimmie, who crosses a particularly difficult moment. When he joins Julia, Vicky's aunt, as soon as he left prison, the arrival of her dismayed the balance but also gives a shock to their daily lives.
cast: Adèle Exarchopoulos, Daphne Patakia, Noée Abita, Patrick Bouchitey, Moustapha Mbengue, Swala Emati, Sally Dramé

title: Les combattants
synopsis: Between friends and the family business, Arnaud's summer promises to be peaceful until the moment he meets Madeleine, as beautiful as she is fragile and passionate about muscles and catastrophic prophecies. Arnaud expects nothing of her as Madeleine prepares for the worst and the end of the world. Theirs will be a story of love and survival, out of any established canon.
cast: Adèle Haenel, Kévin Azaïs, Antoine Laurent, Brigitte Roüan, William Lebghil, Thibault Berducat, Nicolas Wanczycki, Frédéric Pellegeay, Steve Tientcheu, Franc Bruneau
