cast: Pierre Richard, Gérard Depardieu, Anny Duperey, Michel Aumont

title: Les confins du monde
synopsis: Indochina, 1945. Robert, a young French soldier, joins his brother Henri in Hanoi. After an attack by the Japanese army, Robert witnesses the execution of Henri and his pregnant wife. Motivated by the desire for revenge, he decides to take part in the war with the French army. His encounter with Mai, a Vietnamese girl, will overturn his beliefs and his hatred.
cast: Gaspard Ulliel, Guillaume Gouix, Gérard Depardieu, Lang Khê Tran, Anthony Paliotti, Jonathan Couzinié

title: Les corps impatients
synopsis: Charlotte and Paul are two in their twenties who love each other passionately. Charlotte suddenly has to undergo a series of medical tests after which she is diagnosed with a very serious illness. He therefore has to face a long cure that tests his relationship especially as Ninon, his cousin, who Paul feels strongly attracted to, bursts into his life.
cast: Laura Smet, Nicolas Duvauchelle, Marie Denarnaud, Catherine Salviat, Maurice Antoni, Julien Bouvard

title: Les couleurs du diable
synopsis: Nicolas Morgan is in Rome to exhibit some of his works. Willing to do anything to be successful, however, he does not have the talent (or the luck) to break through. And so, to notice it is not a famous gallery owner but a disturbing patron ...
cast: Wadeck Stanczak, Ruggero Raimondi, Isabelle Pasco, Luca Zingaretti

title: Les couloirs du temps - Les visiteurs 2
synopsis: Goffredo, Count of Montmirail, prepares to celebrate his wedding with Fremebonda di Pouille when the Duke, his father, interrupts the preparations for the ceremony. Someone has stolen his jewels, and worse, the precious relic of Santa Rolanda, which ensures fertility for the women of the house. The "booty" remained in the present with Jeancoion, squire of Goffredo and Ginette. The fact prevents the corridors of time from closing.
cast: Christian Clavier, Jean Reno, Muriel Robin, Marie Anne Chazel

title: Les crimes silencieux
synopsis: Some nights, in the heart of the abandoned mines of Courrières, the "silent cries" of the miners buried alive during the largest mining disaster in Europe in 1906 can still be heard. Returning with her family to the places where she grew up, the police captain Tess Borski finds herself having to investigate with Commissioner François Dubois a series of strange crimes that gradually lead back to the painful past never forgotten by the community.
cast: Richard Berry, Odile Vuillemin, Feodor Atkine, Alexis Loret, Olivier Chantreau, Clara Ghesquière, Valérie Kaprisky, Emmanuelle Bouaziz, René Lukasiewicz, Luc Antoni

title: Les créatures
synopsis: Edgard, a mystery and science fiction writer, seeks inspiration on a fishing island, with his wife Milène, who lost her voice in a car accident. In his fantasy, people become the "creatures" of the book he is writing; in particular an elderly castellan whom he "sees" as a diabolical scientist and whom he imagines he is killing. The man really dies, Milène gives birth to a child and regains her voice. Agnès Varda constantly keeps the narrative on a level of intriguing ambiguity, thanks also to an anti-traditional style, skilfully controlled by a shrewd and fruitful inventiveness.
cast: Michel Piccoli, Catherine Deneuve, Eva Dahlbeck

title: Les demoiselles de Rochefort
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Françoise Dorléac, Danielle Darrieux, George Chakiris

title: Les dents de la nuit
synopsis: Sam, Prune and Alice finally manage to get an invitation to an elite party, traditionally held once a year, in an ancient (and uncanny) isolated castle. When they realize that the guests are vampires, maybe it's too late: will they be able to avoid being the main course of the dinner?
cast: Patrick Mille, Frédérique Bel, Julie Fournier, Vincent Desagnat, Sam Karmann, Hélène De Fougerolles, Antoine Duléry, Gilles Gaston Dreyfus, Jean Luc Couchard, Joseph Malerba

title: Les dents, pipi, au lit
synopsis: Antoine, bachelor and inveterate womanizer is close to forty, he lives in a wonderful apartment that he has shared for several years with his best friend. Thomas announces his departure abroad and offers him Jeanne, a beautiful young single woman, as a replacement, whom Antoine is ready to welcome with open arms. When Jeanne shows up at the door with Lou and Théo, her 5 and 8 year old children, the situation suddenly becomes a nightmare ...
cast: Arnaud Ducret, Louise Bourgoin, Timéo Bolland, Saskia Dillais De Melo, Laurent Ferraro, Michael Cohen, Colette Kraffe, Hervé Masquelier, Roby Schinasi, Joana Preiss

title: Les derniers parisiens
synopsis: Two brothers, one of whom just released from prison and seeking social reintegration, compete for a nightclub located in the popular Pigalle district, a few meters from the Moulin Rouge.
cast: Reda Kateb, Slimane Dazi, Elisa Bachir Bey, Yassine Azzouz

title: Les deux amis
synopsis: Vincent, an extra in the cinema, meets Mona, an employee of a sandwich shop at the station, and is fascinated by her. After only a week, Vincent is crazy about her but ignores that Mona is forced to go back to jail to sleep every night.
cast: Louis Garrel, Golshifteh Farahani, Vincent Macaigne

title: Les deux anglaises et le Continent
synopsis: We are at the beginning of the century. Claude is a young Frenchman: invited by Anne Brown to the English province, he falls in love with Anne's sister, Muriel. When Paris is back, it forgets it. But when he meets Anne, who has come to the French capital for a sculpture course, he begins a love story with her ..
cast: Jean Pierre Léaud, Kika Markham, Stacey Tendeter, Irene Tunc

title: Les diables
synopsis: Joseph and Chloé are brother and sister. Abandoned at birth, they lived from one orphanage to another. Chloé is autistic, she doesn't speak, she doesn't accept being touched by anyone. Joseph does what he can to protect her from the outside world. The boy is convinced that if he can find their parents, his sister will get better. The psychiatrist who follows the two children agrees with him but when he finally finds his mother, Joseph discovers that she too is autistic. The dream of getting Chloé to heal seems to be getting more and more unreal.
cast: Adèle Haenel, Vincent Rottiers, Rochdy Labidi, Jacques Bonnaffé, Aurélia Petit, Galamelah Lagra, Dominique Reymond, Frédéric Pierrot, Danielle Ambry, Azouz Begag

title: Les diaboliques
synopsis: Michel Delassalle authoritatively directs the college he founded with the money of his wife Cristina. Nicole is a new teacher becomes Michel's lover. However, the two women end up becoming allies against the man they have in common. With a ruse they lure him into a trap, kill him and simulate an accident in the boarding school swimming pool. But Michel's body disappears ... A classic of French cinema and thriller. Inspired by a novel by Boileau and Narcejac, Clouzot reaches the maximum in his ruthless analysis of the ferocity that can be hidden in the human spirit. 1996 remake by Jeremiah Chechik, with Isabelle Adjani and Sharon Stone.
cast: Simone Signoret, Véra Clouzot, Charles Vanel, Paul Meurisse

title: Les dialogues des Carmélites
synopsis: Bianca della Forza with a very sensitive character and belonging to an aristocratic family, she suffers from the weakness of her character. The girl hopes to strengthen him by entering the Carmelite convent of Compiègne. But his weakness, which often translates into unstoppable fear in the face of danger, manifested itself dramatically during the French Revolution. When the nuns are expelled from the convent, Bianca, although she has devoted herself to martyrdom, lets herself be overcome by fear and returns home.
cast: Jeanne Moreau, Alida Valli, Madeleine Renaud, Pascale Audret

title: Les dimanches de Ville d'Avray
cast: Hardy Krüger, Patricia Gozzi, Nicole Courcel, Daniel Ivernel

title: Les douze travaux d'Astérix
synopsis: Julius Caesar challenges his traditional Galli adversaries to overcome twelve fearsome labors, almost as if they were new Hercules. Asterix and the inseparable Obelix are designated by the village to take up the challenge and, of course, brilliantly overcome every obstacle.

title: Les démoniaques
synopsis: A captain (John Rico), his partner (Joëlle Coeur) and two other looters (Willy Braque and Paul Bisciglia) rape and kill two girls (Lieva Lone and Patricia Hermenier) who survived yet another shipwreck against a cursed rock in Normandy. The two, however, have supernatural powers and - now ghosts - will seek revenge.
cast: Joëlle Coeur, John Rico, Willy Braque, Paul Bisciglia, Lieva Lone, Patricia Hermenier, Louise Dhour, Ben Zimet, Mireille Dargent, Miletic Zivomir

title: Les démons
synopsis: As he burns on the stake, an old witch cursed his executioners, judge Jeffreys (Cihangir Gaffari), the sadistic Lady de Winter (Larin Field) and his lover Thomas Renfield (Alberto Dalbés). Margaret (Britt Nichols), the beautiful daughter of the witch, flees from the convent in which she is locked up with her sister Kathleen (Anne Libert) and decides to take revenge on her by seducing the murderers of her mother and killing them thanks to her magical arts of her
cast: Anne Libert, Britt Nichols, Doris Thomas, Karin Field, Cihangir Gaffari, Luis Barboo, Howard Vernon, Alberto Dalbes, Rosa Palomar

title: Les démons
synopsis: As a series of kidnappings of little boys haunts Montreal, 10-year-old Félix finishes school in Old Longueuil, an ordinary suburb with a peaceful appearance. Imaginative and sensitive, Félix, like many of his peers, is afraid of everything. Gradually, the imaginary demons of his childhood will mix with those of a rather disturbing reality.
cast: Laurent Lucas, Pascale Bussières, Bénédicte Décary, Pier Luc Funk, Victoria Diamond, Théodore Pellerin, Édouard Tremblay Grenier, Vassili Schneider, Sarah Mottet, Jean Luc Terriault

title: Les démons de Jésus
synopsis: We are in 1968 and the Jacob family has settled in a small house in the Parisian suburbs. Jo, the father, has quit his business and drowns his bad mood in alcohol, Rita instead takes care of the house. Néné and Jésus live by their wits and drag themselves to "Elvis", the infamous bar on the corner. Marie, a cashier in a supermarket, is the only one in the family who works.
cast: Thierry Fremont, Patrick Bouchitey, Nadia Farès, Roberto Herlitzka, Marie Trintignant

title: Les enfants de Timpelbach
synopsis: In the village of Timpelbach, some nasty children wreak havoc among other children and parents. Exasperated by this behavior, the parents decide to punish them ...
cast: Raphaël Katz, Adèle Exarchopoulos, Léo Legrand, Baptiste Bétoulaud, Martin Jobert, Lola Creton, Léo Paget, Ilona Bachelier, Gérard Depardieu, Carole Bouquet

title: Les enfants de la pluie
synopsis: Two peoples have always faced each other: the Pyross, sun worshipers for whom water is only death and desolation, and the Hydross, the children of rain who in the dry season are transformed into stone statues. The war between the Pyross and Hydross seems destined to never end, but one day Skän, a young fire warrior sets his gaze on the beautiful Kallisto, of the enemy faction.

title: Les enfants des autres
synopsis: Rachel (Virginie Efira) is a serene woman, who loves her life, her students, her friends, her guitar lessons. When he falls in love with Alì, a man like her separated but who, unlike her, has a daughter. Rachel asks to meet her. Leila is four years old and Rachel begins to become attached, reciprocated. On the wave of this relationship that excites her and intense it, in Rachel the desire for motherhood and a family of its own grows, but is 40 years old and the time is not on its side.
cast: Virginie Efira, Roschdy Zem, Chiara Mastroianni, Antonia Buresi, Yamée Couture, Victor Lefebvre, Mireille Perrier, Sébastien Pouderoux, Henri Noël Tabary, Frederick Wiseman

title: Les enfants du Marais
synopsis: Cri Cri, now elderly, relives the season of her five years and the meeting with Pierrot, her first and only love. Around her, in the swamp on the banks of the Loire, the memory brings to life "the children of the Marais": Riton, the grouchy and slacker father, her dear friend Garris, the shy intellectual Amédée, the rude boxer Jo and the old Pepè , rich and illiterate industrialist born in the swamp. The hunting of frogs, the collection of lily of the valley, the thousand jobs of Garris and Riton, good wine and the sacred value of friendship, mark the days spent in that corner of rural France.
cast: Jacques Villeret, André Dussollier, Michel Serrault

title: Les enfants du Paradis
synopsis: We are in Paris in 1840 and a troupe of actors achieves great success every evening in the popular theater of the "Funambules". Among them there is also a mime, Baptiste Debureau, an artist with a romantic temperament, who falls madly in love with the beautiful Garance. The woman is contested by three other men: Frédérick Lemaître, a brilliant but truculent actor, Lacenaire, a homosexual anarchist, and the Count of Montray ...
cast: Jean Louis Barrault, Arletty, Pierre Brasseur, Maria Casarès

title: Les enfants du siècle
synopsis: The passion between a brave writer and a decadent poet ...
cast: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Magimel, Stefano Dionisi, Robin Renucci

title: Les espions
synopsis: A spy and a scientist who guards the secret of the atomic bomb find refuge in the Parisian asylum of Dr. Malic. But other spies converge inside the place of confinement, both Russian and American, prisoners of the obsession with mutual control.
cast: Gérard Séty, Curd Jürgens, Véra Clouzot, Peter Ustinov, Sam Jaffe

title: Les experiences erotiques de Frankenstein
synopsis: Cagliostro, with the help of Melissa, half rapacious half woman, and the monstrous Morpho, kills Baron Frankenstein and takes possession of his creature. His plan is simple: he would like to create other similar "creatures" with which to march to conquer the world. Frankenstein's daughter tries to stop him.
cast: Dennis Price, Howard Vernon, Anne Libert

title: Les exploits d'un jeune Don Juan
synopsis: In 1914 the young Roger, weaned by the servant, is forced to spend the summer in his father's villa. After the call to the front, the boy is the only man of the house left and finds himself struggling with very sensual women, including the maid, the spinster aunt and the older sister who enrich him in experience.

synopsis: A mummified corpse is found by the workers who were cutting down a wall in an apartment in Le Havre. Investigations in charge of the investigations are Captain Ariane Sallès and colleague Gaspard Lesage. Recently, the apartment - owned by a well -sighted family - was empty and nobody seems to know who was occupied before. The coroner, who is then the father that Ariane has not met for twenty years, informs that the body belongs to a young woman who had recently given birth.
cast: Nicolas Marié, Barbara Cabrita, Frédéric Diefenthal, Marie Bunel, Antoine Duléry, Alexis Loret, Gilles Cohen, Sarah Jane Sauvegrain, Anne Loiret, Corinne Belet, Sophie Lepionnier, Aure Rodenbour, Pierre Philippe, Alain Frédéric Lion, Erwan Szejnok, Fabien Giameluca

title: Les fantômes du chapelier
cast: Michel Serrault, Charles Aznavour, Monique Chaumette, François Cluzet

title: Les favoris de la Lune
synopsis: The real protagonists of the film are a portrait of the last century and a precious service by Sèvres. Once stolen, the two objects pass from hand to hand, in a whirlwind carousel of owners. Money never stops; fortunes collapse and are created suddenly; feelings and people are interchangeable, because that's how the world works. Apologue on the power of money and the neurosis of a civilization, awarded with the special jury prize in Venice. Fierce Iosseliani: the poison is hidden in a crystal bottle with delightful shapes.
cast: Pascal Aubier, Alix De Montaigu, Peter Cloos, Jean Pierre Beauviala

title: Les femmes
synopsis: Writer Jerome Hervé has accumulated a debt of several million with his publisher, which it will be difficult for him to recover. Since travel and women are an inexhaustible source of inspiration for him, on the advice of his publisher, he hires a handyman secretary and starts traveling the world with the aim of writing an autobiography. Jerome hires Claudia and gets on a train bound for Italy, not before, however, having taken leave of Hélène and Marianne, his last two flames.
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Maurice Ronet, Jean Pierre Marielle, Anny Duperey

title: Les femmes de l'ombre
synopsis: Involved in the French resistance, Louise (Marceau) must flee to London following the murder of her husband. There she is recruited by the SOE, the secret service set up by Churchill, who entrusts her with a first mission: to form a group of women who must participate in the liberation operation of a British agent who has fallen into the hands of the Germans and who is aware of the plans to the landing in Normandy. Louise thus hires Suzy (Gillain), a seductive dancer; Gaelle (FranÃ§ois,), chemist and specializing in explosives; Jeanne (Depardieu), a cold-blooded prostitute. The four women will then be joined by Maria (Sansa), an Italian Jewish expert in radio communications.
cast: Sophie Marceau, Julie Depardieu, Marie Gillain, Déborah François, Moritz Bleibtreu, Maya Sansa, Julien Boisselier, Vincent Rottiers, Volker Bruch, Robin Renucci

title: Les femmes du 6ème étage
synopsis: Paris, 1960. Jean-Louis and his wife Suzanne are a wealthy and somewhat bored middle-class couple. The children are growing up and they are preparing to age slowly. In the meantime, however, on the sixth floor of their building - where the dormers and the so-called chambres des bonnes are located - six Spanish women of different ages have settled, who have come to Paris to work as servants. Jean Louis begins by chance to attend the sixth floor, where life is poorer, noisy, but also more intense. In particular, he is attracted to Concepcion, a mature but still pleasant woman, for whom he begins to feel a tenderness destined to grow.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Sandrine Kiberlain, Natalia Verbeke, Carmen Maura, Lola Dueñas, Berta Ojea, Nuria Solé, Concha Galán, Marie Armelle Deguy, Muriel Solvay

title: Les feux de la chandeleur
synopsis: Marie Louise and Alexandre tell their children Laura and Jean-Paul that they want to separate. The main cause of the serious disagreements lies in the activity in the Communist Party of the woman which hinders both the education of the children and the activity of the husband's notary. Ten years pass and Alexandre, having obtained a divorce, has remarried, while Marie Louise has given up political activity. The woman lives in the hope of returning to her ex-husband with whom she is still deeply in love.
cast: Annie Girardot, Bernard Fresson, Gabriella Boccadoro, Claude Jade

title: Les filles de madame Claude
synopsis: Jeanne Descat and her friends Doris and Nathalie have a very profitable secret occupation: they are girls-sequillo. One day all three receive a phone call that asks them to fulfill the extravagant requests of as many customers. Each of the girls uses everything that over time has learned to get away in the best way ...
cast: Carina Barone, Françoise Gayat, Zora Kerowa, Antonio Ferrante, Carmen Russo

title: Les filles du soleil
synopsis: In Kurdistan, Bahar is part of the Daughters of the Sun. He fights in the name of freedom and to find his missing son, taken away by Isis. The French journalist Mathilde arrives from France to follow the group of warriors and their actions.
cast: Golshifteh Farahani, Emmanuelle Bercot, Zübeyde Bulut, Maia Shamoevi, Evin Ahmadguli, Nia Mirianashvili, Mari Semidovi, Ahmet Zirek, Erol Afsin, Arabi Ghibeh

title: Les fils du vent
synopsis: The Yamakasi have decided to open a school in Thailand to teach children Parkour, a revolutionary sport in which you jump off the roofs performing dizzying stunts. Once in Bangkok, however, they realize that the Chinese Triads at war with the Japanese Yakuza are wreaking havoc. As if that weren't enough, there is the gang headed by the beautiful Tsu and her brother Kien, with whom the Yamakasi are forced, in spite of themselves, to collaborate ...
cast: Williams Belle, Châu Belle Dinh, Malik Diouf, Yann Hnautra, Elodie Yung

title: Les fous du stade
synopsis: A group of friends goes on vacation to a location that is about to host the passage of the Olympic torch. Here they meet the daughter of the shopkeeper Lafougasse, Delizia, who runs away with the torchbearer. They chase her by bike, eventually becoming cycling champions.
cast: Les Charlots, Paul Préboist, Martine Kelly, Gérard Croce

title: Les fruits de la passion
synopsis: In the 1920s, Sir Stephen (Klaus Kinski) middle -aged English brought the young lover or (Isabelle Iliers) to a brothel by Hong Kong, Madame's Maison des Fleurs (Pita [Peter], aka Ikehata Shinnosuke). Or does not make resistances to demonstrate his total dedication to Sir Stephen; However, he also has another lover, Nathalie (Arielle Dombasle), a casino in Shanghai and is involved with the first rebellions of the Chinese people to foreign domination. When either he falls in love with the very young and affectionate client Ogaku (Kenichi Nakamura), Sir Stephen spies them on during a embrace and jeopardizes himself.
cast: Isabelle Illiers, Klaus Kinski, Arielle Dombasle, Pîtâ, Keiko Niitaka, Sayoko Yamaguchi, Hitomi Takahashi, Miyuki Ono, Yuka Kamebuchi, Kenichi Nakamura, Akiro Suetsugu, Renji Ishibashi, Takeshi Wakamatsu, Georges Wilson, Maria Meriko, Makiko Hirasawa, Kaoru Iinuma, Keiko Asano, Toshihiko Hino

title: Les fugitifs
synopsis: Just out of jail, while he is in the bank to deposit his meager savings, the former thief Jean Lucas is taken hostage by a certain François Pignon, the author of a disrupted attempted robbery. The two fight her under fire from the police, who naturally suspect that the bandit is Jean. During the escape, the friendship between the fugitives and the dumb daughter that François wanted to heal with the money of the coup is cemented.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Pierre Richard, Jean Carmet, Maurice Barrier, Jean Benguigui, Roland Blanche, Anaïs Bret, Philippe Lelièvre, Yveline Ailhaud

title: Les galets d'Étretat
synopsis: Left with the car broken down in the rain, the beautiful Annie, director of a beauty institute, is rescued by a stranger who takes her to his house and abuses her. Annie discovers that the man is the famous car driver Kelvo and decides to take revenge.
cast: Virna Lisi, Maurice Ronet, Annie Cordy, Juliette Mills, Christian Barbier, Gregoire Aslan, Philippe Baronnet, Michel Robbe, Amarande, Max Amyll

title: Les gamins
synopsis: After getting engaged to Lola (Mélanie Bernier), Thomas (Max Boublil) meets his future father-in-law Gilbert (Alain Chabat), who has been married for 30 years to Suzanne (Sandrine Kiberlain) and in midlife crisis. Convinced that he has wasted his life because of marriage, Gilbert discourages Thomas by inviting him not to marry his daughter and pushing him to join him in his new choices. Convinced that freedom is elsewhere, the two will thus launch into a new life full of adventures, trying to recover the dreams of their adolescence even at a high price.
cast: Alain Chabat, Max Boublil, Sandrine Kiberlain, Mélanie Bernier, Alban Lenoir, Elisa Sednaoui, Arié Elmaleh, François Dunoyer, Nicolas Beaucaire, Mélusine Mayance

title: Les garçons et Guillaume, à table
synopsis: Ever since Guillaume was a child, everyone - especially his mother - has been convinced that he is homosexual. His tragicomic battle lasts until the day when, thirty years later, he meets the one who will become the other most important woman in his life after his mother. Beyond a heterosexual coming out, Guillaume's is the story of an actor who, from middle-class childhood to the stage, has never stopped loving women.
cast: Guillaume Gallienne, André Marcon, Françoise Fabian, Diane Kruger, Yves Jacques, Nanou Garcia, Yvon Back, Pierre Derenne, Catherine Salviat, Yvonne Gradelet, Oscar Copp

title: Les garçons sauvages
synopsis: At the beginning of the twentieth century, on the island of La Réunion, five teenagers from a good family, passionate about the occult sciences, commit a ferocious crime. A Dutch captain takes charge of them and forces them on a re-education cruise aboard a dilapidated and ghostly vessel. Exhausted by the captain's methods, the five boys plan the mutiny. Their destination is a supernatural island with lush vegetation that hides a shocking secret.
cast: Elina Löwensohn, Vimala Pons, Nathalie Richard, Sam Louwyck, Diane Rouxel, Mathilde Warnier, Christophe Bier, Anaël Snoek, Pauline Lorillard

title: Les gens normaux n'ont rien d'exceptionel
synopsis: Martine, 25, a job and a normal existence. But her relationship with François was interrupted and the girl doesn't know how to deal with it. A scene is followed by other alarming episodes, which will cause Martine to be hospitalized as mentally ill. At this point the girl demonstrates an unexpected vitality: she takes an interest in the love life of other patients, attracts the ire of the people in charge of her and others' custody. After directing several short films and a documentary about Bergman, 35-year-old Ferreira Barbosa makes her debut in a fresh and meaningful feature, written in collaboration with Cedric Kahn. And it reveals the talent of Valeria Bruni Tedeschi.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Melvil Poupaud, Marc Citti

title: Les grandes gueules
cast: Lino Ventura, Michel Constantin, Bourvil, Marie Dubois

title: Les grandes manoeuvres
synopsis: Armand, a young and brilliant lieutenant of the dragons and infallible conqueror of women, decides, as a wager, to entrust to chance who his next victim should be. The fate falls on the young divorced Marie Louise Riviére, a lady who has opened a fashion shop in the town. During the courtship, however, Armand really falls in love with the woman. Forced to leave the town for a short time, the lieutenant leaves the field open to the woman who learns of the bet. When Armand returns, determined to declare his love to the woman, he finds Marie Louise disillusioned and now completely detached from him. An excellent Gérard Philippe at the service of the late Clair's masterpiece, a melancholy comedy of yesteryear.
cast: Michèle Morgan, Gérard Philipe, Jean Desailly, Brigitte Bardot, Pierre Dux, Jacques Fabbri, Jacques François, Yves Robert, Lise Delamare

title: Les grandes personnes
synopsis: Every summer, on the occasion of his daughter Jeanne's birthday, Albert takes her to visit a new European country. For his seventeen years, he chooses a small Swedish island, convinced that he will find the lost treasure of an ancient Viking. But the house rented for the living room is already occupied by two women: Anika the owner of the place, and Christine, a French friend of hers. The plans Albert had planned for the vacation will be completely upset, sparking Jeanne's approval.
cast: Jean Pierre Darroussin, Anaïs Demoustier, Judith Henry, Lia Boysen, Jakob Eklund, Anastasios Soulis, Björn Gustafsson, Mirja Turestedt, Dag Malmberg, Åsa Göransson

title: Les grandes vacances
synopsis: Charles Bosquier, who runs a French boarding school for well-to-do boys, sends his son to England (he has to fix his English exam) and welcomes a girl from the best British society as an au pair. But Philippe, the son, does not study in England: he meets the Englishwoman Shirley and the two fall in love. To pursue them, the poor director will throw himself into a sea of ??hilarious troubles. These were the golden years of De Funès. With a decent script and the good vein of the frenetic protagonist, the laugh machine works.
cast: Louis De Funès, Ferdy Mayne, Martine Kelly, François Leccia

title: Les grands esprits
synopsis: Teacher at the most prestigious high school in France, François has always enjoyed a peaceful existence in the intellectual and bourgeois society of Paris. However, forced by events to accept a job in a school located in a difficult neighborhood of dispossessed, he will find himself having to test his limits and question his values ??and certainties.
cast: Denis Podalydès, Abdoulaye Diallo, Zineb Triki, Léa Drucker, Marie Julie Baup, Marie Rémond, Anne Jacquemin, Tom Rivoire, Pauline Huruguen

title: Les géants
synopsis: As every year, with the arrival of summer, two brothers (the fourteen year old Zak and the thirteen year old Seth) foresee horrible days in the country house where they live. With no money and nothing to do, abandoned to themselves by an increasingly absent mother, the two meet Danny, a local teenager a few years older, who will instead lead them on a journey without limits to discover life.
cast: Zacharie Chasseriaud, Martin Nissen, Paul Bartel (II), Marthe Keller

title: Les hauts murs
synopsis: 14-year-old Yves Treguier runs away from home and, found, is sent to a correctional facility on charges of wandering. The reformatory resembles a prison in a sinister way, but Yves is lucky enough to share a cell with Blondeau, a kindly boy abandoned by his rich mother. Despite everything, Yves dreams of escaping and is ready to risk imprisonment in an adult prison.
cast: Carole Bouquet, François Damiens, Emile Berling, Pascal N'Zonzi, Michel Jonasz, Catherine Jacob, Bernard Blancan, Guillaume Gouix, Anthony Decadi, Julien Bouanich

title: Les herbes folles
synopsis: Margherita hadn't foreseen that her bag would be stolen when she left the shop. And even less than the thieves would have thrown the contents into a parking lot. And George? If he could even have had a suspicion, George, he would never have reached down to pick it up.
cast: André Dussollier, Sabine Azéma, Emmanuelle Devos, Mathieu Amalric, Michel Vuillermoz, Anne Consigny

title: Les heroïnes du mal
synopsis: Three heroines of evil that grant themselves to the joys of lust and the pleasure of revenge: Margherita Luti, called the Fornarina, model and lover of Raffaello, betrays the painter with a banker, then he poles them both; Marceline is a teenager who curls with her rabbit; Marie is kidnapped by a gangster, and freed from the adorate Dobermann who first kills the gangster and then the husband.
cast: Marina Pierro, François Guetary, Gaëlle Legrand, Hassan Fall, Pascale Christophe

title: Les héros ne meurent jamais
synopsis: Joachim is an actor while his friend Alice dreams of becoming a director. One morning, a homeless man mistakes Joachim for a criminal named Zoran, who actually died on August 21, 1983: the same day the young man was born. The two friends soon become obsessed with coincidence, which they consider perfect as a starting point for a film. They then decide to go in search of Zoran's tomb, a mission that takes them to the Balkans, in an area haunted by the ghosts of war. While directing the reincarnation film, Alice fulfills Joachim's last wishes: his heart is fragile, his life hangs by a thread, and the director is about to make him immortal forever.
cast: Adèle Haenel, Jonathan Couzinié, Antonia Buresi, Damir Kustura

title: Les héroïques
synopsis: Maxime, a former drug addict, is an eternal child who loves the engines and who likes to hang around with the eldest son Leo and his friends. At fifty years, he finds himself having to deal with his son just had from his ex and to fight so as not to repeat the same mistakes made in the past. For the first time in his life, he will try to be what a good man is said.
cast: François Creton, Romeo Creton, Richard Bohringer, Ariane Ascaride, Patrick D'Assumçao, Clotilde Courau, Clara Ponsot, Chad Chenouga

title: Les infidèles
synopsis: Seven directors make six different episodes to explore the triumphs and failures, glories and merciless thuds of male infidelity, seen in all its different, funny, desperate and absurd varieties. For the men protagonists, all now on the path of middle age, every opportunity is good to let themselves be guided by instinct and pursue the pursuit of pleasure, from a conference in a provincial hotel to a small clinic for sex addicts, from a Parisian nightclub to clubs in glittering Las Vegas.
cast: Jean Dujardin, Guillaume Canet, Alexandra Lamy, Mathilda May, Gilles Lellouche, Sandrine Kiberlain, Géraldine Nakache, Isabelle Nanty, Aina Clotet, Lionel Abelanski
director: Emmanuelle Bercot, Fred Cavayé, Alexandre Courtes, Jean Dujardin, Michel Hazanavicius, Eric Lartigau, Gilles Lellouche

title: Les innocents aux mains sales
synopsis: Julie is bored in her beautiful villa in Saint-Tropez; her husband Louis is too old for her and he drinks. She soon becomes the lover of the young writer Jeff. In fact, we might as well send alcoholic Louis to the creator and enjoy his money. Except that things do not go exactly according to the plan of the two faithless ones.
cast: Romy Schneider, Rod Steiger, Paolo Giusti, Jean Rochefort, François Maistre, Pierre Santini, François Perrot, Hans Christian Blech

title: Les insoumis
synopsis: Despite his manager Soriano's connivance with the mafia, young boxer Mat Prades refuses to be beaten during a match. Ten years later, in Coronado, a small Caribbean village, where Mat has rebuilt his life, the man sees Soriano disembark, accompanied by his girlfriend, Marisa. Soriano tries to convince Mat to help him buy the bay overlooked by the village, to build a luxury tourist complex. Mat is torn between the desire to help his old friend and the desire to protect the place he loves and its inhabitants, who have been close to him in a difficult time.
cast: Antonella Ponziani, Lou Castel, Feodor Atkine, Bernard Verley

title: Les intrigues de Sylvia Couski
synopsis: Paris in the 70s: parties populated by transvestites, intrigues and subterfuges between eccentric artists who populate the wild nights of the city.
cast: Marie France, Michèle Moretti, Howard Vernon, Xavier Grandès, Gaëtane Gaël, Hélène Hazéra, Michel Cressolle

title: Les invasions barbares
synopsis: Rémy, a former university professor and great womanizer, has cancer. His son Sébastien, a successful broker in London, returns to Québec with his girlfriend to assist him. Exasperated by the bureaucracy that afflicts public health, Sébastien pays out huge sums to ensure maximum comfort for his father (with whom he has always had tense relations). Meanwhile, at Rémy's bedside, his ex-wife and old friends gather to help him bear the tragic reality and the burden of memories ...
cast: Rémy Girard, Stéphane Rousseau, Dorothée Berryman, Louise Portal, Dominique Michel

title: Les jeunes amants
synopsis: Shauna, an elegant seventy -year -old architect, crosses Pierre's road, a doctor on the forty who, happily married, had already made her an excellent impression when he saw him for the first time briefly fifteen years earlier. Starting a relationship, Pierre will see her family life complicate while Shauna will relive feelings that she thought they belonged to the past.
cast: Fanny Ardant, Melvil Poupaud, Cécile De France, Florence Loiret Caille, Sharif Andoura

title: Les jolies choses
synopsis: Marie and Lucie are two twin sisters with diametrically opposed characters and linked by a relationship of hate / love. While Lucie is more outgoing and free-spirited, Marie is much more reserved and a model of austerity. One day, Lucie gets the chance to record a record but her voice isn't up to par, unlike Marie's suave one. Soon, the music will lead Marie to take Lucie's place and discover her hidden side.
cast: Marion Cotillard, Stomy Bugsy, Patrick Bruel, Titoff, Ophélie Winter, Tony Amoni, Matthieu Touboul, Olivier Granier, Aude Brenner, Nikita Lespinasse

title: Les jours où je n'existe pas
synopsis: Antoine exists one day out of two: at the stroke of midnight, every once in a while, he disappears to reappear twenty-four hours later in the same place, completely unaware of what happened during his absence. All this causes him many problems when he meets and falls in love with Clementine, a girl who lives, like anyone else, full time.
cast: Antoine Chappey, Clémentine Baert, Luis Miguel Cintra, Antoine Michot

title: Les liaisons dangereuses
synopsis: In late eighteenth-century France, the gentleman Valmont married the Marquise Merteuil. Later he seduces the virgin Cécile, betrothed to his wife's lover. The game of deceit and seduction staged by the cynical libertine will cause victims.
cast: Gérard Philipe, Jeanne Moreau, Annette Vadim, Jean Louis Trintignant

title: Les liens du sang
synopsis: Lyon, late seventies. François, police inspector, learns of the release of his older brother Gabriel, who has served ten years in prison for murder. Their relationships have never been idyllic but they both want to leave everything behind, so much so that François goes out of his way to help Gabriel. Reality and the old demons of the past will eventually take over.
cast: Guillaume Canet, François Cluzet, Clotilde Hesme, Marie Denarnaud, Mehdi Nebbou, Olivier Perrier, Carole Franck, Hélène Foubert, Eric Bonicatto, Alain Beigel

title: Les lions sont lâchés
synopsis: A woman married to a provincial moves to Paris. Here she becomes the lover of a novelist who writes a book of which she is the protagonist, and therefore of a doctor who would like to divorce to join her ...
cast: Jean Claude Brialy, Danielle Darrieux, Michèle Morgan

title: Les lèvres rouges
synopsis: A very young just married couple. Valerie and Stefan. in a large hotel in Ostend - deserted given the winter season - a fascinating and mysterious countess (played by a masterful Delphine Seyrig) and her very young secretary, Ilona. The countess, who introduces herself with the name Bathory, immediately shows an excessive transport towards the couple, which is reciprocated by Stefan and on the contrary rejected by Valerie. Stefan also shows an obsessive interest in some heinous murders of young women that the local press reports were found without a drop of blood. The latest of the murders takes place in the nearby city of Bruges, just as Stefan and Valerie are visiting the city. On the return of the two from Bruges, events will precipitate. The visit of a retired policeman, the intrusiveness of the countess, the impatience of Ilona, ??the lies of Stefan: all will contribute to a dramatic ending.
cast: Delphine Seyrig, John Karlen, Danielle Ouimet, Andrea Rau

title: Les mains d'Orlac
synopsis: Famous pianist Stephen Orlac loses his hands in a plane crash. A surgeon transplants those of a strangler sentenced to death: Orlac is no longer able to play, but begins to feel an irrepressible murderous drive. The ambiguous illusionist Nero takes advantage of the situation and starts blackmailing him ...
cast: Mel Ferrer, Dany Carrel, Christopher Lee, Lucile Saint Simon

title: Les malheurs d'Alfred
synopsis: At the moment of the final act, an would-be suicide meets a woman who promises him another life: that of television. But the bad star has not set.
cast: Pierre Richard, Anny Duperey, Jean Carmet

title: Les malheurs de Sophie
synopsis: Sophie, a six-year-old girl, regularly gives in to all her flaws and cannot resist the temptation of the forbidden. When her parents decide to return to America, Sophie is saddened by the idea of ??having to leave her friends Camille and Madeleine. A year later, Sophie returns to the Château de Réan but in the company of her stepmother, Madame Fichini, who desires a model education for her.
cast: Caroline Grant, Anaïs Demoustier, Golshifteh Farahani, Muriel Robin, Céleste Carrale, Laetitia Dosch, Michel Fau, Annie Mercier

title: Les mariés de l'an II
synopsis: In 1787 the young Nicolas Filibert was forced to flee France, abandoning his wife Charlotte, and to take refuge in the United States. Seven years later, when he returns to France to get a divorce, he is involved in the turbulent events that pit the revolutionaries against the nobles and, of course, finds Charlotte again. Tailor-made film for Jean-Paul Belmondo, unleashed protagonist all fire and action.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Marlène Jobert, Laura Antonelli, Michel Auclair

title: Les maîtres du temps
country: France, Switzerland, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary
synopsis: Little Piel was orphaned following an accident on the planet Perdide. His father, before dying, entrusted him with a radio receiver that he calls Mike and with which he can talk to the crew of a spaceship that changes course to go to save him and whose commander is Jaffar. After various adventures and dangers, the crew will meet colonizers called "masters of the time".
cast: Jean Valmont, Michel Elias, Frédéric Legros, Yves Marie Maurin, Monique Thierry, Sady Rebbot, Patrick Baujin, Pierre Tourneur, Alain Cuny, Yves Brainville

title: Les miens
synopsis: Moussa is the kindest and most altruistic component of an extended family whose members judge and openly criticize every gesture made by his brother. A blow to the head will make him lose the inhibitory and moussa brakes will thus end up expressing every thought that passes through the mind without filters.
cast: Sami Bouajila, Maïwenn, Roschdy Zem, Meriem Serbah, Rachid Bouchareb, Abel Jafri, Nina Zem

title: Les mille et une perversions de Felicia
synopsis: Paul and Gabrielle, a young newlywed couple, welcome their neighbors' daughter Felicia into their home, whom they will host for a few weeks during the summer. It won't be long before the precocious and seductive girl sets her sights on both of them.
cast: Rebecca Brooke, Jean Roche, Béatrice Harnois, Roland Charbaux, Ray Prevet, Nicole Daudet, Cristophe Alberola, Marlène Myller

title: Les miracles n'ont lieu qu'une fois
synopsis: Claudia, follows medical courses in Paris. The girl has a fellow student, Jerome, to whom she is linked by a feeling of sympathy; only at the moment of parting do the two feel that love has blossomed from sympathy and confess it to each other.
cast: Alida Valli, Jean Marais, Marcelle Arnold, Dedi Ristori, Nada Fiorelli

title: Les misérables
synopsis: Stéphane has recently joined the Montfermeil crime team, on the outskirts of Paris. Together with new colleagues Chris and Gwada, both more experienced than him, he quickly discovers that various tensions exist between the neighborhood gangs. In the throes of a difficult stop, a drone captures their every move and action.
cast: Damien Bonnard, Alexis Manenti, Djebril Zonga, Issa Perica, Al Hassan Ly, Steve Tientcheu, Almamy Kanoute, Jeanne Balibar

title: Les morsures de l'aube
synopsis: Antoine, a handsome squatter, lives at night trying to latch into the clubs and boasting important friendships: like the one with Jordan Charlier, dark lord of darkness. Cornered, the young man is forced to find Jordan and his sister Violaine to settle some bills ...
cast: Guillaume Canet, Asia Argento, Gérard Lanvin, Vincent Perez, Orazio Massaro

title: Les neiges du Kilimandjaro
synopsis: Despite having lost his job, Michel, a middle-aged man, continues to live peacefully, in harmony with his wife Marie-Claire, who has been by his side for more than thirty years. One night, however, their modest home is targeted by two criminals, two thieves intent on recovering the money that the couple keeps at home. To scare them, the thugs beat the couple, tie them up and run away. Some time later, Michel discovers that one of the thieves is actually a former co-worker of his, who has to support his two younger brothers. Moved by pity, Michel and Marie-Claire begin to help the young man.

title: Les noces rouges
synopsis: Lucienne (Stephane Audran) betrays her husband Paul (Claude Piéplu), senator and mayor of a town on the Loire, with Pierre (Michel Piccoli), Paul's collaborator. Pierre kills his sick wife then together with Lucienne causes a fatal accident against Paul who was blackmailing him. Héléne, the woman's daughter, believing she is saving her mother, asks for an investigation.
cast: Stéphane Audran, Michel Piccoli, Claude Piéplu, Clotilde Joano, Eliana De Santis, François Robert, Daniel Lecourtois, Pippo Merisi

title: Les novices
synopsis: Agnes is a nun who goes with her order to the beach for a swim in the sea. Finding some clothes that fit her perfectly and a motorcycle ready for use, Agnes decides to run away and go on an adventure, finding refuge in a prostitute's house. The friendship that will be born will push the second to deal with an unexpected vocation.
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Annie Girardot, Jean Carmet, Jacques Duby

title: Les nuits brûlantes de Linda
synopsis: A young woman is taken to take care of an elderly man and the two daughters, who live on an island off the Greek coast. Upon his arrival, the elderly warns him of how evil and dangerous his daughters are. However, it will soon discover how one of them, the adoptive one, is a crazy nymphomaniac chases and seduces everyone at home, including the paralytic stepsister.
cast: Alice Arno, Lina Romay, Verónica Llimerá, Paul Muller, Monica Swinn, James Harris, Catherine Lafferière, Angelo Bassi, Richard Bigotini, Jesús Franco

title: Les nuits de la pleine lune
synopsis: Louise lives with Remi but gladly takes the opportunity of a "pied-à-terre" in which to be alone sometimes. But, having met the young Bastien (on a full moon night), she has a short adventure with him. Then Remi confesses that he has a mistress, and Louise finds herself truly alone.
cast: Pascale Ogier, Tchéky Karyo, Fabrice Luchini, Christian Vadim

title: Les nuits fauves
synopsis: Jean is thirty years old and has an unbridled desire to live: his availability for any experience is total, without inhibitions. Meet Laura, a 17 year old girl. He also has a love affair with her, which soon becomes important even if anything but peaceful. Jean is HIV-positive, but that doesn't change anything in his habits or Laura's feeling for him. Thanks to her, Jean will learn to love. Cyril Collard made it with an "excessive" disposition before dying of AIDS and this cannot leave us indifferent. In France they shouted at the masterpiece but, with all due respect for the drama it reflects, it does not seem to us that it is.
