title: Les orgueilleux
cast: Gérard Philipe, Michèle Morgan, Michèle Cordoue, Carlos Lopez Moctezuma

title: Les parapluies de Cherbourg
synopsis: Genevière Emery loves Guy Foucher, a young mechanic, but Genevière's mother, who owns an umbrella shop, doesn't approve of their relationship. When Guy leaves for the war in Algeria and Geneviève finds herself pregnant, her mother pushes her to marry Roland Cassard, a wealthy diamond cutter. A few years later, however, during a Christmas night, while it is snowing, something unexpected happens.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Nino Castelnuovo, Anne Vernon, Marc Michel, Ellen Farner

title: Les parents terribles
synopsis: Yvonne loves her son Michel morbidly. Michel falls in love with Madeleine, who has a mature protector (Georges, Michel's father). The latter forces Madeleine to confess to Michel that she has a third lover (who, however, does not exist). The truth will come out and then the two young people can get married, but, immediately after the wedding, Yvonne commits suicide.
cast: Jean Marais, Yvonne De Bray, Gabrielle Dorziat, Josette Day

title: Les parias de la gloire
synopsis: Alsace, 1944: André witnesses the death of his half-brother Jacques at the hands of a Nazi officer. A few years later, on duty in a French post during the Indochina campaign, André sees a small, broken-down plane landed, piloted by a German farmer named Lud. Still animated by the thirst for revenge, André immediately proves hostile towards the newcomer: the discovery that he is the murderer of Jacques rekindles the hatred towards him, but in the meantime the two find themselves facing a common danger .. .
cast: Curd Jürgens, Maurice Ronet, Folco Lulli, German Cobos

title: Les passagers de la nuit
synopsis: Elisabeth remained having to look after the two children alone after being left by her husband. She therefore accepts a night work on a radio, where one evening she knows Talulah, a boy you decide to deal with.
cast: Emmanuelle Béart, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Noée Abita, Ophélia Kolb, Thibault Vinçon, Didier Sandre, Laurent Poitrenaux, Quito Rayon Richter, Morgane Portejoie Pinsard

title: Les perles de la couronne
synopsis: It is the story through the centuries of seven pearls originally donated by Pope Clement VII to his niece, Queen Catherine de 'Medici for her marriage to the Dauphin of France. Pseudo-historical fantasy written, directed and performed by an inspired Giutry, who creates hilarious moments and plays with historical and verbal paradoxes.
cast: Jaqueline Delubac, Sacha Guitry, Lynn Arding

title: Les petits mouchoirs
synopsis: The usual summer in Cap Ferret, in the large house by the sea, for a group of Parisian friends, each with their own stress and their own little lies. For all the pain of a lack: the friend was left alone in the hospital after a very serious accident. But this time the summer is a great cold for everyone.
cast: François Cluzet, Marion Cotillard, Benoît Magimel, Gilles Lellouche, Jean Dujardin, Laurent Lafitte, Valérie Bonneton, Pascale Arbillot, Joël Dupuch, Anne Marivin

title: Les plus belles années d'une vie
synopsis: After having met, long ago, and having lived a dazzling passion, Jean-Louis Duroc and Anne Gauthier are ready for the epilogue of their love story. The former pilot is often lost in his memories and the son is committed to finding the one his father always talks about. This will be how Anne will see Jean-Louis again, making their relationship pick up where it left off.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Anouk Aimée, Souad Amidou, Antoine Sire, Marianne Denicourt, Monica Bellucci, Tess Lauvergne, Jean Yves Cressenville, Vincent Vinel, Laurent Dassault

title: Les plus belles escroqueries du monde
synopsis: Four episodes: the first, by Roman Polanski, tells of a high-class thief who manages to cheat a fabulous necklace in disguise; the second, signed Chabrol, tells of a hardware merchant who buys the Eiffel Tower by weight of iron; in the third, by Hiromichio Horikawa, she makes him die of erotic exhaustion to steal his dentures, which he believes to be platinum, but then discovers that it is not; finally, Gregoretti shows us a prostitute who combines a marriage of convenience with the wrong old man ... Four directors, but there should have been five: the planned episode of Godard, "Le grand escroc", was cut. Unequal like all films of this type.
cast: Jean Pierre Cassel, Nicole Karen, Gabriella Giorgelli, Francis Blanche
director: Roman Polanski, Claude Chabrol, Hiromichi Horikawa, Ugo Gregoretti

title: Les portes de la nuit
synopsis: Diego dined with Raimondo's daughter, his fellow prisoner during the war, and is about to spend the night in the house. To satisfy the desire of Raimondo's son who wants to go down to the courtyard to play, he meets a beautiful woman. The girl is called Malou and recently separated from her greedy and selfish husband Georges. The spark of passion strikes between the two and they soon end up making love. Meanwhile, Malou's father and his brother Guy arrive in the nearby restaurant ...
cast: Yves Montand, Nathalie Nattier, Serge Reggiani, Pierre Brasseur

title: Les possédés
synopsis: The indolent prince Stavroghin, the Macchiavellico Pierre, the nihilist Kirilov in late nineteenth-century Russia. Wajda's beautiful reinterpretation of Dostoevsky's masterpiece.
cast: Lambert Wilson, Jerzy Radzwilowicz, Isabelle Huppert, Jutta Lampe, Philippine Leroy Beaulieu, Bernard Blier, Jean Philippe Ecoffey, Laurent Malet, Omar Sharif

title: Les poupées rousses
synopsis: Xavier has grown up, is thirty years old, has become a writer, but the problems are always the same: economic (it is not easy to survive with writing) and sentimental (he keeps going from one adventure to another). When he has to write the script for a normal love story and, at the same time, babysit his ex and nurse his grandfather, he goes into crisis ...
cast: Romain Duris, Kelly Reilly, Audrey Tautou, Cécile De France, Kevin Bishop, Evguenya Obraztsova

title: Les princes
synopsis: The gypsy Nara lives with his old mother and little daughter on the outskirts of a French city. He considers himself integrated into society because he makes a living doing humble jobs, unlike his mother. The woman in the family is the guardian of nomadic traditions while Zorka, the little girl, dreams of becoming an established veterinarian. Nara, who loves her daughter dearly, prevents her mother Miralda from seeing her. The latter was repudiated by the man, because, on the advice of a social worker, he dared to use contraceptives.
cast: Gérard Darmon, Muse Dalbray, Céline Militon, Concha Tavora

title: Les promesses
synopsis: Clémence (Isabelle Huppert), fearless mayor of a town near Paris, is completing the last period of her term. With his faithful right-hand man Yazid (Reda Kateb), he has long fought for this community plagued by inequality, unemployment and poverty. However, when Clémence is offered the post of Minister, her ambition takes over, while devotion and commitment to her citizens begin to falter. Will its political integrity and election promises outlive these new aspirations?
cast: Isabelle Huppert, Reda Kateb, Naidra Ayadi, Jean Paul Bordes, Soufiane Guerrab, Laurent Poitrenaux, Hervé Pierre, Walid Afkir, Stefan Crepon, Vincent Garanger, Anne Loiret, Youssouf Wague, Bruno Georis, Gauthier Battoue, Mama Prassinos, Christian Benedetti, Mustapha Abourachid, Rosita Dadoun Fernandez

title: Les pygmées de Carlo
synopsis: A famous Italian director, such Carlo Ercole, forces his confidence assistant to a perilous journey to the Central African Republic by ordering him to take him to Paris, where he lives and works, twenty pygmies, for a mass scene to turn around in the Saint Denis stadium. Marc, after some hesitations, obeys and together with Oliver leaves for the black continent in search of the bizarre extras.
cast: Stéphane Rideau, Beppe Chierici, Sonia Rolland, Yves Verhoeven

title: Les pétroleuses
synopsis: Maria, along with her four brothers, wants to buy a ranch but has to come up against the gunslingers of Louise's gang, who live in the area. The story is complicated by the presence of oil, but the well is unintentionally destroyed by the girls. The sheriff has the four brothers and the four gunslingers arrested: four marriages will take place in prison.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Brigitte Bardot, Michael J. Pollard

title: Les quarantièmes rugissants
synopsis: A talented electrical engineer, Julien Dantec has never been able to sell his inventions. When he discovers that a solo race around the world will soon be organized, he offers his anti-collision system to the race favorite: Janvier. Faced with the man's refusal, Julien decides to participate in the competition himself, despite his inexperience at sea.
cast: Jacques Perrin, Julie Christie, Michel Serrault, Gila Von Weitershausen, Heinz Weiss, Jean Leuvrais, François Perrot, Christian Ferry, Bernard Lincot, Eric Raphaël

title: Les regrets
synopsis: Following a sudden worsening of his mother's health, Mathieu Lievin - forty and introverted architect - returns to his hometown, where, on the street, he meets Maya, his old flame of the times of the high school he had not seen for 15 years now. The woman, who is in the company of a man and a child, avoids greeting him. However, shortly after, the phone rings in the family home: it is Maya, who invites him to visit her. Mathieu hesitates, then accepts.
cast: Yvan Attal, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Arly Jover, Philippe Katerine, Gurvan Cloatre

title: Les rendez-vous de Paris
synopsis: Three episodes of love, abandonment, jealousy and rip-offs in the somewhat dreamy Paris of artists, teachers and university students. In the first, the suspicion of an unlikely triangle leads to the discovery of a much more ambiguous, but ironic, "quadrangle". In the second, the hesitation of a young woman tired of her current partner, but worried not to hurt his feelings, vanish when ... In the third, a painter, in pursuit of a chimera, lets a much more concrete sentimental opportunity slip away.
cast: Clara Bellar, Antoine Basler, Aurore Rauscher, Michael Kraft

title: Les ripoux
synopsis: Commissioner René has been working in the same neighborhood for twenty years. And for twenty years he has been arranging himself, asking for bribes, organizing intrigues. Now his superiors have joined the young François, a bit of a careerist, a bit inexperienced, but above all an uncompromising moralist. It takes René a while to explain to him how life works, but in the end she manages to convince him that crime pays. The tone is halfway between comedy and yellow. Zidi is almost a master on this. Lhermitte is good enough. In the role of the somewhat corrupt but basically good commissioner, there is Philippe Noiret who is a real ace in this role.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Thierry Lhermitte, Regine, Grace De Capitani

title: Les risques du métier
cast: Jacques Brel, Emmanuelle Riva, René Dary, Nadine Alari, Christine Fabrega

title: Les rivières pourpres
synopsis: Haute-Savoie, area of ??Grenoble; the body of a man who died very very badly is found on the wall of a mountain. They mutilated and tortured him, keeping him alive for hours. Meanwhile, in a nearby village, the grave of a girl who died ten years earlier is desecrated. Commissioner Niémans investigates the first case, Kerkérian, the second. Soon the investigations become one, and focus on the nearby university perched in the mountains.
cast: Jean Reno, Vincent Cassel, Nadia Farès, Dominique Sanda

title: Les rivières pourpres 2. Les anges de l'Apocalypse
synopsis: Commissioner Niemans and his former pupil Reda, now a police captain, are investigating the "angels of the Apocalypse", a group of monks who sow terror in Lorraine. Here there is a mysterious monastery that also interests the very powerful Heinrich. For their investigations, Niemans and Reda turn to Marie, a specialist in the history of religions ...
cast: Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Christopher Lee, Camille Natta, Johnny Hallyday

title: Les roseaux sauvages
synopsis: Henri arrives at the boys' boarding school in a small town, a young "pied-noir" who has his tooth poisoned with his compatriots who have left Algeria, and who is frowned upon by his classmates. Among these, he has relations with Serge and François. Serge's brother dies in the colonial war, François lives his homosexual tendencies very badly. Then there is Maïté, daughter of a teacher and communist militant ... The beautiful film by Téchiné is part of a series produced by TV and by several directors ("Toutes les garçonnes et les filles de mon age"): a collective rethinking in which this episode has the merit of a very well told context and credible characters, without the traps of nostalgic mellowing.
cast: Elodie Bouchez, Gaël Morel, Stéphane Rideau, Frédéric Gorny, Michèle Moretti, Jacques Nolot, Eric Kreikenmayer, Nathalie Vignes, Michel Ruhl, Fatia Maite, Elodie Soulinhac, Claudine Taulère

title: Les routes du sud
synopsis: Juan (Montand) fled Spain and now lives in Paris, continuing to maintain contact with the Spanish resistance. His wife dies in an accident and he begins a relationship with a friend of his son. Just when the dictator Franco dies, Juan discovers that his wife was cheating on him and that his son despises him. He will decide to continue his political commitment. Shot entirely in France, it is one of Losey's less personal films that seems wearily to repeat the clichés of traditional political cinema. Montand is a prisoner of many similar roles already covered in his long career and Miou-Miou is also less interesting than usual.
cast: Yves Montand, Miou Miou, Laurent Malet

title: Les salauds
synopsis: Commander on board of cargo ships for the transport of containers, Marco Silvestri is urgently recalled to Paris. Sister Sandra is desperate: her husband has committed suicide, the family business is on the verge of bankruptcy and her daughter is in need of psychiatric treatment. According to Sandra, it is the powerful businessman Edouard Laport who is responsible for all this and is determined to identify a weakness and get revenge for what he did to his family. Marco moves to the building where Raphaëlle, Mrs. Laport, lives with her son. However, he did not foresee Sandra's shameful secret manipulations or Raphaëlle's charm, with whom he ends up falling in love.
cast: Vincent Lindon, Chiara Mastroianni, Julie Bataille, Michel Subor, Lola Creton, Alex Decas, Grégoire Colin, Florence Loiret Caille, Christophe Miossec, Hélène Fillières

title: Les sanguinaires
synopsis: A few days before the end of the 20th century, in December 1999, François organized a trip to a small island off the coast of Ajaccio with a group of friends to avoid the countdown and collective hysteria of Paris. However, the relationship between François and the young guardian of the island is not the best and the growing tension is joined by boredom and quarrels between friends, leading to greater violence than the Parisian chaos.
cast: Frédéric Pierrot, Catherine Baugué, Jalil Lespert, Marc Adjadj, Nathalie Bensard, Vincent Simonelli, François Lepage, Elisabeth Joinet, Gilles Marchand, Isabelle Coursin

title: Les saveurs du Palais
synopsis: Hortense Laborie, Perigord's top chef, is surprised when the President of the French Republic himself chooses her as his personal cook, appointing her in charge of preparing all his lunches at the Elysée. Despite the envy and jealousy of the other members of the kitchen staff, Hortense immediately succeeds in establishing itself in the kitchen thanks to its indomitable character and the simplicity of its dishes seduces the palate of the president more than expected, so much so that among the rooms of the power his presence begins to generate some suspicion too.
cast: Catherine Frot, Jean D'Ormesson, Hippolyte Girardot, Arthur Dupont, Brice Fournier, Déborah Révy, Arly Jover, Thomas Chabrol, Hugo Malpeyre, Nathalie Vignes

title: Les secrets professionnels du docteur Apfelglück
synopsis: Five unequal episodes, starring the doctor of the title (Lhermitte) and some bizarre patients. The funniest and most ferocious is the one about the vulgarity of certain television games.
cast: Thierry Lhermitte, Alessandro Haber, Jacques Villeret, Micha Bayard
director: Alessandro Capone, Stéphane Clavier, Mathias Ledoux, Thierry Lhermitte, Hervé Palud

title: Les seigneurs
synopsis: Patrick Orbéra, 50, is an old football glory who has completely lost his way. Unemployed, alcoholic and in ruins, he doesn't even have permission to see his daughter Laura. Forced by a judge to find a stable job, he has no choice but to leave for a small island in Brittany and lead the local football team. The fate of the local canning industry is also linked to the team's victories, placed in receivership and place of work for half of the islanders. Right from the start, Patrick realizes that he will have to transform a group of fishermen into professional footballers and to do so he decides to call his old teammates.
cast: José Garcia, Jean Pierre Marielle, Franck Dubosc, Gad Elmaleh, Joey Starr, Ramzy Bedia, Omar Sy, Jean Reno, Ludovic Berthillot, André Penvern

title: Les seins de glace
synopsis: François (Claude Brasseur), is a successful writer. One day he meets Peggy (Mireille Darc) and is immediately taken by her mysterious and somewhat ambiguous charm. Although Marc (Alain Delon), the woman's lawyer, warns him about disturbing suspicions regarding her past, François prefers not to care. By now the man is taken by a morbid passion, and in this way he gets entangled in a dramatic spider's web. Psychological mystery based on a short story by Richard Matheson, with an excellent Brasseur.
cast: Alain Delon, Mireille Darc, Claude Brasseur, Nicoletta Macchiavelli, Fiore Altoviti, Emilio Messina, André Falcon, Michel Peyrelon, Philippe Castelli

title: Les sentiments
synopsis: Jacques is a doctor taken to a small village in the French countryside, he lives in a villa with his wife Carole and two teenage children; one day the young doctor François, who will have to take his place, comes to live next to them with his wife Edith. The two couples make friends, especially women. But the patatrac happens: the older doctor seduces his colleague's wife. Carole discovers everything, by chance, and the uproar begins ...
cast: Jean Pierre Bacri, Nathalie Baye, Melvil Poupaud, Isabelle Carré, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi

title: Les sept pechés capitaux
synopsis: Episode movies: the seven deadly sins are the pretext to tell seven stories bordering on comedy. It's hard to imagine seven more different directors. The results are also very similar, and on the whole there is no memorable episode, even if the whole is curious and pleasant. Dhomme's episode "Wrath" was written by Ionesco. In Molinaro's "Invidia", for example, a waitress becomes the lover of the rich man who maintains a diva she envies. In Godard's "Laziness", which is the most original and mocking episode, an actor (Constantine) renounces the offers of an attractive actress out of laziness.
cast: Claude Brasseur, Jean Louis Trintignant, Marina Vlady
director: Jean Luc Godard, Claude Chabrol, Philippe De Broca, Jacques Demy, Sylvain Dhomme, Max Douy, Edouard Molinaro, Roger Vadim

title: Les septe pechés capitaux
synopsis: Film divided into six episodes on the theme of biblical sins. In Eduardo De Filippo's _Avarizia e ira_, a miser sees his money thrown out of the window by his wife. In _Pride_ by Claude Autant-Lara, fallen nobles participate in a party where they will be pointed out as poor people. In _Gola_ by Carlo Rim, a peasant girl is rejected by a man who prefers the pleasures of the table. In _Lussuria_ by Yves Allégret a young woman is envious of the beauty of her teenage daughter. In _Invidia_ by Roberto Rossellini, the wife of a painter is jealous of the attention that the man reserves for the cat. In _Laziness_ by Jean Dréville, the director of Paradise imposes laziness on human beings and the results are disastrous.
cast: Paolo Stoppa, Isa Miranda, Michèle Morgan, Françoise Rosay, Louis De Funès, Gérard Philipe

title: Les signes vitaux
synopsis: After the death of her grandmother, the young Simone leaves the university to devote herself full time to the care of the terminally ill. But his altruistic gesture has a dark side, linked to his secret and dramatic impairment. And Simone also risks losing a great love.
cast: Marie Hélène Bellavance, Francis Ducharme, Suzanne St Michel, Marie Brassard, Danielle Ouimet, Paul De Strooper, Dominico Caputo, Mireille Arvisais, Jasmine Dubé, Danielle Fichaud

title: Les soeurs Brontë
synopsis: In Victorian England live Emily, Charlotte and Anne Brontë, daughters of a widowed Anglican pastor. All three show a marked vocation for literature from an early age. Although little inclined to worldly life, they show themselves attentive to the literary novelties of the European continent, especially to Romanticism. Téchiné has not yet found his way as a director, but he directs a team of thrilling actresses.
cast: Isabelle Adjani, Marie France Pisier, Isabelle Huppert, Pascal Greggory, Patrick Magee, Hélène Surgere, Roland Bertin, Alice Sapritch, Xavier Depraz, Adrian Brine, Julian Curry, Renee Goddard, Jean Sorel

title: Les sorcières de Salem
synopsis: Salem (Massachussetts), 1692. The young Abigail (M. Demongeot) to take revenge on John Proctor (Y. Montand) who seduced her, accuses his wife (S. Signoret) of being possessed by the devil. Governor Danforth (R. Rouleau) uses the girl and the hysterical excesses of the other local girls to unleash a series of witchcraft trials to strengthen his power. The ending will be fatal.
cast: Simone Signoret, Yves Montand, Mylène Demongeot, Alfred Adam, Pierre Larquey, Jean Debucourt, Jean Gaven, Jeanne Fusier Gir, Françoise Lugagne, Coutan Lambert, Raymond Rouleau, Michel Piccoli, Pascal Petit

title: Les souvenirs
synopsis: 23-year-old Romain has his whole life ahead of him. Student who works in a hotel at night, fantasizes about a career as a writer and great love. Grandma Madeleine, on the other hand, has now reached a certain age but is full of vitality. After her husband's death, her son took her to a retirement home but, considering herself badly arranged, Madeleine runs away and disappears. Romain will follow him, retracing his memories.
cast: Annie Cordy, Mathieu Spinosi, Chantal Lauby, Michel Blanc, Flore Bonaventura, Audrey Lamy, Jacques Boudet, William Lebghil

title: Les sultans
synopsis: Lisa, a young Italian photographer who lives in Paris, waits in vain for the man who lives with her. A phone call informs her that he is having a good time in a nightclub with a very young woman. Distraught, Lisa attempts suicide, but is saved. The next day her man tells her that the girl was his daughter. And that same evening he still has a good reason to refuse the invitation to stay with Lisa ...
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Louis Jourdan, Corinne Marchand, Philippe Noiret

title: Les suspects
synopsis: Candice, an American who moved to the Côte d'Azur, is found lifeless on a road in the south of France. The investigations are entrusted to Commissioners Bonetti and Bretonnet. The main suspect is Matteo, a vagabond found near the body.
cast: Mimsy Farmer, Michael Lonsdale, Bruno Cremer, Jacques Fabbri

title: Les séducteurs
synopsis: Four stories based on sentimental misunderstandings and silly amorous quarrels, set in four different cities, which also give the title to the various episodes: London, Paris, Los Angeles and Rome. The main reason: the sexual itches of middle-aged men who are frustrated in their daily lives.
cast: Roger Moore, Lynn Redgrave, Denholm Elliott, Lino Ventura
director: Dino Risi, Edouard Molinaro, Bryan Forbes, Gene Wilder

title: Les temps qui changent
synopsis: Antoine manages to get himself sent to Tangier to supervise a construction site. Here he finally finds Cécile ... Thirty years ago they loved each other, they broke up and never saw each other again. She has a new life, but he has never been able to forget it. Antoine has only one fixed idea: to win her back.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Gérard Depardieu, Gilbert Melki

title: Les terres froides
synopsis: A Djamel, fired on the spot, all that remains is to leave Paris to move to Grenoble. Here he finds a job and a home. His introverted character leads him to withdraw more and more. Day after day Djamel begins to feel a strange attraction to the boss, to the point of spying on him all the way into the house.
cast: Yasmine Belmadi, Bernard Verley, Valérie Donzelli, Sébastien Charles

title: Les textiles
synopsis: Sophie and Olivier own a bakery in Paris: Olivier gets up at three to make bread, while his wife looks after the shop and their two children. One day Olivier decides to buy a timeshare villa on an island and gets in touch with Paul and Colette, a strange elderly couple who have put their share up for sale at a very low price. Sophie and Olivier do not investigate further, but when they arrive on the island they discover that the house is in the heart of a village of nudists who glare at them because they are "textiles".
cast: Barbara Schulz, Alexandre Brasseur, Jackie Berroyer, Sonia Vollereaux

title: Les tombeaux sans noms
synopsis: When a man, who at thirteen lost almost his entire family under the Khmer Rouge regime, goes in search of the graves of his family, no matter if on clay or purely spiritual ground, what does he find? And above all, what are you looking for? Spooky trees? Villages now unrecognizable? Witnesses so scared that they don't want to talk? The ethereal touch of a brother or sister's body as night falls?

title: Les tribulations d'un Chinois en Chine
synopsis: Belmondo, heir to a colossal heritage, is bored. He tries all ways to commit suicide, but in vain, and then hires a hitman to kill him. But when he meets a beautiful girl who works as a stripper in Hong Kong, he changes his mind and begins the search for the hit man who should kill him to cancel the order. However, the thing is more difficult than expected. Sequel of the "UOmo di Rio", not too lively despite the nice Belmondo.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Ursula Andress, Valerie Lagrange, Jess Hahn

title: Les tricheurs
synopsis: Bob, the young son of an industrialist, makes new friends, but lets himself be seduced by their cynicism and their amorality to the point of getting involved in organizing a blackmail. Marcel Carné tries to modernize his style, but the result is discontinuous. Soundtrack with songs by jazz masters. But in the same year Truffaut was already doing "The 400 hits" ...
cast: Pascale Petit, Jacques Charrier, Laurent Terzieff, Andréa Parisy

title: Les tripes au soleil
synopsis: Bob and Bessy are among the guests at a party. He is white, but she has African origins. Seeing them together, other white guests begin to lose their temper: they don't take it out on Bessy but catch Bob and beat him to death. Meanwhile, the blacks are organizing to try to wash the offense with blood. Bob's father and Bessy's father also end up at loggerheads, which various circumstances bring together in the middle of the desert, where however the two men become friends, return to the city and decide to leave with their families a world in which they do not recognize each other. more.
cast: Jacques Richard, Toto Bissainthe, Douta Seck, Gregoire Aslan

title: Les triplettes de Belleville
synopsis: The old Madame Souza is rather worried about her nephew's attitude: in fact the boy seems to show no interest in anything, except for his collection of photos of the Tour de France and of cycling champions. For this grandmother decides to give him a bicycle, in the hope that in the future he can win the prestigious race. But the "French mafia" involves the young man in a shady round of clandestine betting. With the help of three elderly ladies, called "Les Triplettes", Madame Souza sets out on the trail of her missing nephew ...

title: Les trois mousquetaires
synopsis: Arrived in Paris from Gascony, the young and sanguine D'Artagnan at first strikes a fight, then makes friends with Athos, Porthos and Aramis, the king's musketeers. The four will join forces to thwart the plans of Cardinal Richelieu and the perfidious Milady ...
cast: Gérard Barray, Georges Descrières, Bernard Woringer, Jacques Toja, Mylène Demongeot

title: Les témoins
synopsis: 1984: Manu arrives in Paris, and together with his sister Julie goes to live in a squalid hotel room. He becomes friends with Adrien, a wealthy 50-year-old doctor who, on a boat trip, introduces him to Sarah and Mehdi, a young couple who have recently had a baby. An unexpected love story begins: but the spread of AIDS and the sudden attention of the mass media towards the disease upset everyone's life ...
cast: Michel Blanc, Emmanuelle Béart, Sami Bouajila, Julie Depardieu, Johan Libéreau, Lorenzo Balducci

title: Les uns et les autres
synopsis: Between Moscow, Berlin, Paris and New York, the parallel events of four families (and three generations) of musicians and dancers, whose members intertwine their lives with the most important historical events of the twentieth century, from 1936 to 1980.
cast: Robert Hossein, Nicole Garcia, Geraldine Chaplin, James Caan

title: Les vacances du Petit Nicolas
synopsis: With the end of the school year, the time for a long-awaited vacation finally arrives for Nicolas. Together with his parents and grandmother he leaves for the sea, where he has the opportunity to make new friends in a short time. Among those Nicolas knows are Ben (who is not on vacation but lives there), Freddy (who eats whatever he gets), George (who talks funny because he's English), Paul (who whines constantly), the annoying Christopher (who always wants to be right about everything) and the sweet Elizabeth, a little girl who with her wide eyes never stops following him. Panicking over the adults' belief that he and Elizabeth are destined to be together for life, Nicolas will be able to count on friends, ready to help him but also to cause him a lot of trouble.
cast: Mathéo Boisselier, Valérie Lemercier, Kad Merad, Dominique Lavanant, François Xavier Demaison, Bouli Lanners, Luca Zingaretti, Judith Henry, Francis Perrin, Daniel Prévost, Bruno Lochet, Fabienne Galula

title: Les valseuses
synopsis: Jean-Claude (Gérard Depardieu) and Pierrot (Patrick Dewaere) are two young drifters who spend time in their suburban neighborhood amidst theft, muggings and other thug feats. One day, after harassing an elderly lady in a supermarket parking lot, they go for a run in a Citroën DS, "borrowed" from the owner of a hairdressing shop. The latter surprises them when they are parked the car in the place where they found it. He blocks them by threatening them with a gun. The discussion becomes heated and the two young men try to flee, taking Marie-Ange (Miou-Miou), shamrocker and hairdresser's lover with them. A shot goes off and Pierrot is wounded. Treated in a daring way, he manages to get away with it and, to verify that he has recovered, Jean-Claude advises him to mate with Marie-Ange. The latter accepts passively, without any problem, but not feeling any pleasure. The girl becomes intimately friends with the two, makes love with both of them, but always with total detachment. Jean-Claude and Pierrot are however attracted to him, they would like him to discover the "joys of love" and continue their raids in his company. In their cheerful and reckless journey, they will combine all the colors, they will make surprising encounters, they will learn to know each other through adventurous and often libertine experiences.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Patrick Dewaere, Miou Miou, Jeanne Moreau, Brigitte Fossey, Christian Alers, Michel Peyrelon, Gérard Boucaron, Jacques Chailleux, Eva Damien

title: Les vampires
synopsis: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
cast: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann

title: Les vierges de Rome
synopsis: Despite the valor of Orazio Coclite, Porsenna imposes his conditions on Rome, won thanks to the help of the barbarian Drusus. The requested hostages are chosen from among the women who fought alongside Clelia. While Drusus and Porsenna are inclined to forge an alliance with Rome, the Greek Strabos, their ally, is determined to destroy the city.
cast: Louis Jourdan, Sylvia Syms, Ettore Manni, Corrado Pani

title: Les visiteurs
synopsis: In 1122 the noble Goffredo di Montalcino left the war to marry, according to the will of King Louis VI of France, the beautiful Frenegonda. But he makes up a mess and, to make up for it, he drinks, together with his faithful squire Giancoglione, the potion prepared for him by a sorceress. Something is wrong and the two find themselves thrown forward by 871 years, which is to say today.
cast: Jean Reno, Christian Clavier, Valérie Lemercier, Marie Anne Chazel

title: Les visiteurs en Amérique
synopsis: Persecuted by a witch, Count Thibault and his squire-jester André think it well to turn to a magician: however, something goes wrong and the two are catapulted from the 13th century to the year of grace 2000, with all the consequences of the case ...
cast: Jean Reno, Christian Clavier, Christina Applegate, Malcolm McDowell

title: Les voraces
synopsis: A young croupier attacks and robs an industrialist of his big win. The woman of the industrialist, who witnessed the attack, fell in love with the croupier, becoming his lover with blackmail. Fierce portrait of a company interested only in success and money.
cast: Helmut Berger, Françoise Fabian, Paul Meurisse, Massimo Girotti

title: Les week-ends maléfiques du Comte Zaroff
synopsis: During the day Boris Zarloff is a modern businessman but at night his mind becomes a source of horrible visions and hallucinations, inherited from his father, the famous Count Zarloff. The situation worsens when in his isolated castle he receives a couple on vacation for a weekend and the woman asks him to visit his father's torture chamber. From that moment, the visions will turn into madness, causing Boris to succumb to the fate that haunts his family.
cast: Michel Lemoine, Nathalie Zeiger, Howard Vernon, Joëlle Coeur, Martine Azencot, Stéphane Lorry, Robert De Laroche, Sophie Grynholc, Patricia Mionnet, Manu Pluton

title: Les yeux cernés
cast: Robert Hossein, Marie France Pisier, Michèle Morgan, François Patrice

title: Les yeux sans visage
synopsis: Christine Genessier, following a car accident, for which her father, Dr. Genessier, his face was completely disfigured: only his eyes remained healthy. From that moment on, Dr. Genessier, who runs a clinic, is completely occupied with the idea of ??finding an effective remedy for the misfortune that befell his daughter. He then devotes himself to secret experiments aimed at ascertaining whether there is the possibility of transplanting the skin of a healthy person on the disfigured face of Christine. Dr. Genessier is assisted in his work by a woman who has the task of luring the girls who will have to serve in these cruel experiments. One of these girls dies and the doctor, to deflect suspicions, induces his assistant to throw the body into the river; when he is rescued, Genessier claims that it is his daughter, and orders that the remains be buried in the family tomb. Another of his victims kills himself; this too is secretly buried in the same tomb. However, the facial plastic operations do not achieve the effects that the doctor expected, and Christine, forced to stay closed at home, cannot resist the temptation to make her ex-boyfriend hear her voice over the phone. The latter, worried, turns to the police, but the investigations do not yield any results. Another girl is lured; but Christine, impressed by the victim's heartbreaking screams, intervenes, frees her and kills her father's assistant with a scalpel. Christine then frees the numerous dogs that Genessier needed for the experiments: freed, the dogs rush to the doctor and kill him.
cast: Pierre Brasseur, Alida Valli, Edith Scob, Juliette Mayniel, Beatrice Altariba, Claude Brasseur, François Guérin, Alexandre Rignault, Michel Etcheverry

title: Les Âmes mortes
synopsis: Through the description of the daily life of the now elderly survivors of the Jiabiangou Forced Labor Camp, we try to expose the truth about the political campaigns of the late 1950s that led so many people to suffer or die from the violence they suffered, violence that ended to target all of Chinese society as a whole.

title: Les Éblouis
synopsis: The twelve year old Camille has two brothers and a sister, all younger than her. Passionate about the circus, she lives in a family apparently happy despite her parents are facing an unhappy moment. One day, parents decide to go to live in a Catholic community and Camille's life will change dramatically.
cast: Camille Cottin, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Eric Caravaca, Céleste Brunnquell

title: Les égarés
synopsis: June 1940. The Germans are at the gates of Paris. Odile, a teacher, panics and runs away with her two children, Philippe and Cathy. The little family, who lost everything following the bombings, runs into Yvan, a strange teenager with a shaved head, dressed like a clown. The four find themselves in an abandoned house without electricity where, without any contact with the outside world and forced to invent something every day to get to the next day, they will experience their own personal war.
cast: Emmanuelle Béart, Gaspard Ulliel, Samuel Labarthe, Clémence Meyer

title: Les émotifs anonymes
synopsis: Jean-René (Benoît Poelvoorde) runs a chocolate factory, where the beautiful Angélique (Isabelle Carré) works, an expert in the preparation of delicious cocoa pralines. Both are so shy that they can hardly say a word, despite friends and colleagues trying to encourage them to overcome their insecurities. Furthermore, united by the common passion for the activity they carry out, the two love each other but will have to find the courage to mutually declare their feelings to each other and overcome the lack of trust in the world around them.
cast: Benoît Poelvoorde, Isabelle Carré, Lorella Cravotta, Lise Lamétrie, Swann Arlaud, Pierre Niney, Stéphan Wojtowicz, Jacques Boudet, Alice Pol, Céline Duhamel

title: Les équilibristes
synopsis: Disturbing film by an almost forgotten filmmaker where Piccoli plays Marcel Spadice in a claustrophobic but sensual siege game inspired by Jean Genet. Author of a few films, Papatakis is a crucial filmmaker honored in 2009 by the _I milleocchi_ festival.
cast: Lilah Dadi, Michel Piccoli, Polly Walker, Doris Kunstmann

title: Lesbian Vampire Killers
synopsis: Fletch and Jimmy, two slackers who go to great lengths to escape the duties and pains of their city life, decide to go on a vacation and end up in a remote Welsh village. There they discover that all the local women have been enslaved by Baron Wolfgang MacLaren and turned into lesbian vampires due to an ancient evil. Things get even more complicated with the arrival of a bus loaded with young foreign students and when the local Vicar is convinced that Jimmy is the descendant of a vampire slayer, who lived in the village years and years before ...
cast: James Corden, Mathew Horne, MyAnna Buring, Vera Filatova

title: Leslie Jones: Time Machine
synopsis: From trying to seduce Prince to battling sleep apnea, Leslie Jones traces her evolution as an adult in a joyfully raw and outrageous stand-up special.
cast: Leslie Jones

title: Leslie, My Name Is Evil
synopsis: Perry, a shy chemical engineer, is called to be part of the jury in the trial against the sect of Charles Manson. His life is upset by the encounter with hippie culture, where rock'n'roll, LSD and free love dominate, and above all by the charming Leslie, former cheerleader now a follower of Manson. The girl unleashes feelings in Perry unknown to him, forcing him to question his values.
cast: Gregory Smith, Kristen Hager, Ryan Robbins, Sarah Gadon, Don McKellar, Kristin Adams, Tom Barnett, Peter Keleghan, Kaniehtiio Horn, Peter MacNeill

title: Less Than Evil
synopsis: It is a crime drama about the psychological games between a detective with a strong sense of justice but tormented by the crimes he solves, and a genius woman who is insensitive to her own death. ~~ Remake of the British TV series "Luther" [2010].
tags: Gaslighting, Wrongfully Accused, Smart Female Lead, Calm Female Lead, Smart Male Lead, Trauma, Murder, Investigation, Suspense, Flashback To Past
cast: Shin Ha Kyun, Lee Seol, Park Ho San, Kim Gun Woo
director: Kim Dae Jin, Lee Dong Hyeon

title: Less Than Zero
synopsis: In Los Angeles, Clay and his girlfriend Blair go to great lengths to get their friend Julian out of the cocaine grip (even though Julian had momentarily snatched Blair from Clay). Julian must also beware of Rip, a dangerous drug dealer with a big credit to him. But all is in vain: during the journey that was supposed to be that of salvation, Julian succumbs. A novel by the minimalist Breat Easton Ellis, an Anglo-Polish director on his second film (after "Another Country"), a very glossy photography, not very expressive performers and a juicy musical column (Cult, Aerosmith, Bangles, David Lee Roth). So and so.
cast: Andrew McCarthy, Jami Gertz, Robert Downey Jr., James Spader

title: Lesson In Love
synopsis: New female teacher became a target of a trouble making gifted student's bullying. But their confrontations soon developed a romantic undertone and they began to have a secret affair that played fast and loose with their feelings. (Source: Kumaxell at MyDramaList)
tags: Student-Teacher Relationship, Older Woman/Younger Man, Forbidden Love, Mother-Son Relationship, Love Triangle, Taboo, Teacher Female Lead, High School, School Problems, Investigation

title: Make Mine Music
synopsis: The film consists of ten segments. The Testoni and the Cuticagna: a feud between two clans of mountaineers is interrupted when two young people fall in love. Swamp Blue: Animation originally intended for the film Fantasia, using the musical composition Clair de Lune by Claude Debussy. All the Cats Join In: one of the two segments to which Benny Goodman contributed, an innovative shot in which the pencil draws the actions as they are happening and in which the adolescents of the 40s are carried away by popular music. Without you: a ballad about lost love, sung by Andy Russell (replaced in the Italian edition by Natalino Otto). Casey at the Bat: Jerry Colonna recites Ernest Thayer's poem of the same name, about the arrogant baseball player whose cheekiness becomes his undoing. This segment was not present in the Italian film edition, since at the time baseball was an unknown sport in our country. It was later reintroduced in VHS and TV editions, but was not dubbed (although there was already a previous dubbing for a TV broadcast). Two Silhouettes: Two live-action dancers, David Lichine and Tatiana Riabouchinska, who move in silhouettes with animated backgrounds and characters. Dinah Shore sang the title song. Peter and the Wolf: based on Sergei Prokofiev's 1936 musical composition. A Russian boy named Pierino goes into the forest to hunt the wolf with his animal friends: the little bird Sasha, the duck Sonia and the cat Ivan. Each character is represented by a specific musical accompaniment: Pierino from the string quartet, Sasha from the flute, Sonia from the oboe, Ivan from the clarinet, the grandfather from the bassoon and the hunters from the timpani. The wolf is mainly represented by trumpets and cymbals. After You've Gone: Benny Goodman and his orchestra depicted as anthropomorphized instruments parading through a musical playground. Gianni di Feltro and Alice di Paglia: two hats fall in love in a shop window of a department store. When Alice is sold, Gianni does everything to find her. Eventually, by pure chance, they meet again and live happily ever after together, side by side. The whale who wanted to sing at the Opera: Gianni (Willy in the original) is a whale with an incredible musical talent and his dream is to sing at the Opera. Legend has it spread throughout the city that there is a whale singing the opera, but this is apparently disproved as the whale is presumed to have swallowed an opera singer, which is what sailors actually hear singing. The short-sighted impresario Tetti-Tatti believes in it and proposes to kill Gianni and the newspapers announce that he will go and check. The seagull friend of Gianni excitedly brings the newspaper to the whale, and all his friends believe that this is his big chance, so Gianni goes to meet the boat and sings for Tetti-Tatti. After hearing Gianni sing, Tetti-Tatti comes to believe that the whale has swallowed not one, but three singers, and chases him with a harpoon on a boat with three crewmen. The sailors try to stop Tetti-Tatti from killing Gianni, as they want to keep hearing him sing, to the point of tying Tetti-Tatti up and sitting on him. Nelson Eddy narrates and performs all the voices in this segment (in the Italian edition he is replaced by Alberto Sordi and Saturno Meletti). The segment is also known as The Ugoladoro Whale.

This has a lover, Marco, who fills Margherita with many concerns, arousing Lucia's jealousy. Margherita, while leading the sheep to pasture, meets the noble Arsenio and a pure love blossoms between the two young people.

title: Margini
synopsis: Edoardo, Iacopo and Michele are three young friends who live in Grosseto, in the beautiful and quiet Tuscan province, known for his landscapes, nature, his sea. But the town is close to them: tired of performing between festivals and villages, they will welcome how an unmissable opportunity to play in Bologna to open the Defense concert, a famous American hardcore band. Suddenly, however, the concert is canceled. The three friends, without giving up, will then launch themselves into an ambitious but not impossible undertaking: bring the Defendes to Grosseto. The band accepts, but the paradoxes of life in the province will make the feat decidedly more difficult than expected, even risking putting friendship between the three young people at risk.

title: Margot at the Wedding
synopsis: Margot is invited to her sister Pauline's wedding. The day before the ceremony, preparations are in full swing, but the air is tense at home. The atmosphere is not relaxed, the relations between the two women have never been particularly simple and continue between small provocations and sudden outbursts of anger. The crisis of Margot's marriage, the oddities of Pauline's betrothed, the hostility of the neighbors, the teenage rebellions of Claude also stir things up further.
cast: Nicole Kidman, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Jack Black, John Turturro, Zane Pais, Flora Cross, Ciarán Hinds, Seth Barrish, Matthew Arkin, Michael Cullen, Enid Graham, Susan Blackwell

country: Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Poland, Czech Republic, Iceland

She brought together Denmark, Norway and Sweden, in a single peace -oriented kingdom, which she governs alone through the young adopted son Erik. The union, however, is besieged by the enemies and for this reason Margrete designs a wedding between Erik and an English princess. An alliance with England could give the Union that prestige that is still missing. However, a conspiracy is underway that could destroy Margrete and everything he believes in.
cast: Trine Dyrholm, Søren Malling, Morten Hee Andersen, Jakob Oftebro, Bjørn Floberg, Magnus Krepper, Thomas W. Gabrielsson, Agnes Westerlund Rase, Simon J. Berger, Linus James Nilsson, Halldóra Geirharðsdóttir, Annika Hallin, Tinna Hrafnsdóttir, Richard Sammel, Paul Blackthorne, Per Kjerstad, Joen Højerslev, Diana Martinová

None of them know almost anything about the woman but they all pretend to be interested in hearing her sing. Marguerite in fact has a great passion for singing, she performs with all the passion she knows but is out of tune like a bell, which is why everyone runs to listen to her only to then laugh at her behind. When an irreverent journalist decides to write an exciting article about her latest performance, Marguerite finds the courage to dedicate herself body and soul to her dream and, despite her husband's opposition and with the help of a former diva, she decides to prepare for the his first public concert.

The man is struck by the beauty of Margherita the girl who is performing on stage. Léon who has supernatural powers makes a strange and terrible proposal to the old professor. George must sell his soul, abandoning it to damnation after death, in exchange for Margaret's love and eternal youth.

title: Marguerite et Julien
synopsis: Julien and Marguerite de Ravalet, son and daughter of Lord of Tourlaville, have been in love with each other dearly since childhood. As they grow up, their affection turns into voracious passion but, scandalized by their relationship, society begins to haunt them until, unable to resist their feelings, the two run away.

Their financial promoter has run away with their money and the three, father, mother and daughter, must abruptly change their plans and spend two weeks hidden in the cellar in order not to let envious friends and colleagues smell their status as new destitutes. In that financially desperate situation they also rediscover a new economy of affections.

title: Maria

synopsis: The story of Maria Goretti, holy and martyr of the Catholic Church, a devoted girl and of humble origins grown between the Pontine marshes that at 11 years old was wounded to death following an attempt to rape perpetrated by a neighbor and, during agony , he forgiven his killer.

Deeply saddened, the woman is forced to leave her husband the rich dowry she had brought as a gift for the wedding. The arrival of the Roman prefect Silvano offers her the opportunity to take revenge, she is seduced by Silvano and runs away with him. While in the city of Tiberias, Mary is strongly struck by the encounter with John the Baptist, who preaches the coming of a prophet greater than himself in the desert. Silvano, convinced that Giovanni is a rebel, asks for information about him ...

After getting married, she is enjoying her marital serenity in Tuscany when in 1740 the death of her father Charles VI pushes her to take his place and take the throne. State affairs soon got the better of private affairs and Maria Teresa began to neglect her husband. As if that weren't enough, many enemies plot behind her to take her out of the game.

During the imprisonment, Oyuki will make himself the protagonist of an episode of heroic altruism.

title: Maria per Roma
synopsis: The story of the day, from the early hours of the morning to the night, of Maria, a confused but at the same time dynamic woman, who pursues her career as an actress but gets lost in the fragmentation of the Roman daily. A newspaper that revolves around what seems to be the only source of sustenance of the Eternal City: tourism. We see Maria running from theater rehearsals to check-ins to tourists and from check-ins to auditions, in a frenzy that will lead to comical and exhausting situations.

synopsis: To live Mary is cleaning, but she is a dreamer who never separates from the notebook where, for 25 years, she secretly pinned her poems. She spends her days removing the thorns from the roses until she meets Franklyn who offers her to be a drug courier. It involves swallowing dozens of cocaine balls and transporting them to the United States. Attracted by the gain ($ 5,000 per trip), Maria accepts.

The bad Jack puts the Christmas fittings of Mariah and his family in fun ways. Will Jack be able to break Mariah's hopes for his dream puppy? Or will Christmas reveal how love can work in surprising and mysterious ways?

title: Marianna Ucrìa
synopsis: Sicily, first half of the eighteenth century. The life of the Ucrìa family from Palermo is a succession of weddings, dances, monacations and hangings. At one of these executions, the twelve-year-old Marianna is brought to her grandfather with the secret hope that the shock will cure her of her silence. Protected by her grandmother, wrapped in the love of a desperate and taciturn mother, the girl is forced to marry the old Duke Pietro, who is also her mother's brother, at the age of thirteen. Having become a woman, she learns the language of signs and the pleasure of literature from a French tutor. The reduction of the book by Dacia Maraini is beautiful, clean, very well furnished and dressed (the costumes of Danilo Donati are extraordinary), but inexorably flat, predictable and cowardly.
cast: Emmanuelle Laborit, Laura Morante, Roberto Herlitzka, Philippe Noiret

Their free love, however, underwent a profound evolution when Cohen became a successful musician.

title: Marie
synopsis: Having abandoned her husband, abusive and drunkard, Marie Ragghianti makes a career in the administration of justice. The war between her and the politician, at that point, goes on with no holds barred. Eventually Marie manages, despite the obstacles, to get to the trial. Roger Donaldson hasn't shown much of himself. The film is monotonous, supported only by its intent of civil denunciation and by the commitment of Sissy Spacek in the role of Marie. The title reminds us that the story told actually took place in Tennessee.

title: Marie Antoinette
synopsis: Portrait of the strong-willed wife of Louis XVI, from the last frivolous days of the Ancien Régime to the guillotine. Lavish Mgm production from the Thirties, resulting in a false but sumptuous and spectacular film.

And then there is the fourteen-year-old Marie, the queen of the Bay of Angels, who happily flirts with the sailors and that fate will put on the road to Bear.

synopsis: Already awarded a Nobel Prize and genius of physics and chemistry, the legendary Marie Curie has just lost her husband Pierre. Left alone to raise two young daughters, Marie finds herself struggling to establish herself in the male-dominated academic environment of France and to live her unconventional passion with the mathematician Paul Langevin, causing a scandal that jeopardizes her future awards.

Her father, a modest craftsman, is undecided whether or not to follow the advice of a doctor who suggests he intern her in an institution. Having gone to the institute of Larnay, near Poitiers, where the nuns take care of the deaf girls, the man decides to leave Marie in the care of the young Sister Marguerite, who is convinced that she can help the little girl with the weapon of her wedding ring.

title: Marie from the Bay of Angels
Marie-Antoinette, la véritable histoire
synopsis: Marie Antoinette is undoubtedly one of the most famous characters in the history of France. But who was it really? Benefiting from the advice of Chantal Thomas, a world-renowned specialist on the history of the queen and her period, the epic of Marie Antoinette is told far from clichés from her arrival in Versailles in 1770 until her execution 23 years later.

title: Marie-Jo et ses deux amours
synopsis: Marie-Jo nurtures two passions at the same time: one is her husband Daniel, the other is her lover Marco. However, she herself realizes the difficulty of the situation; naturally the story takes place in Marseille, against the backdrop of echoes and reminiscences ...

title: Marie-Octobre
synopsis: During a clandestine meeting in an elegant villa, an apical cell of French partisans is dismantled by the gestapo thanks to a tip. The leader of the resisters is shot down. Fifteen years later, the ex-members of the group find themselves gathered in the same place at the invitation of Marie-Octobre, the only woman among the ex-comrades, determined to unmask the traitor.

Diego (Stefano Accorsi) is his exact opposite, a man tried by events, with various psychosis and continuous attacks of anger. They find themselves in a day center for the rehab of disturbed people. The test that awaits them seems impossible: they have to manage a restaurant in the center avoiding any conflict with the rest of the group. Too bad they do not have any kind of aptitude for successful companies. But the two will soon begin to discover that the union can lead to incredible results. And who knows, maybe even to love.

title: Marina
synopsis: Italy, 1948. Rocco, ten years old, lives in a small and poor town in Calabria until with his mother (Donatella Finocchiaro) he reaches his father Salvatore (Luigi Lo Cascio), who left for Waterschei in search of fortune with the promise of returning. one day in Italy. Once in Belgium, Rocco suddenly finds himself living as a migrant with all the consequences that the new social status entails. The greyness of the mines, the harsh winters and the difficulties in adapting to a language and a culture not his own kill any enthusiasm of Rocco, who grows up with the dream of becoming someone. Going against his father's will, Rocco seeks an escape route in music and love.
cast: Matteo Simoni, Luigi Lo Cascio, Evelien Bosmans, Donatella Finocchiaro, Chris Van Den Durpel, Warre Borgmans, Cristian Campagna

title: Marina Abramović: The Artist Is Present
synopsis: Marina Abramovic is one of the most controversial artists who established herself at the turn of the twentieth century and the beginning of the 2000s, in a period of forty years in which critics have often wondered if her art was true or not. Countercurrent, seductive, scandalous and often a generator of visual shocks, Abramovic used her body as a vehicle for her production, pushing far beyond physical and mental boundaries. On the occasion of a retrospective of his at the MoMa, he plans to give a definitive answer to his detractors with the preparation of a new work, followed step by step by the cameras.

title: Marina Cicogna, la vita e tutto il resto
synopsis: Marina Cicogna was the first women's manufacturer to impose herself in the exclusively male world of Italian and European cinema in the late 1960s. The documentary tells an undisputed icon of style and creativity, Oscar -winning for investigation into a citizen above all suspicions, on an intimate journey between Rome, Milan and Venice, enriched by precious interviews with the closest friends.

title: Marinai in coperta

He makes friends with Lucio, the son of an industrialist, and with Ferruccio, who hopes to win the case concerning an inheritance. The three are engaged to as many girls: Ferruccio will console himself for the lack of wealth with love; Lucio will end up buying a bar; Antonio will be able to fulfill his dreams by signing an advantageous contract with a record company.

Not wanting to lose Leon, he will be forced to make a difficult decision.

title: Meteor Garden
synopsis: An ordinary girl is admitted to the most prestigious school in the country, where she encounters F4, an exclusive group comprised of the four wealthiest and most handsome boys in the school - Dao Ming Si, Hua Ze Lei, Xi Men, and Mei Zuo. Shan Cai is an 18-year-old girl from a family that's barely able to make ends meet. Due to a turn of events, she gets accepted into a school that only accepts upper-class elites. She immediately clashes with her classmates, especially Dao Ming Si, who is spoiled, arrogant, and a bully. She remains defiant even after becoming a target of a series of pranks intended to torment her, and just when she's about to give up, Hua Ze Lei always seems to show up to lend her a helping hand. Eventually, the four boys begin to acknowledge Shan Cai's unyielding personality, which is like her namesake, which is that of a weed that can never be brought down. She also begins to see the good in the boys, which paves the way for friendship and an eventual romance. ~~ Adapted from the manga “Hana Yori Dango” (花より男子) by Kamio Yoko (神尾葉子).

Dao Ming Si buys a "Meteor Ring" which Shan Cai had her eyes on, and prepares to propose to her in a church that had special meanings of "love". However, on the way to the church, Dao Ming Si gets into a car accident which had causes him to lose his memory. He met Ye Sha at that time, who helps him and looks after him. The sudden disappearance of Ah Si causes Shan Cai to worry, so she asks Jing to help her. The other three members of F4 also came to Spain immediately after they hear the news. What follows is a story full of ups and downs as Shan Cai tries to find Dao Ming Si and help him regain his memory. The reason why Xi Men is such a playboy is revealed, as well as Mei Zuo's own love story since he was in elementary school. ~~ Adapted from the manga “Hana Yori Dango” (花より男子) by Kamio Yoko (神尾葉子).

Louis Jolly, the French police officer in charge of the investigation, is joined by Sandrine Zermatten, a Swiss policewoman. The two will be engaged in a race against time to find the killer ...

The case requires the intervention of a Parisian specialist and everyone is surprised to find themselves facing Captain Léna Valrose, a descendant of the island. title: Meurtres à...: Meurtres à Aix-en-Provence
synopsis: On a corpse, found crucified in the crypt of the cathedral of Saint Sauveur d'Aix-en-Provence, the commander Anne Giudicelli discovers an old parchment written as a prophecy of Nostradamus. He then realizes that to solve the case he needs the help of Pauline, the half-sister with whom he has not spoken for more than ten years. While Anne made a career in the police force, Pauline became a brilliant historian specializing in coding Nostradamus triplets. Soon, however, three other related crimes are committed: is it a curse or is it just the staging of a psychopath?

Just promoted to Commissioner, she is the first woman to occupy the place, with great disappointment of Marc Lemaire, convinced that she was now her. The murder of the old farmer Robert Tixier, soon followed by that of the social worker Martha Rivera, will open an investigation complicated by the discovery of a mysterious writing on the scene of both crimes.

Marine Lamblin, an expert commander with a strong Tempra, investigates with the help of Captain Thomas Keller, an irritating seducer who arrived from the continent. Romantic rivalries, lies, secrets and embezzlement of real estate will thus upset the calm of the place, an island with a thousand facets and with a traumatic past.

Inspector Angélique Demange is assigned to the case, in which she is assisted by her ex-husband, Raphael Leprince. The recordings made by the cameras of the basilica allow a glimpse of the hooded killer running away and we see that around his neck he wears the cross of the order of the Knights Templar. The case brings to mind Angélique the disappearance of her best friend Hélène. Soon, tracing the truth about the murder will become a case of life or death: Angélique and Raphael will have to discover the culprit before the woman herself turns into the next victim.

From large companies to passionate customers, nothing is left to chance: the investigation into the mysterious death will lead the two to explore the universe as fascinating as secret of cognac and to throw new light on the family history of the same clémentine. The captain may not have revealed the whole truth to his colleague.

Alice Catel, local gendarme, and Pascal Loubet, officer of the Perpignan judicial police, join forces to solve the case. During the investigation, they realize that the matter is much more complex than they imagined.

However, Vincent Becker was in charge of the case, under whose command Marie must agree to work. They soon discover that the head was cut off with a 15th-century instrument and that it was branded as Bluebeard used to do with his victims. This makes the mystery even more dense ...

After rejecting the suicide hypothesis, she begins her investigation accompanied by the journalist Batti Vergniot ...

Next to retirement, the commander Sophie Lacaze is in charge of the investigation. With the help of Alexandre Delcroix, the one who is destined to replace her, Sophie tries to trace the killer when the daughter of the deceased, an eight -year -old girl, is kidnapped.

Captain Gwenaële Garrec, in charge of the investigation, is convinced that the case concerns a famous privateer. Sergeant Major Eric Vautier, her colleague, is skeptical of the possibility but Garrec is willing to prove she is right.

The 33 years of the Rocky Horror Picture Show and the two extraordinary years of Il Vento fa la giro are just some of the successes that have made the room a point of reference for professionals and fans of quality cinema.

When she dies in a car accident, the two girls, daughters of different fathers, are taken into custody by social services waiting to be sent each by their parent. synopsis: In front of the praetor Giovanni Pennisi a sample of various humanity passes every day, beset by flaws of all kinds. Sometimes real criminals also appear, but usually they are ordinary people trying to get by as best they can to survive.

title: Mi faccio la barca

In the first part of the journey his ex-wife accompanies him. For a series of misadventures, including a "passage" to some convicts who escaped from Asinara, the two discover that they still love each other despite the sinking of the sweaty yacht. In parallel we also witness the performance of some rich people on another yacht.
cast: Johnny Dorelli, Laura Antonelli, Christian De Sica, Daniela Poggi, Daniele Formica, Cariddi McKinnon Nardulli, Itaco Nardulli, Sal Borgese, Mario Donatone

title: Mi familia

The two are now old and tired, but the spirit of the children, grandchildren and genres still hovers in the rooms painted with the bright and ancient colors of their homeland. Everyone's memory unfolds and takes shape through the moving evocation of the son who became a writer. A soap opera in which stereotypes of melò and tears predominate. The director, fascinated by familiar scenarios and perhaps also with a desire to emulate "The house of the spirits", actually carries out his cinematic theme with a somewhat "bureaucrat of sentiment" style.
cast: Edward James Olmos, Esai Morales, Costance Marie

title: Mi fanno male i capelli

Their meeting is casual, but guided by destiny: in fact - although they do not get along at all - they decide to start collaborating, developing a series of increasingly complex deceptions ...
cast: Alessandro Besentini, Francesco Villa, Maddalena Maggi, Lucia Ocone, Roberto Citran, Ernesto Mahieux

title: Mi gran noche
synopsis: José is invited to take part in the recording of a New Year's Eve gala in August. Like him, hundreds of people for a week and a half will have to pretend to celebrate the New Year, laughing and having fun. Alfonso, the musical star, is capable of anything to make his performance memorable. Adanne, his antagonist, is instead haunted by fans. The presenters of the show, for their part, hate each other and compete to win the trust of the producers. None of them, however, knows how much Alfonso's life is in danger.

His obsessive research continues over the years and to be able to carry out his dream he needs only one figurine: that of his idol Gigi Riva.
cast: Angelo Orlando, Massimiliano Bruno

title: Mi manda Picone
synopsis: An Italsider worker sets himself on fire, in the hall of the municipal council of Naples, considering himself threatened with dismissal by the company. After being rescued by an ambulance, there is no trace of him and the searches for his wife Luciella Picone are in vain. Loy's tragicomic apologue, in a lively Naples of swindlers and specters.

synopsis: Giulio's escapades end up when his wife shows up with a fake husband in the villa of his main one. Adulterine comedian fairly trail.
cast: Walter Chiari, Yvonne Bastien, Akim Tamiroff, Fred Clark, Marisa De Leza

title: Mi pais imaginario
synopsis: Between 1975 and 1979 Patricio Guzmán created the three documentaries of the series of the Battle of Chile who testify and tell in a unique way the dictatorship of Pinochet, the popular revolution and the coup d'état that followed. Fifty years later, Guzmán returns to Chile to take into account the political and social upheavals of his country.

title: Mi permette babbo!
synopsis: Rodolfo, who married into a family of hard-working traders, has artistic aspirations and devotes all his time to singing lessons. With his back to the wall, thanks to his teacher, fearful of seeing his salary drop, he finds an expedient to credit his talent in front of the family. The director is on the safe side in identifying the types and situations, somewhat tested (not to say taken for granted), and in choosing the farcical tone. Sordi and Fabrizi are not at their best but act with ease, giving us some moments of genuine comedy.

title: Mi piace lavorare - Mobbing

Everyone is hostile to her and the harassment begins, small but inexorable: the personnel manager entrusts her with new tasks, all of little importance or aimed at putting her in a bad light in the eyes of colleagues, while her place is occupied by another person. ..
cast: Nicoletta Braschi, Camille Dugay Comencini, Stefano Colace, Marian Serban

title: Mi ricordo Anna Frank
synopsis: Anne Frank and Hannah Gossler have known each other since childhood and are best friends with each other. They share dreams, hopes and the first heartbeats of adolescence, but the invasion of the Nazis and racial persecution separate them: Anna hides with her family in a shelter, Hannah instead is locked up in a concentration camp. However, the two friends will continue to look for each other, hoping to be able to make their dreams come true despite the barbarism of war. The friendship between Anna and Hannah is intertwined with the stories of their families and that of a brave rabbi who wants to help them.
cast: Emilio Solfrizzi, Rosabell Laurenti Sellers, Moni Ovadia, Szurdi Panna, Jaszberenyl Gabor, Meses Gasper, Kapriellan Alexa

title: Mi ricordo, sì io mi ricordo...

cast: Marcello Mastroianni

title: Mi rifaccio il trullo
synopsis: Michele Modugno, an Apulian bricklayer with a hobby of music, lives in a large trullo with his old mother, his sister Melania and his brother-in-law Sebastiano, also a bricklayer and his partner. To settle a debt contracted with the bank, Michele rents a small trullo on the sea of ??his property in the summer. The day before hosting the tourist Giada, however, he receives a nasty surprise: someone has plundered the trullo of the stones that form its cone. Michele looks for another accommodation for the tourist, but in the end, he is forced to host her in his house. Living together with Giada, a beautiful Milanese manager, wreaks havoc in the life of the poor bricklayer. The two, for different characters and ways of life, at first clash and quarrel about everything. But then, slowly, they discover that they are attracted to each other and a beautiful and unlikely love story begins between them.

title: My Fair Lady
synopsis: Min Kyung just graduated high school and finished paying off her father's gambling debt at a liquor restaurant. However, with some borrowed money, she runs away, promising herself that she will find a rich man and live happily ever after. Three years later, she is a stewardess at Asiana Airlines. She constantly looks at the materialistic objects any man has, judging everybody by what they are capable of buying. She meets two-three guys at a time while also attending blind dates with her co-workers. On one blind date, she falls in love with Young Ho, thinking that he is one of the few people in the Yacht Club (a meeting of the few richest people in Korea). Young Ho is the son of a poor rice cake house, and works to pay off his dead father's debt. He falls in love with Min Kyung, because she looks exactly like his dead girlfriend. When Min Kyung finds out that Young Ho is not rich, she dumps him, and goes back to a rich man who proposed to Min Kyung once before. However, Min Kyung wakes up to true love and realizes that happiness does not necessarily come in money. (Source: Soompi)

However, their relationship is put to the ultimate test when Meng Hui learns that Shen Yi was the one responsible for the accident that changed her life, all those years ago. title: Nel nome di Antea
synopsis: When a country goes to war, what does its artistic heritage go towards? Is it worth risking one's life to save a work of art from destruction? Two famous portraits of Italian painting tell how, together with thousands of other masterpieces, they emerged unscathed from the Second World War. The rescue was carried out by a handful of young Italian officials of the Fine Arts, whose courage and dedication remained in the shadows until a few years ago. At the beginning they protected the works from bombing by hiding them in safe places, far from the cities where war sowed death and devastated churches, historic buildings and monuments; then, after the armistice, with very few means and at the risk of their own lives, they tried to protect them from advancing the front line and from possible raids. Many were the humble heroes of this escape to safety, which took place relentlessly behind the scenes of the conflict. Here it is told of Pasquale Rotondi, who saved thousands of works from Northern Italy in two refuges in the Marches; of ministerial officials such as Lavagnino, Argan, Lazzari, who, when no place in Italy was safer, despite being deprived of any post by the new government of the Republic of Salò, managed to admit a part of them to the Vatican; of the odyssey of Neapolitan works of art, taken away from Montecassino where they were hidden shortly before the abbey was razed to the ground; the masterpieces of Florentine museums, stolen by the Nazis and recovered before they crossed the border; of two young scholars, Palma Bucarelli and Fernanda Wittgens, who, combining competence and contempt of danger, saved the masterpieces entrusted to them; finally, attempts to restore what seemed hopelessly lost. Even if not everything has been saved, it is thanks to them that we can still admire and show the world the Caravaggio, the Giorgione, the Raphaeles. General Clark said that waging war in Italy was like fighting in "a cursed museum". That museum has survived, and if on the one hand it continues to tell the story of our identity, on the other hand it transmits the universal value of beauty unchanged to anyone who comes to visit it in Italian museums and squares.
