synopsis: A man in shock and with numerous injuries is hospitalized in a hospital in Los Angeles, who dies after biting Dr. Eileen Flax who had approached to steal his words. It turns out that the man was Charles Pommier, an anthropologist who studied African and Eskimo myths. Eileen relives the last days of Charls's life discovering that he was following a gang of young punks, the incarnation of the spirits he studied. Film with a baroque and complex construction made in flashbacks, centered on the struggle between good (science) and evil (spirits). Disturbing and technically very remarkable.
cast: Pierce Brosnan, Lesley Anne Down, Anna Maria Monticelli, Mary Woronov, Adam Ant, Nina Foch

title: Nome di donna
synopsis: In the early summer, Nina Martini, a single mother, gets a temporary job in the Barrata retirement home and goes to live there with her daughter Caterina. In this way she has the opportunity to enter into a relationship with about thirty other women who work there, some Italian and others - the majority - foreign. But he soon discovers that Marco Torri, the manager of the structure, has set up a system based on small sexual favors, well protected by the ecclesiastical spheres. While investigating the incidents to shed light on the squalor, Nina is isolated by her colleagues who fear losing her job and sued for defamation.
cast: Cristiana Capotondi, Valerio Binasco, Stefano Scandaletti, Michela Cescon, Bebo Storti, Laura Marinoni, Anita Kravos, Adriana Asti, Vanessa Scalera, Linda Caridi

title: Nomi e cognomi
synopsis: Domenico Riva (Enrico Lo Verso) is an esteemed journalist who returns from Milan with his family to his homeland, a small town in Southern Italy. Thanks to the passion and seriousness expressed in his work, he activates a progressive awakening of the civil conscience of the country, becoming a serious problem for organized crime. Determined to carry out his choices but also deeply attached to his wife and daughters, Domenico surrounds himself with a group of young people who enthusiastically help him in his increasingly uncomfortable and risky investigations. In a succession of successes and failures, victories and defeats, even family ones, Riva becomes the protagonist of difficult choices, supported by the collaboration and sharing in the values ??and objectives of a childhood friend and a valid Police Commissioner.
cast: Enrico Lo Verso, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Ninni Bruschetta, Dino Abbrescia, Marco Rossetti, Antonio Stornaiolo, Totò Onnis, Mingo De Pasquale, Barbara Tabita, Aurelio D'Amore, Giorgia Masseroni, Paolo Strippoli

title: Nomis
synopsis: A second lieutenant, his police force and a vigilante are all involved in a dangerous plot involving a troubled man, recently arrested and linked to years of kidnapping and murdering women.
cast: Henry Cavill, Ben Kingsley, Alexandra Daddario, Minka Kelly, Nathan Fillion, Stanley Tucci, Brendan Fletcher, Emma Tremblay

title: Non aprite quella porta 3
synopsis: Norfolk, Virginia. A masked and clawed-gloved killer inside a dance school brutally kills a dancer and the dance teacher. Melanie Beck (Tara Buckman), in crisis with her husband Axel (Peter Hooten), enters the killer's sights. He enters the woman's apartment and abuses her for hours, until Melanie completely loses her memory. Afflicted by depression, she attempts suicide by ingesting barbiturates but is saved by a man, who shows a controversial attitude towards her. Perhaps it is the killer who continues to torment her excited by the fact that the woman has no memories of the molester's face?
cast: Peter Hooten, Tara Buckman, Richard Foster, Mel Davis, Lee Lively, Tova Sardot, Gaby Ford

title: Non aspettare Django, spara
synopsis: Django chases the bandits who killed his father, robbing him of a hundred thousand dollars. He kills them, but has yet to deal with the cruel principal. Fortunately, between one shooting and the next, he made a precious friend. A film that belongs to a vast catalog of miseries, in the vein of the Italian western.
cast: Sean Todd, Pedro Sanchez, Rada Rassimov

title: Non aver paura
synopsis: Mom and Dad are separated and their baby is in pain. On the verge of schizophrenia: he sees his double, speaks to us and gets advice. He is good, patient, he suffers in silence, he unleashes his anger in football and on the playstation: the other is aggressive and pissed off and would like his "twin" to behave "like a man". The father has never digested the betrayal of his wife, who to get to 27 works in a hot line without everyone's knowledge. Arguments and skirmishes give way when a pedophile maniac threatens the woman and the boy.
cast: Laura Morante, Alessio Boni, Eleonora Ivone, Valerio Milillo, Marco Ragno

title: Non avere paura - Un'amicizia con papa Wojtyla
synopsis: In 1981 the family of the ski instructor and skilled mountaineer Lino Zani, who managed an alpine refuge in the Adamello, receives an unexpected visit from Pope John Paul II, who arrives in the company of his friend and President of the Republic Sandro Pertini. Although it should remain secret and private, the visit soon becomes an opportunity for the two great men and the locals to meet and the young Lino is chosen to accompany the Pope on the descents he loves so much, marking the birth of a friendship that will accompany the two men for the rest of their lives.
cast: Giorgio Pasotti, Aleksei Guskov, Claudia Pandolfi, Ugo Dighero, Giuseppe Cederna, Michela Samantha Capitoni, Fabio Fulco, Luigi Di Fiore, Federigo Ceci, Federica Martinelli, Matteo Azchivarni, Katia Ricciarelli, Laura Adriani, Liam Calvo

title: Non avere paura della zia Marta
synopsis: The Clayton family - made up of Fabio, his wife Nora and their children Giorgia and Maurizio - are about to spend the weekend in Aunt Marta's old farmhouse. The visit promises to be quite agitated, since the woman has just left the psychiatric hospital ...
cast: Adriana Russo, Gabriele Tinti, Maurice Poli, Jessica Moore

title: Non c'è 2 senza te
synopsis: The “gay” life of Moreno and Alfonso is turned upside down by the arrival of Niccolò, the 11-year-old nephew. The already difficult threesome coexistence is complicated by the fact that the two pretend to be straight and that moreover Moreno falls in love with the beautiful Laura, leaving Alfonso alone and dejected. But thanks to the child, a nosy neighbor, a confused psychologist and colorful drag queens, Alfonso will be able to win back his great love.
cast: Fabio Troiano, Belén Rodríguez, Dino Abbrescia, Tosca D'Aquino, Samuel Troiano, Cristina Serafini

title: Non c'è campo
synopsis: Perpetually attached to their mobile phones and social media which they can no longer do without, some Roman high school students find themselves on a trip to a small and remote center of Puglia. Accompanied by a teacher in a marriage crisis, they will be forced to live a whole week without connection, rediscovering the beauty of nature and face-to-face contacts.
cast: Vanessa Incontrada, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Corrado Fortuna, Claudia Potenza, Neva Leoni, Beatrice Arnera, Mirko Trovato, Eleonora Gaggero, Caterina Biasiol, Leonardo Pazzagli, Federico Cesari, Valeria Fabrizi, Serena Iansiti, Michele De Virgilio

title: Non c'è due senza quattro
synopsis: A former convict on probation, who plays the sax in a jazz band, and a windsurfing stuntman, are both hired to replace two Brazilian cousins ??who have been repeatedly threatened. Punches, blows, exaggerated feats and tumbles as much as I can.
cast: Bud Spencer, Terence Hill, April Clough, Harold Bergman

title: Non c'è pace tra gli ulivi
synopsis: Francesco, a pastor who has just returned from the front, is looking in vain for work. To take revenge for a theft suffered by the local squire, Antonio, enriched during the war with unclean speculations, steals some sheep from him. Arrested and sentenced to four years he manages to escape. Antonio then fled, taking with him Francesco's sister, Maria Grazia, who he forced to become his mistress. But Francesco and the police chase them ....
cast: Raf Vallone, Lucia Bosé, Folco Lulli, Maria Grazia Francia

title: Non c'è più niente da fare
synopsis: A theatrical company called "I Perseveranti" and made up of people who perform the most diverse jobs finds itself in a theater which is about to close. But they don't want to give up, and they are determined to fight not to lose the only place where they can be truly happy: thanks to a legal quibble, they could keep their headquarters as long as they actually stage the show they are experiencing. ..
cast: Rocco Papaleo, Alba Rohrwacher, Raffaele Pisu, Valeria Valeri, Paolo Ruffini, Cristina Cirilli, Isabella Cecchi, Stefano Filippi, Fabrizio Brandi

title: Non c'è più religione
synopsis: In the living nativity scene of the small island of Porto Buio, the baby has developed. He has the beard and pimples of teenagers and he just doesn't fit in the crib. You have to find another one at all costs.
cast: Claudio Bisio, Alessandro Gassmann, Angela Finocchiaro, Nabiha Akkari, Giovanni Cacioppo, Laura Adriani, Mehdi Meskar, Paola Casella, Massimo De Lorenzo, Giovanni Esposito, Roberto Herlitzka

title: Non c'è tempo per gli eroi
synopsis: Vieri Del Cielo is a Florentine economics student who leads a double life as a cocaine pusher. One day he gets in trouble. But his disreputable acquaintances come to his rescue.
cast: Paolo Bernardini, Luca Campostrini, Linda Collini, Amerigo Fontani, Desirèe Noferini

title: Non chiamarmi Omar
synopsis: Based on the tale Nudi e crudi by Carlo Tullio Altan, the film, set in a foggy metropolis, tells the intertwining of various "human cases" around a radio show and the possession of a mysterious briefcase. Chases, murders, surgeries, feminism regurgitation, are the ingredients of the film. Sergio Staino, the father of "Bobo", brought together a cast of "All Star" (so to speak) of Italian cinema for this film. The result is what it is, stretched gags, stale jokes, all seasoned with a feminist intent, where Thelma and Louise should be successful: boredom wins instead.
cast: Ornella Muti, Stefania Sandrelli, Gastone Moschin, Gianni Cavina, Barbara D'Urso, Elena Sofia Ricci

title: Non chiamatemi papà
synopsis: Vera, tired of the extravagances of her husband Rocco, a guitarist and pub entertainer, throws him out of the house. After knocking in vain on the doors of friends in search of accommodation, Rocco finally arrives at the home of Ugo, his old schoolmate at the conservatory and now a serious orchestra professor. The characters of the two friends, absolutely antithetical, give life to a series of tragicomic misadventures in which also Mara, a mysterious girl whom Rocco meets at the pub and falls in love with ...
cast: Jerry Calà, Umberto Smaila, Nini Salerno, Marina Suma, Naima Perry, Gilda Postiglione

title: Non ci resta che il crimine
synopsis: Rome, 2018. Three long-time friends, with little means but an indomitable creative talent, decide to organize a "Criminal Tour" of Rome to discover the places that were the scene of the exploits of the Banda della Magliana. The idea, they are convinced, will be a mine of money. Vintage dresses, flared jeans, leather jackets, ankle boots and mirrored Ray-Bans, and that's it ... they're ready to embark on a new venture. Except that, by an unpredictable twist of fate, they are catapulted into the eighties in the days of the glorious World Cup in Spain and find themselves face to face with some members of the gang that at the time managed the clandestine bets on football. Not to mention the encounter with a volcanic and disruptive dancer who risks messing up the cards even more. For the three friends it could turn out to be a great opportunity for redemption or….
cast: Marco Giallini, Alessandro Gassmann, Edoardo Leo, Ilenia Pastorelli, Massimiliano Bruno, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Federico Galante, Lorenzo Lucchi, Emanuel Bevilacqua, Daniele Trombetti

title: Non ci resta che piangere
synopsis: The master Saverio and the janitor Mario, surprised by a storm in the countryside, find refuge in an old inn. When they wake up the following day, they discover that they are finished in 1492. After a first bewilderment, they try to adapt to the situation, with predictable results. Then, Saverio gets the great idea of ??going to Spain to stop Christopher Columbus before he discovers America. Benigni and Troisi in a film directed and interpreted by four hands. A pairing that could have been memorable. Too bad it doesn't work properly. However, the film was a huge success and some gags remained famous.
cast: Roberto Benigni, Massimo Troisi, Amanda Sandrelli, Paolo Bonacelli, Iris Peynado, Carlo Monni, Livia Venturini, Elisabetta Pozzi, Nicola Morelli, Peter Boom

title: Non ci resta che ridere
synopsis: A group of friends tells each other some jokes that suddenly turn into as many scenes of life against the backdrop of a surreal and hilarious world.
cast: Alessandro Paci, Massimo Ceccherini, Benedetta Rossi, Alessio Nonfanti, Max Galligani, Gaetano Gennai, Ilaria Filipponi

title: Non commettere atti impuri
synopsis: In Assisi live in two apartments, one next to the other, two families. One is made up of Damiano, elderly, atheist and contester, by his son Pino and Nadine, a lover of the latter. The other is bought from three honest and pious women, the seventeen year old Maria Teresa, the mother and grandmother of Costei. Pino, in love with Maria Teresa, in order to approach it, it offers to give it repetitions of Latin. The young man's mother and grandmother willingly accept the presence of Pino. In fact, the two women hope to convert it. And the thing punctually happens. The arrival of an uncle of Maria, however, risks compromising their relationship.
cast: Luciano Salce, Barbara Bouchet, Dado Crostarosa, Simonetta Stefanelli

title: Non contate su di noi
synopsis: A young Roman musician helps a girl in the grip of an abstinence crisis of heroin encountered on the street: thus was born between the two a love story that, instead of prove to be saved, on the contrary ends up involving man in the dramatic experience of the Toxicoded, shared with the woman and with the group of young people who revolve around the couple.
cast: Francesca Ferrari, Maurizio Rota, Sergio Nuti, Francesco Scalco, Antonio Spoletini, Massimo Scrivo, Manfredi Marzano

title: Non coupable
synopsis: Dr. Michel Ancelin has a serious problem with alcohol. The more people look with contempt at his miserable failure, the more he seems unwilling to react by entrusting the solution to all his problems to the bottle. His situation becomes complicated, however, on the evening when, returning home drunk, he accidentally kills a man. Going unpunished, the accident will trigger revenge projects in the doctor.
cast: Michel Simon, Jean Debucourt, Georges Bréhat, François Joux, Charles Vissières, Pierre Juvenet, Robert Dalban, Henri Charrett, Ariane Murator, Christiane Delacroix

title: Non escludo il ritorno
synopsis: The story of the "third life" of the singer-songwriter Franco Califano: from his decline to his rebirth until his death. Life experiences, tragic moments and suffering always overcome with lightness and stubbornness by the singer-songwriter, who received the push from young people to return to writing and re-emerge from the abyss in which he had confined himself.
cast: Gianfranco Butinar, Enzo Salvi, Michael Madsen, Nadia Rinaldi, Franco Oppini, Stefano Calvagna, Danilo Brugia, Andrea De Rosa

title: Non essere cattivo
synopsis: Those who were once the "boys of life", in the 90s seem to belong, even if in the most desperate suburbs, to a world that revolves around hedonism. A world where money, powerful cars, night clubs, synthetic drugs and cocaine "run easy", in which Vittorio and Cesare, in their early twenties, act in search of their success. The initiation into existence has a very high cost for them and Vittorio, in order to save himself, distances himself from Cesare, who instead falls inexorably. The bond that unites them is so strong that Vittorio will never really abandon his friend, always hoping to be able to look to the future with new eyes.
cast: Luca Marinelli, Alessandro Borghi, Silvia D'Amico, Roberta Mattei, Alessandro Bernardini, Valentino Campitelli, Danilo Cappanelli, Manuel Rulli

title: Non faccio la guerra, faccio l'amore
synopsis: Twenty years after the end of the war, a German submarine has not yet surrendered, preferring to roam the ocean. On board, with a half-doted officer and a haggard crew, travels the beautiful Ombrina, saved from a shipwreck when she was just twelve months old and adopted by the crew. One day, Ombrina meets Nicola, the doctor on board of the yacht of an American billionaire, and love is born between the two.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Philippe Leroy, José Calvo, O.W. Fischer, Frank Wolff, Paul Muller, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Jacques Herlin, Juanjo Menendez, Ugo Adinolfi

title: Non ho niente da perdere
synopsis: Camilla (Carolina Crescentini) is a beautiful woman, hard worker, with a big problem: she is hypochondriac. Which makes it unbearable for most people, even to sister Marta. When the new MRI machine arrives at the hospital, he undergoes it enthusiastically and goes to the villa to cheat the waiting for the results. Here the wedding of Filippo, son of the vulgar entrepreneur Marzaduri (Dario Cassini) is taking place. The wedding planner, Mr. Curry (Sergio Assisi), a good-natured man, soon reveals himself to be the leader of a gang of eco-terrorists who storm the villa. Meanwhile, Camilla receives a text message from the hospital: is she dying, does she have a few months left to live? Camilla, in shock, is involved in a liberation plan by Ettore (Edoardo Pesce), Marzaduri's bodyguard who has been removed by the Carabinieri for an accident. Despite having opposing characters, Camilla and Ettore manage to integrate well: their respective stubbornness unites them and also attracts them sentimentally. Camilla faces dangers and bullets because she has nothing to lose and for the first time in many years, she feels that something is being born inside her. Will he manage not to ruin everything?
cast: Carolina Crescentini, Edoardo Pesce, Sergio Assisi, Ilaria Genatiempo, Dario Cassini, Marco Cassini, Ninni Bruschetta, Michele Venitucci, Margherita Vicario

title: Non ho sonno
synopsis: Commissioner Ulisse Moretti has retired after years of capturing ruthless killers and solving complicated cases. In the 1980s Moretti had solved, or at least all public opinion was convinced, the case of the crimes of the dwarf. But the murders have begun again in the same precise manner as in the past. Investigators charged with investigating the new crimes are groping in the dark despite the most up-to-date investigation techniques. Moretti is still needed to solve the case ...
cast: Max Von Sydow, Stefano Dionisi, Chiara Caselli, Rossella Falk

title: Non ho tempo
synopsis: The short life of Évariste Galois, a boy prodigy, a French mathematician among the founders of abstract algebra, a fervent left-wing republican, who died under mysterious circumstances at the age of twenty-one in 1832.
cast: Mario Garriba, Bruno Alessandro, Mario Bardella, Lucio Lombardo Radice

title: Non lo so ancora
synopsis: One morning in September, in the parking lot of a small Ligurian hospital, Giulia (Donatella Finocchiaro) accidentally meets the eighty-year-old Ettore (Giulio Brogi) and from the first exchange between the two a strong empathy is created that drives them to spend the rest of the day together. While they are both awaiting the outcome of a clinical examination that will arrive only the morning of the following day, the two learn to know each other in a path that, between a chat and a walk, will change the rest of their lives forever.
cast: Donatella Finocchiaro, Giulio Brogi, Orietta Notari, Alessandra Frabetti, Pierluigi Pasino

title: Non ma fille, tu n'iras pas danser
synopsis: Léa (Chiara Mastroianni) is abandoned by her husband Nigel (Jean-Marc Barr) and finds herself having to raise two children alone. The difficulties and tragedies add up one after the other and the woman returns to her Brittany, where she discovers that her parents and sister are trying to bring her closer to Nigel. She is upset, but will understand that the family members only want her good.
cast: Chiara Mastroianni, Marina Foïs, Marie Christine Barrault, Jean Marc Barr, Fred Ulysse, Louis Garrel, Marcial Di Fonzo Bo, Alice Butaud, Julien Honoré, Caroline Sihol

title: Non me lo dire
synopsis: Lello (Uccio De Santis), well -known Apulian comic actor, is left by his wife, tired of his arrogance and his forced distance, due to the thousand commitments related to a lucky theatrical tour. Finding himself suddenly alone, Lello no longer knows what to do when, in the grip of depression, he leaves the last show and turns to a psychiatrist who invites him to find the charge through the affection of the fans. Thus was born his decision to undertake a journey in search of those admirers who, thanks to his actor performances, find their smile, forgetting the crossings of everyday life.
cast: Uccio De Santis, Nando Paone, Mia Benedetta, Aylin Prandi, Gianni Ciardo, Antonella Genga, Michele De Virgilio, Umberto Sardella, Brando Rossi, Pino Fusco

title: Non me lo dire!
synopsis: Michele Colombelli was once the viscount of Castel Perrone, but now that he is decayed and penniless and is forced, to live, to guide the castle he once owned, he calls himself Jimmy. But his misadventures are not over. Not exceptional comedy, like all those played by Macario. The one who appears in the opening credits as Vanda Osiri is the famous Wanda Osiris.
cast: Erminio Macario, Wanda Osiris, Tino Scotti

title: Non mi basta mai
synopsis: Ebe (now physiotherapist), Gianni (fisherman in Sardinia in the "Red Lobster" cooperative), Vincenzo (now working wood), Pasquale (educator in a juvenile prison) and Pietro (creator of foam rubber puppets) apparently have nothing in common, except the fact of living or having lived in Turin. At the end of the sixties the five were the protagonists of the historic dispute, which began in 1969 and ended in the eighties, which saw the workers and Fiat face to face.

title: Non mi muovo!
synopsis: An evicted auctioneer occupies an empty apartment with his family and two friends, despite the protests of the neighbors and the owner of the house: the latter will get back on it only by marrying the daughter of the abusive tenant. Lively, all played on the performers, film based on the comedy "O quattro 'e maggio" by Diego Petriccione.
cast: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Vanna Vanni

title: Non mi uccidere
synopsis: Mirta is madly in love with Robin, who promises her that it will be eternal love. On a full moon night, the desire to transgress costs their lives. But the girl wakes up and can only hope that Robin will do the same, just as he had promised her. But nothing is the same as before. Mirta realizes that she has transformed into a creature that must feed on human flesh to survive. He's afraid. Hunted by mysterious men, she fights in a desperate search for her Robin.
cast: Alice Pagani, Rocco Fasano, Silvia Calderoni, Fabrizio Ferracane, Sergio Albelli, Giacomo Ferrara, Anita Caprioli

title: Non odiare
synopsis: Simone Segre (Alessandro Gassmann), an established surgeon of Jewish origin, lives in a city in the north-east: a quiet life, an elegant apartment and no link with the past. One day, Simone finds herself rescuing a man who is the victim of a hit-and-run, but when she discovers a Nazi tattoo on his chest, she abandons him to his fate. Feeling guilty, he tracks down the man's family: Marica (Sara Serraiocco), the eldest daughter; Marcello (Luka Zunic), a teenager infected with the seed of racial hatred; the "little" Paolo (Lorenzo Buonora). The night will come when Marica will knock on Simone's door, unwittingly presenting him with the bill to pay.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Sara Serraiocco, Luka Zunic, Lorenzo Buonora, Lorenzo Acquaviva, Gabriele Sangrigoli, Paolo Giovannucci, Cosimo Fusco, Maurizio Zacchigna, Lucka Pockaj

title: Non parlo più
synopsis: Zina Barraco, a Sicilian girl, loves her father more than anything in the world. The man is deeply involved with the mafia but Zina, thanks to the particular bond she creates with the judge Lombardo, decides to collaborate with the justice system.
cast: Lorenza Indovina, Luigi Diberti, Anna Bonaiuto, Giusi Cataldo, Giuseppe De Rosa, Antonella Fattori, Daniele Liotti, Bruna Martelli, Totò Onnis, Arturo Paglia, Tony Sperandeo

title: Non pensarci
synopsis: Stefano Nardini is 35 years old and has been living in Rome for four years with the unlikely dream of making a record. But when he finds his girlfriend in the arms of another, he decides to return to his native Rimini: he will discover, among other things, that the family business is sinking due to the bad investments of his brother Alberto, and that his sister Michela has abandoned his studies to devote himself to the dolphins of an amusement park ...
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Anita Caprioli, Giuseppe Battiston, Caterina Murino, Paolo Briguglia, Dino Abbrescia, Luciano Scarpa

title: Non perdiamo la testa
synopsis: Suffering from a very rare disease, the naive Tony receives an invitation from a lady dedicated to charitable activities to spend the last few days he has left in the luxury of his villa. But it is a scam: Tony is healthy as a fish, the lady a cheat and the villa the hideout of a group of counterfeiters. Trouble will follow.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Franca Valeri, Daniele Vargas, Tina Pica, Carlo Campanini

title: Non più di uno
synopsis: Piero, 45, separated and father of two grown children, lives with Roberta, younger than him. The girl unexpectedly becomes pregnant; Piero's first negative reaction provokes a chain of others with a corollary of troubles and sentimental bickering. When Roberta, after losing her baby, asks him to get back together, she places a condition.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Maddalena Crippa, Giulia Fossà, Giorgio Del Bene

title: Non prendere impegni stasera
synopsis: Stories of forty-year-olds in crisis. A man throws himself into the Tiber two days before Christmas; in an apartment Alessandro and Irene chat over a coffee, in the adjacent one Giorgio and Mariella talk about sex, on the street Pietro confesses his pain to Cinzia, Nanni kisses Paola promised to another man, Vittorio falls in love with a Chinese masseuse, Nicola by Cameron Diaz while Iole consumes incense while waiting for a relationship.
cast: Giorgio Tirabassi, Paola Cortellesi, Luca Zingaretti, Andrea Renzi, Alessandro Gassmann, Francesca Inaudi

title: Non si deve profanare il sonno dei morti
synopsis: Two young friends, George and Edna, stop for a few days in Southgate, England, to visit the girl's sister. A series of experiments are being carried out in the area for the elimination of parasites through powerful ultrasound bursts. The results are very satisfying, but the side effects do not betray to be felt: children who turn into ferocious killers, crazed animals, resurrected corpses ... The only one who connects the two events is Steven, but no one wants to believe him ...
cast: Ray Lovelock, Cristina Galbó, Arthur Kennedy, Aldo Massasso, Giorgio Triestini

title: Non si ruba a casa dei ladri
synopsis: Antonio, an honest citizen, seeks his revenge on Simone, a dishonest politician. Antonio initially would like to denounce him but then, knowing Italy, a country in which the process of justice is very long and uncertain, he decides to take revenge in another way: he discovers that his enemy has hidden the proceeds of his misdeeds in a Swiss bank and decides to organize a "coup" to take back what has been stolen. To accomplish the feat, Antonio sets up a small gang, made up of non-professionals who have only one thing in common: they too have been swindled by corrupt politics. The coup takes place in Zurich where the bank where Simone hid the money is located. With a series of unpredictable implications, and with a funny substitution of people (Antonio and his wife pretend to be Simone and his partner), a comic clock mechanism starts. And the blow begins.
cast: Vincenzo Salemme, Massimo Ghini, Stefania Rocca, Manuela Arcuri, Maurizio Mattioli, Teco Celio, Ria Antoniou, Lorenzo Balducci, Fabrizio Buompastore

title: Non si sevizia un paperino
synopsis: In a superstitious Lucanian village three children are cruelly killed. A journalist on vacation investigates with the carabinieri. Suspicions fall on a dissolute city lady who has come to detox, then on a witch. Both are found innocent, but the second, once released, is massacred by the parents of the little victims. The situation becomes gloomier when a fourth child is murdered.
cast: Florinda Bolkan, Barbara Bouchet, Tomas Milian, Irene Papas, Marc Porel, Georges Wilson

title: Non smettere di sognare
synopsis: Stella and her sister Anna live in Genoa and live sadly with Luigi, their stepfather, a gruff man and more addicted to alcohol than to his daughters. Stella has a job at the port, a far cry from her childhood dreams. In the evening she dances as a cubist in the most famous nightclub in the city to supplement her salary, but here she competes with Alessia, an ambitious girl who often humiliates her. An audition for a prestigious dance school brings Stella to Milan, but she is rejected at the exam. A new chance to not stop dreaming is finally given to her by Lorenzo, a famous television producer, who offers her the opportunity to participate in a new talent show ...
cast: Alessandra Mastronardi, Roberto Farnesi, Sara Bellodi, Oriella Dorella, Pamela Prati, Massimo Boldi

title: Non son degno di te
synopsis: Gianni, a singing soldier, is engaged to Carla, daughter of his marshal. The two organize a party inviting all their friends including the rich fellow soldier Giorgio, who soon falls in love with the girl. While Gianni has a first contract with a record company, Giorgio declares himself to Carla and, against her will, manages to snatch a kiss from her. But it so happens that Gianni also attended the meeting from afar.
cast: Gianni Morandi, Laura Efrikian, Nino Taranto, Enrico Viarisio

title: Non sono più guaglione
synopsis: A mechanic falls in love with a girl who works as a tailor, but who aspires to become a diva. Entirely taken by her ambition, the girl despises the attention of the mechanic, while accepting the courtship of a shady individual who has promised her to win a beauty contest. To run after the girl, the mechanic abandons his job and to raise some money he agrees to rent a large-displacement car to the shady individual. synopsis: The drama follows the perspectives of three 30-year-old women and tells the story of urban women who encounter multiple pressures at the age of 30. Gu Jia, a full-time wife with strong abilities, she manages her small family and her husband’s company in an orderly manner. However, it is this excessive pursuit of perfection that makes people around her feel stressed. At the same time, her happy marital life was intruded on by a third party. But Gu Jia did not escape and chose to face it bravely. Wang Man Ni is a maverick rebel, convinced that she has both the face and brain, and she always deserves better. However, she also has her own troubles. Zhong Xiao Qin lives a very standard life. Her husband is committed to his work as a public servant, and she keeps an ordinary job herself. However, due to her husband’s relatively indifferent personality, communication problems arise. (Source: cdramalove)

title: Notturno
synopsis: The director Gianfranco Rosi, in the course of three years spent on the borders between Syria, Iraq, Kurdistan and Lebanon, gives voice to a human drama that transcends geographical divisions and the time of calendars; it illuminates, through encounters and images, the daily life behind the continuous tragedy of civil wars, ferocious dictatorships, foreign invasions and interference, up to the murderous ISIS apocalypse. Different stories, to which the narrative confers a unity that goes beyond borders. The war does not appear directly: we hear it in the mourning songs of mothers, in the stammering of children who are forever wounded, in the staging of the senselessness of politics recited by patients in a psychiatric institution. A street singer sings the praises of the Most High. A poacher in the reeds and oil wells. The grace of the peshmerga guerrillas. The terrorists of the Islamic State in prison. The anguish of a Yazidi mother for her imprisoned daughter. Ali, an adolescent, who struggles to bring bread to his brothers ... All around, and within the consciences, signs of violence and destruction: but in the foreground is humanity that awakens every day from a night that seems infinite .

country: Denmark, Germany, Belgium, United Kingdom, France, Sweden
synopsis: The second half of Lars von Trier's epic follows Joe as her reignited sex addiction destroys her family and thrusts her toward a surprising new trade.
cast: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Stellan Skarsgård, Stacy Martin, Shia LaBeouf, Christian Slater, Jamie Bell, Uma Thurman, Willem Dafoe, Mia Goth, Sophie Kennedy Clark, Michael Pas, Stellan Skarsgard

title: Não, ou vã gloria de mandar
synopsis: While on his way to die in the forests of Mozambique, during the colonial war, a Portuguese lieutenant tells his soldiers several episodes in the history of Portugal. The officer recalls the episode concerning the failed attempt of King Sebastian, which took place in 1578, to conquer North Africa by removing it from the Moors. The king died together with his soldiers, in the battle of Alcacer Khibir, in Morocco at the age of only 21. His body, however, was never found and hence the legend, very important in the Portuguese collective imagination and taken up by the great writer Fernando Pessoa in his esoteric poem, "The Message", that he is still alive and that one day he will return for regain possession of the throne of Portugal.
cast: Luis Miguel Cintra, Diego Doria

title: När mörkret faller
synopsis: A successful television journalist, a young girl who is the daughter of Middle Eastern immigrants, the owner of a trendy nightclub. People who, apparently, have in common only the fact that they live in the same city: the civil Stockholm. They actually have a lot more. They live - albeit in different contexts and for different reasons - the same tragedy: all three are victims of domestic violence. And they try to rebel against situations that many others are subjected to.
cast: Oldoz Javidi, Bahar Pars, Bibi Andersson, Mina Azarian, César Saracho, Zeljko Santrac, Tony Haddad, Elián Jajjo, Amin Alabadi, Alice Dadgostar, Annika Hallin

title: Nära livet
synopsis: Three women are in the same room of a gynecological clinic: the first following an abortion, the other two, one happily married, the other single mother, about to give birth. Dynamics of solidarity are established between the three female comrades in the dormitory, especially after the death of one of the unborn children.
cast: Eva Dahlbeck, Ingrid Thulin, Bibi Andersson, Max Von Sydow

title: Nättlek
synopsis: Jan, young and wealthy, is about to marry his fiancée Mariana. One day he decides to take his betrothed to the castle that will host them and in which the groom has spent his entire life. Crossing the rooms Jan relives some moments of his youth: when, although guided by an old aunt, he had participated in the disorderly life that his mother led among friends devoted to revelry and wildness. He also relives the troubles he felt towards his mother; it will be precisely the resemblance between his betrothed and his mother to make Jan unable to complete the marriage.
cast: Ingrid Thulin, Keve Hjelm, Jörgen Lindström, Lena Brundin

title: Nånting måste gå sönder
synopsis: In Stockholm made up of abandoned industrial areas, dirty clubs and poorly maintained parks, the young homosexual Sebastian dresses up as a woman and often puts himself in danger with his sexual adventures with strangers. When things seem to take a turn for the worse in a public bathroom, he luckily finds a guardian angel in Andreas, a boy wearing a tattered leather jacket. Although Andreas is not gay, the attraction between the two quickly becomes more powerful than all the labels.
cast: Saga Becker, Iggy Malmborg, Shima Niavarani, David Nzinga, Mattias Åhlén

title: Når dyrene drømmer
synopsis: Marie is a beautiful and lonely 16-year-old who lives in a remote village on a small island on the west coast of Denmark. While Marie's mother is forced by an unknown serious illness to remain immobile in a wheelchair, her father Thor runs a small grocery store and does his utmost to ensure that the family lives as normal as possible. Apparently there don't seem to be any particular problems in the house but, nevertheless, Marie cannot help believing that her father is hiding something from her about her mother's illness.
cast: Sonia Suhl, Lars Mikkelsen, Jakob Oftebro, Sonja Richter, Mads Riisom, Gustav Dyekjær Giese, Stig Hoffmeyer, Tina Gylling Mortensen, Benjamin Boe Rasmussen

title: Né Giulietta né Romeo
synopsis: Fourteen-year-old Rocco is the son of separated but present parents. The father Manuele is a psychoanalyst and lover of women while the mother Olga works as a journalist of the printed media and has a tiring personal life. Grandmother Amanda, on the other hand, is much more modern than her years and is determined to interact in her own way with her grandson's teenage turmoil. Carefree, likeable and with a passion for the rock star of the moment, Rocco shares his days with friends Maria and Mauri until the day his world takes a different turn. Revealing to his parents that he is homosexual, Rocco will find himself having to deal with a family that is not as progressive as he believed and a daring escape.
cast: Andrea Amato, Veronica Pivetti, Pia Engleberth, Carolina Pavone, Francesco De Miranda, Corrado Invernizzi, Filippo Dini, Sara Sartini, Carlina Torta

title: Né con te né senza di te
synopsis: Lazio 1848. Francesca, a spinner with a free and wild character, has loved Count De Leonardis for years. Although the young aristocrat responds with passion, to save the family from ruin, he marries Olympias, a rich girl of his rank. Francesca does not resign herself and stabs her lover, who nevertheless forgives her and, seeing her in danger of life, shoots a colonel of the papal army, Cestra, who is about to hit her. Pietro De Leonardis is therefore forced to flee. In an attempt to go to Rome where he intends to enlist with the battalions sent by Pius IX to fight against Austria, he is captured by two brigands, Naschella and Kyrieleison. During his stay in the mountains, the young idealist learns that the peasants of his lands are harassed by Colonel Cestra and the notary Corticelli and, joined by Francesca, he undertakes banditry actions to protect the farmers. After many injustices have been repaired, Francesca is sure that her love for Pietro can finally be lived out in the open, but the young count is instead increasingly intent on fighting for the unity of Italy, following the republican ideals advocated. by Giuseppe Mazzini.
cast: Sabrina Ferilli, Francesco Testi, Massimo Venturiello, Valeria Milillo, Cosimo Cinieri, Barbara Livi, Isa Danieli, Nicola Acunzo, Valentina Corti

title: Né terra né cielo
synopsis: The worker Simone is fired, he discovers that his wife is cheating on him with his union friend and becomes pregnant. The man then matures an extreme gesture: he climbs the factory chimney and remains there, going on a hunger strike. Of course, TV and politicians rush in, and the case mounts. So much so that when Simone loses his voice, friends and enemies decide to leave him there, because it suits everyone.
cast: Davide Gemmani, Antonella D'Arcangelo, Fabio Fulco

title: Nénette et Boni
synopsis: Boni is a pizza maker in Marseille, lives in a strange hovel, pursues his dreams and refuses relationships with others. But one day his sister Nenette arrives in his refuge, who has run away from the boarding school where her father has placed her. Relations between the two young people are not easy.
cast: Grégoire Colin, Alice Houri, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Vincent Gallo

title: Në kërkim të Venerës
synopsis: The calm and taciturn Venra lives in a small village in Kosovo. Three different generations live in its modest home and has almost no privacy. It is not better away from home: the village is small and there is always a relative or a neighbor to keep an eye on it. However, everything changes when he makes friends with Dorina, a rebel who already has a boyfriend. The two girls begin to go out and have fun together and have only one certainty: they don't want to end like their mothers.
cast: Rozafa Celaj, Erjona Kakeli, Kosovare Krasniqi, Basri Lushtaku

title: Nói Albinói
synopsis: 17-year-old Nói lives with his grandmother and alcoholic father in Bolungarvik on a fjord in northern Iceland. In winter, when the village is completely cut off from the world, Nói dreams of escaping in the company of Iris, a city girl who has ended up working in the squalid local gas station. But the boy's clumsy escape attempts are doomed to fail ...
cast: Tómas Lemarquis, Thröstur Leó Gunnarsson, Elin Hansdóttir, Anna Fridriksdóttir

title: Nóz w wodzie
synopsis: André is a journalist, has a silent wife named Christine, a boat on the Masurian lakes and a weekend off. During the trip, the couple picks up a hitchhiker, a student who can't even swim. André invites the boy to go on a boat with them despite the fact that the hostility between the two is clear. The crisis erupts when André throws a knife that the student cared about into the water. In the fight that follows, the boy falls into the water. It is not the usual story of a triangle, it is a square: him, her, the other and the boat. Great debut of Roman Polanski with a boat almost as claustrophobic as the apartment on the third floor. A black and mocking tragedy, co-scripted and edited by Jerzy Skolimowski.
cast: Leon Niemczyk, Jolanta Umecka, Zygmunt Malanowicz

title: O
synopsis: The black boy Odin, an excellent basketball player, managed in a short time to attract the sympathies of all his university friends. He got into the good graces of his coach and won the heart of Desi, a wealthy student of the white bourgeoisie. Everything proceeds in the best way, until one day Hugo, the son of the coach, appears on the scene. Jealousy takes possession of Odin also because Desi has changed his attitude towards him.
cast: Martin Sheen, Julia Stiles, Josh Hartnett, Mekhi Phifer, Rain Phoenix

title: O Barão
synopsis: Bizarre re-enactment of the atmosphere of the myth of Dracula in a remote area of ??Portugal, the Barroso, where an inspector of the Ministry of Education (Marcos Barbosa) arrives at the home of a sinister baron (Nuno Melo) amidst noises of a horrific atmosphere, unrest, grotesque, loneliness, love, alienation.
cast: Nuno Melo, Marcos Barbosa, Leonor Keil, Marina Albuquerque, Vítor Correia, Jorge Prendas, Rogério Rosa, Miguel Sermão, Paula Só

title: O Beautiful Night
synopsis: Although he is very young, Yuri is afraid of dying. Nighttime panic attacks are something he's gotten used to but something unusual happens when he meets a mysterious man who claims to be death himself. A bizarre journey through the night will begin when Yuri falls in love with Nina and ends up dying ...
cast: Noah Saavedra, Marko Mandic, Johanna Polley, Eva Maria Kurz, Gerhard Bös, Vanessa Loibl, Peter Clös

title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
synopsis: Everett Ulysses McGill escaped from prison because he wants to get his hands on the swag he says he hid. They follow him, or rather, they are forced to follow him because they are linked by a single chain: Pete and Delmar. The America of the Great Depression accompanies the three inmates to a treasure that seems increasingly unlikely ...
cast: George Clooney, John Turturro, Tim Blake Nelson, John Goodman, Charles Durning, Michael Badalucco, Holly Hunter, Stephen Root, Chris Thomas King, Wayne Duvall, Daniel Von Bargen, Frank Collison, J.R. Horne, Brian Reddy

title: O Cangaceiro
synopsis: Galdino Ferreira, leader of a gang of criminals, turns the Brazilian Northeast region upside down. During one of the many raids Galdino takes Oliva hostage, a young teacher who fascinated him with her beauty. Theodore, Galdino's lieutenant, who does not approve of this act of arrogance towards a woman, frees her and goes away with her. Realizing that the two have escaped, the bandit puts his men on their trail.
cast: Alberto Ruschell, Marisa Prado, Milton Ribeiro, Ricardo Campos

title: O Cheiro do Ralo
synopsis: Lourenço buys the most disparate objects at bargain prices from people in financial difficulty to whom his only concern is to inform them that the stench that plagues the air of his studio comes from the broken exhaust (and not from him). Insensitive and anaffective, he finds satisfaction by humiliating his neighbor, especially if he tries to sell him things he doesn't like, only to lose all control when he is faced with something that hits him, whether it is the breathtaking rear of a busty waitress or even a simple glass eye. mistaken for a real one.
cast: Selton Mello, Paula Braun, Paulo Alves, Susana Alves, Roberto Audio, Flavio Bauraqui, Boi, Alice Braga, Calico, Jorge Cerruti

title: O Contador de Histórias
synopsis: Born in the Belo Horizonte favela, Roberto is the youngest of ten brothers and has a special talent for telling stories. At the age of six, with his imagination, he goes to live in a recently opened government institution, whose main objective is to help the little poor. The reality of the place, however, is very different from that advertised and in a short time Roberto loses hope. At the age of 13, after a hundred escapes, he is now considered irrecoverable when the French pedagogue Margherit decides to take him under her wing to make him an object of study. Thus a relationship of intense friendship and tenderness was born between the two.
cast: Maria De Medeiros, Malu Galli, Ju Colombo, Marco Antonio, Paulo Enrique, Cleiton Santos, Teuda Bara, Victor Augusto Da Silva, Chico Díaz, Paulinho Mendes

title: O Dia do Desespero
synopsis: The Lusitanian writer Camilo Castelo Branco suffers from a serious eye disease. Blindness, together with economic difficulties and the inner conflict that has always accompanied him, pushes him to make the extreme gesture.
cast: Teresa Madruga, Mário Barroso, Luis Miguel Cintra, Diogo Dória, Canto E Castro, Ruy De Carvalho, Nuno Melo, José Maria Vaz Da Silva, Dina Treno, David Ferreira Dias

title: O Doutrinador
synopsis: A member of the Federal Police Special Forces, Officer Miguel Montessanti is one of the best policemen in his department. However, his life is completely turned upside down when his only daughter is killed before his eyes due to an investigation he conducted that led to the arrest for corruption of one of the presidential candidates. Completely left alone by institutions and justice, the agent decides to start a personal crusade against crime: he becomes Nightwatcher, the nightmare of crime.
cast: Kiko Pissolato, Tainá Medina, Samuel De Assis, Carlos Betão, Tuca Andrada, Eduardo Chagas, Ricardo Dantas, Eucir De Souza, Marília Gabriela, Natália Lage

title: O Dragão da Maldade contra o Santo Guerreiro
synopsis: After the political and ideological conversion, the ruthless killer Antonio das Mortes - hired by the old Colonel Horácio to eliminate the last "cangaçeiros", the brigands favored by the people - takes sides with the dispossessed. By updating the deeds of the "holy warrior" San Giorgio, he will identify new evil dragons to kill ...
cast: Mauricio Do Valle, Odette Lara, Othon Bastos, Hugo Carvana, Joffre Soares, Lorival Pariz, Rosa Maria Penna, Emmanuel Cavalcanti, Vinícius Salvatori, Mário Gusmão

title: O Estado do Mundo
synopsis: In Bright People, by Apichatpong Weerasethakul, a boat travels on the Mekong River with a group of people on board preparing to scatter the ashes of a family member in the water. In Germano, by Vincente Ferras Gonçalves, Germano and his crew of fishermen leave behind the polluted waters of Guanabara bay to try to fish on the high seas despite the small boat with the old engine that they have at their disposal. In One Way, by Ayisha Abraham, the daily life of a security guard is punctuated by memories of his journey from the mountains of Nepal to Bangalore in India. In The Factory of Violence, by Wang Bing, ghosts appear among the ruins in a Chinese industrial complex undergoing demolition and tell their stories. In Tarrafal, by Pedro Costa, it tells of Tarrafal, the island of Cape Verde, where in 1936 Portugal established a concentration camp for political prisoners. In Chantal Akerman's Night Falls on Shanghai, the night skyline of Shanghai becomes the backdrop for large screens that project advertisements.
cast: Shyam Bahadur, Jurandyr Ferreira, Jenjira Jansuda, Sakda Kaewbuadee, Wake Li, Alfredo Mendes, Babu Santana, José Alberto Silva, Lucinda Tavares, Ventura
director: Apichatpong Weerasethakul, Vincente Ferras Gonçalves, Ayisha Abraham, Wang Bing, Pedro Costa, Chantal Akerman

title: O Estranho caso de Angélica
synopsis: Isaac, a professional photographer, is called by Angelica's family to immortalize the lifeless body of the girl, who died suddenly just after her wedding. Arriving in the house in mourning, from the first glance, Isaac is struck by the rare beauty of Angelica and, under his lenses, the woman comes back to life, at least in his eyes ...
cast: Pilar López De Ayala, Ricardo Trêpa, Leonor Silveira, Isabel Ruth, Luis Miguel Cintra, Ana Maria Magalhães

title: O Filme da Minha Vida
synopsis: Young Tony decides to return to Remanso, in the Brazilian region of Serra Gaucha, his hometown. Upon his arrival, however, he discovers that his father Nicolas has moved to France, without feeling the lack of friends and the country of origin. Tony will eventually become a teacher, finding himself having to deal with inexperiences and youth conflicts.
cast: Vincent Cassel, Selton Mello, Bruna Linzmeyer, Bia Arantes, Johnny Massaro, Antonio Skármeta, Martha Nowill, Ondina Clais Castilho, Erika Januza, Rolando Boldrin

title: O Gebo e a sombra
synopsis: At the end of the nineteenth century, despite his age and fatigue, Gebo continued his business as an accountant with which he supports the family. He lives with his wife Doroteia and their daughter-in-law Sofia but it is the absence of their son Joao that occupies everyone's thoughts. Gebo hid from his wife that his son Joao went into hiding after being responsible for some dishonorable actions. The unsuspecting Doroteia waits with hope that Joao will one day be able to return home while in Sofia the expectation is mixed with fear. When Joao suddenly reappears, everything changes and takes a different turn. While Doroteia believes her return is good, Gebo has no illusions and decides not to hide the colossal amount of money she is keeping on behalf of the company she works for.
cast: Michael Lonsdale, Claudia Cardinale, Jeanne Moreau, Ricardo Trêpa, Leonor Silveira, Luis Miguel Cintra

title: O Gigante da América
synopsis: An Indian meets a wild blonde and the two join in the incredible circumnavigation of America. During the journey, they will be taken to meet the ghosts of some of the most important figures of the new world.
cast: Carlos Imperial, Marta Anderson, Hélio Ary, Clóvis Bornay, Tania Boscoli, Teresa Cristina, Suzana De Moraes, Sonia Dias, Dorvigílio, Fabíola Fracaroli

title: O Gios tis Sofias
synopsis: During the 2004 Summer Olympics, 11-year-old Misha travels from Russia to Athens to live with her mother in the home of the elderly Greek woman she works for. When she discovers that the man is actually her new father, Misha runs away but her escape doesn't last forever. Returning to the new home, he will seek solace in the stories he grew up with.
cast: Viktor Khomut, Valery Tcheplanowa, Thanasis Papageorgiou, Artemis Havalits, Christos Stergioglou, Iro Maltezou

title: O Grande Circo Místico
synopsis: The story of five generations belonging to the same circus family: the Knieps, founders of the Great Mystical Circus in 1910. With the help of Celavì, the master of ceremonies who never gets old, we retrace adventures, loves, ascents, fortunes and ruins of the family, which has always been the protagonist of a mystical universe in which reality and fantasy mix.
cast: Jesuíta Barbosa, Bruna Linzmeyer, Rafael Lozano, Catherine Mouchet, Antônio Fagundes, Vincent Cassel, Marina Provenzzano, Juliano Cazarré, Flora Diegues, Luiza Mariani

title: O Homem Que Copiava
synopsis: André, a relatively poor man, falls in love with Silvia, a neighbor whom he spies with a telescope. Increasingly infatuated with her, he follows her around town and discovers she works in a clothing store. To buy a dress there, André, an employee of a copy shop, photocopies a 50 real ticket. What must have been an isolated case ends up becoming a habit and the fake money increases day by day until, when things start to go wrong, André realizes that photocopying is not the only way to make money.
cast: Lazaro Ramos, Renata De Lélis, Sérgio Lulkin, Heitor Schmidt, Janaína Kremer Motta, Gregory Garcia, Sheron Menezzes, Carlos Cunha, Leandra Leal, Giovana Fázio

title: O Homem do Futuro
synopsis: Brazil, 2011. Joao, known by everyone as Zero, is a brilliant physicist who, despite being the head of one of the largest scientific projects in the country, still has in mind the night twenty years before when he was betrayed and publicly humiliated in a party from girlfriend Helena. When finally his eccentric and capricious ways threaten to get him fired, Joao decides to try his invention ahead of time, a machine that should be a new sustainable energy source for humanity. Much to his surprise, the machine instead opens a time gap that takes Joao back to that fateful night in 1991, a few hours before Helena left him for the popular playboy Ricardo. Determined to change the natural order of events, Joao makes a mess that he will realize when he returns to the present.
cast: Wagner Moura, Aline Moraes, Maria Luisa Mendonça, Fernando Ceylão, Gabriel Braga Nunes, Daniel Uemura, José Steimberg, Malu Rodrigues, Gregório Duvivier, Bruno Gradim

title: O Jerusalem
synopsis: In the upheavals of the immediate postwar period, the political geography of the Middle East is involved, in which the State of Israel is about to be established. A Palestinian boy, Saïd, and Bobby, an American of Jewish faith, know each other and become friends, but the current situation will create a series of incurable friction between the two.
cast: JJ Feild, Said Taghmaoui, Daniel Lundh, Mel Raido

title: O Kadhal Kanmani
synopsis: It's love at first sight for a young couple repelled by the concept of marriage, but their view shifts when they meet their older-couple neighbors.
cast: Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menon, Prakash Raj, Leela Samson, Vinodhini, Ramya Subramanian, Siva Ananth, John Devasahayam, Prabhu Lakshman

title: O Lucky Man!
synopsis: Mick Travis is a young careerist looking to make money as a coffee salesman. He undergoes an incredible amount of hardship, between mad scientists, rock bands and nuclear engineers, but these fail to dent his robust and unreasonable optimism.
cast: Malcolm McDowell, Rachel Roberts, Arthur Lowe, Ralph Richardson

title: O Mandarim
synopsis: The tale of the history of 20th century Brazilian popular music focuses above all on the life and works of singer Mario Reis, a loner who, with his particular way of singing, was in a certain sense the precursor of Bossa Nova.
cast: Fernando Eiras, Giulia Gam, Gal Costa, Gilberto Gil, Raphael Rabello, Rubens Santos, Chico Buarque De Hollanda, Edu Lobo, Caetano Veloso, Renata Sorrah

title: O Marinheiro das Montanhas
synopsis: Karim Aïnouz returns to Algiers and ends up shooting an autobiographical road movie in search of his roots and what has remained of the struggle for independence from the French colonial domain.

title: O Matador
synopsis: In a desolate land without law, the lonely Cabeleira wants to discover what happened to the adoptive father, a gunnon, and he also becomes a feared murderer.
cast: Diogo Morgado, Maria De Medeiros, Deto Montenegro, Will Roberts, Jonas Antônio Leite, Phil Miler, Etienne Chicot, Mel Lisboa, Paulo Gorgulho, Marat Descartes, Daniela Galli, Francisco Gaspar

title: O Megalexandros
synopsis: After being proclaimed head of a community of Greek peasants who live according to the principles of socialism together with some Italian anarchist exiles, the brigand Alexander reveals himself to be a despotic tyrant. The regular army will put an end to its ephemeral and violent power, but a boy who bears his own name will leave to see if it is possible to continue the idea of ??a revolution in Greece.
cast: Omero Antonutti, Eva Kotamanidou, Grigoris Evangelatos, Mihalis Giannatos, Miranda Kounelaki, Laura De Marchi, Toula Stathopoulou, Thanos Grammenos

title: O Menino e o Mundo
synopsis: Heartbroken by his father's absence, a child leaves his village and discovers a fantasy world dominated by machine animals and strange beings.

title: O Menino que Matou Meus Pais
O Ornitólogo
synopsis: A 40-year-old ornithologist named Fernando decides to kayak a river, hoping to find very rare black storks. Distracted by the beauty of the landscape, Fernando is soon thrown into the water by the current, and - overwhelmed by the rapids - his motionless and bloody body reaches the river bank. He is saved by two fanatical Chinese girls who are making their way along the Camino de Santiago.
cast: Paul Hamy, João Pedro Rodrigues, Juliane Elting, Xelo Cagiao, Chan Suan, Isabelle Puntel, Flora Bulcao

title: O Pagador de Promessas
synopsis: # Zé-do-Burro, a simple and naive man with a profound Christian faith, has only one thing in the world that he cares enormously: it is his ass Nicolas, who for him is a being with a soul. When the animal is seriously injured during a storm, # Zé-do-Burro - desperate - makes a vow: if Nicolas is saved he will bring an enormous cross to the altar of Santa Barbara, in Bahia. Nicolas heals and so # Zé-do-Burro builds a cross and, accompanied by his wife Rosa, embarks on the tiring journey to Bahia, which will prove to be full of unexpected events and destined to put the poor man's simple faith to a severe test.
cast: Leonardo Villar, Glória Menezes, Dionísio Azevedo, Geraldo Del Rey, Roberto Ferreira, Norma Bengell, Othon Bastos, Antonio Pitanga, Gilberto Marques, Milton Gaucho

title: O Palhaço
synopsis: Benjamim works at the Esperança circus, whose director is his father. Together with the latter he plays the role of the clown Nuisance, in a show that is touring around Brazil, stopping off in various countryside villages. Its number changes every time, adapting to the characters of the place, and the applause is never lacking. However, as the tour progresses, Benjamim feels a growing malaise pervade.
cast: Paulo José, Selton Mello, Larissa Manoela, Giselle Motta, Teuda Bara, Álamo Facó, Cadu Fávero, Erom Cordeiro, Hossein Minussi, Maira Chasseroux

title: O Pioneers!
synopsis: US Midwest at the turn of the last century. A woman, Alexandra (Jessica Lange), takes over the reins of the family farm in rural Nebraska. The enterprise is not the easiest. Alexandra in fact has to face not so much the fatigue of work and the climatic elements of the region, as the resentment on the part of her brothers.
cast: Jessica Lange, David Strathairn, Tom Aldredge, Reed Diamond

title: O Rei do Baralho
synopsis: In a movie studio, the actors put on their makeup and the crew waits to start shooting the film. Grande Otelo, rogue "king of the deck", and Marta Anderson, play in the historical scenario of the chanchadas, the abandoned studios of the Cinédia.
cast: Grande Otelo, Marta Anderson, Wilson Grey, Fininho, Cahuê Filho, Elisa, Elke Maravilha, Edson Santos, Guilherme Guimarães, Ivan Cardoso

title: O Sangue
synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Vicente lives with Nino, his ten-year-old brother, and his ailing father in an old house on the outskirts of the capital. The two boys don't seem to remember much of their mother and are attached to their father, despite his temperament and his constant absences. But when the parent dies, Vicente and Nino find themselves forced to struggle with a legacy of debt and violence that the man has left behind.
cast: Pedro Hestnes, Nuno Ferreira, Ines De Medeiros, Luis Miguel Cintra, Canto E Castro, Isabel De Castro, Henrique Viana, Luís Santos, Manuel João Vieira, Sara Breia

title: O Silêncio do Céu
synopsis: After being raped in her home, a married woman chooses not to tell her husband, unaware that he has his own troubled secret and a plan for revenge.
cast: Leonardo Sbaraglia, Carolina Dieckmann, Chino Darín, Alvaro Armand Ugon, Mirella Pascual, Roberto Suárez, Paula Cohen, Dylan Cortes, Priscila Bellora, Gabriela Freire, María Mendive

title: O Vendedor de Sonhos
synopsis: A disillusioned psychologist tries to commit suicide until he strikes up a friendship with an unlikely savior who teaches him a new way of living.
cast: César Troncoso, Dan Stulbach, Thiago Mendonça, Leonardo Medeiros

title: O anjo nasceu
synopsis: Santamaria is white and pervaded by mystical ignitions, Urtiga is black and naive: outlaws on the run and inseparable cronies, they enter a house and keep two women in prison. When will the advent of the "purifying angel" invoked by Santamaria?
cast: Hugo Carvana, Milton Gonçalves, Maria Gladys, Norma Bengell

title: O bandido da luz vermelha
synopsis: Jorge, an outcast from the city of Sao Paulo, after having upset the entire population, and especially after having challenged the police with his "exploits", becomes famous as "the bandit of the red light". The nickname derives from the particular technique with which he scores the thefts.
cast: Paulo Villaca, Helena Ignez, Luiz Linhares, Pagano Sobrinho

title: O cancer
synopsis: Some characters are the protagonists of situations that do not make up a real story, but reproduce the point of view of the filmmaker regarding a certain historical situation.
cast: Hugo Carvana, Odette Lara, Antonio Pitanga, Rogério Duarte, Hélio Oiticica, Eduardo Coutinho, José Medeiros

title: O convento
synopsis: Professor Michael Padovic is working on a thesis in Paris aimed at proving that Shakespeare was of Spanish descent. He needs some documents that should be found in the ancient convent of Arrabida, Portugal. Michael then leaves for Portugal with his wife Hélène. While staying at the convent, the diabolical guardian Baltar, who is strongly attracted to Hélèn, weaves his plots ...
cast: John Malkovich, Catherine Deneuve, Luis Miguel Cintra, Leonor Silveira

title: O estranho mundo do Zé do Caixão
cast: Vany Miller, Verônica Krimann, George Michel Serkeis, Íris Bruzzi, Oswaldo De Souza

title: O fantasma

title: Oshin
synopsis: The 31st NHK Asadora Drama is Oshin. Oshin tells the story of a girl born in a very poor rural family in Japan, who through hard work and perseverance eventually triumphs over pain and adversity to achieve fame and success. Broadcast in the early 1980s when Japan had finally cast off the legacy of the post-war years and the Japanese were beginning to reap the benefits of economic development, the aim of the story was to recall the hardships the older generation had endured in order to pave the way for their children to enjoy their more affluent lifestyle. Viewers were drawn to the suffering of the main character Oshin - and then drew similarities between her story and their own home lives. Some Japanese worried that showing Oshin abroad would give the country a bad profile - and would even be shameful because it showed the seldom glimpsed, poor, unequal side of Japan. In the event, the reverse proved true. Oshin gave viewers outside Japan - whose only image of Japan was formed by Japanese cars or electric goods, or through bitter memories of Japanese treatment during World War II - a far better understanding of the modern Japan and its people. (Source: DramaWiki)

Since then, the police psychologist has been tortured by the thought that his wife committed suicide bringing their son with him. Not willing to believe this hypothesis, Martin finds himself in spite of himself to be involved in a new case of disappearance aboard the same luxury cruiser. A woman disappeared with her daughter but soon the girl reappears with a teddy bear belonging to Martin's son. In order not to disturb the rest of the holiday of the other passengers, the girl by decision of the wealthy owner of the ship is held under of the age and, here, Martin tries to win his fears and make her speak. However, the bowels of the ship hide something very dangerous lurking: all signs indicate the presence of a serial killer waiting for the right time to hit again.

At the outbreak of the First World War, his father will take on the role of the soldier, setting a good example for the boy.

title: Passato prossimo

But one day a gang of outlaws just escaped from the penitentiary arrives, made up of four bandits already sentenced to death for an endless series of crimes. In short, the outlaws rob the bank, kill the sheriff, kill some other citizens and, not yet happy, kidnap a girl to cover her escape.
cast: Audie Murphy, John Saxon

title: Passe ton bac d'abord
synopsis: Lens. A group of boys and girls, distressed by the last year of high school and above all by the imminent graduation exam, reflect on the not too bright future that awaits them.
cast: Sabine Haudepin, Philippe Marlaud, Annick Alane, Michel Caron

title: Passed Away
synopsis: All relatives gather at the funeral of the head of the family. The occasion is not the happiest, but the fact remains that it ends up being scattered with bizarre events, surprises, human cases: from the woman who has labor pains during the procession, to the appearance of a beautiful mysterious girl, to the midlife crisis. Johnny, who will not get anywhere anyway and will end up returning to the familiar harbor. A skilfully woven comedy, both in terms of situations and dialogues. All the more remarkable as a first work. Life is celebrated there with full black humor but with remarkable taste, supported by an impeccable interpretation.

title: Passeggeri notturni
synopsis: Enrico hosts a night radio program. Among his "night passengers" is Sabrina whom he tries to help overcome a trauma. Despite her intervention, however, the girl commits suicide. synopsis: A spacecraft carrying thousands of people traveling to a distant planet that serves as a colony is struck by a malfunction in one of its sleep chambers. As a result, Jim and Aurora awaken ninety years ahead of schedule. While living their existence aboard the vehicle, the two fall in love and are unable to deny the attraction that binds them until they discover that the spacecraft is in grave danger. With the lives of over 5,000 passengers at stake, Jim and Aurora must work to save everyone.

title: Passengers
synopsis: Psychologist Claire Summers deals with some patients who survived a plane crash of unknown causes, some of whom suddenly begin to evaporate; in the meantime, she has become romantically linked to one of them. Suspicious of the mysterious disappearances, she decides to investigate and discovers that behind the whole affair lies a conspiracy ...
cast: Anne Hathaway, Patrick Wilson, David Morse, Clea DuVall, Dianne Wiest, Andre Braugher, Chelah Horsdal, William B. Davis, Ryan Robbins, Sandra Jessica Couturier

title: Passi di danza su una lama di rasoio
synopsis: The Swedish Kitty (Nieves Navarro) waits for her partner Alberto (Robert Hoffmann) walking on the Pincio and to pass the time she looks in one of the telescopes available to the public. This is how he involuntarily witnesses the murder of a woman, who turns out to be a dancer. Commissioner Meruggi, who leads the investigation, links the crime to another analogue, which always had a dancer as its victim, and begins to suspect Alberto. Other subsequent deaths, however, will exonerate Alberto, in possession of certain alibis, who will begin to investigate on his own helped by Kitty and Lidiia, a journalist interested in the case.

title: Passi di morte perduti nel buio
synopsis: A murder is committed in a compartment of the Athens-Thessaloniki express while the convoy was in the tunnel. The travelers did not have time to put a face to the killer because he took steps to eliminate the lighting inside the carriage. What remains in the hands of the police is the woman's body and a letter opener belonging to an Italian photographer, Luciano Morelli. The agents of the Greek police withdraw Luciano's passport, deeming him guilty of the crime. But Luciano does not give up and investigates the people present in the convoy.
cast: Vera Krouska, Antonio Maimone, Leonard Mann, Barbara Seidel

title: Passi furtivi in una notte boia - Zelmaide
synopsis: At Castello di Imola, the waitress Ida (who goes by the name of Zelmaide) serves at the Ranieri bar, but in her heart there is the hope of soon becoming the owner. Indeed, Father Joseph is absolutely convinced that his team is unbeatable.
cast: Andre Braugher, Rip Torn, Ruby Dee, Bill Nunn, Daniel Hugh Kelly

title: Passion
synopsis: Elegant and casual, Christine is fascinated by the money that comes from her role as a power in international business. Often, in order to show off, he has no qualms about stealing the cutting-edge and profitable ideas of young and innocent Isabelle: after all, they are on the same team and Isabelle is his protégé. Exercising full control over Isabelle, Christine engages her in a game of seduction and manipulation, domination and humiliation. But when Isabelle ends up in bed with one of Christine's lovers, war breaks out between the two women.

title: Passion
synopsis: A stammering worker, a despotic factory owner, a Polish director who tries to recreate in the film he is making exact reproductions of famous paintings. The film fails to make itself, the worker is fired and the director drives back to Poland. It is a film of overwhelming beauty and not only for the paintings it recreates with loving precision: it is an essay, an erotic film and a feast for the eyes.

title: Passion
synopsis: Juan Oberon, a wealthy Southern California farmer, marries Rosa, Gaspar Lopez's granddaughter. Meanwhile, Don Domingo, the local boss who wants to take over all the land in the area, sends a punitive expedition to Gaspar's farm. Everyone dies except Juan and Rosa's son. Then comes the time of revenge. For once the Italian title is better than the original one. However, the photograph of John Alton is saved from the film.

title: Passion Play

He finds her beautiful, she finds someone in him who understands her and finally wants to treat her not for how she appears. But this strange story has many obstacles.
cast: Mickey Rourke, Megan Fox, Bill Murray, Kelly Lynch, Jerry Sawyers, Armin Amiri, Tina Borek, Charlie B. Brown, Chris Browning, Liezl Carstens

title: Passion Simple
synopsis: A man, a married Russian diplomat, and a woman, a university professor and separate mother, often meet in the suburbs of Paris for several months. During this period, it is possible to follow the evolution of their love, from the beginning to the end.

title: Passion of Mind
synopsis: Marty is a charming New York literary agent, single, childless who can't fall in love; Marie is a literary critic, lives in a small village near Menton in France, is a widow with two little girls and is no longer able to see a man. Finally Marty and Marie fall in love but they have a problem: they are the same person and their lives that take shape during the dream, both seem terribly real.
cast: Stellan Skarsgård, Demi Moore, Sinead Cusack, Matthew Beisner

title: Passion. Panache. Pep
synopsis: From delicious delicacies to dream destinations, this collection features vibrant stories on cultural trends across food, fashion and travel in India.

title: Passionate Friends
synopsis: Mary, married to the banker Howard Justine - a rich man and much older than her - accidentally meets an old lover during a stay in Switzerland. Thinking of a betrayal, the husband asks for a divorce. The girl, desperate, tries to throw herself under the subway, but Howard manages to save her life.
cast: Ann Todd, Trevor Howard, Claude Rains, Betty Ann Davies

title: Passionate Love
synopsis: Kang Moo Yeol is a third-generation chaebol who has the both the looks and wealth, seems to have it all on the outside, but grows up with family issues and pain from the loss of his past love Han Yoo Rim. Meanwhile, Han Yoo Jung is a diligent and bright, and very independent woman who has a tomboyish and unruly personality which helped her overcome the sudden loss of her family. She is Han Yoo Rim's younger sister and will get involved with Kang Moo Yeol 10 years later. Both Kang Moo Yeol and his half brother Hong Soo Hyuk will fall in love with Han Yoo Jung. But, Moo Yeol and Yoo Jung are star-crossed lovers. Their tragic love story begins because of a tragedy due to their parents. How will they escape their dreary surroundings to succeed?

cast: Massimo Ranieri, Fiorello, Lina Sastri, Peppe Barra, Peppe Servillo, Raiz, Loredana Simioli

title: Passione d'amore
synopsis: The fascinating cavalry captain Giorgio Bacchetti is the lover of a beautiful woman, Clara. Fosca also lives in the garrison, a girl with a horrible appearance and a tormented and sick soul who makes the captain fall in love with herself. On the death of Fosca the man falls prey to a deep depression.
cast: Valeria D'Obici, Bernard Giraudeau, Laura Antonelli, Massimo Girotti

title: Passione di Giovanni
synopsis: Seven numbered episodes. Each number corresponds to a bunch of figures and situations captured by the present, suspended between collective and individual life. A national demonstration of metalworkers, a visit to prison, a group of actors, a young woman walking alone in the outskirts of Rome and, among all, the children reappear in their homes. Everyone lives his passion like a poor Christ.
cast: Rossella Dassu, Alberto Momo, Alessandra Dell'Atti

title: Passione sinistra
synopsis: Born into a family that is certainly not rich and engaged to the young writer Bernardo (Vinicio Marchioni), Nina (Valentina Lodovini) grew up with strong leftist values ??that she does not hesitate to highlight every time she finds herself faced with the superficial behavior of members and supporters of the political right. Giulio (Alessandro Preziosi), on the other hand, is the son of a wealthy industrial family, little interested in sharing his clearly right-wing political views and keen to enjoy life with his girlfriend Simonetta (Eva Riccobono). A fortuitous meeting will ensure that the destinies of Nina and Giulio meet and that from their initial dislike explodes a passion capable of overshadowing ideological and cultural differences.
cast: Valentina Lodovini, Alessandro Preziosi, Geppi Cucciari, Vinicio Marchioni, Eva Riccobono, Iurij Ferrini, Glenn Blackhall

title: Passo a due

title: Passpartù: Operazione Doppiozero
synopsis: In the small village of Ceraso life flows quiet and quiet. To animate the community are the continuous clashes between the parish priest Don Cataldo and the mayor Nicola Mariotti. The mayor, apart from some "loving" intemperance, is however very attentive to the life of the country and has decided to issue a call for the management of the historic Palazzo di Lorenzo, renovated and transformed into a hotel. Two friends, Giulia and Rossella, disillusioned by their university expectations and uncertain working future, decide to participate, to give a positive turn to their life. In this idea they involve the two friends Antonio and Umberto. The four boys reach Ceraso, where they are welcomed by the mayor, by the deputy mayor Daniela, by Don Cataldo and by Attilio, municipal secretary, Franciscan tertiary and missed priest. Romolo Perretti, a Roman entrepreneur in the health sector, is also affected. Moved by very different interests and with the complicity of his trusted secretary Remo Procacci, Romolo tries to discredit the boys and the Municipality. Valeria, Umberto's girlfriend, chief editor of a well -known magazine, decides to help the four boys and involve some friends and collaborators: Sonia, Laetitia and Antonella. In the meantime, other individuals will come to Ceraso to move the situation even more.

title: Passport to Murder

The choice falls on Paris where the young American lands triumphantly and where she is incredibly mistaken for an arms dealer. Luckily Hank McCabe (Ed Marinaro), the detective her ex-husband hired to stalk her, fortunately saves her from worse trouble. David Hemmings is famous for two things: having made a film as an actor with Michelangelo Antonioni ("Blow Up") and having directed a film with Marlene Dietrich ("Gigolò"). The rest of his career is completely negligible. Including this movie.
cast: Connie Sellecca, Ed Marinaro, Pavel Douglas, Peter Bowles

title: Passport to Paris
synopsis: Little Melanie and Allyson Porter visit their grandfather Edward, the American ambassador to the Ville Lumière. The elderly official, who does not have much time to devote to his restless granddaughters, decides to organize a tour of the city: a young employee of the embassy is ready to accompany them, acting as their guide ...

title: Password: Uccidete agente Gordon

While in Paris he discovers that the ranks of the organization are in the hands of a theatrical impresario, Mrs. Kastiadis. Gordon also learns from Amalia that a shipment of weapons is about to reach the Far East and the gang is about to move to Madrid, where the expedition will take place. The spy thus moves to the Spanish capital ...

title: Past Lives
synopsis: At ten, Nora was forced to abandon the best friend and first love Hae Sung to follow the family, who decided to emigrate to Canada from South Korea. More than ten years later Nora, who lives in New York and studies in A script school decides to look for Hae Sung online and contact him.

title: Past Midnight
synopsis: Ben Jordan is on parole after fifteen years in prison for stabbing his wife to death. Laura, the social worker who follows her case, however, has doubts. Among them, among other things, there is some tender and the girl begins to think that the evidence on the basis of which Ben was convicted is not conclusive. Then he begins to think otherwise and therefore to fear for his life.

title: Past Tense
synopsis: Gene is an agent who is in the throes of a decidedly embarrassing murder. Only he, in fact, is certain of what happened: the victim's body is gone, there are no clues, there is no motive. The facts, as they arise, seem to escape any investigation. And who is really the girl in the house of which Gene saw the mangled body of the victim? A detective story that relies on situations that are anything but new in the genre, with a cast of character actors.
