title: Past-senger
synopsis: Nineties teen Kiao is a good-looking guy and a nuisance who likes to mess with people. His dream is to study architecture, but something unexpected happens and Kiao finds himself twenty-five years in the future. Bamee, a guy from 2022, is introverted and not really close to anyone. His father passed away and he's working hard to get into the architecture faculty with his father as an inspiration for living. (Source: Lazy Subber; MyDramaList)
tags: Gay Romance, LGBTQ+, Student Male Lead, School Setting, Young Adult Male Lead, University, 1990s, Love Triangle, Time Travel, Friendship
cast: Cooper Patpasit Na Songkhla, Marc Pahun Jiyacharoen

title: Pasta
synopsis: Seo Yu Gyeong endured the gruelling job of kitchen assistant at high-class restaurant La Sfera for three years in hopes of being promoted to chef. Things are looking up as she meets a handsome stranger on the street who ends up being the restaurant's new head chef. On his first day on the job, however, he fires all the female cooks, including Yu Gyeong. Yu Gyeong, too stubborn to let go of her dream, is willing to do whatever it takes to get her job back. Yu Gyeong struggles as she butts heads with the new chef while trying to learn everything she can from him at the same time, and sparks begin to fly. Things are complicated by the presence of Kim San, a charming customer with an eye for Yu Gyeong who seems to have mysterious ties to the restaurant, and O Sae Yeong, a famous TV Chef and former love of Hyeon Uk, not to mention the kitchen politics that get in the way of their budding romance.

Sixty years later, those children who have now become grandparents tell their memories of that extraordinary story of solidarity.

Pastorali

synopsis: For Como and his friends, each new adventure is a lesson on why it's important to be considerate — and to take care of one another!

The solution is found, unpredictable, when the teacher finds a handsome and understanding coach (Spencer Tracy). Jealousies, anger, quarrels and so on, but true feelings, in the end ...

Dreaming of the freedom of Patagonia, the two leave for a self -determination journey that will turn into a delusion of control and imprisonment.

synopsis: Matteo, in his thirties, returns after ten years of absence to Giugliano, near Naples. Sudden and continuous visions of the psato mix with those of the present. A way to reconstruct the stories of friends who are no longer there: among them, Antimo, killed by the carabinieri after a robbery gone bad; Michele, massacred by some thugs for defending a girl; Geggé who takes his own life after discovering that his father has stolen his savings; Anna, the girl he was engaged to, raped by his brother out of jealousy and revenge and Rosa, the victim of a violent husband. Matteo has actually returned to close the unfinished business and above all to help Rosa escape from her husband.

title: Paterno

title: Paterson
synopsis: Paterson drives buses in the New Jersey city of his own name. Every day he respects a sort of tried and tested routine: he crosses the usual route, observes the city adrift from his windshield, listens to fragments of the conversations of the people around him, writes poetry, goes for walks with his dog, stops in a bar and have a beer. Then he goes home to his wife Laura, whose world is constantly changing, made up of different and inspired dreams and projects. The two love each other: While Paterson supports her ambitions, Laura secretly appreciates her talent for poetry. Over the course of a week, their triumphs and defeats are observed, as well as those of the entire town of Paterson.

title: Path of Destruction
synopsis: An oil platform explodes and sinks in the middle of the Black Sea: the case is filed as a terrorist attack. Meanwhile, a series of environmental disasters begin to overwhelm Europe, causing the destruction of Rome and Paris. A young reporter begins to investigate and, together with the meteorologist who supports her, comes to discover the true cause of the devastation: on board the platform, experiments were underway on a particularly aggressive virus (generated thanks to nanotechnology) which, due to explosion, it escaped human control, broke free in the earth's stratosphere and upset the climatic equilibrium ...

title: Path to War
synopsis: The presidency of Lyndon Baines Johnson, from the inaugural ceremony in January 1965 until the end of his term in 1968. title: Pather Panchali
synopsis: The little Apu witnesses the sad condition of his fallen Bengali family, of Brahmin caste, at the beginning of the twentieth century. The elder sister Durga dies as a violent monsoon sweeps the village. The father, after losing his job, decides to move with his family to Benares.
cast: Kanu Bannerjee, Karuna Bannerjee, Subir Bannerjee, Runki Bannerjee

An ancient neighborhood inhabited by a vast proletariat now degraded by unemployment, television and the Camorra. Borrelli stands out for his courage in the fight against crime. He also often holds catechetical meetings with young people, and it is to one of them, Nunzio, an introverted thirteen year old, difficult and in need of affection, who is particularly attached.

Sattawat's mother owes a lot of money to Anusaniya's company and in order to erase the debt, Sattawat's mother and Anusaniya's aunt cook up a plan to marry Sattawat and Anusaniya to each other to get rid of the debt. Anusaniya's half-uncle, Chayakorn, breaks up with his girlfriend, Somika, and reveals his love for Anusaniya. Anusaniya, not wanting Chayakorn to have any hope, agrees to marry Sattawat. Desperate Somika falls for Sattawat but finds out that he belongs to Anusaniya, her greatest rival. In vengeance, Somika tries everything to split the couple.

Disguised as a cleaning man and with the bomb connected to a timer, Mancini gets stuck in the elevator with two unsuspecting employees, while his two accomplices, outside, should keep the situation under control. But things don't go as planned ...

synopsis: Life stories in a building on the Neapolitan suburbs which, in 1987, is about to be shot down to build an elevated one: among its inhabitants there is Anna, thirteen years old, the desire to grow quickly to become a woman like her mother, and l 'Meeting with the peer Peppino who will bring her to a world different from his.

synopsis: Rome, Asylum of S. Maria della Pietà. Some people cannot leave the park and cannot enter the old pavilions. Between archaeological documentary and science fiction film, Piano sul gruppo is the attempt to find a participatory cinema in search of new paths.

title: Piano, solo
synopsis: The story of Luca Flores, a brilliant Italian pianist who committed suicide in 1995: from his childhood in Africa - where the family moved to follow his father Giovanni, a geologist - to his return to Florence, where he graduated with full marks ...
cast: Kim Rossi Stuart, Michele Placido, Jasmine Trinca, Sandra Ceccarelli, Paola Cortellesi

title: Pianoforte
synopsis: Paolo, an established journalist, and Maria, a university student, are two drug addicts. The detox in the clinic seems at first to take them away from the circle. But it is only the illusion of a moment, especially for him. In fact, only Maria, thanks to the study of the piano, will be able to detach herself from drugs and return to normalcy. Comencini, here in her first work, chooses a difficult topic, but, also with the help of the screenwriter Vincenzo Cerami, she resolves it in a discreet and non-rhetorical way.
cast: Giulia Boschi, François Siener, Giovannella Grifeo

title: Pianosequenza
synopsis: The encounters and clashes of a group of people: the writer Paolo and his girlfriend Maria, the pimp Francesco and the poet Cupid ...

title: Piazza Fontana. Io ricordo
synopsis: Milan, 12 December 1969. A bomb explodes inside the headquarters of the National Bank of Agriculture in Piazza Fontana. The dead are seventeen and eighty eight are wounded. Italy is shocked by a criminal act that, more than twenty years after the end of the war, returns to kill innocent people, ordinary people and respectable people who are inside the bank on the occasion of the traditional farmers' bargaining Friday of the area. Among them there is also Pietro Dendena, who is killed in the explosion. His story is told thanks to his daughter Francesca, who was then only seventeen years old and who for the rest of her life fought together with the relatives of the victims to name those responsible for that massacre and establish the truth about what happened. afternoon.
cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Nicole Fornaro, Anna Ferruzzo, Simone Gandolfo, Lorenzo Cervasio, Claudia Vismara, Francesco Siciliano, Anna Maria De Luca, Alberto Basaluzzo, Stefano Fregni

title: Piazza Garibaldi
synopsis: On the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the Expedition of the Thousand, the director Davide Ferrario is organizing a trip that aims to revisit the most important stages that characterized the enterprise, stopping in the cities involved to check what remained of the meaning of that at the end of the nineteenth century he had tens of thousands of streets and squares dedicated to the hero Garibaldi. Starting from Bergamo, the city that provided the largest number of volunteers, and arriving in Campania, after passing through Sicily, Calabria and Basilicata, as well as from the descendants of those who participated in the unification of Italy, the documentary is accompanied by reading and staging of passages from classical Italian literature, interpreted by actors such as Filippo Timi, Luciana Littizzetto and Marco Paolini against the backdrop of the courtyard of the first Italian senate, at Palazzo Madama in Turin.
cast: Filippo Timi, Toni Servillo, Marco Paolini, Luciana Littizzetto, Salvatore Cantalupo

title: Piazza Giochi
synopsis: Valentina Tirone, a hippie and independent midwife, ends up in a coma due to a serious illness. His daughter Cassandra, an indocile sixteen year old who grew up around the world next to the woman who worked for Doctors Without Borders, is forced to reunite with Luciano Coscarello, her natural father, a well-known Roman palazzinaro, who lives with his new family Once in her new home, Cassandra meets Aurora, the wild half-sister of the same age who introduces her to her group of friends, who is daily in Piazza Giochi Delfici. To his surprise, he realizes that Cassandra is anything but intimidated and immediately engages with some of the guys in the group, including Nico, her current boyfriend and first cousin. Cassandra will elbow her way through the elite, spoiled and rowdy youth of the city, ending up bumping into her sister and finding herself involved in a love triangle between Nico and Romano, her best friend.
cast: Cecilia Albertini, Laura Adriani, Luca Ward, Susanna Smit, Andrea Montovoli, Lorenzo De Angelis, Dino Giarrusso

title: Piazza Vittorio
synopsis: Piazza Vittorio is the largest Roman square. It stands out for the multi-ethnic variety of its inhabitants. In fact, we find a group of ethnic groups near and far: Romans, Asians, North Africans, Indians who make the square and the neighborhood lively but at the same time difficult to manage. Due to its unique and colorful nature it is the residence of many artists and personalities linked to the world of cinema, including the master Abel Ferrara, who has decided to tell this world with his independent and poetic vision.

title: Piazza delle Cinque Lune
synopsis: The investigating judge Renato Saracini has arrived at his last day of work. A stranger awaits him in the hallway of his house and gives him an envelope. It is a super8 reel in which an attack is confusedly filmed. The next day, the judge confides in Branco, the head of his escort, and shows him the video. Meanwhile, the stranger contacts him again and gives him an appointment in a church, claiming to know where the original of the Moro Memorial is located. Saracini is convinced that this investigation is worthwhile and involves Branco and Ferdinanda Doni, a young deputy prosecutor, in the enterprise.
cast: Donald Sutherland, Giancarlo Giannini, Stefania Rocca, Aisha Cerami

title: Piazza pulita
cast: Tony Anthony, Adolfo Celi, Richard Conte, Corrado Gaipa, Lucretia Love

title: Picasso and Braque Go to the Movies
Picciridda - Con i piedi nella sabbia
synopsis: At the end of the Sixties, in a small fishing village, Lucia is an eleven-year-old girl whose parents emigrate to France in search of work, entrusting her to her grandmother Maria, a severe woman unable to express her feelings. As the months go by, Lucia's existence is filled with people and loved ones. Curiosity pushes her towards men, a mysterious world from which to stay away (as her grandmother says) or to be discovered (as Lucia thinks). One of them hides a terrible secret and Lucia will be a victim of it. In a hostile social context, Lucia will pay a very high price, but she will continue to struggle to grow with dignity, strength and optimism.

title: Piccola patria
synopsis: A group of young people from the north east of Italy and their families are forced to deal with the problems of everyday life in a world that is constantly changing. In a place where everyone has well-kept secrets, Luisa and the young Albanian Bilal are two boyfriends who hide from the world while Menon watches them and, driven by jealousy, seeks revenge for a sexual blackmail hatched by Luisa with her best friend. Franco, Luisa's father, is unhappy with his daughter's bond and is tense because of his xenophobic prejudices. The tragedy will loom on the horizon due to the male solidarity between Franco and Menon, capable of ruining the existence of all those around them.
cast: Maria Roveran, Vladimir Doda, Roberta Da Soller, Lucia Mascino, Mirko Artuso, Diego Ribon, Nicoletta Maragno, Giulio Brogi, Mateo Cili

cast: Luciano Marica, Vari Pescatori

title: Piccola posta
synopsis: Around the very popular column published by the newspaper "Adamo ed Eva" and edited by the self-styled Lady Eva (Franca Valeri), an incredible series of misunderstandings are unleashed. Starting from the identity of the witch writer, countess on paper, borgatara in life. Fake barons, fallen millionaires and aspiring actresses will buzz around her.

title: Piccola santa
synopsis: A young surgeon with the hope of a brilliant career is dominated by his mother, a countess who considers the medical profession too bourgeois. In fact, the woman wants her son to marry a high-ranking girl and leave surgery to devote himself to the administration of his own estates. On his way to the countryside, the young doctor has the opportunity to meet the farmer's daughter, whom he falls in love with, reciprocated.
cast: Virna Lisi, Rosario Borelli, Tina Lattanzi, Virgilio Riento, Rossana Rory, Nino Pavese, Gianna Antonini, Annette Ciarli

title: Piccole labbra
synopsis: The Austrian Paul, a veteran of the Great War, returns to his country house, where he befriends a 12-year-old girl, Eva. In her Paul finds all the feminine sensuality ready to blossom, but he knows very well that he cannot take advantage of it because of the war wounds. Thus he cultivates a platonic love that leads him to write a novel about Eve.

title: Piccoli crimini coniugali
synopsis: After suffering a bad domestic accident, Elia returns home from the hospital completely devoid of memory: he reasons but does not remember, he no longer recognizes his wife, who tries to reconstruct their life as a couple, piece by piece, trying to obscure the shadows. As forgotten information is brought to light, cracks appear: there are many things that begin to not return. Why is she lying? And why does she not want to give herself physically to him, who is also strongly attracted to her? Why does he - who claims to be completely devoid of memory - remember certain details of the honeymoon?
cast: Margherita Buy, Sergio Castellitto

title: Piccoli equivoci
synopsis: The whole story takes place in an apartment. The protagonists are six young prose actors: Paolo, who loves Francesca; Piero, Francesca's new flame; Enrico, where Paolo is to be transferred; Sophie and her boyfriend Giuliano. All are linked by a multiple tangle of jealousies, rivalries, suspicions; the accommodating ending is just an interlude of respite. A decent Italian film directed by Ricky Tognazzi, based on the play of the same name by Claudio Bigagli. The anxieties and uncertainties of a generation staged with some affectation, and with the usual dining room breath. The least worst of director Tognazzi's films, however.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Lina Sastri, Nancy Brilli, Roberto Citran

title: Piccoli fuochi

title: Piccoli segreti, grandi bugie
synopsis: The journalist Mara lives in Turin and works for a highly rated travel portal. Luca Visconti, on the other hand, is the owner of a refined hotel located in an ancient Abruzzo village. The two meet at the station and like each other right away, ending up in bed together. A not very generous article about Luca's hotel and a wife unwilling to let her husband go will complicate the relationship between the two.
cast: Chiara Francini, Giuseppe Zeno, Maria Luisa Crescenzo, Sara D'Amario, Lavinia Biagi, Paolo Romano, Lydia Biondi, Luca Terracciano

title: Piccolo alpino
synopsis: It is April 1915. A boy goes to the mountains with his father, but a storm separates him from him. Left alone, he joins a regiment that is leaving for the front after the declaration of war on Austria and in a short time becomes the mascot of the soldiers. Fallen into the hands of his enemies, he is locked up in an orphanage. Here he makes friends with a peer with whom he escapes. Cross the lines again and bring valuable information to the Italians. In the final offensive the boy will also find his father believed dead. From the novel by Salvator Gotta. Tears and action for an all-Italian epic, now largely ridiculous.
cast: Elio Sannangelo, Mario Ferrari, Filippo Scelzo, Ernesto Almirante, Cesco Baseggio

title: Piccolo corpo
synopsis: On a small island of the Italian North East, in a winter in the early twentieth century, the young Agata loses her daughter at birth. The Catholic tradition says that, in the absence of breath, the girl cannot be baptized. His soul is condemned to limbo, without name and without peace. But a voice reaches the ears of Agata: on the north mountains there seems to be a place where children are brought back to life a time of breath, the one necessary to baptize them. Agata secretly leaves the island and undertakes a dangerous journey attached to this hope, with the small body of the daughter hidden in a box, but does not know the road and has never seen the snow in her life. He meets Lince, a wild and lonely boy, who knows the territory and offers her help in exchange for the mysterious content of the box. Despite mutual distrust, an adventure begins in which courage and friendship will allow both of them to approach a miracle that seems impossible.
cast: Ondina Quadri, Celeste Cescutti

title: Piccolo grande amore
synopsis: In the Lichtenhaus, a small state on the brink of bankruptcy, it is decided to marry the rebellious Princess Sofia with the heir to the throne of an equally unlikely neighboring kingdom. But Sofia escapes for a holiday in Sardinia where she meets a handsome surf instructor and falls in love with him. Meanwhile, a courtier, who is plotting to turn the statelet into a casino, has the girl kidnapped.
cast: Barbara Snellenburg, Raoul Bova, David Warner, Susannah York

title: Piccolo mondo antico
synopsis: In Italy there is a general ferment against Austrian domination. The young scion of a noble family adheres to the ideas of progress and comes into conflict with his aunt, his guardian, especially when he marries a girl of the people. In retaliation, the aunt makes the girl's father lose his job. Later the girl of the two young people drowns. Soldati, in collaboration with Lattuada, signs a film considered among the most important of the "calligraphic" school, based on the classic by Fogazzaro. Charismatic actors, exquisite period re-enactment, and an intense and participatory direction.
cast: Alida Valli, Massimo Serato, Ada Dondini, Annibale Betrone

title: Pick Me Up
synopsis: In a desert area, after an accident, a group of passengers on a bus tries to reach the inhabited centers in a different way. Stacia decides to walk twenty kilometers in the direction of a motel; someone remains in the bus waiting for help; Birdy and Danny, on the other hand, accept the passage of a psychopathic truck driver who can't wait to tear them apart ...

title: Pick of the Litter

title: Picking Up & Dropping Off
synopsis: Will Chaney, a divorced father, travels to the Denver airport to pick up his son Ben after returning from a summer trip. Meet Jane, a divorced woman who has a daughter Ben's age. After the initial doubts caused by the failure of their respective marriages, the two will find the courage to fall in love.
cast: Scott Wolf, Amanda Detmer, Eddie McClintock, Rachelle Lefevre, Roger Haskett, Liam Ranger, Maggie Hill, Aleks Paunovic, Stephen Strachan, Benita Ha

title: Picking Up the Pieces
synopsis: Tex, a kosher butcher from New York, is a repentant under the protection of the federal government of Arizona. Tex in a fit of jealousy killed his wife Candy, after discovering that she was cheating on him with the sheriff and tore her to pieces. To try to hide the broken body of his wife Tex, he leaves for Mexico. On the way, however, he loses a hand which is mistaken for a relic capable of working miracles. All because a blind woman stumbled over it and regained her sight. The news spreads and thousands of people flock. It is at this point that Father Carillo intervenes ...
cast: Woody Allen, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Sharon Stone, David Schwimmer, Elliott Gould, Alfonso Arau, Mia Maestro

title: Pickpocket
synopsis: Surprised in an attempted robbery, after a long "career" of thefts experienced as transgression, Michel ends up in prison. When he goes out he becomes a professional thief. A new arrest and the relationship with a single mother will be the vehicle for a newfound peace with himself. At the center of Dostoevsky's parable, dry and anti-narrative, a character trapped between the opposite automatisms of social integration and revolt. Bresson directs a "short novel" without music, playing with details of the hands and on Emrican planes of non-actors, building a realism of the soul, absolutely earthly, showing the invisible in the visible.
cast: Martin Lassalle, Marika Green, Pierre Leymarie, Jean Pélegri, Dolly Scal, Pierre Etaix

title: Pickpockets

The girl naturally ignores the contents of the document entrusted to her. Unfortunately for her, the purse with the precious microfilm is stolen from her in the subway by a mugger.
cast: Richard Widmark, Jean Peters, Thelma Ritter, Richard Kiley, Roger Moore (II)

title: Picnic
synopsis: In Kansas, Labor Day is celebrated with a picnic on the grass. Madge and Millie, the no longer young teacher Rosemary, family friend Howard and Alan, Madge's boyfriend, prepare for the event. But this year there is something new: it is Hal Carter, a friend of Alan. Its presence acts as a catalyst for all tensions in the group. From a famous comedy by William Inge, the newcomer (at the cinema) Logan directs a choral film, a bitter drama about the American provincial bourgeoisie.
cast: William Holden, Kim Novak, Susan Strasberg, Rosalind Russell, Cliff Robertson

title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
synopsis: On the first Valentine's Day of this century, a group of girls from the aristocratic college of Appleyard are taken on a trip to the mountain called Hanging Rock. Some of them will disappear without explanation. The film that made Peter Weir famous. A sort of all-female thriller, allusive, exciting and impalpable, which preserves the mystery to the last, suspending the places between reality and dream and transforming itself into a reflection (dear to the author) between civilization and nature.
cast: Rachel Roberts, Vivian Gray, Helen Morse, Jacki Weaver, Anne Lambert, Dominic Guard, Kirsty Child, Karen Robson, Jane Vallis

So she decides to move to Toronto with her photographer boyfriend Billy Stuart when, speaking only French, she is mistakenly mistaken for Lily Warden, a woman who killed a smuggler in a coffee shop. While the police hunt down an unsuspecting Claire, two sadistic criminals go after Lily.

Even his mother would like him engaged and Kate, exasperated and on the advice of her colleague Darcy, invents a boyfriend, gives him a name, Nick and, as a precaution, places him in another city. Fake engagement gives coupons.

One day George's daughters and Vicky's son, who are good friends instead, jokingly decide to submit their names to the "Perfect Family" contest, pretending that they are all brothers and that Vicky and George are husband and wife.

However, she finds herself at the center of a mysterious murder case when the bridegroom of one of the ceremonies you followed is killed. The suspicions immediately fall on Greg, brother of Allie and ex -boyfriend of the bride. Allie will then lead his personal investigations to exonerate his brother collaborating with Sam, the new detective in force.

Realizing the evening of his dreams, however, will not be easy at all: he will have to fight on the one hand with his father, overprotective and worried about his new gallant acquaintances, on the other with a squadron of Drew's fierce ex-girlfriends, well determined to keep Mandy away. from their object of desire. With the help of her friends she will face all the difficulties that stand between her and the most awaited party of the year, discovering however all the price of popularity ...

title: Pidä huivista Kiinni, Tatjana
synopsis: Finland, 1960s; Two friends, Valto and Reino traveling on a black Volga, meet two women, one Estonian and the other Russian, who join their wanderings. But establishing a communication relationship is a difficult undertaking, mostly due to the "blocks" from which the two Finns are burdened. Then, little by little, even the feelings manage to manifest themselves and conquer a certain space of their own. In about an hour Aki Kaurismäki elaborates an analysis of characters characterized by the difficulty of opening up, of looking for something outside of oneself. No dramas, indeed a comedy tone, where however the irony, however good-natured, leaves its mark equally.
cast: Kati Uotinen, Matti Pellonpää, Kirsi Tikkuläinen, Mato Valtonen

title: Piece
synopsis: University student Mizuho Suga learns that her former high school classmate Haruka Origuchi died from an illness. At her funeral, Mizuho meets another former high school classmate Hikaru Narumi. In their high school days, Hikaru Narumi was famous for being a playboy. Mizuho and Hikaru Narumi were also in a special relationship. Hikaru was outgoing, but Mizuho found it difficult to make new friends. They once kissed in the classroom and went on a one day summer trip together. They weren't friends or lovers and kept their relationship a secret. Meanwhile, Haruka Origuchi's mother tries to talk to Mizuho, believing Mizuho was her daughter's best friend. Haruka's mother asks about Haruka's boyfriend. Haruka became pregnant with her boyfriend in the past. (Source: AsianWiki)

cast: Vanessa Kirby, Shia LaBeouf, Ellen Burstyn, Molly Parker, Sarah Snook, Iliza Shlesinger, Benny Safdie, Jimmie Fails

title: Pied Piper
synopsis: Every day on the job is tense, dangerous and possibly lethal! synopsis: An anomalous figure in the context of our culture Pasolini, an anomalous figure Laura Betti, singer, actress, writer and now also a director. Because, by editing interviews and excerpts from films, delegating to the great friend of PPP and great poet and writer Paolo Volponi (it is moving to see and listen to Pier Paolo again but it is also moving to see and listen to Paolo Volponi again) the story of the most private and most intimate PPP, choosing and organizing or, at times, disorganizing her materials, Betti goes with a sure hand to the essentials, without indictment, because images and words speak for themselves. Didactic film, conceived above all for those who have no memory of Pasolini, his film is inextricably linked with political aesthetic ethics. In it, PPP appears to us "in the present", because it speaks to us of what it first intuited, understood and explained to the point of death, and of what won and changed us, of the world in which we are and of which we are clearly aware also thanks to films to poems to novels to interviews with essays to reviews to conversations to recitations of the most important and necessary Italian prophet of the twentieth century.

Third: abandoned by his wife, he finds consolation in the contemplation of a tiger. Fourth: An old homeless man spends an unexpected night of love with a concierge. Agosti recovers the episodic structure typical of Italian comedy, but the (real) stories he tells are examples of how the most radical starting realism can acquire an almost surreal aura thanks to the staging. Excellent photography, which is by Agosti himself, a singular character in the Italian panorama.

Edda and Galeazzo tell each other without modesty and travel in the labyrinths of a gloomy story, he with the jokes of his diaries and she with the statements made in an interview of many years ago.

title: Queimada

Gillo Pontecorvo wastes a good subject to make his political metaphor immediately evident (in the middle of the Vietnam War).

title: Quel Pap'occhio di 30 anni fa
synopsis: In 1980 Renzo Arbore directed the film Il Pap'occhio, facing a thousand misadventures that for almost thirty years did not make the entire work visible to the public. Seized before being released in the hall for insult to the Catholic religion and the Pope, the work was fleetingly released in theaters only twenty years later and later in a home video edition from which several fragments still considered outrageous were absent. We have to wait until 2009 to see the film in a new edition in which the most incriminated scene is inserted, Roberto Benigni's dialogue on the Pope and Christianity. Fabrizio Corallo, with the help of Luca Nannini, reconstructs the whole story by meeting the interested parties who tell unpublished anecdotes and judicial vicissitudes.

title: Quel bandito sono io
synopsis: From the comedy of the same name by Peppino De Filippo: a Neapolitan bandit goes to the bank to sell a fake banknote and realizes, with great surprise, that the cashier is his double. From this moment on, all people who try to get in touch with him are mysteriously eliminated.

Oderisi's initiatives for revenge have no better fate towards Olimpo's wife. At which, the two men sign an apparent armistice, but the consequences will be very heavy for both. Good ladies, on the other hand, enjoy themselves with lovers.
cast: Edwige Fenech, Pippo Franco, Karin Schubert, Umberto D'Orsi

title: Quel maledetto giorno d'inverno... Django e Sartana...
synopsis: Black City has long been subjected to raids by a gang of gringos. Just when the new sheriff arrives, the bounty hunter Django shows up and clashes with the bandits. He is about to get the worst of it, but is saved by the decisive intervention of the young guardian of the law, up to that moment anxious to avoid any confrontation. At the time of collecting the bounty it turns out that the sheriff is actually Sartana, a well-known gunslinger and also a bounty hunter. Continuous carnage, costs reduced to a minimum and plot inconsistencies for one of the last serious spaghetti westerns, while the parodies of Trinity were already taking hold.
cast: Hunt Powers, Simone Blondell, Stet Carson, Dean Stratford, Dennys Colt

title: Quel maledetto giorno della resa dei conti

They are soon joined by a German deserter, but events lead them to take the place of a special patrol of American soldiers tasked with neutralizing an armored train carrying material of enormous strategic importance. A classic war film that keeps an eye on spectacle rather than verisimilitude. Cult by Quentin Tarantino.

title: Quel movimento che mi piace tanto
synopsis: The lawyer and honorable Fabrizio Siniscalchi, advised by his cousin Salvatore, decides to switch to a party of the left. Having been discharged in a hurry and for political reasons, the noblewoman meditates revenge and tries to implement it, helped by her friend Marquis Cecco Ottobuoni who puts her in contact with the young and beautiful prostitute Anna. The intention of the two aristocrats is to foster a relationship between the prostitute and the honorable member, in order to create a scandal that ruins her political career.

title: Quel pomeriggio maledetto
synopsis: Harry Chapman (Lee Van Cleef), a robber, is released from prison thanks to the intercession of members of a criminal organization, but once outside is forced to work for them. The father Vittorio, recently hit by a heart attack, and the mother Marinella dream of being able to give new life to their marriage in crisis, the daughter Eleonora - single mother - to reconnect with the beauty of the country Antonio and the fifteen year old son Matteo, sent back to school in as many as three subjects, to conquer the little girl and young Fiorenza, whom he had thought of all winter. Clashing with dreams and hopes, the Rienzis will experience an important and revolutionary summer for their lives.

title: Quella villa in fondo al parco

cast: David Warbeck, Janet Agren, Eva Grimaldi

title: Quelle sporche anime dannate

In defense of the settlers, Tom Kanter intervenes, a man who is looking for a certain Ringo who, years earlier, during a robbery, had killed his brother Jerry. synopsis: Giobatta, a super-gifted erotic performer in a nightclub, succumbs to his wife's jealousy, involves her in the show and fails: the natural consequence is that he is downgraded. Antonio Pecoraro, on the other hand, is an architect who, in bed with a friend's daughter, discovers many things about his wife and daughter. In the final episode, the Jesuit Monsignor Ascanio La Costa is stuck in the elevator with the provocative Donatella ...

director: Luigi Magni, Luigi Comencini, Nanni Loy

title: Quelli del casco

cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Mario Ferrari, Cesco Baseggio

title: Quello che cerchi
synopsis: A private detective finds himself having to investigate a teenager who spends his time between one community center and another. Davide, as the boy is called, could be the result of a relationship that the investigator had with a former flame. Only Michèle, Davide's mother could shed light on the question and on Impero's desire for paternity.
cast: Marcello Mazzarella, Antal Nagy, Stefania Orsola Garello

title: Quello che le ragazze non dicono
synopsis: Francesca, Alice, Paola and Laura are four girls who live in the hectic Milan. Friends have always had a habit they cannot give up: they see each other every week in a restaurant and confide in each other the little facts about their work, their families and their loves. Then Gigi enters their life, a likeable but penniless musician whom all four will fall in love with.

title: Quello strano desiderio

title: Quelque chose qui vit et brûle
synopsis: Throughout Europe, from 1939 to 1945, men and women of the Resistance, sentenced to death, wrote to their loved ones the quintessence of their "life for which to die". No plea, no cry, no lightning: on the contrary, a luminous invitation, supported by a singular polyphony of voices and music, to think about the meaning to give to life, to love, the love of life.

title: Quelques heures de printemps
synopsis: Alain (Vincent Lindon) tried to turn his life around by trying to get over 50 kilos of cannabis across the French border. The police, however, caught him and took him to jail. Sentenced to 18 months, he has the opportunity to serve his sentence under house arrest and, with no other choice, returns to live in the house of his old mother, with whom he must learn to live together before discovering that she is seriously ill with cancer in terminal phase.

title: Quelques mots d'amour

The next day, Romain has to leave for vacation and promises to write Sophie a romantic love letter. She decides to believe him, but not everything will go as planned ...

title: Quentin Durward
synopsis: Quentin Durward, a Scottish knight, is sent to France to take a look at the daughter of the Duke of Burgundy that his rich old uncle would like to marry. The girl, whose name is Isabella and who does not want to know about the marriage, has meanwhile taken refuge with Louis XI of France. Quentin follows the Duchess and even saves her from the ambush of a rebel count. It is almost superfluous to add that, at this point, between the two young people ...

In the corner of the city, the sailor weaves a series of clandestine relationships: he reports the murderer Gil, with whom he is in love, to the police; then he seduces his brother's lover and lets himself be possessed by the owner of the port restaurant, while the ship's captain has a secret passion for him ...

title: Querido Fidel

In the family his wife Elena and his granddaughter Celia support the battle of him with love. But his son Ernesto is the painful thorn in the side: he is a devotee of the American dream. They are the dawn of a new era and, while the world celebrates the end of the Cold War, in the Tagliavini family the battle rages.

title: Quest for Camelot
synopsis: Kayley, a lady in King Arthur's court, aspires to become a member of the Knights of the Round Table. So when Ruber, the villain on duty, steals the legendary Excalibur, the girl goes in search of it.

title: Quest for Love
synopsis: The scientist Colin Trafford discovers that he belongs to the category of the "double track": two contemporary lives of the same subject. He reconciles with the wife of the "other", but she dies. Somewhere there must also be a "double" of her. An original variation on the theme of conjugal love conducted with discrete sensitivity.
cast: Joan Collins, Tom Bell, Denholm Elliott, Laurence Naismith, Geraldine Gardner, Geraldine Moffat, David Weston, Dudley Foster

title: Questa notte parlami dell'Africa

Emma, ​​a lawyer who lives a deep personal crisis, decides to take a break starting for Africa. The young Nuri, on the other hand, narrow among the rigid moral codes of the Muslim family from which he comes, nourishes the desire to find out what is out of his world. The two will come into contact with a group of activists engaged in the fight against the poaching of elephants, including the fascinating and mysterious Dylan and Finn, a young man with a stormy past. Emma and Nuri will deal with their inner ghosts and discover their own way, following it without regrets.

title: Questa notte è ancora nostra

However, according to the manager, to meet the success of the public it is necessary to include a female presence in the group. The chosen one is the beautiful and talented Jing, of Chinese origin, whose character is rather hostile ...
cast: Nicolas Vaporidis, Ilaria Spada, Valentina Izumi, Massimiliano Bruno, Franco Califano, Maurizio Mattioli

title: Questa specie d'amore
synopsis: Federico Ferrari (Ugo Tognazzi) has made a marriage that has elevated him socially compared to his humble origins, but he is not happy, just as his wife Giovanna is not. The troubled return to Parma (from Rome) resolves the situation. Great Tognazzi, but Bevilacqua's direction is what it is.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Jean Seberg, Ewa Aulin, Angelo Infanti, Evi Maltagliati

title: Questa storia qua
synopsis: Vasco Rossi can be considered to all intents and purposes the greatest Italian rock singer-songwriter, able since his debut to attract the attention of thousands of fans thanks to the lyrics, now provocative now romantic, of his songs. Surrounded by an aura of genius and recklessness, which amplified his success and myth, the Emilian singer is the protagonist of this documentary in which he traces the links with his origins, with old childhood friends and new, well-known street doing, and reconstructs the genesis of the songs with which he made entire generations dream.
cast: Vasco Rossi

title: Questa volta parliamo di uomini
synopsis: Four episodes with Manfredi in the role of as many characters. A wealthy industrialist discovers that his wife steals and blackmails. When he is in dire straits he induces her to continue. An old knife thrower ends up killing his partner and finds it difficult to find a new one. A farmer makes a great living by exploiting his wife's work. A professor makes his wife believe that he was killed by her.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Luciana Paluzzi, Milena Vukotic, Margaret Lee

title: Questa è la vita
synopsis: Four-episode film based on Pirandello's short stories. In _La giara_ a walking umbrella maker, after having repaired a jar, remains locked inside. In _Il Ventaglino_ a young woman without work and without a home asks for charity in a park. In _La patente_ a father of a family with a reputation as a jinx obtains a document from the court that proves his condition. In _Marsina narrow_ an old professor invited to the wedding of one of his very poor ex-pupils, borrowed a tailcoat.
cast: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Lucia Bosé, Myriam Bru, Walter Chiari
director: Giorgio Pàstina, Mario Soldati, Luigi Zampa, Aldo Fabrizi

title: Queste pazze, pazze donne
synopsis: Episode movies. "La garçonierre": an industrialist with his amente and his secretary with their respective mistress captain, by a strange coincidence, in the same apartment. Misunderstandings to no end. "Gentil sex": a young Roman in the company of a foreigner is threatened by the brothers of his ex not to be seen again in their neighborhood. He will be defended by the girl's friends, wrestlers. "Few but good": due to a car accident, a moralist is forced to stay in an apartment frequented by girls in skimpy clothes. "Siciliani a Milano": Two Sicilian wine merchants ask their wives to be nice to their customers, but ... Super cast wasted in a series of jokes not even sexual. Thus began the decline of the Italian comedy.
cast: Raimondo Vianello, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Enrico Maria Salerno

title: Questi fantasmi
synopsis: He believes in ghosts, but his wife's lover is made of flesh and blood. With a gimmick he saves face and love.
cast: Sophia Loren, Vittorio Gassman, Mario Adorf, Aldo Giuffré

title: Questi fantasmi
synopsis: From the homonymous comedy by Eduardo De Filippo: Pasquale and Maria live in a dilapidated Neapolitan palace, according to the legend inhabited by ghosts. The adulterous Maria, discovered by her husband, manages to make him believe that her lover is none other than one of the ghosts. Pasquale wants to believe in deception, even against any evidence to the contrary.
cast: Renato Rascel, Maria Frau, Erno Crisa, Franca Valeri, Ugo D'Alessio

title: Questi giorni
synopsis: A provincial town. Between the old walls, in the nocturnal raids on the seafront, in the enchantment of a temporary encroachment into nature, the daily rituals and expectations of four girls are consummated, whose friendship is not born of overwhelming passions, common interests or great ideals. What unites them are not affinities but habits, occasional enthusiasms, harmless contrasts, feelings cultivated in secret. Their bond is nevertheless unique and unrepeatable, just as the few days of the journey they make together to accompany one of them to Belgrade can be unique and unrepeatable, where a mysterious friend and an unlikely job opportunity await her.
cast: Margherita Buy, Maria Roveran, Marta Gastini, Caterina Le Caselle, Laura Adriani, Filippo Timi, Alessandro Averone, Mina Djukic

title: Questi pazzi, pazzi italiani
synopsis: It is a collage made of songs, interpreted by the most famous singers of the time, and sewn from a series of animated drawings. It is part of a trilogy with The Avenue of the Song and 008 Rhythm Operation.

title: Questione di cuore
synopsis: Alberto, screenwriter, has a disorderly and complex life. A sentimental relationship that floats, a professional life in the balance. Paradoxically, what puts him back into play is a heart attack that squeezes his heart and confronts him with the need to choose. During his hospital stay he makes friends with his roommate, Angelo, a coachbuilder. And when the two come out of rehabilitation, they decide to support each other. To the point that Alberto moved for a period to live with his friend. A decision that will prove to be fraught with consequences and responsibility.
cast: Antonio Albanese, Paolo Villaggio, Micaela Ramazzotti, Kim Rossi Stuart, Francesca Inaudi, Chiara Noschese

title: Questione di karma
synopsis: Giacomo is the latest heir of a dynasty of industrialists but, rather than taking an interest in the company, he prefers to deal with his thousand passions. His life was marked by the death of his father when he was very young, and this led him to neither grow up nor take responsibility. The encounter with Ludovic Stern, an eccentric French esotericist, changes his life; in fact, the scholar claims to have identified the current reincarnation of Giacomo's father. This is Mario Fibonacci, a man far from spiritual, interested only in money and indebted to half the city. This seemingly absurd encounter will change the lives of both of them.
cast: Elio Germano, Fabio De Luigi, Stefania Sandrelli, Daniela Virgilio, Valentina Cenni, Massimo De Lorenzo, Corrado Solari, Isabella Ragonese, Philippe Leroy, Eros Pagni

title: Questo amore ai confini del mondo
cast: Antonio Cifariello, Dominique Wilms, Fausto Tozzi, Egle Martin

title: Questo e quello
synopsis: Two-episode film. "This ... impossible love": Giulio (Pozzetto) is a comic artist who has not yet decided whether to be punk or hippie and is also in a professional crisis. Then, one evening, he meets a beautiful Swede whom he immediately falls in love with. In an attempt to show her all his love in comic strips, Giulio finds his lost creative vein. But disappointment is inevitable when he finds out that the big girl has been hired by her editor. "The one with the golden beret": Sandro (Manfredi), a distinguished 60-year-old intellectual, awakens the senses of a frustrated girl, the daughter of a woman with whom he had a relationship in the past.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Renato Pozzetto, Sylva Koscina, Janet Agren

title: Questo film è dedicato a David Riesman e si intitolerà Capolavoro
synopsis: Film in homage to the American sociologist David Riesman, a scholar of the relationship between sociology and other disciplines.
cast: Piero Bargellini

title: Questo mondo è per te
synopsis: Teo (Matteo Petrini), a 19-year-old boy who has just graduated, dreams of becoming a writer but, due to the sudden health problems of his father Italo (Paolo Sassanelli), finds himself having to be economically autonomous. Determined not to abandon his studies, Teo accepts a series of precarious, often absurd jobs, which help him to continue with even more strength and awareness, also thanks to the help of his mother Laura (Cecilia Dazzi) and the young Chiara (Eugenia Costantini) , of which he is in love.
cast: Matteo Petrini, Cecilia Dazzi, Fabrizia Sacchi, Paolo Sassanelli, Eugenia Costantini

title: Questo pazzo, pazzo mondo della canzone
synopsis: A real plot does not exist because the film serves only as a container for the various curtains that surround the singing performances of some famous singers of the sixties. In order: Gianni Morandi, Edoardo Vianello, Lucio Dalla, Petula Clark, Nico Fidenco, Gino Paoli, Luigi Tenco, Little Tony, I Flippers, Ricky Gianco, Los Marcellos Ferial, Jenny Luna and many others.
cast: Sandra Mondaini, Aroldo Tieri, Valeria Fabrizi

title: Questo piccolo grande amore
synopsis: It is 1972 (the year of the publication of the homonymous album by Claudio Baglioni) and Italy is crossed by the ferment of youth movements. It is during an event that Andrea, a university student, meets Giulia, who is still in high school. The spark bursts between the two: the beginning of a love story which, as in Baglioni's album, will go through various phases.
cast: Emanuele Bosi, Mary Petruolo, Daniela Giordano, Mariella Valentini, Federico Galante, Claudio Cotugno

title: Questo sporco mondo meraviglioso
synopsis: Among the many topics covered by the Movie world there are the consequences of pollution on the inhabitants of a Japanese fishing village; some group psychotherapy techniques adopted in the United States; experimentation on animals of drug effects; the artificial fertilization practiced in a Swedish clinic; a dance between homosexuals in London; an operation to the heart of the American surgeon de Bikey; a dog fight in Japan; sex education given to blind children in Sweden; the military training of Palestinian children in Lebanon; the teaching of birth control techniques in Sweden; abortion by the state and at the same time the care of female sterility; the celebration of the mass by a woman-sacerode; A school for focomelic children.

title: Questo è un uomo
synopsis: March 1982. Primo Levi, a Piedmontese writer, walks in the mountains when he sprains his ankle. He is alone, wounded, on the edge of a precipice. He is saved by a mysterious man, who takes him with him to his cabin, wraps his ankle and gives him hospitality. It is to him that Levi tells his story: childhood in Turin, school, racial laws and the brief interlude in the Resistance until his arrest on 13 December 1943, with the decision to declare himself a Jew rather than a partisan and avoid so to be shot. Primo Levi is first interned in the Fossoli Camp, then deported to Auschwitz on February 22, 1944, where he will remain until 1945. When he returns to Turin, the writer feels the need to tell what happened in Auschwitz and in the other concentration camps. in the book If This Is a Man. The work, rejected by Einaudi, is published by a small publisher and sells only a thousand copies, but receives the beautiful review by Italo Calvino. Levi remained a Sunday writer until 1956, when the book was republished by Einaudi and became an international success. And while he recounts his life, Levi discovers the identity of his mysterious interlocutor.
cast: Thomas Trabacchi, Sandra Toffolatti, Werner Waas, Luca Angeletti, Majlinda Agaj, Orlando Bruno, Gianni Bissaca, Alessandra Sgura, Stella Clozza

title: Qui
synopsis: In Val di Susa, a group of people find themselves sharing the fight against the construction of the high-speed railway line and tell of how democracy is a fragile asset that requires constant attention and constant questioning.

title: Qui a envie d'être aimé?
synopsis: Antoine is forty years old. He lives happily with his wife, is the father of two beautiful children, has a bright future as a lawyer ahead of him. It can be said that his life is a successful one: one day, however, Antoine has an unexpected, irrational and overwhelming encounter: he meets God and his existence is completely upset.
cast: Eric Caravaca, Arly Jover, Valérie Bonneton, Jean Luc Bideau, Benjamin Biolay, Philippe Duquesne, Quentin Grosset, Arauna Bernheim Dennery

title: Qui a tué Bambi?
synopsis: Isabelle takes a course to become a nurse. At the hospital she meets Doctor Philipp, a serious and respected surgeon, and is very impressed by his coldness. Over time, the girl begins to suspect that the surgeon is dealing with strange incidents that occurred in another hospital. When she discovers the truth, a real nightmare begins for her.
cast: Sophie Quinton, Laurent Lucas, Catherine Jacob, Yasmine Belmadi

title: Qui comincia l'avventura
synopsis: The quiet life of an ironer (Cardinal) who lives in a small village in Puglia is upset by the arrival in the village of a confident motorcyclist (Vitti): fascinated by the lifestyle of the newcomer, she decides to change her life and follow her to Milan .
cast: Monica Vitti, Claudia Cardinale, Ninetto Davoli, Guido Leontini

title: Qui non è il Paradiso
synopsis: A perfect shot. An armored van of the Post Office is emptied without anyone noticing, without weapons, or shootings. An investigation begins and a suspect is immediately identified. This is Renato, the driver of the van. He is not at home but he has left an alarm clock stabbed by a knife on the wall which means goodbye routine. The hunt is on and Inspector Lucidi sets out on the trail of Renato's best friend, who has also mysteriously disappeared.
cast: Fabrizio Gifuni, Erika Bernardi, Antonio Catania, Ugo Conti

title: Qui rido io
synopsis: The actor and playwright Eduardo Scarpetta will be considered the king of Neapolitan comedians. Natural father of Titina, Eduardo and Peppino De Filippo, he dedicates his entire life to the theater, creating works that will become timeless classics, such as Miseria and Nobiltà. He will get extraordinary successes and will also be the protagonist of a famous dispute with Gabriele D'Annunzio for Il son of Iorio, a parody of the poet's work, which will be the subject of a memorable trial.
cast: Toni Servillo, Maria Nazionale, Cristiana Dell'Anna, Antonia Truppo, Eduardo Scarpetta, Paolo Pierobon, Lino Musella, Roberto De Francesco, Gianfelice Imparato, Iaia Forte, Alessandro Manna, Salvatore Battista, Marzia Onorato

title: Qui?
synopsis: Two young engaged couples, Claude (Tinti) and Marina (Schneider), crash into the sea with their car. Having survived the accident, the girl is hosted by Serge (Ronet), Claude's brother, who suspects her of having concocted a cunning plan to get rid of her boyfriend. But, surprisingly, the man reappears. Thriller without much suspense, with an absolutely wasted Schneider.
cast: Romy Schneider, Gabriele Tinti, Maurice Ronet, Simone Bach, Jacques Duby, Jean Jacques Bourgeous, Anne Marie Coffinet

title: Quick
synopsis: A mysterious brunette kills a gangster and his bodyguard in a Los Angeles boutique. The brunette, who is actually blonde, is called Quick (Teri Polo) and is a killer on behalf of a drug agent. Quick, however, also accepts other assignments, such as that of a mobster who wants to get rid of Herschel, a witness kept under surveillance by the FBI. But there is something that stinks and Quick instead of killing Herschel kidnaps him and takes him away.A good action movie that maybe a little bit like Nikita, but it works well on his legs, thanks also to the interpretation of Teri Polo , an almost revelation.
cast: Teri Polo, Martin Donovan, Jeff Fahey, Tia Carrere, Robert Davi

title: Quick Change
synopsis: Grimm, the beautiful Phyllis and Loomis rob a bank and sneak under the nose of police chief Rotzinger. On their way to the airport, the three are also robbed, but manage to save the loot. Then they run into a foreign taxi driver, with new complications due to his imperfect English and, always chased by the police, they chase a plane among a thousand other hilarious setbacks. The film is remembered for a guessed opening and for the good cast, dominated by the effective Bill Murray (Grimm). For the rest, the story is quite messed up and the lack of comic streak is also diverted by a decidedly incongruous romantic aspect.
cast: Bill Murray, Geena Davis, Randy Quaid, Jason Robards

title: Quickly, spari e baci a colazione
cast: Anthony Vernon, Beryl Cunningham, Jane Avril, Magda Konopka

title: Quicksand
cast: Mickey Rooney, Jeanne Cagney, Peter Lorre, Barbara Bates

title: Quicksand
synopsis: A New York banker, Martin Raikes, is sent to the South of France to investigate a film set that the bank he works for is financing. Not more than a day goes by and a government officer is killed on the set, and Martin finds himself accused of inadvertently putting his hands on the murder weapon. Pursued by gangsters and corrupt policemen, the banker escapes revealing himself to be very ingenious in disguises: he manages to get in touch with two of the protagonists of the film and tries to prove his innocence, but the pursuers also raise the stakes taking Martin's son prisoner ...
cast: Michael Keaton, Michael Caine, Judith Godrèche, Rade Serbedzija

title: Quicksand
synopsis: After a tragedy at a school sends shock waves through a wealthy Stockholm suburb, a seemingly well-adjusted teen finds herself on trial for murder.
cast: Hanna Ardéhn, Felix Sandman, William Spetz, Ella Rappich, David Dencik, Reuben Sallmander, Maria Sundbom, Rebecka Hemse, Arvid Sand, Helena Af Sandeberg, Anna Björk

title: Quien a hierro mata
synopsis: Mario is an exemplary man, he works as a nurse in a retirement home and will soon have a child with his lovely wife Julia. Antonio Padin, on the other hand, is a renowned drug trafficker from Galicia who, after being released from prison, enters the center where Mario works due to a serious illness. Kike and Toño, the two Padin sons, have taken over the family business but some serious problems lead the older brother to prison. It will be then that Toño will try to ask Mario for help.
cast: Luis Tosar, Ismael Martínez, Enric Auquer, Xan Cejudo, María Vázquez, Pablo Guisa Koestinger, Tania Lamata, Hugo Sa Ferreira, Daniel Currás, María Luisa Mayol, Víctor Duplá

title: Quien sabe?
synopsis: Bill Tates (Castel) is commissioned by the Mexican government to liquidate Elias, leader of the revolutionaries. To reach his goal, he joins the gang of the opportunist El Chuncho (Volontè), who raids convoys and government barracks to resell weapons and ammunition to Elias. At the revolutionary headquarters El Chuncho, however, is accused of a horrendous crime and is about to be executed, but Bill saves him, and Elias is killed. With the reward in his pocket, the American would like to take his friend to the United States, but the latter has a jolt of pride. Damiani's skilful amalgamation of action and political message inaugurates a rich vein of western spaghetti. Unforgettable is the immense interpretation of Volontè, a disturbing "ugly dirty and bad" revolutionary anti-hero.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Klaus Kinski, Lou Castel, Martine Beswick, Andrea Checchi

title: Quiet
synopsis: The lives of three Chilean teenage misfits converge as they try to find their place in an unequal society through hip-hop and lasting friendships.
cast: Max Salgado, René Miranda, Ignacia Uribe, Javier Castillo, Steevens Benjamin, Andrés Rebolledo, Alejandro Trejo

title: Quiet Cool
synopsis: A New York policeman is on the trail of an illegal marijuana grower active in the United States After a series of laborious investigations, he must leave for the West. On the trail of her man, he reaches California, but here is someone who is waiting for him with certainly not friendly intentions ...
cast: James Remar, Adam Coleman Howard, Daphne Ashbrook, Nick Cassavetes

title: Quiet Riot: Well Now You're Here, There's No Way Back
Quiet Victory: The Charlie Wedemeyer Story
synopsis: When high school football coach Charlie Wedemeyer is diagnosed with Lou Gehrig's disease, he perseveres in leading his team despite becoming disabled.
cast: Pam Dawber, Michael Nouri, Bess Meyer, Peter Berg, James Handy, Kyle Chandler

title: Quigley Down Under
synopsis: After traveling to Australia for a job, a sharpshooting cowboy becomes a target himself when he refuses an immoral assignment from a corrupt landowner.
cast: Tom Selleck, Laura San Giacomo, Alan Rickman, Chris Haywood, Ron Haddrick, Tony Bonner, Jerome Ehlers, Ben Mendelsohn, Conor McDermottroe, Roger Ward

title: Quijote
synopsis: In a comings and goings of space-time crossings, the errant knight Don Quijote (Peppe Servillo) encounters anomalous encounters with poets, magicians, girls and emperors. Always in love with the beautiful and kind Dulcinea, in his wandering dictated by carrying out an unequal fight, he is accompanied by the faithful Sancho Panza (Lucio Dalla), with whom he shares experiences and memories, until the moment of death.
cast: Peppe Servillo, Lucio Dalla, Ginestra Paladino, Enzo Moscato, Alessandro Bergonzoni, Remo Girone, Enzo Cucchi, Mimmo Cuticchio, Daghi Rondanini

title: Quill: The Life of a Guide Dog
Quills
synopsis: To get rid of an uncomfortable character like D. A. F. de Sade, Napoleon decides to lock him up in the Charenton asylum. His mistress Madeleine often visits him, taking it upon herself to take his latest writings outside those walls; a priest who comes into contact with women thus discovers the subversive force of Sadian ideas.
cast: Geoffrey Rush, Kate Winslet, Joaquin Phoenix, Michael Caine

title: Quinceañera
synopsis: Magdalena is about to turn 15: the day of the traditional "Quinceañera" is approaching for her, the Hispanic festival that marks the transition to adulthood. When the girl discovers she is pregnant, she is thrown out of the house by her very religious family: the only ones who do not turn their back on her are a great-uncle and a gay cousin ...
cast: Emily Rios, Jesse Garcia, Araceli Guzman Rico, Alicia Sixtos, Johnny Chavez

title: Quincy
synopsis: This documentary profiles music and culture icon Quincy Jones, offering unprecedented access to his private life and stories from his unparalleled career.
cast: Quincy Jones

title: Quindici forche per un assassino
synopsis: Bill and Cassel, leaders of two rival gangs unjustly accused of murdering three women, put aside the hatred that divides them and try to escape the ruthless manhunt unleashed by Steve, the boyfriend of one of the victims.
cast: Craig Hill, Susy Andersen, Aldo Sombrell, Tomas Blanco, Eleonora Brown

title: Quingmei Zhuma
synopsis: Qin was promoted to personal assistant to a female executive; the promotion encourages her to leave her parents' home and go to live alone. Long, her boyfriend has never done anything good. He's trying to pull himself out of a trial, and has smoky ideas on how to set up an import-export with his brother-in-law in the United States. He tends to live in the past, and yes, he clings to his youthful fixation for baseball. Qin's boss chooses to leave the company when the company is absorbed by a larger company. Qin is offered a job as a regular secretary, and she too decides to leave. Now, at any moment he has plenty of time, and realizes how difficult it is to talk to Long, and how he is increasingly resembling Qin's father. The girl is now interested in a business with a colleague from the old office. Meanwhile, Long stays in touch with Guan, a childhood friend who was once also Qin's best friend. Guan is married to a Japanese man and lives in Tokyo, but the marriage is not going well. In the days and weeks that follow, the latent tensions between Qin and Long come to a head ...
cast: Hou Hsiao Hsien, Ko Su Yun, Wu Nien Jen

title: Quintet
synopsis: The earth is in the midst of a new glaciation; humanity is exhausted. Among those who still have energy at their disposal, a game called Quintet, which has the life of the losers at stake, is very fashionable. Essex is a hunter who agrees to play to understand what the meaning of this experience is. Cinematic meditation by Robert Altman, full of symbols and based on the very rules of the game that gives it its title. Cold film (and certainly not for its setting), which stages a sort of last act of degraded humanity, openly aiming at an involvement that is more intellectual than emotional.
cast: Paul Newman, Vittorio Gassman, Fernando Rey, Bibi Andersson

title: Quiproquo
synopsis: In a series of interviews conducted by Eugenio Lio, exponents of Italian culture, belonging to the humanistic and scientific academic world, and ordinary passers-by try to tell what the avant-garde is today, trying to understand what can be defined as such in the third millennium.
cast: Franco Battiato, Nicoletta Braschi, Umberto Eco, Andrea Renzi, Eugenio Lio

title: Quiz Show
synopsis: New York 1958. On television, a quiz show by NBC called "Twenty-One", sponsored by a well-known pharmaceutical company, was very successful. Herbie Stempel, a Brooklyn simpleton of Jewish origin, has been the undisputed champion for weeks. But polls show that he is falling in popularity and Dan, the organizer, orders him to get the wrong answer to the final question. Now the champion is Charles Van Doren, a young university professor, typical "wasp", who soon becomes the new TV idol. But Dan doesn't accept the defeat and decides to legally appeal. The appeal is covered up, but the case draws the attention of a young prosecutor, Richard Goodwin.
cast: John Turturro, Ralph Fiennes, Paul Scofield, Rob Morrow, Dick Goodwin, David Paymer, Hank Azaria, Christopher McDonald, Johann Carlo, Mira Sorvino, Elizabeth Wilson, Allan Rich

title: Quiz Whiz Junior
synopsis: Add a Plot

title: Quién te cantará
synopsis: When a near-drowning leaves a famous singer from the '90s with amnesia, she hires a karaoke singer who can imitate her to prep her for a comeback tour.
cast: Najwa Nimri, Eva Llorach, Carme Elias, Natalia De Molina, Julián Villagrán, Ignacio Mateos, Lorena Iglesias, Vicenta N'Dongo, Inma Cuevas, Per Olav Sorensen

title: Quo Vadis
synopsis: Under the dictatorship of the emperor Nero, the valiant Roman officer Marco Vinicius met the Christian Licia and fell in love with her. Following this meeting, Mark begins to have doubts about the faith and also to oppose the tyrannical madness of Nero who, in the meantime, sets fire to Rome, placing the blame on Christians ...
cast: Robert Taylor, Deborah Kerr, Peter Ustinov, Marina Berti

title: Quo vadis, Aida?
country: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Austria, Romania, Netherlands, Germany, Poland, France, Norway
synopsis: The Serbian army has occupied Srebrenica. Aida, a middle-aged English teacher with her husband and two grown-up children, seeks refuge and protection at a UN base. Working as a translator for the United Nations, Aida feels safe. However, the apparatus of protection and empathy around her slowly begins to collapse: Aida will then have to think about how to save her family.
cast: Jasna Djuricic, Izudin Bajrovic, Boris Ler, Dino Bajrovic, Boris Isakovic, Johan Heldenbergh, Raymond Thiry

title: Quo vadis, baby?
synopsis: Giorgia, a declining Bolognese detective who works in her father's investigation agency, spends her nights wandering from one club to another. When Aldo - friend of her older sister, Ada, who inexplicably committed suicide sixteen years earlier - sends her videotapes that reconstruct the suicide diary, Giorgia begins to dig into the past to shed light on her existence and that of Ada.
cast: Angela Baraldi, Gigio Alberti, Claudia Zanella, Luigi Maria Burruano, Andrea Renzi

title: Quo vadis?
cast: Klaus Maria Brandauer, Frederic Forrest, Francesco Quinn, Gabriele Ferzetti

title: Quo vadis?
cast: Amleto Novelli, Gustavo Serena, Lea Giunchi, Carlo Cattaneo, Bruto Castellani

title: Quo vado?
synopsis: Checco is a boy who has made all the dreams of his life come true. He wanted to live with his parents thus avoiding an expensive independence and he succeeded, he wanted to be eternally engaged without ever facing the responsibilities of a marriage with its children and he did it, but above all, he always dreamed of a safe job and is managed to get the most: a permanent position in the provincial hunting and fishing office. With this wonderful lightness Checco faces a life that is the envy of everyone. One day, however, everything changes. The government launches the public administration reform which decrees the cutting of the provinces. Summoned to the ministry by the ruthless manager Sironi, Checco is faced with a difficult choice: to leave his permanent job or be transferred away from home. For Checco the permanent position is sacred and in order to keep it he accepts the transfer. To put him in a position to resign, Dr. Sironi makes him wander in various Italian locations to fill the most unlikely and dangerous roles, but Checco heroically resists everything. The exhausted Sironi increases the dose and transfers it to the North Pole, in an Italian scientific base with the task of defending researchers from the attack of polar bears. Just when he is about to leave his beloved permanent job, Checco meets Valeria, a researcher who studies endangered animals and falls madly in love with her.
cast: Checco Zalone, Eleonora Giovanardi, Sonia Bergamasco, Maurizio Micheli, Lino Banfi, Ludovica Modugno, Ninni Bruschetta, Paolo Pierobon, Azzurra Martino

title: Quore
synopsis: Paola, a twenty-one-year-old double bass player on the last date of her Italian tour, discovers she is pregnant. But that's not the only problem she is forced to face. The relationship with her parents is problematic: her father is lost in alcohol and the future grandmother is becoming a mother for the second time. Her friends who play with her also complicate things. They just signed a contract for a concert tour in Europe. The only one who has not signed is her ...
cast: Michela Noonan, Carla Signoris, Gigio Alberti, Mariella Valentini

title: Qurious Como
synopsis: Shrunk down in size, Como and his friends examine the wonder-filled world around them one item at a time, from foods to household goods.

title: Qué pena tu serie
synopsis: Javier is happily in love with Sofia, so when she breaks up their perfect life, he has to get her back – or maybe try finding a new perfect love.
cast: Ariel Levy, Andrea Velasco, Lucy Cominetti, Ignacia Allamand, Paz Bascuñán, Claudia Celedón, Nicolás Martínez

title: Québec
synopsis: In Canada of the last century the revolt against the English domination mounts. A woman, betrothed to the rebel leader and with whom she also had a son, is coveted by an English officer who makes her believe that her man has been killed. She marries the officer, then discovers the truth and takes revenge. Little drama and little conviction in this feeble historical re-enactment.
cast: Corinne Calvet, John Barrymore Jr., Barbara Rush, Patric Knowles

title: R.D.F. - Rumori di fondo
