cast: Claire Forlani, Michelle Nolden, Mike Shara, Amanda Tilson, Arnold Pinnock, George Tchortov, Allison Brennan, Morgan Dipietrantonio, Michelle LeBlanc, Michael Broderick

title: Running on Empty
synopsis: Arthur and Annie Pope got into trouble at the time of the anti-Vietnam demonstrations, even taking part in acts of sabotage. Since then they have lived under a false name, fleeing from one state to another because they are wanted by the FBI. Fifteen years have passed, the children have grown up and one of them is in crisis because this type of life does not allow him to realize his dream of becoming a musician. A "liberal" film shot by Lumet in the form of a family drama. Little success at the time, but the actors are all admirable starting with Phoenix got an Oscar nomination for supporting role.
cast: Christine Lathi, Judd Hirsch, River Phoenix, Martha Plimpton

title: Running with Scissors
synopsis: Seventies. The young Augusten lives his childhood with an alcoholic father and an unstable mother, a poet with delusions of grandeur. When his parents divorce, his mother sends him to live with Dr. Finch, his psychiatrist, a very unorthodox man, and with his extended family.
cast: Annette Bening, Brian Cox, Joseph Fiennes, Evan Rachel Wood, Alec Baldwin, Gwyneth Paltrow

title: Running with the Devil
synopsis: When a cocaine shipment goes wrong, the cartel boss orders his trusted henchman and partner, another trafficker, to embark on a perilous journey to review the links in the chain. While the sale of drugs continues undaunted to cross international borders, the trafficking is followed not only by gangsters, refiners and couriers, but also by federal agents.
cast: Nicolas Cage, Laurence Fishburne, Cole Hauser, Clifton Collins Jr., Leslie Bibb, Barry Pepper, Peter Facinelli, Adam Goldberg, Natalia Reyes, Sarah Minnich

title: Rupan Sansei - Princess of the breeze - Kakusareta k?ch? toshi
synopsis: After a chaotic robbery, Lupine and Jigen find themselves becoming the keepers of a small child as a young sky pirate named Yutika aims for their loot. Yutika is a resident of the (floating in the sky) city-state of Shahalta, whose form of government has recently moved from monarchy to republic not without some turmoil. Soon, Lupine and Yutika join forces to discover one of Shahalta's greatest treasures and evade the authorities.

title: Rupan Sansei - T?h? kenbunroku - Anaz? P?ji
synopsis: In Genoa, in the basement of Palazzo San Giorgio, the archaeologist Theo Argento found the only page missing from the book The million of Marco Polo. On the page the secret would be enclosed to find something very precious. When the archaeologist is assassinated, Lupine III is suspected of the murder, who is forced to flee together with the professor's grandson, the only one able to decipher the page.

title: Rupan Sansei vasasu Meitantei Konan
synopsis: In the fictional kingdom of Vespania, after the death of her mother and brother, the apparently hysterical princess Mira is forced to travel to Japan, where she meets detectives Goro and Conan. Everything would be normal, were it not for the fact that the princess is the perfect double of Ran, Conan's girlfriend, and that the two, at some point, switch roles. As if that weren't enough, Lupun III and Fujiko appear and aim to steal Vespania's crown.

title: Rupan Sansei: Ai no da capo - Fujiko's Unlucky Days
synopsis: A pleasant dinner between Fujiko and Lupine is interrupted by a helicopter that launches a series of missiles at him. At the controls of the vehicle is Nazaldorf, who hopes to take possession of some precious documents that were in the possession of the two. Unfortunately, however, the documents had previously been destroyed and Fujiko is the only one who remembers their contents and is thus pursued by the pirate. After daring adventures Fujiko arrives at the home of Rosaria, a treasure hunter: however, the fright and the flight have caused her an amnesia for which she no longer remembers anything, not even who Lupine is. A big problem that will have adventurous solutions.

title: Rupan Sansei: Sweet lost night - Maho no lamp wa akumu no yokan
synopsis: Lupine wins a magic lamp at a game and finds himself in contact with a genius, which soon becomes his property. However, the last shot at 7pm is the only thing he remembers. Finding himself in Singapore, Lupine must fight his battle against Colonel Garlic's forces and uncover the secret behind the lamp. But every time the clock strikes 19:00, his memory is erased! How is Lupine going to put together this intricate puzzle when he can't even remember what he's doing? The genius will take care of lending a hand to the nice gentleman thief.
cast: Kanichi Kurita, Kiyoshi Kobayashi, Makio Inoue, Eiko Masuyama, Gorô Naya, Seijin Hagihara, Misato Tanaka, Banjô Ginga, Satoshi Sasaki, Takayuki Sugo

title: Rupan sansei - 1$ Money Wars
synopsis: Lupine attempts to win a ring at an auction, but his bid is beaten for a single dollar by that of Cynthia, president of a bank involved in shady deals. The ring is of little value: what really matters to the contenders is the message it contains, deciphered which would open the doors of enormous power ...

title: Rupan sansei - Bai Bai Ribatii Kiki Ippatsu!
synopsis: In order to have a free hand in view of a sensational blow, and to be able to act undisturbed on the international scene, Lupine III tries to permanently erase the documentation concerning him from the Interpol computers. He decides to get help from Virus Beta, a kid considered the best hacker on the market.

title: Rupan sansei - Fûma ichizoku no inbô
synopsis: The criminal organization headed by the Fuma family kidnaps Murasaki, Goemon's betrothed. The bandits intend to blackmail the girl's family to get to a key that can open the doors of a golden temple. Lupine III intervenes.

title: Rupan sansei - Harimao no Zaiho wo oe!!
synopsis: Lupine III is on the trail of Arimao's treasure, hidden by a gang of thieves who have committed thefts across the islands of Southeast Asia. With the help of the inseparable Fujiko (and not Margot!), Jigen and Gemon, Lupine sets out to look for the statues of the bear, eagle and monkey, considered important as access keys to the treasure room. The thief meets an English adventurer, Sir Archer, who with his niece Diana follows the same trail as Lupine.

title: Rupan sansei - Heminguuei peepaa no nazo
synopsis: Hemingway, in some notes, left a treasure map. These notes are in a box that can only be opened with a gold key in the possession of a certain Mengel. Marcess, an arms dealer whose secretary is Fujico, hires a mercenary to kill Mengel. In the meantime, Lupine tries to anticipate Marcess.

title: Rupan sansei - Moeyo zantetsu ken
synopsis: Goemon's sword is believed to be invincible. At least until the existence of an even more powerful metal alloy is discovered, whose formula - well kept inside the statuette of a dragon, sunk together with the Titanic - is tempting to many: for example Chin Chin, the king of the mafia of Hong Kong. But this is where Lupine comes in ...

title: Rupan sansei - Naporeon no isho wo ubae
synopsis: The world economy is on its knees because of the money spent on the Gulf War. Earth's mighty have no choice but to get their hands on the Lupine family's treasure. The key to the loot is hidden in Napoleon's dictionary.

title: Rupan sansei - Otakara henkyaku daisakusen
synopsis: Lupine I have to rearrange some items stolen by his friend Mark. In return he will be revealed the place where the dark diamond is hidden, a fragment of meteorite that could lead him to a legendary hidden treasure. Along the way, the thief meets Mark's niece Anita ...

title: Rupan sansei - Roshia yori ai wo komete
synopsis: Lupine reads, in an old book, a very interesting story about a certain Yurovski, an imperial guard at the time of Tsar Nicholas II. Who, according to this mysterious testimony, was saved from execution by Yurovski. To reward him, the tsar gave him 500 tons of gold, which have since been lost ...

title: Rupan sansei - Towairaito Jemini no Himitsu
synopsis: Lupine III, rushed to Dolune's bedside, receives a large diamond as a gift from his friend, the key to a fabulous fortune. The treasure belonged to the Gelts, an ancient tribe now subjugated by the ferocious Igo, ruled by Gundam. Accompanied by Jigen, Lupine III arrives in Morocco. But Inspector Zenigata and Gundam set a trap for him ...

title: Rupan sansei - Warusa P38
synopsis: Lupine III is framed by the ferocious "gang of assassins", financed and backed by the governments of the most powerful states in the world. Their aim is to blame Lupine III for the murder of an important politician and to lure him to the island where the gang's lair is based. Lupine III is captured: in order to obey the assassins, he is injected with a poison with a delayed effect.

title: Rupan sansei. Babiron no ogon densetsu
synopsis: For centuries and centuries the subsoil of today's Manhattan has kept some mysterious tablets in which the enigma of the fabulous golden tower of the Babylonian treasure is contained. Lupine III tries to recover them, but Interpol inspector Zenigata does not give him respite; and the Polish mafia is also involved ...

title: Rupan sansei: Dead or Alive
synopsis: In the Republic of Zufu, ruled by Colonel Kubikari, the galleys are full of rebels, faithful to the ex-king and aware that they will never leave alive again. One day, the director of the prison carries out an unexpected inspection and picks up all the prisoners accused of espionage and rebellion as if it were time for their execution. Amidst the general disbelief, however, these shady characters are made to escape by the director himself, who soon turns out to be the fearless Lupine III in disguise: our hero, in fact, had heard rumors about the existence of a treasure that belonged to the former. -re, and hoped that some of his loyalists would know where he was hidden.

title: Rupan sansei: Gurîn vs Reddo
synopsis: Yasuo, a young bartender who turns, if necessary, into a skilled thief, is going through a bad time: he is depressed and dissatisfied, also because his girlfriend, Yukiko, a good television journalist, has left him. To give a "heroic" change to his life, Yasuo is inspired by his myth, Lupine III, and embarks on a feat worthy of Lupine: stealing a huge rough diamond, called the "ice cube", and giving it to Fujiko. (which is, opportunely, allied with him). Yasuo's disguise is so perfect that it even deceives Jigen and Goemon. There is only one thing that distinguishes the two Lupines: one has a green jacket and the other a red one.
cast: Makio Inoue, Eiko Masuyama, Gorô Naya, Jin Katagiri, Aya Hirano, Katsuhisa Hôki, Nobuaki Fukuda, Yu Shimaka

title: Rupan sansei: Honô no kioku Tokyo Crisis
synopsis: Lupine, convinced that the secret of a fantastic treasure is hidden on two old photographic plates, tries to steal them from the rightful owner, the tycoon Michael Suzaku. To prevent him from committing the theft, he finds, as always, the inspector Zenigata who, due to Lupine's fault, is suspended from service. When the sympathetic thief discovers that the tycoon is actually a shady character who intends to use genetic engineering to create super soldiers, Zenigata allies himself with his historical enemy and together, they frame the evil Suzaku. But the unlikely alliance does not last long and, as soon as the case is solved, the inspector sets out on Lupine's trail.

title: Rupan sansei: Ikiteita majutsushi
synopsis: In the midst of a blow, Lupine is interrupted by Pycal, an illusionist believed dead and now in possession of real magical powers.

title: Rupan sansei: Kariosutoro no shiro
synopsis: Lupine and the faithful Jigen have traced the origin of the counterfeit banknotes that are bringing the world economy to its knees: the village of Cagliostro, governed by the homonymous count. Within the stone walls of his castle, the man keeps the beautiful Princess Clarissa imprisoned, who knows the key to a hidden treasure. Lupine is intent on freeing the girl, punishing the wicked and taking the treasure.

title: Rupan sansei: Kiri no eryuushivu
synopsis: While Lupine is looking for clues to find an ancient treasure, it is found by Zenigata. While escaping the police, Lupine, Jigen and Ghemon realize that something strange is happening and the people around them begin to mysteriously disappear. The person in charge turns out to be a man from the future ...

title: Rupan sansei: Majutsu-ou no isan
synopsis: A journalist meets Jigen in a bar, who tells her how - ten years earlier - she had met Lupine. It all started when the thief decided to steal a cylinder containing a manuscript from a powerful underworld boss, on which was written the formula for creating an indestructible metal ...

title: Rupan sansei: Mamo karano chousen
synopsis: The notorious international thief Lupine III is executed in Transylvania. Or so it seems, because the news reaches ... Lupine himself, who immediately runs to check what is happening. Thus begins an adventure that will take him to Egypt, where he will steal a mysterious stone, and then to Japan on an island where many famous people live, actually clones.

title: Rupan sansei: Nusumareta rupan
synopsis: A powerful Mafia boss orders Lupine to steal the precious gem called Bull's Eye but the stone carries a terrible curse and anyone who tries to steal it will run an endless series of dangers. However, Lupine does not seem to believe it and accepts the assignment without hesitation.
cast: Takeshi Aono, Yu Asakawa, Makio Inoue, Kiyoshi Kobayashi, Kanichi Kurita, Eiko Masuyama, Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi, Kouji Nakata, Gorô Naya, Tôru Shinagawa

title: Rupan sansei: Rupan ansatsu shirei
synopsis: Zenigata is removed from the "Lupine case" to offer it to Keith, a professional killer. But the inspector is given the special mission of destroying the Shotshell, an organization of arms traffickers. Lupine III has several purposes: to steal the money of the traffickers, destroy the Shotshell on behalf of Zenigata, and thus have the old inspector return the task of the Lupine III case. To be contacted by Shotshell, Lupine III and the others steal a Russian submarine, the Ivanov, with the somewhat forced collaboration of Karen, the scientist who designed it.

title: Rupan sansei: Sebundeizu rapusodei
synopsis: Lupine wants to steal a wonderful diamond, owned by the president of the United States, on display only for a few days. But the plan is more difficult than expected: even arms traffickers intend to seize the jewel in order to be able to blackmail the American politician ...
cast: Yôsuke Akimoto, Mabuki Andou, Tesshô Genda, Makio Inoue, Mariya Ise, Hiroshi Iwasaki, Masaki Kawanabe, Eriko Kigawa, Kiyoshi Kobayashi, Kousei Kobayashi

title: Rupan sansei: Tenshi no sakuryaku takutikusu yume no kakera wa koroshi no kaori
synopsis: Lupine wants to steal the "Original Metal" that is an alloy that was taken from a spaceship that crashed on Earth a long time ago. So Lupine, Jigen and Goemon disguise themselves as professors to steal it, but Zenigata, with her new assistant Emily, tries to stop them ...

title: Rupan sansei: arukatorazu konnekishion
synopsis: Lupine III is in San Francisco to break into the safe of a floating casino run by criminals. By chance he learns that, on the bottom of the bay near Alcatraz, there is a ship loaded with gold, sunk in the second half of the 19th century. The cunning thief and his friends throw themselves into this new venture.

title: Rupert
synopsis: The adventures of a young bear named Rupert who unintentionally ends up in faraway/mystical places, but at the end manages to make it back safely to his home of Nutwood.
cast: Julie Lemieux, Valerie Boyle, Guy Bannerman, Torquil Campbell

title: Rupi del vino
synopsis: "There are five reasons to drink: the arrival of a friend, the goodness of wine, present and future thirst, and whatever else" ... Ermanno Olmi returns to the documentary and embarks on a journey through valleys, cliffs, traditions and culture of Valtellina.

title: Rupture
synopsis: Renee Morgan, a single mother who lives with 12-year-old son Evan in a quiet suburban home, is terrified of spiders. However, mother and son ignore that they are constantly observed until the day Renee is kidnapped by a group of strangers. 24 hours later, in an anonymous laboratory, Renee finds herself tied up and questioned about her medical history and her arachnophobia. Soon, the kidnappers explain to her that her genetic anomaly could lead to her true alien nature being exposed.
cast: Noomi Rapace, Peter Stormare, Michael Chiklis, Lesley Manville, Kerry Bishé, Sergio Di Zio, Ari Millen, Paul Popowich, Morgan Kelly, Percy Hynes White

title: Rurouni Kenshin

title: Rurôni Kenshin: Meiji kenkaku roman tan
synopsis: Japan is about to enter the Meji era and the Middle Ages are gradually giving way to industrialization. With the advent of modern society, samurai once regarded as heroes turn out to be less useful than traders. Unemployed and unable to use their swords, faced with the spread of guns and cannons, they are doomed to disappear. Kenshin, who was once a valid samurai in the service of the emperor, finds himself in Tokyo ten years later when an old shadow from the past returns to be felt in the guise of a serial killer who commits murders using his old nom de guerre.
cast: Yû Aoi, Takeru Sato, Teruyuki Kagawa, Emi Takei, Yosuke Eguchi, Munetaka Aoki, Taketo Tanaka, Koji Kikkawa

title: Rurôni Kenshin: Sai shûshô - The Beginning
Rusalka: Ozero myortvykh
synopsis: An evil mermaid, who a few centuries earlier was just a woman who died by drowning, falls in love with Roman, Marina's boyfriend, and aims to take him with her to her underwater kingdom. Marina has only a week to overcome her fear of deep water and win the mermaid challenge.
cast: Viktoriya Agalakova, Efim Petrunin, Sesil Plezhe, Nikita Elenev, Sofia Shidlovskaya, Igor Khripunov, Nadezhda Igoshina, Evgeniy Koryakovskiy, Dmitriy Yartsev, Daria Yartseva

title: Rush
synopsis: In the 1970s, a rivalry propels race car drivers Niki Lauda and James Hunt to fame and glory — until a horrible accident threatens to end it all.
cast: Chris Hemsworth, Daniel Brühl, Olivia Wilde, Alexandra Maria Lara, Pierfrancesco Favino, David Calder, Natalie Dormer, Stephen Mangan, Christian McKay, Alistair Petrie

title: Rush
synopsis: Jim Ranor, a narcotics agent from a small town in Texas, joins his young colleague Kristen Cates on a mission that aims to frame Will Gaines, a drug trafficker. The two infiltrate the "circle", but they also fall victims. Based on a novel by Kim Wozencraft and directed by the director in a harsh, harsh style, the film offers an unconventional glimpse of the environment represented, seen as a hellish, desolate Dante's circle. Good soundtrack by Eric Clapton.
cast: Jason Patric, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Sam Elliott, Max Perlich

title: Rush Hour
synopsis: Lee, an unyielding and busy officer, is the pride of the Royal Hong Kong Police Force. His favorite pupil is the eleven-year-old daughter of the Chinese consul, but the girl, traveling to the United States, is kidnapped. So the consul sends him there to try to get his hands on the thugs. The FBI, with little intentions of investigative meddling, assigns the case to Detective James Carter who, when he finds out what his role is to keep Lee away from the case, goes on a rampage.
cast: Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Tzi Ma, Ken Leung, Chris Penn

title: Rush Hour 2
synopsis: The long-awaited vacation for Chief Inspector Lee and Detective James Carter has finally arrived. As soon as they arrive in Hong Kong, the two find themselves involved in the most important case of their career: a bomb exploded in the American embassy, ??killing two customs officers who were investigating a round of illicit trafficking. Everything is linked to the discovery of stencils for printing 100 dollar banknotes that ended up in the hands of the Triad, the powerful Chinese mafia. Lee is immediately assigned to the case and Carter is forced, in spite of himself, to follow him ...
cast: Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Alan King

title: Rush Hour 3
synopsis: LAPD Detective Carter and Hong Kong Chief Inspector Lee are once again "forced" to join forces to defeat a Triad boss hiding in Paris.
cast: Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Max Von Sydow, Roman Polanski

title: Rush To The Dead Summer
synopsis: This is a youthful story which spans the period of ten years and focuses on friendship, alienation, and one ultimate betrayal that breaks the group of close friends, each going their own way and entering society. Despite growing up poor, Li Xia works hard and wins a scholarship into a grand secondary school where she meets the legendary Fu Xiao Si and Lu Zhi Ang. Love booms in more ways than one, and the group of youth quickly became good friends. After graduation, everyone goes their separate ways. Xiao Si becomes a well-known artist, Li Xia becomes Xiao Si's assistant and other half, Qi Qi won a singing competition and becomes a famous idol, Yu Jian heads Beijing to realize her dreams of becoming a singer. Everyone is still fighting for their dreams. However, with the onslaught of adversities: Xiao Si's struggle, Li Xia's departure, imprisonment of Zhi Ang, Qi Qi's betrayal and death of Yu Jian's boyfriend; the warm and bright summer starts to fade away. Everyone is changing and they become doubtful about the origin of their friendship. A span of ten years make them realize that other than memories, nothing can be eternal, but they have learnt to love and grow. (Source: DramaWiki) ~~ Adapted from the novel “Rush to the Dead Summer” (夏至未至) by Guo Jing Ming (郭敬明).

title: Rush of Fear
synopsis: Vin, John 'J.J.' Gillis and Carl are a gang of thieves who have landed a great heist: stealing a 50-carat diamond from De Beers. The diamond is hidden in the packaging of a cosmetic product to go unnoticed by customs but Carl's beauty case, which contains it without his knowledge, is left in a rented car. When the gang notices it is late: the car with the beauty case has now been rented by the lawyer Jack McGuire (Joseph Kell) who is traveling with his wife Alex (Rosanna Arquette) to the coast, to have fun and solve some problems of their report. The gang goes after them and kidnaps Alex. Thus begins an ordeal for Jack that will force him to work personally to find and save his wife.

title: Russicum - I giorni del diavolo
synopsis: Founded in Rome in 1929 by Pius XI, the Russicum college is a renowned Institute of Oriental Studies. A woman named Silvia who is killed in Piazza Navona and who pretended to be a nun, for example, was an American agent of the CIA. The young Alexandra (Rusic), on the other hand, is a Soviet spy, while the young American diplomat Mark (Williams) doesn't know what to do and finds himself in his hands with several corpses. Tremendous spying by Squitieri, a total sculpt for improbability and sloppiness. Among the actors is saved F. Murray Abraham. synopsis: A Russian sailor is shipwrecked on the Florida coast. Three American kids rescue him. Mischa, who has never left the Soviet Union and has a natural distrust of Americans, feels uneasy. But when the ice breaks the three will help him get safe.

Her thesis is corroborated by the fact that - a few days earlier - her husband had confessed to the media about the sexual abuse he suffered during his seminary education. His wife then decides to hire the private investigator Brenner (Josef Hader), assisted in the investigation by his friend Berti (Simon Schwarz). The interior of the uterine cavity, imagined as a hairy and dark cavern, is the background to uninterrupted dialogues. So the more or less positive moments (a little fun but also a little boredom) alternate. Castellitto takes the part better, while Rossi struggling with non-cabaret structures loses immediacy.

title: Sono Gassman! - Vittorio re della commedia
synopsis: Eighteen years after his death, Vittorio Gassman is recalled in his intense career as a protagonist of cinema and theater with particular reference to the golden years of the brilliant films of the "Italian comedy". Through the testimonies of family and colleagues, excerpts from films, theatrical performances and TV programs, the portrait of an extrovert "showman" but also of a more secret and vulnerable man emerges.

synopsis: Three hundred thousand dollars is the spoils of a bank robbery in the West, killing all the employees. The director, the only survivor, accuses Sartana, on which a bounty is placed. Under the guise of Anthony Ascott, the very Italian Carnimeo directs actors of a certain caliber among many banalities but with a touch of self-irony. Fairly acceptable.

title: Sono fotogenico

He moves to Rome and begins to hang out in Cinecittà, but he soon falls prey to characters from the undergrowth who try to take advantage of his naivety to steal money from him with sailor's promises.

title: Sono gosôsha wo nerae: 'Jûsangô taihisen' yori
synopsis: An Asakusa police van is escorting prisoners. The attention of Tamon (Michitaro Mizushima), the chief of the guards, is attracted by Goro (Shôichi Ozawa), intent on looking out of the window at a lonely woman in the night, standing waiting to see them pass. The prisoner also continues to trace and erase the name "Aki" on the window with his fingers. Asked if that is the person who paid his bail, he gives a vague answer. Two men are lurking on the path: one pushes a truck against the van, the other shoots, eliminating two inmates, Fujuchiki and Ryuta. Tamon, held responsible for negligence, is suspended from service for six months, but does not take it: although it is not his job, he decides to use the time to investigate what happened. Why attack a prison van? The two victims offer no clues to trace a motive: one had killed a criminal, the other pushed the girls stranded on the path of prostitution. The man begins the investigation starting from Goro, who is directed to Atami, where a work of which nature is silent has been proposed to him. Ryuta had a sister, Mari, who worked as a stripper in a club. Upon reaching the post, Tamon learns that the girl has changed employer. Attracted by the photo of one of the dancers, in which he recognizes the mysterious woman seen from the van just before the attack, the guard is informed that it is Tsunako (Mari Shiraki), who has recently changed employer along with Mari, and who had to pay a deposit. Now they both probably work at Atami, as private strippers in some hotel rooms. Spotting the hotel, Tamon takes a room, but only has time to see Mari kill by an arrow during a striptease. He manages to trace the Hamaju agency, which supplied the girls, through the hotel manager. He learns from his daughter Yuko (Misako Watanabe), that the agency owner is hospitalized in a Tokyo hospital. Although the girl is temporarily in charge of the company, the reins are actually held by the bully Akabori (Tôru Abe). Yuko, skilled in archery, is struck by the personality of the guard, who is convinced that even the worst offender should be treated like a human being. Tamon later questions Tsunako about the mysterious name "Aki", and learns that it is probably Akiba, a guy Goro is meeting with just then in Wadaya. The two jump into a taxi and head to the meeting place. Just during the journey, they notice someone pushing a man from a precipice into the sea: it is probably Goro himself, since the bag left on the road was his. However, the body is not found. The situation becomes even more intricate, but Tamon does not give up and is determined to get over it.
cast: Michitaro Mizushima, Mari Shiraki, Misako Watanabe, Shinsuke Ashida, Shoichi Ozawa, Ryôhei Uchida, Tôru Abe, Tatsuo Matsushita, Saburo Hiromatsu, Reiko Arai, Toyo Fukuda, Kotoe Hatsui, Akira Hisamatsu

title: Sono in lista
synopsis: Clubbing is an English term translatable with "going for night clubs". In reality, it hides a much deeper and cultural meaning. Clubs, discos and electronic music are a privileged point of view to read society and its changes: artistic, social, cultural, political, costume. In particular, a city like Milan, always crucial in the Italian and world scene, if looked at and narrated from the point of view of the "night", offers an interesting perspective of the country's changes: from the seventies to the brilliant eighties, from confused years Ninety until the sudden change of the early 2000s.

title: Sono innamorato di Pippa Bacca
synopsis: Two women, two artists in a wedding dress. A journey to Jerusalem through countries ravaged by wars. 6000 km to travel by hitchhiking, to celebrate the marriage between peoples and show that trusting others can only be received well. This was the intent of Pippa Bacca and Silvia Moro when, on March 8, 2008, they left Milan to stage a performance in the sign of peace. An artistic performance tragically interrupted by the death of one of the two brides.

title: Sono nato comunista
synopsis: In the midst of the Cold War, from 1955 and for about a decade, the PCI sent 15 young Italian Communists every year to the "Lomonosov" Moscow State University, with the aim of creating an elite of intellectuals and party leaders. The protagonists of the documentary were part of that hundred Italian students in the USSR: Chiara Spano, Dino Bernardini, Massimo Picchianti, Rossana Platone, Maria Rosa Cricchi and Salvatore Pepitoni, all enrolled in the FGCI and coming from families that have made history at various levels. of Italian communism.

title: Sono otoko, kyobo ni tsuki

cast: Takeshi Kitano, Maiko Kawakami, Makoto Ashikawa, Shiro Sano

title: Sono pazzo di Iris Blond
synopsis: Left by his girlfriend after an honored career as a keyboard player in Rome in the seventies, Romeo falls into a depressive crisis, and plays in Brussels for an elderly audience. Romeo falls in love with Iris Blond, a waitress of Italian immigrant origin. He decides to partner with her, but the age difference and her sudden success are felt. Verdone returns to sentimental comedy, recounting the meeting of two neurotics in search of affection and professional creative affirmation. All built on Claudia Gerini, "Iris Blond" starts well, abandons a bit to the macchiettismo in the central part and goes back to the 'last half hour. Shot of the wing, the trip to Charleroi, a Belgian mining town, where Adam and Mino Reitano triumph.
cast: Carlo Verdone, Claudia Gerini, Mino Reitano, Andréa Ferréol

title: Sono positivo

Paradoxically, the disease will become an opportunity for everyone to rediscover and accept their own nature.

title: Sono solo fantasmi
synopsis: Thomas (Christian De Sica), a former magician on the bill, and Carlo (Carlo Buccirosso), a Neapolitan subject to his northern wife and father-in-law, are two half-brothers who meet again after years in Naples for the death of their father Vittorio, an inveterate player and womanizer. They discover they have a third brother, Ugo (Gianmarco Tognazzi), apparently a bit dumb but actually a little genius. The inheritance, coveted by Thomas and Carlo, vanishes due to the debts of their father and the three have a great idea: to exploit Neapolitan superstition and credulity, becoming "ghost catchers". Just when the business unexpectedly seems to be very successful, the spirit of his father Vittorio takes possession of Carlo's body. Thomas and Carlo are convinced that ghosts really exist. Meanwhile, the ghosts captured by the trio free themselves and go to awaken the ghost of a witch who threatens to destroy Naples. With the help of their father, the three brothers will try to save the city.

title: Sono tornato

His return is casually filmed by Andrea Canaletti, a young documentary maker with great aspirations but few, very few successes. Believing him to be a comedian, Canaletti decides to make him the protagonist of a documentary that will finally consecrate him to the world of cinema. The two thus begin a surreal coexistence, which between trips to Italy, hosting TV and curious moments of confrontation with the Italians of today, leads the Duce to make himself known and recognized more and more, to the point of becoming the protagonist of a show on TV and to get it into your head to be able to reconquer the country ...

title: Sora Kara Furu Ichioku No Hoshi
synopsis: The story opens after a young female student kills herself by jumping off a balcony. It's soon discovered that she was in fact stabbed, and the room arranged to make it look like a suicide. And so we begin. A few minor details lead Detective Kanzo to suspect that Ryo, an enigmatic chef's assistant, knows more about her death.The two have run into each other by chance a few times, and each time left Kanzo with an uncomfortable feeling. Every clue that is revealed seems to lead to more questions about Ryo, his obsessive girlfriend, his callous and manipulative relations with several women, and about a painful memory from Kanzo's past. Things get more complicated when a powerful love/hate relationship develops between Ryo and Kanzo's little sister, the beautiful Yuko. What exactly is their connection? As the evidence (and body count) rises, Kanzo tries desperately to save his sister from Ryo's influence. He's no saint, but is he the Devil Kanzo thinks he is? And why? The answers will floor you, even when you think you've got them figured out already. (Source: IMDb)

Beautiful soundtrack with music by Charlie Parker, Keith Jarrett, Tangerine Dream.

title: Sore Wa, Totsuzen, Arashi No You Ni..
synopsis: Kozue Ogawa is a housewife and has been married to Hideo for seven years. They don't have any children, but as they live with her parents at their flower shop, every day is still lively. She is happy with her life and her husband, but she wonders if it is enough. From time to time, she is gripped by this doubt that she cannot raise with anyone. Kozue starts a part-time job in the editing department of the magazine where she used to work. Her former colleague is now working hard as the editor-in-chief. One rainy day, Kozue meets a young man. He is Takuma Fukazawa, a high school student. He seems somehow shrouded in sadness. He is a dance teacher. In the dance studio, there is just the two of them. Takuma curls his hands around Kozue's body, and his dance instruction begins. Their unexpected closeness causes Kozue to hesitate. With her heart pounding, she pushes Takuma's hands away and runs home. But the throbbing in her chest continues. It can't be. But what is this feeling? (Source: TBS)

Tommaso, the brother who runs his father's shop, decides to ask for help from a disreputable acquaintance. From Rome Patrizia, the youngest daughter and from Milan Alberto, the second son, join the family and reluctantly accept the compromise proposed by Tommaso. But Rosa is firmly opposed.

title: Sotto il ristorante cinese
synopsis: Ivan (Botosso) is about to marry Ursula (Brilli), a graduate in engineering, but very respectable, of little imagination and who is also his boss. One day, to escape from criminals, he crosses the door of a basement and finds himself on a beach with a blue sea, where Eva (Sandrelli) and her nutty parent live. She falls in love and follows Ivan into her world, making a mess. Surreal fable written and directed by Bozzetto, who gives you the same poetic and light-hearted stamp of his splendid cartoons. Around the great old Bernard Blier revolve some new faces (Brilli, Sandrelli, Cederna) of Italian cinema.

title: Sotto il segno dello scorpione

A mythological reconstruction of the birth of a society, the film claims the merit of the great changes in the history of mankind to the revolutionary determination. But the film is today almost unwatchable in its metaphorical anxiety and in its cumbersome experimentalism.

Marco (Saul Nanni) has always been in love with Guenda (Fotinì Peluso) but has never found the courage to declare himself. Gualtiero (Andrea Roncato), a playboy and a retired lifeguard, will come to his aid, determined to share his secrets with a boy who seems to definitely lack audacity. Vincenzo (Lorenzo Zurzolo) is finally a blind boy who travels with his mother (Isabella Ferrari), an apprehensive and very protective woman. Unlike in previous years, Vincenzo decided to leave his mother under the umbrella and make friends: thus he meets Furio (Davide Calgaro) and his group, each one different from the other but all united by a great friendship.

Only the dramatic death of his father, caused by his companions, will make him understand his mistakes and change his life. Shot on natural locations and with non-professional actors, in the middle of the Neorealist period, it is an airy and funny film, almost already "pink".

synopsis: 24-year-old Murakami Maiko is a very sheltered girl who has never had a relationship with a guy. Although Maiko is less than thrilled, she discovers when they meet that he is a charming man with an air of maturity and she instinctively makes a move on him. Harumi had intended to meet Maiko once before he turned her down since she is the daughter of the CEO of an important client. However, she turns out to be more than he had imagined. title: Tottaa Pataaka Item Maal
synopsis: Exasperated with living in perpetual fear for their safety, four women kidnap a man to show him the realities of being female in Delhi.
cast: Shalini Vatsa, Chitrangada Chakraborty, Vinay Sharma, Sonal Joshi, Kritika Pande

title: Totò Diabolicus
synopsis: The Marquis Galeazzo di Torrealta is found killed and the murderer signed Diabolicus. Three of the four sons heirs of the conspicuous substances end up in the same way and only one survives, Monsignor Antonino. The suspicions fall on a certain Pasquale, illegitimate son of the Marquis, but, after a series of vicissitudes, it is discovered who had really engineered and carried out the massacre of the noble family. Totò plays all the Torrealta and the "bastard" Pasquale, in a hilarious black comedy that contains some of his most compelling solos.
cast: Totò, Raimondo Vianello, Nadine Sanders, Beatrice Altariba

title: Totò Sapore e la magica storia della pizza
synopsis: Naples, 1700. Every day the young storyteller Totò Sapore tells of rich lunches and delicacies. His dream is to become a great chef and when he inherits four old pots his life is destined to change: any crap is transformed as if by magic into exquisite food. In this way, Totò becomes the cook of the king of Naples and at court he falls in love with the beautiful Confiance. But the evil witch Vesuvia, owner of the pots, is lurking.

title: Totò Story
synopsis: In the year of his death, Totò was finally starting to be re-evaluated by the critics who had ignored him just as the audience crowded the screenings. We thought of compiling an anthology of his films: we can thus review some memorable scenes such as the dictation of a letter in Totò, Peppino e la malafemmina, the change of clothes in the car by Totò, Fabrizi and the young people of today, the printing of fake banknotes in The Band of the Honest, the design of a strange family tomb in Signori is born. It is not the best of the many anthologies then made by television, but it had at least one merit: it was the first.
cast: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Peppino De Filippo, Giacomo Furia

title: Totò a Napoli
synopsis: An unauthorized guide struggling with a group of tourists who would like to know Naples. The exceptional guide is Totò, who in this "special" aired on Rai shortly before the death of the great actor, who on this occasion also reads some of his poems.
cast: Totò, Luisella Boni, Miranda Martino, Peppino Di Capri, Gloria Christian

title: Totò a Parigi
synopsis: The perfidious baron of Chemantel discovers that his perfect double, Totò, lives in Rome, who lives in a shelter in a tree. He manages to take him to Paris and organizes a scam against the insurance: Totò must die and be mistaken for the baron, in order to collect the life insurance policy. Totò sings one of his songs (Miss, my dear Miss) and proposes his usual repertoire. We laugh less than usual due to an annoying romantic subplot. Sylva Koscina is an excellent female presence.
cast: Totò, Sylva Koscina, Lauretta Masiero, Fernand Gravey, Tiberio Mitri

title: Totò a colori
synopsis: Maestro Scannagatti, a misunderstood musical genius, lives in the town of Caianello. To convince him to direct a musical band, they promise him a meeting with the publisher Tiscordi. Scannagatti goes to Milan to bring his compositions to the publisher. He is believed to be mad and hunted. The first Italian color feature film is basically a collection of sketches from Totò's repertoire, from the sleeping car to the conductor's number to that of the puppet. Sublime moments, to be memorized.
cast: Totò, Luigi Pavese, Isa Barzizza, Mario Castellani, Virgilio Riento

title: Totò al Giro d'Italia
synopsis: To marry the woman he is in love with, Totò must win the Giro d'Italia. The devil presents himself to the desperate Totò to offer him victory in exchange for the soul. The race begins and, contrary to all expectations, the strange cyclist begins to beat Coppi, Bartali and other super champions. In an original look, with a mustache and goatee, Totò is unleashed. True pedal professionals crown him, including the two great champions mentioned.
cast: Totò, Isa Barzizza, Walter Chiari, Fulvia Franco, Giuditta Rissone

title: Totò all'inferno
synopsis: After several suicide attempts, Antonio accidentally drowns in a river. He ends up in Hell, where he meets Cleopatra; the great love that breaks out between the two makes Satan jealous and Antonio then runs away. While having fun in an existentialist haunt, he is recaptured by devils and taken back to the afterlife. Totò unleashed in a saraband of gimmicks, for a bizarre and fantastic subject (signed by himself) functional to his irrepressible comedy. The musical gag with the existentialists is hilarious.
cast: Totò, Franca Faldini, Maria Frau, Dante Maggio, Ubaldo Lay

title: Totò cerca casa
synopsis: The war is over and the civil servant Beniamino is one of the displaced people looking for a house. He wins a competition as a guardian with his family, but not reading the destination well, he later discovers that it is the cemetery. The family tries to adapt but a ghost, actually their daughter's jealous boyfriend, puts them on the run. Then they win the lottery and rent a house, but are duped.
cast: Totò, Ada Mangini, Aroldo Tieri, Luigi Pavese, Cesare Polacco

title: Totò cerca moglie
synopsis: Totò, a penniless painter, anxiously awaits the return from Australia of a rich aunt. The relative informs him that he will bring with him a girl that his nephew will have to marry. By mistake, Totò gets a photo of a very ugly woman. He then decides to quickly find a wife and confront his aunt with a fait accompli. A series of hilarious Gags, a dizzying pace: one of the jewels with Totò. Among the screenwriters of the film appear Age and Scarpelli still beginners.
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Aroldo Tieri, Marisa Merlini, Ave Ninchi, Elvy Lissiak

title: Totò cerca pace
synopsis: The marriage between Gennaro Piselli, widower and childless, and Gemma Torresi, widow and childless too, is frowned upon by their respective grandchildren. The only way to cause discord among the no longer young spouses is to instill the worm of jealousy in both of them. The trick works, but only for a short time: Gennaro and Gemma will have a clarifying explanation and will live happily ever after. The film is based on a comedy by Emilio Caglieri and suffers a little too much. Totò, here paired with Ave Ninchi, naturally works even if this is not his funniest film. In a short role also Paolo Ferrari, here on his debut.
cast: Totò, Ave Ninchi, Isa Barzizza, Enzo Turco, Paolo Ferrari

title: Totò che visse due volte
synopsis: Paletta is a man made fun of by everyone and perpetually humiliated who tries, unsuccessfully, to give vent to his insatiable sexual desire. The arrival of the prostitute Tremmotori pushes him to the theft of the votive shrine of the Ecce Homo. He'll have to deal with the neighborhood boss. Around the deathbed of a middle-aged homosexual: the mother waits for Fefé, the elderly lover of her son, to show up. Lazzaro, a mobster belonging to a losing clan is dissolved in acid by Don Totò. In the meantime, an old Messiah is wandering around and it is to him that Lazarus' family members turn to for the resurrection.
cast: Marcello Miranda, Salvatore Gattuso, Carlo Giordano, Pietro Arcidiacono

title: Totò contro Maciste
synopsis: Totocamen is a charlatan who performs in Thebes, where the Pharaoh of Egypt reigns, pretending to be very strong. Meanwhile Maciste, who is in love with the Pharaoh's daughter, is bewitched with a magical potion that makes him side with the Assyrians, enemies of Egypt. Totocamen is entrusted with the task of defeating them, and in vain ours tries to give up the impossible task.
cast: Totò, Nino Taranto, Gabriella Andreini, Nerio Bernardi, Samson Burke

title: Totò contro i quattro
synopsis: The day starts badly for a poor police commissioner whose car was stolen. And it gets worse and worse, with a man who brings a parrot as a witness to his wife's infidelity, a madman who mistakes a group of actors for bandits, a priest who knows all the shady criminals in the city.
cast: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Erminio Macario, Peppino De Filippo, Rossella Como

title: Totò contro il Pirata Nero
synopsis: In the Caribbean there is also room for the thief Totò who, to escape the guards, hides in a barrel that is hoisted onto a pirate ship. Here Totò is about to be hanged, but he is saved because with a sword-shaped magnet he helps the pirates against a Spanish ship. Then the Black Pirate storms the governor's palace and captures his daughter, but Totò saves her.
cast: Totò, Mario Petri, Grazia Maria Spina, Aldo Giuffré, Franco Ressel

title: Totò d'Arabia
synopsis: The head of the Intelligence Service entrusts the servant Totò with a very important mission concerning the oil of Kuwait. In fact, Totò was entrusted with the task of convincing the sheikh to grant the rights to exploit the wells to the British; but ours has to contend with a charming American spy. Endless ups and downs, but in the end Totò himself becomes the absolute master of the deposits.
cast: Totò, Nieves Navarro, Georges Rigaud, Fernando Sancho, Mario Castellani

title: Totò di notte n.1
synopsis: Ninì Cantachiaro (Totò) has received a sudden inheritance and decides to leave with his assistant Mimì (Macario). The two are amateur musicians and would like to play in the most prestigious clubs. They go to Madrid, London, Paris, New York and Hong Kong, but fail in their intent and decide to return to Rome. Parody of the numerous films that imitated the success of Europe by night by proposing sexy attractions taken from foreign night clubs, forbidden dreams of an Italy still bigot and moralistic. Not at all intimidated by Don Lurio or the Blue Bells, Totò manages to get some laughs, with Macario now resigned to the role of shoulder.
cast: Totò, Erminio Macario, Rose Margaret Keil, Mac Ronay, Don Lurio

title: Totò e Carolina
synopsis: In a raid carried out by morality at Villa Borghese, a girl who has just arrived from a nearby town, Carolina, is involved. To stop her was the agent Antonio Caccavallo who is instructed to take her home and supervise her having already attempted suicide.
cast: Totò, Anna Maria Ferrero, Arnoldo Foà, Maurizio Arena, Tina Pica

title: Totò e Cleopatra
synopsis: Marco Antonio loves Cleopatra but is persecuted by his jealous wife. Having found a poor man very similar to her husband, she sends him to the court of the queen of Egypt with the aim of putting an end to the relationship between the two. Cleopatra, for the pains of love, would like to kill herself but the poisonous asp, once bitten by the queen, falls to the ground poisoned. For its part, the unfortunate double gets to safety. All Cinecittà in 1963 was committed to the blockbuster Cleopatra, and imitations and parodies flocked. Totò could not be missing, at ease even in the midst of recycled sets and costumes, with the inevitable shoulders Mario Castellani and Gianni Agus.
cast: Totò, Magali Noël, Mario Castellani, Gianni Agus, Moira Orfei

title: Totò e Marcellino
synopsis: Totò, caught stealing, gets confused among the participants in the funeral of Marcellino's mother and is mistaken for the uncle of the child. Marcellino becomes attached to this alleged relative of his, but here comes a real uncle, the shady Alvaro, exploiter of children. In this way, the little Spaniard Pablito Calvo "pays" for the immense fame he acquired with "Marcellino pane e vino". For (too) good souls with an adequate supply of handkerchiefs. Even Totò's curtains do not do justice to the prince of laughter.
cast: Totò, Pablito Calvo, Fanfulla, Jone Salinas, Memmo Carotenuto

title: Totò e Peppino divisi a Berlino
synopsis: Totò's resemblance to the war criminal Canarinis is striking. Some friends of the Nazi hierarch try to take advantage of it and push the Italian to replace Canarinis in the trial that sees him accused. Totò, late realizing the situation, manages to explain the misunderstanding to the Americans, but the Russian agents kidnap him because he reveals some military secrets he is aware of. Totò's misadventures begin, with his friend Peppino Paglialunga at his side.
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Nadine Sanders, Luigi Pavese

title: Totò e i re di Roma
synopsis: Ercole Pappalardo, head of the archives of a Ministry, gets into collision (due to a sneeze) with its Director General. Fired on the pretext of not having an elementary school certificate, he decides to die in order to appear in a dream to the family with five good numbers to play the lotto. The trick succeeds, but it does not escape the General Managers of the afterlife who put him under investigation again.
cast: Totò, Anna Carena, Giovanna Pala, Alberto Sordi, Aroldo Tieri

title: Totò e le donne
synopsis: Totò is a clerk in a fabric shop and is harassed by a shrewish and intrusive wife. Totò matures for this a misogynistic vision of the world and tries to prove his thesis in a series of comic curtains. Imagine, for example, that you have married an old girlfriend and you figure some situations with her, but the result is not striking. He then separates from his wife, but soon changes his mind. Collection of misogynistic sketches, almost all of a good standard. The most beautiful is that of the prostitute oppressed by family and economic ailments and misfortunes. "And then they call them cheerful little women ...", is Totò's final comment.
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Lea Padovani, Franca Faldini

title: Totò le Moko
synopsis: Totò is chosen for the succession of the famous criminal boss Pepé le Moko, who has nothing to do with it. He is kidnapped and taken to the casbah of Algiers. A potion makes him brave, but a jealous woman cuts his hair and makes his audacity disappear ...
cast: Totò, Carlo Ninchi, Gianna Maria Canale, Carla Calò, Franca Marzi, Luigi Pavese

title: Totò nella fossa dei leoni
synopsis: Totò acts as a bodyguard to the beautiful Laura, saving her from the aims of a self-styled explorer (but an actual swindler) and returning her to her father who is with a tribe of savages. After that, love triumphs.
cast: Totò, Vera Carmi, Enrico Glori, Primo Carnera, Arturo Bragaglia

title: Totò nella luna
synopsis: Totò, editor of a magazine, is perpetually at loggerheads with the messenger Achille, in love with his daughter. For the not vile sum of thirty million dollars, and also due to a series of misunderstandings, Totò and Achille end up on the moon where they find two copies of themselves. Certainly not one of the best things about the prince of laughter. The young and talented Tognazzi launches into an imitation of Totò.
cast: Totò, Sylva Koscina, Ugo Tognazzi, Sandra Milo, Luciano Salce

title: Totò premio Nobel
synopsis: The magazine "Once upon a time in the world", by Michele Galdieri, was an authentic workhorse of Totò in the theater. Among the most famous and successful sketches of this show was the very famous one of the sleeping car played by Totò in a duet with his most trusted and habitual "shoulder": Mario Castellani. In the sketch Totò is an intrusive curmudgeon who is in the same railway compartment with the Hon. Cosimo Trombetta, distinguished and meek gentleman who undergoes the inevitable propotencies of the other. At a certain point, a woman enters between the two of them who, by pretending to be persecuted, ends up relieving them both of the wallet.
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Sandra Milo, Corrado Mantoni

title: Totò sceicco
synopsis: Desperate for a pain of love, the Marquis Gastone enlisted in the Foreign Legion. To "look after him", the butler Antonio Sapore (Totò) is put in tow. Due to a misunderstanding, Antonio is mistaken for the sheikh's son and ends up in the mysterious continent of Atlantis, where Queen Antinea falls in love with him.
cast: Totò, Tamara Lees, Aroldo Tieri, Riccardo Billi, Laura Gore, Cesare Polacco

title: Totò sexy
synopsis: Ninì and Mimì, modest double bass players persecuted by the blackest bad luck, end up in prison. Here to pass the time they tell their dreams: both would like to visit the most famous night clubs in Europe, attend striptease, see and meet beautiful and fascinating women. We see them like this in the best clubs in Paris, London, Berlin, Madrid.
cast: Totò, Erminio Macario, Mario Castellani, Toni Ucci, Mario Pisu, Franca Polesello

title: Totò terzo uomo
synopsis: The town is run by Piero, an austere and rigid man, quite the opposite of his twin Paolo, who instead enjoys life. The two brothers are fighting over the construction of a penitentiary on land owned by Paolo. Piero, in fact, finds every quibble in order not to shell out the expropriation money. Suddenly a third twin arrives in the village, of which everyone was unaware of the existence, which still complicates things.
cast: Totò, Franca Marzi, Elli Parvo, Carlo Campanini, Aroldo Tieri

title: Totò, Eva e il pennello proibito
synopsis: In Madrid, Eva and her accomplice Raoul convince the critic Francisco Montiel that they have discovered a "Maja in a shirt", to be added to Goya's "desnuda" and "vestida". In reality, the work is the birth of Totò, who painted the fake tempted by the promise of Eve's favors. Once the painting has been obtained, the latter does everything to eliminate the suitor. Steno's direction and Metz's screenplay are, as usual, overshadowed by the stage presence of Totò, capable of embroidering skits and nonsense baroque on the tenuous starting idea.
cast: Totò, Abbe Lane, Mario Carotenuto, Louis De Funès, Giacomo Furia, Francesco Mulè

title: Totò, Fabrizi e i giovani d'oggi
synopsis: The cavalier Cocozza (Totò) and the accountant D'Amore (Aldo Fabrizi) have in common only an unstoppable gab and a powerful polemical vocation. Forced to confront the prospect of becoming in-laws, they spark. With so much torque in action it is inevitable that the space that remains for the other characters is almost nil: Totò and Fabrizi, in excellent shape, steal the film, deepening their repertoire in a series of bickering at high speed, high volume and high potential. exhilarating. The story is tenuous, but the stage presence of the two comedians is enough and advances.
cast: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Christine Kaufmann, Geronimo Meynier

title: Totò, Peppino and... the Sweet Life
Totò, Peppino e i fuorilegge
synopsis: Totò's rich wife keeps her husband on the spot. Then he, with the help of his trusted friend Peppino, pretends to be kidnapped by bandits and gets his wife to pay a ransom of five million. Together with his accomplice he squanders the money in a nightclub in Rome, but the television takes over and his wife discovers everything. Later, however, Totò is really kidnapped, but his wife ...
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Dorian Gray, Titina De Filippo, Franco Interlenghi

title: Totò, Peppino e la... malafemmina
synopsis: Totò and Peppino learn that their nephew Gianni, instead of studying at the university, has joined a theater company to follow the beautiful Marisa with whom he has fallen in love. The two uncles try everything to remove the nephew from what they believe is a woman of easy virtue and for this purpose they leave the village for the first time for Milan.
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Teddy Reno, Dorian Gray

title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
synopsis: Cavalier Antonio Vignarello and accountant Peppino Caprioli tell the director of the asylum in which they are hospitalized that they are there because not of their obsessions but of those of their respective family members. And it is such a convincing story that the director decides to free them; at the earliest opportunity he will intern the joint pestilers.
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Aroldo Tieri, Alessandra Panaro, Mario Riva, Virna Lisi, Johnny Dorelli, Elena Borgo, Diana Dei, Enzo Garinei, Giacomo Furia, Fanfulla, Renato Carosone

title: Totò, Peppino e una di quelle
synopsis: A young woman, a widow, with a seriously ill child is forced, driven by a desperate need for money, to seek occasional meetings in the evening. A provincial runs into her in turn in search of adventures. Arriving in her house, however, the son has a violent attack of diphtheria and the man does his utmost to help the poor woman. Twilight comedy, more pathetic than hilarious, in which Fabrizi stands aside as an actor and directs Totò and Peppino in two rather moving roles. The tearful excess is felt only occasionally.
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Lea Padovani, Aldo Fabrizi, Armando Annuale

title: Totò, Peppino e... la dolce vita
synopsis: The notables of a southern village would like to divert the route of the highway near the village. For this they send Antonio to Rome, after having stuffed him with money. However, nothing more is known about Antonio, therefore Peppino sets out from the town in search of him. Tracked down Antonio, Peppino discovers that the companion has given himself up to the dolce vita and promptly follows in his footsteps. The two frequent nightclubs and beautiful women until a relative brings them home. Based only in part on Fellini's original, the film has some exhilarating moments in the confrontation between the two provincials and the city.
cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Mara Berni, Francesco Mulè, Rosalba Neri

title: Totò, Vittorio e la dottoressa
synopsis: Young Othello fell in love with the beautiful Brigitte, an American practicing as a doctor. Othello's two aunts suspect his nephew's beautiful girlfriend and hire two detectives to follow her. But the two are just braggart: in fact they are shoe shine and have been hired for the investigation thanks to a misunderstanding. They combine all kinds of troubles before the affair ends with the marriage of the two young men. Under the guidance of Mastrocinque, Totò and De Sica play the part of two friendly scoundrels. The film is alternate but has hilarious moments (Totò welcoming a lady from San Vincenzo with "Dear Admiral"). The beautiful American is Abbe Lane, then very famous.
cast: Totò, Vittorio De Sica, Abbe Lane, Titina De Filippo, Agostino Salvietti

title: Totò, lascia o raddoppia?
synopsis: Duke Gagliardo della Forcoletta, thanks to his immense culture, becomes a champion in Leave or double, the quiz presented by Mike Bongiorno. Meanwhile, two gangsters, lovers of betting, have staked a lot of money on him: one stating that he will surely leave, the other certain that he will choose the double. When things seem to go wrong, Totò manages to get the bandits arrested and to enjoy the nest egg. For the first time, Totò "confronts" himself with TV and is irresistible, as always, especially in his proverbial puns. Among the actresses there is a very young Valeria Moriconi.
cast: Totò, Mike Bongiorno, Valeria Moriconi, Dorian Gray, Bruce Cabot, Elio Pandolfi

title: Totòtarzan
synopsis: Totò is the grown-up and semi-savage son of a very rich explorer. Abandoned at an early age in the jungle and becoming an adult there, he is brought home by three adventurers and then also approached by a relative, the father of three beautiful daughters of marriageable age. The reason for the many attentions to which Totò Tarzan is subjected is the inheritance he must take possession of, the parent having died.
cast: Totò, Marylin Buferd, Bianca Frisori, Mario Castellani, Tino Buazzelli, Galeazzo Benti

title: Totòtruffa '62
synopsis: Antonio Peluffo with his accomplice Felice Campano scoring small scams against simpleton and gullible. Antonio must support his daughter in a luxurious Swiss boarding school where they believe him to be a career diplomat. However, the girl falls in love with the son of the commissioner who persecutes Antonio who, unbeknownst to his father, has obtained a job thanks to the two swindlers. The whole film is based solely on the comedy of the great Totò well supported by Nino Taranto. Some of the thousands of disguises and expedients of the two comedians belong by right to the anthology of laughter: Totò wife cheating ("She undresses me with her eyes ... dressing room!") And Taranto jealous husband, the sale of the Trevi Fountain etc.
cast: Totò, Nino Taranto, Lia Zoppelli, Ernesto Calindri, Mario Castellani

title: Touch
synopsis: Cha Jung Hyeok, a renowned makeup artist obsessed with perfection, once soared to the pinnacle of his career. However, destiny had other plans, leaving him jobless and deep in debt. Han Soo Yeon, an idol trainee for a decade, yearns for her breakthrough. After a failed audition, she questions her path. Their paths converge in unexpected ways, with Jung Hyeok offering Soo Yeon mentorship as a makeup artist. Recognizing her talent, he becomes her teacher, and their bond deepens. Together, they shed the burdens of shattered dreams, paving the way for a future filled with fresh aspirations.

synopsis: Yoon Ari is a Succubus who feeds off of human "energy". One day, she meets a masked man who seems to be different. This is all happening during the pandemic! (Source: MyDramaList)

title: Touch Your Heart
synopsis: Oh Yoon Seo is a popular actress. She is famous for her beautiful appearance, but her acting is bad. She gets involved in a scandal with the son from a chaebol family. Her acting career declines precipitously. Oh Yoon Seo hears that a famous screenwriter wants her to play the lead female role for a drama series. The character works as a secretary for a lawyer. To gain experience for the role, Oh Yoon Seo is required to work as a lawyer's secretary for a few months. Meanwhile, Kwon Jung Rok is an attorney for a law firm. He is arrogant and cold-hearted. One day, his boss asks Kwon Jung Rok to let actress Oh Yoon Seo work as his secretary for 3 months. He is not happy about the situation, but he has to accept. ~~ Adapted from the web novel “Jinsimi Dadda” by Yegeo.

title: Touch and Go
synopsis: Bobby Barbato is a wealthy ice hockey player. One evening he suffers an attempted robbery by a man who uses a boy as a bait. The baby is so nice that Bobby takes him back to his mother Denise instead of the police. Love is born between Bobby and the woman. Michael Keaton is the usual "boiled", and the story is obvious.
cast: Michael Keaton, Maria Conchita Alonso, Ajay Naidu, Maria Tucci

title: Touch of Evil
synopsis: Mike Vargas, Mexican police inspector, and his wife Susan must interrupt their honeymoon to come to terms with the killing of wealthy owner Linnekar, which took place on the border between the United States and Mexico. Vargas participates in the investigation alongside the American inspector Quinlan. Meanwhile Susan is tricked by a shady guy, who, by blackmailing the woman, aims to free her brother who has been arrested by the Mexican inspector.
cast: Orson Welles, Charlton Heston, Janet Leigh, Joseph Calleia, Marlene Dietrich, Akim Tamiroff, Joanna Moore, Ray Collins, Dennis Weaver, Valentin De Vargas, Mort Mills, Victor Millan

title: Touch of Pink
synopsis: Alim, a young Canadian gay photographer of Indian descent, lives in a trendy area of ??London with his boyfriend Giles. To give him some advice, the ghost of Cary Grant appears every now and then. When his mother Nuru arrives in the city unannounced from Toronto, even his "particular" advisor has some difficulty about what advice to give. Nuru also has a secret plan: to bring her son back to Canada with her so she can settle down and marry a pretty Indian girl.
cast: Jimi Mistry, Kristen Holden Reid, Suleka Mathew, Kyle MacLachlan, Sue Mathew

title: Touch of Truth
synopsis: Michael, an autistic child, is assisted by his mother, who is totally dedicated to him, and by a teacher who tries to bring him back to life. However, no one knows that the child was raped by a young assistant: once again the teacher, with great patience, will bring out the horrible truth, frame the rapist and bring the child back on the path of even partial recovery. There are more and more films destined for television that deal with children, their traumatic experiences, their handicaps, the dramatic relationship with the adult world. Civil commitment supported by unsurprising suspense.
cast: Patty Duke, Melissa Gilbert, Bradley Pierce

title: Touch the Top of the World
synopsis: From an early age, Erik was diagnosed with a genetic disorder, leading him to blindness at the age of thirteen. With the support of his mother, he continued his studies and, spurred on by his father, he kept himself in excellent physical shape: he attended a high school where he even became a fighting champion. Following the sudden death of his mother, Erik begins mountain climbing while finishing college and becoming a teacher. After having conquered ever higher peaks, in 2001 he decides to challenge Everest, helped by some friends and against difficult climatic conditions.
cast: Peter Facinelli, Sarah Manninen, Bruce Campbell, Tom Carey, Cassandra Bennett, Brian Copping, Saxon DeCocq, Dawson Dunbar, Talon Dunbar, Sarah Hyslop

title: Touche pas à la femme blanche
synopsis: Bulldozers demolish the popular district of Les Halles in Paris. Every week she sleeps with men to get some money. Every week she becomes a celebrity (using that money), she is a special customer of a select shop, and this is the most important thing to her. For the sake of this weekly visit, she can do anything. One day she meets a girl and her views about money changes. Episode 2 - Live Chat Live chat is a way of connecting with people -- there she's called "Yuna" (Horikita Maki). Exchanging words with people is her job (Note: The first five persons she's talking to are some of Yamada's friends in Densha Otoko). Two years ago, there was an incident. And then her life changes... Episode 3 - Actress Nao's father is a doll maker and wants her to inherit his business. However, Nao doesn't want to be making dolls for the rest of her life and ends up getting kicked out of the house and fleeing to Tokyo. This was two years ago. In Tokyo, Nao gets swindled by someone calling himself a talent scout and keeps failing at auditions. She soon falls into debt and tries to survive by working part time at a night club and holding other extra jobs. Nao wants to be an actress, but becomes very impatient and makes a big error. It is something that even her boyfriend Riku must never know. Then one day, the one person in her whole family who approves of Nao's goal of becoming an actress suddenly appears in Tokyo: her grandfather. But, her old senile grandfather even recognizing her is another story... Episode 4 - Slot Shimojou Ryoko makes her living by playing slot machines. Abandoned by her parents when she was very young, Ryoko moved from one relationship to another, always seeking permanency and always disappointed. One day she woke up to find a small boy, Kentai, sitting in her room with a note from her boyfriend Kenji. Kenji, a host, asked Ryoko to take care of the boy for a few days. Ryoko, the person who has always wanted to be loved, is about to find out what loving someone is about... Source: DramaWiki

He hasn't visited the family for fifteen years, but regularly mails a check, never having an accompanying word. Shingo (Kamatari Fujiwara), Kimiko's uncle, suspects that this attitude is due to Oyuki's greed, which would force him to send the money secretly. Kimiko is especially worried about her mother, who in her poems always expresses a deep melancholy and great sorrow for her loneliness. The young woman, however, does not want to place all the responsibility on her father, remembering that after all her mother did not seem to care much about him. The girl is about to marry Seiji (Heihachirô Ôkawa), but the latter's father, in agreement with the marriage, wants to meet Kimiko's father before giving his approval. Added to this is the fact that Etsuko cannot refuse to act as an intermediary [= nakoudo, a family friend who is always present in all the meetings of the future spouses, up to the ceremony] at the wedding of one of his students, a role only granted to married people. One day, while she is in a taxi with her boyfriend, the girl spots her father in the streets of Tokyo, but she is unable to reach him. Sure she'll visit the family, she prepares a welcome banquet. The man, however, does not show up. Kimiko, although warned that it will not be easy to get the better of Oyuki, then decides to leave for the country where Shunsaku lives, with the firm intention of bringing him back home.
