synopsis: The analyst Francesco (Marco Giallini) is struggling with three desperate cases to solve and which concern a bookseller (Vittoria Puccini) who fell in love with a book thief (Vinicio Marchioni), a lesbian (Anna Foglietta) who has decided to return heterosexual and an eighteen year old (Laura Adriani) who has lost her head for a fifty year old (Alessandro Gassman) pushing him to leave his wife (Claudia Gerini). What makes poor Francesco's life a real hell is the fact that the three patients are none other than his three beloved daughters.
cast: Marco Giallini, Vittoria Puccini, Anna Foglietta, Vinicio Marchioni, Laura Adriani, Daniele Liotti, Paolo Calabresi, Antonio Manzini, Alessandro Gassmann, Claudia Gerini, Edoardo Leo, Giulia Bevilacqua, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Maurizio Mattioli, Francesco Apolloni, Dodi Conti

title: Tutta colpa di Giuda
synopsis: Irena is a young director who accepts the invitation of Don Iridio, chaplain of a prison, to create a show for Easter with the inmates. But the representation has a hitch. None of the prisoners - for implicit but obvious reasons - accepts the part of the one who betrayed: Judas. And while Irena finds herself fighting with her heart and against those who row against her, she has a sudden "revelation": what if there was no Judas in history? What if things for once went the other way than religion has accustomed us to believe for 2000 years?
cast: Kasia Smutniak, Fabio Troiano, Gianluca Gobbi, Luciana Littizzetto, Cristiano Godano, Ladis Zanini, Francesco Signa, Paolo Ciarchi, Linda Messerklinger

title: Tutta da scoprire
synopsis: A rambling bundle of blackmail and double cross games between two couples plus one (of men, the latter). The highlight of the film should be Nadia Cassini, "to be discovered" in fact. Let alone the side dish.
cast: Nadia Cassini, Yorgo Voyagis, Renzo Montagnani, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale

title: Tutta la città canta
synopsis: A young professor is succubus of the zie with impetus and intrusive. One day he receives an unexpected legacy: a distant relative leaves him a musical magazine he produced. The country and above all the aunts shout at the scandal. But the teacher will be very good in his new employment, to the point of definitively leaving the teaching to devote himself to the variety.
cast: Nino Taranto, Nanda Primavera, Maria Pia Arcangeli, Vivi Gioi, Natalino Otto, Giuseppe Addobbati, Gianni Bonos, Luigi Bonos, Vittorio Bonos, Angelo Calabrese

title: Tutta la conoscenza del mondo
synopsis: Claudio - confined to a wheelchair - and Marco are saved by a luminous being similar to an extraterrestrial, who avoids an accident while they are crossing the tracks. After this episode, the existence of the two is irremediably marked: Marco eagerly throws himself on books that deal with the paranormal, while Claudio begins to archive news regarding extrasensory experiences. At the same time we witness the events of Giovanna, in love with her philosophy professor.
cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Marco Bonini, Claudio Guain, Giorgio Albertazzi

title: Tutta la verità
synopsis: Paola lives happily with her husband Marco and son Adriano. When the brilliant cardiac surgeon Giulio Guidi enters her life, the woman is overwhelmed by an unexpected and all-consuming passion. He becomes his secret lover but after a short time Laura, assistant and former lover of Guidi, mysteriously disappears ...
cast: Vittoria Puccini, Daniele Pecci, Filippo Nigro

title: Tutta la vita davanti
synopsis: 25-year-old Marta, graduated with honors in philosophy, decides to work in a call center to earn some money: her job is to place food robots. Her determination puts her in the good graces of Daniela, who is in charge of telephone operators. But a tenacious trade unionist wants to bring to light the situation of precarious workers ...
cast: Isabella Ragonese, Sabrina Ferilli, Valerio Mastandrea, Massimo Ghini, Micaela Ramazzotti, Elio Germano, Claudio Fragasso, Valentina Carnelutti, Elena Arvigo

title: Tutta un'altra vita
synopsis: What would you do if fate offered you to become another person for a week? Gianni is a Roman taxi driver with an established routine. He has a wife and two children and dreams of winning the lottery to change his dull and always the same everyday, unable as he is to change the flow of his life. And when a wealthy couple, leaving for a week in the Maldives, forgets the keys of their wonderful thousand and one nights villa in his taxi, Gianni takes the risk: he takes possession of the villa and the life of its owner, ending up in a carousel of emotions never lived before that culminate in the unexpected meeting with Lola, a girl's dream who sees in him a winner and that upsets his existence. Gianni becomes another person and the one with Lola is really "a whole other life" ... and he would be ready to give up everything for her if it weren't for the fact that at the end of the holiday week the legitimate owners return to the villa.
cast: Enrico Brignano, Ilaria Spada, Paola Minaccioni, Giorgio Colangeli, Maurizio Lombardi, Monica Vallerini, Daniela Terreri, Paolo Sassanelli, Irene Antonucci, Elio Pagano, Rossella Brescia

title: Tuttapposto
synopsis: Roberto is a college student at a university where teachers sell exams, hire only friends and relatives, and are dedicated to recommending. Roberto's father is also the magnificent Rector. Roberto, going against his family, tired of being subservient to the power of the baron, with his friends, decides to fight this modus operandi. In fact, he creates a smartphone app called "Tuttapposto" which evaluates the work of the professors. All this will lead to a series of twists and turns and a reversal of roles: students acquire unexpected power and professors are forced to behave honestly in order to get a good grade.
cast: Roberto Lipari, Luca Zingaretti, Monica Guerritore, Ninni Bruschetta, Sergio Friscia, Silvana Fallisi, Paolo Sassanelli, Maurizio Marchetti, Victoriya Pisotska, Simona Di Bella, Carlo Calderone, Francesco Russo

title: Tutte le donne della mia vita
synopsis: Davide, a cook by profession, loses his job. In search of consolation, he opens the diary and calls the women he has been with in the past, but they are all trying to forget him. For the first time in his life he is forced to take stock and understand what he went wrong.
cast: Luca Zingaretti, Vanessa Incontrada, Michela Cescon, Lisa Gastoni, Ricky Tognazzi, Jane Alexander (II)

title: Tutte le mie notti
synopsis: On a winter night, in the deserted streets of a seaside town, Veronica and Sara meet and their lives unexpectedly change perspective. Secrets, lies and fears accompany the most hidden truths of the two women.
cast: Barbora Bobulova, Benedetta Porcaroli, Alessio Boni, Carolina Rey

title: Tutte le scuole del Regno
synopsis: A portrait of the last year of school, before retirement, by Marisa Cordone, director of three Palermo schools in the most complicated areas of the city. The experiences of the children's families, the daily difficulties between students and professors, the objective limits of teaching in a complicated and poorly equipped reality are confronted every day with the passion and energy of decades of teaching, right at the moment. in which the teacher is about to stop working.

title: Tutte le storie di Piera
synopsis: In an old theater of the sixties, the actress Piera Degli Esposti retraces her long and extraordinary life, her love for the art world and that for the brilliant director Marco Ferreri. His words alternate with the testimonies of friends and colleagues: from Marco Bellocchio to Paolo Sorrentino, passing through the Taviani brothers, Lina Wertmüller and Giuseppe Tornatore.
cast: Piera Degli Esposti, Marco Bellocchio, Paolo Sorrentino, Paolo Taviani, Vittorio Taviani, Giuseppe Tornatore, Lina Wertmüller

title: Tutte lo vogliono
synopsis: Chiara (Vanessa Incontrada), refined and beautiful entrepreneur, has a crush on the charming Raphael (Giulio Berruti) but cannot let herself go completely. On the advice of a friend, she decides to make an appointment with an inveterate seducer to explain the secrets of passion to her. By mistake, however, he finds himself in front of the clumsy Orazio (Enrico Brignano), who makes ends meet by shampooing the dogs.
cast: Enrico Brignano, Vanessa Incontrada, Giulio Berruti, Ilaria Spada, Michela Andreozzi, Gianna Paola Scaffidi, Marta Zoboli

title: Tutti a bordo
synopsis: Losing the train is very ugly. Seeing him leave with your children and those of your friends who had to accompany on vacation is completely another story ... that of the crazy chase from Turin to Sicily of a father and grandfather as different as it is unreliable.
cast: Stefano Fresi, Giovanni Storti, Giulia Michelini, Gigio Alberti, Carlo Buccirosso, Helena Antonio, Gaia Messerklinger, Paolo Giangrasso, Giorgia Cardaci, Davide Bechini, Alessandro Intini, Samuel Leclerc, Andrea Vasone, Fiorella Zullo, Massimo Ceccherini

title: Tutti a casa
synopsis: Lieutenant Innocenzi, overwhelmed like all his comrades by the armistice of 8 September 1943, tries to go home with three soldiers from his unit. In the end - now left alone with the engineer Ceccarelli - he succeeds, but his father would like to see him enlisted with the Germans ...
cast: Alberto Sordi, Serge Reggiani, Eduardo De Filippo, Carla Gravina

title: Tutti a squola
synopsis: Professor Pippo Bettini who received an old-fashioned education finds himself teaching at the Edmondo De Amicis institute where P38, drugs and feminist extremism reign. He, fish out of water, happens to be blackmailed by a couple of drug dealers, who threatens to kill the son of a colleague of his. In exchange for peace of mind Pippo is forced to sell drugs among the students of the institute.
cast: Pippo Franco, Oreste Lionello, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Lino Banfi, Laura Troschel, Isabella Biagini, Bombolo, Jack La Cayenne

title: Tutti al mare
synopsis: Maurizio (Marco Giallini) is a chioscarolo, and every day he sees many pass by, the patrons come and go, a bestiary in underwear and T-shirt that appears in the morning to disappear in the night lights.
cast: Anna Bonaiuto, Elio Germano, Libero De Rienzo, Ambra Angiolini, Ninetto Davoli, Ennio Fantastichini, Francesco Montanari, Gigi Proietti, Ilaria Occhini, Vincenzo Cerami, Marco Giallini, Sergio Fiorentini, Claudia Zanella

title: Tutti all'attacco
synopsis: Ax Bernabei, professional coach, trains the team of the Psychotherapeutic Center of his city. His big break comes when he is called by a Serie C team, whose President is a charming girl who has to deal with a disastrous budget. The Wong brothers are hired, five boys who are passionate about _Shaolin Soccer_ from China ...
cast: Massimo Ceccherini, Alessandro Paci, Dado, Rosalia Porcaro, Giovanni Cacioppo, Claudio Batta, Sabrina Venezia, Luis Molteni, Isabella Cecchi

title: Tutti contro tutti
synopsis: Agostino (Rolando Ravello) is a worker who lives with his family in an apartment on the outskirts of a big city. Struggling with everyday difficulties, Augustine is upset when, returning from his son's first communion, he finds his home occupied by another family. He then decides, with the support of his wife Anna (Kasia Smutniak), his children and his grandfather (Stefano Altieri) to start a very personal battle to regain what belongs to him and stages a singular form of protest by occupying the landing of the apartment.
cast: Rolando Ravello, Kasia Smutniak, Marco Giallini, Stefano Altieri, Lidia Vitale, Valentina Sperlì, Ivano De Matteo

title: Tutti defunti... tranne i morti
synopsis: In the castle of the Zanetti marquises a man arrives with a book on which a prophecy is written: the death of 9 family members will give indications for finding a hidden treasure. In a short time the expected number passes to a better life: the marquisina Ilaria, the seller of the book and an investigator who does not understand anything remain. Furthermore, one of the deceased reappears alive and well.
cast: Gianni Cavina, Francesca Marciano, Carlo Delle Piane

title: Tutti dentro
synopsis: Judge Salvemini, a very scrupulous official, is conducting a very delicate investigation into alleged bribes on some oil supplies, which would involve ministers and senior state officials, as well as wealthy people from the entertainment world. To ingratiate him, they invite him to spend the weekend on the Côte d'Azur, but the inflexible judge has them arrested. So inflexible, but also so naïve, Salvemini will get stuck, ending up in jail too. Sordi tries to represent the reality of our country: however, more involuntarily grotesque works have come out of it.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Joe Pesci, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Giorgia Moll

title: Tutti figli di mammasantissima
cast: Pino Colizzi, Ornella Muti, Alf Thunder, Tano Cimarosa, Christa Linger

title: Tutti fratelli nel West... per parte di padre
synopsis: Gipo, a young adventurer, receives as a gift a fragment of a nugget on which the map of a legendary mine is engraved. He sets out in search of the other pieces in possession of a varied collection of humanity. When his mission is complete, he discovers that the mine belongs to the state, but does not despair: in the meantime he has found love. The veteran Grieco puts on the best of an epigonal western and slob.
cast: Antonio Sabato, Peter Garsten, Fernando Sancho, Giacomo Furia

title: Tutti giù per terra
synopsis: Walter is twenty-two years old and reluctantly returned to his family in Turin, after spending his adolescence in Rome with his aunt Caterina. Endowed with ferocious irony, but without work, without money and above all without any prospects, he does nothing but hang around the streets of the center. Observe the hated symbols of wealth, fantasizing about a love story worth living.
cast: Valerio Mastandrea, Benedetta Mazzini, Carlo Monni, Gianluca Gobbi

title: Tutti gli anni una volta all'anno
synopsis: Ten elderly people meet every year in a Roman trattoria to celebrate the birthday of two of them. This year, however, one of the celebrated died leaving a curious legacy: an old convent in which the nine survivors could all go to live together.
cast: Giorgio Albertazzi, Lando Buzzanca, Paola Pitagora

title: Tutti gli uomini del deficiente
synopsis: Leone Stella is seventy years old and has had a life full of excesses and genius. But now he is tired of working, he has designed a video game about his life, he has launched a competition to leave everything to a person who is called like him. A group of "Leone Stella" (or "Stella Leone") starts the race: a kind of "treasure hunt" radio-guided by three speakers ...
cast: Claudia Gerini, Paolo Hendel, Gigio Alberti, Arnoldo Foà, Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti

title: Tutti gli uomini di Sara
synopsis: Sara Lancetti, lawyer and betrothed to Max Altieri, is the victim of obscene and threatening phone calls. Try to figure out who could be the author, investigating all his former lovers. Without results. The wedding date is approaching, Max has to go abroad for business and returns on the day of the ceremony. During the same, Sara sees suspicious scratches on his hands and runs away scared ... Tescari arrives from the video clip and can be seen in the editing solutions that support the story: a "strong" story in which yellow tones prevail. pink, diffused light and chic underwear. The complex, however, does not work.
cast: Nancy Brilli, Giulio Scarpati, Claudio Bigagli, Luciano Bartoli, Antonella Lualdi

title: Tutti gli uomini sono uguali
synopsis: Giacomo, Claudio and Martino lead very different existences, but something unites them: the recent separation from their respective consorts. Dried up by the payment of foods, they decide to rent an apartment together and to take a dash: thus arrives the beautiful American Eli, and the mess begins ...
cast: Massimo Wertmüller, Randi Ingerman, Enzo Decaro, Maurizio Crozza, Sabrina Salerno

title: Tutti i colori del buio
synopsis: Due to childhood trauma, Jane suffers from recurring nightmares. Her sister recommends a psychiatrist, while a neighbor tries to cure her with black magic. But it's all a plot to steal her inheritance. After "The strange vice of Mrs. Wardh", Martino tries again with the thriller, leaning on the graces of the beautiful Fenech. But its suspense is taken for granted and second-hand.
cast: Edwige Fenech, George Hilton, Ivan Rassimov, Marina Malfatti, Nieves Navarro, Julián Ugarte, Maria Cumani Quasimodo, George Rigaud, Luciano Pigozzi

title: Tutti i rumori del mare
synopsis: For twenty years, X has lived without an identity, as if he did not exist in the world. He has no name or home and works for a criminal organization, so he secretly carries things and people. He has been commissioned to bring the young Nora from Budapest to Italy to introduce her to the world of high-profile prostitution but discovers that he has been given the wrong girl. At first the organization orders him to abandon her while subsequently the imperative is categorical: he will have to kill Nora or the organization will kill him.
cast: Sebastiano Filocamo, Orsolya Tóth, Benn Northover, Catrinel Marlon, Zsolt Árpád Mészáros, János Papp, Zsolt Anger, Mimmo Craig, Malika Ayane, Rocco Siffredi

title: Tutti i rumori del mondo
synopsis: Elena is a career woman, manager of a company she inherited from her father. She has a partner, Stefano, who loves her deeply. Elena only needs one thing to feel fulfilled: a child. And here, shortly after the beginning of the new year, Alessandro was born. But what appears to be a quiet child is actually suffering from a serious congenital defect: the child is in fact deaf. The difficulties in dealing with the situation will put a strain on Elena and her emotional relationships, even leading her to face painful unresolved issues with her father ...
cast: Elena Sofia Ricci, Stefano Pesce, Gioele Dix, Luigi Diberti

title: Tutti i santi giorni
synopsis: Guido and Antonia have decided to have a child. They have been engaged for a long time and it finally seems the right time to start a family. At first glance, their desire is easy to satisfy if it weren't for the fact that the two hardly ever see each other due to their diabolical working hours. Meek, patient and more cultured than the average, Guido in fact works at night as a porter in a hotel while Antonia, ignorant and restless, is busy all day as an employee of a car rental. The only solution appears to be that of resorting to assisted procreation.
cast: Thony, Luca Marinelli, Micol Azzurro, Giovanni La Parola, Benedetta Barzini, Claudio Pallitto, Stefania Felicioli, Franco Gargia, Mimma Pirrè, Fabio Gismondi, Katie McGovern, Robin Mugnain, Frank Crudele

title: Tutti per 1 - 1 per tutti
synopsis: The Musketeers D'Artagnan (Pierfrancesco Favino), Porthos (Valerio Mastandrea) and Athos (Rocco Papaleo) are recalled by Queen Anne of Austria (Margherita Buy) for a very last secret mission. Guided this time by a singular visionary named Tomtom (Giulia Michelini), they will embark on a new, amazing adventure that will intertwine the destinies of little Princess Ginevra (Sara Ciocca), daughter of Enrichetta of England (Anna Ferzetti), and Buffon ( Federico Ielapi), a very young and curly orphan. In a journey full of challenges of all kinds and fantastic encounters, including the one with Cirano (Guido Caprino), they will face the toughest of tests: choosing between loyalty to the Crown and that of friendship.
cast: Pierfrancesco Favino, Valerio Mastandrea, Rocco Papaleo, Margherita Buy, Federico Ielapi, Giulia Michelini, Guido Caprino, Anna Ferzetti, Sara Ciocca, Giulio Scarpati, Davide Marotta, Massimiliano Varrese, Luis Molteni, Ubaldo Pantani, Anna Bonasso

title: Tutti per Uma
synopsis: Six males: grandfather Attila, Ezio, Dante, Francesco, Emanuele and their dog Patrizio live under the same roof and between continuous quarrels and mutual intolerances try unnecessarily to straighten the family business: a production of wines and champagne once famous in All of Italy, however now full of debts and in the hands of the banks. With the arrival of Uma, however, things change: in front of her everyone pretend to get along with what they are not, convinced of breaching her's heart. Uma, however, does not take much to discover the truth about their account: Attilio's debts, Dante and Ezio's failures and the desire to dance and be accepted by little Francesco. With great surprise of all, however, instead of escaping from that asylum he decides to help them, starting a real "uma therapy" that will lead them to bring out the best of themselves. Uma, however, also hides a secret.
cast: Laura Bilgeri, Pietro Sermonti, Antonio Catania, Pasquale Petrolo, Dino Abbrescia, Gabriele Ansanelli, Valerio Bartocci, Carolina Rey, Pujadevi Elisa Lepore, Nico Abbrescia, Susy Laude

title: Tutti per uno botte per tutti
synopsis: Young Dart wants to join the Texas Rangers. He then leaves his native country but, along the way, he meets a French businessman who is negotiating a cargo of gold with President Ortega, in exchange for the exploitation rights of some mines. The gold travels aboard an "ambulance" driven by the beautiful Alice and escorted by three nice friends always ready to fight. It is a sort of parody of some genres including the western, the picaresque, the karate films, which however, mixed together, cancel the respective potentials of humor and spectacularity, falling into farce.
cast: Timothy Brent, George Eastman, Karin Schubert, Leo Anchoriz

title: Tutti possono arricchire tranne i poveri
synopsis: Giovanni works as a switchboard operator, his wife Viviana instead teaches in an evening school. But suddenly, here is a nice thirteen at the Totocalcio. Giovanni and Viviana leave their jobs, decide to move to Montecarlo, live like the rich, travel aboard a luxurious car complete with a driver, hang out with the local nabobs. But then the wife of Giovanni's former boss, dissatisfied with her husband, convinces him to invest over seven hundred million in the purchase of an islet for which a brilliant tourist future is expected. Despite Montesano and the subject based on a novel by Terzoli and Vaime, it is a stretched film, suspended between vulgar comedy and satirical intentions.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Barbara Bouchet, Anna Mazzamauro

title: Tuttinsieme
synopsis: Two fathers retrace the last four years of their twins 'growth, recalling how their children worked out, at different ages, what it means to live in a family with two fathers and answering their peers' questions about their mother. They relive the climate of strong opposition in which Monica Cirinnà managed to give Italy a law on civil unions. They cultivate the warm and affectionate relationship with the American families of the women who allowed the birth of children. They return to the feast of the civil union celebrated by Nichi Vendola and seek, among different sensitivities, the names to give to the people of extended families born with assisted procreation techniques.

title: Tutto Totò - Don Giovannino
synopsis: Totò is persecuted by a jealous husband, and to escape him he sneaks into the artists' entrance of a fourth-rate theater. Her husband follows him there too, threatening him with death: Totò then disguises himself as a puppet and goes on stage ...
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Gianni Agus, Franco Volpi, Antonella Lualdi, Gloria Paul

title: Tutto Totò - Il grande maestro
synopsis: Mordecai Stonatelli, music teacher, tries in every way to establish himself in the artistic field: a little for musical vein, a little to make ends meet ...
cast: Totò, Ernesto Calindri, Giusi Raspani Dandolo, Mario Castellani

title: Tutto Totò - Il latitante
synopsis: The episode is taken from the screenplay that Corbucci and Grimaldi had prepared for _Le belve_, a film that Toto 'had to interpret but which was never made. Gennaro La Pezza, a professional thief, has just come out of prison and is already continuing his "business". In the end it is Gino Cervi, the commissioner, who arrests him and takes him back to jail: but also here: as soon as he arrives, he steals the watch from the director of the prison ...
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Enzo Turco, Gino Cervi, Lia Zoppelli

title: Tutto Totò - Il tuttofare
synopsis: In the multiform artistic activity of the prince of laughter, in addition to theater and cinema, a little television also appears. Poor, but tasty, as it could not be otherwise. "The handyman" is one of these short films for TV made by Totò shortly before his death, in the first months of 1967 and aired in May of the same year. "The handyman" takes up the theatrical sketch "The hairdresser for lady" included in the magazine "Bada che ti mangio" written by Totò himself and Michele Galdieri. In the television version, alongside the Neapolitan comedian appear some famous television news of the time: Lauretta Masiero and Antonella Steni as well as the inevitable historical shoulder Mario Castellani.
cast: Totò, Lauretta Masiero, Mario Castellani, Antonella Steni, Gisella Sofio

title: Tutto Totò - La scommessa
synopsis: The revival of an episode of the comic series with Totò and Mario Castellani, made for Rai by Bruno Corbucci and directed by Daniele D'Anza. Beyond the sketches presented, _Tutto Totò_ is one of those ancient productions that remind us how once it was possible to make intelligent television.
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Luisella Boni, Mario Pisu

title: Tutto Totò - Premio Nobel
synopsis: Totò is an intrusive curmudgeon who is in the same railway compartment with the Hon. Cosimo Trombetta, distinguished and meek gentleman who undergoes the inevitable propotencies of the other. At a certain point a woman enters between the two who, making believe she is persecuted, ends up relieving them both of the wallet ...
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Enzo Turco, Sandra Milo, Corrado, Vera Drudi

title: Tutto Totò - Totò a Napoli
synopsis: Totò reads one of his most famous poems dedicated to Naples and plays an unauthorized guide struggling with a group of unsuspecting foreign tourists who would like to visit the city. All this is accompanied by the songs of Peppino Di Capri, Nunzio Gallo and the tourist views of the Campania capital.
cast: Totò, Ugo D'Alessio, Luisella Boni, Nunzio Gallo, Miranda Martino, Gloria Christian, Renata Mauro

title: Tutto Totò - Totò ciak
synopsis: Totò is the protagonist of a series of parodies of western and espionage films that were very popular at the time. This television special was broadcast on June 8, 1967 in prime time and achieved considerable public success: as many as 13 million viewers remained glued to the television screens.
cast: Totò, Gordon Mitchell, Ubaldo Lay, Mario Castellani, Gianni Morandi

title: Tutto Totò - Totò yè yè
synopsis: It is a special, one of the few shot by Totò for TV shortly before his death, in which he parodies the so-called "hairy", or those young emerging singers of the Sixties who, in the wake of the Beatles, had revolutionized the world of pop music. Alongside the faithful "shoulder" Mario Castellani, with whom he proposes the double bass sketch, the prince of laughter duets with some singers including Patty Pravo, Mina (with whom he had already participated, the year before, in "Studio Uno") and the American-Lebanese Ricky Shayne, who became famous in the space of one morning with the song "One of the Mods". A vintage gem.
cast: Totò, Mario Castellani, Gianni Agus, Mina, Patty Pravo, Tony Renis

title: Tutto a posto e niente in ordine
synopsis: Stories of a group of immigrants who arrived in Milan to make their fortune and were forced to live together in the same accommodation. Gino, after several attempts, gives himself up to the underworld. Carletto becomes a cook, Biky and Adelina work as waitresses, Isotta ends up on a sidewalk instead. Sante, a Sicilian, soon becomes the father of seven children and ends up in prison, involved in an attack to which he is, moreover, a stranger.
cast: Luigi Diberti, Lina Polito, Claudio Volonté, Nino Bignamini, Eros Pagni, Giuliana Calandra, Sara Rapisarda, Aldo Puglisi

title: Tutto davanti a questi occhi
synopsis: The tragic story of Sami Modiano, one of the few survivors of the Auschwitz Birkenau extermination camp, deported from Rhodes when he was only fourteen, with his father and sister. Only he returned.
cast: Sami Modiano

title: Tutto il giorno davanti
synopsis: A day like any other in Adele Cucci's life is exceptional for the sole result of arriving in the evening. It is the day of a mother who has to accompany her to school, listen, understand, scold and console her two children and then run away to work where another four hundred boys and children are waiting for her to look after. Adele's days have been like this ever since, after her appointment as councilor for social policies in Palermo, she was entrusted with hundreds of unaccompanied foreign minors who landed in the city. Adele has become their legal guardian, their manager, their contact person. In short, she became their ... mother. Time never seems to be enough: decisions, obstacles, problems, races, mistakes, failures and satisfactions fill every minute of her life indissolubly intertwined with the personal events of the hundreds of minors entrusted to her.
cast: Isabella Ragonese, Sara D'Amario, Paolo Briguglia, Selene Caramazza, Enrico Gippetto, Giovanni D'Aleo, Chiara Carullo, Gueye Ndiatte, Odette Adado, Koudous Seihon, Vincenzo Crivello, Aurora Quattrocchi, Massimo Sestini, Andrea Tidona

title: Tutto il mio folle amore
synopsis: The story of the extraordinary adventure of a father and a son with autism problems (which from Eastern Italy reach the deserted streets of the Balkans) and of their tender, funny, problematic and unconventional relationship. Behind them, in an attempt to reach them, also the mother and the new partner will face an equally unpredictable journey. In this adventure everyone will have to deal with themselves and their role as parents.
cast: Claudio Santamaria, Valeria Golino, Diego Abatantuono, Giulio Pranno, Daniel Vivian, Marusa Majer, Tania Garribba, Maria Gnecchi

title: Tutto in quella notte
synopsis: Marco is about to leave with his wife Lucia for a week's vacation in New York. The two will meet disturbing and surreal figures: the kebabbaro Pòpov (Stewart Arnold), the "god of the winds" Aeo (Giovanni Mancaruso), the enigmatic and beautiful transsexual Hermes (Mario Acampa), the charming maitresse Cici (Sigal Diamant), The Seer (Skin), the oracle who will help Ulysses remember his past, the seductive Kaly (Charlotte Kirk) and the tormented Alcyde (Udo Kier) who will help the protagonist reach his goal.
