cast: Andrea Zirio, Anamaria Marinca, Danny Glover, Udo Kier, Skin, Gianni Capaldi, Charlotte Kirk, Drew Kenney, Walter Nudo, Jessica Polsky, Sigal Diamant

title: Ulzana's Raid
synopsis: Ulzana, the famous Apache leader, rebelled against white power and fled the reservation with a handful of loyal warriors. The young Lieutenant De Buine, who hates violence, is sent in pursuit with a group of soldiers and an Indian guide. It is the latter who explains that the tortures imposed by the Indians on their victims are a sacred rite: through them, the strength of the vanquished is transmitted to the victor. But Ulzana is more and more alone, abandoned even by his men ...
cast: Burt Lancaster, Bruce Davison, Jorge Luke, Richard Jaeckel

title: Um copo de cólera
synopsis: He is in his early thirties and has locked himself up in a fazenda on the outskirts of San Paolo as a gardener. She is a beautiful and sensual journalist. One evening while he is returning home she sees him and approaches and without saying too many words they find themselves in each other's arms making love. The next morning the man notices that the ants have broken through the hedge of the garden he is tending. This episode is enough to make him unleash anger and fury.
cast: Alexandre Borges, Julia Lemmertz, Lineu Dias, Ruth De Souza

title: Um filme falado
synopsis: Rosa María, a Portuguese history teacher, embarks in Lisbon with her little daughter María Joana for a cruise that, across the Mediterranean, will take her to join her husband in Bombay. During the trip he will have the opportunity to meet three women (one French, one Italian and one Greek), and the captain of the ship, an American of Polish origin. An unpredictable fate, however, awaits everyone at the gate ...
cast: Leonor Silveira, John Malkovich, Catherine Deneuve, Stefania Sandrelli, Irene Papas

title: Uma História de Amor e Fúria
synopsis: For over six hundred years, a valiant and immortal warrior has been going through the history of Brazil. Indio during the colonization era, leader of a group of slaves during the period of slavery, soldier under the military dictatorship and decisive figure during the war for water of 2096, will always be characterized by the constant search for justice and Janaina, the love of his life.

title: Uma Maheswara Ugra Roopasya
synopsis: Defeated and humiliated in a fight while trying to defuse a conflict among his fellow villagers, a photographer vows revenge on his attacker.
cast: Satya Dev, VK Naresh, Raghavan, Suhas P, Ravindra Vijay, Chandana Koppisetti, Roopa Koduvayur, Kushalini Pulapa

title: Umami
synopsis: The most famous French chef in circulation is desperate for the flavor that persecuted him since, at the time when he was only a promising young cook, he was defeated in a cooking race by the Noodles bowl prepared by a Japanese chef.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Kyozo Nagatsuka, Pierre Richard, Rod Paradot, Sandrine Bonnaire, Eriko Takeda, Akira Emoto, Bastien Bouillon, Zinedine Soualem, Sumire, Kyôko Koizumi, Antoine Duléry, Francis Ressort, You, Mame Yamada, Misuzu Hiratsuka, Assa Sylla, Slony Sow

title: Umano non umano
synopsis: The war on TV, the workers' demonstrations on the street; all this and much more: parties for Vip, sexy striptease and meanwhile Mick Jagger sings Street fighting man ...
cast: Adriano Aprà, Carmelo Bene, Franco Brocani, Rosanna Coppola, Mick Jagger, Alberto Moravia, Anita Pallenberg, Sandro Penna, Rada Rassimov, Keith Richards

title: Umareru.
synopsis: The Hayashidas were a typical happy family of father, mother, two boys and two girls. Until it all changed suddenly with the untimely death of the father, Shinpei. While still mourning his passing, the children are hit by another bit of shocking news from their mother “Truth is… I'm pregnant.” The news of their mother's pregnancy at 51 sets into motion a new series of challenges for the four children, particularly for the eldest sister, Manami, who now becomes the family patriarch, forced to struggle with the pressures and responsibilities of “child rearing” and “family ties”, not to mention greater philosophical questions about the meaning of life. A moving, life-sized human drama.. (Source: TBS)
tags: Pregnant Female Lead, Miniseries, Mother-Daughter Relationship, Pregnancy
cast: Horikita Maki, Okura Tadayoshi, Nakajima Kento, Haruka, Tanaka Misako

title: Umarete wa mita keredo
synopsis: Two stubborn teens organize a hunger strike against their overly subservient father with his boss in the workplace. The film that affirmed Ozu, one of the greatest directors in the history of cinema. Tragic and grotesque tones in a merciless analysis of the class structure and the bourgeoisie of Japan, with an already purified and dry style.
cast: Tomio Aoki, Hideo Sugawara, Tatsuo Saito, Mitsuko Yoshikawa, Takeshi Sakamoto

title: Umberto D.
synopsis: A retired senior ministerial official is not doing particularly well from an economic and affection point of view. In fact, he lives alone, with a dog and a maid. The scarce economic resources no longer allow him a lifestyle in keeping with his culture and decorum and he is constantly late with the payment of the rent, as the grim landlady often points out. In a leap of dignity he decides to take his own life so as not to be a burden to others: however, it will be his dog who will involuntarily reconcile him with the world.
cast: Carlo Battisti, Maria Pia Casilio, Memmo Carotenuto

title: Umberto Eco - La biblioteca del mondo
synopsis: The private library of Umberto Eco has more than thirty thousand contemporary and one thousand five hundred or rare volumes. The director Davide Ferrario, who in 2015 had collaborated with the writer for an installation #al Pavilion Italia of the Venice Biennale #sul theme of memory, reconstructs the Eco relationship with the books starting from his endless library and making use of the collaboration of family members.

title: Umi No Ue No Shinryoujo
synopsis: Doctor Kouta Sezaki works on a clinic ship, which sails around the Seto Inland Sea. He's talented as a doctor, but possesses a weakness to fall easily in love with women. When he lands at an island, Kouta falls in love with a woman from that island. He tries to solve a medical problem which that woman has and makes other people get involved in her situation. Nevertheless, Doctor Kouta Sezaki is rejected by that woman and, with tearing eyes, moves on to the next island.
tags: Doctor Male Lead, Eccentric Male Lead, Slight Romance
cast: Matsuda Shota, Takei Emi

title: Umi ga kikoeru
synopsis: Taku Morisaki, a university student in Tokyo, catches the eye of a girl he knows on the opposite platform of the train. This is Rikako Muto: but didn't he have to go to university in Kochi? Taku's memories take him back two years to that summer he met her. Not only was she beautiful, she was the best in sport and in class. Then to his surprise he found himself jealous to know that Matsuno, his best friend, was attracted to Rikako. From that moment on, the girl would have been nothing more than the object of his friend's crush, or at least that would have been until last year's trip to Hawaii.

title: Umi wa miteita
cast: Misa Shimizu, Nagiko Tono, Masatoshi Nagase, Hidetaka Yoshioka

title: Umi yori mo mada fukaku
synopsis: A former writer lives on the laurels of past accolades, squandering the money he earns as a private detective on gambling and alcohol. After the death of his father, the man is forced to make contact with his mother, ex-wife and son again, and he will slowly find a way to get himself and his life back on track.
cast: Hiroshi Abe, Kirin Kiki, Yoko Maki, Sôsuke Ikematsu, Satomi Kobayashi, Lily Franky, Isao Hashizume, Taiyô Yoshizawa

title: Umimachi Diary
synopsis: The three young Kouda sisters live in a house inherited from their grandmother when they learn that their father, whom they have not seen since he separated from their mother fifteen years earlier, has died. While Yoshino and Chika, the two younger sisters, feel nothing, Sachi is the one who is most affected but, remembering the pain of the past, she cannot forgive him. Deciding not to attend the funeral, she urges the younger sisters to go. At the funeral, Yoshino and Chika meet half-sister Suzu Asano, a student whose future appears uncertain. It will be this circumstance to push the four girls to start a coexistence ...
cast: Haruka Ayase, Masami Nagasawa, Suzu Hirose, Kaho, Ryo Kase, Ryohei Suzuki, Rirî Furankî, Shin'Ichi Tsutsumi, Jun Fubuki, Ohshirô Maeda

title: Umoregi
synopsis: Machi and her student friends from the village concoct a collective story that channels their hopes. A landslide then reveals a petrified forest that gives a mysterious happiness to all the inhabitants.
cast: Tadanobu Asano, Tokie Hidari, Mitsuru Hirata, Karen, Ittoku Kishibe, Tomoko Nakajima, Takashi Nishina, Taka Okubo, Sumiko Sakamoto, Akira Sakata

title: Umorismo in nero
synopsis: "The little beast". A rich and miserly old woman, suffering from severe migraines, suspects that her son has stuck an insect in her ear to suppress it. After having unsuccessfully gone to a healer, the woman decides to pretend to be dying. "The mandrilla". An unemployed man finds a job in a circus where he is chosen by a pair of lovers as a scapegoat for a crime. "The crow". Count Altiero wants to marry a rich widow, invites her to his castle and with terror discovers that the woman ...
cast: Sylvie, Pierre Brasseur, Emma Penella, Leo Anchoriz, Folco Lulli, Alida Valli
director: Claude Autant Lara, José María Forqué, Giancarlo Zagni

title: Umrika
synopsis: An ambitious man leaves his small Indian village for America. But when his letters to home stop coming, his brother sets out on his own adventure.
cast: Suraj Sharma, Tony Revolori, Smita Tambe, Adil Hussain, Rajesh Tailang, Prateik Babbar, Pramod Pathak, Amit Sial, Sauraseni Maitra

title: Umut
synopsis: Cabbar is a very poor driver who one day loses his only source of livelihood, the horse, killed by a passing car. In a world where poverty and social discrimination leave only the possibility of relying on false myths and baseless hopes, Cabbar is the emblem of the destiny of his people, the Kurdish one, deprived of their national identity. The hope of the title is thus just an empty and deceptive word.
cast: Yilmaz Güney, Gülsen Alniaçik, Tuncel Kurtiz, Kürsat Alniaçik, Osman Alyanak, Enver Dönmez, Mehmet Eken, Lütfü Engin, Sema Engin, Nizam Ergüden

title: Un 32 août sur terre
cast: Pascale Bussières, Alexis Martin, Joanne Côté, Frédéric Desager

title: Un Aldo qualunque
synopsis: 1978: Aldo Chimenti, originally from a small town in the province of Bari, has just moved to Turin with his policewoman wife. His life is divided between working as an accountant and rehearsing with the parish rock choir. The meeting with Biagio, a former Communist and nothing, and with Caimano, a naive who lives out of time, is destined to upset Aldo's habits. The three discover that they have in common the dream of making money, and to make it come true they are willing to do anything ...
cast: Fabio De Luigi, Michele Bottini, Giuseppe Battiston, Silvana Fallisi, Manuela Ungaro, Neri Marcoré

title: Un Amleto di meno
synopsis: Claudius became king after killing his brother, who also took over the marriage bed. But instead of worrying about revenge, bored by Horace's revelations and Ophelia's longings, his nephew Hamlet prefers to plan an escape to Paris with Kate, the "star" of the traveling company that should reproduce the misdeeds that occurred at court on stage.
cast: Carmelo Bene, Lydia Mancinelli, Alfredo Vincenti, Franco Leo, Isabella Russo, Luciana Cante, Luigi Mezzanotte, Giuseppe Tuminelli, Alfiero Vincenti, Sergio Di Giulio

title: Un Beau Soleil Intérieur
synopsis: Isabelle, divorced and mother of a child, is looking for love. But a true love that can definitely upset her life.
cast: Juliette Binoche, Xavier Beauvois, Philippe Katerine, Josiane Balasko, Nicolas Duvauchelle, Alex Descas, Laurent Grévill, Bruno Podalydès, Paul Blain, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Gérard Depardieu

title: Un Bébé pour Noël
synopsis: Just before Christmas, Noémie wakes up from the coma, realizes that he had an accident six months earlier and also discovers that he is pregnant. With the return of her memory, she also remembers fundamental details of her: a week before ending up in the hospital, she was on a collision course with her boyfriend Oliver and had sought comfort in the arms of the ex -boyfriend Yann. Soon, he begins to doubt who is the true father of the son he carries on his lap: abandoning the idea of ​​the paternity test, Oliver and Yann let them choose who she would like it to be. Noémie will thus find himself having to choose between the good of the creature and his feelings.
cast: Laëtitia Milot, Alexis Loret, Maud Baecker, Arnaud Binard, Bartholomew Boutellis, Emilie Hantz, Franz Rudolf Lang, Antoine Levannier, Salvatore Ingoglia, Aline Hamou

title: Un Dios prohibido
synopsis: During the Spanish Civil War, the 60 members of the clerical community of Barbastro - 9 priests, 12 brothers and 39 seminarians - found themselves in close contact with the revolutionary fighters. Taken prisoner and kept in conditions at the limit of humanity, the missionaries do not have many possibilities of life before them and among those who will be saved (9 out of 60) there will be two of Argentine nationality who will tell the outside world what it happened within those walls.
cast: Jacobo Muñoz, Elena Furiase, Iñigo Etayo, Jerónimo Salas, Mauro Muñiz, Juan Lombardero, Jesús Guzmán, Gabriel Latorre, Juan Alberto López, Emma Caballero, Chus Pereiro

title: Un Flic
synopsis: Commissioner Coleman investigates a bank robbery. From an informant, he learns that the theft is actually for a bigger blow: robbing a drug dealer. Besieged the gang, Coleman kills Simon, the leader, under the eyes of Cathy, the woman to whom they were both related.
cast: Alain Delon, Richard Crenna, Catherine Deneuve, Riccardo Cucciolla, Simone Valère, Paul Crauchet, Michael Conrad

title: Un Natale al Sud
synopsis: The Milanese carabiniere Peppino Colombo and the Neapolitan florist Ambrogio Esposito, with their wives, Bianca and Celeste, spend Christmas in the same mountain resort in the north. During the holidays, they discover that their respective children, Riccardo and Simone, are engaged to two girls they have met through a dating site but have never seen in person. Back home, the Colombo and the Espositos enroll their boys in the party organized by the site and make sure that the girls also participate. To help them, they then decide to follow them, but the wives, who have other intentions in mind, insist on them: in doing so, the two couples will challenge the stories of their children but also their own, risking going home single.
cast: Massimo Boldi, Biagio Izzo, Anna Tatangelo, Paolo Conticini, Debora Villa, Barbara Tabita, Enzo Salvi, Loredana De Nardis, Ludovica Bizzaglia, Simone Paciello, Giulia Penna, Riccardo Dose, Paola Caruso, Bonaria Decorato

title: Un Natale con i Fiocchi
synopsis: After 30 years, Lino Fiocchi (Silvio Orlando) sees his former friend Alex Morelli (Alessandro Gassman) close to Christmas. Naive policeman, Lino meets Alex in front of a bank while he serves as a post for a robbery. To justify himself, Alex makes him believe that he has become a thief to support his family and his sick son. Lino will take it into his head to redeem him at all costs, facing the most absurd Christmas that both of them have ever experienced.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Silvio Orlando, Valentina Lodovini, Carla Signoris, Blu Yoshimi

title: Un Natale di Maigret
synopsis: At Inspector Maigret's house, preparations are underway to celebrate Christmas. While his wife is busy preparing delicacies for lunch, Maigret receives a visit from Miss Doncouer and Mrs. Loraine Martin, two neighbors, who tell him that during the night little Colette, a guest in Aunt Loraine's house and immobilized for a broken leg, she received a visit from Santa Claus himself who, after giving her a doll, disappeared into thin air. Suspicious of the story, the inspector tries to see more clearly and begins to investigate the true identity of the alleged Santa Claus.
cast: Gino Cervi, Andreina Pagnani, Siria Betti, Lia Angeleri, Elena Demerik, Manlio Busoni, Mario Maranzana, Letizia Frezza, Gian Paolo Rosmino, Andrea Checchi

title: Un Natale per due
synopsis: The manager of a Sicilian company in crisis hires Claudio (Alessandro Gassman), a ruthless head-cutter and unrepentant Latin lover, to rearrange the workforce and fire the redundant employees. The first predestined victim seems to be Danilo (Enrico Brignano), a sensitive and naive worker whose family lives in Turin. The two potential enemies, however, are forced by a series of circumstances to face a journey together throughout the boot, overturning their positions and becoming friends in solidarity when Claudio loses his head for Danilo's sister.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Enrico Brignano, Paolo Sassanelli, Chiara Francini, Claudia Potenza, Roberta Fiorentini, Elena Barolo, Sandra Biondi, Roberto Nobile, Pino Caruso, Cristina Serafini

title: Un Natale stupefacente
synopsis: On the eve of the Christmas holidays, Uncle Lillo and Uncle Greg are suddenly forced to take care of their 8-year-old nephew. His parents were mistakenly arrested for drug cultivation. The two uncles are very different from each other, and inadequate for this task. Greg, a single rocker, will seek the help of Genny (Ambra Angiolini). Lillo, just left by his wife (Paola Minaccioni) and jealous of her new partner, a forced tattoo artist (Paolo Calabresi), will take advantage of the situation to win her back. To complicate matters, the surprise visits of two zealous but bizarre social workers (Francesco Montanari and Riccardo De Filippis) to the "strange family", to verify their suitability.
cast: Pasquale Petrolo, Claudio Gregori, Ambra Angiolini, Paola Minaccioni, Paolo Calabresi, Francesco Montanari, Riccardo De Filippis, Niccolò Calvagna

title: Un Papillon sur l'épaule
synopsis: Roland (Lino Ventura), a French seafarer stopped for a few days in Barcelona, ??is involved in an inexplicable case at the center of which is a mysterious briefcase. The story unfolds without an apparent logic, strewn with corpses. The protagonist finds himself living a distressing nightmare, with no elements to be able to grasp, without holds to get out of the condition of predestined victim.
cast: Lino Ventura, Claudine Auger, Paul Crauchet, Jean Bouise

title: Un Traductor
synopsis: A professor of Russian literature at the University of Havana is commissioned to act as a translator for Russian children who, struck by the Chernobyl nuclear disaster, arrive in Cuba for medical treatment.
cast: Rodrigo Santoro, Maricel Alvarez, Milda Gecaite, Nataliya Rodina, Aleksandra Maslennikova, Genadijs Dolganovs, Yoandra Suárez, Eslinda Nuñez, Nikita Semenov, Osvaldo Doimeadiós

title: Un affaire de femmes
synopsis: Marie Latour would like a less difficult life for herself and her two children than she is forced into in German-occupied France and with her husband imprisoned in Germany. So he begins to practice abortions and rents rooms to prostitutes. Denounced by her husband, on her return, she will be guillotined. A harsh indictment, without pietism.
cast: Isabelle Huppert, François Cluzet, Marie Trintignant

title: Un air de famille
synopsis: The Menard family, every Friday, meets in Henri's bar (the "younger" brother considered "stupid" by his mother), before going to dinner. However, the classic "Black Friday" arrives, despite the fact that Yolande's birthday (the wife of the "older" brother) is to be celebrated. One of those evenings where the knots come to a head, the poison of the snake relatives flows in rivers and hatreds, grudges and dust come out of the carpets. Only Betty and her boyfriend will come out with their heads held high.
cast: Jean Pierre Bacri, Agnès Jaoui, Jean Pierre Darroussin

title: Un aller simple
synopsis: After being involved in the murder of a policeman, Marty a robber expert in illegal gambling dens, worked as a croupier in the underground gambling den of La Balafre in Antwerp, manages to escape to help Tina the girl he loves, who has also ended up in trouble with the law.
cast: Jean Claude Bouillon, Nicoletta, Maurice Garrel, Paola Pitagora, Giancarlo Giannini

title: Un altr'anno e poi cresco
synopsis: Faustino is a young unemployed hypochondriac. Since his parents died in the house explosion, he has been stationed in the emergency room to be ready in case of discomfort. He meets a beautiful, independent woman, single with a daughter, and should finally make up her mind to grow up.
cast: Federico Di Cicilia, Gabriele Mainetti, Novello Novelli, Paola Cortellesi

title: Un altro me
synopsis: The first Italian experiment of "intensified treatment" for perpetrators of sexual violence takes place in the detention house in Bollate (Milan). Claudio Casazza's room is placed cautiously within the center, opening a window onto a disturbing universe, on which it is difficult to stop one's gaze. Day after day, the stories, the observations, the opinions of the inmates are intertwined with the solicitations and questions posed by the psychologists. The latter establish contact with elusive personalities, entrenched behind alibis and de-responsibility, attempting a path of treatment.

title: Un altro mondo
synopsis: Andrea is a thirty year old from a good family like many who has not yet found his own path: he is apathetic, bordering on depression, without interests. His sentimental world also suffers from it: he is with a girl who suffers from anorexia and their relationship is tormented and devoid of impetus. From Africa, where his father lives, separated from Andrea's mother for many years, however, news arrives that is destined to bring about many changes: the man is dying. Andrea thus decides to leave for Africa. He will discover that he has a black brother of only 8 years old: an encounter that will force Andrea to review many things about himself and his life.
cast: Maya Sansa, Silvio Muccino, Isabella Ragonese, Flavio Parenti, Michael Rainey Jr.

title: Un altro pianeta
synopsis: One summer morning, Salvatore observes the horizon of dunes that stands out against the blue of the sky. Beyond is the beach and a whole day to spend. A day with unexpected implications and, perhaps, a new possibility, a new life.
cast: Antonio Merone, Lucia Mascino

title: Un americano a Roma
synopsis: Nando Moriconi (Alberto Sordi) has a dream: to be American. He denies pasta for strange concoctions, he doesn't miss a Hollywood film, he speaks a strange idiom that would like to be Americanizing. Parents no longer tolerate him, friends make fun of him, but he continues undeterred. When he climbs the Colosseum, the American consul is willing to intercede, but then recognizes him as the madman who had driven him off the road some time before and changes his mind.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Maria Pia Casilio, Galeazzo Benti, Anita Durante, Carlo Delle Piane, Rocco D'Assunta, Charles Fawcett, Ursula Andress, Ignazio Leone, Ilse Petersen, Ivy Nicholson

title: Un americano in vacanza
synopsis: Two American soldiers are on their way to Rome; one of them falls in love with a pretty teacher who is going to the capital to find the necessary funds for the reconstruction of his country, destroyed by the war. After some misunderstandings and some difficulties, the American finally manages to declare himself.
cast: Valentina Cortese, Andrea Checchi, Adolfo Celi, Leo Dale

title: Un amore
cast: Rossano Brazzi, Agnès Spaak, Gérard Blain, Marisa Merlini

title: Un amore
synopsis: Marco and Sara met in 1982 in a nightclub and continued to see each other, albeit occasionally, for the rest of their lives. The love between the two, which broke out in those years, is made up of quarrels, encounters and sudden attacks. Marco and Sara meet again on December 31st 1999.
cast: Lorenza Indovina, Fabrizio Gifuni, Luciano Federico, Roberta Lena

title: Un amore a Roma
synopsis: Marcello, a young writer from a noble but now impoverished family, falls in love with Anna, an aspiring actress known by chance. The difference in character of the two young people leads them to a continuous alternation of quarrels and reconciliation. In fact, Marcello is possessive and jealous at least as much as Anna is free and available for sentimental adventures. However, the love swing is destined to last longer.
cast: Mylène Demongeot, Peter Baldwin, Elsa Martinelli, Umberto Orsini, Vittorio De Sica, Claudio Gora, Maria Perschy, Armando Romeo, Maria Laura Rocca, Fanfulla, Jacques Sernas

title: Un amore americano
synopsis: Angelo Fossalto, a teacher at the University of Urbino, is sent to the United States for a year at the University of Iowa. There he meets Greta, a beautiful girl who will be his assistant, and falls in love with her. The girl is of poor origin and her parents press for her to marry her billionaire boyfriend, but Greta is not convinced she loves him and in turn feels attracted to the professor.
cast: Carlo Delle Piane, Brooke Shields, Memé Perlini, Graziella Polesinanti, Richard Joseph Paul, Kate Guimbellot, Joey Garfield

title: Un amore così grande
cast: Giuseppe Maggio, Francesca Loy, Eleonora Brown, Riccardo Polizzy Carbonelli, Fioretta Mari, Franco Castellano, Daniela Giordano (I), Piero Barone, Ignazio Boschetto, Gianluca Ginoble, Jgor Barbazza

title: Un amore di donna
synopsis: The lawyer Bernasconi was first the lover of Gabriella's mother and then he married her daughter. But now they are separated. Gabriella falls in love with a test driver and therefore tries to get a divorce, but Bernasconi does not grant it. It will be his mother who will precipitate things with a cruel confession about his past ... Tragic melodrama enlivened by aerial performances.
cast: Laura Morante, Bruno Ganz, Claudine Auger, Ivan Desny, Cinzia De Ponti

title: Un amore di strega
synopsis: On her thirtieth birthday, Carlotta, a wedding planner, surprises her boyfriend with her lover and leaves him. While depressed, she goes to the Le Beau Marriage agency, which she runs with her mother Emma, ??she comes across a nice shoe shop, created by a magic of the mysterious Vlad. He convinces her to wear a pair of red shoes with a breathtaking heel. In the evening Carlotta gets drunk at parties with her friends, and at the exit she ends up struck by lightning. The next day, oblivious to what happened, he meets Riccardo Valenti an irritating but attractive manager, hired by his mother to get the agency back on track. Between the two are sparks ...
cast: Alessia Marcuzzi, Pietro Sermonti, Anna Galiena, Luca Ward, Eleonora Ivone, Michela Andreozzi, Paola Minaccioni, Simone Colombari

title: Un amore in prima classe
synopsis: Carmelo leaves by train for Calabria with his son Malcolm, but he is rather clumsy like dad. Hardly found two seats in first class, they meet the beautiful Beatrice. Carmelo attempts an approach, fails and, exasperated, abandons his son at a station, but Beatrice recovers him.
cast: Enrico Montesano, Sylvia Kristel, Franca Valeri, Lorenzo Aiello, Felice Andreasi, Memmo Carotenuto, Sergio Di Pinto, Gianfranco Manfredi, Christian De Sica, Enzo Cannavale, Luc Merenda

title: Un amore perfetto
synopsis: Celestino, known as Ceghe, the intemperate Berni and Laura are three twenty-year-olds who live in Cervia in a town on the Romagna coast. Like most children, they have problems with work and growth. Ceghe and Berni are used to sharing everything: the disqualifications on the football field, but also the love for the beautiful Laura.
cast: Cesare Cremonini, Martina Stella, Denis Fasolo, Carlo Simoni

title: Un amore su misura
synopsis: The engineer Olmi is a middle-aged man who leads an absolutely normal and routine existence. When he is left by his wife, he is unexpectedly contacted by a Japanese company that offers him to test his new product: the perfect woman, built according to the customer's needs.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Anna Galiena, Renato Scarpa, Fabrizio Kofler Seigner, Anna Stante

title: Un amore targato Forlì
synopsis: Having moved to Rome, the young Stefano Santi, faced with the realities of the capital, will repeatedly make the figure of the provincial. He will also meet Giorgia, an unscrupulous architecture student temporarily linked to a university friend.
cast: Leonard Mann, Rena Niehaus, Adriana Asti, Gigi Ballista, Mario Scaccia

title: Un amour de Swann
synopsis: In Paris, at the end of the nineteenth century, Charles Swann (Jeremy Irons), a wealthy bourgeois art expert, enters into a relationship with Odette Crécy (Ornella Muti), a woman of the world. Swann suffers this love and the jealousy that derives from it as if it were a disease from which he will be able to heal only by marrying her. It is incredible that Schlöndorff himself managed to bring Proust to the screen after the failed attempts of Visconti, Ophuls, Losey, Resnais, among others. He puts all his good will into it, Nykvist (the director of photography) all his art, Irons and Delon everything possible, but the result is poor.
cast: Jeremy Irons, Ornella Muti, Alain Delon, Fanny Ardant, Marie Christine Barrault, Nathalie Juvet, Charlotte Kerr, Philippine Pascale, Charlotte De Turckheim

title: Un amour de jeunesse
synopsis: The love story between Camille and Sullivan, born when they were still teenagers, survives the passage of time and distance. They met in Paris, in the winter of 1999, when she was 15 and he was 19, they broke up shortly after Sullivan's choice to move to South America. Out of desperation not to hear from him, Camille also tries in vain to commit suicide, and the return to normal promises to be harder and longer than expected. Resignation to the loss of the beloved is aided only by immersion in the studio, by the choice to attend the university of architecture, where she meets Lorenz. In 2007, Camille and Lorenz form a solid couple until the moment she meets Sullivan again on her path, able to rekindle that never dormant feeling.
cast: Lola Creton, Magne Brekke, Gregoire Akcelrod, Olivier Yglesias, Sebastian Urzendowsky, Serge Renko

title: Un amour de pluie
cast: Romy Schneider, Nino Castelnuovo, Bénédicte Bucher, Suzanne Flon, Mehdi El Glaoui

title: Un amour de sorcière - Witch Way Love
synopsis: In the autumn of witchcraft there are only six sorcerers left on earth. Five of them serve Good, while only one, Molok, is at the service of Evil. The problem that arises is that Molok has no heirs and that Morgane, a witch who sided with Good, is the mother of a delightful eleven-month-old baby named Arthur. At six in the morning of June 14th Arthur will be one year old and as tradition dictates, his anniversary will have to be celebrated by the attribution of a godfather.
cast: Vanessa Paradis, Jean Reno, Jeanne Moreau, Gil Bellows, Dabney Coleman

title: Un amour impossible
synopsis: In the late 1950s, Rache, a young office clerk from a provincial town, meets Philippe, a well-bred man from a wealthy family. Together they share a relationship as short as it is intense from which a little girl comes into the world. Over the next fifty years, their lives will be marked by unconditional love between mother and daughter, a woman's impossible love for a man who rejects her, and a daughter's love for an absent and abusive father.
cast: Virginie Efira, Niels Schneider, Jehnny Beth, Estelle Lescure, Ambre Hasaj, Sasha Allessandri Torrès Garcia, Iliana Zabeth, Coralie Russier, Pierre Salvadori

title: Un angelo a New York
synopsis: Enzo decides to spend Christmas in New York with his son Antonio, daughter-in-law Gloria and granddaughter Laura. In reality, things are not going too well between Gloria and Antonio. But Enzo doesn't have time to realize it because, as soon as he arrives at the station, he witnesses the sudden death of a Santa Claus. Loaded the body on a trolley, grandfather and granddaughter escape a robber and get lost in the metropolis. But is Santa Claus really dead? This Santa Claus has indeed something magical.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Tina Majorino, Karen Black

title: Un angelo all'inferno
synopsis: The life of the teenager Martina is upset by the discovery of the adultery of his father Pietro, who divorces his wife and remarries. Neglected by the new family, the girl falls into a drug spiral, just like Marco, the half-brother her father had from a previous marriage.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Laura Adriani, Chiara Conti, Michele Cesari, Cleo Despucches, Roberto Farnesi, Maurizio Mattioli, Luca Ward, Giorgia Wurth

title: Un angelo per Satana
synopsis: Recently visiting her uncle, the beautiful Countess Harriet begins to show worrying signs of imbalance: influenced by an ancestor (the witch Belinda, who disappeared in a lake and apparently "reincarnated" in a statue), the girl behaves in a more and more provocative and comes to be stained with horrendous crimes. But actually Harriet ...
cast: Barbara Steele, Anthony Steffen, Ursula Davis, Aldo Berti, Mario Brega

title: Un anno di scuola
synopsis: Trieste, 1913: Edda Marty attends the last class in a high school for men in order to enter the university. The school year, marked by crises and disturbances, will end amidst the gloomy omens of the Great War.
cast: Laura Lenzi, Stefano Patrizi, Juliette Mayniel, Mario Adorf

title: Un apprezzato professionista di sicuro avvenire
synopsis: A priest, in spite of the vows of chastity, is persuaded by a fraudulent lawyer friend, who recently married to a rich woman discovers that he is impotent, to have relations with his wife. The priest takes his hand and the lawyer gets irritated causing his death.
cast: Lino Capolicchio, Riccardo Cucciolla, Femi Benussi, Yvonne Sanson

title: Un attore contro - Gian Maria Volonté
Un autre homme
synopsis: François has just gone to live with his partner Christine in the Vallée de Joux in Switzerland. To support himself he finds work at the small local newspaper: he will have to keep a cinema column and write about screenings of the only cinema in the country. But François knows nothing about cinema, and will end up secretly copying the articles of the Traveling magazine for which established film critics write. In Lausanne, where he will attend the press screenings of some films, he will meet Rosa, a renowned critic. Between the two will immediately establish a perverse relationship centered on the love for cinema and physical desire.
cast: Robin Harsch, Natacha Koutchoumov, Elodie Weber, Georges Henri Dépraz, Brigitte Jordan, Olivia Csiky Trnka, Bulle Ogier, Agnieszka Kowalski, Jean Stéphane Bron, Ursula Meier

title: Un autre homme, une autre chance
synopsis: What do a Parisian photographer back from the commune and an American veterinarian do in the Wild West of 1878?
cast: James Caan, Geneviève Bujold, Francis Huster, Jennifer Warren

title: Un autre monde
synopsis: Philippe Lesmele, a manager, sees the marriage with his wife to disintegrate. He was gradually swallowed up by the pressure of his work and the woman can no longer bear the situation. Manager of an US industry, Philippe no longer knows how to react to the contradictory requests of his superiors. With his shoulders to the wall, he will soon reach an inevitable breaking point.
cast: Vincent Lindon, Sandrine Kiberlain, Anthony Bajon, Marie Drucker, Guillaume Draux, Olivier Lemaire, Christophe Rossignon, Valérie Lamond, Mehdi Bouzaïda

title: Un año, una noche
synopsis: A boy and a girl who are together and are both surviving a terrorist attack, try to face the present without being able to overcome the trauma they have suffered.
cast: Alba Guilera, Miko Jarry, Noémie Merlant, Quim Gutiérrez, Nahuel Pérez Biscayart, Natalia De Molina, C. Tangana, Alex Moreu Garriga, Mike F. Pamphile, José Javier Domínguez, Edward Lin, Jean Louis Tilburg, Igor Mamlenkov

title: Un bacio
synopsis: Lorenzo, Blu and Antonio have many things in common: they attend the same class in the same high school in a small town in the north east, they each have a family that loves them even if they are very busy with daily chores. All three, even if for different reasons, end up being isolated from other peers.
cast: Rimau Grillo Ritzberger, Valentina Romani, Leonardo Pazzagli, Susy Laude, Thomas Trabacchi, Eugenio Franceschini, Simonetta Solder, Giorgio Marchesi, Laura Mazzi, Sergio Romano, Alessandro Sperduti, Denis Fasolo, Lisa Galantini, Sara Bertelà

title: Un baiser s'il vous plaît
synopsis: Emilie and Gabriel meet casually in Nantes where they spend a pleasant and romantic evening together. The two like each other and Gabriel would like to end their meeting with a kiss, but Emilie refuses, citing as an example the case of a couple of friends: Judith and Nicolas, whose first kiss has given rise to a series of unpredictable consequences. From simple old friends in fact Judith and Nicolas, although already romantically engaged, have ended up becoming lovers. And as Gabriel's anticipation and trepidation about Emilie's final decision grows, the woman continues to tell.
cast: Virginie Ledoyen, Emmanuel Mouret, Julie Gayet, Michael Cohen, Frédérique Bel, Stefano Accorsi, Mélanie Maudran, Marie Madinier, Lucciana De Vogüe, Jacques Lafoly

title: Un balcon sur la mer
synopsis: Marseille, late 1980s. Marc (Jean Dujardin) is a wealthy real estate agent who runs his father-in-law's agency with some success and lives with his wife and daughter in a beautiful villa on the outskirts of the city. An ordinary day, a somewhat complex real estate negotiation leads him to meet a beautiful blonde woman, in charge of buying a beautiful estate for someone else. In the woman, the man is convinced that he recognizes Cathy, the twelve-year-old who in Algeria made her adolescent heart tremble in 1962, before the war and its violence separated them definitively and without warning. But is it really about her as she seems to admit? And why does the woman mysteriously disappear at some point?
cast: Jean Dujardin, Marie Joseé Croze, Toni Servillo, Sandrine Kiberlain, Michel Aumont, Pauline Bélier, Jacques Valles, Claudia Cardinale, Romain Millot, Solène Forveille

title: Un bambino di nome Gesù
synopsis: Mary, Joseph and Jesus live in a village near Palestine when the assassin Sefir, sent by Herod, joins them to kill the child. Joseph is wounded, Mary and Jesus are captured. Sefir, however, goes mad and Joseph joins his family, who leaves for Nazareth ...
cast: Matteo Bellina, Bekim Fehmiu, María Del Carmen San Martín, Alessandro Gassmann, Irene Papas, Franco Interlenghi, Maurizio Donadoni, Hichem Rostom, Roberto Bisacco, Roberto Posse

title: Un bambino perso per sempre
synopsis: Jerry is 17 years old and is in a juvenile detention center. She manages to escape and during a night meeting she lets her boyfriend know that she is pregnant and that she wants the baby at all costs. But, when he returns to the reformatory, he discovers that it will absolutely not be possible, so when the baby is born, he is given up for adoption. After 19 years, the law allows Jerry, who in the meantime has had three other children and leads an irreproachable life, to see his son. But the longed-for meeting will never happen: the child died when he was three, of peritonitis. But some things that the adoptive mother and a relative of this say make her suspicious for their incongruity and strangeness. With the help of a journalist and a policeman, he then reconstructs what had happened many years ago. It is a chilling reality that he discovers: the child died of the beatings and mistreatment suffered by the woman who had adopted him. Jerry then manages, always with the help of his two allies, to bring the woman before the Supreme Court. And it is during a close and dramatic debate that the truth comes out: one of the children of the woman herself confesses it in a decisive and tragic testimony. Jerry then gets a heavy and exemplary sentence for her. It is a not particularly original film for television, inspired by a real story.
cast: Beverly D'Angelo, Max Gail

title: Un barrage contre le Pacifique
synopsis: In the 1920s, in the then southern French Indochina, a sick widow lived with her two children, Joseph and Suzanne (aged 17 and 20) in an isolated bungalow on the Kam swamp plain. Having invested all her money in the purchase of the land, which cannot be cultivated as it is submerged every year by the great tides of the Pacific, the woman tries everything against the adversity and power of nature, trying to get a corrupt administration to intervene, then to build a barrier. Also for this mother wants her daughter to marry Mr. Jo, an unpleasant but very rich man, who for his part is ready to "buy" the marriage, making rich gifts. Among them a ring with a diamond, which contains an inclusion ...
cast: Gaspard Ulliel, Isabelle Huppert, Vincent Grass, Lucy Harrison, Astrid Berges Frisbey

title: Un beau matin
synopsis: A single young woman who lives with her eighteen -year -old daughter must deal in the meantime of her father, who suffers from a serious form of senile dementia. While she damages her soul to find a structure that can accommodate the parent, she comes across an old friend with whom she begins a relationship, despite being already emotionally busy.
cast: Léa Seydoux, Melvil Poupaud, Nicole Garcia, Pascal Greggory, Kester Lovelace, Ema Zampa

title: Un beau monstre
synopsis: The wealthy Alain marries his neighbor Nathalie in second marriage, who had witnessed the suicide of his first wife. The woman does not know that the death was caused precisely by the man's behavior. Alain is afflicted with serious psychic disorders and tries to poison Nathalie, who fortunately notices it.
cast: Helmut Berger, Virna Lisi, Charles Aznavour, Françoise Brion

title: Un bellissimo novembre
synopsis: Nino is seventeen years old and has some sexual disturbances towards his aunt Cettina (Gina Lollobrigida). She has a husband, no children and some maternal instinct towards her grandson. The relationship is short: Cettina then gives herself to Sasà, her husband's partner. Nino makes a drama out of it, but then he recovers and marries his cousin Giulietta. Which does not mean that the affair with the aunt is over ...
cast: Gina Lollobrigida, Paolo Turco, Gabriele Ferzetti, Margarita Lozano, André Lawrence, Danielle Godet, Isabella Savona, Jean Maucorps

title: Un bianco vestito per Marialé
cast: Evelyn Stewart, Ivan Rassimov, Luigi Pistilli, Pilar Velazquez

title: Un bonheur n'arrive jamais seul
synopsis: Sasha spends her evenings in the jazz club where she plays the piano, having fun with friends and dedicating herself to conquering beautiful women. Free as the wind, he has no responsibility on his shoulders: no wake up at dawn to go to work and no wife to give account and reason to. Quite the opposite of Charlotte who, on the other hand, has to manage her career and take care of the three children of her two ex-husbands, never finding time to launch herself in the search for a new love. Although poles apart and with nothing in common, they will soon discover that they are made for each other.
cast: Gad Elmaleh, Sophie Marceau, Maurice Barthélémy, François Berléand, Michaël Abiteboul, Julie Anne Roth, Macha Meril, François Vincentelli, Timéo Leloup, Milena Chiron

title: Un borghese piccolo piccolo
synopsis: Giovanni Vivaldi (Alberto Sordi) worked for a lifetime as a modest employee of the ministry. His only dream is that his son Mario (Vincenzo Crocitti), a graduate accountant, will replace him in the job. To facilitate his son in the ministerial competition, Vivaldi agrees to join the Masonic lodge to which Dr. Spaziani, his superior belongs. The trouble is that, on the very day of the exam, in front of his father's eyes, Mario is killed by a bank robber. Vivaldi then sets out in search of the killer, finds him and, instead of handing him over to the police, kidnaps and kills him by torturing him slowly. Fierce portrait of an ordinary man who becomes the portrait of the violent and monstrous Italy of the seventies. Valuable is the interpretation of Alberto Sordi who, for once, overcomes the mask of the speck and gives life to a character who, while not renouncing the tics and charms of the usual repertoire, manages to reach an unusual depth for the national Albertone. Perhaps the last true, great interpretation of a Deaf man on a slow and inexorable decline.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Shelley Winters, Romolo Valli, Vincenzo Crocitti

title: Un boss in salotto
synopsis: The Cosos live in Bolzano. His wife Cristina (Paola Cortellesi), a Neapolitan of humble origins, is in search of social climbing at any cost while her husband Michele (Luca Argentero) is a convinced northerner. The Cosos' daily routine is suddenly upset when Ciro (Rocco Papaleo), the brother Cristina has not seen for 15 years, is sent to their home accused of being a money laundering Camorra.
cast: Paola Cortellesi, Rocco Papaleo, Luca Argentero, Angela Finocchiaro, Alessandro Besentini, Giselda Volodi, Marco Marzocca, Massimo De Lorenzo, Francesco Villa, Salvatore Misticone, Lavinia De Cocci, Saul Di Nanni, Hal Yamanouchi, Nancy Gabriele

title: Un bounty killer a Trinità
synopsis: In the old west, the village of Trinità is in the hands of Pizarro and his henchmen, led by Sancho and Paco. To put an end to their harassment and abuses, a professional bounty killer is specially summoned.
cast: Jeff Cameron, Enzo Pulcrano, Attilio Dottesio, Carla Mancini, Antonio Cantafora, Calogero Caruana, Amerigo Castrighella, Silvio Klein, Emanuele Seguino

title: Un branco di vigliacchi
synopsis: Four English prisoners who escaped from a concentration camp on 8 September seek and find refuge in the farmhouse of Giuditta, a beautiful girl who works hard to support her little brother Marcello. Their hiding place is discovered, the four are killed and with them the boy who has rushed to warn them of the imminent danger. A Giuditta, united with a group of people on the run, all that remains is to try to reach that area of ??Italy occupied by the Anglo-Americans. The peasant woman will have to submit to the shameful desires of a Nazi commander.
cast: Pascale Petit, Roger Moore, Aroldo Tieri, Scilla Gabel

title: Un buco in fronte
synopsis: A treasure has been hidden in the Sierra Paolo. To get hold of the precious loot you need to gather three playing cards on which the map is drawn. The first card is in the Munguja ha, the second is in the hands of Murienda, the third is in the hands of Garrincha. A tremendous fight breaks out.
cast: Robert Hundar, Bruno Cattaneo, Luigi Marturano, Anthony Ghidra

title: Un bugiardo in Paradiso
synopsis: The homeless Gino with his adoptive godson Tino had the good idea of ??making himself believe that he had never known and for years stubbornly sought after by a young and wealthy entrepreneur. For Gino it is a way to escape forever from an ordinary life of hardship and full of difficulties of all kinds, but then he becomes so passionate about the role of father and grandfather and does not feel like continuing to lie anymore.
cast: Paolo Villaggio, Gabriele Cirilli, Flavio Insinna, Antonella Attili

title: Un burattino di nome Pinocchio
synopsis: Animated film that faithfully reproduces the history of Collodi, including some darker aspects that have usually been omitted in the various versions, animated and otherwise, of the adventures of the wooden puppet.

title: Un cane per due
synopsis: Valerio is tired, far from the successes of the past. The advertising agency he founded is sailing in financially uneventful waters, his workmates look at him with anger, the air is heavy, tense. One day, however, Spugna, her grandson's dog, enters her life, completely overturning it.
cast: Giorgio Tirabassi, Carolina Crescentini, Fabiano Troiano, Dino Abbrescia, Susy Laude, Nicola Nocella, Luca Angeletti, Patrizia Loreti, Pietro De Silva, Gaetano Amato, Valerio Base

title: Un carnet de bal
cast: Louis Jouvet, Raimu, Harry Baur, Marie Bell, Pierre Blanchar, Fernandel

title: Un caso di coscienza
synopsis: Salvatore Vaccagnino, a young lawyer from Maddà, reads in a female rotogravure, in the correspondence column kept by a priest, the naturally anonymous letter of a fellow citizen who confesses to having betrayed her husband. Confident of his wife Rita's fidelity, Salvatore summons Maddà's most respectable cooks, amusing himself by arousing in them all sorts of doubts about the fidelity of their respective wives. While Salvatore continues his investigations, driven by an insatiable curiosity, he is convinced, thanks to another anonymous letter, that his wife could also be among the possible adulterers.
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Françoise Prevost, Saro Urzì, Turi Ferro

title: Un certo giorno
synopsis: A group of advertising creatives is engaged in a major campaign to launch a new product. Among all, one in particular stands out for his zeal and passion: a rampant young man, married and with a lover. The deal represents his golden opportunity for a career breakthrough and he does not intend to let it slip away. But one day he runs over a pedestrian and kills him. The accident creates a lot of legal headaches for him, but, above all, it upsets him on a moral level and makes him question his whole life, so much so as to induce him to radically change his morals.
cast: Brunetto Del Vita, Lidia Fuortes, Vitaliano Damioli

title: Un chapeau de paille d'Italie
cast: Jim Gérald, Marise Maia, Paul Ollivier, Albert Préjean, Valentine Tessier

title: Un château en Italie
synopsis: In the seventies a bourgeois family, Italian industrialists, was forced by the threats of the Red Brigades to abandon their castle on the banks of the Po to move to France in Paris. The coldness of family relationships of those years accompanies the growth of Louise (Valeria Bruni Tedeschi), who has always been impatient with the decisions of a father and mother committed to safeguarding their careers as entrepreneurs and artists. After decades of family secrets that emerge unexpectedly and moments of strong apprehension over the illness affecting her brother Ludovic (Filippo Timi), Louise will come to terms with the ghosts of the past when she has to return to Italy for the sale of the castle. The meeting with Nathan (Louis Garrell) and the birth of their love will allow her to take back her dreams and hope for a better future.
cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Filippo Timi, Louis Garrel, Marisa Borini, Xavier Beauvois, Céline Sallette, André Wilms, Marie Rivière, Pippo Delbono, Silvio Orlando, Omar Sharif, Gérard Falce

title: Un cielo stellato sopra il ghetto di Roma
synopsis: The discovery of a letter and a mysterious photo of a little girl leads Sofia and her young friends in search of the truth. Trying to unravel the mystery that lies behind that image, Sofia and her friends face an adventurous journey through the memory of a painful and difficult to forget past such as that of the roundup of the Jewish quarter of Rome and together, through friendship and I remember, they manage to turn everything into an opportunity to find new hope.
cast: Bianca Panconi, Emma Matilda Lió, Daniele Rampello, Irene Vetere, Francesco Rodrigo, Marco Todisco, Domenico Fortunato, Aurora Cancian, Lucia Zotti, Alessandra Celi

title: Un coccodrillo per amico
synopsis: Lorenzo and Sandro are friends and partners of Agostino, director of a real estate agency, a great lover of Africa. During a lunch they accidentally meet Giovanni, known in Kenya. The man, having become familiar, proposes a real estate deal in the dark continent. This is a project for the construction in Malindi of a resort with villas and swimming pools, designed for the western market. Lorenzo is disinterested and skeptical, while Sandro is enthusiastic. However, they discover that the place where the complex will be built is a mission that deals with helping children. Lorenzo recognizes Laura, the girl he was in love with as a young man, among the nuns. Together then, they decide to help out ...
cast: Massimo Boldi, Maurizio Mattioli, Maurizio Casagrande, Antonio Catania, Barbara De Rossi, Loredana De Nardis, Elisabetta Pellini, George Hilton

title: Un coeur en hiver
synopsis: Stephan and Maxime, after attending the conservatory together, are now business partners. Camille, a talented young violinist, joins their lives and is linked to Maxime. But the cold, skeptical Stephan feels the irresistible urge to take the woman away from his friend, as if to demonstrate the impossibility of love. And he himself finds himself entangled in the "game" of feelings ...
cast: Daniel Auteuil, Emmanuelle Béart, André Dussollier

title: Un coeur oublié
synopsis: All his life, monsieur de Fontenelle (Michel Serrault) has tried to resist passion and romantic feelings but, in old age, he meets a young woman (Vittoria Belvedere) who introduces him to what he has always wanted to ignore: love .
cast: Michel Serrault, Vittoria Belvedere, Annick Alane, Christine Citti, Nathalie Krebs, Thibault De Montalembert, Aurélien Recoing, Catherine Salviat, Jean Paul Roussillon, Antoine

title: Un colpo di pistola
synopsis: Andrea (Fosco Giachetti) has loved Mascia (Assia Noris) for a long time, but fears that the woman is in love with another man, up to that moment his dear friend. It's all a misunderstanding, but Andrea challenges his rival to a duel: he could kill him, but he decides to do it later. Only after many years the deception is finally revealed and the love between the two can triumph.
cast: Fosco Giachetti, Assia Noris, Antonio Centa, Anna Capodaglio, Rubi D'Alma, Renato Cialente, Mimi Dugini

title: Un complicato intrigo di donne, vicoli e delitti
synopsis: Nunziata, a former prostitute, receives the sight of a criminal who, while trying to rape her, is killed. We immediately think of a settling of scores and Nunziata thus ends up under the "protection" of a Camorra gang. Meanwhile, a large batch of drugs arrives on the Neapolitan market and murders similar to the first follow one another at a fast pace. Nunziata's ten-year-old son has also ended up in drugs, while an Italian-American criminal tries to induce the woman to run away with him ...
cast: Angela Molina, Tommaso Bianco, Francisco Rabal, Mario Scarpetta, Harvey Keitel

title: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé
cast: François Leterrier, Roland Monod, Charles Le Clainche

title: Un condé
synopsis: During a police operation against some drug dealers, a young officer dies. His colleague, disillusioned inspector of the criminal section, decides to avenge him without taking legal action. He clears the gang and then resigns in front of the stunned superiors.
cast: Gianni Garko, Adolfo Celi, Michel Bouquet

title: Un confine incerto
synopsis: A strange couple lives in a camper parked in the Black Forest: a boy, Richi, and a little girl named "Spit". In Rome, an undercover agent of the Postal Police, Milia Demetz, always feels late, always "out of sync" with respect to the crimes she is forced to see on the internet. These happen under his eyes. She assists but cannot intervene. Images travel without borders, it is difficult to understand where they come from. The world of the protagonists also fluctuates between different countries and languages. Milia, however, will be able to decipher the absurd disappearance of this child thanks to a language that is not widely spoken, but which she knows well, Ladino.
cast: Valeria Golino, Cosmina Stratan, Heio Von Stetten, Klara Höfels, Moise Curia, Martina Schölzhorn, Benno Steinegger, Jens Weisser, Anna Malfatti, Lissy Pernthaler

title: Un consiglio a Dio
synopsis: At night, along a coast made of dirt and excrement, a man (Vinicio Marchioni) retrieves the bodies of immigrants who had been shipwrecked along the Italian coast. His life as an Italian outcast is integrated with that of migrants fleeing wars and misery, in a remote dialogue constructed through the use of interviews conducted with illegal immigrants welcomed in the first reception centers and then gradually inserted into the Italian social context.
cast: Vinicio Marchioni, Ilaria Dervishllari, Kiswendsida Judicael Ouango, Prasath Jayasinghe Appu, Johnson Ransford, Liana Nesta, Issam Abdi

title: Un conte de Noël
synopsis: The intricate story of a family group made up of two brothers and a sister, in whose past there is the premature death of a fourth brother and in whose present there are misunderstandings and silences, finds a sudden acceleration when the mother discovers that she has a tumor. which makes a bone marrow transplant necessary, forcing everyone to meet again on the occasion of the Christmas holidays.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Mathieu Amalric, Chiara Mastroianni, Melvil Poupaud, Anne Consigny, Emmanuelle Devos, Hippolyte Girardot, Samir Guesmi, Jean Paul Roussillon, Hélène Darras

title: Un couple
synopsis: The long relationship between Leo Tolstoy and his wife Sofia rebuilt through a monologue of the woman, freely taken from the letters that the two were written and from the diary pages of both.
cast: Nathalie Boutefeu

title: Un couple épatant
synopsis: Cécile and Alain have been together for twenty years. In love, inseparable, the typical perfect couple envied by friends and neighbors. But she suspects that something is wrong, because Alain is troubled by an unspeakable secret. Will she be a mistress? Alain, for his part, has serious health problems and does not confess it to Cécile ...
cast: Ornella Muti, François Morel, Valerie Mairesse, Dominique Blanc, Gilbert Melki, Lucas Belvaux

title: Un couteau dans le coeur
synopsis: In the heart of sulphurous Paris of the late 1970s, Anne made a career out of producing gay pornographic films. To win back the favors of his partner Loïs, he decides to change genre and to finance a much more ambitious film, which he entrusts to Archibald. A mysterious serial killer, however, distorts his plans and targets all the actors involved in the project.
cast: Vanessa Paradis, Kate Moran, Nicolas Maury, Pierre Emö, Pierre Pirol, Salim Torki, Thibault Servière

title: Un crime au Paradis
synopsis: Jojo, a candid farmer from a small French village, lives on a farm called Paradiso in the company of the unpleasant, malevolent and sour Lulu, with whom he is unhappily married. Each of the two thinks of eliminating the other: the company succeeds in Jojo, who has the provident foresight to ensure - by deception - the assistance of a famous criminal lawyer ...
cast: Jacques Villeret, Josiane Balasko, André Dussollier

title: Un cuento chino
synopsis: His experience as a soldier in the Falklands war left very deep marks on the Argentine Roberto, who spent the last twenty years of his life alienated from the world, becoming grumpy even with customers who frequent his hardware store. The only interest that Roberto has is to collect newspaper clippings that tell strange stories and, by a twist of fate, he finds himself involved in one of these when he welcomes the Chinese Jun into his home, in search of family members after losing his loved one because of a cow that literally fell from the sky. While not speaking the same language, the almost forced coexistence between the two different cultures will change the existence of both, making them almost soul mates.
cast: Ricardo Darín, Ignacio Huang, Muriel Santa Ana, Javier Pinto, Pablo Seijo, Iván Romanelli, Vivian Jaber

title: Un delitto impossibile
synopsis: Piero, magistrate of the court of Palermo, is called to investigate a murder. A judge of the Sassari court died of poisoning after drinking a cup of coffee. The investigations immediately turned out to be very complex. It turns out that the deceased was having an affair with a colleague married to a president of the Court of Appeal. Not only was he very close to a sister who committed suicide and was involved in unclean traffic.
cast: Carlo Cecchi, Angela Molina, Ivano Marescotti, Lino Capolicchio

title: Un delitto poco comune
synopsis: The life of Robert, a successful pianist, is turned upside down by a rare and irreversible disease. Robert reacts with a chain of murders and also attempts to eliminate a woman who is expecting a child from him.
cast: Michael York, Edwige Fenech, Donald Pleasence, Caterina Boratto, Mapi Galán, Fabio Sartor, Renato Cortesi, Antonella Ponziani, Giovanni Lombardo Radice

title: Un delitto quasi perfetto
synopsis: Returning from a trip to Amsterdam, the journalist Paolo Respighi meets Anne Robson, an orphan and very wealthy heiress, who is going to Beirut to take possession of the five million dollar bequest. Partly out of curiosity, partly for the interest aroused in him by the girl, the next day Paolo decides to follow the woman. When the two arrive at a mysterious villa she disappears ...
cast: Philippe Leroy, Pamela Tiffin, Graziella Granata, Fernando Sancho

title: Un detective. Macchie di belletto
synopsis: A well-known lawyer bribes a police commissioner, asking him to expel a foreign model who seduced his son from Italy, and to investigate a record company his wife would like to finance. The latter is found dead, and later also the son and a friend of the lawyer. Despite being suspected in turn, due to his unclear behavior, the commissioner manages to unravel the intrigue.
cast: Franco Nero, Florinda Bolkan, Adolfo Celi, Delia Boccardo, Renzo Palmer, Susanna Martinkova, Roberto Bisacco, Maurizio Bonuglia

title: Un difetto di famiglia
synopsis: Nicola is the happiest man in the world: his daughter is about to marry a boy from an excellent family. But on the day of the wedding, Nicola's mother died at the ripe old age of 101. During the funeral ceremony, Francesco, Nicola's elder brother, arrives, whom he hasn't seen for forty years. Francesco, the stone of the family scandal because he was homosexual, had forced Nicola and his mother to flee the country. Since then Nicola hates Francesco with all his strength. But to respect the last wishes of the mother, the two brothers are forced to undertake a long journey together to their country to accompany the body.
cast: Nino Manfredi, Lino Banfi, Carlo Cascone, Jane Ashbourne

title: Un divan a Tunis
synopsis: Selma, a psychoanalyst, opens a new studio in her native Tunis. Here, he will find himself struggling with a colorful group of new eccentric patients.
cast: Golshifteh Farahani, Majd Mastoura, Hichem Yacoubi, Aïsha Ben Miled, Ramla Ayari, Feryel Chammari, Moncef Anjegui

title: Un dollaro bucato
synopsis: Gary is commissioned to murder a man. She realizes at the last moment that this is her brother Phil.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Evelyn Stewart, Peter Cross

title: Un dollaro di fifa
synopsis: Mistaken for infallible sheriffs, two little thugs who live by expedients around the West, risk hanging. Pretty bad western parody.
cast: Walter Chiari, Ugo Tognazzi, Dominique Boschero, Mario Carotenuto, Hélène Chanel, Leonora Ruffo, Aroldo Tieri, Arturo Dominici, Renzo Palmer

title: Un dollaro per sette vigliacchi
synopsis: After the brutal murder, which took place in Rome, of the gangster Tony Madigan, of Italian origin but expelled from the US as undesirable, the US tax authorities mandate agent Frank Putzu to recover the substantial sum (one million dollars) robbed and subsequently hidden by the Madigan himself. Putzu - who is not a lightning bolt of war - encounters many difficulties in collaborating with the local police and does not have an easy life even with the band of the "Baron", which in turn is on the trail of the loot ...
cast: Dustin Hoffman, Elsa Martinelli, Cesar Romero, Gustavo Rojo

title: Un dollaro tra i denti
synopsis: The Stranger allies himself with Aguilar to land a substantial robbery; the shot hits, but Aguilar keeps the loot to himself. Betrayed and even humiliated, the Stranger decides to take revenge on his own, facing the bandit and his henchmen alone.
cast: Tony Anthony, Frank Wolff, Jolanda Modio, Gia Sandri, Raf Baldassarre, Aldo Berti, Lars Bloch, Enrico Capoleoni, Arturo Corso, Antonio Marsina

title: Un dono semplice
synopsis: Thomas, a cynical executive of a multinational company, leaves for India to give his daughter Beatrice the news of his mother's death. Thomas will meet Sister Beth who runs the mission where the girl volunteers. In contact with the shocking reality of that country, he will rethink the market strategies of his company.
cast: F. Murray Abraham, Virna Lisi, Valeria D'Obici, Regula Grauwiller

title: Un dottore quasi perfetto
synopsis: Doctor Franchi rescues a girl who has overdosed. Soon after he collides with Francesca, her mother, who doesn't want to believe that her daughter is taking drugs. The woman has to face divorce and the girl's crisis, while the quarrels with the doctor continue: but these actually hide a strong attraction.
cast: Luca Ward, Sonia Aquino, Dario Ballantini, Massimo Ceccherini, Katia Ricciarelli, Ruby Rachel Kammer, Giacinto Ferro

title: Un dramma borghese
synopsis: Abandoned by the mahogile, Carlo goes to recover his sixteen -year -old daughter who studies in a Swiss college. The two stop in Lugano and begins a dangerous relationship between them. To put an end to such an ambiguous relationship, Carlo puts herself with a woman, friend of the girl, but the latter takes her a lot and uses extreme means in order to "recover" the parent-lover.
cast: Franco Nero, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Lara Wendel, Carlo Bagno, Felicita Montrone, Silvio Pascoletti

title: Un drôle de dimanche
synopsis: The good-natured Jean was left by his wife Catherine, who ran away with her lover. After five years, however, he meets the woman again by chance and asks her for an appointment: still upset by jealousy, he would actually like to take revenge by killing her. But Jean's landlady discovers his intentions and warns the intended victim, who, however, does not panic and rather keeps calm: in fact, she does not believe that the man is really capable of such a bloody gesture ...
cast: Danielle Darrieux, Arletty, Bourvil, Cathia Caro, Jean Paul Belmondo, Jean Carmet

title: Un dólar de recompensa
synopsis: In the Far West a painter turns into a gunslinger to avenge his father murdered under his eyes by a group of masked bandits. Italian-Hispanic Westernaccio also a bit late.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Orchidea De Santis, Carlos Romero Marchent

title: Un eroe borghese
synopsis: The lawyer Giorgio Ambrosoli, married and father of three children, is appointed liquidator of the private bank of Michele Sindona, the financier linked to the mafia. The legal task is extremely difficult, both for the internal situation of the bank and for the numerous implications that inevitably interfere with his work. Ambrosoli is determined to fulfill his mandate as best as possible, without allowing himself to be misled or intimidated, despite having the exact perception of the dangers to which he exposes himself. The threats, the "friendly" advice do not stop him: the lawyer wants to highlight all the rottenness behind the Sicilian financier, the complicity, the connivance, at any level and in any capacity. And Sindona, realizing the moral stature of a ruthless and incorruptible antagonist, has him killed. But the state is also jointly responsible for the crime. Michele Placido (director, as well as interpreter in the sober role of Marshal Novembre, of Finance) tackles with seriousness and measure (except for some rare uncontrolled moments) one of the most infamous, most shameful "cases" in our recent history: that of a man became a "hero" only for wanting to do his duty. A man whom the state should have supported and protected and who instead, through its most sordid channels, helped to assassinate. Excellent proof of interpreter for Fabrizio Bentivoglio, but also the minor figures are delineated with attention and vigor.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Michele Placido, Omero Antonutti, Laura Betti

title: Un eroe dei nostri tempi
synopsis: Alberto (Sordi) grew up fearful and fearful that everything and everyone will conspire to damage him. Employed in a hat factory, he has a widow as head of office who maneuvers to get married by him who, moreover, has no desire to. One night when he was away from home, an attack causes some people to be injured and Alberto is suspected. He will get away with it and decide to join the Celere. Too confused and fragmented, the story relies excessively on Sordi's histrionics, but precisely because of this fragile structure it ends up losing part of its satirical value, even if it does not lack hilarious ideas.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Franca Valeri, Giovanna Ralli, Tina Pica

title: Un esercito di 5 uomini
synopsis: An American outlaw, who lives in Mexico and calls himself "the Dutchman", instructs the young Luis to find three cronies to organize a coup. The members of the quintet arrive in a country where they save Esteban, the leader of the revolutionaries, from being shot. Esteban "enlists" them immediately to make them carry out a very audacious blow: rob the gold, transported by an army train, with which to finance the purchase of weapons for the revolutionaries. The five accept but fall prey to the military.
cast: Peter Graves, Bud Spencer, Nino Castelnuovo, James Daly, Tetsuro Tamba, Claudio Gora, Carlo Alighiero

title: Un ettaro di cielo
synopsis: In a remote village at the mouth of the Po, a fair is held every year in which Severino, a friendly salesman, takes part. Retirees, living in poverty, believe in his proposal: to buy a hectare of sky to be able to live well after death. After investing their savings, the old men decide it is time to die and abandon themselves on a boat. They will be saved, the deception will be revealed, but a self-respecting fairy tale cannot end in bad way: Severino marries a local girl and ...
cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Rosanna Schiaffino, Carlo Pisacane, Silvio Bagolini, Salvatore Cafiero, Luigi De Martino, Polidor, Aristide Spelta

title: Un fantastico via vai
synopsis: Thrown out of his home by his wife Anita (Serena Autieri) due to a misunderstanding, Arnaldo (Leonardo Pieraccioni), a man no longer very young who is over forty, finds a room for rent in an apartment inhabited by four students. Thus begins an increasingly intense conflict that will see him grappling with a youth far from his world and his way of seeing things.
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Serena Autieri, Chiara Mastalli, Marianna Di Martino, Davide Sef, Giuseppe Maggio, Maurizio Battista, Marco Marzocca, Massimo Ceccherini, Giorgio Panariello, Alice Bellagamba

title: Un fidanzato per mia moglie
synopsis: To marry Simone and follow him to Milan where he works, Camilla did not hesitate to leave her Sardinia and to review her habits. Without a job, however, he soon falls into depression and his dissatisfaction spills over to Simone, who, tired of the situation, accepts the advice of his friend Carlo (Dino Abbrescia), who suggests him to resort to an original trick: hiring the hardened playboy Falco for push Camilla to betrayal and ask for separation.
cast: Paolo Kessisoglu, Geppi Cucciari, Luca Bizzarri, Dino Abbrescia, Francesco Villa, Alessandro Besentini, Pia Engleberth, Corrado Fortuna, Brenda Lodigiani, Daniela Tusa, Alice Mangione, Astrid Meloni

title: Un figlio a metà
synopsis: In Miami Sandro (Gigi Proietti) is looking for his son Luca (Matteo Bellina), whom his wife Nathalie has stolen from him in Italy by taking him to live with him and his new partner. The task, despite the help of his friend Carlo, is not the easiest: Sandro will be arrested, beaten and robbed by two thugs before being able to find Luca. On returning to Italy, in order not to leave traces, he plans a zigzag air itinerary, with stopovers in various cities in the USA.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Kathy Connelly, Andrea Giordana, Matteo Bellina, Bettina Giovannini

title: Un figlio a tutti i costi
synopsis: Orazio and Anna want a child at all costs. The child, due to the stress to which the husband is subjected, however, does not arrive. With him exhausted, his wife has a valid alternative to a possible adoption: it will be another man who gives her the so long -coveted child in a completely natural way ...
cast: Fabio Gravina, Roberta Garzia, Ivano Marescotti, Paola Riolo, Maurizio Mattioli, Stefano Masciarelli, Gianni Ciardo, Angelo Di Gennaro, Beppe Convertini, Emanuela Tittocchia, Gino Cogliandro, Nduccio

title: Un figlio d'oggi
synopsis: Renzo, a young teddy boy, makes the leap in quality by joining a band. When the leader of the gang is killed in a fight, Renzo flees abroad before turning himself in.
cast: Gino Cervi, Ennio Girolami, Valeria Fabrizi, Roberto Risso, Lauro Gazzolo, Germana Paolieri, Eleonora Bianchi, Elio Jotta, Ignazio Dolce, Pippo Starnazza

title: Un figlio di nome Erasmus
synopsis: Four friends in their forties? Pietro, Enrico, Ascanio and Jacopo? they are called to Lisbon for the funeral of Amalia, the woman all four loved as boys when they were doing Erasmus in Portugal. Amalia left an unexpected legacy: a son conceived with one of them. But who is the father? Waiting for the results of the DNA test, the four friends decide to go in search of their mysterious 20-year-old son and embark on a daring and exciting journey through Portugal with a girl who offers to help them.
cast: Luca Bizzarri, Paolo Kessisoglu, Ricky Memphis, Daniele Liotti, Carol Alt, Filipa Pinto, Giorgio Gobbi, Fernando Rodrigues, Valentina Corti, Elena Vanni

title: Un film comme les autres
synopsis: Starting from the French events of '68 (strikes, occupations of factories, demonstrations, clashes with the police), Godard recounts the politicization of the workers' world.

title: Un fils
synopsis: Mathilde works as a consultant in a parenting center, where she knows exactly what to do or how to put those seeking her help at ease. One day, sixteen-year-old Lea shows up in front of him asking for the morning-after pill. Right from the start, Mathilde has the feeling that behind the request there is something else and the young woman soon confesses that she was raped at a party. When he then learns the name of the manager, he remains of marble: it is his son Florian, who however speaks of a consensual relationship. Where is the truth?
cast: Michele Laroque, Philippe Lefebvre, Maxence Perrin, Victor Meutelet, Liah O'Prey, Roxane Bret, Audrey Chamot, Marie Abidine, Vanessa Jacquin, Anne Conti

title: Un fils
synopsis: Summer 2011. During a vacation in southern Tunisia, Fares, Meriem and their ten-year-old son Aziz are ambushed by an armed group. Aziz is injured and is transported to a rudimentary hospital nearby. As the frantic search for a new liver begins, long-buried truths begin to resurface, jeopardizing the family's chances of finding a donor in time.
cast: Sami Bouajila, Najla Ben Abdallah, Youssef Khemiri, Noomen Hamda, Qasim Rawane, Slah Msaddak, Mohamed Ali Ben Jemaa

title: Un fiocco nero per Deborah
synopsis: Young Deborah (who is unable to have children) is endowed with powers that allow her to predict the future. When she announces her pregnancy to her husband, he thinks she is crazy, like the doctors who diagnose her with a hysterical pregnancy. Nothing could be more false: Deborah is in fact expecting a child that she will give birth to after a car accident that will cost her her life. The little one then ...
cast: Bradford Dillman, Marina Malfatti, Gig Young, Delia Boccardo

title: Un fiume di dollari
cast: Thomas Hunter, Dan Duryea, Henry Silva, Nando Gazzolo, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Gianna Serra

title: Un gallo con muchos huevos
synopsis: Pedro, since he was a chick, has always wanted to fight in a real ring like his legend Sylvester Pollone. The opportunity comes when it comes to winning a very important match whose first prize could save his farm from economic ruin.
director: Gabriel Riva Palacio Alatriste, Rodolfo Riva Palacio Alatriste

title: Un garibaldino al convento
synopsis: Mariella and Caterinetta attend the same college and enliven the days with their quarrels. In helping a wounded Garibaldian who sought refuge in the convent, the two girls discover friendship, and Mariella finds love again. A Vittorio De Sica already mature for results of a very different caliber.

title: Un gatto nel cervello
synopsis: Lucio Fulci, a horror film director, is obsessed with the images of death that he himself created. For this he turns to a psychologist. Even the doctor is not in such good shape, however, since he is actually a serial killer.
cast: Lucio Fulci, Brett Halsey, Malisa Longo, Ria De Simone, Paola Cozzo

title: Un genio, due compari, un pollo
synopsis: Joe Thanks, brains up, convinces Locomotive Bill and his friend Lucy to organize a scam against Major Cabot who kept $ 300,000 for the Red Indians. The gang disguises itself, then the major discovers the trick and then loads the money on a stagecoach which is attacked by Thanks. This is the plan that is punctually implemented, but the ending reserves a surprise even for the smart ones.
cast: Terence Hill, Miou Miou, Robert Charlebois, Klaus Kinski

title: Un gioco da ragazze
synopsis: Elena, Michela, Alice and Livia are four seventeen-year-olds from a good family who have everything: beautiful, young and rich, they are the daughters of the four most prominent families in a town in the province. Their existence is devoted to luxury, self-care and pleasures. However, they are devoid of purpose and imprisoned in the superficiality of the relationships they forge. Especially Elena, who is somewhat the leader of the group, always behaves in an instrumental way, even towards friendship. And when a new professor, Mario Landi, enters his life, trying to change it, he too falls into his traps.
cast: Filippo Nigro, Chiara Chiti, Nadir Caselli, Desirèe Noferini, Valentina Carnelutti, Valeria Milillo, Stefano Santospago, Eleonora Ceci, Tommaso Ramenghi, Elisabetta Piccolomini, Chiara Paoli

title: Un giorno all'improvviso
synopsis: Antonio is seventeen and has a dream: to be a footballer in a great team. He lives in a small town in a province of Campania, a land where getting by is not always so easy. To make the situation even more complex is the beautiful Miriam, a sweet but highly problematic mother who he loves more than any other person in the world. In addition, Carlo, Antonio's father, abandoned them when he was very young and Miriam is obsessed with the idea of ??rebuilding her family. Luckily there is football and above all his friends: Stefano Caccialepre, the center forward of the team, and Peppe Lambiase, the playmaker, always ready to joke, a time waster by vocation and with the nose to always get into trouble. Suddenly life seems to give Antonio and Miriam a real chance: a talent scout, Michele Astarita, is looking for young promises to bring to Parma's Primavera and, when he sees him play, Antonio on the pitch is a real revelation. But every dream has a very high price to pay.
