title: Un giorno da leoni
synopsis: Danilo, Michele and Gino are three boys whose paths and destinies meet and intertwine in Italy divided by war, after September 8, 1943. Escaping a German roundup, the three join a partisan formation led by young Orlando; with him they perform an action of sabotage on a bridge during which Michele loses his life.
cast: Renato Salvatori, Tomas Milian, Nino Castelnuovo, Anna Maria Ferrero, Carla Gravina, Saro Urzì, Romolo Valli, Corrado Pani, Leopoldo Trieste, Valeria Moriconi, Regina Bianchi

title: Un giorno della vita
synopsis: Basilicata 1964. At the age of twelve Salvatore ends up in a reformatory due to his devouring passion for cinema. A passion that drives him to travel every day by bicycle, together with friends Alessio and Caterina, to the village near his to be able to watch the films in a third viewing room. Salvatore then has to face the hostility of his father on a daily basis, a Communist farmer who sees his son's passion as smoke in his eyes. One day, the announcement of the sale of an old 16 mm projector gave Salvatore the idea of ??creating a small cinema. The project, however, has a flaw: the absolute lack of money. Salvatore buys the projector by subtracting the money collected from the militants to send a delegation to the funeral of Togliatti from the coffers of the local section of the Communist Party.
cast: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Alessandro Haber, Ernesto Mahieux, Domenico Fortunato, Mia Benedetta, Matteo Basso, Amedeo Angelone, Daniele Russo, Pascal Zullino, Francesca D'Amico

title: Un giorno devi andare
synopsis: Following some troubled personal events, the 30-year-old Augusta left for Brazil in order to find something that gives new meaning to her life. Arriving in the Amazon, at first she works alongside a friend of her mother, who is committed to helping a small community of indigenous people near the upper rio Anderà, but then, feeling the need to reconcile with the world, with herself and with God , detaches from it to seek a more direct contact with nature and with the indios of the place.
cast: Jasmine Trinca, Anne Alvaro, Pia Engleberth, Sonia Gessner, Amanda Fonseca Galvao, Paulo De Souza, Teresa Benevides Schermuly Santos, Eder Frota Dos Santos, Manuela Mendonca Marinho, Federica Fracassi, Nilton Avani Rodrigues, Michael Parchow Figueiredo, Fredo Valla, Davide Tuniz

title: Un giorno in pretura
synopsis: A day of work of the praetor Salomone Lorusso (Peppino De Filippo). In front of him the defendants pass by in various trials. Nando Moriconi (Alberto Sordi), known as the American, was arrested because he was caught naked in the street. The poor fool had been robbed of his clothes, left at the edge of a river, while doing Tarzan imitation. Gloriana is a former soubrette accused of solicitation and Lorusso is all too indulgent with her. Fragmentary but funny film, based on an idea by Lucio Fulci and also written by Sandro Continenza, Alberto Sordi, Giancarlo Viganotti and by Steno himself.
cast: Peppino De Filippo, Alberto Sordi, Sophia Loren, Silvana Pampanini, Walter Chiari, Tania Weber, Leopoldo Trieste, Armenia Balducci, Virgilio Riento, Ubaldo Lay

title: Un giorno nella vita
synopsis: A group of partisans takes refuge in a convent of cloistered nuns, unaware of what is happening outside their walls and at first very suspicious. Then instead charity and understanding prevail. The partisans are thus saved, but the reprisals of the Germans do not take long to hit the convent.
cast: Elisa Cegani, Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Massimo Girotti, Arnoldo Foà, Dina Sassoli, Ave Ninchi, Ada Colangeli, Luciano Mondolfo

title: Un giorno perfetto
synopsis: Rome, one night in May. The police are about to break into an apartment in via Carlo Alberto. Maybe it's a false alarm or maybe he just committed a crime. A twenty-four hour flashback, and a large group of characters involves us in any day, but full of small events. Camilla turns seven, Zero detonates her first bomb, Emma loses her job, Elio gives the wrong speech at her election rally, Valentina gets a navel piercing, Maja finds the house of her dreams, Kevin an unexpected bride, Sasha celebrates the ten-year anniversary with his lover, Antonio sees his wife for the last time and someone charges his gun with 7 shots + 1. Their paths cross the streets of Rome and tension builds up.
cast: Isabella Ferrari, Valerio Mastandrea, Valerio Binasco, Nicole Grimaudo, Federico Costantini, Monica Guerritore, Angela Finocchiaro, Stefania Sandrelli, Nicole Murgia, Gabriele Paolino

title: Un giorno speciale
synopsis: On the outskirts of Rome, Marco (Filippo Scicchitano) is on his first day of work as the Honorable Balestra's driver. He has just received the task of going to pick up Gina (Giulia Valentini), a girl in search of success as an actress. Gina believes that the appointment with the politician could allow her career to take off but the journey in the car driven by the intrusive Marco seems interminable. Several hitches, delays and unforeseen events force Marco and Gina to spend the whole day together and get to know each other, comparing their experiences.
cast: Filippo Scicchitano, Giulia Valentini, Roberto Infascelli (II), Antonio Giancarlo Zavatteri, Daniela Del Priore, Rocco Miglionico

title: Un giorno, una vita
synopsis: The marriage between Olga and Giuliano no longer makes sense: day after day, they lost sweetness and respect, replaced by indifference and boredom. The situation is now critical, but the only one to react is Olga, who still sees a hope of happiness in her future.
cast: Pierre Brice, Daniela Rocca, Sandra Dall, Corrado Croce

title: Un giudice di rispetto
cast: Tony Sperandeo, Marina Suma, Max Parodi, Giacomo Piperno, Orso Maria Guerrini, Adriana Russo, Philippe Leroy, Tiberio Murgia

title: Un grain de sable
synopsis: The death of a businessman in an accident sets off a bloody struggle for his succession. Wearable, despite the silly Italian title. Kast was one of the leading names of nouvelle vague critics.
cast: Lilli Palmer, Pierre Brasseur, Laurent Terzieff, Sylva Koscina

title: Un grand amour de Beethoven
cast: Harry Baur, Annie Ducaux, Jany Holt, André Nox, Jane Marken

title: Un heureux événement
synopsis: Barbara is in college and is preparing her dissertation when she discovers she is pregnant with her beloved boyfriend Nicolas. Recovering from the initial shock, she begins to experience pregnancy with emotion and trepidation but as the weeks go by she realizes how exasperating it is to participate in endless yoga sessions or give up a normal sex life. The birth of the child, then, puts her in front of a defenseless being who needs all her attention but this makes Barbara even more restless, who struggles to see her world go upside down, despite the help of all those around her. .

title: Un hombre de acción
synopsis: Lucio Urutia was a Spanish anarchist, a humble bricklayer who became a robber of banks. Considered an idol by many, a figure halfway between Don Quixote and Robin Hood, Urutia was also involved in one of the most sensational banking scams ever, which put it in front of a complicated choice between the support for the cause and the protection of its own safety.
cast: Juan José Ballesta, Luis Callejo, Liah O'Prey, Miki Esparbé, Alexandre Blazy, Ben Temple, Ana Polvorosa, Fred Tatien, Josean Bengoetxea, Juan Olivares, Monica Lamberti, Bastien Ughetto, Tomás Pozzi, Gabriela Blin, Anna Caponnetto, Yanet Sierra, Ken Appledorn, Yaël Belicha

title: Un hombre llamado Noon
synopsis: Returning from a business trip, Thomas finds his wife and son killed. To better carry out his revenge, he takes the name of Ruble Noon. But each of his identities creates trouble for him: like Thomas, he is wanted by the police who believe him missing, as well as by some bad guys; like Noon is even accused of murder. As if that weren't enough, our hero has completely lost his memory. Western-spaghetti based on a novel by the prolific Louis Lamour, shot in Spain with American staff. The "yellow" vein of the story and an unusual care of the figurative aspect contribute to making it less obvious than others.
cast: Richard Crenna, Farley Granger, Steven Boyd, Rosanna Schiaffino, Patty Shepard, Ángel Del Pozo, Howard Ross, Aldo Sambrell

title: Un hombre y un colt
synopsis: Gunman Joe Dakota was hired by a landowner to kill a doctor. Before putting his hand to the gun, Joe discovers that the doctor is a fervent supporter of Emiliano Zapata's revolution. The cowboy doesn't take long to go over to the side of the rebels.
cast: Robert Hundar, Fernando Sancho, Gloria Milland, Mirko Ellis, Marta Reves, Jacinto Martín, Paco Morán, Félix Dafauce

title: Un homme est mort
synopsis: Lucien, known to everyone by the false name of Roger, arrives from Paris to Los Angeles to kill the old and very rich underworld boss Victor Kovacs. Man does not find it difficult to carry out his mission. The perpetrators of the crime are Victor's son Alex and stepmother Jacky. Despite the success of the operation, Lucien is robbed of his documents and persecuted by a killer, so he decides to stay in Los Angeles to shed light on the mysterious episodes he was a victim of.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Ann Margret, Roy Scheider, Angie Dickinson

title: Un homme et son chien
synopsis: Jeanne, a charming widow, announces her new marriage to Charles and decides to put him out with her dog. After the death of her husband, Jeanne was the lover of Charles, the companion and friend of the deceased since the time they served in the navy, but now the relationship can no longer continue. Leila, a young woman who Jeanne has at home for domestic services and who is pregnant without knowing who her baby's father is, offers to help the man. With only the meager pension available, Charles and his dog soon find themselves on the street, waiting for the end or the possible beginning of a new life.
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Julika Jenkins, Francis Huster, Hafsia Herzi, Jean Dujardin, Michèle Bernier, José Garcia, Patrick Bosso, Sarah Biasini, Sophie Bouilloux, Rachida Brakni, Nicole Calfan, Valeria Cavalli, Dolores Chaplin, Dorothée Deblaton

title: Un homme et une femme
synopsis: Both widowed and severely tested by life, they meet and slowly give in to feelings. The film that launched Lelouch: Palme d'Or at Cannes and Oscar for best foreign film. Lelouch's mastery and pleasure in filming are undeniable, but the film appeared even then honeyed and cunning in its use of rhetoric and clichés. Still, it worked and how. Francis Lai's music with his "sciabadabada" has remained famous.

title: Un homme et une femme vingt ans déjà
synopsis: The romantic couple from Lelouch's 1966 film meet again twenty years later to never leave. Sequel without the impact of the antecedent.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Anouk Aimée, Richard Berry

title: Un homme fidèle
synopsis: Marianne leaves Abel for Paul, his best friend and father of the unborn child she carries in her womb. Eight years later, Paul dies and Abel and Marianne get back together. In doing so, they arouse feelings of jealousy both in Joseph, Marianne's son, and in Eve, Paul's sister who has always been secretly in love with Abel.
cast: Louis Garrel, Laetitia Casta, Lily Rose Depp, Joseph Engel

title: Un homme heureux
synopsis: Jean, conservative mayor of a small town in Brittany, is in the middle of the election campaign for its re -election. Edith, his wife of him for forty years, announces his intention of changing sex. However, Jean asks her to postpone her transition in the aftermath of the elections. Edith accepts but the voices soon begin to spread.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Catherine Frot, Philippe Katerine

title: Un homme idéal
synopsis: 25-year-old Mathieu aspires to become a renowned author. His is a dream that seems unattainable: despite the efforts, no one seems willing to publish one of his writings and, in the meantime, Mathieu earns his living working with his uncle, a manager of a moving company. However, his fate changes when he comes across the manuscript of a lonely old man who has just died, whom he decides to pass off as his own. This will represent the beginning of a whirlwind of events and lies that will lead him to become famous and to find love, while the wait for his second novel will grow out of all proportion.
cast: Pierre Niney, Ana Girardot, Ludovic Berthillot, Valeria Cavalli, Marc Barbé, Thibault Vinçon, André Marcon, Laurent Grévill, François Rabette, Clemence Chatagnon

title: Un homme pressé
synopsis: Alain is a constantly pressed, powerful and respected businessman. His time is precious and he doesn't like getting lost in small things. There is not even a place in his life for fun or family. One day, however, an illness changes his way of life. During his stay in the hospital, the young speech therapist Jeanne helps him to become aware of the situation and to understand that to get back on his feet he must first of all learn to be patient and take time all to himself.
cast: Fabrice Luchini, Leïla Bekhti, Rebecca Marder, Igor Gotesman, Clémence Massart, Yves Jacques, Micha Lescot, Frédérique Tirmont

title: Un homme qui crie
synopsis: Sixty-year-old Adam, a lifeguard at the swimming pool of a luxury hotel in N'Djamena, must give way to his son Abdul after some Chinese entrepreneurs have acquired the hotel where he works. He lives this passage very badly, which he sees as a sign of social degradation. But Chad is plagued by civil war and armed rebels threaten the government which, in response, invites the population to a "war effort", asking for money and young people of conscription age to fight the rebels.
cast: Emile Abossolo M'bo, Youssouf Djaoro, Dioucounda Koma, Djénéba Koné, Hadje Fatime N'Goua

title: Un homme qui dort
synopsis: A student wanders through the streets of Paris, regardless of the whole world. He never speaks, but a female voice out of the field describes its actions.
cast: Jacques Spiesser, Ludmila Mikael

title: Un homme sans l'Occident
synopsis: Shot in northeastern Chad, the film tells the story of one of the last nomadic peoples of the desert, the Toubou (the only colored nomads in the desert). The protagonist Sid Ahmed, abandoned in the desert as a child and welcomed by the nomads of whom he becomes one of the leaders, is terrified by the modernization that is affecting his country.
cast: Ali Hamit, Wodji Ouardougou

title: Un homme à abattre
synopsis: Having escaped the Nazi extermination camps, Giulio prepares his revenge against an SS general who killed his brother and who now lives under a false name.
cast: Jean Louis Trintignant, Valerie Lagrange, Luis Prendes, André Oumansky

title: Un homme à la hauteur
synopsis: Diane, a newly single lawyer with a sense of humor and great intelligence, receives the call from Alexandre, a charming architect she has never met before who found the laptop she had lost. A certain chemistry is born between the two and Diane is pleasantly struck by the kindness of her interlocutor, eventually falling in love with him. When they get to know each other, nothing will go as planned.
cast: Jean Dujardin, Virginie Efira, Cédric Kahn, Stéphanie Papanian, César Domboy, Myriam Tekaïa, Eléa Clair, François Dominique Blin, Lionel Mur, Adonis Danieletto

title: Un homme, un vrai
synopsis: Aspiring director Boris meets Marilyne at a party in Paris. The two, for fun, pretend to be a couple of lovers but they end up really falling in love. Five years later we find them in Ibiza for work, married with two children: their relationship is in crisis and betrayals and disappointments are consumed, until the breakup. Another five years pass and Maryline finds Boris in the Pyrenees. This time they will pretend to be two strangers, but the game will have unforeseen consequences.
cast: Mathieu Amalric, Hélène Fillières, Pierre Pellet, Philippe Suner, Daniel Cohen, Silvie Laguna, Jocelyne Desverchère, Cécile Reigher, Eva Ionesco, Aitana Sánchez Gijón

title: Un honnête commerçant
synopsis: In a Brussels police station, Hubert Verkamen is subjected to a harsh interrogation: he is under investigation for the brutal murder of an entire family. The policemen are convinced that the man is a drug trafficker who has often escaped capture: Verkamen initially denies, but then decides to play along and identifies with the criminal that others want him to be. Thus begins a sophisticated game of massacre that leads to an unexpected epilogue.
cast: Benoît Verhaert, Philippe Noiret, Yolande Moreau, Frédéric Bodson

title: Un héros très discret
synopsis: In Paris, in the agitated and confused period between 1944 and 1945, towards the end of the Second World War, a man who did not take part in the conflict begins to build an identity by posing as a hero of the resistance. And by dint of lies and omissions it ends up being believed, to the point of acquiring credibility and importance.
cast: Mathieu Kassovitz, Anouk Grinberg, Sandrine Kiberlain, Jean Louis Trintignant, Albert Dupontel, Nadia Barentin, Bernard Bloch, François Chattot, Philippe Duclos, Danièle Lebrun

title: Un indien dans la ville
synopsis: Stephane, a Parisian telematic speculator, must join his wife, who abandoned him thirteen years earlier, in the Amazon rainforest to obtain a divorce signature. When he finds her, among Indians and mosquitoes, he discovers he has a son. The boy, with the whimsical name of "Cat's Piss", is eager to see the Eiffel Tower and can't be said no. But the contact between the little savage and the civilized world is certainly not easy ...
cast: Thierry Lhermitte, Arielle Dombasle, Miou Miou, Ludwig Briand

title: Un inverno freddo freddo
synopsis: The "Guya Valentine Beauty Salon" is a modest beauty salon located in a popular Roman neighborhood. Guya, a former manicurist from the French province, is the unlikely owner of the place, where Daniela, Monica and Rosanna work. Relations between the four women are very tense. Guya, instead of dealing with the problems of the beauty salon (it takes three hundred million to pay all the debts), wastes time in clumsy attempts to track down Bruno, a scruffy playboy, unreliable and, moreover, a troublemaker.
cast: Cecilia Dazzi, Carlotta Natoli, Valerio Mastandrea, Armando De Razza

title: Un italiano in America
synopsis: Giuseppe is a gas station attendant. For thirty years he has not seen his father who emigrated to the United States. Suddenly the man calls him and, during a television broadcast, the two meet again. The father, who pretends to be a businessman, is actually in debt: the money from the show will be used to pay off creditors.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Franco Valobra, Alice Condon, Gray Frederickson, Bettina Brenna, Bill Dana, Lou Perry

title: Un jeans e una maglietta
synopsis: In a luxurious club on the island of Capri, everyone plays the thread to the beautiful Annamaria, and she doesn't seem to be sorry at all. Among these is Tony who would like to marry her and has also obtained the consent of her father. But Tony didn't deal with Nino, the bartender, the one with the angel's voice and a big heart. Thanks also to a boat that runs out of petrol, Nino will have the better of his rival.
cast: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Gabriele Villa, Benito Artesi, Sebastiano Somma, Laura Barbonetti

title: Un jeu brutal
synopsis: Among Professor Tessier, a famous scientist, and the teenage daughter Isabelle, hit by handicaps in the legs from birth, is established a sort of brutal game: that of nature towards the weakest. Father and daughter will follow divergent and dramatic paths, in a violent but salvific role -playing game in which they will end up meeting.
cast: Bruno Cremer, Emmanuelle Debever, María Luisa García, Albert Pigot, Lucien Plazanet, Humbert Balsan, Jean Douchet, Lucienne Le Marchand, Liliane Gaudet, Catherine Griffoni

title: Un jeu d'enfants
synopsis: Marianne and Jacques are the happy parents of two beautiful children, Aude and Julien. Daily life flows peacefully and safely in their Parisian apartment. But one day husband and wife begin to have strange visions: in hers there are violence and rape, while he hallucinates at the end of which wounds remain on his body. When the babysitter hangs herself and the children start acting sadistically, the couple suspects that their children are being possessed by some mysterious evil entity.
cast: Karin Viard, Charles Berling, Ludivine Sagnier, Camille Vatel, Alexandre Bongibault, Aurélien Recoing, Manuela Gourary, Pierre Julien, Idwig Stephane, Jean Claude Perrin

title: Un jour à Marseille
synopsis: One day and one night in Marseille: Boulevard d'Athénes, the Grande Joliette, the Corniche. Four stories, four views of the city.

title: Un killer per Sua Maestà
cast: Venantino Venantini, Bruno Cremer, Gordon Mitchell, Kerwin Mathhews, Marilù Tolo

title: Un lac
synopsis: In the heart of winter, in a country of which nothing is known. Forests without borders, an isolated house and a lake to cross to get there. A family completely cut off from the world but held together by immense love. It is tragic.
cast: Dimitry Kubasov, Natalie Rehorova, Alexei Solonchev

title: Un ladro in paradiso
synopsis: Vincenzo and Gennarino live on tricks and petty thefts in Naples. On Christmas Eve, the former steals a set of glasses and gives it to his girlfriend Nannarella, a poor and honest seamstress. Unfortunately, the thing is discovered, and Vincenzo arrested. While recommending himself to St. Joseph, it seems to him that the latter demonstrates his benevolence to him with a gesture. Released from prison after three months full of good intentions, he obtains Nannarella's pardon and resumes contact with Gennarino. Since they can't find an honest job, the two are forced to steal again ...
cast: Nino Taranto, Geppa, Hélène Remy, Enzo Turco, Marisa Fimiani, Filippo Scelzo

title: Un long dimanche de fiançailles
synopsis: WWI. Mathilde learns that her fiancé Manech is one of five French soldiers condemned by a court martial and abandoned in nobody's land between the French and German trenches. He is almost certainly dead. Mathilde does not give up and begins a journey in her footsteps ...
cast: Audrey Tautou, André Dussollier, Gaspard Ulliel, Tchéky Karyo, Marion Cotillard, Jodie Foster, Dominique Pinon, Chantal Neuwirth, Ticky Holgado, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Clovis Cornillac, Denis Lavant, Dominique Bettenfeld

title: Un maledetto imbroglio
synopsis: Commissioner Ingravallo investigates a theft, but soon finds himself in the throes of a murder. The two crimes are connected and, gifted with humanity as well as acumen, he solves the case in his own way. Not easy and therefore even more appreciable, robust transposition of one of the greatest Italian novels of the twentieth century, Quer pasticciaccio brutto de Via Merulana, by Gadda. Germi replaces the non-ending of the book with a plausible solution, transforming the metaphysical delirium into a simple thriller. Excellent places and surrounding figures. In the cast, the not yet twenty-year-old Claudia Cardinale. Rustichelli's final song, "Sinnò me moro", sung by Alida Chelli (daughter of the musician) is a must.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Pietro Germi, Claudio Gora, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Franco Fabrizi, Cristina Gaioni, Saro Urzì, Nino Castelnuovo, Ildebrando Santafe, Peppino De Martino, Silla Bettini

title: Un mandarino per Teo
synopsis: Teo, an extra, is invited by two unknown individuals to press a button that allows him to become rich. There is only one small detail if he makes that simple gesture in China a mandarin will die. After many hesitations, Teo finally decides to press the button. A few days pass and a notary appears at Teo who tells him that a mandarin has died in China and has left him a huge inheritance. The remorse begins on the part of Teo who is convinced by Rosanella that it is just a pure coincidence. The girl offers to go find the two individuals ...
cast: Walter Chiari, Sandra Mondaini, Ave Ninchi, Riccardo Billi

title: Un maresciallo in gondola
synopsis: Cortina, 1959. Carabiniere Colombo didn't take long to become the vip marshal. In the renowned ski resort he met personalities and stars from the world of cinema. But now even those times have passed and the military is a bit bored. The only spurts of life he has them by dating the young widow Zanin with whom he is secretly in love. To free him from the oppressive boredom comes a phone call from the provincial commander who calls him to report in Venice and entrusts him with a delicate task: to supervise Kim Dorak, a famous American actress and to watch over a precious necklace that the starlet has brought with her.
cast: Ezio Greggio, Victoria Silvstedt, Sandro Ghiani, Philippe Leroy

title: Un marinaio e mezzo
synopsis: Nick, a navigator who loves to sail the waters alone, is rammed by a ship. After some investigation he discovers that the boat is registered to a company based in Colombia. Nick manages to make friends with the boy heir to the mysterious shipowner.
cast: Franco Nero, Santiago Garcia, Francisco Rabal, Galo Ahumada

title: Un marito di troppo
synopsis: Born and raised in a suburb of Turin, Alessia worked hard on herself to become a music producer: she moved to Milan, perfected her vocabulary, changed her way of dressing and lied shamelessly about her humble origins. Appointed editorial director of a music label at the age of 32, Alessia is asked to marry by the charming lawyer Tancredi della Seta, the son of a very prominent Milanese family. Believing that she has realized all her dreams in this way, Alessia will have to deal with a past that returns to mess up the present.
cast: Cristiana Capotondi, Flavio Parenti, Giorgio Marchesi, Massimo Venturiello, Sabina Vannucchi, Viviana Strambelli, Gianluca Gobbi, Nicola Rignanese, Alessia Giuliani, Chiara De Bonis, Laura Lattuada, Rodolfo Baldini

title: Un marito per Anna Zaccheo
synopsis: Anna and the sailor Andrea have sworn eternal love. The woman, who works at a photo agency, is seduced by the boss and tries to kill herself. Andrea, returning from a cruise, does not forgive her, and while Anna is about to marry an elderly merchant, she withdraws at the last moment. Having met Andrea again, the two spend the night together.
cast: Silvana Pampanini, Amedeo Nazzari, Massimo Girotti

title: Un marito per il mese di aprile
synopsis: Reduced on the pavement from the passion of the game, a young man accepts a strange engagement by a girl haunted by a suitor: for a month she must pretend to be her husband and discourage the suitor. Consciously concluded the task, he will discover that he is at ease in the part of her.
cast: Vanna Vanni, Carlo Romano, Vera Carmi, Pina Renzi, Guglielmo Sinaz, Romolo Costa, Fausto Guerzoni, Guido Morisi, Renato Malavasi

title: Un matrimonio
synopsis: The long love story between Carlo Dagnini (Flavio Parenti) and Francesca Osti (Micaela Ramazzotti) takes place against the backdrop of the chronicles of Italy from the second post-war period to 2005. Despite the different classes they belong to - he the son of a wealthy merchant (Christian De Sica) and she of a former immigrant and womanizer Arsenal worker (Andrea Roncato) -, since the first meeting in 1948 the two are destined to love each other for the whole life: they will marry, they will first become parents and then grandparents, overcoming crises and disappointments.
cast: Micaela Ramazzotti, Flavio Parenti, Christian De Sica, Andrea Roncato, Katia Ricciarelli, Eliana Miglio, Andrea Montovoli, Valeria Fabrizi, Edoardo Pesce, Gisella Sofio, Francesco Brandi, Alessandro Sperduti, Marta Iagatti, Isabella Aldovini, Maximilian Dirr, Mariella Valentini, Andrea Santonastaso, Ettore Bassi, Chiara Ricci, Giorgio Borghetti, Jacopo Bicocchi, Roberta Mengozzi, Claudia Salerno, Lucia Loffredo, Viola Sartoretto, Matteo Leoni, Chiara Basile Fasolo, Antonella Ferrari, Silvia De Grandi, Patrizio Pelizzi

title: Un matrimonio da favola
synopsis: Five high school friends meet again twenty years after graduation. The occasion is given by Daniele's marriage in Zurich, the only one to have made a career, with Barbara, the daughter of a well-known Swiss banker. Seeing each other again, the five friends rediscover the complicity of school times and, over a long weekend of misunderstandings, comic situations and twists, they will call their lives into question.
cast: Adriano Giannini, Ricky Memphis, Paola Minaccioni, Andrea Osvart, Giorgio Pasotti, Stefania Rocca, Riccardo Rossi, Emilio Solfrizzi, Ilaria Spada, Max Tortora, Luca Angeletti, Teco Celio, Roberta Fiorentini

title: Un mauvais fils
synopsis: He returns home after five years in prison in the US for drug use and drug dealing. Dad rejects him, he moves in with Catherine and resumes taking drugs. The low and marginal floors of Eighties society narrated in plain language by the director of A heart in winter.
cast: Patrick Dewaere, Yves Robert, Brigitte Fossey

title: Un meurtre est un meurtre
synopsis: Jean kills Paul's paralytic wife and wants five million francs so as not to put the blame on him. Good tension and exceptional cast, but the developments of the story are predictable. In a secondary role the director Claude Chabrol.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Jean Claude Brialy, Stéphane Audran

title: Un milione di giorni
synopsis: While walking with the servant Concettina (Evelyn Famà) who does not hesitate to mock him, a Sicilian duke (Nino Frassica) tells four stories of women on the most significant day of their existence, highlighting how the matriarchal family is rooted in Sicily and what the role is that female figures have had throughout history, often forced to sacrifice themselves to make room for a man. The first story tells of how Franca Florio (Galatea Ranzi), despite her privileged status as the wife of a rich Palermo industrialist, got bored and unhappy; the second has as its protagonist Costanza d'Altavilla (Chiara Caselli), who in the middle of the Bourbon period gave birth to her son Federico in the square in Jesi to demonstrate how her motherhood, albeit belated, was authentic; in the third story, instead, a prostitute (Giulia Golino) who pretends to be a model manages to pose for the painting "Burial of Saint Lucia" that Caravaggio paints while he is staying with a friend in Syracuse; the fourth event, finally, has as its protagonist a woman (Piera Degli Esposti) whom her fellow villagers consider as a saint and to whom they turn to obtain divine graces. The guiding thread of the four stories is a ring that is handed down from one woman to another, century after century.
cast: Piera Degli Esposti, Nino Frassica, Lucia Sardo, Galatea Ranzi, Chiara Caselli, Mita Medici, Luchino Giordana, Giulia Golino, Cristina Borgogni, Evelyn Famà, Mariella Lo Giudice, Santo Santonocito, Vincenzo Crivello, Lidia Giordano

title: Un militare e mezzo
synopsis: An emigrant returns to Italy after thirty years. His joy does not last long because the inexorable Italian bureaucracy discovers that in his youth he had not served in the military. Since "it's never too late" here is the fifty-year-old wearing the stars and marching among the recruits under the orders of a surly marshal.
cast: Renato Rascel, Aldo Fabrizi, Virna Lisi, Terence Hill, Robert Alda, Lella Fabrizi

title: Un minuto per pregare, un istante per morire
synopsis: A gunslinger suffers from temporary paralysis in his arm and finds himself caught between a cruel bandit and a sheriff who is perhaps even worse. Giraldi's direction is more messy than usual, and the cast includes some old American glories.
cast: Alex Cord, Arthur Kennedy, Robert Ryan, Enzo Fiermonte

title: Un modo di essere donna
synopsis: Francesca and Sibilla, two students from Pisa, living together for economic reasons, are great friends and tell each other everything. Their concerns about sex are totally different, while Sibilla, a proud and passionate feminist, wants to establish relationships with the other sex based on maximum independence, Francesca aims to find the man of her life. Years pass and Sibilla, now a journalist and famous writer, is always looking for a man who makes her happy. Laughable uninhibited-with-ideas drama. Waste of a decade.
cast: Marisa Berenson, Venantino Venantini, Riccardo Salvino

title: Un moment d'égarement
synopsis: Antoine and Laurent, longtime friends, spend their holidays in Corsica with their daughters Louna, seventeen, and Maria, eighteen. One evening on the Louna beach seduces Laurent. She is in love but for Laurent it is just a moment of madness. Without revealing the name of her lover, Louna confides in her father, who will try to discover the identity of the man with all the means at his disposal.
cast: François Cluzet, Vincent Cassel, Alice Isaaz, Lola Le Lann

title: Un monde
synopsis: Nora, a seven -year -old girl, and her older brother Abel return to school. When Nora sees Abel remain the victim of bullying by other children, she rushes to protect him by warning her father. Abel, however, forces her to remain silent. Doubtful on what to do, Nora will have to choose which side to be between the world of adults and that of children.
cast: Günter Duret, Lena Girard Voss, Karim Leklou, Thao Maerten, Maya Vanderbeque, Laura Verlinden

title: Un monde sans femmes
synopsis: In a small location on the Piccarda coast, during the first week of August, Sylvain delivers the keys to an apartment to a young mother on vacation with her daughter, two women more attractive than the other. With their presence, the two bring messy and excitement in Sylvain's life, allowing him to come out for a couple of days from a world of solitude in which there has never been a female presence.
cast: Vincent Macaigne, Laure Calamy, Constance Rousseau, Laurent Papot, Terry Fouache, Geoffrey Boulanger, Cédric Cailleux, Marie Picard, Jean Nicolas Joissains, Francine Boulanger

title: Un monde sans pitié
synopsis: The young Hippo allows himself to be supported by his younger brother, who sells drugs. On the other hand, it does nothing, except for a few games of poker and meeting and ditching girls. The meeting with Nathalie, which is his exact opposite, seems to give him a reason for activity, but a trivial mishap separates their destinies. When they meet again, perhaps Hippo finds some stimulus to "live". Eric Rochant's directorial debut offers an example of a generation of young people now apathetic towards society. A credible portrait and context, for a film that portrays a worrying existential void.
cast: Hippolyte Girardot, Mireille Perrier, Yvan Attal, Jean Marie Rollin

title: Un mondo d'amore
synopsis: Winter of 1949. The teacher Pier Paolo Pasolini is indicted by the carabinieri for bribery of minors and obscene acts. During a village party in Ramuscello, in the Friulian countryside, he had convinced some kids to go away with him. The military of the weapon proceeded according to some rumors. Pier Paolo's world collapsed, starting with his father, Carlo Alberto, who fell into a destructive depression. The poet will only have to leave with his mother for Rome.
cast: Arturo Paglia, Guia Jelo, Fernando Pannullo, Teresa Pescarelli

title: Un mondo nuovo
synopsis: 1941. While Nazi-Fascism triumphs by conquering Europe, a group of young people elaborates a utopia: the idea of ??a free Europe, united in a federal state. Altiero Spinelli, Ernesto Rossi, Eugenio Colorni, Ursula Hirshmann and Ada Rossi in the dark days of the triumph of Nazi-fascism secretly write a little book that will be the milestone for the construction of a united Europe: The Ventotene Manifesto.
cast: Isabella Ragonese, Vinicio Marchioni, Orlando Cinque, Peppino Mazzotta, Simone Gandolfo, Valentina Carnelutti, Sergio Albelli, Ignazio Oliva, Stefano Scherini, Francesco Colella, Miro Landoni, Giancarlo Judica Cordiglia

title: Un mondo sotto social
synopsis: In Sicily, in the remote village of Roccapinola, Claudio manages a small agency for influencer. To the stable is added the daughter of the country's mechanic, Annandrea, cute but very male, who dreams of a mechanic future in the workshop of her father. Anna has no intention of leaving the workshop, and Claudio is also a skeptical, but one day a cosmetic company, intrigued by the pounding of the girl decides to focus on Annandrea as a testimonial of the next campaign. After an initial difficulty, his image - that of the strong and filters without filters - breaks through, making her famous. Things get complicated when Claudio is made out of the perfume company that Anna intends to manage directly and when the famous influencer Nadia corrupt Claudio, furious, and convinces him to make public a video of Anna who confesses to tears that he wants to be like all the other girls. But, surprisingly, Anna manages to overthrow the situation and to launch the hashtag #We see everything that makes her keep her popularity. When the company takes possession of Anna's image without her consent, the girl with the help of Claudio will be able to convince her #followers that it is better to be himself without being influenced by anyone.
cast: Claudio Casisa, Annandrea Vitrano

title: Un monsieur de compagnie
synopsis: Antoine, a young man allergic to work and with a passion for idleness, has his model of life in his grandfather. When the old man dies, he makes friends with an ice cream man and his friend, who ask him to work with them, putting him on the run. He ends up hosted by a young nobleman, a maniac of electric trains, and leaves by train for Rome where he works as a model in an atelier and makes friends with five beautiful sisters. After further travels, he falls in love with a female worker and starts working alongside her in the factory. He feels like he's living a nightmare, and in fact ...
cast: Jean Pierre Cassel, Catherine Deneuve, Annie Girardot, Sandra Milo, Jean Claude Brialy, Irina Demick, Adolfo Celi

title: Un monstre à Paris
synopsis: Paris, 1910. While the streets of the city are totally flooded, the projectionist Emile and his friend Raoul, a messenger by day and inventor by night, are driven by curiosity to sneak into the laboratory home of a mad scientist, where an explosion causes the escape of a monster. Fearing that it is dangerous, the two launch into a chaotic chase but the intervention of Lucille, a cabaret singer classmate of Raoul, allows them to understand that the creature is not a source of threat to anyone. However, another problem arises: the chief of police, who aspires to become mayor of the city, is already on the trail of the monster and his capture would represent the certainty of his election. The three then decide to intervene to prevent the beast from falling into his hands.

title: Un monstruo de mil cabezas
synopsis: A woman, cornered by a corrupt and negligent insurance company, is forced to take desperate measures to get the medical treatment her husband, suffering from cancer, badly needs.
cast: Jana Raluy, Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Emilio Echevarria, Marco Antonio Aguirre, Harold Torres, Sebastian Aguirre, Noe Hernandez, Marisol Centeno, Úrsula Pruneda, Ivan Cortes

title: Un monstruo viene a verme
synopsis: Connor's is the story of a boy who feels threatened, guilty and moreover angry with the world. Since his mother is ill and forced to defend himself from bullies at school, Connor fears the night and nightmares. A few minutes after midnight, a monster appears and takes him with him to a world of darkness, wind and screams. Ancient and savage, the monster asks Connor the one thing he can't force him to do: tell the truth.
cast: Lewis MacDougall, Felicity Jones, Sigourney Weaver, Toby Kebbell, Geraldine Chaplin, Ben Moor, James Melville, Oliver Steer, Dominic Boyle, Jennifer Lim, Frida Palsson, Lily Rose Aslandogdu

title: Un mostro e mezzo
synopsis: Franco (Franchi), a thief in action on an international train, steals the suitcase of a surgeon (Ingrassia). Only later does he discover that he has only stolen the remains of a corpse, but at that point the same surgeon intervenes to save him from the police. In fact, he needs the thief to attempt a scam against a billionaire. In this gothic parody, which is one of Steno's best films as well as being one of the best of the Franchi / Ingrassia duo, the pace is unleashed and the supporting actors are excellent. To be rediscovered.
cast: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Margaret Lee, Alberto Bonucci, Anna Maria Bottini, Lena Von Martens, Giuseppe Pertile, Consalvo Dell'Arti, Susanna Clemm

title: Un mundo menos peor
synopsis: A woman leaves Buenos Aires to the south, together with her two daughters, to meet her husband who she believed had died twenty years earlier. Once at their destination, the man (who has something obscure in the past) shows himself hostile and indifferent, pretending not to know his wife. But the woman does not give up. Meanwhile, around, we get to know stickers and side events.
cast: Carlos Roffe, Mónica Galán, Julieta Cardinali, Mex Urtizberea

title: Un nemico che ti vuole bene
synopsis: Immersed in his country estate, far from his life dedicated to university research always without funds, to a wife who still sees her ex-husband and a mother who despises him, Enzo finds himself saving the life of a killer who now owes him a favor: to kill his best enemy. And maybe you need to be more afraid of your family than of a murderer ...
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Antonio Folletto, Sandra Milo, Antonio Catania, Ugo Conti, Massimo Ghini, Andrea Preti, Roberto Ciufoli, Gisella Donadoni, Annabella Calabrese, Mirko Trovato

title: Un neomelodico presidente
synopsis: A singer from the Neapolitan neo-melodic school, looks for the success that does not come and to reach the star system he decides to throw himself into politics, where he manages to collect, paradoxically, a great success, making old politics and old Camorra suspicious.
cast: Mimmo Dany, Lello Musella, Tony Sperandeo, Nando Morra, Francesco Cipriani, Denise Sicignano, Barbara Indaco, Biagio Gragnianello, Vincenzo Sorice, Francesco Invigorito

title: Un nero per casa
synopsis: Lorenzo is an architect who cultivates the dream of creating a multi-ethnic cultural center in a degraded area of ??his city. His project stems from the fact that he lived there in that neighborhood and in the buildings that were partially destroyed. But when Lorenzo learns that his daughter has fallen in love with a black non-EU citizen, everything seems to collapse on him. His militancy in left-wing parties and his known tolerance towards black people also changes radically. And his project, to which he has dedicated so much effort, ends up taking a back seat to the "black in the house".
cast: Gigi Proietti, Sandra Collodel, Eliana Miglio, Nicola Pistoia, Gisella Sofio

title: Un omicidio perfetto a termine di legge
synopsis: An entrepreneur is mentally disturbed following an accident at sea. His wife and friend-partner take care of him, but the man suspects that the two are having an affair and therefore try to eliminate him. It will not be long before a corpse appears. And it won't be the only one either.
cast: Philippe Leroy, Elga Andersen, Ivan Rassimov, Rosanna Yanni, Franco Ressel, Rina Franchetti, Julio Peña, Franco Fantasia, Giorgio Cerioni, Liana Del Balzo

title: Un orso chiamato Arturo
synopsis: Billy, a Rome-based American musician who specializes in soundtracks, is about to go on vacation when a producer urgently asks him for a score. From here begins a very intricate puzzle, with a mysterious Alice looking for a teddy bear, with assorted secret agents, with murdered deaths, transvestites, milirdaires, inventors of synthetic gasoline, and even an Oscar winner. The only valid aspect of the film is the elegance of the setting; otherwise one gets bored with a non-inventive rehashing of various comedies such as The Pink Panther. For the "elephant graveyard" series: meet George Segal and Edmund Purdom.
cast: George Segal, Carol Alt, Doris Von Thury, Mattia Sbragia

title: Un paese di Calabria
synopsis: Riace: a country from which young people fled to build their future elsewhere, leaving behind abandoned houses and a village of old people. Doomed to die? Maybe not. Because in the meantime, waves of migrants fleeing war and poverty have begun to land on the Calabrian coasts and those landings, which many see as a danger, have become the hope of a rebirth for Riace.

title: Un paese quasi perfetto
synopsis: Pietramezzana, a remote village in the Lucanian Dolomites, is in danger of disappearing. Its inhabitants, dragged by the volcanic Domenico (Silvio Orlando) do not give up and, as soon as they see the solution to all their troubles in the opening of a factory, they take action to ensure that the project is successful. But the first thing to do is to find a doctor - without a doctor no factory can set up - and luckily they come across Gianluca Terragni (Fabio Volo), a rampant Milanese cosmetic surgeon. The second thing, much more complicated, will be to convince him to stay.
cast: Fabio Volo, Carlo Buccirosso, Silvio Orlando, Nando Paone, Miriam Leone

title: Un paradiso di bugie
synopsis: After the death of their elderly mother, Anna and her daughter Nanà decide to move to Milan with a billion. They rely on a handsome financier who vows to make money, a real estate agency for a super-luxury apartment and a porter with a candid soul and an adventurous past. The second film for the cinema of the handyman Casini (the first, "Far from where", was from 1983) would like to revive the glories of the "Kim Novak" comedy. But, as usual, the latent courage and the desire for "sublime fiction" is held back by a cumbersome realism. Good, perhaps, as a pilot for a television series.
cast: Antonella Ponziani, Claudio Amendola, Monica Scattini, Carlotta Darò

title: Un paradiso per due
synopsis: Alice is a marine biologist who moved from Rome to Sardinia with her teenage daughter Margherita to study the behavior of a dolphin. An unscrupulous entrepreneur, Carlo Bramati, has long been planning to evict Alice from the area where she lives and works, to build a residence. Together with his lawyer and a colleague, Bramati goes to Sardinia to convince the biologist to leave. His tactic is to pretend to be an environmentalist in order to better deceive the woman, but he unexpectedly falls in love with her and begins to understand and share her philosophy of life. It will end up abandoning the world of building speculations and funding research for the protection of cetaceans.
cast: Vanessa Incontrada, Giampaolo Morelli, Laura Esquivel, Gaston Soffritti, Ricky Memphis, Dino Abbrescia, Claudio Castrogiovanni, Florencia Raggi

title: Un parfum de Caraibes
synopsis: Grandma Mariette's request for help, whose existence she was unaware of, takes the charming 40-year-old Agnès from Paris to Martinique. Thus begins an adventure that will turn her life upside down: in fact, after discovering her Caribbean origins, the woman will have to face a series of intricate and dangerous situations ...
cast: Corinne Touzet, Jean Claude Adelin, Jobby Valente

title: Un passo dal cielo - Il film
synopsis: Pietro (Terence Hill), forest foreman with a painful secret behind him, lives in the tranquility of the village of San Candido, at the foot of the Dolomites. A former mountain legend and courageous climber, Pietro retired there after a tragic accident that deeply affected him and made the defense of the environment his life mission. While Pietro has found his own dimension, the one who does not get used to the peace of San Candido is Vincenzo, a policeman who arrived from chaotic Naples, who very often finds himself in conflict with Silvia, the veterinarian who collaborates with the forestry and involved in some of the cases which he deals with. When Anja, an injured girl Pietro had taken care of, is found killed in the woods, a nasty prostitution trafficking will be discovered.
cast: Terence Hill, Enrico Ianniello, Gaia Bermani Amaral, Katia Ricciarelli, Francesco Salvi, Gianmarco Pozzoli, Mauro Pirovano, Gabriele Rossi, Claudia Gaffuri, Valentina D'Agostino, Bettina Giovannini

title: Un petit frère
synopsis: The portrait of any family, from the eighties to the present day: that of Rose, originally from the Ivory Coast, who arrives in France with his two sons Ernest and Jean and settles in a district of the Parisian suburbs.
cast: Stéphane Bak, Ahmed Sylla, Annabelle Lengronne

title: Un petit monastère en Toscane
synopsis: Made for French television, this medium-length film features five Augustinian monks who retired to the monastery of Castelnuovo dell'Abate, near Montalcino. The film surprises them in prayer, even before the opening credits, and their rites mark the ideal day of the story.

title: Un peu, beaucoup, aveuglément
synopsis: He is a puzzle inventor. He has invested heart and soul in his work and can concentrate only in absolute silence. On the other hand, she is a pianist, she cannot live without music and she is preparing for a competition that could change her life. The two will have to share a house unwittingly, with all the consequences of the case.
cast: Clovis Cornillac, Mélanie Bernier, Lilou Fogli, Philippe Duquesne

title: Un peuple et son roi
synopsis: In 1789 the people in France started the revolution. Every man or woman, ordinary person or historical figure, has something to say, especially in the meetings of the newly formed National Assembly, where the fate of the monarchy and the birth of the Republic are decided.
cast: Gaspard Ulliel, Adèle Haenel, Olivier Gourmet, Louis Garrel, Izia Higelin, Niels Schneider, Laurent Lafitte, Denis Lavant, Céline Sallette, Noémie Lvovsky

title: Un piede in Paradiso
synopsis: Taxi driver Bull (Spencer) risks losing his job. But luck comes to his aid by winning the richest lottery of all time: $ 150 million. At this point, one begins to be interested in him both in heaven and in hell: an angel (Lhermitte) and a she-devil (Alt) contend for him. Spencer returns to the cinema in a film written by his son (Giuseppe Pedersoli) and by the son of director Enzo Barboni, Marco. There are all the ingredients that fueled his long filmography and Carol Alt's side dish, but the result is really dull.
cast: Bud Spencer, Carol Alt, Thierry Lhermitte, Jean Sorel, Ian Bannen, Sharon Madden

title: Un pilota ritorna
synopsis: Prisoner of the English in Greece, Lieutenant Gino Rossati falls in love with a girl who is also a prisoner. The idyll ends when Gino manages to escape and returns to Italy. Rossellini alternates documentary and fictional pages in a fascist propaganda film with pages of strong humanity, even if the humble tone and the daily heroism of the character were quite in line with the ideology of the regime. Vittorio Mussolini, the son of the Duce, signs the screenplay for the film with the anagram Tito Silvio Mursino.
cast: Massimo Girotti, Michela Belmonte, Gaetano Masier, Elvira Betrone

title: Un plain parfait
synopsis: In the Lefebvre family every first marriage ends in divorce. It seems like an ancient curse from which no one can break free and, fearing the same fate, 30-year-old Isabelle (Diane Kruger) has decided not to marry her fiancé Pierre, putting their relationship to the test. When Pierre informs her that they won't have children until they are husband and wife, Isabelle has no choice but to find someone else to marry for the first time, divorce soon after, and return to Pierre for a new marriage that will last. Her plan leads her directly to Jean-Yves Berthier (Dany Boon), editor-in-chief of the travel guide Rough Guides who will force her into an adventurous marriage of ups and downs around the world, from Kilimanjaro to Moscow.
cast: Diane Kruger, Dany Boon, Etienne Chicot, Alice Pol, Yoli Fuller, Bernadette Le Saché, Robert Plagnol, Jonathan Cohen

title: Un plus une
synopsis: A womanizing musician travels to India, where he composes a Bollywood film score and unexpectedly falls for the wife of the French ambassador.
cast: Jean Dujardin, Elsa Zylberstein, Christopher Lambert, Alice Pol, Rahul Vohra, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Abhishek Krishnan, Venantino Venantini, Amma, Kalki Koechlin

title: Un poeta nel Cinema: Andreij Tarkovskij
synopsis: An hour of free-wheeling interview: Russian director Andreij Tarkovskij talks about his relationship with his father, the famous poet Arsenij, about his childhood, about cinema, about art, about the meaning of life.
cast: Donatella Baglivo, Andrei Tarkovsky

title: Un poker di pistole
synopsis: To honor a gambling debt with George, Lucas agrees to take a wagon with a precious cargo to Chamaco. On the road he is attacked by the gang of Masters who are responsible for all the illegal activities in the country. The Mexican Lazar rushes to get him out of the way.
cast: George Hilton, George Eastman, Annabella Incontrera, Dick Palmer

title: Un poliziotto scomodo
synopsis: Commissioner Olmi, involved in a firefight outside his home, accidentally kills an innocent man. For this he was transferred to Civitanova Marche, in the province. He tries to rebuild his life by abandoning the brutal methods. Unfortunately, his girlfriend becomes involved in a kidnapping together with an entire school group and Olmi returns to the attack.
cast: Maurizio Merli, Olga Karlatos, Massimo Serato

title: Un posto all'inferno
synopsis: In 1942 an American journalist, surprised in the Philippines by the Japanese invasion, covers himself with glory. Italian war film shot with little money and without great inventiveness.
cast: Monty Greenwood, Guy Madison, Hélène Chanel, Sandro Korso

title: Un posto ideale per uccidere
synopsis: Two Danish boys on vacation in Italy are hosted in the villa of an eccentric American. The house is pervaded by a sense of mystery: the woman, in fact, has recently murdered her husband and would like to put the blame on the two unsuspecting tourists.
cast: Irene Papas, Ornella Muti, Ray Lovelock, Sal Borgese

title: Un posto sicuro
synopsis: Luca, in his thirties who lives in Casale Monferrato navigating the work of a clown for private parties, learns that his father Eduardo, a former worker of Eternit, is dying of mesothelioma. Thus begins a process of approaching the painful affair, with the rapid course of the disease bringing him closer to his father and forcing them to confront each other.
cast: Marco D'Amore, Matilde Gioli, Giorgio Colangeli

title: Un posto tranquillo
synopsis: Four friars spend their days in a small convent immersed in the tranquility of the Tuscan countryside: Raniero, the gruff but nice guardian father, Gervasio, jovial but hypochondriac, the naive Bettino and Vittorio, an elderly friar who takes care of the vegetable garden. Antonio bursts into their daily routine and soon gains the trust of the three friars, but not that of Raniero, who looks at him with great distrust. Between the two begin real acts of espionage to try to find out something about the past of the other. Raniero rummaging in the cell where Antonio is staying makes a shocking discovery about an unspeakable secret ...
cast: Lino Banfi, Nino Manfredi, Nicole Grimaudo, Felice Andreasi

title: Un povero ricco
synopsis: Forty years, a lot of money but the terror of a possible financial ruin, Eugenio practices living without a penny. He gets hired as a cleaner and goes to live in a council house. Here he meets Marta, a woman overwhelmed by economic problems, but serious and honest. With her he rebuilds a life, naturally as a rich man, after having thrown out his unfaithful wife.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Ornella Muti, Nanni Svampa, Piero Mazzarella

title: Un prince (presque) charmant
synopsis: Jean-Marc (Vincent Perez), forty in his career interested in satisfying his personal interests, crosses the path of Marie (Vahina Giocante) against his will. Totally opposite from Jean-Marc, Marie is a young woman with a strong attachment to freedom and a sense of justice. Once again, life makes fun of destinies and brings two people who could not be more different and distant.
cast: Vincent Perez, Vahina Giocante, Jacques Weber, Nicole Calfan, Chloé Coulloud, Jérôme Kircher, Moussa Maaskri, Côme Levin, Astrid Veillon, Pierre Laplace, Fabrice Colson

title: Un principe chiamato Totò
synopsis: A sort of family album that flows before our eyes, revealing documents hitherto unknown: protagonist Prince Antonio de Curtis, aka Totò, who wrote the lyrics and directed the realization, with his first audition for the cinema . But also manuscripts, love letters, poems and songs never published and photographs made available, for the first time, by the family of the great artist.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Lino Banfi, Gigi Proietti, Dino De Laurentiis, Ben Gazzarra

title: Un profil pour deux
synopsis: Pierre, a widower and retired, has not left home for two years. However, he discovered the joys of the internet thanks to Alex, a young man hired by his daughter to teach him the basics of using a computer. On a dating site, the young and beautiful Flora63 has been seduced by Pierre's charm and offers him to see each other. Pierre accepts but has a big problem: the photo he passed off as his is actually Alex's. He will then have to try to convince Alex to meet Flora in his place.
cast: Pierre Richard, Yaniss Lespert, Fanny Valette, Stephanie Crayencour, Stéphane Bissot, Macha Meril, Gustave Kervern, Pierre Kiwitt, Anna Bederke, Philippe Chaine

title: Un prophéte
synopsis: Sentenced to six years in prison, Malik El Djebena cannot read or write. He is eighteen, alone in the world, and looks much younger and more lost than all the other inmates locked up with him. Malik soon ends up hardening and earning the respect of the group of courses he commands inside the prison. But just as soon, thanks to his cunning, he manages to weave his own network of relationships that escapes the control of courses.
cast: Tahar Rahim, Niels Arestrup, Adel Bencherif, Hichem Yacoubi, Reda Kateb, Jean Philippe Ricci, Gilles Cohen, Antoine Basler, Leïla Bekhti, Pierre Leccia, Foued Nassah, Jean Emmanuel Pagni, Rabah Loucif

title: Un pugno di amici
synopsis: Four rickety friends organize a robbery with the hope of solving all their problems. After a series of misadventures, however, they are forced to a hasty escape from which all their problems begin. Between comic situations and hilarious sketches, the four friends will have to experiment with new ways to make ends meet.
cast: Tony Matranga, Emmanuele Minafò, Maurizio Casagrande, Maria Bolignano, Mariano Bruno, Paride Benassai, Francesco De Fraia, Domenico Manfredi, Raffaele Ferrante, Angelica Massera, Danilo Lo Cicero, Giuseppe Stancampiano, Domenico Fazio, Salvatore Ferraro, Gianni Lattore

title: Un ragazzo d'oro
synopsis: After the suicide of his father, writer and screenwriter, an advertiser from Milan (Riccardo Scamarcio) tries to have his unfinished autobiographical novel published, in which the man tells about the Roman cinematographic and cultural world that rejected him. The novel, however, lacks the ending and the son decides to find one so that he can propose it to a publisher. Leaving for Rome, the young man will end up neglecting his girlfriend (Cristiana Capotondi) and losing his mind to a former actress who has reinvented herself as a publisher.
cast: Riccardo Scamarcio, Sharon Stone, Cristiana Capotondi, Giovanna Ralli, Osvaldo Ruggieri, Valeria Marini, Tiziana Buldini, Guia Zapponi, Christian Stelluti, Patrizio Pelizzi

title: Un ragazzo di Calabria
synopsis: A fan of the Olympic Games (we are in 1960), in a small town in Calabria, a boy challenges his father's anger by running day and night, passionate about foot races. The "grown-ups" would like him to continue the family's pastoral activities, but the boy will win: his passion makes him win a local competition and so he can go to Rome, in a real team of athletes. Loosely inspired by the biography of the champion Francesco Panetta. Comencini stages the hard battle of the dreams of a little boy from one of the most depressed areas of Italy against the conditioning of the family and the environment: good narrative qualities, a bit of a television cut, the thirteen-year-old protagonist is excellent.
cast: Santo Polimeno, Diego Abatantuono, Gian Maria Volonté, Thérèse Liotard

title: Un ragazzo e una ragazza
synopsis: At the center of this comedy is the relationship between the Milanese Calogero (Jerry Calà) and the Neapolitan Anna (Marina Suma), who continue to get together, and leave each other. In this frantic coming and going, she gives birth to a couple of children and establishes herself as a model, while he falls into depression.
cast: Jerry Calà, Marina Suma, Sandro Ghiani, Monica Scattini, Nino Prester, Francesca Ventura, Serena Grandi

title: Un rubio
synopsis: When the reserved Gabo moves to live with the womanizer Juan, the two are initially hesitant to get to know each other. As their bond strengthens, their gazes also become more persistent and opportunities for touching each other increase. Over time, it becomes clear that they are unable to stop the inevitable. But is their attraction purely physical or does it hide something neither of them could ever have imagined?
cast: Gaston Re, Alfonso Baron, Justo Calabria, Antonia De Michelis, Melissa Falter, Malena Irusta, Ailín Salas, Charly Velasco

title: Un sac de billes
synopsis: Maurice and Joseph, two Jewish brothers who love to play with marbles, flee all over France under German occupation during the Second World War. They will have to resort to an incredible dose of malice, courage and ingenuity to escape Nazi barbarism.
cast: Dorian Le Clech, Batyste Fleurial, Patrick Bruel, Elsa Zylberstein, Christian Clavier, Bernard Campan, Holger Daemgen, César Domboy, Kev Adams, Lucas Prisor, Ilian Bergala, Vincent Nemeth

title: Un sacco bello
synopsis: Three episodes. Enzo, a Roman bully, sets out on a trip to Poland with a friend. Purpose: to make a massacre of hearts. Ruggero, who has founded a hippy community, finds his father after years and returns, for a short time, to the family. Leo, dominated by a castrating mother, meets a girl in crisis. When the spark could go off, her boyfriend reappears.
cast: Carlo Verdone, Mario Brega, Renato Scarpa, Veronica Miriel

title: Un sapore di paura
synopsis: Inspector Arnold is looking for a serial killer who claims victims among models and actresses of porn movies. With the help of photographer Diane, friend of the killed girls, Arnold will identify the psychopath in a man disguised as a woman.
cast: Virginia Hey, Gérard Darmon, Gioia Scola, Dario Parisini, Carin McDonald, Teagan Clive, Eva Grimaldi, Kid Creole, Patrick King, Giorgio Cerioni

title: Un silenzio particolare
synopsis: Clara Sereni and the well-known screenwriter Stefano Rulli - parents of Matteo, a 20-year-old with psychic problems - are the founders of "La città del sole", an agritourism destined to host diversity. The moment of the inauguration is a party for everyone except for Matteo, who is on the sidelines. At the end of the day, Stefano and Clara question their son's attitude of rejection ...
cast: Matteo Rulli, Stefano Rulli, Clara Sereni

title: Un singe en hiver
synopsis: Albert Quentin, a mature retired officer, spends his time getting bored in a small town on the French coast: the sudden arrival of the young, reckless and restless Gabriel Fouquet, on the trail of his daughter to be recovered in boarding school, gives him a jolt of vitality and l last chance before finally surrendering to old age.
cast: Jean Gabin, Jean Paul Belmondo, Suzanne Flon, Paul Frankeur

title: Un soir, un train
synopsis: Mathias, a professor at a Belgian university, has been living for some time with a Frenchwoman named Anne and with her he is working on the theatrical adaptation of a Flemish opera that has as its subject the role of man in society. After a brief and banal quarrel, the professor finds himself in a place beyond life and death.
cast: Yves Montand, Anouk Aimée, Adriana Bogdan, Hector Camerlinck

title: Un solo errore. Bologna, 2 agosto 1980
synopsis: On 2 August 1980 a bomb exploded at the Bologna station. What remains is a page of history that has never found answers and that needs to be told.

title: Un sorriso, uno schiaffo, un bacio in bocca
synopsis: Titanus is a historic Italian production house, very active especially in the twenty years following the Second World War. Like the Hollywood majors, Titanus has also made editing films with clips of its most famous titles from the golden age. The comic star of the time was the presenter: Renato Pozzetto. At the slow motion the well-known press agent Enrico Lucherini.
cast: Renato Pozzetto

title: Un spécialiste, portrait d'un criminel modern
synopsis: In 1960, after a grueling work of shadowing, the Mossad finally managed to capture the former lieutenant colonel of the SS Adolf Eichmann in Buenos Aires, where he had led a quiet and anonymous existence for years. The subsequent trial, held in Jerusalem, ended in 1962 with the hanging of the accused.

title: Un sueño a mitad - Un sogno a metà
synopsis: Immediately after the Cuban revolution, three architects (the Cuban Riccardo Porro and the Italians Vittorio Garatti and Roberto Gottardi) were called by Fidel Castro to build three art schools in the park of the Havana Country Club, three buildings that according to the will of the dictator and Che Guevara would have served to allow students from Latin America, Africa and Asia to study for free. The project, however, ran aground almost immediately due to the lack of resources but, forty years later, Castro himself brings together the three architects who with passion and idealism try to complete what they had left unfinished.

title: Un sussurro nel buio
synopsis: Little Martino lives in a beautiful country house with his parents and little sisters. Martino, like many children, has an imaginary friend of his, who, however, does not seem so imaginary in the long run. A psychiatrist is summoned to the villa, but after a few days he has a bad end. The glorious Cotten is also involved in this attempt at synthesis between thrilling and psychological horror. The film went to the archives without leaving any traces.
cast: Joseph Cotten, Lucretia Love, Olga Bisera, Alessandro Poggi

title: Un tango mas
synopsis: 80-year-old Rego and 83-year-old Juan Carlos met when they were 14 and 17, respectively, and have been dancing together for nearly half a century. Over time, they loved, hated, broke up several times and got back together, until Juan Carlos left Rego for a woman twenty years younger with whom he had two children. At the end of their existence, both are ready to tell each other, retracing their story among the tangheri of Buenos Aires.

title: Un tassinaro a New York
synopsis: Pietro is a Roman tax collector who involuntarily witnesses a murder. When he goes to the United States to find his son, he is detained by the police for security reasons and, to support himself, he begins to practice his profession as a taxi driver here as well.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Anna Longhi, Dom DeLuise, George Gaynes

title: Un taxi mauve
synopsis: Elder Dr Scully drives around Ireland in the mauve cab of the title. During his travels, he visits Philippe Marchal, a 50-year-old French journalist who cannot resign himself to the loss of his son and has retired to an isolated village. Here Scully meets the young and wealthy American Jerry (in crisis due to abandonment by his girlfriend), the charming Sharon and the shadowy Taubelman, married to Anne.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Charlotte Rampling, Fred Astaire, Agostina Belli

title: Un taxi pour Tobruk
cast: Lino Ventura, Charles Aznavour, Maurice Biraud, German Cobos, Hardy Krüger

title: Un tenero tramonto
synopsis: Franz Bollenstein is a shady individual dedicated, among other things, to the export of currency. One day, jealous of his stepdaughter Nicoletta's rich heritage, he instructs Antonio, his trusted man, to track down the girl (who has since run away from home) and lock her up in a Swiss clinic. Antonio however falls in love with Nicoletta thus triggering a tragic chain of fate. Dull and goofy drama of a notorious tear-movies specialist.
cast: Mel Ferrer, Cristiana Borghi, Patrick La Place, Laura De Marchi

title: Un tentativo sentimentale
synopsis: Carla and Dino, with their marriages in crisis, meet and begin a relationship that is not perfect due to his "cowardice". Some atmosphere a little Antonioni style, today very dated. Franciosa and Festa Campanoile will find their dimension in comedy.
cast: Françoise Prevost, Jean Marc Bory, Gabriele Ferzetti, Giulio Bosetti

title: Un tipo con una faccia strana ti cerca per ucciderti
synopsis: The young gangster Ricco gets out of prison and decides to take revenge on the old boss Don Vito, who killed his father and stole his girlfriend. He is helped by the beautiful Scilla, but everything gets complicated when Don Vito's son unleashes a bloody war between gangs.
cast: Barbara Bouchet, Christopher Mitchum, Malisa Longo, Arthur Kennedy

title: Un toro da monta
synopsis: A young groom, sexually impotent, following the marriage uses the help of science on the advice of his wife. The remedies are ineffective, and the couple risks going into crisis. However, the death of the boy's father opens the way to unexpected consequences, since the man inherited a bull from the son. The animal proves to be very precious: by communicating in its own way with the new master, he demonstrates the priest and stimulating priests, making a possible remedy for impotence ...
cast: Femi Benussi, Alfonso Saggese, Daniela Giordano, Pupo De Luca

title: Un tournage à la campagne
synopsis: #Unpublished scenes, clips of samples and rushes of Renoir's La scampagnata (1936), never finished due to climatic and production problems.
cast: Jean Renoir, Sylvia Bataille, Jane Marken, André Gabriello, Paul Temps, Jacques B. Brunius, Marguerite Renoir, Pierre Lestinguez, Gabrielle Fontan, Georges D'Arnoux

title: Un tranquillo posto di campagna
synopsis: In full creative stagnation, the well-known painter Leonardo Ferri moves to an ancient Venetian villa, on one of whose walls the peeling portrait of a young woman is painted. But the house is also the scene of mysterious and disturbing phenomena: Leonardo, driven to investigate, thus learns the story of Countess Wanda, who once enjoyed the reputation of a "light girl" and had ended up murdered. Those perceived in the villa would therefore be threatening "signs" sent to Flavia, Leonardo's lover, unwelcome to Wanda's ghost ...
cast: Franco Nero, Vanessa Redgrave, Gabriella Grimaldi, Georges Géret

title: Un treno per Durango
synopsis: Two adventurers, one American and one Mexican, cross Mexico to retrieve a load of gold stolen by bandits during an assault on the train. Every so often a gunslinger appears who solves their difficulties and then disappears. When the two have taken possession of the gold, the man throws off the mask: he is wanted for fraud and, with the complicity of an attractive girl, he manages to deceive them too.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Dominique Boschero, Mark Damon, Enrico Maria Salerno

title: Un triomphe
synopsis: Etienne, an often unemployed but captivating actor, leads a theatrical laboratory in a prison. To the prisoners who follow the laboratory he gave the fairly unlikely task of stageing the work waiting for Godot by Samuel Beckett. When he is allowed to bring the show outside the prison walls, Etienne finally has the opportunity he was waiting for to grab the success. Each date goes beyond every more rosy expectation and a special relationship is created between director and actors. However, the last representation in Paris soon approaches: will their last night together be the greatest success of their life?
cast: Kad Merad, David Ayala, Lamine Cissokho, Sofian Khammes, Pierre Lottin, Wabinlé Nabié, Aleksandr Medvedev, Saïd Benchnafa, Marina Hands, Laurent Stocker

title: Un turco napoletano
synopsis: The wealthy Don Pasquale would like to hire a handyman but is terrified of the idea that he could undermine his wife and daughter. An honorable friend has the solution in his pocket: he will send him a Turkish eunuch. It happens, however, that Totò, just escaped from prison with a friend, manages to take the place of the Oriental and enter the house of her suspicious husband and father in disguise.
cast: Totò, Isa Barzizza, Carlo Campanini, Mario Castellani, Franca Faldini

title: Un tè con Mussolini
synopsis: Florence; 1934: A group of English ladies is found at Elizabeth Barrett Browning's grave for the annual tribute to the poet. At the gathering of "the Scorpios", so called for their pungent humor, only Mary is missing, who arrives holding a child by the hand. This is Luca, the natural son of a textile merchant for whom Mary works: the man refused to recognize little Luca, who was later adopted by the "Scorpios" ...
cast: Cher, Judi Dench, Joan Plowright, Maggie Smith, Lily Tomlin, Massimo Ghini, Claudio Spadaro, Charlie Lucas, Baird Wallace, Paolo Seganti

title: Un témoin dans la ville
cast: Franco Fabrizi, Lino Ventura, Sandra Milo, Jacques Berthier

title: Un ufficiale non si arrende mai, nemmeno di fronte all'evidenza. Firmato Colonnello Buttiglione
synopsis: In the Zanzibar barracks, commanded by Colonel Buttiglione, a group of recruits arrives for the planned training period. A lover of discipline and authoritarian (he can't stand long hair and out-of-order uniforms), Buttiglione is, in reality, a clumsy and noisy officer who throws the barracks into confusion.
cast: Aldo Maccione, Jacques Dufilho, Michele Gammino, Christa Linder

title: Un uomo a metà
cast: Rosemarie Dexter, Jacques Perrin, Ilaria Occhini, Lea Padovani, Gianni Garko

title: Un uomo chiamato Apocalisse Joe
synopsis: The young actor Joe Clifford wanders the Far West reciting Shakepearian monologues on the village squares. When he learns that he has inherited a gold mine and goes there to take possession of it, he discovers that the precious deposit actually belongs to a certain Berg. To tell the truth, the man has a regular deed of assignment that guarantees it before the law. Joe learns that the act was violently extorted and with the help of a brave barber tries to stand up to the usurper.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Eduardo Fajardo, Mary Paz Pondal, Stelio Candelli

title: Un uomo da bruciare
synopsis: Salvatore, a young trade union activist of Marxist inspiration, returns to Sicily after two years spent in Rome and finds himself faced with a hostile reality. He tries with some comrades to occupy an uncultivated land, but the mafia first hinders him and then tries to distract him from the action by hiring him as a foreman in a quarry. But Salvatore is not a man who lets himself be bribed, and so the mafia kills him. First feature film directed by the Taviani brothers (with Valentino Orsini): a work that has the merit of full-blown social commitment, perhaps a little schematic, but very vigorous.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Didi Perego, Spiros Focas, Turi Ferro
director: Paolo Taviani, Vittorio Taviani, Valentino Orsini

title: Un uomo da rispettare
synopsis: An experienced robber, specializing in large safes, plans the coup of a lifetime. To put it into action, he is paired with a good and nice colleague. However, he will prove to be not very reliable.
cast: Kirk Douglas, Florinda Bolkan, Giuliano Gemma, Wolfgang Preiss

title: Un uomo dalla pelle dura
synopsis: After abandoning his old manager who he considered a scammer, Teddy "Cherokee" Wilcox, a young boxer of Indian blood, thanks to the help of his journalist friend Mike Durrel, he moved to Tony LaMonaca's 'stable'. Thanks to his advice and severe training, the boxer obtains a series of encouraging successes, but on the eve of an important match someone forces Tony to make "Cherokee" lose. During the match, the Indian notices that his manager tries to fix the match, but reacts and manages to win. His victory will be for him the beginning of a nightmare: blamed for the murder of his manager, "Cherokee", together with Tony's daughter, will have to prove his innocence and at the same time he will have to understand who is his friend and who is not, also trying to escape from those who would like to prevent him from exposing the organization behind the clandestine fighting racket of which he has become an unwitting pawn.
cast: Robert Blake, Tomas Milian, Catherine Spaak, Ernest Borgnine, Orazio Orlando, Gabriele Ferzetti

title: Un uomo in ginocchio
synopsis: Nino Peralta runs a kiosk next to Palermo's cathedral, but it hasn't been quiet for a few days. There is a guy who follows him and he doesn't know why. It is his partner Colicchia who explains to him that the man is a hitman of a mafia boss, who has decided to eliminate him because he suspects him as a friend of a rival boss. Nino then sells the bar and, in order to save himself, tries to get in touch with the killer. It is the usual film of denunciation against the mafia that does not denounce anything except the obviousness of its plot. Not among the best in Damiani.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Eleonora Giorgi, Michele Placido, Ettore Manni

title: Un uomo perbene
synopsis: June 1983, Enzo Tortora receives a phone call announcing an Ansa news of the following day: "They will arrest Enzo Tortora". Friday, June 17, at a quarter past four, at the Plaza hotel where the presenter is staying, a car arrives from which the carabinieri get out and ask about him: the accusation? Criminal and drug association. A judicial and human ordeal begins that takes Tortora from prison to prison in an attempt to prove his innocence.
cast: Michele Placido, Mariangela Melato, Giovanna Mezzogiorno

title: Un uomo un cavallo una pistola
synopsis: A mysterious adventurer whom everyone calls "the Stranger" learns that a gang of outlaws has taken possession of a solid gold carriage that was attempting to clandestinely cross the border between the United States and Mexico. Once the bandits have been eliminated, "the Stranger" gets his hands on the precious vehicle, but ...
cast: Tony Anthony, Dan Vadis, Marina Berti, Ettore Manni, Marco Guglielmi

title: Un uomo, una città
synopsis: Scenes of the daily fight against crime of a Turin commissioner. Michele Parrino investigates gangs of young bourgeois who sow terror between robberies and drug dealing, and a gang of suburban criminals who killed a jeweler.
cast: Enrico Maria Salerno, Luciano Salce, Tino Scotti

title: Un urlo dalle tenebre
synopsis: Piero suffers from hysterics and should be interned according to the doctor's opinion. His sister Elena, a nun, however, refuses to lock him up in an asylum and from his confession it emerges that during a trip to the woods with friends, including his girlfriend Sherry, Piero was attracted by the vision of a naked girl next to a waterfall: he had photographed it, but it was not impressed on the film. On that occasion he had found an arcane medallion and put it around his neck. Soon strange phenomena began and horrible sensations took hold of the young man who had committed violent acts against his family members
cast: Richard Conte, Françoise Prevost, Elena Svevo, Patrizia Gori, Jean Claude Vernay, Mimma Monticelli, Franco Garofalo

title: Un verano para matar
synopsis: Ray Castor (Christopher Mitchum) witnessed the murder of his parents when he was only six years old. Having become an adult, he puts himself on the trail of the four killers, also counting on the help of the police captain Kiley (Karl Malden).
