cast: Christopher Mitchum, Karl Malden, Olivia Hussey, Claudine Auger, Raf Vallone

title: Un viaggio chiamato amore
synopsis: The human and sentimental story of the narrator and poetess Sibilla Aleramo, from adolescence to maturity: in particular in the two-year period 1916-'18, the period in which the woman binds herself in a passionate relationship with the poet Dino Campana. After an initial exchange of letters, the two decide to meet: it is the beginning of their tormented relationship ...
cast: Laura Morante, Stefano Accorsi, Alessandro Haber, Galatea Ranzi, Diego Ribon

title: Un éléphant, ça trompe énormément
synopsis: Etienne, Bouly, Simon and Daniel are four friends from Paris who have a habit of meeting up at tennis or parties from time to time. When Bouly, a hardened Don Juan, is abandoned by his exasperated wife, friends come to his aid until the armistice is signed. Simon, tyrannized by a possessive mother, is also helped by friends and the same thing happens to the rest of the group, in a sort of mutual aid. Daniel, on the other hand, loses his head for a stranger and leaves the marital roof for her.
cast: Jean Rochefort, Claude Brasseur, Guy Bedos, Victor Lanoux

title: Un épais manteau de sang
synopsis: Having lost sight of her husband Dionis, who had left for Africa for years, Valeria joins the surgeon Hans but then leaves him for the young fisherman Bernard. Later Dionis suddenly returns and Hans, disappointed, instigates him to kill Bernard: Dionis, however, has completely different plans ...
cast: Valerie Lagrange, Eric Arnal, Katia Bartel, Paul Guers, Hans Meyer

title: Un été brûlant
synopsis: The life of the painter Fréderic and his wife Angéle (Monica Bellucci), an actress at the peak of her career, is turned upside down by the meeting with the young Paul, an actor in search of fortune, whom the two host at their Roman home. It is Paul who introduces his friend Roland to the woman, who, taken by the whirlwind of attraction and passion, will abandon her husband, leaving him in a chasm of depression that will drive him to suicide. For Paul, guilt will always lurk.
cast: Monica Bellucci, Louis Garrel, Céline Sallette, Jérôme Robart

title: Un été comme ça
synopsis: Three women meet, inside a nursing home, to confront their respective sexual problems and try to take out their fears under the supervision of a German therapist and a social worker.
cast: Larissa Corriveau, Laure Giappiconi, Samir Guesmi, Aude Mathieu, Anne Ratte Polle

title: Un été inoubliable
synopsis: Romania, 1920s. Captain Dimitriu's wife rejects the advances of a general and he assigns the officer to a garrison on the border with Bulgaria. It is a turbulent area and, when the order comes to capture hostages and shoot them in response to the killing of some border guards, Captain Dimitriu is torn between military discipline and his sense of justice. The film speaks of the past, but as an obvious metaphor for a current reality. It is a "poor" production, but of high moral tension as well as accurate and convincing narrative, also embellished by the impeccable acting of the performers.
cast: Kristin Scott Thomas, Claudiu Bleont, Olga Tudorache, Marcel Iures

title: Un'altra vita
synopsis: Thirty-year-old dentist Saverio who leads a shy and solitary life, meets Alia, a Russian immigrant in Rome, by chance, and is forced to help her. Even if the woman disappears immediately, Saverio was struck by her and goes in search of her, discovering a world of violence alien to him and, perhaps, changing his life.
cast: Silvio Orlando, Adriana Biedrzynska, Monica Scattini, Claudio Amendola, Antonella Ponziani, Antonello Fassari, Giorgio Tirabassi, Pasquale Anselmo, Kim Rossi Stuart

title: Un'anguilla da 300 milioni
synopsis: Vasco kidnaps Tina, and entrusts her to his friend Bissa, initially unaware of everything. Then Vasco dies and Bissa gets the ransom for herself, but the kidnapped is smarter.
cast: Ottavia Piccolo, Lino Toffolo, Mario Adorf, Senta Berger, Rodolfo Baldini, Gabriele Ferzetti, Daniele Dublino, Ricky Gianco

title: Un'anima divisa in due
synopsis: Pietro, a thirty-seven year old Milanese, separated and the father of a child he rarely sees, runs into Pabe, a gypsy who disturbs the customers of the department store where the man is in charge of security. Paolo wants to get to know the girl and her world up close and the two leave together. But the attempt to find a compromise between their different needs of life, unfortunately, fails miserably. Silvio Soldini tackles the theme of the encounter-clash of two cultures, personalizing a situation that is inherent in our society. Without pietism and without crudeness, an attentive and sensitive gaze, an important film with a solid civil commitment.
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Mària Bàkó, Philippine Leroy Beaulieu

title: Un'avventura
synopsis: Seventies. Young and rebellious, Francesca (Laura Chiatti) has traveled the world following the wave of sexual liberation. When she returns to her native village, she is a completely different person from the girl with the blond braids and blue eyes who remembered her neighbor Matteo (Michele Riondino), who has always been in love with her.
cast: Michele Riondino, Laura Chiatti, Valeria Bilello, Giulio Beranek, Alex Sparrow, Gabriele Granito, Simone Corbisiero, Roberto Negri, Thomas Trabacchi, Diodato

title: Un'avventura di Salvator Rosa
synopsis: Salvator Rosa is a little Masaniello and a little Pasquino. During the day he is a painter, at night the troublemaker of the people under the name of Formica. In the Duchy of Torniano, Rosa went there only to rest, but here too she finds a sinister oppressor and a duchess in danger. adventure in 1940.
cast: Gino Cervi, Luisa Ferida, Rina Morelli, Osvaldo Valenti, Ugo Ceseri, Umberto Sacripante, Paolo Stoppa, Piero Mazza, Piero Pastore

title: Un'estate ai Caraibi
synopsis: The fates of several characters all converge in the same place which this time is the island of Antigua in the Caribbean: one man organizes small scams to passing tourists together with an orphaned child, another tries to hide with his lover, a rich and rude Roman builder enslaves his driver ...
cast: Enrico Brignano, Carlo Buccirosso, Biagio Izzo, Enrico Bertolino, Martina Stella, Alena Seredova, Paolo Conticini, Jayde Nicole, Gigi Proietti

title: Un'estate al mare
synopsis: An emigrant in search of social redemption, an irreducible Fiorentina fan, a couple of clandestine lovers. And again: a straight antiques dealer who pretends to be gay, a man who would like to mend the relationship with his son, a physically "unbalanced" couple, a forgetful theater actor lent to dubbing ...
cast: Lino Banfi, Ezio Greggio, Biagio Izzo, Victoria Silvstedt, Anna Falchi, Alena Seredova, Aida Yespica, Gigi Proietti, Nancy Brilli, Massimo Ceccherini, David Traylor, Enrico Brignano

title: Un'isola
synopsis: At the end of the Second World War, while waiting for the insurrection strike in Turin to start, Giorgio Amendola recalls the stages of his life: from the death of his father - a liberal assassinated by the fascists - to his escape to Paris, where he met his future wife Germaine, up to his return to Italy and confinement in Ponza.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Christiane Jean, Stéphane Audran, Gianluca Favilla

title: Un'ombra nell'ombra
synopsis: Two girls were sired by their respective mothers with Lucifer. Possessed by the devil, growing up they have very different reactions: one is ashamed and wants to end it, while the other is proud of it and unleashes violence, blood and satanic rituals as soon as she can. At this point, exorcism seems the only possible answer.
cast: Anne Heywood, Valentina Cortese, Frank Finlay, John Phillip Law, Marisa Mell, Irene Papas, Paola Tedesco, Lara Wendel, Ian Bannen, Ezio Miani, Carmen Russo

title: Un'ora sola ti vorrei
synopsis: Alina Marazzi has recovered sixty reels of amateur films in 16 and 8 mm that tell the life of her mother Líseli Hoepli Marazzi, who committed suicide in 1972 at the age of 33, and of her family. The filming was carried out by the maternal grandfather Ulrico Hoepli, homonymous and son of that Ulrich who founded a publishing house specialized in scientific and technical publications. It is a very painful research journey, which focuses on the discomfort and the evil of living that led a beautiful woman, who seemed to have everything, to give up her life. But it is also the path of a bourgeois family through Italy in the second half of the twentieth century.

title: Un, deux, trois soleil
synopsis: At the edges of the most extreme and degraded Marseille suburbs lives the little Victorine, a decidedly little awake girl who has an even less casual mother than her. Becoming Granichella discovers the love and sex that practices without limits. He falls in love with Petit Paul, but they do it out and then she turns into a ruthless killer and takes revenge. In the meantime, her father also died, Constantin, who then reborn as a ghost. The ambitions of the film are many, many of which are frustrated by an excess of grotesque that is lost in the labyrinths of a slightly boring dreamlike.
cast: Anouk Grinberg, Marcello Mastroianni, Myriam Boyer, Claude Brasseur

title: Una
synopsis: A young woman tracks down the older man who preyed on her as a child, forcing them both to confront the damage done by what happened 15 years earlier.
cast: Rooney Mara, Ben Mendelsohn, Riz Ahmed, Ruby Stokes, Natasha Little, Tara Fitzgerald, Tobias Menzies

title: Una Ferrari per due
synopsis: Almost fifty years old, for two years Marcello has been fired from the company where he worked as marketing director but has not revealed anything to anyone, giving up his savings to continue to study his daughter in an exclusive college. But everything changes the day when, hitchhiking to join his ex-wife in the Lucca countryside, he is welcomed into the Ferrari of Andrea De Lazzaro, the one who torpedoed him judging him too old. Unaware of the identity of the other, the two are forced by circumstances to exchange roles during the journey from Turin to Lucca, in an unexpected reversal of perspectives and prejudices.
cast: Neri Marcoré, Giampaolo Morelli, Anita Caprioli, Aurora Ruffino, Eleonora Sergio, Lorenzo Richelmy

title: Una Película de Policías
synopsis: With a mix of documentary and fiction, you follow the life of a police officer among the dangerous streets of Mexico City.
cast: Raúl Briones, Monica Del Carmen

title: Una bala marcada
synopsis: With the help of a friend, the usual infallible gunslinger dismisses the bully.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, Maria Pia Conte, Roberto Camardiel, Dada Gallotti, Carlo Gaddi, Frank Braña, Luis Induni, Gustavo Re

title: Una bara per lo sceriffo
synopsis: The relatively quiet life of a lawman in the Wild West is turned upside down by the death of his woman. A bandit kidnapped, tortured and then killed her. To take revenge, the sheriff agrees to join, incognito, the band of outlaws who are supposed to join the murderous jackal. He will be discovered, but nothing will stand in the way of his revenge.
cast: Anthony Steffen, Eduardo Fajardo, Arthur Kent

title: Una bella governante di colore
synopsis: The industrialist Nicola Sallustri, who cheats on his wife with a doctor, has a son, Simone who gets any maid who comes within range of him pregnant. When it also happens to Miriam, a black woman, he forces his son to marry her. Not for this, but Simone will give up his Gallicism.
cast: Ines Pellegrini, Renzo Montagnani, Marisa Merlini, Orchidea De Santis, Jean Claude Vernè, Gianfranco D'Angelo

title: Una bella grinta
synopsis: An ambitious industrialist has a new factory built despite being on the verge of bankruptcy. The (neglected) wife has a mistress. The industrialist discovers him, kills him and simulates an accident, so he manages to straighten the business of his company as well. Special Jury Prize at the 1965 Berlin Film Festival.
cast: Renato Salvatori, Norma Bengell, Antonio Segurini, Marina Malfatti

title: Una bella vacanza. Buon compleanno Dino Risi
synopsis: On the occasion of his 90th birthday, the great Italian director retraces his career from the postwar period to today.

title: Una bellezza che non lascia scampo
synopsis: The young musician Tony, romantically linked to Alberto, professor of paleontology at the university, is about to graduate in composition. The meeting with Vittorio, a longtime friend of the teacher, risks bringing out the depression that is harboring in his soul. In fact, while Alberto, always sweet and helpful, reveals his relentless rational and lucid nature, in Vittorio, selective in his relationship with others, a world of affection and sweetness unexpectedly emerges. Tony who fell in love with Vittorio goes into a depressive crisis.
cast: Thekla Reuten, Federico Scribani, Luca Citarella

title: Una boccata d'aria
synopsis: Salvo has long been interrupted by relations with his father for some time, but when he learns of his death he decides to return to Sicily, in the hope of convincing his brother Lillo to sell the family farmhouse. The revenue of the sale would in fact be used to save his pizzeria in Milan, whose imminent failure has kept hidden from everyone until then. However, family dynamics and contrasts will re -emerge, making the two brothers even more difficult to agree.
cast: Aldo Baglio, Lucia Ocone, Giovanni Calcagno, Ludovica Martino, Davide Calgaro, Massimiliano Benvenuto, Marcello Mazzarella, Mario Di Leva, Francesco Faiella, Tony Sperandeo

title: Una botta di vita
synopsis: It is the eve of August 15th and the elderly Elvio Battistini (Alberto Sordi), after the departure of his family who went to Greece, was left alone. The same age Giuseppe Mondardini (Bernard Blier) is also alone, but he still has a great desire to live and, moreover, also a Lancia Aurelia. The two leave for Bordighera, but end up in Saint Tropez, between only imaginary conquests and other pathetic adventures.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Bernard Blier, Andréa Ferréol, Vittorio Caprioli, Alberto Sorrentino

title: Una breve vacanza
synopsis: The Calabrian worker Clara Mataro (Florinda Bolkan), immigrant to Milan and with her husband temporarily disabled, has to support her three children, mother-in-law and brother-in-law with her job. Having deteriorated her health, a stay in the Sondalo sanatorium and friendship with another patient appear to the woman as a period of serenity and illusions about a different future. But they will be, in fact, illusions.
cast: Florinda Bolkan, Renato Salvatori, Daniel Quenaud, José Maria Prada, Teresa Gimpera, Hugo Blanco, Julio Peña, Miranda Campa, Angela Cardile

title: Una bruna indiavolata
synopsis: Carlo Soldi wins a fair sum at the game and from there his troubles begin. He leaves for Rome with the intention of having fun, but he immediately gets his money stolen and at that point he begins, together with the betrothed of a friend of his, a wanderings in a taxi that there
cast: Silvana Pampanini, Ugo Tognazzi, Nando Bruno, Anna Campori

title: Una canzone per te
synopsis: Davide (Emanuele Bosi) is a high school student: the classic boy who is successful, bold and self-confident. He is engaged to the beautiful Silvia (Michela Quattrociocche), he is the leader of Nais Nois - the school group - and has only one big dream: to break through with his music. But one day Davide, in a single, devastating day, loses everything: friends, band and girlfriend. But fate occasionally grants a second chance: when Davide realizes that he can relive that damned day and put everything back in place, he begins with the song he was supposed to write for Silvia. The only way to do this, however, is to get help from Lisa (Agnese Claisse), the "loser" of the school, a classmate who until then has always laughed at and snubbed. Thanks to her, Davide will be able to find the words for his song and to remedy all the mistakes made in a daring way. At least apparently. Yes, because right now that everything seems to have returned to its place, it is David who no longer feels the same as before. And a doubt haunts him: is Silvia still the girl he really loves?
cast: Michela Quattrociocche, Emanuele Bosi, Martina Pinto, Agnese Claisse, Gabriele Galli, Claudio Falconi, Marco Battelli

title: Una casa nel cuore
synopsis: Anna, abandoned by her husband and without resources, suddenly finds herself forced to live with her daughter on the street, in a boat moored on the banks of the Tiber. It will be thanks to unexpected support that Anna will find the strength to go on without losing her dignity.
cast: Cristiana Capotondi, Giorgio Colangeli, Simone Montedoro, Michela Andreozzi, Aurora Giovinazzo, Ninetto Davoli, Nadia Kibout, Denis Campitelli, Ludovico Vitrano

title: Una casa sotto il cielo
synopsis: 1950s: in search of ideas for a book, the American writer Eugene Carter meets a certain Gaetano Piras, who three decades earlier - still a child - had followed his father and his flocks to the Nuorese mountains. His parent then sold him to Count Casula as a "shepherd servant" ...
cast: Gino Lavagetto, William Bradford Borden, Fausto Siddi, Emanuela Cau

title: Una cavalla tutta nuda
cast: Don Backy, Barbara Bouchet, Renzo Montagnani, Vittorio Congia

title: Una cella in due
synopsis: Two different characters find themselves locked in the same cell: the first is Romulus, a mature lawyer whose professionalism and fairness leave something to be desired, the other is Angelo who instead was forced to commit crimes only because he was unemployed and penniless. . The two, having overcome the "cultural" distances, will plan together a spectacular escape.
cast: Enzo Salvi, Maurizio Battista, Massimo Ceccherini, Simona Borioni, Melita Toniolo, Jane Alexander (II), Serena Bonanno, Nicole Murgia

title: Una colt in mano al diavolo
synopsis: Released from prison, the young gunslinger Roy Koster goes to Silvertown to grant the last wish of his companion in misfortune, Geremy Scott known as "Sulky".
cast: Robert Wood, William Berger, Fiorella Mannoia, Mario Dardanelli

title: Una colt in pugno al diavolo
synopsis: Pat Scotty is an ex-officer sent by the army to investigate a gang of Mexican thugs whose leader is called Capataz. Pat passes himself off as a gold digger and manages to make friends with the bandit, then the Settimo Cavalleggeri arrives: an unwatchable, irrelevant and superfluous spaghetti-western.
cast: Bob Henry, George Wang, Marisa Solinas, Lucretia Love, Gerardo Rossi, Luciano Catenacci, Luciano Benetti, Renato Chiantoni

title: Una commedia pericolosa
synopsis: Since at seven years of age she saw a James Bond film for the first time, Maurilio Fattori dreams of becoming a secret agent. Today he is responsible for the security of the Rinascente and calls himself Agent Mao. It is attentive, scrupulous, analytical and integral not only in work, but also in private life. Mao is single and spy from the window on the courtyard the condominiums he knows perfectly. One day, just in the apartment in front of his, he moves a very attractive woman, Rita, line hostess with a melancholy air. One evening, Maurilio witnesses a furious quarrel between her and a stranger. The discussion culminates with the man who puts his hands on the neck of Rita and pushes her out of Maurilio's visual field, who rushes to check. When notes two female legs come out from behind the sofa, Maurilio calls the police. Upon their arrival, however, they find Rita Sana and saves that opens the stunned door. Despite everything, Mao is sure of what he witnessed and is determined to personally investigate the mystery.
cast: Gabriella Pession, Fortunato Cerlino, Niccolò Senni, Marco Zingaro, Enrico Brignano, Paola Minaccioni, Grazia Schiavo, Monica Vallerini, Emanuela Ionica, Giuseppe Lo Piccolo, Leandro Amato, Vincenzo Leto

title: Una coppia modello
synopsis: Adriano and Enzo met in court during the conciliation hearing for their respective separations. While Enzo regrets the choice, Adriano appears more bold but, thrown out of the house, he is forced to ask his new friend for help and shelter for one night only. The night alone, however, turns into a much longer period, during which Enzo and Adriano strike an agreement to help each other win back their wives: the sophisticated and icy Ada and the beautiful and exasperated Valeria.
cast: Bianca Guaccero, Sergio Assisi, Daniele Pecci, Chiara Ricci, Simona Marchini, Riccardo Alemanni, Daniela Scarlatti

title: Una diecimilalire
synopsis: 1960. Vincenzo is a young enterprising and willing young man, who at the age of just eleven decides to escape from a small village in Basilicata, abandoning his family to take refuge in the capital from a his shoemaker. Against the background of an Italy in the middle of the economic boom, he begins to work in a bar and follows an elementary license. Everything seems to run in the right direction but a sad discovery upsets his life. Vincenzo is looking for a further redemption for himself and for his brother by opening a commercial activity and thus consolidating his shareholding in the capital, but always with the regret of not having the family of origin close and above all his brother Giovanni. He returns to his country now as an adult man, to the bedside of the dying father, bringing with him the memories of child, as a winning man for his people, but defeated deep and victim of regret for a life lived in half.
cast: Sebastiano Somma, Gianluca Di Gennaro, Ciro Esposito, Gerardo Amato, Chiara Conti, Paola Lavini, Jonis Bascir, Fabrizio Buompastore, Giorgia Palmucci, Francesco Colangelo

title: Una domenica notte
synopsis: As a young man, Antonio Colucci dreamed of becoming an established horror film director. He was very talented and had managed to make a feature film but several production difficulties had limited its release to Germany only and moreover directly on videotape. After twenty years, during which he put aside his wishes to devote himself to his family life in a provincial town, Antonio sets out to make a new low-budget film, based on a story written by himself with a unique character. The problems begin when he searches for the necessary funds, discovering that the horror that surrounds him is even more terrifying than his horror films.
cast: Antonio Andrisani, Francesca Faiella, Claudia Zanella, Alfio Sorbello, Anna Ferruzzo, Adolfo Margiotta, Pietro De Silva, Saman Anthony, Ernesto Mahieux, Marit Nissen, Rocco Barbaro, Alberto Rubini, Pascal Zullino

title: Una domenica sì
synopsis: Dario, Nik and Davide are three fellow soldiers on Sunday leave. Dario waits for his friend Elena to arrive by train from Rome and Nik hopes that she will bring a friend of hers with her to spend time with. However, events take an unexpected turn and the two friends decide to join Davide at the rich Alfonso's home.
cast: Nik Novecento, Elena Sofia Ricci, Dario Parisini, Mario Mazzarotto

title: Una donna allo specchio
synopsis: The Carnival of Ivrea, with its famous battle with orange strokes, attracts people from all over Italy. Among the many visitors there are also Fabio and Manuela, who know each other on that occasion and begin an intense erotic relationship. They know that after the party, which lasts three days, everything will end, and this stimulates them in the search for unbridled pleasure.
cast: Stefania Sandrelli, Marzio Honorato, Alberto Signetto, Paolo Quaregna, Dina D'Isa, Emilio Locurcio, Ottavio Marcelli, Barbara Dolza, Sergio Daneri, Alfredo Dori

title: Una donna chiamata Apache
synopsis: A cavalry officer saves an Apache woman bringing her with her, since she has fallen in love with it and wants to protect her from a smuggler of weapons. The latter, however, does not give himself for won and chases them together with him to take revenge.
cast: Al Cliver, Yara Kewa, Corrado Olmi, Marie France Boyer, Rick Boyd

title: Una donna da guardare
synopsis: Gianni is a middle-aged man who has become helpless. He consulted a sexologist who, however, was unable to find the right drug treatment to solve the problem. So she advises him to try to seduce all the women he meets in the hope that someone can unblock the situation. But once again it will be love, that of a beautiful and prosperous psychologist to whom he turned, to make him still capable of loving deeply.
cast: Pamela Prati, Mauro Vestri, Georges Ardisson, Elisabetta Focardi

title: Una donna da scoprire
synopsis: Donna (Marina Suma) is a successful rock singer romantically linked to her manager, Aldo. The evenings go well and the couple as well, until Marco enters the scene. He is a photographer and after a first shoot with the diva he falls in love with her. Donna is there, leaves Aldo and prepares a new show. On the evening when she debuts with the new band, Aldo waits for her in the crowd and shoots her. There was a time when Marina Suma looked like she could be the new hope of Italian cinema. A fate that never happened to director Sesani. The result is identical, but the Suma, at least at the time of The Occasions of Rosa, seemed good.
cast: Jean Marie Marion, Marina Suma, Agostina Belli, Bruno Riccardo Di Luia

title: Una donna di notte
synopsis: Aldo, separated from his wife, to pay food and keep his daughter writes novels. Like all writers aspiring to write thick books, but pressed by his publisher, he is forced to give himself to pornography. The hunt for inspiration and finding it very little in the prostitute who comes to visit him, he keeps an eye on an opposite one who always returns home late at night. With her, Aldo finds inspiration.
cast: Lorraine De Selle, Otello Belardi, Daniele Vargas, Ajita Wilson

title: Una donna di seconda mano
synopsis: Augusto wants to sexually initiate his nephew Luca. He thus entrusts him to the care of Nerina, a prostitute with whom he ends up falling in love.
cast: Senta Berger, Enrico Maria Salerno, Stefano Amato, Rena Niehaus

title: Una donna dietro la porta
cast: Dalila Di Lazzaro, John Saxon, Clarita Gatto, Valerio Isidori

title: Una donna ha ucciso
synopsis: After the Second World War, Captain Prescott begins a relationship with the Neapolitan Anna. For him it is an adventure like many others, for her it is love. When the captain is transferred to Rome he decides to leave Anna. But the woman follows him to the capital where, neglected and humiliated, she ends up carrying out an extreme act.
cast: Frank Latimore, Umberto Spadaro, Lidia Cirillo, Lianella Carell

title: Una donna libera
synopsis: Moved by an irresistible desire for independence, Liana abandons her betrothed Fernando shortly before the wedding to escape with Gerardo, a musician. So she goes to live in Paris where she ends up marrying a rich man, but regrets it after just a year. Back home, she has a violent argument with Gerardo which ends tragically. The protagonist's irresolution and her unsettled restlessness translate awkwardly into a juxtaposition of contradictory choices and attitudes that are poorly illuminated by an elementary psychological excavation. And Françoise Cressoy does not contribute to making everything more credible.
cast: Françoise Christophe, Pierre Cressoy, Elisa Cegani, Gino Cervi, Lianella Carell, Christine Carere, Barbara Florian, Galeazzo Benti, Augusto Mastrantoni, Luigi Tosi

title: Una donna per Ringo
synopsis: Bob and Ringo discover a plot against two beautiful twins, headed by the town sheriff. A western undecided between sentimentality and action.
cast: Sean Flynn, Pilar Bayona, Emilia Bayona, Renato Baldini, Luigi Induni

title: Una donna per amica
synopsis: Francesco is an awkward lawyer while Claudia is a nonconformist veterinarian. Beautiful and young, the two have always been best friends but something has irremediably changed over time. After Claudia decides to marry Giovanni, Francesco realizes what he really wants and who he is actually in love with, realizing how complicated the friendship between man and woman is.
cast: Fabio De Luigi, Laetitia Casta, Valeria Solarino, Monica Scattini, Valentina Lodovini, Adriano Giannini, Flavio Montrucchio, Antonia Liskova, Miriam Dalmazio, Geppi Cucciari, Virginia Raffaele

title: Una donna per la vita
synopsis: Maurizio (Maurizio Casagrande) spends his days dividing himself between working as a concierge in a hotel in Naples with a view of Castel dell'Ovo and his eternal girlfriend Marina (Sabrina Impacciatore), a nice pain in the ass whose main dowry is not just beauty. But their relationship risks big when, after a car accident that sees him involved and on the advice of his friend and doctor Paolo (Neri Marcoré), Maurizio goes to the beautiful and mysterious chiropractor Nadine (Margareth Madè), who has the extraordinary power of direct the destinies of others with the particular benefits of his massages. For the Neapolitan, resisting his charm will be almost impossible, so much so that he decides to radically change his life.
cast: Maurizio Casagrande, Sabrina Impacciatore, Margareth Madè, Neri Marcoré, Vincenzo Salemme, Giobbe Covatta, Pino Insegno, Maurizio Mattioli, Biagio Izzo, Alena Seredova, Simona Marchini

title: Una donna senza nome
synopsis: The rich Elize is confined to a wheelchair since childhood, living alone in her big house, assisted by Giulia, a nun, by the faithful driver Angelo and by Vivian, the maid. Giulia and Angelo are named his heirs, on condition that ...
cast: Lisbeth Hummel, Giulia Orso, Pierangelo Pozzato, Beatrice Palme

title: Una famiglia
synopsis: Rome, today. At first glance Vincent, a fifty-year-old French woman who has kept only the accent of her origins, and Maria, about fifteen years younger, seem a couple similar to many others. When they take the subway, they sit close together, hugging each other. When they return home, they make love with passion, tied hand in glove by a mutual attraction that usually characterizes the beginnings of a love story and not consolidated relationships like theirs. In an everyday life lived mainly in the shelter of the walls of the house, even the presence of external people seems not only superfluous, but even avoided, as if both were enough for the other and the rest of the world did not matter or even did not exist. Yet, on closer inspection, it is difficult not to notice small signs of uneasiness that come from the female half of this apparently so united couple. Maria is too vulnerable (and too in love) to affirm her malaise. And his attempts at rebellion, rather than indicate a real desire to distance himself from his partner, resemble almost desperate requests for help addressed to his "Vincenzo", and promptly ignored by him. What Vincent does not seem to understand is that Maria is not questioning their relationship, but the life project that they have carried out together so far and that, of that isolation from the world, was and still is the real and only reason: a frightening and secret project that Maria no longer intends to let live with her love.
cast: Micaela Ramazzotti, Patrick Bruel, Pippo Delbono, Fortunato Cerlino, Marco Leonardi, Matilda De Angelis, Ennio Fantastichini

title: Una famiglia mostruosa
synopsis: A young couple of off -site students - Adalberto and Luna - meets and falls in love. Far from home, the two have no opportunity to get to know their families, but when she is pregnant, Adalberto is forced to bring her to her, although she makes them a little flattering portrait, so much so that it jokingly observes: "you talk about it as If they were monsters ". The girl does not know how close to the truth she is: Vladimiro, the future father -in -law, is in fact a vampire, his wife Brunilde a witch, her brother a Frankenstein, the little sister's sister a vampire and the grandmother a ghost. Adalberto himself is a werewolf, who however aspires to a normal life and has so far managed to hide his identity. The couple thus presents himself to the family castle where Adalberto hopes to discover the identity of the unborn child through a magical mirror: that is to know if he will come human or monster. All this by hiding the truth from the unsuspecting moon and trying to protect it from the hostility of his, who abuse the idea of ​​marriage to a human. Everything is complicated with the unexpected arrival of her family - Nando, Stella, grandfather Paride and little Ivano. The parents Nando and Stella are only human names: since they prove to be so rough, vulgar and venals that they deserve the moral appellation of "monsters". The comparison between the two families develops with a scutilant corollary of misunderstandings and double games until the final discovery of the truth, revealing the surprising implications of this very special pregnancy.
cast: Massimo Ghini, Lucia Ocone, Pasquale Petrolo, Ilaria Spada, Paolo Calabresi, Cristiano Caccamo, Emanuela Rei, Barbara Bouchet, Pippo Franco, Alessandra Scarci, Sara Ciocca, Vincenzo Sebastiani

title: Una famiglia per caso
synopsis: Through a series of adventurous events, sometimes on the verge of legality, four people, tired and disappointed by life and eager to change it, get together and finally realize that they can create a better future for themselves.
cast: Elda Alvigini, Lando Buzzanca, Giovanna Ralli, Enzo Marino Bellanich

title: Una famiglia perfetta
synopsis: Leone (Sergio Castellitto), rich, powerful and mysterious, is a completely alone man. On Christmas Eve, to overcome loneliness, he decides to call a company of comedians and have them interpret those relatives he never had. Each with their own vicissitudes behind them, the actors will be forced for one evening to stage the perfect family until Alicia (Francesca Neri) intervenes to cause havoc.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Marco Giallini, Claudia Gerini, Carolina Crescentini, Eugenio Franceschini, Eugenia Costantini, Ilaria Occhini, Francesca Neri, Giacomo Nasta, Lorenzo Zurzolo, Paolo Calabresi, Sergio Fiorentini

title: Una farfalla con le ali insanguinate
synopsis: Following the death of the young student Françoise, stabbed in a park in Bergamo, a local journalist is arrested, framed by overwhelming evidence. While he is in prison, however, two other murders with similar characteristics are committed. This prompts the court to reopen his case.
cast: Helmut Berger, Giancarlo Sbragia, Ida Galli, Silvano Tranquilli, Lorella De Luca, Carole André

title: Una femmina
synopsis: Rosa (Lina Siciliano) is a restless and rebellious girl who lives with her grandmother and her uncle in a town in Calabria, between mountains and dried rivers. The arrival of adult life for Rosa means betraying his family and looking for his own blood revenge. And when this family is the 'ndrangheta every step can be fatal.
cast: Lina Siciliano, Fabrizio Ferracane, Annamaria De Luca, Simona Malato, Luca Massaro, Mario Russo, Vincenzo Di Rosa

title: Una festa esagerata
synopsis: Naples. At the Parascandolo home, preparations are underway for a magnificent party on the splendid terrace where the head of the family, the naive Gennaro, surveyor and small building contractor, lives with Teresa, a hungry wife with a ferocious ambition to climb higher and higher on the social ladder. For her daughter Mirea's 18th birthday, Teresa decided to go big and spared no expense. Gennaro, in order to please the women in his life and with the help of Lello, the keeper's intrusive assistant, continues to indulge their every whim and spend a fortune on a party that he himself defines as "exaggerated". Everything seems perfect, the guests begin to arrive, but an unexpected news comes from downstairs, from the Scamardella house, where a very old father and his spinster daughter live: misfortune has decided that Mr. Scamardella had to die on the day of the party. What to do? How do you have a party with a dead person in the house?
cast: Vincenzo Salemme, Massimiliano Gallo, Tosca D'Aquino, Iaia Forte, Nando Paone, Andrea Di Maria, Teresa Del Vecchio, Francesco Paolantoni, Giovanni Cacioppo, James Senese, Vincenzo Borrino, Antonella Morea, Mirea Flavia Stellato

title: Una fredda mattina di maggio
synopsis: During the years of lead, Ruggero Manni (Sergio Castellitto), a famous journalist of an important newspaper, investigates the attack of an elderly colleague of his. Despite the hostility of some members of the editorial staff, Manni goes on and discovers that some of the children of friends are part of a terrorist organization. He will continue his search with courage, but will end up murdered.
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Alessandra Acciai

title: Una giornata particolare
synopsis: On May 6, 1938, while all of Rome is in turmoil because there is a visit from Hitler, Antonietta, mother of six children, wife of a fanatical black shirt and a fascist in turn, meets a neighbor in her popular block: a former Eiar announcer, who lost his job as a homosexual. It will be a special day for both of us, and certainly not because the Führer is a guest of the Eternal City. The meeting and the mutual discovery of two "different", both victims of the vulgar machismo of the regime.
cast: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, John Vernon, François Bard

title: Una gita a Roma
synopsis: Francesco is 9 years old and has an unusual passion for his age. With his little sister Maria he arrives in Rome from a provincial town and, along a journey that makes them discover a great metropolis and a varied universe of characters and places, the two find themselves involved in a series of adventures that are now pleasant hours less before reaching a destination long dreamed of and considered one of the most amazing artistic places in the world.
cast: Claudia Cardinale, Libero Natoli, Tea Buranelli, Philippe Leroy, Karin Proia, Chiara Conti, Giovanni Lombardo Radice, Silvana Bosi, Pietro De Silva, Roberta Fiorentini, Carlo De Ruggeri, Raffaele Buranelli, Davide Merlini, Phil Palmer

title: Una gita scolastica
synopsis: An elderly lady recalls the best memory of her life: a school trip on foot from Bologna to Florence, through the Apennines, on the eve of the final exams. The thirty boys are accompanied by a teacher of letters and a teacher of drawing. The latter will have an adventure with one of the pupils. But the professor, in love with her, will defend her from the scandal.
cast: Carlo Delle Piane, Tiziana Pini, Rossana Casale, Lidia Broccolino

title: Una iena in cassaforte
synopsis: Six keys are needed to open a safe full of jewels. Each is in different hands; six international thieves gather in the luxurious villa where the safe is located, to make an agreement between them. But, one at a time, they all die mysteriously.
cast: Dimitri Nabokov, Maria Luisa Geisberger, Ben Salvador, Alex Morrison, Karina Kar, Cristina Gaioni, Otto Tinard

title: Una lacrima sul viso
synopsis: Bobby Tonner (Bobby Solo), the famous American singer, has arrived in Naples to visit the conservatory professor Giovanni Todini, an old friend of his father. The professor's daughter is called Lucia (Laura Efrikian), she is attractive and even the American seems to be fascinated by her.
cast: Bobby Solo, Laura Efrikian, Nino Taranto, Lena Von Martens, Dolores Palumbo, Lucy D'Albert, Dante Maggio, Pina Ceparano, Piero Jossa, Agostino Salvietti, Carlo Taranto

title: Una lettera all'alba
synopsis: In one go, Carlo discovers not only that he has a son, the result of an ancient relationship, but also that the boy is a cocaine dealer. Desperate, he tries to help him especially when he is accused of the murder of a countess. Once his son is proven innocent, Carlo has him board a ship so that he can rebuild a life elsewhere. All this without ever revealing that he is his father. The reference to drugs is not deceiving: this is not a thriller, but a melodrama. It is also the film that reveals Olga Villi to the cinema who, although young, already had a decent theatrical career behind her. Every two hours until 11pm
cast: Fosco Giachetti, Olga Villi, Lea Padovani, Jacques Sernas, Tatyana Pavlova, Margherita Bagni, Franca Marzi, Vittorio Sanipoli, Salvo Randone, Ernesto Calindri, Nerio Bernardi

title: Una lucertola con la pelle di donna
synopsis: Carol Hammond, wife of a lawyer, tells the psychoanalyst the dream in which she herself killed her neighbor, a woman of little virtue. When the woman is actually found dead (in the manner described by Carol) the police suspicions turn first on her and, only later, on several other people, including Carol's husband.
cast: Florinda Bolkan, Stanley Baker, Leo Genn, Jean Sorel, Anita Strindberg, Silvia Monti, Alberto De Mendoza, Penny Brown, Mike Kennedy, Ely Galleani, George Rigaud, Ezio Marano, Franco Balducci, Luigi Antonio Guerra, Erzsi Paal, Gaetano Imbrò

title: Una lunga fila di croci
synopsis: The shady Mexican Fargo smuggles peons from Mexico and hangs a large bounty on him. Braddock and Mardock, two bounty hunters, then decide to join forces and try to collect the money by eliminating Fargo and his gang of men. Along the way, however, a very different reality will emerge from what it seems on the surface.
cast: Anthony Steffen, William Berger, Mario Brega, Riccardo Garrone, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Mariangela Giordano, Giancarlo Sisti, Franco Ukmar, Giulio Mauroni, Gabriele Torrei

title: Una lunga, lunga, lunga, notte d'amore
synopsis: The night of 21 December is the longest of the year. And in this night many love stories are consumed: there is a man who meets a girl and cannot hold back his emotions, a woman who runs away from herself, two others who verify the love for the partner and that for the generations future.
cast: Marie Trintignant, Giancarlo Giannini, Isabelle Pasco, Ornella Muti

title: Una macchia rosa
synopsis: A young documentary maker returned from a trip to India cannot make sense of his life. Irritated by chaotic traffic and the vacant concerns of the friends he has found, he seeks an answer to his restlessness.
cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Valeria Moriconi, Delia Boccardo, Orchidea De Santis, Leopoldo Trieste, Ginevra Benini, Stefanella Giovannini, Ivan Ricci, Carlo Leva, Harold Null

title: Una meravigliosa stagione fallimentare
synopsis: The 2013/2014 season of Bari Calcio hides the first "happy" failure at the time of the crisis, welcomed by the fans with a big party and experienced by an entire city as a moment of rebirth for the favorite team. The competitive season reflects the history experienced by an entire city: a unique and unrepeatable history, made up of conjunctures in which the imponderable happens.

title: Una moglie americana
synopsis: Unhappy with his job at a Magenta shoe factory, Riccardo hopes for the classic "rush of life". The opportunity presents itself to him when the boss sends him to the United States for work. Once in America he decides to settle there, but in order to do so he has to find a woman willing to marry him to get him to take American citizenship. However, the enterprise turns out to be more difficult than expected despite the fact that the myth of the Latin lover still enjoys good fame. Much of the story unfolds showing Riccardo's clumsy attempts to approach the most diverse women, from the Brooklyn negro to the sophisticated uptown lady. A little repetitive.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Rhonda Fleming, Graziella Granata

title: Una moglie bellissima
synopsis: Mariano and Miranda run a fruit and vegetable stand in the market of their small town in Tuscany. The life of the spouses will be upset by the arrival of a handsome photographer who offers the woman to pose for a calendar. Despite the initial fears, the beautiful Miranda will eventually accept ...
cast: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Laura Torrisi, Massimo Ceccherini, Rocco Papaleo, Gabriel Garko, Francesco Guccini, Tony Sperandeo

title: Una mujer fantástica
synopsis: Marina is a young trans waitress who earns her living in the evening by performing as the singer of a small club with a dubious reputation. However, her existence becomes complicated after the sudden death of her boyfriend, a man older than her. The event will force her to a series of hostilities from the authorities and the family of her beloved.
cast: Daniela Vega, Francisco Reyes, Luis Gnecco, Aline Küppenheim, Amparo Noguera

title: Una mujer sin amor
synopsis: After having an affair with a family friend she is in love with, a woman returns to her husband and young son, losing contact with the man and without her husband knowing what happened. After twenty years the news arrives that the man has died, leaving all his belongings to the woman's son. This casts a shadow over her and raises suspicion as to who the boy's real natural father is.
cast: Rosario Granados, Tito Junco, Julio Villarreal, Joaquín Cordero, Xavier Loyá, Elda Peralta, Jaime Calpe, Eva Calvo, Miguel Manzano

title: Una noche con Sabrina Love
synopsis: Daniel is seventeen, lives with his family in a small Argentine town and is bored with a job that doesn't excite him. He spends his free time like all his peers, watching the people passing by in the town square. When he gets home, all Daniel has to do is hang on to the TV and watch the show of Sabrina Love, the porn star of the moment. One night, however, the teenager is drawn to spend a night in Buenos Aires with Sabrina ...
cast: Cecilia Roth, Tomas Fonzi, Giancarlo Giannini, Fabian Vena, Norma Aleandro

title: Una noche embarazosa
synopsis: Emigrated to Mexico for 13 years, the Calabrian taxi driver Amalio Badalamenti had 12 children by his wife Carmen, baptized with the names of the months. But there are also those who have no offspring and risk being disinherited, like the poultry industrialists Pablo and Ronnie Copeka ...
cast: Lando Buzzanca, Claudia Islas, Queta Caver, Carlos Estrada, Francis Córdova

title: Una notte
synopsis: Salvatore, Annamaria, Alfonso and Riccardo return to Naples, their hometown, for the funeral of their friend Antonio. Although they were very close to their university days, they lost sight of each other after they moved to different cities for work reasons. After the wake, the four decide to have dinner together. Thus begins - between the memories, the experiences lived together and the existential budgets - a journey that lasts all night.
cast: Nino D'Angelo, Riccardo Zinna, Luigi Iacuzio, Alfonso Postiglione, Salvatore Sansone, Stefania Troise

title: Una notte al cimitero
synopsis: Five young thugs rob a supermarket and decide to spend the whole night in a makeshift shelter, which is actually a catacomb. They believe that under there is an old treasure of inestimable value and instead they will find only ferocious zombies and vampires of arcane lineage. All guests of the real hostess, Death!
cast: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Beatrice Ring, Lino Salemme

title: Una notte blu cobalto
synopsis: Dino is a young university student who has recently been left by Valeria, his great love, an aspiring theater actress. After a series of strange coincidences and fatalities, Dino ends up in the "Blu cobalto" takeaway pizzeria, where he meets the mysterious owner, Turi, for whom he starts working by making home deliveries that will open the doors to an unexpected world.
cast: Corrado Fortuna, Regina Orioli, Vincenzo Crivello, Valentina Carnelutti, Alessandro Haber, Elio Sofia

title: Una notte che piove
synopsis: Guido's elderly father dies, a famous lawyer, and so he finds himself with a law firm to run. The parent, however, also left him a beautiful house on the coast of Stintino. Guido is a solicitor, but, unlike his father, he carries out his profession with little enthusiasm. Guido loves playing the saxophone very much, he leads a lonely and strike life. However, Guido is deeply attached to that house because the dreams and memories of almost twenty years of life were born there. Well known plot, well known characters, bad acting. Less than television.
cast: Massimo Venturiello, Olga Beaumont, Viola Simoncioni, Giovanni Costa

title: Una notte da dottore
synopsis: Pierfrancesco Mai, 65, is a doctor who works as a night medical guard. And he is also a man full of ailments, grumpy and not empathic with patients at all. One night he has a fortuitous accident with Mario, a thirty -year -old rider who delivers food at home. Mario does nothing but his bike is destroyed. Due to the impact, Pierfrancesco sees, on the other hand, to regain his perennial sciatica and can no longer guide. The two risk losing the job, but the doctor comes an idea that saves both: Mario, "guided" at a distance from Pierfrancesco through an ear, will make visits to his place and with the doctor's car will also make the home delivery. After a series of daring (dis) adventures, the two will learn to support each other and the night will turn to the end by changing their lives for the better.
cast: Diego Abatantuono, Frank Matano, Giorgia Spinelli, Alessandro Betti, Luciano Miele, Antonio Salines, Valentina D'Agostino, Leonardo Sbragia

title: Una notte da paura
synopsis: On Halloween night, for fun, friends Sergio (Francesco Pannofino) and Leopoldo (Leonardo Manera), improvise mediums and stage a séance. Due to a series of coincidences, their invocation of the spirits hits the mark and the soul of a terrible witch, who lived in the sixteenth century and willing to never go away, reveals itself by sowing panic and terror and coming to threaten the safety of the their family members.
cast: Francesco Pannofino, Leonardo Manera, Maurizio Mattioli, Simona Borioni, Manuela Morabito, Lillo, Cosetta Turco, Guendalina Tavassi, Iva Zanicchi, Pierluigi Di Lallo

title: Una nuvola di polvere... un grido di morte... arriva Sartana
synopsis: Sartana makes Grande Full escape from prison to be revealed where she has hidden the huge loot of a robbery. However, many are interested in the loot: everyone tries to kill Sartana who finds help only in Belle, Johnson's widow (accomplice of Grande Full). But this will turn out to be involved in the death of her husband. Classic spaghetti western full of (gratuitous) violence and daring twists.
cast: Gianni Garko, Susan Scott, Massimo Serato

title: Una pallottola nel cuore: Il passato che ritorna
synopsis: Donata Farinelli, owner of a famous marriage agency, sensationally comes out of a coma after four years of resuscitation. In prison, for her attempted murder, Lea Baldini is imprisoned, an employee of the agency who is a friend of the victim, who was surprised by the cleaning lady next to Donata's lifeless body. The awakening of Donata rekindles the interest of the journalist Bruno Palmieri, who at the time had followed the murky story.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Marco Marzocca, Francesca Inaudi, Licia Maglietta, Paola Minaccioni, Teco Celio, Franco Castellano, Carlo Caprioli, Cinzia Mascoli, Rodolfo Corsato, Sara D'Amario, Anna Ammirati, Anna Gigante, Paolo De Vita

title: Una pallottola nel cuore: Il vero e il falso
synopsis: A fire in a restoration laboratory causes the death of Roberto Grassi, a young but renowned owner of the business. The apparent cause appears to be accidental. Maddalena, looking for her first article as a reporter, arrives on the spot together with the deputy commissioner Enrico Vella. While trying to collect testimonies, Maddalena recognizes a girl, Violante Baldi Guarnieri, daughter of a noble Roman family, and discovers that she was a friend of the dead restorer. Thanks to her, he learns of a strange curse that has already claimed three victims. Intrigued by the story, the journalist Bruno Palmieri begins his investigation.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Marco Marzocca, Francesca Inaudi, Licia Maglietta, Paola Minaccioni, Teco Celio, Franco Castellano, Luigi Petrucci, Chiara Mastalli, Valeria Cavalli, Blas Boca Rey, Riccardo Leonelli

title: Una pallottola nel cuore: La maga di Piazza Navona
synopsis: Bruno Palmieri is a crime reporter who has been living for many years with a bullet stuck near his heart. On the threshold of retirement after forty years spent on the streets of Rome, Bruno finds himself having to face a new and unpredictable season in his life when Romolo, who served twenty years in prison for the murder of his wife, turns to him looking for help.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Francesca Inaudi, Licia Maglietta, Marco Marzocca, Paola Minaccioni, Teco Celio, Franco Castellano, Daniela Piazza, Carlotta Proietti, Federico Pacifici, Giovanni Scifoni, Ernesto Mahieux, Gabriele Cirilli, Manuela Mandracchia

title: Una pallottola nel cuore: La ragazza del parco
synopsis: Valeria Bernardi, a simple woman who runs a dry cleaners, decides to go to the journalist Bruno to remind him of the case of her daughter Alice, found murdered in the Villa Borghese Park on New Year's Eve 2000. The murder was not guilty because some witnesses they had revealed that the girl, in addition to studying at the university, prostituted herself for the sake of luxury. Faced with his mother's desperation, Bruno agrees to pick up the case and verify the existence of other leads neglected at the time by the judicial investigation.
cast: Gigi Proietti, Marco Marzocca, Francesca Inaudi, Licia Maglietta, Paola Minaccioni, Teco Celio, Franco Castellano, Duccio Camerini, Lidia Biondi, Ignazio Oliva, Giacomo Piperno, Benedetta Valanzano, Loredana Cannata

title: Una parigina a Roma
synopsis: Riccardo, a brilliant pianist studying in Rome, takes a crush on Germaine, a young and pretty French tourist. Once the crush is disposed of, the concert performer makes court to fellow citizen Fiorella, with whom he discovers he is in love ...
cast: Erwin Strahl, Anna Maria Ferrero, Barbara Laage, Alberto Sordi

title: Una película sobre parejas
synopsis: Natalia and Orol are a couple of thirty -year -old directors with a small daughter named Lia. One day they receive an offer to direct a documentary: they thus decide to make a film about the love of couple, and interview them different, trying to know if they get along and what their most typical problems are. While Natalia and Orol proceed with the filming, the wounds of their own relationship begin to reopen, and the discussions overlap with doubts. To complete the documentary it will be the opportunity to remodel the love that unites them and the love they have for cinema.
cast: Oriol Estrada, Natalia Cabral, Lia Estrada, Carlos M. Matos, Cristina Violines, Alex Saint Hilaire, Yanela Hernández, Ogilbe Núñez, José Homer Mora Acosta, Odilis Sánchez, Rafael García, Pablo Mustonen, Sarah Perez Baez, Helen Pieraldi, Alexa Vargas

title: Una piccola impresa meridionale
synopsis: Stella (Giuliana Lojodice) doesn't feel like facing another scandal in the village after her daughter Rosa Maria left her husband Arturo (Riccardo Scamarcio) by going away with a mysterious lover. So, when his son Don Costantino (Rocco Papaleo) leaves the cassock, he decides to confine him in an old disused lighthouse, belonging to the family, to prevent the news from spreading. In the lighthouse, almost transformed into a refuge for sinners, the former prostitute Magnolia (Barbora Bobulova) and Arturo are also welcomed, before a bizarre renovation company arrives to change everyone's life called to repair the roof.
cast: Rocco Papaleo, Riccardo Scamarcio, Barbora Bobulova, Sarah Felberbaum, Claudia Potenza, Giuliana Lojodice, Giovanni Esposito, Mela Esposito, Giampiero Schiano, Giorgio Colangeli

title: Una pistola en cada mano
synopsis: An ironic and emotional portrait of the shortcomings, weaknesses and other "virtues" of contemporary man. The stories of eight protagonists in their forties, confused and looking for a new identity, intertwine by chance in the wake of their sentimental misadventures. J. fights depression, despite his life being perfect. E., on the other hand, has been sleeping all the time since he returned to live with his mother. S. wishes to return with his ex-wife Elena and decides to face her. G. tries to understand why his wife is cheating on him. P. plans to seduce colleague Mamen. Two men see their wives swap roles so that they discover each other's secrets.
cast: Jordi Mollà, Ricardo Darín, Eduardo Noriega, Luis Tosar, Leonor Watling, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Javier Cámara, Candela Peña, Eduard Fernández, Alberto San Juan

title: Una pistola per Ringo
synopsis: In a small town in Texas, on the border with Mexico, some outlaws robbed a bank and took refuge on a ranch and took farmers hostage. The gunslinger Ringo manages to enter the ranch claiming to be a wanted one; but in reality he agrees with the sheriff and acts in view of the size. Giuliano Gemma, until then, had been an obscure character actor in adventure films. In the wake of Leone, but with a more ironic and light-hearted taste. The results of the experiment were not bad, Gemma was launched, the film had a sequel the following year.
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Fernando Sancho, Lorella De Luca, Nieves Navarro

title: Una pistola per cento bare
synopsis: Jim Slade, a pacifist soldier already sentenced to two years in prison for refusing to fight, turns into a bloodthirsty avenger when he discovers that his family has been exterminated. He will track the killers to hell and discover that their leader is a preacher.
cast: Peter Lee Lawrence, John Ireland, Piero Lulli, Gloria Osuna, Julio Peña

title: Una pistola per cento croci
synopsis: An Irishman is killed in the Wild West. The son Jimmy ponders revenge but ends up dead himself. Santana, a former Southerner, reads the letter he received from his sister Jessica and sets out on his trail. By bringing her her brother's body, Sartana will help her remain unscathed from the aims of her shrewd boyfriend Luis.
cast: Tony Kendall, Marina Muligan, Dick Palmer, Monica Miguel

title: Una prostituta al servizio del pubblico e in regola con le leggi dello stato
synopsis: A prostitute, mother of two children, abandons her abject husband who uses her to join a shy and naive young boxer. In an attempt to defend her from a beating, the man kills one of the attackers, ending up in jail.
cast: Giovanna Ralli, Giancarlo Giannini, Jean Marc Bory, Denise Bataille, Paolo Bonacelli, Roberto Chevalier, Rate Furlan, Raimondo Penne, Pietro Zardini, Gino Pagnani, Aldo Massasso, Fulvio Pellegrino, Salvatore Lago, Giorgio Dolfin

title: Una pura formalità
synopsis: A man is arrested at night, in the flood, and taken to a dilapidated police station. He is increasingly nervous, but when the commissioner arrives, the tension subsides. Interrogation. A dead body has been found and the man (who qualifies as a famous writer) is unable to reconstruct his final hours. At dawn, after the dialectical skirmish, everything will finally become "clear".
cast: Gérard Depardieu, Roman Polanski, Sergio Rubini, Tano Cimarosa

title: Una questione d'onore
synopsis: Efisio Mulas is a Sardinian shepherd who, before consummating the marriage, is forced to leave the island with his young bride. He returns there to commit a crime, but at the last moment he changes his mind and chooses to spend the night in bed with his wife. In the meantime, however, someone commits the murder and Efisio, unable to admit that he has made his wife pregnant, is forced to kill her.
cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Nicoletta Rangoni, Bernard Blier, Franco Fabrizi

title: Una questione privata
synopsis: In the Langhe, during the partisan war, Milton is a young university student, a former officer who plays in autonomous formations. A solitary hero, during a military action he sees the villa where Fulvia had lived, a girl he had loved and still loves. While visiting the places of his love, recalling the events, he learns that Fulvia has fallen in love with her friend, Giorgio: tormented by jealousy, Milton tries to track down his rival, discovering that he has been captured by the fascists.
cast: Luca Marinelli, Lorenzo Richelmy, Valentina Bellè, Francesco Turbanti, Jacopo Olmo Antinori

title: Una questione privata
synopsis: Partisan Milton wants to find out if Giorgio, his best friend, was Fulvia's lover, with whom Milton is in love. He goes in search of him and comes to discover that Giorgio has been captured by the fascists, and is about to be shot. To ask for an exchange of prisoners, Milton manages to capture a black shirt sergeant but, following his escape attempt, is forced to kill him. From the raw novel of one of the greatest Italian writers of the twentieth century, Beppe Fenoglio, here is the third edition for the screen (the first was by Giorgio Trentin, with Valeria Ciangottini). A decidedly unconventional depiction of partisan warfare, wasted by the very mediocre director of "Io e il duce".
cast: Rupert Graves, Céline Beauvallet, Alessandro Stefanelli, Rodolfo Corsato

title: Una questione privata. Vita di Beppe Fenoglio
synopsis: Documentary on the writer and partisan Beppe Fenoglio.
cast: Andrea Bruschi, Stefano Viali

title: Una ragazza piuttosto complicata
synopsis: A man inserts himself into a phone call between two lesbians. Intrigued by the very particular situation, he decides to meet one of the two girls and to become her lover. Problems arise when the other woman tries to break off their relationship.
cast: Catherine Spaak, Jean Sorel, Florinda Bolkan, Gabriella Grimaldi, Gino Lavagetto

title: Una ragione per combattere: A Reason to Fight
synopsis: Marco (Alessandro Baccini) is a model student and leader of a group of children in disarray, who spend the evenings between brawls in the disco and abusing alcohol and drugs. The young man also hides a terrible secret unknown to everyone: he is an ace in the clandestine fights managed by the dangerous trafficker Armando (Moreno Petroni). One day. However, while he is reaching the boys for another good evening, his gaze crosses that of Lisa (Alessandra Angeli), a beautiful girl, simple and of healthy principles, completely different from all the people she knows. The two fall in love and understand that they cannot do without each other. But Lisa also hides a secret that will lead the young champion to face the most dangerous challenge of her life.
cast: Alessandro Baccini, Alessandra Angeli, Moreno Petroni, Martina Landini, Walter Nestola, Benedetta Bruno, Niccolò Gentili, Stefano Martinelli, Alex Lucchesi, Alessio Cherubini

title: Una ragione per vivere e una per morire
synopsis: Colonel Pembroke's defense of Fort Holman wasn't heroic, but the Southerners were holding his son hostage and so we can't blame him too much either. The surrender is worth, however, the loss of degrees and a period of imprisonment. Pembroke manages to escape and, after various vicissitudes, manages to return to Fort Holman, along with a dozen companions to take revenge. A western spaghetti that has more nationality than soul (Italian, German, French and Spanish capitals). The result is a bit of a mess, with a delirious cast (Bud Spencer) and the solid action direction of the usual Valerii. Screenplay by Ferreriano Rafael Azcona.
cast: James Coburn, Bud Spencer, Telly Savalas, José Suarez, Reinhard Kolldehoff

title: Una relazione
synopsis: Tommaso and Alice have been a couple for fifteen years - unmarried and childless, he musician, she actress, both without success. They live in Rome, where they bought a house thanks to a mortgage that was the only real assumption of responsibility in their history. When they are invited to dinner by them for an announcement, friends think it is marriage. And instead Tommaso and Alice communicate that they have decided to leave: but they want to do it gradually, without breaking, remaining friends in a natural way. Their legitimate but naive ambition ends up colliding with the reality principle: the stories end up why? people change. And no change can be painless.
cast: Guido Caprino, Elena Radonicich, Thony, Libero De Rienzo, Alessandro Giallocosta, Isabella Aldovini, Enrica Bonaccorti, Francesca Chillemi, Tommaso Ragno, Jalil Lespert, Luigi Diberti, Sara Mondello

title: Una romantica avventura
synopsis: A lady who lives with her husband and daughter, when she confesses that she wants to run away with her boyfriend, disapproves. Then she thinks back to her life, to the young man who had accompanied her to a dance and with whom she had fallen in love; but he, knowing she was engaged, had disappeared. For twenty years her relations with her husband were cold, in regret of that brief adventure. Only now can she understand her husband's love. A tale of elegant suggestion, of gentle melancholy, with the scent of the past. Camerini tells with subtlety and Assia Noris is effective in the three roles of the protagonist, as a girl and a woman, and her daughter. The musical commentary is excellent. From a story by Thomas Hardy.
cast: Assia Noris, Gino Cervi, Leonardo Cortese, Ernesto Almirante

title: Una rosa per tutti
cast: Nino Manfredi, Mario Adorf, Lando Buzzanca, Akim Tamiroff, Luis Pellegrini

title: Una scomoda eredità
synopsis: Two sixty -year -old lovers, Mariella and Domenico, finally decided to confess to their respective daughters, Diana and Gaia, all the truth about their relationship. Unfortunately, the two die in a car accident before they can do it. The unknown Diana and Gaia still end up getting to know each other, having to agree on the partition of the villa received as inherited. The two women are so different as to stay immediately unpleasant, but they are forced to live until bureaucratic practices are hurry up.
cast: Euridice Axén, Chiara Francini, Cristiano Caccamo, Mariangela D'Abbraccio, Roberto Alpi, Cesare Bocci

title: Una sconfinata giovinezza
synopsis: Lino Settembre and his wife Chicca lead a peaceful married life without serious difficulties. The only real regret that accompanied the twenty-five years of marriage is the lack of children. A lack that did not compromise their union but on the contrary strengthened it. Today, however, in a totally unexpected way, presents them with a great concern: Lino has been accusing memory problems for some time that gradually become accentuated. At first, both he and Chicca decide to laugh at it but the disorder manifests itself more and more, until careful and in-depth examinations are necessary. Thus begins a touching love story between a man, who moves further and further away from the present, with his mind dragged elsewhere, and his woman who, refusing any hypothesis of abandonment and any help that excludes her, decides to stay with him in the process. "regressive".
cast: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Francesca Neri, Serena Grandi, Lino Capolicchio, Gianni Cavina, Manuela Morabito, Erika Blanc, Vincenzo Crocitti, Osvaldo Ruggieri, Brian Fenzi, Marcello Caroli, Riccardo Lucchese, Lucia Gruppioni

title: Una sera c'incontrammo
synopsis: Unlikely love between a commuter laborer and the fat daughter of an industrialist. She woos him with overwhelming intrusiveness, he, who works as a bricklayer, does not want to look like a social climber and shields himself as best he can. Things improve when he manages to become rich and famous as the author of a song brought to success by his obese suitor.
cast: Johnny Dorelli, Fran Fullenwider, Lia Tanzi, Gabriella Giacobbe

title: Una sera d'ottobre
synopsis: Giulia studies medicine in Florence but is from Arezzo and every Friday she returns to her family by train. On one of these trips he meets Alessandro, an alarm system technician. Passion breaks out between the two but the morning after the night they spent together the police show up accusing the boy of robbery and murder ...
cast: Vanessa Hessler, Gabriele Greco, Ottavia Piccolo, Andrea Tidona, Luca Bastianello, Edy Angelillo

title: Una spada per Brando
synopsis: A sect kidnaps some girls to sacrifice them to the god of darkness. The brave Brando and his gang of companions try to save them and stop the dangerous fanatics.
cast: Paul Winston, Karin Schubert, Tano Cimarosa, Dante Maggio

title: Una spada per l'impero
synopsis: In the year 190 d. C. the emperor Commodus sends an expedition against the barbarian Avalo. The consul Marco commands it and the only result is to free the slave Nissia, but not to block the enemy. Since Commodus seems to underestimate the danger to Rome, Mark allies himself with legionaries, gladiators and Christians and gets himself appointed emperor in place of the inept Commodus. This film was shot at the same time as the Fire of Rome. In English this procedure is called "back-to-back" and it means that Grieco with the money of one film was able to make two. To say that you can see it is an understatement.
cast: Lang Jeffries, José Greci, Enzo Tarascio, Angela Angelucci, Giuseppe Addobbati

title: Una spina nel cuore
synopsis: Guido is a young player who gets lucky in a small town on the lake. One day at the station he meets Caterina and falls in love with her; she accepts his court, but it is evident that there is something murky in her past. Things take an increasingly dramatic turn when another lover appears. The son of Alain Delon is the fascinating and unfortunate protagonist of this adaptation of Lattuada from the novel by Piero Chiara; the silent province and its secret, dark passions are at the center of the story, which provides the director with yet another great opportunity to investigate the ambiguities and reticence of the female soul.
cast: Anthony Delon, Sophie Duez, Leonardo Treviglio

title: Una spirale di nebbia
cast: Claude Jade, Marc Porel, Duilio Del Prete, Carole Chauvet, Marina Berti, Stefano Satta Flores, Roberto Posse, Martine Brochard, Flavio Bucci, Eleonora Giorgi, Anna Bonaiuto, Elvira Cortese, Valeria Sabel, Carlo Puri

title: Una squadra
synopsis: Between 1976 and 1980 the Italian tennis team formed by Adriano Panatta, Corrado Barazzutti, Paolo Bertolucci and Tonino Zugarelli competes for the Davis Cup Trophy. Five finals, a single victory against Chile, in a context that creates a real political case. The documentary tells the salient moments of these five years for what is still the only Italian victory in the history of the Davis Cup.
cast: Adriano Panatta, Nicola Pietrangeli, Paolo Bertolucci, Tonino Zugarelli

title: Una stagione all'inferno
synopsis: The young poet Rimbaud, after having participated in the Paris Commune, forms a bond with Verlaine, which however does not last long. Disappointed by the poem, he leaves for Africa, where he trades in slaves and weapons until his return to Europe and an early death. Biography of the French poet, a little chilly, but with some reason of interest. However much better than the recent Holland version.
cast: Terence Stamp, Florinda Bolkan, Jean Claude Brialy

title: Una sterminata domenica
synopsis: The summer love triangle between Alex, Brenda and Kevin evolves and transforms up to touch the first autumn rains.
cast: Enrico Bassetti, Zackary Delmas, Federica Valentini, Lars Rudolph

title: Una storia ambigua
cast: Minnie Minoprio, Beba Balteano, Gabriele Gori, Piero Gerlini

title: Una storia d'amore
synopsis: Gianni, a worker with a good heart, marries the young Anna, a woman with a turbulent past. But the past is always destined to return: when an old acquaintance of Anna blackmails her, she shoots at him and is sentenced to ten years in prison. In prison she gives birth to a girl ...
cast: Assia Noris, Piero Lulli, Carlo Campanini, Guido Notari, Osvaldo Genazzani

title: Una storia d'amore
synopsis: Evy, a happily married woman and mother of two children, taking advantage of the absence of her husband in Hong Kong for work, participates in a party with a group of friends. The birthday boy is Franz, a twenty -year -old play boy disputed by all women. Evy, unaware of the fact that he is hidden photographer for blackmail purposes, he grants Franz, completely loses his head and falls in love with it. Day after day Franz realizes for the first time to feel an authentic feeling towards the woman. Evy hit by this attitude tries to kill himself.
cast: Anna Moffo, Gianni Macchia, Caterina Boratto, Gigi Ballista, Alicia Brandet

title: Una storia italiana
synopsis: The film tells the story of the Abbagnale brothers who, starting from the South and animated by a great willpower and a spirit of sacrifice, managed to become rowing Olympians and to collect victories after victories. XXXNERO The second part airs tomorrow at the same time.XXXNERO
cast: Giuliano Gemma, Raoul Bova, Sabrina Ferilli, Ennio Coltorti

title: Una storia milanese
cast: Danièle Gaubert, Romolo Valli, Enrico Thibault, Lucilla Morlacchi

title: Una storia moderna - L'ape regina
synopsis: Alfonso, a car dealer in his forties, decides to marry. He marries Regina, a strict and reserved girl, who after the wedding turns out to be a ravenous female, a real consumer of males. She also remains pregnant, but things do not change: and while she becomes more and more beautiful and luminous, Alfonso perishes until her death, which occurs on the same day as the heir's birth. Marco Ferreri's first Italian feature film: a caustic and very poisonous "family portrait", on a screenplay also signed by Goffredo Parise and his loyal Rafael Azcona. Vlady was awarded Best Actress at Cannes 1963.
cast: Marina Vlady, Ugo Tognazzi, Linda Sini, Riccardo Fellini, Achille Majeroni, Walter Giller, Gian Luigi Polidoro, Nino Vingelli

title: Una storia qualunque
synopsis: Released from prison after the twenty-eight years inflicted on him for the murder of his wife, Michele La Torre lives in a condition so lonely and confused that it makes him want to go back to prison. Helping him is Mirko, a young idealistic lawyer, whom Michele also asks to help him find the children he has lost track of since his sentence. Having recovered his son's address, Michele goes there but is mistaken for the new gardener, finding himself living incognito together with his own relatives. Meanwhile Mirko, studying the proceedings of Michele's trial, begins to suspect a surprising truth ...
cast: Nino Manfredi, Bruno Wolkowitch, Tano Cimarosa, Carlo Croccolo

title: Una storia sbagliata
synopsis: In Gela, center on the southern coast of Sicily, the soldier Roberto and the nurse Stefania are deeply in love and decide to get married. Their life goes on happily until the day Roberto dies of a bomb in Iraq. Devastated by pain, Stefania decides to visit the place to understand what really happened. Joining a non-governmental association and posing as a doctor, she is determined to find the man who killed her husband but her personal search will force her to discover a country devastated by serious problems and make her change her vision of the world.
cast: Isabella Ragonese, Mehdi Dehbi, Francesco Scianna, Stefania Orsola Garello, Nello Mascia, Pietro De Silva, Yessmine Ouni, Salima Al Wadi, Jazi Abderrazek, Daniele Pilli

title: Una storia semplice
synopsis: Giorgio Roccella, an elderly diplomat, telephones the police because he hears strange noises in a wing of his villa, which stands isolated near a Sicilian town. The agents, who arrived at the scene only the next morning, found his body. Beside him only a gun and a note with the inscription: "I found.". The investigation begins and the first hypothesis is that of suicide. Professor Franzò, an old friend of the dead man, is not of this opinion.
cast: Gian Maria Volonté, Ennio Fantastichini, Ricky Tognazzi, Massimo Ghini, Tony Sperandeo, Massimo Dapporto, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Omero Antonutti, Paolo Graziosi, Macha Meril, Gianluca Favilla

title: Una storia senza nome
synopsis: Valeria, a young secretary of a film producer, lives in seclusion with an eccentric mother and writes undercover for a successful screenwriter, Alessandro. One day, Valeria receives an unusual gift from a stranger: the plot of a film. But that plot is dangerous, in fact it tells of the mysterious theft - which actually took place in Palermo in 1969 - of a famous painting by Caravaggio: The Nativity.
cast: Micaela Ramazzotti, Renato Carpentieri, Laura Morante, Alessandro Gassmann, Antonio Catania, Jerzy Skolimowski, Gaetano Bruno, Renato Scarpa, Silvia Calderoni, Martina Pensa

title: Una su tredici
synopsis: Mario is a barber who emigrated to New York. His life is enlivened by the announcement that he is the sole heir of an old English aunt. Mario then rushes to England, but receives only thirteen vintage chairs. But when he has already sold them to an antique dealer, he discovers that a fortune is hidden in one of them. He then frantically tries to recover the chairs, which in the meantime have been scattered among various buyers.
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Sharon Tate, Orson Welles, Vittorio De Sica, Ottavia Piccolo

title: Una sull'altra
synopsis: George, a young American doctor who owns a clinic together with his brother Henry, entrusts his seriously ill wife Susan to the care of a nurse. Despite the treatment, Susan dies, leaving her husband a large sum, the result of life insurance. The amount allows George to cover the costs of building the clinic. While at a nightclub with Jane, his mistress, George is struck by a stripper's striking resemblance to Susan.
cast: Jean Sorel, Marisa Mell, Elsa Martinelli, John Ireland, Alberto De Mendoza

title: Una talpa al bioparco
synopsis: David takes care of his brother Libero, a boy full of doubts and phobias. To make ends meet, he agrees to be a zoo keeper. Here he meets Martina, the veterinarian, and on his first appointment with her he runs into the charming and aggressive Giorgia, destined to upset his existence.
cast: Adriano Giannini, Giorgia Surina, Luca Angeletti, Emanuela Galliussi

title: Una tenera storia
synopsis: Mature lover of a primary hospital meets a determined young man, who in turn has another story. Sentimental swing with black ending. Already king of "quality" porn, Joe D'Amato (aka Aristide Massaccesi) has given himself from the 1980s to horror and softcore, where the lack of "topics" is discounted.
cast: Annie Papa, Richard Sauer

title: Una vacanza bestiale
synopsis: A group of tourists is captured by the lure of "Via Col Vento Tours", an agency that ends up throwing its customers into a sea of ??trouble. After many adventures, our heroes return home with an idea: to open an agency that will be called "Libidine Tours" ... The tourist-exotic idea seems promising well but everything soon frays in a total lack of rhythm and in a disheartening void of effective ideas. The use of obvious parodies of famous cinematic situations does not allow the situation to be saved.
cast: Jerry Calà, Franco Oppini, Umberto Smaila, Nini Salerno, Diego Abatantuono, Teo Teocoli

title: Una vacanza del cactus
synopsis: Mr. Zerboni (Cannavale) goes on vacation to Greece with his wife Fedora and a group of employees: the rag. Pistilli, Augusto and Angela (Rizzoli). Misunderstandings and messes multiply and while Zerboni tries to seduce the busty employee, his wife gets in the way of her terrible myopia; Augusto (Bombolo), on behalf of the widow, searches for the tomb of an uncle.
cast: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Enzo Cannavale, Bombolo, Vincenzo Crocitti, Bruno Minniti

title: Una vergine in famiglia
synopsis: A girl of respectable bourgeois family has remained virgin. However, when he discovers the hypocrisy of relatives, he will unleash himself.
cast: Franca Gonnella, Femi Benussi, Gianni Dei, Georges Ardisson, Mario Colli, Carla Calò, Luis La Torre, Enzo Andronico, Ester Carloni

title: Una vergine moderna
synopsis: The young Claudia Bardi aspires to free herself from the narrow family horizon and dedicates herself to the activity of model designer, also thanks to the support of a friend, the wearer Annadora. Uninhibited and uninhibited, Claudia first tries to seduce the director of a newspaper, then that of a bank, then a young Italian-American film producer, without however obtaining the desired results.
