In the end she will be with an elderly Brazilian millionaire: it will be the intervention of her brother to prevent her from continuing to throw herself away.
cast: May Britt, Gabriele Ferzetti, Vittorio De Sica, Teresa Pellati

title: Una vergine per il principe
synopsis: Don Vincenzo Gonzaga (Gassman), having obtained the annulment of his marriage with Margherita Farnese, intends to remarry, also for the "reason of state", with Eleonora De 'Medici. But her family has some doubts about the suitor's sexual vigor. These will have to give valid proof of himself with the maid Giulia (Lisi).
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Virna Lisi, Philippe Leroy, Vittorio Caprioli

title: Una villa per due
synopsis: Daniele (Neri Marcoré), an impeccable lawyer from Trento and devoted boyfriend, is having a house built on Lake Ledro for his beloved mother Marion (Giuliana Lojodice) but, the day he goes to the construction site to take over the building , the builder Francesco Ferrandini (Giampaolo Morelli) is forced to reveal the truth to him: the villa is not ready, due to some problems with suppliers and municipal obstructions by the councilor Marisa (Donatella Finocchiaro). What no one knows is that in the past Marisa and Daniele shared a brief and unspoken youthful love, which the two still harbor in secret.
cast: Neri Marcoré, Donatella Finocchiaro, Giuliana Lojodice, Giampaolo Morelli, Camilla Filippi, Selvaggia Quattrini, Stefano Santospago, Luciano Virgilio

title: Una vita da sballo
synopsis: Massimo (Claudio Daniele), twenty-year-old Neapolitan dancer who arrived in Rimini in search of fortune, makes friends with the DJ Franco (Alex Damiani), who hires him as a waiter and introduces him to his sister Rosaria (Cristina Barsacchi), with whom a sympathy is born . Through the "professor" (Alessandro Maresca), Franco manages to perform at the mixer in the "Pascià" disco, where he is noticed by the owner Sandra (Giovanna Chicco), whose lover he quickly becomes. Meanwhile Massimo demonstrates his talent by participating in the annual modern dance competition. But the great success achieved by both begins to create the first problems.
cast: Claudio Daniele, Alex Damiani, Cristina Barsacchi, Alessandro Maresca, Giovanna Chicco, Saverio Vallone, Silvie Pariset, Tania Oggero, Daniela Paganini, Angela Cocozza

title: Una vita da sogno
synopsis: Florentine Florentine Lorenzo works as a worker in his friend Marco Zhang, a Chinese entrepreneur who has lived in Italy and precursor of the art of Kung-fu practiced with a philosophical and spiritual sense for years. One evening, returning home with Marco's car, the randomness leads Lorenzo to meet Song Lee, a beautiful Chinese girl he falls immediately. Since neither has the courage to confess his true identity, Lorenzo does not realize that Song Lee is actually a prostitute nor tells her that she is not the rich man she believes. However, the lies of that evening lead to unexpected consequences when the protector of Song Lee decides to seize Lorenzo to profit from it.
cast: Alessandro Paci, Eugenia Tempesta, Massimo Ceccherini, Annarita Del Piano, Tim Man, Cristina Del Basso, Emanuele De Nicolò

title: Una vita difficile
synopsis: Silvio Magnozzi fought in the communist partisan formations; after the war he found himself working as a journalist. However, man does not accept compromises and his life faces economic and social obstacles of all kinds. For this reason, his wife decides to leave him until he is able to rise socially. To win her back, Silvio abandons his idealism and begins to work and humble himself in the pay of an industrialist. It is one of Sordi's memorable interpretations. Risi in one of his most successful films channels the typical Sordian character into the bitter meanders of a merciless portrait of Italy of reconstruction.
cast: Alberto Sordi, Lea Massari, Lina Volonghi, Franco Fabrizi, Claudio Gora

title: Una vita lunga un giorno
synopsis: In exchange for the sum to pay an expensive operation to the cardiopathic girlfriend, an unemployed sailor participates in the deadly game proposed to him by a billionaire.
cast: Mino Reitano, Ewa Aulin, Philippe Leroy, Eva Czemerys, Luciano Catenacci

title: Una vita non violenta

However, in several collaborations, Shen Yi has repeatedly cracked the "dead end" of cases with his "three-year-old painting", "drawing based on audio," "micro-color discrimination", and other stunts, which slowly started to impress Du Cheng. More importantly, the truth of Lei Yi Fei's death is still buried in Shen Yi's memory. On the way to find out the truth of Lei Yi Fei's life and death, the two people who were pursuing alone gradually untied their knots and relied on each other. After all, Christoph appears on the horizon, with whom he cannot help but fall in love. Theirs is a happy, different love based on mutual trust. Undine follows him on his dives in a reservoir but Christoph soon feels like she is hiding something from him. Once again, the ancient curse will break the spell.
cast: Paula Beer, Jacob Matschenz, Franz Rogowski, Maryam Zaree

title: Undir trénu
synopsis: A man is forced to return to his parents' house after his wife sends him away. As he struggles for custody of his four-year-old daughter, he gradually finds himself sucked into a dispute between his parents and their neighbors over a beautiful old tree casting shade on the wrong side.
cast: Steinþór Hróar Steinþórsson, Edda Björgvinsdóttir, Sigurður Sigurjónsson, Þorsteinn Bachmann, Selma Björnsdóttir, Lára Jóhanna Jónsdóttir

title: Undisputed
synopsis: George, heavyweight champion known as "Iceman", is jailed - according to him unfairly - on rape charges: he does not accept that he cannot defend the crown and his record of victories. In the penitentiary where he is transferred he meets Monroe, a light heavyweight who wonders if one day he will be able to fight him in the ring ...
cast: Fisher Stevens, Jon Seda, Peter Falk, Wesley Snipes, Ving Rhames

title: Undisputed II: Last Man Standing
synopsis: Heavyweight boxing champion George Chambers (Michael Jai White) is wrongfully arrested for heroin possession and taken to a Russian maximum security prison. Here he is involved in a round of fighting between prisoners and soon ends up clashing with Yuri Boyka (Scott Adkins), the reigning champion, considered by all to be the true and undisputed head of the prison
cast: Michael Jai White, Scott Adkins, Ben Cross, Eli Danker, Mark Ivanir, Ken Lerner, Daisy Lang, Silvio Simac, Ivaylo Geraskov, Valentin Ganev

title: Undisputed III : Redemption
synopsis: After the losing fight with George Chambers, inmate Yuri Boyka stopped fighting and devoted himself to his work in the prison. However, when a world tournament is organized among all the best fighters currently held, with freedom for the winner, Boyka resumes training and decides to participate.
cast: Scott Adkins, Marko Zaror, Mykel Shannon Jenkins, Lateef Crowder, Mark Ivanir, Hristo Shopov, Michael Baral, Ilram Choi, Robert Costanzo, Esteban Cueto

title: Undo
synopsis: Yukio and Moemi, a young couple, live in a small apartment. The woman develops a strange and obsessive mania for ropes and strings that lead her to tie and knot all the objects that surround her. The man soon realizes that something is wrong in his partner's mind and understands that Moemi's obsession with knots is nothing more than an attempt to indissolubly tie him to her.
cast: Etsushi Toyokawa, Tomoko Yamaguchi, Tomorowo Taguchi

title: Une Chambre en Ville
synopsis: In Nantes, in 1955, the shipyards went on strike. François, a worker who has rented a room from a colonel's widow, is approached one night by a woman, Edith, who drags him into overwhelming love. Edith, who is the widow's daughter, is married to a helpless and jealous man who cuts his throat in front of her. But the tragedy will also involve the other protagonists. Jacques Demy, a very unique director, has created the film on a story of unusual gloom for him, but the fact that it is entirely set to music and sung upset the drama and realism of the context in derision and breaks the emotion instead of sublimating it.
cast: Dominique Sanda, Richard Berry, Danielle Darrieux, Michel Piccoli, Fabienne Guyon, Anna Gaylor, Jean François Stévenin, Jean Louis Rolland

title: Une Estonienne à Paris
synopsis: Anne (Laine Mägi) leaves Estonia to move to Paris to take care of Frida (Jeanne Moreau), an elderly Estonian who has emigrated to France for a long time. Very soon Anne realizes that she is not welcome. All Frida wants from life is to have the attention of Stéphane (Patrick Pineau), her lover younger than her. Stéphane, on the other hand, wants Anne to stay and take care of Frida, even against her will. In the midst of a conflict between two strangers, Anne must find her way and decide what to do.
cast: Jeanne Moreau, Laine Mägi, Patrick Pineau, François Beukelaers, Ita Ever, Fabrice Colson, Corentin Lobet, Tõnu Mikiver, Helene Vannari, Ago Anderson, Piret Kalda

title: Une Fille facile
synopsis: Naïma has just turned 16 and over the course of the summer she has to decide what to do with her life. The arrival of her cousin Sofia, a twenty-two year old with a fantastic body and a fascinating lifestyle, will mark the beginning of days that she will hardly forget.
cast: Mina Farid, Zahia Dehar, Benoît Magimel, Clotilde Courau, Nuno Lopes, Lakdhar Dridi

title: Une Intime conviction
synopsis: Attending the trial of Jacques Viguier, accused of the murder of his wife, Nora is convinced of his innocence. Fearing a judicial error, he convinces the best lawyer on the square to defend him on appeal. As the times tighten, Nora embarks on a search for the truth that soon turns into an obsession.
cast: Marina Foïs, Olivier Gourmet, Laurent Lucas, Philippe Uchan, Jean Benguigui, Armande Boulanger, François Fehner, Arnaud Pépin

title: Une Vie Démente
synopsis: Suzanne, a woman who has passed the sixty, can no longer live alone. Her health conditions require someone who takes care of her: although he is physically fit, senile dementia began to take over the intellectual faculties of her. Alex and Noemie, a couple of lovers who are struggling with the arrival of the first child, will find themselves with the life completely upset for the disorder made by Suzanne, mother of him.
cast: Lucie Debay, Jo Deseure, Jean Le Peltier, Gilles Remiche

title: Une affaire d'hommes
cast: Claude Brasseur, Jean Louis Trintignant, Jean Paul Roussillon

title: Une affaire de goût
synopsis: In prison for who knows why, questioned for who knows what, the young Nicolas challenges the viewer to discover his secret and to follow his story. Hired by the billionaire Delamont as a taster, the boy discovers that he is destined for a very different end, plagiarized by the "guardian" to the point of assuming the same characteristics, even a similar physiognomy. The game of slaughter continues and Nicolas's head goes haywire.
cast: Bernard Giraudeau, Jean Pierre Lorit, Charles Berling, Jean Pierre Léaud

title: Une affaire privée
synopsis: Rachel has been missing for six months; private detective François is in charge of the investigation. The complex and multifaceted personality of the young woman is "revealed" by her best friend Clarissa, her ex-boyfriend, her stepfather, neighbors and all those who know her. Thus François finds himself frequenting Rachel's friends and acquaintances, penetrating deeply into her daily and nocturnal habits, until he gets stuck in the "lives of others" ...
cast: Thierry Lhermitte, Marion Cotillard, Samuel Le Bihan, Aurore Clément, Jeanne Balibar

title: Une aussi longue absence
synopsis: Thérèse Langlois has been alone since 1944, after the Germans unjustly arrested her husband. Sixteen years later, man reappears profoundly changed both in the physical and in the psyche: now he is nothing more than a vagabond without memory who barely survives. With infinite love and a unique spirit of sacrifice, Thérèse tries to win him back and heal him, enduring enormous efforts and bitter disappointments ...
cast: Alida Valli, Georges Wilson, Jacques Harden, Diane Lepvrier, Catherine Fonteney, Charles Blavette, Amédée, Paul Faivre, Pierre Parel

title: Une belle fille comme moi
synopsis: Criminologist with high professional hopes, but certainly not very awake in dealing with women, he has a new "object" of study: a refined killer. Of course, dealing with a "femme fatale" of such proportions, any man would succumb to the lure of passion. The criminologist is no exception, he falls in love with the murderer and ignores a not exactly secondary detail: he is the next victim of his beloved ...
cast: Bernadette Lafont, André Dussollier, Claude Brasseur

title: Une belle équipe
synopsis: After a quarrel, the entire Clourrières football team is suspended until the end of the season. In order to save the small club from the North that could disappear forever, the coach decides to form a team made up exclusively of women to complete the championship. The situation will forever change the lives of the families involved and the consolidated habits of the small local community.
cast: Kad Merad, Sabrina Ouazani, Céline Sallette, Laure Calamy, Alban Ivanov, Maëlle Genet, Kristina Dogolich, Marion Mezadorian

title: Une chance sur deux
synopsis: Twenty-year-old Alice has never had a father, her mother died recently and left her a cassette in which he reveals the truth: twenty years earlier, she had loved two men and one of them had made her pregnant, but she never knew who the "culprit" was ...
cast: Jean Paul Belmondo, Alain Delon, Vanessa Paradis, Eric Defosse

title: Une colonie
synopsis: Juggling between school and home, 12-year-old Mylia is going through a complicated period in her life. Everything in her life changes when she meets classmate Jimmy, a young boy from the nearby Abenaki reservation who encourages her to overcome the imposed limits.
cast: Emilie Bierre, Jacob Whiteduck Lavoie, Robin Aubert, Irlande Côté, Noémie Godin Vigneau, Cassandra Gosselin Pelletier

title: Une corde, un colt
synopsis: Rogers, a wealthy landowner, hangs Caine guilty of stealing gold in front of his wife Maria. She hires the ex-gunfighter Manuel, who manages to kidnap his daughter and demands a solemn funeral from Rogers to rehabilitate her husband. But the vendettas continue. "Spurious" Western of discreet workmanship but burdened by excessive formalisms.
cast: Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Guido Lollobrigida, Daniel Vargas, Serge Marquand, Pierre Hatet, Philippe Baronnet, Pierre Collet

title: Une dimanche à la campagne
synopsis: Ladmiral, an elderly painter who never achieved stardom, lives, we are in 1912, with a housekeeper in his country house not far from Paris. It's Sunday and their son Gonzague, daughter-in-law and their three children arrive by train. They will spend the whole day with their father, between an excellent lunch and a walk waiting for Irene, the painter's youngest daughter.
cast: Louis Ducreux, Sabine Azéma, Michel Aumont, Geneviève Mnich

title: Une famille à louer
synopsis: Paul-André has many things. A luxurious house, a trendy car and a butler at his service, however, are not enough to break his boredom and his loneliness. Disillusioned businessman, Paul-André decides to treat himself to a family for three months, offering to pay all the debts to Violette, an overprotective mother of two children. In return, Violette will have to host him for three months in her home and make him discover the joys of family life.
cast: Benoît Poelvoorde, Virginie Efira, François Morel, Edith Scob, Nancy Tate, Yvonne Gradelet, Pauline Serieys, Stéphanie Bataille, Xavier Mathieu, Gaelle Jeantet

title: Une femme d'honneur: Droit de garde
synopsis: Udo Walmer lives in Cologne with his son Julien and, when the boy's grandmother dies, he is forced to travel to France to allow him to attend the funeral. After the two spend the night in the house of the deceased, in the morning of Julien there is no trace and Udo is found in a coma. Commissioner Isabelle Florent is investigating the matter and the first suspicions seem to fall on the young man's mother, to whom the court has always denied custody.
cast: Corinne Touzet, Romaric Perche, Franck Capillery, Pierre Marie Escourrou, Pierre Deny, Xavier Clément, Blanche Raynal, Nathalie Roussel, Didier Bienaimé, Olivier Morancais

title: Une femme d'honneur: Mort programmée
synopsis: Nurse Camille Deleuze comes out of the prison where she spent the last years of her life for helping her father die in dignity. With the intention of recovering as soon as possible the relationship with her son Mathieu entrusted to a foster home, Camille needs a new job and Dr. Guy Morel tries to help her by proposing to nurse Louis Guéret, who is ill with cancer. Soon, Louis asks Camille to help him die but she refuses to comply with his request. When Louis is found dead from a lethal dose of morphine the next day, Camille is the number one suspect but Commander Isabelle Florent's investigation will shed new light on the murder.
cast: Corinne Touzet, Franck Capillery, Blanche Raynal, Pierre Marie Escourrou, Romaric Perche, Xavier Clément, Luce Mouchel, Marc Rioufol, Marina Golovine, Geoffrey Sauveaux, Louis Schmitt

title: Une femme d'honneur: Sans mobile apparent
synopsis: Isabelle Florent is commissioned to investigate the murder of Michel Deniau, the manager of a swimming pool installation company when she remembers a very similar old case she dealt with years ago ...
cast: Corinne Touzet, Romaric Perche, Franck Capillery, Pierre Marie Escourrou, Pierre Deny, Xavier Clément, Blanche Raynal, Maka Sidibe, Philippe Magnan, Marc Berman

title: Une femme douce
synopsis: A woman (Sanda) flies out of a window. In front of the corpse reassembled on the wedding bed, the husband wonders why and goes back with his memory. Think back to the first time they met (at the pawnshop), the marriage, his passion as mad as his jealousy, the time she tried to kill him, her final submission. If you think this is a flamboyant and passionate story, full of twists and turns and extreme feelings, you can see that you have never seen a Bresson film (which here, in adapting Dostoevsky's "La mite", does not allow its characters not even a proper name). But it means that you have never seen the Sanda either, so cold, so sweet. A masterpiece.
cast: Dominique Sanda, Guy Frangin, Jane Lobre, Dorothée Blank

title: Une femme est une femme
synopsis: Angela (Karina), a young Danish stripper who works in a Parisian club, would like a child with her partner, Emilio (Brialy), but he fears a marriage trap and disagrees. Indeed, he suggests that she take Alfredo (Belmondo) as an occasional partner, who is in love with Angela. Said and done, but then Emilio is moved and decides to stay by the woman's side forever. One of the most captivating "chapters" in Godard's filmography, as creative in the narrative form as it is insightful in the analysis of characters and situations. The participation of the performers was excellent, especially the charming Anna Karina.
cast: Anna Karina, Jean Claude Brialy, Jean Paul Belmondo

title: Une femme française
synopsis: Jeanne is beautiful, seductive, restless and in love with the idea of ??passion and amorous disturbance. She systematically betrays her overly patient husband, who is constantly kept away from home by his military career; and he does so mainly out of vanity, weakness and curiosity. The Second World War, the ruins of Berlin, the Indochina War, the missions in the Middle East mark the passage of time while Jeanne, always equal to herself, collects lovers and adventures.
cast: Emmanuelle Béart, Daniel Auteuil, Gabriel Barylli, Jean Claude Brialy

title: Une femme mariée
cast: Macha Meril, Bernard Noël, Philippe Leroy, Roger Leenhardt

title: Une femme à sa fenêtre
synopsis: After the coup of General Metaxas in 1936, a heavy repression is underway in Greece. Margot (Romy Schneider) is the wife of the Marquis Santorini (Umberto Orsini), secretary of the Italian embassy, ??and ignores the drama of the country until, one night, she finds in her hotel room Michel (Victor Lanoux), a communist hunted by the police. Margot falls in love with him and makes him run away.The screenwriter is the communist Jorge Semprun who worked on the book by the fascist Drieu La Rochelle. The result is weak, but Romy Schneider redeems the inconveniences of the script.
cast: Romy Schneider, Umberto Orsini, Philippe Noiret, Victor Lanoux, Gastone Moschin, Joachim Hansen, Carl Möhner

title: Une fille et des fusils
synopsis: Four men, tired of the worker's wretched life, improvise as gangsters and kidnap a novice actress, thinking of a lavish ransom. But the production of the film in which she is acting uses the situation to advertise the film. Eventually the girl will be freed and the "four machine guns" will return to a normal life.
cast: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Pierre Barouh, Amidou, Jacques Portet

title: Une heure de tranquillité
synopsis: Michel, a jazz enthusiast, has just found a rare album and dreams of listening to it sitting quietly in his living room. The world, however, seems to conspire against him: his wife has chosen that moment to make him an unwelcome revelation, the son suddenly swoops into the house, a friend knocks on the door and the mother does not stop calling him on his cell phone, let alone talk. of the fact that that is also the day of the famous 'neighbor's party'. Manipulator and liar, Michel will be ready to do anything to have some peace.
cast: Christian Clavier, Rossy De Palma, Valérie Bonneton, Carole Bouquet, Stéphane De Groodt, Sébastien Castro

title: Une hirondelle a fait le printemps
synopsis: Sandrine tries to escape the stress of city life and her job as a computer expert. Her dream is to become a farmer and take possession of a farm in Vercos. Adrien, an old farmer, is determined to sell his property, but not to pass on everything he has learned to Sandrine, much less to give him a hand. Despite the initial difficulties between the two, a deep feeling of friendship will break out.
cast: Mathilde Seigner, Michel Serrault, Jean Paul Roussillon, Frédéric Pierrot

title: Une histoire d'amour et de desir
synopsis: Ahmed, an eighteen year old French of Algerian origin, grew up on the outskirts of Paris. At the University he has the opportunity to meet Farah, a young Tunisian who has just arrived in the French capital. As he discovers a corpus of erotic and sensual Arab literature that he would never have imagined. Ahmed falls madly in love with Farah. Although he is literally overwhelmed by desire, Ahmed will try to resist him.
cast: Sami Outalbali, Zbeida Belhajamor, Diong Kéba Tacu, Aurélia Petit, Mahia Zrouki, Bellamine Abdelmalek, Mathilde La Musse

title: Une histoire de vent
synopsis: Old Joris is ninety years old, many of whom spent traveling the world making documentaries. Now he is in Mongolia, determined to film the wind that rises (must rise) over the desert. Lyrical and meditative visual poem, it is the spiritual testament of the ninety-year-old director.
cast: Joris Ivens, Fu Dalin, Han Zenkiang, Liu Guilian, Liu Zhuang

title: Une histoire immortelle
synopsis: Macau, 19th century: lonely and exclusively in love with money, the elderly merchant Clay sets out to demonstrate its infinite power. To this end, he plans to materialize a legend that tells of a wealthy gentleman who "hires" a sailor to spend a night with his wife, giving him an heir. Clay then instructs his accountant Levinsky to engage the protagonists of the staging, which is destined, however, to an unexpected and bitter ending.
cast: Orson Welles, Jeanne Moreau, Roger Coggio, Norman Eshley

title: Une histoire simple
cast: Romy Schneider, Bruno Cremer, Claude Brasseur, Arlette Bonnard, Vera Schroeder, Francine Bergé, Sophie Daumier, Eva Darlan

title: Une jeune fille qui va bien
synopsis: Paris, summer 1942. Irene is a young Jewish who is experiencing the momentum of his 19 years. The family observes her while she discovers the world, friendship, a new love and passion for theater. Irene wishes to become an actress and her days spend in the name of the light -heartedness typical of those who are his age. However, he does not know that the time at his disposal is already about to expire.
cast: Rebecca Marder, India Hair, André Marcon, Anthony Bajon, Ben Attal, Lucie Gallo, Florence Viala, Jean Chevalier, Cyril Metzger, Françoise Widhoff

title: Une journée bien remplie
synopsis: While his old father takes his place in the work of baking bread and in the shop, Jean, a gentle baker in his fifties, kills one by one all the nine jurors who have unjustly sent his son Fernand to the gallows.
cast: Jacques Dufilho, André Falcon, Denise Péron, Antoine Marin, Luce Marquand, Franco Pesce, Andrée Bernard, Louis Malignon, Vittorio Caprioli

title: Une liaison pornographique
synopsis: A man and a woman, with no name, no identity, no past. A bar where they meet every Thursday. Chat, coffee, cognac. They are the faint signs of a pornographic relationship, upset and canceled by an unexpected and uninvited love. The ghost that brings them together remains unclear, secret, even when the relationship is over. Only the memory of an unlived love remains. The characters confess to a witness (a journalist, the director himself?). With silences, inaccuracies, amazements, sadness they rework the banal exceptionality of their adventure of senses, feelings and too many words.
cast: Nathalie Baye, Sergi López, Jacques Viala, Paul Pavel

title: Une mauvaise Mere
synopsis: Judith and Lionel, a couple who already have a daughter of their own, adopted Mina from Ethiopia. Although she was abandoned as a child, Mina doesn't seem to have had any psychological consequences from it. At thirteen, however, he has a profound identity crisis: hovering between two different worlds, he doesn't feel at home anywhere. Thus began a growing destructive spiral for her: jealous of her sister, she began to engage in harmful behaviors towards her family. Judith and Lionel no longer know what to do: perhaps their parental love will not be enough to heal the wounds of Mina's soul.
cast: Barbara Schulz, Thierry Godard, Jessyrielle Massengo, Ariane Massenet, Sophie Breyer, Luce Mouchel

title: Une nouvelle amie
synopsis: Claire and Léa have been through ups and downs since childhood. Things don't change even when both young women get married and Léa becomes a mother. Shortly after giving birth, Léa becomes seriously ill and on her deathbed asks her friend to take care of her family and her husband David. After Léa's death, Claire searches for the man and discovers a long-kept secret: she loves wearing women's clothes and has also chosen Virginia as her name.
cast: Romain Duris, Anaïs Demoustier, Raphaël Personnaz, Isild Le Besco, Aurore Clément, Jean Claude Bolle Reddat

title: Une nouvelle vie
synopsis: After the death of her mother, Tina, a young saleswoman at the supermarket and close to marriage, sets out in search of the father she never met. Instead, he will find a stepsister, Lisa ...
cast: Sophie Aubry, Judith Godrèche, Bernard Giraudeau, Philippe Torreton, Nelly Borgeaud

title: Une nuit
synopsis: Simon Weiss is a policeman of the Mondaine brigade who specializes in supervising the night activities of the city of Paris. What surrounds him, however, is a world in which he finds himself increasingly isolated due to a lawyer, who for his interests does not hesitate to exploit Simon's best friend, and a young agent, who traps him after a long night of underground guerrilla warfare to save his wife and child.
cast: Roschdy Zem, Sara Forestier, Samuel Le Bihan, Grégory Fitoussi, Jean Pierre Martins, Sophie Broustal, Richard Bohringer, Magloire

title: Une partie de plaisir
synopsis: Chronicle of the gradual collapse of the marriage of Philippe and Esther, an initially happy high-bourgeois couple with a young daughter. All is well, but he is obsessed with sexual freedom, and he is so convinced and exalted that he pushes his wife to practice it in turn and betray him. But then he feels a fierce and unexpected jealousy that leads to terrible consequences.
cast: Paul Gégauff, Danièle Gégauff, Clemence Gégauff, Paula Moore

title: Une place parmi les vivants
synopsis: A serial killer spreads terror in the northern districts of Paris, killing many women. Joseph Arcimboldo, an insignificant man who accuses himself of the crimes, proposes to Ernest Ripper, a third-rate writer, to write his biography.
cast: Christian Vadim, Thierry Gibaut, Valérie Kaprisky, Cécile Bois, Julie Judd, Jacques Pieiller, Denis Karvil, Don Condurache, Tomi Cristian, Vlad Ivanov, Monalisa Basarab, Lucia Muresan, Lamia Beligan, Antoine Burret

title: Une place sur la Terre
synopsis: Antoine, happily disillusioned photographer, has Matèo as his only friend, the young son of his often absent neighbor, to whom he gives an imaginative education. One morning, the piano notes coming from the building opposite capture the attention of Antoine, who ignores that the student Elena is playing. With her idealistic and uncompromising attitude, Elena will be the one who will forever change the rest of Antoine's life, allowing him to finally find his place on earth.
cast: Benoît Poelvoorde, Ariane Labed, Max Baissette De Malglaive, Olivier Bonjour, Thomas Coumans, Brigitte Sy, Jacques Spiesser, Catherine Demaiffe, Jean Jacques Rausin, Marie Armelle Deguy

title: Une pour toutes
synopsis: Three good-looking actresses, who haven't made it to the ground, come up with a brilliant money-making ploy: they lure the wealthy passengers of the Concorde and seduce them. Commissioner Bayard learns of the scam and thinks well of making a film of it, which he proposes to a convicted director ...
cast: Jean Pierre Marielle, Anne Parillaud, Marianne Denicourt, Alessandra Martines, Alice Evans, Olivia Bonamy, Samy Naceri

title: Une promesse
synopsis: Germany, 1912. Ludwig (Richard Madden), a young graduate of humble origins, works in a steel factory. Impressed by his industriousness, the elderly owner (Alan Rickman) hires him as his personal secretary. Weak and ill, the owner lives confined to his house, where Ludwig also moves. Falling madly in love with his young, beautiful and reserved wife (Rebecca Hall) of the elder, Ludwig does not dare to reveal his feelings to anyone until the day he has to leave to take care of the mines in Mexico. Faced with the idea of ??distance, the young wife also reveals her secret love to him, promising that she will leave her husband as soon as he returns home after 2 years of overseas stay. From that moment on, a dense correspondence of passionate letters begins waiting for the day of the meeting to arrive but, when everything seems to be approaching, the outbreak of the First World War requires another postponement that will put their feelings to the test.
cast: Richard Madden, Rebecca Hall, Alan Rickman, Shannon Tarbet, Jonathan Sawdon, Maggie Steed, Toby Murray, Jean Louis Sbille

title: Une ravissante idiote
synopsis: Harry Compton wants to avenge capitalism by offering his services to Soviet espionage. He receives the task of stealing a dossier, which in reality hides a trap. He falls in love with the hairdresser Penelope and, with her help, manages, despite everything, to fulfill the task.
cast: Anthony Perkins, Brigitte Bardot, Gregoire Aslan, Denise Provence, Jean Marc Tennberg, Hans Verner, Jacques Monod

title: Une rencontre
synopsis: Pierre has been married for fifteen years and is the father of a family. Still in love with his wife and satisfied with his family life, he is a happy man. One evening, Pierre meets Elsa and the two talk, laugh and have fun. Fifteen days later, the case brings them together again but, while admitting their mutual attraction, Pierre and Elsa remain faithful to their convictions: for Elsa married men are a taboo and for Pierre the bond with his wife is more important. By separating without even exchanging phone numbers, they prefer to let life take its course. Between what they think of their history and what actually happens, however, there are many fantasies in between that alter reality.
cast: Sophie Marceau, François Cluzet, Teresa Mahoney, Emily Butterfield, Simon DeSilva, Stuart Matthews, Sophie Baignères, Toby Osmond, Sébastien Deux, David Broughton Davies

title: Une semaine de vacances
synopsis: The week is the one prescribed to Laurence, apparently in an inexplicable crisis with respect to her teaching job. Intimate and subdued chronicle of a reflection on the meaning of one's own existence, with a realist and poetic cinema tone of the Popular Front. The actors are very talented and well directed.
cast: Nathalie Baye, Gérard Lanvin

title: Une si jolie petite plage
cast: Madeleine Robinson, Gérard Philipe, Jean Servais, André Valmy

title: Une sirène à Paris
synopsis: Heartbroken singer. Gaspard has sworn never to fall in love again. Lula, a beautiful mermaid, has only the song to defend herself from men. Due to a flood of the river Seine, Lula arrives in front of the Flowerburger, the cabaret in which Gaspard performs. For both of them, it will be the beginning of a whirlwind of unexpected emotions.
cast: Nicolas Duvauchelle, Marilyn Lima, Tchéky Karyo, Rossy De Palma, Romane Bohringer, Alexis Michalik, Lou Gala, Nicolas Ullmann

title: Une vie
synopsis: Normandy, 1819. Jeanne Le Perthuis des Vauds, a young woman who is too protected and full of childhood dreams, leaves the convent where she was educated and marries Julien de Lamare. The man will soon prove brutal, stingy and fickle but Jeanne's illusions will gradually take off.
cast: Judith Chemla, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Yolande Moreau, Swann Arlaud, Nina Meurisse, Finnegan Oldfield, Clotilde Hesme, Alain Beigel

title: Une vie de chat
synopsis: The cat Dino lives a double life. During the day he is the docile and lovable kitten who keeps company with Zoe, a six-year-old girl. At night, however, he goes on raids on the rooftops with Nico, a gentleman thief. But Zoe, whose mother works for the police, has a trauma: she hasn't spoken since her father, also a policeman, died by a terrible criminal, Victor Costa. It will be Dino's nocturnal visits to allow Zoe to discover a track that will lead to the terrible Victor.

title: Une vie meilleure
synopsis: Yann is a qualified chef from years of study but cannot find work in Paris restaurants due to a lack of practical experience in the sector. During yet another job interview, he meets Nadia, a single mother of Franco-Algerian origins, with whom he falls in love. Yann, Nadia and their son Slimane form a perfect family but, to pursue his dream, Yann takes a loan from a bank to buy an abandoned building near a lake and turn it into a restaurant, thus compromising both his economic situation and his his love life due to the impossibility of repaying the debt contracted, so much so that Nadia, accepting a job in Montreal, decides to leave, leaving him alone to grapple with Slimane's growth.
cast: Guillaume Canet, Leïla Bekhti, Slimane Khettabi

title: Une vie violente

Against this state of affairs some men, gathered in the Gaps, try to oppose, preparing attacks, placing bombs and trying to prevent the enemies from reorganizing. Not an easy task, of course. Especially since these men and women have their own private life that can sometimes collide with their collective commitment.
cast: Flavio Bucci, Monica Guerritore, Ivana Monti, Renato Scarpa

title: Uomini e nobiluomini
synopsis: A penniless noble "Count Max" style cultivates a dream: to marry his daughter to an aristocrat and thus regain the ancient lineage. Too bad that the daughter does not want to know, and is well determined to get married with a penniless. When the nobleman discovers the truth, he makes up for it in another way. He marries a rich lady.
cast: Vittorio De Sica, Antonio Cifariello, Mario Carotenuto, Silvia Pinal, Raffaele Pisu, Alberto Talegalli, Elke Sommer, Marco Tulli, Maria Grazia Spina, Tiberio Murgia

title: Uomini ombra
synopsis: During the Second World War, a group of men from the Italian naval counterintelligence waged a long-distance fight with colleagues in the British Intelligence. The British try to make our "shadow men" fall into a trap but are mocked; In turn, the spies who escaped the trap dismantle the information network of the enemies and their base.
cast: Mara Lane, Giorgio Albertazzi, Eduardo Cianelli

title: Uomini senza donne
synopsis: Alex is a copywriter in an advertising agency. He is handsome, athletic, and surrounded by a bevy of girls in love with him; but he has eyes only for Eleonora, who instead denies him. Max plays the saxophone, is shy, drinks beer, smokes cigars and marijuana. What unites them in any case is unhappiness in relationships with the other sex.
cast: Alessandro Gassmann, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Alessandra Acciai, Veronica Logan

title: Uomini si nasce poliziotti si muore
synopsis: Alfredo and Antonio are the spearheads of a special police brigade that fights the underworld on equal terms. Free from any legal constraint and with license to kill, the two act with ruthlessness covered by their leader. Things get complicated when the two begin to hunt down a very ferocious criminal, the gambler Roberto Pasquini, who dominates Rome with connivance in every sector of the underworld.
cast: Marc Porel, Ray Lovelock, Adolfo Celi, Franco Citti, Silvia Dionisio, Renato Salvatori

title: Uomini sul fondo
synopsis: During a navy exercise, a submarine hits a cargo ship in the port of La Spezia and sinks. It will take the courage of a sailor and a new technical trick to be able to save the crew.
cast: Attori Non Professionisti

title: Uomini sull'orlo di una crisi di nervi
synopsis: Vincenzo, Gianni, Nicola and Pino are four friends who have been meeting every Monday to play poker for years. But this time Nicola is in crisis with his wife. The evening is ruined, but Pino has an idea. Why not invite a "ring"?
cast: Pino Ammendola, Vincenzo Crocitti, Gianni Garofalo, Claudia Koll

title: Uomini uomini uomini
synopsis: An architect, a film producer, a tailor and an orthopedist, all gay, form a quartet of close-knit friends who spend most of their time together. Everyone has some problem in interpersonal relationships (in the family and / or outside) which sometimes provoke real crises. The tailor's mother dies, who moves to New York, the orthopedist dies of a heart attack ... Christian De Sica, when he gets behind the camera, seems convinced that he is facing important problems. And maybe it is. It is a pity, however, that his films are systematically a disconcerting banality. To say the least.
cast: Christian De Sica, Massimo Ghini, Leo Gullotta, Alessandro Haber

title: Uomo avvisato mezzo ammazzato... parola di Spirito Santo
synopsis: The infallible gunslinger Holy Spirit tries to take over a gold mine. To succeed, he must ally himself with a group of revolutionaries who try to overthrow a cruel dictator: only their leader, in fact, knows the exact location of the mine. Among all kinds of pitfalls he will succeed in his intent thanks also to the strong friend with the indicative nickname Carezza. Comic Western that takes advantage of the success of Trinity and makes fun of the political westerns that were fashionable a few years earlier. Among the performers also Paolo Gozlino, one of the most famous Italian dancers and set designers, masked with the Anglicizing pseudonym Paul Stevens.
cast: Gianni Garko, Pilar Velasquez, Paolo Gozlino

title: Uomo d'acqua dolce
synopsis: A young married couple, Antonio and Beatrice live their lives on the outskirts of Milan. He is a history teacher, while she gives private lessons to the neighborhood children. The two love each other and have been together since childhood. Beatrice is pregnant and Antonio is very apprehensive. One day Beatrice gets a terrible craving for mushrooms in oil, which forces Antonio to go to the supermarket. Here Antonio has an inciednete and loses his memory. Like "La Linea" of the well-known brand of pressure cookers, Albanese's cartoon moves madly within its implosive comedy. Piovani's soundtrack follows the comic as Henry Mancini followed the Pink Panther, the script is ambitious, the direction hastily cordial.
cast: Antonio Albanese, Valeria Milillo, Antonio Petrocelli, Sara Anticoli

title: Uova di garofano
synopsis: Silvano goes with his little son to the old abandoned country cottage, where he spent his childhood and begins to remember the joys and pains of family life, in the background the last years of fascism, the Second World War and the partisan struggles. He remembers his visits to old Crimen, a strange character who insisted on living in isolation and whose wife he was said to have killed and eaten. He remembers the episode of his death and his escape to the mountains.
cast: Federico Zanola, Elisa Murolo, Lou Castel, Alain Cuny

title: Uova fatali
synopsis: 1920s. A Russian scientist conducts animal experiments; he thus discovers a ray capable of multiplying and magnifying tadpoles, creating very strong frogs. The contemporary death of sick hens pushes him to try to replicate these animals too, but something goes wrong.
cast: Gastone Moschin, Santo Versace, Alessandro Haber, Wilma D'Eusebio, Bruno Alessandro, Franco Bergasio, Toni Bertorelli, Daria Bonello, Mario Brusa, Alfredo Dari

title: Up
synopsis: A story from the past that tells the adventures of Carl Fredricksen, a sprightly seventy-year-old. After having dreamed of traveling the world for a lifetime, he will find himself fulfilling his wish in the company of a small, but persistent, eight-year-old boy scout. The bizarre couple, aboard Carl's old cottage transformed by thousands of colorful balloons into a cheerful airship, will fly over the globe and will have to face monsters and villains of all kinds.

title: Up & Down - Un film normale
synopsis: What does it mean to be normal? What characteristics exactly should we have to define ourselves that way? Five actors with Down's Syndrome and one with autism are accompanied on a year-long journey by their friend Paolo Ruffini. Theirs is the story of a dream that turns into an adventure, the story of a theater company that wants to accomplish a "normal" enterprise: to create a great show - incorrect, hilarious, irreverent - and take it on tour in the most prestigious theaters of Italy. Federico, Andrea, Erika, Giacomo, Simone and David are the protagonists of this enterprise, they are the "wrong" super heroes with the unconscious ability to accomplish the impossible.
cast: Paolo Ruffini, Lamberto Giannini, Erika Bonura, Simone Cavaleri, Andrea Lo Schiavo, Federico Parlanti, David Raspi, Giacomo Scarno

title: Up Among The Stars
synopsis: A grieving filmmaker struggling to keep custody of his young son after his wife's death uses magical, imaginary stories to maintain their bond.
cast: Luis Callejo, Jorge Andreu, Macarena Gómez, Magüi Mira, Álvaro Roig, María Morales, José Luis García Pérez, Kiti Mánver, Ingrid García Jonsson, Liz Lobato

title: Up Close & Personal
synopsis: Anchor-woman Telly Atwater is one of the most loved women in the United States. Yet not long ago Tally had been a waitress and had also worked at the craps table at a casino in Reno, Nevada. In those days she called herself Sallyanne, she had a lot of ambitions and a talent about to blossom. Warren noticed her, a brilliant television journalist, who quickly became her protector and lover. Thus the inexperienced Sallyanne transforms herself from the "weather girl" of a provincial network into the attractive Tally Atwater. Yet it is their work that threatens to divide them. Classic vehicle for stars: Redford defends herself with her profession and Michelle Pfeiffer with beauty married to skill. Valgano - for the record - the following data: fifty minutes to have the first kiss, eighty-five to get married, one hundred to quarrel, one hundred twenty-two to regret.
cast: Robert Redford, Michelle Pfeiffer, Stockard Channing, Joe Mantegna, Kate Nelligan

title: Up North
synopsis: A pampered heir must complete a year of service work to inherit his dad's assets but unearths new goals when he's placed in an unfamiliar region.
cast: Banky Wellington, Rahama Sadau, Kanayo O. Kanayo, Ibrahim Suleiman, Michelle Dede, Adesua Etomi, Hilda Dokubo, Akin Lewis

title: Up Periscope
synopsis: During the Second World War, an American submarine lands Second Lieutenant Ken Braden on an island occupied by the Japanese, where the officer will have to get hold of the secret cipher of the enemy fleet. During the voyage Braden and the commander of the submarine have an altercation that threatens to jeopardize the already difficult balance between the crew and the cockpit.
cast: James Garner, Edmond O'Brien, Andra Martin, Alan Hale Jr.

title: Up at the Villa
synopsis: In Florence, at the end of the Thirties, a community of Anglo-Americans experienced the arrival of the war amid parties and gossip. Among them is Mary Panton, a beautiful widow whom her husband left in poverty, a guest of the princess of San Ferdinando. The woman is joined by her mature suitor, but the encounter with an American playboy and a night of love with an Austrian refugee change her plans.
cast: Kristin Scott Thomas, Sean Penn, Anne Bancroft, James Fox

title: Up in Arms
cast: Danny Kaye, Dana Andrews, Costance Dowling, Dinah Shore, Margaret Dumont

title: Up in Smoke
synopsis: The journey of two hippies driving a marijuana truck from Los Angeles to the Mexican border.
cast: Cheech Marin, Tommy Chong, Strother Martin, Edie Adams, Harold Fong, Richard Novo, Jane Moder, Pam Bille, Arthur Roberts, Marian Beeler

title: Up in the Air
synopsis: Ryan Bingham flies around the country firing employees on behalf of companies, but he faces losing the job he savors to recent college grad Natalie.
cast: George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick, Jason Bateman, Amy Morton, Melanie Lynskey, J.K. Simmons, Sam Elliott, Danny McBride, Zach Galifianakis, Chris Lowell

title: Up the Creek
synopsis: Some American and Canadian colleges decide to challenge each other in single combat: a rafting race through the rapids of a winding river. During the competition the boys combine all the colors and also have time to think about the girls.
cast: Tim Matheson, John Hillerman, Jennifer Runyon

title: Up the Down Staircase
synopsis: The difficulties, disappointments and betrayals of a young American high school teacher in contact with difficult children. Sandy Dennis, so young, alone saves the film, which is an honest social drama from specialist Mulligan.
cast: Sandy Dennis, Patrick Bedford, Eileen Heckart, Ruth White

title: Up!
synopsis: The sad fate of Adolf Schwarz, "killed" by a ravenous piranha, is consummated in a pseudo-Bavarian-style manor. But who really is the breasted Margo Winchester, whose arrival has turned the local males upside down?
cast: Edward Schaaf, Raven De La Croix, Monty Bane, Janet Wood, Robert McLane, Candy Samples, Su Ling, Linda Sue Ragsdale, Marianne Marks, Bob Schott, Foxy Lae, Elaine Collins, Ray Reinhardt, Kitten Natividad

title: Upgrade
synopsis: Gray Trace, a technophobe living in a dystopian future where computers control almost everything, is paralyzed during an anomalous robbery in which his wife loses her life. When a billionaire technologist offers him the chance to undergo an experimental cure for paralysis, Gray accepts and finds himself grappling with Stem, an implanted microchip with a voice and mind of its own. Together, Gray and Stem embark on a mission to obtain revenge against the perpetrators of the attack.
cast: Logan Marshall Green, Betty Gabriel, Harrison Gilbertson, Christopher Kirby, Clayton Jacobson, Melanie Vallejo, Benedict Hardie, Sachin Joab, Richard Cawthorne, Michael M. Foster

title: Upin & Ipin
synopsis: Two mischievous yet lovable five-year-old twins and their friends enjoy daily life and new discoveries with the residents of their Malaysian village.
cast: Nurfathiah Diaz

title: Uppena
synopsis: The son of a fishing community falls for a village head's daughter, but they face violent opposition from the girl’s doggedly old-fashioned father.
cast: Panja Vaisshnav Tej, Krithi Shetty, Vijay Sethupathi

title: Upperseven. L'uomo da uccidere
synopsis: Criminal organization serving the Communist bloc wants to sabotage American peacekeeping in Africa. To settle things, flying from Switzerland to Denmark, from Rome to South Africa, there is a beautiful blonde from the CIA and the British agent Upperseven, very skilled in dressing up. Penoso 007 local, written and directed by Alberto De Martino.
cast: Paul Hubschmid, Karin Dor, Vivi Bach

title: Uppity: The Willy T. Ribbs Story
synopsis: This documentary profiles a defiant driver who challenged racial barriers in American auto racing, becoming the first black man to race in the Indy 500.
cast: Willy T. Ribbs

title: Uprising
synopsis: 1939: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, 350,000 Polish Jews are killed by starvation and disease in the Warsaw ghetto. Mordechai and Yitzhak, both teachers, organize the Jewish resistance by founding the Jewish Fighting Organization. In 1943, they will lead about two hundred boys and children in an uneven fight with artisanal weapons against Hitler's troops, managing to resist for several months.
cast: Leelee Sobieski, Hank Azaria, David Schwimmer, Jon Voight

title: Upside Down
synopsis: Adam (Jim Sturgess) and Eden (Kirsten Dunst) met as children in a parallel dimension adjacent to ours, a sort of reflected world whose peculiarity is to be turned upside down, due to a force of gravity reversed with respect to the earth. From the moment of separation, despite having continuous relationships with other women, Adam has been unable to forget that strong and crazy love and, when he thinks he is seeing Eden again on TV, he does everything to meet her again and reunite with her, defying every law of science and nature.
cast: Kirsten Dunst, Jim Sturgess, Heidi Hawkins, Larry Day, Timothy Spall, John Maclaren, Holly O'Brien, Don Jordan, James Kidnie, Neil Napier, Vincent Messina

title: Upside Down: The Creation Records Story
Upstarts
synopsis: Hoping to do good while making millions, three college graduates create a startup. But as business begins to flourish, their own bond starts to fray.
cast: Priyanshu Painyuli, Chandrachoor Rai, Shadab Kamal, Rajeev Siddhartha, Sheetal Thakur, Ninad Kamat, Swati Semwal, Eijaz Khan

title: Upstream Color
synopsis: Kris, an art dealer of sorts, went off the rails of her life when she was drugged by a group of thieves, amateur scientists who enjoy playing with plants, finding narcoleptic elixirs and picking up larvae to insert into victims' bodies. . Trapped in a world that has become too big for her to face, along the way she will find solace in Jeff, a man consumed by even greater strength. As a refuge for each other, the two will fight to piece together the fragments of their shattered lives.
cast: Amy Seimetz, Shane Carruth, Andrew Sensenig, Thiago Martins, Juli Erickson, Ted Ferguson, Frank Mosley, Charles Reynolds, Kerry McCormick, Karen Jagger, Jack Watkins, Jeff Fenter, Cody Pottkotter

title: Uptown Girls
synopsis: Molly Gunn, the daughter of a rock legend, is forced to find a job when her father's manager seizes her inheritance. She then becomes Ray's nanny, a very precocious eight-year-old girl, the ignored daughter of a record company. The adventures of the two girls begin and find themselves having to solve several problems.
cast: Carmen Electra, Brittany Murphy, Dakota Fanning, Heather Locklear, Jesse Spencer, Donald Faison, Marley Shelton

title: Upworld
synopsis: It is difficult to imagine that a gnome, with supernatural powers and who hates criminals and the violent, cares about how things are in the human world. However, it happens to a nice policeman who receives more than valid help from the gnome to solve a difficult case. But when he reveals the truth, no one believes him.
cast: Anthony Michael Hall, Jerry Orbach, Claudia Christian, Eli Danker

title: Uranya
synopsis: In a small Greek village, five children are preparing to grow up and discover the world. Around them is the Greece of the colonels: a regime of oppressive semi-tyranny. But the summer of 1969 will be a defining moment in the lives of the five little friends as they enter adolescence. The central figure of their first erotic dreams is Uranya, a beautiful woman (Cucinotta) who lives just outside the town, near the sea. The guys take an oath: they will save their money together so that they can offer it to the woman in exchange for the first, dreamed of relationship. But it is 1969 and humanity is preparing to land on the Moon: buying a black and white television to be able to witness the epic moment is a very strong temptation for everyone, especially for Achilles - the smartest of the five -, who is enchanted by the flight and the conquest of space. So what will be the best expense in which to invest the small capital?
cast: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Dimitris Piatas, Tassos Palatzidis, Fotini Baxevani, Taxiarhis Hanos, Manolis Mavromatakis, Dina Michaelidi, Maria Antoulinaki, Maria Filippou, Stelios Iakovidis

title: Urban Cowboy
synopsis: Bud is a country boy who has found a job in Houston. In a famous club, "Gilley's", he makes a name for himself as a rodeo champion on a mechanical bull. He marries Sissy, but things change due to a rivalry between the two, to which the mechanical bull is no stranger. At first it ends in divorce, but, after other misadventures in which their respective new partners are also involved, everything falls into place. Travolta recovered some credit on the square, after the Minuto per Minute fiasco; alongside him stands Debra Winger in her first major role. A good insight into the South American province and its "honky tonky" people.
cast: John Travolta, Debra Winger, Scott Glenn, Madolyn Smith

title: Urban Justice
synopsis: When his son, a young police officer, is killed in cold blood during a gang shootout, Simon Ballister decides to shed some light on the incident. So he returns to his old neighborhood where he starts asking uncomfortable questions. It doesn't take long for his violent interrogations to annoy evil boss Armand. The latter unleashes his gang against him, but Simon is ready to do anything to know the identity and motives of the killers. Not everything is as linear as it appears, and behind what appears to be an "accident", Ballister uncovers a conspiracy involving unsuspected names.
cast: Steven Seagal, Eddie Griffin, Carmen Serano, Cory Hart, Liezl Carstens, Kirk B.R. Woller, Mary Evans, Al Staggs, Jade Yorker, Jermaine Washington

title: Urban Legend
synopsis: A girl, on her way back to college after a short vacation, is beheaded in her car. It is only the beginning of a long series of chilling murders of a psychopath who enjoys putting into practice the hottest urban legends, thus decimating the population of the university campus.
cast: Jared Leto, Alicia Witt, Rebecca Gayheart, Brad Dourif, Joshua Jackson

title: Urban Legends: Bloody Mary
synopsis: College friends Samantha, Gina and Mindy spend a quiet evening at home telling stories of terror. The level of tension rises when Samantha playfully evokes the spirit of Mary Banner, a student murdered at a dance party in 1969 by her boyfriend. What should have been just a joke opens the door to something really scary. In fact, an urban legend wants the girl to return to eliminate the descendants of those who killed her on the night of the prom.
cast: Kate Mara, Tina Lifford, Ed Marinaro, Olesya Rulin, Haley McCormick, Robert Vito

title: Urban Legends: Final Cut
synopsis: A group of students is attending a university course in an institution with questionable architecture, but with a prestigious name: Orson Welles Complex. A competition is held in the school. Whoever makes the best film among the students will win the Alfred Hitchcock award. Amy decides to shoot a film based on some particularly brutal urban legends. It happens that several members of the troupe become victims of a murderer. Amy decides to investigate ...
cast: Jennifer Morrison, Matthew Davis, Hart Bochner, Loretta Devine

title: Urban Safari
synopsis: When all of your friends go on vacation, it's hard to admit that you're forced to stay home because household finances don't allow anything else. This is why a nice little family invents a "pretend" holiday: after informing relatives, friends and acquaintances that they are about to travel to a phantom exotic island, they seal doors and windows and move to the garden.
cast: David Naughton, Linda Kash, Andrea Nemeth, Donnelly Rhodes

title: Urban Warriors
synopsis: After a nuclear attack, technicians from an underground defense center return to the surface, where bands of survivors hunt down uncontaminated men to extract their bone marrow. A fantastic catastrophic of Italian production difficult to digest.
cast: Karl Landgren, Alex Vitale

title: Urga
synopsis: Gombo lives in the Mongolian steppe with his family (wife, three children, the old mother) according to the archaic rhythms and goes hunting with the "urga", a sort of lasso fixed on the tip of a pole. One day, his wife asks him to comply with the birth limitation law. Gombo goes to town, with a worker he saved after an accident, to buy condoms.
cast: Bayaertu, Badema, Vladimir Gosthukin, Larissa Kuznetsova

title: Urge
synopsis: A group of friends on an island vacation try a new type of experimental drug, which causes them to lose the ability to control their impulses.
cast: Ashley Greene, Pierce Brosnan, Alexis Knapp, Justin Chatwin, Danny Masterson, Bar Paly, Chris Geere, Nick Thune, James DeBello, Kea Ho

title: Urgency
synopsis: Tony, an executive of a large pharmaceutical company, is forced into a frantic race against time to save his kidnapped wife before she is killed. As he slowly unravels the mystery behind the kidnapping, he discovers that the kidnappers aren't just looking for the $ 50,000 ransom.
cast: Brian Austin Green, Jeffrey Combs, Scott William Winters, Sally Kirkland, Chira Cassel, Luciana Carro, John Colton, Craig Barnett, Shaun T. Benjamin, Kasan Butcher, Mistii Comeau, Leon Dawes, Saladin Florence

title: Urideul cheonguk
synopsis: Add a Plot
cast: Jang Dong Gun, Chan Woo Kim, Seung Yun Lee

title: Uriyadi 2
synopsis: When a chemical plant's poor conditions cause tragedies, an employee leads a protest against the company’s callous owner and local politicians.
cast: Vijay Kumar, Vismaya, Shankar Thas, Abbas, Sudhakar, Durai Ramesh

title: Urlatori alla sbarra
synopsis: The songs of the screamers excite young people but do not find favor with concert organizers. Some young singers try to ask on television. The austere professor Gammarelli, director general of Rai, is against it: but on the side of the young there is his daughter Giulia, who has her grandfather, senator, intervene. After some bickering, the concert will be broadcast with great success. After the success of the "Juke Box Boys", Fulci conducts with a certain panache and plenty of musical numbers.
cast: Joe Sentieri, Mina, Adriano Celentano, Elke Sommer

title: Urmel voll in Fahrt
synopsis: Impy is a small dinosaur who lives on the Pacific island of HulaHula, in a "mixed" family with his mother Piggy and his new baby sister, Baboo, a panda whose arrival doesn't exactly make the protagonist happy. But when the impresario of a playground in search of attractions finds Impy and catches him with the trick, even Baboo will become essential for the "Luna Park Mission" ...

title: Urok
synopsis: In a small school class in a small Bulgarian village, one of the children has stolen a small sum of money and this only brings further problems into the already troubled life of the honest teacher Nadezha. While trying to track down the identity of the little bandit, the woman will have to face her own economic ruin, eviction from home and an unemployed, drunkard husband.
cast: Margita Gosheva, Ivan Barnev, Ivanka Bratoeva, Ivan Savov, Deya Todorova, Stefan Denolyubov, Petar Valchanov

title: Uroki Garmonii
synopsis: During a medical examination, 13-year-old student Asan is humiliated in front of his classmates. Following the episode, Asan develops an obsessive-compulsive personality disorder which leads him to be a perfectionist. His perfectionism, however, does not fit well with the crime rate that also characterizes his school. He then decides to eliminate Bolat, the contemporary at the head of a band of thugs who harasses other schoolmates and who is responsible for the humiliation suffered.
cast: Timur Aidarbekov, Aslan Anarbayev, Mukhtar Andassov, Abzal Ermagambetov

title: Ursus
synopsis: Back from the war, Ursus (Ed Fury) discovers that his fiancée Attea (Moira Orfei) has been kidnapped and decides to go in search of her. Doreide accompanies him, a blind slave present at the rapture who thinks she can recognize those responsible by her voice. Overcoming traps and ambushes, Ursus manages to find Attea, but it is she, who has become a cruel queen, who condemns him to death ... the film focuses on the protagonist's spectacular vicissitudes and on the scenography bordering on the surreal.
cast: Ed Fury, Cristina Gaioni, Moira Orfei, Mario Scaccia, Mary Marlon

title: Ursus nella terra di fuoco
synopsis: Ursus is the "guarantor of freedom" of a peaceful and hard-working people on which the perfidious Amilcare has expansionist aims. At the first good opportunity Hamilcar neutralizes Ursus, kills the king and invades the country. The hero, however, is not dead and at the tournament called to celebrate the victory he takes the field and defeats the opposing champions. His (mis) adventures are not over, however, also because Diana, daughter of the legitimate ruler, is a prisoner of the usurper ...
cast: Ed Fury, Claudia Mori, Luciana Gilli, Adriano Micantoni

title: Ursus nella valle dei leoni
synopsis: Ursus is the son of a king, but his father was ousted by a usurper when he was very young and was raised by the beasts of the Title Valley. Growing up, he has become very strong and can therefore claim the paternal throne which, once regained, he shares with his sweet partner Anja.
cast: Ed Fury, Moira Orfei, Alberto Lupo, Mary Marlon, Giacomo Furia

title: Urusei Yatsura 1: Onri yû
synopsis: At Liceo Tomobiki there is an uproar: everyone has received an invitation to participate in the wedding between Ataru Moroboshi and Elle, as the crowning of an engagement that has lasted for eleven years. Megane opens a trial against the ugly bigamous, Mendo mobilizes his armored troops and Shinobu sows panic and destruction. Lum, too, of course, is on a rampage and his betrayed pride ends up escalating into an interplanetary war. But there are too many unclear things in this story: how is it possible that there is another girl in the universe who is so bizarre as to fall in love with Ataru?

title: Urusei Yatsura 2: Byûtifuru dorîmâ
synopsis: Pupils from Tomobiki High School are excited about the inauguration of the student festival. But no one seems to realize that the eve of the festival has been repeating itself the same for who knows how long. As if that weren't enough, Ataru and his companions discover that they are the only living things left in the neighborhood. Who will be responsible for this absurd nightmare?

title: Urvi
synopsis: After getting tricked into working at a brothel, a medical student joins forces with two of her co-workers to fight their unscrupulous exploiters.
cast: Sruthi Hariharan, Shraddha Srinath, Shweta Pandit, Achyuth Kumar, Madhukar Niyogi, Prabhu Mundkur, Bhavani Prakash, Ananya Bhat

title: Urzila Carlson: Overqualified Loser
synopsis: Stand-up comedian Urzila Carlson keeps the crowd roaring with her thoughts on recasting "The Biggest Loser," sex tape regrets and boxed wine hangovers.
cast: Urzila Carlson

title: Us
synopsis: Adelaide Wilson returns to her childhood home on the beach with her husband Gabe and their two children for an idyllic summer vacation. Haunted by an inexplicable and unresolved trauma from her past and plagued by a series of disturbing coincidences, Adelaide falls into an ever-increasing state of paranoia as she realizes that something bad can happen to her family. After a day at the beach with the Tylers, Adelaide and her family return home but as night falls they discover the silhouette of four figures holding hands in the driveway: they are their doubles, as terrifying as they are mysterious.
cast: Lupita Nyong'o, Winston Duke, Elisabeth Moss, Tim Heidecker, Shahadi Wright Joseph, Evan Alex, Cali Sheldon, Noelle Sheldon, Madison Curry, Anna Diop, Yahya Abdul Mateen II

title: Us and Them
synopsis: Two strangers meet on a train and form a bond that evolves over the years. After a separation, they reconnect and reflect on their love for each other.
cast: Jing Boran, Zhou Dongyu, Zhuangzhuang Tian, Qu Zheming, Zhang Zixian

title: Uscio e bottega
synopsis: Lapo Corsini, a sprightly, forty-year-old Florentine out of love with television and its constant chatter, decides to write to the Uscio e bottega program, asking to be invited as a man of the people who has specific questions to present to the various guests. Rai decides to satisfy his request and Lapo, with his friend Mancuso, leaves for Rome. The colorful episode of the talk show in which Lapo will be the undisputed protagonist will attract the attention of even the Pope, who will call him for a private interview.
cast: Brunetto Salvini, Luciano Casaredi, Filippo Di Martino, Mery Nacci, Federico Westkemper, Fulvio Ferrati, Carlo Monni, Valeria Vitti, Adelaide Foti, Sergio Forconi, Francesco Ciampi, Gaetano Gennai, Cristiano Militello, Andrea Agresti

title: Use For My Talent
synopsis: Because of his incomplete family, Gu Ren Qi has a closed up personality and mysophobia. Growing up he discovers Western culture, racial prejudices and war in the occupied territories. Between Fausto (Luca Argentero) and Claudia (Ilaria Spada), on the other hand, an irrepressible passion breaks out that leads them to give up their respective partners on the spot. Everything will go smoothly until they realize that there is an insurmountable incompatibility between them. Finally, a technological addict (Dario Bandiera) is shipwrecked on a desert island with his inseparable tablet. The situation will turn for the worse when he sees that on the island there is no field for the instrument that has always regulated his life.

cast: Michel Serrault, Daniel Auteuil, Laura Morante, Jorge Perrugorria

title: Vajont '63 - Il coraggio di sopravvivere
synopsis: On the evening of October 9, 1963, 250 million cubic meters of earth detached from Mount Toc caused the transfer of the waters of the Vajont dam. Almost 2000 people died instantly and the town of Longarone was completely destroyed. Beyond the economic and political interests behind the tragedy, there remain the individual stories of those who, survivor or rescuer, were present that night and can testify to what they saw.

title: Vajont, una tragedia italiana
synopsis: The tragedy that on 9 October 1963 caused almost 2000 deaths in Longarone, in the Piave Valley. The whole story is told, from the conception of the dam to the reconstruction of Longarone. Thanks to the consultation of the procedural documentation kept in the Belluno State Archive, it was possible to carry out new reflections on an event that has marred the Italy of the boom and that continues to disturb consciences.

title: Val Lewton: The Man in the Shadows
Valdez Is Coming

Since neither Samira nor Rosa want to back off, a dispute arises between the two motorists that attracts the attention of all the inhabitants of the street, who are immediately ready to intervene with their observations. The young Nicolò Calafiore, the only one Samira trusts, tries to act as an intermediary without too much success, while the bets are opened among the bystanders on who will sell first. Tired of staying under the sun in a situation that is inconceivable for her, Clara asks Nicolò to accompany her on her scooter on a tour of Palermo.

Directing lessons - through some letters from the set written to his daughter Emi, Vittorio De Sica reveals his "method" in a sort of daily working diary full of artistic and human notations that reveal his greatness and extraordinary humanity.
