synopsis: Inspector Massa while chasing a convict in his car crashes into a waste bin, from which, after the collision, a man comes out. For the blow received, he seems to have lost his memory. The inspector, after taking him to the hospital and the police station, thinks about taking the stranger to his home. She gives him a bed and tries to educate him as if he were her own son. Meanwhile at the police station there is a beautiful policewoman who is about to make a historic decision.
cast: Vincenzo Salemme, Tosca D'Aquino, Maurizio Casagrande, Biagio Izzo

title: Volevamo essere gli U2
synopsis: Six Roman boys led by the volcanic Marco come together to form a rock group that re-evaluates the repertoire of the seventies. The group includes Marco, on drums, Rocco, on guitar, Matteo, on keyboards, Saverio, on bass, and Margherita and Sonia, the singers. After a year of rehearsals the group is booed during a concert at the university and disbanded. The members of the band will reunite following the tragedy that engulfed one of them.
cast: Marco Galli, Enrico Lo Verso, Paola Magnanini, Carolina Salomé, Alberto Molinari, Federico Scribani, Marina Giulia Cavalli, Valentina Forte, Massimo Ghini

title: Volevo i pantaloni
synopsis: Annetta, daughter of Sicilian peasants, suffers from the contrast between male and female conditions of life: the former permissive, the latter marked by very severe restrictions. Rebelling against this state of affairs, she is withdrawn from school and locked up in the home of some relatives. Here her uncle tries to rape her and Annetta denounces him. Back at her parents' house, she marries her Nicola with whom she has a little girl. Upon its release, the novel by Lara Cardella, from which the film is based, caused a certain sensation, immediately amplified by the mass media. The film follows the plot pedestrianized without ever having a shot of originality.
cast: Giulia Fossà, Lucia Bosé, Angela Molina, Natasha Hovey, Pino Colizzi

title: Volevo nascondermi
synopsis: The story of the life of Antonio Ligabue, a naive and imaginative painter who painted tigers, gorillas, lions and jaguars living in the boundless poplar groves of the Po floodplains. A life of hardness that is at the same time a fairy tale: the story of Toni, a lonely child and outcast who, thanks to his meeting with the sculptor Renato Marino Mazzacurati, found in painting a form of redemption to express himself and be loved by the world.
cast: Elio Germano, Oliver Johann Ewy, Leonardo Carrozzo, Pietro Traldi, Orietta Notari, Andrea Gherpelli, Gianni Fantoni, Denis Campitelli, Filippo Marchi, Mario Perrotta

title: Volevo solo dormirle addosso
synopsis: Marco Pressi, a young manager who deals with training in a multinational company, is summoned by his bosses for a proposal to which it is difficult to say no: if he wants to have a substantial career advancement, he must cut a third of the staff within a few weeks ...
cast: Giorgio Pasotti, Cristiana Capotondi, Eleonora Mazzoni, Carlo Freccero

title: Volevo solo vivere
synopsis: From the highly applauded speech by Mussolini who announced the racial laws in Trieste in 1938, we move on to the testimonies of nine Italian Jews deported to Auschwitz, with inserts of archive images. Effective description of the inhuman progression of the Holocaust. Spielberg produces and gives us the more "civilized" Calopreste.

title: Volevo un figlio maschio
synopsis: Alberto is a husband and a happy father. However, he has a worry: he managed to have only daughters. Thanks to a magic, however, Alberto suddenly finds himself to be the father of four males.
cast: Enrico Brignano, Giulia Bevilacqua, Giulia Tumbarello, Roberta Volponi, Samira Finotti, Edoardo Giugliarelli, Massimo Quagliata, Tommaso Guidi

title: Volga - Volga
synopsis: Ivan Byvalov is commissioned to prepare, with some local companies, a festival of amateur artists. The popular chorus of the peasant Dunja participates, who incidentally composes a radio success: Ivan will try to steal the authorship of the song from her ...
cast: Igor Ilyinskij, Ljubov Orlova, Pavel Olenev, Andrej Tutyshkin

title: Volki i ovtsy. Beeezumnoe prevrashchenie
synopsis: In a distant magical land, in a small picturesque village nestled between green meadows and rolling hills, a flock of sheep lives. But their life is cut short when a pack of wolves camps in a nearby ravine. In accordance with ancient traditions, the pack leader Magra announces that his future successor will have to prove himself the strongest of his rivals. When the powerful and bloodthirsty Ragear steps forward, the only wolf with the courage to challenge him is Gray, the favorite of the pack, but clumsy and hopeless. To become a leader and win Bianca's love, Gray goes to the woods, where he discovers a field of rabbits. This is where the rabbit I guess Mami gives him a magic potion. Gray drinks the potion and returns to the wolves' lair, but upon his arrival he discovers that he has been turned into a ram.

title: Volkodav iz roda Serykh Psov
synopsis: A young boy witnesses the destruction of his village and the extermination of the entire tribe by a mysterious and merciless army. Fifteen years later, having become a fearless warrior, he scours the countryside in search of the person responsible for the massacre. Along the way he will meet singular characters ...
cast: Aleksandr Bukharov, Oksana Akinshina, Aleksandr Domogarov, Igor Petrenko, Juozas Budraitis, Rezo Esadze, Artyom Semakin, Nina Usatova, Natalya Varley, Tatyana Lyutayeva

title: Volontaire
synopsis: Laure, twenty-two, is looking for her place in the world. After a brilliant course of study in the literary field, she joined the marine infantry corps as a communications officer. In a short time, he will have to integrate and assimilate the rules of the body. But Laure is determined and is still eager to learn, even to know and accept herself.
cast: Diane Rouxel, Lambert Wilson, Alex Descas, Josiane Balasko, Corentin Fila, Hélène Fillières, Pauline Acquart, André Marcon, Marc Fraize, Jonathan Couzinié

title: Volontari per destinazione ignota
cast: Michele Placido, Vito Passeri, Verner Di Donato, Pasqualino Di Turi

title: Voltati Eugenio
synopsis: Eugenio, the son of two ex-sixties in crisis, grows up raised more by the couple's grandparents and friends than by his parents: he will be alone with a dog. Comencinian apologue (which does not take a stand) on the separate worlds of adults and children. Sober, bitter, well interpreted.
cast: Saverio Marconi, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Memé Perlini, Francesco Bonelli

title: Voltati... ti uccido
synopsis: Ted, an unscrupulous adventurer, has managed to seize, with the help of the outlaw El Bicho and his gang, almost all of the gold mines in New Mexico. Sam, an old pioneer who owns a mine, hires Bill, a gunslinger, to try to resist Ted's pressure. He decides to pit Ted and El Bicho against each other.
cast: Richard Wyler, Fernando Sancho, Eleonora Bianchi

title: Voltron: Legendary Defender
synopsis: In an all-new series, five unlikely heroes and their flying robot lions unite to form the megapowerful Voltron and defend the universe from evil.
cast: Jeremy Shada, Tyler Labine, Bex Taylor Klaus, Josh Keaton, Steven Yeun, Kimberly Brooks, Rhys Darby, A.J. LoCascio

title: Volubilis
synopsis: Abdelkader is a security guard, Malika, a maid. The two have just married and are madly in love. Despite the economic difficulties, they dream of going to live elsewhere to crown their love story. One day, however, Abdelkader is the victim of a violent and humiliating episode that distorts the fate of the couple.
cast: Mouhcine Malzi, Nadia Kounda

title: Volunteers
synopsis: Lawrence Bourne III (Tom Hanks) is an arrogant and snobbish young man with huge gambling debts. Sneaking into a Peace Corps only to escape threats from his creditors, he is sent to a remote Thai village where he finds himself building a bridge together with the ultra-optimist Tom (John Candy) and a beautiful volunteer, Beth. But the Communists kidnap Tom to brainwash him. A flat comedy, with rare moments of effective entertainment. Too bad, because only the year before the Hanks-Candy couple had shown themselves capable of excellent performances, thanks to a very robust script, in "Splash", by Ron Howard.
cast: Tom Hanks, John Candy, Rita Wilson, Tim Thomerson

title: Volver
synopsis: Raimunda covers the traces of the murder of her husband by her daughter Paula (who had been threatened by him), then decides to directly manage a restaurant with friends without men. Meanwhile, the spirit of the mother - who died years before in a fire - returns to phrases alive, generous with advice ...
cast: Penélope Cruz, Carmen Maura, Lola Dueñas, Blanca Portillo, Yohana Cobo, Chus Lampreave, Antonio De La Torre, Carlos Blanco, María Isabel Díaz

title: Volver a morir
synopsis: A woman wakes up next to a mysterious man she has never seen before. Eager to find out what happened, she is seduced by the man and brutally killed in a moment of passion. Waking up several times, the woman always relives the same fate and death. To stop the cycle and save his life, he will have to dig through his faded memories and try to understand the true identity of the killer.
cast: Andrea Montenegro, Luis Fernando Bohórquez

title: Von Buttiglione Sturmtruppenführer
synopsis: During the Second World War, a regiment of the German army is commanded by Major Hoffman. At the news of his dismissal Hoffman would like to commit suicide, but withdraws from his plans when he learns that Colonel Von Buttiglione will take over the command.
cast: Jacques Dufilho, Mario Marenco, John Steiner, Isabelle Marchal, Peter Boom

title: Von Caligari zu Hitler: Das deutsche Kino im Zeitalter der Massen
synopsis: An investigation to clarify the relationship between cinema and German political involution in the years between 1928 and 1933, when Hitler became Chancellor of the Reich, to show that films always reflect, to a greater or lesser extent - and beautiful or ugly they may be from an aesthetic point of view -, the national political situation. And since the political situation of a country is always the product of various complementary situations - economic, social, moral, etc. - the film is valid, from time to time, as a document of society in its many aspects. Caligari is the name of the protagonist of the manifesto of German Expressionism: a film about violence, manipulation and madness.
cast: Siegfried Kracauer, Fritz Lang, Thomas Elsaesser, Elisabeth Bronfen, Volker Schlöndorff, Eric D. Weitz, Fatih Akin, Robert Wiene, F.W. Murnau, Billy Wilder

title: Von Richthofen and Brown
synopsis: In 1916, over the skies of France, like ancient knights, the German aviation ace, Baron von Richtofen, and his Canadian rival Roy Brown duel. Brown destroys the enemy base and then the baron takes a retaliatory action on the opponent's soil. The war turns for the worst for Germany, but von Richtofen rejects the order to return and finds his death in an epic duel with his rival.
cast: John Phillip Law, Don Stroud, Barry Primus, Corin Redgrave, Karen Ericson, Hurd Hatfield, Stephen McHattie, Brian Foley, Robert La Tourneaux, Peter Masterson, Clint Kimbrough

title: Von Ryan's Express
synopsis: Shot down in his plane, Colonel Ryan is taken prisoner and locked up in a concentration camp. The camp is in pitiful condition, both because of the fascist major and the obstruction of a British major. Ryan initiates forms of collaboration that however earned him the derogatory nickname of Von Ryan. Upon liberation, the prisoners end up in the hands of the Germans, but Ryan arranges a daring escape.
cast: Frank Sinatra, Trevor Howard, Raffaella Carrà, Sergio Fantoni, Brad Dexter, John Leyton, Edward Mulhare, Wolfgang Preiss, James Brolin, Adolfo Celi

title: Von einem, der auszog, das Fürchten zu lernen
Voodoo Baby
synopsis: The researcher Paul goes to Santo Domingo with his wife Helen to discover the secrets of an autochthonous sect. While her husband leads her research, Helen gets bored until the day she knows the young man haini and is impressed by his sensuality ...
cast: Nieves Navarro, Lucia Ramirez, Richard Harrison, Annj Goren

title: Voor een verloren soldaat
synopsis: Jeroen Boman is an accomplished choreographer in crisis of inspiration. In having to explain to his dancers the meaning of the word freedom, he remembers in a long flashback his childhood, when in 1944, 12 years old, due to the ongoing war, he was evacuated together with many other peers from Amsterdam to a small village on the coast. . The boy, welcomed by a poor but altruistic family of fishermen, will begin in this new reality to become aware of his being attracted to people of his own sex. The central knot of the story, however, concerns the adolescent bond of friendship and falling in love (treated with modesty and extreme delicacy) that is established between Jeroem and a Canadian soldier of the liberation army. At the end of the war, the two lose contact and Jeroen is left with only a pair of lenses and a deep desire to find the man who was her first great love. Having become a successful dancer and choreographer, he never stopped his research, made fruitless by the lack of certain elements. Back in the present and rediscovered the fruitful key of inspiration thanks to that reconnaissance in the past, he receives from his assistant, who knows his story, an envelope that could reopen the road to hope.
cast: Maarten Smit, Jeroen Krabbe, Andrew Kelley, Freark Smink, Elsje De Wijn, Derk Jan Kroon, Wiendelt Hooijer, Iris Misset, Gineke De Jager, Tatum Dagelet

title: Vor
synopsis: In 1946, in the Soviet Union, the young Katya gave birth to Sanya, a child conceived with a soldier who died in the war. In an attempt to overcome despair and poverty, six years later, Katya falls in love with Tolyan, a libertine soldier, who poses as Sanya's husband and father in order to get a state home. Tolyan, however, soon shows his true nature and soon reveals himself for the man he is. Violent and unfaithful, he survives by stealing thefts, an activity to which little Sanya also initiates.
cast: Vladimir Maskov, Ekaterina Rednikova, Misa Filipcuk, Dima Chigarev

title: Vor der Morgenröte - Stefan Zweig in Amerika
synopsis: In 1936 the Austrian Jewish writer Stefan Zweig, faced with the changes that Europe is undergoing, decides to leave Europe for good. Thus begins an exile that will take him from Rio de Janeiro to Buenos Aires, from New York to Pétropolis.
cast: Josef Hader, Barbara Sukowa, Aenne Schwarz, Matthias Brandt, Tómas Lemarquis, Lenn Kudrjawizki, Charly Hübner, Harvey Friedman, Ivan Shvedoff, Nahuel Pérez Biscayart, André Szymanski, Nicolau Breyner

title: Vorrei vederti ballare
synopsis: Twenty-year-old Martino has lived in Cosenza with his psychoanalyst father since he lost his mother at the age of 13. He spends his days between a visit to the Isola Capo Rizzuto nature reserve and the arthouse films seen at the cinema where the cashier Giusy, a failed actress who has become his friend, works. Moreover, every day he stares at Ilaria, a dancer of the same age with whom he is secretly in love. When he discovers that Ilaria is being treated by her father due to the anorexia problems that torment her, Martino pretends to be a psychologist. By doing so, he will be able to help her thanks to the strength of his love.
cast: Chiara Chiti, Giulio Forges Davanzati, Alessandro Haber, Giuliana De Sio, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Paola Barale, Franco Castellano, Luis Molteni, Stefano Santospago

title: Vorstadtkrokodile
synopsis: Kai, a boy in a wheelchair, dreams of becoming a member of the gang of neighborhood boys, the Crocodiles. Because of his handicap he was never accepted by the group, not even when he saved the life of Hannes, another child, during an initiation rite. One night Kai sees a shop robbery with his telescope and the reward for whoever finds the thieves will convince the Crocodiles to ask the child for help on a dangerous adventure.
cast: Nick Romeo Reimann, Fabian Halbig, Leonie Tepe, Manuel Steitz, David Hürten, Javidan Imani, Robin Walter, Nicolas Schinseck, Nora Tschirner, Maria Schrader

title: Vorstadtkrokodile 2
synopsis: During the summer holidays, the life of the Crocodiles, a gang of neighborhood kids, is upset by the news that two of them, Olli and Maria, could soon move due to the serious financial situation of their parents, whose company is the victim of strange accidents. To avoid the feared risk, the Crocodiles investigate the causes of the mysterious episodes with the help of Jenny, Kai's cousin.
cast: Nick Romeo Reimann, Fabian Halbig, Leonie Tepe, Manuel Steitz, David Hürten, Javidan Imani, Robin Walter, Ella Maria Gollmer, Nora Tschirner, Maria Schrader

title: Vorstadtkrokodile 3
synopsis: For Hannes' birthday, the Crocodiles, a gang of neighborhood kids, go to a go-kart track. The happiness of the day and the euphoria for the speed of cars, however, soon give way to despair: Frank, one of them, is the victim of an accident and needs a liver transplant. The only compatible donor seems to be the elder brother, in prison for a theft committed years earlier. The gang will work to come up with a solution.
cast: Nick Romeo Reimann, Fabian Halbig, Manuel Steitz, Leonie Tepe, David Hürten, Ella Maria Gollmer, Javidan Imani, Robin Walter, Jacob Matschenz, Nicolas Schinseck

title: Vortex
synopsis: An elderly couple lives in a Parisian apartment full of objects, memories, books. He is a cinema scholar who is writing a book on the relationship between dreams and films, she is a retired psychoanalyst, who begins to suffer the symptoms of Alzheimer's. Their very long relationship gradually disintegrates, as they try as far as they can support the son, who has problems with drug addiction.
cast: Dario Argento, Francoise Lebrun, Alex Lutz

title: Vortice
synopsis: To save her father from financial distress, Elena leaves Guido and marries Luigi. Between the two there is not even a semblance of love, but Elena does not yield to Guido even when her husband suffers a serious accident. Then Luigi is killed and Elena is accused of murder. Comic book that exudes tear-jerking emotions with every frame. Except that Matarazzo was a master of this kind of film and knew how to "speak to the heart" of his audience.
cast: Silvana Pampanini, Massimo Girotti, Gianni Santuccio, Irene Papas

title: Vorzimmer zur Hölle
synopsis: Juule Engelhardt works at the reception of a cosmetics company. She bankrupt student, one day she is a witness of Anneore's illness, the historical secretary of Philip Richter, president of the company. The intervention saves the life of Annedore and Juule earns the esteem of the president, who promotes her secretary. After the initial difficulties with the new job, Jule will have the opportunity to be surprised by the fold that will take the events.
cast: Henriette Richter Röhl, Andreas Pietschmann, Eleonore Weisgerber, Heidelinde Weis, Ivonne Schönherr, Andreas Günther, Gregor Bloeb, Elzemarieke De Vos, Thomas Balou Martin, Beate Maes

title: Vorzimmer zur Hölle - Streng geheim!
synopsis: In Berlin, one summer morning, Jule Engelhardt and Philip Richter wake up at the same time and are late for their office work. That day is not like many: for Jule it is the first day of work while for Philip, who is also her boss, an important meeting is planned with the banker Earl G. Kennel, the man who acquired the majority of the cosmetics company they both work for. During her shift as secretary, Jule will have to cope with professional needs and try to keep her relationship with Philip a secret but it won't be easy.
cast: Henriette Richter Röhl, Andreas Pietschmann, Heidelinde Weis, Eleonore Weisgerber, Ivonne Schönherr, Hansa Czypionka, Andreas Guenther, Elzemarieke De Vos, Thomas Balou Martin, Dirk Martens

title: Vorzimmer zur Hölle III - Plötzlich Boss
synopsis: Jule Engelhardt works as secretary in an international Berlin cosmetics company and is happy with her boyfriend Philip Richter, who is also his boss. Furthermore, Philip is the only one who could help you for the launch of a new line of products when Frieda Winter, the owner of the company, decides an exchange of roles between garments and subordinates. This means that Jule will play the role of CEO and that Philip will work as secretary for her. In a completely unpublished situation for her, Jule will soon find herself having to choose what is most important for her, her relationship with Philip or professional success.
cast: Henriette Richter Röhl, Andreas Pietschmann, Ivonne Schönherr, Eleonore Weisgerber, Gila Von Weitershausen, Simon Böer, Leslie Vanessa Lill, Nils Buschmann, Alexander Metelmann, Theresa Underberg

title: Voschodzenie
synopsis: Belarus: Partisans Sotnikov and Rybak leave their group to look for food on a nearby farm. But the Nazis precede them, and the two are thus forced to make a dangerous detour within the territory occupied by the enemy. They will be taken prisoner and interrogated.
cast: Boris Plotnikov, Vladimir Gostyukhin, Sergej Jakoviev

title: Vostochnaya elegiya
synopsis: On the ground lies the corpse of a woman. Next to her there is the son who caresses her and who tries with words of desolation to find a meaning to the suffering.

title: Voto di castità
synopsis: An elderly man decides to leave all his possessions to his nephew. These, however, unexpectedly decides to become a priest. The money then goes to a hospice for prostitutes.
cast: Gillian Bray, Enzo Colajacono, Flavia Fabiani, Laura Gemser

title: Vou para casa/Je rentre à la maison
synopsis: Gilbert is an established theatrical performer. One evening, at the end of the show, tragedy bursts into his life abruptly: his agent informs him that his wife, daughter and son-in-law have died in a car accident. Time passes and existence, despite everything, resumes its course: Gilbert just has to divide himself between his beloved grandson and the stage he never left. When an American director offers him to participate in a film adaptation of Joyce's Ulysses, Gilbert eagerly accepts. But at the time of rehearsals ...
cast: Michel Piccoli, Catherine Deneuve, John Malkovich, Leonor Silveira

title: Voulez-vous danser avec moi?
synopsis: Virginie, scion of a rich family, marries a dentist against the will of her father Hervé. But the young man remains involved in the affair with another woman, Anita, who has him photographed in order to be able to blackmail him. The next day Hervé returns to the place where he met Anita and finds her killed. Virginie discovers him with the murder weapon in hand, but the young groom proclaims himself innocent ...
cast: Brigitte Bardot, Henri Vidal, Philippe Nicaud, Dario Moreno

title: Voulez-vous rire avec moi ce soir?
synopsis: French humorist Yacine Belhousse tours the world to explore how stand-up comedians make audiences laugh across cultures.
cast: Gad Elmaleh, Eddie Izzard, Bill Burr, Todd Barry, Kyan Khojandi, Judah Friedlander, Blanche Gardin, Mike Ward, Igor Meerson, Dan Naturman, Tony Law, Daniel Gagnon, Sebastian Marx, Michael Mittermeier, Paul Taylor, Korine Côté, Guillermo Guiz, Virginie Fortin, Francesco De Carlo

title: Vous n'avez encore rien vu
synopsis: Once in a rich and ancient villa lost in the countryside of France to attend the funeral of the playwright and director Antoine d'Anthac, a group of actor friends learn from reading the will that they are the recipients of a particular challenge. Since everyone had participated years before in the realization of a new version of Orpheus and Eurydice, adapted by the author for the occasion and unanimously judged an exceptional work for its time, they will have to see the recording of the same work, however staged by the young actors of the company de la Colombe, and understand if they are still able to confront on stage with themes such as life, death, love and love after death.
cast: Lambert Wilson, Mathieu Amalric, Anne Consigny, Michel Piccoli, Sabine Azéma, Hippolyte Girardot, Pierre Arditi, Denis Podalydès, Andrzej Seweryn, Anny Duperey

title: Vous ne désirez que moi
synopsis: In October 1982 Yann Andrea asked Michèle Manceaux to interview him. Yann has been Marguerite Duras for two years and is 38 years older than her, while Michèle, journalist and writer, is an accomplice and neighbor of Marguerite. They meet on the first floor of Nauphle's house and Yann's first phrase is "I would like to talk about Marguerite". The relationship he has with the writer leaves him no longer any freedom. During the two meetings with Michèle he will try to understand what he is experiencing, to find out how to save his skin and continue to love Marguerite.
cast: Emmanuelle Devos, Swann Arlaud

title: Vovka in the Kingdom of Far Far Away
Vox Lux
synopsis: Celeste becomes one of the world's pop superstars after surviving a life-changing event. His 18 years of success and travail are intertwined with some of the key historical events taking place in the world.
cast: Natalie Portman, Jude Law, Stacy Martin, Raffey Cassidy, Jennifer Ehle

title: Voyage of Terror
synopsis: A new and deadly virus epidemic breaks out on board the cruise ship Orion Star. Stephanie Tauber, a scientist, is among the passengers along with her daughter. The President of the United States, after ordering the ship's quarantine, instructs Stephanie to take control of the situation. The ship becomes the laboratory where the woman searches for the vaccine to defeat the epidemic. Meanwhile, the infected passengers begin to die. The President's advisor, however, by playing a double game exploits the misfortune to put the boss in a bad light and hinder his re-election.
cast: Lindsay Wagner, Michael Ironside, Brian Dennehy, Martin Sheen

title: Voyage of Terror: The Achille Lauro Affair
cast: Burt Lancaster, Eva Marie Saint, Brian Bloom, Renzo Montagnani

title: Voyage of Time
synopsis: An excursus on the birth and death of the universe.

title: Voyage of the Damned
synopsis: On May 13, 1939 the German transatlantic St. Louis, commanded by Captain Schroeder, sails from Hamburg with 937 Jews on board to reach Cuba. When the ship arrives in Havana, the Batista government does not allow the landing and the ship begins a long odyssey. Modest remake of Stanley Kramer's "Ship of Fools", with an all-star cast but very boring.
cast: Faye Dunaway, Max Von Sydow, Orson Welles, Lee Grant, Sam Wanamaker

title: Voyage of the Rock Aliens
synopsis: Frankie is the leader of the rock group of the local high school. Dee Dee is in love with him and, moreover, dreams of a career as a singer. Things are unpredictable when a new band appears on the scene, the Aliens, from the origin ... unusual. James Fargo had made a couple of Picarschi films with Clint Eastwood, and here he pulls to live.
cast: Pia Zadora, Tom Nolan, Craig Sheffer, Ruth Gordon, Michael Berryman, Alison La Placa, Gregory Bond, Craig Quiter

title: Voyage of the Unicorn
synopsis: After the death of their mother, a book illustrator, their daughters Cassie and Miranda and their father Alan are sucked into a magical world. To return home, they will have to find the magical dragon that will stop the troll threat.
cast: Chantal Conlin, Heather McEwen, Beau Bridges, Mackenzie Gray

title: Voyage to the Beginning of the World
Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
synopsis: To save Earth from a sudden surge in cosmic radiation, Admiral Nelson proposes to launch a missile from his atomic submarine into the sky.
cast: Walter Pidgeon, Joan Fontaine, Peter Lorre, Barbara Eden

title: Voyage to the Planet of Prehistoric Women
Voyagers
synopsis: With the future of the human race in danger, a group of young men and women, endowed with enhanced intelligence and deprived of all emotional impulses, embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. But discovering disturbing secrets, they challenge the way they were formed and begin to rediscover their most primitive nature. As the ship plunges into chaos, they will be consumed with fear, lust, and the lust for power.
cast: Tye Sheridan, Lily Rose Depp, Fionn Whitehead, Colin Farrell, Isaac Hempstead Wright, Veronica Falcón, Viveik Kalra, Archie Madekwe, Madison Hu, Quintessa Swindell

title: Voyeur
synopsis: Legendary journalist Gay Talese unmasks a motel owner who spied on his guests for decades. But his bombshell story soon becomes a scandal of its own.
cast: Gay Talese

title: Voyna
synopsis: British actor John and his girlfriend Margaret are kidnapped while in Georgia for a movie and taken to Chechnya. The Chechen kidnappers ask for a large ransom for their release and, in the meantime, keep them hidden in a burrow dug underground, where the two meet two Russian soldiers, also prisoners: captain Medvedev (Sergey Bodrov Jr.), wounded, and soldier Ermakov (Aleksey Chadov). When the Chechen leader realizes that he will never get the ransom, he lets John go and, as a sign of generosity, Ermakov too, but he holds the girl back. It will be John's job to go and get the two million pound ransom needed to free Margaret.
cast: Aleksey Chadov, Ian Kelly, Ingeborga Dapkunaite, Sergey Bodrov Jr., Evklid Kyurdzidis, Giorgi Gurgulia, Vladimir Gostyukhin, Ben Foster, Yuriy Stepanov, David McAlister

title: Voyna i mir I: Andrey Bolkonskiy
synopsis: In Russia in 1905, the young Natasha Rostov dreams of falling in love soon and living a romantic love story, perhaps with one of the young people who frequent the noble living room of Annette Scherer, such as the charming Piotr Bezuchov, a carefree young man, illegitimate son. of a wealthy earl. The alliance of Russia with Austria causes Piotr and Nikolai, Natasha's brother, to leave for the war that the Central European nation is fighting in Bavaria against the expansive aims of Napoleon Bonaparte. Prince Andrey Bolkonskiy is also called to arms, who takes his pregnant wife to safety in a country house before leaving Moscow. After a bloody fight, Piotr and Andrey return to Moscow, where a new destiny awaits them: Piotr will be forced to marry the beautiful and immoral Hélène while Andrey will arrive in time to see his wife die in childbirth.
cast: Ljudmila Saveljeva, Sergey Bondarchuk, Vyacheslav Tikhonov, Viktor Stanitsyn, Kira Golovko, Oleg Tabakov, Irina Gubanova, Anatoli Ktorov, Antonina Shuranova, Anastasiya Vertinskaya

His family is in disarray: his wife is cheating on him, his daughter is in a juvenile prostitution ring, and his son is targeted by bullies at school. Shinichi’s only reason for living is Zebraman, a TV show about a mysterious superhero. His only hobby - making Zebraman costumes - takes hold of him to the point that he gets into the habit of wearing one and wandering around the city late at night. In doing so he runs into various suspicious characters and each time manages to get involved in a fist fight. In reality, these dubious types are aliens from another galaxy who have invaded human bodies and plan to take over the Earth. Although taken aback, our recalcitrant hero providentially begins to defend his city. Meanwhile, the Japanese government launches an investigation into the strange events in the Yachiyo neighborhood. "Men in Black" charged with repelling aliens from outer space accidentally discover the existence of "a mysterious striped man" defending the city. Before the truth is fully exposed, however, the situation is definitely for the worse. The alien invasion begins: will Zebraman be able to defend peace, justice and the Japanese way of life?

Potential criminals are thus recognized and annihilated. Since the Zebra Hour goes into effect, the crime rate has started to decline, making Zebra City the safest metropolis in the world - and finally black and white are clearly distinct! On the streets of Tokyo, completely transformed, Shinichi suddenly wakes up: he has lost his memory. It is exactly 5:00 - the Hour of the Zebra begins! And here is that a policeman of the Zebra-Police opens fire on him. Meanwhile, Queen Zebra, a super supermodel who is actually called Yui and is the governor's daughter, acts as a testimonial for Zebra City, ruling the city and carrying out her plans for world conquest with increasing success. In the area designated for displaced persons, Shinichi meets Asano-san, a doctor, and Sumire, a mysterious young woman. When Shinichi touches her, zebra stripes sprout on a part of her body and in the same instant she recovers her memory. With near perfect synchrony, Yui is in violent convulsions as zebra stripes appear on her body! It is the beginning of a black and white battle between Good and Evil, and what is at stake is the fate of humanity!
