The Count of Seville, a traitor who aspires to Isabella's hand, plots with Cardinal Richelieu but, as soon as he enters French territory, meets Zorro. After defeating the count, Zorro takes his place and is escorted by the musketeers, with whom he befriends.
cast: Gordon Scott, José Greci, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Livio Lorenzon, Franco Fantasia, Nazzareno Zamperla, Nerio Bernardi, Ignazio Leone, Mario Pisu, Giuseppe Addobbati

title: Zorro il cavaliere della vendetta
synopsis: An adventurer, in early 19th century California, recruits henchmen to wage his own war with the Indians. No pioneering intentions: man, in fact, is looking for a precious talisman that the redskins consider sacred. To stop him, and avert a bloodbath, Zorro intervenes.
cast: Charles Quiney, Malisa Longo, Fernando Hilbeck, Maria Mahor

title: Zorro il dominatore
synopsis: Antonio Sandoval, having finished his studies, returns to his native town. Because the head of the garrison, Colonel Cordoba, unbeknownst to the governor, subjects the defenseless citizenry to harassment of all kinds. Antonio decides to straighten things out by becoming Zorro. Low-cost Italo-Iberian Zorro, with faces of well-known character actors.
cast: Charles Quiney, Maria Pia Conte, Aldo Bufi Landi, José Jaspe

title: Zorro il ribelle
synopsis: In a small town on the border of Texas, Zorro (Ross) fights alongside the rebels against the tyrannical governor Alvarez (Dominici).
cast: Renato Rossini, Dina De Santis, Howard Ross, Arturo Dominici

title: Zorro marchese di Navarra
synopsis: In the Spanish regions oppressed by the French yoke, movements of revolt spread with little success. Only the garrison under the orders of Colonel Brizard, which presides over the city of Pamplona, ??is put in ambush by the rebel bands led by a mysterious masked individual. He manages to free some condemned to be shot under the eyes of the same senior officer. Naturally, Zorro hides under the role of the avenger and arouses the sympathy of Carmen, the niece of the city alcalde.
cast: Nino Vingelli, Daniele Vargas, Maria Luisa Longo, Loris Gizzi

title: Zorro the Avenger
synopsis: Don Diego de la Vega secretly wears the clothes and mask of the executioner Zorro again. Armed with his trusty sword and ready to brand every place with his usual acronym, he prepares to counter the conspiratorial policy of Jose Sebastian Varga, a corrupt dictator, intent on selling the territory of California to a foreign power.
cast: Guy Williams, Charles Korvin, Henry Calvin, Gene Sheldon, George J. Lewis, Jay Novello, Ralph Clanton, Henry Rowland, Michael Pate

title: Zorro the Gay Blades
synopsis: The famous Zorro had two children, one of whom is gay.
cast: George Hamilton, Lauren Hutton, Brenda Vaccaro

title: Zoya
synopsis: Zoya is a beautiful young Russian aristocrat related to the Tsar. During the 1917 revolution, Zoya lost both parents and was orphaned. He manages to leave St. Petersburg, thus escaping the horrors of the war and the consequences (dire for a girl of the nobility left alone) of the revolution, and moves to Paris. In the French capital, she meets an American who marries her and takes her with him to New York. But he too dies leaving her with two children to raise. But the strength of despair will lead her, with great difficulty, to become a successful business woman. Only after having also thought about the future of her grandchildren, will the poignant desire to see her homeland again after decades of being away.
cast: Melissa Gilbert, Cameron Brancroft, Bruce Boxleitner, Tom Laughlin

title: Zozo
country: Sweden, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Denmark, Netherlands
synopsis: When Lebanon's Civil War deprives Zozo of his family, he's left with grief and little means as he escapes to Sweden in search of his grandparents.
cast: Imad Creidi, Antoinette Turk, Elias Gergi, Carmen Lebbos, Viktor Axelsson, Charbel Iskandar, Yasmine Awad

title: Zoé: Panoramas
synopsis: This introspective rockumentary follows the career triumphs and intimate moments of legendary Mexican band Zoé as they embark on a global tour.
cast: Sergio Acosta, Jesús Báez, Ángel Mosqueda, Rodrigo Guardiola, León Larregui

title: Zu: Warriors from the Magic Mountain
Zubaan
synopsis: A scrappy but poor boy worms his way into a tycoon's dysfunctional family, while facing his fear of music and the truth about his past.
cast: Vicky Kaushal, Sarah Jane Dias, Raaghav Chanana, Manish Chaudhary, Meghna Malik, Malkeet Rauni, Anita Shabdish, Chittaranjan Tripathy

title: Zucchero, miele e peperoncino
synopsis: Three episodes. In the first, the good Lino Banfi is mistaken for a ferocious murderer, and ends up in the hands of a journalist on the hunt for a scoop, with easily imaginable consequences. Then there is Pippo Franco, unemployed, who finds work as a "waitress", becomes the mistress of the hostess and is discovered by her husband, a manesco butcher. Finally, Renato Pozzetto is a quiet taxi driver who dotes on his new car.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Lino Banfi, Pippo Franco, Edwige Fenech

title: Zuckerbaby
synopsis: The anomalous love of a fat office worker and a handsome subway driver. A film that starts as a comedy and immediately becomes bitter, despite the title. Sagebrecht is a revelation, Adlon conducts with grace.
cast: Marianne Sägebrecht, Eisi Gulp, Toni Berger, Manuela Denz

title: Zuei hao de shih guang
synopsis: In _A Time for Love_, in 1966, a soldier falls in love with a girl who frequents a billiard room; she escapes him and he follows her across the country. In _A Time for Freedom_, a courtesan and a writer who is fighting for independence from Japan love each other in a 1911 brothel. Today, in _A Time for Youth_, an epileptic rock singer goes from bed to bed and her partner has a mistress too.
cast: Shu Qi, Chang Chen, Mei Fang, Liao Su Jen, Di Mei

title: Zulu
synopsis: In January 1879, Reverend Otto Witt (Hawkins) and his daughter Margareta (Jacobson) attended the wedding ceremonies of the Zulu warriors in Natal. Suddenly, the news that 1,200 Brits have been slaughtered pushes the natives to revolt against the whites. In the fort there are only one hundred and five men, while the arriving Zulus are at least four thousand. The resistance, led by Chard and Lieutenant Bromhead (Caine), is desperate. Then, just when surrender seems near, the Zulus retreat.
cast: Stanley Baker, Jack Hawkins, Ulla Jacobsson, Michael Caine, James Booth

title: Zulu
synopsis: Cape Town, 2010. A mutilated body is found in the city's botanical garden. As police chief, black Ali (Forest Whitaker) is in charge of investigating together with white colleague Brian (Orlando Bloom) the mysterious circumstances surrounding the macabre murder of the young teenager. It immediately emerges that the cause of death is a drug with an unknown composition that has recently been introduced in the city. Moving from one side of the metropolis to the other, from the suburbs to the luxurious villas by the sea, Ali and Brian will find themselves with their lives changed and forced to confront their own inner demons.
cast: Orlando Bloom, Forest Whitaker, Tanya Van Graan, Natasha Loring, Conrad Kemp, Sven Ruygrok, Tinarie Van Wyk Loots, Adrian Galley, Kelsey Egan, Roxanne Prentice

title: Zulu Dawn
synopsis: Year of grace 1878: the English soldiers, regimented and loyal to formal discipline, in order not to break ranks sprawling, let themselves be massacred in an ambush set by the warriors of the Zulu tribe, backward in terms of strategy but certainly more alert in tactics. The massacre creates complications for the settlement operations of the colonizers.
cast: Burt Lancaster, Peter O'Toole, Simon Ward, Denholm Elliott

title: Zulu Man in Japan
synopsis: In this documentary, South African rapper Nasty C hits the stage and streets of Tokyo, introducing himself to the city's sights, sounds and culture.
cast: Nasty C

title: Zum Vergleich
synopsis: The study of how brick production changes in the world is the subject of Haroun Farocki's analysis. The reflection in the form of a film essay focuses on the transformations that the forms of work have taken on in the era of neoliberalism and the great economic crisis.

title: Zum zum zum n. 2 - Sarà capitato anche a voi
synopsis: Tony is engaged to Rosalia, but one day he meets Valeria, a beautiful airplane pilot. Rosalia is a traditional girl, Valeria goes to the rich and goes shopping on Carnaby Street. A disappointed lover of Valeria accuses her rival of theft. Tony escapes and has the real culprit arrested. Then he decides to leave Valeria's company and return with Rosalia.
cast: Little Tony, Isabella Savona, Pippo Baudo, Orietta Berti, Walter Brugiolo, Peppino De Filippo, Dolores Palumbo, Enzo Cannavale, Nino Terzo, Enzo Guarini, Carlo Delle Piane, Lino Banfi

title: Zum zum zum. La canzone che mi passa per la testa
synopsis: Tony and Rosalia, neighbors in a southern village, love each other with a simple but sincere love. However, they are hindered by their respective families, especially by her father who would prefer the son of the landlady as son-in-law. Tony then, to force the situation, and with the complicity of his mother, "kidnaps" Rosalia.
cast: Little Tony, Isabella Savona, Peppino De Filippo, Walter Brugiolo, Enzo Cannavale, Nino Terzo, Vittorio Congia, Enzo Guarini, Elvira Tonelli, Enrico Montesano, Mario Meniconi, Paolo Panelli, Orietta Berti, Pippo Baudo, Bruno Canfora

title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
synopsis: Dessert wizard Adriano Zumbo looks for the next “Willy Wonka” in this tense competition that finds skilled amateurs competing for a $100,000 prize.
cast: Adriano Zumbo, Rachel Khoo

title: Zuppa di pesce
synopsis: In a large villa in Ansedonia, the family of the producer Ragonelli, a rich widower who has married an attractive widow, gathers. The children of the previous unions and the couple's only daughter, Isabella, therefore converge in the villa. It is she who recounts the successes and misadventures of her father, his contradictory character between scenes and tenderness, his own life and those of his family. Then, when she became an adult, Isabella devoted herself to cinema, which her parent loved so much.
cast: Philippe Noiret, Macha Meril, Chiara Caselli, Renzo Montagnani

title: Zurich
synopsis: In a desperate attempt to put the past behind her, Nina wanders the European highways when she meets German trucker Matthias and joins his travels. Nina, however, does not reveal much about herself and who she is, but it will soon become clear that her escape is the result of pain caused by the latest betrayal she suffered.
cast: Wende Snijders, Sacha Alexander Gersak, Barry Atsma, Martijn Lakemeier, Waléra Kanischtscheff, Eva Duijvestein, Tristan Göbel

title: Zvenigora
synopsis: An old Ukrainian stands guard over an ancient treasure buried many years ago. The old man has two grandsons, Pavlo, who is idle and arrogant, and Timoš, who is hardworking and jovial. When the First World War breaks out, the second will leave for the front, where he fraternizes with his German comrades, even risking being shot by the Tsarist army. When the October Revolution arrives, Timoš joins the Bolshevik faction, while Pavlo joins the counter-revolutionaries.
cast: Georgi Astafyev, Nikolai Nademsky, Vladimir Uralsky, Les Podorozhnij, Semyon Svashenko, I. Selyuk, L. Barné, L. Parshina, P. Sklyar Otawa, A. Simonov

title: Zvizdan
synopsis: Three different stories of forbidden love, of its fragility but also of its strength. Three stories spanning three decades and involving two neighboring Bosnian villages, separated by conflict and intolerance.
cast: Tihana Lazovic, Goran Markovic, Nives Ivankovic, Mira Banjac, Slavko Sobin, Dado Cosic, Trpimir Jurkic, Lukrecija Tudor, Stipe Radoja

title: Zwart water
synopsis: Lisa, a nine-year-old girl, discovers that her new friend is none other than the ghost of her mother's dead twin sister. His father, on the other hand, begins to suspect that his wife is hiding a terrible secret with deadly consequences.
cast: Hadewych Minis, Barry Atsma, Isabelle Stokkel, Charlotte Arnoldy, Steven Boen, Warre Borgmans, Philippe Colpaert, Els Dottermans, Marc Lauwrys, Viviane De Muynck

title: Zwartboek
synopsis: September 1944: the Jewish Rachel Stein, a splendid showgirl of the variety, escapes Nazi Germany to take refuge in Holland after her family was exterminated by Commander Franken. To take revenge on those who - by betraying - favored the carnage, Rachel assumes the new identity of Ellis de Vries and infiltrates the high German officers ...
cast: Carice Van Houten, Sebastian Koch, Thom Hoffman, Halina Reijn, Derek De Lint

title: Zwei Leben
synopsis: Europe, 1990. The Berlin Wall has just collapsed and Katherine (Liv Ullman), who grew up in East Germany, has lived happily in Norway for more than 20 years with her mother, husband, daughter and granddaughter. Born from a relationship between a Norwegian woman and a German soldier during the Second World War, she is a so-called "daughter of war". Her peaceful existence is turned upside down when a lawyer asks her and her mother to testify in a trial against the Norwegian state brought by a group of other war children. Slowly a web of secrets and concealments is revealed to her, stripping her of any certainty about her real identity.
cast: Liv Ullmann, Ken Duken, Juliane Köhler, Vicky Krieps, Rainer Bock, Sven Nordin, Julia Bache Wiig, Jürgen Rißmann, Daniel Krauss, Thomas Lawincky

title: Zycie jako smiertelna choroba przenoszona droga plciowa
synopsis: Tomasz, a 60-year-old doctor, discovers he is seriously ill. Shocked, he begins to deny the values ??on which his life was based and behaves in a cynical and ruthless manner. But a film about the life of Saint Bernard leads him to question the meaning of his own existence ...
cast: Zbigniew Zapasiewicz, Krystyna Janda, Tadeusz Bradecki, Monika Krzywkowska, Szymon Bobrowski, Pawel Okraska

title: Zyuden Sentai Kyoryuger
synopsis: Long ago, in the time of the dinosaurs, the Earth was invaded by forces from outer space. The only people capable of the stopping them was a team known as the Kyouki Ryu no Sha, the People of the Strong Dragons, or, Kyoryuger for short. Now, in the modern world, they return using the powers of the Beast Batteries to fight off this revived threat
tags: Father-Son Relationship, Superhero Male Lead, Slight Romance, Multiple Mains
cast: Saito Syuusuke, Ryusei Ryo, Maruyama Atsushi, Shiono Akihisa, Kinjo Yamato, Konno Ayuri
director: Sakamoto Koichi, Shibasaki Takayuki, Watanabe Katsuya, Suzumura Nobuhiro, Konaka Kazuya

title: Záhrada
cast: Roman Luknár, Marián Labuda, Zuzana Sulajová, Jana Svandová

title: Zéro de conduite
synopsis: A group of adolescents, at the end of the holidays, return to the boarding school, to its teachers and supervisors, to its rigid and ill-tolerated discipline. Between transgressions, provocations and exemplary punishments, the tension grows. While a young overseer passes to the opposite camp, the boys join forces, led by a trio of rebels, and they come to unleash a real revolt.
cast: Jean Dasté, Louis Lefebvre, Gilbert Pruchon, Robert Le Flon, Coco Golstein, Gérard De Bédarieux

title: [REC] 4 - Apocalipsis
synopsis: Angela Vidal, a young television reporter who entered the infected building with the firefighter, has become the main carrier of the strange infection. She needs to be provisionally quarantined, in a place from which she cannot easily escape, and in solitary confinement for several days. An old oil tanker, several miles offshore and surrounded by water on all sides, has been specially equipped to accommodate cases like yours.
cast: Manuela Velasco, Paco Manzanedo, Héctor Colomé, Ismael Fritschi, Críspulo Cabezas, Paco Obregón, Mariano Venancio, María Alfonsa Rosso, Cristian Aquino

title: [REC]²
synopsis: The story resumes fifteen minutes after the events recounted in [REC]. A medical officer and an assault team are sent to the building whose inhabitants have been infected with a dangerous virus.
cast: Manuela Velasco, Leticia Dolera, Javier Botet, Ferran Terraza, Ana Isabel Velásquez, David Vert, Andrea Ros, Juli Fàbregas, Alejandro Casaseca, Ariel Casas

title: [REC]³ Genesis
synopsis: Clara and Koldo have organized their wedding in the smallest detail in order to make it the most beautiful and unforgettable day of their entire life. They did not foresee, however, that none of the guests will be able to erase from their mind what is about to happen due to a mysterious virus that spreads quickly during the reception, unleashing a hell of horrors from which it is impossible to escape.
cast: Leticia Dolera, Diego Martín, Javier Botet, Àlex Monner, Ismael Martínez, Ana Isabel Velásquez, Mireia Ros, Itziar Castro, Blai Llopis, Emilio Mencheta

title: [Rec]
synopsis: A TV journalist looking for a story of great impact finally has the right opportunity: one night, in fact, she is invited to shoot a report on the firefighters of the city. The moment seems to come when an old lady is trapped in the house, but the night turns into a nightmare ...
cast: Manuela Velasco, Ferran Terrazza, Carlos Lasarte

title: [email Protected]
synopsis: Akihabara is a Tokyo district full of mangas, anime, electronics, video games, figurines, etc. It is a place that gathers fanatics of such themes, people who are commonly referred to as otaku. Page, Box, Akira, Taiko, Daruma, and Izumu are six otakus, each with his/her own troubles, who sought relief through a website called "Yui's Lifeguard". When the site owner, Yui, died of a mysterious death, the six, who are each expert in their own fields, gathered to form "[email protected]", a "troubleshooter" group that vows to protect Akihabara and solve the problems of its inhabitants. (Source: AsianMediaWiki)
tags: Adapted From A Novel, City Setting, Friendship
cast: Ikuta Toma, Kazama Shunsuke, Himura Yuki, Hoshino Gen, Honjo Manami, Kosaka Yuka

title: aKasha
synopsis: Adnan is a Sudanese revolutionary who is considered a war hero. The love for his AK47 rifle is matched only by that for Lina, his patient girlfriend. When Adnan, on leave, is slow to return to the military unit, the Blues commander launches a kasha: a round-up to arrest the lazy soldiers who are missing the roll. Taken by surprise, Adnan runs away with his friend Absi. The odd couple research all ways to reunite Adnan with his weapon - and with Lina - and to escape the comrades of the military unit.
cast: Kamal Ramadan, Ekram Marcus, Ganja Chakado, Abdallah Alnur

title: e Dio disse a Caino...
synopsis: Gary Hamilton is a Northern Army officer who, following Acombar's false accusations, is convicted of a robbery and murder. After ten years, Gary obtains a pardon and returns to his country, however determined to take revenge on his accuser, who in the meantime has become very rich.
cast: Klaus Kinski, Perter Carsten, Marcella Michelangeli, Lee Burton

title: eXistenZ
synopsis: eXistenZ, a game based on advanced technologies created by the executives of Antenna Research, has been a great success with the public. Behind the game lies the ingenuity of Allegra Geller, a determined and attractive woman. What makes eXistenZ so real is the fact that the device that drives it, the game pod, plugs directly into the player's nervous system via a spinal connector. But anti-eXistenZ forces, who have put a bounty on Allegra's head, sabotage the game.
cast: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Ian Holm, Jude Law, Don McKellar

title: iKON TV
synopsis: From YG Entertainment, the K-Pop boyband called 'iKON' releases their TV Reality showing how they are in their personal life, how they get along with work and partners and they show a lot of fun with some of their activities
cast: Han Bin Kim, Koo Jun Hoe, Kim Jin Hwan, Chan Woo Jung

title: io sono Li
synopsis: Shun Li came to Italy from China in search of fortune. After being employed in a Roman textile workshop, the girl finds a job as a bartender in a tavern in Chioggia, where she meets Bepi, nicknamed the Poet, a fisherman of Slavic origins. Their friendship is destined to strengthen and become ever deeper thanks to the poetry that allows them to estrange themselves from the hostilities that divide their respective communities and from the economic difficulties that affect the country.
cast: Zhao Tao, Rade Serbedzija, Marco Paolini, Roberto Citran, Giuseppe Battiston

title: loudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
w Delta z
synopsis: A series of mysterious deaths occur in New York. Some corpses are found mutilated while others have a mysterious equation engraved on the skin. As Detective Argo and new colleague Helen discover the meaning of the equation, they realize that each victim is faced with a difficult choice: kill someone they love or die. It quickly becomes clear to them that the killer has also suffered the same fate and must be stopped before it is too late.
cast: Stellan Skarsgård, Melissa George, Ashley Walters, Tom Hardy, Paul Kaye, John Sharian, Selma Blair, Barbara Adair, Peter Ballance, Sally Hawkins

title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
synopsis: Xander Cage, a former extreme athlete turned government agent, emerges from his self-imposed exile and collides with the deadly warrior Xiang and his gang to recover a sinister, seemingly unstoppable weapon known as Pandora's Box. By recruiting new helpers in search of strong emotions, Xander finds himself embroiled in a deadly plot that could affect even the top ranks of world governments.
cast: Vin Diesel, Nina Dobrev, Samuel L. Jackson, Ice Cube, Ruby Rose, Toni Collette, Deepika Padukone, Donnie Yen, Tony Jaa, Conor McGregor

title: ¡Ay, mi madre!
synopsis: When her estranged mother suddenly dies, a woman must follow the quirky instructions laid out in the will in order to collect an important inheritance.
cast: Estefanía De Los Santos, Secun De La Rosa, Terele Pávez, María Alfonsa Rosso, Mariola Fuentes, Alfonso Sánchez, Paz Vega, Marta Torné, Concha Galán

title: ¡Dispara!
synopsis: Ana is a circus acrobat whose specialty is shooting from a running horse. A journalist, Marcos, frequents her and falls in love with her, but one night, Marcos is absent, the woman is raped by three young mechanics. Ana lurks near the garage where the three work and shoots them all. The hunt for the avenging horseman is unleashed all over the country and not even Marcos can save her.
cast: Francesca Neri, Antonio Banderas, Walter Vidarte, Eulalia Ramon

title: ¡Muere, Monstruo, muere!
synopsis: At the end of winter, a snowstorm covers the Andes. The bodies of several beheaded women are found near an isolated border post at the foot of the mountains. A man, David, who has been missing for days, is searched in vain by the local police, led by Cruz. Husband of Francisca, Cruz's lover, David soon becomes the prime suspect. Captured, he is sent to a psychiatric hospital, from where he begins to claim that he witnesses the brutal and inexplicable apparitions of a monster.
cast: Esteban Bigliardi, Victor Lopez, Romina Iniesta, Tania Casciani, Jorge Prado, Sofía Palomino, Stéphane Rideau

title: ¡Mátalo!
synopsis: Escaped from the gallows and left for dead by his partners after the assault on a stagecoach, a bandit arrives in an abandoned village, where his accomplices have found refuge, for the showdown. Here he meets a young Aussie who looks meek and helpless but is a real boomerang ace.
cast: Lou Castel, Corrado Pani, Antonio Salines, Luis Davila, Claudia Gravy, Anna Maria Noè, Miguel Del Castillo, Ana María Mendoza, Bruno Boschetti, Mirella Pamphili

title: ¡Que viva Mexico!
synopsis: The original project of his film included some episodes enclosed between a prologue and an epilogue. Dominant reasons: death and the eternal feminine. In the prologue the faces of the peons are compared with the pre-Columbian sculptures and underline the continuity of the story. The first episode is set in a sort of primeval Eden where men and nature coexist peacefully. In another chapter, the director shows the rural world of the turn of the century under the dictatorship of Porfirio Díaz. A peasant is brutally murdered by the fazenderos for wanting to rebel against an outrage made to his woman. Also famous is the epilogue with the macabre dance of the day of the dead and people covered in skull-shaped masks ...
cast: Attori Non Professionisti

title: ¡Viva America!
synopsis: Twenties. Frank, having abandoned Sicily, joins his brothers in Chicago. We are in full prohibition and the quick-handed Sicilian, determined to expand business, puts a spoke in the wheel of the local underworld. But the offenders do not allow their business to be hindered.
cast: Jeffrey Hunter, Margaret Lee, William Bogart, Anna Maria Pierangeli

title: ¡Vivan las Antipodas!
synopsis: Following the contradictions of nature and the people who inhabit our planet, the documentary focuses on four pairs of states at the antipodes. Telling antithetical but similar life stories - centered on a lone fisherman in an Argentine village, a woman selling fish on a busy Shanghai street, a Chilean lighthouse keeper on Cape Horn and a ship's officer on the lake Baikal - images of four pairs of countries located opposite each other are offered: Argentina and China, Chile and Russia, Hawaii and Botswana, New Zealand and Spain.

title: ¿A quién te llevarías a una isla desierta?
synopsis: Marcos, Marta, Celeste and Eze created their universe in a ramshackle apartment they share in the Spanish capital, Madrid. They are neither college students nor teenagers, although they are still waiting for the big moment to remember forever. The day they leave the apartment they are called to face reality made up of dreams, successes, failures, fifteen minutes of fame and the moment that changes everything forever.
cast: Pol Monen, Jaime Lorente, Andrea Ros, María Pedraza, Celia De Molina

title: ¿Por qué lo llaman amor cuando quieren decir sexo?
synopsis: Gloria is a porn actress who performs in live shows. After his workmate falls ill, he is replaced by a boy, Manu, who turns out to be surprisingly good, so much so that Gloria gets involved with him. But Gloria doesn't know that the boy is full of gambling debts. Things soon start to change ...
cast: Veronica Forqué, Jorge Sanz, Rosa María Sardà, Fernando Guillen

title: ¿Quién puede matar a un niño?
synopsis: A couple of British tourists on vacation rent a boat to go to an island off the south coast of Spain. Upon their arrival they discover that the village seems to be inhabited only by children, who moreover do not answer their questions and look at them with a strange and disturbing smile. They will soon discover that children are possessed and possessed by a mysterious force that makes them aggressive (and lethal) towards adults.
cast: Lewis Fiander, Prunella Ransome, Antonio Iranzo, Miguel Narros, María Luisa Arias, Marisa Porcel, Juan Cazalilla, Luis Ciges, Antonio Canal, Aparicio Rivero

title: ¿Qué he hecho yo para merecer esto?
synopsis: Gloria is desperate: she works as a cleaner in a gym, her husband Antonio lives in the memory of Ingrid, his German mistress; of the two children, Toni is a drug dealer and Miguel, a homosexual, leads "life". Moreover, Antonio's mother also has to put up with her mother at home. Luckily there is Cristal, a prostitute but a true friend. In a quarrel, Gloria will end up killing Antonio with a ham bone, but this does not mean things will fall into place ... Pedro Almodovar unleashed, in one of his best films, when his fame still barely crossed the Spanish borders and his name was not yet a signature destined for international circuits. Turbulent narration and free-wheeling vitriol.
cast: Carmen Maura, Angel De Andrés López, Veronica Forqué, Kiti Manver

title: À Deriva
synopsis: Filipa is 14 years old and is on vacation with her parents in Buzios, a paradise located on the coast north of Rio. He is in a delicate phase of his growth, a transition phase between adolescence and maturity, and his first love has the effect of making it tangible. But the difficulty translates into anguish when he discovers that his father, a well-known writer, is cheating on his mother with a woman who lives in a small town by the sea. A secret that will prove to be not the only one, but the first of a long series, about her family, about herself.
cast: Camilla Belle, Vincent Cassel, Taís Araújo, Cauã Reymond, Débora Bloch, Laura Leto, Max Huzar

title: À Flor do Mar
synopsis: A young Italian widow spends the summer in Portugal. One day on the beach he finds a man dying, he hosts him in his house and, at the request of the same man, he keeps him hidden, even if he does not yet know why. As the days go by, the two deepen their knowledge and love blossoms again in the woman.
cast: Laura Morante, Philip Spinelli, Manuela De Freitas, Georges Claisse, Teresa Villaverde, Sérgio Antunes, Rita Figueiredo, Conceição Senna, Haddy Moss, Gerd Volkmar

title: À Nous la Liberté
synopsis: Emilie helps Louis escape from prison by sacrificing himself. Some time later, both of them are free to find the first worker the second master but once again in difficulty. They decide to drop everything and go wandering.
cast: Raymond Cordy, Henri Marchand, Paul Olivier, Rolla France

title: À Voix Haute
synopsis: Every year at the University of Saint Denis, in the Parisian suburbs, a contest based on eloquence is held to determine the best speaker. Coming from diverse socio-cultural backgrounds, students prepare for the competition closely followed by speaking professionals such as lawyers and poets. Thanks to rhetoric, young people tell and discover themselves, revealing their most personal stories.

title: À bout de souffle
synopsis: Michel is a displaced young man: the modern heir to the cursed romantics is incapable of living according to the rules of bourgeois society. He steals a car, flees to Italy, but the police chase him. Two agents intercept him and Michel kills one. He returns to Paris where he finds refuge with Patricia, a young American with whom he has a complicated love affair. The termination of their relationship coincides with a new police report. For Michel, the reckoning is getting closer and closer.
cast: Jean Seberg, Jean Paul Belmondo, Henri Jacques Huet, Van Doude, Daniel Boulanger, Roger Hanin, Claude Mansard, Liliane Dreyfus, Michel Fabre, Jean Pierre Melville, Jean Luc Godard

title: À bout portant
synopsis: Following a car accident, an undocumented man is hospitalized in serious condition. While he is in the hospital unconscious, someone tries to kill him. It turns out then that the stranger is a certain Hugo Sartet, prejudiced, and perhaps implicated in the murder of an entrepreneur. Meanwhile, Samuel Pierret, a student nurse in the ward where Sartet is, is the victim of a terrible blackmail: his young wife, expecting their first child, is kidnapped by two criminals, who threaten to kill her if Samuel does not satisfy theirs. criminal request.
cast: Gilles Lellouche, Roschdy Zem, Gérard Lanvin, Elena Anaya, Mireille Perrier, Claire Pérot, Moussa Maaskri, Pierre Benoist, Valérie Dashwood, Virgile Bramly

title: À bras ouverts
synopsis: A leading figure on the French literary and media scene, Jean-Etienne Fougerole is a humanist intellectual married to a wealthy heiress disconnected from reality. While promoting his new book on TV in which he invites those in need to welcome them into their homes, his opponent challenges him to put into practice what he wrote in the volume. Caught off guard and determined not to lose face, Jean-Etienne accepts the challenge, putting his very existence to the test.
cast: Christian Clavier, Ary Abittan, Elsa Zylberstein, Cyril Lecomte, Nanou Garcia, Oscar Berthe, Mirela Nicolau

title: À chacun son enfer
cast: Annie Girardot, Hardy Krüger, Bernard Fresson, Stéphane Hillel

title: À corps et à cris
synopsis: Journalist Bernard Terrier is transferred from Paris to Bordeaux for having caused the suicide of a banker in an article of his own. On his first evening in Bordeaux, he finds himself embroiled in the murder of a bar pianist. With the help of a radio announcer he decides to investigate, but discovers that several strong powers are hidden behind the murder.
cast: Martin Lamotte, Zabou, Jean Pierre Bisson, Bernard Freyd

title: À fond
synopsis: A family leaves early in the morning in a minivan to avoid the traffic jams of the summer holidays. Programming a speed of 130 km / h with the cruise control, his father Tom proceeds quickly when, due to an error for which he should turn back, he realizes that he no longer has control of the car. All the maneuvers to slow the machine have no effect.
cast: José Garcia, André Dussollier, Caroline Vigneaux, Josephine Callies, Stylane Lecaille, Charlotte Gabris, Vincent Desagnat, Florence Foresti, Jérôme Commandeur, Vladimir Houbart

title: À l'abordage
synopsis: One summer evening, in Paris, Félix meets Alma by chance and the two are immediately in harmony. Félix then decides to visit her by surprise in the place where she is on vacation with her family and involves her best friend in an adventure that will change their lives forever.
cast: Éric Nantchouang, Salif Cissé, Édouard Sulpice, Asma Messaoudene, Ana Blagojevic, Lucie Gallo, Martin Mesnier, Nicolas Pietri, Cécile Feuillet, Jordan Rezgui

title: À l'attaque!
synopsis: Two screenwriters have to write a political film set in the district of l'Estaque in Marseille. They invent the story of a family of Italian origin who manages a garage with money that is never enough, banks that hound and bosses who do not pay with the trick of "bankruptcy liquidation. The two authors have irony to sell and enough detachment to avoid fall into the pitfalls of Manichaeism that takes itself seriously, and then they throw themselves first into the Jacques Demy musical, then into the cinema of the Popular Front.
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Jacques Boudet, Pierre Banderet

title: À l'aventure
synopsis: A young woman, after a philosophical discussion with a taxi driver, decides to change her life, in search of freedom. First, she quits her job and breaks up with her boyfriend, who hasn't satisfied her for a long time. In a bar, a psychiatrist, Grégoire, meets with whom he begins a sexual relationship. Things get complicated when the two meet a woman who is particularly susceptible to hypnosis. The three, then, together with a former lover of Grégoire, begin an adventure in sexuality that will lead them to discover - and perhaps reach - the ultimate orgasm.
cast: Carole Brana, Arnaud Binard, Nadia Chibani, Lise Bellynck, Etienne Chicot, Estelle Galarme, Frédéric Aspisi, Jocelyn Quivrin, Michèle Larue

title: À l'aveugle
synopsis: The mutilated corpse of a young woman is found inside her home, which shows no sign of forced entry and does not present evidence to help trace the perpetrator of the crime. The investigation ends up in the hands of Commissioner Lassalle, a policeman with a long experience and in full crisis after the untimely death of his wife. While a series of unsolved crimes begins to follow one another in the city that suggest the imprint of a serial killer, Lassalle's suspicions focus on the blind Narvik, whose infirmity could be an excellent alibi to act undisturbed.
cast: Jacques Gamblin, Lambert Wilson, Raphaëlle Agogué, Antoine Levannier, Frédéric Kontogom, David Capelle, Marie Vincent, Nathalie Vignes, Pascal Demolon, Nicolas Pignon, Miglen Mirtchev

title: À l'intérieur
synopsis: After the tragic death of her husband in a car accident, which took place four months earlier when she was five months pregnant, Sarah remained alone and such wants to remain on Christmas Eve, despite the insistence of the mother. The night of the eve is the last one that the young woman will be able to spend in her home. The next morning, in fact, he is expected in the hospital to give birth. At Sarah's house everything appears calm, until someone wakes it up by knocking insistently. Beyond the door, an unknown woman ready for anything to tear the child Sarah brings on his lap.
cast: Béatrice Dalle, Alysson Paradis, Nathalie Roussel, François Régis Marchasson, Jean Baptiste Tabourin, Dominique Frot, Claude Lulé, Hyam Zeytoun, Tahar Rahim, Emmanuel Guez

title: À l'origine
synopsis: A scammer manages to pass himself off as foreman responsible for the construction of a motorway section in France. In his intentions there is only the idea of ??being able to steal some money, but the scam gets out of hand. And as the business escalates and he is believed to be increasingly powerful and influential, he meets a woman - mayor of a village involved in the construction of the highway - who gets in the way and at the same time reveals to him a world that he did not know: that feelings.
cast: Gérard Depardieu, François Cluzet, Emmanuelle Devos, Stéphanie Sokolinski, Vincent Rottiers, Brice Fournier, Roch Leibovici

title: À la folie... pas du tout
synopsis: Angelica, a student at the academy of fine arts, to earn some money works as a bartender in a club. Met by chance Loïc, an appreciated cardiologist, he falls in love with her. She doesn't care much that the man is married and that his wife is expecting a baby. Angelica storms him with messages and sends him gifts that make him nervous. The girl continues to imagine a happy life with him.
cast: Sophie Guillemin, Isabelle Carré, Samuel Le Bihan, Audrey Tautou, Clément Sibony

title: À la place du coeur
synopsis: Clim goes to see Bebé in prison, unjustly imprisoned by a racist policeman (Bebé is black), to tell him that she is pregnant. The two have always known each other and family members are also at home. The background is Marseille, with its alleys and its hanging clothes, its races and its strong contradictions. It will be the girl's mother who will find the witness "invited" to recognize Bebé and then fled to Sarajevo, her homeland.
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Gérard Meylan

title: À ma s¦ur!
synopsis: Anaïs and Elena are two sisters of twelve and sixteen. The first is quite plump and suffers from her condition. The second, on the contrary, is of explosive beauty and is aware of its power of seduction. Over the course of a summer Elena meets an Italian boy who makes her discover the pleasures of physical love. Anaïs is content to follow and secretly observe the two lovers. When the parents notice what is happening they decide to return home. On the way back, the drama breaks out.
cast: Anaïs Reboux, Roxane Mesquida, Laura Betti, Libero De Rienzo

title: À meia-noite levarei sua alma
cast: José Mojica Marins (Zé Do Caixão), Magda Mei, Nivaldo Lima, Valéria Vasquez

title: À mon âge je me cache encore pour fumer
synopsis: In the heart of a hammam, far from the accusing gazes of men, a group of women - mothers, lovers, virgins and Islamic fanatics - mingle and confront each other. They laugh, cry, express their anger and talk about the Bible and the Koran, before the flash of a dagger and the silence of God.
cast: Hiam Abbass, Fadila Belkebla, Nassima Benchicou, Biyouna, Nadia Kaci

title: À nos amours
synopsis: A wealthy young woman looks for new emotions and casually switches from one love to another. The fifteen-year-old on a break with her family decides to leave for America with one of her boyfriends.
cast: Sandrine Bonnaire, Maurice Pialat, Evelyne Ker, Dominique Besnehard

title: À nous deux
synopsis: Françoise is a charming bourgeois, Simon is a nice rogue: they meet and fall in love, so much so that Françoise decides to give up her comfortable life to raid - like Bonnie and Clyde - in the South of France ...
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Jacques Dutronc, Jacques Villeret, Paul Préboist

title: À peine j'ouvre les yeux
synopsis: Tunis, summer 2010, a few months before the Revolution against Ben Ali's government. Eighteen-year-old Farah joins the Joujma band that voices the discontent of a generation, ignoring the warnings of her mother who is well aware of the dangers of a regime that infiltrates youth protest and strikes by surprise. The woman will do everything to protect her daughter, even putting her past on the line.
cast: Baya Medhaffer, Ghalia Benali, Montassar Ayari, Aymen Omrani, Lassaad Jamoussi, Deena Abdelwahed, Youssef Soltana, Marwen Soltana

title: À plein temps
synopsis: Determined to do what she can to raise her two children in the countryside, Julie meanwhile works in a luxurious Parisian hotel. When he finally gets an interview for a job in which he had long ago pinned his hopes, a national strike breaks out and paralyzes the public transport system. The precarious balance that the woman has built is in jeopardy. Julie then engages in a frantic race against time, risking to waver.
cast: Laure Calamy, Lucie Gallo, Cyril Masson, Olivier Faliez

title: À vendre
synopsis: In front of the church where Lindien's wedding should be celebrated, there are many people curious to see a guy like him get married. But there's a problem. France Robert, betrothed, ran away with a purse containing five hundred thousand francs. What does Lindien know about his future wife? Virtually nothing. The investigator in charge of finding her, Luigi Primo, will have to settle for somewhat fragmentary information: that the woman is an orphan, was born in the Champagne region and has a passion for running ...
cast: Sergio Castellitto, Sandrine Kiberlain, Jean François Stévenin, Aurore Clément, Chiara Mastroianni

title: Á annan veg
synopsis: Iceland, 1980s. Finn and Alfred are two employees who work for the Icelandic road administration who have decided to spend the summer drawing lines on the asphalt in the north of the country, in an arid and desolate territory almost on the edge of the world where there is no no one else but them. The two can bear very little and Finn has accepted the presence of the younger Alfred only because he is the boyfriend of his sister but the almost forced coexistence leads him to discover sides of the other's character that give rise to an unexpected and intense friendship.
cast: Hilmar Guðjónsson, Sveinn Ólafur Gunnarsson, Þorsteinn Bachmann, Valgerður Rúnarsdóttir, Þorbjörn Guðmundsson, Runólfur Ingólfsson

title: Á köldum klaka
cast: Masatoshi Nagase, Lili Taylor, Fisher Stevens, Gísli Halldórsson

title: Água e sal
synopsis: Ana lives with her husband and daughter in a small seaside town. When the man decides to leave, Ana is presented with the opportunity to complete a long pending job. But his concentration is seriously threatened when he starts walking on the beach: he will have to save a stranger from drowning, he will meet Alexandre and Emilia and welcome Vera, a friend who suddenly shows up at his house ...
cast: Galatea Ranzi, Joaquim De Almeida, Alexandre Pinto, Clara Jost

title: Árni
synopsis: A lone nomad who works for an itinerant circus, tries in every way to tame a python in the hope of being able to enter the graces of the family that manages the show.
cast: Péter Turi, Andrea Spolarics

title: Átame!
synopsis: "Released from the asylum and alone in the world, Ricky is in love with a horror film actress, Marina. He follows her home and kidnaps her to convince her to live with him and have children together. The woman, little by little, begins to to feel attraction for that man; in the end, when they come to free her, a great love is born between the two.
cast: Victoria Abril, Antonio Banderas, Francisco Rabal, Loles Leon, Maria Barranco, Rossy De Palma, Julieta Serrano, Lola Cardona

title: Äkta människor
synopsis: In a parallel present, the Androids called Hubot have become part of human everyday life but also began to originate new problems and dilemmas. For example, who is responsible for the actions of a hubot? What rights do the same hubots have? What rewards should they have for their work? Then when an ever -growing number of Hubot holds emotional relationships with humans, the boundaries between men and machines are confused, generating a further and thorny question: what does human really mean?
cast: Lisette Pagler, Pia Halvorsen, Johan Paulsen, Natalie Minnevik, Kåre Hedebrant, Leif Andrée, Josephine Alhanko, Marie Robertson, Fredrik Silbersky, Anki Larsson

title: Äta sova dö
synopsis: Rasa has just lost its job within a Swedish factory. For her, a young Balkan immigrant and without a high school diploma, this means confronting the first time with the much feared employment system in crisis. Finding a new job, also miserable that it is, is not somewhat easy and it soon finds itself on a collision course with the society of the well -thinking, made of values ​​and expectations in clear contradiction with real behaviors.
cast: Nermina Lukac, Milan Dragisic, Jonathan Lampinen, Peter Falt, Ruzica Pichler

title: Ådalen '31
synopsis: The Swedish city of Adalen in 1931 was the scene of violent clashes between the striking workers and the police, on the one hand, and the strike-breakers on the other, waiting for a solution, which did not come from the trade unionists and the bosses.
cast: Peter Schildt, Kerstin Tidelius, Roland Hedlund, Jonas Bergström

title: Året jag slutade prestera och började onanera
synopsis: The ambitious and determined Hanna is determined to get pregnant and have a son before he is too late, but his boyfriend suddenly leaves her and without too many explanations. The world of Hanna collapsed on itself and everything on which she has always entrusted now it seems senseless, forcing her to reflect on the profound meaning of everything that has chased up to that moment.
cast: Katia Winter, Jesper Zuschlag, Henrik Dorsin, Nour El Refai, Vera Carlbom, Hannes Fohlin, Siw Erixon, Antonio Di Ponziano, Pablo Leiva Wenger, David Wiberg, Bahar Pars, Sara Shirpey, Albin Grenholm, Disa Östrand, Amadeus Durmaz, Hulda Sveindís Jóhannesdóttir, Happy Jankell, Zacke Zachrisson

title: Återträffen
synopsis: Twenty years after finishing her studies, Anna has to go on a reunion with her former schoolmates but arrives late for dinner. Recalling the painful period in which she was systematically avoided by everyone, Anna throws words of fire and accusations against the diners, bullying, hierarchies, oppression and aggression, ending up being ousted again.
cast: Anna Odell, Anders Berg, Robert Fransson, Sandra Andreis, Rikard Svensson, Niklas Engdahl, Sanna Krepper

title: Æon Flux
synopsis: Aiming to hasten an uprising, the leader of an underground rebellion dispatches acrobatic assassin Aeon Flux to eliminate the government's top leader.
cast: Charlize Theron, Marton Csokas, Jonny Lee Miller, Sophie Okonedo, Frances McDormand, Pete Postlethwaite, Amelia Warner, Caroline Chikezie, Nikolai Kinski, Paterson Joseph, Yangzom Brauen

title: Æon Flux
synopsis: Æon Flux is a mysterious and amoral secret agent from the country of Monica. Her motives or background are left unexplained, as are those of her antagonist/love, Trevor Goodchild. On her ... See full summary »
cast: Denise Poirier, John Rafter Lee, Julia Fletcher, Alex Fernandez

title: Ça commence aujourd'hui
synopsis: Daniel, a man in his fifties, is a teacher and runs the Hernaing kindergarten near Valenciennes. The town's population is made up of former miners. Daniel loves his job, but feels trapped by the hierarchy. He has to limit himself to teaching the basic disciplines, while his pupils arrive in the classroom hungry and in tattered clothes. But Daniel, the son of a miner, decides to rebel against this state of affairs.
cast: Philippe Torreton, Maria Pitarresi, Nadia Kaci, Françoise Bette

title: Ça commence par la fin
synopsis: During a summer in Paris, a man (Michaël Cohen) and a woman (Emmanuelle Béart) love each other carried away by passion, they break up abruptly and then they reunite. Theirs is a love story like many others but without a logical order in which everything starts from the end.
cast: Emmanuelle Béart, Michael Cohen, Léopold Kraus, Jean Paul Dubois, Meiji U Tum'si, Patrick Vincent, Mikis Cerleix, Shane Vives Atsara Woodward, Jean Pierre Monnier, Jérémie Bloess

title: Ça ira - Il fiume della rivolta
synopsis: Tinto Brass, light years away from the erotic cinema that made it famous, offers an overview of the main events of the twentieth century. From the October revolution to the Mexican one, from the Great War to the invasion of China by the Japanese, from the Spanish War to the Second World War, from the Nazi madness to the death camps, to the dropping of the two atomic bombs on Japan. In short, there is no historical event that has escaped this skilful work of editing stock images.
cast: Attori Non Professionisti

title: Ça ira mieux demain
synopsis: Elizabeth is a 30-year-old aspiring writer, single, obsessive and depressed. Sophie is in her forties, married to Xavier, a psychoanalyst, pranotherapist and sexual handle, and quite irritable. Franck, on the other hand, is a bulimic in love with Sophie. These and other characters chase each other and escape each other in the course of their bourgeois lives.
cast: Nathalie Baye, Jeanne Balibar, Jean Pierre Darroussin, Danielle Darrieux

title: Ça reste entre nous
synopsis: Patrick is a man divided in half. He has a beautiful wife, Hélène, and two beautiful children. But he also has a mistress, Elisabeth, who in turn gave him a daughter, Rosalie. Perfectly able to handle this ménage, Patrick has been going on like this for years. But one day, when his wife throws a party on the occasion of their wedding anniversary, inviting the whole family and giving them a surprise, he realizes that without the gift of ubiquity he will not be able to hide the truth for much longer.
cast: Catherine Frot, Sam Karmann, Carole Brenner, Fanny Cottençon, Antoine Duléry, Séverine Ferrer, Stéphane Freiss, Martin Lamotte, François Morel, Isabelle Nanty

title: Çarsi Pazar
synopsis: The slacker owner of a public bath house rallies his community to save it when a big developer comes to town to close it down and open a new mall.
cast: Erdem Yener, Ayhan Taş, Emin Olcay, Muharrem Gülmez, Elif Nur Kerkük, Tarık Papuççuoğlu, Suzan Aksoy, Doğa Konakoğlu, Esin Eden, Deniz Özerman

title: Çirkin dünya
synopsis: Three criminals force themselves into the villa of a Turkish surgeon. To leave they ask for a lot of money. The doctor agrees, but the reckoning will come.
cast: Hülya Koçyigit, Savas Basar, Dogan Bavli, Oktar Durukan, Bülent Kayabas, Günfer Feray, Ahmet Danyal Topatan, Osman Alyanak, Ismail Hakki Sen, Renan Fosforoglu

title: Çok Filim Hareketler Bunlar
synopsis: Vignettes of the summer holidays follow vacationers as they battle mosquitoes, suffer ruined plans and otherwise hit snags in their precious time off.
cast: Ayça Erturan, Aydan Taş, Ayşegül Akdemir, Burcu Gönder, Bülent Emrah Parlak, Büşra Pekin, Emre Canpolat, Ersin Korkut, Eser Yenenler, Gizem Tuğral, Gülhan Tekin, Gülsüm Alkan, Hamdi Kahraman, İbrahim Büyükak, Metin Keçeci

title: È arrivata la parigina
synopsis: An ambitious French girl, who moved to Italy to be an actress, fails to break through and then opts for a normal life. But love and work are around the corner.
cast: Magali Noël, Jorge Mistral, Titina De Filippo, Maria Fiore, Franco Fabrizi

title: È arrivato il Cavaliere
synopsis: The knight is the factotum of a group of street vendors camped in the Milanese suburbs who go out of their way to save friends from eviction.
cast: Tino Scotti, Enrico Viarisio, Enzo Biliotti, Silvana Pampanini

title: È arrivato l'accordatore
synopsis: Achille Scorzella is a poor, always hungry devil who can't find a job. Arrived in the home of a rich family, he is mistaken for a piano tuner. It so happens that Achille, who has been dreaming of having a hearty lunch for days, attends the preparations for the sumptuous lunch set to celebrate the engagement of the host's daughter. A series of amusing setbacks prevents the partner from sitting at the table. Poor Achilles ends up in the hands of some criminals who have mistaken him for another person.
cast: Nino Taranto, Alberto Sordi, Virgilio Riento, Antonella Lualdi

title: È arrivato mio fratello
synopsis: The very boring and banal Professor Ovid has a twin brother who, on the contrary, is exuberant and a troublemaker. More banal than that you die and in fact both Pozzetto and Castellano and Pipolo have never recovered.
cast: Renato Pozzetto, Carin McDonald, Armando Bandini, Pamela Prati

title: È caduta una donna
synopsis: A single mother marries a young doctor who doesn't seem to tolerate her past. Reluctantly he decides to leave his son to his mother-in-law.
cast: Isa Miranda, Rossano Brazzi, Claudio Gora, Luigi Pavese, Carla Martinelli

title: È forte un casino!
synopsis: Michele and his three friends find an advertisement in the newspaper: a rich American heiress is looking for an Italian noble with a romantic temperament. The cronies organize the scam, taking advantage of the fact that one of them is a guardian in the villa of a count. Of course, however, even to pretend to be noble a minimum of class would be necessary. But the woman is actually a crook herself ... The tireless couple Bombolo / Cannavale rages in this farce, which scrapes the bottom of the barrel, looking for four chewed gags for an audience of few pretensions. A worthy product of the darkest years of Italian "popular" cinema.
cast: Enzo Cannavale, Licinia Lentini, Bombolo, Sandro Ghiani, Gianni Ciardo

title: È già ieri
synopsis: Filippo, a well-known television journalist who deals with scientific dissemination, is sent to an islet in the Canary Islands to study a flock of storks that have nested on the top of a volcano. Enrico, a shy and kind young operator, accompanies him. Rita, a biologist, awaits them on the spot, who will guide them. Filippo has a hostile attitude towards his companions and the place. Having completed the service in one day, he would like to leave immediately, but is forced to spend the night on the island due to a violent storm. When he wakes up he realizes that everything seems to repeat itself the same as the previous day ...
cast: Antonio Albanese, Fabio De Luigi, Goya Toledo, Pepón Nieto, Beatriz Rico

title: È l'amor che mi rovina
synopsis: A ring containing a few drops of a dangerous atomic liquid is carried by the innocent Walter, a quiet shop assistant, to Sestrière to be delivered to a countess. Walter naturally manages to get himself, a friend of his and also Carla, a ski instructor with whom he is madly in love, into trouble. Then, fortunately, everything ends in the best way.
cast: Walter Chiari, Lucia Bosé, Aroldo Tieri, Eduardo Ciannelli, Jackie Frost, Virgilio Riento, Amedeo Dejana, Eugenio Cancelli, Enrico Leurini

title: È nata una star?
synopsis: Marco (Pietro Castellitto) is a teenager like the others who, without particular skills, is looking for his purpose in life when, realizing that nature has been particularly generous towards him, he shoots a porn film in the dark about his parents (Luciana Littizzetto and Rocco Papaleo). One morning, however, the mother finds in the mailbox the video, left especially by a neighbor, and she discovers Marco's secret with amazement. From that moment, feeling guilty, both parents realize that they know little about their son and that new reality but, while the father refuses to accept what happened, the mother begins to worry about everything that revolves around porn, about waiting for a adolescent like Marco disavows, such as money laundering, exploitation and violence.
cast: Luciana Littizzetto, Rocco Papaleo, Pietro Castellitto, Michela Cescon, Gisella Burinato, Cristina Odasso, Alice Torriani

title: È per il tuo bene
synopsis: Three families go into crisis when their daughters get engaged. Arturo, a conservative lawyer, Sergio, a quick-tempered worker with self-control problems, and Antonio, an upright policeman with a penchant for his daughter, are three fathers who see their worst nightmare come true when they realize that their three young and beautiful daughters have grown up. too fast. Arturo will see his daughter run away on his wedding day with a woman. Sergio, an overprotective father, will have to deal with his daughter's boyfriend who is thirty years older than her and Antonio will have to confront his daughter's boyfriend, a young rapper. Confident of acting for their own good, they will join forces to get rid of the three suitors as soon as possible, testing their wives' patience so much that their own marriages are wrecked. In the end, good will win, but whose good?
cast: Marco Giallini, Vincenzo Salemme, Giuseppe Battiston, Isabella Ferrari, Valentina Lodovini, Claudia Pandolfi, Matilde Gioli, Alice Ferri, Eleonora Trezza, Lorena Cesarini, Biondo, Alberto Lo Porto

title: È permesso maresciallo?
synopsis: Maria, owner of the village bar, is disputed by the police marshal and an enriched former emigrant. Will the charm of the uniform or the scent of money emerge? Inspired by the song "Tuppe tuppe marescià", Bragaglia turns a playful comedy that has the flavor of an era.
cast: Peppino De Filippo, Lorella De Luca, Roberto Risso, Giovanna Ralli

title: È più facile che un cammello...
synopsis: Commendator Bacchi, a rich industrialist, dies and is condemned to hell for having brought a poor usher to the brink of suicide that Bacchi does not even remember. By dint of begging he gets twelve hours of new life to try to make up for it. He thus returns to Earth, but the enterprise turns out to be more difficult than expected because, finally satisfied in his desires, the usher becomes more and more greedy ...
cast: Jean Gabin, Mariella Lotti, Elli Parvo, Antonella Lualdi, Paola Borboni

title: È primavera!
synopsis: The Florentine Beppe, in Catania for his military service, marries Maria Antonia. Transferred to Milan, he consoles himself in the loneliness in Lucia's arms and marries her too. But Maria Antonia, suspicious, joins him from Sicily. The crime of passion is touched upon, but Beppe manages to juggle the very delicate situation. Pleasant and sparkling portrait of the environment, in which the neorealism is already dissolved in the vernacular comedy. The Sicilian part is particularly successful, vital but not stereotyped.
cast: Mario Angelotti, Elena Varzi, Donato Donati, Irene Genna, Ettore Jannetti

title: È sbarcato un marinaio
synopsis: Gianni (Nazzari) is a sailor who, for the love of a girl, gives up boarding. Between the two, however, things do not go smoothly: he gets into trouble, she has to deal with a little good.
cast: Amedeo Nazzari, Doris Duranti, Germana Paolieri

title: È stata la mano di Dio
synopsis: The story of a boy in the tumultuous Naples of the Eighties. 17-year-old Fabietto Schisa is a clumsy boy who struggles to find his place in the world, but who finds joy in an extraordinary, life-loving family. Until some events change everything. One is the arrival in Naples of a sporting legend similar to a god: the football idol Maradona, who arouses in Fabietto, and in the entire city, a pride that once seemed impossible. The other is a dramatic accident that will make Fabietto hit rock bottom, showing him the way to his future. Apparently saved by Maradona, touched by chance or by the hand of God, Fabietto struggles with the nature of destiny, the confusion of loss and the intoxicating freedom of being alive.
cast: Filippo Scotti, Toni Servillo, Teresa Saponangelo, Marlon Joubert, Luisa Ranieri, Renato Carpentieri, Massimiliano Gallo, Betti Pedrazzi, Biagio Manna, Ciro Capano, Enzo Decaro, Lino Musella, Sofya Gershevich, Alfonso Perugini, Tommaso Servillo, Franco Pinelli, Roberto De Francesco

title: È stato il figlio
synopsis: The luxurious new car that the Ciraulo people from Palermo bought with the money from the state compensation for the death of Serenella, the little daughter killed by a stray bullet from the mafia, counts much more than its market value, is the symbol of a sought-after social redemption For years.
